	public class DataDependentEntity
	{
		public HashSet<ColumnBase> Columns { get; }

		public HashSet<SummaryItem> TotalSummary { get; }

		public HashSet<SummaryItem> GroupSummary { get; }

		public bool HasSorting { get; }

		public bool HasFilter { get; }

		public bool HasRowConditions { get; }

		public bool HasGrouping { get; }

		public bool HasCheckBox { get; }

		public bool HasExpandStateBinding { get; }

		public DataDependentEntity(HashSet<ColumnBase> columns, HashSet<SummaryItem> totalSummary, HashSet<SummaryItem> groupSummary, bool hasSorting, bool hasGrouping, bool hasFilter, bool hasRowConditions, bool hasCheckBox, bool hasExpandStateBinding)
		{
			if (columns == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("columns");
			}
			if (totalSummary == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("totalSummary");
			}
			if (groupSummary == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("groupSummary");
			}
			Columns = columns;
			TotalSummary = totalSummary;
			GroupSummary = groupSummary;
			HasSorting = hasSorting;
			HasGrouping = hasGrouping;
			HasFilter = hasFilter;
			HasRowConditions = hasRowConditions;
			HasCheckBox = hasCheckBox;
			HasExpandStateBinding = hasExpandStateBinding;
		}

		public DataDependentEntity(HashSet<ColumnBase> columns, HashSet<SummaryItem> totalSummary, HashSet<SummaryItem> groupSummary)
			: this(columns, totalSummary, groupSummary, hasSorting: false, hasGrouping: false, hasFilter: false, hasRowConditions: false, hasCheckBox: false, hasExpandStateBinding: false)
		{
		}

		public DataDependentEntity()
			: this(new HashSet<ColumnBase>(), new HashSet<SummaryItem>(), new HashSet<SummaryItem>(), hasSorting: false, hasGrouping: false, hasFilter: false, hasRowConditions: false, hasCheckBox: false, hasExpandStateBinding: false)
		{
		}

		internal static DataDependentEntity CreateFromColumns(HashSet<ColumnBase> columns)
		{
			return new DataDependentEntity().Update(columns);
		}

		internal static DataDependentEntity CreateFromTotalSummary(HashSet<SummaryItem> totalSummary)
		{
			return new DataDependentEntity().Update(null, totalSummary);
		}

		internal static DataDependentEntity CreateFromGroupSummary(HashSet<SummaryItem> groupSummary)
		{
			return new DataDependentEntity().Update(null, null, groupSummary);
		}

		internal static DataDependentEntity Combine(IEnumerable<DataDependentEntity> entities)
		{
			HashSet<ColumnBase> hashSet = new HashSet<ColumnBase>();
			HashSet<SummaryItem> hashSet2 = new HashSet<SummaryItem>();
			HashSet<SummaryItem> hashSet3 = new HashSet<SummaryItem>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool flag6 = false;
			foreach (DataDependentEntity entity in entities)
			{
				hashSet.UnionWith(entity.Columns);
				hashSet2.UnionWith(entity.TotalSummary);
				hashSet3.UnionWith(entity.GroupSummary);
				flag |= entity.HasSorting;
				flag2 |= entity.HasGrouping;
				flag3 |= entity.HasFilter;
				flag4 |= entity.HasRowConditions;
				flag5 |= entity.HasCheckBox;
				flag6 |= entity.HasExpandStateBinding;
			}
			return new DataDependentEntity(hashSet, hashSet2, hashSet3, flag, flag2, flag3, flag4, flag5, flag6);
		}

		internal DataDependentEntity Update(HashSet<ColumnBase> columns = null, HashSet<SummaryItem> totalSummary = null, HashSet<SummaryItem> groupSummary = null, bool? hasSorting = null, bool? hasGrouping = null, bool? hasFilter = null, bool? hasRowConditions = null, bool? hasCheckBox = null, bool? hasExpandStateBinding = null)
		{
			return new DataDependentEntity(columns ?? Columns, totalSummary ?? TotalSummary, groupSummary ?? GroupSummary, hasSorting ?? HasSorting, hasGrouping ?? HasGrouping, hasFilter ?? HasFilter, hasRowConditions ?? HasRowConditions, hasCheckBox ?? HasCheckBox, hasExpandStateBinding ?? HasExpandStateBinding);
		}
	}
	internal static class DataDependentEntityExtensions
	{
		public static DataDependentEntity AddColumn(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity, ColumnBase column)
		{
			dataDependentEntity.Columns.Add(column);
			return dataDependentEntity;
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddTotalSummary(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity, SummaryItem totalSummary)
		{
			dataDependentEntity.TotalSummary.Add(totalSummary);
			return dataDependentEntity;
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddGroupSummary(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity, SummaryItem groupSummary)
		{
			dataDependentEntity.GroupSummary.Add(groupSummary);
			return dataDependentEntity;
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddSorting(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity)
		{
			return dataDependentEntity.Update(null, null, null, true);
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddGrouping(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity)
		{
			return dataDependentEntity.Update(null, null, null, hasGrouping: true, hasSorting: true);
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddFilter(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity)
		{
			return dataDependentEntity.Update(null, null, null, null, null, true);
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddCheckBox(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity)
		{
			return dataDependentEntity.Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, null, true);
		}

		public static DataDependentEntity AddRowConditions(this DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity)
		{
			return dataDependentEntity.Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, true);
		}
	}

		private sealed class ErrorInfoContainer : ErrorInfo
		{
			private readonly MultiErrorInfo info;

			internal ErrorInfoContainer(MultiErrorInfo info)
			{
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				this.info = info ?? MultiErrorInfo.Create();
				((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorText = info.ErrorText;
				((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorType = info.ErrorType;
			}

			internal MultiErrorInfo FinalizeErrorInfo()
			{
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorText == info.ErrorText && ((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorType == info.ErrorType)
				{
					return info;
				}
				return MultiErrorInfo.Create(((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorText, ((ErrorInfo)this).ErrorType);
			}
		}

		internal static Type GetListItemPropertyType(IList list, ICollectionView collectionView)
		{
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = null;
			type = ((collectionView?.SourceCollection != null) ? collectionView.SourceCollection.GetType() : ListDataControllerHelper.GetListType((object)list));
			if (type.IsArray && list.Count == 0)
			{
				return type.GetElementType();
			}
			Type indexerPropertyType = ListDataControllerHelper.GetIndexerPropertyType(type);
			if (indexerPropertyType != null)
			{
				return indexerPropertyType;
			}
			indexerPropertyType = GenericTypeHelper.GetGenericIListTypeArgument(type);
			if (indexerPropertyType == typeof(object))
			{
				indexerPropertyType = null;
			}
			return indexerPropertyType;
		}

		internal void DoActionWithLockedItemFetch(Action action)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			InfiniteSourceBase infiniteSource = InfiniteSource;
			if (infiniteSource == null || (int)infiniteSource.FetchMode == 1)
			{
				action();
				return;
			}
			FetchMode fetchMode = infiniteSource.FetchMode;
			infiniteSource.FetchMode = (FetchMode)1;
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			finally
			{
				infiniteSource.FetchMode = fetchMode;
			}
		}

		public bool IsColumnReadonly(string fieldName, bool requireColumn)
		{
			if (!AllowEdit)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DataColumnInfo val = Columns[fieldName];
			if (val == null)
			{
				return requireColumn;
			}
			return val.ReadOnly;
		}

		internal PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties()
		{
			if (properties != null)
			{
				return properties;
			}
			List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
			for (int i = 0; i < ((CollectionBase)(object)Columns).Count; i++)
			{
				DataColumnInfo info = Columns[i];
				list.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new RowPropertyDescriptor(info));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < ((CollectionBase)(object)DetailColumns).Count; j++)
			{
				DataColumnInfo info2 = DetailColumns[j];
				list.Add((PropertyDescriptor)(object)new RowPropertyDescriptor(info2));
			}
			properties = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
			return properties;
		}

		private void InitializeValidationAttributes()
		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (validationAttributes != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			validationAttributes = new Dictionary<DataColumnInfo, PropertyValidator>();
			propertyValidatorsCount = 0;
			Type itemType = ItemType;
			foreach (DataColumnInfo item in (CollectionBase)(object)Columns)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val = item;
				PropertyValidator propertyValidator = DataColumnAttributesExtensions.CreatePropertyValidator(val.PropertyDescriptor, itemType);
				validationAttributes.Add(val, propertyValidator);
				if (propertyValidator != null)
				{
					propertyValidatorsCount++;
				}
			}
		}

		private static MultiErrorInfo Extract(ErrorInfo info)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (info is ErrorInfoContainer errorInfoContainer)
			{
				return errorInfoContainer.FinalizeErrorInfo();
			}
			if (info == null)
			{
				return MultiErrorInfo.Create();
			}
			return MultiErrorInfo.Create(info.ErrorText, info.ErrorType);
		}

		private MultiErrorInfo GetErrorInfoCore(int rowHandle, DataColumnInfo ci, RowValidationObjectAccessor accessor)
		{
			return GetValidationAttributeErrorInfo(rowHandle, ci).If((MultiErrorInfo x) => x.HasErrors()) ?? GetErrorInfoCore(accessor, CreatePropertyDataErrorValidator(ci));
		}

		private MultiErrorInfo GetValidationAttributeErrorInfo(int controllerRow, DataColumnInfo ci)
		{
			return MultiErrorInfo.Create((ci != null && ValidationOwner != null && ValidationOwner.CalculateValidationAttribute(ci.Name, controllerRow)) ? GetValidationAttributesErrorText(controllerRow, ci) : null, (ErrorType)1);
		}

		private MultiErrorInfo GetErrorInfoCore(RowValidationObjectAccessor accessor, DataErrorValidator dataErrorValidator)
		{
			if (accessor == null || dataErrorValidator == null)
			{
				return MultiErrorInfo.Create();
			}
			return dataErrorValidator.Validate(accessor, ValidatesOnNotifyDataErrors);
		}

		internal virtual RowValidationObjectAccessor CreateRowValidationObjectAccessor(int controllerRow)
		{
			if (!((DataController)DataController).IsControllerRowValid(controllerRow))
			{
				return null;
			}
			int listSourceRow = ((DataController)DataController).GetListSourceRowIndex(controllerRow);
			if (listSourceRow == int.MinValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseDataControllerHelper helper = ((DataControllerBase)DataController).Helper;
			return new RowValidationObjectAccessor(() => helper.GetRow(listSourceRow) as INotifyDataErrorInfo, () => helper.GetRowDXErrorInfo(listSourceRow), () => helper.GetRowErrorInfo(listSourceRow));
		}

		internal virtual RowValidationObjectAccessor CreateRowValidationObjectAccessor(object row)
		{
			return new RowValidationObjectAccessor(() => row as INotifyDataErrorInfo, delegate
			{
				object obj = row;
				return (IDXDataErrorInfo)((obj is IDXDataErrorInfo) ? obj : null);
			}, () => row as IDataErrorInfo);
		}

		public string GetValidationAttributesErrorText(object value, int controllerRow, string columnName)
		{
			DataColumnInfo ci = Columns[columnName];
			if (ColumnSupportsValidation(ci))
			{
				return GetValidationAttributesErrorTextCore(controllerRow, ci, value);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public string GetValidationAttributesErrorText(int controllerRow, DataColumnInfo columnInfo)
		{
			if (ColumnSupportsValidation(columnInfo))
			{
				return GetValidationAttributesErrorTextCore(controllerRow, columnInfo, GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(controllerRow, columnInfo.Name));
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected virtual object GetRowValueForValidationAttribute(int controllerRow, string columnName)
		{
			return ((DataController)DataController).GetRowValue(controllerRow, columnName);
		}

		private string GetValidationAttributesErrorTextCore(int controllerRow, DataColumnInfo ci, object value)
		{
			object rowValue = GetRowValue(controllerRow);
			if (rowValue == null || AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(rowValue))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object obj = value;
			try
			{
				obj = ci.ConvertValue(value, true);
			}
			catch
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return GetValidationAttributesErrorTextCore(obj, rowValue, ci);
		}

		public string GetValidationAttributesErrorTextCore(object value, object instance, DataColumnInfo ci)
		{
			if (!ColumnSupportsValidation(ci) || AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(instance))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = ci.PropertyDescriptor;
			ComplexPropertyDescriptor val = (ComplexPropertyDescriptor)(object)((propertyDescriptor is ComplexPropertyDescriptor) ? propertyDescriptor : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return validationAttributes[ci].GetErrorText(value, instance);
			}
			instance = val.GetOwnerOfLast(instance);
			if (instance != null)
			{
				return validationAttributes[ci].GetErrorText(value, instance);
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		private bool ColumnSupportsValidation(DataColumnInfo ci)
		{
			if (((ci != null) ? ci.PropertyDescriptor : null) == null || ci.Unbound)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (validationAttributes != null && !validationAttributes.ContainsKey(ci))
			{
				ResetValidationAttributes();
			}
			InitializeValidationAttributes();
			if (validationAttributes != null && validationAttributes.ContainsKey(ci))
			{
				return validationAttributes[ci] != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected UnboundColumnInfoCollection GetUnboundColumnsCore(IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> columns)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0079: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UnboundColumnInfoCollection val = new UnboundColumnInfoCollection();
			foreach (IColumnInfo column in columns)
			{
				if (!IColumnInfoExtensions.IsUnbound(column) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.FieldName))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (column is ConditionalFormattingColumnInfo)
				{
					val.Add((UnboundColumnInfo)new ConditionalFormattingUnboundColumnInfo(column.FieldName, column.UnboundType, column.UnboundExpression, column.UnboundDataType));
					continue;
				}
				UnboundColumnInfo val2 = new UnboundColumnInfo(column.FieldName, column.UnboundType, false, column.UnboundExpression, true);
				if (column.UnboundDataType != typeof(void))
				{
					val2.DataType = column.UnboundDataType;
					val2.RequireValueConversion = true;
				}
				val.Add(val2);
			}
			if (((CollectionBase)(object)val).Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val;
		}

	public class RowTypeDescriptor : RowTypeDescriptorBase
	{
		private RowHandle rowHandle;

		private int listSourceRowIndex;

		public RowHandle RowHandle => rowHandle;

		public RowTypeDescriptor(WeakReference ownerReference, RowHandle rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex)
			: base(ownerReference)
		{
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
			this.listSourceRowIndex = listSourceRowIndex;
		}

		protected internal override object GetValue(DataColumnInfo info)
		{
			return GetValueCore(info.Name);
		}

		internal override object GetValue(string fieldName)
		{
			return GetValueCore(fieldName);
		}

		protected internal override void SetValue(DataColumnInfo info, object value)
		{
			base.Owner.SetRowValue(RowHandle, info, value);
		}

		private object GetValueCore(string fieldName)
		{
			if (RowHandle.Value != int.MinValue)
			{
				return base.Owner.GetRowValue(RowHandle.Value, fieldName);
			}
			if (listSourceRowIndex == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Owner.GetCellValueByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex, fieldName);
		}
	}

		}

	public class FormatConditionRuleBase : IFormatConditionRuleBase
	{
		public virtual bool IsValid => true;

		internal Type ColumnType { get; set; }

		public static System.Drawing.Color GetColor(System.Windows.Media.Brush brush, bool isPositiveBrush = true)
		{
			if (brush is SolidColorBrush)
			{
				return GetColor(((SolidColorBrush)brush).Color);
			}
			if (brush is LinearGradientBrush linearGradientBrush && linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Count > 0)
			{
				if (isPositiveBrush)
				{
					return GetColor(linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.First().Color);
				}
				return GetColor(linearGradientBrush.GradientStops.Last().Color);
			}
			return System.Drawing.Color.Empty;
		}

		public static System.Drawing.Color GetColor(System.Windows.Media.Color color)
		{
			return System.Drawing.Color.FromArgb(color.A, color.R, color.G, color.B);
		}
	}

		private XlFill GetXlFill()
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				return val;
			}
			if (Format.FontSize > 1.0)
			{
				((XlFontBase)val).Size = Format.FontSize;
			}
			if (Format.FontFamily != null)
			{
				((XlFontBase)val).Name = Format.FontFamily.Source;
			}
			val.Color = XlColor.op_Implicit(FormatConditionRuleBase.GetColor(Format.Foreground));
			((XlFontBase)val).Bold = Format.FontWeight >= FontWeights.Bold;
			((XlFontBase)val).StrikeThrough = IsStrikeThrough();
			((XlFontBase)val).Italic = Format.FontStyle == FontStyles.Italic || Format.FontStyle == FontStyles.Oblique;
			((XlFontBase)val).Extend = Format.FontStretch >= FontStretches.Expanded;
			((XlFontBase)val).Condense = Format.FontStretch <= FontStretches.Condensed;
			if (IsUnderline())
			{
				((XlFontBase)val).Underline = (XlUnderlineType)1;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private bool IsStrikeThrough()
		{
			if (Format.TextDecorations != null)
			{
				return Format.TextDecorations.Contains(TextDecorations.Strikethrough[0]);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsUnderline()
		{
			if (Format.TextDecorations != null)
			{
				return Format.TextDecorations.Contains(TextDecorations.Underline[0]);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private static byte[] ImageToByteArray(DrawingImage drawingImage)
		{
			DrawingVisual drawingVisual = new DrawingVisual();
			using (DrawingContext drawingContext = drawingVisual.RenderOpen())
			{
				drawingContext.DrawDrawing(drawingImage.Drawing);
				drawingContext.Close();
			}
			RenderTargetBitmap renderTargetBitmap = new RenderTargetBitmap((int)drawingVisual.Drawing.Bounds.Right, (int)drawingVisual.Drawing.Bounds.Bottom, 96.0, 96.0, PixelFormats.Pbgra32);
			renderTargetBitmap.Render(drawingVisual);
			MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			BitmapEncoder bitmapEncoder = new PngBitmapEncoder();
			bitmapEncoder.Frames.Add(BitmapFrame.Create(renderTargetBitmap));
			bitmapEncoder.Save(memoryStream);
			return memoryStream.ToArray();
		}

		private static bool AreIconsEqual(ImageSource imageA, ImageSource imageB)
		{
			if (imageA == imageB)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DrawingImage drawingImage = imageA as DrawingImage;
			DrawingImage drawingImage2 = imageB as DrawingImage;
			if (drawingImage != null && drawingImage2 != null)
			{
				string iconName = IconSetExtension.GetIconName((DependencyObject)drawingImage);
				string iconName2 = IconSetExtension.GetIconName((DependencyObject)drawingImage2);
				bool flag = true;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(iconName2))
				{
					flag = iconName.Equals(iconName2, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return ImageToByteArray(drawingImage).SequenceEqual(ImageToByteArray(drawingImage2));
				}
				return false;
			}
			BitmapImage bitmapImage = imageA as BitmapImage;
			BitmapImage bitmapImage2 = imageB as BitmapImage;
			if (bitmapImage != null && bitmapImage2 != null)
			{
				return bitmapImage.UriSource == bitmapImage2.UriSource;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool AreIconsEqual(ImageSource imageA, Uri imageBUri)
		{
			if (imageA is BitmapImage bitmapImage && imageBUri != null)
			{
				return bitmapImage.UriSource == imageBUri;
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal abstract class RowExpandService : IAutoExpandService
	{
		private readonly DataViewBase view;

		private DateTime? rowTimestamp;

		private RowPointer currentRow;

		private Func<DateTime> timeProvider;

		public Func<DateTime> TimeProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return timeProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				timeProvider = value;
			}
		}

		public RowExpandService(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			this.view = view;
			timeProvider = () => DateTime.Now;
		}

		public void Update(DropInfo dropInfo)
		{
			if (!view.AutoExpandOnDrag)
			{
				currentRow = null;
				rowTimestamp = null;
				return;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = TimeProvider();
			if (!((object)dropInfo.RowPointer).Equals((object)currentRow))
			{
				currentRow = dropInfo.RowPointer;
				rowTimestamp = dateTime;
			}
			if (rowTimestamp.HasValue && currentRow != null && Subtract(dateTime, rowTimestamp.Value) >= (double)view.AutoExpandDelayOnDrag)
			{
				Expand(dropInfo.RowPointer);
				currentRow = null;
				rowTimestamp = null;
			}
		}

		private static double Subtract(DateTime time1, DateTime time2)
		{
			return time1.Subtract(time2).TotalMilliseconds;
		}

		protected abstract void Expand(RowPointer rowPointer);
	}

			{
				return GestFixedPanelOwner(view).FixedBottomRowsHeight;
			}

			public void Scroll(DataViewBase view, double offset)
			{
				view.ChangeVerticalScrollOffsetBy(offset);
			}

			private HierarchyPanel GestFixedPanelOwner(DataViewBase view)
			{
				return view.DataPresenter.Panel;
			}
		}

		private class HorizontalScrolling : IScrollStrategy
		{
			public double GetPosition(System.Windows.Point point)
			{
				return point.X;
			}

			public double GetSize(FrameworkElement element)
			{
				return element.ActualWidth;
			}

			public double GetFixedPreviousAreaSize(DataViewBase view)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}

			public double GetFixedNextAreaSize(DataViewBase view)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}

			public void Scroll(DataViewBase view, double offset)
			{
				view.ChangeHorizontalScrollOffsetBy(offset);
			}
		}

		private readonly DataViewBase view;

		private double speed = 1.0;

		private double scrollActivationAreaHeight = 10.0;

		private Orientation orientation = Orientation.Vertical;

		private IScrollStrategy scrollStrategy;

		private DataViewBase View => view;

		public double Speed
		{
			get
			{
				return speed;
			}
			set
			{
				speed = value;
			}
		}

		public double ScrollActivationAreaSize
		{
			get
			{
				return scrollActivationAreaHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				scrollActivationAreaHeight = value;
			}
		}

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return orientation;
			}
			set
			{
				if (orientation != value)
				{
					orientation = value;
					UpdateScrollStrategy();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScrollStrategy()
		{
			if (Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				scrollStrategy = new HorizontalScrolling();
			}
			else
			{
				scrollStrategy = new VerticalScrolling();
			}
		}

		public GridDragScrollService(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			this.view = view;
			UpdateScrollStrategy();
		}

		public void Update(IDragEventArgs e)
		{
			Update((Func<IInputElement, System.Windows.Point>)e.GetPosition);
		}

		public void Update(Func<IInputElement, System.Windows.Point> getPosition)
		{
			if (CanAutoScroll())
			{
				double position = GetPosition(getPosition);
				if (position < GetScrollPreviousThreshold())
				{
					ScrollPrevious();
				}
				if (position > GetScrollNextThreshold())
				{
					ScrollNext();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanAutoScroll()
		{
			return GetContentSize() > 2.0 * ScrollActivationAreaSize;
		}

		private double GetContentSize()
		{
			return scrollStrategy.GetSize(View.ScrollContentPresenter);
		}

		private double GetPosition(Func<IInputElement, System.Windows.Point> getPosition)
		{
			return scrollStrategy.GetPosition(getPosition(View.ScrollContentPresenter));
		}

		private double GetScrollPreviousThreshold()
		{
			return GetTotalScrollAreaSize(scrollStrategy.GetFixedPreviousAreaSize(View));
		}

		private double GetScrollNextThreshold()
		{
			return GetContentSize() - GetTotalScrollAreaSize(scrollStrategy.GetFixedNextAreaSize(View));
		}

		private double GetTotalScrollAreaSize(double fixedArea)
		{
			return ScrollActivationAreaSize + fixedArea;
		}

		private void ScrollPrevious()
		{
			scrollStrategy.Scroll(View, 0.0 - Speed);
		}

		private void ScrollNext()
		{
			scrollStrategy.Scroll(View, Speed);
		}
	}

	internal abstract class GridDragValidatorBase<T> : IDropTargetValidator where T : DataViewBase
	{
		private readonly T view;

		protected internal T View => view;

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => View.DataControl;

		public GridDragValidatorBase(T view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)view, "view");
			this.view = view;
		}

		public abstract MoveValidationState Validate(DropPointer dropPointer);

		protected MoveValidationState ValidateSortedDataDragDropRestrictions(bool isDragInsideGroup)
		{
			if (DataControl.ActualSortInfo.Count != 0 && !(DataControl.ActualSortInfo.Count == DataControl.ActualGroupCountCore && isDragInsideGroup))
			{
				if (View.AllowSortedDataDragDrop)
				{
					if (HasReadOnlyColumns())
					{
						return (MoveValidationState)1;
					}
					return (MoveValidationState)0;
				}
				return (MoveValidationState)2;
			}
			return (MoveValidationState)0;
		}

		private bool HasReadOnlyColumns()
		{
			return (from x in DataControl.ActualSortInfo
				select DataControl.ColumnsCore[x.FieldName] into y
				where y != null
				select y).Any((ColumnBase z) => z.ReadOnly);
		}
	}
	internal class GridInternalDragValidator<T> : GridDragValidatorBase<T> where T : DataViewBase
	{
		private readonly DragInfo activeDragInfo;

		private int sourceParentRowHandle;

		private bool allDraggingRowsAreInsideOneGroup;

		private bool draggingWholeGroup;

		protected DragInfo ActiveDragInfo => activeDragInfo;

		public GridInternalDragValidator(T view, DragInfo activeDragInfo)
			: base(view)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)activeDragInfo, "activeDragInfo");
			this.activeDragInfo = activeDragInfo;
			UpdateDragGroupInfo();
		}

		public override MoveValidationState Validate(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ((MoveValidationState)0).Validate(() => ValidateCriticalInternalDragRestrictions(dropPointer)).Validate(() => ValidateSortedDataDragDropRestrictions(dropPointer)).Validate(() => ValidateOverride(dropPointer));
		}

		private MoveValidationState ValidateCriticalInternalDragRestrictions(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			if ((base.View.AllowDropRecordToItself || !IsDragRowToItself(dropPointer)) && !IsDragGroupRowToItsChildren(dropPointer) && !IsDragRowToItsParentGroupRow(dropPointer))
			{
				return (MoveValidationState)0;
			}
			return (MoveValidationState)2;
		}

		private MoveValidationState ValidateSortedDataDragDropRestrictions(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return base.ValidateSortedDataDragDropRestrictions(IsDragInsideGroup(dropPointer));
		}

		private bool IsDragRowToItself(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_00bb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers == null || ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers.Length != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RowPointer val = ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers.Single();
			RowPointer rowPointer = dropPointer.RowPointer;
			if (val.Handle < 0 || rowPointer.Handle < 0 || !val.Path.SequenceEqual(rowPointer.Path))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.ActualGroupCountCore > 0 && GetParentRowHandle(val) != GetParentRowHandle(rowPointer))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndex = GetRowVisibleIndex(ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers[0]);
			if (rowVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndex2 = GetRowVisibleIndex(dropPointer.RowPointer);
			if (rowVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsDragRowToItselfCore(val.Handle, rowVisibleIndex, rowPointer.Handle, rowVisibleIndex2, dropPointer.Position);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDragRowToItselfCore(int draggingRowHandle, int draggingVisibleIndex, int droppingRowHandle, int droppingVisibleIndex, DropPosition dropPosition)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			int num = droppingVisibleIndex - draggingVisibleIndex;
			if (num != 0 && (num != 1 || (int)dropPosition != 1))
			{
				if (num == -1)
				{
					return (int)dropPosition == 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsDragGroupRowToItsChildren(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			if (draggingWholeGroup)
			{
				return IsDragInsideGroup(dropPointer);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsDragRowToItsParentGroupRow(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			if (allDraggingRowsAreInsideOneGroup)
			{
				return dropPointer.RowPointer.Handle == sourceParentRowHandle;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual MoveValidationState ValidateOverride(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			return (MoveValidationState)0;
		}

		private bool IsDragInsideGroup(DropPointer pointer)
		{
			if (allDraggingRowsAreInsideOneGroup)
			{
				return GetParentRowHandle(pointer.RowPointer) == sourceParentRowHandle;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateDragGroupInfo()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.ActualGroupCountCore == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowPointer[] rowPointers = ActiveDragInfo.RowPointers;
			if (rowPointers != null && rowPointers.Length != 0)
			{
				int firstParentRowHandle = GetParentRowHandle(rowPointers.First());
				if (rowPointers.All((RowPointer x) => GetParentRowHandle(x) == firstParentRowHandle))
				{
					sourceParentRowHandle = firstParentRowHandle;
					allDraggingRowsAreInsideOneGroup = true;
					draggingWholeGroup = GetChildRowCount(sourceParentRowHandle) == rowPointers.Length;
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetParentRowHandle(RowPointer pointer)
		{
			return base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetParentRowHandle(pointer.Handle);
		}

		private int GetChildRowCount(int rowHande)
		{
			return base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetChildRowCount(rowHande);
		}

		private int GetRowVisibleIndex(RowPointer pointer)
		{
			return base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(pointer.Handle);
		}
	}
	internal class GridExternalDragValidator<T> : GridDragValidatorBase<T> where T : DataViewBase
	{
		public GridExternalDragValidator(T view)
			: base(view)

		}

		public override MoveValidationState Validate(DropPointer dropPointer)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)dropPointer.Position == 0)
			{
				return (MoveValidationState)0;
			}
			return ValidateSortedDataDragDropRestrictions(isDragInsideGroup: false);
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public sealed class FilterSetInfo
	{
		private readonly Action updateCommandsStatus;

		internal readonly Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> Filters = new Dictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>();

		internal readonly HashSet<FilterModelBase> Models = new HashSet<FilterModelBase>();

		internal bool IsFilterCleared { get; private set; }

		internal FilterSetInfo(Action updateCommandsStatus)
		{
			this.updateCommandsStatus = updateCommandsStatus;
		}

		internal void ApplyFilter(string propertyName, CriteriaOperator value)
		{
			Filters[propertyName] = value;
			IsFilterCleared = false;
			updateCommandsStatus();
		}

		internal void RegisterModel(FilterModelBase model)
		{
			Models.Add(model);
			updateCommandsStatus();
		}

		internal void FilterUpdated()
		{
			IsFilterCleared = false;
			Reset();
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			Filters.Clear();
			updateCommandsStatus();
		}

		internal void ClearFilter()
		{
			foreach (FilterModelBase model in Models)
			{
				model.Update(null);
				ApplyFilter(model.PropertyName, null);
			}
			IsFilterCleared = true;
			updateCommandsStatus();
		}
	}

			AssignableServiceHelper2<DataViewBase, IDialogService>.DoServiceAction(owner, filterEditorDialogServiceTemplate, (Action<IDialogService>)delegate(IDialogService service)
			{
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				FilterEditorDialogViewModel viewModel = new FilterEditorDialogViewModel(context, propertyName, filterEditorTemplate, allowFieldOperand);
				List<UICommand> list = UICommand.GenerateFromMessageBoxButton(MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, (IMessageBoxButtonLocalizer)new DXDialogWindowMessageBoxButtonLocalizer());

					{

						IsDefault = false,

						{
							e.Cancel = true;
							viewModel.Apply();
						})
					};
					list.Add(item);
				}
				service.ShowDialog(list, title, viewModel);
			});
		}

	internal sealed class TreeNavigation<T> where T : class
	{
		private readonly NavigationNodeClient<T> client;

		private TreeNavigationState<T> stateCore;

		public T Root { get; }

		public TreeNavigationState<T> State
		{
			get
			{
				return stateCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (stateCore != value)
				{
					TreeNavigationState<T> oldValue = stateCore;
					stateCore = value;
					OnStateChanged(oldValue, stateCore);
				}
			}
		}

		public TreeNavigation(T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			if (client == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("client");
			}
			Root = root;
			this.client = client;
		}

		public bool IsNavigated(T node)
		{
			if (node != null)
			{
				TreeNavigationState<T> state = State;
				return ((state != null) ? state.Node : null) == node;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnStateChanged(TreeNavigationState<T> oldValue, TreeNavigationState<T> newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && !TreeNavigationState<T>.AreSame(oldValue, newValue))
			{
				client.SetIsFocused(oldValue, arg2: false);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				client.SetIsFocused(newValue, arg2: true);
			}
		}

		public void MoveNext()
		{
			if (State != null && Root != null)
			{
				State = MoveToNextIndexInsideNode(State, client.GetPaths) ?? MoveToFirstIndexOnNextNode(State, Root, client) ?? MoveToFirstIndexInsideNode(State.Node, client.GetPaths) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MovePrevious()
		{
			if (State != null && Root != null)
			{
				State = MoveToPreviousIndexInsideNode(State, client.GetPaths) ?? MoveToLastIndexOnPreviousNode(State, Root, client) ?? MoveToLastIndexInsideNode(State.Node, client.GetPaths) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MoveUp()
		{
			if (State != null && Root != null)
			{
				State = MoveToSameIndexOnPreviousNode(State, Root, client) ?? MoveToLastIndexOnPreviousNode(State, Root, client) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MoveDown()
		{
			if (State != null && Root != null)
			{
				State = MoveToSameIndexOnNextNode(State, Root, client) ?? MoveToLastIndexOnNextNode(State, Root, client) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MoveFirst()
		{
			if (Root != null)
			{
				State = MoveToFirstIndexOnFirstNode(Root, client);
			}
		}

		public void MoveToFirstIndex(T node)
		{
			if (Root != null && node != null)
			{
				State = MoveToFirstIndexInsideNode(node, client.GetPaths) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MoveToLastIndex(T node)
		{
			if (Root != null && node != null)
			{
				State = MoveToLastIndexInsideNode(node, client.GetPaths) ?? State;
			}
		}

		public void MoveToFirstIndex()
		{
			if (Root != null && State != null)
			{
				MoveToFirstIndex(State.Node);
			}
		}

		public void MoveToLastIndex()
		{
			if (Root != null && State != null)
			{
				MoveToLastIndex(State.Node);
			}
		}

		public void MoveToNearestBranch()
		{
			if (State != null && Root != null)
			{
				NavigationNodeClient<T> navigationNodeClient = new NavigationNodeClient<T>(client.GetPaths, delegate(T node)
				{
					TreeNavigationState<T> state = State;
					return (((state != null) ? state.Node : null) != node) ? client.GetChildren(node) : new T[0];
				}, client.SetIsFocused);
				TreeNavigationState<T> treeNavigationState = MoveToFirstIndexOnNextNode(State, Root, navigationNodeClient);
				if (((treeNavigationState != null) ? treeNavigationState.Node : null) == FindFirstNode(Root, navigationNodeClient))
				{
					treeNavigationState = MoveToFirstIndexOnPreviousNode(State, Root, navigationNodeClient);
				}
				if (treeNavigationState != null)
				{
					State = treeNavigationState;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Restore()
		{
			if (Root != null)
			{
				if (State == null)
				{
					MoveFirst();
				}
				else
				{
					OnStateChanged(null, State);
				}
			}
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToNextIndexInsideNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> getPaths)
		{
			return (from x in getPaths(state.Node)
				where x.IsToTheRight(state.Path)
				select x).LeftMost().With((NavigationPath index) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(state.Node, index));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToPreviousIndexInsideNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> getPaths)
		{
			return (from x in getPaths(state.Node)
				where x.IsToTheLeft(state.Path)
				select x).RightMost().With((NavigationPath index) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(state.Node, index));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToFirstIndexInsideNode(T node, Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> getPaths)
		{
			return getPaths(node).LeftMost().With((NavigationPath index) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, index));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToLastIndexInsideNode(T node, Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> getPaths)
		{
			return getPaths(node).RightMost().With((NavigationPath index) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, index));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToFirstIndexOnNextNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindNextNode(state, root, client).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, client.GetPaths(node).LeftMost()));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToSameIndexOnNextNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindNextNode(state, root, client).If((T node) => HasPath(node, state.Path, client)).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, state.Path));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToSameIndexOnPreviousNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindPreviousNode(state, root, client).If((T node) => HasPath(node, state.Path, client)).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, state.Path));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToLastIndexOnNextNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindNextNode(state, root, client).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, client.GetPaths(node).RightMost()));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToLastIndexOnPreviousNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindPreviousNode(state, root, client).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, client.GetPaths(node).RightMost()));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToFirstIndexOnPreviousNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindPreviousNode(state, root, client).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, client.GetPaths(node).LeftMost()));
		}

		private static TreeNavigationState<T> MoveToFirstIndexOnFirstNode(T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindFirstNode(root, client).With((T node) => new TreeNavigationState<T>(node, client.GetPaths(node).LeftMost()));
		}

		private static T FindFirstNode(T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindFirstNodeWithValidIndices(GetLinearNodeSequence(root, root, (IEnumerable<T> path) => path.FlattenFromWithinForward(client.GetChildren), client), client);
		}

		private static T FindPreviousNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindRelativeNode(state, root, (IEnumerable<T> path) => path.FlattenFromWithinBackward(client.GetChildren), client);
		}

		private static T FindNextNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindRelativeNode(state, root, (IEnumerable<T> path) => path.FlattenFromWithinForward(client.GetChildren), client);
		}

		private static T FindRelativeNode(TreeNavigationState<T> state, T root, Func<IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable<T>> flatten, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return FindFirstNodeWithValidIndices(GetLinearNodeSequence(state.Node, root, flatten, client).Skip(1), client);
		}

		private static IEnumerable<T> GetLinearNodeSequence(T node, T root, Func<IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable<T>> flatten, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return flatten(FindNodePath(node, root, client.GetChildren));
		}

		private static T FindFirstNodeWithValidIndices(IEnumerable<T> nodes, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return nodes.FirstOrDefault((T x) => client.GetPaths(x).Any());
		}

		private static T[] FindNodePath(T target, T root, Func<T, T[]> getChildren)
		{
			return FindNodePath(target, root, new T[0], getChildren);
		}

		private static T[] FindNodePath(T target, T currentNode, T[] currentNodePath, Func<T, T[]> getChildren)
		{
			T[] array;
			if (currentNode != target)
			{
				array = (from node in getChildren(currentNode)
					select FindNodePath(target, node, Concat(currentNode, currentNodePath), getChildren)).FirstOrDefault((T[] nodePath) => nodePath.Any());
				if (array == null)
				{
					return new T[0];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				array = Concat(currentNode, currentNodePath);
			}
			return array;
		}

		private static T[] Concat(T node, T[] nodes)
		{
			return node.Yield().Concat(nodes).ToArray();
		}

		private static bool IsCurrentIndexValid(TreeNavigationState<T> state, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return HasPath(state.Node, state.Path, client);
		}

		private static bool HasPath(T node, NavigationPath path, NavigationNodeClient<T> client)
		{
			return client.GetPaths(node).Any((NavigationPath p) => NavigationPathExtensions.AreSame(p, path));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class TreeNavigationState<T> where T : class
	{
		public T Node { get; }

		public NavigationPath Path { get; }

		public TreeNavigationState(T node, NavigationPath path)
		{
			Node = node;
			Path = path;
		}

		internal static bool AreSame(TreeNavigationState<T> oldValue, TreeNavigationState<T> newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue == null && newValue == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((oldValue == null) ^ (newValue == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (oldValue.Node == newValue.Node)
			{
				return NavigationPathExtensions.AreSame(oldValue.Path, newValue.Path);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class NavigationNodeClient<T> where T : class
	{
		public Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> GetPaths { get; }

		public Func<T, T[]> GetChildren { get; }

		public Action<TreeNavigationState<T>, bool> SetIsFocused { get; }

		public NavigationNodeClient(Func<T, IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath>> getPaths, Func<T, T[]> getChildren, Action<TreeNavigationState<T>, bool> setIsFocused)
		{
			if (getPaths == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("getPaths");
			}
			if (getChildren == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("getChildren");
			}
			if (setIsFocused == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("setIsFocused");
			}
			GetPaths = getPaths;
			GetChildren = getChildren;
			SetIsFocused = setIsFocused;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class NavigationPath
	{
		public IReadOnlyCollection<int> Value { get; }

		public NavigationPath(IReadOnlyCollection<int> value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}

		public NavigationPath()
			: this((IReadOnlyCollection<int>)(object)new int[0])
		{
		}
	}
	internal static class NavigationPathExtensions
	{
		public static bool IsToTheRight(this NavigationPath first, NavigationPath second)
		{
			return Compare(first.Value, second.Value) > 0;
		}

		public static bool IsToTheLeft(this NavigationPath first, NavigationPath second)
		{
			return Compare(first.Value, second.Value) < 0;
		}

		public static NavigationPath LeftMost(this IEnumerable<NavigationPath> paths)
		{
			return FindBoundedPath(paths, IsToTheLeft);
		}

		public static NavigationPath RightMost(this IEnumerable<NavigationPath> paths)
		{
			return FindBoundedPath(paths, IsToTheRight);
		}

		private static NavigationPath FindBoundedPath(IEnumerable<NavigationPath> paths, Func<NavigationPath, NavigationPath, bool> predicate)
		{
			return paths.Aggregate(null, (NavigationPath acc, NavigationPath current) => (acc != null && !predicate(current, acc)) ? acc : current);
		}

		private static int Compare(IReadOnlyCollection<int> first, IReadOnlyCollection<int> second)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(first.Count, second.Count); i++)
			{
				int num = Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(first.ElementAt(i), second.ElementAt(i));
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(first.Count, second.Count);
		}

		public static bool AreSame(NavigationPath first, NavigationPath second)
		{
			if (first == null && second == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if ((first == null) ^ (second == null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return first.Value.SequenceEqual(second.Value);
		}
	}
	internal interface INavigationService
	{
		void SetIsFocused(NavigationPath path, bool isFocused);

		IReadOnlyCollection<NavigationPath> GetPaths();
	}

			Down = down;
		}

	internal sealed class NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> where TNode : class
	{
		public TNode Node { get; }

		public double VerticalOffset { get; }

		public NodeOffsetRecord(TNode node, double verticalOffset)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)node, "node");
			Node = node;
			VerticalOffset = verticalOffset;
		}
	}
	internal static class FilterEditorNavigationPager<TNode> where TNode : class
	{
		private enum NavigationDirection
		{
			Up,
			Down
		}

		public static NavigationPager<TNode> Pager(TNode focusedNode, Func<IList<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>>> getRecords, double viewportHeight)
		{
			return new NavigationPager<TNode>(() => GetTarget(focusedNode, getRecords, viewportHeight, NavigationDirection.Up), () => GetTarget(focusedNode, getRecords, viewportHeight, NavigationDirection.Down));
		}

		private static TNode GetTarget(TNode focusedNode, Func<IList<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>>> getRecords, double viewportHeight, NavigationDirection direction)
		{
			if (focusedNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>> list = getRecords();
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (direction)
			{
			case NavigationDirection.Down:
			{
				TNode val2 = MaxByOffset(list.Where((NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record) => IsOnCurrentPage(record, viewportHeight)));
				if (val2 != focusedNode)
				{
					return val2;
				}
				return MaxByOffset(list.Where((NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record) => IsOnNextPage(record, viewportHeight)));
			}
			case NavigationDirection.Up:
			{
				TNode val = MinByOffset(list.Where((NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record) => IsOnCurrentPage(record, viewportHeight)));
				if (val != focusedNode)
				{
					return val;
				}
				return MinByOffset(list.Where((NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record) => IsOnPreviousPage(record, viewportHeight)));
			}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsOnCurrentPage(NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record, double viewportHeight)
		{
			if (record.VerticalOffset >= 0.0)
			{
				return record.VerticalOffset <= viewportHeight;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsOnNextPage(NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record, double viewportHeight)
		{
			if (record.VerticalOffset > viewportHeight)
			{
				return record.VerticalOffset <= viewportHeight * 2.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsOnPreviousPage(NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> record, double viewportHeight)
		{
			if (record.VerticalOffset < 0.0)
			{
				return record.VerticalOffset >= 0.0 - viewportHeight;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static TNode MaxByOffset(IEnumerable<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>> records)
		{
			return ByOffsetCore(records, (NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> x, NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> y) => x.VerticalOffset > y.VerticalOffset);
		}

		private static TNode MinByOffset(IEnumerable<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>> records)
		{
			return ByOffsetCore(records, (NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> x, NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> y) => x.VerticalOffset < y.VerticalOffset);
		}

		private static TNode ByOffsetCore(IEnumerable<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>> records, Func<NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>, NodeOffsetRecord<TNode>, bool> predicate)
		{
			NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> nodeOffsetRecord = records.Aggregate(null, (NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> acc, NodeOffsetRecord<TNode> current) => (acc != null && !predicate(current, acc)) ? acc : current);
			if (nodeOffsetRecord == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return nodeOffsetRecord.Node;
		}
	}

	public class QueryGroupTypesEventArgs
	{
		private readonly Lazy<CriteriaOperator> lazyFilter;

		public CriteriaOperator Filter => lazyFilter.Value;

		public bool AllowAnd { get; set; }

		public bool AllowNotAnd { get; set; }

		public bool AllowOr { get; set; }

		public bool AllowNotOr { get; set; }

		internal QueryGroupTypesEventArgs(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter, AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters)
		{
			lazyFilter = filter;
			if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.And))
			{
				AllowAnd = true;
			}
			if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotAnd))
			{
				AllowNotAnd = true;
			}
			if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.Or))
			{
				AllowOr = true;
			}
			if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotOr))
			{
				AllowNotOr = true;
			}
		}

		internal AllowedGroupFilters GetActualAllowedGroupFilters()
		{
			AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters = AllowedGroupFilters.None;
			if (AllowAnd)
			{
				allowedGroupFilters |= AllowedGroupFilters.And;
			}
			if (AllowNotAnd)
			{
				allowedGroupFilters |= AllowedGroupFilters.NotAnd;
			}
			if (AllowOr)
			{
				allowedGroupFilters |= AllowedGroupFilters.Or;
			}
			if (AllowNotOr)
			{
				allowedGroupFilters |= AllowedGroupFilters.NotOr;
			}
			return allowedGroupFilters;
		}
	}

	public sealed class CustomExpressionNodeModel : NodeModelBase

		private sealed class FilteringColumnDataInfoAdapter : IDataColumnInfo
		{
			private readonly string caption;

			private readonly string fieldName;

			private readonly Type type;

			private readonly List<IDataColumnInfo> columns;

			private readonly string unboundExpression;

			List<IDataColumnInfo> IDataColumnInfo.Columns => columns;

			string IDataColumnInfo.UnboundExpression => unboundExpression;

			string IDataColumnInfo.Caption => caption;

			string IDataColumnInfo.FieldName => fieldName;

			string IDataColumnInfo.Name => string.Empty;

			Type IDataColumnInfo.FieldType => type;

			DataControllerBase IDataColumnInfo.Controller => null;

			internal FilteringColumnDataInfoAdapter(string caption, string fieldName, Type type, List<IDataColumnInfo> columns, string unboundExpression)
			{
				this.caption = caption;
				this.fieldName = fieldName;
				this.type = type;
				this.columns = columns;
				this.unboundExpression = unboundExpression;
			}
		}

		private readonly CustomExpressionNodeClient nodeClient;

		private DelegateCommand removeCommandCore;

		public string FilterText => GetFilterText();

		public CriteriaOperator Filter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<CriteriaOperator>("Filter");
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue<CriteriaOperator>(value, OnFilterChanged, "Filter");
			}
		}

		public ICommand ShowExpressionEditorCommand { get; }

		public override ICommand RemoveCommand
		{
			get
			{
				if (removeCommandCore == null)
				{
					removeCommandCore = new DelegateCommand(delegate
					{
						nodeClient.RemoveNode(this);
					}, () => nodeClient.CanExecuteRemoveAction(new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => this.BuildEvaluableFilter())), false);
				}
				return removeCommandCore;
			}
		}

		internal static CustomExpressionNodeModel Create(CustomExpressionNodeClient client, CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return new CustomExpressionNodeModel(client, filter);
		}

		private CustomExpressionNodeModel(CustomExpressionNodeClient nodeClient, CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)nodeClient, "nodeClient");
			this.nodeClient = nodeClient;
			Filter = filter;
			ShowExpressionEditorCommand = new DelegateCommand(ShowExpressionEditor);
		}

		private void OnFilterChanged()
		{
			removeCommandCore?.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			RaisePropertyChanged("FilterText");
		}

		private void ShowExpressionEditor()
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IDialogService service = GetService<IDialogService>();
			if (service != null)
			{
				ExpressionEditorModel expressionEditorModel = new ExpressionEditorModel(CreateColumn(FilterText));
				List<UICommand> list = UICommand.GenerateFromMessageBoxButton(MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, (IMessageBoxButtonLocalizer)new DXDialogWindowMessageBoxButtonLocalizer());
				if (service.ShowDialog(list, GetString((EditorStringId)276), expressionEditorModel) == list[0])
				{
					Filter = CriteriaOperator.Parse(expressionEditorModel.Expression, new object[0]);
					nodeClient.FilterChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IDataColumnInfo> GetColumns()
		{
			return (IEnumerable<IDataColumnInfo>)(from x in nodeClient.GetColumns()
				select new FilteringColumnDataInfoAdapter(x.GetHeaderAppearance()?.Content?.ToString() ?? string.Empty, x.Name, nodeClient.GetColumnType(x.Name), null, null));
		}

		private string GetFilterText()
		{
			return UnboundExpressionConvertHelper.ConvertToCaption(CreateColumn(null), ((object)Filter)?.ToString() ?? string.Empty);
		}

		private IDataColumnInfo CreateColumn(string expression)
		{
			List<IDataColumnInfo> list = GetColumns().ToList();
			return (IDataColumnInfo)(object)list.FirstOrDefault().Return((IDataColumnInfo x) => new FilteringColumnDataInfoAdapter(x.Caption, x.Name, x.FieldType, list, expression), () => (FilteringColumnDataInfoAdapter)null);
		}

		private static string GetString(EditorStringId id)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return EditorLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}
	}

	internal class FilterEditorNodeModelFactory
	{
		private FilterEditorNodeModelFactoryOptions Options { get; }

		private NodeTreeListener Listener { get; }

		private FilteringUIContext Context => Options.Context;

		public FilterEditorNodeModelFactory(FilterEditorNodeModelFactoryOptions options, NodeTreeListener listener)
		{
			Options = options;
			Listener = listener;
		}

		public NodeModelFactory Factory(Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor)
		{
			Action onNodesChanged = CreateNodesChangedCallback(rootAccessor);
			NodeClient nodeClient = CreateNodeClient(rootAccessor, onNodesChanged, Listener.OnTreeChanged);
			CustomExpressionNodeClient customNodeClient = CreateCustomNodeClient(rootAccessor, Listener.OnTreeChanged);
			return CreateFactory(onNodesChanged, nodeClient, customNodeClient);
		}

		private Action CreateNodesChangedCallback(Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor)
		{
			return delegate
			{
				GroupNodeModel groupNodeModel = rootAccessor();
				if (groupNodeModel != null)
				{
					IEnumerable<GroupNodeModel> enumerable = ((NodeModelBase)groupNodeModel).Yield().Flatten((NodeModelBase x) => x.GetChildren()).OfType<GroupNodeModel>();
					foreach (GroupNodeModel item in enumerable)
					{
						item.Update();
					}
					Listener.OnTreeChanged();
				}
			};
		}

		private NodeClient CreateNodeClient(Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor, Action onNodesChanged, Action onContentChanged)
		{
			return new NodeClient((string propertyName, Func<NodeModelBase> nodeAccessor) => CreateFilterModelClient(propertyName, nodeAccessor, onNodesChanged, rootAccessor), (string propertyName) => GetColumn(propertyName).Type, (CriteriaOperator filter) => Options.GetPropertyColumnsInfo(filter, GetColumns((string _, Type __) => true)), Options.GetOperandTypesInfo, (CriteriaOperator filter, string propertyName, Type propertyType, FilterEditorCriteriaOperatorType operatorType) => Options.GetValueColumnsInfo(filter, propertyName, propertyType, operatorType, GetColumns((string name, Type type) => propertyName != name && FilteringUIHelper.IsCompatibleTypes(propertyType, type))), Options.GetParametersInfo, Options.GetDateTimeFunctionsInfo, Options.ShowCounts, new OperandListObserver<NodeModelBase>(Listener.OnOperandAdding, Listener.OnOperandRemoving), delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				RemoveNode(node, rootAccessor);
			}, (OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<FilterEditorOperatorItem> items, CriteriaOperator filter, string propertyName) => Options.SubstituteOperatorMenuItems(items, filter, propertyName), Options.SelectTemplate, Options.CanRemove, onContentChanged);
		}

		private CustomExpressionNodeClient CreateCustomNodeClient(Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor, Action filterChanged)
		{
			return new CustomExpressionNodeClient(() => Context.GetColumnForest().FlattenLeaves(), (string propertyName) => GetColumn(propertyName).Type, delegate(NodeModelBase node)
			{
				RemoveNode(node, rootAccessor);
			}, (Lazy<CriteriaOperator> x) => Options.CanRemove(x, null), filterChanged);
		}

		private FieldItem[] GetColumns(Func<string, Type, bool> columnPredicate)
		{
			IEnumerable<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>> forest = ((Options.PropertySelectorMode == PropertySelectorMode.List) ? Context.GetColumnForest().FlattenLeavesContainers() : Context.GetColumnForest());
			return forest.HierarchicalWhere((VisualFilteringColumn column) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.Name) && columnPredicate(column.Name, column.Type), (HeaderAppearanceAccessor _, IEnumerable<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>> children) => children.Any()).Transform(delegate(VisualFilteringColumn column)
			{
				HeaderAppearance headerAppearance = column.GetHeaderAppearance();
				return FieldItem.CreateLeaf(headerAppearance?.Content, headerAppearance?.Selector, column.Name);
			}, delegate(HeaderAppearanceAccessor getHeaderAppearance, IEnumerable<FieldItem> children)
			{
				HeaderAppearance headerAppearance = getHeaderAppearance();
				return FieldItem.CreateGroup(headerAppearance?.Content, headerAppearance?.Selector, children.ToArray());
			}).ToArray();
		}

		private FilterModelClient CreateFilterModelClient(string propertyName, Func<NodeModelBase> nodeAccessor, Action onNodesChanged, Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor)
		{
			return new FilterModelClient(propertyName, GetColumn, (CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode) => Context.GetUniqueValues(propertyName, FilterEditorUniqueValuesHelper.BuildUniqueValuesFilter(rootAccessor(), nodeAccessor()), countsIncludeMode == CountsIncludeMode.Include, FilterValuesThrottleMode.Forbid), delegate
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}, null, delegate
			{
				onNodesChanged();
			}, Context.SubstituteWholeFilter, null, () => Context.GetFormatConditionFilters(propertyName));
		}

		private FilteringColumn GetColumn(string propertyName)
		{
			FilteringColumn column = Context.GetColumn(propertyName);
			if (column != null)
			{
				return column;
			}
			return new FilteringColumn(propertyName ?? string.Empty, typeof(string), -1, ColumnFilterMode.Value, allowHierarchicalFilterTree: false, () => (BaseEditSettings)null, () => false, (object _) => (string)null, FilterRestrictions.All, () => (string)null, (CriteriaOperator _, bool __, CountsIncludeMode ___, FilterValuesThrottleMode ____) => UniqueValues.EmptyAsync, () => false, (SummaryFilterInfo[] _) => (object[])null, () => (PredefinedFilterCollection)null);
		}

		private void RemoveNode(NodeModelBase node, Func<GroupNodeModel> rootAccessor)
		{
			GroupNodeModel groupNodeModel = rootAccessor();
			if (node != null && node != groupNodeModel)
			{
				Listener.OnRemovingNode(node);
				node.GetParent(groupNodeModel)?.RemoveChild(node);
			}
		}

		private NodeModelFactory CreateFactory(Action onNodesChanged, NodeClient nodeClient, CustomExpressionNodeClient customNodeClient)
		{
			return LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue(delegate(Lazy<NodeModelFactory> factoryAccessor)
			{
				GroupNodeModelClient groupClient = CreateGroupNodeClient(onNodesChanged, nodeClient, factoryAccessor);
				return new NodeModelFactory((CriteriaOperator filter) => LeafNodeModel.Create(nodeClient, filter), (CriteriaOperator filter, IList<NodeModelBase> operandModels, bool isRoot, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom) => (!isRoot) ? GroupNodeModel.CreateSubGroup(groupClient, filter, operandModels, addNewCriteriaToBottom) : GroupNodeModel.CreateRoot(groupClient, filter, operandModels, addNewCriteriaToBottom), (CriteriaOperator filter) => CustomExpressionNodeModel.Create(customNodeClient, filter));
			});
		}

		private GroupNodeModelClient CreateGroupNodeClient(Action onNodesChanged, NodeClient nodeClient, Lazy<NodeModelFactory> factoryAccessor)
		{
			return new GroupNodeModelClient(factoryAccessor, onNodesChanged, Listener.OnNodeAdded, Options.GetAllowedGroupFilters, nodeClient.RemoveNode, (Lazy<CriteriaOperator> x) => Options.CanRemove(x, null), Options.GetChildMenuOptions);
		}
	}

		{

			DefaultItem = defaultItem;
		}
	}

	internal static class FilterEditorUniqueValuesHelper
	{
		private static OperandValue TrueCriteria = new OperandValue((object)true);

		private static OperandValue FalseCriteria = new OperandValue((object)false);

		internal static CriteriaOperator BuildUniqueValuesFilter(NodeModelBase root, NodeModelBase target)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (root == null || target == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = SimplifyOperator((CriteriaOperator)new GroupOperator((GroupOperatorType)1, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[2]
			{
				BuildTreeFilterWithSubstitutedNode(root, target, (CriteriaOperator)(object)TrueCriteria),
				BuildTreeFilterWithSubstitutedNode(root, target, (CriteriaOperator)(object)FalseCriteria)
			}));
			if (object.Equals(val, TrueCriteria))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static GroupOperator CloneAndRemove(GroupOperator groupOperator, OperandValue value)
		{
			GroupOperator val = groupOperator.Clone();
			((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val.Operands).Remove((CriteriaOperator)(object)value);
			return val;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator BuildTreeFilterWithSubstitutedNode(NodeModelBase root, NodeModelBase substitutedNode, CriteriaOperator substitutedNodeFilter)
		{
			return root.BuildEvaluableFilter((IList<NodeModelBase> nodes) => nodes.Select((NodeModelBase x) => (x != substitutedNode) ? BuildTreeFilterWithSubstitutedNode(x, substitutedNode, substitutedNodeFilter) : substitutedNodeFilter));
		}

	public sealed class GroupNodeModel : NodeModelBase
	{
		private readonly DelegateCommand addCommandCore;

		private readonly ObservableCollectionCore<MenuItemBase> addChildMenuCore = new ObservableCollectionCore<MenuItemBase>();

		private readonly ObservableCollectionCore<MenuItemBase> operatorTypeMenuCore = new ObservableCollectionCore<MenuItemBase>();

		private readonly ObservableCollection<NodeModelBase> childrenCore;

		private readonly GroupNodeModelClient client;

		private readonly bool isRoot;

		private readonly bool addNewCriteriaToBottom;

		private GroupOperatorInfo groupOperatorCore;

		private DelegateCommand removeCommandCore;

		public GroupOperatorInfo GroupOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return groupOperatorCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (groupOperatorCore != value)
				{
					groupOperatorCore = value;
					client.NodesChangedCallback();
					RaisePropertyChanged("GroupOperator");
					removeCommandCore?.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public IList<MenuItemBase> OperatorTypeMenu { get; }

		public IList<MenuItemBase> AddChildMenu { get; }

		public IList<NodeModelBase> Children { get; }

		public ICommand AddCommand => addCommandCore;

		public override ICommand RemoveCommand
		{
			get
			{
				if (removeCommandCore == null)
				{
					Lazy<CriteriaOperator> lazyFilter = new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => this.BuildEvaluableFilter());
					removeCommandCore = (isRoot ? new DelegateCommand(ClearChildren, () => Children.Any() && client.CanExecuteRemoveAction(lazyFilter), false) : new DelegateCommand(delegate
					{
						client.RemoveNode(this);
					}, () => client.CanExecuteRemoveAction(lazyFilter), false));
				}
				return removeCommandCore;
			}
		}

		internal static GroupNodeModel CreateRoot(GroupNodeModelClient client, CriteriaOperator filter, IList<NodeModelBase> children, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			return new GroupNodeModel(client, filter, children, isRoot: true, addNewCriteriaToBottom);
		}

		internal static GroupNodeModel CreateSubGroup(GroupNodeModelClient client, CriteriaOperator filter, IList<NodeModelBase> children, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			return new GroupNodeModel(client, filter, children, isRoot: false, addNewCriteriaToBottom);
		}

		private GroupNodeModel(GroupNodeModelClient client, CriteriaOperator filter, IList<NodeModelBase> children, bool isRoot, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			this.client = client;
			this.isRoot = isRoot;
			this.addNewCriteriaToBottom = addNewCriteriaToBottom;
			childrenCore = new ObservableCollection<NodeModelBase>(children);
			childrenCore.CollectionChanged += delegate
			{
				OnChildrenCollectionChanged();
			};
			Children = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<NodeModelBase>(childrenCore);
			Lazy<CriteriaOperator> arg = new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => filter);
			GroupNodeModelChildMenuOptions options = client.GetChildMenuOptions(arg);
			AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters = client.AllowedGroupFilters(arg);
			UpdateAddChildMenu(options, allowedGroupFilters);
			AddChildMenu = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<MenuItemBase>((ObservableCollection<MenuItemBase>)(object)addChildMenuCore);
			UpdateOperatorTypeMenu(allowedGroupFilters);
			OperatorTypeMenu = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<MenuItemBase>((ObservableCollection<MenuItemBase>)(object)operatorTypeMenuCore);
			groupOperatorCore = CreateGroupOperatorInfo(filter, allowedGroupFilters);
			addCommandCore = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				((IEnumerable)addChildMenuCore).OfType<MenuItem>().FirstOrDefault()?.Command.Execute(null);
			}, () => ((IEnumerable)addChildMenuCore).OfType<MenuItem>().Any());
		}

		private void UpdateOperatorTypeMenu(AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters)
		{
			MenuItem[] array = (from x in new[]
				{
					new
					{
						Flag = AllowedGroupFilters.And,
						StringId = (EditorStringId)286,
						ImageName = "And",
						Factory = (Func<GroupOperatorInfo>)CreateAnd
					},
					new
					{
						Flag = AllowedGroupFilters.Or,
						StringId = (EditorStringId)287,
						ImageName = "Or",
						Factory = (Func<GroupOperatorInfo>)CreateOr
					},
					new
					{
						Flag = AllowedGroupFilters.NotAnd,
						StringId = (EditorStringId)290,
						ImageName = "NotAnd",
						Factory = (Func<GroupOperatorInfo>)CreateNotAnd
					},
					new
					{
						Flag = AllowedGroupFilters.NotOr,
						StringId = (EditorStringId)291,
						ImageName = "NotOr",
						Factory = (Func<GroupOperatorInfo>)CreateNotOr
					}
				}
				where allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(x.Flag)
				select new MenuItem(GetString(x.StringId), GetImage(x.ImageName), delegate
				{
					GroupOperator = x.Factory();
				})).ToArray();
			operatorTypeMenuCore.Assign((IList<MenuItemBase>)array);
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			Lazy<CriteriaOperator> arg = new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => this.BuildMinimizedFilter());
			GroupNodeModelChildMenuOptions options = client.GetChildMenuOptions(arg);
			AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters = client.AllowedGroupFilters(arg);
			UpdateAddChildMenu(options, allowedGroupFilters);
			UpdateOperatorTypeMenu(allowedGroupFilters);
		}

		private void UpdateAddChildMenu(GroupNodeModelChildMenuOptions options, AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters)
		{
			List<MenuItemBase> list = new List<MenuItemBase>();
			bool flag = !Children.Any() || allowedGroupFilters != AllowedGroupFilters.None;
			if (options.AllowAddCondition && flag)
			{
				list.Add(new MenuItem(GetString((EditorStringId)292), GetImage("AddCondition"), delegate
				{
					AddChild(CreateDefaultLeaf());
				}));
			}
			if (options.AllowAddGroup && allowedGroupFilters != AllowedGroupFilters.None)
			{
				list.Add(new MenuItem(GetString((EditorStringId)293), GetImage("AddGroup"), delegate
				{
					LeafNodeModel[] arg = CreateDefaultLeaf().Return((LeafNodeModel x) => x.YieldToArray(), () => new LeafNodeModel[0]);
					AddChild(client.NodeModelFactory.CreateGroup(null, arg, arg3: false, addNewCriteriaToBottom));
				}));
			}
			if (options.AllowAddCustomExpression && flag)
			{
				list.Add(new MenuItem(GetString((EditorStringId)294), GetImage("AddCondition"), delegate
				{
					AddChild(CreateDefaultCustomExpression());
				}));
			}
			addChildMenuCore.Assign((IList<MenuItemBase>)list);
		}

		private void AddChild(NodeModelBase newNode)
		{
			if (newNode != null)
			{
				if (addNewCriteriaToBottom)
				{
					childrenCore.Add(newNode);
				}
				else
				{
					childrenCore.Insert(0, newNode);
				}
				client.NodeAddedCallback(newNode);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveChild(NodeModelBase node)
		{
			childrenCore.Remove(node);
		}

		private void ClearChildren()
		{
			childrenCore.Clear();
		}

		private void OnChildrenCollectionChanged()
		{
			addCommandCore.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			client.NodesChangedCallback();
			removeCommandCore?.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}

		private static GroupOperatorInfo CreateGroupOperatorInfo(CriteriaOperator filter, AllowedGroupFilters allowedGroupFilters)
		{
			Lazy<GroupOperatorInfo> and = new Lazy<GroupOperatorInfo>(CreateAnd);
			Lazy<GroupOperatorInfo> or = new Lazy<GroupOperatorInfo>(CreateOr);
			return FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<GroupOperatorInfo>(filter, (BinaryOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)null, (UnaryOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)null, (InOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)null, (BetweenOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)null, (FunctionOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)((GroupOperatorInfo[] _) => and.Value), (GroupOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)((GroupOperatorInfo[] _) => or.Value), (NotOperatorMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)delegate(GroupOperatorInfo x)
			{
				if (x == and.Value)
				{
					return CreateNotAnd();
				}
				if (x == or.Value)
				{
					return CreateNotOr();
				}
				if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotAnd))
				{
					return CreateNotAnd();
				}
				return allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotOr) ? CreateNotOr() : CreateNotAnd();
			}, (FallbackMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (GroupOperatorInfo)null), (NullMapper<GroupOperatorInfo>)delegate
			{
				if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.And))
				{
					return and.Value;
				}
				if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.Or))
				{
					return or.Value;
				}
				if (allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotAnd))
				{
					return CreateNotAnd();
				}
				return allowedGroupFilters.HasFlag(AllowedGroupFilters.NotOr) ? CreateNotOr() : and.Value;
			});
		}

		public DataTemplate Group { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item is MenuItemGroup)
			{
				return Group;
			}
			if (item is MenuItem)
			{
				if (((MenuItem)item).FormatCondition != null)
				{
					return FormatConditionButton;
				}
				return Button;
			}
			if (item is MenuSeparator)
			{
				return Separator;
			}
			return base.SelectTemplate(item, container);
		}
	}

	internal sealed class OperatorItemListCore<T, U> where T : OperatorItemBase where U : struct
	{
		private readonly IList<T> list;

		private readonly Func<T, U?> getKey;

		public OperatorItemListCore(IList<T> list, Func<T, U?> getKey)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)list, "list");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getKey, "getKey");
			this.list = list;
			this.getKey = getKey;
		}

		internal T GetItem(U key)
		{
			int? num = FindIndex(key);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				return list[num.Value];
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetItem(U key, T newItem)
		{
			int? num = FindIndex(key);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				list[num.Value] = newItem;
			}
		}

		internal bool Remove(U key)
		{
			int? num = FindIndex(key);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				list.RemoveAt(num.Value);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int? FindIndex(U key)
		{
			int num = list.IndexOf(delegate(T item)
			{
				U? val = getKey(item);
				return val.HasValue && val.Value.Equals(key);
			});
			if (num > -1)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	internal static class OperatorMenuItemIdentityExtensions
	{
		public static T Match<T>(this IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity op, Func<BuiltInFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> builtIn, Func<PredefinedFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> predefined, Func<FormatConditionFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> formatCondition, Func<CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> custom)
		{
			if (op is BuiltInFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return builtIn((BuiltInFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			if (op is PredefinedFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return predefined((PredefinedFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			if (op is FormatConditionFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return formatCondition((FormatConditionFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			if (op is CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return custom((CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		public static T Match<T>(this IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity op, Func<BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> builtIn, Func<CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T> custom)
		{
			if (op is BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return builtIn((BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			if (op is CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity)
			{
				return custom((CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity)op);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}
