			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)type <= 5)
			{
				if ((int)type == 4)
				{
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsNull);
				}
				if ((int)type == 5)
				{
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsNullOrEmpty);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				switch (type - 46)
				{
				case 2:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.Contains);
				case 0:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.StartsWith);
				case 1:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.EndsWith);
				}
				switch (type - 93)
				{
				case 0:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsSameDay);
				case 3:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsJanuary);
				case 4:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsFebruary);
				case 5:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsMarch);
				case 6:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsApril);
				case 7:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsMay);
				case 8:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsJune);
				case 9:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsJuly);
				case 10:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsAugust);
				case 11:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsSeptember);
				case 12:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsOctober);
				case 13:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsNovember);
				case 14:
					return new BuiltInExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity(ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.IsDecember);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

			{
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.Top, 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.Bottom, 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.AboveAverage, 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.BelowAverage, 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.Unique, 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate => ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorType.Duplicate, 
				_ => throw new IndexOutOfRangeException(), 
			};
		}

	internal class HierarchyToSelfReferenceSourceConverter<HR, SR>
	{
		private const int RootID = -1;

		private readonly Func<HR, int, int, SR> createSelfReferenceItem;

		private readonly Func<HR, IList<HR>> getChildren;

		private int currentID;

		internal HierarchyToSelfReferenceSourceConverter(Func<HR, int, int, SR> createSelfReferenceItem, Func<HR, IList<HR>> getChildren)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)createSelfReferenceItem, "createSelfReferenceItem");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getChildren, "getChildren");
			this.createSelfReferenceItem = createSelfReferenceItem;
			this.getChildren = getChildren;
		}

		public SR[] Convert(IEnumerable<HR> hierarchicalSouce)
		{
			currentID = -1;
			return ConvertCore(hierarchicalSouce).ToArray();
		}

		private IList<SR> ConvertCore(IEnumerable<HR> hierarchicalSouce)
		{
			if (hierarchicalSouce == null)
			{
				return new SR[0];
			}
			int arg = currentID;
			List<SR> list = new List<SR>();
			foreach (HR item in hierarchicalSouce)
			{
				currentID++;
				list.Add(createSelfReferenceItem(item, currentID, arg));
				list.AddRange(ConvertCore(getChildren(item)));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public abstract class BindableFast : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected bool SetValue<T>(ref T storage, T value, [CallerMemberName] string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (object.Equals(storage, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			storage = value;
			RaisePropertyChanged(propertyName);
			return true;
		}

		protected void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName = null)
		{
			this.PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
		}
	}

	public abstract class FilterModel : FilterModelBase
	{
		private struct LookUp<TValue>
		{
			public readonly TValue Value;

			public readonly object Row;

			public LookUp(TValue value, object row)
			{
				Value = value;
				Row = row;
			}
		}

		protected struct CountedLookUp<TValue>
		{
			public readonly TValue Value;

			public readonly object Row;

			public readonly int Count;

			public CountedLookUp(TValue value, object row, int count)
			{
				Value = value;
				Row = row;
				Count = count;
			}
		}

		private LazyReadonlyObservableCollection<FilterValueInfo> filterValues;

		internal Lazy<BaseEditSettings> SupportedEditSettingsLazy;

		public ReadOnlyObservableCollection<FilterValueInfo> FilterValues => filterValues.ReadonlyCollection;

		protected bool FilterValuesCreated => filterValues.CollectionCreated;

		public FilterValuesSortMode[] FilterValuesSortModes
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<FilterValuesSortMode[]>("FilterValuesSortModes");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "FilterValuesSortModes");
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IncludeNullValues => true;

		public bool IsLoading
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("IsLoading");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "IsLoading");
			}
		}

		private CancellationTokenSource GetFilterValuesCancellationTokenSource { get; set; }

		protected void EnsureFilterValuesCollection()
		{
			filterValues.EnsureCollection();
		}

		internal FilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
			filterValues = new LazyReadonlyObservableCollection<FilterValueInfo>(base.ForceUpdate);
			FilterValuesSortModes = new FilterValuesSortMode[0];
		}

		internal virtual void ResetFilterValues()
		{
			GetFilterValuesCancellationTokenSource?.Cancel();
			filterValues = new LazyReadonlyObservableCollection<FilterValueInfo>(base.ForceUpdate);
			RaisePropertyChanged("FilterValues");
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			if (!FilterValuesCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			IsLoading = true;
			Either<ReadOnlyCollection<object>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>>>? uniqueValues = null;
			CancellationTokenSource cancellationTokenSource = (GetFilterValuesCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource());
			using (cancellationTokenSource)
			{
				try
				{
					Either<ReadOnlyCollection<object>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>>> value = (await GetUniqueValues(ActualCountsInculedMode).AddCancellation(GetFilterValuesCancellationTokenSource.Token)).Value;
					uniqueValues = value;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			GetFilterValuesCancellationTokenSource = null;
			IsLoading = false;
			if (!uniqueValues.HasValue || !FilterValuesCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			FilterValuesSortModes = GetFilterValuesSortModes(ActualShowCounts && uniqueValues.Value.IsRight(), ShowAllLookUpFilterValues, Column);
			BeginUpdateCountedValues(filterValues.Collection);
			FilteringColumn filteringColumn = GetActualFilteringColumn();
			if (SupportedEditSettingsLazy == null)
			{
				SupportedEditSettingsLazy = new Lazy<BaseEditSettings>(() => FilterModelHelper.GetSupportedEditSettings(filteringColumn));
			}
			ObservableCollectionCore<FilterValueInfo> collection = filterValues.Collection;
			Either<ReadOnlyCollection<object>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>>> value2 = uniqueValues.Value;
			Func<object, int?, object, FilterValueInfo> createValueWithCount = (object val, int? count, object row) => new FilterValueInfo(val, count, filteringColumn.GetDisplayText, row, SupportedEditSettingsLazy);
			Action<FilterValueInfo, object> setRow = delegate(FilterValueInfo info, object row)
			{
				info.Row = row;
				info.EditSettingsLazy = SupportedEditSettingsLazy;
			};
			BaseEditSettings obj2 = SupportedEditSettingsLazy?.Value;
			UpdateCountedValues(collection, value2, createValueWithCount, setRow, (LookUpEditSettingsBase)(object)((obj2 is LookUpEditSettingsBase) ? obj2 : null), ShowAllLookUpFilterValues, IncludeNullValues, GetSortedFilterValues);
			EndUpdateCountedValues(filterValues.Collection);
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> GetSortedFilterValues<TValue>(IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> actualValues, bool showCounts)
		{
			if (!showCounts)
			{
				return actualValues;
			}
			return base.FilterValuesSortMode switch
			{
				FilterValuesSortMode.AvailableFirst => actualValues.Where((CountedLookUp<TValue> x) => x.Count != 0).Concat(actualValues.Where((CountedLookUp<TValue> x) => x.Count == 0)), 
				FilterValuesSortMode.PopularFirst => actualValues.OrderByDescending((CountedLookUp<TValue> x) => x.Count), 
				_ => actualValues, 
			};
		}

		internal virtual FilteringColumn GetActualFilteringColumn()
		{
			return Column;
		}

		internal override void UpdateEditSettings()
		{
			SupportedEditSettingsLazy = null;
		}

		{
			return client.GetUniqueValues(countsIncludeMode);
		}

		internal virtual void BeginUpdateCountedValues(ObservableCollectionCore<FilterValueInfo> filterValues)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void EndUpdateCountedValues(ObservableCollectionCore<FilterValueInfo> filterValues)
		{
		}

		private static FilterValuesSortMode[] GetFilterValuesSortModes(bool showCounts, bool showAllLookUpFilterValues, FilteringColumn column)
		{
			List<FilterValuesSortMode> list = new List<FilterValuesSortMode>();
			list.Add(FilterValuesSortMode.NoSort);
			if (showCounts)
			{
				BaseEditSettings obj = column?.GetEditSettings();
				if (UseLookUpValues((LookUpEditSettingsBase)(object)((obj is LookUpEditSettingsBase) ? obj : null), showAllLookUpFilterValues))
				{
					list.Add(FilterValuesSortMode.AvailableFirst);
				}
				list.Add(FilterValuesSortMode.PopularFirst);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		protected static void UpdateCountedValues<TValue, TValueWithCount>(ObservableCollectionCore<TValueWithCount> values, Either<ReadOnlyCollection<TValue>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TValue>>> valuesWithCounts, Func<TValue, int?, object, TValueWithCount> createValueWithCount, Action<TValueWithCount, object> setRow, LookUpEditSettingsBase lookUpEditSettings, bool showAllLookUpFilterValues, bool includeNullValues, Func<IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>>, bool, IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>>> getSortedValues) where TValue : class where TValueWithCount : ValueInfo<TValue>
		{
			bool flag = valuesWithCounts.IsRight();
			IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> enumerable;
			if (UseLookUpValues(lookUpEditSettings, showAllLookUpFilterValues))
			{
				Func<TValue, int> getCount = valuesWithCounts.Match((Func<ReadOnlyCollection<TValue>, Func<TValue, int>>)((ReadOnlyCollection<TValue> x) => (TValue _) => 0), (Func<ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TValue>>, Func<TValue, int>>)((ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TValue>> x) => x.ToDictionaryWithNullableKey((Counted<TValue> y) => y.Value, (Counted<TValue> y) => y.Count).GetValueOrDefault));
				IEnumerable<LookUp<TValue>> source = from object obj in GetLookUpSource(lookUpEditSettings)
					select new LookUp<TValue>((TValue)lookUpEditSettings.GetValueFromItem(obj), obj);
				enumerable = source.Select((LookUp<TValue> x) => new CountedLookUp<TValue>(x.Value, x.Row, getCount(x.Value)));
			}
			else
			{
				enumerable = valuesWithCounts.Match((ReadOnlyCollection<TValue> y) => y.Select((TValue x) => new Counted<TValue>(x, 0)), (ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TValue>> y) => y).Select(delegate(Counted<TValue> x)
				{
					TValue value = x.Value;
					LookUpEditSettingsBase obj = lookUpEditSettings;
					return new CountedLookUp<TValue>(value, (obj != null) ? obj.GetItemFromValue((object)x.Value) : null, x.Count);
				});
			}
			if (!includeNullValues)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Where((CountedLookUp<TValue> x) => x.Value != null && x.Value as string != string.Empty && (object)x.Value != DBNull.Value);
			}
			enumerable = getSortedValues(enumerable, flag);
			int num = 0;
			foreach (CountedLookUp<TValue> item2 in enumerable)
			{
				int? num2 = (flag ? new int?(item2.Count) : ((int?)null));
				if (num < ((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values).Count)
				{
					TValueWithCount val = ((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values)[num];
					val.Value = item2.Value;
					val.Count = num2;
					setRow(val, item2.Row);
				}
				else
				{
					TValueWithCount item = createValueWithCount(item2.Value, num2, item2.Row);
					((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values).Add(item);
				}
				num++;
			}
			int num3 = ((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values).Count - num;
			for (int num4 = 0; num4 < num3; num4++)
			{
				((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values).RemoveAt(((Collection<TValueWithCount>)(object)values).Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private static bool UseLookUpValues(LookUpEditSettingsBase editSettings, bool showAllLookUpFilterValues)
		{
			if (showAllLookUpFilterValues)
			{
				return GetLookUpSource(editSettings) != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IEnumerable GetLookUpSource(LookUpEditSettingsBase editSettings)
		{
			return editSettings.If((LookUpEditSettingsBase settings) => settings.ItemsSource is IEnumerable).With((LookUpEditSettingsBase settings) => (IEnumerable)settings.ItemsSource);
		}

		{

			this.columnType = columnType;
			EditSettings = editSettings;
			valueItemInfo = info ?? FilterModelValueItemInfo.CreateDefault();
			nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy = new Lazy<NodeOperatorTypeInfo>(() => valueItemInfo.GetNodeOperatorTypeInfo());
			Lazy<NodeClientColumnsInfo> propertiesInfoLazy = new Lazy<NodeClientColumnsInfo>(() => valueItemInfo.GetColumnsInfo());
			propertiesLazy = new Lazy<ReadOnlyCollection<PropertySelectorModelBase>>(() => (!filterModelValueItem.nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowFieldOperatorType) ? null : LeafNodeModel.CreatePropertySelectorModels(propertiesInfoLazy.Value.Columns).ToReadOnlyCollection());
			defaultPropertyLazy = new Lazy<PropertySelectorColumnModel>(() => propertiesInfoLazy.Value.DefaultField.With((string field) => filterModelValueItem.Properties.OfType<PropertySelectorColumnModel>().FirstOrDefault((PropertySelectorColumnModel x) => x.Name == field)));
			showSearchPanelLazy = new Lazy<bool>(() => propertiesInfoLazy.Value.AllowSearch);
			Lazy<NodeClientParametersInfo> parametersInfoLazy = new Lazy<NodeClientParametersInfo>(() => valueItemInfo.GetParametersInfo());
			parametersLazy = new Lazy<ReadOnlyCollection<string>>(() => (!filterModelValueItem.nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowParameterOperatorType) ? null : parametersInfoLazy.Value.Parameters?.ToReadOnlyCollection());
			defaultParameterLazy = new Lazy<string>(() => parametersInfoLazy.Value.DefaultParameter);
			Lazy<NodeClientDateTimeFunctionsInfo> dateTimeFunctionsInfoLazy = new Lazy<NodeClientDateTimeFunctionsInfo>(() => valueItemInfo.GetDateTimeFunctionsInfo());
			dateTimeFunctionsLazy = new Lazy<ReadOnlyCollection<DateTimeFunctionType>>(() => ((filterModelValueItem.nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowDateTimeFunctionOperatorType && FilterTreeHelper.IsDateTimeProperty(columnType)) ? dateTimeFunctionsInfoLazy.Value.DateTimeFunctions : null)?.ToReadOnlyCollection());
			defaultDateTimeFunctionLazy = new Lazy<DateTimeFunctionType?>(() => dateTimeFunctionsInfoLazy.Value.DefaultLocalDateTimeFunction);
			Index = index;
			RemoveCommand = removeCommand;
			SelectParameterCommand = new DelegateCommand<string>(delegate(string parameter)

			});

			{

				SelectedDateTimeFunction = localDateTimeFunctionType;
			});
			Update(valueData);
			this.onFilterablePropertyChanged = onFilterablePropertyChanged;
		}

		internal void Update(ValueData valueData)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ValueDataKind valueDataKind;
			if (valueData != null && valueData != ValueData.NullValue)
			{
				valueDataKind = GetActualValueDataKindAndUpdateState(valueData);
			}
			else
			{

				valueDataKind = GetDefaultValueDataKind();
			}
			UpdateMenuAndSelectMenuItem(valueDataKind);
		}

		private void UpdateMenuAndSelectMenuItem(ValueDataKind valueDataKind)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<ValueDataKind> allowedValueDataKinds = GetAllowedValueDataKinds();
			if (allowedValueDataKinds.Count == 1 && allowedValueDataKinds.Single() == valueDataKind)
			{
				allowedValueDataKinds.Clear();
			}
			OperandMenuItems = allowedValueDataKinds.Select(CreateOperandMenuItem).ToReadOnlyCollection();
			SelectedOperandMenuItem = OperandMenuItems.SingleOrDefault((OperandMenuItem x) => x.ValueDataKind == valueDataKind) ?? CreateOperandMenuItem(valueDataKind);
		}

		private void OnSelectedOperandMenuItemChanged()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			ValueDataKind valueDataKind = SelectedOperandMenuItem.ValueDataKind;
			switch (valueDataKind - 1)
			{
			case 0:
				if (SelectedProperty == null)
				{
					SelectedProperty = defaultPropertyLazy.Value;
				}
				break;
			case 1:
				if (!SelectedDateTimeFunction.HasValue)
				{
					SelectedDateTimeFunction = defaultDateTimeFunctionLazy.Value;
				}
				break;
			case 2:
				if (SelectedParameter == null)
				{
					SelectedParameter = defaultParameterLazy.Value;
				}
				break;
			}
			onFilterablePropertyChanged?.Invoke();
		}

		private ValueDataKind GetActualValueDataKindAndUpdateState(ValueData valueData)
		{
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return valueData.Match<ValueDataKind>((Func<object, ValueDataKind>)delegate(object value)
			{
				Value = value;
				return (ValueDataKind)0;
			}, (Func<string, ValueDataKind>)delegate(string propertyName)
			{
				SelectedProperty = LeafNodeModel.SelectProperty(Properties, propertyName);
				return (ValueDataKind)1;
			}, (Func<string, ValueDataKind>)delegate(string parameter)
			{
				SelectedParameter = parameter;
				return (ValueDataKind)3;
			}, (Func<DateTimeFunctionType, ValueDataKind>)delegate(DateTimeFunctionType localDateTimeFunction)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				SelectedDateTimeFunction = localDateTimeFunction;
				return (ValueDataKind)2;
			}, (Func<ValueDataKind>)delegate
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			});
		}

		private ValueDataKind GetDefaultValueDataKind()
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ValueDataKind val = nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.FilterEditorOperandType.ToValueDataKind();
			List<ValueDataKind> allowedValueDataKinds = GetAllowedValueDataKinds();
			if (allowedValueDataKinds.Contains(val))
			{
				return val;
			}
			return allowedValueDataKinds.FirstOrDefault();
		}

		private List<ValueDataKind> GetAllowedValueDataKinds()
		{
			List<ValueDataKind> list = new List<ValueDataKind>();
			if (nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowValueOperatorType)
			{
				list.Add((ValueDataKind)0);
			}
			if (nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowFieldOperatorType)
			{
				IReadOnlyCollection<PropertySelectorModelBase> properties = Properties;
				if (properties != null && properties.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add((ValueDataKind)1);
				}
			}
			if (nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowParameterOperatorType)
			{
				IReadOnlyCollection<string> parameters = Parameters;
				if (parameters != null && parameters.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add((ValueDataKind)3);
				}
			}
			if (nodeOperatorTypeInfoLazy.Value.AllowDateTimeFunctionOperatorType && SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsDateTime(columnType))
			{
				IReadOnlyCollection<DateTimeFunctionType> dateTimeFunctions = DateTimeFunctions;
				if (dateTimeFunctions != null && dateTimeFunctions.Count > 0)
				{
					list.Add((ValueDataKind)2);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal ValueData ToValueData()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ValueDataKind valueDataKind = SelectedOperandMenuItem.ValueDataKind;
			switch ((int)valueDataKind)
			{
			case 0:
				return ValueData.FromValue((EditSettings != null && EditSettings.IsUserDefined) ? Value : FilterModelHelper.GetEffectiveFilterValue(Value, columnType));
			case 1:
				return ValueData.FromProperty(SelectedProperty?.Name);
			case 2:
				if (!SelectedDateTimeFunction.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ValueData.FromLocalDateTimeFunction(SelectedDateTimeFunction.Value);
			case 3:
				return ValueData.FromParameter(SelectedParameter);
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
		}
	}

	internal sealed class OperandValuesRecord
	{
		private readonly List<ValueData> SavedValues;

		public ValueData Binary => SavedValues.FirstOrDefault((ValueData v) => v != null && !v.IsNullOrEmpty);

		public Tuple<ValueData, ValueData> Ternary => GetActualTernary();

		public ValueData[] Variable => GetActualVariable();

		public CriteriaOperator CustomFilter { get; }

		public CriteriaOperator DateTimeOperatorsFilter { get; }

		public CriteriaOperator FormatConditionFilter { get; }

		public Tuple<double, TopBottomValueType> PredefinedFormatConditionFilter { get; }

		public bool IsEmpty { get; }

		private Tuple<ValueData, ValueData> GetActualTernary()
		{
			List<ValueData> savedValues = SavedValues;
			if (savedValues != null && savedValues.Count == 2)
			{
				return new Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>(SavedValues[0], SavedValues[1]);
			}
			List<ValueData> list = SavedValues.Where((ValueData v) => v != null && !v.IsNullOrEmpty).Take(2).ToList();
			ValueData item = ((list.Count > 0) ? list[0] : ValueData.NullValue);
			ValueData item2 = ((list.Count > 1) ? list[1] : ValueData.NullValue);
			return new Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>(item, item2);
		}

		private ValueData[] GetActualVariable()
		{
			if (SavedValues.Any((ValueData v) => v != null && !v.IsNullOrEmpty))
			{
				return SavedValues.ToArray();
			}
			return (ValueData[])(object)new ValueData[1] { ValueData.NullValue };
		}

		private OperandValuesRecord(IEnumerable<ValueData> variable)
		{
			SavedValues = variable?.ToList() ?? new List<ValueData>();
			IsEmpty = SavedValues.FirstOrDefault((ValueData v) => v != null && !v.IsNullOrEmpty) == null;
		}

		private OperandValuesRecord(CriteriaOperator customFilter = null, CriteriaOperator dateTimeOperatorsFilter = null, CriteriaOperator formatConditionFilter = null, Tuple<double, TopBottomValueType> predefinedFormatConditionFilter = null)
			: this((IEnumerable<ValueData>)(object)new ValueData[0])
		{
			CustomFilter = customFilter;
			DateTimeOperatorsFilter = dateTimeOperatorsFilter;
			FormatConditionFilter = formatConditionFilter;
			PredefinedFormatConditionFilter = predefinedFormatConditionFilter;
			IsEmpty = CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(CustomFilter) && CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(DateTimeOperatorsFilter) && CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(FormatConditionFilter) && PredefinedFormatConditionFilter == null;
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateEmpty()
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord((IEnumerable<ValueData>)null);
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateBinary(ValueData value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord(value.Yield<ValueData>());
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateTernary(Tuple<ValueData, ValueData> value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord((IEnumerable<ValueData>)(object)new ValueData[2]
			{
				value?.Item1,
				value?.Item2
			});
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateVariable(ValueData[] value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord((IEnumerable<ValueData>)value);
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateCustom(CriteriaOperator value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord(value);
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateDateTimeOperators(CriteriaOperator value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord(null, value);
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreateFormatCondition(CriteriaOperator value)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord(null, null, value);
		}

		public static OperandValuesRecord CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionFilterModel model)
		{
			return new OperandValuesRecord(null, null, null, new Tuple<double, TopBottomValueType>(model.Value, model.ValueType));
		}
	}
	public class CalendarFilterModel : FilterModel
	{
		public IList<DateTime> SelectedDates
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<IList<DateTime>>("SelectedDates");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, base.ApplyFilter, "SelectedDates");
			}
		}

		public bool AllowMultipleDateRanges
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("AllowMultipleDateRanges");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "AllowMultipleDateRanges");
			}
		}

		internal CalendarFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
			AllowMultipleDateRanges = CanBuildMultipleDateRangesFilter();
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			SelectedDates = Filter?.ToDates(PropertyName).ToList();
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			if (SelectedDates == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(base.PropertyName, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)SelectedDates);
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			if (!CanBuildSingleDateRangeFilter())
			{
				return CanBuildMultipleDateRangesFilter();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanBuildSingleDateRangeFilter()
		{
			return Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.SingleDateRange);
		}

		private bool CanBuildMultipleDateRangesFilter()
		{
			return Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges);
		}
	}

	public sealed class CheckedListFilterModel : FilterModel
	{
		private Locker locker = new Locker();

		public ObservableCollection<object> SelectedFilterValuesSource { get; private set; }

		public List<object> SelectedFilterValues
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<List<object>>("SelectedFilterValues");
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = FilteringUIExtensions.ListReallyChanged(SelectedFilterValues, value);
				if (!(SetValue(value, "SelectedFilterValues") && flag))
				{
					return;
				}
				locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					if (SelectedFilterValuesSource.Count != 0)
					{
						SelectedFilterValuesSource.Clear();
					}
					foreach (object item in SelectedFilterValues ?? new List<object>())
					{
						SelectedFilterValuesSource.Add(item);
					}
				});
				ApplyFilter();
			}
		}

		internal bool SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull");
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetValue(value, "SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull") && base.Filter == null)
				{
					Update();
				}
			}
		}

		internal CheckedListFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectedFilterValuesSource = (ObservableCollection<object>)(object)new ObservableCollectionCore<object>();
			SelectedFilterValuesSource.CollectionChanged += delegate
			{
				locker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					SelectedFilterValues = SelectedFilterValuesSource.ToList();
				});
			};
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			Func<object, bool> isSelectedFunc = FilterTreeHelper.CreateContainsValueFunc(PropertyName, Column.Type, Filter, client.SubstituteFilter);
			SelectedFilterValues = ((!FilterValuesCreated) ? new List<object>() : (HasFilter ? ((IEnumerable<object>)FilterValues.Where((FilterValueInfo x) => isSelectedFunc(x.Value))).ToList() : (SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull ? ((IEnumerable<object>)FilterValues).ToList() : new List<object>())));
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			List<object> checkedValues = (from FilterValueInfo x in SelectedFilterValues?
				select x.Value).ToList() ?? new List<object>();
			return BuildMultiValuesFilter(this, new CheckedValuesInfo(checkedValues, () => base.FilterValues.Select((FilterValueInfo x) => x.Value).Except(checkedValues).ToList()));
		}

		internal static CriteriaOperator BuildMultiValuesFilter(FilterModelBase model, CheckedValuesInfo values)
		{
			return HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.GetAppropriateBuilder(model.PropertyName, (string x) => (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(x)), delegate(string name)
			{
				if (name != model.Column.Name)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException();
				}
				return model.Column.GetUseRangeDateFilter();
			}).BuildValuesFilter(model.Column.GetFilterRestrictions(), values, nullOnNoUncheckedValues: true);
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return SimpleFilterTreeBase.CanBuildFilter(Column.GetFilterRestrictions());
		}
	}

				SetValue(value, RebuildStringFilterTree, "StringFilterTreeType");

		}

		internal bool ImplyEmptyStringLikeBlank
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("ImplyEmptyStringLikeBlank");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, RebuildStringFilterTree, "ImplyEmptyStringLikeBlank");
			}
		}

		internal bool SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, ValidateDefaultSelection, "SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull");
			}
		}

		public IReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> Nodes
		{
			get
			{
				if (nodes == null)
				{
					EnsureFilterValuesCollection();
				}
				return nodes;
			}
		}

		public string SearchString
		{
			get
			{
				return searchString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (SetValue(ref searchString, value, "SearchString"))
				{
					OnSearchStringChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsUpdating
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("IsUpdating");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "IsUpdating");
			}
		}

		public bool ShowSearchPanel
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("ShowSearchPanel");
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(value, "ShowSearchPanel");
				UpdateActualShowSearchPanel();
			}
		}

		public bool ActualShowSearchPanel
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("ActualShowSearchPanel");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "ActualShowSearchPanel");
			}
		}

		public bool HasGroupedNodes
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("HasGroupedNodes");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "HasGroupedNodes");
			}
		}

		public bool FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand");
			}

				SetValue(value, "FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand");
			}
		}

		internal bool? CalculateHasFilter()
		{
			if (!base.FilterValuesCreated)
			{
				return null;
			}
			EnsureFilterValuesCollection();
			return filterTree?.RootNode != null && (filterTree.RootNode.ActualIsChecked ?? true);
		}

		internal CheckedTreeListFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
			DateTimeFilterTreeType = DateTimeFilterTreeType.Hierarchy;
			StringFilterTreeType = StringFilterTreeType.Linear;
			ShowSearchPanel = true;
		}

		private void UpdateActualShowSearchPanel()
		{
			ActualShowSearchPanel = ShowSearchPanel && !Column.GroupFields.Any();
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			RebuildFilterTree();
			UpdateActualShowSearchPanel();
		}

		private void RebuildFilterTree()
		{
			filterTree = CreateFilterTree();
			FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand = filterTree.FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand;
			if (base.FilterValuesCreated)
			{
				filterTree?.Build(base.FilterValues, base.Filter, client.SubstituteFilter);
				HasGroupedNodes = filterTree?.HasGroupedNodes ?? false;
				ValidateDefaultSelection();
				nodes = ((filterTree == null) ? null : new List<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>>(new GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>[1] { filterTree.RootNode }).AsReadOnly());
				RaisePropertyChanged("Nodes");
			}
		}

		internal override FilteringColumn GetActualFilteringColumn()
		{
			return client.GetColumnByName(Column.RootFilterValuesPropertyName);
		}

		internal override Task<UniqueValues> GetUniqueValues(CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode)
		{
			if (Column.GroupFields.Any())
			{
				return client.GetGroupUniqueValues(Column.RootFilterValuesPropertyName, null, countsIncludeMode, Column.Name);
			}
			return base.GetUniqueValues(countsIncludeMode);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> GetSortedFilterValues<TValue>(IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> actualValues, bool showCounts)
		{
			if (Column.AllowHierarchicalFilterTree)
			{
				if (FilterTreeHelper.IsDateTimeProperty(Column.Type) && DateTimeFilterTreeType == DateTimeFilterTreeType.Hierarchy)
				{
					return GetSortedFilterValuesCore<TValue, DateTime>(actualValues);
				}
				if (Column.Type == typeof(string) && StringFilterTreeType == StringFilterTreeType.Alphabetical)
				{
					return GetSortedFilterValuesCore<TValue, string>(actualValues);
				}
			}
			return base.GetSortedFilterValues(actualValues, showCounts);
		}

		private static IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> GetSortedFilterValuesCore<TValue, TType>(IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TValue>> actualValues)
		{
			CountedLookUp<TValue>? value = null;
			List<CountedLookUp<TValue>> list = new List<CountedLookUp<TValue>>();
			List<CountedLookUp<TValue>> list2 = new List<CountedLookUp<TValue>>();
			foreach (CountedLookUp<TValue> actualValue in actualValues)
			{
				if (actualValue.Value is TType)
				{
					list.Add(actualValue);
				}
				else if (actualValue.Value == null)
				{
					value = actualValue;
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(actualValue);
				}
			}
			return value.YieldIfNotNull().Cast<CountedLookUp<TValue>>().Concat(list.OrderBy((CountedLookUp<TValue> x) => x.Value))
				.Concat(list2);
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			return filterTree?.BuildFilter();
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			if (filterTree != null)
			{
				return filterTree.CanBuildFilter();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private FilterTreeBase CreateFilterTree()
		{
			FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient = new FilterTreeClient(base.PropertyName, client.GetColumnByName, SupportedEditSettingsLazy, delegate(string propertyName)
			{
				FilteringColumn filteringColumn = client.GetColumnByName(propertyName);
				return (!(filteringColumn.Type == typeof(string))) ? FilterTreeHelper.ObjectBlankOperations : FilterTreeHelper.GetStringBlankOperations(ImplyEmptyStringLikeBlank);
			}, base.ApplyFilter, delegate
			{
				IsUpdating = true;
			}, delegate
			{
				IsUpdating = false;
			}, CheckIsNodeVisible, Column.GetFilterRestrictions(), Column.GroupFields, async delegate(string valuesPropertyName, CriteriaOperator filter, string filterPropertyName)
			{
				Func<object, string> getValuesDisplayText = client.GetColumnByName(valuesPropertyName).GetDisplayText;
				Func<object, int?, FilterValueInfo> createValueInfo = (object val, int? count) => new FilterValueInfo(val, count, getValuesDisplayText, null, null);
				return (await client.GetGroupUniqueValues(valuesPropertyName, filter, ActualCountsInculedMode, filterPropertyName)).Value.Match((ReadOnlyCollection<object> left) => left.Select((object x) => createValueInfo(x, null)), (ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>> right) => right.Select((Counted<object> x) => createValueInfo(x.Value, x.Count))).ToList();
			});
			if (Column.GroupFields.Any())
			{
				return new GroupFilterTree(filterTreeClient, Column.RootFilterValuesPropertyName);
			}
			if (FilterTreeHelper.IsDateTimeProperty(Column.Type))
			{
				return CreateDateTimeFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
			}
			if (Column.Type == typeof(string))
			{
				return CreateStringFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
			}
			return CreateSimpleFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
		}

		private FilterTreeBase CreateDateTimeFilterTree(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient)
		{
			switch (DateTimeFilterTreeType)
			{
			case DateTimeFilterTreeType.Linear:
				return CreateLinearDateTimeFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
			case DateTimeFilterTreeType.Hierarchy:
				if (Column.AllowHierarchicalFilterTree)
				{
					return new DateTimeHierarchyFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
				}
				return CreateLinearDateTimeFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException(DateTimeFilterTreeType.ToString());
			}
		}

		private FilterTreeBase CreateLinearDateTimeFilterTree(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient)
		{
			if (Column.GetRoundDateTimeFilter())
			{
				return new DateTimeLinearFilterTree(filterTreeClient, Column.GetDisplayText);
			}
			return CreateSimpleFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
		}

		private FilterTreeBase CreateStringFilterTree(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient)
		{
			switch (StringFilterTreeType)
			{
			case StringFilterTreeType.Linear:
				return LinearFilterTree.StringLinear(filterTreeClient);
			case StringFilterTreeType.Alphabetical:
				if (Column.AllowHierarchicalFilterTree)
				{
					return new StringHierarchyFilterTree(filterTreeClient);
				}
				return LinearFilterTree.StringLinear(filterTreeClient);
			default:
				throw new NotSupportedException(DateTimeFilterTreeType.ToString());
			}
		}

		private FilterTreeBase CreateSimpleFilterTree(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient)
		{
			return LinearFilterTree.Linear(filterTreeClient);
		}

		private bool CheckIsNodeVisible(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchString))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.CompareInfo.IndexOf(node.Value.GetDisplayText() ?? string.Empty, SearchString, CompareOptions.IgnoreCase) >= 0;
		}

		private void OnDateTimeFilterTreeTypeChanged()
		{
			if (FilterTreeHelper.IsDateTimeProperty(Column.Type))
			{
				UpdateFilterTreeIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		private void RebuildStringFilterTree()
		{
			if (Column.Type == typeof(string))
			{
				UpdateFilterTreeIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFilterTreeIfNeeded()
		{
			UpdateContentAsync(delegate
			{
				RebuildFilterTree();
				return FilteringUIExtensions.CompletedTask;
			}).AwaitIfNotCompleted();
		}

		private void OnSearchStringChanged()
		{
			IsUpdating = true;
			(filterTree as LoadedFilterTreeBase)?.ValidateNodes();
			IsUpdating = false;
		}

		private void ValidateDefaultSelection()
		{
			if (base.Filter == null && filterTree != null && filterTree.RootNode != null)
			{
				filterTree.RootNode.IsChecked = SelectAllWhenFilterIsNull;
			}
		}

		internal override void ResetFilterValues()
		{
			base.ResetFilterValues();
			RebuildFilterTree();
		}
	}
	public enum DateTimeFilterTreeType
	{
		Linear,
		Hierarchy
	}
	public enum StringFilterTreeType
	{
		Linear,
		Alphabetical
	}
	public enum GroupFilterInfoValuesType
	{
		Checked,
		Unchecked
	}
	internal class GroupFilterInfo
	{
		private readonly List<object> values;

		private readonly GroupFilterInfoValuesType type;

		public readonly string PropertyName;

		private readonly List<GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo> indeterminate;

		public GroupFilterInfo(string propertyName, List<object> values, GroupFilterInfoValuesType type, List<GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo> indeterminate)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			this.values = values;
			this.type = type;
			this.indeterminate = indeterminate;
		}

		public Either<GroupFilterInfo, bool> GetState(object value)
		{
			GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo groupFilterIndeterminateInfo = indeterminate?.FirstOrDefault((GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo x) => object.Equals(x.Value, value));
			if (groupFilterIndeterminateInfo != null)
			{
				return groupFilterIndeterminateInfo.FilterInfo.AsLeft();
			}
			bool flag = values.Contains(value);
			return ((type == GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked) ? flag : (!flag)).AsRight();
		}

		public GroupFilterInfo Invert()
		{
			if (indeterminate != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return new GroupFilterInfo(PropertyName, values, (type == GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked) ? GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Unchecked : GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked, null);
		}

		public GroupFilterInfo MakeIndeterminate(GroupFilterInfo info)
		{
			if (values.Count != 1 || type != GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return new GroupFilterInfo(PropertyName, new List<object>(), GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked, new List<GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo>
			{
				new GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo(values.Single(), info)
			});
		}

		public static GroupFilterInfo Merge(GroupFilterInfo[] infos)
		{
			string propertyName = infos.First().PropertyName;
			if (!infos.All((GroupFilterInfo x) => x.PropertyName == propertyName))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			List<object> determinateValues = new List<object>();
			GroupFilterInfoValuesType? determinateType = null;
			List<GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo> list = infos.Where(delegate(GroupFilterInfo x)
			{
				if (x.indeterminate == null)
				{
					determinateValues.AddRange(x.values);
					if (determinateType.HasValue && determinateType.Value != x.type)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException();
					}
					determinateType = x.type;
				}
				return x.indeterminate != null;
			}).SelectMany((GroupFilterInfo x) => x.indeterminate).ToList();
			return new GroupFilterInfo(propertyName, determinateValues, determinateType ?? GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked, list.Any() ? list : null);
		}
	}
	internal class GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo
	{
		public readonly object Value;

		public readonly GroupFilterInfo FilterInfo;

		public GroupFilterIndeterminateInfo(object value, GroupFilterInfo filterInfo)
		{
			Value = value;
			FilterInfo = filterInfo;
		}
	}
	internal static class GroupFilterParser
	{
		public static GroupFilterInfo Parse(CriteriaOperator filter, string field, string[] groupFields)
		{
			try
			{
				return ParseUnsafe(filter, field, groupFields);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static GroupFilterInfo ParseUnsafe(CriteriaOperator filter, string field, string[] groupFields)
		{
			filter = BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(filter);
			GroupFilterInfo groupFilterInfo = FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<GroupFilterInfo>(filter, (BinaryOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)delegate(string propertyName, object value, BinaryOperatorType type)
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if ((int)type == 0)
				{
					return value.Yield().AsChecked(propertyName);
				}
				return ((int)type == 1) ? value.Yield().AsUnchecked(propertyName) : null;
			}, (UnaryOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)((string propertyName, UnaryOperatorType type) => ((int)type == 4) ? MakeNullChecked(propertyName) : null), (InOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)((string propertyName, object[] values) => values.AsChecked(propertyName)), (BetweenOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)null, (FunctionOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)delegate(string propertyName, object[] values, FunctionOperatorType type)
			{
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((int)type == 5)
				{
					return MakeNullChecked(propertyName);
				}
				ValueData[] array = ((IEnumerable<object>)values).Select((Func<object, ValueData>)ValueData.FromValue).ToArray();
				Attributed<ValueData[]> val = BetweenDatesHelper.TryGetPropertyValuesFromSubstituted<DateTime>(propertyName, array, type);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.Value.Select((ValueData x) => ValueDataExtensions.ToValue(x)).AsChecked(propertyName);
				}
				Attributed<ValueDataRange> range = BetweenDatesHelper.TryGetRangeFromSubstituted<DateTime>(propertyName, array, type);
				return (range != null) ? Enumerable.Range(0, ((DateTime)ValueDataExtensions.ToValue(range.Value.To) - (DateTime)ValueDataExtensions.ToValue(range.Value.From)).Days + 1).Select((Func<int, object>)((int x) => ((DateTime)ValueDataExtensions.ToValue(range.Value.From)).AddDays(x))).AsChecked(propertyName) : null;
			}, (GroupOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)delegate(GroupFilterInfo[] infos)
			{
				if (infos.HasNullItems())
				{
					return (GroupFilterInfo)null;
				}
				List<GroupFilterInfo> list = infos.OrderByDescending((GroupFilterInfo x) => groupFields.IndexOf((string y) => y == x.PropertyName)).ToList();
				return list.Skip(1).Aggregate(list[0], (GroupFilterInfo acc, GroupFilterInfo info) => info.MakeIndeterminate(acc));
			}, (GroupOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)((GroupFilterInfo[] infos) => infos.HasNullItems() ? null : GroupFilterInfo.Merge(infos)), (NotOperatorMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)((GroupFilterInfo info) => info.Invert()), (FallbackMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (GroupFilterInfo)null), (NullMapper<GroupFilterInfo>)(() => (GroupFilterInfo)null));
			if (groupFilterInfo?.PropertyName != field)
			{
				groupFilterInfo = null;
			}
			return groupFilterInfo ?? new GroupFilterInfo(field, new List<object>(), GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked, null);
		}

		private static bool HasNullItems(this GroupFilterInfo[] infos)
		{
			return infos.Any((GroupFilterInfo x) => x == null);
		}

		private static GroupFilterInfo MakeNullChecked(string propertyName)
		{
			return ((object)null).Yield<object>().AsChecked(propertyName);
		}

		private static GroupFilterInfo AsChecked(this IEnumerable<object> values, string propertyName)
		{
			return new GroupFilterInfo(propertyName, values.ToList(), GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Checked, null);
		}

		private static GroupFilterInfo AsUnchecked(this IEnumerable<object> values, string propertyName)
		{
			return new GroupFilterInfo(propertyName, values.ToList(), GroupFilterInfoValuesType.Unchecked, null);
		}

		public static bool? GetCheckState(this Either<GroupFilterInfo, bool> state)
		{
			return state.Match((GroupFilterInfo _) => (bool?)null, (bool isChecked) => isChecked);
		}

		public static GroupFilterInfo GetGroupFilterInfo(this Either<GroupFilterInfo, bool> state)
		{
			return state.Match((GroupFilterInfo x) => x, (bool _) => (GroupFilterInfo)null);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class GroupFilterTree : FilterTreeBase
	{
		private readonly string rootFilterValuesPropertyName;

		internal override bool HasGroupedNodes => true;

		internal override bool FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand => false;

		private string[] GroupFields => client.GroupFields;

		public GroupFilterTree(FilterTreeClient client, string rootFilterValuesPropertyName)
			: base(client, FilterTreeKind.Groups)
		{
			this.rootFilterValuesPropertyName = rootFilterValuesPropertyName;
		}

		protected override async void BuildTree(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, IList<FilterValueInfo> filterValues, CriteriaOperator filter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter)
		{
			await CreateAndAddGroupValueNodes(root?.AsNodeParent, Task.FromResult(filterValues), rootFilterValuesPropertyName, GroupFilterParser.Parse(filter, rootFilterValuesPropertyName, GroupFields), true, new List<object>());
		}

		private async Task<IList<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>>> CreateAndAddGroupValueNodes(NodeParent<NodeValueInfo> nodeParent, Task<IList<FilterValueInfo>> filterValues, string fieldName, GroupFilterInfo parentGroupInfo, bool? parentCheckState, List<object> parentValues)
		{
			List<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> nodes = new List<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>>();
			foreach (FilterValueInfo filterValue in MergeBlankAndEmptyValues(await filterValues, client.GetBlankOperations(fieldName)))
			{
				Either<GroupFilterInfo, bool>? either = parentGroupInfo?.GetState(filterValue.Value);
				bool? checkState = (either.HasValue ? either.Value.GetCheckState() : new bool?(parentCheckState.Value));
				GroupFilterInfo groupInfo = either?.GetGroupFilterInfo();
				nodes.Add(LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue(delegate(Lazy<GroupValueNode<NodeValueInfo>> parent)
				{
					GroupValueNode<NodeValueInfo> groupValueNode = new GroupValueNode<NodeValueInfo>(CreteNodeValueInfo(fieldName, filterValue), null, base.ApplyFilter, nodeParent, (parentValues.Count >= GroupFields.Length) ? null : ((Func<Task<ICollection<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>>>>)async delegate
					{
						NodeParent<NodeValueInfo> nodeParent2 = new NodeParent<NodeValueInfo>(delegate
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException();
						}, delegate
						{
						}, delegate
						{
						}, parent.Value.OnChildIsCheckedChanged, parent.Value.OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged);
						List<object> list = parentValues.Concat(filterValue.Value.Yield()).ToList();
						string text = GroupFields[parentValues.Count];
						bool? flag = (parent.Value.ActualIsChecked.HasValue ? new bool?(parent.Value.ActualIsChecked.Value) : checkState);
						return await CreateAndAddGroupValueNodes(nodeParent2, GetFilterValues(list, GroupFields.Take(parentValues.Count), text), text, (flag ?? true) ? groupInfo : null, flag, list);
					}));
					groupValueNode.SetCount(filterValue.Count);
					((NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>)groupValueNode).SetIsCheckedInternal(checkState, NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>.IsCheckedUpdateMode.Parent);
					return groupValueNode;
				}));
			}
			return nodes;
		}

		private IEnumerable<FilterValueInfo> MergeBlankAndEmptyValues(IList<FilterValueInfo> filterValues, BlankOperations blankOperations)
		{
			if (filterValues.Count <= 2)
			{
				return filterValues;
			}
			FilterValueInfo filterValueInfo = filterValues[1];
			if (!blankOperations.IsBlankValue(filterValueInfo.Value))
			{
				return filterValues;
			}
			FilterValueInfo filterValueInfo2 = filterValues[0];
			filterValueInfo2.Count += filterValueInfo.Count;
			return filterValueInfo2.Yield().Concat(filterValues.Skip(2));
		}

		private NodeValueInfo CreteNodeValueInfo(string fieldName, FilterValueInfo filterValue)
		{
			BlankOperations blankOperations = client.GetBlankOperations(fieldName);
			if (blankOperations.IsBlankValue(filterValue.Value))
			{
				return new NodeValueInfo(null, () => FilterTreeBase.SelectBlanksText, DisplayMode.DisplayText, null);
			}
			if (blankOperations.IsEmptyValue(filterValue.Value))
			{
				return new NodeValueInfo(filterValue.Value, () => FilterTreeBase.EmptyStringText, DisplayMode.DisplayText, null);
			}
			BaseEditSettings editSettings = FilterModelHelper.GetSupportedEditSettings(client.GetColumn(fieldName));
			return new NodeValueInfo(filterValue.Value, filterValue.GetDisplayText, DisplayMode.Value, (editSettings != null) ? new Lazy<BaseEditSettings>(() => editSettings) : null);
		}

		private Task<IList<FilterValueInfo>> GetFilterValues(IEnumerable<object> values, IEnumerable<string> groupFields, string valuesPropertyName)
		{
			IEnumerable<string> second = rootFilterValuesPropertyName.Yield().Concat(groupFields);
			CriteriaOperator arg = CriteriaOperator.And(values.Zip(second, delegate(object value, string property)
			{
				BlankOperations blankOperations = client.GetBlankOperations(property);
				return GetHierarchyFilterBuilder(property).BuildSingleValueFilter(value, invert: false, () => blankOperations.CreateIsNullOperator(property, AllowedUnaryFilters.All));
			}));
			return client.GetGroupFilterValues(valuesPropertyName, arg, base.PropertyName);
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore()
		{
			return GetHierarchyFilterBuilder(rootFilterValuesPropertyName).BuildValuesFilter(FilterRestrictions.All(), GetCheckedValuesInfo(base.RootNode.Nodes, 0), nullOnNoUncheckedValues: false);
		}

		private HierarchyFilterBuilderBase GetHierarchyFilterBuilder(string fieldName)
		{
			return HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.GetAppropriateBuilder(fieldName, (string x) => client.GetBlankOperations(x).CreateIsNullOperator(x, AllowedUnaryFilters.All), (string name) => client.GetColumn(name).GetUseRangeDateFilter());
		}

		private CheckedValuesInfo GetCheckedValuesInfo(ReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> nodes, int level)
		{
			return new CheckedValuesInfo(GetValues(nodes, isChecked: true), () => GetValues(nodes, isChecked: false), (from x in GetNodes(nodes, null)
				select new IndeterminateValueInfo(x.Value.Value, GetCheckedValuesInfo(((GroupValueNode<NodeValueInfo>)x).Nodes, level + 1), GroupFields[level])).ToList());
		}

		private IEnumerable<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> GetNodes(IEnumerable<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> nodes, bool? isChecked)
		{
			return nodes.Where((NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> x) => x.ActualIsChecked == isChecked);
		}

		private List<object> GetValues(IEnumerable<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> nodes, bool isChecked)
		{
			return (from x in GetNodes(nodes, isChecked)
				select x.Value.Value).ToList();
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilter()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class LinearFilterTree : SimpleFilterTreeBase
	{
		internal override bool HasGroupedNodes => false;

		{

			{
				ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> valueNode = CreateAndAddRegualValueNode(root, filterValue.Value, filterValue.GetDisplayText, EditSettingsLazy);

		}

	internal abstract class LoadedFilterTreeBase : FilterTreeBase
	{
		private readonly BlankOperations BlankOperations;

		private readonly Type PropertyType;

		protected readonly Lazy<BaseEditSettings> EditSettingsLazy;

		private ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> blanksNode;

		private Func<object, bool> isRegualValueCheckedFunc;

		public LoadedFilterTreeBase(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient, FilterTreeKind kind)
			: base(filterTreeClient, kind)
		{
			FilteringColumn filteringColumn = client.GetColumn(base.PropertyName);
			BlankOperations = client.GetBlankOperations(base.PropertyName);
			PropertyType = filteringColumn.Type;
			EditSettingsLazy = filterTreeClient.RootEditSettingsLazy;
		}

		protected override void BuildTree(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, IList<FilterValueInfo> filterValues, CriteriaOperator filter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter)
		{
			List<CriteriaOperator> customItemsFilters = FilterTreeHelper.SplitCriteriaOperator(filter);
			isRegualValueCheckedFunc = FilterTreeHelper.CreateContainsValueFunc(base.PropertyName, PropertyType, filter, substituteFilter);
			Func<object, bool> func = FilterTreeHelper.CreateContainsValueFunc(base.PropertyName, typeof(object), filter, substituteFilter);
			Action<GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>, FilterValueInfo> regularValueProcessor = GetRegularValueProcessor(filter);
			foreach (FilterValueInfo filterValue in filterValues)
			{
				if (BlankOperations.IsBlankValue(filterValue.Value))
				{
					if (blanksNode == null)
					{
						if (CreateIsNullOperator() == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						blanksNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, null, () => FilterTreeBase.SelectBlanksText);
					}
					if (blanksNode != null)
					{
						blanksNode.SetCount(blanksNode.Count + filterValue.Count);
						blanksNode.IsChecked = (blanksNode.IsChecked ?? false) || filterValue.Value is DBNull || func(filterValue.Value);
					}
				}
				else if (BlankOperations.IsEmptyValue(filterValue.Value))
				{
					ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> valueNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, filterValue.Value, () => FilterTreeBase.EmptyStringText);
					valueNode.IsChecked = IsRegularValueChecked(filterValue.Value);
					valueNode.SetCount(filterValue.Count);
				}
				else if (IsRegularValue(filterValue.Value))
				{
					regularValueProcessor(root, filterValue);
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessCustomValue(customItemsFilters, root, filterValue);
				}
			}
			ValidateNodes();
			foreach (NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> depthFirstNode in CheckedTreeHelper.GetDepthFirstNodes(base.RootNode))
			{
				depthFirstNode.IsExpanded = !depthFirstNode.IsChecked.HasValue;
			}
		}

		protected abstract Action<GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>, FilterValueInfo> GetRegularValueProcessor(CriteriaOperator filter);

		protected bool IsRegularValueChecked(object value)
		{
			return isRegualValueCheckedFunc(value);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsRegularValue(object value)
		{
			if (!HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsBlankElement(value))
			{
				return PropertyType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType());
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected CriteriaOperator CreateIsNullOperator()
		{
			return BlankOperations.CreateIsNullOperator(base.PropertyName, base.FilterRestrictions.AllowedUnaryFilters);
		}

		private void ProcessCustomValue(List<CriteriaOperator> customItemsFilters, GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, FilterValueInfo filterValue)
		{
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> valueNode;
			if (filterValue.Value is CriteriaOperator)
			{
				CriteriaOperator op = (CriteriaOperator)filterValue.Value;
				valueNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, op, () => ((object)op).ToString());
			}
			else if (filterValue.Value is ICustomItem)
			{
				ICustomItem customItem = (ICustomItem)filterValue.Value;
				valueNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, customItem.EditValue, () => customItem.DisplayValue?.ToString());
			}
			else
			{
				valueNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, filterValue.Value, () => filterValue.Value.ToString());
			}
			valueNode.SetCount(null);
			valueNode.IsChecked = IsCustomItemChecked(customItemsFilters, filterValue.Value);
		}

		private bool IsCustomItemChecked(List<CriteriaOperator> customItemsFilters, object value)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (value is CriteriaOperator)
			{
				return IsCustomFilterItemChecked(customItemsFilters, (CriteriaOperator)value);
			}
			if (value is ICustomItem)
			{
				ICustomItem val = (ICustomItem)value;
				if (val.EditValue is CriteriaOperator)
				{
					return IsCustomFilterItemChecked(customItemsFilters, (CriteriaOperator)val.EditValue);
				}
				if (IsRegularValue(val.EditValue))
				{
					return IsRegularValueChecked(val.EditValue);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsCustomFilterItemChecked(List<CriteriaOperator> customItemsFilters, CriteriaOperator customOperator)
		{
			if (customItemsFilters.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return FilterTreeHelper.SplitCriteriaOperator(customOperator).All((CriteriaOperator x) => customItemsFilters.Contains(x));
		}

		public void ValidateNodes()
		{
			ValidateNodesCore(base.RootNode, isParentVisible: false);
		}

		private void ValidateNodesCore(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node, bool isParentVisible)
		{
			foreach (NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> child in node.GetChildren())
			{
				bool isParentVisible2 = isParentVisible || CalcIsVisible(child);
				ValidateNodesCore(child, isParentVisible2);
			}
			node.IsVisible = node == base.RootNode || isParentVisible || node.HasVisibleChildren();
			node.RaiseCountChangedIfNeeded();
		}

		private bool CalcIsVisible(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node)
		{
			if (!IsCustomNode(node))
			{
				return client.GetIsNodeVisible?.Invoke(node) ?? true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsCustomNode(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node)
		{
			return !IsRegularValue(node.Value.Value);
		}

		protected sealed override CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore()
		{
			return BuildRegularValuesFilter(base.RootNode) | FilterTreeHelper.BuildCustomValuesFilter(base.RootNode, base.PropertyName, (object x) => !IsRegularValue(x));
		}

		protected abstract CriteriaOperator BuildRegularValuesFilter(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root);
	}

	internal static class PredefinedFormatConditionFilterExtensions
	{
		public static ConditionFilterType ToConditionFilterType(this PredefinedFormatConditionType type, TopBottomValueType unit)
		{
			switch (type)
			{
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top:
				if (unit == TopBottomValueType.Items)
				{
					return (ConditionFilterType)9;
				}
				return (ConditionFilterType)11;
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom:
				if (unit == TopBottomValueType.Items)
				{
					return (ConditionFilterType)10;
				}
				return (ConditionFilterType)12;
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage:
				return (ConditionFilterType)13;
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage:
				return (ConditionFilterType)14;
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique:
				return (ConditionFilterType)15;
			case PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate:
				return (ConditionFilterType)16;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public static PredefinedFormatConditionType ToPredefinedFormatConditionType(this ConditionFilterType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (type - 9)
			{
			case 0:
			case 2:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top;
			case 1:
			case 3:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom;
			case 4:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage;
			case 5:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage;
			case 6:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique;
			case 7:
				return PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsPredefinedFormatCondition(this ConditionFilterType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)type != 9 && (int)type != 11 && (int)type != 10 && (int)type != 12 && (int)type != 13 && (int)type != 14 && (int)type != 15)

	internal static class DictionaryWithNullableKey
	{
		public static DictionaryWithNullableKey<TKey, TElement> ToDictionaryWithNullableKey<TSource, TKey, TElement>(this IEnumerable<TSource> source, Func<TSource, TKey> keySelector, Func<TSource, TElement> elementSelector)
		{
			TElement nullKeyValue = default(TElement);
			Dictionary<TKey, TElement> dictionary = source.Select((TSource x) => new KeyValuePair<TKey, TElement>(keySelector(x), elementSelector(x))).Where(delegate(KeyValuePair<TKey, TElement> x)
			{
				if (x.Key == null)
				{
					nullKeyValue = x.Value;
				}
				return x.Key != null;
			}).ToDictionary((KeyValuePair<TKey, TElement> x) => x.Key, (KeyValuePair<TKey, TElement> x) => x.Value);
			return new DictionaryWithNullableKey<TKey, TElement>(dictionary, nullKeyValue);
		}
	}
	internal class DictionaryWithNullableKey<TKey, TValue>
	{
		private readonly IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary;

		private TValue nullKeyValue;

		public IEnumerable<TValue> Values => nullKeyValue.YieldIfNotNull().Concat(dictionary.Values);

		public DictionaryWithNullableKey(IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dictionary, TValue nullKeyValue)
		{
			this.dictionary = dictionary;
			this.nullKeyValue = nullKeyValue;
		}

		public TValue GetValueOrDefault(TKey key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				return nullKeyValue;
			}
			return dictionary.GetValueOrDefault(key);
		}

		public void Remove(TKey key)
		{
			if (key == null)
			{
				nullKeyValue = default(TValue);
			}
			else
			{
				dictionary.Remove(key);
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class FilteringUIExtensions
	{
		public static readonly Task CompletedTask = Task.FromResult(result: false);

		public static bool ListReallyChanged(List<object> oldList, List<object> newList)
		{
			if (oldList == null && newList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (oldList == null && newList != null)
			{
				return newList.Count != 0;
			}
			if (oldList != null && newList == null)
			{
				return oldList.Count != 0;
			}
			return !ListHelper.AreEqual<object>((IList<object>)oldList, (IList<object>)newList);
		}

		public static Lazy<TOut> Select<TIn, TOut>(this Lazy<TIn> lazy, Func<TIn, TOut> select)
		{
			return new Lazy<TOut>(() => select(lazy.Value));
		}

		public static async Task DoLockedTaskAsync(this Locker locker, Func<Task> getTask)
		{
			Locker val = locker.Lock();
			try
			{
				await getTask();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public static async Task DoLockedTaskIfNotLockedAsync(this Locker locker, Func<Task> getTask)
		{
			if (!locker.IsLocked)
			{
				await locker.DoLockedTaskAsync(getTask);
			}
		}

		public static void AwaitIfNotCompleted(this Task task)
		{
			if (task.IsCompleted)
			{
				if (task.Status == TaskStatus.Faulted)
				{
					throw task.Exception;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				task.AwaitCore();
			}
		}

		public static async Task<T> AddCancellation<T>(this Task<T> task, CancellationToken token)
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<object> completionSource = new TaskCompletionSource<object>();
			using (token.Register(delegate
			{
				completionSource.TrySetResult(null);
			}))
			{
				if (task != await Task.WhenAny(task, completionSource.Task))
				{
					throw new OperationCanceledException(token);
				}
			}
			return await task;
		}

		private static async void AwaitCore(this Task task)
		{
			await task;
		}
	}

		private ReadOnlyObservableCollection<T> readonlyCollection;

		public ObservableCollectionCore<T> Collection { get; private set; }

		public bool CollectionCreated => Collection != null;

		public ReadOnlyObservableCollection<T> ReadonlyCollection
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureCollection();
				return readonlyCollection;
			}
		}

		public LazyReadonlyObservableCollection(Action initialize)
		{
			this.initialize = initialize;
		}

		public void EnsureCollection()
		{
			if (!CollectionCreated)
			{
				Collection = new ObservableCollectionCore<T>();
				readonlyCollection = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<T>((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)Collection);
				initialize();
			}
		}
	}

				{
					ApplyFilter();
				}
			}
		}

		protected static ICollection<T> ParseCustomFunctions<T>(CriteriaOperator filter, Func<FunctionOperator, T> mapper) where T : class
		{
			return FormatConditionFiltersHelper.ParseGroupOrOperator<T>(filter, (Func<CriteriaOperator, T>)((CriteriaOperator x) => CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<FunctionOperator, T>(x, mapper, (Func<CriteriaOperator, T>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (T)null))));
		}

		internal CustomFiltersModelBase(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
			filters = new LazyReadonlyObservableCollection<ValueInfo<TFilter>>(base.ForceUpdate);
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			FunctionOperator[] array = (from ValueInfo<TFilter> x in SelectedFilters ?? new List<object>()
				select CreateFilter(x.Value)).ToArray();
			return CriteriaOperator.Or((CriteriaOperator[])(object)array);
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			UpdateFilters();
			Func<TFilter, bool> isSelectedFilter = GetIsSelectedFilterChecker(Filter);
			SelectedFilters = ((filters.CollectionCreated && isSelectedFilter != null) ? ((IEnumerable<object>)Filters.Where((ValueInfo<TFilter> x) => isSelectedFilter(x.Value))).ToList() : new List<object>());
		}

		protected abstract Func<TFilter, bool> GetIsSelectedFilterChecker(CriteriaOperator filter);

		private void UpdateFilters()
		{
			ReadOnlyCollection<TFilter> readOnlyCollection = CoreFilters.ToReadOnlyCollection();
			if (filters.CollectionCreated)
			{
				int[] array = (base.ActualShowCounts ? client.GetCounts((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)readOnlyCollection.Select((TFilter x) => CreateFilter(x))) : null);
				FilterModel.UpdateCountedValues(valuesWithCounts: (array == null) ? ((Either<ReadOnlyCollection<TFilter>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TFilter>>>)readOnlyCollection.AsLeft()) : ((Either<ReadOnlyCollection<TFilter>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<TFilter>>>)readOnlyCollection.Zip(array, (TFilter x, int y) => new Counted<TFilter>(x, y)).ToReadOnlyCollection().AsRight()), values: filters.Collection, createValueWithCount: (TFilter val, int? count, object row) => new ValueInfo<TFilter>(val, count, null), setRow: delegate
				{
				}, lookUpEditSettings: null, showAllLookUpFilterValues: false, includeNullValues: IncludeNullValues, getSortedValues: (IEnumerable<CountedLookUp<TFilter>> actualValues, bool _) => actualValues);
			}
		}

		internal sealed override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract FunctionOperator CreateFilter(TFilter filter);

		internal void EnsureFilters()
		{
			filters.EnsureCollection();
		}
	}

	public class DatePeriodsFilterModel : FilterModel
	{
		public List<object> SelectedPredefinedFilters
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<List<object>>("SelectedPredefinedFilters");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, base.ApplyFilter, "SelectedPredefinedFilters");
			}
		}

		public ReadOnlyCollection<DatePeriodFilterValue> PredefinedFilters
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<ReadOnlyCollection<DatePeriodFilterValue>>("PredefinedFilters");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "PredefinedFilters");
			}
		}

		internal static FilterDateType[] GetFilters(AllowedDateTimeFilters allowedFilters)
		{
			List<FilterDateType> list = new List<FilterDateType>();
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsBeyondThisYear))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.BeyondThisYear);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisYear))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.LaterThisYear);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisMonth))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.LaterThisMonth);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsNextWeek))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.NextWeek);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisWeek))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.LaterThisWeek);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsTomorrow))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Tomorrow);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsToday))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Today);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsYesterday))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.Yesterday);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisWeek))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.EarlierThisWeek);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLastWeek))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.LastWeek);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisMonth))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.EarlierThisMonth);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisYear))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.EarlierThisYear);
			}
			if (allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsPriorThisYear))
			{
				list.Add(FilterDateType.PriorThisYear);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static EditorStringId GetLocalizationString(FilterDateType filterDateType)
		{
			return (EditorStringId)(filterDateType switch
			{
				FilterDateType.PriorThisYear => 398, 
				FilterDateType.EarlierThisYear => 397, 
				FilterDateType.EarlierThisMonth => 396, 
				FilterDateType.LastWeek => 395, 
				FilterDateType.EarlierThisWeek => 394, 
				FilterDateType.Yesterday => 393, 
				FilterDateType.Today => 392, 
				FilterDateType.Tomorrow => 391, 
				FilterDateType.LaterThisWeek => 390, 
				FilterDateType.NextWeek => 389, 
				FilterDateType.LaterThisMonth => 388, 
				FilterDateType.LaterThisYear => 387, 
				FilterDateType.BeyondThisYear => 386, 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			});
		}

		internal DatePeriodsFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
		}

		private List<DatePeriodFilterValue> GetPredefinedFilters()
		{
			FilterDateType[] filters = GetFilters(Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedDateTimeFilters);
			return filters.Select((FilterDateType x) => new DatePeriodFilterValue(x, EditorLocalizer.GetString(GetLocalizationString(x)))).ToList();
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			PredefinedFilters = GetPredefinedFilters().AsReadOnly();
			if (Filter != null)
			{
				List<FilterDateType> actualFilters = Filter.ToFilters(PropertyName).ToList();
				SelectedPredefinedFilters = ((IEnumerable<object>)PredefinedFilters.Where((DatePeriodFilterValue i) => actualFilters.Contains(i.Value))).ToList();
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedPredefinedFilters = null;
			}
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			return (from DatePeriodFilterValue x in SelectedPredefinedFilters?
				select x.Value).ToCriteria(base.PropertyName);
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return PredefinedFilters.Any();
		}
	}
