	public sealed class ExcelStyleFilterModel : FilterModelBase
	{
		private readonly MultiFilterModel RulesFilterModel;

		private readonly CheckedTreeListFilterModel ValuesFilterModel;

		private AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes allowedFilterTypes = AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.All;

		private AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes actualAllowedFilterTypes = AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.All;

		public IReadOnlyList<FilterModelBase> FilterModels { get; }

		public AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes AllowedFilterTypes
		{
			get
			{
				return allowedFilterTypes;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(ref allowedFilterTypes, value, "AllowedFilterTypes", UpdateActualAllowedFilterTypes);
			}
		}

		public AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes ActualAllowedFilterTypes
		{
			get
			{
				return actualAllowedFilterTypes;
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(ref actualAllowedFilterTypes, value, "ActualAllowedFilterTypes", OnActualAllowedFilterTypesChanged);
			}
		}

		public ExcelStyleFilterType DefaultFilterType
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<ExcelStyleFilterType>("DefaultFilterType");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, "DefaultFilterType");
			}
		}

		public FilterModelBase SelectedFilterModel
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<FilterModelBase>("SelectedFilterModel");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, "SelectedFilterModel");
			}
		}

		internal ExcelStyleFilterModel(FilterModelClient client, Func<UniqueValues, UniqueValues> getUniqueValuesForValuesTab, Func<OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem>, OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem>> getOperatorsForRulesTab, Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate> selectTemplate)
			: base(client)
		{
			ExcelStyleFilterModel excelStyleFilterModel = this;
			RulesFilterModel = MultiFilterModelFactory.CreateMultiElementModel(client.Update(delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter)
			{
				ApplyFilter(filter);
				ValuesFilterModel.Update(filter.Value);
			}), getOperatorsForRulesTab, selectTemplate);
			Func<CountsIncludeMode, Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValues = ((getUniqueValuesForValuesTab == null) ? null : (getUniqueValues = async delegate(CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode)
			{
				Func<UniqueValues, UniqueValues> func = getUniqueValuesForValuesTab;
				return func(await client.GetUniqueValues(countsIncludeMode));
			}));
			ValuesFilterModel = new CheckedTreeListFilterModel(client.Update(delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter)
			{
				ApplyFilter(filter);
				UpdateRulesFilterModel(filter.Value);
			}, getUniqueValues));
			DefaultFilterType = ExcelStyleFilterType.Values;
			FilterModels = new List<FilterModelBase> { RulesFilterModel, ValuesFilterModel }.ToReadOnlyObservableCollection();
			ValuesFilterModel.PropertyChanged += LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue<PropertyChangedEventHandler>((Lazy<PropertyChangedEventHandler> t) => delegate(object _, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (e.PropertyName == "Nodes")
				{
					ValuesFilterModel.PropertyChanged -= t.Value;
					UpdateSelectedFilterModel();
				}
			});
		}

		protected override void UpdateShowCounts()
		{
		}

		private void UpdateRulesFilterModel(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			RulesFilterModel.Update(CanApplyRulesFilter(filter) ? filter : null);
		}

		private bool CanApplyRulesFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			if (FilteringUIHelper.CheckFilterFieldName(filter, Column.Name))
			{
				return RulesFilterModel.CanUpdate(filter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			UpdateRulesFilterModel(base.Filter);
			ValuesFilterModel.Update(base.Filter);
			UpdateActualAllowedFilterTypes();
			UpdateSelectedFilterModel();
			return FilteringUIExtensions.CompletedTask;
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return ActualAllowedFilterTypes != AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.None;
		}

		private void UpdateActualAllowedFilterTypes()
		{
			AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes allowedExcelStyleFilterTypes = AllowedFilterTypes;
			if (!ValuesFilterModel.CanBuildFilter)
			{
				allowedExcelStyleFilterTypes &= ~AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.Values;
			}
			if (!RulesFilterModel.CanBuildFilter)
			{
				allowedExcelStyleFilterTypes &= ~AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.Rules;
			}
			ActualAllowedFilterTypes = allowedExcelStyleFilterTypes;
		}

		private void OnActualAllowedFilterTypesChanged()
		{
			UpdateCanBuildFilter();
			UpdateSelectedFilterModel();
		}

		private List<FilterModelBase> GetAllowedFilterModels()
		{
			List<FilterModelBase> list = new List<FilterModelBase>();
			if (ActualAllowedFilterTypes.HasFlag(AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.Rules))
			{
				list.Add(RulesFilterModel);
			}
			if (ActualAllowedFilterTypes.HasFlag(AllowedExcelStyleFilterTypes.Values))
			{
				list.Add(ValuesFilterModel);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedFilterModel()
		{
			List<FilterModelBase> allowedFilterModels = GetAllowedFilterModels();
			if (SelectedFilterModel == null || !allowedFilterModels.Contains(SelectedFilterModel))
			{
				SelectedFilterModel = ((allowedFilterModels.Count == 1) ? allowedFilterModels.Single() : GetAppropriateFilterModel());
			}
		}

		private FilterModelBase GetAppropriateFilterModel()
		{
			if (base.Filter == null)
			{
				if (DefaultFilterType != ExcelStyleFilterType.Rules)
				{
					return ValuesFilterModel;
				}
				return RulesFilterModel;
			}
			if (IsRulesModelAppropriate())
			{
				return RulesFilterModel;
			}
			bool? flag = ValuesFilterModel.CalculateHasFilter();
			if (!flag.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!flag.Value)
			{
				return RulesFilterModel;
			}
			return ValuesFilterModel;
		}

		private bool IsRulesModelAppropriate()
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(base.Filter);
			if (!CanApplyRulesFilter(val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<bool>(val, (BinaryOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (UnaryOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (InOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (BetweenOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FunctionOperatorMapper<bool>)delegate(string propertyName, object[] values, FunctionOperatorType type)
			{
				//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				ValueData[] array = ((IEnumerable<object>)values).Select((Func<object, ValueData>)ValueData.FromValue).ToArray();
				return BetweenDatesHelper.TryGetRangeFromSubstituted<object>(propertyName, array, type) != null || BetweenDatesHelper.TryGetPropertyValuesFromSubstituted<object>(propertyName, array, type) != null;
			}, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FallbackMapper<bool>)((CriteriaOperator _) => false), (NullMapper<bool>)null))
			{
				return CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<UnaryOperator, bool>(base.Filter, (Predicate<UnaryOperator>)((UnaryOperator unary) => (int)unary.OperatorType == 3), (Func<UnaryOperator, bool>)((UnaryOperator unaryNot) => FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<bool>(unaryNot.Operand, (BinaryOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (UnaryOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, UnaryOperatorType type) => (int)type != 4), (InOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (BetweenOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FunctionOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FallbackMapper<bool>)((CriteriaOperator _) => true), (NullMapper<bool>)null)), (Func<CriteriaOperator, bool>)((CriteriaOperator op) => FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<bool>(op, (BinaryOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, object __, BinaryOperatorType type) => ((int)type != 0 && (int)type != 1) || FilterTreeHelper.IsDateTimeProperty(Column.Type)), (UnaryOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, UnaryOperatorType type) => (int)type != 4), (InOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (BetweenOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FunctionOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (FallbackMapper<bool>)((CriteriaOperator _) => true), (NullMapper<bool>)null)));
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

	public abstract class RangeFilterModelBase<T> : FilterModel where T : struct, IComparable<T>
	{
		private static Comparer<T> Comparer = Comparer<T>.Default;

		protected Locker locker = new Locker();

		public T From
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<T>("From");
			}
			set
			{
				locker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					value = GetMax(value, Min);
					value = GetMin(value, To);
				});
				SetValue(value, base.ApplyFilter, "From");
			}
		}

		public T To
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<T>("To");
			}
			set
			{
				locker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					value = GetMin(value, Max);
					value = GetMax(value, From);
				});
				SetValue(value, base.ApplyFilter, "To");
			}
		}

		public T Min
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<T>("Min");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "Min");
			}
		}

		public T Max
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<T>("Max");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "Max");
			}
		}

		private static T GetMin(T a, T b)
		{
			if (Comparer.Compare(a, b) >= 0)
			{
				return b;
			}
			return a;
		}

		private static T GetMax(T a, T b)
		{
			if (Comparer.Compare(a, b) <= 0)
			{
				return b;
			}
			return a;
		}

		internal RangeFilterModelBase(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
		}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


		internal sealed override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			CriteriaOperator result = null;
			if (Comparer.Compare(Min, From) < 0 || Comparer.Compare(To, Max) < 0)
			{
				result = BuildFilterCore();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			Tuple<T, T> range = ParseFilter();
			locker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				Tuple<object, object> tuple = client.GetMinMaxRange();
				if (tuple != null)
				{
					Tuple<T, T> tuple2 = ValidateRange(tuple);
					Min = tuple2.Item1;
					Max = tuple2.Item2;
					From = GetMax(range?.Item1 ?? Min, Min);
					To = GetMin(range?.Item2 ?? Max, Max);
				}
			});
		}

		protected abstract CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore();

		protected abstract Tuple<T, T> ParseFilter();

		protected abstract Tuple<T, T> ValidateRange(Tuple<object, object> range);
	}
	public class RangeFilterModel : RangeFilterModelBase<decimal>
	{
		internal RangeFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore()
		{
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!IsBetweenAllowed())
			{
				if (!IsGreaterLessAllowed())
				{
					return null;
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(base.PropertyName, base.From, (BinaryOperatorType)5) & (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(base.PropertyName, base.To, (BinaryOperatorType)4);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BetweenOperator(base.PropertyName, CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(base.From), CriteriaOperator.op_Implicit(base.To));
		}

		protected override Tuple<decimal, decimal> ParseFilter()
		{
			return FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>(base.Filter, (BinaryOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (UnaryOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (InOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (BetweenOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)((string name, object from, object to) => new Tuple<decimal, decimal>(Convert.ToDecimal(from), Convert.ToDecimal(to))), (FunctionOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null, (FallbackMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (Tuple<decimal, decimal>)null), (NullMapper<Tuple<decimal, decimal>>)null) ?? ((GroupOperator)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/).With(delegate(GroupOperator x)
			{
				Tuple<object, object> tuple = CriteriaRangeHelper.TryConvertToValueRange(CriteriaRangeHelper.TryGetRegularRange<decimal>(x, true));
				return (tuple == null) ? null : new Tuple<decimal, decimal>(Convert.ToDecimal(tuple.Item1), Convert.ToDecimal(tuple.Item2));
			});
		}

		protected override Tuple<decimal, decimal> ValidateRange(Tuple<object, object> range)
		{
			return new Tuple<decimal, decimal>(Convert.ToDecimal(range.Item1), Convert.ToDecimal(range.Item2));
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions = Column.GetFilterRestrictions();
			if (!IsBetweenAllowed())
			{
				return IsGreaterLessAllowed();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsGreaterLessAllowed()
		{
			AllowedBinaryFilters allowedBinaryFilters = Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedBinaryFilters;
			if (allowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.LessOrEqual))
			{
				return allowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.GreaterOrEqual);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsBetweenAllowed()
		{
			return Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedBetweenFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBetweenFilters.Between);
		}
	}
	public class DateRangeFilterModel : RangeFilterModelBase<DateTime>
	{
		internal DateRangeFilterModel(FilterModelClient client)
			: base(client)
		{
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore()
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!CanBuildFilterCore())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(base.PropertyName, base.From, (BinaryOperatorType)5) & (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(base.PropertyName, base.To.AddDays(1.0), (BinaryOperatorType)3);
		}

		protected override Tuple<DateTime, DateTime> ParseFilter()
		{
			CriteriaOperator filter = base.Filter;
			return ((GroupOperator)(object)((filter is GroupOperator) ? filter : null)).With(delegate(GroupOperator groupOperator)
			{
				Tuple<object, object> tuple = CriteriaRangeHelper.TryConvertToValueRange(CriteriaRangeHelper.TryGetRoundedDateTimeRange(groupOperator, true));
				return (tuple == null) ? null : new Tuple<DateTime, DateTime>((DateTime)tuple.Item1, (DateTime)tuple.Item2);
			});
		}

		protected override Tuple<DateTime, DateTime> ValidateRange(Tuple<object, object> range)
		{
			return new Tuple<DateTime, DateTime>((DateTime)range.Item1, (DateTime)range.Item2);
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			AllowedDateTimeFilters allowedDateTimeFilters = Column.GetFilterRestrictions().AllowedDateTimeFilters;
			return allowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.SingleDateRange);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class InplaceEditorOwner : InplaceEditorOwnerBase
	{
		private readonly Action<IAction> enqueueAction;

		private readonly Action<KeyEventArgs> processKeyDown;

		private readonly Func<MouseButtonEventArgs, bool> performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown;

		protected override FrameworkElement FocusOwner => null;

		protected override EditorShowMode EditorShowMode => (EditorShowMode)0;

		protected override bool EditorSetInactiveAfterClick => false;

		protected override Type OwnerBaseType => base.owner.GetType();

		public InplaceEditorOwner(FrameworkElement owner, Action<KeyEventArgs> processKeyDown, Func<MouseButtonEventArgs, bool> performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown, Action<IAction> enqueueAction)
			: base(owner, true)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("owner");
			}
			if (processKeyDown == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("processKeyDown");
			}
			if (performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown");
			}
			this.enqueueAction = enqueueAction;
			this.processKeyDown = processKeyDown;
			this.performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown = performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown;
			owner.PreviewMouseDown += OnPreviewMouseDown;
			owner.PreviewMouseUp += OnPreviewMouseUp;
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButton.Left)
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangedButton == System.Windows.Input.MouseButton.Left)
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ProcessMouseLeftButtonUp(e);
			}
		}

		public void CommitCurrentCellEditor()
		{
			InplaceEditorBase currentCellEditor = ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor;
			if (currentCellEditor != null)
			{
				currentCellEditor.CommitEditor(true);
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			processKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override bool CommitEditing()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedsKey(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers, bool defaultValue)
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor != null && key == Key.Down && (modifiers & ModifierKeys.Alt) == ModifierKeys.Alt)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).NeedsKey(key, modifiers, defaultValue);
		}

		protected override void EnqueueImmediateAction(IAction action)
		{
			enqueueAction(action);
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayText(InplaceEditorBase inplaceEditor, string originalDisplayText, object value)
		{
			return originalDisplayText;
		}

		protected override bool? GetDisplayText(InplaceEditorBase inplaceEditor, string originalDisplayText, object value, out string displayText)
		{
			displayText = originalDisplayText;
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			return performNavigationOnLeftButtonDown(e);
		}
	}

		public readonly bool AllowHierarchicalFilterTree;

		private readonly Func<BaseEditSettings> getEditSettingsCore;

		private readonly Func<string> getGroupFields;

		private readonly Func<CriteriaOperator, bool, CountsIncludeMode, FilterValuesThrottleMode, Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValues;

		private readonly Func<PredefinedFilterCollection> getPredefinedFilters;

		public string[] GroupFields => FilteringUIContextHelper.SplitGroupFields(Name, getGroupFields(), skipRootIfInverted: true);

		public string RootFilterValuesPropertyName => FilteringUIContextHelper.SplitGroupFields(Name, getGroupFields(), skipRootIfInverted: false)[0];

		public BaseEditSettings GetEditSettings()
		{
			if (filterMode != ColumnFilterMode.Value)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return getEditSettingsCore();
		}

		public Task<UniqueValues> GetUniqueValues(CriteriaOperator filter, bool forceIsColumnFiltered, CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode, FilterValuesThrottleMode throttleMode = FilterValuesThrottleMode.Allow)
		{
			return getUniqueValues(filter, forceIsColumnFiltered, countsIncludeMode, throttleMode);
		}

		public IEnumerable<PredefinedFilter> GetSustitutedPredefinedFilters()
		{
			IList<PredefinedFilter> list = getPredefinedFilters();
			IList<PredefinedFilter> source = list ?? EmptyArray<PredefinedFilter>.Instance;
			return source.Select((PredefinedFilter y) => new PredefinedFilter
			{
				Filter = PredefinedFiltersSubstituteHelper.SubstituteProperty(y.Filter, Name),
				Name = y.Name
			});
		}

		public FilteringColumn(string name, Type type, int visibleIndex, ColumnFilterMode filterMode, bool allowHierarchicalFilterTree, Func<BaseEditSettings> getEditSettings, Func<bool> getRoundDateTimeFilter, Func<object, string> getDisplayText, Func<FilterRestrictions> getFilterRestrictions, Func<string> getGroupFields, Func<CriteriaOperator, bool, CountsIncludeMode, FilterValuesThrottleMode, Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValues, Func<bool> showAllValuesInFilter, Func<SummaryFilterInfo[], object[]> getSummaryValues, Func<PredefinedFilterCollection> getPredefinedFilters)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)name, "name");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)type, "type");
			Name = name;
			this.filterMode = filterMode;
			Type = ((filterMode == ColumnFilterMode.Value) ? type : typeof(string));
			VisibleIndex = visibleIndex;
			GetRoundDateTimeFilter = getRoundDateTimeFilter;
			getEditSettingsCore = getEditSettings;
			GetDisplayText = getDisplayText;
			GetFilterRestrictions = getFilterRestrictions;
			this.getGroupFields = getGroupFields;
			this.getUniqueValues = getUniqueValues;
			ShowAllValuesInFilter = showAllValuesInFilter;
			GetSummaryValues = getSummaryValues;
			this.getPredefinedFilters = getPredefinedFilters;
			AllowHierarchicalFilterTree = allowHierarchicalFilterTree;
		}
	}

	internal struct UniqueValues
	{
		public static readonly UniqueValues Empty = FromCountedValues(EmptyArray<Counted<object>>.Instance.ToReadOnlyCollection());

		public static readonly Task<UniqueValues> EmptyAsync = Task.FromResult(Empty);

		public readonly Either<ReadOnlyCollection<object>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>>> Value;

		public static UniqueValues FromValues(IList<object> values)
		{
			return new UniqueValues(values.ToReadOnlyCollection().AsLeft());
		}

		public static UniqueValues FromValuesAndCounts(ValueAndCount[] values)
		{
			return FromCountedValues(values.Select((ValueAndCount x) => new Counted<object>(x.Value, x.Count)).ToReadOnlyCollection());
		}

		public static UniqueValues FromCountedValues(ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>> values)
		{
			return new UniqueValues(values.AsRight());
		}

		private UniqueValues(Either<ReadOnlyCollection<object>, ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>>> value)
		{
			Value = value;
		}
	}

	public sealed class FilteringUIContext
	{
		private class ExtractPropertiesVisitor : ClientCriteriaVisitorBase
		{
			public List<string> Properties = new List<string>();

			protected override CriteriaOperator Visit(OperandProperty theOperand)
			{
				Properties.Add(theOperand.PropertyName);
				return ((ClientCriteriaVisitorBase)this).Visit(theOperand);
			}
		}

		private readonly FilteringUIContextClient client;

		private CriteriaOperator lastFilter;

		private FilterInfo split;

		private readonly ObservableCollectionCore<CriteriaOperator> mruFilters = new ObservableCollectionCore<CriteriaOperator>();

		internal readonly ReadOnlyObservableCollection<CriteriaOperator> MRUFilters;

		private List<FilteringContextListener> listeners = new List<FilteringContextListener>();

		private bool notifyListChangedScheduled;

		internal CriteriaOperator Filter
		{
			get
			{
				return client.Filter;
			}
			set
			{
				client.Filter = value;
			}
		}

		internal ICollection<string> Columns => split.Columns;

		internal AllowedGroupFilters AllowedGroupFilters { get; }

		internal object DetailHeaderContent => client.GetDetailHeaderContent();

		internal double DetailIndent => client.GetDetailIndent();

		internal bool AllowCustomExpressionInFilterEditor => client.GetAllowCustomExpressionInFilterEditor();

		internal void AddMRUFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			if (filter != null)
			{
				int num = MRUFilterIndex(filter);
				((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Insert(0, filter);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count > client.GetMRUFilterListCount())
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count - 1);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveMRUFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			if (filter != null)
			{
				int num = MRUFilterIndex(filter);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyMRUFilterListCountChanged()
		{
			int num = client.GetMRUFilterListCount();
			int num2 = ((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count;
			while (--num2 >= num)
			{
				((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(num2);
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyAllowMRUFilterListChanged(bool allowMRUFilterList)
		{
			UpdateAllListeners(delegate(FilteringContextListener x)
			{
				x.AllowMRUFilterListChanged(allowMRUFilterList);
			});
		}

		internal void ShowFilterEditor()
		{
			client.ShowFilterEditor?.Invoke();
		}

		internal void ClearFilter()
		{
			client.ClearFilter?.Invoke();
		}

		internal void IsFilterEnabled(bool isFilterEnabled)
		{
			client.SetIsFilterEnabled?.Invoke(isFilterEnabled);
		}

		internal object CreateMRUFiltersItemOnDeserializing(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			string text = (string)item.ChildProperties["FilterString"].Value;
			FilteringUIContextFilterCriteria filteringUIContextFilterCriteria = new FilteringUIContextFilterCriteria(CriteriaOperator.Parse(text, new object[0]));
			((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Add(filteringUIContextFilterCriteria.FilterOperator);
			return filteringUIContextFilterCriteria;
		}

		internal void ClearMRUFilters()
		{
			((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Clear();
		}

		internal void BeginUpdateMRUFilters()
		{
			mruFilters.BeginUpdate();
		}

		internal void EndUpdateMRUFilters(IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> legacyMruFilters)
		{
			if (legacyMruFilters != null)
			{
				int num = client.GetMRUFilterListCount();
				foreach (CriteriaOperator legacyMruFilter in legacyMruFilters)
				{
					if (((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count >= num)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (MRUFilterIndex(legacyMruFilter) < 0)
					{
						((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Add(legacyMruFilter);
					}
				}
			}
			mruFilters.EndUpdate();
		}

		internal void DeleteColumnFilter(string propertyName)
		{
			ApplyFilter(propertyName, null);
		}

		internal void DeleteComplexFilter()
		{
			split.ClearComplexFilter();
			client.Filter = split.Build();
		}

		internal void ApplyFilter(string propertyName, CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			ApplyFilters(new KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator>(propertyName, filter).Yield());
		}

		internal void ApplyFilters(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator>> filters)
		{
			split.Change(filters, this);
			client.Filter = split.Build();
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator GetFilter(string fieldName)
		{
			return GetFilter(client.GetColumn(fieldName), fieldName);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator GetFilter(FilteringColumn column, string propertyName = null)
		{
			return split.GetFilter(column, propertyName);
		}

		internal FilteringUIContext(FilteringUIContextClient client)
		{
			MRUFilters = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<CriteriaOperator>((ObservableCollection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters);
			this.client = client;
			SplitFilter();
		}

		internal Tuple<object, object> GetMinMaxRange(string propertyName, bool includeFilteredOut)
		{
			object[] summaryValues = GetSummaryValues(propertyName, (SummaryItemType[])(object)new SummaryItemType[2]
			{
				(SummaryItemType)1,
				(SummaryItemType)2
			}, includeFilteredOut);
			if (summaryValues == null || !summaryValues.All((object x) => x != null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Tuple.Create(summaryValues[0], summaryValues[1]);
		}

		internal int[] GetCounts(string propertyName, IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> filters)
		{
			CriteriaOperator filter = split.Build(propertyName);
			SummaryFilterInfo[] summaries = filters.Select((CriteriaOperator x) => new SummaryFilterInfo((SummaryItemType)3, CriteriaOperator.And(filter, x), ignoreNulls: false)).ToArray();
			return GetSummaryValues(propertyName, summaries)?.Cast<int>()?.ToArray();
		}

		internal Task<UniqueValues> GetUniqueValues(string propertyName, bool includeCounts)
		{
			return GetUniqueValuesCore(propertyName, BuildExceptGroupFieldsFilter(propertyName), null, includeFilteredOut: false, includeCounts, FilterValuesThrottleMode.Forbid);
		}

		internal Task<UniqueValues> GetGroupUniqueValues(string valuesPropertyName, bool includeCounts, CriteriaOperator filter, string filterPropertyName)
		{
			return GetUniqueValuesCore(valuesPropertyName, BuildExceptGroupFieldsFilter(filterPropertyName), filter, includeFilteredOut: true, includeCounts, FilterValuesThrottleMode.Forbid);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator BuildExceptGroupFieldsFilter(string propertyName)
		{
			FilteringColumn column = GetColumn(propertyName);
			string[] array = column?.GroupFields;
			if (array == null || !array.Any())
			{
				return split.Build(propertyName);
			}
			return split.Build(column.RootFilterValuesPropertyName.Yield().Concat(array).ToArray());
		}

		internal Task<UniqueValues> GetUniqueValues(string propertyName, CriteriaOperator filter, bool includeCounts, FilterValuesThrottleMode throttleMode = FilterValuesThrottleMode.Allow)
		{
			return GetUniqueValuesCore(propertyName, filter, null, includeFilteredOut: true, includeCounts, throttleMode);
		}

		private Task<UniqueValues> GetUniqueValuesCore(string propertyName, CriteriaOperator filter, CriteriaOperator fixedFilter, bool includeFilteredOut, bool includeCounts, FilterValuesThrottleMode throttleMode)
		{
			FilteringColumn filteringColumn = client.GetColumn(propertyName);
			if (filteringColumn == null)
			{
				return UniqueValues.EmptyAsync;
			}
			bool flag = filteringColumn.ShowAllValuesInFilter();
			return filteringColumn.GetUniqueValues(flag ? fixedFilter : (filter & fixedFilter), (flag && CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(fixedFilter)) || includeFilteredOut, includeCounts ? CountsIncludeMode.Include : CountsIncludeMode.Exclude, throttleMode);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator SubstituteWholeFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return client.SubstituteFilter(filter);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator SubstituteExternalFilters(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(filter))
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<Attributed<IPredefinedFilter>> list = (from x in GetColumnForest(ColumnForestFilterMode.All).FlattenLeaves()
				select GetColumn(x.Name) into x
				where x != null
				select x).SelectMany((FilteringColumn x) => from y in x.GetSustitutedPredefinedFilters()
				select Attributed.Attribute<IPredefinedFilter>((IPredefinedFilter)(object)y, x.Name)).ToList();
			return PredefinedFiltersSubstituteHelper.Substitute(filter, (ICollection<Attributed<IPredefinedFilter>>)list, (Func<ICollection<FormatConditionFilter>>)(() => client.GetFormatConditionFilters().ToList()), client.SubstituteTopBottomFilter, false);
		}

		internal UnsubscribeAction RegisterListener(FilteringContextListener listener)
		{
			listeners.Add(listener);
			listener.FilterChanged();
			bool removed = false;
			return delegate
			{
				if (removed)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Listener already removed");
				}
				removed = true;
				listeners.Remove(listener);
			};
		}

		private void SplitFilter()
		{
			lastFilter = client.Filter;
			split = this.Split(lastFilter);
		}

		internal static List<string> ExtractProperties(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			ExtractPropertiesVisitor extractPropertiesVisitor = new ExtractPropertiesVisitor();
			if (filter != null)
			{
				filter.Accept<CriteriaOperator>((ICriteriaVisitor<CriteriaOperator>)(object)extractPropertiesVisitor);
			}
			return extractPropertiesVisitor.Properties.Distinct().ToList();
		}

		private object[] GetSummaryValues(string propertyName, SummaryItemType[] summaryTypes, bool includeFilteredOut)
		{
			CriteriaOperator filter = (includeFilteredOut ? null : split.Build(propertyName));
			return GetSummaryValues(propertyName, summaryTypes.Select((SummaryItemType x) => new SummaryFilterInfo(x, filter, ignoreNulls: true)).ToArray());
		}

		internal object[] GetSummaryValues(string propertyName, SummaryFilterInfo[] summaries)
		{
			return GetColumn(propertyName)?.GetSummaryValues(summaries);
		}

		internal FilteringColumn GetColumn(string propertyName)
		{
			return client.GetColumn(propertyName);
		}

		internal VisualFilteringColumn GetVisualColumn(string propertyName)
		{
			return client.GetVisualColumn(propertyName);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>> GetColumnForest(ColumnForestFilterMode filterMode = ColumnForestFilterMode.FilterEditorVisibleOnly)
		{
			return client.GetColumnForest(filterMode);
		}

		internal HeaderAppearance GetHeader(string name)
		{
			return GetColumnForest().FlattenLeaves().FirstOrDefault((VisualFilteringColumn x) => x.Name == name)?.GetHeaderAppearance();
		}

		internal AllowedGroupFilters GetAllowedGroupFilters()
		{
			return client.GetAllowedGroupFilters();
		}

		internal IEnumerable<FormatConditionFilter> GetFormatConditionFilters(string propertyName)
		{
			return from x in client.GetFormatConditionFilters()
				where x.Info.PropertyName == propertyName || x.ApplyToRow
				select x;
		}

		internal bool GetIsFilterEnabled()
		{
			return client.GetIsFilterEnabled();
		}

		internal bool GetAllowEditFilter()
		{
			return client.GetAllowEditFilter();
		}

		internal void NotifyEndDataUpdate()
		{
			UpdateAllListeners(delegate(FilteringContextListener x)
			{
				x.EndDataUpdate();
			});
		}

		internal void NotifyListChanged(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (notifyListChangedScheduled)
			{
				return;
			}
			notifyListChangedScheduled = true;
			Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateAllListeners(delegate(FilteringContextListener x)
				{
					x.ListChanged();
				});
				notifyListChangedScheduled = false;
			}, DispatcherPriority.Normal);
		}

		internal void SetFilter()
		{
			if (split != null && lastFilter == client.Filter)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (lastFilter != null && client.GetAllowAddMRUFilter())
			{
				((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Insert(0, lastFilter);
			}
			SplitFilter();
			if (lastFilter != null)
			{
				int num = MRUFilterIndex(lastFilter);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			if (((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count > client.GetMRUFilterListCount())
			{
				((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).RemoveAt(((Collection<CriteriaOperator>)(object)mruFilters).Count - 1);
			}
		}

		private int MRUFilterIndex(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			string lastFilterString = ((object)filter).ToString();
			return ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)mruFilters).IndexOf((CriteriaOperator x) => ((object)x).ToString() == lastFilterString);
		}

			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			if (value is string text)

				return CriteriaOperator.Parse(text, new object[0]);
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

	internal static class FilterEditorTreeBuilder
	{
		public static GroupNodeModel BuildRoot(FilteringUIContext context, Func<Func<GroupNodeModel>, NodeModelFactory> createFactory, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (context == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Locker treeIsBuildingLocker = new Locker();
			GroupNodeModel result = null;
			treeIsBuildingLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				result = LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue(delegate(Lazy<GroupNodeModel> root)
				{
					NodeModelFactory factory = createFactory(() => (!treeIsBuildingLocker.IsLocked) ? root.Value : null);
					if (CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(context.Filter))
					{
						return factory.CreateGroup(null, new NodeModelBase[0], arg3: true, addNewCriteriaToBottom);
					}
					CriteriaOperator filter = BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(context.Filter);
					NodeModelBase nodeModelBase = BuildNode(DatePeriodsFilterModelHelper.ExtractFilter(filter), isRoot: true, factory, addNewCriteriaToBottom);
					return nodeModelBase.Match((GroupNodeModel group) => group, (NodeModelBase node) => factory.CreateGroup(null, node.YieldToArray(), arg3: true, addNewCriteriaToBottom));
				});
			});
			return result;
		}

		private static NodeModelBase BuildNode(CriteriaOperator filter, bool isRoot, NodeModelFactory factory, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			return CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<GroupOperator, NodeModelBase>(filter, (Func<GroupOperator, NodeModelBase>)((GroupOperator groupOperator) => factory.CreateGroup(filter, BuildNodes((IList<CriteriaOperator>)groupOperator.Operands, factory), isRoot, addNewCriteriaToBottom)), (Func<CriteriaOperator, NodeModelBase>)((CriteriaOperator leafOperator) => factory.CreateLeaf(leafOperator) ?? CreateUnaryNotOperatorNode(filter, isRoot, factory) ?? factory.CreateCustom(leafOperator)));
		}

		private static NodeModelBase CreateUnaryNotOperatorNode(CriteriaOperator filter, bool isRoot, NodeModelFactory factory, bool addNewCriteriaToBottom = false)
		{
			return CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<UnaryOperator, NodeModelBase>(filter, (Predicate<UnaryOperator>)((UnaryOperator unaryOperator) => (int)unaryOperator.OperatorType == 3), (Func<UnaryOperator, NodeModelBase>)delegate(UnaryOperator notOperator)
			{
				IList<CriteriaOperator> operands = CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<GroupOperator, IList<CriteriaOperator>>(notOperator.Operand, (Func<GroupOperator, IList<CriteriaOperator>>)((GroupOperator groupInsideNotOperator) => (IList<CriteriaOperator>)groupInsideNotOperator.Operands), (Func<CriteriaOperator, IList<CriteriaOperator>>)((CriteriaOperator leafInsideNotOperator) => leafInsideNotOperator.YieldToArray<CriteriaOperator>()));
				return factory.CreateGroup((CriteriaOperator)(object)notOperator, BuildNodes(operands, factory), isRoot, addNewCriteriaToBottom);
			}, (Func<CriteriaOperator, NodeModelBase>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (NodeModelBase)null));
		}

		private static IList<NodeModelBase> BuildNodes(IList<CriteriaOperator> operands, NodeModelFactory factory)
		{
			return operands.Select((CriteriaOperator x) => BuildNode(x, isRoot: false, factory)).ToArray();
		}
	}

	public abstract class NodeModelBase : ViewModelBase
	{
		public abstract ICommand RemoveCommand { get; }

		internal NodeModelBase()
		{
		}

		internal T Match<T>(Func<LeafNodeModel, T> leaf, Func<GroupNodeModel, T> group, Func<CustomExpressionNodeModel, T> customExpression)
		{
			if (this is LeafNodeModel arg)
			{
				return leaf(arg);
			}
			if (this is GroupNodeModel arg2)
			{
				return group(arg2);
			}
			if (this is CustomExpressionNodeModel arg3)
			{
				return customExpression(arg3);
			}
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

		internal T Match<T>(Func<GroupNodeModel, T> group, Func<NodeModelBase, T> otherwise)
		{
			return Match((LeafNodeModel l) => otherwise(l), (GroupNodeModel g) => group(g), (CustomExpressionNodeModel ce) => otherwise(ce));
		}

		internal INavigationService GetNavigationService()
		{
			return GetService<INavigationService>();
		}
	}
	internal static class NodeModelBaseExtensions
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator BuildMinimizedFilter(this NodeModelBase node, Func<IList<NodeModelBase>, IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>> getChildrenFilters = null)
		{
			return node.Match<CriteriaOperator>((LeafNodeModel l) => l.MultiModel.With((MultiFilterModel x) => x.BuildFilter()), delegate(GroupNodeModel g)
			{
				if (g.GroupOperator == null)
				{
					return (CriteriaOperator)null;
				}
				IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> source = ((getChildrenFilters != null) ? getChildrenFilters(g.Children) : g.Children.Select((NodeModelBase x) => x.BuildMinimizedFilter()));
				CriteriaOperator[] arg = source.Where((CriteriaOperator y) => !CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(y)).ToArray();
				return g.GroupOperator.Factory(arg);
			}, (CustomExpressionNodeModel c) => c.Filter);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator BuildEvaluableFilter(this NodeModelBase node, Func<IList<NodeModelBase>, IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>> getChildrenFilters = null)
		{
			return BetweenDatesHelper.RemoveDateInRange(DatePeriodsFilterModelHelper.CompressFilter(node.BuildMinimizedFilter(getChildrenFilters)));
		}

		public static IList<NodeModelBase> GetChildren(this NodeModelBase node)
		{
			return node.Match((GroupNodeModel g) => g.Children, (NodeModelBase _) => new List<NodeModelBase>());
		}

		public static GroupNodeModel GetParent(this NodeModelBase node, GroupNodeModel root)
		{
			if (node == null || root == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (NodeModelBase child in root.GetChildren())
			{
				if (child == node)
				{
					return root;
				}
				GroupNodeModel groupNodeModel = child.Match((LeafNodeModel _) => (GroupNodeModel)null, (GroupNodeModel g) => node.GetParent(g), (CustomExpressionNodeModel _) => (GroupNodeModel)null);
				if (groupNodeModel != null)
				{
					return groupNodeModel;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal static class ColumnConfigurationInfoCalculator
	{
		public static FilterSelectorBuildInfo Calculate(FilterModelClient client)
		{
			FilteringColumn filteringColumn = client.GetColumn();
			if (filteringColumn == null)
			{
				return new FilterSelectorBuildInfo(OperatorMenuCategory.None, FilterRestrictions.None(), roundDateTime: false, Enumerable.Empty<FormatConditionFilter>(), Enumerable.Empty<PredefinedFilter>(), null, isNullable: false);
			}
			return new FilterSelectorBuildInfo(CalculateCategory(filteringColumn), filteringColumn.GetFilterRestrictions(), filteringColumn.GetRoundDateTimeFilter(), client.GetFormatConditionFilters(), filteringColumn.GetSustitutedPredefinedFilters(), filteringColumn.Name, NullableHelpers.CanAcceptNull(filteringColumn.Type));
		}

		private static OperatorMenuCategory CalculateCategory(FilteringColumn column)
		{
			BaseEditSettings editSettings = column.GetEditSettings();
			if (column.Type == typeof(bool?) || column.Type == typeof(bool))
			{
				return OperatorMenuCategory.Boolean;
			}
			if (editSettings is ComboBoxEditSettings || editSettings is ListBoxEditSettings)
			{
				return OperatorMenuCategory.Selector;
			}
			if (editSettings is ImageEditSettings || column.Type == typeof(byte[]))
			{
				return OperatorMenuCategory.Object;
			}
			if (column.Type == typeof(string))
			{
				return OperatorMenuCategory.String;
			}
			if (column.Type == typeof(DateTime?) || column.Type == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return OperatorMenuCategory.DateTime;
			}
			return OperatorMenuCategory.Numeric;
		}
	}

	internal sealed class FilterSelector<T>
	{
		public readonly Tree<T, string>[] Available;

		public readonly Func<CriteriaOperator, T> SelectItem;

		public FilterSelector(Tree<T, string>[] available, Func<CriteriaOperator, T> selectItem)
		{
			if (available == null || selectItem == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			Available = available;
			SelectItem = selectItem;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class OperatorMenuBuilderBase<TItem, TID> where TItem : class where TID : class
	{
		private FilterSelector<TItem> selectorCore;

		private OperatorMenuItemFactory<TItem, TID> Builder { get; }

		protected FilterSelectorBuildInfo Info { get; }

		private OperatorMenuItemIdentityFactoryBase<TID> IdentityFactory { get; }

		public FilterSelector<TItem> Selector
		{
			get
			{
				if (selectorCore == null)
				{
					Tree<TID, string>[] availableIds = GetAvailableIds();
					AvailableMenuItems<TItem, TID> availableItemsInfo = Builder.CreateAvailableItems(new AvailableMenuItemIdentities<TID>(availableIds, SelectDefaultID(availableIds)));
					Tree<TItem, string>[] available = availableItemsInfo.Items.Select((Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem>, string> x) => x.Transform((IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem> leaf) => leaf.Value)).ToArray();
					selectorCore = new FilterSelector<TItem>(available, (CriteriaOperator filter) => SelectItem(filter, availableItemsInfo.Items, availableItemsInfo.DefaultID));
				}
				return selectorCore;
			}
		}

		protected FilterRestrictions Restrictions => Info.Restrictions;

		protected string FieldName => Info.FieldName;

		public OperatorMenuBuilderBase(OperatorMenuItemFactory<TItem, TID> builder, FilterSelectorBuildInfo info, OperatorMenuItemIdentityFactoryBase<TID> identityFactory)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)builder, "builder");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)info, "info");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)identityFactory, "identityFactory");
			Builder = builder;
			Info = info;
			IdentityFactory = identityFactory;
		}

		private Tree<TID, string>[] GetAvailableIds()
		{
			return GetAvailableIdsInternal().Concat(GetPredefinedFormatCondition()).Concat(GetFormatConditions()).Concat(GetPredefined())
				.ToArray();
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetAvailableIdsInternal()
		{
			return Info.Category switch
			{
				OperatorMenuCategory.Selector => GetEqualityOperators().Concat(GetNullOperators()).Concat(GetAnyOfOperators()), 
				OperatorMenuCategory.Object => GetNullOperators(), 
				OperatorMenuCategory.String => GetEqualityOperators().Concat(GetComparisonOperators()).Concat(GetRangeOperators()).Concat(AddStringContentOperators())
					.Concat(GetAnyOfOperators())
					.Concat(GetBlankOperators()), 
				OperatorMenuCategory.DateTime => GetDateComparisonOperators(isRange: false).SelectMany((IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> x) => x).Concat(GetComparisonOperators()).Concat(GetDateComparisonOperators(isRange: true).SelectMany((IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> x) => x))
					.Concat(GetNullOperators())
					.Concat(GetOutlookIntervalOperators()), 
				OperatorMenuCategory.Numeric => GetEqualityOperators().Concat(GetComparisonOperators()).Concat(GetRangeOperators()).Concat(GetNullOperators())
					.Concat(GetAnyOfOperators()), 
				OperatorMenuCategory.Boolean => GetEqualityOperators().Concat(GetNullOperators()), 
				_ => Enumerable.Empty<Tree<TID, string>>(), 
			};
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetEqualityOperators()
		{
			return from type in (IEnumerable<BinaryOperatorType>)(object)new BinaryOperatorType[2]
				{
					default(BinaryOperatorType),
					(BinaryOperatorType)1
				}
				where Restrictions.Allow(type)
				select CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateBinary(type));
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetComparisonOperators()
		{
			BinaryOperatorType[] array = new BinaryOperatorType[4];
			RuntimeHelpers.InitializeArray(array, (RuntimeFieldHandle)/*OpCode not supported: LdMemberToken*/);
			return from type in (IEnumerable<BinaryOperatorType>)(object)array
				where Restrictions.Allow(type)
				select CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateBinary(type));
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetRangeOperators()
		{
			if (Restrictions.AllowedBetweenFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBetweenFilters.Between))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateBetween());
			}
			if (Restrictions.AllowedBetweenFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBetweenFilters.NotBetween))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateNotBetween());
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetAnyOfOperators()
		{
			yield break;
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetNullOperators()
		{
			if (Info.IsNullable)
			{
				if (Restrictions.AllowedUnaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateIsNull());
				}
				if (Restrictions.AllowedUnaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNotNull))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotNull());
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> AddStringContentOperators()
		{
			if (Restrictions.Allow((FunctionOperatorType)48))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)48));
			}
			if (Restrictions.AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.DoesNotContain))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateDoesNotContain());
			}
			if (Restrictions.Allow((FunctionOperatorType)46))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)46));
			}
			if (Restrictions.Allow((FunctionOperatorType)47))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)47));
			}
			if (Restrictions.AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Like))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateLike());
			}
			if (Restrictions.AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.NotLike))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateNotLike());
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetBlankOperators()
		{
			if (Restrictions.Allow((FunctionOperatorType)5))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)5));
			}
			if (Restrictions.AllowedUnaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNotNullOrEmpty))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotNullOrEmpty());
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>>> GetDateComparisonOperators(bool isRange)
		{
			if (Info.RoundDateTime)
			{
				if (Restrictions.AllowCustomDateFilters)
				{
					if (isRange)
					{
						yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateBetweenDates()).Yield();
						yield return GetIsOnDates();
					}
					else
					{
						yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateIsOnDate()).Yield();
						yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotOnDate()).Yield();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				yield return isRange ? GetRangeOperators() : GetEqualityOperators();
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetIsOnDates()
		{
			yield break;
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetOutlookIntervalOperators();

		protected abstract IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetFormatConditions();

		protected abstract IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetPredefined();

		private IEnumerable<Tree<TID, string>> GetPredefinedFormatCondition()
		{
			switch (Info.Category)
			{
			default:
				yield break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Selector:
				yield break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.DateTime:
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Numeric:
				if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top));
				}
				if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom));
				}
				if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage));
				}
				if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage))
				{
					yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage));
				}
				break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Object:
			case OperatorMenuCategory.String:
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Boolean:
				break;
			}
			if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique));
			}
			if (Info.Restrictions.Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate))
			{
				yield return CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate));
			}
		}

		protected static Tree<TID, string> CreateID(TID id)
		{
			return Tree<TID, string>.CreateLeaf(id);
		}

		protected static Tree<TID, string> CreateGroup(string groupName, TID[] ids)
		{
			if (ids == null || ids.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ids.Length == 1)
			{
				return CreateID(ids[0]);
			}
			Tree<TID, string>[] children = ids.Select(Tree<TID, string>.CreateLeaf).ToArray();
			return Tree<TID, string>.CreateGroup(groupName, children);
		}

		protected static string GetString(EditorStringId id)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return EditorLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		private TItem SelectItem(CriteriaOperator filter, Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem>, string>[] available, TID defaultID)
		{
			TID id = SelectID(filter, available, defaultID);
			if (id == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem> identifiedOperatorMenuItem = available.FlattenLeaves().FirstOrDefault((IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem> x) => x.ID.Equals(id));
			return ((identifiedOperatorMenuItem != null) ? identifiedOperatorMenuItem.Value : null) ?? Builder.CreateNonAvailableItem(id);
		}

		protected virtual TID SelectID(CriteriaOperator filter, Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem>, string>[] available, TID defaultID)
		{
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Info.PredefinedFilters.Any())
			{
				string[] predefinedNames = (from x in PredefinedFiltersModel.GetPredefinedFilters(filter)
					where x != null
					select x).ToArray();
				TID val = SelectPredefinedID(predefinedNames);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val;
				}
			}
			if (Info.FormatConditionFilters.Any())
			{
				Func<FormatConditionFilter, bool> formatConditionFilterChecker = FormatConditionFilterModel.GetFormatConditionFilterChecker(filter);
				TID val2 = SelectFormatConditionID(Info.FormatConditionFilters.Where(formatConditionFilterChecker).ToArray());
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					return val2;
				}
			}
			if (filter is FunctionOperator)
			{
				FormatConditionFilterInfo topBottomFilterInfo = FormatConditionFiltersHelper.GetTopBottomFilterInfo((FunctionOperator)filter);
				if (topBottomFilterInfo != null && topBottomFilterInfo.Type.IsPredefinedFormatCondition())
				{
					return SelectPredefinedFormatConditionID(topBottomFilterInfo.Type.ToPredefinedFormatConditionType());
				}
			}
			return FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.MapExtended<TID>(filter, (Func<string, ValueData, BinaryOperatorType, Option<TID>>)((string _, ValueData valueData, BinaryOperatorType type) => IdentityFactory.CreateBinary(type).ToOption()), (UnaryOperatorMapper<TID>)(object)(UnaryOperatorMapper<?>)((string _, UnaryOperatorType type) => ((int)type != 4) ? null : IdentityFactory.CreateIsNull()), (Func<string, ValueData[], Option<TID>>)((string _, ValueData[] __) => SelectIn().ToOption()), (Func<string, ValueData, ValueData, Option<TID>>)((string _, ValueData __, ValueData ___) => IdentityFactory.CreateBetween().ToOption()), (Func<string, ValueData[], FunctionOperatorType, Option<TID>>)delegate(string propertyName, ValueData[] valuesData, FunctionOperatorType type)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0051: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (BetweenDatesHelper.IsBetweenDatesFunction(valuesData, type))
				{
					return IdentityFactory.CreateBetweenDates().ToOption();
				}
				if (BetweenDatesHelper.IsIsOnDatesFunction(valuesData, type))
				{
					if (valuesData.Skip(1).Count() == 1)
					{
						return IdentityFactory.CreateIsOnDate().ToOption();
					}
					return SelectIsOnDates().ToOption();
				}
				if ((int)type == 1)
				{
					ValueData obj = valuesData.FirstOrDefault();
					string text = ((obj != null) ? ValueDataExtensions.ToValue(obj) : null) as string;
					if (CustomFunctionHelper.IsLikeCustomFunction(text))
					{
						return IdentityFactory.CreateLike().ToOption();
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) || CustomFunctionHelper.GetCustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable(text) == null)
					{
						return Option<TID>.Empty;
					}
					return IdentityFactory.CreateCustom(text).ToOption();
				}
				return IdentityFactory.CreateFunction(type).ToOption();
			}, (GroupOperatorMapper<TID>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<TID>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<TID>)(object)new NotOperatorMapper<?>(SelectNot), (FallbackMapper<TID>)(object)(FallbackMapper<?>)((CriteriaOperator _) => (TID)null), (NullMapper<TID>)(object)(NullMapper<?>)(() => defaultID));
		}

		protected virtual TID SelectIsOnDates()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual TID SelectIn()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual TID SelectNot(TID identity)
		{
			if (identity == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (identity.Equals(IdentityFactory.CreateBetween()))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateNotBetween();
			}
			if (identity.Equals(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)48)))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateDoesNotContain();
			}
			if (identity.Equals(IdentityFactory.CreateIsNull()))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotNull();
			}
			if (identity.Equals(IdentityFactory.CreateIsOnDate()))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotOnDate();
			}
			if (identity.Equals(IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)5)))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotNullOrEmpty();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected abstract TID SelectPredefinedID(string[] predefinedNames);

		protected abstract TID SelectFormatConditionID(FormatConditionFilter[] formatConditionFilters);

		private TID SelectPredefinedFormatConditionID(PredefinedFormatConditionType type)
		{
			return IdentityFactory.CreatePredefinedFormatCondition(type);
		}

		protected virtual TID SelectDefaultID(Tree<TID, string>[] available)
		{
			TID val = null;
			switch (Info.Category)
			{
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Object:
				val = IdentityFactory.CreateIsNull();
				break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.String:
				val = IdentityFactory.CreateFunction((FunctionOperatorType)46);
				break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.DateTime:
				val = (Info.RoundDateTime ? IdentityFactory.CreateIsOnDate() : IdentityFactory.CreateIsNotOnDate());
				break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Selector:
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Numeric:
				val = IdentityFactory.CreateBinary((BinaryOperatorType)0);
				break;
			case OperatorMenuCategory.Boolean:
				val = IdentityFactory.CreateBinary((BinaryOperatorType)0);
				break;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			IEnumerable<TID> source = available.FlattenLeaves();
			if (val == null || !source.Contains(val))
			{
				return source.FirstOrDefault();
			}
			return val;
		}
	}

		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetFormatConditions()
		{
			if (base.Restrictions.AllowedFormatConditionFilters == AllowedFormatConditionFilters.None)
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>>();
			}
			FormatConditionFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity[] ids = base.Info.FormatConditionFilters.Select((FormatConditionFilter x) => new FormatConditionFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity(x)).ToArray();

		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetPredefined()
		{
			PredefinedFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity[] ids = base.Info.PredefinedFilters.Select((PredefinedFilter x) => new PredefinedFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity(x.Name)).ToArray();

		}

		protected override IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectPredefinedID(string[] predefinedNames)
		{
			if (predefinedNames.Length != 1)

		}

		protected override IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectFormatConditionID(FormatConditionFilter[] formatConditionFilters)
		{
			if (formatConditionFilters.Length != 1)

		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetOutlookIntervalOperators()
		{
			FunctionOperatorType[] array = new FunctionOperatorType[13];
			RuntimeHelpers.InitializeArray(array, (RuntimeFieldHandle)/*OpCode not supported: LdMemberToken*/);
			FunctionOperatorType[] source = (FunctionOperatorType[])(object)array;
			IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity[] ids = (from type in source
				where base.Restrictions.Allow(type)
				select IdentityFactory.CreateFunction(type)).ToArray();
			return OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.CreateGroup(OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.GetString((EditorStringId)399), ids).Return((Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string> x) => x.Yield(), () => Enumerable.Empty<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>>());
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetAnyOfOperators()
		{
			if (Restrictions.AllowedAnyOfFilters.HasFlag(AllowedAnyOfFilters.AnyOf))

				yield return OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateAnyOf());

			if (Restrictions.AllowedAnyOfFilters.HasFlag(AllowedAnyOfFilters.NoneOf))

		protected override IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectIsOnDates()

	internal sealed class MultiElementOperatorMenuBuilder<T> : OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity> where T : class
	{
		private ExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentityFactory IdentityFactory { get; }

		private bool HasPredefinedFilter => base.Info.PredefinedFilters.Any();

		private bool HasFormatConditions => base.Info.FormatConditionFilters.Any();

		public MultiElementOperatorMenuBuilder(OperatorMenuItemFactory<T, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity> builder, FilterSelectorBuildInfo info, ExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentityFactory identityFactory)
			: base(builder, info, (OperatorMenuItemIdentityFactoryBase<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity>)identityFactory)
		{
			IdentityFactory = identityFactory;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetFormatConditions()
		{
			if (Restrictions.AllowedFormatConditionFilters == AllowedFormatConditionFilters.All && HasFormatConditions)
			{
				yield return OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateFormatConditions());
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetPredefined()
		{
			if (HasPredefinedFilter)
			{
				yield return OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreatePredefined());
			}
		}

		protected override IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectPredefinedID(string[] predefinedNames)
		{
			if (!predefinedNames.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return IdentityFactory.CreatePredefined();
		}

		protected override IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectFormatConditionID(FormatConditionFilter[] formatConditionFilters)
		{
			if (!formatConditionFilters.Any())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return IdentityFactory.CreateFormatConditions();
		}

		protected override IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectDefaultID(Tree<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>[] available)
		{
			if (HasPredefinedFilter)
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreatePredefined();
			}
			return base.SelectDefaultID(available);
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<Tree<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, string>> GetOutlookIntervalOperators()
		{
			if (Restrictions.AllowedDateTimeFilters != AllowedDateTimeFilters.None)
			{
				yield return OperatorMenuBuilderBase<T, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity>.CreateID(IdentityFactory.CreateDateOperators());
			}
		}

		protected override IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity SelectID(CriteriaOperator filter, Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, T>, string>[] available, IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity defaultID)
		{
			if (IsDateTimeOperatorsFilter(filter, base.Restrictions, base.FieldName))
			{
				return IdentityFactory.CreateDateOperators();
			}
			return base.SelectID(filter, available, defaultID);
		}

		private static bool IsDateTimeOperatorsFilter(CriteriaOperator filter, FilterRestrictions restrictions, string fieldName)
		{
			FilterDateType[] filters = DatePeriodsFilterModel.GetFilters(restrictions.AllowedDateTimeFilters);
			if (filters.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return filter.ToFilters(fieldName).Intersect(filters).Any();
		}
	}

	internal sealed class OperatorMenuItemFactoryImplementation<TItem, TID> where TItem : class where TID : class
	{
		private readonly Func<TID, TItem> createItem;

		private OperatorMenuItemFactory<TItem, TID> factoryCore;

		public OperatorMenuItemFactory<TItem, TID> Factory
		{
			get
			{
				if (factoryCore == null)
				{
					factoryCore = new OperatorMenuItemFactory<TItem, TID>(CreateAvailableItems, createItem);
				}
				return factoryCore;
			}
		}

		public OperatorMenuItemFactoryImplementation(Func<TID, TItem> createItem)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)createItem, "createItem");
			this.createItem = createItem;
		}

		private AvailableMenuItems<TItem, TID> CreateAvailableItems(AvailableMenuItemIdentities<TID> ids)
		{
			Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem>, string>[] items = ids.Identities.Transform((TID id) => new IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, TItem>(id, createItem(id))).ToArray();
			TID defaultID = ids.DefaultID;
			return new AvailableMenuItems<TItem, TID>(items, defaultID);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class MultiFilterOperatorMenuSubstitutionDecorator<TID, TOP> where TID : class where TOP : class
	{
		private readonly OperatorMenuItemFactory<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> component;

		private readonly Func<OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP>, OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP>> substituteOperatorMenuItems;

		private readonly OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<TID, TOP> provider;

		private OperatorMenuItemFactory<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> factoryCore;

		public OperatorMenuItemFactory<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> Factory
		{
			get
			{
				if (factoryCore == null)
				{
					factoryCore = new OperatorMenuItemFactory<MultiFilterModelItem, TID>(CreateAvailableItems, component.CreateNonAvailableItem);
				}
				return factoryCore;
			}
		}

		public MultiFilterOperatorMenuSubstitutionDecorator(OperatorMenuItemFactory<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> component, Func<OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP>, OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP>> substituteOperatorMenuItems, OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<TID, TOP> provider)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)component, "component");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)substituteOperatorMenuItems, "substituteOperatorMenuItems");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)provider, "provider");
			this.component = component;
			this.substituteOperatorMenuItems = substituteOperatorMenuItems;
			this.provider = provider;
		}

		private AvailableMenuItems<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> CreateAvailableItems(AvailableMenuItemIdentities<TID> identities)
		{
			AvailableMenuItems<MultiFilterModelItem, TID> availableMenuItems = component.CreateAvailableItems(identities);
			TOP[] array = CreateUserOperatorItems(availableMenuItems.Items).ToArray();
			OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP> arg = new OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP>(array, GetDefaultOperatorItem(array, availableMenuItems.DefaultID));
			arg = substituteOperatorMenuItems(arg);
			return new AvailableMenuItems<MultiFilterModelItem, TID>(CreateMultiModelItems(arg.List), GetDefaultID(arg));
		}

		private TOP[] CreateUserOperatorItems(Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string>[] forest)
		{
			return forest.Transform((IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem> leaf) => provider.CreateOperatorInfo(leaf).Yield(), (string group, IEnumerable<IEnumerable<TOP>> children) => children.SelectMany((IEnumerable<TOP> child) => child.Select((TOP operatorItem) => provider.UpdateGroupName(operatorItem, group)))).SelectMany((IEnumerable<TOP> x) => x).ToArray();
		}

		private TOP GetDefaultOperatorItem(IList<TOP> items, TID id)
		{
			return items.FirstOrDefault((TOP x) => object.Equals(provider.GetOperatorInfoID(x), id));
		}

		private TID GetDefaultID(OperatorMenuItemsSubstitutionInfo<TOP> info)
		{
			TOP defaultItem = info.DefaultItem;
			if (defaultItem == null || !info.List.Contains(defaultItem))
			{
				return info.List.FirstOrDefault().With((TOP x) => provider.GetOperatorInfoID(x));
			}
			return provider.GetOperatorInfoID(defaultItem);
		}

		private Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string>[] CreateMultiModelItems(IList<TOP> userOperatorItems)
		{
			return userOperatorItems.GroupBy(provider.GetGroupName).SelectMany(CreateMultiModelItems).ToArray();
		}

		private IEnumerable<Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string>> CreateMultiModelItems(IGrouping<string, TOP> group)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.Key))
			{
				return group.Select((TOP x) => CreateMultiModelItemTree(x));
			}
			return Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string>.CreateGroup(group.Key, group.Select((TOP z) => CreateMultiModelItemTree(z)).ToArray()).Yield();
		}

		private Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string> CreateMultiModelItemTree(TOP item)
		{
			return Tree<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, string>.CreateLeaf(new IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>(provider.GetOperatorInfoID(item), provider.CreateMultiModelItem(item)));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<TID, TOP> where TID : class
	{
		public Func<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, TOP> CreateOperatorInfo { get; }

		public Func<TOP, string, TOP> UpdateGroupName { get; }

		public Func<TOP, string> GetGroupName { get; }

		public Func<TOP, TID> GetOperatorInfoID { get; }

		public Func<TOP, MultiFilterModelItem> CreateMultiModelItem { get; }

		public OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider(Func<IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<TID, MultiFilterModelItem>, TOP> createOperatorInfo, Func<TOP, string, TOP> updateGroupName, Func<TOP, string> getGroupName, Func<TOP, TID> getOperatorInfoID, Func<TOP, MultiFilterModelItem> createMultiModelItem)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)createOperatorInfo, "createOperatorInfo");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)updateGroupName, "updateGroupName");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getGroupName, "getGroupName");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getOperatorInfoID, "getOperatorInfoID");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)createMultiModelItem, "createMultiModelItem");
			CreateOperatorInfo = createOperatorInfo;
			UpdateGroupName = updateGroupName;
			GetGroupName = getGroupName;
			GetOperatorInfoID = getOperatorInfoID;
			CreateMultiModelItem = createMultiModelItem;
		}
	}
	internal static class OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProviders
	{
		internal static OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, FilterEditorOperatorItem> FilterEditor(Func<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> createItem)
		{
			return new OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, FilterEditorOperatorItem>((IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<IFilterEditorOperatorMenuItemIdentity, MultiFilterModelItem> x) => new FilterEditorOperatorItem(x.ID, null)
			{
				Caption = x.Value.DisplayName,
				Image = x.Value.Icon
			}, delegate(FilterEditorOperatorItem x, string newGroupName)
			{
				x.GroupName = newGroupName;
				return x;
			}, (FilterEditorOperatorItem x) => x.GroupName, (FilterEditorOperatorItem x) => x.ID, (FilterEditorOperatorItem x) => CreateMultiFilterModelItem(createItem, x, x.ID));
		}

		internal static OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem> ExcelStyle(Func<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> createItem)
		{
			return new OperatorItemSubstitutionInfoProvider<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem>((IdentifiedOperatorMenuItem<IExcelStyleOperatorMenuItemIdentity, MultiFilterModelItem> x) => new ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem(x.ID, null)
			{
				Caption = x.Value.DisplayName,
				Image = x.Value.Icon
			}, (ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem x, string _) => x, (ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem x) => string.Empty, (ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem x) => x.ID, (ExcelStyleFilterElementOperatorItem x) => CreateMultiFilterModelItem(createItem, x, x.ID));
		}

		private static MultiFilterModelItem CreateMultiFilterModelItem<TID>(Func<TID, BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> createItem, OperatorItemBase operatorItem, TID id) where TID : class
		{
			MultiFilterModelItem multiFilterModelItem = createItem(id, operatorItem.EditSettings);
			Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate> selectTemplate = ((operatorItem.OperandTemplate == null) ? multiFilterModelItem.SelectTemplate : ((Func<FilterModelBase, DataTemplate>)((FilterModelBase _) => operatorItem.OperandTemplate)));
			return new MultiFilterModelItem(operatorItem.Caption ?? multiFilterModelItem.DisplayName, multiFilterModelItem.Factory, operatorItem.Image ?? multiFilterModelItem.Icon, multiFilterModelItem.FormatCondition, selectTemplate);
		}
	}
