		public abstract MultiFilterModelItem Create(TID id, BaseEditSettings[] editSettings = null);

		protected Func<BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> CreateBuiltIn(TID id)
		{
			Func<BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> value = null;
			if (builtInOperators.TryGetValue(id, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return (BaseEditSettings[] _) => (MultiFilterModelItem)null;
		}

		protected Func<BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> CreateBuiltIn(EditorStringId displayNameId, Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> factory, string imageName)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (BaseEditSettings[] editSettings) => new MultiFilterModelItem(EditorLocalizer.GetString(displayNameId), factory(editSettings), FilterImageProvider.GetImage(imageName), null, selectTemplate);
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> BinaryFactory(FilterModelValueItemInfo info, BinaryOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return BinaryFactory(info, CriteriaConverterFactory.CreateBinary(type));
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> BinaryFactory(FilterModelValueItemInfo info, FunctionOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return BinaryFactory(info, CriteriaConverterFactory.CreateBinaryFunction(type));
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> BinaryFactory(FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<ValueData> converter)
		{
			return (BaseEditSettings[] editSettings) => OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Binary((FilterModelClient client) => new BinaryFilterModel(client, info, converter, CreateSettings(client, 0, editSettings)));
		}

		protected static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> UnaryFunctionFactory(FunctionOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return UnaryFactory((FilterModelClient client) => ConstantFilterModel.CreateFunction(client, type));
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> UnaryFactory(Func<FilterModelClient, FilterModel> createModel)
		{
			return (BaseEditSettings[] _) => OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Default(createModel);
		}

		private static Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> TernaryFactory(FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>> converter)
		{
			return (BaseEditSettings[] editSettings) => OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Ternary((FilterModelClient client) => new TernaryFilterModel(client, info, converter, CreateSettings(client, 0, editSettings), CreateSettings(client, 1, editSettings)));
		}

		protected Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> VariadicFactory(FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<ValueData[]> converter)
		{
			return (BaseEditSettings[] editSettings) => OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Variadic(delegate(FilterModelClient client)
			{
				int? fixedOperandCount = null;
				Func<int, EditSettingsInfo> createEditSettings = null;
				if (editSettings != null && editSettings.Length != 0)
				{
					fixedOperandCount = editSettings.Length;
					createEditSettings = (int index) => CreateSettings(client, index, editSettings);
				}
				return new VariadicFilterModel(client, info, converter, operandListObserver, fixedOperandCount, createEditSettings);
			});
		}

		protected Func<BaseEditSettings[], MultiFilterModelItem> CreateCustom(CustomOperatorMenuItemIdentity id)
		{
			return delegate(BaseEditSettings[] editSettings)
			{
				string name = id.Name;
				return new MultiFilterModelItem(name, CreateCustomFactory(name)(editSettings), null, null, selectTemplate);
			};
		}

		private Func<BaseEditSettings[], OperandRestoreAdapterFactory> CreateCustomFactory(string customName)
		{
			return delegate(BaseEditSettings[] editSettings)
			{
				ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable customFunctionOperatorBrowsable = CustomFunctionHelper.GetCustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable(customName);
				if (customFunctionOperatorBrowsable == null)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException($"The {customName} is not registered. Register it with the CriteriaOperator.RegisterCustomFunction method.");
				}
				if (customFunctionOperatorBrowsable.MinOperandCount != customFunctionOperatorBrowsable.MaxOperandCount || !customFunctionOperatorBrowsable.IsValidOperandCount(customFunctionOperatorBrowsable.MaxOperandCount))
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("You cannot edit a custom function with unequal the MinOperandCount and MaxOperandCount properties.");
				}
				int operandCountIncludingPropertyValue = customFunctionOperatorBrowsable.MaxOperandCount;
				if (operandCountIncludingPropertyValue == 0)
				{
					return OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Default((FilterModelClient client) => ConstantFilterModel.CreateFilter(client, (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator(customName, Enumerable.Empty<CriteriaOperator>())));
				}
				if (operandCountIncludingPropertyValue == 1)
				{
					return OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Default((FilterModelClient client) => ConstantFilterModel.CreateFilter(client, (CriteriaOperator)new FunctionOperator(customName, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[1] { (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(client.PropertyName) })));
				}
				if (operandCountIncludingPropertyValue == 2)
				{
					return OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Binary((FilterModelClient client) => new BinaryFilterModel(client, null, CriteriaConverterFactory.CreateCustomBinaryFunction(customName), CreateSettings(client, 0, editSettings)));
				}
				return (operandCountIncludingPropertyValue == 3) ? OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Ternary((FilterModelClient client) => new TernaryFilterModel(client, null, CriteriaConverterFactory.CreateCustomTernaryFunction(customName), CreateSettings(client, 0, editSettings), CreateSettings(client, 1, editSettings))) : OperandRestoreAdapterFactories.Default((FilterModelClient client) => new VariadicFilterModel(client, null, CriteriaConverterFactory.CreateCustomVariadicFunction(customName), operandListObserver, operandCountIncludingPropertyValue - 1, (int index) => CreateSettings(client, index, editSettings)));
			};
		}

		private static EditSettingsInfo CreateSettings(FilterModelClient client, int index, BaseEditSettings[] editSettings)
		{
			if (editSettings == null || index < 0 || index >= editSettings.Length)
			{
				return EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(client.GetColumn());
			}
			return editSettings[index].With((BaseEditSettings settings) => EditSettingsInfo.CreateUserDefined(settings)) ?? EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(client.GetColumn());
		}
	}

	public class BinaryFilterModel : CriteriaConverterFilterModelBase<ValueData>
	{
		public FilterModelValueItem ValueItem { get; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return ValueItem.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ValueItem.Value != value)
				{
					ValueItem.Value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal BinaryFilterModel(FilterModelClient client, FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<ValueData> converter, EditSettingsInfo editSettings = null)
			: base(client, converter)
		{
			ValueItem = new FilterModelValueItem(client.GetColumn().Type, 0, editSettings ?? EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(Column), info, delegate
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Value");
				ApplyFilter();
			});
		}

		protected internal override ValueData CreateConverterValue()
		{
			return ValueItem.ToValueData();
		}

		protected override void UpdateFromConverterValue(ValueData value)
		{
			ValueItem.Update(value);
		}
	}

		}

		private static ValueData FixNull(this ValueData valueData)
		{
			if (valueData == null || valueData.IsNull)
			{
				return ValueData.NullValue;
			}
			return valueData;
		}

		private static Func<CriteriaOperator, T> Not<T>(Func<CriteriaOperator, T> criteriaToValue)
		{
			return (CriteriaOperator filter) => (!CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(filter)) ? CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<UnaryOperator, T>(filter, (Predicate<UnaryOperator>)((UnaryOperator unaryOperator) => (int)unaryOperator.OperatorType == 3), (Func<UnaryOperator, T>)((UnaryOperator unaryOperator) => criteriaToValue(unaryOperator.Operand)), (Func<CriteriaOperator, T>)((CriteriaOperator _) => InvalidFilterMap<T>())) : criteriaToValue(null);
		}

		private static Func<T, string, CriteriaOperator> Not<T>(Func<T, string, CriteriaOperator> valueToCriteria)
		{
			return (T obj, string propertyName) => (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)3, valueToCriteria(obj, propertyName));
		}

		private static T InvalidFilterMap<T>()
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}

	public abstract class CriteriaConverterFilterModelBase<T> : FilterModel
	{
		private readonly CriteriaConverter<T> converter;

		protected override bool IncludeNullValues => false;

		internal CriteriaConverterFilterModelBase(FilterModelClient client, CriteriaConverter<T> converter)
			: base(client)
		{
			this.converter = converter;
		}

		internal sealed override async Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			await base.UpdateCoreAsync();
			UpdateFromConverterValue(converter.ToValue(Filter));
		}

		protected internal abstract T CreateConverterValue();

		protected abstract void UpdateFromConverterValue(T value);

		internal sealed override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			return BuildFilter(CreateConverterValue());
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator BuildFilter(T converterValue)
		{
			return converter.ToCriteria(converterValue, base.PropertyName);
		}

		internal sealed override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return converter.CanBuildFilter(Column.GetFilterRestrictions());
		}

		internal sealed override void BeginUpdateCountedValues(ObservableCollectionCore<FilterValueInfo> filterValues)
		{
			filterValues.BeginUpdate();
		}

		internal sealed override void EndUpdateCountedValues(ObservableCollectionCore<FilterValueInfo> filterValues)
		{
			filterValues.EndUpdate();
		}
	}
	internal class CriteriaConverter<T>
	{
		public readonly Func<CriteriaOperator, T> ToValue;

		public readonly Func<T, string, CriteriaOperator> ToCriteria;

		public readonly Func<FilterRestrictions, bool> CanBuildFilter;

		public CriteriaConverter(Func<CriteriaOperator, T> toValue, Func<T, string, CriteriaOperator> toCriteria, Func<FilterRestrictions, bool> canBuildFilter)
		{
			ToValue = toValue;
			ToCriteria = toCriteria;
			CanBuildFilter = canBuildFilter;
		}
	}
	public class MultiFilterModel : FilterModelBase
	{
		private sealed class MultiFilterModelTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
		{
			private readonly Func<object, DataTemplate> selectTemplate;

			internal MultiFilterModelTemplateSelector(Func<object, DataTemplate> selectTemplate)
			{
				this.selectTemplate = selectTemplate;
			}

			public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
			{
				return selectTemplate(item);
			}
		}

		private readonly FilterSelector<MultiFilterModelItem> selector;

		private readonly bool applyEmptyFilter;

		private OperandValuesRecord memorizedOperandValues = OperandValuesRecord.CreateEmpty();

		private Locker operandValuesLocker = new Locker();

		private FilterModelOperandRestoreAdapter operandRestoreAdapter;

		public MultiFilterModelItem[] Items { get; private set; }

		public MultiFilterModelItem SelectedItem
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => SelectedItem);
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty(() => SelectedItem, value, OnSelectedItemChanged);
			}
		}

		public FilterModelBase Model
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => Model);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(() => Model, value);
			}
		}

		public DataTemplateSelector ModelTemplateSelector
		{
			get
			{
				return GetProperty(() => ModelTemplateSelector);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetProperty(() => ModelTemplateSelector, value);
			}
		}

		public MenuItemBase[] ItemsMenu { get; }

		internal MultiFilterModel(FilterSelector<MultiFilterModelItem> selector, FilterModelClient client, bool applyEmptyFilter)
			: base(client)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (selector == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.selector = selector;
			this.applyEmptyFilter = applyEmptyFilter;
			Items = selector.Available.FlattenLeaves().ToArray();
			ItemsMenu = CreateItemsMenu(selector.Available, delegate(MultiFilterModelItem item)
			{
				SelectedItem = item;
			});
			ModelTemplateSelector = new MultiFilterModelTemplateSelector((object model) => SelectedItem?.SelectTemplate(model as FilterModelBase));
		}

		private FilterModelClient CreateNestedFilterClient()
		{
			Action<Lazy<CriteriaOperator>> applyFilter = delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> x)
			{
				UpdateMemorizedOperandValues();
				if (applyEmptyFilter || !HasEmptyValues(x.Value))
				{
					ApplyFilter(x.Select((Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>)BetweenDatesHelper.RemoveDateInRange));
				}
				else
				{
					ApplyFilter(new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => (CriteriaOperator)null));
				}
			};
			return client.Update(applyFilter);
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemChanged(MultiFilterModelItem oldSelectedItem)
		{
			FilterModelBase model = Model;
			operandValuesLocker.DoLockedAction<FilterModelOperandRestoreAdapter>((Func<FilterModelOperandRestoreAdapter>)(() => operandRestoreAdapter = SelectedItem?.Factory(CreateNestedFilterClient())));
			Model = operandRestoreAdapter?.Model;
			if (Model != null)
			{
				Model.ShowCounts = base.ShowCounts;
				Model.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues = base.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues;
				Model.AllowLiveDataShaping = base.AllowLiveDataShaping;
				if (model != null)
				{
					Model.FilterValuesSortMode = model.FilterValuesSortMode;
				}
				operandRestoreAdapter.Restore(memorizedOperandValues);
				operandValuesLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)Model.ApplyFilter);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMemorizedOperandValues()
		{
			if (!operandValuesLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				OperandValuesRecord operandValuesRecord = operandRestoreAdapter?.Save();
				if (operandValuesRecord != null)
				{
					memorizedOperandValues = operandValuesRecord;
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool HasEmptyValues(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.Map<bool>(filter, (BinaryOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, object value, BinaryOperatorType __) => IsEmptyValue(value)), (UnaryOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (InOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, object[] values) => values.Any(IsEmptyValue)), (BetweenOperatorMapper<bool>)((string _, object beginValue, object endValue) => IsEmptyValue(beginValue) || IsEmptyValue(endValue)), (FunctionOperatorMapper<bool>)((string propertyName, object[] values, FunctionOperatorType type) => values.Any(IsEmptyValue)), (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<bool>)((bool val) => val), (FallbackMapper<bool>)((CriteriaOperator _) => false), (NullMapper<bool>)null);
		}

		private static bool IsEmptyValue(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value as string == string.Empty;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static MenuItemBase[] CreateItemsMenu(IEnumerable<Tree<MultiFilterModelItem, string>> containers, Action<MultiFilterModelItem> select)
		{
			return containers.Select((Tree<MultiFilterModelItem, string> x) => x.Match((Func<MultiFilterModelItem, MenuItemBase>)((MultiFilterModelItem leaf) => new MenuItem(leaf.DisplayName, leaf.Icon, leaf.FormatCondition, delegate
			{
				select(leaf);
			})), (Func<string, IList<Tree<MultiFilterModelItem, string>>, MenuItemBase>)((string group, IList<Tree<MultiFilterModelItem, string>> children) => new MenuItemGroup(group, null, CreateItemsMenu(children, select))))).ToArray();
		}

		internal override Task UpdateCoreAsync()
		{
			if (Items.Length == 0)
			{
				return FilteringUIExtensions.CompletedTask;
			}
			memorizedOperandValues = OperandValuesRecord.CreateEmpty();
			if (SelectedItem != null && CriteriaProcessingExtensions.ReferenceEqualsNull(base.Filter) && HasEmptyValues(Model.BuildFilter()))
			{
				return FilteringUIExtensions.CompletedTask;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(base.Filter);
			MultiFilterModelItem multiFilterModelItem = selector.SelectItem(val);
			if (multiFilterModelItem == null)
			{
				val = null;
				multiFilterModelItem = selector.SelectItem(val);
			}
			if (multiFilterModelItem == null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			SelectedItem = multiFilterModelItem;
			Model?.Update(val);
			UpdateMemorizedOperandValues();
			return FilteringUIExtensions.CompletedTask;
		}

		internal bool CanUpdate(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			MultiFilterModelItem multiFilterModelItem = selector.SelectItem(BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(filter));
			if (multiFilterModelItem != null)
			{
				return Items.Contains(multiFilterModelItem);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanSelectItem(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return selector.SelectItem(filter) != null;
		}

		internal override CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			return Model.With((FilterModelBase x) => x.BuildFilter());
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilterCore()
		{
			return Items.Length != 0;
		}

		protected sealed override void UpdateShowCounts()
		{
			Model.Do(delegate(FilterModelBase x)
			{
				x.ShowCounts = base.ShowCounts;
			});
		}

		protected sealed override void UpdateShowAllLookUpFilterValues()
		{
			Model.Do(delegate(FilterModelBase x)
			{
				x.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues = base.ShowAllLookUpFilterValues;
			});
		}

		protected override void UpdateAllowLiveDataShaping()
		{
			Model.Do(delegate(FilterModelBase x)
			{
				x.AllowLiveDataShaping = base.AllowLiveDataShaping;
			});
		}
	}

	public class TernaryFilterModel : CriteriaConverterFilterModelBase<Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>>
	{
		public FilterModelValueItem LeftValueItem { get; }

		public FilterModelValueItem RightValueItem { get; }

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object Left
		{
			get
			{
				return LeftValueItem.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (LeftValueItem.Value != value)
				{
					LeftValueItem.Value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public object Right
		{
			get
			{
				return RightValueItem.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (RightValueItem.Value != value)
				{
					RightValueItem.Value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal TernaryFilterModel(FilterModelClient client, FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>> converter, EditSettingsInfo leftEditSettings = null, EditSettingsInfo rightEditSettings = null)
			: base(client, converter)
		{
			LeftValueItem = new FilterModelValueItem(client.GetColumn().Type, 0, leftEditSettings ?? EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(Column), info, delegate
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Left");
				ApplyFilter();
			});
			RightValueItem = new FilterModelValueItem(client.GetColumn().Type, 1, rightEditSettings ?? EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(Column), info, delegate
			{
				RaisePropertyChanged("Right");
				ApplyFilter();
			});
		}

		protected internal override Tuple<ValueData, ValueData> CreateConverterValue()
		{
			return new Tuple<ValueData, ValueData>(LeftValueItem.ToValueData(), RightValueItem.ToValueData());
		}

		protected override void UpdateFromConverterValue(Tuple<ValueData, ValueData> value)
		{
			LeftValueItem.Update(value?.Item1);
			RightValueItem.Update(value?.Item2);
		}
	}

	public class VariadicFilterModel : CriteriaConverterFilterModelBase<ValueData[]>
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollectionCore<FilterModelValueItem> itemsCore;

		private readonly OperandListObserver<FilterModelBase> operandListObserver;

		private readonly Func<int, EditSettingsInfo> createEditSettings;

		private readonly int? fixedOperandCount;

		private readonly FilterModelValueItemInfo info;

		public ICommand AddCommand { get; }

		public IList<FilterModelValueItem> Items { get; }

		internal VariadicFilterModel(FilterModelClient client, FilterModelValueItemInfo info, CriteriaConverter<ValueData[]> converter, OperandListObserver<FilterModelBase> operandListObserver = null, int? fixedOperandCount = null, Func<int, EditSettingsInfo> createEditSettings = null)
			: base(client, converter)
		{
			this.fixedOperandCount = fixedOperandCount;
			this.createEditSettings = createEditSettings ?? ((Func<int, EditSettingsInfo>)((int _) => EditSettingsInfoFactory.Default(Column)));
			this.operandListObserver = operandListObserver ?? OperandListObserver<FilterModelBase>.Empty();
			this.info = info;
			itemsCore = new ObservableCollectionCore<FilterModelValueItem>();
			((ObservableCollection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore).CollectionChanged += OnItemsCollectionChanged;
			Items = new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<FilterModelValueItem>((ObservableCollection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore);
			AddCommand = new DelegateCommand(AddNewValue, () => !fixedOperandCount.HasValue);
		}

		private void AddNewValue()
		{
			operandListObserver.OnAdding(this);
			((Collection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore).Add(CreateModelItem(null, ((Collection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore).Count));
			ApplyFilter();
		}

		private FilterModelValueItem CreateModelItem(ValueData value, int index)
		{
			return LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue((Lazy<FilterModelValueItem> x) => new FilterModelValueItem(client.GetColumn().Type, index, createEditSettings(index), info, base.ApplyFilter, value, new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				RemoveItem(x.Value);
			}, () => !fixedOperandCount.HasValue)));
		}

		private void RemoveItem(FilterModelValueItem item)
		{
			operandListObserver.OnRemoving(this);
			((Collection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore).Remove(item);
			ApplyFilter();
		}

		private void OnItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore).Count; i++)
			{
				((Collection<FilterModelValueItem>)(object)itemsCore)[i].Index = i;
			}
		}

		protected internal override ValueData[] CreateConverterValue()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FilterModelValueItem>)itemsCore).Select((FilterModelValueItem item) => item.ToValueData()).ToArray();
		}

		protected override void UpdateFromConverterValue(ValueData[] values)
		{
			if (((values != null) ? values.Length : 0) < (fixedOperandCount ?? 0))
			{
				values = values.Concat(from _ in Enumerable.Range(0, fixedOperandCount.Value - values.Length)
					select ValueData.NullValue).ToArray();
			}
			if (values != null && !values.SequenceEqual(((IEnumerable<FilterModelValueItem>)itemsCore).Select((FilterModelValueItem x) => x.ToValueData())))
			{
				itemsCore.Assign((IList<FilterModelValueItem>)values.Select(CreateModelItem).ToList());
			}
		}
	}
	internal class OperandListObserver<TOwner>
	{
		public Action<TOwner> OnAdding { get; }

		public Action<TOwner> OnRemoving { get; }

		public OperandListObserver(Action<TOwner> onAdding, Action<TOwner> onRemoving)
		{
			OnAdding = onAdding;
			OnRemoving = onRemoving;
		}

		public static OperandListObserver<TOwner> Empty()
		{
			return new OperandListObserver<TOwner>(delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			});
		}
	}
	internal static class FilteringContextExtensionsForFilterModel
	{
		internal class RegisteredModelInfo<TModel> where TModel : FilterModelBase
		{
			internal readonly TModel Model;

			internal readonly UnsubscribeAction Unsubscribe;

			public RegisteredModelInfo(TModel model, UnsubscribeAction unsubscribe)
			{
				Model = model;
				Unsubscribe = unsubscribe;
			}
		}

		internal static RegisteredModelInfo<TModel> CreateAndRegisterModel<TModel>(this FilteringUIContext context, string propertyName, Func<FilterModelClient, TModel> createModel, Func<FilterSetInfo> getFilterSetInfo) where TModel : FilterModelBase
		{
			FilterModelClient client = new FilterModelClient(propertyName, context.GetColumn, (CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode) => context.GetUniqueValues(propertyName, countsIncludeMode == CountsIncludeMode.Include), (string valuesPropertyName, CriteriaOperator filter, CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode, string filterPropertyName) => context.GetGroupUniqueValues(valuesPropertyName, countsIncludeMode == CountsIncludeMode.Include, filter, filterPropertyName), (IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator> x) => context.GetCounts(propertyName, x), delegate(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> x)
			{
				FilterSetInfo filterSetInfo = getFilterSetInfo?.Invoke();
				CriteriaOperator value = x.Value;
				if (filterSetInfo != null)
				{
					filterSetInfo.ApplyFilter(propertyName, value);
				}
				else
				{
					context.ApplyFilter(propertyName, value);
				}
			}, context.SubstituteWholeFilter, () => context.GetMinMaxRange(propertyName, includeFilteredOut: true), () => context.GetFormatConditionFilters(propertyName));
			if (client.GetColumn() == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TModel model = createModel(client);
			getFilterSetInfo?.Invoke()?.RegisterModel(model);
			Action update = delegate
			{
				model.UpdateEditSettings();
				model.Update();
			};
			Action<string> action = delegate(string fieldName)
			{
				if (fieldName == propertyName)
				{
					update();
				}
			};
			FilteringContextListener listener = new FilteringContextListener(delegate
			{
				FilteringColumn filteringColumn = client.GetColumn();
				if (filteringColumn != null)
				{
					CriteriaOperator filter = context.GetFilter(filteringColumn);
					model.Update(filter);
					getFilterSetInfo?.Invoke()?.FilterUpdated();
				}
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
				if (model.AllowLiveDataShaping)
				{
					model.Update();
				}
			}, delegate
			{
				model.Update();
			}, action, update, action, action, action, delegate
			{
				model.UpdateFormatConditionFilters();
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			}, delegate
			{
			});
			UnsubscribeAction unsubscribe = context.RegisterListener(listener);
			return new RegisteredModelInfo<TModel>(model, unsubscribe);
		}
	}
	public abstract class FilterModelBase : BindableBase
	{
		private bool showAllLookUpFilterValues = true;

		internal readonly FilteringColumn Column;

		internal readonly FilterModelClient client;

		private readonly Locker updateLocker = new Locker();

		private Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filterLazy = new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => (CriteriaOperator)null);

		protected internal string PropertyName => client.PropertyName;

		protected bool ActualShowCounts => ShowCounts ?? true;

		internal CountsIncludeMode ActualCountsInculedMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ActualShowCounts)
				{
					return CountsIncludeMode.Exclude;
				}
				return CountsIncludeMode.Include;
			}
		}

		public string FieldDisplayName => PropertyName;

		public bool CanBuildFilter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("CanBuildFilter");
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(value, "CanBuildFilter");
			}
		}

		public FilterValuesSortMode FilterValuesSortMode
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<FilterValuesSortMode>("FilterValuesSortMode");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, (Action)delegate
				{
					Update();
				}, "FilterValuesSortMode");
			}
		}

		internal bool ShowAllLookUpFilterValues
		{
			get
			{
				return showAllLookUpFilterValues;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref showAllLookUpFilterValues, value, UpdateShowAllLookUpFilterValues, "ShowAllLookUpFilterValues");
			}
		}

		internal bool? ShowCounts
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool?>("ShowCounts");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, UpdateShowCounts, "ShowCounts");
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowLiveDataShaping
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue<bool>("AllowLiveDataShaping");
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(value, UpdateAllowLiveDataShaping, "AllowLiveDataShaping");
			}
		}

		protected CriteriaOperator Filter => filterLazy.Value;

		protected bool HasFilter => Filter != null;

		internal FilterModelBase(FilterModelClient client)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.client = client;
			Column = client.GetColumn();
			CanBuildFilter = true;
		}

		protected internal void ApplyFilter()
		{
			ApplyFilter(new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(BuildFilter));
		}

		protected void ApplyFilter(Lazy<CriteriaOperator> filter)
		{
			updateLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				filterLazy = filter;
				client.ApplyFilter(filter);
			});
		}

		protected void ForceUpdate()
		{
			Update();
		}

		internal void Update()
		{
			UpdateContentAsync(async delegate
			{
				await UpdateCoreAsync();
				UpdateCanBuildFilter();
			}).AwaitIfNotCompleted();
		}

		protected async Task UpdateContentAsync(Func<Task> updateAsync)
		{
			await updateLocker.DoLockedTaskIfNotLockedAsync(updateAsync);
		}

		internal void Update(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			filterLazy = new Lazy<CriteriaOperator>(() => filter);
			Update();
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateEditSettings()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateShowCounts()
		{
			Update();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateShowAllLookUpFilterValues()
		{
			Update();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAllowLiveDataShaping()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateFormatConditionFilters()
		{
		}

		internal abstract Task UpdateCoreAsync();

		internal abstract CriteriaOperator BuildFilter();

		protected void UpdateCanBuildFilter()
		{
			CanBuildFilter = CanBuildFilterCore();
		}

		internal abstract bool CanBuildFilterCore();
	}

	{
		NoSort,
		AvailableFirst,
		PopularFirst
	}

	internal sealed class FilterModelClient
	{
		public readonly string PropertyName;

		internal readonly Func<FilteringColumn> GetColumn;

		internal readonly Func<string, FilteringColumn> GetColumnByName;

		internal readonly Func<CountsIncludeMode, Task<UniqueValues>> GetUniqueValues;

		internal readonly Func<string, CriteriaOperator, CountsIncludeMode, string, Task<UniqueValues>> GetGroupUniqueValues;

		internal readonly Func<IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>, int[]> GetCounts;

		internal readonly Action<Lazy<CriteriaOperator>> ApplyFilter;

		internal readonly Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> SubstituteFilter;

		internal readonly Func<Tuple<object, object>> GetMinMaxRange;

		internal readonly Func<IEnumerable<FormatConditionFilter>> GetFormatConditionFilters;

		public FilterModelClient(string propertyName, Func<string, FilteringColumn> getColumnByName, Func<CountsIncludeMode, Task<UniqueValues>> getUniqueValues, Func<string, CriteriaOperator, CountsIncludeMode, string, Task<UniqueValues>> getGroupUniqueValues, Func<IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>, int[]> getCounts, Action<Lazy<CriteriaOperator>> applyFilter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter, Func<Tuple<object, object>> getMinMaxRange, Func<IEnumerable<FormatConditionFilter>> getFormatConditionFilters)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			GetColumnByName = getColumnByName;
			GetColumn = () => GetColumnByName(PropertyName);
			GetUniqueValues = getUniqueValues;
			GetGroupUniqueValues = getGroupUniqueValues;
			GetCounts = getCounts;
			ApplyFilter = applyFilter;

			GetMinMaxRange = getMinMaxRange;
			GetFormatConditionFilters = getFormatConditionFilters;
		}

		{

	internal sealed class DateTimeHierarchyFilterTree : LoadedFilterTreeBase
	{
		internal override bool HasGroupedNodes => true;

		public DateTimeHierarchyFilterTree(FilterTreeClient client)
			: base(client, FilterTreeKind.DateTimeHierarchy)
		{
		}

		protected override Action<GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>, FilterValueInfo> GetRegularValueProcessor(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> currentDayNode = null;
			GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> currentYearNode = null;
			GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> currentMonthNode = null;
			return delegate(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, FilterValueInfo filterValue)
			{
				DateTime date = ((DateTime)filterValue.Value).Date;
				DateTime? dateTime = currentDayNode.Return((ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> x) => ((DateTimeUnit)x.Value.Value).Date, () => (DateTime?)null);
				bool flag = !dateTime.HasValue || dateTime.Value.Year != date.Year;
				bool flag2 = flag || dateTime.Value.Month != date.Month;
				bool flag3 = flag2 || dateTime.Value.Day != date.Day;
				if (flag)
				{
					currentYearNode = CreateAndAddGroupNode(root, new DateTimeUnit(DateTimeUnitType.Year, date), () => date.Year.ToString());
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					currentMonthNode = CreateAndAddGroupNode(currentYearNode, new DateTimeUnit(DateTimeUnitType.Month, date), () => CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.GetMonthName(date.Month));
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					(currentDayNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(currentMonthNode, new DateTimeUnit(DateTimeUnitType.Day, date), () => date.Day.ToString())).IsChecked = IsRegularValueChecked(date);
				}
				currentDayNode.SetCount(currentDayNode.Count + filterValue.Count);
			};
		}

		protected override bool IsRegularValue(object value)
		{
			if (!base.IsRegularValue(value))
			{
				return value is DateTimeUnit;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildRegularValuesFilter(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root)
		{
			List<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> topmostCheckedNodes = CheckedTreeHelper.GetTopmostCheckedNodes(root);
			CriteriaOperator val = DateRangesFilterBuilder.Build(base.PropertyName, DateRangesFilterInfo.Create(topmostCheckedNodes));
			NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> nodeBase = ((topmostCheckedNodes.Count > 0) ? topmostCheckedNodes[0] : null);
			if (nodeBase != null && HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsBlankElement(nodeBase.Value.Value))
			{
				return CreateIsNullOperator() | val;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal override bool CanBuildFilter()
		{
			return FilterTreeHelper.AllowDateTimeFilters(base.FilterRestrictions);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DateTimeLinearFilterTree : LoadedFilterTreeBase
	{
		private readonly Func<object, string> getDisplayText;

		internal override bool HasGroupedNodes => false;

		public DateTimeLinearFilterTree(FilterTreeClient client, Func<object, string> getDisplayText)
			: base(client, FilterTreeKind.DateTimeLinear)
		{
			this.getDisplayText = getDisplayText;
		}

		protected override Action<GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>, FilterValueInfo> GetRegularValueProcessor(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> currentDateNode = null;
			return delegate(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, FilterValueInfo filterValue)
			{
				DateTime date = ((DateTime)filterValue.Value).Date;
				if (currentDateNode == null || (DateTime)currentDateNode.Value.Value != date)
				{
					ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> valueNode = CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(root, date, () => getDisplayText(date));
					valueNode.SetCount(filterValue.Count);
					valueNode.IsChecked = IsRegularValueChecked(date);
					currentDateNode = valueNode;
				}
				else
				{
					currentDateNode.SetCount(currentDateNode.Count + filterValue.Count);
				}
			};
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildRegularValuesFilter(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root)
		{
			List<object> checkedRegularValues = FilterTreeHelper.GetCheckedRegularValues(root, IsRegularValue);
			if (checkedRegularValues.Count > 0 && HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsBlankElement(checkedRegularValues[0]))
			{
				return CreateIsNullOperator() | BuildDateFilter(checkedRegularValues.Skip(1));
			}
			return BuildDateFilter(checkedRegularValues);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator BuildDateFilter(IEnumerable<object> checkedValues)
		{
			return MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(base.PropertyName, checkedValues.Cast<DateTime>());
		}

		internal sealed override bool CanBuildFilter()
		{
			return FilterTreeHelper.AllowDateTimeFilters(base.FilterRestrictions);
		}

	internal abstract class FilterTreeBase
	{
		protected readonly FilterTreeClient client;

		private readonly FilterTreeKind kind;

		internal static string SelectAllText => EditorLocalizer.GetString((EditorStringId)414);

		internal static string SelectBlanksText => EditorLocalizer.GetString((EditorStringId)415);

		internal static string EmptyStringText => EditorLocalizer.GetString((EditorStringId)416);

		protected Action ApplyFilter => client.ApplyFilter;

		protected string PropertyName => client.PropertyName;

		protected FilterRestrictions FilterRestrictions => client.FilterRestrictions;

		internal GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> RootNode { get; private set; }

		internal abstract bool HasGroupedNodes { get; }

		internal virtual bool FetchSublevelChildrenOnExpand => true;

		public FilterTreeBase(FilterTreeClient filterTreeClient, FilterTreeKind kind)
		{
			client = filterTreeClient;
			this.kind = kind;
		}

		public void Build(IList<FilterValueInfo> filterValues, CriteriaOperator filter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter)
		{
			RootNode = CreateRootNode();
			BuildTree(RootNode, filterValues ?? new List<FilterValueInfo>(), filter, substituteFilter);
			RootNode.IsExpanded = true;
		}

		private GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> CreateRootNode()
		{
			NodeValueInfo value = new NodeValueInfo(null, () => SelectAllText, DisplayMode.DisplayText, null);
			Action endChecking = delegate
			{
				client.EndUpdate?.Invoke();
				ApplyFilter?.Invoke();
			};
			return new GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>(value, client.BeginUpdate, endChecking, null);
		}

		protected abstract void BuildTree(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, IList<FilterValueInfo> filterValues, CriteriaOperator filter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter);

		private ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> CreateAndAddValueNode(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> parent, object value, Func<string> getDisplayText, DisplayMode displayMode, Lazy<BaseEditSettings> editSettingsLazy)
		{
			return new ValueNode<NodeValueInfo>(new NodeValueInfo(value, getDisplayText, displayMode, editSettingsLazy), null, ApplyFilter, parent?.AsNodeParent);
		}

		protected ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> CreateAndAddRegualValueNode(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> parent, object value, Func<string> getDisplayText, Lazy<BaseEditSettings> editSettingsLazy)
		{
			return CreateAndAddValueNode(parent, value, getDisplayText, DisplayMode.Value, editSettingsLazy);
		}

		protected ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> CreateAndAddCustomValueNode(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> parent, object value, Func<string> getDisplayText)
		{
			return CreateAndAddValueNode(parent, value, getDisplayText, DisplayMode.DisplayText, null);
		}

		protected GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> CreateAndAddGroupNode(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> parent, object value, Func<string> getDisplayText)
		{
			return new GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>(new NodeValueInfo(value, getDisplayText, DisplayMode.DisplayText, null), null, ApplyFilter, parent);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator BuildFilter()
		{
			if (RootNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (RootNode.ActualIsChecked.HasValue || !CanBuildFilter())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return BuildFilterCore();
		}

		protected abstract CriteriaOperator BuildFilterCore();

		internal abstract bool CanBuildFilter();
	}

	internal sealed class StringHierarchyFilterTree : SimpleFilterTreeBase
	{
		internal override bool HasGroupedNodes => true;

		public StringHierarchyFilterTree(FilterTreeClient client)
			: base(client, FilterTreeKind.StringHierarchy)
		{
		}

		protected override Action<GroupNode<NodeValueInfo>, FilterValueInfo> GetRegularValueProcessor(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			string currentString = null;
			GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> currentGroupNode = null;
			return delegate(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> root, FilterValueInfo filterValue)
			{
				string text = (string)filterValue.Value;
				Func<string, string> func = (string x) => x.Substring(0, 1);
				string newGroupKey = func(text);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentString) || newGroupKey != func(currentString))
				{
					currentGroupNode = CreateAndAddGroupNode(root, newGroupKey, () => newGroupKey);
				}
				if (currentString != text)
				{
					currentString = text;
					CreateAndAddStringNode(currentGroupNode, filterValue, filterValue.GetDisplayText);
				}
			};
		}

		private void CreateAndAddStringNode(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> group, FilterValueInfo filterValue, Func<string> getDisplayText)
		{
			ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> valueNode = CreateAndAddRegualValueNode(group, filterValue.Value, getDisplayText, EditSettingsLazy);
			valueNode.SetCount(filterValue.Count);
			valueNode.IsChecked = IsRegularValueChecked(filterValue.Value);
		}
	}
	internal static class FilterTreeHelper
	{
		private sealed class FilterParserDescriptor<T> : CriteriaCompilerDescriptor
		{
			private readonly string PropertyName;

			public override Type ObjectType => typeof(T);

			public FilterParserDescriptor(string propertyName)
			{
				PropertyName = propertyName;
			}

			public override System.Linq.Expressions.Expression MakePropertyAccess(System.Linq.Expressions.Expression baseExpression, string propertyPath)
			{
				if (propertyPath == PropertyName)
				{
					return baseExpression;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		public static BlankOperations ObjectBlankOperations { get; } = new BlankOperations((object value) => value == null || value is DBNull, (string propertyName, AllowedUnaryFilters allowedFilters) => (CriteriaOperator)(allowedFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNull) ? new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, propertyName) : ((UnaryOperator)null)), (object value) => false);

		private static List<object> GetValueNodesValuesCore(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node, bool isChecked, Func<object, bool> takeValue)
		{
			return (from x in CheckedTreeHelper.GetDepthFirstNodes(node).OfType<ValueNode<NodeValueInfo>>()
				where x.ActualIsChecked == isChecked
				select x.Value.Value into x
				where takeValue(x)
				select x).ToList();
		}

		public static List<object> GetCheckedRegularValues(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node, Func<object, bool> checkIsRegularValue)
		{
			return GetValueNodesValuesCore(node, isChecked: true, checkIsRegularValue);
		}

		public static List<object> GetUncheckedRegularValues(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node, Func<object, bool> checkIsRegularValue)
		{
			return GetValueNodesValuesCore(node, isChecked: false, checkIsRegularValue);
		}

		private static List<object> GetCheckedCustomValues(NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node, Func<object, bool> checkIsCustomValue)
		{
			return GetValueNodesValuesCore(node, isChecked: true, checkIsCustomValue);
		}

		public static bool IsSelectAllNodesExceptBlank(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> node, ValueNode<NodeValueInfo> blanksNode)
		{
			if (blanksNode == null || blanksNode.ActualIsChecked.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<object> valueNodesValuesCore = GetValueNodesValuesCore(node, isChecked: false, (object n) => n != blanksNode);
			if (valueNodesValuesCore.Count == 1)
			{
				return valueNodesValuesCore.Single() == blanksNode.Value.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator BuildCustomValuesFilter(GroupNode<NodeValueInfo> node, string propertyName, Func<object, bool> checkIsCustomValue)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown

			List<CriteriaOperator> list2 = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			CriteriaOperator val = null;

			{

					val |= (CriteriaOperator)checkedCustomValue;

		}

		public static List<CriteriaOperator> SplitCriteriaOperator(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (op == null)
			{
				return new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			}
			GroupOperator val = (GroupOperator)(object)((op is GroupOperator) ? op : null);
			if (val == null || (int)val.OperatorType != 1)
			{
				return new List<CriteriaOperator> { op };
			}
			return ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)val.Operands).ToList();
		}

		public static Func<object, bool> CreateContainsValueFunc(string propertyName, Type propertyType, CriteriaOperator filter, Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> substituteFilter)
		{
			filter = substituteFilter(filter);
			if (filter == null)
			{
				return (object x) => false;
			}
			List<string> list = FilteringUIContext.ExtractProperties(filter);
			if (list.Count > 1 || list.SingleOrDefault() != propertyName)
			{
				return (object x) => false;
			}
			try
			{
				MethodInfo method = typeof(FilterTreeHelper).GetMethod("GetGenericPredicateFunc", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic);
				return (Func<object, bool>)method.MakeGenericMethod(propertyType).Invoke(null, new object[2] { filter, propertyName });
			}
			catch
			{
				return (object _) => false;
			}
		}

			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Func<T, bool> genericFunc = CriteriaCompiler.ToPredicate<T>(filter, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)new FilterParserDescriptor<T>(propertyName), new CriteriaCompilerAuxSettings(true));
			return (object o) => genericFunc((T)o);
		}

	internal struct FilterRestrictions
	{
		public readonly AllowedUnaryFilters AllowedUnaryFilters;

		public readonly AllowedAnyOfFilters AllowedAnyOfFilters;

		public readonly AllowedDateTimeFilters AllowedDateTimeFilters;

		public readonly AllowedBinaryFilters AllowedBinaryFilters;

		public readonly AllowedBetweenFilters AllowedBetweenFilters;

		public readonly AllowedCustomDateFilters AllowedCustomDateFilters;

		public readonly AllowedDataAnalysisFilters AllowedDataAnalysisFilters;

		public readonly AllowedFormatConditionFilters AllowedFormatConditionFilters;

		public bool AllowCustomDateFilters
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.GreaterOrEqual))
				{
					return AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Less);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public static FilterRestrictions None()
		{
			return new FilterRestrictions(AllowedUnaryFilters.None, AllowedAnyOfFilters.None, AllowedDateTimeFilters.None, AllowedBinaryFilters.None, AllowedBetweenFilters.None, AllowedCustomDateFilters.None, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.None, AllowedFormatConditionFilters.None);
		}

		public static FilterRestrictions All()
		{
			return new FilterRestrictions(AllowedUnaryFilters.All, AllowedAnyOfFilters.All, AllowedDateTimeFilters.All, AllowedBinaryFilters.All, AllowedBetweenFilters.All, AllowedCustomDateFilters.All, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.All, AllowedFormatConditionFilters.All);
		}

		public FilterRestrictions(AllowedUnaryFilters allowedUnaryFilters, AllowedAnyOfFilters allowedAnyOfFilters, AllowedDateTimeFilters allowedDateTimeFilters, AllowedBinaryFilters allowedBinaryFilters, AllowedBetweenFilters allowedBetweenFilters, AllowedCustomDateFilters allowedCustomDateFilters, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters dataAnalysis, AllowedFormatConditionFilters allowedFormatConditionFilters)
		{
			AllowedUnaryFilters = allowedUnaryFilters;
			AllowedAnyOfFilters = allowedAnyOfFilters;
			AllowedDateTimeFilters = allowedDateTimeFilters;
			AllowedBinaryFilters = allowedBinaryFilters;
			AllowedBetweenFilters = allowedBetweenFilters;
			AllowedCustomDateFilters = allowedCustomDateFilters;
			AllowedDataAnalysisFilters = dataAnalysis;
			AllowedFormatConditionFilters = allowedFormatConditionFilters;
		}

		public FilterRestrictions Update(AllowedAnyOfFilters? anyOf = null, AllowedUnaryFilters? unary = null, AllowedDateTimeFilters? dateTime = null, AllowedBinaryFilters? binary = null, AllowedBetweenFilters? between = null, AllowedCustomDateFilters? customDate = null, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters? dataAnalysis = null, AllowedFormatConditionFilters? formatCondition = null)
		{
			return new FilterRestrictions(unary ?? AllowedUnaryFilters, anyOf ?? AllowedAnyOfFilters, dateTime ?? AllowedDateTimeFilters, binary ?? AllowedBinaryFilters, between ?? AllowedBetweenFilters, customDate ?? AllowedCustomDateFilters, dataAnalysis ?? AllowedDataAnalysisFilters, formatCondition ?? AllowedFormatConditionFilters);
		}

		public FilterRestrictions Intersect(FilterRestrictions restrictions)
		{
			return new FilterRestrictions(AllowedUnaryFilters & restrictions.AllowedUnaryFilters, AllowedAnyOfFilters & restrictions.AllowedAnyOfFilters, AllowedDateTimeFilters & restrictions.AllowedDateTimeFilters, AllowedBinaryFilters & restrictions.AllowedBinaryFilters, AllowedBetweenFilters & restrictions.AllowedBetweenFilters, AllowedCustomDateFilters & restrictions.AllowedCustomDateFilters, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters & restrictions.AllowedDataAnalysisFilters, AllowedFormatConditionFilters & restrictions.AllowedFormatConditionFilters);
		}

		public bool Allow(FunctionOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if ((int)type != 5)
			{
				return (type - 46) switch
				{
					2 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Contains), 
					0 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.BeginsWith), 
					1 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.EndsWith), 
					_ => (type - 72) switch
					{
						0 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsBeyondThisYear), 
						1 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisYear), 
						2 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisMonth), 
						3 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsNextWeek), 
						4 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLaterThisWeek), 
						5 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsTomorrow), 
						6 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsToday), 
						7 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsYesterday), 
						8 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisWeek), 
						9 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsLastWeek), 
						10 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisMonth), 
						11 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsEarlierThisYear), 
						12 => AllowedDateTimeFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDateTimeFilters.IsPriorThisYear), 
						_ => false, 
					}, 
				};
			}
			return AllowedUnaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNullOrEmpty);
		}

		private bool AllowInverted(FunctionOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)type != 5)
			{
				if ((int)type == 48)
				{
					return AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.DoesNotContain);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return AllowedUnaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNotNullOrEmpty);
		}

		public bool Allow(BinaryOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)type switch
			{
				0 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Equals), 
				1 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.DoesNotEqual), 
				2 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Greater), 
				5 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.GreaterOrEqual), 
				3 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Less), 
				4 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.LessOrEqual), 
				6 => AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.Like), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private bool AllowInverted(BinaryOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)type == 6)
			{
				return AllowedBinaryFilters.HasFlag(AllowedBinaryFilters.NotLike);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Allow(PredefinedFormatConditionType predefinedFormatConditionType)
		{
			return predefinedFormatConditionType switch
			{
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Top => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.Top), 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Bottom => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.Bottom), 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.AboveAverage => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.AboveAverage), 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.BelowAverage => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.BelowAverage), 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Unique => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.Unique), 
				PredefinedFormatConditionType.Duplicate => AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.HasFlag(AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.Duplicate), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

	internal static class Observing
	{
		public static Observing<T> Create<T>(Option<T> initialValue, Action stop)
		{
			return new Observing<T>(initialValue, stop);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Observing<T>
	{
		public readonly Option<T> InitialValue;

		public readonly Action Stop;

		public Observing(Option<T> initialValue, Action stop)
		{
			InitialValue = initialValue;
			Stop = stop;
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Observable<T>
	{
		public readonly Func<Action<Option<T>>, Observing<T>> Observe;

		public Observable(Func<Action<Option<T>>, Observing<T>> observe)
		{
			Observe = observe;
		}
	}
	internal static class Observable
	{
		private sealed class Listener : DependencyObject
		{
			private readonly Action<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs> changed;

			private static readonly object DefaultValue = new object();

			public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(Listener), new PropertyMetadata(DefaultValue, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (DefaultValue != e.OldValue && DefaultValue != e.NewValue)
				{
					((Listener)d).changed(e);
				}
			}));

			public Listener(Action<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs> changed)
			{
				this.changed = changed;
			}
		}

		private static readonly DependencyProperty ListenersProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("Listeners", typeof(HashSet<Listener>), typeof(Observable), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static Observable<UnitT> Clock(Func<Action, Action> @event)
		{
			return Clock((Action<UnitT> x) => @event(delegate
			{
				x(default(UnitT));
			}));
		}

		public static Observable<T> Clock<T>(Func<Action<T>, Action> @event)
		{
			return new Observable<T>((Action<Option<T>> x) => Observing.Create(Option<T>.Empty, @event((x == null) ? null : ((Action<T>)delegate(T e)
			{
				x(e.AsOption());
			}))));
		}

			{
			}));
		}

			{
			}));
		}

				selector(x);
				return default(UnitT);
			});

		public static Observable<TOut> Select<TIn, TOut>(this Observable<TIn> observable, Func<TIn, TOut> selector)
		{
			return new Observable<TOut>(delegate(Action<Option<TOut>> s)
			{
				Observing<TIn> observing = observable.Observe(delegate(Option<TIn> x)
				{
					s(x.Apply(selector));
				});
				return Observing.Create(observing.InitialValue.Apply(selector), observing.Stop);
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> Where<T>(this Observable<T> observable, Func<T, bool> predicate)
		{
			return new Observable<T>(delegate(Action<Option<T>> s)
			{
				Observing<T> observing = observable.Observe(delegate(Option<T> v)
				{
					s(v.Bind((T x) => (!predicate(x)) ? Option<T>.Empty : x.AsOption()));
				});
				return Observing.Create(observing.InitialValue.Bind((T x) => (!predicate(x)) ? Option<T>.Empty : x.AsOption()), observing.Stop);
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> DefaultValue<T>(this Observable<T> observable, Func<T> defaultValue)
		{

				{
					s(x.GetValueOrDefault(defaultValue).AsOption());
				});
				return Observing.Create(observing.InitialValue.GetValueOrDefault(defaultValue).AsOption(), observing.Stop);
			});
		}

		public static Func<Task<T>> Execute<T>(this Observable<T> observable)
		{
			TaskCompletionSource<T> execute = new TaskCompletionSource<T>();
			observable.Execute(delegate(T r)
			{
				TaskCompletionSource<T> taskCompletionSource = execute;
				execute = new TaskCompletionSource<T>();
				taskCompletionSource.SetResult(r);
			});
			return () => execute.Task;
		}

		public static Action Execute<T>(this Observable<T> observable, Action<T> action)
		{
			Observing<T> observing = observable.Observe(delegate(Option<T> x)
			{
				x.DoIfHasValue(action);
			});
			observing.InitialValue.DoIfHasValue(action);
			return observing.Stop;
		}

				action();
			});
		}

		public static Observable<TR> SelectMany<TI, TC, TR>(this Observable<TI> observable, Func<TI, Observable<TC>> selector, Func<TI, TC, TR> projector)
		{
			return new Observable<TR>(delegate(Action<Option<TR>> s)
			{
				Action stopBase = null;
				Observing<TI> observing = observable.Observe(delegate(Option<TI> oi)
				{
					stopBase();
					Observing<TR> observing3 = oi.Match(delegate(TI i)
					{
						Observing<TC> observing4 = selector(i).Observe(delegate(Option<TC> oc)
						{
							s(oc.Apply((TC x) => projector(i, x)));
						});
						return Observing.Create(observing4.InitialValue.Apply((TC x) => projector(i, x)), observing4.Stop);
					}, () => Observing.Create(Option<TR>.Empty, delegate
					{
					}));
					stopBase = observing3.Stop;
					s(observing3.InitialValue);
				});
				Observing<TR> observing2 = observing.InitialValue.Match(delegate(TI i)
				{
					Observing<TC> observing3 = selector(i).Observe(delegate(Option<TC> oc)
					{
						s(oc.Apply((TC x) => projector(i, x)));
					});
					return Observing.Create(observing3.InitialValue.Apply((TC x) => projector(i, x)), observing3.Stop);
				}, () => Observing.Create(Option<TR>.Empty, delegate
				{
				}));
				stopBase = observing2.Stop;
				Action stopSelector = observing.Stop;
				return Observing.Create(observing2.InitialValue, delegate
				{
					stopSelector();
					stopSelector = null;
					stopBase();
					stopBase = null;
				});
			});
		}

		private static HashSet<Listener> GetListeners(DependencyObject d)
		{
			HashSet<Listener> hashSet = (HashSet<Listener>)d.GetValue(ListenersProperty);
			if (hashSet != null)
			{
				return hashSet;
			}
			hashSet = new HashSet<Listener>();
			d.SetValue(ListenersProperty, hashSet);
			return hashSet;
		}

		public static Observable<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs> OnChanged(this DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty p)
		{
			return new Observable<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>(delegate(Action<Option<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs>> s)
			{
				object value = d.GetValue(p);
				Option<DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs> initialValue = new DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs(p, value, value).AsOption();
				if (s == null)
				{
					return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
					{
					});
				}
				Listener listener = new Listener(delegate(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs x)
				{
					s(x.AsOption());
				});
				BindingOperations.SetBinding(listener, Listener.ValueProperty, new Binding
				{
					Path = new PropertyPath(p),
					Source = d,
					Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
				});
				GetListeners(d).Add(listener);
				return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearBinding(listener, Listener.ValueProperty);
					GetListeners(d).Remove(listener);
				});
			});
		}

		public static Observable<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> OnChanged(this INotifyCollectionChanged collection)
		{
			return new Observable<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>(delegate(Action<Option<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs>> s)
			{
				Option<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> initialValue = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset).AsOption();
				if (s == null)
				{
					return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
					{
					});
				}
				NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler h = delegate(object _, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs x)
				{
					s(x.AsOption());
				};
				collection.CollectionChanged += h;
				return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
				{
					collection.CollectionChanged -= h;
				});
			});
		}

		public static Observable<PropertyChangedEventArgs> OnChanged<TOwner, T>(this TOwner obj, Expression<Func<TOwner, T>> property) where TOwner : INotifyPropertyChanged
		{
			return obj.OnChanged(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName(property));
		}

		public static Observable<PropertyChangedEventArgs> OnChanged(this INotifyPropertyChanged obj, string propertyName)
		{
			return new Observable<PropertyChangedEventArgs>(delegate(Action<Option<PropertyChangedEventArgs>> s)
			{
				Option<PropertyChangedEventArgs> initialValue = new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName).AsOption();
				if (s == null)
				{
					return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
					{
					});
				}
				PropertyChangedEventHandler h = delegate(object _, PropertyChangedEventArgs x)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.PropertyName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) || propertyName == x.PropertyName)
					{
						s(x.AsOption());
					}
				};
				obj.PropertyChanged += h;
				return Observing.Create(initialValue, delegate
				{
					obj.PropertyChanged -= h;
				});
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> NotifyValue<TOwner, T>(this TOwner obj, Expression<Func<TOwner, T>> property) where TOwner : INotifyPropertyChanged
		{
			Func<TOwner, T> getValue = property.Compile();
			return from _ in obj.OnChanged(property)
				select getValue(obj);
		}

		public static Observable<T> DependencyValue<TOwner, T>(this TOwner obj, Expression<Func<TOwner, T>> property) where TOwner : DependencyObject
		{
			string propertyName = DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.ExpressionHelper.GetPropertyName(property);
			DependencyProperty depProperty = (DependencyProperty)obj.GetType().GetField(propertyName + "Property", BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy).GetValue(null);
			return from _ in obj.OnChanged(depProperty)
				select (T)obj.GetValue(depProperty);
		}

		public static Observable<object> DependencyValue(this DependencyObject obj, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return from _ in obj.OnChanged(property)
				select obj.GetValue(property);
		}

		public static Observable<T> Memoize<T>(this Observable<T> observable, Func<T, T, bool> equals = null)
		{
			equals = equals ?? ((Func<T, T, bool>)((T a, T b) => object.Equals(a, b)));
			Option<Option<T>> memoizedValue = Option<Option<T>>.Empty;
			return new Observable<T>(delegate(Action<Option<T>> s)
			{
				Observing<T> observing = observable.Observe(delegate(Option<T> v)
				{
					if (!memoizedValue.Match((Option<T> u) => u.Match((T uv) => v.Match((T vv) => equals(uv, vv), () => false), () => v.Match((T _) => false, () => true)), () => false))
					{
						memoizedValue = v.AsOption();
						s(v);
					}
				});
				memoizedValue = observing.InitialValue.AsOption();
				return observing;
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> Trigger<T>(this Observable<T>[] input)
		{
			return new Observable<T>(delegate(Action<Option<T>> s)
			{
				Action stop = input.Select((Observable<T> x) => x.Observe(s).Stop).Aggregate(delegate
				{
				}, (Action a, Action b) => (Action)Delegate.Combine(a, b));
				return Observing.Create(Option<T>.Empty, stop);
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> Trigger<TCollection, TItem, T>(this TCollection collection, Func<TItem, Observable<T>> item) where TCollection : IList<TItem>, INotifyCollectionChanged
		{
			return new Observable<T>(delegate(Action<Option<T>> s)
			{
				List<Action> stopItems = null;
				Action stopCollection = collection.OnChanged().Observe(delegate(Option<NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs> oc)
				{
					oc.Match(delegate(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs c)
					{
						switch (c.Action)
						{
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset:
							stopItems.ForEach(delegate(Action x)
							{
								x();
							});
							stopItems = collection.Select((TItem x) => item(x).Observe(s).Stop).ToList();
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
							stopItems.InsertRange(c.NewStartingIndex, from TItem x in c.NewItems
								select item(x).Observe(s).Stop);
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
							stopItems.Skip(c.OldStartingIndex).Take(c.OldItems.Count).ForEach(delegate(Action x)
							{
								x();
							});
							stopItems.RemoveRange(c.OldStartingIndex, c.OldItems.Count);
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
							c.NewItems.Cast<TItem>().ForEach(delegate(TItem e, int i)
							{
								stopItems[c.OldStartingIndex + i]();
								stopItems[c.OldStartingIndex + i] = item(e).Observe(s).Stop;
							});
							break;
						case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Move:
							stopItems.Skip(c.OldStartingIndex).Take(c.OldItems.Count).ForEach(delegate(Action x)
							{
								x();
							});
							stopItems.RemoveRange(c.OldStartingIndex, c.OldItems.Count);
							stopItems.InsertRange(c.NewStartingIndex, from TItem x in c.NewItems
								select item(x).Observe(s).Stop);
							break;
						}
					}, delegate
					{
						stopItems.ForEach(delegate(Action x)
						{
							x();
						});
						stopItems.Clear();
					});
				}).Stop;
				stopItems = collection.Select((TItem x) => item(x).Observe(s).Stop).ToList();
				return Observing.Create(Option<T>.Empty, delegate
				{
					stopCollection();
					stopCollection = null;
					stopItems.ForEach(delegate(Action x)
					{
						x();
					});
					stopItems = null;
				});
			});
		}

		public static Observable<T> InitialValue<T>(this Observable<T> observable, T initialValue)
		{
			return new Observable<T>((Action<Option<T>> s) => Observing.Create(initialValue.AsOption(), observable.Observe(s).Stop));
		}

		public static Observable<UnitT> Hierarchy<TCollection, TItem>(this TCollection collection, Func<TItem, Observable<UnitT>> item) where TCollection : IList<TItem>, INotifyCollectionChanged
		{
			return collection.Trigger(item).InitialValue(default(UnitT)).SelectMany(() => collection.OnChanged())
				.Void();
		}

		public static Observable<UnitT> Void<T>(this Observable<T> observable)
		{
			return observable.Select((T _) => default(UnitT));
		}
	}
	internal sealed class Tree<L, G>
	{
		private class Group
		{
			public G Value { get; }

			public IList<Tree<L, G>> Children { get; }

			public Group(G value, IList<Tree<L, G>> children)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)children, "children");
				Value = value;
				Children = children;
			}
		}

		private readonly Either<L, Group> either;

		private Tree(Either<L, Group> either)
		{
			this.either = either;
		}

		public static Tree<L, G> CreateLeaf(L value)
		{
			return new Tree<L, G>(Either<L, Group>.Left(value));
		}

		public static Tree<L, G> CreateGroup(G value, IList<Tree<L, G>> children)
		{
			return new Tree<L, G>(Either<L, Group>.Right(new Group(value, children)));
		}

		public T Match<T>(Func<L, T> leaf, Func<G, IList<Tree<L, G>>, T> group)
		{
			return either.Match(leaf, (Group g) => group(g.Value, g.Children));
		}
	}
	internal static class TreeExtensions
	{
		public static IEnumerable<Tree<T, G>> Transform<L, G, T>(this IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> forest, Func<L, T> transformLeaf)
		{
			return forest.Select((Tree<L, G> tree) => tree.Transform(transformLeaf));
		}

		public static IEnumerable<T> Transform<L, G, T>(this IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> forest, Func<L, T> transformLeaf, Func<G, IEnumerable<T>, T> transformGroup)
		{
			return forest.Select((Tree<L, G> tree) => tree.Transform(transformLeaf, transformGroup));
		}

		public static T Transform<L, G, T>(this Tree<L, G> tree, Func<L, T> transformLeaf, Func<G, IEnumerable<T>, T> transformGroup)
		{
			return tree.Match((L leaf) => transformLeaf(leaf), (G group, IList<Tree<L, G>> children) => transformGroup(group, children.Select((Tree<L, G> x) => x.Transform(transformLeaf, transformGroup))));
		}

		public static Tree<T, G> Transform<L, G, T>(this Tree<L, G> tree, Func<L, T> transformLeaf)
		{
			return tree.Transform((L leaf) => Tree<T, G>.CreateLeaf(transformLeaf(leaf)), (G group, IEnumerable<Tree<T, G>> children) => Tree<T, G>.CreateGroup(group, children.ToArray()));
		}

		public static IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> HierarchicalWhere<L, G>(this IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> forest, Func<L, bool> leafPredicate, Func<G, IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>>, bool> groupPredicate)
		{
			return from tree in forest
				select tree.HierarchicalWhere(leafPredicate, groupPredicate) into tree
				where tree != null
				select tree;
		}

		public static Tree<L, G> HierarchicalWhere<L, G>(this Tree<L, G> tree, Func<L, bool> leafPredicate, Func<G, IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>>, bool> groupPredicate)
		{
			return tree.Match((L leaf) => (!leafPredicate(leaf)) ? null : tree, delegate(G groupValue, IList<Tree<L, G>> children)
			{
				Tree<L, G> tree2 = Tree<L, G>.CreateGroup(groupValue, children.HierarchicalWhere(leafPredicate, groupPredicate).ToArray());
				return (!tree2.MatchGroup(groupPredicate)) ? null : tree2;
			});
		}

		public static IEnumerable<L> FlattenLeaves<L, G>(this IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> forest)
		{
			return forest.SelectMany((Tree<L, G> tree) => tree.Match((L leaf) => leaf.Yield(), (G _, IList<Tree<L, G>> children) => children.FlattenLeaves()));
		}

		public static IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> FlattenLeavesContainers<L, G>(this IEnumerable<Tree<L, G>> forest)
		{
			return from node in forest.Flatten((Tree<L, G> node) => node.GetChildren())
				where node.MatchLeaf((L _) => true)
				select node;
		}

		public static IList<Tree<L, G>> GetChildren<L, G>(this Tree<L, G> tree)
		{
			return tree.MatchGroup((G _, IList<Tree<L, G>> children) => children, () => new Tree<L, G>[0]);
		}

		public static T MatchLeaf<L, G, T>(this Tree<L, G> tree, Func<L, T> leaf, Func<T> otherwise = null)
		{
			return tree.Match(leaf, (G _, IList<Tree<L, G>> __) => GetValueOrDefault(otherwise));
		}

		public static T MatchGroup<L, G, T>(this Tree<L, G> tree, Func<G, IList<Tree<L, G>>, T> group, Func<T> otherwise = null)
		{
			return tree.Match((L _) => GetValueOrDefault(otherwise), group);
		}

		private static T GetValueOrDefault<T>(Func<T> getValue)
		{
			if (getValue != null)
			{
				return getValue();
			}
			return default(T);
		}
	}
}
