	internal static class FilteringUIContextHelper
	{
		private static readonly char[] Separators;

		private static readonly Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>[] TrackingEditSettings;

		public static string[] SplitGroupFields(string fieldName, string groupFields, bool skipRootIfInverted)
		{
			string[] array = (from x in groupFields?.Split(Separators)
				where x != string.Empty
				select x).ToArray() ?? EmptyArray<string>.Instance;
			if (Array.IndexOf(array, fieldName) == -1)
			{
				if (!skipRootIfInverted)
				{
					return new string[1] { fieldName }.Concat(array).ToArray();
				}
				return array;
			}
			if (!skipRootIfInverted)
			{
				return array;
			}
			return array.Skip(1).ToArray();
		}

		static FilteringUIContextHelper()
		{
			Separators = new char[3] { ';', ',', ' ' };
			TrackingEditSettings = CreateTrackingEditSettings();
		}

		private static Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>[] CreateTrackingEditSettings()
		{
			return new Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>[4]
			{
				new Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>(typeof(BaseEditSettings), new DependencyProperty[1] { BaseEditSettings.DisplayFormatProperty }),
				new Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>(typeof(TextEditSettings), new DependencyProperty[2]
				{
					TextEditSettings.MaskProperty,
					TextEditSettings.MaskUseAsDisplayFormatProperty
				}),
				new Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>(typeof(LookUpEditSettingsBase), new DependencyProperty[6]
				{
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemTemplateProperty,
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemTemplateSelectorProperty,
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.ItemsSourceProperty,
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.ValueMemberProperty,
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.DisplayMemberProperty,
					LookUpEditSettingsBase.ApplyItemTemplateToSelectedItemProperty
				}),
				new Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]>(typeof(ListBoxEditSettings), new DependencyProperty[5]
				{
					ListBoxEditSettings.ItemTemplateProperty,
					ListBoxEditSettings.ItemTemplateSelectorProperty,
					ListBoxEditSettings.ItemsSourceProperty,
					ListBoxEditSettings.ValueMemberProperty,
					ListBoxEditSettings.DisplayMemberProperty
				})
			};
		}

		public static UnsubscribeAction SubscribeSettings(BaseEditSettings editSettings, EventHandler action)
		{
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<PropertyChangeTracker> trackingProperties = TrackingEditSettings.Where((Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]> info) => info.Item1.IsInstanceOfType(editSettings)).SelectMany((Tuple<Type, DependencyProperty[]> info) => info.Item2).Select((Func<DependencyProperty, PropertyChangeTracker>)((DependencyProperty prop) => new PropertyChangeTracker((DependencyObject)(object)editSettings, prop)))
				.ToList();
			trackingProperties.ForEach(delegate(PropertyChangeTracker x)
			{
				x.Changed += action;
			});
			return delegate
			{
				trackingProperties.ForEach(delegate(PropertyChangeTracker x)
				{
					x.Changed -= action;
				});
			};
		}

		public static FilterInfo Split(this FilteringUIContext context, CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			Tuple<CriteriaOperator, IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>> tuple = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnNames(filter, (IEqualityComparer<string>)null);
			IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> item = tuple.Item2;
			ICollection<CriteriaOperator> collection = CriteriaProcessingExtensions.Transform<GroupOperator, ICollection<CriteriaOperator>>(tuple.Item1, (Predicate<GroupOperator>)((GroupOperator x) => (int)x.OperatorType == 0), (Func<GroupOperator, ICollection<CriteriaOperator>>)((GroupOperator x) => ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)x.Operands).ToList()), (Func<CriteriaOperator, ICollection<CriteriaOperator>>)((CriteriaOperator x) => new List<CriteriaOperator> { x }));
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item2 in collection.ToList())
			{
				List<string> list = FilteringUIContext.ExtractProperties(item2);
				if (list.Count < 2)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (string item3 in list.Concat(item.Keys))
				{
					FilteringColumn column = context.GetColumn(item3);
					string[] array = column?.GroupFields;
					if (array != null && !list.Except(column.RootFilterValuesPropertyName.Yield().Concat(array)).Any())
					{
						item[item3] = item.GetValueOrDefault(item3) & item2;
						collection.Remove(item2);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)collection);
			List<CriteriaOperator> list2 = FormatConditionFiltersHelper.ParseGroupOrOperator<CriteriaOperator>(val, (Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>)((CriteriaOperator x) => x)).ToList();
			foreach (FunctionOperator item4 in list2.OfType<FunctionOperator>().ToList())
			{
				AppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo appliedFormatConditionFilterInfo = FormatConditionFiltersHelper.GetAppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo(item4);
				if (appliedFormatConditionFilterInfo != null)
				{
					item[appliedFormatConditionFilterInfo.PropertyName] = item.GetValueOrDefault(appliedFormatConditionFilterInfo.PropertyName) | (CriteriaOperator)(object)item4;
					list2.Remove((CriteriaOperator)(object)item4);
				}
			}
			val = CriteriaOperator.Or((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)list2);
			return new FilterInfo(item, val);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator Build(this FilterInfo filter, params string[] exceptProperties)
		{
			return filter.Build(filter.Columns.Except(exceptProperties), (Func<string, CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator>)((string _, CriteriaOperator x) => x), (Func<IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>, CriteriaOperator>)CriteriaOperator.And);
		}
	}
	internal sealed class FilterInfo
	{
		private CriteriaOperator complexFilter;

		private readonly IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> split;

		public ICollection<string> Columns => split.Keys;

		public FilterInfo(IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> split, CriteriaOperator complexFilter)
		{
			this.split = split;
			this.complexFilter = complexFilter;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator GetFilter(FilteringColumn column, string propertyName = null)
		{
			if (column == null && propertyName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = split.GetValueOrDefault(column?.RootFilterValuesPropertyName ?? propertyName);
			string[] array = column?.GroupFields;
			if (array != null)
			{
				string[] array2 = array;
				foreach (string key in array2)
				{
					val &= split.GetValueOrDefault(key);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		public void Change(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator>> filters, FilteringUIContext context)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator> filter in filters)
			{
				FilteringColumn column = context.GetColumn(filter.Key);
				split.Remove(column?.RootFilterValuesPropertyName ?? filter.Key);
				string[] array = column?.GroupFields;
				if (array != null)
				{
					string[] array2 = array;
					foreach (string key in array2)
					{
						split.Remove(key);
					}
				}
				if (filter.Value != null)
				{
					split[filter.Key] = filter.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearComplexFilter()
		{
			complexFilter = null;
		}

		public R Build<T, R>(IEnumerable<string> properties, Func<string, CriteriaOperator, T> select, Func<IEnumerable<T>, R> aggregate)
		{
			return aggregate(properties.Select((string x) => select(x, split[x])).Concat(complexFilter.Return((CriteriaOperator x) => select(null, x).Yield(), () => EmptyArray<T>.Instance)));
		}
	}
	internal static class ImplicitConvertHelper
	{
		public static bool CanConvert(Type oldType, Type newType)
		{
			if (newType.IsAssignableFrom(oldType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			newType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(newType) ?? newType;
			if (oldType == typeof(sbyte))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(short)) && !(newType == typeof(int)) && !(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(byte))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(short)) && !(newType == typeof(ushort)) && !(newType == typeof(int)) && !(newType == typeof(uint)) && !(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(ulong)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(short))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(int)) && !(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(ushort))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(int)) && !(newType == typeof(uint)) && !(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(ulong)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(int))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(uint))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(long)) && !(newType == typeof(ulong)) && !(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(long) || oldType == typeof(ulong))
			{
				if (!(newType == typeof(float)) && !(newType == typeof(double)))
				{
					return newType == typeof(decimal);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (oldType == typeof(float))
			{
				return newType == typeof(double);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static object GetTargetValue(object value, Type newType)
		{
			return Convert.ChangeType(value, Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(newType) ?? newType);
		}
	}
	public static class DatePeriodsFilterModelHelper
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator ExtractFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return ConvertFilterCore(filter, GetFilterFromFilterDateType);
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator CompressFilter(CriteriaOperator filter)
		{
			return ConvertFilterCore(filter, (string fieldName, FilterDateType[] filterDateTypes) => filterDateTypes.ToCriteria(fieldName));
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator ConvertFilterCore(CriteriaOperator filter, Func<string, FilterDateType[], CriteriaOperator> getConvertedFilter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			Tuple<CriteriaOperator, IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>> tuple = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnNames(filter, (IEqualityComparer<string>)null);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator> item in tuple.Item2)
			{
				FilterDateTypeResult filterDateTypeResult = item.Value.ToFilterDateTypeAndCriteria(item.Key, useFiltersAlt: false);
				if (filterDateTypeResult.FilterDateTypes.Length == 0)
				{
					val &= item.Value;
					continue;
				}
				val &= filterDateTypeResult.OtherFilter;
				val &= getConvertedFilter(item.Key, filterDateTypeResult.FilterDateTypes);
			}
			return val & tuple.Item1;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator GetFilterFromFilterDateType(string propertyName, FilterDateType[] filterDateTypes)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			foreach (FilterDateType filter in filterDateTypes)
			{
				val |= filter.ToCriteria(propertyName);
			}
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal static class FilteringUIHelper
	{
		public static bool IsCompatibleTypes(Type left, Type right)
		{
			left = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(left) ?? left;
			right = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(right) ?? right;
			if (left == right)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsNumericalType(left))
			{
				return SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsNumericalType(right);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static ValueDataKind ToValueDataKind(this FilterEditorOperandType filterEditorOperandType)
		{
			return (ValueDataKind)(filterEditorOperandType switch
			{
				FilterEditorOperandType.Value => 0, 
				FilterEditorOperandType.Property => 1, 
				FilterEditorOperandType.Parameter => 3, 
				FilterEditorOperandType.DateTimeFunction => 2, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("filterEditorOperandType", filterEditorOperandType, null), 
			});
		}

		public static bool CheckFilterFieldName(CriteriaOperator filter, string fieldName)
		{
			Func<string, bool> fieldNameEqual = (string propertyName) => propertyName == fieldName;
			return FilterCriteriaMapperExtensions.MapExtended<bool>(filter, (Func<string, ValueData, BinaryOperatorType, Option<bool>>)((string propertyName, ValueData _, BinaryOperatorType __) => fieldNameEqual(propertyName).AsOption()), (UnaryOperatorMapper<bool>)((string propertyName, UnaryOperatorType type) => fieldNameEqual(propertyName)), (Func<string, ValueData[], Option<bool>>)((string propertyName, ValueData[] __) => fieldNameEqual(propertyName).AsOption()), (Func<string, ValueData, ValueData, Option<bool>>)((string propertyName, ValueData __, ValueData ___) => fieldNameEqual(propertyName).AsOption()), (Func<string, ValueData[], FunctionOperatorType, Option<bool>>)((string propertyName, ValueData[] valuesData, FunctionOperatorType type) => fieldNameEqual(propertyName).AsOption()), (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (GroupOperatorMapper<bool>)null, (NotOperatorMapper<bool>)((bool _) => true), (FallbackMapper<bool>)((CriteriaOperator _) => true), (NullMapper<bool>)(() => true));
		}
	}
	internal static class HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper
	{
		public static HierarchyFilterBuilderBase GetAppropriateBuilder(string propertyName, Func<string, CriteriaOperator> getBlanksFilter, Func<string, bool> getUseDateRangeFilter = null)
		{
			getUseDateRangeFilter = getUseDateRangeFilter ?? ((Func<string, bool>)((string _) => false));
			if (getUseDateRangeFilter(propertyName))
			{
				return new HierarchyFilterBuilderDateRange(propertyName, getBlanksFilter, getUseDateRangeFilter);
			}
			return new HierarchyFilterBuilderSimple(propertyName, getBlanksFilter, getUseDateRangeFilter);
		}

		public static bool IsFirstElementBlank(IEnumerable<object> values)
		{
			if (values.Any())
			{
				return IsBlankElement(values.First());
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsBlankElement(object value)
		{
			return value == null;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class HierarchyFilterBuilderBase
	{
		private readonly Func<string, bool> GetUseDateRangeFilter;

		protected readonly string PropertyName;

		protected readonly Func<string, CriteriaOperator> GetBlanksFilter;

		public HierarchyFilterBuilderBase(string propertyName, Func<string, CriteriaOperator> getBlanksFilter, Func<string, bool> getUseDateRangeFilter)
		{
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			GetBlanksFilter = getBlanksFilter;
			GetUseDateRangeFilter = getUseDateRangeFilter;
		}

		public CriteriaOperator BuildSingleValueFilter(object value, bool invert, Func<CriteriaOperator> getBlanksFilter)
		{
			if (HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsBlankElement(value))
			{
				if (!invert)
				{
					return getBlanksFilter();
				}
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)(!getBlanksFilter());
			}
			return BuildSingleValueFilterCore(value, invert);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator BuildValuesFilter(FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions, CheckedValuesInfo checkedValuesInfo, bool nullOnNoUncheckedValues)
		{
			CriteriaOperator indeterminateFilter = GetIndeterminateFilter(checkedValuesInfo);
			if (!checkedValuesInfo.CheckedValues.Any())
			{
				return indeterminateFilter;
			}
			return BuildValuesFilterCore(filterRestrictions, checkedValuesInfo, nullOnNoUncheckedValues, indeterminateFilter);
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetIndeterminateFilter(CheckedValuesInfo checkedValuesInfo)
		{
			CriteriaOperator result = null;
			List<IndeterminateValueInfo> indeterminateValues = checkedValuesInfo.IndeterminateValues;
			if (indeterminateValues.Any())
			{
				return CriteriaOperator.Or(indeterminateValues.Select((IndeterminateValueInfo x) => BuildSingleValueFilter(x.Value, invert: false, () => GetBlanksFilter(PropertyName)) & HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.GetAppropriateBuilder(x.PropertyName, GetBlanksFilter, GetUseDateRangeFilter).BuildValuesFilter(FilterRestrictions.All(), x.Children, nullOnNoUncheckedValues: true)));
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected abstract CriteriaOperator BuildSingleValueFilterCore(object value, bool invert);

		protected abstract CriteriaOperator BuildValuesFilterCore(FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions, CheckedValuesInfo checkedValuesInfo, bool nullOnNoUncheckedValues, CriteriaOperator indeterminateFilter);
	}
	internal class HierarchyFilterBuilderSimple : HierarchyFilterBuilderBase
	{
		public HierarchyFilterBuilderSimple(string propertyName, Func<string, CriteriaOperator> getBlanksFilter, Func<string, bool> getUseDateRangeFilter)
			: base(propertyName, getBlanksFilter, getUseDateRangeFilter)
		{
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildSingleValueFilterCore(object value, bool invert)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(PropertyName, value, (BinaryOperatorType)(invert ? 1 : 0));
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildValuesFilterCore(FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions, CheckedValuesInfo checkedValuesInfo, bool nullOnNoUncheckedValues, CriteriaOperator indeterminateFilter)
		{
			List<object> checkedValues = checkedValuesInfo.CheckedValues;
			if (checkedValues.Count == 1 && filterRestrictions.Allow((BinaryOperatorType)0))
			{
				return BuildSingleValueFilter(checkedValues.Single(), invert: false, () => GetBlanksFilter(PropertyName)) | indeterminateFilter;
			}
			List<object> list = checkedValuesInfo.GetUncheckedValues();
			List<IndeterminateValueInfo> indeterminateValues = checkedValuesInfo.IndeterminateValues;
			if (nullOnNoUncheckedValues && list.Count == 0 && indeterminateValues.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count == 1 && indeterminateValues.Count == 0 && filterRestrictions.Allow((BinaryOperatorType)1))
			{
				return BuildSingleValueFilter(list.Single(), invert: true, () => GetBlanksFilter(PropertyName));
			}
			bool flag = filterRestrictions.AllowedAnyOfFilters.HasFlag(AllowedAnyOfFilters.AnyOf);
			bool flag2 = filterRestrictions.AllowedAnyOfFilters.HasFlag(AllowedAnyOfFilters.NoneOf);
			if (flag && (!flag2 || (list.Count == 0 && indeterminateValues.Count == 0) || checkedValues.Count <= list.Count))
			{
				return BuildInFilter(checkedValues, invert: false, filterRestrictions) | indeterminateFilter;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				List<object> list2 = list;
				if (indeterminateValues.Any())
				{
					list2 = list2.Concat(indeterminateValues.Select((IndeterminateValueInfo x) => x.Value)).ToList();
				}
				return BuildInFilter(list2, invert: true, filterRestrictions) | indeterminateFilter;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator BuildInFilter(List<object> values, bool invert, FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions)
		{
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Func<CriteriaOperator, CriteriaOperator> func = (CriteriaOperator x) => (CriteriaOperator)(object)((x != null) ? (!x) : null);
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			if (HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsFirstElementBlank(values))
			{
				val = GetBlanksFilter(PropertyName);
				values = values.Skip(1).ToList();
			}
			CriteriaOperator val2 = TryCreateSingleValueFilter(values, invert, filterRestrictions);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				if (!invert)
				{
					return val | val2;
				}
				return func(val) & val2;
			}
			if (!values.Any())
			{
				if (!invert)
				{
					return val;
				}
				return func(val);
			}
			if (!invert)
			{
				return val | (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(PropertyName, (IEnumerable)values);
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)(!(val | (CriteriaOperator)new InOperator(PropertyName, (IEnumerable)values)));
		}

		private CriteriaOperator TryCreateSingleValueFilter(List<object> values, bool invert, FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions)
		{
			if (values.Count != 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (invert)
			{
				if (!filterRestrictions.Allow((BinaryOperatorType)1))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return BuildSingleValueFilter(values.Single(), invert: true, null);
			}
			if (!filterRestrictions.Allow((BinaryOperatorType)0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return BuildSingleValueFilter(values.Single(), invert: false, null);
		}
	}
	internal class HierarchyFilterBuilderDateRange : HierarchyFilterBuilderBase
	{
		public HierarchyFilterBuilderDateRange(string propretyName, Func<string, CriteriaOperator> getBlanksFilter, Func<string, bool> getUseDateRangeFilter)
			: base(propretyName, getBlanksFilter, getUseDateRangeFilter)
		{
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildSingleValueFilterCore(object value, bool invert)
		{
			if (invert)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(PropertyName, ((DateTime)value).Yield());
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator BuildValuesFilterCore(FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions, CheckedValuesInfo checkedValuesInfo, bool nullOnNoUncheckedValues, CriteriaOperator indeterminateFilter)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			if (HierarchyFilterBuilderHelper.IsFirstElementBlank(checkedValuesInfo.CheckedValues))
			{
				val = GetBlanksFilter(PropertyName);
			}
			return val | MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(PropertyName, checkedValuesInfo.CheckedValues.OfType<DateTime>()) | indeterminateFilter;
		}
	}

			return (ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable)(object)((customFunction is ICustomFunctionOperatorBrowsable) ? customFunction : null);

	public sealed class GroupNode<T> : NodeBase<T>
	{
		internal class GroupNodeCounters
		{
			private int count;

			private int visibleCount;

			private int nullCount;

			private int visibleNullCount;

			private int checkedCount;

			private int visibleCheckedCount;

			public bool HasVisibleNodes()
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(visibleCount, "visibleCount");
				return visibleCount > 0;
			}

			public void OnChildAdded(NodeBase<T> child)
			{
				count++;
				if (child.IsVisible)
				{
					visibleCount++;
				}
				OnChildIsCheckedChanged(child, false);
				OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(child, false);
			}

			public void OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> childNode, bool? oldValue)
			{
				OnChildActualIsCheckedChangedCore(childNode.ActualIsChecked, oldValue, count, ref checkedCount, ref nullCount);
			}

			public void OnChildIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> childNode, bool? oldValue)
			{
				if (childNode.IsVisible)
				{
					OnChildActualIsCheckedChangedCore(childNode.IsChecked, oldValue, visibleCount, ref visibleCheckedCount, ref visibleNullCount);
				}
			}

			private static void OnChildActualIsCheckedChangedCore(bool? isChecked, bool? oldIsChecked, int totalCount, ref int checkedCount, ref int nullCount)
			{
				if (isChecked.HasValue && isChecked.Value)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentIsInRange(0, totalCount - 1, checkedCount, "checkedCount");
					checkedCount++;
				}
				if (!isChecked.HasValue)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentIsInRange(0, totalCount - 1, nullCount, "nullCount");
					nullCount++;
				}
				if (oldIsChecked.HasValue && oldIsChecked.Value)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentPositive(checkedCount, "checkedCount");
					checkedCount--;
				}
				if (!oldIsChecked.HasValue)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentPositive(nullCount, "nullCount");
					nullCount--;
				}
			}

			public void OnChildIsVisibleChanged(NodeBase<T> childNode)
			{
				if (childNode.IsVisible)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentIsInRange(0, count - 1, visibleCount, "visibleCount");
					visibleCount++;
					if (!childNode.IsChecked.HasValue)
					{
						Guard.ArgumentIsInRange(0, count - 1, visibleNullCount, "visibleNullCount");
						visibleNullCount++;
					}
					else if (childNode.IsChecked.Value)
					{
						Guard.ArgumentIsInRange(0, count - 1, visibleCheckedCount, "visibleCheckedCount");
						visibleCheckedCount++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Guard.ArgumentPositive(visibleCount, "visibleCount");
					visibleCount--;
					Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(visibleCount, "visibleCount");
					if (childNode.IsChecked.HasValue && childNode.IsChecked.Value)
					{
						Guard.ArgumentPositive(visibleCheckedCount, "visibleCount");
						visibleCheckedCount--;
					}
				}
			}

			public void FlushVisibleCounters(bool? isChecked)
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)isChecked, "VisibleIsChecked");
				visibleCheckedCount = (isChecked.Value ? visibleCount : 0);
				visibleNullCount = 0;
			}

			public bool? GetCheckedState()
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(count, "count");
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(checkedCount, "checkedCount");
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(nullCount, "nullCount");
				if (count != 0 && checkedCount == count)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (checkedCount != 0 || nullCount != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool? GetVisibleCheckedState()
			{
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(visibleCount, "visibleCount");
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(visibleCheckedCount, "visibleCheckedCount");
				Guard.ArgumentNonNegative(visibleNullCount, "visibleNullCount");
				if (count != 0 && visibleCheckedCount == visibleCount)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (visibleCheckedCount != 0 || visibleNullCount != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly GroupNodeCounters counters = new GroupNodeCounters();

		private readonly List<NodeBase<T>> ChildNodes = new List<NodeBase<T>>();

		public override bool HasNodes => true;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<T>> Nodes { get; }

		internal NodeParent<T> AsNodeParent { get; }

		internal GroupNode(T value, Action beginChecking, Action endChecking, GroupNode<T> parent)
			: base(value, beginChecking, endChecking, parent?.AsNodeParent)
		{
			Nodes = ChildNodes.AsReadOnly();
			AsNodeParent = new NodeParent<T>(OnChildIsVisibleChanged, OnChildCountSummaryChanged, AddChild, OnChildIsCheckedChanged, OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged);
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<NodeBase<T>> GetChildren()
		{
			return Nodes;
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<NodeBase<T>> GetChildrenFast()
		{
			return Nodes;
		}

		internal void AddChild(NodeBase<T> node)
		{
			ChildNodes.Add(node);
			counters.OnChildAdded(node);
			UpdateIsChecked();
			SetActualIsChecked(counters.GetCheckedState());
			if (node.IsVisible)
			{
				base.Count += node.Count;
			}
		}

		internal override bool HasVisibleChildren()
		{
			return counters.HasVisibleNodes();
		}

		private void UpdateIsChecked()
		{
			base.SetIsCheckedInternal(counters.GetVisibleCheckedState(), IsCheckedUpdateMode.Parent);
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualIsChecked()
		{
			bool? actualIsChecked = ((ChildNodes.Count == 0) ? base.IsChecked : counters.GetCheckedState());
			SetActualIsChecked(actualIsChecked);
		}

		internal void OnChildCountSummaryChanged(NodeBase<T> child, int? oldCount)
		{
			if (child.IsVisible)
			{
				base.Count += child.Count - oldCount;
			}
		}

		internal void OnChildIsVisibleChanged(NodeBase<T> node)
		{
			counters.OnChildIsVisibleChanged(node);
			UpdateIsChecked();
			base.Count += (node.IsVisible ? node.Count : (-node.Count));
		}

		internal void OnChildIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> node, bool? oldValue)
		{
			counters.OnChildIsCheckedChanged(node, oldValue);
			UpdateIsChecked();
		}

		internal void OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> node, bool? oldValue)
		{
			counters.OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(node, oldValue);
			UpdateActualIsChecked();
		}

		protected override void SetIsCheckedOnChildren()
		{
			counters.FlushVisibleCounters(base.IsChecked);
			foreach (NodeBase<T> item in from x in GetChildren()
				where x.IsVisible
				select x)
			{
				item.SetIsCheckedInternal(base.IsChecked, IsCheckedUpdateMode.Children);
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class GroupValueNode<T> : ValueNodeBase<T>
	{
		private GroupNode<T>.GroupNodeCounters counters;

		private Lazy<ReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<T>>> nodes;

		public override bool HasNodes => nodes != null;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<T>> Nodes => nodes?.Value;

		private bool NodesLoaded
		{
			get
			{
				if (nodes != null)
				{
					return counters != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal GroupValueNode(T value, Action beginChecking, Action endChecking, NodeParent<T> parent, Func<Task<ICollection<NodeBase<T>>>> getChildren)
			: base(value, beginChecking, endChecking, parent)
		{
			GroupValueNode<T> groupValueNode = this;
			if (getChildren != null)
			{
				nodes = new Lazy<ReadOnlyCollection<NodeBase<T>>>(delegate
				{
					ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<T>> val = (ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<T>>)(object)new ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<NodeBase<T>>>();
					groupValueNode.ProcessChildren(val, getChildren);
					return new ReadOnlyObservableCollection<NodeBase<T>>((ObservableCollection<NodeBase<T>>)(object)val);
				});
			}
		}

		private async void ProcessChildren(ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<T>> childrenList, Func<Task<ICollection<NodeBase<T>>>> getChildren)
		{
			ICollection<NodeBase<T>> collection = await getChildren();
			GroupNode<T>.GroupNodeCounters groupNodeCounters = new GroupNode<T>.GroupNodeCounters();
			((ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<NodeBase<T>>>)(object)childrenList).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (NodeBase<T> item in collection)
			{
				((Collection<NodeBase<T>>)(object)childrenList).Add(item);
				if (IsChecked == true)
				{
					item.IsChecked = true;
				}
				groupNodeCounters.OnChildAdded(item);
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<NodeBase<NodeBase<T>>>)(object)childrenList).EndUpdate();
			counters = groupNodeCounters;
		}

		protected override void UpdateActualIsChecked()
		{
			SetActualIsChecked((HasNodes && NodesLoaded) ? counters.GetCheckedState() : base.IsChecked);
		}

		internal void OnChildIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> child, bool? oldValue)
		{
			if (NodesLoaded)
			{
				counters.OnChildIsCheckedChanged(child, oldValue);
				((NodeBase<T>)this).SetIsCheckedInternal(counters.GetVisibleCheckedState(), IsCheckedUpdateMode.Parent);
			}
		}

		internal void OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(NodeBase<T> child, bool? oldValue)
		{
			if (NodesLoaded)
			{
				counters.OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(child, oldValue);
				UpdateActualIsChecked();
			}
		}

		protected override void SetIsCheckedOnChildren()
		{
			if (!HasNodes || !NodesLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			counters.FlushVisibleCounters(base.IsChecked);
			foreach (NodeBase<T> node in Nodes)
			{
				node.SetIsCheckedInternal(base.IsChecked, IsCheckedUpdateMode.Children);
			}
		}
	}

		Value,
		DisplayText
	}
	internal class NodeParent<T>
	{
		public readonly Action<NodeBase<T>> OnChildIsVisibleChanged;

		public readonly Action<NodeBase<T>, int?> OnChildCountSummaryChanged;

		public readonly Action<NodeBase<T>> OnChildCreated;

		public readonly Action<NodeBase<T>, bool?> OnChildIsCheckedChanged;

		public readonly Action<NodeBase<T>, bool?> OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged;

		public NodeParent(Action<NodeBase<T>> onChildIsVisibleChanged, Action<NodeBase<T>, int?> onChildCountSummaryChanged, Action<NodeBase<T>> onChildCreated, Action<NodeBase<T>, bool?> onChildIsCheckedChanged, Action<NodeBase<T>, bool?> onChildActualIsCheckedChanged)
		{
			OnChildIsVisibleChanged = onChildIsVisibleChanged;
			OnChildCountSummaryChanged = onChildCountSummaryChanged;
			OnChildCreated = onChildCreated;
			OnChildIsCheckedChanged = onChildIsCheckedChanged;
			OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged = onChildActualIsCheckedChanged;
		}
	}
	public abstract class NodeBase<T> : BindableFast
	{
		internal enum IsCheckedUpdateMode
		{
			Parent = 1,
			Children,
			ParentAndChildren
		}

		private readonly Action beginChecking;

		private readonly Action endChecking;

		private bool? isCheckedCore = false;

		private bool isVisibleCore;

		private int? countCore;

		private bool shouldUpdateCountProperty;

		private bool isExpanded;

		public T Value { get; }

		internal NodeParent<T> Parent { get; }

		public bool? IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return isCheckedCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsChecked != value)
				{
					Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)value, "value");
					beginChecking?.Invoke();
					SetIsCheckedInternal(value, IsCheckedUpdateMode.ParentAndChildren);
					endChecking?.Invoke();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool? ActualIsChecked { get; private set; }

		public bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return isVisibleCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (isVisibleCore != value)
				{
					isVisibleCore = value;
					Parent?.OnChildIsVisibleChanged(this);
				}
			}
		}

		public int? Count
		{
			get
			{
				return countCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (countCore != value)
				{
					int? arg = countCore;
					countCore = value;
					shouldUpdateCountProperty = true;
					Parent?.OnChildCountSummaryChanged(this, arg);
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowCount => Count.HasValue;

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return isExpanded;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ref isExpanded, value, "IsExpanded");
			}
		}

		public abstract bool HasNodes { get; }

		internal NodeBase(T value, Action beginChecking, Action endChecking, NodeParent<T> parent)
		{
			this.beginChecking = beginChecking;
			this.endChecking = endChecking;
			Value = value;
			ActualIsChecked = false;
			Count = 0;
			IsVisible = true;
			Parent = parent;
			Parent?.OnChildCreated(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual IEnumerable<NodeBase<T>> GetChildren()
		{
			return Enumerable.Empty<NodeBase<T>>();
		}

		protected internal virtual IEnumerable<NodeBase<T>> GetChildrenFast()
		{
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual bool HasVisibleChildren()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetIsCheckedInternal(bool? value, IsCheckedUpdateMode updateMode)
		{
			if (IsChecked != value)
			{
				bool? isChecked = IsChecked;
				SetValue(ref isCheckedCore, value, "IsChecked");
				if (updateMode.HasFlag(IsCheckedUpdateMode.Children))
				{
					SetIsCheckedOnChildren();
				}
				if (updateMode.HasFlag(IsCheckedUpdateMode.Parent))
				{
					Parent?.OnChildIsCheckedChanged(this, isChecked);
				}
				UpdateActualIsChecked();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetIsCheckedOnChildren()
		{
		}

		protected void SetActualIsChecked(bool? newIsChecked)
		{
			if (ActualIsChecked != newIsChecked)
			{
				bool? actualIsChecked = ActualIsChecked;
				ActualIsChecked = newIsChecked;
				Parent?.OnChildActualIsCheckedChanged(this, actualIsChecked);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateActualIsChecked();

		internal void RaiseCountChangedIfNeeded()
		{
			if (shouldUpdateCountProperty)
			{
				shouldUpdateCountProperty = false;
				if (IsVisible)
				{
					RaisePropertyChanged("Count");
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public static class CheckedTreeHelper
	{
		internal static IEnumerable<NodeBase<T>> GetDepthFirstNodes<T>(NodeBase<T> node)
		{
			return new NodeBase<T>[1] { node }.Flatten((NodeBase<T> x) => x.GetChildrenFast());
		}

		public static List<NodeBase<T>> GetTopmostCheckedNodes<T>(NodeBase<T> node)
		{
			List<NodeBase<T>> list = new List<NodeBase<T>>();
			if (node.ActualIsChecked.HasValue)
			{
				if (node.ActualIsChecked.Value)
				{
					list.Add(node);
				}
				return list;
			}
			foreach (NodeBase<T> node2 in ((GroupNode<T>)node).Nodes)
			{
				list.AddRange(GetTopmostCheckedNodes(node2) ?? new List<NodeBase<T>>());
			}
			Guard.ArgumentPositive(list.Count, "result");
			return list;
		}
	}
	public static class FilterModelHelper
	{
		private static readonly Type[] AllBooleanEditSettings = new Type[2]
		{
			typeof(CheckEditSettings),
			typeof(ToggleSwitchEditSettings)
		};

		private static readonly Type[] UnsupportedEditSettings = new Type[11]
		{
			typeof(RatingEditSettings),
			typeof(TrackBarEditSettings),
			typeof(HyperlinkEditSettings),
			typeof(ProgressBarEditSettings),
			typeof(BarCodeEditSettings),
			typeof(PasswordBoxEditSettings),
			typeof(ColorEditSettings),
			typeof(ImageEditSettings),
			typeof(SparklineEditSettings),
			typeof(MemoEditSettings),
			typeof(PopupColorEditSettings)
		};

		private static readonly Type[] UnsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings = new Type[6]
		{
			typeof(TokenComboBoxStyleSettings),
			typeof(CheckedTokenComboBoxStyleSettings),
			typeof(RadioTokenComboBoxStyleSettings),
			typeof(SearchControlStyleSettings),
			typeof(CheckedComboBoxStyleSettings),
			typeof(RadioComboBoxStyleSettings)
		};

		private static ComboBoxEditSettings ConvertBoolEditSettings(Type columnType, Func<object, string> getDisplayText)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ComboBoxEditSettings val = new ComboBoxEditSettings();
			List<object> list = new List<object> { true, false };
			if (columnType == typeof(bool?))
			{
				list.Insert(0, null);
			}
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ItemsSource = list.Select((object value) => new CustomComboBoxItem
			{
				EditValue = value,
				DisplayValue = getDisplayText(value)
			});
			((ButtonEditSettings)val).IsTextEditable = false;
			return val;
		}

		private static ComboBoxEditSettings ConvertComboBoxEditSettings(ComboBoxEditSettings editSettings)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BaseEditStyleSettings styleSettings = ((BaseEditSettings)editSettings).StyleSettings;
			if (!IsUnsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings((BaseComboBoxStyleSettings)(object)((styleSettings is BaseComboBoxStyleSettings) ? styleSettings : null)))
			{
				return editSettings;
			}
			ComboBoxEditSettings val = new ComboBoxEditSettings();
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ItemTemplate = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).ItemTemplate;
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ItemTemplateSelector = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).ItemTemplateSelector;
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ItemsSource = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).ItemsSource;
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ValueMember = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).ValueMember;
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).DisplayMember = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).DisplayMember;
			((LookUpEditSettingsBase)val).ApplyItemTemplateToSelectedItem = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)editSettings).ApplyItemTemplateToSelectedItem;
			return val;
		}

		private static bool IsUnsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings(BaseComboBoxStyleSettings styleSettings)
		{
			if (styleSettings == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type[] unsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings = UnsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings;
			foreach (Type type in unsupportedComboBoxStyleSettings)
			{
				if (type.IsInstanceOfType(styleSettings))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static BaseEditSettings ConvertListBoxEditSettings(ListBoxEditSettings listBoxEditSettings)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Expected O, but got Unknown

		public static BaseEditSettings GetSupportedEditSettings(BaseEditSettings editSettings, Type columnType, Func<object, string> getDisplayText)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}

			{
				return (BaseEditSettings)(object)ConvertBoolEditSettings(columnType, getDisplayText);
			}

		}

	internal static class DateRangesFilterBuilder
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator Build(string propertyName, IEnumerable<FilterDateRange> dateRanges)
		{
			List<FilterDateRange> list = new List<FilterDateRange>();
			List<DateTime> list2 = new List<DateTime>();
			foreach (FilterDateRange dateRange in dateRanges)
			{
				int? num = (dateRange.End - dateRange.Begin)?.Days;
				if (num < 3)
				{
					list2.AddRange(from x in Enumerable.Range(0, num.Value)
						select dateRange.Begin.AddDays(x));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(dateRange);
				}
			}
			return CreateRangesFilter(propertyName, list) | CreateDatesFilter(propertyName, list2);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator CreateRangesFilter(string propertyName, List<FilterDateRange> ranges)
		{
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			foreach (FilterDateRange range in ranges)
			{
				val |= RangeToCriteria(range, propertyName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator CreateDatesFilter(string propertyName, List<DateTime> dates)
		{
			if (dates.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(propertyName, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)dates);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator RangeToCriteria(FilterDateRange range, string propertyName)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BinaryOperator val = new BinaryOperator(propertyName, range.Begin, (BinaryOperatorType)5);
			if (!range.End.HasValue)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)(object)val;
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)(object)val & (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(propertyName, range.End.Value, (BinaryOperatorType)3);
		}
	}

	internal class FilterDateRange
	{
		public DateTime Begin { get; }

		public DateTime? End { get; private set; }

		public FilterDateRange(DateTime begin, DateTime? end)
		{
			Begin = begin;
			End = end;
		}

		internal bool Enlarge(FilterDateRange other)
		{
			if (End?.Year == other.Begin.Year)
			{
				int? num = End?.Month;
				int month = other.Begin.Month;
				if (num.GetValueOrDefault() == month && num.HasValue && End?.Day == other.Begin.Day)
				{
					End = other.End;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal static class DateRangesFilterInfo
	{
		public static IEnumerable<FilterDateRange> Create(IEnumerable<NodeBase<NodeValueInfo>> nodes)
		{
			List<FilterDateRange> list = new List<FilterDateRange>();
			FilterDateRange filterDateRange = null;
			foreach (NodeBase<NodeValueInfo> node in nodes)
			{
				if (node.Value.Value is DateTimeUnit dateTimeUnit)
				{
					filterDateRange = Process(list, filterDateRange, dateTimeUnit.DateTimeUnitType, dateTimeUnit.Date);
				}
				else if (node.Value.Value is DateTime)
				{
					filterDateRange = Process(list, filterDateRange, DateTimeUnitType.Day, (DateTime)node.Value.Value);
				}
			}
			if (filterDateRange != null)
			{
				list.Add(filterDateRange);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static FilterDateRange Process(List<FilterDateRange> ranges, FilterDateRange currentRange, DateTimeUnitType dateTimeUnitType, DateTime date)
		{
			return EnlargeGroup(ranges, currentRange, CreateDateRange(dateTimeUnitType, date));
		}

		private static FilterDateRange CreateDateRange(DateTimeUnitType dateTimeUnitType, DateTime date)
		{
			return dateTimeUnitType switch
			{
				DateTimeUnitType.Year => new FilterDateRange(new DateTime(date.Year, 1, 1), new DateTime(date.Year, 1, 1).AddYearSafe()), 
				DateTimeUnitType.Month => new FilterDateRange(new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, 1), new DateTime(date.Year, date.Month, 1).AddMonthSafe()), 
				DateTimeUnitType.Day => new FilterDateRange(date.Date, date.Date.AddDaysSafe()), 
				_ => throw new NotSupportedException(), 
			};
		}

		private static DateTime? AddDaysSafe(this DateTime date)
		{
			if (!(date > DateTime.MaxValue.AddDays(-1.0)))
			{
				return date.AddDays(1.0);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DateTime? AddYearSafe(this DateTime date)
		{
			if (!(date > DateTime.MaxValue.AddYears(-1)))
			{
				return date.AddYears(1);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DateTime? AddMonthSafe(this DateTime date)
		{
			if (!(date > DateTime.MaxValue.AddMonths(-1)))
			{
				return date.AddMonths(1);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static FilterDateRange EnlargeGroup(List<FilterDateRange> ranges, FilterDateRange currentRange, FilterDateRange newRange)
		{
			if (currentRange == null)
			{
				return newRange;
			}
			if (currentRange.Enlarge(newRange))
			{
				return currentRange;
			}
			ranges.Add(currentRange);
			return newRange;
		}
	}

	{

		public static string GetFilterDisplayText(CriteriaOperator filter, DisplayCriteriaHelperClient client, bool useFriendlyDateRangePresentation, Func<CriteriaOperator, object> raiseCustomDisplayCriteria)
		{
			Lazy<List<FormatConditionFilter>> formatFilters = new Lazy<List<FormatConditionFilter>>(() => client.GetFormatConditionFilters().ToList());
			return GetFilterPanelText(GetFilterCriteria(filter, client, useFriendlyDateRangePresentation, raiseCustomDisplayCriteria), (AppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo f) => formatFilters.Value.Any((FormatConditionFilter x) => FormatConditionFiltersHelper.IsMatchedInfo(x, f)));
		}

		internal static object GetFilterCriteria(CriteriaOperator filter, DisplayCriteriaHelperClient client, bool useFriendlyDateRangePresentation, Func<CriteriaOperator, object> raiseCustomDisplayCriteria)
		{
			if (useFriendlyDateRangePresentation)
			{
				filter = BetweenDatesHelper.SubstituteDateInRange(filter);
			}
			return raiseCustomDisplayCriteria(DXDisplayCriteriaGenerator.ProcessEx((IDisplayCriteriaGeneratorNamesSourceEx)(object)new DisplayCriteriaHelper(client), filter));
		}

		private static string GetFilterPanelText(object op, Func<AppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo, bool> isValidFormatConditionFilter)
		{
			if (op == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (op is CriteriaOperator)
			{
				return LocalaizableCriteriaToStringProcessor.Process((CriteriaOperator)((op is CriteriaOperator) ? op : null), isValidFormatConditionFilter);
			}
			return op.ToString();
		}

		private DisplayCriteriaHelper(DisplayCriteriaHelperClient client)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.client = client;
		}

		T IDisplayCriteriaGeneratorNamesSourceEx.WithDateRangeProcessing<T>(Func<T> func)
		{
			T result = default(T);
			inRangeLocker.DoLockedAction<T>((Func<T>)(() => result = func()));
			return result;
		}

		public string GetDisplayPropertyName(OperandProperty property)
		{
			return ReplaceEscapeSequences(client.GetColumn(property.PropertyName)?.HeaderCaption?.ToString() ?? property.PropertyName);
		}

		public string GetValueScreenText(OperandProperty property, object value)
		{
			if (property == null)
			{
				return GetValueString(value);
			}
			return GetColumnDisplayText(client, property.PropertyName, inRangeLocker.IsLocked, value);
		}

		public static string GetColumnDisplayText(DisplayCriteriaHelperClient client, string propertyName, bool roundDateTimeFilter, object value)
		{
			DisplayCriteriaColumnTraits column = client.GetColumn(propertyName);
			if (column != null && column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.Value)
			{
				TextEditSettings textSettings = default(TextEditSettings);
				ref TextEditSettings reference = ref textSettings;
				BaseEditSettings actualEditSettings = column.ActualEditSettings;
				reference = (TextEditSettings)(object)((actualEditSettings is TextEditSettings) ? actualEditSettings : null);
				return GetRoundDateDisplayTextOrFallback(roundDateTimeFilter, value, column.RoundDateDisplayFormat, textSettings, () => client.HasCustomColumnDisplayText() || !BetweenDatesHelper.CanSubstitute(textSettings) || column.RoundDateDisplayFormat != null, column.GetDisplayText);
			}
			return GetRoundDateDisplayTextOrFallback(roundDateTimeFilter, value, null, null, () => true, GetValueString);
		}

		private static string GetRoundDateDisplayTextOrFallback(bool roundDateTimeFilter, object value, string roundDateDisplayFormat, TextEditSettings settings, Func<bool> shouldUseRoundDateDisplayFormat, Func<object, string> fallback)
		{
			if (roundDateTimeFilter && value is DateTime && shouldUseRoundDateDisplayFormat())
			{
				return ((DateTime)value).ToString(roundDateDisplayFormat ?? "d", (settings != null && settings.MaskUseAsDisplayFormat) ? settings.MaskCulture : CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			return fallback(value);
		}

		private static string GetValueString(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return value.ToString();
		}

		private string ReplaceEscapeSequences(string input)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(input))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			input = input.Replace("\n", " ");
			input = input.Replace("\t", " ");
			input = input.Replace("\r", " ");
			input = Regex.Replace(input, "\\s{2,}", " ");
			return input;
		}
	}

		{

	internal abstract class DataErrorValidator
	{
		public MultiErrorInfo Validate(RowValidationObjectAccessor accessor, bool validatesOnNotifyDataErrors)
		{
			if (accessor == null)
			{
				return MultiErrorInfo.Create();
			}
			if (validatesOnNotifyDataErrors)
			{
				INotifyDataErrorInfo notifyDataErrorInfo = accessor.NotifyDataErrorInfo;
				if (notifyDataErrorInfo != null)
				{
					return CreateFromNotifyDataErrorInfo(notifyDataErrorInfo);
				}
			}
			IDXDataErrorInfo dXErrorInfo = accessor.DXErrorInfo;
			if (dXErrorInfo != null)
			{
				return CreateFromDXDataErrorInfo(dXErrorInfo);
			}
			IDataErrorInfo errorInfo = accessor.ErrorInfo;
			if (errorInfo != null)
			{
				return CreateFromDataErrorInfo(errorInfo);
			}
			return MultiErrorInfo.Create();
		}

		protected internal abstract MultiErrorInfo CreateFromNotifyDataErrorInfo(INotifyDataErrorInfo obj);

		protected internal abstract MultiErrorInfo CreateFromDXDataErrorInfo(IDXDataErrorInfo obj);

		protected internal abstract MultiErrorInfo CreateFromDataErrorInfo(IDataErrorInfo obj);
	}

	internal static class ValidationMultiErrorReader
	{
		public static MultiErrorInfo Read<T>(T[] errorContainers) where T : class
		{
			return Read(errorContainers, (T x) => x);
		}

		public static MultiErrorInfo Read<T>(T[] errorContainers, Func<T, object> containerExtractor) where T : class
		{
			//IL_00c2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (errorContainers == null || !errorContainers.Any())
			{
				return MultiErrorInfo.Create();
			}
			object obj = containerExtractor(errorContainers.First());
			return MultiErrorInfo.Create(MatchErrorContent(obj, (object obj2) => (obj2 == null) ? string.Empty : obj2.ToString(), (string str) => str, (ErrorInfo info) => info.ErrorText), errorContainers, MatchErrorContent(obj, (object _) => (ErrorType)1, null, (ErrorInfo info) => info.ErrorType));
		}

		private static T MatchErrorContent<T>(object obj, Func<object, T> fallback, Func<string, T> stringMatcher = null, Func<ErrorInfo, T> errorInfoMatcher = null)
		{
			if (stringMatcher != null && obj is string arg)
			{
				return stringMatcher(arg);
			}
			if (errorInfoMatcher != null)
			{
				ErrorInfo val = (ErrorInfo)((obj is ErrorInfo) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					return errorInfoMatcher(val);
				}
			}
			return fallback(obj);
		}
	}

		}

		public static void RemoveListener(INotificationManager manager, INotificationListener listener)
		{
			foreach (NotificationType supportedNotification in listener.SupportedNotifications)
			{
				GetManager(supportedNotification).ProtectedRemoveListener(manager, listener);
			}
		}

		private static NotificationEventManager GetManager(NotificationType notification)
		{
			Type managerType = notification switch
			{
				NotificationType.Data => typeof(DataType), 
				NotificationType.Layout => typeof(LayoutType), 
				_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
			};
			NotificationEventManager notificationEventManager = (NotificationEventManager)WeakEventManager.GetCurrentManager(managerType);
			if (notificationEventManager == null)
			{
				notificationEventManager = new NotificationEventManager(notification);
				WeakEventManager.SetCurrentManager(managerType, notificationEventManager);
			}
			return notificationEventManager;
		}

		private NotificationEventManager(NotificationType notification)
		{
			this.notification = notification;
		}

		private void OnRequireMeasure(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			DeliverEvent(sender, args);
		}

		protected override void StartListening(object source)
		{
			INotificationManager notificationManager = (INotificationManager)source;
			notificationManager.SubscribeRequireMeasure(notification, OnRequireMeasure);
		}

		protected override void StopListening(object source)
		{
			INotificationManager notificationManager = (INotificationManager)source;
			notificationManager.UnsubscribeRequireMeasure(notification, OnRequireMeasure);
		}
	}
	public class NotificationManager : DependencyObject, INotificationManager
	{
		private Delegate[] delegates = new Delegate[EnumHelper.GetEnumCount(typeof(NotificationType))];

		protected object owner;

		public NotificationManager(object owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		void INotificationManager.AcceptNotification(DependencyObject sender, NotificationType notification)
		{
			if ((object)delegates[(int)notification] != null)
			{
				((NotificationEventHandler)delegates[(int)notification])(owner, new NotificationEventArgs(sender, notification));
			}
		}

		void INotificationManager.SubscribeRequireMeasure(NotificationType notification, NotificationEventHandler eventHandler)
		{
			delegates[(int)notification] = Delegate.Combine(delegates[(int)notification], eventHandler);
		}

		void INotificationManager.UnsubscribeRequireMeasure(NotificationType notification, NotificationEventHandler eventHandler)
		{
			delegates[(int)notification] = Delegate.Remove(delegates[(int)notification], eventHandler);
		}
	}
	public interface ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner
	{
		DependencyObject NotificationManager { get; }

		void InvalidateMeasure();
	}
	public class LayoutNotificationHelper : INotificationListener, IWeakEventListener
	{
		private bool subscribed;

		protected ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner owner;

		private DependencyObject manager;

		IEnumerable<NotificationType> INotificationListener.SupportedNotifications => SupportedNotificationsCore;

		protected virtual IEnumerable<NotificationType> SupportedNotificationsCore => new NotificationType[1] { NotificationType.Layout };

		public LayoutNotificationHelper(ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void Subscribe()
		{
			if (!subscribed || manager != owner.NotificationManager)
			{
				manager = owner.NotificationManager;
				subscribed = NotificationEventManager.AddListener(manager, this);
			}
		}

		public void Unsubscribe()
		{
			NotificationEventManager.RemoveListener(manager as INotificationManager, this);
			subscribed = false;
		}

		bool IWeakEventListener.ReceiveWeakEvent(Type managerType, object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (managerType == typeof(NotificationEventManager))
			{
				NotificationEventArgs e2 = (NotificationEventArgs)e;
				ReceiveNotification(e2.Sender, e2.Notification);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void ReceiveNotification(object sender, NotificationType notification)
		{
			if (notification == NotificationType.Layout)
			{
				owner.InvalidateMeasure();
				ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner layoutNotificationHelperOwner = owner;
				ItemsControlBase val = (ItemsControlBase)((layoutNotificationHelperOwner is ItemsControlBase) ? layoutNotificationHelperOwner : null);
				if (val != null && val.Panel != null)
				{
					val.Panel.InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class InlineInfo
	{
		public string DisplayText { get; set; }

		public Style Style { get; set; }

		public object Data { get; set; }
	}
	public static class InlineTextService
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty InlineInfoProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("InlineInfo", typeof(InlineCollectionInfo), typeof(InlineTextService), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnInlineInfoChanged));

		public static InlineCollectionInfo GetInlineInfo(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (InlineCollectionInfo)obj.GetValue(InlineInfoProperty);
		}

		public static void SetInlineInfo(DependencyObject obj, IList<string> value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(InlineInfoProperty, value);
		}

		private static void OnInlineInfoChanged(DependencyObject obj, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(obj as TextBlock).Do(delegate(TextBlock t)
			{
				UpdateInlines(t, e.NewValue as InlineCollectionInfo);
			});
		}

		private static void UpdateInlines(TextBlock textBlock, InlineCollectionInfo info)
		{
			if (textBlock != null && info != null)
			{
				InlineTextUpdater inlineTextUpdater = new InlineTextUpdater();
				inlineTextUpdater.TextBlock = textBlock;
				inlineTextUpdater.UseInlines = info.HasStyle;
				inlineTextUpdater.Update(info);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class InlineTextUpdater
	{
		public TextBlock TextBlock { get; set; }

		public bool UseInlines { get; set; }

		public void Update(InlineCollectionInfo info)
		{
			if (info != null)
			{
				if (UseInlines)
				{
					UpdateInlines(info.InlineSource);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateText(info.TextSource);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateInlines(IList<InlineInfo> newValues)
		{
			if (TextBlock == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (newValues == null)
			{
				newValues = new InlineInfo[0];
			}
			if (!AreInlinesAssignedFrom(newValues))
			{
				SetRuns(newValues.Select((InlineInfo x) => CreateRun(x)));
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetRuns(IEnumerable<Run> runs)
		{
			TextBlock.Text = string.Empty;
			TextBlock.Inlines.Clear();
			TextBlock.Inlines.AddRange(runs);
		}

		private void UpdateText(string value)
		{
			TextBlock.Do(delegate(TextBlock x)
			{
				x.Text = value;
			});
		}

		private Run CreateRun(InlineInfo source)
		{
			Style style = source.Style;
			Run run = new Run(source.DisplayText);
			if (style != null)
			{
				run.DataContext = source.Data;
				run.Style = style;
			}
			return run;
		}

		private bool AreInlinesAssignedFrom(IList<InlineInfo> infoList)
		{
			Inline[] array = TextBlock.Inlines.ToArray();
			if (array.Length != infoList.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				Inline inline = array[i];
				InlineInfo info = infoList[i];
				if (!IsInlineAssignedFrom(inline, info))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsInlineAssignedFrom(Inline inline, InlineInfo info)
		{
			if (inline is Run run && run.DataContext == info.Data && run.Style == info.Style)
			{
				return run.Text == info.DisplayText;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class SummaryInlineInfoCreator
	{
		public Func<GridSummaryData, string> GetItemDisplayText;

		public Func<SummaryItemBase, Style> GetSummaryStyle;

		public Style DefaultStyle { get; set; }

		public string SeparatorText { get; set; }

		public InlineCollectionInfo Create(IEnumerable<GridSummaryData> data)
		{
			if (data == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IList<InlineInfo> list = new List<InlineInfo>();
			using (IEnumerator<GridSummaryData> enumerator = data.GetEnumerator())
			{
				bool flag = false;
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						list.Add(CreateSeparator());
					}
					list.Add(CreateItem(enumerator.Current));
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			InlineCollectionInfo inlineCollectionInfo = new InlineCollectionInfo(CreateTextSource(list), list);
			inlineCollectionInfo.HasStyle = CalcHasStyle(list);
			return inlineCollectionInfo;
		}

		private string CreateTextSource(IList<InlineInfo> inlineSource)
		{
			return string.Join(null, inlineSource.Select((InlineInfo x) => x.DisplayText));
		}

		private bool CalcHasStyle(IList<InlineInfo> inlineSource)
		{
			return inlineSource.Any((InlineInfo x) => x.Style.ReturnSuccess());
		}

		public virtual InlineInfo CreateItem(GridSummaryData data)
		{
			string displayText = null;
			if (GetItemDisplayText != null)
			{
				displayText = GetItemDisplayText(data);
			}
			Style style = null;
			if (GetSummaryStyle != null && data.Item != null)
			{
				style = GetSummaryStyle(data.Item);
			}
			return new InlineInfo
			{
				DisplayText = displayText,
				Style = (style ?? DefaultStyle),
				Data = new GridSummaryDisplayData(data, displayText)
			};
		}

		public virtual InlineInfo CreateSeparator()
		{
			return new InlineInfo
			{
				DisplayText = SeparatorText,
				Style = DefaultStyle,
				Data = new GridSummaryDisplayData(null, null, null, SeparatorText)
			};
		}
	}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[XtraSerializableProperty]
		public string UnboundDataTypeName
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ShouldSerializeUnboundDataType())
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return UnboundDataType.FullName;
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					UnboundDataType = typeof(void);
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					UnboundDataType = UnboundColumnTypeHelper.ResolveUnboundDataType(value) ?? typeof(void);
				}
				catch
				{
					UnboundDataType = typeof(void);
				}
				UnboundType = (UnboundColumnType)0;
			}
		}

		protected bool CanReduce
		{
			get
			{
				if (GetAllowResizing())
				{
					return ActualDataWidth - base.MinWidth > 1.0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayMemberBindingEditable
		{
			get
			{
				if (Binding == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Binding is Binding { Mode: BindingMode.TwoWay })
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Binding is MultiBinding { Mode: BindingMode.TwoWay })
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsActualReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ReadOnly && !IsReadOnlyVirtualSource() && IsDisplayMemberBindingEditable)
				{
					if (base.View != null && base.View.DataProviderBase != null)
					{
						return base.View.DataProviderBase.IsColumnReadonly(FieldName, requireColumn: true);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal IItemsProvider2 ItemsProvider
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsProvider;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0029: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006b: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (itemsProvider == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (itemsProvider != null)
				{
					itemsProvider.ItemsProviderChanged -= new ItemsProviderChangedEventHandler(itemsProvider_ItemsProviderChanged);
					if (OwnerControl != null && IsAsyncLookupBusy)
					{
						OwnerControl.UpdateColumnInstantFeedbackCounter(newValue: false);
					}
				}
				itemsProvider = value;
				if (itemsProvider != null)
				{
					itemsProvider.ItemsProviderChanged += new ItemsProviderChangedEventHandler(itemsProvider_ItemsProviderChanged);
					if (OwnerControl != null && IsAsyncLookupBusy)
					{
						OwnerControl.UpdateColumnInstantFeedbackCounter(newValue: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		bool IDefaultEditorViewInfo.HasTextDecorations
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				FormatConditionCollection formatConditionCollection = (base.View as ITableView).With((ITableView x) => x.FormatConditions);
				if (formatConditionCollection == null || !formatConditionCollection.HasNonEmptyTextDecorations())
				{
					return false;
				}
				ConditionalFormatMask conditionsMask = ConditionalFormattingMaskHelper.GetConditionsMask(formatConditionCollection.GetInfoByFieldName(FieldName));

		protected internal virtual int AutoBestFitWidth { get; protected set; }

		protected internal virtual int AutoBestFitHeaderWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (!autoBestFitHeaderWidth.HasValue)
				{
					if (base.View == null || base.View.ViewBehavior == null || !base.View.IsLoaded || base.View.IsTreeView || base.View.IsDesignTime)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					autoBestFitHeaderWidth = (int)Math.Ceiling(base.View.ViewBehavior.CalcHeaderBestFit(this));
					if ((double?)autoBestFitHeaderWidth == base.MinWidth)
					{
						autoBestFitHeaderWidth = null;
					}
				}
				if (!autoBestFitHeaderWidth.HasValue)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return autoBestFitHeaderWidth.Value;
			}
		}

		private Type GetEnumType(BaseEditSettings columnEditSettings)
		{
			BaseEditSettings obj = ((columnEditSettings is LookUpEditSettingsBase) ? columnEditSettings : null);
			object obj2 = ((obj != null) ? ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)obj).ItemsSource : null);
			if (obj2 != null)
			{
				if (!(obj2 is IEnumerable<EnumMemberInfo> source))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return source.FirstOrDefault()?.Id.GetType();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private DefaultBoolean CoerceAllowSorting(DefaultBoolean value)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (OwnerControl == null || !OwnerControl.IsDissalowSortingColumn(this))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return (DefaultBoolean)1;
		}

		private static void OnActualEditSettingsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (d is ColumnBase columnBase)
			{
				columnBase.OnActualEditSettingsChanged((BaseEditSettings)e.NewValue, (BaseEditSettings)e.OldValue);
			}
		}

		private void OnActualEditSettingsChanged(BaseEditSettings newValue, BaseEditSettings oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && (object)((FrameworkContentElement)(object)oldValue).Parent == this)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null && ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)newValue).Parent == null)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).AddLogicalChild((object)newValue);
			}
			ActualEditSettingsCore = newValue;
			UpdateActualCellTemplateSelector();
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				EditSettingsChangedEventHandler.Unsubscribe(oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				EditSettingsChangedEventHandler.Subscribe(newValue);
			}
			OnEditSettingsContentChanged();
			OnShowCheckBoxInHeaderChanged();
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.OnGroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameChanged();
			}
			UpdateActualAllowAutoFilterClearButton();
		}

		private void SetLeftSeparator(IList<ColumnBase> actualColumns)
		{
			if (actualColumns != null && actualColumns.Count > 0 && this == actualColumns.MinBy((ColumnBase x) => x.VisibleIndex))
			{
				base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(base.ParentBand.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth, right: false);
				base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor;
				base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor;
				base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor;
				base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor ?? base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool OnBandSeparatorChanged()
		{
			SeparatorForceUpdate = false;
			if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView) || base.ActualVisibleIndex == -1 || (tableView.UseLightweightTemplates.HasValue && tableView.UseLightweightTemplates.Value != UseLightweightTemplates.All))
			{
				return base.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
			}
			double actualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore = base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
			double actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore = base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush actualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore = base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore;
			System.Windows.Media.Brush actualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore = base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
			if (base.ParentBand == null)
			{
				base.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
			}
			else if (base.ParentBand.ActualRows != null && base.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in base.ParentBand.ActualRows)
				{
					if (actualRow.Columns != null && actualRow.Columns.Contains(this))
					{
						base.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
						if (actualRow.Columns != null && actualRow.Columns.Count > 0 && this == actualRow.Columns.MaxBy((ColumnBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex))
						{
							base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(base.ParentBand.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore);
							base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
							base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColorCore;
							base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore;
							base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColorCore ?? base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore;
							SetLeftSeparator(actualRow.Columns);
							break;
						}
						SetLeftSeparator(actualRow.Columns);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
			}
			bool flag = actualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore != base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore || actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore != base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
			if (flag || actualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore != base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore || actualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore != base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore)
			{
				UpdateContentLayout();
			}
			SeparatorForceUpdate = flag;
			return flag;
		}

		internal static string GetSummaryDisplayName(ColumnBase column, SummaryItemBase summaryItem)
		{
			return GetDisplayName(column, summaryItem.FieldName);
		}

		internal static string GetDisplayName(ColumnBase column, string fieldName)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return fieldName;
			}
			return column.HeaderCaption.ToString();
		}

		protected virtual void OnOwnerChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualHeaderCustomizationAreaTemplateSelector();
			UpdateActualHeaderTemplateSelector();
			UpdateActualHeaderToolTipTemplate();
			UpdateActualCellToolTipTemplate();
			UpdateActualCellTemplateSelector();
			UpdateActualCellEditTemplateSelector();
			UpdateActualEditSettings();
			UpdateAppearance();
			UpdateActualHeaderImageStyle();
			ValidateSimpleBinding(SimpleBindingState.Data);
			SetUnboundType();
			UpdateActualAllowAutoFilter();
			UpdateAutoFilterInitialized();
			OnActualShowCheckBoxInHeaderChanged(ownerChanged: true);
			UpdateActualHeaderStyle();
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateAutoFilterInitialized()
		{
			if (OwnerControl != null && !OwnerControl.IsDeserializing)
			{
				if (AutoFilterValue != null)
				{
					UpdateAutoFilter(autoFilterValueChanged: false);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateAutoFilterValueCore();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnAutoFilterRowStateChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			AutoFilterHeaderState autoFilterHeaderState = (AutoFilterHeaderState)e.NewValue;
			ColumnBase columnBase = (ColumnBase)(object)d;
			if (autoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit)
			{
				columnBase.View.DataControl.CurrentColumn = columnBase;
				columnBase.View.FocusedRowHandle = -2147483645;
				columnBase.View.AddHandler(ScrollViewer.ScrollChangedEvent, new ScrollChangedEventHandler(columnBase.OnViewScroll));
			}
			else
			{
				columnBase.View.RemoveHandler(ScrollViewer.ScrollChangedEvent, new ScrollChangedEventHandler(columnBase.OnViewScroll));
			}
			columnBase.RaiseContentChanged(AutoFilterHeaderStateProperty);
		}

		internal void OnViewScroll(object sender, ScrollChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.HorizontalChange != 0.0 && AutoFilterHeaderState == AutoFilterHeaderState.Edit)
			{
				AutoFilterHeaderState = AutoFilterHeaderState.Display;
			}
		}

		protected internal ColumnSortMode GetSortMode()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)SortMode == 0)
			{
				if (BaseEditHelper.GetRequireDisplayTextSorting(ActualEditSettings))
				{
					return (ColumnSortMode)2;
				}
				return (ColumnSortMode)1;
			}
			return SortMode;
		}

		internal bool ActualAllowTotalSummary(SummaryItemType summaryItemType)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			AllowedTotalSummaries actualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes = GetActualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes();
			switch ((int)summaryItemType)
			{
			case 0:
				return actualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes.HasFlag(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.Sum);
			case 1:
				return actualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes.HasFlag(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.Min);
			case 2:
				return actualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes.HasFlag(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.Max);
			case 3:
				if (base.View != null)
				{
					return base.View.ActualAllowCountTotalSummary;
				}
				return true;
			case 4:
				return actualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes.HasFlag(DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.Average);
			default:
				return !GetIsVirtualSource();
			}
		}

		internal bool ActualAllowTotalSummary()
		{
			return GetActualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes() != DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.None;
		}

		private AllowedTotalSummaries GetActualAllowedTotalSummariesTypes()
		{
			if (IsUnbound && GetIsVirtualSource())
			{
				return DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.None;
			}
			if (!AllowedTotalSummaries.HasValue)
			{
				if (!GetIsVirtualSource())
				{
					return DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.All;
				}
				return DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.AllowedTotalSummaries.None;
			}
			return AllowedTotalSummaries.Value;
		}

		protected virtual ColumnFilterInfoBase CreateColumnFilterInfo()
		{
			ColumnFilterInfoBase columnFilterInfoBase = OwnerControl?.CreateDateColumnFilterInfo(this);
			if (columnFilterInfoBase != null)
			{
				return columnFilterInfoBase;
			}
			switch (FilterPopupMode)
			{
			case FilterPopupMode.Disabled:
				return new DisabledFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.CheckedList:
				return new CheckedListColumnFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.Custom:
				return new CustomColumnFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.Excel:
				return new ExcelColumnFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.ExcelSmart:
				return new ExcelSmartColumnFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.List:
				return new ListColumnFilterInfo(this);
			case FilterPopupMode.Default:
				switch (OwnerControl?.DataView?.ColumnFilterPopupMode)
				{
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Disabled:
					return new DisabledFilterInfo(this);
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Excel:
					return new ExcelColumnFilterInfo(this);
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.ExcelSmart:
					return new ExcelSmartColumnFilterInfo(this);
				case ColumnFilterPopupMode.Default:
					if (!CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyColumnFilterPopup)
					{
						return new ExcelSmartColumnFilterInfo(this);
					}
					return new ListColumnFilterInfo(this);
				default:
					return new ListColumnFilterInfo(this);
				}
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		}

		private string GetNameFromAttributes()
		{
			if (OwnerControl?.ColumnsSource != null && OwnerControl.ColumnGeneratorTemplate != null)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val = OwnerControl.DataProviderBase.Columns[FieldName];
				if (val != null)
				{
					string text = (val.PropertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DisplayAttribute)] as DisplayAttribute)?.Name ?? (val.PropertyDescriptor.Attributes[typeof(DisplayNameAttribute)] as DisplayNameAttribute)?.DisplayName;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						return text;
					}
					return null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
