		private void UpdateSorting(string oldFieldName)
		{
			if (OwnerControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (OwnerControl.InvalidSortCache.ContainsKey(FieldName))
			{
				OwnerControl.UpdateSortingFromInvalidSortCache(this);
				return;
			}
			OwnerControl.UpdateDefaultSorting();
			OwnerControl.ApplyColumnSorting(this);
			if (oldFieldName != FieldName)
			{
				OwnerControl.SortInfoCore.OnColumnHeaderClickRemoveSort(oldFieldName);
			}
		}

		}

		protected virtual bool HasSizeableColumnsFromRight()
		{
			if (Owner.VisibleColumns == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = Owner.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(this);
			for (int i = num + 1; i < Owner.VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				if ((CanReduce || Owner.VisibleColumns[i].CanReduce) && Owner.VisibleColumns[i].GetAllowResizing() && (!Owner.VisibleColumns[i].FixedWidth || Owner.AutoWidth))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (num < Owner.VisibleColumns.Count - 1 && Owner.VisibleColumns[num + 1].CanReduce)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool GetActualAllowResizing(bool autoWidth)
		{
			if (!DesignerHelper.GetValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, GetAllowResizing() && Owner.AllowColumnsResizing, designerValue: true) || Owner.VisibleColumns == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!autoWidth || base.Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!base.HasRightSibling)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (OwnerControl != null && OwnerControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				return base.HasRightSibling;
			}
			if (Owner.VisibleColumns.IndexOf(this) == Owner.VisibleColumns.Count - 1 || !HasSizeableColumnsFromRight())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanReduce)
			{
				return HasSizeableColumnsFromRight();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetAllowEditing()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return DesignerHelper.GetValue((DependencyObject)(object)this, DefaultBooleanExtension.GetValue(AllowEditing, Owner.AllowEditing), designerValue: false);
		}

		private bool IsReadOnlyVirtualSource()
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0054: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (GetIsVirtualSource() && !AllowVirtualSourceEditing)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (base.View is ITableView && ((ITableView)base.View).EditFormShowMode != EditFormShowMode.None)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (base.View == null || (base.View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && !flag))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return (int)AllowEditing > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetAutoFilterValue(object value)

				filterUpdateLocker.DoLockedAction<object>((Func<object>)(() => AutoFilterValue = value));
				base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateAutoFilter(autoFilterValueChanged: true);
				});
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected void UpdateAutoFilter(bool autoFilterValueChanged)
		{
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).IsInitialized || InsertLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			Owner.LockEditorClose = true;
			lockAutoFilterUpdate = true;
			AutoFilterCondition condition = ResolveAutoFilterCondition();
			try
			{
				if (base.View != null && AutoFilterValue != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(AutoFilterValue.ToString()))
				{
					CriteriaOperator op = ((!AutoFilterCriteria.HasValue) ? (Owner as DataViewBase).CreateAutoFilterCriteria(FieldName, condition, AutoFilterValue) : (Owner as DataViewBase).CreateAutoFilterCriteria(FieldName, condition, AutoFilterValue, AutoFilterCriteria.Value));
					ApplyColumnFilter(op);
				}
				else if (autoFilterValueChanged)
				{
					ApplyColumnFilter(null);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Owner.LockEditorClose = false;
				lockAutoFilterUpdate = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).OnInitialized(e);
			UpdateAutoFilterInitialized();
		}

		protected internal AutoFilterCondition ResolveAutoFilterCondition()
		{
			if (ActualEditSettings is CheckEditSettings)
			{
				return AutoFilterCondition.Equals;
			}
			if (AutoFilterCondition != AutoFilterCondition.Default)
			{
				return AutoFilterCondition;
			}
			if (ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
			{
				return AutoFilterCondition.Like;
			}
			if (ActualEditSettings is DateEditSettings || ActualEditSettings is ImageEditSettings || ActualEditSettings is ProgressBarEditSettings || ActualEditSettings is TrackBarEditSettings || ActualEditSettings is LookUpEditSettingsBase)
			{
				return AutoFilterCondition.Equals;
			}
			return AutoFilterCondition.Like;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAutoFilterValue(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (!(Owner is DataViewBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ActualShowCriteriaInAutoFilterRow)
			{
				ClauseType? autoFilterCriteria = CriteriaOperatorToClauseType(op);
				if (autoFilterCriteria.HasValue)
				{
					AutoFilterCriteria = autoFilterCriteria;
				}
			}
			AutoFilterValue = ((DataViewBase)Owner).GetAutoFilterValue(this, op);
		}

		internal void UpdateAutoFilterValueCore()
		{
			if (!((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).IsInitialized || base.View == null || base.View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isFiltered;
			CriteriaOperator op = base.View.DataControl.GetColumnFilterCriteriaCore(this, out isFiltered, useGroupFields: false);
			IsFiltered = isFiltered;
			if ((!lockAutoFilterUpdate || OwnerControl.IsFilterSortEventLocked) && !InsertLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				filterUpdateLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateAutoFilterValue(op);
				});
			}
		}

		internal object GetAutoFilterValue(CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			return GetAutoFilterValue(op, AutoFilterCriteria);
		}

		protected object GetAutoFilterValue(CriteriaOperator op, ClauseType? autoFilterCriteria)
		{
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fd: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d6: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0225: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0229: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_022e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0214: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_021b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BinaryOperator val = (BinaryOperator)(object)((op is BinaryOperator) ? op : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator rightOperand = val.RightOperand;
				OperandValue val2 = (OperandValue)(object)((rightOperand is OperandValue) ? rightOperand : null);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				object value = val2.Value;
				if (value == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				AutoFilterCondition autoFilterCondition = ResolveAutoFilterCondition();
				if (autoFilterCondition == AutoFilterCondition.Equals && (int)val.OperatorType == 0)
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (autoFilterCriteria.HasValue && FilterClauseHelper.IsValidClause(this, autoFilterCriteria.Value, ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText, checkSingleFieldClause: true))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
			FunctionOperator val3 = null;
			if (autoFilterCriteria.HasValue && (autoFilterCriteria == (ClauseType?)11 || autoFilterCriteria == (ClauseType?)15))
			{
				UnaryOperator val4 = (UnaryOperator)(object)((op is UnaryOperator) ? op : null);
				if (val4 != null)
				{
					CriteriaOperator operand = val4.Operand;
					val3 = (FunctionOperator)(object)((operand is FunctionOperator) ? operand : null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val3 = (FunctionOperator)(object)((op is FunctionOperator) ? op : null);
			}
			if (val3 != null)
			{
				if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val3.Operands).Count != 2)
				{
					if (((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val3.Operands).Count == 3 && (int)val3.OperatorType == 1)
					{
						CriteriaOperator obj = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val3.Operands)[0];
						ConstantValue val5 = (ConstantValue)(object)((obj is ConstantValue) ? obj : null);
						if (val5 != null && ((OperandValue)val5).Value as string == "Like")
						{
							CriteriaOperator obj2 = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val3.Operands)[2];
							OperandValue val6 = (OperandValue)(object)((obj2 is OperandValue) ? obj2 : null);
							if (val6 != null)
							{
								return val6.Value as string;
							}
						}
					}
					return null;
				}
				CriteriaOperator obj3 = ((List<CriteriaOperator>)(object)val3.Operands)[1];
				OperandValue val7 = (OperandValue)(object)((obj3 is OperandValue) ? obj3 : null);
				if (val7 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				string text = val7.Value as string;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (FieldType == typeof(DateTime) && DateTime.TryParse(text, out var result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				AutoFilterCondition autoFilterCondition2 = ResolveAutoFilterCondition();
				if (autoFilterCondition2 == AutoFilterCondition.Contains && (int)val3.OperatorType == 48)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (autoFilterCondition2 == AutoFilterCondition.Like && (int)val3.OperatorType == 48)
				{
					if (!autoFilterCriteria.HasValue || autoFilterCriteria == (ClauseType?)14)
					{
						return "%" + text;
					}
					return text;
				}
				if (autoFilterCondition2 == AutoFilterCondition.Like && (int)val3.OperatorType == 46)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (autoFilterCriteria == (ClauseType?)13)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			GroupOperator val8 = (GroupOperator)(object)((op is GroupOperator) ? op : null);
			if (val8 != null)
			{
				return FilterClauseHelper.TryParseDayEqualsOperatorValue(val8);
			}
			UnaryOperator val9 = (UnaryOperator)(object)((op is UnaryOperator) ? op : null);
			if (val9 != null)
			{
				CriteriaOperator operand2 = val9.Operand;
				GroupOperator val10 = (GroupOperator)(object)((operand2 is GroupOperator) ? operand2 : null);
				if (val10 != null)
				{
					return FilterClauseHelper.TryParseDayEqualsOperatorValue(val10);
				}
				return null;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateTotalSummaries()
		{
			IList<SummaryItemBase> actualTotalSummaries = GetActualTotalSummaries();
			if (HasTotalSummaries || actualTotalSummaries.Any())
			{
				HasTotalSummaries = actualTotalSummaries.Any();
				TotalSummaries = CreateSummaryData(actualTotalSummaries, GetValue);
			}
			InlineCollectionInfo inlineCollectionInfo = GetTotalSummaryTextValues(TotalSummaries);
			string totalSummaryText = GetTotalSummaryText(inlineCollectionInfo);
			if (inlineCollectionInfo == null)
			{
				inlineCollectionInfo = new InlineCollectionInfo(totalSummaryText, null);
			}
			else
			{
				inlineCollectionInfo.TextSource = totalSummaryText;
			}
			TotalSummaryTextInfo = inlineCollectionInfo;
			TotalSummaryText = inlineCollectionInfo.TextSource;
		}

		internal string GetPrintingTotalSummaryText(Func<SummaryItemBase, object> getSummaryValue)
		{
			return GetTotalSummaryText(GetTotalSummaryTextValues(CreateSummaryData(GetActualPrintingTotalSummaries(), getSummaryValue)));
		}

		private string GetTotalSummaryText(InlineCollectionInfo info)
		{
			string text = info?.TextSource;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return " ";
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected IList<SummaryItemBase> GetActualTotalSummaries()
		{
			if (base.View == null)
			{
				return TotalSummariesCore;
			}
			return TotalSummariesCore.Where((SummaryItemBase item) => base.View.DataProviderBase.IsSummaryItemExists(SummaryItemCollectionType.Total, item)).ToList();
		}

		protected IList<SummaryItemBase> GetActualPrintingTotalSummaries()
		{
			if (base.View == null)
			{
				return TotalSummariesCore;
			}
			return TotalSummariesCore.Where((SummaryItemBase item) => base.View.GetActualCalculationMode(item) == GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows && base.View.DataProviderBase.IsSummaryItemExists(SummaryItemCollectionType.Total, item)).ToList();
		}

		private IList<GridTotalSummaryData> CreateSummaryData(IList<SummaryItemBase> summaries, Func<SummaryItemBase, object> getSummaryValue)
		{
			return summaries.Select((SummaryItemBase item) => new GridTotalSummaryData(item, getSummaryValue(item), Owner.GetColumn(item.FieldName))).ToList();
		}

		private InlineCollectionInfo GetTotalSummaryTextValues(IList<GridTotalSummaryData> summaryData)
		{
			SummaryInlineInfoCreator summaryInlineInfoCreator = new SummaryInlineInfoCreator();
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.SeparatorText = Environment.NewLine;
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.DefaultStyle = base.View.With((DataViewBase x) => x.TotalSummaryElementStyle);
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetItemDisplayText = (GridSummaryData d) => GetSummaryText(d);
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetSummaryStyle = (SummaryItemBase s) => s.TotalSummaryElementStyle;
			return summaryInlineInfoCreator.Create(summaryData);
		}

		internal static string GetDisplayFormatFromEditSettings(BaseEditSettings editSettings)
		{
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			TextEditSettings val = (TextEditSettings)(object)((editSettings is TextEditSettings) ? editSettings : null);
			if (val != null && val.MaskUseAsDisplayFormat && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.Mask))
			{
				return FormatStringConverter.GetDisplayFormat(val.Mask);
			}
			return FormatStringConverter.GetDisplayFormat(editSettings.DisplayFormat);
		}

		internal static string GetSummaryText(GridSummaryData data)
		{
			bool forceShowColumnName = false;
			data.Column.With((ColumnBase column) => column.View).Do(delegate(DataViewBase view)
			{
				forceShowColumnName = view.ForceShowTotalSummaryColumnName;
			});
			return GetSummaryText(data, forceShowColumnName);
		}

		internal static string GetSummaryText(GridSummaryData data, string forceDisplayFormat)
		{
			return GetSummaryText(data, forceShowColumnName: false, forceDisplayFormat, useForceDisplayFormat: true);
		}

		internal static string GetSummaryText(GridSummaryData data, bool forceShowColumnName, string forceDisplayFormat, bool useForceDisplayFormat)
		{
			if (forceShowColumnName)
			{
				return data.Item.GetFooterDisplayTextWithColumnName(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, GetSummaryDisplayName(data.Column, data.Item), data.Value, forceDisplayFormat);
			}
			return data.Item.GetFooterDisplayText(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture, GetSummaryDisplayName(data.Column, data.Item), data.Value, forceDisplayFormat, useForceDisplayFormat);
		}

		internal void UpdateHasTopElement()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (base.ParentBand != null)
			{
				flag = base.ParentBand.ActualRows.IndexOf(base.BandRow) > 0;
			}
			if (base.HasTopElement != flag)
			{
				base.HasTopElement = flag;
			}
			else
			{
				RaiseHasTopElementChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateHasBottomElement()
		{
			if (base.ParentBand != null && base.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count > 0)
			{
				base.HasBottomElement = base.ParentBand.ActualRows.IndexOf(base.BandRow) != base.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				base.HasBottomElement = false;
			}
		}

		}

		{

				{
					defaultSettings = val;
				}
				UpdateActualEditSettingsAndRaiseContentChanged(defaultSettings);
			}
			else

				UpdateActualEditSettingsAndRaiseContentChanged(EditSettings);

		}

		private DisplayMemberBindingCalculator CreateDisplayMemberBindingCalculator()
		{
			if (base.View == null || Binding == null)

			return displayMemberBindingCalculator;

		protected virtual void OnDisplayMemberBindingChanged()
		{
			if (Binding == null)
			{
				SetUnboundDataType(typeof(void));
			}
			if (!IsCloned)
			{
				DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.ValidateBinding(Binding);
			}
			simpleBindingProcessor = new SimpleBindingProcessor(this);
			ValidateSimpleBinding(SimpleBindingState.Binding);
			SetUnboundType();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(FieldName))
			{
				FieldName = PatchBindingName(DisplayMemberBindingCalculator.GetBindingName(Binding));
			}
			else
			{
				OnFieldNameChanged(FieldName);
			}
		}

		private string PatchBindingName(string name, int uid = 0)
		{
			if (ParentCollection == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return name;
			}
			string text = ((uid > 0) ? (name + uid) : name);
			if (ParentCollection[text] == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			return PatchBindingName(name, uid + 1);
		}

			}
			UpdateCellDataValues();
			UpdateSorting(oldValue);
			UpdateGrouping(oldValue);
			OnDataPropertyChanged();
			ValidateSimpleBinding(SimpleBindingState.Field);
		}

		{
			if (isAutoDetectedUnboundDataType)

				UnboundDataType = FilterUnboundType(unboundDataType);
				isAutoDetectedUnboundDataType = true;
			}
		}

		private static Type FilterUnboundType(Type unboundDataType)
		{
			if (unboundDataType.IsGenericType && typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(unboundDataType.GetGenericTypeDefinition()))
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(unboundDataType))
			{
				return typeof(object);
			}
			return unboundDataType;
		}

		protected virtual void OnIsCheckedChanged()
		{
			if (base.View != null && !UpdateIsCheckedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				isCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.ColumnCheckedChanged(this);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateIsChecked(bool ownerChanged = false)
		{
			if (base.View?.DataProviderBase != null && base.View.DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!ActualShowCheckBoxInHeader || isCheckedLocker.IsLocked || base.View?.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				if (!isCheckedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					UpdateIsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = null));
				}
				return;
			}
			bool? calculatedIsChecked = null;
			bool isCalculatedOnce = false;
			for (int num = 0; num < base.View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount; num++)
			{
				if (base.View.IsCellReadonly(num, this))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num);
				if (base.View.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
				{
					GroupRowInfoCollection groupInfo = ((DataController)base.View.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo;
					int childCount = groupInfo.GetChildCount(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
					for (int num2 = 0; num2 < childCount; num2++)
					{
						int childRow = ((DataController)base.View.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo.GetChildRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, num2);
						if (CalcIsChecked((bool?)base.View.DataControl.GetCellValue(childRow, FieldName), ref isCalculatedOnce, ref calculatedIsChecked))
						{
							UpdateIsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = null));
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				if (CalcIsChecked((bool?)base.View.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, FieldName), ref isCalculatedOnce, ref calculatedIsChecked))
				{
					UpdateIsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = null));
					return;
				}
			}
			UpdateIsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => IsChecked = calculatedIsChecked));
		}

		private static bool CalcIsChecked(bool? cellValue, ref bool isCalculatedOnce, ref bool? calculatedIsChecked)
		{
			if (isCalculatedOnce)
			{
				return cellValue != calculatedIsChecked;
			}
			isCalculatedOnce = true;
			calculatedIsChecked = cellValue;
			return false;
		}

		private void OnShowCheckBoxInHeaderChanged()
		{
			ActualShowCheckBoxInHeader = ShowCheckBoxInHeader && ActualEditSettings is CheckEditSettings;
		}

		private void OnActualShowCheckBoxInHeaderChanged(bool ownerChanged = false)
		{
			RaiseContentChanged(ActualShowCheckBoxInHeaderProperty);
			if (base.View != null && base.View.DataProviderBase != null && base.View.DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateIsChecked(ownerChanged);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateIsChecked(ownerChanged);
			}
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.ShowCheckBoxInHeaderColumnsChanged();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void AutoBestFitCacheClear()
		{
			autoBestFitCache.Clear();
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateAutoBestFitCache(long id, Func<int> getVisibleIndex, int width)
		{
			double num = AutoBestFitWidth;
			Tuple<Func<int>, int> tuple = null;
			if (autoBestFitCache.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				tuple = autoBestFitCache[id];
				autoBestFitCache[id] = new Tuple<Func<int>, int>(getVisibleIndex, width);
			}
			else
			{
				autoBestFitCache.Add(id, new Tuple<Func<int>, int>(getVisibleIndex, width));
			}
			ITableView tableView = base.View as ITableView;
			if (width > AutoBestFitWidth || (tableView != null && !tableView.AutoWidth && tuple != null && tuple.Item2 == AutoBestFitWidth))
			{
				UpdateAutoBestFitWidth();
			}
		}

		internal int? GetAutoBestFitWidth(long id)
		{
			if (autoBestFitCache.ContainsKey(id))
			{
				return autoBestFitCache[id].Item2;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateAutoBestFitWidth()
		{
			ITableView tableView = base.View as ITableView;
			if (base.View == null || base.View.ViewBehavior == null || !base.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsRange range = base.View.ViewBehavior.CalcViewPortRowsRange();
			double num = AutoBestFitWidth;
			List<KeyValuePair<long, Tuple<Func<int>, int>>> source = (base.View.HasFixedRows ? autoBestFitCache.Where((KeyValuePair<long, Tuple<Func<int>, int>> x) => (x.Value.Item1() >= range.TopRowHandle && x.Value.Item1() < range.TopRowHandle + range.RowCount) || base.View.RowIsFixedByVisibleIndex(x.Value.Item1())).ToList() : autoBestFitCache.Where((KeyValuePair<long, Tuple<Func<int>, int>> x) => x.Value.Item1() >= range.TopRowHandle && x.Value.Item1() < range.TopRowHandle + range.RowCount).ToList());
			if (source.Any())
			{
				SetAutoBestFitWidth(source.Max((KeyValuePair<long, Tuple<Func<int>, int>> x) => x.Value.Item2));
				if ((double)AutoBestFitWidth != num || (double)Math.Max(AutoBestFitWidth, autoBestFitHeaderWidth.HasValue ? AutoBestFitHeaderWidth : 0) != base.ActualWidth)
				{
					SetAutoBestFit();
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (base.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				SetAutoBestFitWidth(0);
			}
			if (!autoBestFitHeaderWidth.HasValue || (double)AutoBestFitHeaderWidth != base.ActualWidth)
			{
				SetAutoBestFit();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetAutoBestFitWidth(int maxVisibleWidth)
		{
			if (base.View is ITableView tableView && tableView.TableViewBehavior.IsFirstAndTreeColumn(this))
			{
				maxVisibleWidth -= (int)Math.Ceiling(tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)tableView.TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.GroupCount);
			}
			AutoBestFitWidth = maxVisibleWidth;
		}

		protected virtual void SetAutoBestFit()
		{
			if (base.View == null || BestFitModeOnSourceChangeLocker.IsLocked || AutoBestFitLocker.IsLocked || !base.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (base.View != null && base.View is ITableView && !BestFitModeOnSourceChangeLocker.IsLocked && base.WidthCore.IsAuto && base.ActualVisibleIndex >= 0 && (double)Math.Max(AutoBestFitWidth, AutoBestFitHeaderWidth) != base.ActualWidth)
				{
					((ITableView)base.View).TableViewBehavior.ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyBestFit(this, Math.Max(AutoBestFitWidth, AutoBestFitHeaderWidth), base.ParentBand == null, autoBestFit: true);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void ForceUpdateAutoBestFitCache()
		{
			AutoBestFitWidth = 0;
			AutoBestFitCacheClear();
			if (base.View == null || base.View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = Math.Max(0, base.View.PageVisibleTopRowIndex);
			CellEditor cellEditor = null;
			do
			{
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num);
				cellEditor = base.View.GetCellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, this);
				if (cellEditor != null)
				{
					UpdateAutoBestFitCache(cellEditor.Id, cellEditor.GetRowVisibleIndex, cellEditor.CalcBestFitWidth(null));
				}
				num++;
			}
			while (cellEditor != null);
		}

		protected override void OnWidthChanged(GridColumnWidth oldValue)
		{
			base.OnWidthChanged(oldValue);
			if (!oldValue.IsAuto && base.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				ForceUpdateAutoBestFitCache();
			}
			else if (!base.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				AutoBestFitCacheClear();
			}
		}

		protected override void HeaderWidthChanged()
		{
			autoBestFitHeaderWidth = null;
			UpdateAutoBestFitWidth();
		}

		protected internal BestFitMode? ActualBestFitModeOnSourceChange()
		{
			return BestFitModeOnSourceChange ?? (base.View as ITableView)?.BestFitModeOnSourceChange;
		}

		private void IsFilteredChanged()
		{
			RaiseContentChanged(IsFilteredProperty);
			HeaderWidthChanged();
		}

		internal virtual void OnIsSortedChanged(bool newValue)
		{
		}
	}
	public class ColumnFilteringUIDataContext : ImmutableObject
	{
		private Func<FilteringUIContext> context;

		public FilteringUIContext Context => context();

		public string PropertyName { get; }

		public DataTemplate Template { get; }

		public bool ApplyFilterImmediately { get; }

		public bool IncludeFilteredOut { get; }

		public string ClearFilterButtonCaption { get; }

		public ICommand ClearFilterCommand { get; }

		internal Func<UniqueValues, UniqueValues> GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab { get; }

		internal ColumnFilteringUIDataContext(Func<FilteringUIContext> context, string propertyName, DataTemplate template, bool applyFilterImmediately, bool includeFilteredOut, string clearFilterButtonCaption, ICommand clearFilterCommand, Func<UniqueValues, UniqueValues> getUniqueValuesForValuesTab)
		{
			this.context = context;
			PropertyName = propertyName;
			Template = template;
			ApplyFilterImmediately = applyFilterImmediately;
			IncludeFilteredOut = includeFilteredOut;
			ClearFilterButtonCaption = clearFilterButtonCaption;
			ClearFilterCommand = clearFilterCommand;
			GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab = getUniqueValuesForValuesTab;
		}
	}
	public class ExcelSmartColumnFilterInfo : ColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		private UnsubscribeAction unsubscribeFromFilteringContext;

		public ExcelSmartColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanShowFilterPopup()
		{
			DataViewBase view = base.View;
			object obj;
			if (view == null)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				DataControlBase dataControl = view.DataControl;
				obj = ((dataControl != null) ? dataControl.DataProviderBase.Columns[base.Column.FieldName] : null);
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				if (IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedUnaryFilters, AllowedUnaryFilters.None) && IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedBinaryFilters, AllowedBinaryFilters.None) && IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedBetweenFilters, AllowedBetweenFilters.None) && IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedDateTimeFilters, AllowedDateTimeFilters.None) && IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedAnyOfFilters, AllowedAnyOfFilters.None) && IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedDataAnalysisFilters, AllowedDataAnalysisFilters.None))
				{
					return !IsNoneFiltersAllowed(base.Column.AllowedFormatConditionFilters, AllowedFormatConditionFilters.None);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsNoneFiltersAllowed<T>(T? allowedFilters, T noneFilters) where T : struct
		{
			if (!allowedFilters.HasValue)
			{
				return GetIsVirtualSource();
			}
			return allowedFilters.Value.Equals(noneFilters);
		}

		protected override void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
		}

		protected internal override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private static ControlTemplate CreatePopupTemplate()
		{
			string xamlText = "<ControlTemplate xmlns:dxg='http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/grid' xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation'>\r\n                <dxg:ColumnFilteringUIContentControl Content='{Binding}' ApplyFilterImmediately='{Binding ApplyFilterImmediately}' />\r\n            </ControlTemplate>";
			return (ControlTemplate)XamlReader.Parse(xamlText);
		}

		private static DataTemplate CreatePopupContentTemplate()
		{
			string xamlText = "<DataTemplate xmlns:dxfui='http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/core/filteringui' xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation' xmlns:x='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml' xmlns:dxg='http://schemas.devexpress.com/winfx/2008/xaml/grid'>\r\n                <dxfui:ExcelStyleFilterElement x:Name='PART_FilterElement' />\r\n            </DataTemplate>";
			return (DataTemplate)XamlReader.Parse(xamlText);
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			FilteringUIContext filteringContext = base.View.DataControl.FilteringContext;
			DelegateCommand clearFilterCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				filteringContext.ApplyFilter(base.Column.FieldName, null);
			}, () => filteringContext.GetFilter(base.Column.FieldName) != null);
			unsubscribeFromFilteringContext = filteringContext.RegisterListener(new FilteringContextListener(delegate
			{
				clearFilterCommand.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}));
			DataTemplate template = base.Column.CustomColumnFilterPopupTemplate ?? CreatePopupContentTemplate();
			ColumnFilteringUIDataContext dataContext = new ColumnFilteringUIDataContext(() => filteringContext, base.Column.FieldName, template, base.Column.ImmediateUpdateColumnFilter, base.Column.GetShowAllTableValuesInFilterPopup(), base.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.ExcelColumnFilterPopupClearFilter.ToString()), clearFilterCommand, (UniqueValues getValues) => GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab(getValues, popup));
			((FrameworkElement)(object)popup).DataContext = dataContext;
			popup.PopupContentTemplate = CreatePopupTemplate();
		}

		internal override void OnPopupClosed(PopupBaseEdit popup, bool applyFilter)
		{
			base.OnPopupClosed(popup, applyFilter);
			unsubscribeFromFilteringContext?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeFromFilteringContext = null;
		}

		private UniqueValues GetUniqueValuesForValuesTab(UniqueValues uniqueValues, PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			Lazy<ExcelColumnFilterSettings> lazy = new Lazy<ExcelColumnFilterSettings>(delegate
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterSettings excelColumnFilterSettings = new ExcelColumnFilterSettings();
				List<object> innerList = uniqueValues.Value.Match((ReadOnlyCollection<object> x) => x, (ReadOnlyCollection<Counted<object>> x) => x.Select((Counted<object> y) => y.Value)).ToList();
				excelColumnFilterSettings.FilterItems = new TrackChangesList<object>(innerList);
				return excelColumnFilterSettings;
			});
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				base.View.RaiseFilterPopupEvent(base.Column, popup, lazy);
			}
			if (lazy.IsValueCreated && lazy.Value.IsChanged)
			{
				return UniqueValues.FromValues(lazy.Value.FilterItems.ToReadOnlyCollection());
			}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserColumn(IBandsOwner rootBand, BaseColumn source, bool isVisibleInHeaders)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			RootBand = rootBand;
			Source = source;
			InitializeValues(isVisibleInHeaders);
			SubscribePropertyChanges();
		}

		private void SubscribePropertyChanges()
		{
			unsubscribeAction = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeAction, (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine((UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(((DependencyObject)(object)Source).AddPropertyChanged(UpdateIsVisible, BaseColumn.VisibleProperty), ((DependencyObject)(object)Source).AddPropertyChanged(UpdateVisibleIndex, BaseColumn.VisibleIndexProperty)), ((DependencyObject)(object)Source).AddPropertyChanged(UpdateParentBand, BaseColumn.ParentBandProperty)), ((DependencyObject)(object)(Source as ColumnBase))?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateHeader, ColumnBase.ActualColumnChooserHeaderCaptionProperty)), ((DependencyObject)(object)(Source as BandBase))?.AddPropertyChanged(UpdateHeader, BaseColumn.HeaderCaptionProperty)));
			unsubscribeAction = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeAction, (UnsubscribeAction)delegate
			{
				Source = null;
				RootBand = null;
			});
		}

		internal static ExtendedColumnChooserColumn Factory(IBandsOwner rootBand, BaseColumn source, bool isVisibleInHeaders, ref UnsubscribeAction unsubscribeAction)
		{
			ExtendedColumnChooserColumn extendedColumnChooserColumn = new ExtendedColumnChooserColumn(rootBand, source, isVisibleInHeaders);
			unsubscribeAction = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(unsubscribeAction, extendedColumnChooserColumn.unsubscribeAction);
			return extendedColumnChooserColumn;
		}

		private void DoIfColumnsNotLocked(Action action)
		{
			DataViewBase view = Source.View;
			if (view == null || view.DataControl?.ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate != true)
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateIsVisible(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(UpdateIsVisible);
		}

		private void UpdateVisibleIndex(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(delegate
			{
				UpdateVisibleIndex();
			});
		}

		private void UpdateParentBand(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(UpdateParentBand);
		}

		private void UpdateHeader(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			DoIfColumnsNotLocked(UpdateHeader);
		}

		private void InitializeValues(bool isVisibleInHeaders)
		{
			UpdateIsVisible();
			UpdateVisibleIndex();
			UpdateHeader();
			UpdateParentBand();
			UpdateFixed();
			UpdateAllowHide(isVisibleInHeaders);
		}

		private void UpdateIsVisible()
		{
			initializationLocker.DoLockedAction<bool>((Func<bool>)(() => IsVisible = Source.Visible));
		}

		private void UpdateVisibleIndex()
		{
			VisibleIndex = Source.VisibleIndex;
		}

		private void UpdateHeader()
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = Source as ColumnBase;
			object obj = null;
			Header = ((columnBase != null) ? columnBase.ActualColumnChooserHeaderCaption : Source.HeaderCaption)?.ToString();
		}

		private void UpdateParentBand()
		{
			IBandsOwner parentBand = Source.ParentBand;
			ParentBand = parentBand ?? RootBand;
		}

		public void UpdateFixed()
		{
			if (Source.View != null)
			{
				Fixed = Source.View.ViewBehavior.GetActualColumnFixed(Source);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateAllowHide(bool isVisibleInHeaders)
		{
			bool canStartDragSingleColumn = Source.View != null && Source.CanStartDragSingleColumn;
			bool isLastVisible = Source.View != null && Source.IsLastVisible;
			AllowChangeVisibility = ((Source is BandBase) ? CanChangeBandVisibility(isLastVisible, isVisibleInHeaders) : CanChangeColumnVisibility(canStartDragSingleColumn, isVisibleInHeaders));
		}

		private bool CanChangeBandVisibility(bool isLastVisible, bool isVisibleInHeaders)
		{
			if (!isLastVisible)
			{
				return !isVisibleInHeaders;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanChangeColumnVisibility(bool canStartDragSingleColumn, bool isVisibleInHeaders)
		{
			if (canStartDragSingleColumn && isVisibleInHeaders)
			{
				if (ParentBand == null)
				{
					return !Source.View.IsLastVisibleColumn(Source);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnIsVisibleChanged()
		{
			if (Source != null)
			{
				Source.Visible = IsVisible;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			unsubscribeAction?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeAction = null;
		}
	}

						{
							PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = CloneDetailHelper.GetCloneProperties(dependencyObject, type, baseComponentType)[DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(property)];
							if (propertyDescriptor != null)
							{
								DependencyObject sourceElement = getTarget(sourceControl);
								object newValue = sourceElement.GetValue(property);
								DataControlOriginationElementHelper.EnumerateDependentElements(sourceControl, getTarget, delegate(DependencyObject dObject)
								{
									CloneDetailHelper.SetClonePropertyValue(sourceElement, propertyDescriptor, newValue, dObject);
								});
							}
						}
					}
				});
			}

			void IDataControlOriginationElement.NotifyCollectionChanged(DataControlBase sourceControl, Func<DataControlBase, IList> getCollection, Func<object, object> convertAction, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)

		private class EventArgsConverter : IDataRowEventArgsConverter, IDataCellEventArgsConverter
		{
			private readonly DataControlBase dataControl;

			public EventArgsConverter(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				this.dataControl = dataControl;
			}

			object IDataRowEventArgsConverter.GetDataRow(RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				DataViewBase dataView = dataControl.DataView;
				if (dataView == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IDataViewHitInfo dataViewHitInfo = dataView.CalcHitInfoCore(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
				if (!dataViewHitInfo.InRow)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return dataView.DataControl.GetRow(dataViewHitInfo.RowHandle);
			}

			CellValue IDataCellEventArgsConverter.GetDataCell(RoutedEventArgs e)
			{
				DataViewBase dataView = dataControl.DataView;
				if (dataView == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				IDataViewHitInfo dataViewHitInfo = dataView.CalcHitInfoCore(e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject);
				if (!dataViewHitInfo.IsRowCell)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new CellValue(dataView.DataControl.GetRow(dataViewHitInfo.RowHandle), dataViewHitInfo.Column.FieldName, dataView.DataControl.GetCellValue(dataViewHitInfo.RowHandle, dataViewHitInfo.Column.FieldName));
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]

		[CloneDetailMode(CloneDetailMode.Skip)]
		public string GetDataContextNameForDesignTime
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataContext == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Type type = base.DataContext.GetType();
				if (!ViewModelSourceHelper.IsPOCOGeneratedType(type))
				{
					return type.FullName;
				}
				return type.BaseType.FullName;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[CloneDetailMode(CloneDetailMode.Skip)]
		public string DesignTimeColumnsList
		{
			get
			{
				return designTimeColumnsList;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
				bool flag = value == "CreateEditSettings";
				designTimeColumnsList = null;
				InvalidateDesignTimeDataSource();
				PopulateDesignTimeColumns(ModelExtensions.GetRoot((IEditingContext)new RuntimeEditingContext((object)this, (EditingContextTrace)null)), expandSmartColumns: false);
				XDocument xDocument = new XDocument();
				XElement xElement = new XElement("Columns");
				xDocument.Add(xElement);
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					XElement xElement2 = new XElement("Column", new XAttribute("FieldName", item.FieldName));
					if (flag)
					{
						BaseEditSettings editSettings = item.EditSettings;
						if (editSettings != null)
						{
							string text = XamlWriter.Save(editSettings);
							XElement xElement3 = SafeXml.CreateXElement(text, (Action<XmlReaderSettings>)null);
							(from x in xElement3.Attributes()
								where x.Value == "{assembly:Null}"
								select x).Remove();
							xElement2.Add(xElement3);
						}
					}
					xElement.Add(xElement2);
				}
				designTimeColumnsList = xDocument.ToString();
				ColumnsCore.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren
		{
			get
			{
				List<object> list = new List<object>();
				list.Add(DataView);
				if (ItemsSource is InfiniteAsyncSource || ItemsSource is PagedAsyncSource)
				{
					list.Add(ItemsSource);
				}
				if (IsOriginationDataControl() && DetailDescriptorCore != null)
				{
					list.Add(DetailDescriptorCore);
				}
				if (BandsCore == null || BandsCore.Count == 0)
				{
					list.AddRange(ColumnsCore.Cast<object>());
				}
				else
				{
					list.AddRange(BandsCore.Cast<object>());
				}
				if (DataView != null && DataView.CheckBoxSelectorColumn != null)
				{
					list.Add(DataView.CheckBoxSelectorColumn);
				}
				return list.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected void RunDesignerInDesignTime(string value, Action<string> showWizard)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] inputs = value.Split(new char[1] { '|' }, 2);
			if (inputs.Length != 2)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TryParse(inputs[0], out var result))
			{
				resultEvent = new AutoResetEvent(initialState: false);
				SetSafeWaitHandle(resultEvent, new SafeWaitHandle(result, ownsHandle: true));
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(inputs[1]))
			{
				Dispatcher.CurrentDispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					try
					{
						showWizard(inputs[1]);
					}
					catch
					{
					}
					finally
					{
						resultEvent?.Set();
						resultEvent = null;
					}
				});
			}
			else
			{
				resultEvent?.Set();
				resultEvent = null;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private static void SetSafeWaitHandle(WaitHandle waitHandle, SafeWaitHandle value)
		{
			if (waitHandle == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("waitHandle");
			}
			waitHandle.SafeWaitHandle = value;
		}

		private bool TryParse(string s, out IntPtr result)
		{
			long result3;
			bool result2 = long.TryParse(s, out result3);
			result = new IntPtr(result3);
			return result2;
		}

		private static void OnBandsSourceChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			dataControlBase.ColumnsCore.BeginUpdate();
			dataControlBase.lockBandsSourceUpdate.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<DataControlBase, BandBase>.OnItemsSourceExtLockPropertyChanged(d, e, BandsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, BandGeneratorTemplateProperty, BandGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty, BandGeneratorStyleProperty, (DataControlBase grid) => grid.BandsCore, (DataControlBase grid) => grid.CreateBand());
				if (e.NewValue == null && ((DataControlBase)d).ColumnsSource != null)
				{
					ItemsAttachedBehaviorCore<DataControlBase, ColumnBase>.OnItemsSourcePropertyChanged(d, e, ColumnsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty, ColumnGeneratorTemplateProperty, ColumnGeneratorTemplateSelectorProperty, ColumnGeneratorStyleProperty, (Func<DataControlBase, IList>)((DataControlBase grid) => grid.ColumnsCore), (Func<DataControlBase, ColumnBase>)((DataControlBase grid) => grid.CreateColumn()), (Action<int, object>)null, (Action<ColumnBase>)null, (ISupportInitialize)null, (Action<ColumnBase, object>)null, true, true, (Func<ColumnBase, bool>)null, false);
				}
			});
			dataControlBase.ColumnsCore.EndUpdate();
			if (dataControlBase.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				((IBandsOwner)dataControlBase.BandsLayoutCore).OnColumnsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		internal static T FindElementWithAttachedPropertyValue<T>(DependencyObject d, DependencyProperty attachedProperty) where T : class
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(d, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject element) => element.GetValue(attachedProperty) != null), false, (DependencyObject)null);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (T)dependencyObject.GetValue(attachedProperty);
		}

		private static List<ColumnBase> SetGroupSortInfoAndBuildGroupedColumns(IColumnCollection columns, IList<GridSortInfo> sortInfo, int groupCount)
		{
			//IL_0101: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			foreach (ColumnBase column in columns)
			{
				column.GroupIndexCore = -1;
				column.SortIndex = -1;
				column.SetSortInfo((ColumnSortOrder)0, isGrouped: false);
				column.SetGroupMerge(mergeWithPreviousGroup: false, -1);
			}
			IList<GridSortInfo> list2 = sortInfo.Distinct(new GridSortInfoComparer()).ToList();
			groupCount -= sortInfo.Where((GridSortInfo info) => info.IsGrouped).Count() - list2.Where((GridSortInfo info) => info.IsGrouped).Count();
			int num = -1;
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < list2.Count; num2++)
			{
				GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = list2[num2];
				ColumnBase columnBase2 = columns[gridSortInfo.FieldName];
				gridSortInfo.SetGroupSortIndexes(-1, -1);
				if (columnBase2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = num2 < groupCount;
				columnBase2.SetSortInfo(gridSortInfo.GetSortOrder(), flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					columnBase2.GroupIndexCore = num2;
					gridSortInfo.SetGroupSortIndexes(-1, num2);
					list.Add(columnBase2);
					if (gridSortInfo.MergeWithPreviousGroup && num2 != 0)
					{
						columnBase2.SetGroupMerge(mergeWithPreviousGroup: true, num);
						continue;
					}
					num++;
					columnBase2.SetGroupMerge(mergeWithPreviousGroup: false, num);
				}
				else
				{
					int sortIndex = (columnBase2.SortIndex = num2 - groupCount);
					gridSortInfo.SetGroupSortIndexes(sortIndex, -1);
					columnBase2.SetGroupMerge(mergeWithPreviousGroup: false, -1);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal virtual void SetCellValueCore(int rowHandle, string fieldName, object value)
		{
			if (IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return;
			}
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(rowHandle, fieldName);
			DataProviderBase.SetRowValue(rowHandle, fieldName, value);
			if ((ItemsSource is IBindingList || ItemsSource is DataTable || ItemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged) && !CanNotifyChanges(rowHandle, fieldName))
			{
				DoUpdateRow(rowHandle);
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateGroupRowCheckedLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					UpdateGroupRowChecked(rowHandle, fieldName);
				});
			}
			DataView.RaiseCellValueChanged(rowHandle, ColumnsCore[fieldName], GetCellValue(rowHandle, fieldName), cellValue);
		}

			UpdateRowCore(rowHandle);
		}

		private bool CanNotifyChanges(int rowHandle, string fieldName)
		{
			object rowValue = DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(rowHandle);
			if (!(rowValue is INotifyPropertyChanged))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ColumnsCore[fieldName] != null && ColumnsCore[fieldName].IsUnbound)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowValue is IEditableObject && rowHandle == DataView.FocusedRowHandle && DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void RefreshData()
		{
			BeginRestoreOffset(() => -1);
			IRefreshable refreshableSource = DataProviderBase.RefreshableSource;
			if (refreshableSource != null)
			{
				refreshableSource.Refresh();
			}
			DataProviderBase.DoRefresh();
			UpdateSelectionRowsSummary();
			viewCore?.UpdateWatchErrors();
			viewCore?.UpdateScrollBarAnnotations();
			NotifyEndDataUpdate();
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionRowsSummary()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase?.DataController != null && viewCore != null)
			{
				UpdateSelectionRowsSummariesCore(TotalSummaryCore, (SummaryItemCollection)(object)((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).TotalSummary, (Action<List<SummaryItem>, bool>)((DataControllerBase)DataProviderBase.DataController).UpdateTotalSummary, (Action)viewCore.UpdateColumnsTotalSummary);
				UpdateSelectionRowsSummariesCore(GroupSummaryCore, ((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupSummary, (Action<List<SummaryItem>, bool>)((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).UpdateGroupSummary, (Action)viewCore.UpdateGroupSummary);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionRowsSummariesCore(ISummaryItemOwner gridSummary, SummaryItemCollection dataControllerSummary, Action<List<SummaryItem>, bool> updateDataControllerSummary, Action syncronizeGridSummary)
		{
			if (gridSummary != null && gridSummary.Any())
			{
				List<SummaryItem> arg = (from x in gridSummary
					where x.CalculationMode == GridSummaryCalculationMode.SelectedRows
					select dataControllerSummary.GetSummaryItemByTag((object)x) into x
					where x != null
					select x).ToList();
				updateDataControllerSummary(arg, arg2: false);
				syncronizeGridSummary();
			}
		}

		public void BeginDataUpdate()
		{
			DataProviderBase.BeginUpdate();
			BeginRestoreOffset(() => -1);
			DataProviderBase.BindingListAdapter.Do(delegate(BindingListAdapterBase x)
			{
				x.RaisesItemChangedEvents = false;
			});
		}

		public void EndDataUpdate()
		{
			EndDataUpdateCore();
			NotifyEndDataUpdate();
		}

		private void EndDataUpdateCore()
		{
			DataProviderBase.BindingListAdapter.Do(delegate(BindingListAdapterBase x)
			{
				x.RaisesItemChangedEvents = true;
			});
			IRefreshable refreshableSource = DataProviderBase.RefreshableSource;
			if (refreshableSource != null)
			{
				refreshableSource.Refresh();
			}
			DataProviderBase.EndUpdate();
		}

		protected internal virtual void BeginRestoreOffset(Func<int> getChangedVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (!CanAdjustScrollOffset)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked && DataView.RootNodeContainer != null && DataView.RootNodeContainer.Items.Count > 0 && DataView.RootNodeContainer.Items[0] is DataRowNode && ((DataRowNode)DataView.RootNodeContainer.Items[0]).Row == null)
			{
				scrollOffsetIsImmediate = true;
				DataView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					nodeDefinitions = SaveNodeDefinitions(DataView.RootNodeContainer, getChangedVisibleIndex());
				});
			}
			else
			{
				nodeDefinitions = SaveNodeDefinitions(DataView.RootNodeContainer, getChangedVisibleIndex());
			}
		}

		private IList<NodeDefinition> SaveNodeDefinitions(NodeContainer nodeContainer, int changedVisibleIndex)
		{
			List<NodeDefinition> list = new List<NodeDefinition>();
			if (nodeContainer == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			foreach (RowNode item in nodeContainer.Items)
			{
				if (item is DataRowNode dataRowNode && dataRowNode.ControllerValues.VisibleIndex != changedVisibleIndex && item.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					int visibleIndex = dataRowNode.ControllerValues.VisibleIndex;
					NodeDefinition nodeDefinition = new NodeDefinition(dataRowNode.Row, visibleIndex, DataView.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex), dataRowNode.Level, dataRowNode.View.DataControl, dataRowNode.Row ?? ((dataRowNode.RowHandle != null) ? GetRow(dataRowNode.RowHandle.Value) : null));
					nodeDefinition.Nodes.AddRange(SaveNodeDefinitions(dataRowNode.NodesContainer, changedVisibleIndex));
					list.Add(nodeDefinition);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndRestoreOffset()
		{
			if (scrollOffsetIsImmediate)
			{
				scrollOffsetIsImmediate = false;
				DataView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					EndRestoreOffsetCore();
				});
			}
			else if (nodeDefinitions != null && nodeDefinitions.Count > 0 && nodeDefinitions[0].Row == null)
			{
				DataView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					EndRestoreOffsetCore();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				EndRestoreOffsetCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void EndRestoreOffsetCore()
		{
			if (nodeDefinitions != null && CanAdjustScrollOffset && DataView != null && (DataProviderBase == null || !DataProviderBase.MakeRowVisibleLocker.IsLocked))
			{
				CorrectOffsetIfNeeded();
				nodeDefinitions = null;
			}
		}

		public void CorrectOffsetIfNeeded()
		{
			CorrectOffsetIfNeeded(nodeDefinitions);
		}

		private bool CorrectOffsetIfNeeded(IList<NodeDefinition> nodes)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (NodeDefinition node in nodes)
			{
				int num = ((node.Row != null) ? node.DataControl.FindRow(node.Row) : node.DataControl.FindRow(node.RowDirty));
				if (num == int.MinValue)
				{
					if (CorrectOffsetIfNeeded(node.Nodes))
					{
						return true;
					}
					continue;
				}
				while (node.Level < node.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(num))
				{
					int parentRowHandle = node.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetParentRowHandle(num);
					if (node.DataControl.GetRow(parentRowHandle) != node.Row)
					{
						break;
					}
					num = parentRowHandle;
				}
				int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = node.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(num);
				int num2 = DataView.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore) - node.ScrollIndex - offsetCorrection;
				if (num2 != 0)
				{
					DataView.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(DataView.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + (double)num2, skipValidation: true);
					offsetCorrection += num2;
				}
				CorrectOffsetIfNeeded(node.Nodes);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnItemsGenerated()
		{
			offsetCorrection = 0;
		}

		public override void BeginInit()
		{
			GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyBeginInit(this, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl);
			loadingCount++;
			base.BeginInit();
		}

		public override void EndInit()
		{
			UpdateUnboundColumnsType();
			GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyEndInit(this, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl);
			rebuildSortInfoPostponedAction.PerformActionOnEndInitIfNeeded((Action)RebuildSortInfo);
			loadingCount--;
			rePopulateColumnsPostponedAction.PerformActionOnEndInitIfNeeded((Action)OnColumnUnboundChanged);
			endInitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (base.IsInitialized)
				{
					OnInitialized(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
				base.EndInit();
			});
			if (DataView.Parent != this)
			{
				AddLogicalChild(DataView);
			}
			OnDataChanged(synchronize: true);
			InitializeSelection();
		}

		private void UpdateUnboundColumnsType()
		{
			if (DataView == null || DataView.OriginationView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GridColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.SetUnboundType();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnColumnUnboundChanged()
		{
			RepopuateColumnLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)OnColumnUnboundChangedCore);
		}

		private void OnColumnUnboundChangedCore()
		{
			if (LockRepopulateColumnsOnUnboundChanged)
			{
				NeedRepopulateColumnsOnUnboundChanged = true;
				return;
			}
			BeginDataUpdate();
			try
			{
				DataProviderBase.RePopulateColumns();
				if (DataView != null && !IsDeserializing)
				{
					SynchronizeDataProvider();
				}
				_FilteringContext?.NotifyColumnUnboundChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndDataUpdateCore();
			}
			UpdateSimpleBinding();
		}

		private void UpdateSimpleBinding()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.UpdateDisplayMemberBindingData();
			}
		}

		}

		private void OnColumnUnboundChangedPosponed(bool isLocked)
		{
			if (isLocked)
			{
				doUnboundChangedOnColumnsEndUpdate = true;
			}
			else
			{
				rePopulateColumnsPostponedAction.PerformIfNotLoading((Action)OnColumnUnboundChanged, (Action)null);
			}
		}

		}

		internal int GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (viewCore.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow && visibleIndex == VisibleRowCount - 1)
			{
				return -2147483646;
			}
			if (viewCore.ShouldDisplayBottomRow && visibleIndex == VisibleRowCount - 1)
			{
				return -2147483647;
			}
			return DataProviderBase.GetControllerRow(visibleIndex);
		}

		internal int GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (DataView != null && ((DataView.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow && rowHandle == -2147483646) || (DataView.ShouldDisplayBottomRow && DataView.IsNewItemRowHandle(rowHandle))))
			{
				return VisibleRowCount - 1;
			}
			return DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle);
		}

		internal int GetCommonVisibleIndex(int rowHandle)
		{
			int visibleIndex = GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			int commonVisibleIndex = 0;
			if (DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible && rowHandle == -2147483647)
			{
				visibleIndex = 0;
				commonVisibleIndex = -1;
			}
			EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl, int index)
			{
				commonVisibleIndex += dataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(index);
				commonVisibleIndex += index;
				if (dataControl.DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					commonVisibleIndex++;
				}
				if (dataControl != this)
				{
					commonVisibleIndex++;
				}
			}, visibleIndex);
			return commonVisibleIndex;
		}

		internal KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(int commonVisibleIndex)
		{
			return GetRootDataControl().FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndexCore(commonVisibleIndex);
		}

		private KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndexCore(int commonVisibleIndex)
		{
			MasterRowNavigationInfo masterRowNavigationInfo = MasterDetailProvider.CalcMasterRowNavigationInfo(commonVisibleIndex);
			if (masterRowNavigationInfo == null)
			{
				return default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			}
			if (!masterRowNavigationInfo.IsDetail)
			{
				int num = masterRowNavigationInfo.StartVisibleIndex;
				if (DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(DataView, num);
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(masterRowNavigationInfo.StartVisibleIndex);
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = MasterDetailProvider.FindVisibleDetailDataControl(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			return dataControlBase.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndexCore(masterRowNavigationInfo.DetailStartVisibleIndex);
		}

		internal void AddMRUFilter(CriteriaOperatorInfo filter)
		{
			if (filter != null)
			{
				if (((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Contains(filter))
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Remove(filter);
				}
				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Insert(0, filter);
				if (((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Count > MRUFilterListCount)
				{
					((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).RemoveAt(MRUFilterListCount);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveMRUFilter(CriteriaOperatorInfo filter)
		{
			((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Remove(filter);
		}

		public void AddMRUFilter(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (DataView?.UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel)
			{
				ForceCreateView();
				CriteriaOperatorInfo filter = new CriteriaOperatorInfo(filterCriteria, DataView.GetFilterOperatorCustomText(filterCriteria));
				AddMRUFilter(filter);
			}
			else
			{
				FilteringContext.AddMRUFilter(filterCriteria);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveMRUFilter(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			if (DataView?.UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel)
			{
				if (filterCriteria != null)
				{
					CriteriaOperatorInfo item = ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)MRUFiltersInternal).FirstOrDefault((CriteriaOperatorInfo x) => object.Equals(x.FilterOperator, filterCriteria));
					((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Remove(item);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FilteringContext.RemoveMRUFilter(filterCriteria);
			}
		}

		public void ClearMRUFilter()
		{
			if (DataView?.UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel)

				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Clear();

			else
			{
				FilteringContext.ClearMRUFilters();
			}
		}

		private CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs RaiseCustomUniqueValuesEvent(ColumnBase column, bool showAllValues, bool roundDateTime, CriteriaOperator columnFilter, Action<object> asyncCompleted)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs e = new CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs(column, showAllValues, roundDateTime, (OperationCompleted)delegate(object valuesObject)
			{
				asyncCompleted(valuesObject);
			}, columnFilter)
			{
				RoutedEvent = CustomUniqueValuesEvent
			};
			RaiseEventInOriginationGrid(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ICommand<UniqueValuesArgs> customUniqueValuesCommand = GetOriginationDataControl().CustomUniqueValuesCommand;
				if (customUniqueValuesCommand != null)
				{
					UniqueValuesArgs uniqueValuesArgs = new UniqueValuesArgs(column.FieldName, showAllValues, roundDateTime, ConvertCriteria(columnFilter));
					customUniqueValuesCommand.Execute(uniqueValuesArgs);
					e.UniqueValues = uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValues;
					e.UniqueValuesAsync = uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAsync;
					e.UniqueValuesAndCounts = uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAndCounts;
					e.UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync = uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync;
					e.Handled = uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValues != null || uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAsync != null || uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAndCounts != null || uniqueValuesArgs.UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync != null;
				}
			}
			return e;
		}

		protected internal object[] GetUniqueColumnValues(ColumnBase column, bool includeFilteredOut, bool roundDateTime, CriteriaOperator columnFilter, bool? implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering = null, CriteriaOperator remainingFilter = null)
		{
			Func<Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>?, Func<object[]>, object[]> uniqueValuesToArray = (Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>? uniqueValues, Func<object[]> defaultResult) => (!uniqueValues.HasValue) ? defaultResult() : uniqueValues.Value.Match((ValueAndCount[] left) => left.Select((ValueAndCount x) => x.Value).ToArray(), (object[] right) => right);
			Action<object[]> callback = delegate(object[] values)
			{
				column.ColumnFilterInfo.UpdateCurrentPopupData(values);
			};
			CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs e = RaiseCustomUniqueValuesEvent(column, includeFilteredOut, roundDateTime, columnFilter, delegate(object valuesObject)
			{
				callback(valuesObject as object[]);
			});
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				return DataProviderBase.GetUniqueColumnValues(column, includeFilteredOut, roundDateTime, implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering ?? ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, CriteriaOperator.And(FixedFilter, remainingFilter));
			}
			Task<Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>?> uniqueValuesAsync = e.GetUniqueValuesAsync();
			if (uniqueValuesAsync.Status == TaskStatus.RanToCompletion)
			{
				return uniqueValuesToArray(uniqueValuesAsync.Result, () => new object[1] { AsyncServerModeDataController.NoValue });
			}
			uniqueValuesAsync.ContinueWith(delegate(Task<Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>?> t)
			{
				if (t.Status == TaskStatus.Faulted)
				{
					throw t.Exception;
				}
				callback(uniqueValuesToArray(t.Result, () => new object[0]));
			}, CancellationToken.None, TaskContinuationOptions.None, TaskScheduler.FromCurrentSynchronizationContext());
			return new object[1] { AsyncServerModeDataController.NoValue };
		}

		}

		private void OnFilterCriteriaChanged()
		{
			FilterCriteriaChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				_FilteringContext?.SetFilter();
				UpdateHasConditionFormatFilters();
				CriteriaOperator val = CriteriaOperator.TryParse(FilterString, new object[0]);
				string text = ((FilterCriteria != null) ? ((object)FilterCriteria).ToString() : string.Empty);
				if ((val == null || !((object)val).Equals((object)FilterCriteria)) && text != FilterString)
				{
					FilterString = text;
				}
				ApplyFilter(checkFilterEnabled: false);
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					item.UpdateAutoFilterValueCore();
				}
				if (DataView != null)
				{
					DataView.UpdateFilterPanel();
					DataView.UpdateFilterGrid();
				}
				UpdatePropertySchemeController();
			});
		}

			HasPredefinedFormatConditionFilter = FormatConditionFiltersHelper.IsConditionFormatFilter(actualFilterCriteria, (TopBottomFilterKind)1);
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseFilterGroupSortChangingEventAndCheckChanges(FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs filterSortArgs)
		{
			RaiseFilterGroupSortChanging(filterSortArgs);
			if (filterSortArgs.FilterChanged)
			{
				FilterCriteria = filterSortArgs.GetFilterCriteria();
				if (viewCore != null && viewCore.SearchString != filterSortArgs.SearchString)
				{
					viewCore.SearchString = filterSortArgs.SearchString;
				}
			}
			if (IsSortInfoChanged(filterSortArgs.SortInfo, filterSortArgs.GroupCount))
			{
				int num = 0;
				List<GridSortInfo> list = new List<GridSortInfo>();
				foreach (SortDefinition item in filterSortArgs.SortInfo)
				{
					num++;
					list.Add(new GridSortInfo(item.PropertyName, item.Direction)
					{
						GroupIndex = ((num < filterSortArgs.GroupCount) ? num : (-1))
					});
				}
				SortInfoCore.ClearAndAddRangeCore(filterSortArgs.GroupCount, list.ToArray());
			}
			else if (filterSortArgs.GroupCount != sortInfoCore.GroupCountInternal)
			{
				SortInfoCore.GroupCountInternal = filterSortArgs.GroupCount;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual IList<SortDefinition> ConvertSortInfoToList(SortInfoCollectionBase sortInfoCore, out int groupCount)
		{
			groupCount = sortInfoCore.GroupCountInternal;
			List<SortDefinition> list = new List<SortDefinition>();
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in (Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)sortInfoCore)
			{
				list.Add(new SortDefinition(item.FieldName, item.SortOrder));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSortInfoChanged(IList<SortDefinition> newSortInfo, int newGroupCount)
		{
			int groupCount;
			IList<SortDefinition> list = ConvertSortInfoToList(SortInfoCore, out groupCount);
			if (groupCount != newGroupCount)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !ListExtension.SafeListsEqual<SortDefinition>(list, newSortInfo);
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyFilter(bool checkFilterEnabled, bool skipIfFilterEquals = false)
		{
			if (!IsLoading && !IsDeserializing && !IsFilterSortEventLocked)
			{
				FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs filterSortArgs = CreateFilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs();
				filterSortEventLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					RaiseFilterGroupSortChangingEventAndCheckChanges(filterSortArgs);
				});
				ApplyFilter(checkFilterEnabled ? GetActualFilterCriteria() : FilterCriteria, filterSortArgs, skipIfFilterEquals);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ApplyFilter(CriteriaOperator op, FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs filterSortArgs, bool skipIfFilterEquals)
		{
			CriteriaOperator filterCriteria = DataProviderBase.FilterCriteria;
			CriteriaOperator filterCriteriaForDataProvider = GetFilterCriteriaForDataProvider(op);
			if (skipIfFilterEquals && !filterSortArgs.FilterChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			dataResetLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				DestroyFilterData();
				if (op != null)
				{
					SetCurrentValue(IsFilterEnabledProperty, true);
				}
				object row = null;
				if (!AllowInitiallyFocusedRow && DataView != null && DataView.FocusedRowHandle != int.MinValue)
				{
					row = GetRow(DataView.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				if (DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
				{
					DataProviderBase.VirtualSourceAccess.Apply((SortDefinition[])null, (CriteriaOperatorValue?)CreateVirtualSourceFilter(filterCriteriaForDataProvider), (SummaryDefinition[])null);
				}
				else
				{
					DataProviderBase.FilterCriteria = filterCriteriaForDataProvider;
				}
				if (!DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
				{
					UpdateRowsCore(updateColumnsViewInfo: false);
					InitiallyFocusedRowAfterFiltering(row);
					UpdateTotalSummaryCore();
					if (DataView != null)
					{
						if (DataView.DataPresenter != null)
						{
							DataView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((IAction)(object)new ScrollRowsAfterApplyFilterAction(DataView));
						}
						if (DataView is ITableView)
						{
							((ITableView)DataView).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
						}
						DataView.UpdateIsCheckedForHeaderColumns();
						if (DataView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
						{
							DataView.UpdateCheckBoxSelectorState();
						}
					}
				}
			});
			_FilteringContext?.NotifyFilterChanged();
			if (filterCriteria != DataProviderBase.FilterCriteria)
			{
				RaiseFilterChanged();
			}
			DataView?.UpdateFilterGrid();
		}

		internal CriteriaOperatorValue CreateVirtualSourceFilter(CriteriaOperator filterCriteriaForDataProvider)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new CriteriaOperatorValue(SubstituteFilterInternal(filterCriteriaForDataProvider, SubstituteFilterTarget.GridRows));
		}

		protected virtual void InitiallyFocusedRowAfterFiltering(object row)
		{
			if (!AllowInitiallyFocusedRow && row != null && DataView != null && DataView.FocusedRowHandle != int.MinValue && GetRow(DataView.FocusedRowHandle) != row)
			{
				DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow = int.MinValue;
			}
		}

		}

		internal void UpdateDefaultSorting()
		{

			SortInfoCore.DefaultSorting = DefaultSorting;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultSorting))
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = ColumnsCore[DefaultSorting];

		protected virtual void OnItemsSourceChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is InfiniteAsyncSource || oldValue is PagedAsyncSource)
			{
				RemoveChild((FrameworkContentElement)oldValue);
			}
			if (newValue is InfiniteAsyncSource || newValue is PagedAsyncSource)
			{
				FrameworkContentElement frameworkContentElement = (FrameworkContentElement)newValue;
				if (frameworkContentElement.Parent == null)
				{
					AddChild(frameworkContentElement);
				}
			}
			bool skipCommitEditor = oldValue is InfiniteAsyncSource && newValue == null;
			DataSourceChangingLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				updateFocusedRowDataposponedAction.PerformLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					if (!IsLoading)
					{
						if (DataView != null)
						{
							if (!skipCommitEditor)
							{
								DataView.CommitAndCleanEditor();
							}
							DataView.ValidationError = null;
						}
						DestroyFilterData();
						ClearClonedDetails();
						SetDataSource();
						if (DataView != null)
						{
							DataView.OnDataSourceReset();
							DataView.UpdateContentLayout();
							if (DataProviderBase != null)
							{
								DataProviderBase.EndUpdateBase(DataView);
							}
						}
					}
				});
			});
			ICollectionView collectionView = newValue as ICollectionView;
			SubscribeCollectionViewCurrentItem(oldValue as ICollectionView, collectionView);
			UpdateUnboundColumnsAllowSorting(collectionView);
			ReturnCurrentItem();
			if (DataView != null && DataView.DataProviderBase.DataController != null)
			{
				((DataControllerBase)DataView.DataProviderBase.DataController).SummariesIgnoreNullValues = DataView.SummariesIgnoreNullValues;
			}
			RaiseItemsSourceChanged(oldValue, newValue);
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.InvalidateVirtualDataSource();
			}
			_FilteringContext?.NotifyItemsSourceChanged();
			if (ItemsSource == null)
			{
				RaiseVisibleRowCountChanged();
			}
			BestFitColumnsOnItemsSourceChanged();
		}

		private void ClearClonedDetails()
		{
			if (DetailDescriptorCore == null || (DataView != null && !DataView.IsRootView))
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				foreach (DataControlBase detailClone in dataControl.DetailClones)
				{
					detailClone.dataControlOriginationElement = null;
					DataViewBase dataView = detailClone.DataView;
					if (dataView != null)
					{
						DataControlPopupMenu dataControlMenu = dataView.DataControlMenu;
						if (dataControlMenu != null)
						{
							((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)dataControlMenu).Destroy();
						}
					}
					if (detailClone.ColumnsCore != null)
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase item in detailClone.ColumnsCore)
						{
							item.EditSettings = null;
						}
					}
				}
				dataControl.DetailClones.Clear();
			});
		}

			//IL_001c: Expected O, but got Unknown

				IVirtualSourceAccess val = (IVirtualSourceAccess)o;
				if (val.IsReady)
				{
					val.IsReadyChanged -= handler.Value;
					SetDataSourceCore();
					UpdatePagerControlPropertiesIfNeeded();
				}
			});
		}

		private void SubscribeCollectionViewCurrentItem(ICollectionView previousSource, ICollectionView newSource)
		{
			if (previousSource != null)
			{
				CurrentChangedEventManager.RemoveListener(previousSource, this);
			}
			if (newSource != null)
			{
				CurrentChangedEventManager.AddListener(newSource, this);
				CollectionViewSyncCurrentItem(newSource);
			}
		}

			}
			return false;
		}

		}
