		protected internal virtual void OnViewChanged(DataViewBase oldValue, DataViewBase newValue)
		{
			if (newValue == null)
			{
				DataView = (newValue = DesignTimeAdorner.GetDefaultView(this));
			}
			viewCore = newValue;
			ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			ValidateDataProvider(newValue);
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				DestroyFilterData();
				if (newValue.Parent is DataControlBase)
				{
					((DataControlBase)newValue.Parent).DataView = null;
				}
				newValue.DataControl = this;
				UpdateViewActualColumnChooserTemplate();
				UpdateBandsLayoutProperties();
				SynchronizeCurrentColumn();
				if (!IsLoading)
				{
					newValue.DataProviderBase.DataSource = ActualItemsSource;
				}
				if ((newValue != null && newValue.ViewBehavior.GetServiceUnboundColumns().Any()) || (oldValue != null && oldValue.ViewBehavior.GetServiceUnboundColumns().Any()))
				{
					AttachToFormatConditions((FormatConditionChangeType)3);
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.ChangeOwner();
			}
			ApplyNewView();
			if (newValue != null)
			{
				if (!IsLoading)
				{
					AddLogicalChild(newValue);
				}
				newValue.InitMenu();
			}
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.ResetMenu();
				oldValue.DataControl = null;
				oldValue.ResetDataProvider();
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
			}
			UpdateSearchPanel(oldValue, newValue);
			DesignTimeAdorner.UpdateDesignTimeInfo();
			UpdateColumnSummaries(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
			UpdateTotalSummary();
			UpdateAllowPartialGrouping();
			UpdateHasDetailViews();
			BestFitColumnsOnItemsSourceChanged();
			OnUseLegacyFilterPanelChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColumnSummaries(NotifyCollectionChangedAction action)
		{
			UpdateColumnSummaries(TotalSummaryCore, action, SummaryItemCollectionType.Total);
			UpdateColumnSummaries(GroupSummaryCore, action, SummaryItemCollectionType.Group);
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.UpdateColumnSummaries(action);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void AttachToFormatConditions(FormatConditionChangeType changeType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((Enum)changeType).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(FormatConditionChangeType)1))
			{
				OnColumnUnboundChangedPosponed();
			}
			else if (((Enum)changeType).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(FormatConditionChangeType)2))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		internal abstract void ValidateDataProvider(DataViewBase newValue);

		protected internal virtual void SynchronizeDataProvider(bool sortUpdate = false)
		{
			if (SortInfoCore.GroupCountCore > 0)
			{
				if (DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("GridControl does not support grouping data records from Virtual Source.");
				}
				if (viewCore != null && viewCore.IsPagingMode)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("The paged GridControl does not support grouping data.");
				}
			}
			syncronizationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				ApplyFilter(checkFilterEnabled: true, skipIfFilterEquals: true);
			});
			DataView.ScrollAnimationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				try
				{
					int groupCount = ((viewCore == null || !viewCore.IsPagingMode) ? SortInfoCore.GroupCountCore : 0);
					DataProviderBase.Synchronize((IList<GridSortInfo>)SortInfoCore, groupCount, GetFilterCriteriaForDataProvider(GetActualFilterCriteria()), sortUpdate);
				}
				catch (Exception e)
				{
					OnSynchronizeDataProviderException(e);
				}
			});
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
		}

		internal static T CoerceCommandArgs<T>(DependencyObject d, T value, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = ((FrameworkElement)d).GetBindingExpression(property);
			if (value != null || bindingExpression == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			CommandBindingValidationHelper.ValidateCommandBinding(bindingExpression, property);
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = (d as DataControlBase) ?? ((DataViewBase)d).DataControl;
			if (dataControlBase != null && dataControlBase.IsDataEventsCommandsReady())
			{
				dataControlBase.setDataSourcePostponedAction.PerformActionOnEndInitIfNeeded();
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal static void OnDataEventCommandChanged(DependencyObject owner, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = (DataControlBase)owner;
			dataControlBase?.OnDataEventCommandChangedCore(dataControlBase, e);
		}

		internal void OnDataEventCommandChangedCore(FrameworkElement owner, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldValue == null && owner.GetBindingExpression(e.Property) != null && IsDataEventsCommandsReady())
			{
				setDataSourcePostponedAction.PerformActionOnEndInitIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsDataEventsCommandsReady()
		{
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReadyCore(CriteriaConverter, this, CriteriaConverterProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataViewBase dataView = DataView;
			if (dataView != null && !dataView.IsDataEventsCommandsReady())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!DataEventCommandIsReady(CustomUniqueValuesCommand, CustomUniqueValuesCommandProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool DataEventCommandIsReady(ICommand command, DependencyProperty commandProperty)
		{
			return DataEventCommandIsReadyCore(command, this, commandProperty);
		}

		internal static bool DataEventCommandIsReadyCore(object command, FrameworkElement owner, DependencyProperty commandProperty)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = owner.GetBindingExpression(commandProperty);
			if (command == null)
			{
				return CommandBindingValidationHelper.IsBindingReady(bindingExpression);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool HasCustomSummaryCommand(ICommand summaryCommand, SummaryItemBase summaryItem)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (summaryCommand != null)
			{
				return (int)summaryItem.SummaryType != 6;
			}
			return false;
		}

				1 => SummaryType.Min, 
				2 => SummaryType.Max, 
				4 => SummaryType.Avg, 
				3 => SummaryType.Count, 
				5 => SummaryType.Custom, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("SummaryItemType"), 
			};
		}

		private void InvalidateDesignTimeDataSourceCore()
		{
			if (!updateDataSourceLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				updateDataSourceLocker.Lock();
				base.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					DesignTimeAdorner.InvalidateDataSource();
					updateDataSourceLocker.Unlock();
				});
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateDesignTimeDataSource()
		{
			OnItemsSourceChanged(ItemsSource, ItemsSource);
		}

		internal virtual void OnColumnsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GetDataControlOriginationElement().ColumnsChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
			UpdateColumnSummaries(e.Action);
			UpdateDefaultSorting();
			InvalidateDesignTimeDataSourceCore();
			DesignTimeAdorner.UpdateDesignTimeInfo();
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					ClearColumnFilter(oldItem);
				}
			}
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.ApplySearchColumns();
			}
			GetDataControlOriginationElement().SynchronizationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				OnDataCollectionChanged(sender, e);
			});
			if (BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyCollectionChanged(this, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl.ColumnsCore, (object obj) => CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement<BaseColumn>((BaseColumn)(ColumnBase)obj, (Action<BaseColumn>)null, (Func<BaseColumn, Locker>)null, (object[])null), e);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add)
			{
				NotifyColumnAddedRemoved(e.NewItems);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
			{
				NotifyColumnAddedRemoved(e.OldItems);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
			{
				NotifyColumnAddedRemoved(e.OldItems);
				NotifyColumnAddedRemoved(e.NewItems);
			}
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				NotifyColumnsReset();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldSynchronizeAfterAddColumns(IList addedColumns)
		{
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in (Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfoCore)
			{
				if (addedColumns != null && addedColumns.Contains(ColumnsCore[item.FieldName]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnTotalSummaryCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSummaryCollectionChanged(sender as ISummaryItemOwner, e, SummaryItemCollectionType.Total);
		}

		internal void OnGroupSummaryCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnSummaryCollectionChanged(sender as ISummaryItemOwner, e, SummaryItemCollectionType.Group);
		}

		protected internal void OnSummaryCollectionChanged(ISummaryItemOwner summaries, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			UpdateColumnSummaries(summaries, e.Action, collectionType);
			OnSummaryChanged();
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
		}

		protected internal void UpdateColumnSummaries(ISummaryItemOwner summaries, NotifyCollectionChangedAction action, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			if (!ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate && NeedCalculateSummaries(summaries))
			{
				if (summaries.Count == 0 || action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset || action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove)
				{
					SummaryItemCollectionUpdater.ClearColumnSummaries(collectionType, ColumnsCore);
				}
				SummaryItemCollectionUpdater.Update(DataView, collectionType, summaries, ColumnsCore);
			}
		}

		private bool NeedCalculateSummaries(ISummaryItemOwner summaries)
		{
			if (summaries == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ColumnsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return summaries.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase summaryItem) => (int)summaryItem.SummaryType == 3 && summaryItem.Alignment != GridSummaryItemAlignment.Default) != null;
		}

		internal void OnDataCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				if (DataView != null)
				{
					DataView.OnColumnCollectionChanged(e);
				}
				OnDataChanged(NeedSynchronize || ShouldSynchronizeAfterAddColumns(e.NewItems), rebuildVisibleColumns: true, SortUpdateLocker.IsLocked);
				NeedSynchronize = false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnSortInfoChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
			syncronizationLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate)
				{
					NeedSynchronize = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (sender == SortInfoCore)
					{
						ClearGroupSummarySortInfo();
					}
					OnDataChanged(synchronize: true, rebuildVisibleColumns: true, !HasCustomRowFilter || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly: true);
					if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataView?.SearchString))
					{
						DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = DataProviderBase;
						if (dataProviderBase != null)
						{
							BaseGridController dataController = dataProviderBase.DataController;
							if (dataController != null)
							{
								((DataControllerBase)dataController).DoRefresh();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearGroupSummarySortInfo()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual string GetSortFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			if (fieldName == null || ColumnsCore == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = ColumnsCore[fieldName];
			if (columnBase != null && columnBase.SortFieldName != null)
			{
				return columnBase.SortFieldName;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnSummaryChanged()
		{
			PerformDataResetLockedActionCore(delegate
			{
				SynchronizeSummaryIfAcitve();
				if (DataView != null)
				{
					DataView.OnSummaryDataChanged();
				}
			});
		}

		internal void SynchronizeSummaryIfAcitve()
		{
			if (IsActive)
			{
				DataProviderBase.SynchronizeSummary();
			}
		}

		private void OnDataChanged(bool synchronize = false, bool rebuildVisibleColumns = true, bool sortUpdate = false, bool updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly = false)
		{
			if (IsActive && synchronize && DataView != null)
			{
				SynchronizeDataProvider(sortUpdate);
			}
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.OnDataChanged(rebuildVisibleColumns, updateColumnsDataPropertiesOnly);
			}
		}

		private void OnUnloaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.ForceDestroyColumnChooser();
				ResetMenus();
			}
		}

		private void ResetMenus()
		{
			UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (dataControl.viewCore != null)
				{
					dataControl.viewCore.ResetMenu();
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ForceLoad();
			InitializeCurrentColumn();
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.UpdateVisibleGroupPanel();
				DataView.InitMenu();
				DataView.UpdateIsKeyboardFocusWithinView();
				DataView.ErrorWatch.GridLoaded = true;
				DataView.UpdateWatchErrors();
				if (DataView is ITableView tableView && DataView.IsRootView)
				{
					tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.GridLoaded = true;
					tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					item.AutoFilterCriteriaUpdate();
				}
			}
			if (AutomationPeer != null)
			{
				AutomationPeer.ResetDataPanelPeerCache();
			}
		}

		internal static IEnumerator GetSingleObjectEnumerator(object obj)
		{
			return ((obj == null) ? new object[0] : new object[1] { obj }).GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected internal void AddChild(FrameworkContentElement child)
		{
			if (BandsLayoutCore == null || DataView.Return((DataViewBase x) => (object)x.CheckBoxSelectorColumn == child, () => false))
			{
				AddLogicalChild(child);
			}
			if (child is ColumnBase)
			{
				OnAddColumn((ColumnBase)(object)child);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveColumnsFromLogicalChildren()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(item);
			}
		}

		protected internal void RemoveChild(FrameworkContentElement child)
		{
			if (child is ColumnBase)
			{
				OnRemoveColumn((ColumnBase)(object)child);
			}
			if (BandsLayoutCore == null || DataView.Return((DataViewBase x) => (object)x.CheckBoxSelectorColumn == child, () => false))
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(child);
			}
		}

		private void OnAddColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			UpdateColumnFilteringCounters(column.ActualAllowFilterEditor, null);
			UpdateColumnCellMergeCounter(null, column.AllowCellMerge);
			if (column.IsAsyncLookupBusy)
			{
				UpdateColumnInstantFeedbackCounter(newValue: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnRemoveColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			UpdateColumnFilteringCounters(null, column.ActualAllowFilterEditor);
			UpdateColumnCellMergeCounter(column.AllowCellMerge, null);
			if (column.IsAsyncLookupBusy)
			{
				UpdateColumnInstantFeedbackCounter(newValue: false);
			}
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<DataControlBase, BandBase> itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock = (ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<DataControlBase, BandBase>)GetValue(BandsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
			if (itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock == null)
			{
				DependencyObjectExtensions.SetDataContext((DependencyObject)(object)column, (object)null);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (themeLoader != null)
			{
				themeLoader.Content = null;
			}
			themeLoader = GetTemplateChild("PART_ThemesLoader") as ContentControl;
			SetDataControlContent(themeLoader);
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
		}

		protected virtual void SetDataControlContent(ContentControl content)
		{
			themeLoader.SetBinding(ContentControl.ContentProperty, new Binding("View")
			{
				Source = this
			});
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnInitialized(e);
			UpdatePropertySchemeController();
			ForceCreateView();
			SetDataSource();
			IsSync = true;
			if (DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource != null)
			{
				CollectionViewSyncCurrentItem(DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource);
			}
			DataView.RebuildColumns();
			InitializeSelection();
			_FilteringContext?.NotifyFilterChanged();
		}

		private void InitializeSelection()
		{
			if (endInitLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<DataControlBase> source = new List<DataControlBase> { this };
			if (IsOriginationDataControl())
			{
				source = from x in this.GetAllOriginationDataControls()
					where x.GetThisAndOwnerDataControls().All((DataControlBase owner) => owner.IsSync)
					select x;
			}
			source.ForEach(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				dataControl.IsSelectionInitialized = true;
				if (dataControl.IsOriginationDataControl())
				{
					dataControl.SynchronizeCurrentItem();
				}
				dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.OnDataControlInitialized();
			});
		}

		internal void ForceCreateView()
		{
			if (DataView == null)
			{
				DataView = CreateDefaultView();
			}
		}

		internal void ReInitializeCurrentColumn()
		{
			CurrentColumn = null;
			InitializeCurrentColumn();
		}

		internal void InitializeCurrentColumn()
		{
			if (this.HasValue(CurrentColumnProperty) || DataView.NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in DataView.VisibleColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.AllowFocus)
				{
					CurrentColumn = item;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SynchronizeCurrentColumn()
		{
			if (this.HasValue(CurrentColumnProperty))
			{
				DataView.CurrentColumnChanged(null);
				DataView.SetValue(DataView.GetFocusedColumnProperty(), CurrentColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentColumn = (ColumnBase)DataView.GetValue(DataView.GetFocusedColumnProperty());
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeCurrentItem()
		{
			if (this.HasValue(CurrentItemProperty))
			{
				OnCurrentItemChanged(null, raiseEvent: false);
				return;
			}
			DataView.SetFocusOnCurrentControllerRow();
			UpdateCurrentItem();
		}

			return DataView.ViewBehavior.GetRowState(rowHandle) ?? DataProviderBase.GetRowState(rowHandle, createNewIfNotExist);
		}

		}

		public void ClearColumnFilter(string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			IDictionary<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnsWithOptionalLegacyFallback(FilterCriteria);
			dictionary.Remove(new OperandProperty(fieldName));
			FilterCriteria = CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)dictionary.Values);
		}

		public void ClearColumnFilter(ColumnBase column)
		{
			ClearColumnFilter(column.FieldName);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperatorInfo GetInfoFromCriteriaOperator(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string filterDisplayText = DisplayCriteriaHelper.GetFilterDisplayText(criteriaOperator, CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient(DataView), useFriendlyDateRangePresentation: false, (CriteriaOperator x) => x);
			return new CriteriaOperatorInfo(criteriaOperator, filterDisplayText);
		}

		public CriteriaOperator GetColumnFilterCriteria(string fieldName)
		{
			if (fieldName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (fieldName == string.Empty)
			{
				return FilterCriteria;
			}
			return FilteringContext.GetFilter(fieldName);
		}

		public string GetColumnFilterString(string fieldName)
		{
			return CriteriaOperator.ToString(GetColumnFilterCriteria(fieldName));
		}

		public CriteriaOperator GetColumnFilterCriteria(ColumnBase column)
		{
			bool isFiltered;
			return GetColumnFilterCriteriaCore(column, out isFiltered);
		}

		protected internal CriteriaOperator GetColumnFilterCriteriaCore(ColumnBase column, out bool isFiltered, bool useGroupFields = true)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				isFiltered = false;
				return null;
			}
			if (useGroupFields)
			{
				FilteringColumn column2 = CreateFilteringColumn(column.FieldName, () => column, useGroupFields);
				CriteriaOperator filter = FilteringContext.GetFilter(column2, column.FieldName);
				isFiltered = filter != null;
				return filter;
			}
			FilteringColumn column3 = CreateFilteringColumn(column.FieldName, () => column, useGroupFields: false);
			CriteriaOperator filter2 = FilteringContext.GetFilter(column3, column.FieldName);
			isFiltered = filter2 != null;
			if (!isFiltered && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.FilterPopupGroupFields))
			{
				FilteringColumn column4 = CreateFilteringColumn(column.FieldName, () => column);
				CriteriaOperator filter3 = FilteringContext.GetFilter(column4, column.FieldName);
				isFiltered = filter3 != null;
			}
			return filter2;
		}

		public void MergeColumnFilters(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			Dictionary<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator> dictionary = new Dictionary<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator>(CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnsWithOptionalLegacyFallback(FilterCriteria));
			IDictionary<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator> dictionary2 = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnsWithOptionalLegacyFallback(filterCriteria);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator> item in dictionary2)

				dictionary[item.Key] = item.Value;

		}

		protected virtual void RebuildSortInfo()
		{
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			List<ColumnBase> list2 = new List<ColumnBase>();
			List<ColumnBase> list3 = new List<ColumnBase>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (item.GroupIndexCore >= 0)
				{
					list2.Add(item);
				}
				else if (item.SortIndex >= 0)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else if ((int)item.SortOrder != 0)
				{
					list3.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0 && list2.Count == 0 && list3.Count == 0)
			{
				SortInfoCore.ClearAndAddRange(0);
			}
			list.Sort((ColumnBase column1, ColumnBase column2) => Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(column1.SortIndex, column2.SortIndex));
			RebuildGroupedColumnsInfo(list2);
			list.ForEach(ApplyColumnSortIndexWithoutLoadingCheck);
			list3.ForEach(ApplyColumnSortOrderWithoutLoadingCheck);
		}

			{

					groupCount--;

				sortList.RemoveAt(0);

			ActualSortInfoCore.BeginUpdate();

				ActualGroupCountCore = groupCount;

				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)ActualSortInfoCore).Clear();

					if (flag)

		protected internal virtual bool OnDeserializeAllowProperty(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (((PropertyEventArgs)e).DependencyProperty != null && ((PropertyEventArgs)e).DependencyProperty.ReadOnly)
			{
				return false;
			}
			StoreLayoutMode storeLayoutMode = DXSerializer.GetStoreLayoutMode((DependencyObject)this);
			if ((int)storeLayoutMode != 1)
			{
				if ((int)storeLayoutMode == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (e.IsSerializing && IsObsoleteProperty(((PropertyEventArgs)e).Property))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsSpecificSerializationProperty(e))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (e.PropertyId != 1)
			{
				if (e.IsSerializing)
				{
					return e.PropertyId == 2;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsSpecificSerializationProperty(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source is BandBase)
			{
				if (((PropertyEventArgs)e).DependencyProperty == BaseColumn.HeaderProperty)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return e.Allow;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ClearAutoGeneratedColumns()
		{
			IList list;
			if (BandsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				IList columnsCore = ((BandBase)BandsCore[0]).ColumnsCore;
				list = columnsCore;
			}
			else
			{
				IList columnsCore = ColumnsCore;
				list = columnsCore;
			}
			IList list2 = list;
			ColumnBase[] array = new ColumnBase[list2.Count];
			list2.CopyTo(array, 0);
			ColumnBase[] array2 = array;
			foreach (ColumnBase columnBase in array2)
			{
				if (columnBase.IsAutoGenerated)
				{
					list2.Remove(columnBase);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveAutoGeneratedBands()
		{
			if (BandsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
				RemoveAutoGeneratedBandsCore(BandsCore, list);
				list.ForEach(delegate(ColumnBase c)
				{
					ColumnsCore.Add(c);
				});
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAutoGeneratedBandsCore(IBandsCollection bandsCollection, List<ColumnBase> savedColumns)
		{
			List<BandBase> list = new List<BandBase>();
			foreach (BandBase item in bandsCollection)
			{
				if (!item.IsAutoGenerated)
				{
					RemoveAutoGeneratedBandsCore(item.BandsCore, savedColumns);
					continue;
				}
				list.Add(item);
				if (AutoGenerateColumns != AutoGenerateColumnsMode.RemoveOld)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item2 in item.ColumnsCore)
					{
						if (!item2.IsAutoGenerated)
						{
							savedColumns.Add(item2);
						}
					}
				}
				item.ColumnsCore.Clear();
			}
			list.ForEach(delegate(BandBase b)
			{
				bandsCollection.Remove(b);
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual GridFilterColumn CreateGridFilterColumn(ColumnBase column, bool ignoreColumnFilterMode = false)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GridFilterColumn gridFilterColumn = DataView.CreateFilterColumn(column, SupportDomainDataSource, IsWcfSource());
			((FilterColumn)gridFilterColumn).FieldName = column.FieldName;
			if (column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText && !ignoreColumnFilterMode)
			{
				((FilterColumn)gridFilterColumn).ColumnType = typeof(string);
			}
			else
			{
				((FilterColumn)gridFilterColumn).ColumnType = ((DataProviderBase.Columns[column.FieldName] != null) ? DataProviderBase.Columns[column.FieldName].Type : (GetDesignTimeFilterColumnType(column) ?? typeof(string)));
			}
			return gridFilterColumn;
		}

		internal bool IsWcfSource()
		{
			if (ItemsSource == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = ItemsSource.GetType();
			string[] wcfSources = WcfSources;
			foreach (string text in wcfSources)
			{
				if (type.Name == text)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			switch (e.Item.Name)
			{
			case "Columns":
			case "Bands":
				if (!GetAddNewColumns())
				{
					BandSerializationHelper.ClearCollection(e);
				}
				break;
			case "MRUFilters":
				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Clear();
				break;
			case "MRUFilterList":
				FilteringContext.ClearMRUFilters();
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (e.CollectionName)
			{
			case "MRUFilters":
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["FilterText"];
				CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator = GetCriteriaOperator(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
				CriteriaOperatorInfo item = (CriteriaOperatorInfo)(e.CollectionItem = (object)new CriteriaOperatorInfo(criteriaOperator, val.Value.ToString()));
				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Add(item);
				break;
			}
			case "MRUFilterList":
				e.CollectionItem = FilteringContext.CreateMRUFiltersItemOnDeserializing(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
				break;
			case "TotalSummary":
			{
				SummaryItemBase item3 = (SummaryItemBase)(e.CollectionItem = CreateSummaryItem());
				TotalSummaryCore.Add(item3);
				break;
			}
			case "SortInfo":
			{
				GridSortInfo item2 = (GridSortInfo)(e.CollectionItem = new GridSortInfo());
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfoCore).Add(item2);
				break;
			}
			case "Columns":
				if (!GetRemoveOldColumns())
				{
					OnDeserializeCreateColumn(e);
				}
				break;
			case "Bands":
				if (!GetRemoveOldColumns())
				{
					OnDeserializeCreateBand(e);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeStart(StartDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataView != null && DataView.IsEditing)
			{
				DataView.CommitAndCleanEditor();
			}
			BeginDataUpdate();
			SaveUseFieldNameForSerializationPropertyValue();
			DataView.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
			ColumnsCore.BeginUpdate();
			BandsCore?.BeginUpdate();
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)SortInfoCore).BeginUpdate();
			BeginUpdateGroupSummary();
			TotalSummaryCore.BeginUpdate();
			MRUFiltersInternal.BeginUpdate();
			FilteringContext.BeginUpdateMRUFilters();
			ClearMRUFilter();

			IsDeserializing = true;
		}

		{

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeEnd(EndDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			DataView.UpdateFilterOnDeserializationLock();
			for (int num = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfoCore).Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfoCore)[num];
				if (ColumnsCore[gridSortInfo.FieldName] == null)
				{
					OnDeserializeEndBeforeRemoveSummary(num);
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)SortInfoCore).RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			PopulateUnboundColumnsIfNeeded();
			TotalSummaryCore.EndUpdate();
			EndUpdateGroupSummary();
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)SortInfoCore).EndUpdate();
			BandsCore?.EndUpdate();
			if (BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				BandsLayoutCore.FillColumns();
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (item.ParentBand != null)
					{
						((ICollectionOwner)item.ParentBand).OnRemoveItem((object)item);
					}
					item.ParentBand = null;
				}
			}
			ColumnsCore.EndUpdate();
			IsDeserializing = false;
			bool flag = !(DataView?.UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel);
			FilteringContext.EndUpdateMRUFilters(flag ? ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)MRUFiltersInternal).Select((CriteriaOperatorInfo x) => x.FilterOperator) : null);
			if (flag)
			{
				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Clear();
			}
			MRUFiltersInternal.EndUpdate();
			DataView.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
			BandSerializationHelper = null;
			if (BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				BandsLayoutCore.UpdateBandsLayout();
			}
			UpdateFilter();
			EndDataUpdate();
			RestoreUseFieldNameForSerializationPropertyValue();
			DataView.UpdateFilterOnDeserializationUnlock();
			DataView.OnDataControlDeserializeEnd();
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeFindCollectionItem(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			string collectionName = e.CollectionName;
			if (!(collectionName == "Columns"))
			{
				if (collectionName == "Bands")
				{
					BandSerializationHelper.FindBand(e, BandsLayoutCore);
				}
			}
			else

				BandSerializationHelper.FindColumn(e);
			}
		}

		internal void OnDeserializeCreateColumn(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Collection is IList list)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = CreateColumn();
				XtraPropertyInfo val = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["FieldName"];
				if (val != null)
				{
					columnBase.FieldName = val.Value as string;
				}
				list.Add(columnBase);
				if (!ColumnsCore.Contains(columnBase))
				{
					ColumnsCore.Add(columnBase);
				}
				e.CollectionItem = columnBase;
			}
		}

		internal void OnDeserializeCreateBand(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Collection is IList list))
			{
				return;
			}
			BandBase bandBase = CreateBand();
			list.Add(bandBase);
			if (((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Owner == this)
			{
				if (BandsLayoutCore == null)
				{
					SetBandsLayout(CreateBandsLayout());
				}
				bandBase.Owner = BandsLayoutCore;
			}
			else
			{
				bandBase.Owner = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Owner as IBandsOwner;
			}
			e.CollectionItem = bandBase;
		}

		private CriteriaOperator GetCriteriaOperator(XtraPropertyInfo xtraPropertyInfo)
		{
			XtraPropertyInfo val = xtraPropertyInfo.ChildProperties["FilterOperator"];
			if (val == null)
			{
				XtraPropertyInfo val2 = xtraPropertyInfo.ChildProperties["FilterString"];
				string text = val2.ValueToObject(typeof(string)) as string;
				return CriteriaOperator.Parse(text, new object[0]);
			}
			object obj = val.ValueToObject(typeof(CriteriaOperator));
			return (CriteriaOperator)((obj is CriteriaOperator) ? obj : null);
		}

		private void BandsCore_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			Func<BandsLayoutBase> createBandsLayout = null;
			if (GetOriginationDataControl().BandsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				if (BandsLayoutCore == null)
				{
					createBandsLayout = () => CreateBandsLayout();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				createBandsLayout = () => (BandsLayoutBase)null;
			}
			Action notifyBandsLayout = delegate
			{
				BandsLayoutCore.Do(delegate(BandsLayoutBase x)
				{
					x.OnGridControlBandsChanged(e);
				});
			};
			if (createBandsLayout != null)
			{
				GetOriginationDataControl().syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					notifyBandsLayout();
					SetBandsLayout(createBandsLayout());
				});
				GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyCollectionChanged(this, (DataControlBase dc) => dc.BandsCore, (object band) => BandsLayoutBase.CloneBand((BandBase)band), e);
			}
			else
			{
				notifyBandsLayout();
			}
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<DataControlBase, BandBase> behavior = (ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<DataControlBase, BandBase>)GetValue(BandsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
			if (behavior == null || !(BandsSource is IList) || ((IList)BandsSource).Count == bandsCore.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			lockBandsSourceUpdate.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				behavior.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: true);
				SyncCollectionHelper.SyncCollection(e, (IList)BandsSource, bandsCore, (object source) => DependencyObjectExtensions.GetDataContext((DependencyObject)source));
				behavior.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: false);
				foreach (object item in BandsCore)
				{
					((BandBase)item).RefreshSource();
				}
			});
		}

		protected void OnBandsLayoutChanged(BandsLayoutBase oldValue, BandsLayoutBase newValue)
		{
			bandsLayoutCore = newValue;

		}

		internal void UpdateCurrentItem()
		{
			if (!IsSelectionInitialized || IsOriginationDataControlCore())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked && this.HasCurrentItemBinding())
			{
				UpdateCurrentItemWasLocked = true;
				return;
			}
			object currentItem = null;
			if (!DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(DataView.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				currentItem = DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(DataView.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			SetCurrentItem(currentItem);
			UpdateCurrentItemWasLocked = false;
		}

		private void OnCurrentItemChanged(object oldValue, bool raiseEvent)
		{
			if (IsOriginationDataControlCore())
			{
				CurrentItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					SetCurrentItemInOriginationGrid();
				});
				return;
			}
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				if (CurrentItem != DataView.GetValue(DataViewBase.FocusedRowProperty))
				{
					DataView.SetValue(DataViewBase.FocusedRowProperty, CurrentItem);
				}
				CurrentItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					DataView.SetFocusOnCurrentItem();
				});
				if (IsServerMode)
				{
					DataView.SelectionStrategy.UpdateSelectedItem();
				}
			}
			UpdateCurrentCellValue();
			if (!CurrentItemChangedLocker.IsLocked && raiseEvent)
			{
				RaiseCurrentItemChanged(oldValue, CurrentItem);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseCurrentItemChanged(object oldValue, object newValue)
		{
			UpdateCurrentItemInOriginationGrid();
			if (!IsOriginationDataControlCore())
			{
				RaiseEventInOriginationGrid(new CurrentItemChangedEventArgs(this, oldValue, newValue)
				{
					RoutedEvent = CurrentItemChangedEvent
				});
			}
		}

		private void SetCurrentItem(object newValue)
		{
			if (CurrentItem == newValue)
			{
				if (DataView.GetValue(DataViewBase.FocusedRowProperty) != CurrentItem)
				{
					DataView.SetValue(DataViewBase.FocusedRowProperty, CurrentItem);
				}
				return;
			}
			CurrentItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				object currentItem = CurrentItem;
				SetCurrentItemCore(newValue);
				RaiseCurrentItemChanged(currentItem, CurrentItem);
			});
		}

		internal void SetCurrentItemCore(object currentItem)
		{
			SetCurrentValue(CurrentItemProperty, currentItem);
		}

		private void ReturnCurrentItem()
		{
			if (DataView != null && UpdateCurrentItemWasLocked)
			{
				DataView.SetFocusOnCurrentItem();
			}
		}

		private object CoerceCurrentItem(object newValue)
		{
			if (newValue != CurrentItem && DataView != null && DataView.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				DataView.HideEditor(closeEditor: false);
			}
			return newValue;
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.SelectionStrategy.OnSelectedItemChanged(oldValue);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseSelectedItemChanged(object oldItem)
		{
			RaiseEventInOriginationGrid(new SelectedItemChangedEventArgs(this, oldItem, SelectedItem)
			{
				RoutedEvent = SelectedItemChangedEvent
			});
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemsChanged(IList oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)oldValue).CollectionChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<DataControlBase, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
			else if (oldValue is IBindingList)
			{
				((IBindingList)oldValue).ListChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<DataControlBase, ListChangedEventArgs, ListChangedEventHandler>)(object)ListChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
			if (SelectedItems is INotifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCollectionChanged)SelectedItems).CollectionChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<DataControlBase, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
			else if (SelectedItems is IBindingList)
			{
				((IBindingList)SelectedItems).ListChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<DataControlBase, ListChangedEventArgs, ListChangedEventHandler>)(object)ListChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
			ProcessSelectedItemsChanged();
		}

		private void ProcessSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.SelectionStrategy.ProcessSelectedItemsChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemsListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e2 = null;
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				e2 = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add, SelectedItems[e.NewIndex], e.NewIndex);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.Reset:
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				e2 = new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset);
				break;
			}
			OnSelectedItemsCollectionChanged(this, e2);
		}

		private void OnSelectedItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.SelectionStrategy.OnSelectedItemsChanged(e);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetSelectedItems(IList items)
		{
			DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectItems(items);
		}

		internal void SelectAllMasterDetail()
		{
			DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectAllMasterDetail();
		}

		internal void ClearMasterDetailSelection()
		{
			Action<DataControlBase> action = delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				if (detail.SelectionMode != MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
				{
					detail.UnselectAll();
				}
			};
			UpdateAllDetailDataControls(action, action);
		}

		private void UpdateCurrentItemInOriginationGrid()
		{
			DataControlBase originationDataControl = GetOriginationDataControl();
			if (originationDataControl == this)
			{
				return;
			}
			object currentItem = null;
			DataControlBase dataControl = DataView.FocusedView.DataControl;
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				if (dataControl.GetOriginationDataControl() == originationDataControl)
				{
					currentItem = dataControl.CurrentItem;
				}
				if (!originationDataControl.CurrentItemChangedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					originationDataControl.SetCurrentItem(currentItem);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCurrentItemInOriginationGrid()
		{
			if (DataView != null && DataView.IsDesignTime)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = DataControlOwner.FindDetailDataControlByRow(CurrentItem);
			if (dataControlBase != null)
			{
				dataControlBase.CurrentItem = CurrentItem;
				return;
			}
			DataControlBase dataControl = GetRootDataControl().DataView.FocusedView.DataControl;
			if (dataControl.GetOriginationDataControl() == this)
			{
				dataControl.SetCurrentItemCore(null);
			}
		}

		private void OnCurrentColumnChanged(GridColumnBase oldValue, GridColumnBase newValue)
		{
			CurrentColumnCore = newValue;
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				if (CurrentColumn != (ColumnBase)DataView.GetValue(DataView.GetFocusedColumnProperty()))
				{
					DataView.SetValue(DataView.GetFocusedColumnProperty(), CurrentColumn);
				}
				DataView.CurrentColumnChanged(oldValue);
				UpdateCurrentCellValue();
			}
			RaiseCurrentColumnChanged(oldValue, newValue);
		}

		protected virtual ColumnBase CoerceCurrentColumn(ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			if (DataView == null)
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			if (!DataView.EditFormManager.IsEditFormVisible && DataView.RequestUIUpdate())
			{
				return newValue;
			}
			return (ColumnBase)DependencyObjectExtensions.GetCoerceOldValue((DependencyObject)this, CurrentColumnProperty);
		}

		private void RaiseCurrentColumnChanged(GridColumnBase oldValue, GridColumnBase newValue)
		{
			RaiseEventInOriginationGrid(new CurrentColumnChangedEventArgs(this, oldValue, newValue)
			{
				RoutedEvent = CurrentColumnChangedEvent
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateCurrentCellValue()
		{
			if (DataView == null || CurrentColumn == null || CurrentItem == null)
			{
				CurrentCellValue = null;
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentCellValue = GetCellValue(DataView.FocusedRowHandle, CurrentColumn.FieldName);
			}
		}

		protected void OnDetailDescriptorChanged(DetailDescriptorBase oldValue)
		{
			if (CanAssignDetailDescriptorOwner(oldValue))
			{
				RemoveLogicalChild(oldValue);
				oldValue.Owner = null;
			}
			if (CanAssignDetailDescriptorOwner(DetailDescriptorCore))
			{
				AddLogicalChild(DetailDescriptorCore);
			}
			UpdateMasterDetailProvider();
			UpdateDetailContainers(oldValue);
			UpdateHasDetailViews();
			if (DataView != null)
			{
				DataView.RootView.OnDataReset();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDetailContainers(DetailDescriptorBase oldDetailDescriptor)
		{
			if (oldDetailDescriptor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (int detailContainersIndex in DataProviderBase.GetDetailContainersIndices())
			{
				int rowHandleByListIndex = DataProviderBase.GetRowHandleByListIndex(detailContainersIndex);
				RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer = DataProviderBase.GetRowDetailContainer(rowHandleByListIndex, null, createNewIfNotExist: false);
				rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo.Detach();
				if (rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo.IsExpanded && DetailDescriptorCore != null)
				{
					rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo = DetailDescriptorCore.CreateRowDetailInfo(rowDetailContainer);
					rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo.IsExpanded = true;
				}
				else
				{
					DataProviderBase.RemoveRowDetailContainer(detailContainersIndex);
				}
			}
			if (DetailDescriptorCore != null)
			{
				DetailDescriptorCore.InvalidateTree();
				return;
			}
			DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.RootView.OnDataReset();
			});
		}

		private bool CanAssignDetailDescriptorOwner(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
		{
			return detailDescriptor?.Owner.CanAssignTo(this) ?? false;
		}

		private void UpdateMasterDetailProvider()
		{
			if (DetailDescriptorCore != null && DataView != null)
			{
				masterDetailProvider = DataView.ViewBehavior.CreateMasterDetailProvider();
			}
			else
			{
				MasterDetailProvider.OnDetach();
				masterDetailProvider = NullDetailProvider.Instance;
			}
			if (CanAssignDetailDescriptorOwner(DetailDescriptorCore))
			{
				DetailDescriptorCore.Owner = MasterDetailProvider as IDetailDescriptorOwner;
			}
		}

		{
		}

		internal void ChangeMasterRowExpanded(object parameter)
		{
			int? num = ObjectToInt(parameter);
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				num = FindRow(parameter);
			}
			ChangeMasterRowExpanded(num.Value);
		}

		private void ChangeMasterRowExpanded(int handle)
		{
			MasterDetailProvider.ChangeMasterRowExpanded(handle);
		}

		internal void SetMasterRowExpanded(object parameter, bool expanded)
		{
			int? num = ObjectToInt(parameter);
			if (!num.HasValue)
			{
				num = FindRow(parameter);
			}
			SetMasterRowExpanded(num.Value, expanded);
		}

		private void SetMasterRowExpanded(int handle, bool expanded)
		{
			if (expanded != MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(handle))
			{
				MasterDetailProvider.ChangeMasterRowExpanded(handle);
			}
		}

		private int? ObjectToInt(object obj)
		{
			int result = 0;
			if (int.TryParse(obj.ToString(), out result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			return GetRootDataControl().FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndexCore(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		internal bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndexCore(int commonScrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			MasterRowScrollInfo masterRowScrollInfo = MasterDetailProvider.CalcMasterRowScrollInfo(commonScrollIndex);
			if (masterRowScrollInfo != null)
			{
				int num = DataProviderBase.ConvertScrollIndexToVisibleIndex(masterRowScrollInfo.StartScrollIndex, DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore);
				if (masterRowScrollInfo.WholeDetailScrolledOut)
				{
					targetView = DataView;
					targetVisibleIndex = num;
					return true;
				}
				if (!MasterDetailProvider.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(masterRowScrollInfo.DetailStartScrollIndex, num, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
				{
					targetView = DataView;
					if (forwardIfServiceRow)
					{
						if (num == VisibleRowCount - 1)
						{
							targetView = null;
							targetVisibleIndex = -1;
							return false;
						}
						targetVisibleIndex = num + 1;
					}
					else
					{
						targetVisibleIndex = num;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			targetView = null;
			targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			return false;
		}

		internal int FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			if (DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore)
			{
				while (visibleIndex < VisibleRowCount - 1 && DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) && DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
				{
					visibleIndex++;
					rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
				}
			}
			return DataView.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex) - MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountForRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
		}

		internal int FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex()
		{
			int scrollIndexWithDetails = 0;
			DataControlParent.EnumerateParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl, int index)
			{
				int num = dataControl.DataProviderBase.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(index, dataControl.DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore);
				scrollIndexWithDetails += num;
				scrollIndexWithDetails += dataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(num);
			});
			return scrollIndexWithDetails;
		}

		internal bool IsExpandedFixedRow(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			bool flag = false;
			if (DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
			{
				return DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore && DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			}
			return MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
		}

		internal DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView()
		{
			if (VisibleRowCount == 0 && !DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = MasterDetailProvider.FindLastInnerDetailView(VisibleRowCount - 1);
			if (dataViewBase == null)
			{
				dataViewBase = DataView;
			}
			return dataViewBase;
		}

		internal bool FindNextOuterMasterRow(int visibleIndex, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (visibleIndex < VisibleRowCount - 1)
			{
				targetView = DataView;
				targetVisibleIndex = visibleIndex + 1;
				return true;
			}
			return DataControlParent.FindNextOuterMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		internal DataControlBase CloneDetail(MasterNodeContainer masterNodeContainer, MasterRowsContainer masterRowsContainer, object dataContext, BindingBase itemsSourceBinding, DataControlDetailInfo parent, bool cloneColumns = true, bool addToClones = true)
		{
			ForceCreateView();
			if (dataControlOriginationElement == null)
			{
				dataControlOriginationElement = new DataControlOriginationElement(this);
			}
			DataControlBase clone = null;
			syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				clone = CloneDetailHelper.CreateElement(this, new object[1] { dataControlOriginationElement });
				parent.DataControl = clone;
				parent.ForceCreateContainers();
				CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement(this, clone, delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					if (cloneColumns)
					{
						if (BandsCore.Count > 0 && BandsSource == null)
						{
							BandsLayoutCore.CloneBandsCollection(dataControl.BandsCore);
						}
						else
						{
							CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<BaseColumn>((IList)ColumnsCore, (IList)dataControl.ColumnsCore);
						}
					}
					CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<SummaryItemBase>(TotalSummaryCore, dataControl.TotalSummaryCore);
					CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<SummaryItemBase>(GroupSummaryCore, dataControl.GroupSummaryCore);
					dataControl.DataView = CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement(DataView, null, null, new object[3] { masterNodeContainer, masterRowsContainer, DataControlOwner });
					DataView.ViewBehavior.CloneDetail(dataControl);
					dataControl.DataContext = dataContext;
					dataControl.DataControlParent = parent;
					if (itemsSourceBinding != null)
					{
						dataControl.SetBinding(ItemsSourceProperty, itemsSourceBinding);
					}
				}, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl.CloneDetailLocker);
			});
			clone.viewCore.UpdateUseLightweightTemplates();
			clone.FinalizeClonedDetail();
			if (addToClones)
			{
				detailClones.Add(clone);
			}
			UpdateAllDetailViewIndents();
			return clone;
		}

		internal DataControlBase CloneDetailForPrint(MasterNodeContainer masterNodeContainer, MasterRowsContainer masterRowsContainer)
		{
			ForceCreateView();
			if (dataControlOriginationElement == null)
			{
				dataControlOriginationElement = new DataControlOriginationElement(this);
			}
			DataControlBase clone = null;
			DataControlBase result = null;
			syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				clone = CloneDetailHelper.CreateElement(this, new object[1] { dataControlOriginationElement });
				CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement(this, clone, delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<SummaryItemBase>(TotalSummaryCore, dataControl.TotalSummaryCore);
					CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<SummaryItemBase>(GroupSummaryCore, dataControl.GroupSummaryCore);
					dataControl.DataView = CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement(DataView, null, null, new object[3] { masterNodeContainer, masterRowsContainer, DataControlOwner });
					result = dataControl;
				}, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl.CloneDetailLocker);
			});
			clone.FinalizeClonedDetail();
			return result;
		}

		internal void CopyToDetail(DataControlBase clone)
		{
			syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				CloneDetailHelper.CopyToElement(this, clone, delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					if (BandsCore.Count > 0)
					{
						BandsLayoutCore.CopyBandCollection(dataControl.BandsCore);
					}
					else
					{
						CloneDetailHelper.CopyToCollection<BaseColumn>((IList)ColumnsCore, (IList)dataControl.ColumnsCore);
					}
					CloneDetailHelper.CopyToCollection<SummaryItemBase>(TotalSummaryCore, dataControl.TotalSummaryCore);
					CloneDetailHelper.CopyToCollection<SummaryItemBase>(GroupSummaryCore, dataControl.GroupSummaryCore);
					DataView.ViewBehavior.CopyToDetail(dataControl);
					CloneDetailHelper.CopyToElement(DataView, dataControl.DataView);
				});
				CloneGroupSummarySortInfo(clone);
			});
		}

		internal List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> GetViewVisibleIndexChain(int innerVisibleIndex)
		{
			List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>>(3);
			if (innerVisibleIndex >= 0)
			{
				list.Insert(0, new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(DataView, innerVisibleIndex));
			}
			CollectViewVisibleIndexChain(list);
			return list;
		}

		internal List<int> GetParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(int visibleIndex)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			CollectParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(visibleIndex, list);
			return list;
		}

		internal void CollectParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(int visibleIndex, List<int> scrollIndexes)
		{
			if (DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore)
			{
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
				int num = rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore;
				if ((DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) && !DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore)) || !DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(num))
				{
					num = DataProviderBase.GetParentRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				}
				while (num != int.MinValue)
				{
					scrollIndexes.Add(DataView.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(num)));
					num = DataProviderBase.GetParentRowHandle(num);
				}
			}
			DataControlParent.CollectParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(scrollIndexes);
		}

		internal void NavigateToFirstMasterRow()
		{
			DataControlParent.FindMasterView()?.MoveFocusedRow(0);
		}

		internal void NavigateToLastMasterRow()
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = DataControlParent.FindMasterView();

		}

		internal bool NavigateToPreviousInnerDetailRow()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex == 0)
			{

			if (dataViewBase != null)

		}

		internal bool NavigateToPreviousInnerDetailCell(bool isTabNavigation)
		{

			{

			if (dataViewBase != null)

		internal int CalcTotalLevel(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return CalcTotalLevelByRowHandle(GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex));
		}

		internal int CalcTotalLevelByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			int num = DataControlParent.CalcTotalLevel();
			if (DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore)
			{
				num += DataProviderBase.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(rowHandle);
			}
			if (rowHandle == -2147483647 && DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				num--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void ProcessSearchControlFocus()
		{
			GridControlColumnProviderBase searchPanelColumnProvider = DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.SearchPanelColumnProvider;
			if (base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin && searchPanelColumnProvider != null && searchPanelColumnProvider.IsSearchLookUpMode && DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.SearchControl != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)DataView.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.SearchControl).Focus();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSearchPanel(DataViewBase oldValue, DataViewBase newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null && newValue != null)
			{
				if (newValue.SearchString != oldValue.SearchString)
				{
					newValue.SearchString = oldValue.SearchString;
				}
				if (newValue.SearchPanelColumnProvider != null)
				{
					newValue.SearchPanelColumnProvider.ResetUpdateActionEnqueued();
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool IsFirst(int index)
		{
			if (index != 0)
			{
				if (viewCore != null)
				{
					return viewCore.FirstVisibleIndexOnPage == index;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal bool IsLast(int index)
		{
			return index == LastRowIndex;
		}

		protected internal bool GetAllowInitiallyFocusedRow()
		{
			if (AllowInitiallyFocusedRow)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow == int.MinValue || DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				if (restoreLayoutLocker.IsLocked && restoreLayoutCurrentRowIsNull.HasValue && !restoreLayoutCurrentRowIsNull.Value)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CanCancelRow(object row)
		{
			if (DataProviderBase.DataSource is IEditableCollectionView { IsEditingItem: not false, CanCancelEdit: not false })
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (row is IEditableObject)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void CancelRowEditIfNeeded()
		{
			bool flag = DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing || viewCore.IsEditing;
			bool flag2 = !viewCore.IsNewItemRowFocused && !viewCore.IsAutoFilterRowFocused;
			if (flag && flag2)
			{
				viewCore.CancelRowEdit();
			}
		}

		internal void BestFitColumnsOnItemsSourceChanged()
		{
			if (!(viewCore is ITableView))
			{
				return;
			}
			viewCore.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (item.ActualBestFitModeOnSourceChange().HasValue && item.Visible && !item.Width.IsStar)
					{
						BestFitColumnOnItemsSourceChanged(item);
					}
				}
			});
		}

		internal void BestFitColumnOnItemsSourceChanged(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!IsDesignMode && (base.IsVisible || !IsOriginationDataControl()))
			{
				column.BestFitModeOnSourceChangeLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((ITableView)viewCore).BestFitColumn(column);
				});
			}
		}

		{

			{
				FilteringContext.BeginUpdateMRUFilters();
				FilteringContext.EndUpdateMRUFilters(((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)MRUFiltersInternal).Select((CriteriaOperatorInfo x) => x.FilterOperator));
				((Collection<CriteriaOperatorInfo>)(object)MRUFiltersInternal).Clear();
			}
		}

		private FilteringUIContextClient CreateFilteringUIContextClient()
		{
			Func<ColumnBase, VisualFilteringColumn> getVisualColumn = (ColumnBase column) => new VisualFilteringColumn(column.FieldName, column.FieldType, () => GetHeaderAppearance(column), (object x) => GetDisplayText(column, x));
			return new FilteringUIContextClient(() => FilterCriteria, delegate(CriteriaOperator x)
			{
				FilterCriteria = x;
			}, (CriteriaOperator x) => SubstituteFilterInternal(x, SubstituteFilterTarget.FilterPopupValues), (string propertyName) => CreateFilteringColumn(propertyName, () => ColumnsCore[propertyName]), (string name) => ColumnsCore[name].With(getVisualColumn), delegate(ColumnForestFilterMode filterMode)
			{
				Func<IEnumerable<ColumnBase>, IList<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>>> gridColumnsToContainers = (IEnumerable<ColumnBase> columns) => (from c in columns
					where filterMode == ColumnForestFilterMode.All || c.ActualAllowFilterEditor
					orderby c.ActualVisibleIndex
					select c).Select(getVisualColumn).Select(Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>.CreateLeaf).ToArray();
				Func<IEnumerable<BandBase>, IList<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>>> func = LinqExtensions.WithReturnValue<Func<IEnumerable<BandBase>, IList<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>>>>((Lazy<Func<IEnumerable<BandBase>, IList<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>>>> gridBandsToContainersRecursive) => (IEnumerable<BandBase> bands) => bands.OrderBy((BandBase c) => c.ActualVisibleIndex).SelectMany(delegate(BandBase b)
				{
					IList<Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>> list = ((b.ColumnsCore.Count > 0) ? gridColumnsToContainers(b.ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>()) : gridBandsToContainersRecursive.Value(b.BandsCore.Cast<BandBase>()));
					return (!b.OverlayHeaderByChildren) ? Tree<VisualFilteringColumn, HeaderAppearanceAccessor>.CreateGroup(() => new HeaderAppearance(b.HeaderCaption, b.ActualHeaderTemplateSelector), list).Yield() : list;
				}).ToArray());
				return (BandsCore != null && BandsCore.Count != 0) ? func(BandsCore.Cast<BandBase>()) : gridColumnsToContainers(ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>());
			}, () => ((AllowedGroupFilters)(((int?)DataView?.AllowedGroupFilters) ?? 15)).ToCoreFilters(), () => !DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource, GetFormatConditionFilters, SubstituteTopBottomFilter, () => MRUFilterListCount, delegate
			{
				DataView?.ShowFilterEditor(null);
			}, delegate
			{
				DataView?.ClearFilter();
			}, () => DataView?.DetailHeaderContent, () => DataView?.DataControl.OwnerDetailDescriptor?.DetailViewIndents.Select((DetailIndent x) => x.Width).Sum() ?? 0.0, delegate(bool isFilterEnabled)
			{
				SetCurrentValue(IsFilterEnabledProperty, isFilterEnabled);
			}, () => !(DataView?.UseLegacyFilterPanel ?? CompatibilitySettings.UseLegacyFilterPanel), () => IsFilterEnabled, () => DataView != null && DataView.ShowEditFilterButton);
		}

		private FilteringColumn CreateFilteringColumn(string fieldName, Func<ColumnBase> getColumn, bool useGroupFields = true)
		{
			DataColumnInfo dataColumnInfo = DataProviderBase.Columns[fieldName];
			if (dataColumnInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Func<bool> getRoundDateTimeFilter = () => getColumn()?.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter ?? true;
			return new FilteringColumn(dataColumnInfo.Name, dataColumnInfo.Type, getColumn()?.VisibleIndex ?? (-1), getColumn()?.ColumnFilterMode ?? ColumnFilterMode.Value, allowHierarchicalFilterTree: true, () => getColumn()?.ActualEditSettings, getRoundDateTimeFilter, (object x) => GetDisplayText(getColumn(), x), () => CreateFilterRestrictions(getColumn()), () => (!useGroupFields) ? null : getColumn()?.FilterPopupGroupFields, async delegate(CriteriaOperator filter, bool forceIsColumnFiltered, CountsIncludeMode countsIncludeMode, FilterValuesThrottleMode throttleMode)
			{
				bool flag = getRoundDateTimeFilter();
				TaskCompletionSource<UniqueValues> tcs = new TaskCompletionSource<UniqueValues>();
				CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs customUniqueValuesArgs = RaiseCustomUniqueValuesEvent(getColumn(), forceIsColumnFiltered, flag, FilteringContext.GetFilter(fieldName), delegate(object valuesObject)
				{
					if (!tcs.Task.IsCompleted)
					{
						tcs.SetResult(UniqueValues.FromValues((valuesObject as object[]) ?? new object[0]));
					}
				});
				if (!customUniqueValuesArgs.Handled)
				{
					return await DataProviderBase.GetUniqueColumnValuesWithCounts(dataColumnInfo.Name, CreateColumnValuesArgs(dataColumnInfo.Name, FilteringContext, FixedFilter & filter, forceIsColumnFiltered, flag), countsIncludeMode == CountsIncludeMode.Include, throttleMode == FilterValuesThrottleMode.Allow);
				}
				Task<Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>?> uniqueValuesTask = customUniqueValuesArgs.GetUniqueValuesAsync();
				return (uniqueValuesTask.Status == TaskStatus.RanToCompletion && (!uniqueValuesTask.Result.HasValue || uniqueValuesTask.Result.Value.RightOrDefault()?.FirstOrDefault() == AsyncServerModeDataController.NoValue)) ? (await tcs.Task) : ((await uniqueValuesTask)?.Match<UniqueValues>(UniqueValues.FromValuesAndCounts, UniqueValues.FromValues) ?? UniqueValues.Empty);
			}, () => getColumn()?.GetShowAllTableValuesInFilterPopup() ?? ShowAllTableValuesInFilterPopup, (SummaryFilterInfo[] summaries) => (DataProviderBase.IsServerMode || DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode || DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource) ? null : summaries.Select((SummaryFilterInfo x) => DataProviderBase.GetSummaryValue(dataColumnInfo.Name, x.SummaryType, ColumnValuesArgumentsHelper.GetColumnValuesArgs(x.Filter), x.IgnoreNulls)).ToArray(), () => getColumn()?.PredefinedFilters);
		}

		private FilterRestrictions CreateFilterRestrictions(ColumnBase c)
		{
			FilterRestrictions filterRestrictions = (DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource ? FilterRestrictions.None() : FilterRestrictions.All());
			filterRestrictions = filterRestrictions.Update(null, null, null, null, null, null, filterRestrictions.AllowedDataAnalysisFilters & DataView?.GetAllowedDataAnalysisFilters(c));
			if (c == null)
			{
				return filterRestrictions;
			}
			return filterRestrictions.Update(c.AllowedAnyOfFilters?.ToCoreFilters(), c.AllowedUnaryFilters?.ToCoreFilters(), c.AllowedDateTimeFilters?.ToCoreFilters(), c.AllowedBinaryFilters?.ToCoreFilters(), c.AllowedBetweenFilters?.ToCoreFilters(), null, c.AllowedDataAnalysisFilters & filterRestrictions.AllowedDataAnalysisFilters, c.AllowedFormatConditionFilters);
		}

		internal IEnumerable<FormatConditionFilter> GetFormatConditionFilters()
		{
			if (!(viewCore is ITableView tableView))
			{
				return Enumerable.Empty<FormatConditionFilter>();
			}
			return from x in ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)tableView.FormatConditions).Select((Func<FormatConditionBase, FormatConditionFilter>)delegate(FormatConditionBase conditionBase)
				{
					if (conditionBase.IsEnabled)
					{
						ColumnBase columnBase = ColumnsCore[conditionBase.FieldName];
						if ((columnBase == null || columnBase.ColumnFilterMode != ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText) && conditionBase.Info.FormatCore != null)
						{
							return CreateFormatConditionFilter(conditionBase);
						}
					}
					return (FormatConditionFilter)null;
				})
				where x != null
				select x;
		}

		protected virtual FormatConditionFilter CreateFormatConditionFilter(FormatConditionBase conditionBase)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ed: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0105: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0110: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0116: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (conditionBase is FormatCondition formatCondition && (int)formatCondition.ValueRule != 0)
			{
				DataColumnInfo obj = DataProviderBase.Columns[formatCondition.FieldName];
				Type targetType = ((obj != null) ? obj.Type : null);
				Func<object, Option<object>> func = delegate(object x)
				{
					try
					{
						return ((x != null && targetType != null) ? TypeCastHelper.TryCast(x, targetType) : x).AsOption();
					}
					catch
					{
						return Option<object>.Empty;
					}
				};
				Option<object> option = func(formatCondition.Value1);
				if (!option.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Option<object> option2 = func(formatCondition.Value2);
				if (!option2.HasValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
				CriteriaOperator filter = FormatDisplayInfoHelper.GetCriteria(formatCondition.ValueRule, formatCondition.Expression, formatCondition.FieldName, option.ToValue(), option2.ToValue());
				return new FormatConditionFilter((object)formatCondition, (Func<CriteriaOperator>)(() => filter), (Func<string>)(() => viewCore.GetFilterOperatorCustomText_NoSubstitute(filter)), formatCondition.Format, new FormatConditionFilterInfo(formatCondition.FieldName, FormatConditionFiltersHelper.ToFilterType(formatCondition.ValueRule), ((int)formatCondition.ValueRule == 9) ? formatCondition.Expression : option.ToValue(), option2.ToValue()), formatCondition.ApplyToRow);
			}
			return null;
		}

	internal class ErrorWatch
	{
		private List<int> errorsHandles = new List<int>();

		private readonly DataViewBase View;

		public bool GridLoaded { get; set; }

		public bool HasError => errorsHandles.Count > 0;

		private bool IsNotWatchError
		{
			get
			{
				if ((!View.IsRootView || GridLoaded) && !View.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode && !View.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
				{
					return View.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ErrorWatch(DataViewBase view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		private static bool IsRootView(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return view.OriginationView == null;
		}

		public static ErrorsWatchMode ActualErrorsWatchMode(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (IsRootView(view))
			{
				ErrorsWatchMode errorsWatchModeCore = view.ErrorsWatchModeCore;
				if (errorsWatchModeCore != ErrorsWatchMode.Default)
				{
					return errorsWatchModeCore;
				}
				return ErrorsWatchMode.None;
			}
			if (view.ErrorsWatchModeCore == ErrorsWatchMode.Default)
			{
				DataControlBase dataControlBase = ((view.DataControl != null) ? view.DataControl.GetMasterGridCore() : null);
				if (dataControlBase == null || dataControlBase.DataView == null)
				{
					return ErrorsWatchMode.Default;
				}
				return dataControlBase.DataView.ErrorsWatchModeCore;
			}
			return view.ErrorsWatchModeCore;
		}

		public static bool IsStop(ErrorsWatchMode mode)
		{
			if (mode != ErrorsWatchMode.None)
			{
				return mode == ErrorsWatchMode.Default;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void RemoveNewItemRowHandle()
		{
			errorsHandles.Remove(-2147483647);
			if (!errorsHandles.Any())
			{
				View.SetHasErrors(value: false);
			}
		}

		public void CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType changedType, int newHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			if ((View?.DataProviderBase != null && View.DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked) || IsNotWatchError)
			{
				return;
			}
			ErrorsWatchMode errorsWatchMode = ActualErrorsWatchMode(View);
			if (IsStop(errorsWatchMode))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!View.HasErrors)
			{
				if (View.IsValidRowByRowHandle(newHandle, errorsWatchMode, !errorsWatchMode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Cells)).HasValue)
				{
					errorsHandles.Add(newHandle);
					View.SetHasErrors(value: true);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (!oldRowHandle.HasValue)
			{
				UpdateWatchErrorsView(View);
				return;
			}
			if (changedType == ListChangedType.ItemDeleted)
			{
				newHandle = oldRowHandle.Value;
			}
			bool hasValue = View.IsValidRowByRowHandle(newHandle, errorsWatchMode, !errorsWatchMode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Cells)).HasValue;
			switch (changedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				if (View.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount == 1)
				{
					errorsHandles.Clear();
				}
				AddOrDeleteIndexes(added: true, newHandle, hasValue);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				AddOrDeleteIndexes(added: false, newHandle);
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				AddOrDeleteIndexes(added: false, oldRowHandle.Value);
				AddOrDeleteIndexes(added: true, newHandle, hasValue);
				break;
			default:
				UpdateWatchErrorsView(View);
				return;
			}
			View.SetHasErrors(errorsHandles.Count > 0);
		}

		public void UpdateWatchErrors()
		{
			if (View.DataControl == null || View.DataProviderBase == null || IsNotWatchError)
			{
				return;
			}
			ErrorsWatchMode mode = ActualErrorsWatchMode(View);
			if (IsStop(mode))
			{
				errorsHandles.Clear();
				View.SetHasErrors(value: false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (View.DataControl == null || View.DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (View.RootView.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore == null)
				{
					UpdateWatchErrorsView(View);
					return;
				}
				View.RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					if (dataControl != null && dataControl.DataView != null)
					{
						UpdateWatchErrorsView(dataControl.DataView);
					}
				});
			}
		}

		private void AddOrDeleteIndexes(bool added, int newHandle, bool newError = false)
		{
			int num = errorsHandles.BinarySearch(newHandle);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			else if (!added)
			{
				errorsHandles.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			for (int i = num; i < errorsHandles.Count; i++)
			{
				if (added)
				{
					errorsHandles[i]++;
				}
				else
				{
					errorsHandles[i]--;
				}
			}
			if (newError)
			{
				errorsHandles.Add(newHandle);
				errorsHandles.Sort();
			}
		}

		private static void UpdateWatchErrorsView(DataViewBase view)
		{
			view.ErrorWatch.errorsHandles.Clear();
			if (view.DataControl == null || view.DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				view.SetHasErrors(value: false);
				return;
			}
			ErrorsWatchMode errorsWatchMode = ActualErrorsWatchMode(view);
			if (errorsWatchMode == ErrorsWatchMode.None || errorsWatchMode == ErrorsWatchMode.Default)
			{
				view.SetHasErrors(value: false);
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < view.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount; i++)
			{
				if (view.IsValidRowByRowHandle(i, errorsWatchMode, !errorsWatchMode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Cells)).HasValue)
				{
					view.ErrorWatch.errorsHandles.Add(i);
				}
			}
			view.SetHasErrors(view.ErrorWatch.errorsHandles.Count > 0);
		}
	}

		protected override ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase CreateList()
		{
