		}

		protected override void FillList(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items, IList<object> columnFilterValues, out bool shouldCreateBlanks)
		{
			shouldCreateBlanks = false;
			foreach (object columnFilterValue in columnFilterValues)
			{
				if (columnFilterValue == null || ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IsNullOrEmptyString(columnFilterValue) || columnFilterValue is DBNull)
				{
					shouldCreateBlanks = true;
					continue;
				}
				ICustomItem val = (ICustomItem)((columnFilterValue is ICustomItem) ? columnFilterValue : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					items.AddItem(new ExcelColumnFilterValue(val.EditValue, val.DisplayValue));
				}
				else
				{
					items.AddItem(new ExcelColumnFilterValue(columnFilterValue, IsAsyncLookupColumn ? base.View.GetColumnDisplayText(columnFilterValue, base.Column) : null));
				}
			}
			if (IsAsyncLookupColumn)
			{
				SubscribeAsyncLookupColumn();
			}
		}

		private void SubscribeAsyncLookupColumn()
		{
			unsubscribeAsyncLookupColumn = AsyncLookupColumnListener.Subscribe(base.Column.ItemsProvider, UpdateValueFromAsyncLookupColumn);
		}

		private void UpdateValueFromAsyncLookupColumn(object value)
		{
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue filterItem in base.FilterItems)
			{
				object editValue = filterItem.EditValue;
				if (editValue != null && editValue.Equals(value))
				{
					filterItem.DisplayValue = base.View.GetColumnDisplayText(value, base.Column);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			base.ClearPopupData(popup);
			unsubscribeAsyncLookupColumn?.Invoke();
			unsubscribeAsyncLookupColumn = null;
		}

		protected override BaseEditSettings GetValueEditSettings()
		{
			if (!ColumnFilterInfoHelper.CanUseEditSettingsInExcelColumnFilter(base.Column))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.Column.EditSettings;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetSelectedItems()
		{
			return from item in base.FilterItems.GetFilterableValues()
				where item.IsChecked.HasValue && item.IsChecked.Value
				select item;
		}

		protected IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetVisibleSelectedItems()
		{
			return from item in base.FilterItems.GetFilterableValues()
				where item.IsChecked.HasValue && item.IsChecked.Value && item.IsVisible
				select item;
		}

		private List<DateTime> ExtractDates(IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> selectedItems, out bool hasBlankItem)
		{
			hasBlankItem = false;
			return (from item in selectedItems
				where item.EditValue is DateTime
				select (DateTime)item.EditValue).ToList();
		}

		protected override List<DateTime> GetAllDates(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items, out bool hasBlankItem)
		{
			return ExtractDates(items, out hasBlankItem);
		}

		protected override void UpdateFilter(string oldFilter, string newFilter)
		{
			base.FilterItems.UpdateFilter(oldFilter, newFilter);
		}

		protected override string GetActualSearchText()
		{
			return base.SearchText;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetSelectedItemsCore()
		{
			return GetSelectedItems();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetVisibleSelectedItemsCore()
		{
			return GetVisibleSelectedItems();
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria(List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> selectedItems)
		{
			if (selectedItems == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool hasBlankItem = false;
			List<DateTime> list = ExtractDates(selectedItems, out hasBlankItem);
			CriteriaOperator val;
			if (RoundDateTimeValues && list.Count > 0)
			{
				val = MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(base.Column.FieldName, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)list);
				if (hasBlankItem)
				{
					val |= ColumnFilterInfoHelper.CreateIsNullOrEmptyCriteria(base.Column.FieldName);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				val = ColumnFilterInfoHelper.CreateCriteriaOperator(selectedItems, base.Column.FieldName, ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, base.GetValue);
				val |= ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetIsNullOrEmptyCriteria(selectedItems, base.Column.FieldName, ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, base.GetValue);
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected internal override string GetDisplayText(object value, string originalDisplayText)
		{
			if (base.Column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText || base.View == null)
			{
				return originalDisplayText;
			}
			return base.View.GetColumnDisplayText(value, base.Column);
		}

		protected override bool CanShowValuesCore()
		{
			return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedAnyOfFilters.AnyOf);
		}
	}

		private void CreateColumnFilterInfos(object[] values)
		{
			CriteriaOperator columnFilterCriteria = base.View.DataControl.GetColumnFilterCriteria(base.Column);
			IList<object> list2;
			if (FilterSettings == null)
			{
				IList<object> list = ((values != null) ? values.ToList() : new List<object>());
				list2 = list;
			}
			else
			{
				list2 = FilterSettings.FilterItems;
			}
			IList<object> columnFilterValues = list2;
			bool useActualColumnFilter = CreateAndFillFilterItemsCollection(columnFilterValues, columnFilterCriteria);
			SubscribeEvents();
			CreateCustomFilterInfo(values, useActualColumnFilter, columnFilterCriteria);
			SetCurrentStateFromFilterSettings();
		}

		private void SetCurrentStateFromFilterSettings()
		{
			if (!CanShowRules() || !CanShowValues())
			{
				if (!CanShowValues())
				{
					AllowedFilterTypes = ExcelColumnFilterType.FilterRules;
					FilterType = ExcelColumnFilterType.FilterRules;
				}
				if (!CanShowRules())
				{
					AllowedFilterTypes = ExcelColumnFilterType.FilterValues;
					FilterType = ExcelColumnFilterType.FilterValues;
				}
			}
			if (FilterSettings != null)
			{
				if (!AllowedFilterTypes.HasValue)
				{
					AllowedFilterTypes = FilterSettings.AllowedFilterTypes;
				}
				if (AllowedFilterTypes.HasValue)
				{
					FilterType = AllowedFilterTypes.Value;
				}
				else if (FilterSettings.DefaultFilterType.HasValue)
				{
					FilterType = FilterSettings.DefaultFilterType.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool CanShowFilterPopup()

		protected virtual bool CanShowRules()
		{
			return CreateRulesOperators().ToList().Count > 0;
		}

		protected internal IEnumerable<ClauseType> CreateRulesOperators()
		{
			GridFilterColumn filterColumn = Column.View.DataControl.CreateGridFilterColumn(Column);
			foreach (ClauseType item in from op in FilterControlHelper.GetListOperationsByFilterColumn((FilterColumn)(object)filterColumn)
				where !FilterControlHelper.IsCollectionClause(op)
				select op)
			{
				if (((FilterColumn)filterColumn).IsValidClause(item))
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		private bool CreateAndFillFilterItemsCollection(IList<object> columnFilterValues, CriteriaOperator columnFilter)
		{
			ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase excelColumnFilterValuesListBase = CreateList();
			excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.AddSelectAllItem(base.View.GetDefaultFilterItemLocalizedString(DefaultFilterItem.PopupFilterAll), columnFilter == null);
			excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.AddSearchAddFilterItem(base.View.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.AddCurrentSelectionToFilter));
			bool shouldCreateBlanks = false;
			FillList(excelColumnFilterValuesListBase, columnFilterValues, out shouldCreateBlanks);
			if (shouldCreateBlanks && base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNullOrEmpty))
			{
				excelColumnFilterValuesListBase.AddSelectBlanksItem(base.View.GetDefaultFilterItemLocalizedString(DefaultFilterItem.PopupFilterBlanks));
			}
			bool flag = false;
			FilterItems = excelColumnFilterValuesListBase;
			flag = UpdateSelectedItems(columnFilterValues, columnFilter);
			UpdateExpandState();
			return flag;
		}

		internal static void SetDefaultPopupSize(PopupBaseEdit popup, ColumnBase column)
		{
			bool flag = CommonThemeHelper.GetIsTouchlineTheme((DependencyObject)column.View) || CommonThemeHelper.GetIsTouchEnabled((DependencyObject)column.View);
			double popupHeight = (popup.PopupMinHeight = (flag ? 390 : 310));
			popup.PopupHeight = popupHeight;
			popup.PopupMinWidth = (flag ? 320 : 260);
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable GetSelectedItems(IEnumerable items, CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			if (op == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool hasBlankItem = false;
			List<DateTime> allDates = GetAllDates(FilterItems, out hasBlankItem);
			int num = allDates.Count + (hasBlankItem ? 1 : 0);
			IEnumerable<object> enumerable = null;
			List<CriteriaOperator> customOperators = null;
			enumerable = ((num <= 0) ? ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetSelectedItems(op, out customOperators) : MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.GetCheckedDates(op, base.Column.FieldName, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)allDates).Cast<object>());
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			foreach (object item in ColumnFilterInfoHelper.AddNullOrEmptyOperator(enumerable, op))
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue = FilterItems.FindItem(item, base.Column.ColumnFilterMode);
				if (excelColumnFilterValue != null)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			if (customOperators != null && customOperators.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue item2 in FilterItems.GetItemsWithCriteriaOperator())
				{
					if (GetIsCustomCriteriaItemChecked(item2, customOperators))
					{
						list.Add(item2.EditValue);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == FilterItems.FilterValuesCount && !base.Column.IsFiltered)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private bool UpdateSelectedItems(IEnumerable items, CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (op == null)
			{
				FilterItems.ChangeSelectAll(isTrue: false);
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable checkedFilterPopupSelectedItems = base.View.GetCheckedFilterPopupSelectedItems(base.Column, items, op);
			if (checkedFilterPopupSelectedItems == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> itemsWithCriteriaOperator = FilterItems.GetItemsWithCriteriaOperator();
			foreach (object item in checkedFilterPopupSelectedItems)
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue = null;
				if (item is CriteriaOperator)
				{
					CriteriaOperator operatorValue = (CriteriaOperator)item;
					excelColumnFilterValue = itemsWithCriteriaOperator.FirstOrDefault((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i.EditValue == operatorValue);
				}
				else
				{
					excelColumnFilterValue = FilterItems.FindItem(item, base.Column.ColumnFilterMode);
				}
				if (excelColumnFilterValue != null)
				{
					excelColumnFilterValue.IsChecked = (result = true);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual ClauseType? GetRulesDefaultFilterType(GridFilterColumn filterColumn = null)
		{
			if (filterColumn == null)
			{
				filterColumn = CreateFilterColumn();
			}
			return FilterClauseHelper.GetDefaultOperation(base.Column, allowChangeDefaultOperation: true, checkSingleFieldClause: false);
		}

		protected internal virtual GridFilterColumn CreateFilterColumn()
		{
			return base.Column.View.DataControl.CreateGridFilterColumn(base.Column);
		}

		private List<CriteriaOperator> GetCriteriaOperatorsFromCustomItem(ExcelColumnFilterValue customItem)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			CriteriaOperator val = (CriteriaOperator)customItem.EditValue;
			GroupOperator val2 = (GroupOperator)(object)((val is GroupOperator) ? val : null);
			if (val2 != null && (int)val2.OperatorType == 1)
			{
				return ((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)val2.Operands).ToList();
			}
			return new List<CriteriaOperator> { val };
		}

		private bool GetIsCustomCriteriaItemChecked(ExcelColumnFilterValue customItem, List<CriteriaOperator> customOperators)
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator item in GetCriteriaOperatorsFromCustomItem(customItem))
			{
				if (!customOperators.Contains(item))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract List<DateTime> GetAllDates(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items, out bool hasBlankItem);

		{

		}

		protected override string GetEditValueString(object item)
		{
			return item as string;
		}

		protected override void UpdateSizeGripVisibility(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			popup.ShowSizeGrip = true;
		}

		{
			get
			{
				if (TrackChangesList != null)
				{
					return TrackChangesList.IsChanged;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TrackChangesList<T> : IList<T>, ICollection<T>, IEnumerable<T>, IEnumerable
	{
		private readonly IList<T> innerList;

		public bool IsChanged { get; private set; }

		public T this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return innerList[index];
			}
			set
			{
				SetChanged(delegate
				{
					innerList[index] = value;
				});
			}
		}

		public int Count => innerList.Count;

		public bool IsReadOnly => innerList.IsReadOnly;

		public TrackChangesList(IList<T> innerList)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)innerList, "innerList");
			if (innerList.IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.innerList = innerList;
		}

		private void SetChanged(Action action)
		{
			action();
			IsChanged = true;
		}

		public int IndexOf(T item)
		{
			return innerList.IndexOf(item);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, T item)
		{
			SetChanged(delegate
			{
				innerList.Insert(index, item);
			});
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			SetChanged(delegate
			{
				innerList.RemoveAt(index);
			});
		}

		public void Add(T item)
		{
			SetChanged(delegate
			{
				innerList.Add(item);
			});
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			SetChanged(innerList.Clear);
		}

		public bool Contains(T item)
		{
			return innerList.Contains(item);
		}

		public void CopyTo(T[] array, int arrayIndex)
		{
			innerList.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
		}

		public bool Remove(T item)
		{
			bool result = false;
			SetChanged(delegate
			{
				result = innerList.Remove(item);
			});
			return result;
		}

		public IEnumerator<T> GetEnumerator()
		{
			return innerList.GetEnumerator();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable)innerList).GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public class ExcelColumnFilterValuesList : ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase
	{
		public override int FilterValuesCount => base.Count - ((ServiceItem_SelectAll != null) ? 1 : 0) - ((ServiceItem_AddFilter != null) ? 1 : 0);

		internal override bool AllItemsVisible => VisibleItemsCount == FilterValuesCount;

		internal override bool ForceCalcVisibility => true;

		public override bool IsAllItemsChecked => base.CheckedItemsCount == FilterValuesCount;

		public override ExcelColumnFilterValue FindItem(object value, ColumnFilterMode columnFilterMode)
		{
			if (columnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue = this.FirstOrDefault((ExcelColumnFilterValue item) => !(item is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase) && item.GetComputedValue() == value);
				if (excelColumnFilterValue != null)
				{
					return excelColumnFilterValue;
				}
			}
			return this.FirstOrDefault((ExcelColumnFilterValue item) => object.Equals(item.GetComputedValue(), value));
		}
	}
	public abstract class ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase : List<ExcelColumnFilterValue>
	{
		private readonly Locker IsCheckedChangedLocker = new Locker();

		private int VisibleNullItemsCount;

		protected int VisibleItemsCount;

		protected internal ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll ServiceItem_SelectAll;

		protected internal ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueAddFilter ServiceItem_AddFilter;

		protected internal ExcelColumnFilterValue ServiceItem_SelectBlanks;

		protected internal bool LockCheckedChanged;

		protected int VisibleCheckedItemsCount { get; private set; }

		protected int CheckedItemsCount { get; private set; }

		public bool IsSelectAll => GetIsSelectAll();

		public bool IsSelectNone => GetIsSelectNone();

		public abstract bool IsAllItemsChecked { get; }

		internal abstract bool AllItemsVisible { get; }

		public bool SelectedItemsAddedToFilter
		{
			get
			{
				if (ServiceItem_AddFilter == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ServiceItem_AddFilter.IsChecked.HasValue)
				{
					return ServiceItem_AddFilter.IsChecked.Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public abstract int FilterValuesCount { get; }

		internal abstract bool ForceCalcVisibility { get; }

		public event EventHandler IsCheckedChanged;

		public event EventHandler BeginSelection;

		public event EventHandler EndSelection;

		public virtual void AddItem(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			Add(item);
			item.PropertyChanging += Item_PropertyChanging;
			item.PropertyChanged += Item_PropertyChanged;
			if (!(item is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase))
			{
				item.IsVisibleChanged += Item_IsVisibleChanged;
				if (item.IsVisible)
				{
					VisibleItemsCount++;
					if (item.IsChecked.HasValue)
					{
						if (item.IsChecked.Value)
						{
							VisibleCheckedItemsCount++;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						VisibleNullItemsCount++;
					}
				}
				if (item.IsChecked.HasValue && item.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					CheckedItemsCount++;
				}
				if (ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IsNullOrEmptyString(item.EditValue))
				{
					ServiceItem_SelectBlanks = item;
				}
			}
			else if (item is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueAddFilter)
			{
				ServiceItem_AddFilter = item as ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueAddFilter;
			}
			else if (item is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll)
			{
				ServiceItem_SelectAll = item as ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll;
			}
		}

		private void Item_IsVisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue && !(excelColumnFilterValue is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase))
			{
				UpdateVisibleItemsCount(excelColumnFilterValue);
			}
		}

		private void Item_PropertyChanging(object sender, PropertyChangingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "IsChecked" && sender is ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue && !(excelColumnFilterValue is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase))
			{
				DataItemCheckedChanging(excelColumnFilterValue);
			}
		}

		private void Item_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "IsChecked" && sender is ExcelColumnFilterValue excelColumnFilterValue)
			{
				if (!(excelColumnFilterValue is ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueBase))
				{
					DataItemCheckedChanged(excelColumnFilterValue);
				}
				else if (excelColumnFilterValue == ServiceItem_AddFilter)
				{
					UpdateCollection(excelColumnFilterValue);
				}
				else if (excelColumnFilterValue == ServiceItem_SelectAll && excelColumnFilterValue.IsChecked.HasValue)
				{
					ChangeSelectAll(excelColumnFilterValue.IsChecked.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool GetIsSelectAll()
		{
			bool? selectAllValue = GetSelectAllValue();
			if (selectAllValue.HasValue)
			{
				return selectAllValue.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetIsSelectNone()
		{
			bool? selectAllValue = GetSelectAllValue();
			if (selectAllValue.HasValue)
			{
				return !selectAllValue.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void DataItemCheckedChanging(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			if (item.IsChecked.HasValue)
			{
				if (item.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					CheckedItemsCount--;
					if (item.IsVisible)
					{
						VisibleCheckedItemsCount--;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisibleNullItemsCount--;
			}
		}

		private void DataItemCheckedChanged(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			if (item.IsChecked.HasValue)
			{
				if (item.IsChecked.Value)
				{
					CheckedItemsCount++;
					if (item.IsVisible)
					{
						VisibleCheckedItemsCount++;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				VisibleNullItemsCount++;
			}
			IsCheckedChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateSelectAllItem();
				RaiseOnCheckedChanged();
			});
		}

		private void UpdateVisibleItemsCount(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			if (item.IsVisible)
			{
				VisibleItemsCount++;
			}
			else
			{
				VisibleItemsCount--;
			}
			if (item.IsChecked.HasValue && item.IsChecked.Value)
			{
				if (item.IsVisible)
				{
					VisibleCheckedItemsCount++;
				}
				else
				{
					VisibleCheckedItemsCount--;
				}
			}
			UpdateSelectAllItem();
		}

		private bool? GetSelectAllValue()
		{
			if (VisibleCheckedItemsCount == VisibleItemsCount && VisibleItemsCount > 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (VisibleCheckedItemsCount + VisibleNullItemsCount == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectAllItem()
		{
			if (ServiceItem_SelectAll != null)
			{
				ServiceItem_SelectAll.IsChecked = GetSelectAllValue();
			}
		}

		public void AddSelectAllItem(string caption, bool isChecked, bool isVisible = true)
		{
			ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll excelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll = new ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll(caption, isChecked);
			excelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll.SetIsVisible(isVisible);
			AddItem(excelColumnFilterServiceValueSelectAll);
		}

		public void AddSelectBlanksItem(string caption)
		{
			ExcelColumnFilterValue item = new ExcelColumnFilterValue(string.Empty, caption);
			AddItem(item);
		}

		public void AddSearchAddFilterItem(string caption)
		{
			ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueAddFilter item = new ExcelColumnFilterServiceValueAddFilter(caption);
			AddItem(item);
		}

		protected void UpdateCollection(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			RaiseOnCheckedChanged();
		}

		public IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetVisibleItems()
		{
			return this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue item) => item.IsVisible);
		}

		public IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetFilterableValues()
		{
			return this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue item) => item != ServiceItem_SelectAll && item != ServiceItem_AddFilter);
		}

		public void ChangeSelectAll(bool isTrue)
		{
			ChangeSelectAll(isTrue, includeInvisible: false);
		}

		internal void ChangeSelectAll(bool isTrue, bool includeInvisible)
		{
			IsCheckedChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				RaiseBeginSelection();
				using (Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator())
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						ExcelColumnFilterValue current = enumerator.Current;
						if ((current.IsVisible || includeInvisible) && current != ServiceItem_AddFilter && current != ServiceItem_SelectAll)
						{
							current.IsChecked = isTrue;
						}
					}
				}
				UpdateSelectAllItem();
				RaiseEndSelection();
			});
			RaiseOnCheckedChanged();
		}

		public abstract ExcelColumnFilterValue FindItem(object value, ColumnFilterMode columnFilterMode);

		internal List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetItemsWithCriteriaOperator()
		{
			List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> list = new List<ExcelColumnFilterValue>();
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.EditValue is CriteriaOperator)
				{
					list.Add(current);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected void RaiseBeginSelection()
		{
			if (this.BeginSelection != null)
			{
				this.BeginSelection(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseEndSelection()
		{
			if (this.EndSelection != null)
			{
				this.EndSelection(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected void RaiseOnCheckedChanged()
		{
			if (!LockCheckedChanged && this.IsCheckedChanged != null)
			{
				this.IsCheckedChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateFilter(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			if (ServiceItem_AddFilter != null)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(newValue))
				{
					ServiceItem_AddFilter.IsChecked = false;
					ServiceItem_AddFilter.SetIsVisible(value: false);
				}
				else
				{
					ServiceItem_AddFilter.SetIsVisible(value: true);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public enum ExcelColumnFilterType
	{
		FilterValues,
		FilterRules
	}
	public class ExcelColumnFilterValue : INotifyPropertyChanging, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private object _DisplayValue;

		private bool? _IsChecked = false;

		private bool _IsExpanded;

		public object EditValue { get; private set; }

		public object DisplayValue
		{
			get
			{
				return _DisplayValue;
			}
			set
			{
				_DisplayValue = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("DisplayValue");
			}
		}

		public bool? IsChecked
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsChecked;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IsChecked != value)
				{
					OnPropertyChanging("IsChecked");
					bool? isChecked = _IsChecked;
					_IsChecked = value;
					OnCheckedChanged(isChecked, value);
					OnPropertyChanged("IsChecked");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsVisible { get; private set; }

		public bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return _IsExpanded;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_IsExpanded != value)
				{
					_IsExpanded = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("IsExpanded");
				}
			}
		}

		public event PropertyChangingEventHandler PropertyChanging;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public event EventHandler IsVisibleChanged;

		public virtual object GetComputedValue()
		{
			return EditValue;
		}

		public ExcelColumnFilterValue(object editValue)
			: this(editValue, null)
		{
		}

		public ExcelColumnFilterValue(object editValue, object displayValue)
		{
			IsVisible = true;
			EditValue = editValue;
			DisplayValue = displayValue;
		}

		public void SetIsVisible(bool value)
		{
			if (IsVisible != value)
			{
				IsVisible = value;
				if (this.IsVisibleChanged != null)
				{
					this.IsVisibleChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCheckedChanged(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanging(string propName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanging != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanging(this, new PropertyChangingEventArgs(propName));
			}
		}

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propName));
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExcelDateColumnFilterValue : ExcelColumnFilterValue
	{
		public ExcelDateColumnFilterList Items { get; private set; }

		public event EventHandler ItemsCheckedChanged;

		public ExcelDateColumnFilterValue(object editValue, ExcelDateColumnFilterScope innerScope)
			: base(editValue)
		{
			Items = new ExcelDateColumnFilterList(innerScope);
			Items.AddSelectAllItem(string.Empty, isChecked: false, isVisible: false);
			Items.ServiceItem_SelectAll.PropertyChanged += ServiceItem_SelectAll_PropertyChanged;
			Items.IsCheckedChanged += Items_IsCheckedChanged;
		}

		private void ServiceItem_SelectAll_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "IsChecked")
			{
				base.IsChecked = Items.ServiceItem_SelectAll.IsChecked;
			}
		}

		private void Items_IsCheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.ItemsCheckedChanged != null)
			{
				this.ItemsCheckedChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCheckedChanged(bool? oldValue, bool? newValue)
		{
			Items.LockCheckedChanged = true;
			if (newValue.HasValue)
			{
				Items.ChangeSelectAll(newValue.Value);
			}
			Items.LockCheckedChanged = false;
		}
	}

		public ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue(object editValue, DateTime date)

		}
	}

	public class ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		private readonly ExcelCustomFilterClause Root;

		private CriteriaOperator _Operand;

		private int _Index;

		public CriteriaOperator Operand
		{
			get
			{
				return _Operand;
			}
			set
			{
				_Operand = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Operand");
				if (Root != null)
				{
					Root.UpdateFilterCriteria();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return _Index;
			}
			set
			{
				_Index = value;
				OnPropertyChanged("Index");
			}
		}

		public ICommand RemoveCommand { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand(ExcelCustomFilterClause root, int index)
			: this(root, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(), index)
		{
		}//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown


		public ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand(ExcelCustomFilterClause root, CriteriaOperator operand, int index)
		{
			Operand = operand;
			Root = root;
			Index = index;
			RemoveCommand = new DelegateCommand(Remove);
		}

		private void Remove()
		{
			Root.RemoveOperandAt(Index);
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string name)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExcelCustomFilterClause : IClauseNode, INode, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		IList<CriteriaOperator> IClauseNode.AdditionalOperands => GetValidAdditionalOperands();

		public ObservableCollection<ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand> AdditionalOperands { get; set; }

		public OperandProperty FirstOperand { get; private set; }

		public ClauseType Operation { get; private set; }

		public ExcelColumnCustomFilterInfo CustomFilterInfo { get; private set; }

		public OperandsCount OperandCountMode { get; private set; }

		public IGroupNode ParentNode { get; set; }

		public ICommand AddAdditionalOperandCommand { get; set; }

		public IEnumerable<FunctionOperator> LocalDateTimeFunctions { get; private set; }

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		public ExcelCustomFilterClause(ExcelColumnCustomFilterInfo info, ClauseType operation, OperandProperty firstOperand, IList<CriteriaOperator> additionalOperands = null)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			CustomFilterInfo = info;
			Operation = operation;
			FirstOperand = firstOperand;
			if (additionalOperands != null)
			{
				CreateLocalDateTimeFunctions();
			}
			PopulateAdditionalOperands(additionalOperands ?? new List<CriteriaOperator>());
			CreateCommands();
		}

		private void PopulateAdditionalOperands(IList<CriteriaOperator> operands)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AdditionalOperands = new ObservableCollection<ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand>();
			FilterControlHelpers.ValidateAdditionalOperands(Operation, operands);
			OperandCountMode = FilterControlHelper.GetSecondOperandsCount(Operation, operands);
			if ((int)OperandCountMode == 0)
			{
				UpdateFilterCriteria();
				return;
			}
			operands.ForEach(delegate(CriteriaOperator operand)
			{
				AdditionalOperands.Add(new ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand(this, operand, AdditionalOperands.Count + 1));
			});
			AdditionalOperands.CollectionChanged += AdditionalOperands_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void AdditionalOperands_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateFilterCriteria();
		}

		public void UpdateFilterCriteria()
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsValidAdditionalOperands())
			{
				if (FilterClauseHelper.IsSupportAutoFilter(Operation))
				{
					CustomFilterInfo.FilterCriteria = CustomFilterInfo.Info.CreateCustomFilterCriteria(CustomFilterInfo.Info.Column.FieldName, GetFilterValue(), Operation);
				}
				else
				{
					CustomFilterInfo.FilterCriteria = FilterControlHelpers.ToCriteria((INode)(object)this);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CustomFilterInfo.FilterCriteria = null;
			}
		}

		private object GetFilterValue()
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (AdditionalOperands[0].Operand is OperandValue)
			{
				return ((OperandValue)AdditionalOperands[0].Operand).Value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void Apply(ExcelCustomFilterClause otherClause)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (OperandCountMode == otherClause.OperandCountMode && (int)OperandCountMode != 0 && (int)OperandCountMode != 3)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < AdditionalOperands.Count; i++)
				{
					AdditionalOperands[i].Operand = otherClause.AdditionalOperands[i].Operand;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidAdditionalOperands()
		{
			foreach (CriteriaOperator additionalOperand in ((IClauseNode)this).AdditionalOperands)
			{
				OperandValue val = (OperandValue)(object)((additionalOperand is OperandValue) ? additionalOperand : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (val.Value == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.Value.ToString()))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CreateCommands()
		{
			AddAdditionalOperandCommand = new DelegateCommand(AddOperand);
		}

		private void AddOperand()
		{
			AdditionalOperands.Add(new ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand(this, AdditionalOperands.Count + 1));
		}

		public void RemoveOperandAt(int index)
		{
			AdditionalOperands.RemoveAt(index - 1);
			for (int i = 0; i < AdditionalOperands.Count; i++)
			{
				AdditionalOperands[i].Index = i + 1;
			}
		}

		public void CreateLocalDateTimeFunctions()
		{
			LocalDateTimeFunctions = ((IEnumerable<FunctionOperatorType>)FilterControlHelper.GetLocalDateTimeFuncs()).Select((Func<FunctionOperatorType, FunctionOperator>)((FunctionOperatorType f) => new FunctionOperator(f, (CriteriaOperator[])(object)new CriteriaOperator[0])));
		}

		private IList<CriteriaOperator> GetValidAdditionalOperands()
		{
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (CustomFilterInfo.Column == null || CustomFilterInfo.Column.View == null || CustomFilterInfo.Column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
			{
				return AdditionalOperands.Select((ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand operandWrapper) => operandWrapper.Operand).ToList();
			}
			List<CriteriaOperator> list = new List<CriteriaOperator>();
			foreach (ExcelCustomFilterAdditionalOperand additionalOperand in AdditionalOperands)
			{
				CriteriaOperator operand = additionalOperand.Operand;
				OperandValue val = (OperandValue)(object)((operand is OperandValue) ? operand : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					list.Add((CriteriaOperator)new OperandValue(CustomFilterInfo.Column.View.DataProviderBase.CorrectFilterValueType(CustomFilterInfo.Column.FieldType, val.Value)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public object Accept(INodeVisitor visitor)
		{
			return visitor.Visit((IClauseNode)(object)this);
		}

		public void SetParentNode(IGroupNode parentNode)
		{
			ParentNode = parentNode;
		}

		private void OnPropertyChanged(string name)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
			}
		}
	}
	public class ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo : ExcelColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		internal const string SubItemsPropertyName = "Items";

		private ExcelDateColumnFilterScope _SearchScope = ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.All;

		protected override bool RoundDateTimeValues => true;

		protected override bool ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering => true;

		public override bool ShowSearchPanelScopeSelector => true;

		public override ExcelDateColumnFilterScope SearchScope
		{
			get
			{
				return _SearchScope;
			}
			set
			{
				if (_SearchScope != value)
				{
					_SearchScope = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SearchScope");
					base.FilterItems.LockCheckedChanged = true;
					UpdateFilter(base.SearchText, base.SearchText);
					base.FilterItems.LockCheckedChanged = false;
					OnPropertyChanged("ActualSearchText");
					UpdateExpandState();
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsHierarchicalView => true;

		public override string ChildPropertyName => "Items";

		public event EventHandler BeginUpdateExpandState;

		public event EventHandler EndUpdateExpandState;

		public ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		protected override ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase CreateList()
		{
			return new ExcelDateColumnFilterList();
		}

		protected override void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			base.ClearPopupData(popup);
			_SearchScope = ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.All;
		}

		protected override void FillList(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase list, IList<object> columnFilterValues, out bool shouldCreateBlanks)
		{
			ExcelDateColumnFilterList excelDateColumnFilterList = (ExcelDateColumnFilterList)list;
			int num = -1;
			ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue = null;
			int num2 = -1;
			ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue2 = null;
			foreach (DateTime dateTimeColumnFilterValue in GetDateTimeColumnFilterValues(columnFilterValues, out shouldCreateBlanks))
			{
				int year = dateTimeColumnFilterValue.Year;
				if (num != year)
				{
					num2 = -1;
					num = year;
					excelDateColumnFilterValue = new ExcelDateColumnFilterValue(year, ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Month);
					excelDateColumnFilterList.AddItem(excelDateColumnFilterValue);
				}
				int month = dateTimeColumnFilterValue.Month;
				if (num2 != month)
				{
					num2 = month;
					excelDateColumnFilterValue2 = new ExcelDateColumnFilterValue(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.GetMonthName(num2), ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Day);
					excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.AddItem(excelDateColumnFilterValue2);
				}
				ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue item = new ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue(dateTimeColumnFilterValue.Day, dateTimeColumnFilterValue);
				excelDateColumnFilterValue2.Items.AddItem(item);
			}
		}

		private List<DateTime> GetDateTimeColumnFilterValues(IList<object> columnFilterValues, out bool shouldCreateBlanks)
		{
			shouldCreateBlanks = false;
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			foreach (object columnFilterValue in columnFilterValues)
			{
				if (columnFilterValue == null || columnFilterValue is DBNull)
				{
					shouldCreateBlanks = true;
				}
				else if (columnFilterValue is DateTime)
				{
					list.Add((DateTime)columnFilterValue);
				}
				else if (columnFilterValue is DateTime? dateTime)
				{
					list.Add(dateTime.Value);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			return list;
		}

		protected override BaseEditSettings GetValueEditSettings()
		{
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> EnumerateItemsCore(Func<ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase, IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue>> getSubItems)
		{
			List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> list = new List<ExcelColumnFilterValue>();
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue item in getSubItems(base.FilterItems))
			{
				if (!(item is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue))
				{
					if (ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IsNullOrEmptyString(item.EditValue) && item.IsChecked.HasValue && item.IsChecked.Value)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
					continue;
				}
				if (excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.IsAllItemsChecked && (excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.AllItemsVisible || base.FilterItems.SelectedItemsAddedToFilter))
				{
					list.Add(excelDateColumnFilterValue);
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ExcelDateColumnFilterValue item2 in getSubItems(excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items))
				{
					if (item2.Items.IsAllItemsChecked && (item2.Items.AllItemsVisible || base.FilterItems.SelectedItemsAddedToFilter))
					{
						list.Add(item2);
						continue;
					}
					foreach (ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue item3 in getSubItems(item2.Items))
					{
						if (item3.IsChecked.HasValue && item3.IsChecked.Value)
						{
							list.Add(item3);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues GetSelectedDates(List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> selectedItems)
		{
			ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues = new ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues();
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				if (selectedItem is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue)
				{
					switch (excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.FilterScope)
					{
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Month:
						excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues.Years.Add(GetDateFromYear(excelDateColumnFilterValue));
						break;
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Day:
						excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues.Months.Add(GetDateFromMonth(excelDateColumnFilterValue));
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (selectedItem is ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue excelDateDayColumnFilterValue)
				{
					excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues.Dates.Add(excelDateDayColumnFilterValue.Date);
				}
				else if (ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IsNullOrEmptyString(selectedItem.EditValue))
				{
					excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues.IncludeBlanks = true;
				}
			}
			return excelDateTimeColumnFilterValues;
		}

		private DateTime GetDateFromYear(ExcelDateColumnFilterValue year)
		{
			return GetDateFromMonth((ExcelDateColumnFilterValue)year.Items[1]);
		}

		private DateTime GetDateFromMonth(ExcelDateColumnFilterValue month)
		{
			return ((ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue)month.Items[1]).Date;
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetSelectedItemsCore()
		{
			return EnumerateItemsCore((ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items) => GetSelectedItemsCore(items));
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetVisibleSelectedItemsCore()
		{
			return EnumerateItemsCore((ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items) => GetVisibleSelectedItemsCore(items));
		}

		protected override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria(List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> selectedItems)
		{
			if (selectedItems == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues selectedDates = GetSelectedDates(selectedItems);
			CriteriaOperator val = null;
			foreach (Tuple<int, int> yearRange in selectedDates.GetYearRanges())
			{
				val |= ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IncludeYears(base.Column.FieldName, yearRange);
			}
			foreach (Tuple<int, int, int> monthRange in selectedDates.GetMonthRanges())
			{
				val |= ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IncludeMonths(base.Column.FieldName, monthRange);
			}
			if (selectedDates.Dates.Count > 0)
			{
				CriteriaOperator val2 = MultiselectRoundedDateTimeFilterHelper.DatesToCriteria(base.Column.FieldName, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)selectedDates.Dates);
				val |= val2;
			}
			if (selectedDates.IncludeBlanks)
			{
				val |= ColumnFilterInfoHelper.CreateIsNullOrEmptyCriteria(base.Column.FieldName);
			}
			return val;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetSelectedItemsCore(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase list)
		{
			return list.GetFilterableValues();
		}

		private IEnumerable<ExcelColumnFilterValue> GetVisibleSelectedItemsCore(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase list)
		{
			return from item in list.GetFilterableValues()
				where item.IsVisible
				select item;
		}

		protected override List<DateTime> GetAllDates(ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase items, out bool hasBlankItem)
		{
			hasBlankItem = false;
			List<DateTime> list = new List<DateTime>();
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue filterableValue in items.GetFilterableValues())
			{
				if (!(filterableValue is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue))
				{
					if (filterableValue == items.ServiceItem_SelectBlanks)
					{
						hasBlankItem = true;
					}
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ExcelDateColumnFilterValue filterableValue2 in excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.GetFilterableValues())
				{
					foreach (ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue filterableValue3 in filterableValue2.Items.GetFilterableValues())
					{
						list.Add(filterableValue3.Date);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void UpdateFilter(string oldFilter, string newFilter)
		{
			((ExcelDateColumnFilterList)base.FilterItems).UpdateFilter(SearchScope, oldFilter, newFilter);
		}

		protected override void UpdateExpandState()
		{
			if (this.BeginUpdateExpandState != null)
			{
				this.BeginUpdateExpandState(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			EnumerateItems((ExcelDateColumnFilterList)base.FilterItems);
			if (this.EndUpdateExpandState != null)
			{
				this.EndUpdateExpandState(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private void EnumerateItems(ExcelDateColumnFilterList items)
		{
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue filterableValue in items.GetFilterableValues())
			{
				if (filterableValue.IsChecked.HasValue)
				{
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.SearchText))
					{
						filterableValue.IsExpanded = false;
						continue;
					}
					switch (SearchScope)
					{
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.All:
						filterableValue.IsExpanded = true;
						break;
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Year:
						filterableValue.IsExpanded = false;
						continue;
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Month:
						filterableValue.IsExpanded = items.FilterScope == ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Year;
						break;
					case ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Day:
						if (items.FilterScope == ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Year || items.FilterScope == ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Month)
						{
							filterableValue.IsExpanded = true;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					filterableValue.IsExpanded = true;
				}
				if (filterableValue is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue)
				{
					EnumerateItems(excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override string GetActualSearchText()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(base.SearchText))
			{
				return base.SearchText;
			}
			return base.SearchText + " " + SearchScope;
		}

		protected internal override string GetDisplayText(object value, string originalDisplayText)
		{
			return originalDisplayText;
		}

		protected override bool CanShowValuesCore()
		{
			return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedDateTimeFilters.MultipleDateRanges);
		}
	}
	public class ExcelDateColumnFilterList : ExcelColumnFilterValuesListBase
	{
		internal readonly ExcelDateColumnFilterScope FilterScope;

		protected bool HasVisibleItems;

		public override int FilterValuesCount => FindAllDayItems().Count;

		internal override bool AllItemsVisible => (from item in FindAllDayItems()
			where !item.IsVisible
			select item).ToList().Count == 0;

		internal override bool ForceCalcVisibility => false;

		public override bool IsAllItemsChecked => GetCheckedSubItemsCount() == base.Count - 1 - ((ServiceItem_AddFilter != null) ? 1 : 0);

		public ExcelDateColumnFilterList()
			: this(ExcelDateColumnFilterScope.Year)
		{
		}

		public ExcelDateColumnFilterList(ExcelDateColumnFilterScope filterScope)
		{
			FilterScope = filterScope;
		}

		public override void AddItem(ExcelColumnFilterValue item)
		{
			base.AddItem(item);
			if (item is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue)
			{
				excelDateColumnFilterValue.ItemsCheckedChanged += DateValue_ItemsCheckedChanged;
			}
		}

		private void DateValue_ItemsCheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCollection(sender as ExcelColumnFilterValue);
		}

		public override ExcelColumnFilterValue FindItem(object value, ColumnFilterMode columnFilterMode)
		{
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				return FindDayItem((DateTime)value);
			}
			DateTime? dateTime = value as DateTime?;
			if (dateTime.HasValue)
			{
				return FindDayItem(dateTime.Value);
			}
			if (ColumnFilterInfoHelper.IsNullOrEmptyString(value))
			{
				return ServiceItem_SelectBlanks;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue FindDayItem(DateTime date)
		{
			foreach (ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue item in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue))
			{
				if (item.Date == date)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			foreach (ExcelDateColumnFilterValue item2 in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue))
			{
				ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue excelDateDayColumnFilterValue2 = item2.Items.FindDayItem(date);
				if (excelDateDayColumnFilterValue2 != null)
				{
					return excelDateDayColumnFilterValue2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> FindAllDayItems()
		{
			List<ExcelColumnFilterValue> list = new List<ExcelColumnFilterValue>();
			foreach (ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue item in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue))
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (ExcelDateColumnFilterValue item2 in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue))
			{
				list.AddRange(item2.Items.FindAllDayItems());
			}
			if (ServiceItem_SelectBlanks != null)
			{
				list.Add(ServiceItem_SelectBlanks);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public void UpdateFilter(ExcelDateColumnFilterScope filterScope, string oldValue, string value)
		{
			HasVisibleItems = false;
			bool flag = (filterScope & FilterScope) == FilterScope;
			foreach (ExcelDateColumnFilterValue item in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value) || (flag && ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetStringContainsSubstring(item.GetComputedValue().ToString(), value)))
				{
					item.SetIsVisible(value: true);
					item.Items.UpdateFilter(filterScope, oldValue, null);
					HasVisibleItems = true;
					continue;
				}
				item.Items.UpdateFilter(filterScope, oldValue, value);
				if (item.Items.HasVisibleItems)
				{
					HasVisibleItems = true;
				}
				item.SetIsVisible(item.Items.HasVisibleItems);
			}
			foreach (ExcelColumnFilterValue item2 in this.Where((ExcelColumnFilterValue i) => i is ExcelDateDayColumnFilterValue || (i.EditValue is string && (string)i.EditValue == string.Empty)))
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
				{
					item2.SetIsVisible(value: true);
					HasVisibleItems = true;
				}
				else if (item2 == ServiceItem_SelectBlanks && item2.DisplayValue != null)
				{
					ServiceItem_SelectBlanks.SetIsVisible(ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetStringContainsSubstring(ServiceItem_SelectBlanks.DisplayValue.ToString(), value));
					if (ServiceItem_SelectBlanks.IsVisible)
					{
						HasVisibleItems = true;
					}
				}
				else if (!flag)
				{
					item2.SetIsVisible(value: false);
				}
				else
				{
					item2.SetIsVisible(ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetStringContainsSubstring(item2.GetComputedValue().ToString(), value));
					if (item2.IsVisible)
					{
						HasVisibleItems = true;
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateFilter(oldValue, value);
		}

		private int GetCheckedSubItemsCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			using Enumerator enumerator = GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ExcelColumnFilterValue current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current != ServiceItem_SelectAll && current != ServiceItem_AddFilter)
				{
					if (current is ExcelDateColumnFilterValue excelDateColumnFilterValue && excelDateColumnFilterValue.Items.IsAllItemsChecked)
					{
						num++;
					}
					else if (current.IsChecked.HasValue && current.IsChecked.Value)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum ExcelDateColumnFilterScope
	{
		Day = 1,
		Month = 2,
		Year = 4,
		All = 7
	}
	public class ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues
	{
		public List<DateTime> Years { get; private set; }

		public List<DateTime> Months { get; private set; }

		public List<DateTime> Dates { get; private set; }

		public bool IncludeBlanks { get; set; }

		public ExcelDateTimeColumnFilterValues()
		{
			Dates = new List<DateTime>();
			Years = new List<DateTime>();
			Months = new List<DateTime>();
		}

		public List<Tuple<int, int>> GetYearRanges()
		{
			List<Tuple<int, int>> list = new List<Tuple<int, int>>();
			int num = int.MinValue;
			int item = int.MinValue;
			int num2 = int.MinValue;
			for (int i = 0; i < Years.Count; i++)
			{
				int year = Years[i].Year;
				if (num != int.MinValue)
				{
					if (year == num2)
					{
						item = year;
						num2++;
						if (i == Years.Count - 1)
						{
							list.Add(new Tuple<int, int>(num, item));
						}
						continue;
					}
					list.Add(new Tuple<int, int>(num, item));
					num = int.MinValue;
				}
				num = year;
				item = year;
				num2 = num + 1;
				if (i == Years.Count - 1)
				{
					list.Add(new Tuple<int, int>(num, item));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public List<Tuple<int, int, int>> GetMonthRanges()
		{
			List<Tuple<int, int, int>> list = new List<Tuple<int, int, int>>();
			List<Tuple<int, List<int>>> list2 = new List<Tuple<int, List<int>>>();
			Tuple<int, List<int>> tuple = null;
			foreach (DateTime month in Months)
			{
				if (tuple != null)
				{
					if (tuple.Item1 == month.Year)
					{
						tuple.Item2.Add(month.Month);
						continue;
					}
					tuple = null;
				}
				tuple = new Tuple<int, List<int>>(month.Year, new List<int> { month.Month });
				list2.Add(tuple);
			}
			foreach (Tuple<int, List<int>> item2 in list2)
			{
				int num = int.MinValue;
				int item = int.MinValue;
				int num2 = int.MinValue;
				for (int i = 0; i < item2.Item2.Count; i++)
				{
					int num3 = item2.Item2[i];
					if (num != int.MinValue)
					{
						if (num3 == num2)
						{
							item = num3;
							num2++;
							if (i == item2.Item2.Count - 1)
							{
								list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, int>(item2.Item1, num, item));
							}
							continue;
						}
						list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, int>(item2.Item1, num, item));
						num = int.MinValue;
					}
					num = num3;
					item = num3;
					num2 = num + 1;
					if (i == item2.Item2.Count - 1)
					{
						list.Add(new Tuple<int, int, int>(item2.Item1, num, item));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

"By default, an infinite grid width is not allowed since all grid cards will be rendered and, hence, the grid will work very slowly. To fix this issue, place the grid into a container that will give a finite height to the grid, or manually specify the grid's Height or MaxHeight. Note that you can also avoid this exception by setting the {0}.AllowInfiniteGridSize static property to True, but in that case, the grid will run slowly.", DataControlTypeName));

	public abstract class FilterCriteriaControlBase : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ColumnProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DefaultIndexProperty;

		public ColumnBase Column
		{
			get
			{
				return (ColumnBase)GetValue(ColumnProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ColumnProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int DefaultIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(DefaultIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DefaultIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		static FilterCriteriaControlBase()
		{
			ColumnProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Column", typeof(ColumnBase), typeof(FilterCriteriaControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((FilterCriteriaControlBase)d).ColumnChanged((ColumnBase)e.OldValue);
			}));
			DefaultIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DefaultIndex", typeof(int), typeof(FilterCriteriaControlBase), new PropertyMetadata(-1));
		}

		protected abstract void ColumnChanged(ColumnBase oldColumn);
	}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(GridColumnWidthConverter))]
	public struct GridColumnWidth : IEquatable<GridColumnWidth>
	{
		private double _value;

		private GridColumnUnitType _unitType;

		public double Value => _value;

		public GridColumnUnitType UnitType => _unitType;

		public bool IsAbsolute => UnitType == GridColumnUnitType.Pixel;

		public bool IsStar => UnitType == GridColumnUnitType.Star;

		public bool IsAuto => UnitType == GridColumnUnitType.Auto;

		public GridColumnWidth(double value)
			: this(value, GridColumnUnitType.Pixel)
		{
		}

		public GridColumnWidth(double value, GridColumnUnitType unitType)
		{
			_value = value;
			_unitType = unitType;
		}

		public static implicit operator GridColumnWidth(double value)
		{
			return new GridColumnWidth(value);
		}

		public static bool operator ==(GridColumnWidth value1, GridColumnWidth value2)
		{
			if (value1.Value == value2.Value)
			{
				return value1.UnitType == value2.UnitType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool operator !=(GridColumnWidth value1, GridColumnWidth value2)
		{
			return !(value1 == value2);
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is GridColumnWidth)
			{
				return this == (GridColumnWidth)obj;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (int)((int)Value + UnitType);
		}

		public bool Equals(GridColumnWidth other)
		{
			return this == other;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return GridColumnWidthConverter.ToString(this, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
		}
	}
	public class GridColumnWidthConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		private static Dictionary<string, double> unitFactors = new Dictionary<string, double>
		{
			{ "px", 1.0 },
			{ "in", 96.0 },
			{ "cm", 37.79527559055118 },
			{ "pt", 1.3333333333333333 }
		};

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			switch (Type.GetTypeCode(sourceType))
			{
			case TypeCode.Int16:
			case TypeCode.UInt16:
			case TypeCode.Int32:
			case TypeCode.UInt32:
			case TypeCode.Int64:
			case TypeCode.UInt64:
			case TypeCode.Single:
			case TypeCode.Double:
			case TypeCode.Decimal:
			case TypeCode.String:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext typeDescriptorContext, CultureInfo cultureInfo, object source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				throw GetConvertFromException(source);
			}
			if (source is string)
			{
				return FromString((string)source, cultureInfo);
			}
			return new GridColumnWidth(Convert.ToDouble(source, cultureInfo), GridColumnUnitType.Pixel);
		}

		private GridColumnWidth FromString(string source, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			string text = source.Trim().ToLowerInvariant();
			if (text == "auto")
			{
				return new GridColumnWidth(120.0, GridColumnUnitType.Auto);
			}
			GridColumnUnitType unitType = GridColumnUnitType.Pixel;
			double num = 1.0;
			if (text.EndsWith("*", StringComparison.Ordinal))
			{
				unitType = GridColumnUnitType.Star;
				if (text.Length == 1)
				{
					return new GridColumnWidth(1.0, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
				}
				text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - 1);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (string key in unitFactors.Keys)
				{
					if (text.EndsWith(key, StringComparison.Ordinal))
					{
						num = unitFactors[key];
						text = text.Substring(0, text.Length - key.Length);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return new GridColumnWidth(Convert.ToDouble(text, cultureInfo) * num, unitType);
		}

		public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!(destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor)))
			{
				return destinationType == typeof(string);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (value != null || value is GridColumnWidth)
			{
				GridColumnWidth gridColumnWidth = (GridColumnWidth)value;
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return ToString(gridColumnWidth, culture);
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(GridColumnWidth).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(double),
						typeof(GridColumnUnitType)
					});
					object[] arguments = new object[2] { gridColumnWidth.Value, gridColumnWidth.UnitType };
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, arguments);
				}
			}
			throw GetConvertToException(value, destinationType);
		}

		public static string ToString(GridColumnWidth value, CultureInfo cultureInfo)
		{
			if (value.IsStar && value.Value == 1.0)
			{
				return "*";
			}
			if (value.IsAuto)
			{
				return "auto";
			}
			return Convert.ToString(value.Value, cultureInfo) + (value.IsStar ? "*" : string.Empty);
		}
	}
	public static class GridCompatibilitySettings
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty UseLegacyColumnChooserProperty;

		static GridCompatibilitySettings()
