			UseLegacyColumnChooserProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("UseLegacyColumnChooser", typeof(bool?), typeof(GridCompatibilitySettings), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
		}

		public static bool? GetUseLegacyColumnChooser(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return (bool?)obj.GetValue(UseLegacyColumnChooserProperty);
		}

		public static void SetUseLegacyColumnChooser(DependencyObject obj, bool? value)
		{
			obj.SetValue(UseLegacyColumnChooserProperty, value);
		}
	}
	public interface IMergeWithPreviousGroup
	{
		bool MergeWithPreviousGroup { get; }
	}
	internal class BandColumnsMoveAdapter
	{
		private class Position
		{
			public int VisibleIndex { get; set; }

			public int CollectionIndex { get; set; }

			public int Row { get; set; }

			public Position(int visibleIndex, int collectionIndex, int row)
			{
				VisibleIndex = visibleIndex;
				CollectionIndex = collectionIndex;
				Row = row;
			}
		}

		private class MoveAdapterInsertInfo
		{
			public ColumnNode Source { get; private set; }

			public BandedViewDropPlace InsertMode { get; private set; }

			public MoveAdapterInsertInfo(ColumnNode source, BandedViewDropPlace mode)
			{
				Source = source;
				InsertMode = mode;
			}
		}

		private enum ShiftMode
		{
			Left,
			Right
		}

		private class ShiftIndex
		{
			private bool allowShiftCore = true;

			private int delta;

			private Func<int, int, bool> needShift;

			public int Index { get; set; }

			public bool AllowShift
			{
				get
				{
					return allowShiftCore;
				}
				set
				{
					allowShiftCore = value;
				}
			}

			public ShiftIndex(int index, ShiftMode mode)
			{
				Index = index;
				InitShiftMode(mode);
			}

			private void InitShiftMode(ShiftMode mode)
			{
				switch (mode)
				{
				case ShiftMode.Left:
					needShift = (int x, int y) => x > y;
					delta = -1;
					break;
				case ShiftMode.Right:
					needShift = (int x, int y) => x >= y;
					delta = 1;
					break;
				}
			}

			public int CalcShiftedValue(int index)
			{
				if (AllowShift && needShift(index, Index))
				{
					return index + delta;
				}
				return index;
			}
		}

		private readonly Dictionary<ColumnNode, Position> positionCache;

		private readonly ColumnNodeCollection columnNodes;

		private CollectionModificationListener<MoveAdapterInsertInfo, ColumnNode> modificationListener = new CollectionModificationListener<MoveAdapterInsertInfo, ColumnNode>((MoveAdapterInsertInfo x) => x.Source);

		private bool hasExplicitVisibleIndexes;

		private bool allowMoveInsideCollectionCore;

		private HeaderPresenterType MoveFrom;

		private bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes;

		public bool AllowMoveInsideCollection
		{
			get
			{
				return allowMoveInsideCollectionCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowMoveInsideCollectionCore != value)
				{
					allowMoveInsideCollectionCore = value;
					OnAllowMoveInsideCollectionChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IndexedMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (!hasExplicitVisibleIndexes)
				{
					return !AllowMoveInsideCollection;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal ColumnNodeCollection ColumnNodes => columnNodes;

		private void OnAllowMoveInsideCollectionChanged()
		{
			modificationListener.EnableMinimization = IndexedMode;
		}

		public BandColumnsMoveAdapter(ColumnNodeCollection columnNodes, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (columnNodes == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.columnNodes = columnNodes;
			MoveFrom = moveFrom;
			this.useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes = useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes;
			positionCache = new Dictionary<ColumnNode, Position>();
			PopulatePositionCache();
		}

		private void PopulatePositionCache()
		{
			hasExplicitVisibleIndexes = columnNodes.HasExplicitIndexes();
			foreach (ColumnNode item in (Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)columnNodes)
			{
				CachePosition(item, item.VisibleIndex, item.CollectionIndex, item.Row);
			}
		}

		private void CachePosition(ColumnNode node, int visibleIndex, int collectionIndex, int row)
		{
			positionCache[node] = new Position(visibleIndex, collectionIndex, row);
		}

		public void Insert(ColumnNode source, ColumnNode target, BandedViewDropPlace mode)
		{
			if (source != null && target != null && !IsInCollection(source) && IsInCollection(target))
			{
				CollectionInsert(source, target, mode);
				PositionInsert(source, target, mode);
			}
		}

		private void CollectionInsert(ColumnNode source, ColumnNode target, BandedViewDropPlace mode)
		{
			modificationListener.Add(new MoveAdapterInsertInfo(source, mode));
		}

		private void PositionInsert(ColumnNode source, ColumnNode target, BandedViewDropPlace mode)
		{
			Position cachedPosition = GetCachedPosition(target);
			int visibleIndex = CalcInsertIndex(cachedPosition, mode, (Position x) => x.VisibleIndex);
			int collectionIndex = CalcInsertIndex(cachedPosition, mode, (Position x) => x.CollectionIndex);
			int num = CalcInsertRow(cachedPosition.Row, mode);
			bool allowShiftRowIndex = mode == BandedViewDropPlace.Top || mode == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom;
			ShiftIndexes(visibleIndex, collectionIndex, num, allowShiftRowIndex, allowShift: true, ShiftMode.Right);
			CachePosition(source, visibleIndex, collectionIndex, num);
		}

		private int CalcInsertIndex(Position targetPosition, BandedViewDropPlace mode, Func<Position, int> indexSelector)
		{
			return mode switch
			{
				BandedViewDropPlace.Left => indexSelector(targetPosition), 
				BandedViewDropPlace.Right => indexSelector(targetPosition) + 1, 
				BandedViewDropPlace.Top => GetPositions(targetPosition.Row).Min(indexSelector), 
				BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom => GetPositions(targetPosition.Row).Max(indexSelector) + 1, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		private IEnumerable<Position> GetPositions(int row)
		{
			return positionCache.Values.Where((Position x) => x.Row == row);
		}

		private int CalcInsertRow(int targetRow, BandedViewDropPlace mode)
		{
			int num = targetRow;
			if (mode == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Add(ColumnNode column)
		{
			if (column != null && !IsInCollection(column))
			{
				CollectionInsert(column, null, BandedViewDropPlace.None);
				PositionAdd(column);
			}
		}

		private void PositionAdd(ColumnNode column)
		{
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = -1;
			foreach (Position value in positionCache.Values)
			{
				if (num < value.VisibleIndex)
				{
					num = value.VisibleIndex;
				}
				if (num2 < value.CollectionIndex)
				{
					num2 = value.CollectionIndex;
				}
			}
			CachePosition(column, num + 1, num2 + 1, column.Row);
		}

		public void Remove(ColumnNode column)
		{
			if (column != null && IsInCollection(column))
			{
				CollectionRemove(column);
				PositionRemove(column);
			}
		}

		private void CollectionRemove(ColumnNode column)
		{
			modificationListener.Remove(column);
		}

		private void PositionRemove(ColumnNode column)
		{
			Position cachedPosition = GetCachedPosition(column);
			int visibleIndex = cachedPosition.VisibleIndex;
			int currentRow = cachedPosition.Row;
			int collectionIndex = cachedPosition.CollectionIndex;
			positionCache.Remove(column);
			bool allowShiftRowIndex = !positionCache.Values.Any((Position x) => x.Row == currentRow);
			ShiftIndexes(visibleIndex, collectionIndex, currentRow, allowShiftRowIndex, GetAllowShift(column), ShiftMode.Left);
		}

		private bool GetAllowShift(ColumnNode column)
		{
			if (!useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (column.IsVisible)
			{
				return MoveFrom != HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ShiftIndexes(int visibleIndex, int collectionIndex, int rowIndex, bool allowShiftRowIndex, bool allowShift, ShiftMode mode)
		{
			ShiftIndexes(new ShiftIndex(visibleIndex, mode)
			{
				AllowShift = allowShift
			}, new ShiftIndex(collectionIndex, mode), new ShiftIndex(rowIndex, mode)
			{
				AllowShift = allowShiftRowIndex
			});
		}

		private void ShiftIndexes(ShiftIndex visible, ShiftIndex collection, ShiftIndex row)
		{
			foreach (Position value in positionCache.Values)
			{
				value.VisibleIndex = visible.CalcShiftedValue(value.VisibleIndex);
				value.CollectionIndex = collection.CalcShiftedValue(value.CollectionIndex);
				value.Row = row.CalcShiftedValue(value.Row);
			}
		}

		public void Apply()
		{
			ApplyCollectionModifications();
			ApplyPositionCache();
		}

		private void ApplyCollectionModifications()
		{
			foreach (ColumnNode removedItem in modificationListener.RemovedItems)
			{
				removedItem.VisibleIndex = -1;
				((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)columnNodes).Remove(removedItem);
			}
			foreach (MoveAdapterInsertInfo addedItem in modificationListener.AddedItems)
			{
				ColumnNode source = addedItem.Source;
				int collectionIndex = GetCachedPosition(source).CollectionIndex;
				((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)columnNodes).Insert(collectionIndex, source);
			}
			modificationListener.Reset();
		}

		private Position GetCachedPosition(ColumnNode node)
		{
			Position value = null;
			positionCache.TryGetValue(node, out value);
			return value;
		}

		private void ApplyPositionCache()
		{
			foreach (ColumnNode item in (Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)columnNodes)
			{
				Position position = GetCachedPosition(item);
				if (position == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				item.Row = position.Row;
				if (IndexedMode)
				{
					item.ForceSet(delegate(ColumnNode n)
					{
						n.VisibleIndex = position.VisibleIndex;
					});
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsInCollection(ColumnNode node)
		{
			return positionCache.ContainsKey(node);
		}
	}
	internal class BandsMover
	{
		private readonly DataControlBase grid;

		private readonly bool isInDesignMode;

		private BandsMoverHierarchy hierarchy;

		private IDesignTimeAdornerBase designTimeAdorner;

		private IndexSynchronizer synchronizerCore;

		private IndexSynchronizer Synchronizer
		{
			get
			{
				if (synchronizerCore == null)
				{
					synchronizerCore = CreateIndexSynchronizer();
				}
				return synchronizerCore;
			}
		}

		private void MapDragColumns(BaseColumn sourceCol, BaseColumn targetCol, out ColumnNode sourceNode, out ColumnNode targetNode)
		{
			InvalidateHierarchy();
			sourceNode = FindNode(sourceCol);
			if (sourceNode != null)
			{
				sourceNode.Prototype = sourceCol;
			}
			targetNode = FindNode(targetCol);
			if (targetNode != null)
			{
				targetNode.Prototype = targetCol;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateHierarchy()
		{
			hierarchy = new BandsMoverHierarchy();
			hierarchy.AllowModelClear = isInDesignMode;
			hierarchy.UseColumnClones = isInDesignMode;
			hierarchy.Init(grid);
			PrepareHierarchy(hierarchy);
		}

		private ColumnNode FindNode(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = IndexOf(column);
			if (num == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int[] collection = new int[0];
			if (column.ParentBand != null)
			{
				collection = BandWalker.GetIndexes(column.ParentBand);
			}
			IColumnNodeOwner columnNodeOwner = hierarchy;
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>(collection);
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = stack.Pop();
				columnNodeOwner = ((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)columnNodeOwner.BandNodes)[index];
			}
			ColumnNodeCollection children = GetChildren(columnNodeOwner, (!column.IsBand) ? BandedCollectionType.Columns : BandedCollectionType.Bands);
			return ((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)children)[num];
		}

		private int IndexOf(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				if (column is BandBase)
				{
					ISupportGetCachedIndex<BandBase> val = ((column.ParentBand != null) ? column.ParentBand.BandsCore : grid.BandsCore);
					return val.GetCachedIndex((BandBase)column);
				}
				if (column is ColumnBase)
				{
					ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase> val2 = null;
					val2 = (ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>)((column.ParentBand == null) ? ((object)grid.ColumnsCore) : ((object)column.ParentBand.ColumnsCore));
					return val2.GetCachedIndex((ColumnBase)column);
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public BandsMover(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.grid = grid;
			isInDesignMode = DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(grid);
		}

		public void MoveColumnToColumn(ColumnBase source, ColumnBase target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			MapDragColumns(source, target, out var sourceNode, out var targetNode);
			IBandsMoverDropTarget target2 = null;
			if (sourceNode != null && targetNode != null)
			{
				ColumnNode columnNode = null;
				if (sourceNode != targetNode)
				{
					columnNode = targetNode;
				}
				else if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Top || dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
				{
					columnNode = FindRowSibling(sourceNode);
				}
				if (columnNode != null)
				{
					target2 = new AnchorBandsMoverDropTarget(columnNode)
					{
						DropPlace = dropPlace
					};
				}
			}
			Move(sourceNode, target2, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		public void MoveColumnToBand(ColumnBase source, BandBase target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			MapDragColumns(source, target, out var sourceNode, out var targetNode);
			IBandsMoverDropTarget target2 = null;
			ColumnNode firstChildColumn = GetFirstChildColumn(targetNode);
			if (firstChildColumn == null)
			{
				target2 = new BandsMoverDropTarget(targetNode);
			}
			else
			{
				ColumnNode columnNode = firstChildColumn;
				if (columnNode == sourceNode)
				{
					columnNode = FindRowSibling(sourceNode);
				}
				if (columnNode != null)
				{
					target2 = new AnchorBandsMoverDropTarget(columnNode)
					{
						DropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Top
					};
				}
			}
			Move(sourceNode, target2, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		public void MoveBand(BandBase source, BandBase target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Top)
			{
				return;
			}
			MapDragColumns(source, target, out var sourceNode, out var targetNode);
			IBandsMoverDropTarget dropTarget = null;
			if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
			{
				if (grid.BandsLayoutCore.AllowChangeBandParent || isInDesignMode)
				{
					dropTarget = new BandsMoverDropTarget(targetNode)
					{
						NeedTransferChildren = true
					};
				}
			}
			else if (target != null && target.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Right)
				{
					BandBase bandBase = grid.BandsLayoutCore.VisibleBands.FirstOrDefault((BandBase x) => x != target);
					if (bandBase != null)
					{
						ColumnNode columnNode = FindNode(bandBase);
						columnNode.Prototype = bandBase;
						dropTarget = new AnchorBandsMoverDropTarget(columnNode)
						{
							DropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Left
						};
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dropTarget = new AnchorBandsMoverDropTarget(targetNode)
				{
					DropPlace = dropPlace
				};
			}
			if (grid != null)
			{
				grid.BandsSourceSyncLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					Move(sourceNode, dropTarget, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				});
				{
					foreach (object item in grid.BandsCore)
					{
						if (item is BandBase bandBase2)
						{
							bandBase2.SyncBandsColectionWithSource(full: true);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			Move(sourceNode, dropTarget, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		private void TransferBandChildren(IColumnNodeOwner oldOwner, IColumnNodeOwner newOwner, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (oldOwner != null && newOwner != null)
			{
				TransferBandChildren(oldOwner, newOwner, BandedCollectionType.Bands, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				IColumnNodeOwner firstLeafBand = GetFirstLeafBand(newOwner);
				TransferBandChildren(newOwner, firstLeafBand, BandedCollectionType.Columns, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				TransferBandChildren(oldOwner, firstLeafBand, BandedCollectionType.Columns, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
		}

		private void TransferBandChildren(IColumnNodeOwner oldOwner, IColumnNodeOwner newOwner, BandedCollectionType childrenType, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (oldOwner == newOwner)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnNodeCollection children = GetChildren(oldOwner, childrenType);
			ColumnNodeCollection children2 = GetChildren(newOwner, childrenType);
			ColumnNode[] array = ((IEnumerable<ColumnNode>)children).OrderBy((ColumnNode x) => x.VisibleIndex).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Func<ColumnNodeCollection, HeaderPresenterType, bool, BandColumnsMoveAdapter> func = CreateAdapterFactory();
			BandColumnsMoveAdapter bandColumnsMoveAdapter = func(children, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			BandColumnsMoveAdapter bandColumnsMoveAdapter2 = func(children2, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			ColumnNode[] array2 = array;
			foreach (ColumnNode columnNode in array2)
			{
				if (columnNode != newOwner)
				{
					bandColumnsMoveAdapter.Remove(columnNode);
					bandColumnsMoveAdapter2.Add(columnNode);
				}
			}
			bandColumnsMoveAdapter.Apply();
			bandColumnsMoveAdapter2.Apply();
		}

		private ColumnNodeCollection GetChildren(IColumnNodeOwner owner, BandedCollectionType childrenType)
		{
			return childrenType switch
			{
				BandedCollectionType.Bands => owner.BandNodes, 
				BandedCollectionType.Columns => owner.ColumnNodes, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		private ColumnNode FindRowSibling(ColumnNode source)
		{
			ColumnNodeCollection children = GetChildren(source.Owner, source.CollectionType);
			return ((IEnumerable<ColumnNode>)children).FirstOrDefault((ColumnNode x) => x.Row == source.Row && x != source && x.IsVisible);
		}

		private ColumnNode GetFirstChildColumn(ColumnNode band)
		{
			if (band == null || ((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)band.ColumnNodes).Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnNode columnNode = null;
			foreach (ColumnNode item in (Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)band.ColumnNodes)
			{
				if (item.IsVisible)
				{
					int row = item.Row;
					if (columnNode == null || row < columnNode.Row || (row == columnNode.Row && item.VisibleIndex < columnNode.VisibleIndex))
					{
						columnNode = item;
					}
				}
			}
			return columnNode;
		}

		private IColumnNodeOwner GetFirstLeafBand(IColumnNodeOwner root)
		{
			ColumnNodeCollection bandNodes = root.BandNodes;
			ColumnNode columnNode = ((IEnumerable<ColumnNode>)bandNodes).FirstOrDefault((ColumnNode x) => x.IsVisible);
			if (columnNode == null)
			{
				return root;
			}
			return GetFirstLeafBand(columnNode);
		}

		private void Move(ColumnNode source, IBandsMoverDropTarget target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase viewCore = grid.viewCore;
			if (viewCore == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			viewCore.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
			viewCore.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Lock();
			designTimeAdorner = grid.DesignTimeAdorner;
			try
			{
				IModelEditingScope val = designTimeAdorner.DataControlModelItem.BeginEdit("DragDrop");
				try
				{
					BeforeColumnMove(source, moveFrom);
					MoveCore(source, target, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
					AfterColumnMove(source, moveFrom);
					ApplyEditingScope(val);
					Synchronizer.Process();
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				viewCore.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Unlock();
				viewCore.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyEditingScope(IModelEditingScope scope)
		{
			if (isInDesignMode)
			{
				grid.BeginDesignColumnMoverApply();
				try
				{
					scope.Complete();
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					grid.EndDesignColumnMoverApply();
				}
			}
			scope.Complete();
		}

		private void BeforeColumnMove(ColumnNode source, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			grid.BeforeColumnMove(source.Prototype, moveFrom);
		}

		private void AfterColumnMove(ColumnNode source, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (moveFrom == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser)
			{
				source.Prototype.Visible = true;
			}
			designTimeAdorner.SelectModelItem(hierarchy.FindNodeModel(source));
		}

		private void MoveCore(ColumnNode source, IBandsMoverDropTarget target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			if (source != null && target != null)
			{
				IColumnNodeOwner nodeOwner = target.GetNodeOwner();
				BandedCollectionType collectionType = source.CollectionType;
				ColumnNodeCollection children = GetChildren(source.Owner, collectionType);
				ColumnNodeCollection children2 = GetChildren(nodeOwner, collectionType);
				Func<ColumnNodeCollection, HeaderPresenterType, bool, BandColumnsMoveAdapter> func = CreateAdapterFactory();
				BandColumnsMoveAdapter bandColumnsMoveAdapter = func(children, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				BandColumnsMoveAdapter bandColumnsMoveAdapter2 = ((children == children2) ? bandColumnsMoveAdapter : func(children2, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes));
				PrepareMoveAdapter(bandColumnsMoveAdapter);
				PrepareMoveAdapter(bandColumnsMoveAdapter2);
				bandColumnsMoveAdapter.Remove(source);
				target.Drop(bandColumnsMoveAdapter2, source);
				bandColumnsMoveAdapter.Apply();
				bandColumnsMoveAdapter2.Apply();
				UpdateSyncRequests(bandColumnsMoveAdapter, bandColumnsMoveAdapter2);
				if (target.NeedTransferChildren)
				{
					TransferBandChildren(nodeOwner, source, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				}
			}
		}

		private Func<ColumnNodeCollection, HeaderPresenterType, bool, BandColumnsMoveAdapter> CreateAdapterFactory()
		{
			return (ColumnNodeCollection nds, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes) => CreateMoveAdapter(nds, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		private BandColumnsMoveAdapter CreateMoveAdapter(ColumnNodeCollection nodes, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			BandColumnsMoveAdapter bandColumnsMoveAdapter = new BandColumnsMoveAdapter(nodes, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			bandColumnsMoveAdapter.AllowMoveInsideCollection = isInDesignMode;
			return bandColumnsMoveAdapter;
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareMoveAdapter(BandColumnsMoveAdapter adapter)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void PrepareHierarchy(BandsMoverHierarchy hierarchy)
		{
		}

		protected virtual IndexSynchronizer CreateIndexSynchronizer()
		{
			return new IndexSynchronizer();
		}

		private void UpdateSyncRequests(params BandColumnsMoveAdapter[] adapters)
		{
			foreach (BandColumnsMoveAdapter item in adapters.Distinct())
			{
				Synchronizer.EnqueueSyncRequest(item);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class IndexSynchronizer
	{
		private Queue<BandColumnsMoveAdapter> syncQueue = new Queue<BandColumnsMoveAdapter>();

		public ReadOnlyCollection<BandColumnsMoveAdapter> GetUnsyncedAdapters()
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<BandColumnsMoveAdapter>(syncQueue.ToList());
		}

		public void EnqueueSyncRequest(BandColumnsMoveAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter != null && IsSyncNeeded(adapter))
			{
				syncQueue.Enqueue(adapter);
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSyncNeeded(BandColumnsMoveAdapter adapter)
		{
			return !adapter.IndexedMode;
		}

		public void Process()
		{
			BeforeProcess();
			ProcessCore();
		}

		protected virtual void BeforeProcess()
		{
		}

		private void ProcessCore()
		{
			while (syncQueue.Count != 0)
			{
				BandColumnsMoveAdapter adapter = syncQueue.Dequeue();
				SyncCurrentValueIndexes(GetColumns(adapter));
			}
		}

		private IList<BaseColumn> GetColumns(BandColumnsMoveAdapter adapter)
		{
			if (adapter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnNodeCollection columnNodes = adapter.ColumnNodes;
			if (columnNodes == null || columnNodes.Owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnNodes.Owner.GetRoot()?.FindColumns(columnNodes);
		}

		private void SyncCurrentValueIndexes(IList<BaseColumn> columns)
		{
			if (columns != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
				{
					columns[i].VisibleIndex = i;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CollectionModificationListener<TInsert, TItem>
	{
		private HashSet<TItem> removedSet = new HashSet<TItem>();

		private Dictionary<TItem, TInsert> insertions = new Dictionary<TItem, TInsert>();

		private readonly Func<TInsert, TItem> mapInsertion;

		private bool enableMinimizationCore = true;

		public ReadOnlyCollection<TItem> RemovedItems => CreateReadOnlyCollection(removedSet);

		public ReadOnlyCollection<TInsert> AddedItems => CreateReadOnlyCollection(insertions.Values);

		public bool IsDirty { get; set; }

		public bool EnableMinimization
		{
			get
			{
				return enableMinimizationCore;
			}
			set
			{
				enableMinimizationCore = value;
			}
		}

		private ReadOnlyCollection<T> CreateReadOnlyCollection<T>(IEnumerable<T> set)
		{
			return new ReadOnlyCollection<T>(IsDirty ? Enumerable.Empty<T>().ToList() : set.ToList());
		}

		public CollectionModificationListener(Func<TInsert, TItem> mapInsertion)
		{
			if (mapInsertion == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.mapInsertion = mapInsertion;
		}

		public void Remove(TItem v)
		{
			if (!TryMinimizeModification(() => insertions.Remove(v)))
			{
				removedSet.Add(v);
			}
		}

		public void Add(TInsert v)
		{
			TItem newItem = mapInsertion(v);
			if (!TryMinimizeModification(() => removedSet.Remove(newItem)))
			{
				insertions.Add(newItem, v);
			}
		}

		private bool TryMinimizeModification(Func<bool> minimizationAction)
		{
			if (EnableMinimization)
			{
				return minimizationAction();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			removedSet.Clear();
			insertions.Clear();
			IsDirty = false;
		}
	}

		public void ForceSet(Action<ColumnNode> setAction)

		private void OnModelPropertyChanging(object oldValue, object newValue, object defaultValue, DXPropertyIdentifier propId)
		{
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsInitializing && (!object.Equals(oldValue, newValue) || forceSetModelProperties))
			{
				OnNodeChanging(new NodeChangingInfo
				{
					Node = this,
					NewValue = newValue,
					OldValue = oldValue,
					DefaultValue = defaultValue,
					PropertyID = propId
				});
			}
		}

			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			collectionTypeCore = collectionType;
			if (collectionFactory == null)
			{
				collectionFactory = CreateDefaultCollectionFactory();
			}
			bandNodes = collectionFactory.CreateBandCollection(this);
			columnNodes = collectionFactory.CreateColumnCollection(this);
		}

		}

		BandsMoverHierarchy IColumnNodeOwner.GetRoot()

	internal class ColumnNodeCollection : ObservableCollectionCore<ColumnNode>
	{
		private IColumnNodeOwner ownerCore;

		public IColumnNodeOwner Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ownerCore != value)
				{
					ownerCore = value;
					OnOwnerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnOwnerChanged()
		{
			SetNodeOwner((IList)this, Owner);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!base.IsLockUpdate && (Owner == null || !Owner.IsInitializing))
			{
				UpdateItems(e);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateItems(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			object nodes;
			if (e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				nodes = e.NewItems;
			}
			else
			{
				nodes = this;
			}
			SetNodeOwner((IList)nodes, Owner);
			SetNodeOwner(e.OldItems, null);
			InvalidateCollectionIndexes();
			Owner.Do(delegate(IColumnNodeOwner x)
			{
				x.OnNodeCollectionChanged(this, e);
			});
		}

		private void SetNodeOwner(IList nodes, IColumnNodeOwner owner)
		{
			if (nodes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnNode node in nodes)
			{
				node.Owner = owner;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateCollectionIndexes()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)this).Count; i++)
			{
				((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)this)[i].CollectionIndex = i;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HasExplicitIndexes()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<IModelItem>)Owner.With((IColumnNodeOwner o) => o.GetRoot()).With((BandsMoverHierarchy x) => x.FindCollectionModel(this)))?.Any((IModelItem x) => x.Properties[BaseColumn.VisibleIndexProperty.Name].IsSet) ?? true;
		}
	}
	internal class BandsMoverHierarchy : IColumnNodeOwner
	{
		private const int RootCollectionIndex = -1;

		private const string BandsPropertyName = "Bands";

		private const string ColumnsPropertyName = "Columns";

		private ColumnNodeCollection bandNodes;

		private ColumnNodeCollection columnNodes;

		private Locker initLocker = new Locker();

		private IDesignTimeAdornerBase adorner;

		private DataControlBase grid;

		private ColumnNodeCollectionFactory collectionFactoryCore;

		private NodeModelCache modelBufferCore = new NodeModelCache();

		public ColumnNodeCollectionFactory CollectionFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (collectionFactoryCore == null)
				{
					collectionFactoryCore = CreateDefaultCollectionFactory();
				}
				return collectionFactoryCore;
			}
			set
			{
				collectionFactoryCore = value;
			}
		}

		public bool AllowModelClear { get; set; }

		public bool UseColumnClones { get; set; }

		public NodeModelCache ModelBuffer => modelBufferCore;

		public ColumnNodeCollection BandNodes => bandNodes;

		public ColumnNodeCollection ColumnNodes => columnNodes;

		bool IColumnNodeOwner.IsInitializing => initLocker.IsLocked;

		int IColumnNodeOwner.CollectionIndex => -1;

		IColumnNodeOwner IColumnNodeOwner.Owner => null;

		private ColumnNodeCollectionFactory CreateDefaultCollectionFactory()
		{
			return new ColumnNodeCollectionFactory();
		}

		public BandsMoverHierarchy()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ResetNodes();
		}

		public void Init(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			adorner = grid.DesignTimeAdorner;
			this.grid = grid;
			ResetNodes();
			IList bands = grid.BandsCore;
			IList columns = null;
			if (bands.Count > 0)
			{
				columns = new ColumnBase[0];
			}
			else
			{
				columns = grid.ColumnsCore;
			}
			initLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				PopulateNodes(bands, columns, this);
			});
		}

		private void ResetNodes()
		{
			bandNodes.Do(delegate(ColumnNodeCollection x)
			{
				x.Owner = null;
			});
			columnNodes.Do(delegate(ColumnNodeCollection x)
			{
				x.Owner = null;
			});
			bandNodes = CollectionFactory.CreateBandCollection(this);
			columnNodes = CollectionFactory.CreateColumnCollection(this);
		}

		private void PopulateNodes(IList bands, IList columns, IColumnNodeOwner owner)
		{
			PopulateNodes<BandBase>(bands, BandedCollectionType.Bands, owner, OnBandNodeCreated);
			PopulateNodes<ColumnBase>(columns, BandedCollectionType.Columns, owner, OnColumnNodeCreated);
		}

		private void OnBandNodeCreated(BandBase band, ColumnNode node)
		{
			PopulateNodes(band.BandsCore, band.ColumnsCore, node);
		}

		private void OnColumnNodeCreated(ColumnBase column, ColumnNode node)
		{
			node.Row = BandBase.GetGridRow((DependencyObject)(object)column);
		}

		private void PopulateNodes<T>(IList source, BandedCollectionType collectionType, IColumnNodeOwner owner, Action<T, ColumnNode> onNodeCreated = null) where T : BaseColumn
		{
			ColumnNodeCollection collection = GetCollection(owner, collectionType);
			if (source.Count != 0)
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<ColumnNode>)collection).BeginUpdate();
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					T val = (T)source[i];
					ColumnNode columnNode = new ColumnNode(collectionType, CollectionFactory);
					columnNode.Owner = owner;
					columnNode.VisibleIndex = val.VisibleIndex;
					columnNode.IsVisible = IsColumnActualVisible(val);
					columnNode.CollectionIndex = i;
					((Collection<ColumnNode>)(object)collection).Add(columnNode);
					onNodeCreated?.Invoke(val, columnNode);
				}
				((ObservableCollectionCore<ColumnNode>)collection).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private bool IsColumnActualVisible(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column.Visible)
			{
				return grid.viewCore.Return((DataViewBase x) => x.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(column), () => true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static ColumnNodeCollection GetCollection(IColumnNodeOwner owner, BandedCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			return collectionType switch
			{
				BandedCollectionType.Bands => owner.BandNodes, 
				BandedCollectionType.Columns => owner.ColumnNodes, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		public virtual IModelItemCollection FindCollectionModel(ColumnNodeCollection nodes)
		{
			if (adorner == null || grid == null || nodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IModelItem dataControlModelItem = adorner.DataControlModelItem;
			if (dataControlModelItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Tuple<Stack<int>, BandedCollectionType> nodePath = GetNodePath(nodes);
			if (nodePath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return FindCollectionModel(dataControlModelItem, nodePath.Item1, nodePath.Item2);
		}

		private Tuple<Stack<int>, BandedCollectionType> GetNodePath(ColumnNodeCollection nodes)
		{
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>();
			IColumnNodeOwner owner = nodes.Owner;
			BandedCollectionType item = ((nodes == owner.ColumnNodes) ? BandedCollectionType.Columns : BandedCollectionType.Bands);
			while (owner != this && owner != null)
			{
				stack.Push(owner.CollectionIndex);
				owner = owner.Owner;
			}
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new Tuple<Stack<int>, BandedCollectionType>(stack, item);
		}

		private IModelItemCollection FindCollectionModel(IModelItem root, Stack<int> indexStack, BandedCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			IModelItemCollection modelCollection = GetModelCollection(root, (indexStack.Count == 0) ? collectionType : BandedCollectionType.Bands);
			if (indexStack.Count == 0 || modelCollection == null)
			{
				return modelCollection;
			}
			int num = indexStack.Pop();
			return FindCollectionModel(modelCollection[num], indexStack, collectionType);
		}

		public virtual IModelItem FindNodeModel(ColumnNode node)
		{
			if (adorner == null || grid == null || node == null || node.Owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnNodeCollection collection = GetCollection(node.Owner, node.CollectionType);
			IModelItemCollection val = FindCollectionModel(collection);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return val[node.CollectionIndex];
		}

		private IModelItemCollection GetModelCollection(IModelItem parent, BandedCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			string collectionName = GetCollectionName(collectionType);
			return parent.With((IModelItem p) => p.Properties).With((IModelPropertyCollection x) => x[collectionName]).With((IModelProperty y) => y.Collection);
		}

		private string GetCollectionName(BandedCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			return collectionType switch
			{
				BandedCollectionType.Bands => "Bands", 
				BandedCollectionType.Columns => "Columns", 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			};
		}

		public virtual IList<BaseColumn> FindColumns(ColumnNodeCollection nodes)
		{
			if (grid == null || nodes == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Tuple<Stack<int>, BandedCollectionType> nodePath = GetNodePath(nodes);
			if (nodePath == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BandedCollectionType item = nodePath.Item2;
			Stack<int> item2 = nodePath.Item1;
			Func<IList> func = null;
			func = ((item != BandedCollectionType.Bands && item2.Count <= 0) ? ((Func<IList>)(() => grid.ColumnsCore)) : ((Func<IList>)(() => grid.BandsCore)));
			return FindColumns(func, item2, item);
		}

		private IList<BaseColumn> FindColumns(Func<IList> collectionAccessor, Stack<int> indexStack, BandedCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			IList list = collectionAccessor();
			if (list == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (indexStack.Count == 0)
			{
				return list.Cast<BaseColumn>().ToList();
			}
			int index = indexStack.Pop();
			object obj = list[index];
			if (collectionType == BandedCollectionType.Bands || indexStack.Count > 0)
			{
				IBandsOwner bandsOwner = obj as IBandsOwner;
				if (bandsOwner != null)
				{
					return FindColumns(() => bandsOwner.BandsCore, indexStack, collectionType);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BandBase band = obj as BandBase;
				if (band != null)
				{
					return FindColumns(() => band.ColumnsCore, indexStack, collectionType);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		void IColumnNodeOwner.OnNodeCollectionChanged(ColumnNodeCollection source, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			IModelItemCollection val = FindCollectionModel(source);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnNode oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					int collectionIndex = oldItem.CollectionIndex;
					IModelItem model = val[collectionIndex];
					AddNodeToBuffer(oldItem, model);
					val.RemoveAt(collectionIndex);
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnNode newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				int collectionIndex2 = newItem.CollectionIndex;
				IModelItem value = null;
				if (ModelBuffer.TryGetValue(newItem, out value))
				{
					val.Insert(collectionIndex2, value);
				}
				else if (newItem.Prototype != null)
				{
					val.Insert(collectionIndex2, (object)newItem.Prototype);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddNodeToBuffer(ColumnNode node, IModelItem model)
		{
			IModelItem val = model;
			if (UseColumnClones && node.CollectionType == BandedCollectionType.Columns)
			{
				ModelItemCloner modelItemCloner = new ModelItemCloner();
				val = modelItemCloner.Clone(val);
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				ModelBuffer.Add(node, val);
			}
		}

		void IColumnNodeOwner.OnNodeChanging(NodeChangingInfo change)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (change == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IModelItem val = FindNodeModel(change.Node);
			if (val == null || val.Properties == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IModelProperty val2 = val.Properties[change.PropertyID];
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				if (AllowModelClear && object.Equals(change.NewValue, change.DefaultValue))
				{
					val2.ClearValue();
				}
				else
				{
					val2.SetValue(change.NewValue);
				}
			}
		}

		BandsMoverHierarchy IColumnNodeOwner.GetRoot()
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	internal class ModelItemCloner
	{
		public IModelItem Clone(IModelItem original)
		{
			IEditingContext context = original.Context;
			IModelItem val = context.CreateItem(original.ItemType);
			foreach (IModelProperty item in (IEnumerable<IModelProperty>)original.Properties)
			{
				if (item.IsSet && !item.IsReadOnly)
				{
					val.Properties[item.Name].SetValue((object)item.Value);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}
	}
	internal static class IncrementalSearchHelper
	{
		public static CriteriaOperator GetCriteriaOperator(string[] columns, FilterCondition filterCondition, string searchText, CriteriaOperatorType operatorType)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(searchText) || columns == null || columns.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FindSearchParserResults val = new FindSearchParser().Parse($"\"{searchText}\"");
			val.SearchTexts[0] = val.SearchTexts[0].Trim('"');
			val.AppendColumnFieldPrefixes();
			return DxFtsContainsHelper.Create(columns, val, filterCondition);
		}

		public static TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex SearchCallback(string prefix, TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex startIndex, bool ignoreStartIndex, bool down, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefix))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (startIndex == null)
			{
				startIndex = new TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex(CalcStartRowIndex(view.RootView, down), CalcStartColumnIndex(view.RootView, down), view.RootView, 0);
			}
			TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex result = new TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex();
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = view;
			int num = startIndex.Level;
			bool flag = false;
			Dictionary<int, DataViewBase> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, DataViewBase>();
			while (num >= 0 && startIndex.Level != 0)
			{
				flag = true;
				int masterRowHandle = GetMasterRowHandle(dataViewBase.DataControl);
				DataControlBase masterGridCore = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetMasterGridCore();
				dictionary.Add(num, dataViewBase);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					dataViewBase = masterGridCore.DataView;
				}
				num--;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (SearchOnMasterView(view, prefix, startIndex.RowIndex, startIndex.ColumnIndex, ignoreStartIndex, down, result))
				{
					return result;
				}
				DataViewBase view2 = null;
				for (int num2 = startIndex.Level; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					int? num3 = CalcContinuedRowIndex(view2, down);
					view2 = dictionary[num2];
					if ((num2 != startIndex.Level) ? SearchOnMasterView(view2, prefix, num3 ?? CalcStartRowIndex(view2, down), CalcStartColumnIndex(view2, down), ignoreStartIndex, down, result) : SearchOnMasterView(view2, prefix, startIndex.RowIndex, startIndex.ColumnIndex, ignoreStartIndex, down, result))
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (SearchOnMasterView(startIndex.View, prefix, startIndex.RowIndex, startIndex.ColumnIndex, ignoreStartIndex, down, result))
			{
				return result;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static int GetMasterRowHandle(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl.GetMasterRowHandleInternal();
		}

		private static bool SearchOnMasterView(DataViewBase view, string prefix, int startIndex, int startColumnIndex, bool ignoreStartIndex, bool down, TableTextSearchEngine.TableIndex result)
		{
			string[] incrementalSearchColumns = view.IncrementalSearchColumns;
			bool flag = view.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore != null;
			if (down)
			{
				int num = (ignoreStartIndex ? (startColumnIndex + 1) : startColumnIndex);
				for (int i = startIndex; i < view.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount; i++)
				{
					for (int j = num; j < view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; j++)
					{
						if (incrementalSearchColumns.Length == 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (incrementalSearchColumns.Contains(view.VisibleColumnsCore[j].FieldName))
						{
							string cellDisplayText = view.DataControl.GetCellDisplayText(i, view.VisibleColumnsCore[j].FieldName);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellDisplayText) && cellDisplayText.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
							{
								result.RowIndex = i;
								result.ColumnIndex = j;
								result.View = view;
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag && view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(i))
					{
						RowDetailInfoBase rowDetailInfo = ((MasterDetailProvider)view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider).GetRowDetailInfo(i);
						DataViewBase dataViewBase = rowDetailInfo.FindFirstDetailView();
						if (dataViewBase == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						result.Level++;
						if (SearchOnMasterView(dataViewBase, prefix, CalcStartRowIndex(dataViewBase, down), CalcStartColumnIndex(dataViewBase, down), ignoreStartIndex: false, down, result))
						{
							return true;
						}
						result.Level--;
					}
					num = CalcStartColumnIndex(view, down: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num2 = (ignoreStartIndex ? (startColumnIndex - 1) : startColumnIndex);
				for (int num3 = startIndex; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					if (flag && num3 != startIndex && view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(num3))
					{
						RowDetailInfoBase rowDetailInfo2 = ((MasterDetailProvider)view.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider).GetRowDetailInfo(num3);
						DataViewBase dataViewBase2 = rowDetailInfo2.FindFirstDetailView();
						if (dataViewBase2 == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (SearchOnMasterView(dataViewBase2, prefix, CalcStartRowIndex(dataViewBase2, down), CalcStartColumnIndex(dataViewBase2, down), ignoreStartIndex: false, down, result))
						{
							return true;
						}
						result.Level--;
					}
					int num4 = num2;
					while (num4 >= 0 && incrementalSearchColumns.Length != 0)
					{
						if (incrementalSearchColumns.Contains(view.VisibleColumnsCore[num4].FieldName))
						{
							string cellDisplayText2 = view.DataControl.GetCellDisplayText(num3, view.VisibleColumnsCore[num4].FieldName);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellDisplayText2) && cellDisplayText2.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
							{
								result.RowIndex = num3;
								result.ColumnIndex = num4;
								result.View = view;
								return true;
							}
						}
						num4--;
					}
					num2 = CalcStartColumnIndex(view, down: false);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int CalcStartRowIndex(DataViewBase view, bool down)
		{
			if (down)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return view.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount - 1;
		}

		private static int? CalcContinuedRowIndex(DataViewBase view, bool down)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (down)
			{
				return GetMasterRowHandle(view.DataControl) + 1;
			}
			return GetMasterRowHandle(view.DataControl);
		}

		private static int CalcStartColumnIndex(DataViewBase view, bool down)
		{
			if (down)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1;
		}
	}
	public class TableTextSearchEngine : TextSearchEngineBase
	{
		public class TableIndex
		{
			public int RowIndex { get; set; }

			public int ColumnIndex { get; set; }

			public DataViewBase View { get; set; }

			public int Level { get; set; }

			public TableIndex()
			{
			}

			public TableIndex(int rowIndex, int columnIndex, DataViewBase view, int level)
			{
				RowIndex = rowIndex;
				ColumnIndex = columnIndex;
				View = view;
				Level = level;
			}
		}

		private readonly Func<string, TableIndex, bool, bool, DataViewBase, TableIndex> searchCallback;

		public TableIndex MatchedItemIndex { get; private set; }

		public TableTextSearchEngine(Func<string, TableIndex, bool, bool, DataViewBase, TableIndex> searchCallback, int? delay)
			: base(delay.HasValue ? new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, delay.Value) : TextSearchEngineBase.DefaultTextSearchTimeout)
		{
			this.searchCallback = searchCallback;
		}

		protected override void ResetState()
		{
			((TextSearchEngineBase)this).ResetState();
			MatchedItemIndex = null;
		}

		internal bool DoSearch(string nextChar, int currentItemIndex, int currentColumnIndex, int level, DataViewBase view, bool? down = null)
		{
			if (IsEscape(nextChar))
			{
				((TextSearchEngineBase)this).ResetState();
				return false;
			}
			bool lookForFallbackMatchToo = false;
			TableIndex tableIndex = null;
			if (((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsActive)
			{
				tableIndex = new TableIndex(currentItemIndex, currentColumnIndex, view, level);
			}
			if (base.charsEntered.Count > 0 && string.Compare(base.charsEntered[base.charsEntered.Count - 1], nextChar, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				lookForFallbackMatchToo = true;
			}
			bool wasNewCharUsed = false;
			TableIndex tableIndex2 = ((!down.HasValue) ? FindMatchingPrefix(((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix, nextChar, tableIndex, lookForFallbackMatchToo, ref wasNewCharUsed, view, null) : FindMatchingPrefix(((TextSearchEngineBase)this).SeachText, nextChar, new TableIndex(currentItemIndex, currentColumnIndex, view, level), lookForFallbackMatchToo: true, ref wasNewCharUsed, view, down.Value));
			if (tableIndex2 != null)
			{
				if (!((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsActive || tableIndex2 != tableIndex)
				{
					MatchedItemIndex = tableIndex2;
				}
				if (wasNewCharUsed)
				{
					((TextSearchEngineBase)this).AddCharToPrefix(nextChar);
				}
				if (!((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsActive)
				{
					((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsActive = true;
					if (!down.HasValue)
					{
						((TextSearchEngineBase)this).SeachText = ((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsBackSpace(nextChar) && ((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix.Length > 0)
			{
				((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix = ((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix.Substring(0, ((TextSearchEngineBase)this).Prefix.Length - 1);
			}
			if (((TextSearchEngineBase)this).IsActive)
			{
				((TextSearchEngineBase)this).ResetTimeout();
			}
			return tableIndex2 != null;
		}

		private TableIndex FindMatchingPrefix(string prefix, string newChar, TableIndex startIndex, bool lookForFallbackMatchToo, ref bool wasNewCharUsed, DataViewBase view, bool? down)
		{
			TableIndex result = null;
			string text = ((TextSearchEngineBase)this).StartFindMatchingPrefix(prefix, newChar);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			wasNewCharUsed = false;
			TableIndex tableIndex = (down.HasValue ? null : searchCallback(text, startIndex, arg3: false, arg4: true, view));
			if (tableIndex != null)
			{
				wasNewCharUsed = true;
				result = tableIndex;
			}
			else
			{
				if (lookForFallbackMatchToo)
				{
					tableIndex = searchCallback(prefix, startIndex, arg3: true, !down.HasValue || down.Value, view);
				}
				if (tableIndex != null)
				{
					result = tableIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					tableIndex = searchCallback(prefix, null, arg3: false, !down.HasValue || down.Value, view);
					if (tableIndex != null)
					{
						result = tableIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private bool IsEscape(string text)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return text[0] == '\u001b';
		}
	}

	public class FormatConditionCollection : ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>
	{
		private ConditionalFormatSummaryInfo[] summaries;

		private Dictionary<string, IList<FormatConditionBase>> cache = new Dictionary<string, IList<FormatConditionBase>>();

		private bool? hasDataUpdateFormatCondition;

		private bool? hasNonEmptyTextDecorations;

		internal ConditionalFormatSummaryInfo[] Summaries => summaries ?? (summaries = CollectSummaries());

		public IFormatConditionCollectionOwner Owner { get; private set; }

		internal IList<FormatConditionBase> this[string fieldName]
		{
			get
			{
				if (((Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).Count == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return cache.GetOrAdd(fieldName, () => GetItemsByFieldName(fieldName));
			}
		}

		public FormatConditionCollection(IFormatConditionCollectionOwner owner)
		{
			Owner = owner;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public IList<FormatConditionBaseInfo> GetInfoByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			IList<FormatConditionBase> list = this[fieldName];
			if (list != null)
			{
				return list.Select((FormatConditionBase x) => x.Info).ToList();
			}
			return new List<FormatConditionBaseInfo>();
		}

		private IList<FormatConditionBase> GetItemsByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			if (fieldName == string.Empty)
			{
				fieldName = null;
			}
			FormatConditionBase[] array = ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Where((FormatConditionBase x) => x.GetApplyToFieldName() == fieldName && x.IsValid).ToArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!base.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				OnChanged((FormatConditionChangeType)3);
				Owner.SyncFormatConditionCollectionWithDetails(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnChanged(FormatConditionChangeType changeType)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			cache.Clear();
			hasDataUpdateFormatCondition = null;
			hasNonEmptyTextDecorations = null;
			if (((Enum)changeType).HasFlag((Enum)(object)(FormatConditionChangeType)2))
			{
				summaries = null;
			}
			Owner.OnFormatConditionCollectionChanged(changeType);
		}

		internal void OnItemPropertyChanged(FormatConditionBase item, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e, FormatConditionChangeType changeType)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!base.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				OnChanged(changeType);
				Owner.SyncFormatConditionPropertyWithDetails(item, e);
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, FormatConditionBase item)
		{
			((ObservableCollection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
			SetOwner(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			NullOwner(((Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this)[index]);
			((ObservableCollection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			foreach (FormatConditionBase item in (Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this)
			{
				NullOwner(item);
			}
			((ObservableCollection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).ClearItems();
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, FormatConditionBase item)
		{
			NullOwner(((Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this)[index]);
			((ObservableCollection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).SetItem(index, item);
			SetOwner(item);
		}

		private void SetOwner(FormatConditionBase item)
		{
			if (item.Owner != null && item.Owner != this)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(typeof(FormatCondition).Name + " object cannot be added to more than one " + typeof(FormatConditionCollection).Name + ".");
			}
			item.Owner = this;
		}

		private void NullOwner(FormatConditionBase item)
		{
			item.Owner = null;
		}

		private ConditionalFormatSummaryInfo[] CollectSummaries()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Where((FormatConditionBase x) => x.IsValid).SelectMany((FormatConditionBase x) => x.CreateSummaryItems()).Distinct()
				.ToArray();
		}

		internal IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> GetUnboundColumns()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Where((FormatConditionBase x) => x.IsValid).SelectMany((FormatConditionBase x) => x.GetUnboundColumnInfo());
		}

		internal bool HasRowConditions()
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Where((FormatConditionBase x) => x.IsValid).Any((FormatConditionBase x) => x.ApplyToRow);
		}

		internal bool HasDataUpdateFormatConditions()
		{
			if (!hasDataUpdateFormatCondition.HasValue)
			{
				hasDataUpdateFormatCondition = ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Any((FormatConditionBase x) => x.Info.IsAnimationEnabled(false));
			}
			return hasDataUpdateFormatCondition.Value;
		}

		internal bool HasNonEmptyTextDecorations()
		{
			if (!hasNonEmptyTextDecorations.HasValue)
			{
				hasNonEmptyTextDecorations = ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)this).Any((FormatConditionBase x) => x.Info.HasNonEmptyTextDecorations());
			}
			return hasNonEmptyTextDecorations.Value;
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase> conditionals)
		{
			if (conditionals == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)this).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (FormatConditionBase conditional in conditionals)
			{
				((Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)this).Add(conditional);
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)this).EndUpdate();
		}
	}
