			return (BaseEditUnit)new IconSetEditUnit();
		}

		protected override void UpdateEditUnit(BaseEditUnit unit)
		{
			base.UpdateEditUnit(unit);
			IconSetEditUnit val = (IconSetEditUnit)(object)((unit is IconSetEditUnit) ? unit : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				val.Format = Format;
			}
		}
	}
	public class ColumnGeneratorItemContext
	{
		public DataControlBase Control { get; private set; }

		public PropertyDescriptor PropertyDescriptor { get; private set; }

		internal ColumnGeneratorItemContext(DataControlBase control, PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor)
		{
			Control = control;
			PropertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptor;
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarAnnotationsManager
	{
		private readonly SortedDictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> InfoAnnotations = new SortedDictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>>();

		private readonly ScrollBarAnnotationMode[] FullCrawlAnnotation = new ScrollBarAnnotationMode[3]
		{
			ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells,
			ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows,
			ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom
		};

		private ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance scrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault;

		internal readonly Locker UpdateLock = new Locker();

		public readonly ITableView TableView;

		private readonly bool IsDesignTime;

		private ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (scrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault == null)
				{
					scrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault = RootTableView.CreateDefaultScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance();
				}
				return scrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault;
			}
		}

		private DataViewBase View => TableView.ViewBase;

		private bool HasDetailRootViews
		{
			get
			{
				if (RootView.DataControl != null)
				{
					return RootView.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool HasDetailCurrentViews
		{
			get
			{
				if (View.DataControl != null)
				{
					return View.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool GridLoaded { get; set; }

		public ITableView RootTableView => RootView as ITableView;

		public DataViewBase RootView => View.RootView;

		public IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRange
		{
			get
			{
				List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
				if (InfoAnnotations.Any((KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> x) => x.Value != null && x.Value.Count > 0) && (View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount != 0 || View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount != 0))
				{
					list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationFixedRowInfo(View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount, View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount, View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount));
				}
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> infoAnnotation in InfoAnnotations)
				{
					list.AddRange(infoAnnotation.Value);
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		private bool IsServerOrAsyncServer
		{
			get
			{
				if (RootView == null || RootView.DataProviderBase == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!RootView.DataProviderBase.IsServerMode)
				{
					return RootView.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void CheckSource()
		{
			if (View != null && View.DataProviderBase != null && View.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource && TableView.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.HasValue && TableView.ScrollBarAnnotationMode != ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The GridControl bound to the Virtual data source does not support scrollbar annotations.");
			}
		}

		private bool IsLock()
		{
			if (View.ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate || UpdateLock.IsLocked)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (View.DataProviderBase != null && View.DataProviderBase.IsLockUpdateScrollBarAnnotations)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ScrollBarAnnotationsManager(ITableView tableView)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			TableView = tableView;
			GridLoaded = false;
			IsDesignTime = View.IsDesignTime;
		}

		public void ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration()
		{
			CheckSource();
			if (!IsDesignTime && !IsLock())
			{
				if (RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationMode != ScrollBarAnnotationMode.All)
				{
					InfoAnnotations.Clear();
				}
				ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration(TableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual, fullGeneration: true);
			}
		}

		public void ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration(ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollAnnotation, bool fullGeneration = false)
		{
			CheckSource();
			if (IsDesignTime || IsLock())
			{
				return;
			}
			ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollAnnotationCurrent = ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None;
			Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> currentRange = CreateRangeDictionary();
			if (!HasDetailRootViews)
			{
				scrollAnnotationCurrent = scrollAnnotation;
				if (!CheckStartGeneration(TableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual, View))
				{
					RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
					return;
				}
				ScrollBarAnnotationGenerationCore(scrollAnnotationCurrent, View, currentRange, fullGeneration);
			}
			else
			{
				bool start = false;
				RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					ITableView tableView = dataControl.viewCore as ITableView;
					ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollBarAnnotationModeActual = tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual;
					if (CheckStartGeneration(scrollBarAnnotationModeActual, dataControl.DataView) || start)
					{
						start = true;
						if (tableView.ViewBase.DataControl != null && tableView.ViewBase.DataControl.VisibleRowCount != 0 && tableView != null)
						{
							ScrollBarAnnotationGenerationCore(scrollBarAnnotationModeActual, tableView.ViewBase, currentRange, fullGeneration);
							scrollAnnotationCurrent |= scrollBarAnnotationModeActual;
						}
					}
				});
				if (!start)
				{
					RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult]);
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells]);
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows]);
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom]);
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected]);
			}
			if (scrollAnnotationCurrent.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow))
			{
				SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow, currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow]);
			}
			RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
		}

		public void ScrollBarAnnotationChanged(ListChangedType changedType, int newHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			CheckSource();
			if (IsDesignTime || IsLock())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!oldRowHandle.HasValue)
			{
				ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!CheckStartGeneration(RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual, View))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (changedType == ListChangedType.ItemDeleted)
				{
					newHandle = oldRowHandle.Value;
				}
				switch (changedType)
				{
				case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
					ChangeOrderAnnotations(newHandle, true);
					break;
				case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
					ChangeOrderAnnotations(newHandle, false);
					break;
				case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
					MoveItem(oldRowHandle.Value, newHandle);
					break;
				case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
					if (oldRowHandle.Value != newHandle)
					{
						MoveItem(oldRowHandle.Value, newHandle);
					}
					ChangeOrderAnnotations(newHandle, null);
					break;
				default:
					ScrollBarAnnotationGeneration();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CheckStartGeneration(ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollAnnotation, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (scrollAnnotation == ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None || view.DataControl == null || view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 0)
			{
				bool flag = RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.Count > 0;
				UpdateScrollAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None, RootView);
				if (flag)
				{
					RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> CreateRangeDictionary()
		{
			Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>>();
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected, new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>());
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void ScrollBarAnnotationGenerationCore(ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollAnnotation, DataViewBase view, Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> currentRange, bool fullGeneration)
		{
			if (view.DataControl == null || view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 0)
			{
				UpdateScrollAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None, view);
				return;
			}
			ScrollBarAnnotationsCreatingEventArgs e = ((ITableView)view).RaiseScrollBarAnnotationsCreating();
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> enumerable = GenerationAnnotationsIfNeed(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow, scrollAnnotation, view);
			if (enumerable != null)
			{
				currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow].AddRange(enumerable);
			}
			enumerable = GenerationAnnotationsIfNeed(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected, scrollAnnotation, view);
			if (enumerable != null)
			{
				currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected].AddRange(enumerable);
			}
			if (((fullGeneration && scrollAnnotation.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult)) || scrollAnnotation == ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult) && NeedSearch(view))
			{
				enumerable = GenerationAnnotationsIfNeed(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult, scrollAnnotation, view);
				if (enumerable != null)
				{
					currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult].AddRange(enumerable);
				}
			}
			ScrollBarAnnotationMode[] fullCrawlAnnotation = FullCrawlAnnotation;
			foreach (ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollBarAnnotationMode in fullCrawlAnnotation)
			{
				if (scrollAnnotation.HasFlag(scrollBarAnnotationMode))
				{
					UpdateScrollAnnotationInfo(scrollBarAnnotationMode, view, e.CustomScrollBarAnnotations, currentRange);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> GenerationAnnotationsIfNeed(ScrollBarAnnotationMode instanceMode, ScrollBarAnnotationMode scrollAnnotation, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (((ITableView)view).ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(instanceMode) && scrollAnnotation.HasFlag(instanceMode))
			{
				return UpdateScrollAnnotationInfo(instanceMode, view);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> UpdateScrollAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode annotation, DataViewBase view, ICollection<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> customCollection = null, Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> currentRange = null)
		{
			IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> result = null;
			switch (annotation)
			{
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.None:
				(view as ITableView).ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.Clear();
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected:
				result = GetSelectedAnnotation(view);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow:
			{
				int correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2 = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(view.FocusedRowHandle, view);
				result = ((correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2 >= 0) ? new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>
				{
					new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2, GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow))
				} : null);
				break;
			}
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult:
				result = GetSearchAnnotation(view);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows:
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells:
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom:
			{
				Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> fullCrawlIndexes = GetFullCrawlIndexes(view);
				if (customCollection != null && customCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
					foreach (ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo item in customCollection)
					{
						int correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(item.RowIndex, view);
						if (correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle >= 0)
						{
							list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle, item.ScrollAnnotationInfo));
						}
					}
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						currentRange[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom].AddRange(list);
					}
				}
				FullCrawlIndexesSyncDictionary(currentRange, fullCrawlIndexes);
				return null;
			}
			default:
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("annotation");
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SyncInfoAnnotations(ScrollBarAnnotationMode annotation, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> infoAnnotations)
		{
			SortedDictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> infoAnnotations2 = RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations;
			if (infoAnnotations == null || infoAnnotations.Count == 0)
			{
				infoAnnotations2.Remove(annotation);
				return;
			}
			infoAnnotations.Sort();
			if (infoAnnotations2.ContainsKey(annotation))
			{
				infoAnnotations2[annotation] = infoAnnotations;
			}
			else
			{
				infoAnnotations2.Add(annotation, infoAnnotations);
			}
		}

		internal ScrollBarAnnotationInfo GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode mode)
		{
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo result = null;
			switch (mode)
			{
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows:
				result = ((RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance == null || RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.InvalidRows == null) ? ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault.InvalidRows : RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.InvalidRows);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells:
				result = ((RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance == null || RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.InvalidCells == null) ? ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault.InvalidCells : RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.InvalidCells);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected:
				result = ((RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance == null || RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.Selected == null) ? ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault.Selected : RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.Selected);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult:
				result = ((RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance == null || RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.SearchResult == null) ? ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault.SearchResult : RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.SearchResult);
				break;
			case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.FocusedRow:
				result = ((RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance == null || RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.FocusedRow == null) ? ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearanceDefault.FocusedRow : RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsAppearance.FocusedRow);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> GetSelectedAnnotation(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.None)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo actualAnnotationInfo = GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected);
			if (view.AllItemsSelected.HasValue && view.AllItemsSelected.Value && !HasDetailRootViews)
			{
				int correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex(0, view);
				int correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex2 = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex(view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1, view);
				if (correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex < 0 || correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex2 < 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>
				{
					new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex2, actualAnnotationInfo)
				};
			}
			int[] selectedRowHandles = view.DataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = null;
			if (selectedRowHandles != null)
			{
				list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
				int[] array = selectedRowHandles;
				foreach (int rowHandle in array)
				{
					int correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle, view);
					if (correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle >= 0)
					{
						list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle, actualAnnotationInfo));
					}
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					list = null;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> GetSearchAnnotation(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Func<int, bool> func = view.CreateAnnotationFilterFitPredicate();
			if (func == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo actualAnnotationInfo = GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult);
			GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase = view.SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase;
			if (!view.CanStartIncrementalSearch && gridSearchControlBase != null && gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo != null && gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (int item in gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo)
				{
					if (view.DataProviderBase.IsRowVisible(item))
					{
						list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(item, view), actualAnnotationInfo));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount; i++)
				{
					int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
					if (View.IsSearchResult(func, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, i))
					{
						list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, view), actualAnnotationInfo));
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount)
			{
				return new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>
				{
					new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(0, view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1, actualAnnotationInfo)
				};
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list;
		}

		private Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> GetFullCrawlIndexes(DataViewBase view, int? index = null)
		{
			Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> dictionary = new Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>>();
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list2 = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list3 = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list4 = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			Func<int, bool> func = null;
			bool flag = NeedSearch(view);
			if (flag)
			{
				func = view.CreateAnnotationFilterFitPredicate();
				if (func == null)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			ITableView tableView = view as ITableView;
			bool flag2 = tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells) && !IsServerOrAsyncServer;
			bool flag3 = tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows) && !IsServerOrAsyncServer;
			bool flag4 = tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom) && tableView.NeedCustomScrollBarAnnotation && !IsServerOrAsyncServer;
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo actualAnnotationInfo = GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult);
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo actualAnnotationInfo2 = GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells);
			ScrollBarAnnotationInfo actualAnnotationInfo3 = GetActualAnnotationInfo(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows);
			if (!index.HasValue)
			{
				if (flag2 || flag3 || flag4 || flag)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < view.DataControl.VisibleRowCount; i++)
					{
						AnnotationOneIterate(view, i, flag, flag2, flag3, flag4, func, actualAnnotationInfo, actualAnnotationInfo3, actualAnnotationInfo2, list, list2, list3, list4);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag5 = RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom) && !IsServerOrAsyncServer;
				if (flag2 || flag3 || flag || flag5)
				{
					ScrollBarAnnotationsCreatingEventArgs e = ((ITableView)view).RaiseScrollBarAnnotationsCreating();
					if (!e.Handled)
					{
						AnnotationOneIterate(view, index.Value, flag, flag2, flag3, flag4, func, actualAnnotationInfo, actualAnnotationInfo3, actualAnnotationInfo2, list, list2, list3, list4);
						if (flag5 && e.CustomScrollBarAnnotations != null)
						{
							IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> enumerable = e.CustomScrollBarAnnotations.Where((ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo x) => GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(x.RowIndex) == index.Value);
							if (enumerable != null)
							{
								list4.AddRange(enumerable.Select((ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo x) => new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(x.RowIndex), x.ScrollAnnotationInfo)));
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom, list4);
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells, list2);
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows, list3);
			dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult, list);
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void AnnotationOneIterate(DataViewBase view, int visibleIndex, bool searchNeed, bool cellErrorNeed, bool rowsErrorNeed, bool customNeed, Func<int, bool> fitSearch, ScrollBarAnnotationInfo searchInfo, ScrollBarAnnotationInfo rowErrorhInfo, ScrollBarAnnotationInfo cellErrorInfo, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> search, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> errorsCells, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> errorsRows, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> customRows)
		{
			int correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex, view);
			if (correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			if (searchNeed && View.IsSearchResult(fitSearch, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex))
			{
				search.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, searchInfo));
			}
			if (cellErrorNeed || rowsErrorNeed)
			{
				if (cellErrorNeed && rowsErrorNeed)
				{
					ErrorsWatchMode? errorsWatchMode = view.IsValidRowByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, ErrorsWatchMode.All, ignoreAlowLeaveEditor: false);
					if (errorsWatchMode.HasValue)
					{
						if (errorsWatchMode.Value == ErrorsWatchMode.Rows)
						{
							errorsRows.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, rowErrorhInfo));
						}
						else
						{
							errorsCells.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, cellErrorInfo));
						}
					}
				}
				else if (cellErrorNeed)
				{
					if (view.IsValidRowByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, ErrorsWatchMode.Cells, ignoreAlowLeaveEditor: false).HasValue)
					{
						errorsCells.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, cellErrorInfo));
					}
				}
				else if (rowsErrorNeed && view.IsValidRowByRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, ErrorsWatchMode.Rows).HasValue)
				{
					errorsRows.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, rowErrorhInfo));
				}
			}
			if (customNeed)
			{
				object row = view.DataControl.GetRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				ScrollBarCustomRowAnnotationEventArgs e = new ScrollBarCustomRowAnnotationEventArgs(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, row);
				((ITableView)view).RaiseScrollBarCustomRowAnnotation(e);
				if (e.ScrollBarAnnotationInfo != null)
				{
					customRows.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(correctVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex, e.ScrollBarAnnotationInfo));
				}
			}
		}

		private void FullCrawlIndexesSyncDictionary(Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> source, Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> added)
		{
			source[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult].AddRange(added[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult]);
			source[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells].AddRange(added[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells]);
			source[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows].AddRange(added[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows]);
			source[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom].AddRange(added[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom]);
		}

		internal bool NeedSearch(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult) && !IsServerOrAsyncServer)
			{
				if (!view.IsRootView || view.SearchControl == null || view.SearchControl.FilterCriteria == null || view.SearchPanelAllowFilter)
				{
					return view.CanStartIncrementalSearch;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(int rowHandle, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (!HasDetailRootViews)
			{
				return View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			}
			return view.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(view.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle));
		}

		private int GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle, View);
		}

		private int GetCorrectVisibleIndexByVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (!HasDetailRootViews)
			{
				return visibleIndex;
			}
			return view.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(visibleIndex);
		}

		private bool NeedSelected(DataViewBase view)
		{
			ITableView tableView = view as ITableView;
			return tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationModeActual.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected);
		}

		private void ChangeOrderAnnotations(int rowHandle, bool? direct)
		{
			int num = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				bool? flag = direct;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (flag == true != flag2 || !flag.HasValue || rowHandle != View.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(rowHandle - 1);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				num++;
			}
			Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> dictionary = null;
			if (direct != false)
			{
				dictionary = GetFullCrawlIndexes(View, num);
				if (NeedSelected(View))
				{
					IEnumerable<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> selectedAnnotation = GetSelectedAnnotation(View);
					if (selectedAnnotation != null)
					{
						dictionary.Add(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected, GetSelectedAnnotation(View).ToList());
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> infoAnnotation in RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations)
			{
				switch (infoAnnotation.Key)
				{
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult:
					if (dictionary != null)
					{
						ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo = (dictionary.ContainsKey(infoAnnotation.Key) ? dictionary[infoAnnotation.Key].FirstOrDefault() : null);
						if (scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo == null || scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo.RowIndex == scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo.EndRowIndex)
						{
							AnnotationOrderCorrect(direct, infoAnnotation, num, dictionary);
						}
						else if (dictionary == null || !dictionary.ContainsKey(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult) || dictionary[ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult].FirstOrDefault() == null)
						{
							infoAnnotation.Value.Clear();
							infoAnnotation.Value.AddRange(new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>(GetSearchAnnotation(View)));
						}
					}
					break;
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Selected:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom:
					AnnotationOrderCorrect(direct, infoAnnotation, num, dictionary);
					break;
				}
			}
			if (dictionary != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> item in dictionary)
				{
					if (item.Value.FirstOrDefault() != null && !RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.ContainsKey(item.Key))
					{
						RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
					}
				}
			}
			RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationInfoRangeChanged();
		}

		private void AnnotationOrderCorrect(bool? direct, KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> item, int index, Dictionary<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> elementAnnotations)
		{
			if (direct.HasValue)
			{
				if (direct.Value)
				{
					if (elementAnnotations.ContainsKey(item.Key))
					{
						AddedOrRemoveRow(item.Value, index, elementAnnotations[item.Key].FirstOrDefault(), direct.Value);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					AddedOrRemoveRow(item.Value, index, null, direct.Value);
				}
			}
			else if (elementAnnotations.ContainsKey(item.Key))
			{
				ChangeRow(item.Key, index, elementAnnotations[item.Key].FirstOrDefault());
			}
		}

		private void ChangeRow(ScrollBarAnnotationMode key, int visibleIndex, ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo info)
		{
			List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list = new List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>();
			if (!RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				return;
			}
			list = RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations[key];
			if (list == null)
			{
				throw new Exception();
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				if (info != null)
				{
					list.Add(info);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num = BinarySearch(list, visibleIndex);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (info != null)
				{
					list[num] = info;
				}
				else
				{
					list.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			else if (info != null)
			{
				list.Add(info);
				list.Sort();
			}
		}

		private void AddedOrRemoveRow(List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> value, int visibleIndex, ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo info, bool inc)
		{
			if ((value == null || value.Count == 0) && inc)
			{
				if (info != null)
				{
					value?.Add(info);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num = BinarySearch(value, visibleIndex);
			MoveIndexes(inc, (num >= 0) ? num : (~num), value);
			if (inc)
			{
				if (info != null)
				{
					value.Add(info);
				}
			}
			else if (num >= 0)
			{
				value.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			value.Sort();
		}

		private void MoveIndexes(bool inc, int index, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> value, int? endIndex = null)
		{
			index = Math.Max(index, 0);
			int num = (endIndex.HasValue ? Math.Min(endIndex.Value, value.Count) : value.Count);
			for (int i = index; i < num; i++)
			{
				int newIndex = (inc ? (value[i].RowIndex + 1) : (value[i].RowIndex - 1));
				value[i].ChangeIndex(newIndex);
			}
		}

		private void MoveItem(int startHandle, int endHandle)
		{
			int correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(startHandle);
			int correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2 = GetCorrectVisibleIndexByRowHandle(endHandle);
			if (correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle < 0 || correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2 < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ScrollBarAnnotationMode, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo>> infoAnnotation in RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations)
			{
				switch (infoAnnotation.Key)
				{
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.SearchResult:
				case ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Custom:
					if (RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations.ContainsKey(infoAnnotation.Key))
					{
						MoveItemAnnotation(correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle, correctVisibleIndexByRowHandle2, RootTableView.ScrollBarAnnotationsManager.InfoAnnotations[infoAnnotation.Key]);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void MoveItemAnnotation(int startIndex, int endIndex, List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list)
		{
			int num = BinarySearch(list, startIndex);
			ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo = null;
			if (num >= 0 && list.Count > 0)
			{
				scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo = list[num];
				list.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			else
			{
				num = ~num;
			}
			MoveIndexes(inc: false, num, list);
			int num2 = BinarySearch(list, endIndex);
			num2 = ((num2 >= 0) ? num2 : (~num2));
			MoveIndexes(inc: true, num2, list);
			if (scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo != null)
			{
				list.Add(new ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo(endIndex, scrollBarAnnotationRowInfo.ScrollAnnotationInfo));
			}
			list.Sort();
		}

		private int BinarySearch(List<ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo> list, int item)
		{
			List<int> list2 = list.Select((ScrollBarAnnotationRowInfo x) => x.RowIndex).ToList();
			return list2.BinarySearch(item);
		}
	}
	internal static class MovementSearchResults
	{
		public static bool MoveSearchResult(DataViewBase view, bool? next, bool useCurrentPosition = false)
		{
			if (!CanMovementSearchResult(view))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = view.FocusedRowHandle;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			if (view.IsEditing && !view.CommitEditingInternal())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return SearchResultMove(view, num, next, useCurrentPosition);
		}

		public static bool CanMovementSearchResult(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.IsRootView && view.SearchControlCore != null && view.SearchControlCore.FilterCriteria != null && view.DataControl != null)
			{
				return view.NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.None;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool SearchResultMove(DataViewBase view, int indexFocusedRow, bool? next, bool useCurrentPosition = false)
		{
			Func<int, bool> func = view.CreateFilterFitPredicate();
			if (func == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (next == false)
			{
				if (PrevMove(view, indexFocusedRow, func, useCurrentPosition))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (NextMove(view, indexFocusedRow, func, next.HasValue, useCurrentPosition))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (next.HasValue)
			{
				if (next.Value)
				{
					if (CheckSearchPanelColumnProvider(view) && (view.FocusedRowHandle != 0 || view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[0]))
					{
						return NextMove(view, null, func, next.Value, useCurrentPosition);
					}
				}
				else if (CheckSearchPanelColumnProvider(view) && (view.FocusedRowHandle != view.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount - 1 || view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1]))
				{
					return PrevMove(view, null, func, useCurrentPosition);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int GetCorrectColumnIndex(DataViewBase view, ColumnBase column, int defaultVal)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i] == column)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return defaultVal;
		}

		private static bool MoveWithSearchResult(DataViewBase view, bool next, bool useCurrentPosition = false)
		{
			GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase = view.SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase;
			if (view.DataControl == null || gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo == null || gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>(gridSearchControlBase.SearchInfo);
			int index = ((((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex - 1 > 0) ? (((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex - 1) : 0);
			int firstDataFocusedRowHandle = view.GetFirstDataFocusedRowHandle();
			if (next)
			{
				bool flag = firstDataFocusedRowHandle > list[index] || !view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (!useCurrentPosition && list[index] <= firstDataFocusedRowHandle && flag)
				{
					view.FocusedRowHandle = ((list.Count > ((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex) ? list[((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex] : list.First());
				}
				else
				{
					view.FocusedRowHandle = list[index];
				}
				return true;
			}
			bool flag2 = firstDataFocusedRowHandle < list[index] || !view.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle);
			if (!useCurrentPosition && list[index] >= firstDataFocusedRowHandle && flag2)
			{
				view.FocusedRowHandle = ((((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex - 2 >= 0) ? list[((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).ResultIndex - 2] : list.Last());
			}
			else
			{
				view.FocusedRowHandle = list[index];
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool NextMove(DataViewBase view, int? focusedRowIndex, Func<int, bool> fitFunc, bool next, bool useCurrentPosition = false)
		{
			view.rowHandleNavigationType = NavigationType.Next;
			if (view.SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase && view.ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo)
			{
				return MoveWithSearchResult(view, next: true, useCurrentPosition);
			}
			bool flag = !focusedRowIndex.HasValue;
			if (!focusedRowIndex.HasValue)
			{
				focusedRowIndex = 0;
			}
			int dataRowCount = view.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount;
			int num = ((view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && !flag) ? GetCorrectColumnIndex(view, view.DataControl.CurrentColumn, 0) : 0);
			if (num != 0 && view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null)
			{
				string fieldName = view.DataControl.CurrentColumn.FieldName;
				for (int i = 0; i < view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnBase columnBase = (ColumnBase)view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i];
					if (columnBase.FieldName == fieldName)
					{
						num = i;
						break;
					}
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			int startIndex = 0;
			if (!flag && !useCurrentPosition)
			{
				if ((next && num + 1 >= view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1) || view.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
				{
					startIndex = 0;
					focusedRowIndex++;
				}
				else
				{
					startIndex = (next ? Math.Min(num + 1, view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1) : num);
				}
			}
			int endIndex = (CheckSearchPanelColumnProvider(view) ? (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1) : 0);
			DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = view.DataProviderBase;
			for (int j = focusedRowIndex.Value; j < dataRowCount; j++)
			{
				if (!dataProviderBase.IsFilteredByRowHandle(j) && fitFunc(j))
				{
					if (j != focusedRowIndex)
					{
						startIndex = 0;
					}
					if (SearchIterateColumn(view, startIndex, endIndex, j))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool PrevMove(DataViewBase view, int? focusedRowIndex, Func<int, bool> fitFunc, bool useCurrentPosition = false)
		{
			view.rowHandleNavigationType = NavigationType.Prev;
			if (view.SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase && view.ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo)
			{
				return MoveWithSearchResult(view, next: false, useCurrentPosition);
			}
			bool flag = !focusedRowIndex.HasValue;
			if (!focusedRowIndex.HasValue)
			{
				focusedRowIndex = view.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount - 1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = ((view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && !flag) ? GetCorrectColumnIndex(view, view.DataControl.CurrentColumn, view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1) : (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1));
			if (num2 != view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1 && view.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null)
			{
				string fieldName = view.DataControl.CurrentColumn.FieldName;
				for (int i = 0; i < view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnBase columnBase = (ColumnBase)view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i];
					if (columnBase.FieldName == fieldName)
					{
						num2 = i;
						break;
					}
					num2 = view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1;
				}
			}
			if (num2 - 1 < 0 && num == focusedRowIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num3 = 0;
			if (!flag && !useCurrentPosition)
			{
				if (num2 - 1 < 0 || view.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
				{
					num3 = view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1;
					focusedRowIndex--;
				}
				else
				{
					num3 = Math.Max(num2 - 1, 0);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num3 = (CheckSearchPanelColumnProvider(view) ? (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1) : 0);
			}
			int endIndex = 0;
			DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = view.DataProviderBase;
			for (int num4 = focusedRowIndex.Value; num4 >= num; num4--)
			{
				if (!dataProviderBase.IsFilteredByRowHandle(num4) && fitFunc(num4))
				{
					if (num4 != focusedRowIndex)
					{
						num3 = view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count - 1;
					}
					if (SearchIterateColumn(view, num3, endIndex, num4))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool SearchOneIterateColumn(DataViewBase view, int i, int rowHanlde)
		{
			if (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns == null || view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count == 0 || view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count <= i)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object cellValue = view.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHanlde, ((ColumnBase)view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i]).FieldName);
			if (CheckFilter(view, view.SearchString, (cellValue != null) ? cellValue.ToString() : string.Empty, (ColumnBase)view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i]))
			{
				view.DataControl.CurrentColumn = (ColumnBase)view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns[i];
				view.FocusedRowHandle = rowHanlde;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool SearchIterateColumn(DataViewBase view, int startIndex, int endIndex, int rowHandle)
		{
			if (startIndex < 0 || endIndex < 0 || endIndex > view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count || startIndex > view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (endIndex >= startIndex)
			{
				for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
				{
					if (SearchOneIterateColumn(view, i, rowHandle))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int num = startIndex; num >= endIndex; num--)
				{
					if (SearchOneIterateColumn(view, num, rowHandle))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckFilter(DataViewBase view, string original, string cellValue, ColumnBase column)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			FindSearchParserResults val = new FindSearchParser().Parse(original, view.ColumnsCore.Cast<IDataColumnInfo>());
			if (val == null || val.SearchTexts == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string[] searchTexts = val.SearchTexts;
			foreach (string text in searchTexts)
			{
				if (cellValue.IndexOf(text, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) >= 0 || StringExtensions.IndexOfInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(cellValue, text) >= 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (FindSearchField field in val.Fields)
			{
				if (!(field.Column.Column.FieldName == column.FieldName))
				{
					continue;
				}
				string[] values = field.Values;
				foreach (string text2 in values)
				{
					if (cellValue.IndexOf(text2, StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase) >= 0 || StringExtensions.IndexOfInvariantCultureIgnoreCase(cellValue, text2) >= 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool CheckSearchPanelColumnProvider(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view != null && view.SearchPanelColumnProvider != null && view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns != null)
			{
				return view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.Columns.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			{
				if (headerCustomizationAreaCore != value)
				{
					UIElement oldElement = headerCustomizationAreaCore;
					headerCustomizationAreaCore = value;
					ReplaceChild(oldElement, headerCustomizationAreaCore);
				}
			}
		}

		static ColumnHeaderDockPanel()
		{
			DependencyPropertyRegistrator<ColumnHeaderDockPanel>.New().Register<Thickness>("ContentMargin", ref ContentMarginProperty, new Thickness(0.0), (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)null).Register<HorizontalAlignment>("ContainerAlignment", ref ContainerAlignmentProperty, HorizontalAlignment.Left, (FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions?)FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange);
		}

		private void ReplaceChild(UIElement oldElement, UIElement newElement)
		{
			oldElement.Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				base.Children.Remove(x);
			});
			newElement.Do(delegate(UIElement x)
			{
				if (!base.Children.Contains(x))
				{
					CheckParent(x);
					base.Children.Add(x);
				}
			});
		}

		private void CheckParent(UIElement element)
		{
			if ((element as FrameworkElement)?.Parent is Panel panel)
			{
				panel.Children.Remove(element);
			}
		}

		private bool IsDocked(UIElement element)
		{
			if (element != null)
			{
				return GetDockedElements().Contains(element);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private IEnumerable<UIElement> GetDockedElements()
		{
			if (Image != null)
			{
				yield return Image;
			}
			if (SortIndicator != null)
			{
				yield return SortIndicator;
			}
			if (HeaderFilterDisplay != null)
			{
				yield return HeaderFilterDisplay;
			}
			if (HeaderCustomizationArea != null)
			{
				yield return HeaderCustomizationArea;
			}
			if (FilterPresenter != null)
			{
				yield return FilterPresenter;
			}
			if (CheckEdit != null)
			{
				yield return (UIElement)(object)CheckEdit;
			}
			if (HeaderPresenter != null)
			{
				yield return HeaderPresenter;
			}
			if (HeaderFilterEditor != null)
			{
				yield return HeaderFilterEditor;
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			double num = ContentMargin.Left + ContentMargin.Right;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (!IsDocked(child))
				{
					child.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(constraint.Width, constraint.Height));
				}
			}
			foreach (UIElement dockedElement in GetDockedElements())
			{
				num = Measure(dockedElement, num, constraint);
				num2 = GetHeight(dockedElement, num2);
			}
			num2 += ContentMargin.Top + ContentMargin.Bottom;
			return new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(num, constraint.Width), Math.Min(num2, constraint.Height));
		}

		private double Measure(UIElement element, double width, System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			element.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, constraint.Width - width), constraint.Height));
			return width + element.DesiredSize.Width;
		}

		private double GetHeight(UIElement element, double currentHeight)
		{
			return Math.Max(currentHeight, element.DesiredSize.Height);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			double num = ContentMargin.Left;
			double num2 = ContentMargin.Right;
			double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, finalSize.Height - (ContentMargin.Top + ContentMargin.Bottom));
			foreach (UIElement child in base.Children)
			{
				if (!IsDocked(child))
				{
					child.Arrange(new Rect(0.0, 0.0, finalSize.Width, finalSize.Height));
				}
			}
			if (HeaderFilterEditor != null)
			{
				ArrangeStretch(HeaderFilterEditor, num, num2, finalSize.Width, num3);
			}
			if (Image != null && ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Near)
			{
				num = ArrangeLeft(Image, num, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
			}
			if (SortIndicator != null)
			{
				num2 = ArrangeRight(SortIndicator, num2, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
			}
			if (HeaderFilterDisplay != null)
			{
				num2 = ArrangeRight(HeaderFilterDisplay, num2, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
			}
			if (HeaderCustomizationArea != null)
			{
				num2 = ArrangeRight(HeaderCustomizationArea, num2, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
			}
			double num4 = num3;
			double top = ContentMargin.Top;
			if (HeaderPresenter != null && FilterPresenter != null)
			{
				double height = HeaderPresenter.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (height > FilterPresenter.DesiredSize.Height && height < num3)
				{
					num4 = height;
					top = ContentMargin.Top + (num3 - num4) / 2.0;
				}
			}
			if (Image != null)
			{
				if (ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Far)
				{
					num2 = ArrangeRight(Image, num2, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
				}
				else if (ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Center)
				{
					double num5 = Image.DesiredSize.Width + ((FilterPresenter != null) ? FilterPresenter.DesiredSize.Width : 0.0);
					double indent = Math.Max(0.0, num + (finalSize.Width - num - num2 - num5) / 2.0);
					num = ArrangeCenter(Image, num3, indent);
					if (FilterPresenter != null)
					{
						num = ArrangeLeft(FilterPresenter, num, num4, top);
					}
					return finalSize;
				}
			}
			double num6 = ((CheckEdit != null) ? Math.Round(((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).DesiredSize.Width / 2.0) : 0.0);
			switch (ContainerAlignment)
			{
			case HorizontalAlignment.Left:
				if (HeaderPresenter != null)
				{
					num = ArrangeLeft(HeaderPresenter, num, num3, ContentMargin.Top) + num6;
				}
				if (CheckEdit != null)
				{
					num = ArrangeLeft((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
				}
				if (FilterPresenter != null)
				{
					num = ArrangeLeft(FilterPresenter, num, num4, top);
				}
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Right:
				if (FilterPresenter != null)
				{
					num2 = ArrangeRight(FilterPresenter, num2, finalSize.Width, num4, top) + num6;
				}
				if (CheckEdit != null)
				{
					num2 = ArrangeRight((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num2, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
				}
				if (HeaderPresenter != null)
				{
					num2 = ArrangeRight(HeaderPresenter, num2 + num6, finalSize.Width, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
				}
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Stretch:
				if (FilterPresenter != null)
				{
					num2 = ArrangeRight(FilterPresenter, num2, finalSize.Width, num4, top);
				}
				if (CheckEdit != null)
				{
					if (HeaderPresenter != null)
					{
						num = ArrangeLeft(HeaderPresenter, num, num3, ContentMargin.Top) + num6;
					}
					num = ArrangeStretch((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num, num2, finalSize.Width, num3);
				}
				else if (HeaderPresenter != null)
				{
					num = ArrangeStretch(HeaderPresenter, num, num2, finalSize.Width, num3);
				}
				break;
			case HorizontalAlignment.Center:
				if (HeaderPresenter != null)
				{
					double num7 = HeaderPresenter.DesiredSize.Width + ((FilterPresenter != null) ? FilterPresenter.DesiredSize.Width : 0.0) + ((CheckEdit != null) ? (((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).DesiredSize.Width + num6) : 0.0);
					double indent2 = Math.Max(0.0, num + (finalSize.Width - num - num2 - num7) / 2.0);
					double num8 = num;
					num = ArrangeCenter(HeaderPresenter, num3, indent2) + ((HeaderPresenter.DesiredSize.Width > 0.0) ? num6 : 0.0);
					if (CheckEdit != null)
					{
						if (HeaderPresenter.DesiredSize.Width > 0.0)
						{
							num = ArrangeLeft((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num, num3, ContentMargin.Top);
						}
						else
						{
							indent2 = Math.Max(0.0, num8 + (finalSize.Width - num8 - num2 - ((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).DesiredSize.Width) / 2.0);
							num = ArrangeCenter((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num3, indent2);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (CheckEdit != null)
				{
					double num9 = ((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).DesiredSize.Width + ((FilterPresenter != null) ? FilterPresenter.DesiredSize.Width : 0.0);
					double indent3 = Math.Max(0.0, num + (finalSize.Width - num - num2 - num9) / 2.0);
					num = ArrangeCenter((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit, num3, indent3);
				}
				if (FilterPresenter != null)
				{
					num = ArrangeLeft(FilterPresenter, num, num4, top);
				}
				break;
			}
			return finalSize;
		}

		private double ArrangeLeft(UIElement element, double left, double height, double top)
		{
			element.Arrange(new Rect(left, top, element.DesiredSize.Width, height));
			return left + element.DesiredSize.Width;
		}

		private double ArrangeRight(UIElement element, double right, double width, double height, double top)
		{
			element.Arrange(new Rect(Math.Max(0.0, width - right - element.DesiredSize.Width), top, element.DesiredSize.Width, height));
			return right + element.DesiredSize.Width;
		}

		private double ArrangeStretch(UIElement element, double left, double right, double width, double height)
		{
			element.Arrange(new Rect(left, ContentMargin.Top, Math.Max(0.0, width - (left + right)), height));
			return width - right;
		}

		private double ArrangeCenter(UIElement element, double height, double indent)
		{
			element.Arrange(new Rect(indent, ContentMargin.Top, element.DesiredSize.Width, height));
			return indent + element.DesiredSize.Width;
		}
	}

		internal bool ActualShowInBandsPanel
		{
			get
			{
				if (OverlayHeaderByChildren && (ActualRows.Count != 0 || VisibleBands.Count != 0))
				{
					if (BandsLayout != null)
					{
						return !BandsLayout.ShowBandsPanel;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal IBandsOwner Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return ownerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (value != null)
				{
					flag = ownerCore != value;
				}
				else if (ownerCore != null && ownerCore.DataControl != null)
				{
					flag = !ownerCore.DataControl.BandsSourceSyncLocker.IsLocked;
				}
				ownerCore = value;
				base.ParentBand = value as BandBase;
				if (flag)
				{
					OwnerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		DataControlBase IBandsOwner.DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				if (Owner == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Owner.DataControl;
			}
		}

		internal List<BandBase> VisibleBands { get; private set; }

		internal IEnumerable<BandBase> PrintableBands => VisibleBands.Where((BandBase band) => band.AllowPrinting);

		List<BandBase> IBandsOwner.VisibleBands => VisibleBands;

		private double GetSpecifiedSeparatorWidth()
		{
			if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			for (BandBase parentBand = base.ParentBand; parentBand != null; parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand)
			{
				if (parentBand.BandSeparatorWidth.HasValue)
				{
					return parentBand.BandSeparatorWidth.Value;
				}
			}
			return tableView.BandSeparatorWidth;
		}

		private System.Windows.Media.Brush GetSpecifiedSeparatorColor(bool header = false)
		{
			if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView))
			{
				return null;
			}
			BandBase parentBand = base.ParentBand;
			if (header)
			{
				while (parentBand != null)
				{
					if (parentBand.BandHeaderSeparatorColor != null)
					{
						return parentBand.BandHeaderSeparatorColor;
					}
					parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				while (parentBand != null)
				{
					if (parentBand.BandCellSeparatorColor != null)
					{
						return parentBand.BandCellSeparatorColor;
					}
					parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand;
				}
			}
			if (!header)
			{
				return tableView.BandCellSeparatorColor;
			}
			return tableView.BandHeaderSeparatorColor;
		}

		private BandBase GetRightParentBand()
		{
			IBandsCollection bandsCollection = null;
			if (base.ParentBand != null)
			{
				bandsCollection = base.ParentBand.BandsCore;
			}
			else if (Owner != null)
			{
				bandsCollection = Owner.BandsCore;
			}
			if (bandsCollection == null || bandsCollection.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = bandsCollection.IndexOf(this);
			if (num < 0 || num + 1 == bandsCollection.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(bandsCollection[num + 1] is BandBase bandBase))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return bandBase.ParentBand;
		}

		private bool IsSetLeftSeparator()
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = null;
			BandBase bandBase = this;
			if (base.View == null || base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (bandBase != null)
			{
				int count = bandBase.ColumnsCore.Count;
				if (count > 0 && bandBase.BandsCore.Count == 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
					{
						columnBase = bandBase.ColumnsCore[i] as ColumnBase;
						if (columnBase != null && columnBase.Visible)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				bandBase = ((bandBase.BandsCore.Count > 0) ? (bandBase.BandsCore[0] as BandBase) : null);
			}
			if (columnBase == null || !columnBase.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BandBase parentBand = columnBase.ParentBand;
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int num = columnBase.ActualVisibleIndex; num > 0; num--)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase2 = ((base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count > num - 1) ? base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[num - 1] : null);
				if (columnBase2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				BandBase parentBand2 = columnBase2.ParentBand;
				if (parentBand2 == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (parentBand2 != parentBand)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (base.View is ITableView tableView)
					{
						flag = tableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(columnBase2);
					}
					if (columnBase2.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore == 0.0)
					{
						return !flag;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HasRightColumnChildren()
		{
			if (BandsCore.Count == 0 && ColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (BandsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				IEnumerable<BandBase> enumerable = from BandBase x in BandsCore
					where x.Visible
					select x;
				if (enumerable != null && enumerable.Any())
				{
					BandBase bandBase = enumerable.MaxBy((BandBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex);
					if (bandBase != null && bandBase.HasRightColumnChildren())
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ColumnsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal override bool OnBandSeparatorChanged()
		{
			ITableView tableView = base.View as ITableView;
			if (!base.Visible || base.ActualVisibleIndex == -1 || tableView == null || base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count == 0 || (tableView.UseLightweightTemplates.HasValue && tableView.UseLightweightTemplates.Value != UseLightweightTemplates.All))
			{
				return base.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
			}
			double actualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore = base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
			double actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore = base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
			bool flag = !HasRightColumnChildren();
			if (base.ParentBand == null)
			{
				base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = (flag ? 0.0 : ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(tableView.BandSeparatorWidth));
				base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = (IsSetLeftSeparator() ? ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(GetSpecifiedSeparatorWidth(), right: false) : 0.0);
				base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = tableView.BandCellSeparatorColor;
				base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = tableView.BandHeaderSeparatorColor ?? tableView.BandCellSeparatorColor;
				base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
				base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColorCore;
			}
			else
			{
				List<BandBase> list = ((base.ParentBand.BandsCore != null && base.ParentBand.BandsCore.Count > 0) ? (from BandBase x in base.ParentBand.BandsCore
					where x.Visible
					select x).ToList() : null);
				base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = 0.0;
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (list != null && this == list.MaxBy((BandBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex))
				{
					double val = ((base.ParentBand.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0) ? base.ParentBand.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore : (base.ParentBand.BandSeparatorWidth ?? 0.0));
					base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = (flag ? 0.0 : ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(val));
					if (list != null && this == list.MinBy((BandBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex) && IsSetLeftSeparator())
					{
						base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(GetSpecifiedSeparatorWidth(), right: false);
					}
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else
				{
					base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = (flag ? 0.0 : ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(GetSpecifiedSeparatorWidth()));
					if (list != null && this == list.MinBy((BandBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex) && IsSetLeftSeparator())
					{
						base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(GetSpecifiedSeparatorWidth(), right: false);
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
					if (base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor == null && base.ParentBand.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore == 0.0)
					{
						base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = GetSpecifiedSeparatorColor();
					}
					base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor ?? base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
					if (base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor == null && base.ParentBand.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore == 0.0)
					{
						base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = GetSpecifiedSeparatorColor(header: true) ?? base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColorCore ?? base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = GetSpecifiedSeparatorColor();
					base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = GetSpecifiedSeparatorColor(header: true) ?? base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColorCore;
				}
				base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore;
				base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = base.ParentBand.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor ?? base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore;
			}
			if (base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore == 0.0)
			{
				BandBase rightParentBand = GetRightParentBand();
				if (rightParentBand != null)
				{
					base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = (flag ? 0.0 : (rightParentBand.BandSeparatorWidth.HasValue ? rightParentBand.BandSeparatorWidth.Value : 0.0));
					base.ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = rightParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColorCore;
					base.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = rightParentBand.ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColorCore;
				}
			}
			if (base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColorCore == null)
			{
				base.ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = BandCellSeparatorColor;
			}
			if (base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor == null)
			{
				base.ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = BandHeaderSeparatorColor;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			foreach (BandBase item in BandsCore)
			{
				flag3 |= item.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
			}
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in ActualRows)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					flag3 |= column.OnBandSeparatorChanged();
				}
			}
			if (!flag3 && actualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore == base.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore)
			{
				return actualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore != base.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static Type GetTypeFromObject<T>(T obj)
		{
			return typeof(T);
		}

		private void OwnerChanged()
		{
			lockColumnsSourceUpdate.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (Owner == null || Owner.DataControl == null)
				{
					RefreshSource();
				}
				else if (!Owner.DataControl.BandsSourceChangedLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					DataControl.BandsSourceSyncLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
					{
						RefreshSource();
					});
				}
			});
		}

		internal void RefreshSource()
		{
			RefreshBandsSource();
			RefreshColumnsSource();
		}

		internal void RefreshColumnsSource()
		{
			ActualColumnGeneratorTemplateSelector = GetActualColumnGeneratorTemplateSelector();
			ActualColumnGeneratorTemplate = GetActualColumnGeneratorTemplate();
			ActualColumnGeneratorStyle = GetActualColumnGeneratorStyle();
			foreach (object item in BandsCore)
			{
				((BandBase)item).RefreshColumnsSource();
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshBandsSource()
		{
			ActualBandGeneratorTemplateSelector = GetActualBandGeneratorTemplateSelector();
			ActualBandGeneratorTemplate = GetActualBandGeneratorTemplate();
			ActualBandGeneratorStyle = GetActualBandGeneratorStyle();
			foreach (object item in BandsCore)
			{
				((BandBase)item).RefreshBandsSource();
			}
		}

		}

		private static void OnGridRowChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is ColumnBase { OwnerControl: not null } columnBase && !columnBase.OwnerControl.ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate && columnBase.OwnerControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				columnBase.OwnerControl.BandsLayoutCore.UpdateBandsLayout();
			}
		}

		IBandsOwner IBandsOwner.FindClone(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return CreateCloneAccessor()(dataControl) as IBandsOwner;
		}

		internal void OnBandsLayoutChanged()
		{
			UpdateActualHeaderTemplateSelector();
			UpdateActualHeaderToolTipTemplate();
			UpdateActualPrintBandHeaderStyle();
			UpdateActualHeaderImageStyle();
		}

		internal abstract IBandsCollection CreateBands();

		void ICollectionOwner.OnInsertItem(object item)
		{
			if (base.View == null || base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn != item)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).AddLogicalChild(item);
			}
		}

		void ICollectionOwner.OnRemoveItem(object item)
		{
			if (base.View == null || base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn != item)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).RemoveLogicalChild(item);
				if (item is BaseColumn baseColumn)
				{
					baseColumn.ParentBand = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract IBandColumnsCollection CreateColumns();

		public BandBase()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			bandsHelper = new BandsHelper(this, subscribe: true);
			ColumnsCore.CollectionChanged += columns_CollectionChanged;
			BandsCore.CollectionChanged += bands_CollectionChanged;
			rowDefinitions = new ObservableCollection<BandRowDefinition>();
			columnDefinitions = new ObservableCollection<BandColumnDefinition>();
			ActualRows = new List<BandRow>();
			VisibleBands = new List<BandBase>();
			base.HasBottomElement = true;
		}

		private void bands_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataControl == null || !DataControl.BandsSourceSyncLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				lockBandsSourceUpdate.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					SyncBandsColectionWithSource(e);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void SyncBandsColectionWithSource(bool full = false)
		{
			SyncBandsColectionWithSource(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset), full);
			if (!full)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object item in bandsCore)
			{
				if (item is BandBase bandBase)
				{
					bandBase.SyncBandsColectionWithSource(full);
				}
			}
			SyncColumnsColectionWithSource();
		}

		private void SyncBandsColectionWithSource(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e, bool full = false)
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<BandBase, BandBase> itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock = (ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<BandBase, BandBase>)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(BandsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
			if (itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock != null && BandsSource is IList && (full || ((IList)BandsSource).Count != bandsCore.Count))
			{
				itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: true);
				SyncCollectionHelper.SyncCollection(e, (IList)BandsSource, bandsCore, (object source) => DependencyObjectExtensions.GetDataContext((DependencyObject)source));
				itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: false);
			}
		}

		private void columns_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
					{
						item.ParentBand = this;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (e.OldItems != null)
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
						{
							oldItem.ParentBand = null;
						}
					}
					if (e.NewItems != null)
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase newItem in e.NewItems)
						{
							newItem.ParentBand = this;
						}
					}
				}
				((IBandsOwner)this).OnColumnsChanged(e);
			};
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl().syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
				Func<DataControlBase, BaseColumn> cloneAccessor = CreateCloneAccessor();
				DataControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyCollectionChanged(DataControl, (DataControlBase dc) => ((BandBase)cloneAccessor(dc)).ColumnsCore, (object column) => CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement<BaseColumn>((BaseColumn)(ColumnBase)column, (Action<BaseColumn>)null, (Func<BaseColumn, Locker>)null, (object[])null), e);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
			if (DataControl == null || !DataControl.BandsSourceSyncLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				lockColumnsSourceUpdate.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					SyncColumnsColectionWithSource(e);
				});
			}
		}

		internal void ResetBand()
		{
			if (DataControl != null && !DataControl.BandsSourceSyncLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				((IBandsOwner)this).OnColumnsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			}
		}

		private void SyncColumnsColectionWithSource()
		{
			SyncColumnsColectionWithSource(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		private void SyncColumnsColectionWithSource(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<BandBase, ColumnBase> itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock = (ItemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock<BandBase, ColumnBase>)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(ColumnsItemsAttachedBehaviorProperty);
			if (itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock != null && ColumnsSource is IList && ((IList)ColumnsSource).Count != columnsCore.Count)
			{
				itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: true);
				SyncCollectionHelper.SyncCollection(e, (IList)ColumnsSource, columnsCore, (object source) => DependencyObjectExtensions.GetDataContext((DependencyObject)source));
				itemsAttachedBehaviorExtendedLock.SetLockSynchronization(lockSynchronization: false);
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnBandsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.OnBandsChanged(e);
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnColumnsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner != null && (DataControl == null || !DataControl.lockBandsSourceUpdate.IsLocked))
			{
				Owner.OnColumnsChanged(e);
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnLayoutPropertyChanged()
		{
			OnLayoutPropertyChanged();
		}

		private void OnDeserializeCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			string collectionName = e.CollectionName;
			if (!(collectionName == "Columns"))
			{
				if (collectionName == "Bands" && !BandSerializationHelper.CanRemoveOldColumns)
				{
					DataControl.OnDeserializeCreateBand(e);
				}
			}
			else if (!BandSerializationHelper.CanRemoveOldColumns)
			{
				DataControl.OnDeserializeCreateColumn(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnDeserializeClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			string name = e.Item.Name;
			if ((name == "Columns" || name == "Bands") && !BandSerializationHelper.CanAddNewColumns)
			{
				BandSerializationHelper.ClearCollection(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnDeserializeFindCollectionItem(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			string collectionName = e.CollectionName;
			if (!(collectionName == "Columns"))
			{
				if (collectionName == "Bands")
				{
					BandSerializationHelper.FindBand(e, this);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BandSerializationHelper.FindColumn(e);
			}
		}

		protected internal override DataTemplate GetActualTemplate()
		{
			if (base.HeaderTemplate == null && BandsLayout != null)
			{
				return BandsLayout.BandHeaderTemplate;
			}
			return base.HeaderTemplate;
		}

		protected internal override DataTemplateSelector GetActualTemplateSelector()
		{
			if (base.HeaderTemplateSelector == null && BandsLayout != null)
			{
				return BandsLayout.BandHeaderTemplateSelector;
			}
			return base.HeaderTemplateSelector;
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateActualHeaderToolTipTemplate()
		{
			if (base.HeaderToolTipTemplate != null)
			{
				base.ActualHeaderToolTipTemplate = base.HeaderToolTipTemplate;
			}
			else if (BandsLayout != null)
			{
				base.ActualHeaderToolTipTemplate = BandsLayout.BandHeaderToolTipTemplate;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateActualPrintBandHeaderStyle()
		{
			if (PrintBandHeaderStyle != null)
			{
				ActualPrintBandHeaderStyle = PrintBandHeaderStyle;
			}
			else if (BandsLayout != null)
			{
				ActualPrintBandHeaderStyle = BandsLayout.PrintBandHeaderStyle;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLayoutPropertyChanged()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.OnLayoutPropertyChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnActualHeaderWidthChanged()
		{
			base.OnActualHeaderWidthChanged();
			UpdateContentLayout();
		}

		private void OnShowInBandsPanelChanged()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.UpdateHasTopElement();
			}
			UpdateContentLayout();
		}

		protected internal override bool CanDropTo(BaseColumn target)
		{
			for (BandBase bandBase = target.ParentBandInternal; bandBase != null; bandBase = bandBase.Owner as BandBase)
			{
				if (bandBase == this)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override Func<DataControlBase, BaseColumn> CreateCloneAccessor()
		{
			return BandWalker.CreateBandCloneAccessor(this);
		}

		internal override DataControlBase GetNotifySourceControl()
		{
			return DataControl;
		}

		protected abstract ColumnBase CreateColumn();

		protected abstract BandBase CreateBand();

		internal override void UpdateActualHeaderImageStyle()
		{
			base.UpdateActualHeaderImageStyle();
			if (base.ActualHeaderImageStyle == null)
			{
				base.ActualHeaderImageStyle = BandsLayout.With((BandsLayoutBase x) => x.HeaderImageStyle);
			}
		}

		private static void OnDeserializeAllowProperty(object sender, AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			((BandBase)sender).OnDeserializeAllowPropertyInternal(e);
		}

		private void OnDeserializeAllowPropertyInternal(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Allow = OnDeserializeAllowProperty(e);
		}

		protected virtual bool OnDeserializeAllowProperty(AllowPropertyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataControl.OnDeserializeAllowProperty(e);
		}
	}

		internal DataControlBase DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				return dataControl;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataControl == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (dataControl != null && !dataControl.IsDeserializing)
				{
					dataControl.ColumnsCore.Clear();
				}
				dataControl = value;
				if (dataControl != null)
				{
					bandsHelper = new BandsHelper(this, subscribe: false);
					if (!dataControl.IsDeserializing)
					{
						FillColumns();
					}
					else
					{
						dataControl.RemoveColumnsFromLogicalChildren();
					}
				}
			}
		}
