		private RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase RebuildBandsLayoutHelper
		{
			get
			{
				if (View.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes != useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes || rebuildBandsLayoutHelper == null)
				{
					useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes = View.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes;
					rebuildBandsLayoutHelper = (useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes ? ((RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase)new RebuildBandsLayoutHelperLegacy(this)) : ((RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase)new RebuildBandsLayoutHelper(this)));
				}
				return rebuildBandsLayoutHelper;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowSyncWithPlainColumnCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataControl != null && (View == null || !View.IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout))
				{
					return !IsRootBandsCollectionLocked;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool IsRootBandsCollectionLocked
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataControl?.BandsCore != null)
				{
					return DataControl.BandsCore.IsLockUpdate;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static BandsLayoutBase()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BandsLayoutBase);
			ShowBandsPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowBandsPanel", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).OnShowBandsPanelChanged();
			}));
			BandHeaderTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BandHeaderTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateBandActualHeaderTemplateSelector();
			}));
			BandHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BandHeaderTemplateSelector", typeof(DataTemplateSelector), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateBandActualHeaderTemplateSelector();
			}));
			BandHeaderToolTipTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("BandHeaderToolTipTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateBandHeaderToolTipTemplate();
			}));
			AllowChangeColumnParentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowChangeColumnParent", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			AllowChangeBandParentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowChangeBandParent", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ShowBandsInCustomizationFormProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowBandsInCustomizationForm", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).OnShowBandsInCustomizationFormChanged();
			}));
			AllowBandMovingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowBandMoving", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateViewInfo();
			}));
			AllowBandResizingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowBandResizing", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateViewInfo();
			}));
			ColumnChooserBandsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("ColumnChooserBands", typeof(ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ColumnChooserBandsProperty = ColumnChooserBandsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparerProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparer", typeof(IComparer<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).RebuildColumnChooserColumns();
			}));
			AllowAdvancedVerticalNavigationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowAdvancedVerticalNavigation", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			AllowAdvancedHorizontalNavigationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowAdvancedHorizontalNavigation", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			PrintBandHeaderStyleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("PrintBandHeaderStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdatePrintBandHeaderStyle();
			}));
			FixedLeftVisibleBandsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("FixedLeftVisibleBands", typeof(ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).OnFixedLeftVisibleBandsChanged();
			}));
			FixedLeftVisibleBandsProperty = FixedLeftVisibleBandsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FixedRightVisibleBandsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("FixedRightVisibleBands", typeof(ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).OnFixedRightVisibleBandsChanged();
			}));
			FixedRightVisibleBandsProperty = FixedRightVisibleBandsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FixedNoneVisibleBandsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("FixedNoneVisibleBands", typeof(ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).OnFixedNoneVisibleBandsChanged();
			}));
			FixedNoneVisibleBandsProperty = FixedNoneVisibleBandsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ShowIndicatorPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("ShowIndicator", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			ShowIndicatorProperty = ShowIndicatorPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AllowBandMultiRowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("AllowBandMultiRow", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BandsLayoutBase)(object)d).UpdateBandsLayout();
			}));
		}

		public BandsLayoutBase()
		{
			VisibleBands = new List<BandBase>();
			ColumnChooserBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(new BandBase[0]);
			FixedLeftVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(new BandBase[0]);
			FixedRightVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(new BandBase[0]);
			FixedNoneVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(new BandBase[0]);
		}

		internal void OnGridControlBandsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			bandsHelper.OnBandsChanged(e);
		}

		IBandsOwner IBandsOwner.FindClone(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl.BandsLayoutCore;
		}

		private void OnShowBandsPanelChanged()
		{
			UpdateBandsContainer(GetBandsContainerControl());
		}

		internal FrameworkElement GetBandsContainerControl()
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (DataControl == DataControl.GetRootDataControl())
			{
				return DataControl.viewCore.RootBandsContainer;
			}
			RowDataBase headersRowData = DataControl.DataControlParent.GetHeadersRowData();
			if (headersRowData?.WholeRowElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(headersRowData.WholeRowElement, "PART_BandsContainer");
		}

		internal void UpdateBandsContainer(FrameworkElement bandsContainer)
		{
			if (bandsContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bandsContainer.Visibility = ((!ShowBandsPanel) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in DataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.RaiseHasTopElementChanged();
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnBandsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				bandsPlainSyncListener.IsDirty = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (BandBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						OnBandRemoved(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (BandBase newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						OnBandAdded(newItem);
					}
				}
			}
			SyncWithPlainBandCollection();
		}

		internal void UpdateBandsLayout()
		{
			if (View != null && !View.IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout)
			{
				View.RebuildColumns();
				View.UpdateContentLayout();
			}
		}

		internal IList<ColumnBase> RebuildBandsVisibleColumns()
		{
			DataViewBase view = View;
			view.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
			});
			ForceSyncPlainCollections();
			view.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.EndUpdateColumnsLayout(calcLayout: false);
			});
			view.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Lock();
			});
			IList<ColumnBase> list = RebuildBandsLayoutHelper.RebuildVisibleColumns();
			LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner = new LayoutAssigner();
			UpdateFixedBands(layoutAssigner);
			UpdateVisibleColumnsAndBands(list, layoutAssigner);
			view.Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Unlock();
			});
			return list;
		}

		internal void UpdateVisibleColumnsAndBands(IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumns, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner = null)
		{
			UpdateBandsPositions(layoutAssigner ?? new LayoutAssigner());
			RebuildBandsLayoutHelper.UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(visibleColumns);
		}

		internal void UpdateBandsPositions(LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			UpdateBandPosition(FixedLeftVisibleBands, hasTopElement: false, ownerIsLeft: true, ownerIsRight: true, emptyLeftSibling: false, layoutAssigner);
			UpdateBandPosition(FixedNoneVisibleBands, hasTopElement: false, FixedLeftVisibleBands.Count == 0, ownerIsRight: true, emptyLeftSibling: false, layoutAssigner);
			UpdateBandPosition(FixedRightVisibleBands, hasTopElement: false, ownerIsLeft: false, ownerIsRight: true, emptyLeftSibling: false, layoutAssigner);
		}

		internal void UpdateFixedBands(LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			List<BandBase> list = new List<BandBase>();
			List<BandBase> list2 = new List<BandBase>();
			List<BandBase> list3 = new List<BandBase>();
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in VisibleBands)
			{
				if (visibleBand.Visible)
				{
					switch (visibleBand.Fixed)
					{
					case FixedStyle.Left:
						list.Add(visibleBand);
						break;
					case FixedStyle.Right:
						list2.Add(visibleBand);
						break;
					default:
						list3.Add(visibleBand);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<BandBase>((IList<BandBase>)FixedLeftVisibleBands, (IList<BandBase>)list))
			{
				FixedLeftVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(list);
			}
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<BandBase>((IList<BandBase>)FixedRightVisibleBands, (IList<BandBase>)list2))
			{
				FixedRightVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(list2);
			}
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<BandBase>((IList<BandBase>)FixedNoneVisibleBands, (IList<BandBase>)list3))
			{
				FixedNoneVisibleBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(list3);
			}
		}

		internal void RebuildColumnChooserColumns()
		{
			List<ColumnBase> columnChooserColumns = new List<ColumnBase>();
			List<BandBase> columnChooserBands = new List<BandBase>();
			ForeachBand(delegate(BandBase band)
			{
				if (!band.Visible && band.ShowInColumnChooser)
				{
					columnChooserBands.Add(band);
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase item in band.ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (!item.Visible && item.ShowInColumnChooser)
					{
						columnChooserColumns.Add(item);
					}
				}
			});
			columnChooserColumns.Sort(View.ColumnChooserColumnsSortOrderComparer);
			if (ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparer != null)
			{
				columnChooserBands.Sort(ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparer);
			}
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<ColumnBase>((IList<ColumnBase>)View.ColumnChooserColumns, (IList<ColumnBase>)columnChooserColumns))
			{
				View.ColumnChooserColumns = new ReadOnlyCollection<ColumnBase>(columnChooserColumns);
			}
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<BandBase>((IList<BandBase>)ColumnChooserBands, (IList<BandBase>)columnChooserBands))
			{
				ColumnChooserBands = new ReadOnlyCollection<BandBase>(columnChooserBands);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void PatchBands(List<BandBase> bands, bool hasFixedLeftBands)
		{
		}

		private bool UpdateBandPosition(IList<BandBase> bands, bool hasTopElement, bool ownerIsLeft, bool ownerIsRight, bool emptyLeftSibling, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < bands.Count; i++)
			{
				BandBase bandBase = bands[i];
				bool flag = i == 0 && ownerIsLeft;
				bool flag2 = i == bands.Count - 1 && ownerIsRight;
				bandBase.ColumnPosition = GetColumnPosition(flag);
				bandBase.HasTopElement = hasTopElement;
				bandBase.HasRightSibling = !flag2;
				bandBase.HasLeftSibling = !flag;
				if (bandBase.ActualRows.Count > 0)
				{
					UpdateColumnsPositions(bandBase, flag, flag2, emptyLeftSibling, layoutAssigner);
					emptyLeftSibling = false;
				}
				else if (bandBase.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
				{
					emptyLeftSibling = true;
				}
				emptyLeftSibling = UpdateBandPosition(bandBase.VisibleBands, hasTopElement: true, flag, flag2, emptyLeftSibling, layoutAssigner);
			}
			return emptyLeftSibling;
		}

		private ColumnPosition GetColumnPosition(bool isLeft)
		{
			if (!isLeft || GetShowIndicator())
			{
				return ColumnPosition.Middle;
			}
			return ColumnPosition.Left;
		}

		private bool GetShowIndicator()
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(View is ITableView tableView))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return tableView.ShowIndicator;
		}

		private void UpdateColumnsPositions(BandBase band, bool ownerIsLeft, bool ownerIsRight, bool hasEmptyLeftSibling, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < actualRow.Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnBase column = actualRow.Columns[i];
					ColumnPosition position = ((!hasEmptyLeftSibling || i != 0) ? GetColumnPosition(i == 0 && ownerIsLeft) : ColumnPosition.Left);
					layoutAssigner.SetColumnPosition(column, position);
					bool value = !(i == actualRow.Columns.Count - 1 && ownerIsRight);
					layoutAssigner.SetHasRightSibling(column, value);
					bool value2 = !(i == 0 && ownerIsLeft);
					layoutAssigner.SetHasLeftSibling(column, value2);
				}
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnColumnsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				columnsPlainSyncListener.IsDirty = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (e.OldItems != null)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						columnsPlainSyncListener.Remove(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.NewItems != null)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						columnsPlainSyncListener.Add(newItem);
					}
				}
			}
			SyncWithPlainColumnCollection();
		}

		private void ForceSyncPlainCollections()
		{
			SyncWithPlainBandCollection(force: true);
			SyncWithPlainColumnCollection(force: true);
		}

		private void SyncWithPlainColumnCollection(bool force = false)
		{
			if (!force && !AllowSyncWithPlainColumnCollection)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (columnsPlainSyncListener.IsDirty)
			{
				FillColumns();
				return;
			}
			ReadOnlyCollection<ColumnBase> removedItems = columnsPlainSyncListener.RemovedItems;
			ReadOnlyCollection<ColumnBase> addedItems = columnsPlainSyncListener.AddedItems;
			columnsPlainSyncListener.Reset();
			if (addedItems.Count != 0 || removedItems.Count != 0)
			{
				RemoveColumnsFromGrid(removedItems);
				AddColumnsToGrid(addedItems, setExtDataContext: false);
			}
		}

		void IBandsOwner.OnLayoutPropertyChanged()
		{
			UpdateBandsLayout();
		}

		private void OnBandAdded(BandBase band)
		{
			bandsPlainSyncListener.Add(band);
			foreach (BandBase item in band.BandsCore)
			{
				OnBandAdded(item);
			}
		}

		private void OnBandRemoved(BandBase band)
		{
			bandsPlainSyncListener.Remove(band);
			foreach (BandBase item in band.BandsCore)
			{
				OnBandRemoved(item);
			}
		}

		private void SyncWithPlainBandCollection(bool force = false)
		{
			if (DataControl == null || (!force && !AllowSyncWithPlainColumnCollection))
			{
				return;
			}
			Tuple<IEnumerable<BandBase>, IEnumerable<BandBase>> bandsRemoveAddInfo = GetBandsRemoveAddInfo();
			if (bandsRemoveAddInfo.Item1.Any() || bandsRemoveAddInfo.Item2.Any())
			{
				DataControl.ColumnsCore.BeginUpdate();
				if (bandsPlainSyncListener.IsDirty)
				{
					DataControl.ColumnsCore.Clear();
				}
				bandsPlainSyncListener.Reset();
				foreach (BandBase item in bandsRemoveAddInfo.Item2)
				{
					item.BandsLayout = null;
					RemoveColumnsFromGrid(item.ColumnsCore);
				}
				foreach (BandBase item2 in bandsRemoveAddInfo.Item1)
				{
					SyncBandWithGrid(item2);
				}
				DataControl.ColumnsCore.EndUpdate();
			}
			else
			{
				bandsPlainSyncListener.Reset();
			}
			UpdateBandsLayout();
		}

		private Tuple<IEnumerable<BandBase>, IEnumerable<BandBase>> GetBandsRemoveAddInfo()
		{
			if (!bandsPlainSyncListener.IsDirty)
			{
				return Tuple.Create((IEnumerable<BandBase>)bandsPlainSyncListener.AddedItems, (IEnumerable<BandBase>)bandsPlainSyncListener.RemovedItems);
			}
			return Tuple.Create((IEnumerable<BandBase>)GetBandsIterator(), (IEnumerable<BandBase>)EmptyArray<BandBase>.Instance);
		}

		private void SyncBandWithGrid(BandBase band)
		{
			band.BandsLayout = this;
			AddColumnsToGrid(band.ColumnsCore, ((DependencyObject)(object)band).GetValue(BandBase.ColumnsSourceProperty) != null);
		}

		private void RemoveColumnsFromGrid(IList source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in source)
			{
				if (DataControl.ColumnsCore.Contains(item))
				{
					DataControl.ColumnsCore.Remove(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddColumnsToGrid(IList source, bool setExtDataContext)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in source)
			{
				if (ShouldAddColumnToDataControl(item))
				{
					DataControl.ColumnsCore.Add(item);
					if (setExtDataContext)
					{
						DependencyObjectExtensions.SetDataContext((DependencyObject)(object)item, ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)item).DataContext);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldAddColumnToDataControl(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!DataControl.ColumnsCore.Contains(column))
			{
				return !column.IsServiceColumn();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FillColumns()
		{
			columnsPlainSyncListener.Reset();
			DataControl.ColumnsCore.BeginUpdate();
			DataControl.ColumnsCore.Clear();
			ForeachBand(SyncBandWithGrid);
			DataControl.ColumnsCore.EndUpdate();
		}

		internal virtual void ForeachBand(Action<BandBase> action)
		{
			BandIterator<BandBase> bandsIterator = GetBandsIterator();
			foreach (BandBase item in (IEnumerable<BandBase>)bandsIterator)
			{
				action(item);
			}
		}

		internal void ForeachVisibleBand(Action<BandBase> action)
		{
			ForeachVisibleBand(this, action);
		}

		internal static void ForeachVisibleBand(IEnumerable bands, Action<BandBase> action)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				action(band);
				ForeachVisibleBand(band.VisibleBands, action);
			}
		}

		private void ForeachVisibleBand(IBandsOwner owner, Action<BandBase> action)
		{
			ForeachVisibleBand(owner.VisibleBands, action);
		}

		private BandIterator<BandBase> GetBandsIterator()
		{
			return new BandIterator<BandBase>(BandsCore);
		}

		internal void DoMoveAction(Action action)
		{
			try
			{
				View.UpdateAllDependentViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
				});
				action();
			}
			finally
			{
				View.UpdateAllDependentViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
				});
			}
			View.UpdateContentLayout();
		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveBandTo(BandBase source, BandBase target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			Move(source, target, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		private void Move(BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl().syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				Func<DataControlBase, BaseColumn> getCloneSource = source.CreateCloneAccessor();
				Func<DataControlBase, BaseColumn> getCloneTarget = target.CreateCloneAccessor();
				DataControlOriginationElementHelper.EnumerateDependentElementsIncludingSource(DataControl, (DataControlBase dc) => dc, delegate(DataControlBase dc)
				{
					BaseColumn source2 = getCloneSource(dc);
					BaseColumn target2 = getCloneTarget(dc);
					BandsMover mover = new BandsMover(dc);
					Move(mover, source2, target2, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				}, delegate(DataControlBase dc)
				{
					dc.BandsCore.Clear();
				});
			});
		}

		private void Move(BandsMover mover, BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			BandBase bandBase = source as BandBase;
			BandBase bandBase2 = target as BandBase;
			if (bandBase != null && bandBase2 != null)
			{
				mover.MoveBand(bandBase, bandBase2, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				return;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = source as ColumnBase;
			if (columnBase != null && bandBase2 != null)
			{
				mover.MoveColumnToBand(columnBase, bandBase2, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				return;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase2 = target as ColumnBase;
			if (columnBase != null && columnBase2 != null)
			{
				mover.MoveColumnToColumn(columnBase, columnBase2, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveColumnTo(BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			Move(source, target, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		internal void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn baseColumn, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (!View.IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout && baseColumn != null)
			{
				DoMoveAction(delegate
				{
					RebuildBandsLayoutHelper.ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(baseColumn, oldVisibleIndex);
				});
			}
		}

		private void UpdateViewInfo()
		{
			View?.UpdateColumnsViewInfo();
		}

		internal IList GetBands(BandBase band, bool isLeft, bool skipNotFixedBands = false)
		{
			return GetBands(band, new List<BandBase>(), isLeft, skipNotFixedBands);
		}

		private bool IsFixedBand(BandBase band)
		{
			if (object.Equals(band.Owner, this))
			{
				return band.Fixed != FixedStyle.None;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool SkipItem(int itemIndex, int currentIndex, bool isLeft)
		{
			if (itemIndex == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isLeft)
			{
				return currentIndex >= itemIndex;
			}
			return currentIndex <= itemIndex;
		}

		private IList GetBands(BandBase band, IList bands, bool isLeft, bool skipNotFixedBands)
		{
			if (DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode((DependencyObject)(object)this) && band.Owner == null)
			{
				return bands;
			}
			int itemIndex = band.Owner.VisibleBands.IndexOf(band);
			for (int i = 0; i < band.Owner.VisibleBands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!SkipItem(itemIndex, i, isLeft) && (!skipNotFixedBands || IsFixedBand(band.Owner.VisibleBands[i])))
				{
					bands.Add(band.Owner.VisibleBands[i]);
				}
			}
			if (!(band.Owner is BandBase))
			{
				return bands;
			}
			return GetBands((BandBase)band.Owner, bands, isLeft, skipNotFixedBands);
		}

		}

		internal List<ColumnBase> GetVisibleColumns()
		{
			List<ColumnBase> visibleColumns = new List<ColumnBase>();
			ForeachVisibleBand(delegate(BandBase band)
			{
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
					{
						visibleColumns.Add(column);
					}
				}
			});
			return visibleColumns;
		}

		internal virtual BandsLayoutBase CloneAndFillEmptyBands()
		{
			BandsLayoutBase bandsLayoutBase = (BandsLayoutBase)Activator.CreateInstance(((object)this).GetType());
			bandsLayoutBase.VisibleBands = ClonePrintBands();
			return bandsLayoutBase;
		}

		private List<BandBase> ClonePrintBands()
		{
			List<BandBase> list = new List<BandBase>();
			ClonePrintBands(PrintableBands, list);
			return list;
		}

		private void ClonePrintBands(IEnumerable<BandBase> sourceBands, IList<BandBase> cloneBands)
		{
			foreach (BandBase sourceBand in sourceBands)
			{
				cloneBands.Add(ClonePrintBand(sourceBand));
			}
		}

		private BandBase ClonePrintBand(BandBase source)
		{
			BandBase bandBase = Activator.CreateInstance(((object)source).GetType()) as BandBase;
			bandBase.ActualHeaderWidth = source.ActualHeaderWidth;
			if (source.PrintableBands.Any())
			{
				ClonePrintBands(source.PrintableBands, bandBase.VisibleBands);
			}
			else if (HasColumns(source))
			{
				CloneActualRows(source, bandBase);
			}
			else
			{
				CreateFakeColumn(source, bandBase);
			}
			return bandBase;
		}

		private bool HasColumns(BandBase band)
		{
			return band.ActualRows.SelectMany((BandRow row) => row.Columns).Any((ColumnBase column) => column.AllowPrinting);
		}

		private void CloneActualRows(BandBase source, BandBase clones)
		{
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in source.ActualRows)
			{
				BandRow bandRow = new BandRow
				{
					Columns = new List<ColumnBase>()
				};
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					if (column.AllowPrinting)
					{
						bandRow.Columns.Add(column);
					}
				}
				clones.ActualRows.Add(bandRow);
			}
		}

		private void CreateFakeColumn(BandBase sourceBand, BandBase cloneBand)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			BandRow bandRow = new BandRow
			{
				Columns = new List<ColumnBase>()
			};
			ColumnBase columnBase = DataControl.CreateColumn();
			columnBase.EditSettings = (BaseEditSettings)new TextEditSettings();
			columnBase.HasLeftSibling = sourceBand.HasLeftSibling;
			columnBase.HasRightSibling = sourceBand.HasRightSibling;
			columnBase.UpdateActualPrintProperties(View);
			SetPrintWidth(columnBase, sourceBand.ActualHeaderWidth);
			bandRow.Columns.Add(columnBase);
			cloneBand.ActualRows.Add(bandRow);
		}

		protected virtual void SetPrintWidth(BaseColumn column, double width)
		{
		}

		internal BandBase GetRootBand(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band.Owner is BandBase band2)
			{
				return GetRootBand(band2);
			}
			return band;
		}

		internal void CloneBandsCollection(IBandsCollection destination)
		{
			CloneBandsCollection(BandsCore, destination, CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<BaseColumn>);
		}

		internal void CopyBandCollection(IBandsCollection destination)
		{
			CloneBandsCollection(BandsCore, destination, CloneDetailHelper.CopyToCollection<BaseColumn>);
		}

		internal static BandBase CloneBand(BandBase source)
		{
			BandBase bandBase = (BandBase)CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement<BaseColumn>((BaseColumn)source, (Action<BaseColumn>)null, (Func<BaseColumn, Locker>)null, (object[])null);
			CloneInnerBandsCollection(source, bandBase, CloneDetailHelper.CloneCollection<BaseColumn>);
			return bandBase;
		}

		private static void CloneBandsCollection(IBandsCollection source, IBandsCollection destination, Action<IList, IList> cloneAction)
		{
			if (source.Count != 0)
			{
				cloneAction(source, destination);
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					CloneInnerBandsCollection((BandBase)source[i], (BandBase)destination[i], cloneAction);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CloneInnerBandsCollection(BandBase source, BandBase destination, Action<IList, IList> cloneAction)
		{
			CloneBandsCollection(source.BandsCore, destination.BandsCore, cloneAction);
			cloneAction(source.ColumnsCore, destination.ColumnsCore);
		}

		internal void UpdateShowIndicator(bool showIndicator)
		{
			ShowIndicator = DataControl.GetRootDataControl() == DataControl && showIndicator;
		}
	}

	public abstract class BandCollectionBase<T> : ObservableCollectionCore<T>, ISupportGetCachedIndex<T>
	{
		private readonly ICollectionOwner owner;

		public BandCollectionBase(ICollectionOwner owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
			owner.OnInsertItem(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			T val = ((Collection<T>)(object)this)[index];
			owner.OnRemoveItem(val);
			ResetItem(val);
			((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<T>)(object)this).Count; i++)
			{
				owner.OnRemoveItem(((Collection<T>)(object)this)[i]);
				ResetItem(((Collection<T>)(object)this)[i]);
			}
			((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).ClearItems();
		}

		private void ResetItem(T item)
		{
			(item as BandBase)?.ResetBand();
		}
	}

	public class BandIterator<TBand> : IEnumerator<TBand>, IDisposable, IEnumerator, IEnumerable<TBand>, IEnumerable where TBand : BandBase
	{
		private Stack<TBand> stack = new Stack<TBand>();

		private IBandsCollection startBands;

		private TBand current;

		public TBand Current => current;

		object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

		public BandIterator(IBandsCollection bands)
		{
			startBands = bands;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (current == null && startBands != null)
			{
				TraverseChildBands(startBands);
			}
			else if (startBands != null)
			{
				TraverseChildBands(current.BandsCore);
			}
			UpdateCurrent();
			return current != null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			stack.Clear();
			current = null;
		}

		private void TraverseChildBands(IBandsCollection bands)
		{
			int count = bands.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (bands[count - 1 - i] is TBand item)
				{
					stack.Push(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCurrent()
		{
			current = ((stack.Count > 0) ? stack.Pop() : null);
		}

		IEnumerator<TBand> IEnumerable<TBand>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return this;
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return this;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			Reset();
		}
	}
	internal class BandsHelper
	{
		private IBandsOwner owner;

		public BandsHelper(IBandsOwner owner, bool subscribe)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			if (subscribe)
			{
				owner.BandsCore.CollectionChanged += delegate(object d, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
				{
					OnBandsChanged(e);
				};
			}
			OnBandsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		internal void OnBandsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataControlBase dataControl = owner.DataControl;
			Action action = delegate
			{
				InvalidateOwner(e);
				owner.OnBandsChanged(e);
			};
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				dataControl.GetOriginationDataControl().syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
				dataControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyCollectionChanged(dataControl, (DataControlBase dc) => owner.FindClone(dc).BandsCore, (object band) => BandsLayoutBase.CloneBand((BandBase)band), e);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateOwner(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
			{
				foreach (BandBase item in owner.BandsCore)
				{
					item.Owner = owner;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (BandBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.Owner = null;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BandBase newItem in e.NewItems)
			{
				newItem.Owner = owner;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class BandedViewSerializationHelper
	{
		private Dictionary<string, BandBase> namedBands;

		private Dictionary<string, BandBase> namedSerializationBands;

		private Dictionary<string, BandBase> headersBands;

		private Dictionary<string, ColumnBase> namedColumns;

		private Dictionary<string, ColumnBase> fieldNamedColumns;

		public bool CanRemoveOldColumns { get; private set; }

		public bool CanAddNewColumns { get; private set; }

		public BandedViewSerializationHelper(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			namedBands = new Dictionary<string, BandBase>();
			namedSerializationBands = new Dictionary<string, BandBase>();
			headersBands = new Dictionary<string, BandBase>();
			namedColumns = new Dictionary<string, ColumnBase>();
			fieldNamedColumns = new Dictionary<string, ColumnBase>();
			CanRemoveOldColumns = dataControl.GetRemoveOldColumns();
			CanAddNewColumns = dataControl.GetAddNewColumns();
			SaveNamedElements(dataControl);
		}

		private void SaveNamedElements(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				dataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ForeachBand(delegate(BandBase band)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(band.Name))
					{
						if (namedBands.ContainsKey(band.Name))
						{
							throw new InvalidOperationException("The GridControl cannot deserialize the layout. Two or more bands have the same names");
						}
						namedBands.Add(band.Name, band);
					}
					else if (band.BandSerializationName != null && !namedSerializationBands.ContainsKey(band.BandSerializationName))
					{
						namedSerializationBands.Add(band.BandSerializationName, band);
					}
					else if (band.Header is string && (string)band.Header != null && !headersBands.ContainsKey((string)band.Header))
					{
						headersBands.Add((string)band.Header, band);
					}
				});
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in dataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.Name))
				{
					namedColumns.Add(item.Name, item);
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.FieldName) && !fieldNamedColumns.ContainsKey(item.FieldName))
				{
					fieldNamedColumns.Add(item.FieldName, item);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearCollection(XtraItemRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!(e.Collection is IList list))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> list2 = new List<string>();
			List<string> list3 = new List<string>();
			List<string> list4 = new List<string>();
			List<string> list5 = new List<string>();
			bool flag = false;
			DataControlBase dataControlBaseFromOwner = GetDataControlBaseFromOwner(e.Owner);
			if (dataControlBaseFromOwner != null)
			{
				flag = dataControlBaseFromOwner.UseFieldNameForSerialization;
			}
			if (e.Item.ChildProperties != null)
			{
				foreach (XtraPropertyInfo item2 in (IEnumerable)e.Item.ChildProperties)
				{
					XtraPropertyInfo item = item2;
					string serializationName = GetSerializationName(item);
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationName))
					{
						list2.Add(serializationName);
						continue;
					}
					string serializationFieldName = GetSerializationFieldName(item);
					if (flag && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationFieldName))
					{
						list3.Add(serializationFieldName);
						continue;
					}
					string serializationBandName = GetSerializationBandName(item);
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationBandName))
					{
						list4.Add(serializationBandName);
						continue;
					}
					object bandHeader = GetBandHeader(item);
					if (bandHeader is string && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace((string)bandHeader))
					{
						list5.Add((string)bandHeader);
					}
				}
			}
			for (int num = list.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)list[num];
				if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(baseColumn.Name) || !list2.Contains(baseColumn.Name))
				{
					BandBase bandBase = baseColumn as BandBase;
					ColumnBase columnBase = baseColumn as ColumnBase;
					if (bandBase != null)
					{
						if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bandBase.BandSerializationName) && !list4.Contains(bandBase.BandSerializationName))
						{
							list.RemoveAt(num);
							continue;
						}
						if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(bandBase.BandSerializationName) && bandBase.Header is string && !list5.Contains((string)bandBase.Header))
						{
							list.RemoveAt(num);
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (columnBase == null)
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
						continue;
					}
					if (bandBase == null && (columnBase == null || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(columnBase.FieldName) || !list3.Contains(columnBase.FieldName)))
					{
						list.RemoveAt(num);
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(baseColumn.Name) && !list2.Contains(baseColumn.Name))
				{
					list.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private DataControlBase GetDataControlBaseFromOwner(object owner)
		{
			if (owner == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (owner is DataControlBase result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (owner is BandBase { Owner: not null } bandBase)
			{
				return bandBase.Owner.DataControl;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void FindColumn(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			ColumnBase value = null;
			string serializationName = GetSerializationName(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationName))
			{
				namedColumns.TryGetValue(serializationName, out value);
			}
			else
			{
				DataControlBase dataControlBaseFromOwner = GetDataControlBaseFromOwner(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Owner);
				if (dataControlBaseFromOwner != null && dataControlBaseFromOwner.UseFieldNameForSerialization)
				{
					string serializationFieldName = GetSerializationFieldName(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
					if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationFieldName))
					{
						fieldNamedColumns.TryGetValue(serializationFieldName, out value);
					}
				}
			}
			MoveColumn(value, ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Collection as IList);
			e.CollectionItem = value;
		}

		public void FindBand(XtraFindCollectionItemEventArgs e, IBandsOwner newOwner)
		{
			BandBase value = null;
			string serializationName = GetSerializationName(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
			if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(serializationName))
			{
				namedBands.TryGetValue(serializationName, out value);
				ChangeBandsOwner(value, newOwner);
			}
			else
			{
				string serializationBandName = GetSerializationBandName(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
				if (serializationBandName != null)
				{
					namedSerializationBands.TryGetValue(serializationBandName, out value);
					if (value != newOwner)
					{
						ChangeBandsOwner(value, newOwner);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					object bandHeader = GetBandHeader(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
					if (bandHeader != null && bandHeader is string)
					{
						headersBands.TryGetValue((string)bandHeader, out value);
						if (value != newOwner)
						{
							ChangeBandsOwner(value, newOwner);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			e.CollectionItem = value;
		}

		private string GetSerializationName(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			return GetSerializationProperty(item, "Name");
		}

		private string GetSerializationFieldName(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			return GetSerializationProperty(item, "FieldName");
		}

		private string GetSerializationBandName(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			return GetSerializationProperty(item, "BandSerializationName");
		}

		private object GetBandHeader(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			return GetSerializationProperty(item, "Header");
		}

		private string GetSerializationProperty(XtraPropertyInfo item, string propertyName)
		{
			if (item.ChildProperties == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string result = null;
			XtraPropertyInfo val = item.ChildProperties[propertyName];
			if (val != null && val.Value != null)
			{
				result = val.Value.ToString();
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ChangeBandsOwner(BandBase band, IBandsOwner newOwner)
		{
			if (band != null && newOwner != null && band.Owner != newOwner)
			{
				band.Owner.BandsCore.Remove(band);
				newOwner.BandsCore.Add(band);
				band.Owner = newOwner;
			}
		}

		private void MoveColumn(ColumnBase column, IList collection)
		{
			if (column == null || collection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (column.ParentBand != null)
			{
				if (column.ParentBand.ColumnsCore == collection)
				{
					return;
				}
				column.ParentBand.ColumnsCore.Remove(column);
			}
			if (!collection.Contains(column))
			{
				collection.Add(column);
			}
		}
	}

	internal static class BandWalker
	{
		public static Func<DataControlBase, ColumnBase> CreateColumnCloneAccessor(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null || column.OwnerControl == null)
			{
				return CreateEmptyAccessor<ColumnBase>();
			}
			if (column.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				return CreateServiceColumnAccessor(column, column.OwnerControl);
			}
			BandBase parentBand = column.ParentBand;
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				return CreateEmptyAccessor<ColumnBase>();
			}
			int index = ((ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>)parentBand.ColumnsCore).GetCachedIndex(column);
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return CreateEmptyAccessor<ColumnBase>();
			}
			Func<DataControlBase, BandBase> bandCloneAccessor = CreateBandCloneAccessor(parentBand);
			return delegate(DataControlBase dc)
			{
				BandBase bandBase = bandCloneAccessor(dc);
				return (bandBase == null) ? null : (bandBase.ColumnsCore[index] as ColumnBase);
			};
		}

		public static Func<DataControlBase, BandBase> CreateBandCloneAccessor(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band == null || band.DataControl == null)
			{
				return CreateEmptyAccessor<BandBase>();
			}
			if (band.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				return CreateServiceColumnAccessor(band, band.DataControl);
			}
			int[] indexes = GetIndexes(band);
			return (DataControlBase dc) => GetBandByIndexes(dc, indexes);
		}

		private static Func<DataControlBase, T> CreateServiceColumnAccessor<T>(T column, DataControlBase originalControl) where T : BaseColumn
		{
			return (DataControlBase dc) => (dc != originalControl) ? null : column;
		}

		private static Func<DataControlBase, T> CreateEmptyAccessor<T>() where T : class
		{
			return (DataControlBase dc) => (T)null;
		}

		internal static int[] GetIndexes(BandBase band)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			for (BandBase bandBase = band; bandBase != null; bandBase = bandBase.ParentBand)
			{
				int num = -1;
				if (bandBase.Owner != null)
				{
					num = ((ISupportGetCachedIndex<BandBase>)bandBase.Owner.BandsCore).GetCachedIndex(bandBase);
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return EmptyArray<int>.Instance;
				}
				list.Add(num);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static BandBase GetBandByIndexes(DataControlBase dataControl, int[] indexes)
		{
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>(indexes);
			IBandsCollection bandsCore = dataControl.BandsCore;
			BandBase bandBase = null;
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				int index = stack.Pop();
				bandBase = (BandBase)bandsCore[index];
				bandsCore = bandBase.BandsCore;
			}
			return bandBase;

	public class ColumnGeneratorTemplateNameAttribute : Attribute
	{
		public string Name { get; set; }

		public ColumnGeneratorTemplateNameAttribute(string name)
		{
			Name = name;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			ColumnGeneratorItemContext columnGeneratorItemContext = (ColumnGeneratorItemContext)item;
			string text = null;
			foreach (Attribute attribute in columnGeneratorItemContext.PropertyDescriptor.Attributes)
			{
				if (attribute is ColumnGeneratorTemplateNameAttribute)
				{
					text = ((ColumnGeneratorTemplateNameAttribute)attribute).Name;
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(container is Control control))
			{
				throw new Exception();
			}
			return control.Resources[text] as DataTemplate;
		}
	}

		private string GetFooterDisplayFormat(SummaryFormatFactory formatFactory, string columnDisplayFormat, bool columnIsSet, bool forseUseColumnDisplayFormat)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			string displayFormat = FormatStringConverter.GetDisplayFormat(forseUseColumnDisplayFormat ? columnDisplayFormat : DisplayFormat);
			if (displayFormat != string.Empty)
			{
				return displayFormat;
			}
			SummaryItemType summaryType = SummaryType;
			displayFormat = formatFactory.CreateFormat(summaryType);
			if (columnDisplayFormat != string.Empty && AllowColumnDisplayFormat(summaryType))
			{
				displayFormat = string.Format(displayFormat, (!columnIsSet && DisplayFormatHelper.GetLastParameterIndex(displayFormat) != 1) ? new string[1] { columnDisplayFormat } : new string[2] { columnDisplayFormat, "{1}" });
			}
			return displayFormat;
		}

		private bool AllowColumnDisplayFormat(SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)summaryType != 3 && (int)summaryType != 6)
			{
				return (int)summaryType != 5;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private string GetFooterDisplayTextCore(IFormatProvider language, string columnCaption, object value, string columnDisplayFormat, ColumnSummaryType columnSummaryType, bool forceColumnDisplayFormat)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ShowInColumn) || FieldName == ShowInColumn)
			{
				return GetDisplayTextCore(language, GetFooterDisplayFormatSameColumn(columnDisplayFormat, columnSummaryType, forceColumnDisplayFormat), value, columnCaption);
			}
			return GetFooterDisplayTextWithColumnNameCore(language, columnCaption, value, columnDisplayFormat, columnSummaryType);
		}

		private string GetFooterDisplayTextCore(IFormatProvider language, string columnCaption, object value, string columnDisplayFormat, ColumnSummaryType columnSummaryType)
		{
			return GetFooterDisplayTextCore(language, columnCaption, value, columnDisplayFormat, columnSummaryType, forceColumnDisplayFormat: false);
		}

		private string GetDisplayTextCore(IFormatProvider language, string format, params object[] args)
		{
			return DisplayFormatHelper.GetDisplayTextFromDisplayFormat(language, format, args);
		}

		}

		private string GetFooterDisplayTextWithColumnNameCore(IFormatProvider language, string columnCaption, object value, string columnDisplayFormat, ColumnSummaryType columnSummaryType)
		{
			return GetDisplayTextCore(language, GetFooterDisplayFormat(columnDisplayFormat, columnSummaryType), value, columnCaption);
		}

		protected void OnSummaryChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (CalculationModeCore != CalculationMode)
			{
				CalculationModeChanged = true;
				CalculationModeCore = CalculationMode;
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Collections.Count; i++)
				{
					Collections[i]?.OnSummaryChanged(this, e);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				CalculationModeChanged = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool EqualsToControllerSummaryItem(SummaryItem controllerSummaryItem, GridSummaryCalculationMode viewCalculationMode)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (FieldName == controllerSummaryItem.FieldName && SummaryType == controllerSummaryItem.SummaryType)
			{
				return GetActualControllerCalculationMode(viewCalculationMode) == controllerSummaryItem.CalculatedSummaryMode;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsInDataController(SummaryItemCollection controllerSummaries)
		{
			return controllerSummaries.GetSummaryItemByTag((object)this) != null;
		}

		internal SummaryMode GetActualControllerCalculationMode(GridSummaryCalculationMode viewCalculationMode)
		{
			//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ToControllerSummaryMode(CalculationMode.HasValue ? CalculationMode.Value : viewCalculationMode);
		}

		internal static SummaryMode ToControllerSummaryMode(GridSummaryCalculationMode mode)
		{
			return (SummaryMode)(mode switch
			{
				GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows => 0, 
				GridSummaryCalculationMode.SelectedRows => 1, 
				GridSummaryCalculationMode.Mixed => 2, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("SummaryMode"), 
			});
		}
	}
	internal class SummaryFormatFactory
	{
		private const string NoneLocalizedFormat = "{0}";

		public GridControlStringId? Sum { get; set; }

		public GridControlStringId? Min { get; set; }

		public GridControlStringId? Max { get; set; }

		public GridControlStringId? Count { get; set; }

		public GridControlStringId? Average { get; set; }

		public string CreateFormat(SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GridControlStringId? localizationId = GetLocalizationId(summaryType);
			if (!localizationId.HasValue)
			{
				return "{0}";
			}
			return GridControlLocalizer.GetString(localizationId.Value);
		}

		private GridControlStringId? GetLocalizationId(SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)summaryType switch
			{
				0 => Sum, 
				1 => Min, 
				2 => Max, 
				3 => Count, 
				4 => Average, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

	public abstract class SummaryItemCollectionBase<T> : ObservableCollectionCore<T>, ISummaryItemOwner, IEnumerable<SummaryItemBase>, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged, IList, ICollection, ISupportGetCachedIndex<SummaryItemBase> where T : SummaryItemBase, new()
	{
		private readonly DataControlBase dataControl;

		private readonly SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType;

		private Locker originationElementCollectionChangedLocker = new Locker();

		SummaryItemBase ISummaryItemOwner.this[int index] => ((Collection<T>)(object)this)[index];

		protected SummaryItemCollectionBase(DataControlBase dataControl, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.dataControl = dataControl;
			this.collectionType = collectionType;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, T item)
		{
			((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
			item.Collections.Add((ISummaryItemOwner)this);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			((Collection<T>)(object)this)[index].Collections.Remove((ISummaryItemOwner)this);
			((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected internal List<T> GetActiveItems()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (T item in (Collection<T>)(object)this)
			{
				if ((int)item.SummaryType != 6)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public T Add(SummaryItemType summaryType, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			T val = new T
			{
				SummaryType = summaryType,
				FieldName = fieldName
			};
			((Collection<T>)(object)this).Add(val);
			return val;
		}

		void ISummaryItemOwner.OnSummaryChanged(SummaryItemBase summaryItem, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			dataControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyPropertyChanged(dataControl, e.Property, delegate(DataControlBase dc)
			{
				ISummaryItemOwner destinationCollection = ((collectionType == SummaryItemCollectionType.Group) ? dc.GroupSummaryCore : dc.TotalSummaryCore);
				return CloneDetailHelper.SafeGetDependentCollectionItem(summaryItem, this, destinationCollection);
			}, typeof(SummaryItemBase));
			originationElementCollectionChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				((ObservableCollection<T>)(object)this).OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
			});
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			originationElementCollectionChangedLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				dataControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyCollectionChanged(dataControl, (DataControlBase dc) => (collectionType != SummaryItemCollectionType.Total) ? dc.GroupSummaryCore : dc.TotalSummaryCore, (object summaryItem) => CloneDetailHelper.CloneElement((SummaryItemBase)summaryItem), e);
			});
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
		}

		int ISupportGetCachedIndex<SummaryItemBase>.GetCachedIndex(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			return base.GetCachedIndex((T)item);
		}

		IEnumerator<SummaryItemBase> IEnumerable<SummaryItemBase>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			foreach (T item in (Collection<T>)(object)this)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}

		void ISummaryItemOwner.Add(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			((Collection<T>)(object)this).Add((T)item);
		}

		void ISummaryItemOwner.Remove(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			((Collection<T>)(object)this).Remove((T)item);
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<T> summaries)
		{
			if (summaries == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<T>)this).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (T summary in summaries)
			{
				((Collection<T>)(object)this).Add(summary);
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<T>)this).EndUpdate();
		}

	public enum SummaryItemCollectionType
	{
		Group,
		Total
	}
	public static class SummaryItemCollectionUpdater
	{
		public static void ClearColumnSummaries(SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType, IColumnCollection columns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				GetActualSummaryItemCollection(columns[i], collectionType).Clear();
			}
		}

		public static void Update(DataViewBase dataView, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType, ISummaryItemOwner summaries, IColumnCollection columns)
		{
			if (dataView == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (collectionType == SummaryItemCollectionType.Total)
			{
				dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore.Clear();
				dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore.Clear();
			}
			foreach (SummaryItemBase summary in summaries)
			{
				string actualShowInColumn = summary.ActualShowInColumn;
				if (columns[actualShowInColumn] != null)
				{
					RefreshSummariesByColumn(dataView, summary, GetActualSummaryItemCollection(columns[actualShowInColumn], collectionType), collectionType);
				}
				else if (collectionType == SummaryItemCollectionType.Total && summary.Visible)
				{
					switch (summary.Alignment)
					{
					case GridSummaryItemAlignment.Left:
						dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore.Add(summary);
						break;
					case GridSummaryItemAlignment.Right:
						dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore.Add(summary);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateSummariesIsLastProperty(dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore);
			UpdateSummariesIsLastProperty(dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore);
		}

		private static bool CanUseFixedTotalSummary(DataViewBase dataView, SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)item.SummaryType == 3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.FieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return dataView.DataProviderBase.Columns[item.FieldName] != null;
		}

		private static void UpdateSummariesIsLastProperty(IList<SummaryItemBase> totalSummariesCore)
		{
			if (totalSummariesCore.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < totalSummariesCore.Count - 1; i++)
				{
					totalSummariesCore[i].IsLast = false;
				}
				totalSummariesCore[totalSummariesCore.Count - 1].IsLast = true;
			}
		}

		private static IList<SummaryItemBase> GetActualSummaryItemCollection(ColumnBase column, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			return collectionType switch
			{
				SummaryItemCollectionType.Group => column.GroupSummariesCore, 
				SummaryItemCollectionType.Total => column.TotalSummariesCore, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private static void RefreshSummariesByColumn(DataViewBase dataView, SummaryItemBase item, IList<SummaryItemBase> columnSummaries, SummaryItemCollectionType collectionType)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!item.Visible || (int)item.SummaryType == 6)
			{
				columnSummaries.Remove(item);
				return;
			}
			if (collectionType == SummaryItemCollectionType.Group)
			{
				if (!columnSummaries.Contains(item))
				{
					columnSummaries.Add(item);
				}
				return;
			}
			switch (item.Alignment)
			{
			case GridSummaryItemAlignment.Left:
				dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesLeftCore.Add(item);
				return;
			case GridSummaryItemAlignment.Right:
				dataView.FixedSummariesHelper.FixedSummariesRightCore.Add(item);
				return;
			}
			if (!columnSummaries.Contains(item))
			{
				columnSummaries.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}
