	public class UniqueDuplicateRuleFormatConditionInfo : ExpressionConditionBaseInfo
	{
		private readonly IColumnInfo selectiveColumnInfo;

		public UniqueDuplicateRule Rule { get; set; }

		public string SelectiveExpression { get; set; }

		public UniqueDuplicateRuleFormatConditionInfo()
		{
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			selectiveColumnInfo = (IColumnInfo)new ConditionalFormattingColumnInfo((Func<string>)(() => SelectiveExpression));
		}

		public override bool CalcCondition(FormatValueProvider provider)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (selectiveColumnInfo.UnboundExpression != null && !((FormatValueProvider)(ref provider)).GetSelectiveValue(selectiveColumnInfo.FieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(((FormatValueProvider)(ref provider)).GetTotalSummaryValue(GetSummaryType()) is ICollection<object> collection))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return collection.Contains(((FormatValueProvider)(ref provider)).Value);
		}

		public override IEnumerable<ConditionalFormatSummaryType> GetSummaries()
		{
			yield return GetSummaryType();
		}

		private ConditionalFormatSummaryType GetSummaryType()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UniqueDuplicateRule rule = Rule;
			if ((int)rule != 0)
			{
				if ((int)rule == 1)
				{
					return (ConditionalFormatSummaryType)5;
				}
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			return (ConditionalFormatSummaryType)4;
		}

		public override IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> GetUnboundColumnInfo()
		{
			IEnumerable<IColumnInfo> enumerable = ((FormatConditionBaseInfo)this).GetUnboundColumnInfo();
			if (selectiveColumnInfo.UnboundExpression != null)
			{
				enumerable = enumerable.Concat((IEnumerable<IColumnInfo>)(object)new IColumnInfo[1] { selectiveColumnInfo });
			}
			return enumerable;
		}
	}
	public class UniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator
	{
		private readonly UniqueDuplicateRule rule;

		private HashSet<object> uniqueValues;

		private HashSet<object> knownValues;

		private HashSet<object> duplicateValues;

		public UniqueDuplicateSummaryCalculator(UniqueDuplicateRule rule)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.rule = rule;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Calculate(object currentValue)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)rule == 1)
			{
				CalcDuplicate(currentValue);
			}
			else if ((int)rule == 0)
			{
				CalculateUnique(currentValue);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateUnique(object currentValue)
		{
			if (Register(currentValue))
			{
				uniqueValues.Add(currentValue);
			}
			else
			{
				uniqueValues.Remove(currentValue);
			}
		}

		private void CalcDuplicate(object currentValue)
		{
			if (!Register(currentValue))
			{
				duplicateValues.Add(currentValue);
			}
		}

		private bool Register(object currentValue)
		{
			return knownValues.Add(currentValue);
		}

		public HashSet<object> Finish()
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			HashSet<object> result = null;
			if ((int)rule == 1)
			{
				result = duplicateValues;
			}
			else if ((int)rule == 0)
			{
				result = uniqueValues;
			}
			Reset();
			return result;
		}

		private void Reset()
		{
			uniqueValues = new HashSet<object>();
			knownValues = new HashSet<object>();
			duplicateValues = new HashSet<object>();
		}
	}
	public class NodeContainerPrintInfo
	{
		public bool IsGroupRowsContainer { get; set; }
	}
	public abstract class NodeContainer
	{
		internal static readonly IEnumerator<RowNode> EmptyEnumerator = ((IEnumerable<RowNode>)new RowNode[0]).GetEnumerator();

		private int startScrollIndex;

		private IEnumerator<RowNode> rowNodeEnumerator;

		private RowNode currentItem;

		internal int oldVisibleRowCount;

		internal bool oldDisplayLoadingRow;

		private IEnumerator<RowNode> RowNodeEnumerator
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowNodeEnumerator == null)
				{
					rowNodeEnumerator = GetRowDataEnumerator();
				}
				return rowNodeEnumerator;
			}
		}

		private RowNode CurrentItem
		{
			get
			{
				if (currentItem == null)
				{
					GetNextItem();
				}
				return currentItem;
			}
		}

		public IList<RowNode> Items { get; private set; }

		internal int StartScrollIndex => startScrollIndex;

		internal bool Initialized => RowNodeEnumerator != null;

		public virtual int ItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (Items != null)
				{
					foreach (RowNode item in Items)
					{
						num += item.ItemsCount;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsEnumeratorFinished => CurrentItem == null;

		protected internal virtual bool IsEnumeratorValid => true;

		internal bool IsFinished
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Initialized)
				{
					return false;
				}
				foreach (RowNode item in Items)
				{
					if (!item.IsFinished)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return IsEnumeratorFinished;
			}
		}

		internal virtual IEnumerator<RowNode> GetSortedItemsEnumerator()
		{
			return Items.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public NodeContainer()
		{
			Items = new List<RowNode>();
		}

		internal void ReGenerateItemsCore(int startScrollIndex, int itemsCount)
		{
			this.startScrollIndex = startScrollIndex;
			OnDataChangedCore();
			GenerateItems(itemsCount);
		}

		internal virtual void ReGenerateExpandItems(int startScrollIndex, int itemsCount)
		{
			ReGenerateItemsCore(startScrollIndex, itemsCount);
		}

		private void GetNextItem()
		{
			if (RowNodeEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				currentItem = RowNodeEnumerator.Current;
			}
			else
			{
				currentItem = null;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDataChangedCore()
		{
			Items = new List<RowNode>();
			rowNodeEnumerator = null;
			currentItem = null;
		}

		internal virtual int GenerateItems(int count)
		{
			if (!Initialized)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (RowNode item in Items)
			{
				num += item.GenerateItems(count - num);
			}
			while (num < count && !IsEnumeratorFinished)
			{
				RowNode rowNode = CurrentItem;
				GetNextItem();
				Items.Add(rowNode);
				num += rowNode.ItemsCount;
				num += rowNode.GenerateItems(count - num);
			}
			OnItemsGenerated();
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual void OnItemsGenerated()
		{
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowDataEnumerator();

		internal virtual RowNode GetNodeToScroll()
		{
			RowNode input = Items.FirstOrDefault((RowNode x) => x.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.None);
			return input.Return((RowNode x) => x.GetNodeToScroll(), () => (RowNode)null);
		}
	}
	public class DataNodeContainer : NodeContainer
	{
		protected internal readonly DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder;

		private readonly DataRowNode parentNode;

		internal int parentVisibleIndex;

		private int lastVisibleCount;

		private List<int> selectedRows;

		internal int DetailStartScrollIndex { get; set; }

		protected DataIteratorBase DataIterator => treeBuilder.View.DataIterator;

		internal bool IsGroupRowsContainer => DataIterator.IsGroupRowsContainer(this);

		internal int TotalVisibleCount => treeBuilder.VisibleCount;

		internal bool EnumerateOnlySelectedRows { get; set; }

		public int GroupLevel { get; private set; }

		public NodeContainerPrintInfo PrintInfo { get; set; }

		protected internal override bool IsEnumeratorValid => lastVisibleCount == TotalVisibleCount;

		protected internal virtual int FixedTopRowsCount => 0;

		protected internal int FixedBottomRowsCount => treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount;

		internal List<int> SelectedRows
		{
			get
			{
				if (selectedRows == null)
				{
					selectedRows = new List<int>(treeBuilder.View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.Selection.GetSelectedRows());
				}
				return selectedRows;
			}
		}

		public int CurrentLevelItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsGroupRowsContainer)
				{
					return base.Items.Count;
				}
				int num = 0;
				if (base.Items != null)
				{
					foreach (RowNode item in base.Items)
					{
						if (item is DataRowNode dataRowNode)
						{
							num += dataRowNode.CurrentLevelItemCount;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public DataNodeContainer(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int level, DataRowNode parentNode)
		{
			GroupLevel = level;
			this.treeBuilder = treeBuilder;
			this.parentNode = parentNode;
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataChangedCore()
		{
			parentVisibleIndex = DataIterator.GetRowParentIndex(this, base.StartScrollIndex + FixedTopRowsCount, GroupLevel);
			base.OnDataChangedCore();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowDataEnumerator()
		{
			if (parentNode != null && treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.GetChildRowCount(parentNode.ControllerValues.RowHandle.Value) == 0)
			{
				return NodeContainer.EmptyEnumerator;
			}
			return GetRowDataEnumeratorCore();
		}

		private IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowDataEnumeratorCore()
		{
			lastVisibleCount = TotalVisibleCount;
			bool shouldBreak = false;
			IEnumerator<RowNode> topRowsEnumerator = GetTopRowsEnumerator();
			while (topRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return topRowsEnumerator.Current;
			}
			for (int i = StartScrollIndex + FixedTopRowsCount; i < lastVisibleCount - FixedBottomRowsCount; i++)
			{
				RowNode rowNodeForCurrentLevel = DataIterator.GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(this, i, (i == StartScrollIndex) ? DetailStartScrollIndex : 0, isFixedNode: false, ref shouldBreak);
				if (rowNodeForCurrentLevel != null && IsNodeSelected(rowNodeForCurrentLevel))
				{
					i = rowNodeForCurrentLevel.SkipChildNodes(i);
					yield return rowNodeForCurrentLevel;
				}
				if (shouldBreak)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			IEnumerator<RowNode> bottomRowsEnumerator = GetBottomRowsEnumerator();
			while (bottomRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				yield return bottomRowsEnumerator.Current;
			}
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerator<RowNode> GetTopRowsEnumerator()
		{
			return NodeContainer.EmptyEnumerator;
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerator<RowNode> GetBottomRowsEnumerator()
		{
			return NodeContainer.EmptyEnumerator;
		}

		private bool IsNodeSelected(RowNode node)
		{
			if (!EnumerateOnlySelectedRows)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(node is DataRowNode dataRowNode))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int value = dataRowNode.RowHandle.Value;
			return SelectedRows.Contains(value);
		}

		private GridContainerRowsLocation GetRowsLocation()
		{
			return GetRowsLocation(GetHasTop(), GetHasBottom());
		}

		internal RowPosition GetRowPosition(RowNode node)
		{
			GridContainerRowsLocation rowsLocation = GetRowsLocation();
			if (base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return RowPosition.Top;
			}
			bool flag = base.Items[0] == node;
			bool flag2 = base.Items[base.Items.Count - 1] == node;
			switch (rowsLocation)
			{
			case GridContainerRowsLocation.TopOnly:
				if (!flag)
				{
					return RowPosition.Middle;
				}
				return RowPosition.Top;
			case GridContainerRowsLocation.BottomOnly:
				if (!flag2)
				{
					return RowPosition.Middle;
				}
				return RowPosition.Bottom;
			case GridContainerRowsLocation.TopAndBottom:
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					return RowPosition.Single;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return RowPosition.Top;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					return RowPosition.Bottom;
				}
				return RowPosition.Middle;
			default:
				return RowPosition.Middle;
			}
		}

		private GridContainerRowsLocation GetRowsLocation(bool hasTop, bool hasBottom)
		{
			if (hasTop && hasBottom)
			{
				return GridContainerRowsLocation.TopAndBottom;
			}
			if (hasTop)
			{
				return GridContainerRowsLocation.TopOnly;
			}
			if (hasBottom)
			{
				return GridContainerRowsLocation.BottomOnly;
			}
			return GridContainerRowsLocation.Middle;
		}

		private bool GetHasTop()
		{
			return DataIterator.GetHasTop(this);
		}

		private bool GetHasBottom()
		{
			return DataIterator.GetHasBottom(this);
		}

		protected override void OnItemsGenerated()
		{
			treeBuilder.SetRowStateDirty();
		}
	}
	public class DetailNodeContainer : DataNodeContainer
	{
		internal bool IsScrolling { get; set; }

		public DetailNodeContainer(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int level)
			: base(treeBuilder, level, null)
		{
		}

		internal override void ReGenerateExpandItems(int commonStartScrollIndex, int itemsCount)
		{
			ReGenerateItems(commonStartScrollIndex, itemsCount, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
		}

		internal void ReGenerateItems(int commonStartScrollIndex, int itemsCount, bool checkShouldRegenerateItems = true)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int detailStartScrollIndex = 0;
			MasterRowScrollInfo masterRowScrollInfo = treeBuilder.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcMasterRowScrollInfo(commonStartScrollIndex);
			if (masterRowScrollInfo != null)
			{
				num = masterRowScrollInfo.StartScrollIndex;
				detailStartScrollIndex = masterRowScrollInfo.DetailStartScrollIndex;
			}
			if (checkShouldRegenerateItems)
			{
				if (!ShouldRegenerateItems(detailStartScrollIndex, num))
				{
					return;
				}
				IsScrolling = true;
			}
			base.DetailStartScrollIndex = detailStartScrollIndex;
			ReGenerateItemsCore(num, itemsCount);
		}

		private bool ShouldRegenerateItems(int detailStartScrollIndex, int startScrollIndex)
		{
			if (base.DetailStartScrollIndex == detailStartScrollIndex && base.StartScrollIndex == startScrollIndex)
			{
				return parentVisibleIndex != base.DataIterator.GetRowParentIndex(this, startScrollIndex + FixedTopRowsCount, base.GroupLevel);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ReGenerateMasterRootItems()
		{
			treeBuilder.View.DataControl.InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache();
			treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.InvalidateVisibleIndicesCache();
			treeBuilder.MasterRootNodeContainer.ReGenerateItemsCore();
		}

		internal void OnMasterRooDataChanged()
		{
			if (treeBuilder.View.DataControl != null)
			{
				treeBuilder.View.DataControl.InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache();
				treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.InvalidateVisibleIndicesCache();
				treeBuilder.MasterRootNodeContainer.OnDataChanged();
			}
		}
	}
	public class MasterNodeContainer : DetailNodeContainer
	{
		private int maxItemCount;

		public override int ItemCount => Math.Min(base.ItemCount, maxItemCount);

		protected internal override int FixedTopRowsCount => treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount;

		public MasterNodeContainer(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int level)
			: base(treeBuilder, level)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnItemsGenerated()
		{
			base.OnItemsGenerated();
			treeBuilder.SynchronizeMasterNode();
			oldVisibleRowCount = treeBuilder.View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
			oldDisplayLoadingRow = treeBuilder.View.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow;
			UpdateLineLevel(treeBuilder.View.MasterRootRowsContainer.Items);
			treeBuilder.View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
			treeBuilder.View.UpdateNewItemRowData();
			treeBuilder.View.DataControl.OnItemsGenerated();
		}

		private void UpdateLineLevel(IList<RowDataBase> items)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Count; i++)
			{
				RowDataBase rowDataBase = items[i];
				rowDataBase.UpdateLineLevel();
				if (rowDataBase.RowsContainer != null)
				{
					UpdateLineLevel(rowDataBase.RowsContainer.Items);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnDataChangedCore()
		{
			maxItemCount = 0;
			base.OnDataChangedCore();
		}

		internal override int GenerateItems(int count)
		{
			maxItemCount += count;
			return base.GenerateItems(count);
		}

		internal void OnDataChanged()
		{
			OnDataChangedCore();
			OnItemsGenerated();
		}

		internal void ReGenerateItemsCore()
		{
			if (treeBuilder.View.DataControl != null)
			{
				treeBuilder.View.layoutUpdatedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					ReGenerateItemsCore(base.StartScrollIndex, ItemCount);
				});
				treeBuilder.ForceLayout();
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetTopRowsEnumerator()
		{
			treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount = 0;
			treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount = 0;
			if (!treeBuilder.View.HasFixedRows)
			{
				yield break;
			}
			int lastVisibleCount = TotalVisibleCount;
			bool shouldBreak = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < lastVisibleCount && treeBuilder.View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex(i) == FixedRowPosition.Top; i++)
			{
				treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount++;
				RowNode rowNodeForCurrentLevel = DataIterator.GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(this, i, 0, isFixedNode: true, ref shouldBreak);
				rowNodeForCurrentLevel.FixedRowPosition = FixedRowPosition.Top;
				rowNodeForCurrentLevel.IsLastFixedRow = i + 1 == lastVisibleCount || treeBuilder.View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex(i + 1) != FixedRowPosition.Top;
				yield return rowNodeForCurrentLevel;
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < lastVisibleCount; j++)
			{
				object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = treeBuilder.View.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(lastVisibleCount - j - 1);
				if (!(visibleIndexByScrollIndex is int) || treeBuilder.View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex((int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex) != FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					break;
				}
				treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount++;
			}
			if (!treeBuilder.GenerateBottomFixedRowInEnd)
			{
				IEnumerator<RowNode> bottomRowsEnumerator = GetFixedBottomRowsEnumerator();
				while (bottomRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return bottomRowsEnumerator.Current;
				}
			}
		}

		private IEnumerator<RowNode> GetFixedBottomRowsEnumerator()
		{
			int lastVisibleCount = TotalVisibleCount;
			bool shouldBreak = false;
			for (int i = lastVisibleCount - treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount; i < lastVisibleCount; i++)
			{
				RowNode rowNodeForCurrentLevel = DataIterator.GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(this, i, 0, isFixedNode: true, ref shouldBreak);
				rowNodeForCurrentLevel.FixedRowPosition = FixedRowPosition.Bottom;
				rowNodeForCurrentLevel.IsLastFixedRow = i == lastVisibleCount - treeBuilder.View.ActualFixedBottomRowsCount;
				yield return rowNodeForCurrentLevel;
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetBottomRowsEnumerator()
		{
			if (treeBuilder.GenerateBottomFixedRowInEnd)
			{
				IEnumerator<RowNode> bottomRowsEnumerator = GetFixedBottomRowsEnumerator();
				while (bottomRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return bottomRowsEnumerator.Current;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetSortedItemsEnumerator()
		{
			if (!treeBuilder.View.HasFixedRows)
			{
				return base.GetSortedItemsEnumerator();
			}
			return base.Items.OrderBy((RowNode x) => (x.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Bottom) ? 1 : 0).GetEnumerator();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RowDataBase : DataObjectBase, IItem, ISupportVisibleIndex, INotifyPropertyChanged

				throw new NotImplementedException();

				throw new NotImplementedException();

			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();

			protected readonly RowDataBase rowData;

			private readonly Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate;

			public DetailRowDataReusingStrategy(RowDataBase rowData, Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)

				this.rowData = rowData;
				this.createRowElementDelegate = createRowElementDelegate;

			internal override void AssignFrom(RowsContainer parentRowsContainer, NodeContainer parentNodeContainer, RowNode rowNode, bool forceUpdate = false)
			{
				DetailInfoWithContent.DetailRowNode detailRowNode = (DetailInfoWithContent.DetailRowNode)rowNode;

		protected virtual int GetLineLevel(RowDataBase rowData, int lineLevel, int detailCount)
		{
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			if (rowData.View.DataControl.DataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
			{
				RowData rowData2 = targetView.GetRowData(targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex));
				if (rowData2 != null)
				{
					bool flag = rowData.View.DataControl.OwnerDetailDescriptor.Return((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.HasBottomMargin, () => false);
					bool flag2 = targetView.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == targetVisibleIndex + 1;
					bool flag3 = !targetView.IsRootView && (targetView.ShowFixedTotalSummary || targetView.ShowTotalSummary);
					if (flag2)
					{
						if (!flag3 && !flag)
						{
							lineLevel++;
							return GetLineLevel(rowData2, lineLevel, detailCount);
						}
					}
					else if (targetView.GroupCount > 0 && !flag && (rowData2.RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || rowData2.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single))
					{
						lineLevel++;
					}
				}
			}
			return lineLevel;
		}

		protected int GetDetailLevel(RowDataBase rowData, int level, ref bool isLastRow)
		{
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			if (rowData.View.DataControl.DataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
			{
				RowData rowData2 = targetView.GetRowData(targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex));
				if (rowData2 != null)
				{
					bool flag = targetView.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == targetVisibleIndex + 1;
					bool flag2 = !targetView.IsRootView && (targetView.ShowFixedTotalSummary || targetView.ShowTotalSummary);
					bool flag3 = rowData.View.DataControl.OwnerDetailDescriptor.Return((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.HasBottomMargin, () => false);
					if (!flag || flag2 || flag3)
					{
						isLastRow = false;
					}
					level++;
					return GetDetailLevel(rowData2, level, ref isLastRow);
				}
			}
			return level;
		}

		internal GridColumnData GetCellDataByColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return GetCellDataByColumn(column, updateNewCellData: true, addToCache: true);
		}

		internal GridColumnData GetCellDataByColumn(ColumnBase column, bool updateNewCellData, bool addToCache)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CellDataCache.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
			{
				value = CreateGridCellDataCore();
				if (addToCache)
				{
					if (CellDataCache.ContainsKey(column))
					{
						CellDataCache[column] = value;
					}
					else
					{
						CellDataCache.Add(column, value);
					}
				}
				if (updateNewCellData)
				{
					UpdateCellData(column, value);
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		internal GridColumnData CreateCellDataByColumn(ColumnBase column)
		{
			GridColumnData result = CreateGridCellDataCore();
			UpdateCellData(column, result);
			return result;
		}

	public class DisplayMemberBindingCalculator
	{
		private interface ICalculatorStrategy
		{
			bool IsSimpleMode { get; }

			object GetValue(int rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex);

			void SetValue(int rowHandle, object value);

			Type GetColumnType();
		}

		private class DefaultStrategy : ICalculatorStrategy
		{
			internal RowData RowData { get; private set; }

			private DataViewBase GridView { get; set; }

			private ColumnBase Column { get; set; }

			public bool IsSimpleMode => false;

			public DefaultStrategy(DisplayMemberBindingCalculator owner)
			{
				Column = owner.Column;
				GridView = owner.GridView;
				RowData = new StandaloneRowData(owner.GridView.VisualDataTreeBuilder, updateOnlyData: false, updateErrors: false);
			}

			public object GetValue(int rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex)
			{
				RowData.conditionalFormattingLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					RowData.AssignFromCore(rowHandle, listSourceRowIndex, Column);
				});
				GridCellData gridCellData = (GridCellData)RowData.GetCellDataByColumn(Column);
				object displayMemberBindingValue = gridCellData.DisplayMemberBindingValue;
				ClearRowData();
				return displayMemberBindingValue;
			}

			public void SetValue(int rowHandle, object value)
			{
				if (!TrySetValue(rowHandle, value, useRealData: true))
				{
					TrySetValue(rowHandle, value, useRealData: false);
				}
				ClearRowData();
			}

			private bool TrySetValue(int rowHandle, object value, bool useRealData)
			{
				RowData rowData = (useRealData ? GridView.GetRowData(rowHandle) : RowData);
				if (rowData == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				rowData.AssignFrom(rowHandle);
				if (!(rowData.GetCellDataByColumn(Column) is GridCellData gridCellData))
				{
					return false;
				}
				gridCellData.DisplayMemberBindingValue = value;
				return gridCellData.displayMemberBinding != null;
			}

			public Type GetColumnType()
			{
				RowData.AssignFrom(0);
				GridColumnData cellDataByColumn = RowData.GetCellDataByColumn(Column);
				object value = ((EditableDataObject)cellDataByColumn).Value;
				ClearRowData();
				return value?.GetType();
			}

			private void ClearRowData()
			{
				if (RowData.RowHandle != null && RowData.RowHandle.Value != int.MinValue)
				{
					RowData.AssignFrom(int.MinValue);
				}
			}
		}

		private class SimpleBindingStrategy : ICalculatorStrategy
		{
			private ISimpleBindingProcessor SimpleBindingProcessor { get; set; }

			private DataControlBase DataControl { get; set; }

			public bool IsSimpleMode => true;

			public SimpleBindingStrategy(DisplayMemberBindingCalculator owner)
			{
				SimpleBindingProcessor = owner.Column.SimpleBindingProcessor;
				DataControl = owner.GridView.DataControl;
			}

			public object GetValue(int rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex)
			{
				object row = null;
				if (rowHandle != int.MinValue)
				{
					row = GetRowByRowHandle(rowHandle);
				}
				else if (listSourceRowIndex != int.MinValue)
				{
					row = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
				}
				return SimpleBindingProcessor.GetValue(row);
			}

			public void SetValue(int rowHandle, object value)
			{
				SimpleBindingProcessor.SetValue(GetRowByRowHandle(rowHandle), value);
			}

			public Type GetColumnType()
			{
				return GetValue(0, 0)?.GetType();
			}

			private object GetRowByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
			{
				return DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		private ICalculatorStrategy strategyCore;

		internal const string RowPath = "RowData.Row";

		private const string RowDataContextPath = "RowData.DataContext";

		internal const string RowPathWithDot = "RowData.Row.";

		internal const string DataPath = "Data.";

		private ICalculatorStrategy Strategy
		{
			get
			{
				ValidateStrategy();
				return strategyCore;
			}
		}

		public DataViewBase GridView { get; private set; }

		private ColumnBase Column { get; set; }

		private void ValidateStrategy()
		{
			if (strategyCore == null || strategyCore.IsSimpleMode != Column.IsSimpleBindingEnabled)
			{
				if (Column.IsSimpleBindingEnabled)
				{
					strategyCore = new SimpleBindingStrategy(this);
				}
				else
				{
					strategyCore = new DefaultStrategy(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static string GetBindingNameCore(BindingBase binding)
		{
			if (binding == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (binding is Binding { Path: not null } binding2)
			{
				return binding2.Path.Path;
			}
			if (binding is MultiBinding multiBinding && multiBinding.Bindings.Count > 0)
			{
				return GetBindingNameCore(multiBinding.Bindings[0]);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetBindingName(BindingBase binding)
		{
			if (binding == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string bindingNameCore = GetBindingNameCore(binding);
			if (bindingNameCore == null)
			{
				return binding.GetHashCode().ToString();
			}
			return bindingNameCore;
		}

		public static void ValidateBinding(BindingBase displayMemberBinding)
		{
			ValidateBinding(displayMemberBinding, "RowData.Row", "RowData.Row.");
		}

		public static void ValidateBinding(BindingBase displayMemberBinding, string path, bool isSelf)
		{
			ValidateBinding(displayMemberBinding, path, path + ".", isSelf);
		}

		private static void ValidateBinding(BindingBase displayMemberBinding, string path, string pathWithDot, bool self = true)
		{
			if (displayMemberBinding == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PatchUpdateSourceTrigger(displayMemberBinding);
			foreach (Binding item in BindingParser.ExtractBindings(displayMemberBinding))
			{
				bool flag = item.Source != null;
				if (self && !flag)
				{
					item.RelativeSource = new RelativeSource(RelativeSourceMode.Self);
				}
				if (item.Converter == null)
				{
					item.Converter = DisplayMemberBindingConverter.Instance;
				}
				if (ShouldBindToEntireRow(item))
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						item.Path = new PropertyPath(path);
					}
					continue;
				}
				PropertyPath path2 = item.Path;
				string path3 = path2.Path;
				if (ShouldPatchPath(path3) && !flag)
				{
					if (StartWithDataContext(path3))
					{
						item.Path = new PropertyPath("RowData." + path3, path2.PathParameters.ToArray());
					}
					else
					{
						item.Path = new PropertyPath(pathWithDot + path3, path2.PathParameters.ToArray());
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static void PatchUpdateSourceTrigger(BindingBase displayMemberBinding)
		{
			if (displayMemberBinding is Binding)
			{
				((Binding)displayMemberBinding).UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;
			}
			if (displayMemberBinding is MultiBinding)
			{
				((MultiBinding)displayMemberBinding).UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;
				return;
			}
			foreach (Binding item in BindingParser.ExtractBindings(displayMemberBinding))
			{
				item.UpdateSourceTrigger = UpdateSourceTrigger.PropertyChanged;
			}
		}

		private static bool ShouldBindToEntireRow(Binding binding)
		{
			if (binding.Path != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.Path.Path))
			{
				return binding.Path.Path == ".";
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ShouldPatchPath(string path)
		{
			if (!ContainsRowData(path) && !StartWithRowDataContext(path) && !StartsWithData(path))
			{
				return !StartsWithView(path);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool ContainsRowData(string path)
		{
			return path.Contains("RowData.Row");
		}

		private static bool StartsWithData(string path)
		{
			return path.StartsWith("Data.");
		}

		private static bool StartsWithView(string path)
		{
			return path.StartsWith("View.");
		}

		private static bool StartWithRowDataContext(string path)
		{
			return path.StartsWith("RowData.DataContext");
		}

		private static bool StartWithDataContext(string path)
		{
			return path.StartsWith("DataContext");
		}

		public DisplayMemberBindingCalculator(DataViewBase gridView, ColumnBase column)
		{
			GridView = gridView;
			Column = column;
		}

		public object GetValue(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetValue(rowHandle, -1);
		}

		public object GetValue(int rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex)

			bool isSimpleMode = Strategy.IsSimpleMode;

			if (Strategy.IsSimpleMode != isSimpleMode)
			{
				value = Strategy.GetValue(rowHandle, listSourceRowIndex);
			}
			return value;
		}

		public void SetValue(int rowHandle, object value)
		{
			bool isSimpleMode = Strategy.IsSimpleMode;
			Strategy.SetValue(rowHandle, value);
			if (Strategy.IsSimpleMode != isSimpleMode)
			{
				Strategy.SetValue(rowHandle, value);
			}
		}

		public Type GetColumnType()

		}

			if (GridView.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount == 0)
			{
				return (UnboundColumnType)6;
			}
			return UnboundColumnTypeHelper.TypeToUnboundColumnType(GetColumnType());
		}

		public Type GetUnboundColumnDataType()

	internal interface ISimpleBindingProcessor
	{
		PropertyDescriptor DescriptorToListen { get; }

		PropertyDescriptor DataControllerDescriptor { get; }

		object GetValue(object row);

		void SetValue(object row, object newValue);
	}
	internal class SimpleBindingProcessor : ISimpleBindingProcessor
	{
		private IValueConverter converter;

		private object converterParameter;

		private CultureInfo userCultureInfo;

		private CultureInfo cultureInfoCore;

		private static Func<Binding, int> GetDelay = CreateGetDelayFunction();

		private string pathCore;

		private ColumnBase column;

		private DataColumnInfo valueColumnInfo;

		private CultureInfo CultureInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (cultureInfoCore == null)
				{
					cultureInfoCore = userCultureInfo ?? ((XmlLanguage)OwnerControl.GetValue(FrameworkElement.LanguageProperty)).GetSpecificCulture();
				}
				return cultureInfoCore;
			}
		}

		private DataControlBase OwnerControl => column.OwnerControl;

		public PropertyDescriptor DescriptorToListen { get; private set; }

		public PropertyDescriptor DataControllerDescriptor
		{
			get
			{
				if (valueColumnInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return valueColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor;
			}
		}

		private SimpleBindingState ValidStates { get; set; }

		public bool IsEnabled => ValidStates.HasFlag(SimpleBindingState.All);

		private static Func<Binding, int> CreateGetDelayFunction()
		{
			PropertyInfo property = typeof(Binding).GetProperty("Delay");
			if (property != null)
			{
				return (Func<Binding, int>)Delegate.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<Binding, int>), property.GetGetMethod());
			}
			return (Binding b) => 0;
		}

		public SimpleBindingProcessor(ColumnBase column)
		{
			this.column = column;
		}

		public void Validate(SimpleBindingState changedState)
		{
			ValidateIfNeeded(changedState, SimpleBindingState.Binding, ValidateBinding);
			ValidateIfNeeded(changedState, SimpleBindingState.Data, ValidateData);
			ValidateIfNeeded(changedState, SimpleBindingState.Field, ValidateField);
		}

		private void ValidateBinding()
		{
			Binding binding = column.Binding as Binding;
			pathCore = ((binding != null && binding.GetType().Equals(typeof(Binding)) && ValidateBindingSettings(binding)) ? GetPath(binding) : null);
			ChangeState(SimpleBindingState.Binding, pathCore != null);
			ValidateData();
		}

		private void ValidateData()
		{
			valueColumnInfo = GetValueColumnInfo();
			DescriptorToListen = null;
			if (valueColumnInfo != null)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = valueColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor;
				Type componentType = propertyDescriptor.ComponentType;
				if (!typeof(INotifyPropertyChanged).IsAssignableFrom(componentType))
				{
					DescriptorToListen = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(componentType)[propertyDescriptor.Name];
				}
				ChangeState(SimpleBindingState.Data, validValue: true);
			}
			else
			{
				ChangeState(SimpleBindingState.Data, validValue: false);
			}
			ValidateField();
		}

		private void ValidateField()
		{
			DataColumnInfo infoByFieldName = GetInfoByFieldName(column.FieldName);
			ChangeState(SimpleBindingState.Field, infoByFieldName == null || IsUnboundColumnInfo(infoByFieldName));
		}

		private bool IsUnboundColumnInfo(DataColumnInfo info)
		{
			if (OwnerControl != null)
			{
				return OwnerControl.DataProviderBase.IsUnboundColumnInfo(info);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ChangeState(SimpleBindingState state, bool validValue)
		{
			if (validValue)
			{
				ValidStates |= state;
			}
			else
			{
				ValidStates &= ~state;
			}
		}

		private static void ValidateIfNeeded(SimpleBindingState change, SimpleBindingState flag, Action validateAction)
		{
			if (change.HasFlag(flag))
			{
				validateAction();
			}
		}

		private void Disable()
		{
			ChangeState(SimpleBindingState.All, validValue: false);
		}

		public object GetValue(object row)
		{
			if (row != null && !AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(row) && CheckDataAccess(row))
			{
				object value = valueColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(row);
				if (converter != null)
				{
					value = converter.Convert(value, typeof(object), converterParameter, CultureInfo);
				}
				value = CoerceValue(value, typeof(object));
				if (value == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					Disable();
				}
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void SetValue(object row, object newValue)
		{
			if (row != null && CheckDataAccess(row))
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = valueColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor;
				object value = newValue;
				if (converter != null)
				{
					value = converter.ConvertBack(value, propertyDescriptor.PropertyType, converterParameter, CultureInfo);
				}
				value = CoerceValue(value, propertyDescriptor.PropertyType);
				if (value == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue)
				{
					Disable();
				}
				else
				{
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(row, value);
				}
			}
		}

		private object CoerceValue(object value, Type targetType)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return NullValueForType(targetType);
			}
			if (!targetType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()) || Convert.IsDBNull(value) || value == Binding.DoNothing)
			{
				return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static object NullValueForType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!type.IsValueType)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (type.IsGenericType && type.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(Nullable<>))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return DependencyProperty.UnsetValue;
		}

		private bool CheckDataAccess(object row)
		{
			if (valueColumnInfo.PropertyDescriptor.ComponentType.IsAssignableFrom(row.GetType()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Disable();
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetLanguage()
		{
			cultureInfoCore = null;
		}

		private bool ValidateBindingSettings(Binding binding)
		{
			converter = ((binding.Converter == DisplayMemberBindingConverter.Instance) ? null : binding.Converter);
			converterParameter = binding.ConverterParameter;
			userCultureInfo = binding.ConverterCulture;
			ResetLanguage();
			return ValidateBindingProperties(binding);
		}

		protected internal static bool ValidateBindingProperties(Binding binding)
		{
			Func<Binding, bool>[] array = new Func<Binding, bool>[11]
			{
				(Binding b) => b.FallbackValue == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue,
				(Binding b) => string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.BindingGroupName),
				(Binding b) => b.TargetNullValue == DependencyProperty.UnsetValue,
				(Binding b) => b.StringFormat == null,
				(Binding b) => !b.IsAsync,
				(Binding b) => b.AsyncState == null,
				(Binding b) => b.XPath == null,
				(Binding b) => !b.NotifyOnSourceUpdated,
				(Binding b) => !b.NotifyOnTargetUpdated,
				(Binding b) => !b.ValidatesOnDataErrors,
				(Binding b) => GetDelay(b) == 0
			};
			Func<Binding, bool>[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Func<Binding, bool> func in array2)
			{
				if (!func(binding))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static string GetPath(Binding binding)
		{
			BindingParseResult bindingParseResult = BindingParser.Parse(binding);
			if (bindingParseResult.Properties.Length != 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return bindingParseResult.Properties[0];
		}

		protected internal static bool IsFieldValid(string field)
		{
			char[] array = field.ToCharArray();
			if (array.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!char.IsLetter(array[0]))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (array.Length > 1)
			{
				for (int i = 1; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					if (!char.IsLetterOrDigit(array[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private DataColumnInfo GetValueColumnInfo()
		{
			DataColumnInfo infoByFieldName = GetInfoByFieldName(pathCore);
			if (infoByFieldName == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type componentType = infoByFieldName.PropertyDescriptor.ComponentType;
			if (typeof(DataRowView).IsAssignableFrom(componentType))
			{
				return infoByFieldName;
			}
			Type[] array = new Type[3]
			{
				typeof(DependencyObject),
				typeof(IDynamicMetaObjectProvider),
				typeof(ICustomTypeDescriptor)
			};
			Type[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Type type in array2)
			{
				if (type.IsAssignableFrom(componentType))
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (componentType.GetInterface("INotifyDataErrorInfo") != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return infoByFieldName;
		}

		private DataColumnInfo GetInfoByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			if (OwnerControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return OwnerControl.DataProviderBase.GetActualColumnInfo(fieldName);
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	internal enum SimpleBindingState
	{
		None = 0,
		Field = 1,
		Data = 2,
		Binding = 4,
		All = 7
	}
	internal class BindingParseResult
	{
		private readonly string[] properties;

		private readonly bool row;

		public string[] Properties => properties;

		public bool Row => row;

		private BindingParseResult(string[] properties, bool row)
		{
			this.properties = properties;
			this.row = row;
		}

		internal static BindingParseResult CreateForProperties(string[] properties)
		{
			return new BindingParseResult(properties, row: false);
		}

		internal static BindingParseResult CreateForRow()
		{
			return new BindingParseResult(new string[0], row: true);
		}

		internal static BindingParseResult CreateEmpty()
		{
			return new BindingParseResult(new string[0], row: false);
		}
	}
	internal static class BindingParser
	{
		internal static BindingParseResult Parse(BindingBase binding)
		{
			if (binding == null)
			{
				return BindingParseResult.CreateEmpty();
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (Binding item in ExtractBindings(binding))
			{
				string text = item.Path.With((PropertyPath x) => x.Path);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (text == "RowData.Row")
				{
					return BindingParseResult.CreateForRow();
				}
				foreach (string pathHeader in GetPathHeaders())
				{
					if (text.StartsWith(pathHeader))
					{
						list.Add(text.Substring(pathHeader.Length));
					}
				}
			}
			return BindingParseResult.CreateForProperties(list.ToArray());
		}

		internal static IEnumerable<Binding> ExtractBindings(BindingBase binding)
		{
			if (binding is Binding singleElement)
			{
				return singleElement.Yield();
			}
			if (binding is MultiBinding multiBinding)
			{
				return multiBinding.Bindings.OfType<Binding>();
			}
			if (binding is PriorityBinding priorityBinding)
			{
				return priorityBinding.Bindings.OfType<Binding>();
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<Binding>();
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetPathHeaders()
		{
			yield return "RowData.Row.";
			yield return "Data.";
		}
	}
	public class FocusRectPresenter : ContentControl
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ViewProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("View", typeof(DataViewBase), typeof(FocusRectPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FocusRectPresenter)d).OnViewChanged();
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SizeExpansionProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SizeExpansion", typeof(int), typeof(FocusRectPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(0));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChildTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ChildTemplate", typeof(ControlTemplate), typeof(FocusRectPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FocusRectPresenter)d).OnChildTemplateChanged();
		}));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsHorizontalScrollHostProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsHorizontalScrollHost", typeof(bool), typeof(FocusRectPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsVerticalScrollHostProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsVerticalScrollHost", typeof(bool), typeof(FocusRectPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		private FrameworkElement owner;

		private FrameworkElement HorizontalClipParent;

		private FrameworkElement VerticalClipParent;

		private System.Windows.Size size = System.Windows.Size.Empty;

		private Rect oldOwnerRect;

		private double oldHorizontalClipParentWidth;

		private double oldVerticalClipParentHeight;

		public DataViewBase View
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataViewBase)GetValue(ViewProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ViewProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public int SizeExpansion
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(SizeExpansionProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SizeExpansionProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ControlTemplate ChildTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				return (ControlTemplate)GetValue(ChildTemplateProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChildTemplateProperty, value);
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			set
			{
				if (owner != value)
				{
					owner = value;
					if (owner != null)
					{
						HorizontalClipParent = FindScrollHost(owner, IsHorizontalScrollHostProperty);
						VerticalClipParent = FindScrollHost(owner, IsVerticalScrollHostProperty);
					}
					else
					{
						HorizontalClipParent = null;
						VerticalClipParent = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void SetIsHorizontalScrollHost(DependencyObject element, bool value)
		{
			element.SetValue(IsHorizontalScrollHostProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetIsHorizontalScrollHost(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (bool)element.GetValue(IsHorizontalScrollHostProperty);
		}

		public static void SetIsVerticalScrollHost(DependencyObject element, bool value)
		{
			element.SetValue(IsVerticalScrollHostProperty, value);
		}

		public static bool GetIsVerticalScrollHost(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return (bool)element.GetValue(IsVerticalScrollHostProperty);
		}

		private void OnViewChanged()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.FocusRectPresenter = this;
			}
		}

		private void OnChildTemplateChanged()
		{
			((Control)base.Content).Template = ChildTemplate;
		}

		internal static FrameworkElement FindScrollHost(DependencyObject element, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			while (element != null)
			{
				if ((bool)element.GetValue(property))
				{
					return element as FrameworkElement;
				}
				element = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public FocusRectPresenter()
		{
			base.Content = new Control();
			base.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			base.IsHitTestVisible = false;
		}

		private Rect GetCoerceRect()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = Owner;
			IChrome val = (IChrome)(object)((frameworkElement is IChrome) ? frameworkElement : null);
			if (val == null || val.Root == null)
			{
				return new Rect(default(System.Windows.Point), Owner.RenderSize);
			}
			return val.Root.RenderRect;
		}

		internal void UpdateRendering(double leftIndent, double rightIndent = 0.0)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)Owner, FrameworkElementExtensions.GetTemplatedParent((FrameworkElement)this) as UIElement);
			Rect coerceRect = GetCoerceRect();
			relativeElementRect.X += coerceRect.Left;
			relativeElementRect.Y += coerceRect.Top;
			relativeElementRect.Width -= Owner.ActualWidth - coerceRect.Width + rightIndent;
			relativeElementRect.Height -= Owner.ActualHeight - coerceRect.Height;
			relativeElementRect.X += leftIndent;
			if (relativeElementRect.Width >= leftIndent)
			{
				relativeElementRect.Width -= leftIndent;
			}
			relativeElementRect.X -= SizeExpansion;
			relativeElementRect.Y -= SizeExpansion;
			relativeElementRect.Height += SizeExpansion * 2;
			relativeElementRect.Width += SizeExpansion * 2;
			double num = ((HorizontalClipParent != null) ? HorizontalClipParent.ActualWidth : 0.0);
			double num2 = ((VerticalClipParent != null) ? VerticalClipParent.ActualHeight : 0.0);
			if (!(relativeElementRect == oldOwnerRect) || oldHorizontalClipParentWidth != num || oldVerticalClipParentHeight != num2)
			{
				oldHorizontalClipParentWidth = num;
				oldVerticalClipParentHeight = num2;
				oldOwnerRect = relativeElementRect;
				base.Clip = GetClip(relativeElementRect);
				base.Margin = new Thickness(relativeElementRect.Left, relativeElementRect.Top, 0.0, 0.0);
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private RectangleGeometry GetClip(Rect ownerRect)
		{
			System.Windows.Point location = default(System.Windows.Point);
			Rect rect = ((VerticalClipParent != null) ? LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)VerticalClipParent, FrameworkElementExtensions.GetTemplatedParent((FrameworkElement)this) as UIElement) : ownerRect);
			double num = rect.Top + GetFixedElementsHeight();
			if (ownerRect.Top < num && ownerRect.Bottom >= num)
			{
				location.Y = num - ownerRect.Top;
			}
			Rect rect2 = ((HorizontalClipParent != null) ? LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)HorizontalClipParent, FrameworkElementExtensions.GetTemplatedParent((FrameworkElement)this) as UIElement) : ownerRect);
			if (ownerRect.Left < rect2.Left)
			{
				location.X = rect2.Left - ownerRect.Left;
			}
			double num2 = ownerRect.Size.Width - location.X;
			double num3 = ownerRect.Size.Height - location.Y;
			if (rect.Bottom < ownerRect.Bottom)
			{
				num3 += rect.Bottom - ownerRect.Bottom;
			}
			if (rect2.Right < ownerRect.Right)
			{
				num2 += rect2.Right - ownerRect.Right;
			}
			size = new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, num2), Math.Max(0.0, num3));
			return new RectangleGeometry
			{
				Rect = new Rect(location, size)
			};
		}

		private double GetFixedElementsHeight()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (View.DataPresenter.Content is HierarchyPanel hierarchyPanel)
			{
				foreach (FrameworkElement fixedElement in hierarchyPanel.FixedElements)
				{
					num += fixedElement.ActualHeight;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			base.MeasureOverride(new System.Windows.Size(oldOwnerRect.Width, oldOwnerRect.Height));
			return size;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			if (VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(this, 0) is UIElement uIElement)
			{
				uIElement.Arrange(new Rect(oldOwnerRect.Size));
			}
			return finalSize;
		}
	}

		public void UpdateColumns()
		{

		protected bool AllowColumnSearch(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (DataControlBase == null || DataControlBase.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			IColumnsServerActions dataController = (IColumnsServerActions)(object)DataControlBase.DataProviderBase.DataController;
			if (dataController == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return dataController.AllowAction(column.FieldName, (ColumnServerActionType)2);
		}

		public void UpdateColumnNameCollection()
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00e2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_011f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (DataControlBase == null)
			{
				Columns = null;
				oldColumns = null;
				return;
			}
			oldColumns = Columns;
			Columns = new List<ColumnBase>();
			FilterByColumnsMode filterByColumnsMode = FilterByColumnsMode;
			if ((int)filterByColumnsMode != 0)
			{
				if ((int)filterByColumnsMode == 1 && CustomColumns != null)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item in DataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
					{
						if (AllowColumnSearch(item) && (int)item.AllowSearchPanel == 0)
						{
							Columns.Add(item);
						}
						else if (CustomColumns.Contains(item.FieldName) && AllowColumnSearch(item) && (int)item.AllowSearchPanel != 1)
						{
							Columns.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item2 in DataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item2.FieldName) && AllowColumnSearch(item2) && item2.ActualAllowSearchPanel)
					{
						Columns.Add(item2);
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateColumnsPrefix();
		}

		private void UpdateColumnsPrefix()
		{
			columnsForceWithoutPrefix = new List<ColumnBase>();
			List<DataColumnInfo> source = DataControlBase.DataProviderBase.Columns.ToArray().ToList();
			foreach (ColumnBase column in DataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (Columns.Contains(column) && source.Where((DataColumnInfo info) => ((IDataColumnInfo)info).FieldName == column.FieldName).FirstOrDefault() == null)
				{
					if (column.IsUnbound)
					{
						columnsForceWithoutPrefix.Add(column);
					}
					Columns.Remove(column);
				}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateGridFilter(bool force = false)
		{
			if (DataControlBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!force && oldFilterCriteria == null && FilterCriteria == null)
			{
				if (!(DataControlBase.DataView.SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (GridColumnListParser.IsColumnsListsEquals(oldColumns, Columns))
				{
					if (SearchString != ((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).SearchText)
					{
						SearchString = ((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).SearchText;
					}
				}
				else if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).SearchText))
				{
					((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).UpdateColumnProvider();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (force)
			{
				DataControlBase.ExtraFilter = null;
			}
			UpdateGridFilterCore();
		}

		private void UpdateGridFilterCore()
		{
			CriteriaOperator extraFilter = (AllowGridExtraFilter ? FilterCriteria : null);
			if (!ApplyToColumnsFilter)
			{
				DataControlBase.ExtraFilter = extraFilter;
			}
			else
			{
				DataControlBase.FilterCriteria = extraFilter;
			}
			if (DataControlBase.DataView.SearchControl != null && DataControlBase.DataProviderBase.IsReady && DataControlBase.VisibleRowCount > 0)
			{
				DataControlBase.DataView.SearchControl.UpdateMRU();
			}
			ApplyHighlighting();
		}

		private void ApplyHighlighting()
		{
			if (DataControlBase != null && DataControlBase.DataView != null && !updateActionEnqueued)
			{
				updateActionEnqueued = true;
				bool lockScrollBarAnnotation = DataControlBase.RestoreLayoutIsLock;
				DataControlBase.DataView.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)delegate
				{
					ApplyHighlightingCore(lockScrollBarAnnotation);
				});
			}
		}

		private void ApplyHighlightingCore(bool lockScrollBarAnnotation)
		{
			ResetIncrementalSearch();
			if (AllowColumnsHighlighting)
			{
				ApplyColumnsHighlighting();
			}
			ApplyTextHighlighting();
			if (DataControlBase.DataView.SearchControl != null && DataControlBase.VisibleRowCount > 0)
			{
				if (lockScrollBarAnnotation)
				{
					DataControlBase.DataView.UpdateFilterOnDeserializationLock();
				}
				DataControlBase.DataView.UpdateFilterGrid();
				if (lockScrollBarAnnotation)
				{
					DataControlBase.DataView.UpdateFilterOnDeserializationUnlock(forceUpdate: false);
				}
			}
			ResetUpdateActionEnqueued();
		}

		internal void ResetUpdateActionEnqueued()
		{
			updateActionEnqueued = false;
		}

		private void ApplyColumnsHighlighting()
		{
			if (DataControlBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GridColumnBase item in DataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.AllowSearchHeaderHighlighting = AllowColumnsHighlighting && Columns.Contains(item);
			}
		}

		private List<FieldAndHighlightingString> GetHighlightingStrings()
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!AllowTextHighlighting)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SearchControlHelper.GetTextHighlightingString(searchString, (ICollection)Columns, FilterCondition, (int)DataControlBase.DataView.SearchPanelParseMode == 1);
		}

		private void ApplyTextHighlighting()
		{
			//IL_009e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Expected O, but got Unknown
			allHighlighingProperties.Clear();
			if (DataControlBase == null || (oldSearchString == null && searchString == null))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Highlighting == null || Highlighting.Count == 0)
			{
				UpdateViewHighlightingText();
				return;
			}
			foreach (GridColumnBase gridColumn in DataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
			{
				FieldAndHighlightingString val = Highlighting.Where((FieldAndHighlightingString fhr) => fhr.Field == gridColumn.FieldName).FirstOrDefault();
				if (val != null)
				{
					allHighlighingProperties.Add(gridColumn, new TextHighlightingProperties(val.HighlightingString, FilterCondition));
				}
			}
			UpdateViewHighlightingText();
		}

		protected internal TextHighlightingProperties GetTextHighlightingProperties(ColumnBase column)
		{
			TextHighlightingProperties value = null;
			allHighlighingProperties.TryGetValue(column, out value);
			return value;
		}

		}

		private void SubscribeToGridControl(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			DataControlBase = grid;
			grid.ColumnsCore.CollectionChanged += ColumnsCollectionChanged;
			SetColumnProvider(grid, this);
			if (grid.viewCore != null)

				grid.viewCore.ApplySearchColumns();
			}
		}

			grid.ClearValue(ColumnProviderProperty);

		}

		public List<string> GetAllSearchColumns()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			if (Columns != null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in Columns)
				{
					list.Add(column.FieldName);
				}
			}
			if (ColumnsForceWithoutPrefix != null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsForceWithoutPrefix)
				{
					list.Add(item.FieldName);
				}
			}
			if (CustomColumns != null)
			{
				foreach (string customColumn in CustomColumns)
				{
					list.Add(customColumn);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		string ISearchPanelColumnProviderBase.GetSearchText()
		{
			return SearchString;
		}

		bool ISearchPanelColumnProviderBase.UpdateFilter(string searchText, FilterCondition filterCondition, CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DataControlBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SearchString = GetSeatchText(searchText, filterCondition, filterCriteria);
			FilterCondition = filterCondition;
			FilterCriteria = GetFilterCriteria(searchText, filterCondition, filterCriteria);
			UpdateColumns();
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual string GetSeatchText(string searchText, FilterCondition filterCondition, CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			return searchText;
		}

		protected virtual CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria(string searchText, FilterCondition filterCondition, CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			if (DataControlBase != null && DataControlBase.viewCore != null)
			{
				SearchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper searchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper = DataControlBase.viewCore.ConvertSearchStringToFilterCriteria(searchText, filterCriteria, GetHighlightingStrings());
				filterCriteria = searchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper.Filter;
				Highlighting = searchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper.Highlighting ?? FilterCriteriaToHighlighting(filterCriteria);
				ApplyToColumnsFilter = searchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper.ApplyToColumnsFilter;
			}
			return filterCriteria;
		}

		protected virtual List<FieldAndHighlightingString> FilterCriteriaToHighlighting(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
		{
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			List<FieldAndHighlightingString> list = new List<FieldAndHighlightingString>();
			Tuple<CriteriaOperator, IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>> tuple = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnNames(criteriaOperator, (IEqualityComparer<string>)null);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, CriteriaOperator> item in tuple.Item2)
			{
				string key = item.Key;
				SearchPanelHighlightingResolver searchPanelHighlightingResolver = new SearchPanelHighlightingResolver();
				List<string> values = item.Value.Accept<List<string>>((ICriteriaVisitor<List<string>>)searchPanelHighlightingResolver);
				list.Add(new FieldAndHighlightingString(key, string.Join("\n", values)));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public class GridColumnListParser
	{
		private List<ColumnBase> columnsSource;

		private List<string> columnsNames;

		private List<string> result;

		private GridColumnListParser(List<ColumnBase> columnsSource, string searchColumns)
		{
			this.columnsSource = columnsSource;
			columnsNames = SearchControlHelper.ParseColumnsString(searchColumns);
		}

		private ObservableCollection<string> GetSearchColumns()
		{
			if (columnsNames.Count == 1 && columnsNames[0] == "*")
			{
				return null;
			}
			result = new List<string>();
			UpdateAllowColumnInSeachPanelIfNeed(removeSpaces: false, isToLower: false);
			if (columnsNames.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columnsNames.Count; i++)
				{
					columnsNames[i] = columnsNames[i].ToLower();
				}
				UpdateAllowColumnInSeachPanelIfNeed(removeSpaces: false, isToLower: true);
			}
			if (columnsNames.Count != 0)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < columnsNames.Count; j++)
				{
					columnsNames[j] = columnsNames[j].Replace(" ", string.Empty);
				}
				UpdateAllowColumnInSeachPanelIfNeed(removeSpaces: true, isToLower: true);
			}
			return new ObservableCollection<string>(result);
		}

		private void UpdateAllowColumnInSeachPanelIfNeed(bool removeSpaces, bool isToLower)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			List<ColumnBase> list2 = new List<ColumnBase>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in columnsSource)
			{
				string text = (removeSpaces ? item.FieldName.ToString().Replace(" ", string.Empty) : item.FieldName.ToString());
				text = (isToLower ? text.ToLower() : text);
				if (columnsNames.Contains(text))
				{
					list.Add(item.FieldName);
					columnsNames.Remove(text);
					list2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item2 in list2)
			{
				if (columnsSource.Contains(item2))
				{
					columnsSource.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
			result.AddRange(list);
		}

		public static bool IsColumnsListsEquals(IList oldColumns, IList newColumns)
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase oldColumn in oldColumns)
			{
				if (!newColumns.Contains(oldColumn))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase newColumn in newColumns)
			{
				if (!oldColumns.Contains(newColumn))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static ObservableCollection<string> GetSearchColumns(List<ColumnBase> columnsSource, string searchColumns)
		{
			return new GridColumnListParser(columnsSource, searchColumns).GetSearchColumns();
		}
	}

	public class GridSearchControlBase : SearchControl

			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(ViewProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		protected override bool SaveMRUOnStringChanged => false;

		internal SortedSet<int> SearchInfo { get; private set; }

		static GridSearchControlBase()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GridSearchControlBase);
			ViewProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("View", typeof(DataViewBase), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSearchControlBase)(object)d).ViewChanged((DataViewBase)e.OldValue, (DataViewBase)e.NewValue);
			}));
		}

		private void ViewChanged(DataViewBase oldView, DataViewBase view)
		{
			OnViewChanged(oldView, view);
		}

		protected void OnViewChanged(DataViewBase oldView, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (oldView != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeViewEvens(oldView);
			}
			if (view != null)
			{
				view.SearchControl = (SearchControl)(object)this;
				BindSearchPanel(view);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UnsubscribeViewEvens(DataViewBase oldView)
		{
			oldView.SearchControl = null;
		}

		internal void FindCommandExecuted()
		{
			((SearchControl)this).OnFindCommandExecuted();
		}

		protected virtual void BindSearchPanel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchPanelFindFilterProperty));
			Binding binding2 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.FilterConditionProperty, (BindingBase)binding2);
			binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchPanelParseModeProperty));
			Binding binding3 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.ParseModeProperty, (BindingBase)binding3);
			binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchPanelFindModeProperty));
			Binding binding4 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.FindModeProperty, (BindingBase)binding4);
			binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchDelayProperty));
			Binding binding5 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.SearchTextPostDelayProperty, (BindingBase)binding5);
			binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchPanelNullTextProperty));
			binding.Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay;
			Binding binding6 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.NullTextProperty, (BindingBase)binding6);
			binding = new Binding();
			binding.Source = view;
			binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.SearchStringProperty));
			binding.Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay;
			Binding binding7 = binding;
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(SearchControl.SearchTextProperty, (BindingBase)binding7);
		}

		internal void InitSearchInfo()
		{
			if (View != null && View.ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo)
			{
				SearchInfo = new SortedSet<int>();
				Func<int, bool> func = View.CreateFilterFitPredicate();
				if (func == null)
				{
					((SearchControl)this).ResultCount = 0;
					((SearchControl)this).ResultIndex = 0;
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount; i++)
				{
					if (!View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsFilteredByRowHandle(i) && func(i))
					{
						SearchInfo.Add(i);
					}
				}
				((SearchControl)this).ResultCount = SearchInfo.Count;
			}
			else
			{
				SearchInfo = null;
			}
			UpdateResultIndex();
		}

		private void UpdateSearchInfo()
		{
			((SearchControl)this).ResultCount = SearchInfo.Count;
			UpdateResultIndex();
		}

		internal void UpdateResultIndex()
		{
			if (View == null || SearchInfo == null || SearchInfo.Count == 0)
			{
				((SearchControl)this).ResultCount = 0;
				((SearchControl)this).ResultIndex = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				int firstDataFocusedRowHandle = View.GetFirstDataFocusedRowHandle();
				SortedSet<int> viewBetween = SearchInfo.GetViewBetween(0, firstDataFocusedRowHandle);
				((SearchControl)this).ResultIndex = ((viewBetween.Count > 0) ? viewBetween.Count : 0);
			}
		}

		internal void SearchInfoChanged(ListChangedType changedType, int newHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (View != null && View.DataProviderBase != null && View.DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SearchInfo == null || !oldRowHandle.HasValue)
			{
				InitSearchInfo();
				return;
			}
			Func<int, bool> func = View.CreateFilterFitPredicate();
			if (func == null)
			{
				InitSearchInfo();
				return;
			}
			switch (changedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
				if (func(newHandle))
				{
					SearchInfo.Add(newHandle);
				}
				UpdateSearchInfo();
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
				SearchInfo.Remove(oldRowHandle.Value);
				UpdateSearchInfo();
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
				SearchInfo.Remove(oldRowHandle.Value);
				if (func(newHandle))
				{
					SearchInfo.Add(newHandle);
				}
				UpdateSearchInfo();
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
				SearchInfo.Remove(oldRowHandle.Value);
				if (func(newHandle))
				{
					SearchInfo.Add(newHandle);
				}
				UpdateSearchInfo();
				break;
			default:
				InitSearchInfo();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void FadeSearchPanel(Action completed)
		{
			((SearchControl)this).BeginFadeAnimation(completed);
		}
	}

	public abstract class DataControlPopupMenu : GridPopupMenuBase
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GridMenuTypeProperty;

		protected internal static readonly RoutedEvent ManagerChangedEvent;

		protected override bool ShouldClearItemsOnClose => true;

		public GridMenuInfo MenuInfo => (GridMenuInfo)(object)((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)this).MenuInfo;

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		public GridMenuType? MenuType
		{
			get
			{
				if (MenuInfo != null)
				{
					return MenuInfo.MenuType;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		static DataControlPopupMenu()
		{
			GridMenuTypeProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("GridMenuType", typeof(GridMenuType?), typeof(DataControlPopupMenu), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			ManagerChangedEvent = EventManager.RegisterRoutedEvent("ManagerChanged", RoutingStrategy.Direct, typeof(RoutedPropertyChangedEventHandler<BarManager>), typeof(DataControlPopupMenu));
		}

		public static void SetGridMenuType(DependencyObject element, GridMenuType? value)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			element.SetValue(GridMenuTypeProperty, value);
		}

		public static GridMenuType? GetGridMenuType(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			return (GridMenuType?)element.GetValue(GridMenuTypeProperty);
		}

		public DataControlPopupMenu(DataViewBase view)
			: base((ILogicalOwner)(object)view.RootView)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		private bool RequestUIUpdate()
		{
			View.LockEditorClose = true;
			try
			{
				return View.RequestUIUpdate();
			}
			finally
			{
				View.LockEditorClose = false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool RaiseShowMenu()
		{
			if (!RequestUIUpdate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			GridMenuEventArgs e = new GridMenuEventArgs(this)
			{
				RoutedEvent = DataViewBase.ShowGridMenuEvent
			};
			View.RaiseShowGridMenu(e);
			return !e.Handled;
		}

		protected override MenuInfoBase CreateMenuInfo(UIElement placementTarget)
		{
			if (placementTarget == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			GridMenuType? gridMenuType = GetGridMenuType(placementTarget);
			if (!gridMenuType.HasValue)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateMenuInfoCore(gridMenuType);
		}

		protected abstract MenuInfoBase CreateMenuInfoCore(GridMenuType? type);

		protected internal bool ExecuteOriginationViewMenuController(Func<DataViewBase, BarManagerMenuController> getMenuController)
		{
			DataViewBase originationView = View.OriginationView;
			if (originationView == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BarManagerMenuController val = getMenuController(originationView);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			val.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)this;
			try
			{
				((BarManagerControllerBase)val).Execute((DependencyObject)null);
			}
			finally
			{
				val.Menu = (PopupMenu)(object)originationView.DataControlMenu;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

	public abstract class GridSummaryHelper : IGridSummaryItemsOwner, ISummaryItemsOwner
	{
		private GridSummaryItemsEditorController summaryController;

		internal readonly DataViewBase view;

		internal GridSummaryItemsEditorController Controller
		{
			get
			{
				if (summaryController == null)
				{
					summaryController = CreateSummaryItemController();
					int num = 0;
					while (num < ((SummaryItemsEditorController)summaryController).Items.Count)
					{
						if (!((SummaryItemBase)(object)((SummaryItemsEditorController)summaryController).Items[num]).Visible)
						{
							((SummaryItemsEditorController)summaryController).Items.Remove(((SummaryItemsEditorController)summaryController).Items[num]);
						}
						else
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
				return summaryController;
			}
		}

		protected abstract ISummaryItemOwner SummaryItems { get; }

		internal bool ActualShowLegacySummaryEditor
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (CompatibilitySettings.AlwaysUseLegacySummaryEditor)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return (int)FloatingContainerFactory.CheckPopupHost((DependencyObject)view) == 2;
			}
		}

		protected virtual GridSummaryItemsEditorController CreateSummaryItemController()
		{
			return new GridSummaryItemsEditorController((ISummaryItemsOwner)(object)this);
		}

		protected GridSummaryHelper(DataViewBase view)

			this.view = view;
		}

		ISummaryItem ISummaryItemsOwner.CreateItem(string fieldName, SummaryItemType summaryType)

		}

			summaryItemBase.SummaryType = summaryType;
			return summaryItemBase;
		}

		}

		List<string> ISummaryItemsOwner.GetFieldNames()
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in view.DataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if (PassesSummaryLimitations(item) && CanBeUsedInSummary(item))
				{
					list.Add(item.FieldName);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal virtual bool PassesSummaryLimitations(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return true;
		}

		}

		List<ISummaryItem> ISummaryItemsOwner.GetItems()
		{
			List<ISummaryItem> list = new List<ISummaryItem>();
			foreach (SummaryItemBase summaryItem in SummaryItems)
			{
				if (CanUseSummaryItem((ISummaryItem)(object)summaryItem))
				{
					list.Add((ISummaryItem)(object)summaryItem);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanUseSummaryItem(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.FieldName);
		}

		{
			return view.GetColumnType(view.DataControl.ColumnsCore[fieldName]);
		}

		{
			SetItemsCore(items);
		}

		string IGridSummaryItemsOwner.FormatSummaryItemCaption(ISummaryItem item, string defaultCaption)
		{
			return view.FormatSummaryItemCaptionInSummaryEditor(item, defaultCaption);
		}

		private SummaryItemBase FindSummaryItem(SummaryItemBase item, ISummaryItemOwner list)
		{
			foreach (SummaryItemBase item2 in list)
			{
				if (AreItemsEqual(item2, item))
				{
					return item2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void SetItemsCore(List<ISummaryItem> items)
		{
			try
			{
				SummaryItems.BeginUpdate();
				foreach (SummaryItemBase summaryItem in SummaryItems)
				{
					if (CanUseSummaryItem((ISummaryItem)(object)summaryItem))
					{
						summaryItem.Visible = false;
					}
				}
				foreach (SummaryItemBase item in items)
				{
					SummaryItemBase summaryItemBase = FindSummaryItem(item, SummaryItems);
					if (summaryItemBase == null)
					{
						SummaryItems.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					SummaryItems.Remove(summaryItemBase);
					SummaryItems.Add(summaryItemBase);
					summaryItemBase.Visible = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				SummaryItems.EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool AreItemsEqual(SummaryItemBase item1, SummaryItemBase item2)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (item1.FieldName == item2.FieldName && item1.SummaryType == item2.SummaryType && item1.Alignment == item2.Alignment)
			{
				return item1.ShowInColumn == item2.ShowInColumn;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract string GetEditorTitle();

				ShowSummaryEditor();
			}
			else

			}
		}

			});
		}

			if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.OK)

			}
		}

		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ThemedWindow val = new ThemedWindow();

			val.ControlBoxButtonSet = (ControlBoxButtons)1;

			((Window)(object)val).WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterOwner;
			((Window)(object)val).SizeToContent = SizeToContent.WidthAndHeight;
			((Window)(object)val).Owner = Window.GetWindow(view);
			return val;
		}
