	public class GridTotalSummaryHelper : GridSummaryHelper
	{
		private readonly Func<ColumnBase> getColumn;

		protected ColumnBase Column => getColumn();

		protected override ISummaryItemOwner SummaryItems => view.DataControl.DataProviderBase.TotalSummaryCore;

		public GridTotalSummaryHelper(DataViewBase view, Func<ColumnBase> getColumn)
			: base(view)
		{
			this.getColumn = getColumn;
		}

		protected override string GetEditorTitle()
		{
			return string.Format(view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.TotalSummaryEditorFormCaption), Column.HeaderCaption.ToString());
		}

		protected internal override bool CanUseSummaryItem(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			SummaryItemBase summaryItemBase = item as SummaryItemBase;
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryItemBase.ShowInColumn);
			if (item.FieldName != Column.FieldName && flag && summaryItemBase.ShowInColumn == Column.FieldName)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (item.FieldName == Column.FieldName && flag && summaryItemBase.ShowInColumn != Column.FieldName)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return item.FieldName == Column.FieldName;
		}

		protected override SummaryItemBase CreateItemCore(string fieldName, SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SummaryItemBase summaryItemBase = base.CreateItemCore(fieldName, summaryType);
			InitializeSummaryItemCore(summaryItemBase);
			return summaryItemBase;
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeSummaryItemCore(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			item.ShowInColumn = Column.FieldName;
		}

		public override bool IsSummaryItemExists(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			return view.DataProviderBase.IsSummaryItemExists(SummaryItemCollectionType.Total, (SummaryItemBase)(object)item);
		}

		internal override bool PassesSummaryLimitations(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!view.ActualAllowCountTotalSummary)
			{
				return column.ActualAllowTotalSummary();
			}
			return true;
		}
	}

		protected override bool AreItemsEqual(SummaryItemBase item1, SummaryItemBase item2)

		public override void RemoveSummary(string fieldName, SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)summaryType != 3)
			{
				((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).RemoveSummary(fieldName, summaryType);
				return;
			}
			IList<ISummaryItem> list = FindSummaryItems(summaryType, ((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).Items);
			foreach (ISummaryItem item in list)
			{
				((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).Items.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public override void AddSummary(string fieldName, SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)summaryType != 3)
			{
				base.AddSummary(fieldName, summaryType);
			}
			else
			{
				if (FindSummaryItems(summaryType, ((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).Items).Count != 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				IList<ISummaryItem> list = FindSummaryItems(summaryType, ((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).InitialItems);
				foreach (ISummaryItem item in list)
				{
					((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).Items.Add(item);
				}
				if (list.Count == 0)
				{
					((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).Items.Add(((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).ItemsOwner.CreateItem(fieldName, summaryType));
				}
			}
		}

		private IList<ISummaryItem> FindSummaryItems(SummaryItemType summaryType, List<ISummaryItem> list)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IList<ISummaryItem> list2 = new List<ISummaryItem>();
			foreach (IAlignmentItem item in list)
			{
				if (((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).TestItemAlignment((ISummaryItem)item) && ((ISummaryItem)item).SummaryType == summaryType && ((SummaryItemsEditorController)this).IsGroupSummaryItem((ISummaryItem)item))
				{
					list2.Add((ISummaryItem)item);
				}
			}
			return list2;
		}

				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			foreach (UIElement child in summaryTypePanel.Children)

		private void UpdateOrderItems()
		{
			displayFormatControl.CurrentDisplayFormat = null;
			List<SummaryEditorOrderUIItem> orderItems = ((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).CreateOrderItems();
			if (SummaryEditorType != SummaryEditorType.TotalSummaryPanel)
			{

				return;
			}

			orderListRight.ItemsSource = orderListHelper.GetOrderListSource(orderItems, GridSummaryItemAlignment.Right);
		}

		private void OnMoveButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			SummaryEditorOrderUIItem activeOrderUIItem = ActiveOrderUIItem;
			ListBox listBox = (orderList.Items.Contains(activeOrderUIItem) ? orderList : orderListRight);
			int num = listBox.Items.IndexOf(activeOrderUIItem);
			if (activeOrderUIItem != null)
			{
				Button button = sender as Button;
				if (button == upButton)
				{
					activeOrderUIItem.MoveUp();
					num--;
				}
				else
				{
					activeOrderUIItem.MoveDown();
					num++;
				}
				UpdateOrderItems();
				UpdateButtonsState();
				listBox.SelectedIndex = num;
				listBox.ScrollIntoView(listBox.Items[num]);
			}
		}

		internal void OnAlignmentButtonClick(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ActiveOrderUIItem != null)
			{
				GridSummaryItemAlignment gridSummaryItemAlignment = ((sender == leftButton) ? GridSummaryItemAlignment.Left : GridSummaryItemAlignment.Right);
				if (orderListHelper.GetSummaryItemAlignment(ActiveOrderUIItem.Item) != gridSummaryItemAlignment)
				{
					orderListHelper.SetSummaryItemAlignment(ActiveOrderUIItem.Item, gridSummaryItemAlignment);
					ListBox listBox = ((sender == leftButton) ? orderListRight : orderList);
					int selectedIndex = listBox.SelectedIndex;
					UpdateOrderItems();
					SetOrderlistSelectedIndex(listBox, selectedIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetOrderlistSelectedIndex(ListBox list, int index)
		{
			list.SelectedIndex = ((index < list.Items.Count) ? index : (list.Items.Count - 1));
		}

		private void OnOrderListSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			displayFormatControl.CurrentDisplayFormat = null;
			UpdateButtonsState();
			if (e.AddedItems.Count != 0)
			{
				if (sender == orderList)
				{
					orderListRight.SelectedItem = null;
				}
				else
				{
					orderList.SelectedItem = null;
				}
				ISummaryItem item = ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)e.AddedItems[0]).Item;
				SetCurrentDisplayFormat(item);
			}
		}

		private SummaryEditorOrderUIItem GetActiveOrderUIItem()

		private void UpdateButtonsState()
		{
			leftButton.IsEnabled = false;
			rightButton.IsEnabled = false;
			if (ActiveOrderUIItem == null)
			{
				upButton.IsEnabled = false;
				downButton.IsEnabled = false;
				return;
			}
			upButton.IsEnabled = ActiveOrderUIItem.CanUp;
			downButton.IsEnabled = ActiveOrderUIItem.CanDown;
			if (orderList.Items.Contains(ActiveOrderUIItem))
			{
				rightButton.IsEnabled = true;
			}
			if (orderListRight.Items.Contains(ActiveOrderUIItem))
			{
				leftButton.IsEnabled = true;
			}
		}

		private Visibility GetAlignmentListBoxVisibility(IList addedItems)

		private void ApplyDisplayFormats()
		{

		}

		private Type GetColumnValueType(SummaryItemBase item)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)item.SummaryType == 3 || string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.FieldName))

		}

		private void displayFormatControl_CurrentDisplayFormatChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ActiveOrderUIItem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ISummaryItem item = ActiveOrderUIItem.Item;
			string text = (string)e.NewValue;
			if (item.DisplayFormat == text)
			{
				if (displayFormatListSource.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					displayFormatListSource.Remove(item);
				}
			}
			else if (displayFormatListSource.ContainsKey(item))
			{
				displayFormatListSource[item] = text;
			}
			else
			{
				displayFormatListSource.Add(item, text);
			}
		}

		private void SetCurrentDisplayFormat(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			displayFormatControl.NullValueDisplayFormat = GetNullValueDisplayFormat(item);
			displayFormatControl.SecondParameterName = item.FieldName;
			displayFormatControl.HeaderName = GetHeaderText(item);
			displayFormatControl.SourceValueType = GetColumnValueType((SummaryItemBase)(object)item);
			displayFormatControl.CurrentDisplayFormat = (displayFormatListSource.ContainsKey(item) ? displayFormatListSource[item] : item.DisplayFormat);
		}

		internal string GetNullValueDisplayFormat(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			string nullValueDisplayFormatFromColumn = GetNullValueDisplayFormatFromColumn(item);
			string displayFormatEditSettigsModifier = GetDisplayFormatEditSettigsModifier(item);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayFormatEditSettigsModifier))
			{
				return nullValueDisplayFormatFromColumn;
			}
			return string.Format(string.Format(nullValueDisplayFormatFromColumn, "{0}", "{1}"), displayFormatEditSettigsModifier, "{1}");
		}

		private string GetNullValueDisplayFormatFromColumn(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is SummaryItemBase summaryItemBase))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			switch (SummaryEditorType)
			{
			case SummaryEditorType.TotalSummaryPanel:
				return summaryItemBase.GetFooterDisplayFormat(SummaryItemBase.ColumnSummaryType.Total);
			case SummaryEditorType.GroupSummary:
				return summaryItemBase.GetGroupDisplayFormat();
			default:
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(summaryItemBase.FieldName) || summaryItemBase.ActualShowInColumn == summaryItemBase.FieldName)
				{
					return summaryItemBase.GetFooterDisplayFormatSameColumn(SummaryItemBase.ColumnSummaryType.Group);
				}
				return summaryItemBase.GetFooterDisplayFormat(SummaryItemBase.ColumnSummaryType.Group);
			}
		}

		private string GetDisplayFormatEditSettigsModifier(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			if (View == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = View.ColumnsCore[item.FieldName];
			if (columnBase == null || columnBase.ActualEditSettings == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return columnBase.DisplayFormat;
		}

		private string GetHeaderText(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			return (View?.ColumnsCore[item.FieldName])?.Header as string;
		}

	public class AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem : SummaryEditorOrderUIItem
	{
		private SummaryEditorOrderListHelper orderHelper;

		public AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem(SummaryItemsEditorController controller, SummaryEditorOrderListHelper orderHelper, IAlignmentItem item, string caption)
			: base(controller, (ISummaryItem)item, caption)
		{
			this.orderHelper = orderHelper;
		}

		protected override bool IsCanUp()
		{
			return GetPreviousIndex() >= 0;
		}

		protected override bool IsCanDown()
		{
			return GetNextIndex() < ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items.Count;
		}

		private int GetPreviousIndex()
		{
			GridSummaryItemAlignment value = orderHelper.GetSummaryItemAlignment(((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Item).Value;
			for (int num = ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Index - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (orderHelper.GetSummaryItemAlignment(((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[num]) == value)
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetNextIndex()
		{
			GridSummaryItemAlignment value = orderHelper.GetSummaryItemAlignment(((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Item).Value;
			for (int i = ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Index + 1; i < ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				if (orderHelper.GetSummaryItemAlignment(((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[i]) == value)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items.Count;
		}

		public override void MoveUp()
		{
			if (((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).CanUp)
			{
				InterchangeItems(GetPreviousIndex());
			}
		}

		public override void MoveDown()
		{
			if (((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).CanDown)
			{
				InterchangeItems(GetNextIndex());
			}
		}

		private void InterchangeItems(int prevIndex)
		{
			ISummaryItem value = ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Index];
			((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Index] = ((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[prevIndex];
			((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)this).Controller.Items[prevIndex] = value;
		}
	}

	public class SummaryEditorOrderListHelper
	{
		private Dictionary<IAlignmentItem, GridSummaryItemAlignment> alignmentListSource = new Dictionary<IAlignmentItem, GridSummaryItemAlignment>();

		private GridSummaryItemsEditorController Controller { get; set; }

		public SummaryEditorOrderListHelper(GridSummaryItemsEditorController controller)
		{
			Controller = controller;
		}

		public List<AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem> GetOrderListSource(List<SummaryEditorOrderUIItem> orderItems)
		{
			Dictionary<IAlignmentItem, GridSummaryItemAlignment> dictionary = new Dictionary<IAlignmentItem, GridSummaryItemAlignment>();
			List<AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem> list = new List<AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem>();
			foreach (SummaryEditorOrderUIItem orderItem in orderItems)
			{
				if (!alignmentListSource.TryGetValue((IAlignmentItem)orderItem.Item, out var value))
				{
					value = ((IAlignmentItem)orderItem.Item).Alignment;
				}
				list.Add(new AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem((SummaryItemsEditorController)(object)Controller, this, (IAlignmentItem)orderItem.Item, orderItem.Caption));
				dictionary.Add((IAlignmentItem)orderItem.Item, value);
			}
			alignmentListSource = dictionary;
			return list;
		}

		public List<AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem> GetOrderListSource(List<SummaryEditorOrderUIItem> orderItems, GridSummaryItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			List<AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem> orderListSource = GetOrderListSource(orderItems);
			return orderListSource.Where((AlignmentSummaryEditorOrderUIItem item) => GetSummaryItemAlignment(((SummaryEditorOrderUIItem)item).Item) == alignment).ToList();
		}

		public void ApplyAlignments()
		{
			foreach (ISummaryItem item in ((SummaryItemsEditorController)Controller).Items)
			{
				if (item is IAlignmentItem alignmentItem && alignmentListSource.ContainsKey(alignmentItem))
				{
					alignmentItem.Alignment = alignmentListSource[alignmentItem];
				}
			}
		}

		public void SetSummaryItemAlignment(ISummaryItem item, GridSummaryItemAlignment alignment)
		{
			if (!(item is IAlignmentItem alignmentItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IAlignmentItem key in alignmentListSource.Keys)
			{
				if (key == alignmentItem)
				{
					alignmentListSource[key] = alignment;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public GridSummaryItemAlignment? GetSummaryItemAlignment(ISummaryItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is IAlignmentItem alignmentItem))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (IAlignmentItem key in alignmentListSource.Keys)
			{
				if (key == alignmentItem)
				{
					return alignmentListSource[key];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool TryGetAlignment(IAlignmentItem alignmentItem, out GridSummaryItemAlignment actualItemAlignment)
		{
			if (!alignmentListSource.TryGetValue(alignmentItem, out actualItemAlignment))
			{
				actualItemAlignment = alignmentItem.Alignment;
				return true;
			}
			actualItemAlignment = GridSummaryItemAlignment.Default;
			return false;
		}
	}

		internal abstract BandBase ParentBandInternal { get; }

		internal BandRow BandRow { get; set; }

		protected internal virtual bool CanStartDragSingleColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (View == null || View.DataControl == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ShowBandsPanel)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (View.IsLastVisibleColumn(this))
				{
					return View.CanStartDragSingleColumn();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsLastVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (View == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return View.IsLastVisibleColumn(this);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsBand => false;

		protected internal virtual bool AllowChangeParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowChangeColumnParent;
			}
		}

		private static object OnMinWidthChanging(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if ((double)value < 5.0)
			{
				return 5.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private void OnMinWidthChanginged()
		{
			OnLayoutPropertyChanged();
			HeaderWidthChanged();
		}

		private GridColumnWidth OnWidthChanging(GridColumnWidth value)
		{
			if (value == Width && (Width.Value != ActualWidth || Width.Value != ColumnWidth || value != ActualHeaderWidth))
			{
				OnWidthChanged(Width);
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(value.Value))
			{
				return new GridColumnWidth(120.0);
			}
			if (value.IsAbsolute)
			{
				return new GridColumnWidth(Math.Min(Math.Max(MinWidth, value.Value), MaxWidth));
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected virtual void OnWidthChanged(GridColumnWidth oldValue)
		{
			if (Width.IsStar)
			{
				ActualWidth = Width.Value * ColumnWidth / oldValue.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualWidth = Width.Value;
			}
			ForcedWidth = double.NaN;
			OnLayoutPropertyChanged();
			WidthCore = Width;
		}

		private static object CoerceHorizontalHeaderContentAlignment(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)(object)d;
			if (baseColumn.Visible)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return HorizontalAlignment.Left;
		}

		public BaseColumn()
		{
			instance_number = instance_counter++;
			HeaderWidth = double.NaN;
			ForcedWidth = double.NaN;

		protected object GetFormattedHeader()
		{
			object header = Header;
			if (header == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseColumn baseColumn = GetOriginationColumn() ?? this;
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = ((FrameworkContentElement)(object)baseColumn).GetBindingExpression(HeaderProperty);
			if (bindingExpression != null && bindingExpression.ParentBinding != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bindingExpression.ParentBinding.StringFormat))
			{
				return FormatStringConverter.GetFormattedValue(bindingExpression.ParentBinding.StringFormat, header, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}
			return header;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
			DataControlBase notifySourceControl = GetNotifySourceControl();
			if (notifySourceControl != null && !notifySourceControl.LockUpdateLayout && ShouldCloneProperty(e.Property))
			{
				Func<DataControlBase, DependencyObject> getTarget = (Func<DataControlBase, DependencyObject>)(object)CreateCloneAccessor();
				notifySourceControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement().NotifyPropertyChanged(notifySourceControl, e.Property, getTarget, typeof(BaseColumn));
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldCloneProperty(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			if ((property == VisibleIndexProperty || property == ActualVisibleIndexProperty) && View != null && !View.IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout && View.IsApplyingVisibleIndex)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected double ValidateActualSeparatorWidth(double val, bool right = true)
		{
			if (right)
			{
				if (!HasRightSibling)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return val;
			}
			if (!HasLeftSibling)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool OnBandSeparatorChanged()
		{
			ActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = 0.0;
			ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = 0.0;
			ActualBandCellRightSeparatorColor = null;
			ActualBandHeaderRightSeparatorColor = null;
			ActualBandCellLeftSeparatorColor = null;
			ActualBandHeaderLeftSeparatorColor = null;
			return false;
		}

		}

		internal bool CheckAndUpdateBandSeparatorWidth()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (OldActualBandRightSeparatorWidth != ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore)
			{
				OldActualBandRightSeparatorWidth = ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (OldActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth != ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore)
			{
				OldActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth = ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (!flag && !(ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0))
			{
				return ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static double CoerceBestFitWidth(double baseValue)
		{
			return Math.Max(baseValue, 0.0);
		}

		internal BandBase GetRootParentBand()
		{
			BandBase parentBand = ParentBand;
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			while (parentBand.ParentBand != null)
			{
				parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand;
			}
			return parentBand;
		}

		{
			OnBandSeparatorChanged();
		}

		}

		{
			SetHeaderCaption();
		}

		{
		}

	public class ColumnChooserDropTarget : IDropTarget
	{
		internal static void DropColumnCore(UIElement source)
		{
			if (source is ColumnChooserControlBase || IsForbiddenUngroupGesture(source))
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseColumn column = GetColumn(source);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader = BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(source);
			if (headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel || column.CanStartDragSingleColumn)
			{
				column.View.BeforeMoveColumnToChooser(column, headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader);
				if (!column.View.IsLastVisibleColumn(column) || column.View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
				{
					column.Visible = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsForbiddenUngroupGesture(UIElement source)
		{
			return (GetColumn(source) as ColumnBase).Return((ColumnBase c) => !c.CanBeGroupedByDataControlOwner() && GetHeaderPresenterType(source) == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel, () => false);
		}

		private static HeaderPresenterType GetHeaderPresenterType(UIElement source)
		{
			return BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(source);
		}

		private static BaseColumn GetColumn(UIElement source)
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(source);
			BaseColumn columnFromDragSource = DropTargetHelper.GetColumnFromDragSource((FrameworkElement)source);
			if (dataViewBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnFromDragSource;
		}

		internal void DropColumn(UIElement source)
		{
			DropColumnCore(source);
		}

		public void Drop(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			DropColumn(source);
		}

		public void OnDragLeave()
		{
		}

		public void OnDragOver(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
		}
	}

	internal class ColumnChooserCaptionLocalizationStringConvertor : IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly DataViewBase view;

		public ColumnChooserCaptionLocalizationStringConvertor(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is LocalizationDescriptor localizationDescriptor))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (view.DataControl.AllowBandChooser)
			{
				return localizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.ColumnBandChooserCaption.ToString());
			}
			if (view.DetailHeaderContent != null)
			{
				return string.Format(localizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.ColumnChooserCaptionForMasterDetail.ToString()), view.DetailHeaderContent);
			}
			return localizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlRuntimeStringId.ColumnChooserCaption.ToString());
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	public class DefaultColumnChooser : ColumnChooserBase
	{
		protected DataViewBase View => (DataViewBase)(object)((ColumnChooserBase)this).Owner;

		protected override ILogicalOwner Owner => (ILogicalOwner)(object)View.RootView;

		public DefaultColumnChooser(DataViewBase view)
			: base((ILogicalOwner)(object)view)
		{
			UpdateCaption();
		}

		protected override Control CreateContentControl()
		{
			Control control = ((ColumnChooserBase)this).CreateContentControl();
			DataControlBase.SetCurrentViewInternal(control, View);
			string name = DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.ActualColumnChooserTemplateProperty);
			control.SetBinding(Control.TemplateProperty, new Binding(name)
			{
				Source = View
			});
			return control;
		}

		protected override void OnContainerHidden(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			View.IsColumnChooserVisible = false;
		}

		internal void UpdateCaption()
		{
			BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ColumnChooserBase.CaptionProperty, new Binding("LocalizationDescriptor")
			{
				Source = View,
				Converter = new ColumnChooserCaptionLocalizationStringConvertor(View)
			});
		}

		protected override void DestroyContentControl()
		{
			((ColumnChooserBase)this).DestroyContentControl();
			if (((ContentControl)(object)((ColumnChooserBase)this).Container).Content is Control element)
			{
				DataControlBase.SetCurrentViewInternal(element, null);
			}
		}

		internal void DestroyBase(bool force)
		{
			((ColumnChooserBase)this).Destroy(force);
		}
	}

	public interface IColumnCollection : IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged, ILockable, ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>
	{
		DataControlBase Owner { get; }

		ColumnBase this[string fieldName] { get; }

		new ColumnBase this[int index] { get; }

		void OnColumnsChanged();

		ColumnBase GetColumnByName(string name);
	}
	public abstract class ColumnCollectionBase<TColumn> : ObservableCollectionCore<TColumn>, IColumnCollection, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, INotifyCollectionChanged, ILockable, ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase> where TColumn : ColumnBase
	{
		private readonly DataControlBase owner;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, TColumn> fieldsNameCache = new Dictionary<string, TColumn>();

		private Dictionary<string, TColumn> FieldsNameCache => fieldsNameCache;

		public TColumn this[string fieldName] => GetColumnByFieldName(fieldName);

		DataControlBase IColumnCollection.Owner => owner;

		ColumnBase IColumnCollection.this[string fieldName] => this[fieldName];

		ColumnBase IColumnCollection.this[int index] => ((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this)[index];

		public ColumnCollectionBase(DataControlBase owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public TColumn GetColumnByName(string name)
		{
			return ListHelper.Find<TColumn>((IList<TColumn>)this, (Predicate<TColumn>)((TColumn column) => column.Name == name));
		}

		public TColumn GetColumnByFieldName(string fieldName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName) || ((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this).Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!fieldsNameCache.TryGetValue(fieldName, out var value))
			{
				foreach (TColumn item in (Collection<TColumn>)(object)this)
				{
					if (item.FieldName == fieldName)
					{
						fieldsNameCache.Add(fieldName, item);
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected void ResetColumnsByFieldsNameCache()
		{
			fieldsNameCache.Clear();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, TColumn item)
		{
			item.InsertLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				OnInsertItem(item);
				owner.OnColumnAdding(item);
				((ObservableCollection<TColumn>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
			});
			owner.OnColumnAdded(item);
			item.UpdateAutoFilterInitialized();
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			TColumn column = ((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this)[index];
			OnRemoveItem(column);
			ResetColumnsByFieldsNameCache();
			((ObservableCollection<TColumn>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
			owner.OnColumnRemoved(column);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, TColumn item)
		{
			ResetColumnsByFieldsNameCache();
			((ObservableCollection<TColumn>)(object)this).SetItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this).Count; i++)
			{
				OnRemoveItem(((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this)[i]);
			}
			((ObservableCollection<TColumn>)(object)this).ClearItems();
			ResetColumnsByFieldsNameCache();
			owner.OnClearColumns();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRemoveItem(TColumn column)
		{
			column.ClearBindingValues();
			column.OwnerControl = null;
			owner.RemoveChild((FrameworkContentElement)(object)column);
		}

		protected virtual void OnInsertItem(TColumn column)
		{
			owner.AddChild((FrameworkContentElement)(object)column);
			column.OwnerControl = owner;
		}

		public override void EndUpdate()
		{
			base.EndUpdate();
			owner.OnColumnCollectionEndUpdate();
		}

		void IColumnCollection.OnColumnsChanged()
		{
			ResetColumnsByFieldsNameCache();
			((ObservableCollection<TColumn>)(object)this).OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		ColumnBase IColumnCollection.GetColumnByName(string name)
		{
			return GetColumnByName(name);
		}

		int ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>.GetCachedIndex(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return base.GetCachedIndex((TColumn)column);
		}

		public void AddRange(IEnumerable<TColumn> columns)
		{
			if (columns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<TColumn>)this).BeginUpdate();
			foreach (TColumn column in columns)
			{
				((Collection<TColumn>)(object)this).Add(column);
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<TColumn>)this).EndUpdate();
		}
	}

		}

	public abstract class ColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		private PopupBaseEdit currentPopup;

		public ColumnBase Column { get; private set; }

		protected DataViewBase View => Column.Owner as DataViewBase;

		protected virtual bool ImmediateUpdateFilter => Column.ImmediateUpdateColumnFilter;

		protected virtual bool AddNullItem => false;

		protected virtual bool ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering => View.DataControl.ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering;

		protected virtual bool RoundDateTimeValues => Column.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter;

		protected bool IsVirtualSource => GetIsVirtualSource();

		protected virtual bool GetIsVirtualSource()
		{
			if (View == null || View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource;
		}

		public ColumnFilterInfoBase(ColumnBase column)
		{
			Column = column;
		}

		internal void UpdateCurrentPopupData(object[] values)
		{
			if (currentPopup != null)
			{
				UpdatePopupData(currentPopup, values);
			}
		}

		internal void OnPopupOpening(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			View.IsColumnFilterLoaded = false;
			View.IsColumnFilterOpened = true;
			currentPopup = popup;
			UpdatePopupData(popup);
			UpdatePopupButtonsVisibility(popup);
			UpdateSizeGripVisibility(popup);
			RaiseFilterPopupEvent(popup);
			AfterPopupOpening(popup);
			View.IsColumnFilterLoaded = true;
		}

		internal void OnPopupOpened(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			View.KeyboardLocker.Lock();
			OnPopupOpenedCore(popup);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPopupOpenedCore(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
		}

		internal virtual void OnPopupClosed(PopupBaseEdit popup, bool applyFilter)
		{
			View.IsColumnFilterOpened = false;
			if (applyFilter && !ImmediateUpdateFilter)
			{
				ApplyDelayedFilter();
			}
			ClearPopupData(popup);
			currentPopup = null;
			View.KeyboardLocker.Unlock();
			if (View.DataControl.GetRootDataControl().IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				View.SetFocusToRowCell();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyDelayedFilter()
		{
			ApplyFilter(GetFilterCriteriaCore(), updateImmediately: false);
		}

		protected virtual void AfterPopupOpening(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseFilterPopupEvent(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.RaiseFilterPopupEvent(Column, popup, new Lazy<ExcelColumnFilterSettings>(GetExcelColumnCustomFilterSettings));
			}
		}

		protected virtual ExcelColumnFilterSettings GetExcelColumnCustomFilterSettings()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColumnFilterIfNeeded(Func<CriteriaOperator> getOperator)
		{
			if (ImmediateUpdateFilter && View != null && View.KeyboardLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				ApplyFilter(getOperator(), updateImmediately: true);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyFilter(CriteriaOperator op, bool updateImmediately)
		{
			if (updateImmediately)
			{
				Column.ApplyColumnFilter(op);
			}
			else if (View != null)
			{
				View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					Column.ApplyColumnFilter(op);
				});
			}
		}

		internal abstract PopupBaseEdit CreateColumnFilterPopup();

		protected abstract void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup);

		protected virtual void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup, object[] values)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdatePopupButtonsVisibility(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			popup.PopupFooterButtons = ShowButtons();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSizeGripVisibility(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			popup.ShowSizeGrip = true;
		}

		protected virtual PopupFooterButtons ShowButtons()
		{
			if (!ImmediateUpdateFilter)
			{
				return (PopupFooterButtons)1;
			}
			return (PopupFooterButtons)0;
		}

		protected virtual CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteriaCore()
		{
			return GetFilterCriteria();
		}

		protected internal abstract CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria();

		protected abstract void ClearPopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup);

		protected internal virtual IEnumerable GetSelectedItems(IEnumerable items, CriteriaOperator op)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIsNullableColumn()
		{
			Type fieldType = Column.FieldType;
			if (Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(fieldType) != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (fieldType.IsValueType)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDateTimeColumn()
		{
			return SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsDateTime(Column.FieldType);
		}

		public abstract bool CanShowFilterPopup();
	}

	public abstract class ListColumnFilterInfoBase : ColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		protected bool EmptyIncluded { get; set; }

		protected bool IsColumnFilterItemsLoading { get; set; }

		protected abstract bool CalcColumnCriteriaOperator { get; }

		protected bool IsWaitingAsyncData(object[] values)
		{
			if (values.Length != 0)
			{
				return AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(values[0]);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public ListColumnFilterInfoBase(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
		}

		protected virtual CriteriaOperator GetColumnCriteriaOperator()
		{
			if (!CalcColumnCriteriaOperator || base.Column.GetShowAllTableValuesInFilterPopup())
			{
				return null;
			}
			CriteriaOperator val = (base.View.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource ? base.View.DataControl.ExtraFilter : null);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<OperandProperty, CriteriaOperator> item in CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnsWithOptionalLegacyFallback(base.View.DataControl.GetActualFilterCriteria()))
			{
				string propertyName = item.Key.PropertyName;
				ColumnBase columnBase = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName)) ? base.View.DataControl.ColumnsCore[item.Key.PropertyName] : null);
				if (columnBase == null || columnBase != base.Column)
				{
					val = CriteriaOperator.And(val, item.Value);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual object[] GetColumnFilterValues(bool includeFilteredOut, bool roundDateTimeValues, bool implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering)
		{
			if (!AllowColumnFilterValues())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.View.DataControl.GetUniqueColumnValues(base.Column, includeFilteredOut, roundDateTimeValues, base.View.DataControl.GetColumnFilterCriteria(base.Column), implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, GetColumnCriteriaOperator());
		}

		protected abstract bool AllowColumnFilterValues();

		protected virtual bool AllowImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering(bool implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering)
		{
			return implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering;
		}

		protected internal IList GetColumnFilterItems(object[] values, Func<IList> createFilterList, Action<object[]> sortAction, bool includeFilteredOut, bool roundDateTimeValues, bool implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, bool addNullItem, out bool isColumnFilterItemsLoading)
		{
			isColumnFilterItemsLoading = false;
			IList list = createFilterList();
			AddMRUItemsToList(list);
			foreach (object defaultItem in GetDefaultItems(base.Column.IsFiltered))
			{
				list.Add(defaultItem);
			}
			if (base.View == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (values == null)
			{
				values = GetColumnFilterValues(includeFilteredOut, roundDateTimeValues, implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering);
			}
			if (values == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (IsWaitingAsyncData(values) && !base.Column.IsAsyncLookup)
			{
				isColumnFilterItemsLoading = true;
				return list;
			}
			sortAction?.Invoke(values);
			int num = 0;
			object[] array = values;
			foreach (object obj in array)
			{
				if (num == base.Column.ColumnFilterPopupMaxRecordsCount)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (ShouldIncludeItem(obj, implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, addNullItem))
				{
					list.Add(obj);
					num++;
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected abstract void ShowWaitIndicator(IList list);

		protected internal virtual object GetItem(ColumnFilterComboBoxEditHelper comboBoxHelper, object value, bool implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering)
		{
			if (implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering && (value == null || value is DBNull))
			{
				value = string.Empty;
			}
			if (base.Column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
			{
				return new CustomComboBoxItem
				{
					EditValue = value,
					DisplayValue = value
				};
			}
			if (GetComboBoxItem(comboBoxHelper, value, out var item))
			{
				return item;
			}
			return new CustomComboBoxItem
			{
				EditValue = value,
				DisplayValue = GetComboBoxItemDisplayValue(value)
			};
		}

		private string GetComboBoxItemDisplayValue(object value)
		{
			if (base.Column.IsAsyncLookup)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (IsDateTimeColumn() && RoundDateTimeValues && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Column.RoundDateDisplayFormat))
			{
				return string.Format(FormatStringConverter.GetDisplayFormat(base.Column.RoundDateDisplayFormat), value);
			}
			return base.View.GetColumnDisplayText(value, base.Column);
		}

		protected bool GetComboBoxItem(ColumnFilterComboBoxEditHelper comboBoxHelper, object value, out object item)
		{
			item = null;
			if (comboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEditSettings != null)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((LookUpEditSettingsBase)comboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEditSettings).ValueMember) || EnumItemsSource.IsEnumItemsSource(((LookUpEditSettingsBase)comboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEditSettings).ItemsSource))
				{
					item = ((LookUpEditSettingsBase)comboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEditSettings).GetItemFromValue(value);
					return true;
				}
				if (((LookUpEditSettingsBase)comboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEditSettings).ItemTemplate != null)
				{
					item = value;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual IList CreateFilterList()
		{
			return new List<object>();
		}

		protected virtual void AddMRUItemsToList(IList list)
		{
		}

		protected virtual List<object> GetDefaultItems(bool addShowAllItem)
		{
			return new List<object>();
		}

		protected virtual bool GetIncludeFilteredOut()
		{
			return ColumnFilterInfoHelper.GetIncludeFilteredOut(base.Column);
		}

		protected virtual void SortColumnFilterItems(object[] values)
		{
			EmptyIncluded = false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldIncludeItem(object item, bool implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, bool addNullItem)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return addNullItem;
			}
			string editValueString = GetEditValueString(item);
			if (editValueString != null)
			{
				if (implyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering && editValueString == string.Empty)
				{
					if (EmptyIncluded)
					{
						return false;
					}
					EmptyIncluded = true;
					return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedUnaryFilters.IsNullOrEmpty);
				}
				if (editValueString == string.Empty && base.Column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract string GetEditValueString(object item);
	}
	public class ListColumnFilterInfo : ListColumnFilterInfoBase
	{
		protected override bool ImmediateUpdateFilter => false;

		protected List<CustomComboBoxItem> ColumnMRUFilters { get; set; }

		protected ColumnFilterComboBoxEditHelper ComboBoxHelper { get; private set; }

		protected override bool CalcColumnCriteriaOperator => base.View.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource;

		internal virtual void AddColumnMRUFilter(CustomComboBoxItem filter)
		{
			if (filter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = ColumnMRUFilters.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (AreCustomItemsEquals(ColumnMRUFilters[num], filter))
				{
					ColumnMRUFilters.Remove(ColumnMRUFilters[num]);
				}
			}
			ColumnMRUFilters.Insert(0, filter);
			if (ColumnMRUFilters.Count > base.View.DataControl.MRUColumnFilterListCount + 1)
			{
				ColumnMRUFilters.RemoveAt(base.View.DataControl.MRUColumnFilterListCount + 1);
			}
		}

		private void ClearColumnMRUFilter()
		{
			ColumnMRUFilters.Clear();
		}

		private void TruncateColumnMRUFilterToMaxCount()
		{
			for (int i = base.View.DataControl.MRUColumnFilterListCount + 1; i < ColumnMRUFilters.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnMRUFilters.RemoveAt(i);
			}
		}

		internal override void OnPopupClosed(PopupBaseEdit popup, bool applyFilter)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (applyFilter && !ImmediateUpdateFilter)
			{
				CustomComboBoxItem customComboBoxItem = ((LookUpEditBase)(ComboBoxEdit)popup).SelectedItem as CustomComboBoxItem;
				if (!CheckIsItemDefault(customComboBoxItem))
				{
					AddColumnMRUFilter(customComboBoxItem);
				}
			}
			base.OnPopupClosed(popup, applyFilter);
		}

		protected override PopupFooterButtons ShowButtons()
		{
			return (PopupFooterButtons)0;
		}

		internal override PopupBaseEdit CreateColumnFilterPopup()
		{
			ComboBoxHelper = new ColumnFilterComboBoxEditHelper(base.Column);
			ComboBoxHelper.CreateComboBoxEdit(SetupComboBox);
			return (PopupBaseEdit)(object)ComboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEdit;
		}

		protected virtual void SetupComboBox(ComboBoxEdit comboBoxEdit)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).StyleSettings = (BaseEditStyleSettings)new ComboBoxStyleSettings();
			((BaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).ShowNullText = false;
			((ButtonEdit)comboBoxEdit).IsTextEditable = false;
			((LookUpEditBase)comboBoxEdit).AutoComplete = true;
			((PopupBaseEdit)comboBoxEdit).FocusPopupOnOpen = false;
		}

		public ListColumnFilterInfo(ColumnBase column)
			: base(column)
		{
			ColumnMRUFilters = new List<CustomComboBoxItem>();
		}

		protected override bool AllowColumnFilterValues()
		{
			return base.Column.AllowFilter(AllowedBinaryFilters.Equals);
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
			UpdatePopupData(popup, null);
		}

		protected override void UpdatePopupData(PopupBaseEdit popup, object[] values)
		{
			bool isColumnFilterItemsLoading = false;
			IList columnFilterItems = GetColumnFilterItems(values, CreateFilterList, SortColumnFilterItems, GetIncludeFilteredOut(), RoundDateTimeValues, ImplyNullLikeEmptyStringWhenFiltering, AddNullItem, out isColumnFilterItemsLoading);
			base.IsColumnFilterItemsLoading = isColumnFilterItemsLoading;
			if (base.IsColumnFilterItemsLoading)
			{
				ShowWaitIndicator(columnFilterItems);
			}
			if ((object)ComboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEdit != popup)
			{
				ComboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEdit = (ComboBoxEdit)(object)((popup is ComboBoxEdit) ? popup : null);
			}
			ComboBoxHelper.UpdateItems(base.View, base.IsColumnFilterItemsLoading, columnFilterItems);
		}

		protected internal override CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
		{
			object selectedItem = ((LookUpEditBase)ComboBoxHelper.ComboBoxEdit).SelectedItem;
			if (selectedItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(selectedItem is CustomComboBoxItem customItem))
			{
				if (selectedItem is WaitIndicatorItem)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CreateEqualsOperator(GetValue(selectedItem));
			}
			return GetFilterCriteria(customItem);
		}

		protected CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria(CustomComboBoxItem customItem)
		{
			if (customItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (customItem.EditValue is CustomComboBoxItem)
			{
				object editValue = (customItem.EditValue as CustomComboBoxItem).EditValue;
				return (CriteriaOperator)((editValue is CriteriaOperator) ? editValue : null);
			}
			if (customItem.EditValue is CriteriaOperator)
			{
				object editValue2 = customItem.EditValue;
				return (CriteriaOperator)((editValue2 is CriteriaOperator) ? editValue2 : null);
			}
			return CreateEqualsOperator(customItem.EditValue);

	internal class CustomComboBoxItemComparer : IComparer
	{
		public int Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			CustomComboBoxItem customComboBoxItem = x as CustomComboBoxItem;
			CustomComboBoxItem customComboBoxItem2 = y as CustomComboBoxItem;
			if (customComboBoxItem == customComboBoxItem2)
			{

			}
			if (customComboBoxItem == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (customComboBoxItem2 == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return Comparer<object>.Default.Compare(customComboBoxItem.DisplayValue, customComboBoxItem2.DisplayValue);
		}

		private void PopupListBoxSelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)

				{
					SelectedItems.Add(val.f_component);

				}
			}
			foreach (object removedItem in e.RemovedItems)

				{

		}

			}

		}

					}
					return (FilterColumnClauseClass)3;
				}
				return (FilterColumnClauseClass)2;
			}
		}

		public GridFilterColumn(ColumnBase column, bool useDomainDataSourceRestrictions, bool useWcfSource)
		{
			GridColumn = column;
			UseDomainDataSourceRestrictions = useDomainDataSourceRestrictions;
			UseWcfSource = useWcfSource;
		}

		public override bool IsValidClause(ClauseType clause)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0062: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0069: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0071: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (UseFilterClauseHelper && !FilterClauseHelper.IsClauseEnabled(GridColumn, clause))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = ((FilterColumn)this).IsValidClause(clause);
			if (UseDomainDataSourceRestrictions)
			{
				if (DomainDataSourceClauses.Contains(clause))
				{
					return result;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (UseWcfSource && ((int)clause == 14 || (int)clause == 15 || (int)clause == 30 || (int)clause == 31 || (int)clause == 33 || (int)clause == 36 || (int)clause == 29 || (int)clause == 27 || (int)clause == 24 || (int)clause == 32 || (int)clause == 34 || (int)clause == 35 || (int)clause == 28 || (int)clause == 26 || (int)clause == 25))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override ClauseType GetDefaultOperation()
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return (ClauseType)(((??)FilterClauseHelper.GetDefaultOperation(GridColumn, allowChangeDefaultOperation: true, checkSingleFieldClause: false)) ?? 0);
		}
	}

		{
			return CreateDelegateCommand<object>(executeMethod, canExecuteMethod);
		}

		protected DelegateCommand<T> CreateDelegateCommand<T>(Action<T> executeMethod, Func<T, bool> canExecuteMethod)
		{
			DelegateCommand<T> delegateCommand = DelegateCommandFactory.Create(executeMethod, canExecuteMethod, useCommandManager: false);
			commands.Add(delegateCommand);
			return delegateCommand;
		}

		internal void RaiseCanExecutedChanged()
		{
			commands.ForEach(delegate(IDelegateCommand command)
			{
				command.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			});
		}

	public class DataControlFilteredComponent : IFilteredComponent, IFilteredComponentBase
	{
		private DataControlBase dataControl;

		private EventHandler propertiesChanged;

		private EventHandler rowFilterChanged;

		private bool useFilterClauseHelper = true;

		CriteriaOperator IFilteredComponentBase.RowCriteria { get; set; }

		internal bool UseFilterClauseHelper
		{
			get
			{
				return useFilterClauseHelper;
			}
			set
			{
				useFilterClauseHelper = value;
			}
		}

		event EventHandler IFilteredComponentBase.PropertiesChanged
		{
			add
			{
				propertiesChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(propertiesChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				propertiesChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(propertiesChanged, value);
			}
		}

		event EventHandler IFilteredComponentBase.RowFilterChanged
		{
			add
			{
				rowFilterChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Combine(rowFilterChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				rowFilterChanged = (EventHandler)Delegate.Remove(rowFilterChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public DataControlFilteredComponent(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			this.dataControl = dataControl;
		}

		public IEnumerable<FilterColumn> CreateFilterColumnCollection()
		{
			List<FilterColumn> list = new List<FilterColumn>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in dataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				if ((UseFilterClauseHelper ? item.ActualAllowFilterEditor : item.GetAllowConditionFormatingFilterEditor()) || item.IsFiltered || dataControl.DesignTimeAdorner.ForceAllowUseColumnInFilterControl)
				{
					list.Add(dataControl.GetFilterColumnFromGridColumn(item, getUniqueColumnValues: true, UseFilterClauseHelper));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal void RaiseFilterColumnsChanged()
		{
			if (propertiesChanged != null)
			{
				propertiesChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}
	}

	internal class DataControlSerializationProvider : SerializationProvider
	{
		protected override object OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			object obj = ((SerializationProvider)this).OnCreateCollectionItem(e);
			if (obj == null)
			{
				object source = ((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Source;
				IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem val = (IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem)((source is IXtraSupportDeserializeCollectionItem) ? source : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					obj = val.CreateCollectionItem(e.CollectionName, new XtraItemEventArgs(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Owner, ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Collection, ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item));
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataPresenterBase : ContentControl, IScrollInfoOwner, IScrollInfo, INotifyCurrentViewChanged
	{
		public const double DefaultTouchScrollThreshold = 3.0;

		public const double WheelScrollLinesPerPage = -1.0;

		private ScrollInfo scrollInfoCore;

		private System.Windows.Size lastConstraint;

		private DataViewBase viewCore;

		private IContinousAction currentContinousAction;

		private Queue<IContinousAction> continousActionsQueue = new Queue<IContinousAction>();

		private bool prohibitAdjustment;

		private bool adjustmentInProgress;

		private double childDesiredHeight;

		private double lastEmptyHeight;

		protected bool rendered;

		private double adjustmentDelta;

		internal ScrollAccumulator accumulatorHorizontal = new ScrollAccumulator();

		internal ScrollAccumulator accumulatorVertical = new ScrollAccumulator();

		internal static int GenerateItemsCount { get; set; }

		internal System.Windows.Size LastConstraint
		{
			get
			{
				return lastConstraint;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (!(lastConstraint == value))
				{
					lastConstraint = value;
					View.OnLastConstraintChanged();
					Panel?.CalcViewport(lastConstraint);
				}
			}
		}

		internal HierarchyPanel Panel { get; set; }

		private bool HasQueuedContinuousActions => continousActionsQueue.Count > 0;

		public virtual double ScrollItemOffset => 0.0;

		internal int ItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (View != null && View.IsPagingMode)
				{
					return View.ItemsOnPage;
				}
				if (DataControl != null)
				{
					return DataControl.VisibleRowCount + View.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount() + View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCount();
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement ContentElement => base.Content as FrameworkElement;

				View.WidthChanged(double.NaN, double.NaN, forceUpdate: true);
				AddUpdateRowsStateAction();
				UpdateViewCore();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{

			if (e.Property == UIElement.IsVisibleProperty && base.IsVisible)

			}

		private void OnLayoutUpdated(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			rendered = true;
			if (LayoutUpdatedHelper.GlobalLocker.IsLocked || (View != null && View.layoutUpdatedLocker.IsLocked))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!CheckIsTreeValid())
			{
				ForceCompleteContinuousActions();
			}
			else
			{
				if (View == null || DataControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				View.RaiseCommandsCanExecuteChanged();
				DataControl.UpdateAllDetailAndOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior.EnsureSurroundingsActualSize(LastConstraint);
				});
				if (currentContinousAction != null && currentContinousAction.IsDone)
				{
					currentContinousAction = null;
				}
				if (currentContinousAction == null && HasQueuedContinuousActions)
				{
					currentContinousAction = continousActionsQueue.Dequeue();
					currentContinousAction.Prepare();
					InvalidateMeasure();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!OnLayoutUpdatedCore())
					{
						return;
					}
					View.ClearFreeRowData();
					if (currentContinousAction == null)
					{
						UpdateScrollInfo();
						if (!View.FocusedView.IsRootView)
						{
							View.FocusedView.ClearCurrentCellIfNeeded();
						}
						View.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
						{
							dataControl.DataView.UpdateRowsState();
						});
						ExecuteImmediateActions();
					}
					IContinousAction continousAction = currentContinousAction;
					if (continousAction != null)
					{
						((IAction)continousAction).Execute();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool OnLayoutUpdatedCore()
		{
			if (IsEnoughItems())
			{
				View.RootNodeContainer.IsScrolling = false;
				if (!View.CanAdjustScrollbar())
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!prohibitAdjustment && currentContinousAction == null)
				{
					double childHeight = GetChildHeight();
					if (adjustmentInProgress && childHeight > base.DesiredSize.Height)
					{
						prohibitAdjustment = true;
						if (View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
						{
							double height = GetFirstVisibleRow().DesiredSize.Height;
							SetVerticalOffsetForce(CurrentOffset + (height * (1.0 - ScrollItemOffset) - lastEmptyHeight) / height);
						}
						else
						{
							SetVerticalOffsetForce(CurrentOffset + 1.0);
						}
						return false;
					}
					if (childHeight < base.DesiredSize.Height && CurrentOffset > 0.0)
					{
						lastEmptyHeight = base.DesiredSize.Height - childHeight;
						adjustmentInProgress = true;
						View.LockEditorClose = true;
						double num = 1.0;
						if (View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && ScrollItemOffset != 0.0 && GetFirstVisibleRow() != null)
						{
							double height2 = GetFirstVisibleRow().DesiredSize.Height;
							num = ((!(height2 * ScrollItemOffset > base.DesiredSize.Height - childHeight)) ? ScrollItemOffset : ((base.DesiredSize.Height - childHeight) / height2));
						}
						adjustmentDelta = num;
						if (!View.IsEditFormVisible || (!View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && Math.Abs(num) > 1.0) || (View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && Math.Abs(num) > 0.1))
						{
							SetVerticalOffsetForce(CurrentOffset - num);
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				View.LockEditorClose = false;
				if (adjustmentInProgress)
				{
					adjustmentInProgress = false;
					UpdatePostponedData();
				}
				return true;
			}
			GenerateItems(GenerateItemsCount, LastConstraint.Height);
			return false;
		}

		protected double GetChildHeight()
		{
			if (!(base.Content is UIElement { DesiredSize: var desiredSize }))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return desiredSize.Height;
		}

		{
			return GetRowDataToScroll()?.WholeRowElement;
		}

		protected internal RowDataBase GetRowDataToScroll()

		}

			View.MasterRootRowsContainer.UpdatePostponedData(updateStartIndex: false, updateImmediately: false);
		}

		internal void ForceCompleteContinuousActions()
		{
			ForceCompleteCurrentAction();
			continousActionsQueue.Clear();
		}

		internal void ForceCompleteCurrentAction()
		{
			if (currentContinousAction != null)
			{
				currentContinousAction.ForceComplete();
				currentContinousAction = null;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateScrollInfo()
		{
			UpdateDefineSizeScrollInfo();
			UpdateSecondarySizeScrollInfo();
		}

		private void UpdateDefineSizeScrollInfo()
		{
			double viewportHeight = ScrollInfo.ViewportHeight;
			ScrollInfoCore.DefineSizeScrollInfo.UpdateScrollInfo((View.ScrollingModeCore == ScrollingMode.Normal) ? 1.0 : Math.Max(0.0, PanelViewport), Extent);
			if (viewportHeight != ScrollInfo.ViewportHeight)
			{
				UpdatePostponedData();
				View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateSecondarySizeScrollInfo(bool allowUpdateViewportVisibleColumns = true)
		{
			if (View == null || (View.DataProviderBase != null && View.DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked) || DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ScrollBarCombineHelper helper = new ScrollBarCombineHelper();
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				dataControl.DataView.Do(delegate(DataViewBase detailView)
				{
					helper.ProcessScrollInfo(detailView.FixedViewport, detailView.FixedExtent);
				});
			});
			ScrollInfoCore.SecondarySizeScrollInfo.UpdateScrollInfo(helper.FinalViewport, helper.FinalExtent);
			ScrollInfoCore.UpdateIsHorizontalScrollBarVisible();
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				dataControl.DataView?.ViewBehavior.UpdateSecondaryScrollInfoCore(0.0 - helper.ConvertToRealOffset(ScrollInfoCore.SecondarySizeScrollInfo.Offset, dataControl.DataView.FixedViewport, dataControl.DataView.FixedExtent), allowUpdateViewportVisibleColumns);
			});
		}

		internal void ClearScrollInfoAndUpdate()
		{
			scrollInfoCore.ClearScrollInfo();
			UpdateScrollInfo();
			SetVerticalOffsetForce(0.0);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			if (base.DesiredSize.Height != constraint.Height && !adjustmentInProgress)
			{
				prohibitAdjustment = false;
			}
			if (View == null)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Size(0.0, 0.0);
			}
			bool flag = currentContinousAction == null && LastConstraint != constraint && !adjustmentInProgress;
			LastConstraint = ColumnsLayoutParametersValidator.GetLastDataPresenterConstraint(constraint);
			if (!View.IsDesignTime)
			{
				InfiniteGridSizeException.ValidateDefineSize(SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(LastConstraint), View.OrientationCore, DataControl.GetType().Name);
			}
			ClearAutomationEventsHelper.ClearAutomationEvents();
			PregenerateItems(constraint);
			int num = View.RootNodeContainer.ItemCount;
			if (AdjustmentInProgress)
			{
				num += (int)Math.Ceiling(adjustmentDelta);
			}
			CancelAllGetRows();
			int commonStartScrollIndex = Math.Min(GenerateItemsOffset, Math.Max(0, ItemCount - 1));
			bool flag2 = false;
			int pageVisibleTopRowIndex = View.PageVisibleTopRowIndex;
			int pageVisibleDataRowCount = View.PageVisibleDataRowCount;
			View.RootNodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(commonStartScrollIndex, num);
			flag2 = View.PageVisibleTopRowIndex != pageVisibleTopRowIndex || View.PageVisibleDataRowCount != pageVisibleDataRowCount;
			EnsureAllRowsLoaded(ScrollOffset, num);
			System.Windows.Size result = base.MeasureOverride(GetMeasureSize(constraint));
			if (DataControl.AutomationPeer != null)
			{
				DataControl.AutomationPeer.ResetDataPanelChildrenForce();
			}
			if (childDesiredHeight != result.Height && !adjustmentInProgress)
			{
				prohibitAdjustment = false;
			}
			childDesiredHeight = result.Height;
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateScrollInfo();
			}
			ITableView tableView = View as ITableView;
			if (tableView != null && flag2)
			{
				IList<ColumnBase> list = (tableView.AutoWidth ? View.VisibleColumnsCore : tableView.ViewportVisibleColumns);
				if (list != null)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item in list)
					{
						item.UpdateAutoBestFitWidth();
					}
				}
			}
			return View.ViewBehavior.CorrectMeasureResult(ActualScrollOffset, constraint, result);
		}

		double IScrollInfoOwner.ScrollInsideActiveEditorIfNeeded(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			if (View == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (View.ActiveEditor.Return((BaseEdit x) => !LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)(object)x, (DependencyObject)visual), () => true))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!(GetRowDataToScroll() is RowData rowData) || (!View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling && rowData.RowHandle.Value == View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double invisiblePart = GetInvisiblePart(visual.TransformToVisual(View.ScrollContentPresenter).TransformBounds(rectangle));
			if (invisiblePart == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			View.LockEditorClose = true;
			if (invisiblePart < 0.0)
			{
				SetVerticalOffsetForce(CurrentOffset + invisiblePart / rowData.WholeRowElement.ActualHeight);
			}
			else
			{
				SetVerticalOffsetForce((double)ScrollOffset + View.CalcOffsetByHeight(invisiblePart, View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling));
			}
			View.LockEditorClose = false;
			return invisiblePart;
		}

		private double GetInvisiblePart(Rect rect)
		{
			if (rect.Top < 0.0)
			{
				return rect.Top;
			}
			double num = rect.Bottom - View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight;
			if (num > 0.0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private void OnSecondaryScrollInfoChangedCore()
		{
			ScrollInfoCore.OnScrollInfoChanged();
			if (View == null)
			{
				return;

			UpdateSecondarySizeScrollInfo(allowUpdateViewportVisibleColumns: false);
			View.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				x.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dc)
				{
					dc.DataView.ViewBehavior.UpdateViewportVisibleColumns();
				});
			});
			View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)View.ViewBehavior.ResetHeadersChildrenCache);
		}

		internal bool IsElementPartiallyVisible(FrameworkElement element)

			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)element, (UIElement)this);

		}

		internal bool IsElementPartiallyVisible(System.Windows.Size size, Rect elementRect)
		{
			return SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.BottomRight(elementRect)) > SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(size) - Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => x.FixedBottomRowsHeight, () => 0.0);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsElementVisible(RowNode node)
		{
			if (!node.IsRowVisible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			FrameworkElement rowElement = node.GetRowElement();
			if (rowElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!rowElement.IsVisible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)rowElement, (UIElement)this);
			return SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.Location(relativeElementRect)) < SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(LastConstraint) + CollapseBufferSize - Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => x.FixedBottomRowsHeight, () => 0.0);
		}

		protected bool AreAllElementsVisible(NodeContainer containerItem)
		{
			if (containerItem.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			for (int num = containerItem.Items.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RowNode rowNode = containerItem.Items[num];
				if (!IsElementVisible(rowNode) && rowNode.FixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool IsEnoughItems()
		{
			if (!IsEnoughExpandingItems())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (View.RootNodeContainer.IsFinished)
			{
				if (View.DataControl == null || (View.DataControl.BottomRowBelowOldVisibleRowCount && ShouldDisplayLoadingRow) || View.RootNodeContainer.IsEnumeratorValid)
				{
					return true;
				}
				View.RootNodeContainer.OnDataChangedCore();
				return false;
			}
			return !AreAllElementsVisible(View.RootNodeContainer);
		}

		internal virtual bool IsEnoughExpandingItems()
		{
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CanApplyScroll(out FrameworkElement firstVisibleRowElement)
		{
			firstVisibleRowElement = null;
			if (View == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			firstVisibleRowElement = View.DataPresenter.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			return firstVisibleRowElement != null;
		}

		void INotifyCurrentViewChanged.OnCurrentViewChanged(DependencyObject d)
		{
			UpdateView();
		}

		public bool UseSmartMouseScrolling()
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void SetManipulation(bool isColumnFilterOpened)
		{
		}
	}

	internal class ScrollAccumulator
	{
		public const double ScrollLineSize = 120.0;

		private double accumulator;

		private int direction;

		private void ChangeDirection(double delta)
		{
			if (Math.Sign(delta) != direction)
			{
				direction = Math.Sign(delta);
				accumulator = 0.0;
			}
		}

		public double GetCorrectedDelta(bool useAccumulator, double elementSize, double delta)
		{
			ChangeDirection(delta);
			double num = (0.0 - delta) / elementSize;
			if (!useAccumulator)
			{
				return num;
			}
			double value = num - (double)(int)num;
			num = Math.Round(num);
			accumulator += Math.Abs(value);
			if (Math.Abs(accumulator) >= 1.0)
			{
				accumulator -= 1.0;
				num -= (double)direction;
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

				((GridDataViewBase)base.RootView).globalSelectionAnchor = value;
			}
		}

			: base(masterRootNode, masterRootDataItem, detailDescriptor)
		{
		}

		internal void SetSelectionAnchor()
		{
			if (base.RootView.FocusedView == this)
			{
				int valueForSelectionAnchorRowHandle = base.ViewBehavior.GetValueForSelectionAnchorRowHandle(base.FocusedRowHandle);
				GlobalSelectionAnchor = new SelectionAnchor(this, valueForSelectionAnchorRowHandle);
			}
		}
	}

		protected internal virtual bool ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataControl != null && DataControl.ClipboardCopyMode != ClipboardCopyMode.Default)
				{
					return DataControl.ClipboardCopyMode == ClipboardCopyMode.IncludeHeader;
				}
				return (bool)GetValue(ClipboardCopyWithHeadersProperty);
			}
		}

				return (bool)GetValue(ClipboardCopyAllowedProperty);

		internal bool ActualUseLegacyColumnChooser
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				bool? useLegacyColumnChooser = GridCompatibilitySettings.GetUseLegacyColumnChooser(this);
				if (useLegacyColumnChooser.HasValue)
				{
					return useLegacyColumnChooser.Value;
				}
				if (CompatibilitySettings.AlwaysUseLegacyColumnChooser)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return (int)FloatingContainerFactory.CheckPopupHost((DependencyObject)RootView) == 2;
			}
		}

		internal IList<ColumnBase> VisibleColumnsCore
		{
			get
			{
				return visibleColumnsCore;
			}
			set
			{
				visibleColumnsCore = value;
				SetVisibleColumns(visibleColumnsCore);
				if (DataControl != null)
				{
					if (DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && !visibleColumnsCore.Contains(DataControl.CurrentColumn))
					{
						DataControl.CurrentColumn = null;
					}
					DataControl.InitializeCurrentColumn();
				}
			}
		}

		internal IColumnChooser ActualColumnChooser
		{
			get
			{
				if (actualColumnChooser == null)
				{
					ActualColumnChooser = CreateColumnChooser();
				}
				return actualColumnChooser;
			}
			set
			{
				if (actualColumnChooser == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (actualColumnChooser != null)
				{
					if (columnChooserForceDestoyLocker.IsLocked && actualColumnChooser is DefaultColumnChooser)
					{
						((DefaultColumnChooser)(object)actualColumnChooser).DestroyBase(force: true);
					}
					else
					{
						actualColumnChooser.Destroy();
					}
				}
				actualColumnChooser = value;
			}
		}

		internal Border SelectionRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				return RootView.selectionRactangle;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a0: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (RootView.selectionRactangle != null)
				{
					RootView.RemoveChild(selectionRactangle);
					if (RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner != null)
					{
						GetAdornerLayerTopContainer()?.Remove((Adorner)(object)RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner);
					}
				}
				RootView.selectionRactangle = value;
				if (RootView.selectionRactangle != null)
				{
					RootView.AddChild(RootView.selectionRactangle);
					AdornerLayer adornerLayerTopContainer = GetAdornerLayerTopContainer();
					if (adornerLayerTopContainer != null)
					{
						RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner = new PositionedAdornerContainer((UIElement)RootView, (UIElement)RootView.selectionRactangle);
						adornerLayerTopContainer.Add((Adorner)(object)RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string[] IncrementalSearchColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (!CanStartIncrementalSearch)
				{
					return new string[0];
				}
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				if (UseOnlyCurrentColumnInIncrementalSearch && NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
				{
					string text = ((DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && DataControl.CurrentColumn.AllowIncrementalSearch) ? DataControl.CurrentColumn.FieldName : null);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						list.Add(text);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase item in VisibleColumnsCore)
					{
						if (item.AllowIncrementalSearch)
						{
							list.Add(item.FieldName);
						}
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}
		}

		protected internal bool CanStartIncrementalSearch
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActualIncrementalSearchMode == IncrementalSearchMode.Default || ActualIncrementalSearchMode == IncrementalSearchMode.Disabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None || IsPagingMode || (DataProviderBase != null && (DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode || DataProviderBase.IsServerMode || IsVirtualSource)))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return CheckStartIncrementalSearch(ActualIncrementalSearchMode);
			}
		}

		protected IncrementalSearchMode ActualIncrementalSearchMode
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsRootView)
				{
					return IncrementalSearchModeCore;
				}
				if (IncrementalSearchMode == IncrementalSearchMode.Default)
				{
					DataControlBase dataControlBase = ((DataControl != null) ? DataControl.GetMasterGridCore() : null);
					if (dataControlBase == null || dataControlBase.DataView == null)
					{
						return IncrementalSearchMode.Default;
					}
					return dataControlBase.DataView.ActualIncrementalSearchMode;
				}
				return IncrementalSearchMode;
			}
		}

					return null;

					RootView.textSearchEngineRoot = value;

		internal PositionedAdornerContainer UpdateRowRectangleAdorner { get; private set; }

		internal System.Windows.Shapes.Path UpdateRowRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				return RootView.updateRowRectangle;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_00aa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b4: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (!RootView.IsLoaded)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (RootView.updateRowRectangle != null)
				{
					RootView.RemoveChild(RootView.updateRowRectangle);
					if (RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner != null)
					{
						GetAdornerLayerTopContainer()?.Remove((Adorner)(object)RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner);
					}
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					AdornerLayer adornerLayerTopContainer = GetAdornerLayerTopContainer();
					if (adornerLayerTopContainer != null && adornerLayerTopContainer.IsVisible)
					{
						RootView.updateRowRectangle = value;
						RootView.AddChild(RootView.updateRowRectangle);
						RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner = new PositionedAdornerContainer((UIElement)RootView, (UIElement)RootView.updateRowRectangle);
						adornerLayerTopContainer.Add((Adorner)(object)RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner);
					}
					else
					{
						RootView.updateRowRectangle = null;
						RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RootView.updateRowRectangle = null;
					RootView.UpdateRowRectangleAdorner = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldListenToItemsSourceErrors
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(this is ITableView { ScrollBarAnnotationMode: var scrollBarAnnotationMode } tableView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (scrollBarAnnotationMode.HasValue && (tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Value.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidCells) || tableView.ScrollBarAnnotationMode.Value.HasFlag(ScrollBarAnnotationMode.InvalidRows)))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ErrorsWatchMode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Cells) || ErrorsWatchMode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Rows))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static object CoerceScrollStep(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			if ((int)value < 1)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static object CoerceWheelScrollLines(DependencyObject d, object value)
		{
			double num = (double)value;
			if (num < 0.0 && num != -1.0)
			{
				return SystemParameters.WheelScrollLines;
			}
			return value;
		}
