		internal static string GetColumnChooserSortableCaption(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column.HeaderCaption == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return column.HeaderCaption.ToString();
		}

		internal static DependencyObject GetStartHitTestObject(DependencyObject d, DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (!view.IsRootView)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedInMasterDetailException("Hit testing is supported only by a master view. Hit information cannot be calculated for detail views.");
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = d;
			while (dependencyObject != null && dependencyObject != view)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is DataViewBase)
				{
					d = dependencyObject;
				}
				dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false);
			}
			return d;
		}

		internal void CopyFocusedRowToClipboardCore()
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();

			{
				list.Add(FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			ClipboardController.CopyRowsToClipboard(list);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator CreateAutoFilterCriteriaEquals(string fieldName, object value, bool equals = true)
		{
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ColumnBase columnBase = DataControl.ColumnsCore[fieldName];
			if (columnBase.ActualEditSettings is CheckEditSettings && columnBase.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
			{
				value = GetDisplayObject(value, columnBase);
			}
			if (!columnBase.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter || DataProviderBase.Columns == null || DataProviderBase.Columns[fieldName] == null)
			{
				return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(fieldName, value, (BinaryOperatorType)(!equals));
			}
			return DataProviderBase.CalcColumnFilterCriteriaByValue(columnBase, value);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator CreateAutoFilterCriteriaContains(string fieldName, object value)

		internal CriteriaOperator CreateAutoFilterCriteriaLike(string fieldName, object value)

			});

		protected virtual SearchStringToFilterCriteriaEventArgs CreateSearchStringToFilterCriteriaEventArgs(string searchString, CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, List<FieldAndHighlightingString> highlighting)

		internal SearchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper ConvertSearchStringToFilterCriteria(string searchString, CriteriaOperator filterCriteria, List<FieldAndHighlightingString> highlighting)
		{
			if (this.SearchStringToFilterCriteria == null)
			{
				if (IsVirtualSource)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException("The GridControl bound to the Virtual data source does not support the search panel feature out of the box." + Environment.NewLine + "Handle the DataViewBase.SearchStringToFilterCriteria event to apply searching manually.");
				}
				return new SearchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper(filterCriteria, highlighting, applyToColumnsFilter: false);
			}
			SearchStringToFilterCriteriaEventArgs e = CreateSearchStringToFilterCriteriaEventArgs(searchString, IsVirtualSource ? null : filterCriteria, IsVirtualSource ? null : highlighting);
			this.SearchStringToFilterCriteria(this, e);
			return new SearchStringToFilterCriteriaWrapper(e.Filter, e.Highlighting, e.ApplyToColumnsFilter);
		}

		internal CriteriaOperator CreateAutoFilterCriteriaCustom(string fieldName, object value, BinaryOperatorType type)
		{
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00c5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cc: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0062: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ColumnBase columnBase = DataControl.ColumnsCore[fieldName];
			if (value == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = null;
			obj = ((columnBase == null || columnBase.ColumnFilterMode != ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText) ? DataProviderBase.CorrectFilterValueType(columnBase.FieldType, value) : value);
			object obj2 = ((obj != null) ? obj : value);
			if ((int)type == 0 || (int)type == 1)
			{
				if (columnBase.ActualEditSettings is CheckEditSettings && columnBase.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText)
				{
					if ((int)type != 0)
					{
						return (CriteriaOperator)(object)(!CreateAutoFilterCriteriaEquals(fieldName, value));
					}
					return CreateAutoFilterCriteriaEquals(fieldName, value);
				}
				FilterColumn val = FilterClauseHelper.CreateFilterColumn(columnBase);
				if (columnBase.RoundDateTimeForColumnFilter && val != null && SummaryItemTypeHelper.IsDateTime(val.ColumnType))
				{
					if ((int)type == 0)
					{
						return DataProviderBase.CalcColumnFilterCriteriaByValue(columnBase, obj2);
					}
					return (CriteriaOperator)(object)(!DataProviderBase.CalcColumnFilterCriteriaByValue(columnBase, obj2));
				}
			}
			return (CriteriaOperator)new BinaryOperator(fieldName, obj2, type);
		}

		protected internal virtual CriteriaOperator CreateAutoFilterCriteria(string fieldName, AutoFilterCondition condition, object value)
		{
			if (condition == AutoFilterCondition.Equals)
			{
				return CreateAutoFilterCriteriaEquals(fieldName, value);
			}
			string value2 = value.ToString();
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (condition == AutoFilterCondition.Contains)
			{
				return CreateAutoFilterCriteriaContains(fieldName, value);
			}
			return CreateAutoFilterCriteriaLike(fieldName, value);
		}

		}

		protected internal bool IsLastVisibleColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (!column.Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ViewBehavior.GetActualColumnFixed(column) != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return VisibleColumnsCore.Count <= 1;
			}
			return FixedNoneColumnsCount <= 1;
		}

		internal bool CanBecameFixed(BaseColumn column)
		{
			int num = FixedNoneColumnsCount;
			if (DataControl.BandsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				num = DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedNoneVisibleBands.Count;
			}
			if (column.Visible && column.Fixed == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return num != 1;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void OnColumnFilterPopupModeChanged()
		{
			if (dataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnBase item in dataControl.ColumnsCore)
			{
				item.ResetFilterPopup();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetDataControl(DataControlBase newValue)
		{
			if (dataControl != newValue)
			{
				DataControlBase oldValue = dataControl;
				dataControl = newValue;
				OnDataControlChanged(oldValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDataControlChanged(DataControlBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.IsVisibleChanged -= OnDataControlIsVisibleChanged;
			}
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				dataControl.IsVisibleChanged += OnDataControlIsVisibleChanged;
				if (dataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && DataControl.ColumnsCore.Count == 0 && DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(dataControl))
				{
					dataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FillColumns();
				}
				ValidateSelectionStrategy();
				if (dataControl.IsSelectionInitialized && dataControl.CurrentItem != null)
				{
					UpdateFocusedRowHandleCore();
				}
				OnDataReset();
				SetFocusedRowHandle(dataControl.DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow);
				SelectionStrategy.OnAssignedToGrid();
				UpdateBorderForFocusedUIElement();
				UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties();
				UpdateSummariesIgnoreNullValues();
				UpdateActualAllowCellMergeCore();
				dataControl.NotifyDetailHeaderContentChanged();
				RebuildDragManager();
				if (IsDetail)
				{
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, SearchStringProperty, new Binding("SearchString")
					{
						Source = RootView
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, SearchPanelHighlightResultsProperty, new Binding("SearchPanelHighlightResults")
					{
						Source = OriginationView
					});
					if (DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(OriginationView, SearchPanelAllowFilterProperty).BaseValueSource == BaseValueSource.Default)
					{
						OriginationView.SetCurrentValue(SearchPanelAllowFilterProperty, false);
					}
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, SearchPanelAllowFilterProperty, new Binding("SearchPanelAllowFilter")
					{
						Source = OriginationView
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, SearchPanelFindFilterProperty, new Binding("SearchPanelFindFilter")
					{
						Source = OriginationView
					});
					BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, SearchPanelParseModeProperty, new Binding("SearchPanelParseMode")
					{
						Source = OriginationView
					});
					this.SearchStringToFilterCriteria = OriginationView.SearchStringToFilterCriteria;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HideColumnChooser();
			}
			UpdateIsKeyboardFocusWithinView();
		}

		protected internal virtual IEnumerable<UIElement> GetTopLevelDropContainers()
		{

				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			IColumnChooser visibleColumnChooser = null;
			UpdateAllOriginationViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
			{
				if (view.IsColumnChooserVisible)
				{
					visibleColumnChooser = view.ActualColumnChooser;
				}
			});
			if (visibleColumnChooser != null)
			{
				yield return visibleColumnChooser.TopContainer;
			}
			yield return LayoutHelper.GetTopContainerWithAdornerLayer((UIElement)this);
		}

		internal static bool IsCellEditorDatasEqual(CellEditorData[] firstData, CellEditorData[] secondData)
		{
			if (firstData.Length != secondData.Length)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < firstData.Length; i++)
			{
				CellEditorData cellEditorData = firstData[i];
				CellEditorData cellEditorData2 = secondData[i];
				if (cellEditorData.FieldName != cellEditorData2.FieldName || cellEditorData.Value != cellEditorData2.Value || cellEditorData.ReadOnly != cellEditorData2.ReadOnly)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

				}
			});
		}

		protected static void OnNavigationStyleChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = (DataViewBase)d;
			if (dataViewBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dataViewBase.DataControl == null)
			{
				dataViewBase.OnNavigationStyleChanged();
				return;
			}
			Action<DataControlBase> action = delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (dataControl.DataView != null)
				{
					dataControl.DataView.OnNavigationStyleChanged();
				}
			};
			dataViewBase.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(action, action);
		}

		protected virtual SelectionState CorrectSelectionState(SelectionState selectionState, bool isCellSelectionState)
		{
			if (!EnableSelectedRowAppearanceCore && (!isCellSelectionState || GetActualSelectionMode() != MultiSelectMode.Cell))
			{
				switch (selectionState)
				{
				case SelectionState.Focused:
				case SelectionState.Selected:
				case SelectionState.FocusedAndSelected:
					selectionState = SelectionState.None;
					break;
				}
			}
			return selectionState;
		}

		protected internal SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle, bool isMouseOver)
		{
			SelectionState selectionState = CorrectSelectionState(SelectionStrategy.GetRowSelectionState(rowHandle), isCellSelectionState: false);
			if (isMouseOver && CanHighlightedState(rowHandle, null, isCell: false, selectionState, IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle)))
			{
				return SelectionState.Highlighted;
			}
			return selectionState;
		}

		protected internal SelectionState GetCellSelectionState(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, bool isMouseOver, ColumnBase column)
		{
			SelectionState selectionState = CorrectSelectionState(SelectionStrategy.GetCellSelectionState(rowHandle, isFocused, isSelected, column), isCellSelectionState: true);
			if (isMouseOver && CanHighlightedState(rowHandle, column, isCell: true, selectionState))
			{
				return SelectionState.Highlighted;
			}
			return selectionState;
		}

		internal void UpdateFocusedRowHandleCore()
		{
			if (!object.Equals(DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(FocusedRowHandle), DataControl.CurrentItem) || DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				int num = DataProviderBase.FindRowByRowValue(DataControl.CurrentItem);
				if (num != int.MinValue || !DataControl.HasCurrentItemBinding() || DataControl.AllowUpdateTwoWayBoundPropertiesOnSynchronization)
				{
					SetFocusedRowHandle(num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetFocusOnCurrentItem()
		{
			if (DataControl.CurrentItem != null)
			{
				UpdateFocusedRowHandleCore();
			}
			else
			{
				SetFocusedRowHandle(int.MinValue);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateCheckBoxSelectorState()
		{
			bool isSelectedEnabled = true;
			bool isUnselectEnabled = true;
			AllItemsSelected = SelectionStrategy.GetAllItemsSelected(out isSelectedEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled);
			if (AllItemsSelected == true)
			{
				EnabledCheckBoxSelector = isUnselectEnabled;
			}
			else if (AllItemsSelected == false)
			{
				EnabledCheckBoxSelector = isSelectedEnabled;
			}
		}

			UpdateCheckBoxSelectorState();

		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSelectionSummary()
		{
			if (DataControl == null || DataControl.IsListChanging)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataControl.GroupSummaryCore.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase x) => GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows) != null)
			{
				List<SummaryItem> list = ((IEnumerable<SummaryItem>)((DataController)DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupSummary).Where((SummaryItem x) => GetActualCalculationMode((SummaryItemBase)((SummaryItemBase)x).Tag) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows).ToList();
				if (list.Count != 0)
				{
					((DataController)DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).UpdateGroupSummary(list, false);
					UpdateGroupSummary();
				}
			}
			if (DataControl.TotalSummaryCore.FirstOrDefault((SummaryItemBase x) => GetActualCalculationMode(x) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows) != null)
			{
				List<SummaryItem> list2 = ((IEnumerable<SummaryItem>)((DataController)DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).TotalSummary).Where((SummaryItem x) => GetActualCalculationMode((SummaryItemBase)((SummaryItemBase)x).Tag) != GridSummaryCalculationMode.AllRows).ToList();
				if (list2.Count != 0)
				{
					((DataControllerBase)DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).UpdateTotalSummary(list2, false);
					UpdateColumnsTotalSummary();
				}
			}
		}

		private IColumnChooser CreateColumnChooser()
		{
			IColumnChooserFactory obj;
			if (!ActualUseLegacyColumnChooser)
			{
				obj = ColumnChooserFactory;
			}
			else
			{
				IColumnChooserFactory instance = (IColumnChooserFactory)(object)DefaultLegacyColumnChooserFactory.Instance;
				obj = instance;
			}
			IColumnChooserFactory val = obj;
			IColumnChooser val2 = val.Create((Control)this);
			NullColumnChooserException.CheckColumnChooserNotNull(val2);
			val2.ApplyState(RootView.ColumnChooserState);
			return val2;
		}

		internal void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn column, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (IsUpdateVisibleIndexesLocked || IsLoading || DataControl.IsDeserializing || ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate || (UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes && !column.Visible))
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				ViewBehavior.ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(column, oldVisibleIndex);
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		public void MoveColumnTo(ColumnBase source, int newVisibleIndex, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, HeaderPresenterType moveTo, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition = MergeGroupPosition.None)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnsCore.BeginUpdate();
			IDataControlOriginationElement dataControlOriginationElement = DataControl.GetDataControlOriginationElement();
			if (moveFrom != HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel && moveTo != HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel)
			{
				dataControlOriginationElement.ColumnsChangedLocker.Lock();
			}
			else
			{
				dataControlOriginationElement.SynchronizationLocker.Lock();
				DataControl.SortUpdateLocker.Lock();
			}
			try
			{
				if (moveFrom == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser)
				{
					source.Visible = true;
				}
				HandleGroupMoveAction(source, newVisibleIndex, moveFrom, moveTo, mergeGroupPosition);
				if (moveTo == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
				{
					Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace> columnDropTarget = ViewBehavior.GetColumnDropTarget(source, newVisibleIndex, moveFrom);
					BandsMover bandsMover = new BandsMover(DataControl);
					bandsMover.MoveColumnToColumn(source, columnDropTarget.Item1, columnDropTarget.Item2, moveFrom, UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataControlOriginationElement.SynchronizationLocker.Unlock();
				DataControl.syncronizationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)ColumnsCore.EndUpdate);
				dataControlOriginationElement.ColumnsChangedLocker.Unlock();
				DataControl.SortUpdateLocker.Unlock();
			}
			NotifyDesignTimeAdornerOnColumnMoved(moveFrom, moveTo);
		}

		protected virtual void NotifyDesignTimeAdornerOnColumnMoved(HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, HeaderPresenterType moveTo)
		{
			DesignTimeAdorner.OnColumnMoved();
		}

		protected internal string GetTextForClipboard(int rowHandle, int visibleColumnIndex)
		{
			string text = ((rowHandle == int.MinValue) ? VisibleColumnsCore[visibleColumnIndex].HeaderCaption.ToString() : GetRowCellDisplayText(rowHandle, visibleColumnIndex));
			if (text == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (text.Contains(Environment.NewLine))
			{
				text = "\"" + text.Replace("\"", "\"\"").Replace(Environment.NewLine, "\n") + "\"";
			}
			return text.Replace("\t", " ");
		}

		protected internal string GetRowCellDisplayText(int rowHandle, int visibleColumnIndex)
		{
			if (DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return GetGroupRowDisplayText(rowHandle);
			}
			if (VisibleColumnsCore[visibleColumnIndex].CopyValueAsDisplayText)
			{
				return GetColumnDisplayText(DataControl.GetCellValueCore(rowHandle, VisibleColumnsCore[visibleColumnIndex]), VisibleColumnsCore[visibleColumnIndex], rowHandle);
			}
			object cellValueCore = DataControl.GetCellValueCore(rowHandle, VisibleColumnsCore[visibleColumnIndex]);
			if (cellValueCore == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return cellValueCore.ToString();
		}

		internal int VisibleComparison(BaseColumn x, BaseColumn y)
		{
			int? num = ViewBehavior.VisibleComparisonCore(x, y);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				return num.Value;
			}
			if (BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)x) == BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)y))
			{
				return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(x.index, y.index);
			}
			num = CompareGroupedColumns(x, y);
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				return num.Value;
			}
			if (BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)x) < 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)y) < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)x), BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)y));
		}

		private void UpdateColumnsCore(Action updateAction, bool needUpdateErrors = true)
		{
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.DataView == this && !DataControl.IsLoading && !DataControl.IsDeserializing && !IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout && !ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				updateAction();
				RebuildColumnChooserColumns();
				DataControl.UpdateAllDetailViewIndents();
				ViewBehavior.VisibleColumnsChanged();
				ShowCheckBoxInHeaderColumnsChanged();
				if (needUpdateErrors)
				{
					UpdateWatchErrors();
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void AssignVisibleColumns(IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumnsList)
		{
			bool changed = false;
			if (VisibleColumnsCore != visibleColumnsList && !ListHelper.AreEqual<ColumnBase>(VisibleColumnsCore, visibleColumnsList))
			{
				VisibleColumnsCore = visibleColumnsList;
				changed = true;
				DesignTimeAdorner.OnColumnsLayoutChanged();
			}
			changed = OnVisibleColumnsAssigned(changed);
			if (changed)
			{
				if (DataPresenter != null)
				{
					IsUpdateCellDataEnqueued = true;
					ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)UpdateCellData);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateCellData();
				}
			}
			ITableView tView = this as ITableView;
			if (tView != null && changed)
			{
				updateColumnsLayoutSeparatorLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					tView.OnChangeBandSeparator();
				});
			}
			if (!updateColumnsLayoutSeparatorLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				ViewBehavior.UpdateColumnsLayout();
				ViewBehavior.UpdateViewportVisibleColumns();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateRowDataByRowHandle(int rowHandle, UpdateRowDataDelegate updateMethod)
		{
			RowData focusedRowData = FocusedRowData;
			if (focusedRowData != null && focusedRowData.RowHandle.Value == rowHandle)
			{
				updateMethod(focusedRowData);
			}
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(rowHandle);
			if (rowData != null && rowData != focusedRowData)
			{
				updateMethod(rowData);
			}
		}

		private object CoerceTopRowIndex(int value)
		{
			if (value < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (DataControl == null || ScrollInfoOwner == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (value > DataControl.VisibleRowCount)
			{
				switch (ScrollingModeCore)
				{
				case ScrollingMode.Smart:
					return DataControl.VisibleRowCount - ScrollInfoOwner.ItemsOnPage;
				case ScrollingMode.Normal:
					return DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1;
				}
			}
			return value;
		}

			}
			SetFocusedRectangleOnElement((FocusedView.CurrentCellEditor != null) ? (FocusedView.CurrentCell as FrameworkElement) : null, GetCellFocusedRectangleTemplate(), CalcCellFocusedRectangleOffset() + num, rightIndent);
		}

		protected void SetFocusedRectangleOnRowData(ControlTemplate template)
		{
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				IFocusedRowBorderObject focusedRowBorderObject = rowData.RowElement as IFocusedRowBorderObject;
				FrameworkElement element = rowData.RowElement;
				double leftIndent = 0.0;
				if (focusedRowBorderObject != null)
				{
					element = focusedRowBorderObject.RowDataContent;
					leftIndent = focusedRowBorderObject.LeftIndent;
				}
				SetFocusedRectangleOnElement(element, template, leftIndent);
			}
			else
			{
				ClearFocusedRectangle();
			}
		}

		protected void SetFocusedRectangleOnElement(FrameworkElement element, ControlTemplate template, double leftIndent = 0.0, double rightIndent = 0.0)
		{
			if (element != null && UIElementHelper.IsVisibleInTree((UIElement)element, true))
			{
				if (RootView.FocusRectPresenter != null && RootDataPresenter != null)
				{
					RootView.FocusRectPresenter.Owner = element;
					RootView.FocusRectPresenter.ChildTemplate = template;
					RootView.FocusRectPresenter.UpdateRendering(leftIndent, rightIndent);
					RootView.FocusRectPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearFocusedRectangle();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearFocusedRectangle()
		{
			if (RootView.FocusRectPresenter != null)
			{
				RootView.FocusRectPresenter.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}

		private void OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			FocusedRowHandleCore = FocusedRowHandle;
			if (!FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(oldRowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnFocusedRowHandleChangedCore(int oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (FocusedRowHandle != int.MinValue)
			{
				MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView = this;
			}
			UpdateFullRowState(oldRowHandle);
			UpdateIsFocusedCellIfNeeded(oldRowHandle);
			UpdateFullRowState(FocusedRowHandle);
			UpdateIsFocusedCellIfNeeded(FocusedRowHandle);
			SelectionStrategy.OnFocusedRowHandleChanged(oldRowHandle);
			if (IsAdditionalRowFocused)
			{
				ViewBehavior.UpdateAdditionalFocusedRowData();
				ForceUpdateRowsState();
				DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
				SelectionStrategy.OnFocusedRowDataChanged();
				ScrollToFocusedRowIfNeeded();
				return;
			}
			DataProviderBase.MakeRowVisible(FocusedRowHandle);
			if (DataProviderBase.AllowUpdateFocusedRowData)
			{
				UpdateFocusedRowData();
			}
			else
			{
				DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
			}
			int currentIndex = DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex;
			DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow = FocusedRowHandle;
			ForceUpdateRowsState();
			if (currentIndex == DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex)
			{
				RowsStateDirty = true;
			}
			UpdateBorderForFocusedUIElement();
			ScrollToFocusedRowIfNeeded();
			(SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase)?.UpdateResultIndex();
		}

		private void ScrollToFocusedRowIfNeeded()
		{
			if (RootView.AllowScrollToFocusedRow && !DataControl.IsRestoreOffsetInProgress && !DataControl.IsDataResetLocked && IsFocusedView)
			{
				ScrollIntoView(FocusedRowHandle);
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessFocusedElement()
		{
			if (FocusedRowElement != null)
			{
				UpdateRowCellFocusIfNeeded();
				RaiseItemSelectAutomationEvents();
			}
		}

		private void RaiseItemSelectAutomationEvents()
		{
			if (GetNavigation(FocusedRowHandle).ShouldRaiseRowAutomationEvents)
			{
				bool flag = NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row;
				bool flag2 = DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(FocusedRowHandle);
				if ((flag || flag2) && (base.IsFocused || base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin))
				{
					RaiseItemSelectAutomationEvents(FocusedRowElement);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRowCellFocusIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!FloatingContainer.IsModalContainerOpened && IsKeyboardFocusWithinView && (!IsEditing || DataProviderBase == null || !DataProviderBase.RetainCellEditingOnSourceChanges || !DataProviderBase.TrySynchronizeEditingControllerRow()) && !LayoutHelper.IsChildElementEx((DependencyObject)FocusedRowElement, KeyboardHelper.FocusedElement, true) && !IsColumnFilterOpened && !IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && !IsFocusInSearchPanel() && !ColumnChooserHasKeyboardFocus() && !(CurrentCellEditor is FilterRowCellEditor) && LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject(KeyboardHelper.FocusedElement, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject e) => e is FilterPanelControlBase), false, (DependencyObject)null) == null)
			{
				SetFocusToRowCell();
			}
		}

		internal bool ColumnChooserHasKeyboardFocus()
		{
			return DataControl?.FindFirstOriginationDataControl((DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl.viewCore != null && dataControl.viewCore.IsActualColumnChooserCreated && dataControl.viewCore.ActualColumnChooser.TopContainer != null && dataControl.viewCore.ActualColumnChooser.TopContainer.IsKeyboardFocusWithin) != null;
		}

		internal void SetFocusToRowCell()
		{
			if (CurrentCellEditor != null)
			{
				CurrentCellEditor.Edit.SetKeyboardFocus();
			}
			else if (FocusedRowElement != null)
			{
				KeyboardHelper.Focus((UIElement)FocusedRowElement);
			}
			else
			{
				KeyboardHelper.Focus((UIElement)this);
			}
		}

		private bool IsFocusInSearchPanel()
		{
			SearchControl val = (IsRootView ? SearchControl : ((RootView != null) ? RootView.SearchControl : null));
			if (val == null || !UIElementExtensions.GetIsKeyboardFocusWithin((UIElement)(object)val))
			{
				return IsKeyboardFocusInHeadersPanel();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ProcessFocusedViewChange()
		{
			if (!IsFocusedView)
			{
				FocusedRowHandle = int.MinValue;
			}
			UpdateIsKeyboardFocusWithinView();
			UpdateFullRowState();
			ForceUpdateRowsState();
			if (IsFocusedView)
			{
				ScrollIntoView(FocusedRowHandle);
				ScrollToCurrentColumnIfNeeded();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateIsKeyboardFocusWithinView()
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				IsKeyboardFocusWithinView = false;
			}
			else
			{
				IsKeyboardFocusWithinView = IsFocusedView && DataControl.GetRootDataControl().IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateFocusedRowData()
		{
			if (FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (FocusedRowData == null || ViewBehavior.IsAdditionalRowData(FocusedRowData))
			{
				FocusedRowData = CreateFocusedRowData();
			}
			RowHandle rowHandle = FocusedRowData.RowHandle;
			object row = FocusedRowData.Row;
			FocusedRowData.AssignFrom(FocusedRowHandle);
			if (dataControl != null)
			{
				dataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
				if (!object.Equals(rowHandle, FocusedRowData.RowHandle) || !object.Equals(row, FocusedRowData.Row))
				{
					DataControl.UpdateFocusedRowDataposponedAction.PerformIfNotInProgress((Action)RaiseFocusedRowHandleChanged);
				}
				SelectionStrategy.OnFocusedRowDataChanged();
			}
		}

		internal string GetFilterOperatorCustomText(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			filterCriteria = PredefinedFiltersSubstituteHelper.Substitute(filterCriteria, (ICollection<Attributed<IPredefinedFilter>>)EmptyArray<Attributed<IPredefinedFilter>>.Instance, (Func<ICollection<FormatConditionFilter>>)(() => (DataControl?.GetFormatConditionFilters() ?? Enumerable.Empty<FormatConditionFilter>())?.Where((FormatConditionFilter x) => !FormatConditionFiltersHelper.IsTopBottomOrAverageOrUniqueDuplicate(x.Info.Type))?.ToReadOnlyCollection()), (Func<FormatConditionFilterInfo, CriteriaOperator>)((FormatConditionFilterInfo filterInfo) => (CriteriaOperator)null), true);
			return GetFilterOperatorCustomText_NoSubstitute(filterCriteria);
		}

		internal string GetFilterOperatorCustomText_NoSubstitute(CriteriaOperator filterCriteria)
		{
			return DisplayCriteriaHelper.GetFilterDisplayText(filterCriteria, DataControlBase.CreateDisplayCriteriaHelperClient(this), CompatibilitySettings.UseFriendlyDateRangePresentation, delegate(CriteriaOperator x)
			{
				CustomFilterDisplayTextEventArgs e = new CustomFilterDisplayTextEventArgs(this, x)
				{
					RoutedEvent = CustomFilterDisplayTextEvent
				};
				RaiseCustomFilterDisplayText(e);
				return e.Value;
			});
		}

		internal void PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDownCore(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject mouseLeftButtonDownSourceObject = GetMouseLeftButtonDownSourceObject(e);
			IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo = RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(mouseLeftButtonDownSourceObject);
			CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectionStrategy.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			});
			GetNavigation(GetRowHandleByTreeElement(mouseLeftButtonDownSourceObject)).ProcessMouse(mouseLeftButtonDownSourceObject);
			CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectionStrategy.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo, e.StylusDevice, e.ClickCount);
			});
			ViewBehavior.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool UpdateRowsState()
		{
			FocusedView.UpdateBorderForFocusedUIElement();
			if (!RowsStateDirty)
			{
				return false;

			Navigation.UpdateRowsState();
			AdditionalRowNavigation.UpdateRowsState();
			RowsStateDirty = false;
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual bool RequestUIUpdate()
		{
			return EnumerateViewsForCommitEditingAndRequestUIUpdate((DataViewBase view) => view.RequestUIUpdateCore());
		}

		private bool RequestUIUpdateCore(bool cleanError = false, bool skipUIMessages = false)
		{
			if (EnqueueScrollIntoViewLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (RootDataPresenter != null)
			{
				RootDataPresenter.ForceCompleteCurrentAction();
			}
			if (!RootView.LockEditorClose)
			{
				CloseEditor(Navigation.NavigationMouseLocker.IsLocked, cleanError);
			}
			if (!EditFormManager.RequestUIUpdate(skipUIMessages))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI == 0)
			{
				return UpdateRowButtonsRequestUI();
			}
			if (!UpdateRowCommitEditingLocker.IsLocked && UpdateRowButtonsLocker > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !HasCellEditorError;
		}

		protected virtual bool UpdateRowButtonsRequestUI()
		{
			return false;
		}

		private bool EnumerateViewsForCommitEditingAndRequestUIUpdate(Func<DataViewBase, bool> getResult)
		{
			bool flag = getResult(this);
			if (this != MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView)
			{
				flag &= getResult(MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected internal virtual int FindRowHandle(DependencyObject element)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = FindParentRow(element);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			return GetRowHandle(dependencyObject).Value;
		}

		protected internal static DependencyObject FindParentRow(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = obj;
			while (dependencyObject != null && GetRowHandle(dependencyObject) == null)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is DataViewBase)
				{
					return null;
				}
				dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false);
			}
			return dependencyObject;
		}

		protected internal static DependencyObject FindParentCell(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = obj;
			while (dependencyObject != null && ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject) == int.MinValue)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is DataViewBase)
				{
					return null;
				}
				dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false);
			}
			return dependencyObject;
		}

		protected virtual string GetInvalidRowErrorText(string errorText)
		{
			if (errorText.EndsWith("\n") || errorText.EndsWith("\r"))
			{
				return errorText + GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.InvalidRowExceptionMessage);
			}
			return errorText + "\r\n" + GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.InvalidRowExceptionMessage);
		}

		protected virtual MessageBoxResult DisplayInvalidRowError(IInvalidRowExceptionEventArgs e)
		{
			string invalidRowErrorText = GetInvalidRowErrorText(e.ErrorText);
			string windowCaption = e.WindowCaption;
			Window window = DataControl.Window;
			if (window != null)
			{
				return MessageBox.Show(window, invalidRowErrorText, windowCaption, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
			}
			return MessageBox.Show(invalidRowErrorText, windowCaption, MessageBoxButton.YesNo, MessageBoxImage.Hand);
		}

		protected void HandleInvalidRowExceptionEventArgs(ControllerRowExceptionEventArgs e, IInvalidRowExceptionEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (eventArgs.ExceptionMode == ExceptionMode.DisplayError)
			{
				MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult = DisplayInvalidRowError(eventArgs);
				if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.No || messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Cancel)
				{
					eventArgs.ExceptionMode = ExceptionMode.Ignore;
				}
				AllowMouseMoveSelection = false;
			}
			if (eventArgs.ExceptionMode == ExceptionMode.Ignore)
			{
				e.Action = (ExceptionAction)0;
			}
			if (eventArgs.ExceptionMode == ExceptionMode.ThrowException)
			{
				throw e.Exception;
			}
			if ((int)e.Action == 0)
			{
				DataControl.SetRowStateError(((ControllerRowEventArgs)e).RowHandle, null);
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnKeyDown(e);
			if (CurrentCellEditor == null || CurrentCellEditor.Edit.CanHandleBubblingEvent)
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessKeyDown(e);
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape && UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && !IsEditing)
			{
				CancelRowChangesCore();
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = DataControl.FindTargetView(e.OriginalSource);
			if (dataViewBase != this && dataViewBase.IsRootView)
			{
				return;
			}
			dataViewBase.UpdateAllowMouseMoveSelection(e, CanStartSelection() || ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) || ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers));
			UIElement uIElement = e.OriginalSource as UIElement;
			if (SearchControl != null && uIElement != null && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)(object)SearchControl, (DependencyObject)uIElement))
			{
				SetSearchPanelFocus(isKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel: true);
				return;
			}
			SetSearchPanelFocus();
			if (!EditFormManager.IsInlineFormChild(uIElement))
			{
				SelectionStrategy.OnBeforeProcessMouseDown();
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)dataViewBase.InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAllowMouseMoveSelection(MouseButtonEventArgs e, bool canStartSelection)
		{
			if (AllowDragDropOnRootView)
			{
				AllowMouseMoveSelection = (e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject).With((DependencyObject d) => RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(d) as ITableViewHitInfo).Return((ITableViewHitInfo x) => x.IsRowIndicator, () => false);
			}
			else
			{
				AllowMouseMoveSelection = DataControl.With((DataControlBase dc) => DragManager.GetAllowMouseMoveSelectionFunc((DependencyObject)dc)).Return((Func<MouseEventArgs, bool> selectfunc) => selectfunc(e), () => canStartSelection);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanStartSelection()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)EditorShowMode != 1;
		}

		internal void ProcessMouseRightButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)DataControl.FindTargetView(e.OriginalSource).InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessMouseRightButtonDown(e);
		}

		internal void ProcessPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(KeyboardFocusChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessPreviewLostKeyboardFocus(e);
		}

		internal void ProcessIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged()
		{
			if (!base.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
			{
				AllowMouseMoveSelection = false;
			}
			if (!IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && !IsKeyboardFocusInHeadersPanel() && !IsKeyboardFocusWithinContentView() && !IsKeyboardFocusWithinEditForm())
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessIsKeyboardFocusWithinChanged();
			}
			UpdateIsKeyboardFocusWithinView();
			UpdateBorderForFocusedUIElement();
			if (IsKeyboardFocusWithinView)
			{
				ViewBehavior.OnGotKeyboardFocus();
			}
			TryEndRowEdit();
		}

		private void TryEndRowEdit()
		{
			if (!IsFocusedRowModified && !IsKeyboardFocusWithinView && PresentationSource.FromVisual(this) != null && !IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				ViewBehavior.EndRowEdit(isModified: false);
			}
		}

		private bool IsKeyboardFocusWithinContentView()
		{
			if (!(FocusHelper.GetFocusedElement() is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject<DataViewBase>(dependencyObject, false, (DependencyObject)null);
			if (dataViewBase != null && dataViewBase != this)
			{
				return dataViewBase.IsRootView;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsKeyboardFocusWithinEditForm()
		{
			if (!(FocusHelper.GetFocusedElement() is DependencyObject source))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EditFormManager.IsInlineFormChild(source);
		}

		protected virtual void OnNavigationStyleChanged()

			Navigation = null;
			ValidateSelectionStrategy();
			UpdateActualAllowCellMergeCore();
		}

		}

		internal virtual int CoerceFocusedRowHandle(int newValue)
		{
			FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				if (IsAutoFilterRowFocused && DataControl.IsDataResetLocked)
				{
					return FocusedRowHandle;
				}
				if (newValue == FocusedRowHandle)
				{
					return FocusedRowHandle;
				}
				if (IsEditing && DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.RetainCellEditingOnSourceChanges && DataProviderBase.FindEditingControllerRow() == newValue)
				{
					return newValue;
				}
				if (!FocusedView.CommitEditingInternal())
				{
					SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationCanceled();
					return FocusedRowHandle;
				}
				if (ViewBehavior.CheckNavigationStyle(newValue))
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				if (newValue == -2147483646)
				{
					return FocusedRowHandle;
				}
				if (DataControl != null && !DataControl.DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked && IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem && DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource != null && !IsNewItemRowHandle(newValue) && !DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(newValue) && dataControl.IsSync)
				{
					object rowValue = GetRowValue(new RowHandle(newValue));
					DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource.MoveCurrentTo(rowValue);
					return (rowValue == DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource.CurrentItem) ? newValue : FocusedRowHandle;
				}
				return ValidateNewFocusedRowHandleValueByEvent(newValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private int ValidateNewFocusedRowHandleValueByEvent(int newValue)
		{
			FocusedRowHandleChangingEventArgs e = CreateFocusedRowHandleChangingArgs(newValue, rowHandleNavigationType);
			RaiseEventInOriginationView(e);
			return e.NewRowHandle;
		}

		protected internal DependencyObject FindNavigationIndex(int minIndex, int maxIndex, bool findMin, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DependencyObject result = null;
			int num = (findMin ? int.MaxValue : int.MinValue);
			DataViewBase rootView = RootView;
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator((DependencyObject)FocusedRowElement);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				DependencyObject current = val.Current;
				if (current == null || rootView != LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)rootView, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject el) => el is DataViewBase), false, (DependencyObject)null))
				{
					break;
				}
				int navigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(current);
				bool flag = current is FrameworkElement && UIElementHelper.IsVisibleInTree((UIElement)(FrameworkElement)current);
				if (navigationIndex != int.MinValue && navigationIndex >= minIndex && navigationIndex <= maxIndex && flag && (navigationIndex >= VisibleColumnsCore.Count || IsColumnNavigatable(VisibleColumnsCore[navigationIndex], isTabNavigation)) && ((num > navigationIndex && findMin) || (num < navigationIndex && !findMin)))
				{
					result = current;
					num = navigationIndex;
					if ((findMin && num == minIndex) || (!findMin && num == maxIndex))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected internal DependencyObject FindNearLeftNavigationIndex(int currIndex, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return FindNavigationIndex(0, currIndex - 1, findMin: false, isTabNavigation);
		}

		protected internal DependencyObject FindNearRightNavigationIndex(int currIndex, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return FindNavigationIndex(currIndex + 1, int.MaxValue, findMin: true, isTabNavigation);
		}

			}
		}

		internal void ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ViewBehavior.IsNavigationLocked)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			ProcessKeyDownCore(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessKeyDownCore(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsColumnFilterOpened || IsContextMenuOpened)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionStrategy.OnBeforeProcessKeyDown(e);
			if (RootDataPresenter != null && RootDataPresenter.IsInAction)
			{
				RootDataPresenter.ForceCompleteContinuousActions();
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Tab && (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) || AllowLeaveFocusOnTab))
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)InplaceEditorOwner).MoveFocus(e);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (CanStartIncrementalSearch)
			{
				if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
				{
					IncrementalSearchEnd();
				}
				else if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsOnlyCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
				{
					if (e.Key == Key.Down)
					{
						if (IncrementalSearchMoveNext())
						{
							e.Handled = true;
							return;
						}
					}
					else if (e.Key == Key.Up && IncrementalSearchMovePrev())
					{
						e.Handled = true;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.F3)
			{
				ModifierKeys keyboardModifiers = ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e);
				if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(keyboardModifiers))
				{
					SearchResultPrev();
				}
				else if (ModifierKeysHelper.NoModifiers(keyboardModifiers))
				{
					SearchResultNext();
				}
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.Delete && DataControl.DeleteKeyBehavior != DeleteKeyBehavior.None)
			{
				if (DataControl.DeleteKeyBehavior == DeleteKeyBehavior.DeleteFocusedRow && MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.CanDeleteFocusedRow())
				{
					MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.DeleteFocusedRowCommand();
				}
				if (DataControl.DeleteKeyBehavior == DeleteKeyBehavior.DeleteSelectedRows && MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.CanDeleteSelectedRows())
				{
					MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.DeleteSelectedRowsCommand();
				}
			}
			SearchControlKeyDownProcessing(e);
			GetNavigation(FocusedRowHandle).ProcessKey(e);
			CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectionStrategy.OnAfterProcessKeyDown(e);
			});
		}

		internal void SelectRowForce()
		{
			SelectionStrategy.SelectRowForce();
		}

		protected virtual void OnColumnHeaderClick(ColumnBase column, bool isShift, bool isCtrl)
		{
			ColumnHeaderClickEventArgs e = new ColumnHeaderClickEventArgs(column, isShift, isCtrl)
			{
				RoutedEvent = ColumnHeaderClickEvent
			};
			RaiseColumnHeaderClick(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				isShift = e.IsShift;
				isCtrl = e.IsCtrl;
			}
			if (!e.Handled || e.AllowSorting)
			{
				SortInfoCore.OnColumnHeaderClick(column.FieldName, isShift, isCtrl, GetAllowGroupingSortingBySingleColumnOnly(), column.AllowedSortOrders, column.DefaultSortOrder, ColumnSortClearMode);
			}
		}

		protected internal void MovePrevCell(bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (!ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.CanMoveLeftOnString(this, isTabNavigation) || ShouldChangeRowByTab)
			{
				if (IsAutoFilterRowFocused || !ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsTopNewItemRowFocused && IsRootView)
				{
					MovePrevCellCore(isTabNavigation);
				}
				else if ((IsFirstRow && !CanNavigateToNewItemRow) || IsTopNewItemRowFocused)
				{
					DataControl.NavigateToMasterCell(isTabNavigation);
				}
				else if (!DataControl.NavigateToPreviousInnerDetailCell(isTabNavigation))
				{
					MovePrevRow();
					MoveLastNavigationIndex(isTabNavigation);
					if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.IsBeginNavigationIndex(this, isTabNavigation))
					{
						GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle)?.UpdateButtonTabPress(prev: true);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
				{
					RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
					if (rowData != null && rowData.UpdateButtonIsFocused())
					{
						rowData.UpdateButtonTabPress(prev: true);
						return;
					}
				}
				MovePrevCellCore(isTabNavigation);
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
			}
		}

		protected internal void MoveNextCell(bool isTabNavigation, bool isEnterNavigation = false)
		{
			if (!ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.CanMoveRightOnString(this, isTabNavigation) || ShouldChangeRowByTab)
			{
				bool flag = IsTopNewItemRowFocused && (IsRootView || ViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowEditing || isEnterNavigation);
				bool flag2 = IsBottomNewItemRowFocused && (ViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowEditing || (!IsRootView && isEnterNavigation));
				if (flag || flag2)
				{
					MoveNextNewItemRowCell(isTabNavigation: true);
				}
				else if (!IsAutoFilterRowFocused && ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore && !DataControl.NavigateToFirstChildDetailCell(isTabNavigation))
				{
					if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && ViewBehavior.NavigationStrategyBase.IsEndNavigationIndex(this, isTabNavigation))
					{
						GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle)?.UpdateButtonTabPress(prev: false);
						return;
					}
					if (IsLastRow)
					{
						DataControl.NavigateToNextOuterMasterCell(isTabNavigation);
						return;
					}
					MoveNextRow();
					MoveFirstNavigationIndex(isTabNavigation);
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
				{
					RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
					if (rowData != null && rowData.UpdateButtonIsFocused())
					{
						rowData.UpdateButtonTabPress(prev: false);
						return;
					}
				}
				MoveNextCellCore(isTabNavigation);
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
			}
		}

		private void EnqueueScrollIntoView(int rowHandle, bool useLock = false, Action postAction = null)
		{
			if (ImmediateActionsManager.FindActionOfType(typeof(ScrollRowIntoViewAction)) is ScrollRowIntoViewAction scrollRowIntoViewAction)
			{
				scrollRowIntoViewAction.Reassign(this, rowHandle);
				scrollRowIntoViewAction.UseLock = useLock;
				scrollRowIntoViewAction.PostAction = postAction;
			}
			else
			{
				EnqueueImmediateAction((IAction)(object)new ScrollRowIntoViewAction(this, rowHandle, 0)
				{
					UseLock = useLock,
					PostAction = postAction
				});
			}
		}

		public virtual void ScrollIntoView(int rowHandle)
		{
			ScrollIntoViewCore(rowHandle, useLock: false);
		}

		internal void ScrollIntoViewCore(int rowHandle, bool useLock, Action postAction = null)
		{
			ScrollIntoViewLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				DataProviderBase.MakeRowVisible(rowHandle);
				EnqueueScrollIntoView(rowHandle, useLock, postAction);
			});
		}

		public void ScrollIntoView(object row)
		{
			ScrollIntoView(DataProviderBase.FindRowByRowValue(row));
		}

		public virtual void MovePrevPage()
		{
			if ((DataControl.VisibleRowCount != 0 || IsNewItemRowVisible) && (!IsAdditionalRowFocused || !IsRootView) && IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				MovePrevPageCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void MovePrevPageCore()
		{
			if (HasFixedRows && ScrollInfoOwner.Offset == 0)
			{
				MoveFirstRow();
				SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
			else if (ShouldScrollOnePageBack())
			{
				if (RootDataPresenter.CanScrollWithAnimation)
				{
					ScrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction scrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction = new ScrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction(this);
					scrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction.Execute();
				}
				else
				{
					ScrollOnePageUpAction scrollOnePageUpAction = new ScrollOnePageUpAction(this);
					scrollOnePageUpAction.Execute();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocusedRowToFirstScrollRow();
				SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
		}

		public virtual void MoveNextPage()
		{
			if ((DataControl.VisibleRowCount != 0 || IsNewItemRowVisible) && CanMoveFromFocusedRow() && IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				MoveNextPageCore();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void MoveNextPageCore()
		{
			if (HasFixedRows && ScrollInfoOwner.Offset + ScrollInfoOwner.ItemsOnPage >= ScrollInfoOwner.ItemCount)
			{
				MoveLastRow();
				SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
			else if (ShouldScrollOnePageForward())
			{
				if (RootDataPresenter.CanScrollWithAnimation)
				{
					ScrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction scrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction = new ScrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction(this);
					scrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction.Execute();
				}
				else
				{
					ScrollOnePageDownAction scrollOnePageDownAction = new ScrollOnePageDownAction(this);
					scrollOnePageDownAction.Execute();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocusedRowToLastScrollRow();
				SelectionStrategy.OnNavigationComplete(isTabPressed: false);
			}
		}

		internal bool CanMoveFromFocusedRow()
		{
			if (IsAutoFilterRowFocused && NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
			{
				if (DataControl.CurrentColumn != null)
				{
					return DataControl.CurrentColumn.AllowFocus;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ShouldScrollOnePageBack()
		{
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonCurrentItem = default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonTargetItem = default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			DataViewBase view = null;
			int visibleIndex = -1;
			GetFirstScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view, out visibleIndex);
			if (view != null && view.IsPagingMode && visibleIndex == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			FindCommonViewVisibleIndexes(view, visibleIndex, out commonCurrentItem, out commonTargetItem);
			int num = commonCurrentItem.Value - commonTargetItem.Value;
			return num <= 0;
		}

		private bool ShouldScrollOnePageForward()
		{
			if (IsTopNewItemRowFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonCurrentItem = default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonTargetItem = default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			DataViewBase view = null;
			int visibleIndex = -1;
			GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view, out visibleIndex);
			if (view == null || (view.IsPagingMode && visibleIndex == view.LastVisibleIndexOnPage))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FindCommonViewVisibleIndexes(view, visibleIndex, out commonCurrentItem, out commonTargetItem);
			int num = commonCurrentItem.Value - commonTargetItem.Value;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				int num2 = ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex);
				int num3 = view.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex);
				if (num2 > num3)
				{
					List<int> parentFixedRowsScrollIndexes = view.DataControl.GetParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(visibleIndex);
					if (parentFixedRowsScrollIndexes.Contains(num2))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return num >= 0;
		}

		private void FindCommonViewVisibleIndexes(DataViewBase targetView, int targetVisibleIndex, out KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonCurrentItem, out KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> commonTargetItem)
		{
			List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> viewVisibleIndexChain = DataControl.GetViewVisibleIndexChain(DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex);
			if (viewVisibleIndexChain.Count == 0)
			{
				viewVisibleIndexChain = DataControl.GetViewVisibleIndexChain(targetVisibleIndex);
			}
			if (targetView == null)
			{
				commonCurrentItem = (commonTargetItem = viewVisibleIndexChain[0]);
				return;
			}
			List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> viewVisibleIndexChain2 = targetView.DataControl.GetViewVisibleIndexChain(targetVisibleIndex);
			commonCurrentItem = viewVisibleIndexChain[0];
			commonTargetItem = viewVisibleIndexChain2[0];
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> item in viewVisibleIndexChain)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> item2 in viewVisibleIndexChain2)
				{
					if (item.Key == item2.Key)
					{
						commonCurrentItem = item;
						commonTargetItem = item2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal int CalcFirstScrollRowScrollIndex()
		{
			return Math.Min((int)Math.Ceiling(RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + (double)ActualFixedTopRowsCount), RootDataPresenter.ItemCount - 1);
		}

		internal void GetFirstScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out DataViewBase view, out int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(CalcFirstScrollRowScrollIndex(), forwardIfServiceRow: true, out view, out visibleIndex))
			{
				DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(CalcFirstScrollRowScrollIndex(), forwardIfServiceRow: false, out view, out visibleIndex);
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = view;
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = view.DataControl;
			int visibleIndex2 = visibleIndex;
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataControlBase.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			if (dataControlBase.IsExpandedFixedRow(visibleIndex2))
			{
				GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
				while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext() && (!(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData) || rowData.View != dataViewBase || rowData.RowHandle.Value != rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
				{
				}
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext() && gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData2)
				{
					view = rowData2.View;
					visibleIndex = dataControlBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowData2.RowHandle.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int CalcLastScrollRowScrollIndex()
		{
			DataViewBase view = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view, out visibleIndex);
			return view?.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex) ?? 0;
		}

		protected internal bool IsLoadingRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			return rowData is LoadingRowData;
		}

		internal void GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out DataViewBase view, out int visibleIndex)
		{
			RowData rowData = null;
			int num = 0;
			System.Windows.Point point = default(System.Windows.Point);
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentNode.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData.WholeRowElement, (UIElement)RootDataPresenter);
					System.Windows.Point point2 = RectHelper.TopLeft(relativeElementRect);
					if ((point2.X >= point.X || DXArranger.Floor(point2.Y, 4) >= point.Y) && SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(point2) >= RootDataPresenter.Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => x.FixedTopRowsHeight, () => 0.0))
					{
						num++;
					}
					point = new System.Windows.Point(relativeElementRect.Right, DXArranger.Floor(relativeElementRect.Bottom, 4));
					if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData2 && !(rowData2.MatchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey) && !IsLoadingRowData(rowData2))
					{
						rowData = rowData2;
					}
					if (num >= RootDataPresenter.FullyVisibleItemsCount)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				view = rowData.View;
				visibleIndex = rowData.View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			}
			else
			{
				view = null;
				visibleIndex = -1;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void MoveFocusedRowToFirstScrollRow()
		{
			DataViewBase view = null;

		protected internal virtual void MoveFocusedRowToLastScrollRow()

		internal void MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndexForPageUpPageDown(int scrollIndex, bool pageUp)
		{
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = 0;
			if (scrollIndex == 0 && pageUp)
			{
				targetView = RootView;
				targetVisibleIndex = (IsPagingMode ? FirstVisibleIndexOnPage : 0);
			}
			else
			{
				DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex, pageUp, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
			}
			int num = targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex);
			if (targetView.DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 0 && targetView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				num = -2147483647;
			}
			if (RootDataPresenter.CanScrollWithAnimation && targetView == FocusedView && num == targetView.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				ScrollIntoView(num);
			}
			FocusViewAndRow(targetView, num, pageUp ? NavigationType.Prev : NavigationType.Next);
		}

			EnqueueImmediateAction(val);
		}

		protected internal virtual int ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int scrollIndexWithDetails = 0;
			DataControl.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl, int index)
			{
				int num = dataControl.DataProviderBase.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(index, dataControl.DataView.AllowFixedGroupsCore);
				scrollIndexWithDetails += num;
				scrollIndexWithDetails += dataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(num);
			}, visibleIndex);
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			scrollIndexWithDetails += DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountForRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			return scrollIndexWithDetails;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldChangeForwardIndex(int rowHandle)
		{
			DataViewBase view = null;
			int visibleIndex = -1;
			GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view, out visibleIndex);
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			if (rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore <= visibleIndex + 1 && view == this)
			{
				if (ScrollActionsHelper.IsRowElementVisible(this, rowHandle))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ScrollActionsHelper.GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(this, rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, needToAdjustScroll: true) > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual double CalcOffsetForward(int rowHandle, bool perPixelScrolling)
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = null;
			frameworkElement = ((rowHandle != -2147483647 || !IsNewItemRowVisible) ? GetRowElementByVisibleIndex(dataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle)) : GetRowElementByRowHandle(rowHandle));
			if (frameworkElement == null || !FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree(frameworkElement))
			{
				return 1.0;
			}
			return CalcOffsetByHeight(GetItemInvisibleSize(frameworkElement), perPixelScrolling);
		}

		internal double CalcOffsetForBackwardScrolling(int firstInvisibleIndex)
		{
			FrameworkElement rowElementByVisibleIndex = GetRowElementByVisibleIndex(firstInvisibleIndex);
			if (rowElementByVisibleIndex == null || !FrameworkElementExtensions.IsInVisualTree(rowElementByVisibleIndex))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double itemVisibleSize = GetItemVisibleSize(rowElementByVisibleIndex);
			if (itemVisibleSize == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return CalcOffsetByHeight(itemVisibleSize, perPixelScrolling: true);
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetRowElementByVisibleIndex(int index)
		{
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(index));
			if (rowData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetRowVisibleElement(rowData);
		}

		protected virtual double GetItemInvisibleSize(FrameworkElement elem)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)elem, (UIElement)RootDataPresenter);
			return SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(RectHelper.Size(relativeElementRect)) - GetItemVisibleSize(elem);
		}

		protected virtual double GetItemVisibleSize(FrameworkElement elem)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)elem, (UIElement)RootDataPresenter);
			return SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(RootDataPresenter.LastConstraint) - RootDataPresenter.Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => x.FixedBottomRowsHeight, () => 0.0) - SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.Location(relativeElementRect));
		}

		internal double CalcOffsetByHeight(double invisibleHeight, bool perPixelScrolling)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			RowDataBase rowDataToScroll = RootDataPresenter.GetRowDataToScroll();
			bool flag = false;
			double num2 = RootDataPresenter.Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => x.FixedTopRowsHeight, () => 0.0);
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentNode.FixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					continue;
				}
				FrameworkElement rowVisibleElement = GetRowVisibleElement(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData);
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)rowVisibleElement, (UIElement)RootDataPresenter);
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (rowDataToScroll != null && rowDataToScroll.node != gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentNode)
					{
						num2 = relativeElementRect.Bottom;
						continue;
					}
					flag = true;
				}
				double defineSize = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(RectHelper.Size(relativeElementRect));
				if (SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.Location(relativeElementRect)) < num2)
				{
					invisibleHeight -= SizeHelper.GetDefinePoint(RectHelper.Location(relativeElementRect)) - num2;
				}
				if (defineSize >= invisibleHeight)
				{
					num += (perPixelScrolling ? (invisibleHeight / defineSize) : 1.0);
					break;
				}
				invisibleHeight -= defineSize;
				num += 1.0;
				num2 = relativeElementRect.Bottom;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void FocusViewAndRow(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle, NavigationType navigationType = NavigationType.Other)
		{
			if (MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView == view || MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.CommitEditingInternal())
			{
				MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView = view;
				view.SetFocusedRowHandle(rowHandle, navigationType);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal void NavigateToFirstRow()
		{
			if (!IsNewItemRowVisible)

			else
			{
				FocusViewAndRow(this, -2147483647);
			}
		}

		public virtual void MoveLastRow()
		{
			if (IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds() && CanMoveFromFocusedRow())
			{
				FocusViewAndRow(this, DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(DataControl.LastRowIndex), NavigationType.Last);
			}
		}

		internal void NavigateToLastRow()
		{
			if (DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0)
			{
				MoveFocusedRow(DataControl.LastRowIndex - ActualFixedBottomRowsCount);
			}
			else if (IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				FocusViewAndRow(this, -2147483647);
			}
		}

		internal void MoveLastOrLastMasterRow()

				else
				{
					MoveLastMasterRow();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void OnIsColumnChooserVisibleChanged()
		{
			if (OriginationView == null && !DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(this))
			{
				if (RootView.IsLoaded)
				{
					OnIsColumnChooserVisibleChangedCore();
				}
				else
				{
					ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)OnIsColumnChooserVisibleChangedCore);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnIsColumnChooserVisibleChangedCore()
		{
			if (IsColumnChooserVisible)
			{
				RootView.UpdateAllOriginationViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					if (view != this)
					{
						view.HideColumnChooser();
					}
				});
				RootView.ForceCreateColumnChooserStateInternal();
				ActualColumnChooser.ApplyState(RootView.ColumnChooserState);
				ActualColumnChooser.Show();
				RaiseShownColumnChooser(new RoutedEventArgs(ShownColumnChooserEvent));
			}
			else
			{
				ActualColumnChooser.SaveState(RootView.ColumnChooserState);
				ActualColumnChooser.Hide();
				RaiseHiddenColumnChooser(new RoutedEventArgs(HiddenColumnChooserEvent));
			}
		}

		private void OnActiveEditorChanged()
		{
			if (CurrentCellEditor is CellEditorBase)
			{
				((CellEditorBase)(object)CurrentCellEditor).CellData.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
			if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.RetainCellEditingOnSourceChanges)
			{
				if (ActiveEditor != null)
				{
					DataProviderBase.EditingControllerRow = FocusedRowHandle;
					DataProviderBase.EditingControllerRowObject = DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				else
				{
					DataProviderBase.EditingControllerRow = int.MinValue;
					DataProviderBase.EditingControllerRowObject = null;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public FrameworkElement GetRowElementByRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			Nodes.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out var value);
			if (value != null && IsInvisibleGroupRow(value))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (rowHandle == -2147483645 || (IsNewItemRowHandle(rowHandle) && IsNewItemRowVisible))
			{
				return ViewBehavior.GetAdditionalRowElement(rowHandle);
			}
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(rowHandle);
			if (rowData != null && ((ISupportVisibleIndex)rowData).VisibleIndex >= 0)
			{
				return rowData.RowElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

			if (IsAdditionalRowFocused && !IsNewItemRowHandle(FocusedRowHandle) && FocusedRowHandle != -2147483645)

			{

			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = -1;

			{

			int index = ((FocusedRowHandle == int.MinValue) ? (-1) : DataControl.CurrentIndex);

		internal void ChangeColumnsSortOrder(ChangeColumnsSortOrderMode mode)
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>().Where(delegate(ColumnBase x)
			{
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (mode.HasFlag(ChangeColumnsSortOrderMode.NotSortedColumns) && (int)x.SortOrder == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (mode.HasFlag(ChangeColumnsSortOrderMode.SortedColumns) && (int)x.SortOrder != 0 && x.GroupIndexCore < 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return (mode.HasFlag(ChangeColumnsSortOrderMode.GroupedColumns) && (int)x.SortOrder != 0 && x.GroupIndexCore >= 0) ? true : false;
			}))
			{
				OnColumnHeaderClick(item, isShift: true, isCtrl: false);
			}
		}

		protected void ShowFilterEditorInternal(object filterCriteriaSource, string filterCriteriaPropertyName, ColumnBase defaultColumn)
		{

			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_012e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0133: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0142: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0151: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0158: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (IsFilterControlOpened || PresentationSource.FromVisual(RootView) == null)
			{

			{

			};

		internal FloatingContainer ShowDialogContent(FrameworkElement dialogContent, System.Windows.Size size, FloatingContainerParameters parameters)
		{
			PopupBaseEdit popupBaseEdit = default(PopupBaseEdit);
			ref PopupBaseEdit reference = ref popupBaseEdit;
			BaseEdit ownerEdit = BaseEdit.GetOwnerEdit((DependencyObject)this);
			reference = (PopupBaseEdit)(object)((ownerEdit is PopupBaseEdit) ? ownerEdit : null);
			bool? staysPopupOpen = false;
			popupBaseEdit.Do(delegate(PopupBaseEdit edit)
			{
				staysPopupOpen = edit.StaysPopupOpen;
				edit.StaysPopupOpen = true;
			});
			FloatingContainer floatingContainer = null;
			if (!DesignTimeAdorner.IsDesignTime)
			{
				floatingContainer = FloatingContainer.ShowDialogContent(dialogContent, (FrameworkElement)RootView, size, parameters);
			}
			else
			{
				DesignTimeAdorner.ShowDialogContent(dialogContent, RootView, size, parameters);
			}
			RoutedEventHandler floatingContainerHidden = null;
			floatingContainerHidden = delegate
			{
				floatingContainer.Hidden -= floatingContainerHidden;
				DataControl.Focus();
				popupBaseEdit.Do(delegate(PopupBaseEdit edit)
				{
					edit.StaysPopupOpen = staysPopupOpen;
				});
			};
			if (floatingContainer != null)
			{
				floatingContainer.Hidden += floatingContainerHidden;
			}
			return floatingContainer;
		}

		internal async void DeleteRows(List<int> rowHandles)
		{
			IsDeleting = true;
			rowHandles = rowHandles.OrderBy((int x) => x).Distinct().ToList();
			int[] descendedRowHandles = rowHandles.OrderByDescending((int x) => x).ToArray();
			List<int> sourceIndices = descendedRowHandles.Select((int r) => DataProviderBase.GetListIndexByRowHandle(r)).ToList();
			List<object> initialRows = sourceIndices.Select((int i) => DataProviderBase.GetRowByListIndex(i)).ToList();
			try
			{
				GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs e = await GetValidationResultAsync(rowHandles);
				bool flag = true;
				if (e.Result?.ErrorContent != null)
				{
					ShowDeletionError(e.Result.ErrorContent, e.DisplayErrorMode);
					flag = false;
				}
				if (!IsRowsActual(initialRows, sourceIndices))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					DeleteRowsCore(descendedRowHandles);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ShowDeletionError(ExceptionMessageHelper.GetExceptionMessage(ex), DisplayDeleteOperationError.ShowMessageBox);
			}
			finally
			{
				OnDeleted();
			}
		}

		private void OnDeleted()
		{
			CloseSplashScreen();
			IsDeleting = false;
			FocusedRowHandle = ValidateNewFocusedRowHandleValueByEvent(FocusedRowHandle);
		}

		private bool IsRowsActual(IEnumerable<object> rows, IEnumerable<int> sourceIndices)
		{
			return rows.SequenceEqual(sourceIndices.Select((int i) => DataProviderBase.GetRowByListIndex(i)));
		}

		private async Task<GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs> GetValidationResultAsync(List<int> rowHandles)
		{
			GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs validationResult = ValidateRowDeletionCore(rowHandles);
			if (validationResult.ResultAsync != null)
			{
				ShowSplashScreen();
				GridValidateRowDeletionEventArgs e = validationResult;
				e.Result = await validationResult.ResultAsync;
			}
			return validationResult;
		}

		private void ShowDeletionError(string message, DisplayDeleteOperationError mode)
		{
			switch (mode)
			{
			case DisplayDeleteOperationError.ShowMessageBox:
				messageBoxService.ShowMessage(message, LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlStringId.DeletionErrorCaption.ToString()), MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error, MessageResult.None);
				break;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Unknown value for DeletionErrorShowMode");
			case DisplayDeleteOperationError.Disabled:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected virtual List<int> GetRowHandlesToDelete(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			return rowHandles.SelectMany((int r) => GetRowHandlesToDeleteCore(r, new HashSet<int>(rowHandles))).ToList();
		}

		private List<int> GetRowHandlesToDeleteCore(int rowHandle, HashSet<int> skip)
		{
			if (!IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return new List<int> { rowHandle };
			}
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			Stack<int> stack = new Stack<int>();
			stack.Push(rowHandle);
			while (stack.Any())
			{
				int groupRowHandle = stack.Pop();
				List<int> list2 = GetGroupChildRowHandles(groupRowHandle).ToList();
				foreach (int item in list2)
				{
					if (!skip.Contains(item))
					{
						if (IsGroupRowHandleCore(item))
						{
							stack.Push(item);
						}
						else
						{
							list.Add(item);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal virtual void DeleteFocusedRowCommand()
		{
			DeleteFocusedRow();
		}

		internal virtual void DeleteSelectedRowsCommand()
		{
			DeleteSelectedRows();
		}

		protected internal virtual void DeleteRowsCore(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			CancelEditIfNeeded(rowHandles);
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(FocusedRowHandle);
			FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				DataProviderBase.DeleteRows(rowHandles.Select((int r) => new RowHandle(r)).ToArray());
			});
			RestoreFocus(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore);
		}

		protected internal virtual void DeleteRowCore(int rowHandle)
		{
			CancelEditIfNeeded(new int[1] { rowHandle });
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(FocusedRowHandle);
			FocusedRowHandleChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				DataProviderBase.DeleteRow(new RowHandle(rowHandle));
			});
			RestoreFocus(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore);
		}

		private void CancelEditIfNeeded(IEnumerable<int> rowHandles)
		{
			if ((IsNewItemRowFocused && IsFocusedRowModified) || rowHandles.Any((int r) => r == -2147483647))
			{
				CancelEditFocusedRow();
			}
		}

		private void RestoreFocus(int previousFocusedIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(previousFocusedIndex);
			if (rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore == int.MinValue)
			{
				rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1);
			}
			SetFocusedRowHandle(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
		}
