		protected bool IsAddDeleteInSource()
		{
			if (IsVirtualSource)
			{
				DataControlBase dataControlBase = DataControl;
				if (dataControlBase == null || !dataControlBase.DataProviderBase.IsInfiniteAsyncSource)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				if (!(DataProviderBase.DataSource is IList) && !(DataProviderBase.DataSource is IEditableCollectionView))
				{
					return DataProviderBase.DataSource is IListSource;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanEndEditFocusedRow()
		{
			if (!DoingLongTermOperation && !IsAutoFilterRowFocused)
			{
				return IsEditing;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanCancelEditFocusedRow()
		{
			if (!DoingLongTermOperation && !IsAutoFilterRowFocused)
			{
				if (!DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing)
				{
					return ActiveEditor != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanDeleteRows()
		{
			if (!UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.AllowRemove && !IsEditing && !DoingLongTermOperation && IsFocusedView && DataProviderBase.DataRowCount > 0)
			{
				return IsAddDeleteInSource();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanDeleteRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle != int.MinValue && rowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return rowHandle != -2147483645;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanDeleteFocusedRow()
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (CanDeleteRows() && FocusedRowData != null)
			{
				return CanDeleteRow(FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanDeleteSelectedRows()
		{
			int[] recursiveSelectedRowHandles = DataControl.GetRecursiveSelectedRowHandles();
			if (CanDeleteRows() && recursiveSelectedRowHandles.Length != 0)
			{
				return recursiveSelectedRowHandles.All((int r) => CanDeleteRow(r));
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanAddNewRow()
		{
			if (!IsEditing && !AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && !DoingLongTermOperation && IsAddDeleteInSource() && DataProviderBase.DataController != null)
			{
				return ((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).AllowNew;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanEditFocusedRow()
		{
			if (DoingLongTermOperation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (this is ITableView && ((ITableView)this).EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.None)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (IsVirtualSource && ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (EditFormManager.AllowEditForm && CanShowEditForm())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsAutoFilterRowFocused || NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell || DataControl == null || DataControl.CurrentColumn == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ActiveEditor == null && CurrentCellEditor != null)
			{
				return CurrentCellEditor.CanShowEditor();
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		public bool CanRefreshDataSource()
		{
			if (IsDataSourceRefreshing || AreUpdateRowButtonsShown || IsEditFormShown || DoingLongTermOperation)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = DataProviderBase;
			if (dataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (dataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode && dataProviderBase.IsAsyncOperationInProgress)
			{
				return false;
			}
			VirtualSourceBase virtualSource = dataProviderBase.VirtualSource;
			if (virtualSource == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			VirtualSourceBase obj = ((virtualSource is InfiniteSourceBase) ? virtualSource : null);
			if (obj == null || !((InfiniteSourceBase)obj).IsResetting)
			{
				return !virtualSource.AreRowsFetching;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public async Task RefreshDataSourceAsync()
		{
			IsDataSourceRefreshing = true;
			ShowSplashScreen();
			try
			{
				await DoRefreshCore();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				messageBoxService.ShowMessage(ExceptionMessageHelper.GetExceptionMessage(ex), GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.RefreshDataSourceFailed), MessageButton.OK, MessageIcon.Error, MessageResult.None);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode || !DataProviderBase.IsAsyncOperationInProgress)
				{
					OnRefreshDataSourceEnded();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnRefreshDataSourceEnded()
		{
			if (IsDataSourceRefreshing)
			{
				CloseSplashScreen();
				IsDataSourceRefreshing = false;
			}
		}

		private async Task DoRefreshCore()
		{
			DataSourceRefreshEventArgs e = new DataSourceRefreshEventArgs(DataSourceRefreshEvent, this);
			RaiseEvent(e);
			Task refreshAsync = e.RefreshAsync;
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				await AwaitRefresh(refreshAsync);
				return;
			}
			if (DataSourceRefreshCommand != null)
			{
				DataSourceRefreshArgs dataSourceRefreshArgs = new DataSourceRefreshArgs();
				DataSourceRefreshCommand.Execute(dataSourceRefreshArgs);
				refreshAsync = dataSourceRefreshArgs.RefreshAsync;
				if (dataSourceRefreshArgs.Handled)
				{
					await AwaitRefresh(refreshAsync);
					return;
				}
			}
			await AwaitRefresh(refreshAsync);
			XtraRefreshSource();
		}

		private void XtraRefreshSource()
		{
			IXtraRefreshable val = (IXtraRefreshable)(((object)DataProviderBase?.XtraRefreshableSource) ?? ((object)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/));
			if (val != null && val.RefreshSupported)
			{
				val.Refresh();
			}
		}

		private async Task AwaitRefresh(Task refreshAsync)
		{
			if (refreshAsync != null)
			{
				await refreshAsync;
			}
		}

		}

		}

		internal void HideEditor(bool closeEditor)
		{
			if (CurrentCellEditor != null)
			{
				if (closeEditor)
				{
					CurrentCellEditor.CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
				}
				else
				{
					CurrentCellEditor.HideEditor(false);
				}
			}
		}

		public void CloseEditor()
		{
			CloseEditor(closeEditor: true);
		}

		internal void CloseEditor(bool closeEditor, bool cleanError = false)
		{
			if (CurrentCellEditor == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			CurrentCellEditor.CommitEditor(closeEditor);
			if (!cleanError)
			{
				return;
			}
			InplaceEditorBase currentCellEditor = CurrentCellEditor;
			if (currentCellEditor != null)
			{
				currentCellEditor.ClearError();
			}
			if (HasCellEditorError)
			{
				InplaceEditorBase currentCellEditor2 = CurrentCellEditor;
				if (currentCellEditor2 != null)
				{
					currentCellEditor2.CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal virtual bool CommitEditingImpl(bool forceCommit, bool cleanError = false, bool skipUIMessages = false)
		{
			return EnumerateViewsForCommitEditingAndRequestUIUpdate((DataViewBase view) => view.CommitEditingCore(forceCommit, cleanError, skipUIMessages));
		}

		private bool CommitEditingCore(bool forceCommit, bool cleanError = false, bool skipUIMessages = false)
		{
			bool isModified = IsFocusedRowModified;
			bool result = RequestUIUpdateCore(cleanError, skipUIMessages);
			if (!result && !forceCommit)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (!result)
			{
				HideEditor(closeEditor: false);
			}
			if (!AutoScrollOnSorting)
			{
				ScrollIntoViewLocker.Lock();
			}
			CommitEditingLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				result = result && ViewBehavior.EndRowEdit(isModified);
			});
			if (!AutoScrollOnSorting)
			{
				ScrollIntoViewLocker.Unlock();
			}
			if (!result)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CancelRoutedEventArgs e = (CancelRoutedEventArgs)(object)new GridCancelRoutedEventArgs(DataControl, BeforeLayoutRefreshEvent);
			RaiseBeforeLayoutRefresh(e);
			return !e.Cancel;
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseBeforeLayoutRefresh(CancelRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEventInOriginationView((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e);
		}

		protected internal virtual void RaiseCustomScrollAnimation(CustomScrollAnimationEventArgs e)
		{
			RaiseEvent(e);
		}

		public void CancelRowEdit()
		{
			bool isFocusedRowModified = IsFocusedRowModified;
			if (CurrentCellEditor != null)
			{
				CurrentCellEditor.CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
			}
			if (DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing)
			{
				DataProviderBase.CancelCurrentRowEdit();
			}
			ViewBehavior.OnCancelRowEdit(isFocusedRowModified);
			DataControl.SetRowStateError(FocusedRowHandle, null);
		}

		public virtual void ShowUnboundExpressionEditor(ColumnBase column)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UnboundExpressionEditorEventArgs e = new UnboundExpressionEditorEventArgs(UnboundExpressionEditorCreatedEvent, column);
			RaiseEventInOriginationView((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e);
			if (((RoutedEventArgs)(object)e).Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			ExpressionEditorDialogClosedDelegate val = (ExpressionEditorDialogClosedDelegate)delegate(string expression)
			{
				if (expression != null)
				{
					column.UnboundExpression = expression;
				}
			};
			ExpressionEditorHelper.ShowExpressionEditor((ExpressionEditorCreatedEventArgsBase)(object)e, val, (FrameworkElement)this);
		}

		void IColumnOwnerBase.CalcColumnsLayout()
		{
			if (IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout || ColumnsCore.IsLockUpdate)
			{
				return;
			}
			RebuildColumns(needUpdateErrors: false);
			UpdateColumns(delegate(ColumnBase column)
			{
				column.UpdateActualAllowResizing();
				column.UpdateActualAllowMoving();
			});
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ForeachBand(delegate(BandBase b)
				{
					b.UpdateActualAllowResizing();
					b.UpdateActualAllowMoving();
				});
				if (this is ITableView tableView)
				{
					tableView.OnChangeBandSeparator();
				}
			}
		}

		HorizontalAlignment IColumnOwnerBase.GetDefaultColumnAlignment(ColumnBase column)
		{
			Type columnType = GetColumnType(column);
			if (!(columnType != null) || columnType.IsEnum || !DefaultColumnAlignmentHelper.IsColumnFarAlignedByDefault(columnType))
			{
				return HorizontalAlignment.Left;
			}
			return HorizontalAlignment.Right;
		}

		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanSortColumnCore(ColumnBase column, string fieldName, bool prohibitColumnProperty)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!DataControl.DataProviderBase.CanColumnSortCore(fieldName))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (column == null || (int)column.AllowSorting == 2)
			{
				DataColumnInfo val = DataProviderBase.Columns[fieldName];
				if (val != null)
				{
					return CanSortDataColumnInfo(val);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (column != null)
			{
				if (!prohibitColumnProperty)
				{
					return (int)column.AllowSorting != 1;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanSortDataColumnInfo(DataColumnInfo columnInfo)
		{
			return columnInfo.AllowSort;
		}

		object IConvertClonePropertyValue.ConvertClonePropertyValue(string propertyName, object sourceValue, DependencyObject destinationObject)
		{
			if (propertyName != "FocusedColumn")
			{
				return sourceValue;
			}
			if (sourceValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = (ColumnBase)sourceValue;
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = (DataViewBase)destinationObject;
			if (dataViewBase.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CloneDetailHelper.SafeGetDependentCollectionItem<ColumnBase>(columnBase, (ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>)columnBase.View.ColumnsCore, (IList)dataViewBase.ColumnsCore);
		}

				});
			});
		}

		private void UpdateSearchPanelColumnProviderBindings()
		{
			if (DataControl != null && SearchControl != null)
			{
				if (SearchPanelColumnProvider == null)
				{
					UpdateGridControlColumnProvider();
				}
				if (SearchPanelColumnProvider.DataControlBase != null && SearchPanelColumnProvider.DataControlBase != DataControl)
				{
					SearchPanelColumnProvider.DataControlBase = DataControl;
				}
				Binding binding = new Binding();
				binding.Source = SearchPanelColumnProvider;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(GridControlColumnProviderBase.FilterByColumnsModeProperty));
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				Binding binding2 = binding;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)SearchControl).SetBinding(SearchControl.FilterByColumnsModeProperty, (BindingBase)binding2);
				SearchControl.ColumnProvider = (ISearchPanelColumnProviderBase)(object)SearchPanelColumnProvider;
				binding = new Binding();
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(SearchPanelHighlightResultsProperty));
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				Binding binding3 = binding;
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.SetBinding(GridControlColumnProviderBase.AllowTextHighlightingProperty, binding3);
				binding = new Binding();
				binding.Source = this;
				binding.Path = new PropertyPath(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(SearchPanelAllowFilterProperty));
				binding.Mode = BindingMode.OneWay;
				Binding binding4 = binding;
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.SetBinding(GridControlColumnProviderBase.AllowGridExtraFilterProperty, binding4);
				ApplySearchColumns();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateShowSearchPanelNavigationButtons()

		}

		internal void UpdateShowSearchPanelResultInfo()
		{
			int actualShowSearchPanelResultInfo;
			if (ShowSearchPanelResultInfo && !SearchPanelAllowFilter)
			{
				GridControlColumnProviderBase searchPanelColumnProvider = SearchPanelColumnProvider;
				actualShowSearchPanelResultInfo = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty((searchPanelColumnProvider != null) ? ((ISearchPanelColumnProviderBase)searchPanelColumnProvider).GetSearchText() : null)) ? 1 : 0);
			}
			else
			{
				actualShowSearchPanelResultInfo = 0;
			}
			ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo = (byte)actualShowSearchPanelResultInfo != 0;
		}

				GridControlColumnProviderBase value = new GridControlColumnProviderBase

					AllowColumnsHighlighting = false
				};
				GridControlColumnProviderBase.SetColumnProvider(DataControl, value);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSearchPanelText()
		{
			UpdateSearchPanelVisibility(updateSearchControl: false);
			UpdateSearchPanelTextCore();
			RaisePropertyChanged(SearchStringProperty.Name);
			UpdateShowSearchPanelResultInfo();
		}

		private void UpdateSearchPanelTextCore()
		{
			if (SearchControl == null && (ShowSearchPanelMode == ShowSearchPanelMode.Never || (IsVirtualSource && ShowSearchPanelMode == ShowSearchPanelMode.Default)))
			{
				SearchControl = (SearchControl)(object)new GridSearchControlBase
				{
					View = this
				};
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSearchPanelVisibility(bool updateSearchControl = true)
		{
			switch (ShowSearchPanelMode)
			{
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Never:
				ActualShowSearchPanel = false;
				break;
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Always:
				ActualShowSearchPanel = true;
				break;
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Default:
				if (!IsVirtualSource)
				{
					if (!ActualShowSearchPanel)
					{
						ActualShowSearchPanel = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchString);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ActualShowSearchPanel = false;
				}
				break;
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.HotKey:
				if (!ActualShowSearchPanel)
				{
					ActualShowSearchPanel = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchString);
				}
				break;
			}
			if (updateSearchControl && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchString))
			{
				UpdateSearchPanelTextCore();
			}
		}

		public void ShowSearchPanel(bool moveFocusInSearchPanel)
		{
			if (ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Never && (!IsVirtualSource || ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Default))
			{
				if ((ShowSearchPanelMode == ShowSearchPanelMode.Default || ShowSearchPanelMode == ShowSearchPanelMode.HotKey) && !ActualShowSearchPanel)
				{
					ActualShowSearchPanel = true;
				}
				if (moveFocusInSearchPanel)
				{
					FocusSearchPanel();
				}
			}
		}

			{
				result = Convert.ToBoolean(commandParameter);
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void OnActualShowSearchPanelChanged()
		{
			if (ActualShowSearchPanel)
			{
				ShowSearchPanel(moveFocusInSearchPanel: false);
			}
			else
			{
				HideSearchPanel();
			}
		}

		private void SearchColumnsChanged(string columnsString)
		{
			ApplySearchColumns();
		}

		internal void ApplySearchColumns()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchColumns) || SearchPanelColumnProvider == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			ObservableCollection<string> searchColumns = GridColumnListParser.GetSearchColumns(list, SearchColumns);
			if (searchColumns != null)
			{
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.FilterByColumnsMode = (FilterByColumnsMode)1;
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.CustomColumns = searchColumns;
			}
			else
			{
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.FilterByColumnsMode = (FilterByColumnsMode)0;
			}
			if (SearchControl == null)
			{
				SearchPanelColumnProvider.UpdateColumns();
			}
			else
			{
				SearchControl.UpdateColumnProvider();
			}
		}

		public void HideSearchPanel()
		{
			if (ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Default && ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.HotKey)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase)
			{
				gridSearchControlBase.FadeSearchPanel(delegate
				{
					ActualShowSearchPanel = false;
				});
			}
			else
			{
				ActualShowSearchPanel = false;
			}
		}

		{
			if (SearchPanelColumnProvider != null && SearchControl != null)
			{
				SearchControl.UpdateColumnProvider();
			}
		}

		protected bool CanShowSearchPanel()
		{
			switch (ShowSearchPanelMode)
			{
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Default:
				return !IsVirtualSource;
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.HotKey:
			case ShowSearchPanelMode.Always:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected void SearchControlKeyDownProcessing(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsRootView && RootView != null)
			{
				RootView.SearchControlKeyDownProcessing(e);
				return;
			}
			if (e.Key == Key.F && ModifierKeysHelper.IsOnlyCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
			{
				if (!ActualShowSearchPanel && CanShowSearchPanel())
				{
					if (FocusSearchPanel())
					{
						ActualShowSearchPanel = true;
					}
					else
					{
						e.Handled = true;
					}
				}
				e.Handled = !FocusSearchPanel();
			}
			SearchControlKeyButtonUpProcessing(e);
		}

		protected virtual void SearchControlKeyButtonUpProcessing(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected bool FocusSearchPanel(bool commitEditing = true)
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SupportValidateRow() && ((IsEditing && !CommitEditingInternal()) || HasValidationError))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (SearchControl == null)
			{
				if (ShowSearchPanelMode != ShowSearchPanelMode.Never)
				{
					PostponedSearchControlFocus = true;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (!UIElementExtensions.GetIsKeyboardFocusWithin((UIElement)(object)SearchControl))
			{
				((UIElement)(object)SearchControl).Focus();
			}
			return true;
		}

		}

		private void UpdateSearchControlMRU(SearchControl oldValue, SearchControl newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null || newValue != null)
			{
				if (oldValue != null)
				{
					searchControlMru = oldValue.MRU;
				}
				if (newValue != null && searchControlMru != null)
				{
					newValue.MRU = searchControlMru;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual TextHighlightingProperties GetTextHighlightingProperties(ColumnBase column)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (CanStartIncrementalSearch && TextSearchEngineRoot != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText))
			{
				if (IncrementalSearchColumns.Contains(column.FieldName))
				{
					return new TextHighlightingProperties(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText, (FilterCondition)1);
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (SearchPanelColumnProvider == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return SearchPanelColumnProvider.GetTextHighlightingProperties(column);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSerializeStart()
		{
			ForceCreateColumnChooserStateInternal();
			bool isActualColumnChooserCreated = IsActualColumnChooserCreated;
			ActualColumnChooser.SaveState(ColumnChooserState);

			{

			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeStart(StartDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			ForceCreateColumnChooserStateInternal();
			columnChooserStateDeserialized = false;
		}

		protected virtual void OnDeserializeEnd(EndDeserializingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (columnChooserStateDeserialized)
			{
				bool isActualColumnChooserCreated = IsActualColumnChooserCreated;
				ActualColumnChooser.ApplyState(ColumnChooserState);
				if (!isActualColumnChooserCreated)
				{
					ForceDestroyColumnChooser();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual AutomationPeer GetAutomationPeer(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Row || IsGroupRowHandleCore(FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return DataControl.AutomationPeer.GetRowPeer(FocusedRowHandle);

			if (NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell && dataControl.CurrentColumn != null)

				return DataControl.AutomationPeer.GetCellPeer(FocusedRowHandle, DataControl.CurrentColumn);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RaiseItemSelectAutomationEvents(DependencyObject obj)
		{

		private IEnumerable<int> GetGroupChildRowHandles(int groupRowHandle)
		{
			if (IsGroupRowHandleCore(groupRowHandle))
			{
				GroupRowInfo info = ((IEnumerable<GroupRowInfo>)((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo).First((GroupRowInfo x) => x.Handle == groupRowHandle);
				int i = 0;
				while (i < info.ChildControllerRowCount)
				{
					yield return info.ChildControllerRow + i;
					int num = i + 1;
					i = num;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsMergedCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandle) || ViewBehavior.IsAdditionalRowCore(rowHandle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			if (!IsPrevRowCellMerged(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, column, checkRowData: false))
			{
				return IsNextRowCellMerged(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, column, checkRowData: false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateIsFocusedCellIfNeeded(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column = null)
		{
			if (!ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (column == null)
			{
				if (DataControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				column = DataControl.CurrentColumn;
			}
			int num = CalcActualRowHandle(rowHandle, column);
			if (num != rowHandle)
			{

		internal ErrorsWatchMode? IsValidRowByRowHandle(int rowHandle, ErrorsWatchMode mode, bool ignoreAlowLeaveEditor = true)
		{
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ea: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (mode == ErrorsWatchMode.None || DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
			{
				return null;
			}
			object row = DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle);
			if (row == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (mode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Rows))
			{
				MultiErrorInfo multiErrorInfo = DataProviderBase.GetMultiErrorInfo(rowHandle, row);
				if (multiErrorInfo.HasErrors() && (int)multiErrorInfo.ErrorType != 0)
				{
					return ErrorsWatchMode.Rows;
				}
			}
			if (mode.HasFlag(ErrorsWatchMode.Cells))
			{
				bool flag = SupportValidateCell() && (ignoreAlowLeaveEditor || AllowLeaveInvalidEditor || FocusedRowHandle == rowHandle);
				foreach (ColumnBase item in VisibleColumnsCore)
				{
					MultiErrorInfo multiErrorInfo2 = DataProviderBase.GetMultiErrorInfo(rowHandle, DataProviderBase.GetActualColumnInfo(item.FieldName), row);
					if (multiErrorInfo2.HasErrors() && (int)multiErrorInfo2.ErrorType != 0)
					{
						return ErrorsWatchMode.Cells;
					}
					if (flag && RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(this, this, DataControl.GetCellValueCore(rowHandle, item), rowHandle, item) != null)
					{
						return ErrorsWatchMode.Cells;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetRowErrorsCount(int rowHandle)
		{
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			object row = DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle);
			if (DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle) || row == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = SupportValidateCell() && (AllowLeaveInvalidEditor || FocusedRowHandle == rowHandle);
			foreach (ColumnBase item in VisibleColumnsCore)
			{
				MultiErrorInfo multiErrorInfo = DataProviderBase.GetMultiErrorInfo(rowHandle, DataProviderBase.GetActualColumnInfo(item.FieldName), row);
				if (multiErrorInfo.HasErrors() && (int)multiErrorInfo.ErrorType != 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (flag && RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(this, this, DataControl.GetCellValueCore(rowHandle, item), rowHandle, item) != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal virtual Func<int, bool> CreateFilterFitPredicate(CriteriaOperator criteria)
		{
			if (object.Equals(criteria, null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IFilterRowStub stub = null;
			try
			{
				stub = FilterRowStub.Create4Xpf((DataController)(object)DataProviderBase.DataController, criteria);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
			return delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				if (!DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					int listSourceRowIndex = ((DataController)DataProviderBase.DataController).GetListSourceRowIndex(rowHandle);
					try
					{
						return stub.Filter(listSourceRowIndex);
					}
					finally
					{
						((IBaseRowStub)stub).Reset();
					}
				}
				GroupTextHighlightingProperties groupHighlightingProperties = GetGroupHighlightingProperties(rowHandle);
				if (groupHighlightingProperties != null && groupHighlightingProperties.TextHighlightingProperties != null)
				{
					object groupDisplayValue = GetGroupDisplayValue(rowHandle);
					if (groupDisplayValue != null)
					{
						return groupDisplayValue.ToString().ToLower().EndsWith(groupHighlightingProperties.TextHighlightingProperties.Text.ToLower());
					}
				}
				return false;
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual Func<int, bool> CreateFilterFitPredicate()
		{
			if (SearchControl == null || object.Equals(SearchControl.FilterCriteria, null))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreateFilterFitPredicate(SearchControl.FilterCriteria);
		}

		protected internal virtual Func<int, bool> CreateAnnotationFilterFitPredicate()
		{
			if (CanStartIncrementalSearch)
			{
				if (TextSearchEngineRoot == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText))
				{
					if (SearchControl != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchControl.SearchText))
					{
						return CreateFilterFitPredicate();
					}
					return null;
				}
				string[] incrementalSearchColumns = IncrementalSearchColumns;
				if (incrementalSearchColumns.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return CreateFilterFitPredicate(IncrementalSearchHelper.GetCriteriaOperator(IncrementalSearchColumns, (FilterCondition)1, ((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText, (CriteriaOperatorType)0));
			}
			return CreateFilterFitPredicate();
		}

		private void IncrementalSearchModeChanged()
		{
			IncrementalSearchModeCore = IncrementalSearchMode;
			ResetIncrementalSearch();
			if (CanStartIncrementalSearch)
			{
				TextSearchEngineRoot = new TableTextSearchEngine(IncrementalSearchHelper.SearchCallback, IncrementalSearchClearDelay);
				return;
			}
			TextSearchEngineRoot = null;
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				UpdateEditorHighlightingText();
				UpdateFilterGrid();
			}
		}

		private void OnUseOnlyCurrentColumnInIncrementalSearchChanged()
		{
			if (TextSearchEngineRoot != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText))
			{
				RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
					//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
					dataControl.DataView.ClearEditorHighlightingText();
					dataControl.DataView.UpdateEditorHighlightingText(new TextHighlightingProperties(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText, (FilterCondition)1), dataControl.DataView.IncrementalSearchColumns);
				});
				UpdateAfterIncrementalSearch();
			}
		}

		public void IncrementalSearchEnd()
		{
			ResetIncrementalSearch();
		}

		private bool CheckStartIncrementalSearch(IncrementalSearchMode mode)
		{
			if (IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() || IsKeyboardFocusInHeadersPanel() || IsAutoFilterRowFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (mode)
			{
			case IncrementalSearchMode.Disabled:
			case IncrementalSearchMode.Default:
				return false;
			case IncrementalSearchMode.Enabled:
				if (!IsEditing && !IsKeyboardFocusWithinEditForm())
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewTextInput(TextCompositionEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewTextInput(e);
			if (!e.Handled && CanStartIncrementalSearch && TextSearchEngineRoot != null)
			{
				string text = e.Text;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					ProcessTextSearch(text, null);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessTextSearch(string text, bool? down)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (TextSearchEngineRoot == null || DataControl == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (TextSearchEngineRoot.DoSearch(text, (MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.FocusedRowHandle >= 0) ? MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.FocusedRowHandle : 0, (MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null) ? MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.DataControl.CurrentColumn.ActualVisibleIndex : 0, (MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.FocusedRowData != null && MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.FocusedRowData.DetailIndents != null) ? MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView.FocusedRowData.DetailIndents.Count : 0, MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView, down))
			{
				if (TextSearchEngineRoot.MatchedItemIndex != null)
				{
					DataViewBase view = TextSearchEngineRoot.MatchedItemIndex.View;
					view.FocusedRowHandle = TextSearchEngineRoot.MatchedItemIndex.RowIndex;
					view.MoveFocusedRow(view.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle));
					if (TextSearchEngineRoot.MatchedItemIndex != null)
					{
						view.DataControl.CurrentColumn = view.VisibleColumnsCore[TextSearchEngineRoot.MatchedItemIndex.ColumnIndex];
					}
				}
				result = true;
			}
			if (TextSearchEngineRoot != null)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText))
				{
					RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
					{
						dataControl.DataView.UpdateEditorHighlightingText();
					});
				}
				else
				{
					RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
					{
						//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
						//IL_0032: Expected O, but got Unknown
						dataControl.DataView.ClearEditorHighlightingText();
						dataControl.DataView.UpdateEditorHighlightingText(new TextHighlightingProperties(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText, (FilterCondition)1), dataControl.DataView.IncrementalSearchColumns);
					});
				}
				result = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText);
			}
			UpdateAfterIncrementalSearch();
			return result;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetIncrementalSearch()
		{
			if (RootView != null && RootView.DataControl != null && !ScrollAnimationLocker.IsLocked && !layoutUpdatedLocker.IsLocked && !IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout)
			{
				if (TextSearchEngineRoot != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((TextSearchEngineBase)TextSearchEngineRoot).SeachText))
				{
					RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
					{
						dataControl.DataView.ClearEditorHighlightingText();
					});
				}
				else
				{
					RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
					{
						dataControl.DataView.UpdateEditorHighlightingText();
					});
				}
			}
			TextSearchEngineRoot = new TableTextSearchEngine(IncrementalSearchHelper.SearchCallback, IncrementalSearchClearDelay);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAfterIncrementalSearch()
		{
		}

		internal virtual void SearchResultNextCore(bool useCurrentPosition)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (IsVirtualSource)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase)
			{
				if ((int)SearchPanelFindMode == 1)
				{
					gridSearchControlBase.FindCommandExecuted();
				}
				else
				{
					((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).DoValidate();
				}
			}
			int visibleRowCount = DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
			searchResult = MovementSearchResults.MoveSearchResult(this, true, useCurrentPosition);
			if (DataControl.VisibleRowCount != visibleRowCount)
			{
				UpdateScrollBarAnnotations();
			}
		}

		public void SearchResultPrev()
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsVirtualSource)
			{
				if (SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase && (int)SearchPanelFindMode == 0)
				{
					((SearchControl)gridSearchControlBase).DoValidate();
				}
				int visibleRowCount = DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				searchResult = MovementSearchResults.MoveSearchResult(this, false);
				if (DataControl.VisibleRowCount != visibleRowCount)
				{
					UpdateScrollBarAnnotations();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CanMoveSearchResultCore()
		{
			if (!(SearchControl is GridSearchControlBase gridSearchControlBase))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return gridSearchControlBase.ClearButtonIsVisible;
		}

		public bool CanMoveSearchResult()
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.None && SearchControl != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SearchControl.SearchText) && CanMoveSearchResultCore())
			{
				if (!searchResult && (int)SearchPanelFindMode != 1)
				{
					if (DataControl != null && SearchPanelAllowFilter)
					{
						return DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool IsSearchResult(Func<int, bool> fitSearch, int rowHandle, int rowVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (!MovementSearchResults.CanMovementSearchResult(this))
			{
				return fitSearch(rowHandle);
			}
			if (fitSearch(rowHandle))
			{
				searchResult = true;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void UpdateSearchResult(bool checkNavigationButtons = true)
		{
			if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.IsServerMode)
			{
				searchResult = true;
				return;
			}
			searchResult = false;
			if (!MovementSearchResults.CanMovementSearchResult(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			searchResult = false;
			if (SearchPanelAllowFilter)
			{
				searchResult = DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0;
			}
			else if (ActualShowSearchPanelResultInfo && SearchControl != null)
			{
				searchResult = SearchControl.ResultCount > 0;
			}
			else
			{
				if (checkNavigationButtons && !ShowSearchPanelNavigationButtons)
				{
					return;
				}
				Func<int, bool> func = CreateFilterFitPredicate();
				if (func == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < DataControl.VisibleRowCount; i++)
				{
					int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
					if (func(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
					{
						searchResult = true;
						return;
					}
				}
				if (DataControl.VisibleRowCount == 0 || DataProviderBase == null || !ShowSearchPanelNavigationButtons || (DataProviderBase.DataRowCount == DataControl.VisibleRowCount && GroupCount <= 0))
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < DataProviderBase.DataRowCount; j++)
				{
					if (!DataProviderBase.IsFilteredByRowHandle(j) && func(j))
					{
						searchResult = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateFilterGrid()
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			(SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase)?.InitSearchInfo();
			UpdateSearchResult();
			UpdateSelectionSummary();
			if (!SearchPanelAllowFilter && DataControl != null && !DataControl.RestoreLayoutIsLock && !FilterOnDeserializationLock.IsLocked && !DataControl.IsServerMode && ((int)SearchPanelFindMode == 0 || !DataControl.FilterCriteriaChangedLocker.IsLocked))
			{
				SearchResultNextCore(useCurrentPosition: true);
			}
		}

		internal void SetHasErrors(bool value)
		{
			HasErrors = value;
			if (RootView.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (RootView.ErrorWatch.HasError)
			{
				RootView.HasErrors = true;
				return;
			}
			bool hasError = false;
			RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (!hasError && dataControl != null && dataControl.DataView != null)
				{
					hasError = dataControl.DataView.ErrorWatch.HasError;
				}
			});
			if (hasError)
			{
				RootView.HasErrors = true;
			}
			else
			{
				RootView.HasErrors = RootView.ErrorWatch.HasError;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool NeedWatchRowChanged()
		{
			if (DataProviderBase != null && DataProviderBase.IsUpdateLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ErrorsWatchMode errorsWatchMode = ErrorWatch.ActualErrorsWatchMode(this);
			if ((errorsWatchMode & ErrorsWatchMode.Cells) == 0)
			{
				return (errorsWatchMode & ErrorsWatchMode.Rows) != 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal virtual void CurrentRowRemoving(int rowHandle)
		{
			ErrorWatch.CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, rowHandle, rowHandle);
			(SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase)?.SearchInfoChanged(ListChangedType.ItemDeleted, rowHandle, rowHandle);
		}

		internal virtual void CurrentRowChanged(ListChangedType changedType, int newHandle, int? oldRowHandle)
		{
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.VisibleItemsCreated)
			{
				DataProviderBase.UpdateVisibleItems(changedType, newHandle, oldRowHandle);
			}
			if (changedType != ListChangedType.ItemDeleted)
			{
				if (NeedErrorWatchCurrentRowChanged(changedType))
				{
					ErrorWatch.CurrentRowChanged(changedType, newHandle, oldRowHandle);
				}
				(SearchControl as GridSearchControlBase)?.SearchInfoChanged(changedType, newHandle, oldRowHandle);
			}
			UpdateSearchResult();
			foreach (ColumnBase showCheckBoxInHeaderColumn in ShowCheckBoxInHeaderColumns)
			{
				showCheckBoxInHeaderColumn.UpdateIsChecked();
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore))
			{
				if (oldRowHandle.HasValue)
				{
					DataControl.UpdateGroupRowChecked(oldRowHandle.Value, GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore);
				}
				if (newHandle != int.MinValue)
				{
					DataControl.UpdateGroupRowChecked(newHandle, GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void RebuildDragManager()
		{
			DragDropManager.Do(delegate(NativeDragManager x)
			{
				x.IsActive = false;
			});
			DragDropManager = null;
			if (AllowDragDrop && !IsDesignTime && OriginationView == null && DataControl != null)
			{
				DragDropManager = CreateDragManagerBuilder().Build((FrameworkElement)this);
				DragDropManager.IsActive = true;
			}
		}

		internal virtual DragManagerBuilder CreateDragManagerBuilder()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DragManagerBuilder val = new DragManagerBuilder
			{
				CreateDragEventFactory = () => (IDragEventFactory)(object)new GridDragDataTransferEventFactory(this),
				GetDropMarkerTemplate = () => DropMarkerTemplate,
				GetDragDropHintTemplate = () => DragDropHintTemplate,
				ShowDragDropHint = ShowDragDropHint,
				GetShowTargetInfoInDragDropHint = () => ShowTargetInfoInDragDropHint
			};
			val.CreateDropTargetValidatorFactory = () => new DropTargetValidatorFactory((Func<DragInfo, IDropTargetValidator>)((DragInfo activeDragInfo) => (IDropTargetValidator)(object)new GridInternalDragValidator<DataViewBase>(this, activeDragInfo)), (Func<IDropTargetValidator>)(() => (IDropTargetValidator)(object)new GridExternalDragValidator<DataViewBase>(this)));
			if (AllowScrollingOnDrag)
			{
				val.CreateScrollService = () => (IDragScrollService)(object)new GridDragScrollService(this);
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal bool CanHighlightedState(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool isCell, SelectionState state, bool isGroupRow = false)
		{
			if (!(this is ITableView { HighlightItemOnHover: not false }) || DataControl == null || state == SelectionState.Focused || state == SelectionState.FocusedAndSelected || state == SelectionState.CellMerge || RootDataPresenter == null || RootDataPresenter.IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsEditing && FocusedRowHandle == rowHandle)
			{
				if (!isCell)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (column == DataControl.CurrentColumn)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (isGroupRow)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (isCell)
			{
				return GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.Cell;
			}
			return GetActualSelectionMode() != MultiSelectMode.Cell;
		}

				});
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ColumnCheckedChanged(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null || !column.IsChecked.HasValue || DataControl == null || DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string fName = column.FieldName;
			bool val = column.IsChecked.Value;
			AutoExpandAllGroupsLockAction(delegate
			{
				DataControl.UpdateGroupRowCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount; i++)
					{
						if (!IsCellReadonly(i, column))
						{
							object cellValue = DataControl.GetCellValue(i, fName);
							if (cellValue is bool && (bool)cellValue != val)
							{
								DataControl.SetCellValueCore(i, fName, val);
								RaiseRowUpdatedBase(i);
							}
						}
					}
				});
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ShowCheckBoxInHeaderColumns)
				{
					if (item != column && item.ActualShowCheckBoxInHeader && item.FieldName == column.FieldName)
					{
						item.UpdateIsCheckedLocker.DoLockedAction<bool?>((Func<bool?>)(() => item.IsChecked = val));
					}
				}
			});
		}

		internal bool IsCellReadonly(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			CellEditor cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn = GetCellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn(rowHandle, column);
			if (cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn).Edit != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)cellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn).Edit.IsReadOnly)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void OnDataControlEnabledChanged(bool isEnabled)
		{
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (!(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (ColumnBase item in ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (GetCellEditorByRowHandleAndColumn(rowData.RowHandle.Value, item) is IGridCellEditorOwner gridCellEditorOwner)
					{
						gridCellEditorOwner.UpdateCellState();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AutoExpandAllGroupsLockAction(Action action)
		{
			if (action != null && DataControl != null)
			{
				bool autoExpandAllGroups = false;
				if (DataControl.DataProviderBase != null)
				{
					autoExpandAllGroups = DataControl.DataProviderBase.AutoExpandAllGroups;
					DataControl.DataProviderBase.AutoExpandAllGroups = false;
				}
				DataControl.BeginDataUpdate();
				action();
				DataControl.EndDataUpdate();
				if (DataControl.DataProviderBase != null)
				{
					DataControl.DataProviderBase.AutoExpandAllGroups = autoExpandAllGroups;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal void ResetCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute()
		{
			CanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute = null;
		}

		internal void UpdateCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute()
		{
			bool value = true;
			if (!AllowCommitOnValidationAttributeError)
			{
				RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
				foreach (GridColumnData cellDatum in rowData.CellData)
				{
					RowValidationError rowValidationError = RowValidationHelper.ValidateAttributes(this, (cellDatum.Editor != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)cellDatum.Editor).Edit != null) ? ((InplaceEditorBase)cellDatum.Editor).Edit.EditValue : ((EditableDataObject)cellDatum).Value, rowData.RowHandle.Value, cellDatum.Column);
					if (rowValidationError != null)
					{
						value = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			CanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute = value;
		}

		protected internal bool CanUpdateRowCore()
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && IsFocusedRowModified && (!HasCellEditorError || !HasModificationsSinceLastCellValidation))
			{
				if (AllowCommitOnValidationAttributeError)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!CanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute.HasValue)
				{
					UpdateCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute();
				}
				return CanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute.Value;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool CanMouseNavigationWithUpdateRow()

			{
				return !HasCellEditorError;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool CanCancelRowChangesCore()
		{
			if (UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction || UpdateRowButtonsLocker > 0)
			{
				return UpdateRowUseCancelationToken;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual GridRowValidationEventArgs RaiseValidateRowCore(object source, object row, int rowHandle, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal async Task UpdateRowCore(bool useAwait = true)
		{
			UpdateRowUseCancelationToken = true;
			UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource = null;
			UpdateRowValidateEventArgs = null;
			if (!CanUpdateRowCore())
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateRowButtonsLocker++;
			UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
			RowData focusedRowData = null;
			try
			{
				IsUpdating = true;
				UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = false;
				RootView.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = false;
				CloseEditor();
				focusedRowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
				focusedRowData.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = false;
				Locker val = CommitEditingLocker.Lock();
				try
				{
					UpdateRowCoreCellsCommit(focusedRowData);
					await UpdateRowCoreRowCommitAsync(focusedRowData, useAwait);
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
				UpdateRowButtonsLocker--;
				if (focusedRowData != null && !GetUpdateRowButtonsShow(focusedRowData))
				{
					focusedRowData?.HideRowButtons(success: false);
				}
				if (UpdateRowValidateEventArgs != null && UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource != null && UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UseCancellationToken && UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					CancelRowChangesCore(useCache: true);
				}
				IsUpdating = false;
				if (UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource != null)
				{
					UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
					UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource = null;
				}
				UpdateRowValidateEventArgs = null;
				if (focusedRowData != null)
				{
					focusedRowData.IsWaitIndicatorVisible = false;
				}
				UpdateRowUseCancelationToken = true;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRowCoreCellsCommit(RowData focusedRowData)
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase item in VisibleColumnsCore)
			{
				if (!item.GetAllowEditing() || item.IsActualReadOnly || !(focusedRowData.GetCellDataByColumn(item) is EditGridCellData editGridCellData))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (editGridCellData.Editor != null)
				{
					if (!((InplaceEditorBase)editGridCellData.Editor).PostEditor(true))
					{
						UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
						RootView.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
						focusedRowData.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = true;
						DataControl.CurrentColumn = item;
						CurrentCellEditor = (InplaceEditorBase)(object)editGridCellData.Editor;
						ScrollToCurrentColumnIfNeeded();
						ShowEditor();
						break;
					}
					((InplaceEditorBase)editGridCellData.Editor).HideEditor(true);
					continue;
				}
				try
				{
					DataControl.SetCellValueCore(FocusedRowHandle, editGridCellData.Column.FieldName, ((EditableDataObject)editGridCellData).Value);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					DataControl.CurrentColumn = item;
					ScrollToCurrentColumnIfNeeded();
					ShowEditor();
					EditGridCellData editGridCellData2 = focusedRowData.GetCellDataByColumn(item) as EditGridCellData;
					UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
					RootView.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
					focusedRowData.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = true;
					((CellEditor)editGridCellData2.Editor).SetValidationError(CreateCellValidationError(ex.Message, (ErrorType)1, FocusedRowHandle, item, ex));
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private async Task UpdateRowCoreRowCommitAsync(RowData focusedRowData, bool useAwait = true)
		{
			UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
			UpdateRowValidateEventArgs = RaiseValidateRowCore(DataControl, focusedRowData.Row, focusedRowData.RowHandle.Value, UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.Token);
			if (UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UpdateRowResult != null)
			{
				UpdateRowUseCancelationToken = UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UseCancellationToken;
				focusedRowData.IsWaitIndicatorVisible = true;
				try
				{
					if (useAwait)
					{
						await UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UpdateRowResult;
					}
					else
					{
						UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UpdateRowResult.Wait();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.Exception = ex.InnerException ?? ex;
				}
				focusedRowData.IsWaitIndicatorVisible = false;
				if (UpdateRowValidateEventArgs.UseCancellationToken && UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.IsCancellationRequested)
				{
					UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource = null;
			}
			if (UpdateRowCommitEditingLocker.DoLockedAction<bool>((Func<bool>)(() => !CommitEditingInternal())))
			{
				UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
				RootView.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = true;
				focusedRowData.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ViewBehavior.HideRowButtons(success: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal void CancelRowChangesCore(bool useCache = false)
		{
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
			if (rowData != null && rowData.HasValidationErrorInternal && rowData.CancelValuesCache.Count > 0)
			{
				useCache = true;
			}
			if (UpdateRowUseCancelationToken && UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource != null)
			{
				UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
				UpdateRowUseCancelationToken = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if ((!UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && !useCache) || rowData == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = false;
				RootView.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = false;
				try
				{
					if (!DataControl.CanCancelRow(rowData.Row))
					{
						CancelRowEdit();
					}
					ValidationError = null;
					if (useCache)
					{
						foreach (KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, object> item in rowData.CancelValuesCache)
						{
							DataControl.SetCellValueCore(rowData.RowHandle.Value, item.Key.FieldName, item.Value);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase item2 in VisibleColumnsCore)
						{
							if (rowData.GetCellDataByColumn(item2) is EditGridCellData editGridCellData)
							{
								editGridCellData.UpdateValue(forceUpdate: true);
								rowData.UpdateCellDataError(item2, editGridCellData);
							}
						}
					}
					CancelRowEditLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
					{
						CancelRowEdit();
					});
					rowData.UpdateRowDataError();
					rowData.UpdateDataErrors();
					rowData.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
					ViewBehavior.HideRowButtons(success: false, rowData);
					if (UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource != null)
					{
						UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
						UpdateRowCancellationTokenSource = null;
					}
					UpdateRowValidateEventArgs = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void OnAreUpdateRowButtonsShownChanged()
		{
			UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction = AreUpdateRowButtonsShown;
			if (AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && UpdateRowButtonsLocker == 0)
			{
				GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle)?.UpdateCancelValuesCache();
				UpdateRowUseCancelationToken = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnIsEditingChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			IsEditingCore = newValue;
			if (newValue)
			{
				if (!AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.OnCellEditorOpen && newValue && FocusedRowHandle != -2147483645)
				{
					ViewBehavior.ShowRowButtons();
				}
				if (AreUpdateRowButtonsShown)
				{
					ViewBehavior.OnUpdateRowButtonsIsEditingChanged(newValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanScrollLeft()
		{
			if (!DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset > 0.0;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanScrollRight()
		{
			if (!DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset + DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport < DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Extent;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ScrollToHorizontalOffset(double offset, bool useAccumulator)
		{
			FrameworkElement firstVisibleRowElement = null;
			if (DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll(out firstVisibleRowElement))
			{
				double delta = (useAccumulator ? DataPresenter.accumulatorHorizontal.GetCorrectedDelta(useAccumulator, firstVisibleRowElement.ActualWidth, 0.0 - offset) : offset);
				ViewBehavior.ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(delta);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanScrollUp()
		{
			if (!DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Offset > 0.0;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool CanScrollDown()
		{
			if (!DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Offset + DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Viewport < DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.VerticalScrollInfo.Extent;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ScrollToVerticalOffset(double offset, bool useAccumulator)
		{
			FrameworkElement firstVisibleRowElement = null;
			if (DataPresenter.CanApplyScroll(out firstVisibleRowElement))
			{
				double delta = (useAccumulator ? DataPresenter.accumulatorVertical.GetCorrectedDelta(!ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling, firstVisibleRowElement.ActualHeight, offset) : offset);
				ViewBehavior.ChangeVerticalOffsetBy(delta);
			}
		}

		internal static void ExecuteValidateCommand(ICommand command, ValidationArgs args, GridRowValidationEventArgs e)
		{
			command.Execute(args);
			if (args.Result != null)
			{
				SetError(e, args.Result);
			}
			if (args.ResultAsync != null)
			{
				e.UpdateRowResult = args.ResultAsync.ContinueWith(delegate(Task<ValidationErrorInfo> x)
				{
					if (x.IsFaulted)
					{
						throw x.Exception.InnerException ?? x.Exception;
					}
					if (x.Result != null)
					{
						SetError(e, x.Result);
					}
				});
			}
			e.UseCancellationToken = args.UseCancellationToken;
		}

		private static void SetError(GridRowValidationEventArgs e, ValidationErrorInfo error)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((ValidationEventArgs)e).SetError((object)error.ErrorContent, ToErrorType(error.ErrorType));
		}

		private static ErrorType ToErrorType(ValidationErrorType type)
		{
			return (ErrorType)(type switch
			{
				ValidationErrorType.Default => 1, 
				ValidationErrorType.Information => 2, 
				ValidationErrorType.Warning => 3, 
				ValidationErrorType.Critical => 4, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException(), 
			});
		}

		protected static ExceptionMode ToGridExceptionMode(DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode exceptionMode)
		{
			return exceptionMode switch
			{
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.DisplayError => ExceptionMode.DisplayError, 
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.Ignore => ExceptionMode.Ignore, 
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.NoAction => ExceptionMode.NoAction, 
				DevExpress.Mvvm.Xpf.ExceptionMode.ThrowException => ExceptionMode.ThrowException, 
				_ => throw new InvalidOperationException("ExceptionMode"), 
			};
		}

		internal static void CanExecuteWithCheckActualView(CanExecuteRoutedEventArgs e, Func<bool> canExecute)
		{
			if (e.Source is DataViewBase && e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject && e.Source != ((DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource).GetValue(DataControlBase.ActiveViewProperty))
			{
				e.CanExecute = false;
			}
			else
			{
				e.CanExecute = canExecute();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisualParentChanged(DependencyObject oldParent)
		{
			if (!CommonThemeHelper.UseLightweightThemes)
			{
				DependencyObject parent = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(this);
				if (parent != null)
				{
					Binding binding = new Binding();
					binding.Path = new PropertyPath("(0)", ThemeManager.TreeWalkerProperty);
					binding.Source = parent;
					Binding binding2 = binding;
					SetBinding(ThemeManager.TreeWalkerProperty, binding2);
				}
				else
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearBinding(this, ThemeManager.TreeWalkerProperty);
				}
			}
			base.OnVisualParentChanged(oldParent);
		}

	public enum FixedRowPosition

	public abstract class RowsClipboardController
	{
		public class RowsClipboardDataProvider : IClipboardDataProvider, IClipboardFormatted
		{
			private IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows;

			private RowsClipboardController owner;

			public RowsClipboardDataProvider(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows, RowsClipboardController owner)
			{
				this.rows = rows;
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public object GetObjectFromClipboard()
			{
				return owner.GetSelectedData(rows);
			}

			public string GetTextFromClipboard()
			{
				return owner.GetTextInRows(rows);
			}

			int IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedCellsCount(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (rows == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return rows.Where((KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> x) => x.Key == dataControl).Count() * ((IClipboardFormatted)this).GetSelectedColumns(dataControl).Count();
			}

			IEnumerable<ColumnBase> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedColumns(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (dataControl == null || dataControl.DataView == null || dataControl.DataView.VisibleColumnsCore == null)
				{
					return new List<ColumnBase>();
				}
				return dataControl.DataView.VisibleColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>().ToList();
			}

			IEnumerable<int> IClipboardFormatted.GetSelectedRows(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (rows == null)
				{
					return new List<int>();
				}
				return (from x in rows
					where x.Key == dataControl
					select x.Value).Distinct().ToList();
			}

			bool IClipboardFormatted.IsSelect(int rowHanle, ColumnBase column, DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				if (rows == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return rows.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> x) => x.Key == dataControl && x.Value == rowHanle).Key != null;
			}
		}

		private DataViewBase view;

		protected DataViewBase View => view;

		protected RowsClipboardController(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void CopyRowsToClipboard(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			IEnumerable<int> source = SortRowHandlesByVisibleIndex(rows);
			IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows2 = source.Select((int x) => new KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>(View.DataControl, x));
			CopyToClipboard(() => CreateRowsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(rows), (IClipboardDataProvider)(object)new RowsClipboardDataProvider(rows2, this));
		}

		internal void CopyRowsToClipboard(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows)
		{
			List<int> rowHandles = null;
			if (!IsMasterDetail())
			{
				rowHandles = rows.Select((KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row) => row.Value).ToList();
			}
			CopyToClipboard(() => CreateRowsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(rowHandles), (IClipboardDataProvider)(object)new RowsClipboardDataProvider(rows, this));
		}

		internal bool IsMasterDetail()
		{
			if (View.RootView.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore != null)
			{
				return View.RootView.AllowMasterDetailCore;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void CopyRangeToClipboard(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			if (startRowHandle == int.MinValue || endRowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = view.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(startRowHandle);
			int num2 = view.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(endRowHandle);
			if (num >= 0 && num2 >= 0)
			{
				if (num > num2)
				{
					int num3 = num2;
					num2 = num;
					num = num3;
				}
				int[] array = new int[num2 - num + 1];
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					array[i - num] = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
				}
				CopyRowsToClipboard(array);
			}
		}

		protected string GetTextInRows(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows)
		{
			StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
			int countCopyRows = GetCountCopyRows(rows);
			List<DataControlBase> printableDataControls = rows.Select((KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row) => row.Key).Distinct().ToList();
			IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> dataAndHeaderRows = GetDataAndHeaderRows(rows.Take(countCopyRows), printableDataControls);
			return GetTextInRowsCore(dataAndHeaderRows, sb, printableDataControls, countCopyRows);
		}

		protected virtual string GetTextInRowsCore(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> actualRows, StringBuilder sb, List<DataControlBase> printableDataControls, int countCopyRows)
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> actualRow in actualRows)
			{
				if (sb.Length > 0)
				{
					sb.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				}
				AppendIndent(sb, actualRow, printableDataControls);
				actualRow.Key.DataView.GetDataRowText(sb, actualRow.Value);
			}
			if (countCopyRows == 0 && View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders)
			{
				GetHeadersText(sb);
			}
			return sb.ToString();
		}

		private IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> GetDataAndHeaderRows(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows, List<DataControlBase> printableDataControls)
		{
			DataControlBase currentDataControl = null;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row in rows)
			{
				if (GetOriginationDataControl(currentDataControl) != GetOriginationDataControl(row.Key) && View.ActualClipboardCopyWithHeaders)
				{
					List<DataControlBase> thisAndParentDataControls = GetThisAndParentDataControls(currentDataControl);
					foreach (KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> item in GetHeadersForRow(row, printableDataControls.Except(thisAndParentDataControls)))
					{
						yield return item;
					}
				}
				currentDataControl = row.Key;
				yield return row;
			}
		}

		private DataControlBase GetOriginationDataControl(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl?.GetOriginationDataControl();
		}

		private static List<DataControlBase> GetThisAndParentDataControls(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			List<DataControlBase> parents = new List<DataControlBase>();
			dataControl?.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase parent)
			{
				parents.Add(parent);
			});
			return parents;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> GetHeadersForRow(KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row, IEnumerable<DataControlBase> printableDataControls)
		{
			List<DataControlBase> thisAndParentDataControls = GetThisAndParentDataControls(row.Key);
			foreach (DataControlBase item in Enumerable.Reverse(thisAndParentDataControls))
			{
				if (printableDataControls.Contains(item))
				{
					yield return GetHeaderRow(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private static KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> GetHeaderRow(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return new KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>(dataControl, int.MinValue);
		}

		protected static void AppendIndent(StringBuilder sb, KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row, List<DataControlBase> printableDataControls)
		{
			int num = printableDataControls.Intersect(GetThisAndParentDataControls(row.Key)).Count();
			sb.Append('\t', num - 1);
		}

		protected void GetHeadersText(StringBuilder sb)
		{
			view.GetDataRowText(sb, int.MinValue);
		}

		protected object GetSelectedData(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			if (rows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetSelectedData(rows.Select((int row) => new KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>(View.DataControl, row)));
		}

		protected virtual object GetSelectedData(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows)
		{
			if (rows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			int countCopyRows = GetCountCopyRows(rows);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int> row in rows)
			{
				if (countCopyRows-- <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (CanAddRowToSelectedData(row.Key, row.Value))
				{
					arrayList.Add(row.Key.DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(row.Value));
				}
			}
			return arrayList;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanAddRowToSelectedData(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual int GetCountCopyRows(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<DataControlBase, int>> rows)
		{
			return rows.Count();
		}

		private List<int> GetListVisibleIndexFromArrayRowsHandle(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			List<int> list = new List<int>();
			foreach (int row in rows)
			{
				int rowVisibleIndexByHandle = view.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(row);
				if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle >= 0)
				{
					list.Add(rowVisibleIndexByHandle);
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<int> SortRowHandlesByVisibleIndex(IEnumerable<int> rows)
		{
			List<int> listVisibleIndexFromArrayRowsHandle = GetListVisibleIndexFromArrayRowsHandle(rows);
			return listVisibleIndexFromArrayRowsHandle.Select((int x) => View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(x));
		}

		protected void CopyToClipboard(Func<CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase> createClipboardCopyingEventArgs, IClipboardDataProvider clipboardDataProvider)
		{
			if (view.ActualClipboardCopyAllowed && !view.DataControl.RaiseCopyingToClipboard(createClipboardCopyingEventArgs()) && !view.RaiseCopyingToClipboard(createClipboardCopyingEventArgs()) && !view.SetDataAwareClipboardData(clipboardDataProvider as IClipboardFormatted, view.DataControl.CallCopyClipboardFromCommand))
			{
				DXClipboard.SetDataFromClipboardDataProvider(clipboardDataProvider);
			}
		}

		protected abstract CopyingToClipboardEventArgsBase CreateRowsCopyingToClipboardEventArgs(IEnumerable<int> rows);
	}

	public class GridRuntimeStringCollection : ObservableCollection<RuntimeStringIdInfo>
	{
		protected override void InsertItem(int index, RuntimeStringIdInfo item)
		{
			if (!Contains(item))
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Element with such stringId already exists in collection");
		}
	}
	public class RuntimeStringIdInfo
	{
		[Description("")]
		public string Value { get; set; }

		[Description("")]
		public GridControlRuntimeStringId Id { get; set; }

		public RuntimeStringIdInfo()
		{
		}

		public RuntimeStringIdInfo(GridControlRuntimeStringId id, string value)
		{
			Id = id;
			Value = value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RuntimeStringIdInfo runtimeStringIdInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Id == runtimeStringIdInfo.Id;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}
	}
	public class LocalizationDescriptor
	{
		private GridRuntimeStringCollection localizationStrings;

		public LocalizationDescriptor(GridRuntimeStringCollection localizationStrings)
		{
			this.localizationStrings = localizationStrings;
		}

		public void SetValue(string name, string value)
		{
			if (localizationStrings != null)
			{
				GridControlRuntimeStringId id = (GridControlRuntimeStringId)Enum.Parse(typeof(GridControlRuntimeStringId), name, ignoreCase: false);
				RuntimeStringIdInfo runtimeStringIdInfo = new RuntimeStringIdInfo(id, value);
				int num = localizationStrings.IndexOf(runtimeStringIdInfo);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					localizationStrings[num] = runtimeStringIdInfo;
				}
				else
				{
					localizationStrings.Add(runtimeStringIdInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		public string GetValue(string name)
		{
			if (localizationStrings != null && Enum.TryParse<GridControlRuntimeStringId>(name, out var result))
			{
				RuntimeStringIdInfo item = new RuntimeStringIdInfo(result, "");
				int num = localizationStrings.IndexOf(item);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					return localizationStrings[num].Value;
				}
			}
			GridControlStringId id = (GridControlStringId)Enum.Parse(typeof(GridControlStringId), name, ignoreCase: false);
			return GridControlLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}
	}

		internal static GridControlStringId? GetMenuSortByGroupSummaryStringId(SummaryItemType summaryType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (int)summaryType switch
			{
				4 => GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortBySummaryAverage, 
				3 => GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortBySummaryCount, 
				2 => GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortBySummaryMax, 
				1 => GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortBySummaryMin, 
				0 => GridControlStringId.MenuColumnSortBySummarySum, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}

	public abstract class DetailDescriptorBase : DXFrameworkContentElement

			ContentTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ContentTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DetailDescriptorBase)(object)d).InvalidateTree();

			MarginProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Margin", typeof(Thickness), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(default(Thickness), delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((DetailDescriptorBase)(object)d).OnMarginChanged((Thickness)e.OldValue);

			DataTemplate template = XamlHelper.GetTemplate("<TextBlock Text=\"{Binding}\"/>");
			template.Seal();

		private void OnMarginChanged(Thickness oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue.Left != Margin.Left || oldValue.Right != Margin.Right)
			{
				Owner.InvalidateIndents();
			}
			if (oldValue.Top != Margin.Top || oldValue.Bottom != Margin.Bottom)
			{
				InvalidateTree();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual IEnumerable<DataControlDetailDescriptor> GetDetailDescriptors(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int rowHandle)
		{
			return EmptyDetailDescriptors;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool HasDataControlDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateDetailViewIndents(ObservableCollection<DetailIndent> ownerIndents, Thickness margin)
		{
			int actualCount = 0;
			int level = 1;
			if (ownerIndents != null)
			{
				foreach (DetailIndent ownerIndent in ownerIndents)
				{
					AddOrChangeDetailViewIndent(actualCount, ownerIndent.Width, ownerIndent.WidthAtRight, ownerIndent.Level, ownerIndent.IsDetailMargin, isLast: false, ownerIndent.IsSelectorMargin, ref actualCount);
					if (!ownerIndent.IsDetailMargin)
					{
						level = ownerIndent.Level + 1;
					}
				}
			}
			bool isSelector = this is DetailDescriptorSelector;
			if (margin.Left != 0.0 || margin.Right != 0.0)
			{
				AddOrChangeDetailViewIndent(actualCount, margin.Left, margin.Right, level, isDetailMargin: false, isLast: false, isSelector, ref actualCount);
			}
			if (Margin.Left != 0.0 || Margin.Right != 0.0)
			{
				AddOrChangeDetailViewIndent(actualCount, Margin.Left, Margin.Right, level, isDetailMargin: true, isLast: true, isSelector, ref actualCount);
			}
			for (int num = DetailViewIndents.Count - 1; num > actualCount - 1; num--)
			{
				DetailViewIndents.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			if (this is DetailDescriptorSelector || DetailViewIndents.Count % 3 != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < DetailViewIndents.Count; i += 3)
			{
				if (DetailViewIndents[i].IsSelectorMargin)
				{
					DetailViewIndents[i].Level = 0;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddOrChangeDetailViewIndent(int index, double left, double right, int level, bool isDetailMargin, bool isLast, bool isSelector, ref int actualCount)
		{
			if (DetailViewIndents.Count == index)
			{
				DetailViewIndents.Add(new DetailIndent());
			}
			DetailViewIndents[index].Update(left, right, level, isDetailMargin, isLast);
			DetailViewIndents[index].IsSelectorMargin = isSelector;
			actualCount++;
		}

		internal abstract DataControlBase GetChildDataControl(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle, object detailRow);
	}

		private void OnDataControlChanged(DataControlBase oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)oldValue);
				oldValue.DataControlOwner = null;
			}
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).AddLogicalChild((object)DataControl);
				DataControl.DataControlOwner = this;
				DataControl.UpdateOwnerDetailDescriptor();
			}
			ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			UpdateMasterControl();
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DetailDescriptorContainer> CreateDataControlDetailDescriptors()
		{
			return new ObservableCollection<DetailDescriptorContainer> { detailDescriptorContainer };
		}

		public DataControlDetailDescriptor()
		{
			detailDescriptorContainer = new DetailDescriptorContainer(this);
			headerContentListener = PropertyChangeListener.Create((BindingBase)new Binding(DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataControlProperty) + ".View." + DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(DataViewBase.DetailHeaderContentProperty))
			{
				Source = this
			}, (Action<object>)delegate(object obj)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(HeaderContentPropertyKey, obj);
			});
		}

		internal override DetailInfoWithContent CreateRowDetailInfo(RowDetailContainer container)
		{
			return new DataControlDetailInfo(this, container);
		}

		internal override void SynchronizeDetailTree()
		{
