			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.SynchronizeDetailTree();
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateDetailDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateOpenDetailMethod, Action<DataControlBase> updateClosedDetailMethod = null)
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControlOriginationElementHelper.EnumerateDependentElementsSkipOriginationControl(DataControl, (DataControlBase dataControl) => dataControl, updateOpenDetailMethod, updateClosedDetailMethod);
				DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.UpdateDetailDataControls(updateOpenDetailMethod, updateClosedDetailMethod);
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateOriginationDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateMethod)
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				updateMethod(DataControl);
				DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.UpdateOriginationDataControls(updateMethod);
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateMasterControl()
		{
			if (DataControl != null && DataControl.DataView != null)
			{
				DataControl.DataView.UpdateMasterDetailViewProperties();
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateDetailViewIndents(ObservableCollection<DetailIndent> ownerIndents, Thickness margin)
		{
			base.UpdateDetailViewIndents(ownerIndents, margin);
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.UpdateChildrenDetailViewIndents(base.DetailViewIndents);
			}
		}

		internal BindingBase GetItemsSourceBinding()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ItemsSourcePath) || ItemsSourceValueConverter != null)
			{
				return new Binding(ItemsSourcePath ?? string.Empty)
				{
					Converter = ItemsSourceValueConverter
				};
			}
			return ItemsSourceBinding;
		}

		private void ValidateMasterDetailConsistency()
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.ThrowNotSupportedInDetailException();
				DataControl.ThrowNotSupportedInMasterDetailException();
				if (DataControl.DataView != null)
				{
					DataControl.DataView.ThrowNotSupportedInMasterDetailException();
					DataControl.DataView.ThrowNotSupportedInDetailException();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnDetach()
		{
			base.SynchronizationQueues.Clear();
		}

		internal void PopulateColumnsIfNeeded(DataProviderBase dataProvider)
		{
			if (isColumnsPopulated)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (DataControl.ShouldPopulateColumns())
			{
				DataControl.PopulateColumnsIfNeeded(dataProvider);
			}
			DataControl.syncPropertyLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in DataControl.ColumnsCore)
				{
					item.UpdateColumnTypeProperties(dataProvider);
				}
			});
			isColumnsPopulated = true;
		}

			action(this);
			base.Owner.EnumerateOwnerDetailDescriptors(action);
		}

		private DataControlBase FindDetailDataControlByRow(object detailRow)
		{
			Stack<object> parentRows = new Stack<object>();
			DataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				parentRows.Push(detailRow);
				if (dataControl != DataControl.GetRootDataControl())
				{
					detailRow = dataControl.DataControlOwner.GetParentRow(detailRow);
				}
			});
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = DataControl.GetRootDataControl();
			int num = int.MinValue;
			foreach (object item in parentRows)
			{
				if (num != int.MinValue)
				{
					dataControlBase = dataControlBase.DetailDescriptorCore.GetChildDataControl(dataControlBase, num, item);
				}
				if (dataControlBase == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				num = dataControlBase.DataProviderBase.FindRowByRowValue(item);
				if (num == int.MinValue)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			return dataControlBase;
		}

		private object GetParentRow(object detailRow)
		{
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0055: Expected O, but got Unknown
			CustomGetParentEventArgs e = new CustomGetParentEventArgs(detailRow);
			if (customGetParentEvent != null)
			{
				customGetParentEvent(DataControl, e);
			}
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return e.Parent;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(ParentPath) || detailRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = detailRow.GetType();
			CriteriaCompiledContextDescriptorDescripted val = new CriteriaCompiledContextDescriptorDescripted(TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(type));
			CriteriaOperator val2 = CriteriaOperator.Parse(ParentPath, new object[0]);
			Func<object, object> func = CriteriaCompiler.ToUntypedDelegate(val2, (CriteriaCompilerDescriptor)(object)val);
			return func(detailRow);
		}

		internal override DataControlBase GetChildDataControl(DataControlBase parent, int parentRowHandle, object detailRow)
		{
			parent.MasterDetailProvider.SetMasterRowExpanded(parentRowHandle, expand: true, this);
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = parent.MasterDetailProvider.FindDetailDataControl(parentRowHandle, this);
			if (dataControlBase == null || dataControlBase.DataProviderBase.FindRowByRowValue(detailRow) != int.MinValue)
			{
				return dataControlBase;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<DataControlDetailDescriptor> GetDetailDescriptors(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int rowHandle)
		{
			yield return this;
		}

		protected internal override bool HasDataControlDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return true;
		}
	}

	[ContentProperty("DetailDescriptors")]
	public abstract class MultiDetailDescriptor : MultiDetailDescriptorBase
	{
		[Description("Provides access to Detail Descriptors to be displayed by this multi-detail container.")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Category("Master-Detail")]
		[XtraSerializableProperty(true, false, false)]
		[GridUIProperty]
		public DetailDescriptorCollection DetailDescriptors => base.DetailDescriptorsCore;

		protected internal override IEnumerable<DataControlDetailDescriptor> GetDetailDescriptors(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int rowHandle)
		{
			return base.DetailDescriptorsCore.SelectMany((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.GetDetailDescriptors(treeBuilder, rowHandle));
		}
	}
	public abstract class MultiDetailDescriptorBase : ContentDetailDescriptor, IDetailDescriptorOwner
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollectionCore<DetailDescriptorContainer> dataControlDescriptors = new ObservableCollectionCore<DetailDescriptorContainer>();

		internal DetailDescriptorCollection DetailDescriptorsCore { get; private set; }

		protected override IEnumerator LogicalChildren => DetailDescriptorsCore.GetEnumerator();

		protected internal override bool HasDataControlDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return DetailDescriptorsCore.Any((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.HasDataControlDetailDescriptor());
		}

		static MultiDetailDescriptorBase()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(MultiDetailDescriptorBase);
			EventManager.RegisterClassHandler(typeFromHandle, DXSerializer.CreateCollectionItemEvent, (Delegate)(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventHandler)delegate(object s, XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
			{
				((MultiDetailDescriptorBase)s).OnCreateCollectionItem(e);
			});
		}

		private void UpdateNestedDetailDescriptorsCache()
		{
			dataControlDescriptors.BeginUpdate();
			((Collection<DetailDescriptorContainer>)(object)dataControlDescriptors).Clear();
			foreach (DetailDescriptorBase item in DetailDescriptorsCore)
			{
				foreach (DetailDescriptorContainer dataControlDetailDescriptor in item.DataControlDetailDescriptors)
				{
					((Collection<DetailDescriptorContainer>)(object)dataControlDescriptors).Add(dataControlDetailDescriptor);
				}
			}
			dataControlDescriptors.EndUpdate();
			if (base.Owner is MultiDetailDescriptor multiDetailDescriptor)
			{
				multiDetailDescriptor.UpdateNestedDetailDescriptorsCache();
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DetailDescriptorContainer> CreateDataControlDetailDescriptors()
		{
			return (IEnumerable<DetailDescriptorContainer>)dataControlDescriptors;
		}

		protected MultiDetailDescriptorBase()
		{
			DetailDescriptorsCore = new DetailDescriptorCollection(this);
		}

		internal override void SynchronizeDetailTree()
		{
			base.SynchronizeDetailTree();
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.SynchronizeDetailTree();
			});
		}

		internal override void UpdateDetailDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateOpenDetailMethod, Action<DataControlBase> updateClosedDetailMethod = null)
		{
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.UpdateDetailDataControls(updateOpenDetailMethod, updateClosedDetailMethod);
			});
		}

		internal override void UpdateOriginationDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateMethod)
		{
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.UpdateOriginationDataControls(updateMethod);
			});
		}

		internal void OnDescriptorAdded(DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			if (this is TabViewDetailDescriptor && descriptor is DetailDescriptorSelector)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("The TabViewDetailDescriptor cannot contain a DetailDescriptorSelector.");
			}
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).AddLogicalChild((object)descriptor);
			descriptor.Owner = this;
			UpdateNestedDetailDescriptorsCache();
		}

		internal void OnDescriptorRemoved(DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			descriptor.Owner = null;
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).RemoveLogicalChild((object)descriptor);
			UpdateNestedDetailDescriptorsCache();
		}

		internal override void UpdateDetailViewIndents(ObservableCollection<DetailIndent> ownerIndents, Thickness margin)
		{
			base.UpdateDetailViewIndents(ownerIndents, margin);
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.UpdateDetailViewIndents(base.DetailViewIndents, default(Thickness));
			});
		}

		internal override void UpdateMasterControl()
		{
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.UpdateMasterControl();
			});
		}

		internal override void OnDetach()
		{
			UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				detailDescriptor.OnDetach();
			});
		}

		private void UpdateChildDetailDescriptors(Action<DetailDescriptorBase> updateAction)
		{
			foreach (DetailDescriptorBase item in DetailDescriptorsCore)
			{
				updateAction(item);
			}
		}

		internal override DataControlBase GetChildDataControl(DataControlBase parent, int parentRowHandle, object detailRow)
		{
			return DetailDescriptorsCore.Select((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.GetChildDataControl(parent, parentRowHandle, detailRow)).FirstOrDefault((DataControlBase x) => x != null);
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.InvalidateTree()
		{
			InvalidateTree();
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.EnumerateOwnerDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> action)
		{
			base.Owner.EnumerateOwnerDataControls(action);
		}

		bool IDetailDescriptorOwner.CanAssignTo(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException("Specified detail descriptor is already the child of another detail descriptor.");
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.InvalidateIndents()
		{
			base.Owner.InvalidateIndents();
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.EnumerateOwnerDetailDescriptors(Action<DetailDescriptorBase> action)
		{
			action(this);
			base.Owner.EnumerateOwnerDetailDescriptors(action);
		}

		private string GetSerializationName(XtraPropertyInfo item)
		{
			if (item.ChildProperties == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string result = null;
			XtraPropertyInfo val = item.ChildProperties["Name"];
			if (val != null && val.Value != null)
			{
				result = val.Value.ToString();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual void OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item != null)
			{
				string name = GetSerializationName(((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item);
				int num = -1;
				num = ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name)) ? IListExtensions.FindIndex<DetailDescriptorBase>((IList<DetailDescriptorBase>)DetailDescriptorsCore, (Predicate<DetailDescriptorBase>)((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.Name == name)) : ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Index);
				if (DetailDescriptorsCore != null && num >= 0 && num < DetailDescriptorsCore.Count && !(DetailDescriptorsCore[num] is ContentDetailDescriptor))
				{
					e.CollectionItem = DetailDescriptorsCore[num];
				}
			}
		}
	}

	internal class BindingValueHelper : FrameworkElement
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(BindingValueHelper), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((BindingValueHelper)d).OnValueChanged(e.OldValue);
		}));

		private readonly Action<object> changedCallback;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public BindingValueHelper(Action<object> changedCallback)
		{
			this.changedCallback = changedCallback;
		}

		private void OnValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (changedCallback != null)
			{
				changedCallback(oldValue);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyBindings(DetailDescriptorSelector detailSelector, object dataContext)
		{
			base.DataContext = dataContext;
			base.Style = DXTriggerHelper.CreateStyle<DetailDescriptorTrigger>((IEnumerable<DetailDescriptorTrigger>)detailSelector.Items, ValueProperty, (Func<DetailDescriptorTrigger, object>)((DetailDescriptorTrigger e) => e.DetailDescriptor), (object)detailSelector.DefaultValue);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			base.Style = null;
			base.DataContext = null;
		}
	}
	[ContentProperty("Items")]
	public class DetailDescriptorSelector : MultiDetailDescriptorBase
	{
		[XtraSerializableProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		[GridStoreAlwaysProperty]
		[XtraResetProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public DetailDescriptorBase DefaultValue { get; set; }

		[XtraSerializableProperty(true, false, false)]
		[GridStoreAlwaysProperty]
		[XtraResetProperty(/*Could not decode attribute arguments.*/)]
		public FreezableCollection<DetailDescriptorTrigger> Items { get; private set; }

		public DetailDescriptorSelector()
		{
			Items = new FreezableCollection<DetailDescriptorTrigger>();
		}

		internal override DetailInfoWithContent CreateRowDetailInfo(RowDetailContainer container)
		{
			return new DetailDescriptorSelectorInfo(this, container);
		}

		protected override void OnMasterControlChanged()
		{
			PopulateDetailDescriptors();
			base.OnMasterControlChanged();
		}

		private void PopulateDetailDescriptors()
		{
			if (!((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).IsInitialized || Items.IsFrozen)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(Items))
			{
				Items.Freeze();
			}
			if (DefaultValue != null)
			{
				base.DetailDescriptorsCore.Add(DefaultValue);
			}
			foreach (DetailDescriptorTrigger item in Items)
			{
				base.DetailDescriptorsCore.Add(item.DetailDescriptor);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkContentElement)(object)this).OnInitialized(e);
			PopulateDetailDescriptors();
		}

		protected internal override IEnumerable<DataControlDetailDescriptor> GetDetailDescriptors(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int rowHandle)
		{
			BindingValueHelper bindingValueHelper = new BindingValueHelper(null);
			bindingValueHelper.ApplyBindings(this, treeBuilder.View.DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle));
			DetailDescriptorBase input = (DetailDescriptorBase)bindingValueHelper.Value;
			bindingValueHelper.Clear();
			return input.Return((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.GetDetailDescriptors(treeBuilder, rowHandle), () => DetailDescriptorBase.EmptyDetailDescriptors);
		}

		protected override void OnCreateCollectionItem(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Index >= 0 && ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Index < Items.Count)
			{
				e.CollectionItem = Items[((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Index];
			}
		}
	}
	public class DetailDescriptorCollection : ObservableCollection<DetailDescriptorBase>
	{
		private readonly MultiDetailDescriptorBase owner;

		public DetailDescriptorCollection(MultiDetailDescriptorBase owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, DetailDescriptorBase item)
		{
			base.InsertItem(index, item);
			owner.OnDescriptorAdded(item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			owner.OnDescriptorRemoved(base[index]);
			base.RemoveItem(index);
		}

		protected override void SetItem(int index, DetailDescriptorBase item)
		{
			owner.OnDescriptorRemoved(base[index]);
			base.SetItem(index, item);
			owner.OnDescriptorAdded(item);
		}

		protected override void ClearItems()
		{
			using (IEnumerator<DetailDescriptorBase> enumerator = GetEnumerator())
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					DetailDescriptorBase current = enumerator.Current;
					owner.OnDescriptorRemoved(current);
				}
			}
			base.ClearItems();
		}
	}

		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}

	public abstract class RowsContainer : DependencyObject, IItemsContainer
	{
		private class RowsContainerItemsCollection : VersionedObservableCollection<RowDataBase>
		{
			private readonly RowsContainer dataContainerItem;

			public RowsContainerItemsCollection(RowsContainer dataContainerItem, Guid cacheVersion)
				: base(cacheVersion)
			{
				this.dataContainerItem = dataContainerItem;
			}

			protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
				HierarchyChangedEventArgs eventArgs = ((e.Action != NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove) ? HierarchyChangedEventArgs.Default : new HierarchyChangedEventArgs(HierarchyChangeType.ItemRemoved, (IItem)e.OldItems[0]));
				dataContainerItem.MasterRootRowsContainer.RaiseHierarchyChanged(eventArgs);
			}
		}

		protected static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ItemsPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ItemsProperty;

		protected static readonly DependencyPropertyKey RowsLocationPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty AnimationProgressProperty;

		private RowDataBase ownerRowData;

		internal abstract MasterRowsContainer MasterRootRowsContainer { get; }

		internal abstract SynchronizationQueues SynchronizationQueues { get; }

		public double AnimationProgress
		{
			get
			{
				return (double)GetValue(AnimationProgressProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(AnimationProgressProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<RowDataBase> Items
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<RowDataBase>)GetValue(ItemsProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		IList<IItem> IItemsContainer.Items => (IList<IItem>)new SimpleBridgeList<IItem, RowDataBase>((IList<RowDataBase>)Items, (Func<RowDataBase, IItem>)((RowDataBase rowData) => rowData), (Func<IItem, RowDataBase>)null);

		System.Windows.Size IItemsContainer.DesiredSize { get; set; }

		System.Windows.Size IItemsContainer.RenderSize { get; set; }

		static RowsContainer()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(RowsContainer);
			ItemsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("Items", typeof(ObservableCollection<RowDataBase>), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			ItemsProperty = ItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			AnimationProgressProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("AnimationProgress", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0.0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowsContainer)d).OnAnimationProgressChanged();
			}));
		}

		internal void SetOwnerRowData(RowDataBase value)
		{
			if (ownerRowData != value)
			{
				if (ownerRowData != null && ownerRowData.RowsContainer == this)
				{
					ownerRowData.RowsContainer = null;
				}
				ownerRowData = value;
			}
		}

		internal virtual Guid GetCacheVersion()
		{
			return Guid.Empty;
		}

		public void RaiseItemsRemoved(IEnumerable items)
		{
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IItem item in items)
			{
				MasterRootRowsContainer.RaiseHierarchyChanged(new HierarchyChangedEventArgs(HierarchyChangeType.ItemRemoved, item));
				RaiseItemsRemoved(item.ItemsContainer.Items);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void Synchronize(NodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			MasterRootRowsContainer.TreeBuilder.Synchronize(this, nodeContainer);
		}

		internal virtual bool BaseSyncronize(NodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void StoreFreeData()
		{
			if (Items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RowDataBase item in Items)
			{
				item.StoreAsFreeData(this);
			}
		}

		private void OnAnimationProgressChanged()
		{
			MasterRootRowsContainer.RaiseHierarchyChanged(HierarchyChangedEventArgs.Default);
		}

		internal void InitItemsCollection()
		{
			Items = new RowsContainerItemsCollection(this, GetCacheVersion());
		}

		public void StoreFreeRowData(RowNode node, RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			VerifyVisualRootTreeBuilder();
			FreeRowDataInfo freeRowDataInfo = FindRowDataInfo(node.GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues), rowData);
			if (freeRowDataInfo != null)
			{
				freeRowDataInfo.DataContainer = this;
			}
			else
			{
				node.GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues).AddLast(new FreeRowDataInfo(this, rowData));
			}
		}

		public void UnstoreFreeRowData(RowNode node, RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			VerifyVisualRootTreeBuilder();
			FreeRowDataInfo freeRowDataInfo = FindRowDataInfo(node.GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues), rowData);
			if (freeRowDataInfo != null)
			{
				node.GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues).Remove(freeRowDataInfo);
			}
		}

		private static FreeRowDataInfo FindRowDataInfo(LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> list, RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			foreach (FreeRowDataInfo item in list)
			{
				if (item.RowData == rowData)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void VerifyVisualRootTreeBuilder()
		{
			if (!(MasterRootRowsContainer.TreeBuilder is VisualDataTreeBuilder))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("This method is valid only when used inside VisualTreeBuilder");
			}
		}

		internal virtual RowsContainerSyncronizerBase CreateRowsContainerSyncronizer()
		{
			return new RowsContainerSyncronizer(this);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			foreach (RowDataBase item in Items)
			{
				HierarchyPanel.DetachItem(item);
				if (item.RowsContainer != null)
				{
					item.RowsContainer.Clear();
				}
			}
			Items.Clear();
		}

		internal IEnumerable GetEnumerable()
		{
			foreach (RowDataBase item in Items)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
			foreach (LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> allFreeQueue in SynchronizationQueues.AllFreeQueues)
			{
				foreach (FreeRowDataInfo item2 in allFreeQueue)
				{
					yield return item2.RowData;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddItemSafe(RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			if (!Items.Contains(rowData))
			{
				IDetailNode detailNode = rowData as IDetailNode;
				if (detailNode == null || !Items.OfType<IDetailNode>().Any((IDetailNode x) => x.Key == detailNode.Key))
				{
					Items.Add(rowData);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DataRowsContainer : RowsContainer
	{
		internal const string IsGroupRowsContainerPropertyName = "IsGroupRowsContainer";

		protected static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsGroupRowsContainerPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsGroupRowsContainerProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupLevelProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey GroupLevelPropertyKey;

		protected readonly DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder;

		public bool IsGroupRowsContainer
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsGroupRowsContainerProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(IsGroupRowsContainerPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public int GroupLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(GroupLevelProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(GroupLevelPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		protected internal DataViewBase View => TreeBuilder.View;

		internal DataTreeBuilder TreeBuilder => treeBuilder;

		internal override MasterRowsContainer MasterRootRowsContainer => TreeBuilder.MasterRootRowsContainer;

		internal override SynchronizationQueues SynchronizationQueues => ((VisualDataTreeBuilder)TreeBuilder).SynchronizationQueues;

		static DataRowsContainer()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(DataRowsContainer);
			IsGroupRowsContainerPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsGroupRowsContainer", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsGroupRowsContainerProperty = IsGroupRowsContainerPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			GroupLevelPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("GroupLevel", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(0));
			GroupLevelProperty = GroupLevelPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
		}

		public DataRowsContainer(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int level)
		{
			this.treeBuilder = treeBuilder;
			GroupLevel = level;
			InitItemsCollection();
		}

		internal override bool BaseSyncronize(NodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (nodeContainer == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataNodeContainer dataNodeContainer = (DataNodeContainer)nodeContainer;
			GroupLevel = dataNodeContainer.GroupLevel;
			bool isGroupRowsContainer = IsGroupRowsContainer;
			IsGroupRowsContainer = dataNodeContainer.IsGroupRowsContainer;
			if (!(View.CacheVersion != ((ISupportCacheVersion)base.Items).CacheVersion))
			{
				return isGroupRowsContainer != IsGroupRowsContainer;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override Guid GetCacheVersion()
		{
			return View.CacheVersion;
		}
	}

	public class MasterRowsContainer : DetailRowsContainer, IRootItemsContainer, IDetailRootItemsContainer, IItemsContainer
	{
		private DataViewBase focusedView;

		private List<RowData> rowsToUpdate = new List<RowData>();

		private int oldStartVisibleIndex;

		private bool isDirect;

		private List<int> rowData1Indices = new List<int>();

		private List<int> rowData2Indices = new List<int>();

		protected DataControlBase MasterDataControl => base.TreeBuilder.View.DataControl;

		public DataViewBase FocusedView
		{
			get
			{
				return focusedView;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (focusedView != value)
				{
					DataViewBase dataViewBase = focusedView;
					focusedView = value;
					dataViewBase.ProcessFocusedViewChange();
					focusedView.ProcessFocusedViewChange();
					focusedView.RootView.RaiseFocusedViewChanged(dataViewBase, focusedView);
				}
			}
		}

		double IRootItemsContainer.ScrollItemOffset => base.View.DataPresenter.ScrollItemOffset;

		IItem IRootItemsContainer.ScrollItem => base.View.DataPresenter.GetRowDataToScroll();

		internal List<RowData> RowsToUpdate => rowsToUpdate;

		public event HierarchyChangedEventHandler HierarchyChanged;

		public MasterRowsContainer(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int level)
			: base(treeBuilder, level)
		{
			focusedView = treeBuilder.View;
		}

		public void RaiseHierarchyChanged(HierarchyChangedEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (this.HierarchyChanged != null)
			{
				this.HierarchyChanged(this, eventArgs);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdatePostponedData(bool updateStartIndex, bool updateImmediately)
		{
			if ((!base.View.ViewBehavior.AllowCascadeUpdate && !base.View.GetAllowGroupSummaryCascadeUpdate) || base.View.DataPresenter == null || base.View.DataPresenter.AdjustmentInProgress || base.View.PostponedNavigationInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			ProcessInvisibleItems();
			rowsToUpdate.Clear();
			VirtualItemsEnumerator virtualItemsEnumerator = base.View.CreateAllRowsEnumerator();
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)virtualItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				if (virtualItemsEnumerator.CurrentData is RowData)
				{
					rowsToUpdate.Add((RowData)virtualItemsEnumerator.CurrentData);
				}
			}
			ProcessInvisibleItems();
			int scrollOffset = base.View.DataPresenter.ScrollOffset;
			if (updateStartIndex && scrollOffset != oldStartVisibleIndex)
			{
				isDirect = oldStartVisibleIndex < scrollOffset;
				oldStartVisibleIndex = scrollOffset;
			}
			if (!updateImmediately)
			{
				InvokeUpdatePostponedDataItem();
			}
			else if (!base.View.DataPresenter.CanScrollWithAnimation)
			{
				UpdatePostponedDataItem();
			}
		}

		private void InvokeUpdatePostponedDataItem()
		{
			if (rowsToUpdate.Count > 0)
			{
				base.View.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(new Action(UpdatePostponedDataItem), DispatcherPriority.Background);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessInvisibleItems()
		{
			foreach (RowData item in rowsToUpdate)
			{
				item.UpdateIsDirty();
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePostponedDataItem()
		{
			rowsToUpdate.Sort(CompareRowData);
			RowData rowData;
			do
			{
				if (rowsToUpdate.Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				rowData = rowsToUpdate[0];
				rowsToUpdate.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			while (!rowData.IsRowInView() || rowData.IsReady);
			rowData.RefreshData();
			InvokeUpdatePostponedDataItem();
		}

		private int CompareRowData(RowData rowData1, RowData rowData2)
		{
			int num;
			if (rowData1.View == rowData2.View)
			{
				num = Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(rowData1.ControllerVisibleIndex, rowData2.ControllerVisibleIndex);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					if (rowData1.MatchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey)
					{
						num = -1;
					}
					else if (rowData2.MatchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				CollectParentIndices(rowData1, rowData1Indices);
				CollectParentIndices(rowData2, rowData2Indices);
				num = 0;
				int num2 = Math.Min(rowData1Indices.Count, rowData2Indices.Count);
				for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					num = Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(rowData1Indices[rowData1Indices.Count - i], rowData2Indices[rowData2Indices.Count - i]);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = Comparer<int>.Default.Compare(rowData1Indices.Count, rowData2Indices.Count);
				}
			}
			if (!isDirect)
			{
				return -num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static void CollectParentIndices(RowData rowData, List<int> indices)
		{
			indices.Clear();
			rowData.View.DataControl.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl, int visibleIndex)
			{
				indices.Add(visibleIndex);
			}, rowData.ControllerVisibleIndex);
		}
	}
	public abstract class RowsContainerSyncronizerBase
	{
		protected readonly RowsContainer dataContainer;

		private Dictionary<object, RowDataBase> matchedItems = new Dictionary<object, RowDataBase>();

		private bool changed;

		protected int SyncronizeStartIndex => 0;

		protected ObservableCollection<RowDataBase> Items
		{
			get
			{
				return dataContainer.Items;
			}
			set
			{
				dataContainer.Items = value;
			}
		}

		protected RowsContainerSyncronizerBase(RowsContainer dataContainer)
		{
			this.dataContainer = dataContainer;
		}

		public void Synchronize(NodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			bool flag = dataContainer.BaseSyncronize(nodeContainer);
			if (Items == null || flag)
			{
				dataContainer.StoreFreeData();
				dataContainer.RaiseItemsRemoved(Items);
				dataContainer.InitItemsCollection();
			}
			BeforeSyncronize(nodeContainer);
			for (int i = SyncronizeStartIndex; i < nodeContainer.Items.Count; i++)
			{
				RowDataBase rowData = GetRowData(nodeContainer, i);
				AssignRowDataFromNodeContainer(nodeContainer, rowData, i);
			}
			AfterSyncronize();
		}

		private void SetRowDataVisibleIndex(RowDataBase rowData, int nodeIndex)
		{
			int visibleIndex = ((ISupportVisibleIndex)rowData).VisibleIndex;
			if (visibleIndex != nodeIndex)
			{
				changed = true;
				rowData.SetVisibleIndex(nodeIndex);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFixedRowPosition(RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			if (rowData.UpdateFixedRowPosition())
			{
				changed = true;
			}
		}

		private RowDataBase GetRowData(NodeContainer nodeContainer, int nodeIndex)
		{
			return GetItem(nodeContainer.Items[nodeIndex]);
		}

		private void AssignRowDataFromNodeContainer(NodeContainer nodeContainer, RowDataBase rowData, int nodeIndex)
		{
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				SetRowDataVisibleIndex(rowData, nodeIndex);
				rowData.AssignVirtualizedRowData(dataContainer, nodeContainer, nodeContainer.Items[nodeIndex], forceUpdate: false);
				UpdateFixedRowPosition(rowData);
			}
			else
			{
				dataContainer.SynchronizationQueues.UnsynchronizedNodes.Enqueue(new UnsynchronizedNodeInfo(dataContainer, nodeContainer, nodeIndex));
			}
		}

		private void AfterSyncronize()
		{
			SetInvisibleIndex(GetUnmatchedItems(), storeAsFreeData: true);
			if (changed)
			{
				((VersionedObservableCollection<RowDataBase>)Items).RaiseCollectionChanged();
			}
		}

		private void SetInvisibleIndex(IEnumerable items, bool storeAsFreeData)
		{
			foreach (RowDataBase item in items)
			{
				if (!OrderPanelBase.IsInvisibleIndex(((ISupportVisibleIndex)item).VisibleIndex))
				{
					changed = true;
					item.SetVisibleIndex(-1);
					SetInvisibleIndex(((IItem)item).ItemsContainer.Items, storeAsFreeData: false);
				}
				if (storeAsFreeData)
				{
					item.StoreAsFreeData(dataContainer);
				}
			}
		}

		private void BeforeSyncronize(NodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			foreach (RowDataBase item in Items)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (RowNode item2 in nodeContainer.Items)
				{
					if (item2.IsMatchedRowData(item) && !matchedItems.ContainsKey(item2.MatchKey))
					{
						matchedItems.Add(item2.MatchKey, item);
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					EnqueueUnmatchedItem(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private RowDataBase GetItem(RowNode rowNode)
		{
			RowDataBase value = null;
			if (matchedItems.TryGetValue(rowNode.MatchKey, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return DequeueUnmatchedItem(rowNode.MatchKey);
		}

		protected abstract void EnqueueUnmatchedItem(RowDataBase rowData);

		protected abstract RowDataBase DequeueUnmatchedItem(object matchKey);

		protected abstract IEnumerable<RowDataBase> GetUnmatchedItems();
	}
	public class RowsContainerSyncronizer : RowsContainerSyncronizerBase
	{
		private readonly Queue<RowDataBase> unmatchedRowItems = new Queue<RowDataBase>();

		private readonly Queue<RowDataBase> unmatchedGroupRowItems = new Queue<RowDataBase>();

		private readonly Queue<RowDataBase> unmatchedGroupSummaryRowItems = new Queue<RowDataBase>();

		private readonly Queue<RowDataBase> unmatchedServiceRowItems = new Queue<RowDataBase>();

		public RowsContainerSyncronizer(RowsContainer dataContainer)
			: base(dataContainer)
		{
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<RowDataBase> GetUnmatchedItems()
		{
			List<RowDataBase> list = new List<RowDataBase>();
			list.AddRange(unmatchedRowItems);
			list.AddRange(unmatchedGroupRowItems);
			list.AddRange(unmatchedGroupSummaryRowItems);
			list.AddRange(unmatchedServiceRowItems);
			return list;
		}

		private Queue<RowDataBase> GetQueue(object matchKey)
		{
			if (matchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				return unmatchedGroupSummaryRowItems;
			}
			RowHandle rowHandle = (RowHandle)matchKey;
			if (rowHandle.Value == -2147483646)
			{
				return unmatchedServiceRowItems;
			}
			if (rowHandle.Value >= 0 || rowHandle.Value == -2147483647)
			{
				return unmatchedRowItems;
			}
			return unmatchedGroupRowItems;
		}

		protected override void EnqueueUnmatchedItem(RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			GetQueue(rowData.MatchKey).Enqueue(rowData);
		}

		protected override RowDataBase DequeueUnmatchedItem(object matchKey)
		{
			Queue<RowDataBase> queue = GetQueue(matchKey);
			if (queue.Count > 0)
			{
				return queue.Dequeue();
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class GroupSummaryRowKey
	{
		public RowHandle RowHandle { get; private set; }

		public int Level { get; private set; }

		public GroupSummaryRowKey(RowHandle rowHandle, int level)
		{
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
			Level = level;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return RowHandle.Value;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is GroupSummaryRowKey groupSummaryRowKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RowHandle.Equals(groupSummaryRowKey.RowHandle))
			{
				return Level == groupSummaryRowKey.Level;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
			this.viewBase = viewBase;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetHasTop(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			return nodeContainer.StartScrollIndex == 0;
		}

		protected internal bool GetHasBottom(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			int num = nodeContainer.StartScrollIndex + nodeContainer.Items.Count - 1;
			if (num + 1 != nodeContainer.TotalVisibleCount)
			{
				return GetHasBottomCore(nodeContainer, num);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetHasBottomCore(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int lastVisibleIndex)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal abstract RowNode GetRowNodeForCurrentLevel(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int index, int startVisibleIndex, bool isFixedNode, ref bool shouldBreak);

		protected internal abstract RowNode GetSummaryNodeForCurrentNode(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, RowHandle rowHandle, int index);

		protected internal virtual int GetRowParentIndex(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer, int visibleIndex, int level)
		{
			return viewBase.GetRowParentIndex(visibleIndex, level);
		}

		protected internal virtual bool IsGroupRowsContainer(DataNodeContainer nodeContainer)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal DataRowNode GetRowNode(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int startVisibleIndex, DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues)
		{
			DataRowNode rowNode = treeBuilder.GetRowNode((DataControllerValuesContainer values) => new DataRowNode(treeBuilder, values), controllerValues);
			rowNode.summaryNode = null;
			rowNode.UpdateDetailInfo(startVisibleIndex);
			return rowNode;
		}
	}

				if (base.View.HasCellEditorError)

					return base.View.ValidationError == BaseEdit.GetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)this);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool CanSelect(bool checkIsCheckSelectorColumn = true)
		{
			if (base.Column == null || base.View == null || RowData?.RowHandle == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!checkIsCheckSelectorColumn || base.Column == base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
			{
				return base.View.RaiseCanSelectRow(RowData.RowHandle.Value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CanUnselect(bool checkIsCheckSelectorColumn = true)
		{
			if (base.Column == null || base.View == null || RowData?.RowHandle == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!checkIsCheckSelectorColumn || base.Column == base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
			{
				return base.View.RaiseCanUnselectRow(RowData.RowHandle.Value);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateIsEnabledCheckBoxSelectorColumn()
		{
			if (base.View == null || base.Column != base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn || !(((EditableDataObject)this).Value is bool))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = (bool)((EditableDataObject)this).Value;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (editor != null)
			{
				if (base.View.CanRaiseCanSelectRow() && !CanSelect() && !flag)
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
				if (flag2 && base.View.CanRaiseCanUnselectRow() && !CanUnselect() && flag)
				{
					flag2 = false;
				}
				((UIElement)(object)editor).IsEnabled = flag2;
			}
			SyncIsEnabled(flag2);
		}

		private void UpdateCanSelectRow(bool checkColumn = true)
		{
			if (base.Column == null || base.View == null || RowData?.RowHandle == null || !base.View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible || base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GridCellData gridCellData = this;
			if (checkColumn)
			{
				if (base.Column != base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				gridCellData = RowData.GetCellDataByColumn(base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn, updateNewCellData: false, addToCache: false) as GridCellData;
				if (gridCellData == null)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			gridCellData.UpdateIsEnabledCheckBoxSelectorColumn();
		}

		protected override void OnValueChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			if (base.View != null && RowData.RowHandle.Value != -2147483645 && base.View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && base.View.IsEditing && base.View.DataControl != null && base.View.DataControl.CurrentColumn == base.ColumnCore)
			{
				RowData.SetUpdateRowButtonsCache(base.ColumnCore, ((EditableDataObject)this).Value);
				if (base.Editor != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)base.Editor).IsCustomEditor)
				{
					if (base.View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.OnCellValueChange && !base.View.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && base.Editor != null)
					{
						base.View.ViewBehavior?.ShowRowButtons();
					}
					if (base.View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && ((InplaceEditorBase)base.Editor).Edit != null)
					{
						((InplaceEditorBase)base.Editor).Edit.IsValueChanged = true;
					}
				}
			}
			RowData.GetFormatCachingLocker().Unlock();
			((EditableDataObject)this).OnValueChanged(oldValue);
			OnEditorDataChanged();
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateValue(bool forceUpdate = false)
		{
			if (!RowData.GetIsReady())
			{
				return;
			}
			Tuple<bool, object> tuple = RowData.NeedUpdateRowButtonsInit(base.ColumnCore);
			if (!tuple.Item1 && (base.Editor == null || !base.Editor.CancelEditLocker.IsLocked))
			{
				((EditableDataObject)this).Value = tuple.Item2;
				return;
			}
			ResubscribeSimpleBinding();
			BindingBase bindingBase = base.ColumnCore?.ActualBinding;
			object value = ((EditableDataObject)this).Value;
			if (isValueBinded && bindingBase != displayMemberBinding && bindingBase == null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)this).ClearValue(DisplayMemberBindingValueProperty);
			}
			if (!IsEditing && base.ColumnCore != null && base.Data != null && DataControl != null && base.ColumnCore.OwnerControl != null)
			{
				isValueBinded = bindingBase != null;
				if (isValueBinded)
				{
					if (bindingBase != displayMemberBinding)
					{
						displayMemberBinding = bindingBase;
						if (!base.View.IsDesignTime)
						{
							BindingOperations.SetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, DisplayMemberBindingValueProperty, bindingBase);
							base.Editor?.UpdateValidationErrorCore();
						}
					}
					if (((EditableDataObject)this).Value != DisplayMemberBindingValue)
					{
						UpdateGridCellDataValue();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					displayMemberBinding = null;
					object newValue = GetValue();
					if (base.ColumnCore.ActualBinding != null)
					{
						UpdateValue();
						RowData.SetUpdateRowButtonsCache(base.ColumnCore, ((EditableDataObject)this).Value);
						return;
					}
					if (AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(newValue))
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!object.Equals(((EditableDataObject)this).Value, newValue))
					{
						RowData.GetFormatCachingLocker().DoLockedAction<object>((Func<object>)(() => ((EditableDataObject)this).Value = newValue));
					}
					else if (forceUpdate && base.Editor != null)
					{
						((InplaceEditorBase)editor).UpdateDisplayText();
					}
					if (base.ColumnCore.IsSimpleBindingEnabled)
					{
						DisplayMemberBindingValue = ((EditableDataObject)this).Value;
						base.Editor?.UpdateValidationErrorCore();
					}
				}
				RowData.SetUpdateRowButtonsCache(base.ColumnCore, ((EditableDataObject)this).Value);
			}
			if (!base.View.CanStartIncrementalSearch)
			{
				UpdateEditorHighlightingText(columnChanged: false);
			}
			if (object.Equals(((EditableDataObject)this).Value, value))
			{
				OnEditorDataChanged();
				if (base.Column != null && base.View != null && base.Column == base.View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn)
				{
					UpdateCanSelectRow(checkColumn: false);
				}
				if (isValueBinded && forceUpdate && base.Editor != null)
				{
					((InplaceEditorBase)base.Editor).UpdateDisplayText();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateCanSelectRow(checkColumn: false);
			}
		}

			return 0.0;

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((DependencyObject)(object)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == Validation.ErrorsProperty && RowData.CanUpdateErrors)

			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateCellError(RowHandle handle, ColumnBase column, bool customValidate = true)
		{
			if (RowData == null || !RowData.GetValueLeaveInvalidEditorLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				if (CanShowCellError)
				{
					SetCellError(handle, column, customValidate);
				}
				else if (!customValidate || !SetCellErrorOnlyCustom(handle, column, null))
				{
					SetDataErrorText(handle.Value, null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetCellError(RowHandle handle, ColumnBase column, bool customValidate)
		{
			//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!customValidate || !SetCellErrorOnlyCustom(handle, column, null))
			{
				BaseValidationError newError = null;
				MultiErrorInfo multiErrorInfo = ValidationMultiErrorReader.Read(Validation.GetErrors((DependencyObject)(object)this).ToArray(), (ValidationError rule) => rule.ErrorContent);
				if (!multiErrorInfo.HasErrors())
				{
					multiErrorInfo = base.View.DataProviderBase.GetMultiErrorInfo(handle, column.FieldName);
				}
				if (multiErrorInfo.HasErrors())
				{
					newError = (BaseValidationError)(object)base.View.CreateCellValidationError(multiErrorInfo.ErrorText, multiErrorInfo.Errors, multiErrorInfo.ErrorType, handle.Value, base.Column, null);
				}
				SetDataErrorText(handle.Value, newError);
			}
		}

		private bool IsValidRowHandleForRaiseCustomError(RowHandle handle)
		{
			if (handle == null || base.View == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int value = handle.Value;
			if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (value == -2147483645 && !tableView.ShowAutoFilterRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == -2147483647 && !tableView.NewItemRowIsDisplayed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool SetCellErrorOnlyCustom(RowHandle handle, ColumnBase column, RowValidationError info)
		{
			if (!base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor || !IsValidRowHandleForRaiseCustomError(handle))
			{
				return false;
			}
			object value = ((base.IsValueDirty || (base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor && base.View.EnableImmediatePosting)) ? CalculateWithOptionalLocker(RowData?.GetValueLeaveInvalidEditorLocker, GetValueForValidation) : ((EditableDataObject)this).Value);
			info = RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(base.View, this, value, handle.Value, column);
			if (info == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetDataErrorText(handle.Value, (BaseValidationError)(object)info);
			return true;
		}

		private static T CalculateWithOptionalLocker<T>(Locker locker, Func<T> calculate)
		{
			if (locker == null)
			{
				return calculate();
			}
			T result = default(T);
			locker.DoLockedAction<T>((Func<T>)(() => result = calculate()));
			return result;
		}

		private void ResubscribeSimpleBinding()
		{
			if (base.ColumnCore == null || !base.ColumnCore.IsSimpleBindingEnabled)
			{
				UnsubscribeSimpleBinding();
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor descriptorToListen = base.Column.SimpleBindingProcessor.DescriptorToListen;
			object obj = RowData?.Row;
			PropertyDescriptor descriptorToListen2 = GetDescriptorToListen();
			if (!object.Equals(descriptorToListen2, descriptorToListen) && descriptorToListen != null && obj != null)
			{
				UnsubscribeSimpleBinding();
				simpleBindingHandler = new DescriptorWeakEventHandler<GridCellData>(descriptorToListen, this, delegate(GridCellData cellData, object _, EventArgs __)
				{
					cellData.OnSimplePropertyChanged();
				});
				descriptorToListen.AddValueChanged(obj, ((WeakEventHandler<GridCellData, EventArgs, EventHandler>)simpleBindingHandler).Handler);
			}
		}

		private void UnsubscribeSimpleBinding()
		{
			PropertyDescriptor descriptorToListen = GetDescriptorToListen();
			if (descriptorToListen != null)
			{
				object obj = RowData?.Row;
				if (obj != null && simpleBindingHandler != null)
				{
					simpleBindingHandler.Detach(obj);
					simpleBindingHandler = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private PropertyDescriptor GetDescriptorToListen()
		{
			return simpleBindingHandler?.Descriptor;
		}

		private void OnSimplePropertyChanged()
		{
			DisplayMemberBindingValue = GetValue();
		}

		internal override void StartAnimation(IList<IList<AnimationTimeline>> animations)
		{
			if (base.Editor != null)
			{
				AnimationController.Start(animations, base.Editor.CreateAnimationConnector());
			}
		}

		internal override void StopAnimation()
		{
			if (IsAnimationControllerInited)
			{
				AnimationController.Flush();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DescriptorWeakEventHandler<TOwner> : WeakEventHandler<TOwner, EventArgs, EventHandler> where TOwner : class
	{
		private static Func<WeakEventHandler<TOwner, EventArgs, EventHandler>, EventHandler> createHandler = (WeakEventHandler<TOwner, EventArgs, EventHandler> h) => h.OnEvent;

		private readonly PropertyDescriptor descriptor;

		public PropertyDescriptor Descriptor => descriptor;

		public DescriptorWeakEventHandler(PropertyDescriptor descriptor, TOwner owner, Action<TOwner, object, EventArgs> onEventAction)
			: base(owner, onEventAction, (Action<WeakEventHandler<TOwner, EventArgs, EventHandler>, object>)OnDetach, createHandler)
		{
			this.descriptor = descriptor;
		}

		private static void OnDetach(WeakEventHandler<TOwner, EventArgs, EventHandler> handler, object source)
		{
			if (handler is DescriptorWeakEventHandler<TOwner> descriptorWeakEventHandler)
			{
				descriptorWeakEventHandler.Detach(source);
			}
		}

		public void Detach(object source)
		{
			if (source != null && base.Handler != null && Descriptor != null)
			{
				Descriptor.RemoveValueChanged(source, base.Handler);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class GridDataBase : EditableDataObject

		internal CellEditorBase Editor
		{
			get

			set
			{
				if (editor != value)
				{
					editor = value;
					OnEditorChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnEditorChanged()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateValue(bool forceUpdate = false)
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDataChanged()
		{
			contentChangedRaised = false;
			UpdateValueLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateValue(forceUpdate: true);
				if (!contentChangedRaised && CanRaiseContentChangedWhenDataChanged())
				{
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaiseContentChanged();
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual bool CanRaiseContentChangedWhenDataChanged()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override void RaiseContentChanged()
		{
			((DataObjectBase)this).RaiseContentChanged();
			contentChangedRaised = true;
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearBindingValue()
		{
		}
	}
	public class RowNodePrintInfo
	{
		public int NextNodeLevel { get; set; }

		public RowPosition RowPosition { get; set; }

		public int ListIndex { get; set; }

		public int PrevRowHandle { get; set; }

		public int NextRowHandle { get; set; }

		public RowPosition PrevRowPosition { get; set; }

		public Dictionary<ColumnBase, int> MergeValues { get; set; }

	public abstract class RowNode
	{
		protected static IEnumerable<RowNode> EmptyEnumerable = new RowNode[0];

		private bool canGenerateItems;

		private bool isRowVisible = true;

		public bool IsRowVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return isRowVisible;
			}
			protected set
			{
				isRowVisible = value;
			}
		}

		public abstract object MatchKey { get; }

		public NodeContainer NodesContainer { get; protected set; }

		public int ItemsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (IsDataExpanded && NodesContainer != null)
				{
					num += NodesContainer.ItemCount;
				}
				if (IsRowVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool IsDataExpanded { get; }

		public bool IsExpanding { get; internal set; }

		public bool IsExpanded { get; internal set; }

		internal bool IsCollapsing { get; set; }

		internal bool IsFinished
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDataExpanded)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (CanGenerateItems)
				{
					return NodesContainer.IsFinished;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanUpdateState => true;

		internal virtual bool CanGenerateItems
		{
			get
			{
				return canGenerateItems;
			}
			set
			{
				canGenerateItems = value;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsFixedNode => false;

		public FixedRowPosition FixedRowPosition { get; internal set; }

		public bool IsLastFixedRow { get; internal set; }

		protected RowNode()
		{
			FixedRowPosition = FixedRowPosition.None;
		}

		protected internal int GenerateItems(int count)
		{
			if (!CanGenerateItems || NodesContainer == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return NodesContainer.GenerateItems(count);
		}

		internal abstract RowDataBase GetRowData();

		internal abstract FrameworkElement GetRowElement();

		internal IEnumerable<RowNode> GetChildItems()
		{
			if (NodesContainer == null)
			{
				return EmptyEnumerable;
			}
			return NodesContainer.Items;
		}

		internal IEnumerable<RowNode> GetSkipCollapsedChildItems()
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				return EmptyEnumerable;
			}
			return GetChildItems();
		}

		internal virtual bool IsMatchedRowData(RowDataBase data)
		{
			return object.Equals(data.MatchKey, MatchKey);
		}

		internal virtual bool IsRowExpandedForNavigation()
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal abstract LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues synchronizationQueues);

		internal abstract RowDataBase CreateRowData();

		internal void UpdateExpandInfo(int startVisibleIndex, bool isRowVisible)
		{
			if (NodesContainer != null)
			{
				IsRowVisible = isRowVisible;
				CanGenerateItems = !IsCollapsing && !IsExpanding && IsDataExpanded;
				if (CanUpdateState)
				{
					IsExpanded = IsDataExpanded;
				}
				NodesContainer.ReGenerateExpandItems(startVisibleIndex, 0);
			}
		}

		internal virtual RowNode GetNodeToScroll()
		{
			if (NodesContainer == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (IsExpanded)
			{
				return NodesContainer.GetNodeToScroll() ?? this;
			}
			return this;
		}

		public virtual int SkipChildNodes(int index)
		{
			return index;
		}
	}
	public class DataRowNode : RowNode
	{
		private enum ItemType
		{
			DataRow,
			GroupRow,
			GroupSummaryRow
		}

		internal readonly DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder;

		private DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues;

		private int supressUpdateStateCount;

		private object row;

		internal static bool DisableUpdateOptimization;

		protected internal RowNode summaryNode;

		public override object MatchKey => RowHandle;

		public RowNodePrintInfo PrintInfo { get; set; }

		internal DataViewBase View => treeBuilder.View;

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => View.DataControl;

		protected override bool IsDataExpanded => DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(RowHandle.Value);

		internal DataControllerValuesContainer ControllerValues
		{
			get
			{
				return controllerValues;
			}
			private set
			{
				controllerValues = value;
				ValidateControllerValues();
			}
		}

		internal override bool CanGenerateItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.CanGenerateItems)
				{
					return CanGenerateItemsCore;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				base.CanGenerateItems = value;
			}
		}

		protected virtual bool CanGenerateItemsCore => treeBuilder.SupportsMasterDetail;

		public RowHandle RowHandle => ControllerValues.RowHandle;

		public int Level => ControllerValues.Level;

		protected override bool CanUpdateState => supressUpdateStateCount == 0;

		internal object Row => row;

		public virtual int CurrentLevelItemCount => 1;

		public DataRowNode(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues)
		{
			this.treeBuilder = treeBuilder;
			ControllerValues = controllerValues;
		}

		internal void Update(DataControllerValuesContainer info)
		{
			ControllerValues = info;
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateControllerValues()
		{
			if (RowHandle.Value < 0 && RowHandle.Value != -2147483647 && RowHandle.Value != -2147483646)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Internal error: RowHandle should be positive");
			}
			row = null;
		}

		internal void SupressUpdateState()
		{
			supressUpdateStateCount++;
		}

		internal void ResumeUpdateState()
		{
			supressUpdateStateCount--;
		}

		internal void UpdateDetailInfo(int startVisibleIndex)
		{
			base.NodesContainer = View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.GetDetailNodeContainer(RowHandle.Value);
			UpdateExpandInfo(startVisibleIndex, isRowVisible: true);
		}

		internal override RowDataBase GetRowData()
		{
			return View.GetRowData(RowHandle.Value);
		}

		internal override FrameworkElement GetRowElement()
		{
			RowDataBase rowData = GetRowData();
			if (rowData != null && ((ISupportVisibleIndex)rowData).VisibleIndex >= 0)
			{
				return View.GetRowVisibleElement(rowData);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool IsMatchedRowData(RowDataBase data)
		{
			RowData rowData = (RowData)data;
			if (DisableUpdateOptimization || !rowData.GetIsReady() || rowData.IsGroupRowInAsyncServerMode || View.IsNewItemRowHandle(RowHandle.Value) || RowHandle.Value == -2147483646)
			{
				return base.IsMatchedRowData(data);
			}
			if (GetItemType(MatchKey) != GetItemType(data.MatchKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row == null)
			{
				row = treeBuilder.View.DataControl.GetRow(RowHandle.Value);
			}
			return rowData.IsSameRow(row);
		}

		private ItemType GetItemType(object matchKey)
		{
			if (matchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				return ItemType.GroupSummaryRow;
			}
			RowHandle rowHandle = (RowHandle)matchKey;
			if (rowHandle.Value >= 0 || rowHandle.Value == -2147483647 || rowHandle.Value == -2147483646)
			{
				return ItemType.DataRow;
			}
			return ItemType.GroupRow;
		}

		internal override bool IsRowExpandedForNavigation()
		{
			return View.IsDataRowNodeExpanded(this);
		}

		internal override LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues synchronizationQueues)
		{
			return synchronizationQueues.FreeRowDataQueue;
		}

		internal override RowDataBase CreateRowData()
		{
			return View.ViewBehavior.CreateRowDataCore(treeBuilder, updateOnlyData: false);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			row = null;
		}
	}

	public class LoadingRowData : RowData
	{
		public enum LoadingRowAction
		{
			None,
			Retry,
			Refresh
		}

		private string errorTextCore;

		private bool hasErrorCore;

		private bool allowLoadMoreCore;

		private bool showLoadingIndicatorCore = true;

		private LoadingRowAction loadingActionCore;

		public string ErrorText
		{
			get
			{
				return errorTextCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (ErrorText != value)
				{
					errorTextCore = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("ErrorText");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool HasError
		{
			get
			{
				return hasErrorCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (HasError != value)
				{
					hasErrorCore = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("HasError");
				}
			}
		}

		public LoadingRowAction LoadingAction
		{
			get
			{
				return loadingActionCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (LoadingAction != value)
				{
					loadingActionCore = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("LoadingAction");
					OnLoadingActionChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public string LoadingButtonText => LoadingAction switch
		{
			LoadingRowAction.Refresh => base.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlStringId.LoadingRowRefresh.ToString()), 
			LoadingRowAction.Retry => base.View.LocalizationDescriptor.GetValue(GridControlStringId.LoadingRowRetry.ToString()), 
			LoadingRowAction.None => null, 
			_ => throw new ArgumentException("Unknown value for LoadingAction"), 
		};

		public bool IsLoadingButtonVisible => LoadingAction != LoadingRowAction.None;

		public bool AllowLoadMore
		{
			get
			{
				return allowLoadMoreCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (AllowLoadMore != value)
				{
					allowLoadMoreCore = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("AllowLoadMore");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowLoadingIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				return showLoadingIndicatorCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (ShowLoadingIndicator != value)
				{
					showLoadingIndicatorCore = value;
					((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("ShowLoadingIndicator");
				}
			}
		}

		public ICommand LoadRowsCommand { get; set; }

		public LoadingRowData(DataTreeBuilder builder)
			: base(builder, updateOnlyData: false, updateSelectionState: false, updateError: false)
		{
			LoadRowsCommand = new DelegateCommand(async delegate
			{
				await LoadRows();
			});
		}

		private void OnLoadingActionChanged()
		{
			((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("LoadingButtonText");
			((DataObjectBase)this).RaisePropertyChanged("IsLoadingButtonVisible");
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement CreateRowElement()
		{
			return base.View.CreateLoadingRowElement(this);
		}

		public void UpdateLoadingState(bool areRowsFetching, string errorText, LoadingRowAction loadingRowAction, bool allowLoadMore)
		{
			ErrorText = errorText;
			HasError = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ErrorText);
			LoadingAction = loadingRowAction;
			ShowLoadingIndicator = areRowsFetching;
			AllowLoadMore = allowLoadMore;
		}

		public void UpdateLoadingState()
		{
			if (base.View.DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				base.View.DataProviderBase.UpdateLoadingRowState(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignFromCore(NodeContainer nodeContainer, RowNode rowNode)
		{
			base.AssignFromCore(nodeContainer, rowNode);
			UpdateLoadingState();
		}

		public async Task LoadRows()
		{
			switch (LoadingAction)
			{
			case LoadingRowAction.None:
				break;
			case LoadingRowAction.Retry:
				LoadMoreRows();
				break;
			case LoadingRowAction.Refresh:
				await View.RefreshDataSourceAsync();
				break;
			default:
				throw new ArgumentException("Unknown value for LoadingRowAction");
			}
		}

		public void LoadMoreRows()
		{
			if (base.View.DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				base.View.DataProviderBase.FetchMoreRows();
			}
		}
	}

		public static void SetRowData(DependencyObject element, RowData value)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			element.SetValue(RowDataProperty, value);
		}

		public static RowData GetRowData(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (element == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("element");
			}
			return (RowData)element.GetValue(RowDataProperty);
		}

		static RowData()
		{
			RowDataProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("RowData", typeof(RowData), typeof(RowData), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.Inherits));
			CurrentRowDataProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("CurrentRowData", typeof(RowData), typeof(RowData), new PropertyMetadata(null, OnCurrentRowDataChanged));
			BaseEditHelper.GetValidationErrorPropertyKey().OverrideMetadata(typeof(RowData), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((RowData)(object)d).UpdateClientValidationError();
			}));
		}

		private void IterateNotNullData(Action<ColumnBase, GridColumnData> updateMethod)
		{
			base.View.layoutUpdatedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				IterateNotNullDataCore(base.CellDataCache, updateMethod);
			});
		}

		protected static void IterateNotNullDataCore<TData>(Dictionary<ColumnBase, TData> cache, Action<ColumnBase, TData> updateMethod) where TData : GridColumnData
		{
			foreach (KeyValuePair<ColumnBase, TData> item in cache)
			{
				updateMethod(item.Key, item.Value);
			}
		}

		private static void IterateNotNullDataCore<TData>(IEnumerable<ColumnBase> columns, Dictionary<ColumnBase, TData> cache, Action<ColumnBase, TData> updateMethod) where TData : GridColumnData
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase column in columns)
			{
				TData valueOrDefault = cache.GetValueOrDefault(column);
				if (valueOrDefault != null)
				{
					updateMethod(column, valueOrDefault);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void OnCurrentRowDataChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is INotifyCurrentRowDataChanged)
			{
				((INotifyCurrentRowDataChanged)d).OnCurrentRowDataChanged();
			}
		}

		private void OnRowPositionChanged()
		{
			ShowBottomLine = GetShowBottomLine();
			UpdateClientRowPosition();
		}

		private void UpdateLevel()
		{
			int num = controllerValues.Level;
			if (level != num)
			{
				level = num;
				NotifyPropertyChanged("Level");
				UpdateClientLevel();
				ShowBottomLine = GetShowBottomLine();
			}
		}

		public RowData(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, bool updateOnlyData = false, bool updateSelectionState = true, bool updateError = true)
			: base(treeBuilder)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			formatInfoProvider = new VersionedFormatInfoProvider((IFormatInfoProvider)(object)new DataTreeBuilderFormatInfoProvider<RowData>(this, (RowData x) => x.treeBuilder, (RowData x, string fieldName) => x.treeBuilder.GetCellValue(x, fieldName)));
			formatInfoProvider.IsCachingEnabled = false;
			this.updateOnlyData = updateOnlyData;
			this.updateSelectionState = updateSelectionState;
			this.updateError = updateError;
			UseInUpdateQueue = true;
			SetRowDataInternal(base.WholeRowElement, this);
		}

		{

			{
				return;
			}
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				if (columns.Contains(cellData.Column.FieldName))
				{
					((GridCellData)cellData).UpdateEditorHighlightingText(columnChanged: false, textHighlightingProperties);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal virtual bool GetShowBottomLine()
		{
			if (Level > 0)
			{
				if (RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					return RowPosition == RowPosition.Single;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateData()
		{
			UpdateDataCore(null, -1);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateDataCore(ColumnBase column, int listSourceRowIndex)
		{
			OnRowUpdated();
			formatInfoProvider.IsCachingEnabled = base.View.HasDataUpdateFormatConditions();
			bool flag = UpdateRowObjects(listSourceRowIndex);
			if ((IsAsyncServerMode && !GetIsReady()) || updateOnlyData)
			{
				return;
			}
			UpdateRowDataError();
			if (!IsGroupRowInAsyncServerMode && flag)
			{
				if (column != null)
				{
					UpdateCellData(column, GetCellDataByColumn(column));
				}
				else
				{
					IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase col, GridColumnData cellData)
					{
						UpdateCellData(col, cellData);
					});
				}
			}
			UpdateGroupSummaryData();
			UpdateContent();
			((DataObjectBase)this).RaiseContentChanged();
			treeBuilder.UpdateRowData(this);
			if (IsFocused && IsAsyncServerMode)
			{
				base.DataControl.UpdateCurrentItem();
			}
			UpdateMasterDetailInfo(updateRowObjectIfRowExpanded: false, updateDetailRow: true);
			UpatePropertyChangeSubscriptionMode();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRowUpdated()
		{
			if (UseInUpdateQueue)
			{
				base.DataControl.OnRowUpdated(RowHandle.Value);
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateRow()
		{
			Row = treeBuilder.GetRowValue(this);
		}

		internal override void ClearRow()
		{
			Row = null;
			if (DataRowNode != null)
			{
				DataRowNode.Clear();
			}
		}

		protected bool UpdateRowObjects(int listSourceRowIndex)
		{
			object obj = Row;
			RowState = base.DataControl.GetRowState(RowHandle.Value, createNewIfNotExist: false);
			if (!IsGroupRowInAsyncServerMode)
			{
				UpdateRow();
				if (Row == null && listSourceRowIndex != -1)
				{
					Row = base.View.DataProviderBase.GetRowByListIndex(listSourceRowIndex);
				}
			}
			if (!IsAutoFilterRow)
			{
				DataContext = treeBuilder.GetWpfRow(this, listSourceRowIndex);
			}
			if (!IsGroupRowInAsyncServerMode && IsSameRow(obj) && !DataRowNode.DisableUpdateOptimization && (!base.View.ShouldUpdateRow(Row) || base.View.IsEditingControllerRow(Row)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ConditionalUpdater.OnDataChanged();
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsSameRow(object row)
		{
			if (row != null && row.GetType().IsValueType)
			{
				return object.Equals(row, Row);
			}
			return row == Row;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateMasterDetailInfo(bool updateRowObjectIfRowExpanded, bool updateDetailRow)
		{
			if (treeBuilder.SupportsMasterDetail)
			{
				base.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.UpdateMasterDetailInfo(this, updateDetailRow);
				if (updateRowObjectIfRowExpanded && IsRowExpanded)
				{
					UpdateRowObjects(-1);
				}
				UpdateIsMasterRowExpanded();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected virtual void UpdateNextRowLevel()
		{
			if (RowHandle == null || base.View == null || base.View.DataControl == null || base.View.DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				NextRowLevel = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				NextRowLevel = treeBuilder.GetRowLevelByVisibleIndex(treeBuilder.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle.Value) + 1);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateShowRowBreak()
		{
			BaseGridController val = ((base.DataControl != null) ? base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController : null);
			bool flag = base.View is ITableView && ((ITableView)base.View).ShowHorizontalLines;
			if (val != null && ((DataControllerBase)val).AllowPartialGrouping && RowHandle != null && flag)
			{
				int value = RowHandle.Value;
				VisibleIndexCollection visibleIndexes = ((DataController)val).GetVisibleIndexes();
				if (visibleIndexes.IsSingleGroupRow(value))
				{
					ShowRowBreak = true;
					return;
				}
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = treeBuilder.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(treeBuilder.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(value) + 1);
				ShowRowBreak = base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) || visibleIndexes.IsSingleGroupRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			}
			else
			{
				ShowRowBreak = false;
			}
		}

		internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
		{
			if (parentNodeContainer != null)
			{
				RowPosition = ((DataNodeContainer)parentNodeContainer).GetRowPosition(node);
			}
			bool isLastRow = false;
			if ((RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom && RowPosition != RowPosition.Single) || base.View.ShowFixedTotalSummary || base.View.ShowTotalSummary)
			{
				base.LineLevel = 0;
				base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
				return;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle.Value) + 1)
			{
				base.LineLevel = 0;
				base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			if (base.DataControl.DataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
			{
				RowData rowData = targetView.GetRowData(targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex));
				if (rowData != null)
				{
					isLastRow = rowData.RowPosition == RowPosition.Bottom || rowData.RowPosition == RowPosition.Single;
					base.LineLevel = GetLineLevel(this, 0, 0);
					base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
					if (isLastRow)
					{
						base.LineLevel = base.DetailLevel;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			base.LineLevel = 0;
			base.DetailLevel = 0;
		}

		private bool SupportValidateCell()
		{
			if (base.View != null)
			{
				return base.View.SupportValidateCell();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool SupportsDataErrorInfo()
		{
			if (!(Row is IDataErrorInfo) && !(Row is IDXDataErrorInfo) && !(Row is INotifyDataErrorInfo) && !base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.HasValidationAttributes())
			{
				return base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void UpdateDataErrors(bool customValidate = true)
		{
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				UpdateCellDataError(column, cellData, customValidate);
			});
			UpdateRowDataError();
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateCellDataError(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData, bool customValidate = true)
		{
			if (updateError)
			{
				GridCellData gridCellData = (GridCellData)cellData;
				if (SupportsDataErrorInfo() || gridCellData.HasErrorCore)
				{
					gridCellData.UpdateCellError(RowHandle, column, customValidate);
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateRowDataError()
		{
			if (updateError && (SupportsDataErrorInfo() || BaseEditHelper.GetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)this) != null || base.View.SupportValidateRow()))
			{
				treeBuilder.UpdateRowDataError(this);
			}
		}

		protected override NotImplementedRowDataReusingStrategy CreateReusingStrategy(Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
		{
			return new RowDataReusingStrategy(this);
		}

		internal virtual void AssignFrom(RowsContainer parentRowsContainer, NodeContainer parentNodeContainer, RowNode rowNode, bool forceUpdate)
		{
			DataRowNode dataRowNode = (DataRowNode)rowNode;
			if (base.View != dataRowNode.View)
			{
				forceUpdate = true;
			}
			UpdateTreeBuilder(((DataNodeContainer)parentNodeContainer).treeBuilder);
			ControllerValues = dataRowNode.ControllerValues;
			bool flag = node != rowNode || IsDirty;
			if (flag)
			{
				node = rowNode;
				this.parentNodeContainer = parentNodeContainer;
			}
			SyncWithNode();
			if (flag)
			{
				RowHandle = DataRowNode.RowHandle;
				IsLastFixedRow = DataRowNode.IsLastFixedRow;
				if (base.CellData == null || forceUpdate)
				{
					customCellValidate = false;
					UpdateCellData();
				}
				customCellValidate = true;
				if (UpdateImmediately)
				{
					RefreshData();
				}
				else
				{
					treeBuilder.UpdateRowData(this);
					UpdateMasterDetailInfo(updateRowObjectIfRowExpanded: true, updateDetailRow: false);
					IsReady = false;
				}
				if (forceUpdate)
				{
					UpdateEditorButtonVisibilities();
				}
			}
			AssignFromCore(parentNodeContainer, rowNode);
			base.View.ViewBehavior.UpdateFixedNoneContentWidth(this);
			ValidateRowsContainer();
			if (updateSelectionState)
			{
				UpdateIndicatorState();
				UpdateSelectionState();
				UpdateNextRowLevel();
				UpdateIsMasterRowExpanded();
				UpdateShowRowBreak();
			}
		}
