		}

		internal virtual void ValidateSetRowStateClient()
		{
			if (rowStateClient != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void SetRowStateClient(IRowStateClient rowStateClient)
		{
			ValidateSetRowStateClient();
			this.rowStateClient = rowStateClient;
			UpdateClientRowHandle(RowHandleCore);
			if (SelectionState != SelectionState.None)
			{
				UpdateClientSelectionState();
			}
			if (base.View is ITableView tableView)
			{
				UpdateClientScrollingMargin();
				if (!tableView.ShowHorizontalLines)
				{
					UpdateClientHorizontalLineVisibility();
				}
				if (!tableView.ShowVerticalLines)
				{
					UpdateClientVerticalLineVisibility();
				}
				UpdateClientFixedLineWidth();
				UpdateClientFixedLineVisibility();
				UpdateClientFixedNoneContentWidth();
				if (!tableView.ActualShowIndicator)
				{
					UpdateClientShowIndicator();
				}
				UpdateClientIndicatorWidth();
				if (base.IndicatorState != IndicatorState.None)
				{
					UpdateClientIndicatorState();
				}
				if (HasValidationErrorInternal)
				{
					UpdateClientValidationError();
				}
				if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
				{
					UpdateCellsPanel();
					if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedNoneVisibleBands != null)
					{
						UpdateClientFixedNoneBands();
					}
					if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedRightVisibleBands != null)
					{
						UpdateClientFixedRightBands();
					}
					if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands != null)
					{
						UpdateClientFixedLeftBands();
					}
				}
				if (AlternateRow)
				{
					UpdateClientAlternateBackground();
				}
				if (tableView.ActualShowDetailButtons)
				{
					UpdateClientDetailExpandButtonVisibility();
				}
				if (DetailIndents != null)
				{
					UpdateClientDetailViewIndents();
				}
				UpdateClientMinHeight();
				UpdateClientRowStyle();
				UpdateClientAppearance();
				UpdateClientInlineEditForm();
			}
			if (Level > 0)
			{
				UpdateClientLevel();
			}
			UpdateClientRowPosition();
			if (!base.View.IsKeyboardFocusWithinView)
			{
				UpdateClientFocusWithinState();
			}
			if (base.FixedNoneCellData != null)
			{
				UpdateClientFixedNoneCellData();
			}
			if (base.FixedLeftCellData != null)
			{
				UpdateClientFixedLeftCellData(null);
			}
			if (base.FixedRightCellData != null)
			{
				UpdateClientFixedRightCellData(null);
			}
			UpdateClientView();
			UpdateClientShowRowBreak();
		}

		internal bool GetIsReady()
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null || base.DataControl.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsGroupRowInAsyncServerMode)
			{
				return GetIsReady(Row);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal Tuple<bool, object> NeedUpdateRowButtonsInit(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (((IsFocused && base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction) || base.View.UpdateRowButtonsLocker > 0) && updateRowButtonsCache.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return new Tuple<bool, object>(!column.GetAllowEditing() || column.IsActualReadOnly, updateRowButtonsCache[column]);
			}
			return new Tuple<bool, object>(item1: true, null);
		}

		internal void SetUpdateRowButtonsCache(ColumnBase column, object value)
		{
			if (!updateRowButtonsCache.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				updateRowButtonsCache.Add(column, value);
			}
			else
			{
				updateRowButtonsCache[column] = value;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateCancelValuesCache()
		{
			CancelValuesCache.Clear();
			foreach (GridColumnData cellDatum in base.CellData)
			{
				CancelValuesCache.Add(cellDatum.Column, ((EditableDataObject)cellDatum).Value);
			}
		}

		internal static bool GetIsReady(object value)
		{
			return !AsyncServerModeDataController.IsNoValue(value);
		}

		internal void UpdateIsDirty()
		{
			IsDirty = !IsRowInView();
		}

		internal bool IsRowInView()
		{
			if (FixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (((ISupportVisibleIndex)this).VisibleIndex == -1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle.Value);
			int num = base.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore);
			int num2 = base.DataControl.CalcTotalLevel(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore);
			double currentOffset = base.View.RootDataPresenter.CurrentOffset;
			double num3 = ((IScrollInfo)base.View.RootDataPresenter).ViewportHeight;
			if (!base.View.RootView.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				num3 += 1.0;
			}
			return (double)num < currentOffset + (double)base.View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount + num3 - (double)num2;
		}

		protected override void OnVisibilityChanged(bool isVisible)
		{
			if (!isVisible)
			{
				IsDirty = true;
			}
			if (isVisible)
			{
				SubcribeRowObject(Row);
			}
			else
			{
				UnsubcribeRowObject(Row);
			}
			if (isVisible && RowElement is IGridDataRow gridDataRow)
			{
				gridDataRow.UpdateContentLayout();
			}
		}

		internal void UpatePropertyChangeSubscriptionMode()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ItemPropertyNotificationMode val = (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)0;
			if (base.DataControl != null)
			{
				if (base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.SubscribeRowChangedForVisibleRows)
				{
					val = (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)(val | 1);
				}
				if (base.DataControl.DataView != null && base.DataControl.DataView.ValidatesOnNotifyDataErrors)
				{
					val = (ItemPropertyNotificationMode)(val | 8);
				}
			}
			if (subscriber == null || val != subscriber.NotificationMode)
			{
				UnsubcribeRowObject(Row);
				subscriber = new RowDataPropertyChangeSubscriber(this, val);
				SubcribeRowObject(Row);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateObservablePropertyScheme()
		{
			SubcribeRowObject(Row);
		}

		}

		private void OnRowChanging(object oldRow, object newRow)
		{
			StopAnimation();
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				((GridCellData)cellData).OnRowChanging(oldRow, newRow);
			});
		}

		private void OnRowChanged(object oldRow, object newRow)
		{
			updateRowButtonsCache.Clear();
			formatInfoProvider.Clear();
			if (IsAsyncServerMode && GetIsVisible())
			{
				UpdateIsReady();
			}
			UnsubcribeRowObject(oldRow);
			SubcribeRowObject(newRow);
			if (newRow != null || IsNewItemRow)
			{
				UpdateContent();
			}
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				((GridCellData)cellData).OnRowChanged();
			});
		}

		internal void OnRowPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsRefreshInProgress)
			{
				return;
			}
			Action action = delegate
			{
				if (base.DataControl == null)
				{
					UnsubcribeRowObject(Row);
				}
				else if (!ScheduleUpdateRow(e.PropertyName))
				{
					if (e != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.PropertyName))
					{
						UpdateDependentCellData(e.PropertyName);
					}
					else
					{
						UpdateDataOnRowPropertyChanged();
					}
					base.View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
				}
			};
			if (((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateDataOnRowPropertyChanged()
		{
			UpdateData();
		}

		internal virtual bool ScheduleUpdateRow(string propertyName)
		{
			return base.DataControl.ScheduleUpdateSingleRow(RowHandle.Value, propertyName, Row);
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateDependentCellData(IEnumerable<string> propertyNames)
		{
			IEnumerable<DataDependentEntity> entities = propertyNames.Select((string x) => base.DataControl.GetPropertyChangeDependency(x));
			DataDependentEntity dependency = DataDependentEntity.Combine(entities);
			UpdateDependentCellData(dependency);
		}

		internal void UpdateDependentCellData(string propertyName)
		{
			UpdateDependentCellData(base.DataControl.GetPropertyChangeDependency(propertyName));
		}

		private void UpdateDependentCellData(DataDependentEntity dependency)
		{
			if (dependency.HasRowConditions)
			{
				UpdateData();
				return;
			}
			UpdateRowObjects(-1);
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				if (dependency.Columns.Contains(column))
				{
					cellData.UpdateValue();
				}
				else if (column.HasTemplateSelector)
				{
					cellData.OnDataChanged();
				}
			});
			bool flag = SupportsDataErrorInfo();
			if (flag || SupportValidateCell())
			{
				IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
				{
					((GridCellData)cellData).UpdateCellError(RowHandle, column);
				});
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateRowDataError();
			}
		}

		internal void OnErrorsChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (base.DataControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Action action = delegate
			{
				IterateNotNullDataCore(base.DataControl.GetPropertyChangeDependency(propertyName).Columns, base.CellDataCache, delegate(ColumnBase c, GridColumnData d)
				{
					UpdateCellDataError(c, d);
				});
				UpdateRowDataError();
			};
			if (((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.CheckAccess())
			{
				action();
			}
			else
			{
				((DispatcherObject)(object)this).Dispatcher.BeginInvoke(action);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnIsReadyChanged()
		{
			IterateNotNullData(delegate(ColumnBase column, GridColumnData cellData)
			{
				((GridCellData)cellData).UpdateIsReady();
			});
		}

		internal void AssignFrom(int rowHandle)
		{
			AssignFromCore(rowHandle, -1, null);
		}

		internal void AssignFromCore(int rowHandle, int listSourceRowIndex, ColumnBase column)
		{

	public class CellEditor : CellEditorBase
	{
		private static long global_id;

		internal readonly long Id;

		private HashSet<ValidationError> bindingErrors;

		private const double InplaceBaseEditLayoutRoundingCoercion = 1.0;

		protected override bool OptimizeEditorPerformance => true;

		protected override bool IsInTree
		{
			get
			{
				if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsInTree)
				{
					return base.RowDataCore != null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override int RowHandle
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.RowDataCore.RowHandleCore == null)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				return base.RowDataCore.RowHandleCore.Value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.Column.IsActualReadOnly)
				{
					return base.ReadOnly;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool OverrideCellTemplate
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Column != null)
				{
					return base.Column.OwnerControl == null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool AssignEditorSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.View == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.View.AssignEditorSettings;
			}
		}

		protected override bool UpdateContentOnShowEditor
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Column == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).HasCellEditTemplateAssigned)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Column.ActualCellDisplayTemplateSelector != null && (base.Column.ActualCellDisplayTemplateSelector.Template != null || base.Column.ActualCellDisplayTemplateSelector.Selector != null))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override bool HasCellEditTemplateAssigned
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Column == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.Column.ActualCellEditTemplateSelector != null && (base.Column.ActualCellEditTemplateSelector.Template != null || base.Column.ActualCellEditTemplateSelector.Selector != null))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool HasBindingErrors
		{
			get
			{
				if (bindingErrors != null)
				{
					return bindingErrors.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool AllowClipboardPaste
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(base.View is ITableView tableView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!base.View.IsEditing)
				{
					return tableView.AllowClipboardPaste;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		static CellEditor()
		{
			global_id = long.MinValue;
		}

		public CellEditor()
		{
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).FocusVisualStyle = null;
			KeyboardNavigation.SetTabNavigation((DependencyObject)(object)this, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
			KeyboardNavigation.SetDirectionalNavigation((DependencyObject)(object)this, KeyboardNavigationMode.Cycle);
			Id = global_id++;
		}

		protected override bool CanRefreshContent()
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsInTree)
			{
				return base.GridCellEditorOwner.CanRefreshContent;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnInnerContentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.CellData.UpdateValueLocker.IsLocked || base.ColumnCore.HasTemplateSelector || base.DataControl.RepopuateColumnLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				((DataContentPresenter)this).OnInnerContentChanged(sender, e);
			}
		}

		public override bool PostEditor(bool flushPendingEditActions = true)
		{
			IInputElement focusedElement = Keyboard.FocusedElement;
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateFocusIfNeeded(((InplaceEditorBase)this).GetEditValueBinding(((InplaceEditorBase)this).editCore) != null, true);
			bool flag = false;
			if (base.View == null || !base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				if (base.View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never)
				{
					if (!((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged)
					{
						if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).HasCellEditTemplateAssigned)
						{
							((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged = true;
						}
						else if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsEditorActive && ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.EditValue != ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue)
						{
							((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged = true;
						}
					}
					((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged || !base.RowDataCore.NeedUpdateRowButtonsInit(base.Column).Item1;
				}
				flag = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).PostEditor(flushPendingEditActions);
			}
			else if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged)
			{
				base.RowDataCore.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged = true;
				if (base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor)
				{
					base.CellData.UpdateCellError(base.CellData.RowData.RowHandleCore, base.Column);
				}
				else
				{
					((InplaceEditorBase)this).ValidateEditor(flushPendingEditActions);
					flag = !base.View.HasCellEditorError;
					if (!flag)
					{
						((UIElement)(object)this).Focus();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (base.View.HasCellEditorError && focusedElement != null && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)(object)base.View.CurrentCellEditor, (DependencyObject)focusedElement, true) && focusedElement != Keyboard.FocusedElement)
			{
				focusedElement.Focus();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public BaseValidationError Validate()
		{
			ColumnBase column = base.Column;
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseValidationError val = null;
			val = (BaseValidationError)(object)RowValidationHelper.ValidateAttributes(base.View, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue, RowHandle, column);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			return (BaseValidationError)(object)RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(base.View, base.CellData, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue, RowHandle, column);
		}

		protected override bool PostEditorCore()
		{
			if (base.View.HasCellEditorError)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).HasAccessToCellValue)
			{
				BindingExpressionBase editValueBinding = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).GetEditValueBinding(((InplaceEditorBase)this).editCore);
				if (editValueBinding != null && !HasBindingErrors)
				{
					editValueBinding.UpdateTarget();
				}
				if (!SkipSetValue())
				{
					try
					{
						object obj = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue;
						if (editValueBinding != null)
						{
							obj = ((EditableDataObject)base.CellData).Value;
						}
						if (editValueBinding == null || (obj != base.CellData.InitialValue && obj != base.DataControl.GetCellValue(RowHandle, base.Column.FieldName)))
						{
							base.DataControl.SetCellValueCore(base.View.DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow, base.FieldNameCore, obj);
						}
						if (!CheckBindingErrors())
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						ShowError(base.View.CreateCellValidationError(ex.Message, (ErrorType)1, base.RowData.RowHandle.Value, base.Column, ex));
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (base.View != null && base.View.DataControl != null && !base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor)
				{
					base.RowData.UpdateData();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool CheckBindingErrors()
		{
			if (!HasBindingErrors)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ValidationError validationError = bindingErrors.First();
			RowValidationError rowValidationError = base.View.CreateCellValidationError(validationError.ErrorContent, new object[1] { validationError }, (ErrorType)1, base.RowData.RowHandle.Value, base.Column, validationError.Exception);
			if (rowValidationError != null)
			{
				ShowError(rowValidationError);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void UpdateEditContext()
		{
			Tuple<bool, object> tuple = base.RowData.NeedUpdateRowButtonsInit(base.ColumnCore);
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).GetEditValueBinding(((InplaceEditorBase)this).editCore) != null || !tuple.Item1)
			{
				if (!tuple.Item1)
				{
					((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue = tuple.Item2;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateEditContext();
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateEditValueCore(IBaseEdit editor)
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).GetEditValueBinding(editor) == null)
			{
				base.UpdateEditValueCore(editor);
				if (base.ColumnCore != null && base.ColumnCore.WidthCore.IsAuto)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateMeasure();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override DataTemplate SelectTemplate()
		{
			if (base.IsFocusedCell && base.View.IsEditorOpen)
			{
				DataTemplate dataTemplate = ((DataTemplateSelector)(object)base.Column.ActualCellEditTemplateSelector).SelectTemplate((object)base.CellData, (DependencyObject)(object)this);
				if (dataTemplate != null)
				{
					return dataTemplate;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				DataTemplate dataTemplate2 = ((DataTemplateSelector)(object)base.Column.ActualCellDisplayTemplateSelector).SelectTemplate((object)base.CellData, (DependencyObject)(object)this);
				if (dataTemplate2 != null)
				{
					return dataTemplate2;
				}
			}
			return base.Column.ActualCellTemplateSelector.SelectTemplate(base.CellData, (DependencyObject)(object)this);
		}

		private bool SkipSetValue()
		{
			RowData rowData = base.View.GetRowData(base.View.DataProviderBase.CurrentControllerRow);
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				return base.RowData.Row != rowData.Row;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void ValidateEditorCore()
		{
			if (base.View != null && base.View.DataProviderBase != null)
			{
				if (EditValueChangedLocker.IsLocked && base.View.EnableImmediatePosting && base.ValidationErrorCache == null)
				{
					base.ValidationErrorCache = GetValidationError();
					base.ValidationErrorCacheIsValid = true;
				}
				ShowError(base.ValidationErrorCacheIsValid ? base.ValidationErrorCache : GetValidationError(), !base.View.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor || base.View.DataProviderBase.AllowLiveDataShaping == false || base.View.EnableImmediatePosting);
				if (base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && RowHandle == base.View.FocusedRowHandle)
				{
					base.View.UpdateCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnShowEditor()
		{
			base.OnShowEditor();
			Binding.AddSourceUpdatedHandler((DependencyObject)(object)this, OnSourceUpdated);
			Validation.AddErrorHandler((DependencyObject)(object)this, OnBindingError);
			bindingErrors = new HashSet<ValidationError>();
			base.CellData.SetInitialValue();
		}

		protected override void OnHiddenEditor(bool closeEditor)
		{
			if (base.Column.ActualBinding != null)
			{
				UpdateDisplayMemberBindingValue();
			}
			base.OnHiddenEditor(closeEditor);
			base.CellData.UpdateValue();
			base.CellData.ResetInitialValue();
			Binding.RemoveSourceUpdatedHandler((DependencyObject)(object)this, OnSourceUpdated);
			Validation.RemoveErrorHandler((DependencyObject)(object)this, OnBindingError);
			bindingErrors = null;
		}

		private void OnSourceUpdated(object sender, DataTransferEventArgs e)
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged = true;
			OnEditValueChanged();
		}

		private void OnBindingError(object sender, ValidationErrorEventArgs e)
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.IsValueChanged = true;
			if (e.Action == ValidationErrorEventAction.Added && e.Error.RuleInError.ValidationStep < ValidationStep.UpdatedValue)
			{
				bindingErrors.Add(e.Error);
			}
			else
			{
				bindingErrors.Remove(e.Error);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDisplayMemberBindingValue()
		{
			if (base.RowData.Row == null && base.RowData.RowHandle.Value == -2147483647)
			{
				base.RowData.Row = base.RowData.treeBuilder.GetRowValue(base.RowData);
			}
			base.CellData.UpdateGridCellDataValue();
		}

		protected override void CancelRowEdit(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			e.Handled = base.View.IsFocusedRowModified;
			if (e.Key == Key.Escape && base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction && !base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				base.View.CancelRowChangesCore();
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.CancelRowEdit();
			}
		}

		}

		protected override void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (((e.Key == Key.V && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Control) == ModifierKeys.Control) || (e.Key == Key.Insert && (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift)) && AllowClipboardPaste)
			{
				e.Handled = true;
				((ITableView)base.View).OnPaste();
			}
			else
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnPreviewKeyDown(e);
			}
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateContentOnShowEditor)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).OwnerEnqueueImmediateActionCore((IAction)new DelegateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					OnPreviewKeyDownNewItemRow(e);
				}));
			}
			else
			{
				OnPreviewKeyDownNewItemRow(e);
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewKeyDownNewItemRow(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if ((RowHandle == -2147483647 || base.View.EnterMoveNextColumn) && e.Key == Key.Return && !((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsEditorVisible && !base.View.IsEditFormShown)
			{

		private RowValidationError GetValidationError()
		{
			int value = base.RowData.RowHandle.Value;

			if (!((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.DoValidate())
			{
				rowValidationError = RowValidationHelper.CreateEditorValidationError(base.View, value, null, base.Column);
			}
			if (rowValidationError != null)
			{
				return rowValidationError;
			}
			if (!base.View.AllowCommitOnValidationAttributeError)
			{
				rowValidationError = RowValidationHelper.ValidateAttributes(base.View, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue, base.RowData.RowHandle.Value, base.Column);
				if (rowValidationError != null)
				{
					return rowValidationError;
				}
			}

			{
				return null;
			}
			return RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(base.View, this, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditableValue, base.RowData.RowHandle.Value, base.Column);
		}

		internal int CalcBestFitWidth(double? width)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.View is ITableView tableView && tableView.TableViewBehavior.IsFirstAndTreeColumn(base.Column) && base.RowDataCore != null)
			{
				num = (double)(base.RowDataCore.Level + tableView.TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.ServiceIndentsCount) * tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent;
			}
			return (int)Math.Ceiling((width.HasValue ? width.Value : ((UIElement)(object)this).DesiredSize.Width) + MeasureWidthAdditional() + num);
		}

		internal int GetRowVisibleIndex()
		{

			}
			return base.View.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(base.RowDataCore.RowHandleCore.Value);
		}

		{

		}

	internal static class RowValidationHelper
	{
		public static RowValidationError ValidateEvents(DataViewBase view, object source, object value, int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GridRowValidationEventArgs e = view.CreateCellValidationEventArgs(source, value, rowHandle, column);
			System.Windows.Controls.ValidationResult validationResult = null;
			Exception exception = null;
			try
			{
				view.OnValidation(column, e);
				validationResult = new System.Windows.Controls.ValidationResult(((ValidationEventArgs)e).IsValid, ((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorContent);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				exception = ex;
				validationResult = new System.Windows.Controls.ValidationResult(isValid: false, ex.Message);
			}
			ErrorType errorType = (ErrorType)(((int)((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType == 0) ? 1 : ((int)((ValidationEventArgs)e).ErrorType));
			if (!validationResult.IsValid)
			{
				return view.CreateCellValidationError(validationResult.ErrorContent, errorType, rowHandle, column, exception);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static RowValidationError ValidateAttributes(DataViewBase view, object value, int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			string validationAttributesErrorText = column.GetValidationAttributesErrorText(value, rowHandle);
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationAttributesErrorText))
			{
				return view.CreateCellValidationError(validationAttributesErrorText, (ErrorType)1, rowHandle, column);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static RowValidationError CreateEditorValidationError(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle, Exception exception, ColumnBase column)
		{
			object errorContent = ((exception == null) ? view.GetLocalizedString(GridControlStringId.InvalidValueErrorMessage) : exception.Message);
			return view.CreateCellValidationError(errorContent, (ErrorType)1, rowHandle, column);
		}

				((CellEditorBase)(object)d).OnColumnChanged((ColumnBase)e.OldValue, (ColumnBase)e.NewValue);
			}));
			IsFocusedCellProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("IsFocusedCell", typeof(bool), typeof(CellEditorBase), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)(CellEditorBase)(object)d).OnIsFocusedCellChanged();
			}));
			ToolTipContentProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ToolTipContent", typeof(object), typeof(CellEditorBase), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellEditorBase)(object)d).OnToolTipContentChanged();
			}));
			ReadOnlyProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ReadOnly", typeof(bool), typeof(CellEditorBase), new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellEditorBase)(object)d).OnReadOnlyChanged();
			}));
			ColumnBase.NavigationIndexProperty.AddOwner(typeof(CellEditorBase));
		}

		private static bool GetIsInactiveEditorButtonVisible(EditorButtonShowMode editorShowMode, bool isFocusedCell, bool isFocusedRow)
		{
			return editorShowMode switch
			{
				EditorButtonShowMode.ShowAlways => true, 
				EditorButtonShowMode.ShowOnlyInEditor => false, 
				EditorButtonShowMode.ShowForFocusedRow => isFocusedRow, 
				_ => isFocusedCell, 
			};
		}

		protected override void NullEditorInEditorDataContext()
		{
			if (CellData.Editor == this)
			{
				CellData.Editor = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetEditorInEditorDataContext()
		{
			CellData.Editor = this;
			UpdateConditionalAppearance();
		}

		internal void RefreshTooltip()
		{
			IBaseEdit editCore = base.editCore;
			if (editCore != null)
			{
				editCore.UpdateToolTip();
			}
		}

		public virtual void OnColumnChanged(ColumnBase oldValue, ColumnBase newValue)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ToolTipContentProperty);
			ColumnCore = newValue;
			if (base.editCore != null && ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorColumn != null && (int)((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorSourceType == 1)
			{
				BaseEditHelper.ApplySettings(base.editCore, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorColumn.EditSettings, (IDefaultEditorViewInfo)(object)((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorColumn);
			}
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnOwnerChanged((IInplaceEditorColumn)(object)oldValue);
			if (CellData != null)
			{
				CellData.UpdateEditorHighlightingText(columnChanged: true);
			}
			toolTip = null;
			UpdateToolTip();
			UpdateReadOnly();
			UpdateEnabled();
		}

		protected override void UpdateContent(bool updateDisplayTemplate = true)
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateContent(updateDisplayTemplate);
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateEditorDataContext();
		}

		protected override void UpdateEditorDataContext()
		{
			if (CellData != null)
			{
				CellData.OnEditorContentUpdated();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnColumnContentChanged(object sender, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_006f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.DisplayTemplateProperty)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateDisplayTemplate(true);
				return;
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.ReadOnlyProperty)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateIsEditorReadOnly();
			}
			if (e.Property == ReadOnlyProperty)
			{
				UpdateReadOnly();
			}
			if (e.Property == UIElement.IsEnabledProperty)
			{
				UpdateEnabled();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualCellToolTipTemplateProperty)
			{
				UpdateToolTip();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.FieldTypeProperty && (int)((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorSourceType == 0)
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateViewInfoProperties();
			}
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnColumnContentChanged(sender, e);
		}

		protected sealed override object GetEditableValue()
		{
			return DataControl.GetCellValue(RowHandle, FieldNameCore);
		}

		protected override void OnShowEditor()
		{
			ScrollBarExtensions.SetPreventParentScrolling((DependencyObject)(object)this, true);
			View.OnShowEditor(this);
		}

		private void ResetValidationErrorCache()
		{
			ValidationErrorCacheIsValid = false;
			ValidationErrorCache = null;
		}

		protected sealed override void OnEditValueChanged(object sender, EditValueChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			EditValueChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (View.EnableImmediatePosting)
				{
					View.RaiseCellValueChanging(RowHandle, Column, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.EditValue, e.OldValue);
				}
				ResetValidationErrorCache();
				OnEditValueChanged();
				UpdateEditorDataContextValue(e.NewValue);
				ResetValidationErrorCache();
				View.ResetCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute();
				View.HasModificationsSinceLastCellValidation = false;
				if (!View.EnableImmediatePosting)
				{
					View.RaiseCellValueChanging(RowHandle, Column, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).Edit.EditValue, e.OldValue);
				}
			});
		}

		protected virtual void OnEditValueChanged()
		{
			if (View != null && View is ITableView && RowHandle != -2147483645 && View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.OnCellValueChange && !View.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && View.ViewBehavior != null)
			{
				View.ViewBehavior.ShowRowButtons();
			}
		}

		public override bool CanShowEditor()
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorBase)this).CanShowEditor())
			{
				return View.CanShowEditor(RowHandle, Column);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected sealed override bool RaiseShowingEditor()
		{
			return View.RaiseShowingEditor(RowHandle, Column);
		}

		protected override void OnHiddenEditor(bool closeEditor)
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnHiddenEditor(closeEditor);
			ScrollBarExtensions.SetPreventParentScrolling((DependencyObject)(object)this, false);
			View.OnHideEditor(this, closeEditor);
			View.RaiseHiddenEditor(RowHandle, Column, base.editCore);
		}

		private void OnFieldNameChanged()
		{
			if (Column == null && FieldName != null && View != null)
			{
				Column = View.ColumnsCore[FieldName];
			}
		}

		protected sealed override EditableDataObject GetEditorDataContext()
		{
			return (EditableDataObject)(object)CellData;
		}

		internal void UpdateEditableValue()
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateEditValue(base.editCore);
		}

		protected abstract void UpdateEditorDataContextValue(object newValue);

		protected override void UpdateEditValueCore(IBaseEdit editor)
		{
			if (!EditValueChangedLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				GridColumnData gridColumnData = ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorDataContext as GridColumnData;
				BaseEditHelper.SetEditValue(editor, ((InplaceEditorBase)this).EditorDataContext.Value);
				if (gridColumnData != null && Column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText && gridColumnData.CoreValue != GridColumnData.InvalidCoreValue)
				{
					BaseEditHelper.SetValueForDisplayTextCalculation(editor, gridColumnData.CoreValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override HitTestResult HitTestCore(PointHitTestParameters hitTestParameters)
		{
			HitTestResult hitTestResult = ((UIElement)this).HitTestCore(hitTestParameters);
			if (hitTestResult != null)
			{
				return hitTestResult;
			}
			return new PointHitTestResult((Visual)(object)this, hitTestParameters.HitPoint);
		}

		protected sealed override bool HasEditorError()
		{
			return View.HasCellEditorError;
		}

		protected override void OnEditorActivated()
		{
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).OnEditorActivated();
			View.SetActiveEditor();
			View.ViewBehavior.OnEditorActivated();
			View.RowEditStartingLocker = false;
			bool flag = RowHandle != -2147483645;
			if (View.EditingRowHandle == int.MinValue && flag)
			{
				View.EditingRowHandle = RowHandle;
				TableView?.RaiseRowEditStarted(RowHandle);
			}
			if (base.editCore is IInplaceBaseEdit && ((IInplaceBaseEdit)base.editCore).BaseEdit != null)
			{
				View.RaiseShownEditor(RowHandle, Column, ((IInplaceBaseEdit)base.editCore).BaseEdit);
			}
			else
			{
				View.RaiseShownEditor(RowHandle, Column, base.editCore);
			}
		}

		protected sealed override bool IsInactiveEditorButtonVisible()
		{
			if (Column != null && !Column.GetAllowEditing() && ((ButtonEditSettings)/*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/).Return((ButtonEditSettings x) => x.AllowDefaultButton != false, () => false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return GetIsInactiveEditorButtonVisible(View.EditorButtonShowMode, IsFocusedCell, IsRowFocused);
		}

		{
			RowDataCore = RowData;
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateData();
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateContent(true);
		}

			return null;

		protected virtual void UpdateToolTip()
		{
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Column.CellToolTipBinding != null)
			{
				if (BindingOperations.GetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ToolTipContentProperty) != Column.CellToolTipBinding)
				{
					MultiBinding multiBinding = BindingOperations.GetMultiBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ToolTipContentProperty);
					if (multiBinding == null || multiBinding != Column.CellToolTipBinding)
					{
						((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(ToolTipContentProperty, Column.CellToolTipBinding);
					}
				}
				if (toolTip == null && ToolTipContent != null && ToolTipContent != Binding.DoNothing)
				{
					toolTip = new ToolTip
					{
						Content = ToolTipContent
					};
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ToolTipContentProperty);
				toolTip = null;
			}
			SetEditorToolTip(toolTip);
			if (toolTip != null && toolTip.ContentTemplate != Column.ActualCellToolTipTemplate)
			{
				toolTip.ContentTemplate = Column.ActualCellToolTipTemplate;
			}
		}

		private void SetEditorToolTip(ToolTip toolTip)
		{
			if (toolTip == null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).ClearValue(FrameworkElement.ToolTipProperty);
			}
			else
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip((DependencyObject)(object)this, toolTip);
			}
			if (base.editCore != null)
			{
				base.editCore.CustomToolTip = toolTip;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateReadOnly()
		{
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Column.IsReadOnlyBinding != null)
			{
				if (BindingOperations.GetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ReadOnlyProperty) != Column.IsReadOnlyBinding)
				{
					MultiBinding multiBinding = BindingOperations.GetMultiBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ReadOnlyProperty);
					if (multiBinding == null || multiBinding != Column.IsReadOnlyBinding)
					{
						((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(ReadOnlyProperty, Column.IsReadOnlyBinding);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ReadOnlyProperty);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateEnabled()
		{
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Column.IsEnabledBinding != null)
			{
				if (BindingOperations.GetBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty) != Column.IsEnabledBinding)
				{
					MultiBinding multiBinding = BindingOperations.GetMultiBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, ReadOnlyProperty);
					if (multiBinding == null || multiBinding != Column.IsReadOnlyBinding)
					{
						((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(UIElement.IsEnabledProperty, Column.IsEnabledBinding);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)this, UIElement.IsEnabledProperty);
			}
		}

		private void OnReadOnlyChanged()
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateIsEditorReadOnly();
		}

		private void OnToolTipContentChanged()
		{
			if (toolTip != null)
			{
				toolTip.Content = ToolTipContent;
				if (toolTip.Content == null || toolTip.Content == Binding.DoNothing)
				{
					toolTip = null;
					UpdateToolTip();
				}
			}
			else if (ToolTipContent != null)
			{
				UpdateToolTip();
			}
		}

		public override void CancelEditInVisibleEditor()
		{
			CancelEditLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				((InplaceEditorBase)this).CancelEditInVisibleEditor();
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateValidationErrorCore()
		{
			((InplaceEditorBase)this).UpdateValidationError();
		}

		internal bool GetIsReadOnly()
		{
			return ((InplaceEditorBase)this).IsReadOnly;
		}
	}

	public static class GridColumnTypeHelper
	{
		public static BaseEditSettings CreateEditSettings(Type type)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0024: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return (BaseEditSettings)(GetTypeCode(type) switch
			{
				TypeCode.Boolean => (object)new CheckEditSettings(), 
				TypeCode.DateTime => (object)new DateEditSettings(), 
				_ => (object)new TextEditSettings(), 
			});
		}

		public static TypeCode GetTypeCode(Type type)
		{
			return Type.GetTypeCode(ResolveType(type));
		}

		private static Type ResolveType(Type type)
		{
			if (type == null)
			{
				return type;
			}
			return Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type) ?? type;
		}

		public static bool IsNumericType(Type type)
		{
			return IsNumericTypeCode(GetTypeCode(type));
		}

		public static bool IsNumericTypeCode(TypeCode typeCode)
		{
			if (typeCode >= TypeCode.SByte)
			{
				return typeCode <= TypeCode.Decimal;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class GridRowValidationEventArgs : ValidationEventArgs, IDataRowEventArgs
	{
		protected readonly DataViewBase view;

		protected readonly int fRowHandle;

		private Task updateRowResult;

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => view.DataControl;

		public virtual int RowHandle => fRowHandle;

		public bool IsNewItem => RowHandle == -2147483647;

		public virtual object Row => DataControl.GetRow(RowHandle);

		internal Exception Exception { get; set; }

		internal bool AllowAsyncResult => view.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never;

		public Task UpdateRowResult
		{
			get
			{
				return updateRowResult;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!AllowAsyncResult)
				{
					throw new Exception("Specify the TableView.ShowUpdateRowButtons / TreeListView.ShowUpdateRowButtons property to allow the async data update.");
				}
				updateRowResult = value;
			}
		}

		public bool UseCancellationToken { get; set; }

		public CancellationToken CancellationToken { get; protected internal set; }

		public GridRowValidationEventArgs(object source, object value, int rowHandle, DataViewBase view)
			: base(BaseEdit.ValidateEvent, source, value, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture)
		{
			this.view = view;
			fRowHandle = rowHandle;
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException();
		}
	}

			: base(errorContent, exception, errorType)

	public class CellBase
	{
		private int rowHandle;

		private ColumnBase column;

		protected internal int RowHandleCore => rowHandle;

		protected internal ColumnBase ColumnCore => column;

		public CellBase(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			this.column = column;
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
		}

		public bool Equals(CellBase gridCell)
		{
			if (gridCell != null && gridCell.RowHandleCore == rowHandle)
			{
				return gridCell.ColumnCore == column;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public class CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		public new DataControlBase Source => Column.OwnerControl;

		public bool IncludeFilteredOut { get; }

		public bool RoundDateTime { get; }

		public ColumnBase Column { get; }

		public OperationCompleted AsyncCompleted { get; }

		public CriteriaOperator Filter { get; }

		public Task<ValueAndCount[]> UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync { get; set; }

		public Task<object[]> UniqueValuesAsync { get; set; }

		public ValueAndCount[] UniqueValuesAndCounts { get; set; }

		public object[] UniqueValues { get; set; }

		public CustomUniqueValuesEventArgs(ColumnBase column, bool includeFilteredOut, bool roundDateTime, OperationCompleted asyncCompleted, CriteriaOperator filter = null)
		{
			Column = column;
			IncludeFilteredOut = includeFilteredOut;
			RoundDateTime = roundDateTime;
			AsyncCompleted = asyncCompleted;
			Filter = filter;
		}

		internal async Task<Either<ValueAndCount[], object[]>?> GetUniqueValuesAsync()
		{
			if (UniqueValues != null)
			{
				return UniqueValues.AsRight();
			}
			if (UniqueValuesAndCounts != null)
			{
				return UniqueValuesAndCounts.AsLeft();
			}
			if (UniqueValuesAsync != null)
			{
				return (await UniqueValuesAsync)?.AsRight();
			}
			if (UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync != null)
			{
				return (await UniqueValuesAndCountsAsync)?.AsLeft();
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			((CustomUniqueValuesEventHandler)genericHandler)(genericTarget, this);
		}
	}

	public class CustomBestFitEventArgsBase : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		private BestFitMode bestFitMode;

		public BestFitMode BestFitMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return bestFitMode;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((int)value == 4 || (int)value == 0)
				{
					throw new IncorrectBestFitModeException();
				}
				bestFitMode = value;
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<int> BestFitRows { get; set; }

		protected ColumnBase ColumnCore { get; private set; }

		public CustomBestFitEventArgsBase(ColumnBase column, BestFitMode bestFitMode)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BestFitMode = bestFitMode;
			ColumnCore = column;
		}
	}

		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return new CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgs
			{
				OldValue = GetProviderValue(((CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgsSource)(ref argsSource)).OldValueProvider),
				NewValue = GetProviderValue(((CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgsSource)(ref argsSource)).NewValueProvider),
				Condition = GetCondition(((CustomDataUpdateFormatConditionEventArgsSource)(ref argsSource)).ConditionInfo, view)
			};
		}

		}

		internal static FormatConditionBase GetCondition(FormatConditionBaseInfo conditionInfo, ITableView view)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)view.FormatConditions).FirstOrDefault((FormatConditionBase x) => x.Info == conditionInfo);
		}

	public class ClipboardRowCellValuePastingEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private bool cancel;

		private ColumnBase column;

		private object oldValue;

		private int rowHandle;

		private object value;

		private object originalValue;

		public bool Cancel
		{
			get
			{
				return cancel;
			}
			set
			{
				cancel = value;
			}
		}

		public ColumnBase Column => column;

		public object OldValue => oldValue;

		public int RowHandle => rowHandle;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return value;
			}
			set
			{
				this.value = value;
			}
		}

		public object OriginalValue => originalValue;

		private object GetRowCellValueCore(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null || column.View == null || column.View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return column.View.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle, column.FieldName);
		}

		protected ClipboardRowCellValuePastingEventArgs()
		{
		}

		internal ClipboardRowCellValuePastingEventArgs(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, object value, object originalValue)
		{
			oldValue = GetRowCellValueCore(rowHandle, column);
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
			this.column = column;
			this.value = value;
			this.originalValue = originalValue;
			cancel = object.Equals(OldValue, Value);
		}
	}

	public class FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs : RoutedEventArgs
	{
		protected internal class NotifyChangesDictionary<T1, T2> : IDictionary<T1, T2>, ICollection<KeyValuePair<T1, T2>>, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<T1, T2>>, IEnumerable
		{
			private readonly IDictionary<T1, T2> source;

			private bool changed;

			public bool Changed
			{
				get
				{
					return changed;
				}
				private set
				{
					changed = value;
				}
			}

			public T2 this[T1 key]
			{
				get
				{
					return source[key];
				}
				set
				{
					source[key] = value;
					Changed = true;
				}
			}

			public ICollection<T1> Keys => source.Keys;

			public ICollection<T2> Values => source.Values;

			public int Count => source.Count;

			public bool IsReadOnly => source.IsReadOnly;

			public NotifyChangesDictionary(IDictionary<T1, T2> source)
			{
				this.source = source;
			}

			public void Add(T1 key, T2 value)
			{
				source.Add(key, value);
				Changed = true;
			}

			public void Add(KeyValuePair<T1, T2> item)
			{
				source.Add(item);
				Changed = true;
			}

			public void Clear()
			{
				source.Clear();
				Changed = true;
			}

			public bool Contains(KeyValuePair<T1, T2> item)
			{
				return source.Contains(item);
			}

			public bool ContainsKey(T1 key)
			{
				return source.ContainsKey(key);
			}

			public void CopyTo(KeyValuePair<T1, T2>[] array, int arrayIndex)
			{
				source.CopyTo(array, arrayIndex);
			}

			public IEnumerator<KeyValuePair<T1, T2>> GetEnumerator()
			{
				return source.GetEnumerator();
			}

			public bool Remove(T1 key)
			{
				Changed = true;
				return source.Remove(key);
			}

			public bool Remove(KeyValuePair<T1, T2> item)
			{
				Changed = true;
				return source.Remove(item);
			}

			public bool TryGetValue(T1 key, out T2 value)
			{
				return source.TryGetValue(key, out value);
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return ((IEnumerable)source).GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		private bool filterChanged;

		private NotifyChangesDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> splitColumnFilters;

		private string searchString;

		private CriteriaOperator complexFilterCriteria;

		public new DataControlBase Source { get; private set; }

		protected internal bool FilterChanged
		{
			get
			{
				if (!filterChanged)
				{
					return splitColumnFilters.Changed;
				}
				return true;
			}
			protected set
			{
				filterChanged = value;
			}
		}

		public CriteriaOperator ComplexFilterCriteria
		{
			get
			{
				return complexFilterCriteria;
			}
			set
			{
				complexFilterCriteria = value;
				FilterChanged = true;
			}
		}

		public string SearchString
		{
			get
			{
				return searchString;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(searchString == value))
				{
					searchString = value;
					FilterChanged = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> SplitColumnFilters => splitColumnFilters;

		public IList<SortDefinition> SortInfo { get; private set; }

		public int GroupCount { get; set; }

		public FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs(DataControlBase dataControl, IList<SortDefinition> sortInfo, int groupCount)
		{
			Source = dataControl;
			if (Source.DataView != null)
			{
				searchString = Source.DataView.SearchString;
			}
			ParseCriteriaOperator(Source.FilterCriteria);
			SortInfo = sortInfo;
			GroupCount = groupCount;
		}

		protected virtual void ParseCriteriaOperator(CriteriaOperator criteriaOperator)
		{
			Tuple<CriteriaOperator, IDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>> tuple = CriteriaColumnAffinityResolver.SplitByColumnNames(criteriaOperator, (IEqualityComparer<string>)null);
			Setup(tuple.Item1, new NotifyChangesDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator>(tuple.Item2));
		}

		protected void Setup(CriteriaOperator complexFilterCriteria, NotifyChangesDictionary<string, CriteriaOperator> splitColumnFilters)
		{
			this.complexFilterCriteria = complexFilterCriteria;
			this.splitColumnFilters = splitColumnFilters;
		}

		protected internal virtual CriteriaOperator GetFilterCriteria()
		{
			return CriteriaOperator.And(ComplexFilterCriteria, CriteriaOperator.And((IEnumerable<CriteriaOperator>)SplitColumnFilters.Values));
		}

		private bool TryGetSortDefinition(string fieldName, out SortDefinition sortDefinition)
		{
			sortDefinition = SortInfo.Where((SortDefinition info) => info.PropertyName == fieldName).FirstOrDefault();
			return sortDefinition != null;
		}

		public bool IsSortedBy(string fieldName)
		{
			SortDefinition sortDefinition;
			return TryGetSortDefinition(fieldName, out sortDefinition);
		}

		public bool IsGroupedBy(string fieldName)
		{
			if (TryGetSortDefinition(fieldName, out var sortDefinition))
			{
				return SortInfo.IndexOf(sortDefinition) < GroupCount;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsFilteredBy(string fieldName)
		{
			return SplitColumnFilters.ContainsKey(fieldName);
		}

		protected override void InvokeEventHandler(Delegate genericHandler, object genericTarget)
		{
			((FilterGroupSortChangingEventHandler)genericHandler)(genericTarget, this);
		}
	}
	public delegate void FilterGroupSortChangingEventHandler(object sender, FilterGroupSortChangingEventArgs e);

			HasLeftSiblingProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("HasLeftSibling", typeof(bool), typeof(GridColumnHeaderBase), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		static BaseGridHeader()

			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BaseGridHeader);
			GridColumnProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("GridColumn", typeof(BaseColumn), typeFromHandle, (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnGridColumnChanged));
			DropPlaceOrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("DropPlaceOrientation", typeof(Orientation), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Horizontal));
			DragElementTemplateProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("DragElementTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
			CanGroupMergeStateProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("CanGroupMergeState", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsGroupPanelProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsGroupPanel", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsColumnChooserProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("IsColumnChooser", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			ExtendedColumnChooserViewProperty = DependencyProperty.RegisterAttached("ExtendedColumnChooserView", typeof(IExtendedColumnChooserView), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null));
		}

		private static void OnGridColumnChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader)
			{
				baseGridHeader.OnGridColumnChanged((BaseColumn)e.OldValue);
			}

		public BaseGridHeader()
		{
			ColumnContentChangedEventHandler = new ColumnContentChangedEventHandler<BaseGridHeader>(this, (Action<BaseGridHeader, object, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs>)delegate(BaseGridHeader owner, object o, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				owner.OnColumnContentChanged(o, e);
			}, (Action<WeakEventHandler<BaseGridHeader, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs, ColumnContentChangedEventHandler>, object>)delegate(WeakEventHandler<BaseGridHeader, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs, ColumnContentChangedEventHandler> h, object e)
			{
				((BaseColumn)e).ContentChanged -= h.Handler;
			});
			UpdateDragDropHeaderContent();
		}

		protected virtual void OnColumnContentChanged(object sender, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualHeaderCustomizationAreaTemplateSelectorProperty)
			{
				UpdateHeaderCustomizationArea();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualAllowResizingProperty || e.Property == BaseColumn.FixedProperty)
			{
				UpdateGripper();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HeaderCaptionProperty || e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualHeaderTemplateSelectorProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualColumnChooserHeaderCaptionProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualColumnHeaderContentStyleProperty)
			{
				UpdateHeaderPresenter();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignmentProperty)
			{
				UpdateHeaderContainer();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ImageAlignmentProperty)
			{
				UpdateHeaderPresenter();
				UpdateHeaderContainer();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ImageProperty)
			{
				UpdateImage();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HeaderToolTipProperty || e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualHeaderToolTipTemplateProperty)
			{
				UpdateTooltip();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ColumnPositionProperty)
			{
				UpdateColumnPosition();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HasTopElementProperty)
			{
				UpdateHasTopElement();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HasBottomElementProperty)
			{
				UpdateHasBottomElement();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HasRightSiblingProperty)
			{
				UpdateHasRightSiblingState();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HasLeftSiblingProperty)
			{
				UpdateHasEmptySiblingState();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualHeaderStyleProperty)
			{
				UpdateHeaderStyleProperty();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualShowCheckBoxInHeaderProperty)
			{
				UpdateShowCheckBoxInHeader();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.AllowEditingProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.ReadOnlyProperty)
			{
				UpdateEnableShowCheckBoxInHeader();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnGridColumnChanged(BaseColumn oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.ContentChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<BaseGridHeader, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs, ColumnContentChangedEventHandler>)(object)ColumnContentChangedEventHandler).Handler;
			}
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				BaseColumn.ContentChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<BaseGridHeader, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs, ColumnContentChangedEventHandler>)(object)ColumnContentChangedEventHandler).Handler;
			}
			UpdateGripper();
			UpdateHeaderPresenter();
			UpdateImage();
			UpdateTooltip();
			UpdateColumnPosition();
			UpdateHasTopElement();
			UpdateHasBottomElement();
			UpdateHasRightSiblingState();
			UpdateHasEmptySiblingState();
			UpdateHeaderCustomizationArea();
			UpdateHeaderContainer();
			UpdateHeaderStyleProperty();
			UpdateShowCheckBoxInHeader();
		}

		private GridColumnData GetColumnData()
		{
			if (Column != null && Column.View != null && Column.View.HeadersData != null)
			{
				return Column.View.HeadersData.GetCellDataByColumn(Column);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected object GetActualHeaderContent(object caption)
		{
			if (caption != null && (!(caption is string) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption as string)))
			{
				return caption;
			}
			return " ";
		}

				base.ColumnPosition = BaseColumn.ColumnPosition;
			}
		}

				base.HasTopElement = HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers && BaseColumn.HasTopElement;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateHasBottomElement()
		{

				base.HasBottomElement = BaseColumn.HasBottomElement;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateTooltip()
		{
			ToolTip value = null;
			if (BaseColumn != null && (BaseColumn.HeaderToolTip != null || BaseColumn.ActualHeaderToolTipTemplate != null))
			{
				value = new ToolTip
				{
					Content = BaseColumn.HeaderToolTip,
					ContentTemplate = BaseColumn.ActualHeaderToolTipTemplate
				};
			}
			ToolTipService.SetToolTip(this, value);
		}

		bool ISupportDragDrop.CanStartDrag(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		bool ISupportDragDropPlatformIndependent.CanStartDrag(object sender, IndependentMouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			return CanStartDrag((DependencyObject)sender);
		}

		internal bool CanStartDrag(DependencyObject element)
		{
			if (GridView == null || !GridView.CommitEditingInternal())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!BaseColumn.CanStartDragSingleColumn && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)this, element) && HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!BaseColumn.ActualAllowMoving)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode())
			{
				return false;
			}
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = ((Column != null) ? Column.OwnerControl : null);
			if (dataControlBase != null && DesignerProperties.GetIsInDesignMode(dataControlBase))
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase item in dataControlBase.ColumnsCore)
				{
					if (item.IsAutoGenerated)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return GridView.CanStartDrag(element as GridColumnHeaderBase);
		}

		{
			return false;
		}

			return CreateDragElement(offset);
		}

		protected virtual IDragElement CreateDragElement(System.Windows.Point offset)
		{
			IDragElement val = GridView.CreateDragElement(this, offset);
			if (val is ColumnHeaderDragElement columnHeaderDragElement && ((HeaderDragElementBase)columnHeaderDragElement).DragPreviewElement != null)
			{
				ColumnBase.SetHeaderPresenterType(((HeaderDragElementBase)columnHeaderDragElement).DragPreviewElement, HeaderPresenterType);
			}
			return val;
		}

		FixedStyle IColumnPropertyOwner.GetActualFixedStyle()
		{
			if (BaseColumn == null || GridView == null)
			{
				return FixedStyle.None;
			}
			if (BaseColumn.ParentBandInternal == null || GridView.DataControl == null || GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				return BaseColumn.Fixed;
			}
			return GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.GetRootBand(BaseColumn.ParentBandInternal).Fixed;
		}

		private void UpdateActualContentContainer()
		{
			if (HeaderPresenter != null)
			{
				ActualContentContainer = HeaderPresenter;
			}
			else
			{
				ActualContentContainer = TextBlock;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateLayoutPanel()
		{
			if (LayoutPanel != null)
			{
				LayoutPanel.HeaderPresenter = ActualContentContainer;
				LayoutPanel.HeaderGripper = HeaderGripper;
				LayoutPanel.HeaderCustomizationArea = HeaderCustomizationArea;
				LayoutPanel.Image = Image;
				LayoutPanel.CheckEdit = CheckEdit;
				UpdateDragDropHeaderContent();
				UpdateHeaderContainer();
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnHeaderLayoutChanged(ColumnHeaderLayoutBase old)
		{
			old.Do(delegate(ColumnHeaderLayoutBase x)
			{
				x.Header = null;
			});
			ColumnHeaderLayout.Do(delegate(ColumnHeaderLayoutBase x)
			{
				x.Header = this;
			});
			UpdateDragDropHeaderContent();
		}

		private void UpdateDragDropHeaderContent()
		{
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutPanel;
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = ColumnHeaderLayout;
			}
			if (frameworkElement == null)
			{
				frameworkElement = this;
			}
			HeaderContent = frameworkElement;
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			ResetPanelChildren();
			ColumnHeaderLayout = GetTemplateChild("PART_Layout") as ColumnHeaderLayoutBase;
			if (ColumnHeaderLayout == null)
			{
				LayoutPanel = GetTemplateChild("PART_LayoutPanel") as ColumnHeaderDockPanel;
			}
			ContentBorder = GetTemplateChild("PART_Border") as Decorator;
			UpdateHeaderPresenter();
			UpdateImage();
			UpdateHeaderCustomizationArea();
			UpdateHeaderContainer();
			UpdateDesignTimeSelectionControl();
		}

		protected virtual void ResetPanelChildren()
		{
			LayoutPanel = null;
			ColumnHeaderLayout = null;
			TextBlock = null;
			HeaderPresenter = null;
			HeaderGripper = null;
			HeaderCustomizationArea = null;
			ActualContentContainer = null;
			useInnerLayoutHeaderPresenter = false;
		}

		protected bool UseDefaultTemplate(ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper wrapper)
		{
			if (wrapper.Template is DefaultDataTemplate || wrapper.Template == null)
			{
				return wrapper.Selector == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateImage()
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ImageSource imageSource = BaseColumn.With((BaseColumn x) => x.Image);
			Visibility visibility = ((imageSource == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			if (visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && Image == null)
			{
				Image = (System.Windows.Controls.Image)new DXImage();
				Image.Name = "PART_Image";
			}
			if (Image != null)
			{
				SetGridColumn(Image, BaseColumn);
				Image.Source = imageSource;
				Image.Visibility = visibility;
				Image.Style = BaseColumn.With((BaseColumn x) => x.ActualHeaderImageStyle);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateShowCheckBoxInHeader()
		{
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0069: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Column != null)
			{
				Visibility visibility = ((HeaderPresenterType != HeaderPresenterType.Headers || !Column.ActualShowCheckBoxInHeader) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				if (visibility != Visibility.Collapsed && CheckEdit == null)
				{
					CheckEdit val = new CheckEdit();
					((FrameworkElement)val).Margin = new Thickness(0.0, -5.0, 0.0, -5.0);
					CheckEdit = val;
					((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Name = "PART_CheckEdit";
				}
				if (CheckEdit != null)
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearBinding((DependencyObject)(object)CheckEdit, CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty);
					Binding binding = new Binding(ColumnBase.IsCheckedProperty.Name)
					{
						Source = Column
					};
					((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).SetBinding(CheckEdit.IsCheckedProperty, (BindingBase)binding);
					SetGridColumn((DependencyObject)(object)CheckEdit, BaseColumn);
					((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).Visibility = visibility;
					UpdateEnableShowCheckBoxInHeader();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateEnableShowCheckBoxInHeader()
		{
			if (Column != null && CheckEdit != null)
			{
				((UIElement)(object)CheckEdit).IsEnabled = Column.GetAllowEditing() && !Column.IsActualReadOnly;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void SetIsBestFitElement()
		{
			if (CheckEdit != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Margin = new Thickness(((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Margin.Left, ((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Margin.Top, ((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Margin.Right + 7.0, ((FrameworkElement)(object)CheckEdit).Margin.Bottom);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateHeaderPresenter()
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				if (BaseColumn.ImageAlignment == StringAlignment.Center)
				{
					TextBlock = null;
					HeaderPresenter = null;
				}
				else if (UseDefaultTemplate((ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper)BaseColumn.ActualHeaderTemplateSelector) && Column.With((ColumnBase x) => x.ActualColumnHeaderContentStyle) == null && !useInnerLayoutHeaderPresenter && BaseColumn.Image == null)
				{
					UpdateTextBlock();
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateCustomHeaderPresenter();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateTextBlock()
		{
			if (TextBlock == null)
			{
				TextBlock = CreateTextBlock();
			}
			if (HeaderPresenter != null)
			{
				HeaderPresenter = null;
			}
			TextBlock.Text = GetActualHeaderContent(GetCaption()).ToString();
			TextBlock.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
			UpdateHeaderTooltip();
		}

		private object GetCaption()
		{
			if (HeaderPresenterType != HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser || Column == null)
			{
				return BaseColumn.HeaderCaption;
			}
			return Column.ActualColumnChooserHeaderCaption;
		}

		protected virtual TextBlock CreateTextBlock()
		{
			TextBlock textBlock = new TextBlock
			{
				Name = "PART_Content"
			};
			textBlock.TextTrimming = TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis;
			TextBlockService.SetAllowIsTextTrimmed((DependencyObject)textBlock, true);
			TextBlockService.AddIsTextTrimmedChangedHandler((DependencyObject)textBlock, (RoutedEventHandler)OnIsTextTrimmedChanged);
			return textBlock;
		}

		private void OnIsTextTrimmedChanged(object o, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateHeaderTooltip();
		}

		private void UpdateHeaderTooltip()
		{
			if (TextBlock != null && BaseColumn?.HeaderToolTip == null)
			{
				ToolTipService.SetToolTip(TextBlock, TextBlockService.GetIsTextTrimmed(TextBlock) ? TextBlock.Text : DependencyProperty.UnsetValue);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCustomHeaderPresenter()
		{
			if (HeaderPresenter == null)
			{
				HeaderPresenter = (ContentControl)(object)CreateCustomHeaderPresenter();
			}
			if (TextBlock != null)
			{
				TextBlock = null;
			}
			HeaderPresenter.Content = GetActualHeaderContent(GetCaption());
			HeaderPresenter.ContentTemplateSelector = BaseColumn.ActualHeaderTemplateSelector;
			if (Column != null)
			{
				HeaderPresenter.Style = Column.ActualColumnHeaderContentStyle;
			}
			SetGridColumn(HeaderPresenter, BaseColumn);
		}

		protected virtual XPFContentControl CreateCustomHeaderPresenter()
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			return new XPFContentControl();
		}

		private void UpdateGripper()
		{
			if (BaseColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HeaderGripper == null && ShouldCreateHeaderGripper())
			{
				HeaderGripper = CreateGripper();
				HeaderGripper.Cursor = Cursors.SizeWE;
				UpdateResizeHelper();
			}
			if (HeaderGripper == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderGripper.HorizontalAlignment = ((((IColumnPropertyOwner)this).GetActualFixedStyle() != FixedStyle.Right) ? HorizontalAlignment.Right : HorizontalAlignment.Left);
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				HeaderGripper.Margin = new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, 0.0 - BaseColumn.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore, 0.0);
				if (!defaultWidth.HasValue)
				{
					defaultWidth = HeaderGripper.ActualWidth;
				}
				HeaderGripper.Width = defaultWidth.Value + BaseColumn.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
			}
			HeaderGripper.Visibility = ((!BaseColumn.ActualAllowResizing) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
		}

		private bool ShouldCreateHeaderGripper()
		{
			if (isEnabledChanging)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.IsMouseOver)
			{
				return HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateResizeHelper()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (HeaderGripper != null)
			{
				new ResizeHelper((IResizeHelperOwner)(object)new ColumnResizeHelperOwner(this)).Init(HeaderGripper);
			}
		}

		protected virtual Thumb CreateGripper()
		{
			return new Thumb();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateGripper();
			if (DragDropHelper == null)
			{
				DragDropHelper = CreateDragDropHelper();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Property == UIElement.IsEnabledProperty)
			{
				isEnabledChanging = true;
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == UIElement.IsEnabledProperty)
			{
				isEnabledChanging = false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual DragDropElementHelper CreateDragDropHelper()
		{
			return (DragDropElementHelper)(object)new GridDragDropElementHelper((ISupportDragDropColumnHeader)(object)this);
		}

		private void UpdateHeaderCustomizationArea()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (UseDefaultTemplate((ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper)Column.ActualHeaderCustomizationAreaTemplateSelector) || HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser)
			{
				HeaderCustomizationArea = null;
				return;
			}
			if (HeaderCustomizationArea == null)
			{
				HeaderCustomizationArea = CreateHeaderCustomizationArea();
			}
			HeaderCustomizationArea.Content = GetColumnData();
			HeaderCustomizationArea.ContentTemplateSelector = Column.ActualHeaderCustomizationAreaTemplateSelector;
		}

		protected virtual ContentPresenter CreateHeaderCustomizationArea()
		{
			return new ContentPresenter();
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateHasRightSiblingState()
		{
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				base.HasRightSibling = HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers && BaseColumn.HasRightSibling;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateHasEmptySiblingState()
		{
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				base.HasLeftSibling = base.ColumnPosition == ColumnPosition.Left && BaseColumn.HasLeftSibling;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateHeaderStyleProperty()
		{
			if (BaseColumn != null)
			{
				if (BaseColumn.ActualHeaderStyle == null)
				{
					ClearValue(FrameworkElement.StyleProperty);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Style = BaseColumn.ActualHeaderStyle;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateHeaderContainer()
		{
			if (BaseColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HorizontalAlignment alignment = BaseColumn.HorizontalHeaderContentAlignment;
			LayoutPanel.Do(delegate(ColumnHeaderDockPanel x)
			{
				if (ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(LayoutPanel) == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser)
				{
					alignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
				}
				x.ContainerAlignment = alignment;
				x.ImageAlignment = BaseColumn.ImageAlignment;
			});
			HeaderPresenter.Do(delegate(ContentControl x)
			{
				x.HorizontalAlignment = alignment;
			});
		}

		protected override void UpdateDesignTimeSelectionControl()
		{
			if ((base.DesignTimeSelectionControl != null || GridColumnHeaderBase.GetIsSelectedInDesignTime(this)) && ContentBorder != null)
			{
				if (base.DesignTimeSelectionControl == null && GridColumnHeaderBase.GetIsSelectedInDesignTime(this))
				{
					base.DesignTimeSelectionControl = CreateDesignTimeSelectionControl();
					ContentBorder.Child = base.DesignTimeSelectionControl;
				}
				else if (base.DesignTimeSelectionControl != null && !GridColumnHeaderBase.GetIsSelectedInDesignTime(this))
				{
					ContentBorder.Child = null;
					base.DesignTimeSelectionControl = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement CreateDesignTimeSelectionControl()
		{
			return new Control();
		}

		internal virtual void InitInnerLayoutElements()
		{
			if (ColumnHeaderLayout != null)
			{
				ColumnHeaderLayout.LayoutPanel.Do(delegate(ColumnHeaderDockPanel x)
				{
					LayoutPanel = x;
				});
				ColumnHeaderLayout.HeaderPresenter.Do(delegate(ContentControl x)
				{
					HeaderPresenter = x;
					useInnerLayoutHeaderPresenter = true;
					UpdateHeaderPresenter();
				});
				ColumnHeaderLayout.HeaderGripper.Do(delegate(Thumb x)
				{
					HeaderGripper = x;
					UpdateResizeHelper();
					UpdateGripper();
				});
			}
		}

		[SpecialName]
		double IColumnPropertyOwner.get_ActualWidth()
		{
			return base.ActualWidth;
		}
	}

		static BaseGridColumnHeader()
		{
			ShowFilterButtonOnHoverProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ShowFilterButtonOnHover", typeof(bool), typeof(BaseGridColumnHeader), new PropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseGridColumnHeader)d).UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			}));
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(BaseGridColumnHeader);
			IsInDropAreaPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsInDropArea", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsInDropAreaProperty = IsInDropAreaPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			CorrectDragIndicatorLocationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("CorrectDragIndicatorLocation", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			DragElementSizePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("DragElementSize", typeof(System.Windows.Size), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(default(System.Windows.Size)));
			DragElementSizeProperty = DragElementSizePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DragElementAllowTransparencyPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("DragElementAllowTransparency", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(true));
			DragElementAllowTransparencyProperty = DragElementAllowTransparencyPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			ColumnFilterPopupStyleProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttached("ColumnFilterPopupStyle", typeof(Style), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((BaseGridColumnHeader)d).OnColumnFilterPopupStyleChanged();
			}));
		}
