		protected override void OnColumnContentChanged(object sender, ColumnContentChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnColumnContentChanged(sender, e);
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.EditSettingsProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.FilterPopupModeProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.AllowedDateTimeFiltersProperty || e.Property == ColumnBase.ShowEmptyDateFilterProperty)
			{
				UpdateColumnFilterPopup();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.SortOrderProperty)
			{
				UpdateSortIndicators();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ActualHeaderWidthProperty)
			{
				UpdateWidth();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.IsFilteredProperty)
			{
				UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			}
			if (e.Property == ColumnBase.ActualAllowColumnFilteringProperty)
			{
				UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.ColumnPositionProperty)
			{
				UpdateColumnPosition();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.HasTopElementProperty)
			{
				UpdateHasTopElement();
			}
			if (e.Property == BaseColumn.AllowSearchHeaderHighlightingProperty)
			{
				UpdateAllowHighlighting();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateAllowHighlighting()
		{
			if (base.TextBlock != null && base.BaseColumn != null && !base.BaseColumn.AllowSearchHeaderHighlighting)
			{
				base.TextBlock.ClearValue(TextBlock.FontStyleProperty);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGridColumnChanged(BaseColumn oldValue)
		{
			base.OnGridColumnChanged(oldValue);
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			UpdateColumnFilterPopup();
			UpdateSortIndicators();
			UpdateWidth();
			UpdateHeaderPresenter();
			UpdateDesignTimeSelection();
			UpdateAllowHighlighting();
		}

		private void UpdateDesignTimeSelection()
		{
			if (base.Column != null)
			{
				GridColumnHeaderBase.SetIsSelectedInDesignTime(this, GridColumnHeaderBase.GetIsSelectedInDesignTime((DependencyObject)(object)base.Column));
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnFilterPopupChanged(PopupBaseEdit oldValue)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0067: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0095: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.PopupOpening -= new OpenPopupEventHandler(ColumnFilterPopupOpening);
				oldValue.PopupOpened -= ColumnFilterPopupOpened;
				oldValue.PopupClosed -= new ClosePopupEventHandler(ColumnFilterPopupClosed);
				if (oldValue.IsPopupOpen)
				{
					ColumnFilterPopupClosedCore(applyFilter: false);
				}
			}
			if (ColumnFilterPopup != null)
			{
				ColumnFilterPopup.PopupOpening += new OpenPopupEventHandler(ColumnFilterPopupOpening);
				ColumnFilterPopup.PopupOpened += ColumnFilterPopupOpened;
				ColumnFilterPopup.PopupClosed += new ClosePopupEventHandler(ColumnFilterPopupClosed);
			}
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
		}

		private void ColumnFilterPopupOpening(object sender, OpenPopupEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterPopup(allowHide: false);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.Column.FieldName))
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
			else
			{
				base.Column.ColumnFilterInfo.OnPopupOpening(ColumnFilterPopup);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
		}

		private void ColumnFilterPopupOpened(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.Column.ColumnFilterInfo.OnPopupOpened(ColumnFilterPopup);
		}

		private void ColumnFilterPopupClosed(object sender, ClosePopupEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0008: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			ColumnFilterPopupClosedCore((int)e.CloseMode != 1);
		}

		private void ColumnFilterPopupClosedCore(bool applyFilter)
		{
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			base.Column.ColumnFilterInfo.OnPopupClosed(ColumnFilterPopup, applyFilter);
		}

		private void UpdateWidth()
		{
			if (base.Column != null && CanSyncWidth && !double.IsInfinity(base.Column.ActualHeaderWidth))
			{
				base.Width = base.Column.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnFilterPopupStyleChanged()
		{
			if (ColumnFilterPopup != null)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)ColumnFilterPopup).Style = ColumnFilterPopupStyle;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateHasTopElement()
		{
			if (base.Column != null && base.Column.OwnerControl != null && base.Column.OwnerControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && base.Column.OwnerControl.BandsLayoutCore.ShowBandsPanel && base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
			{
				base.HasTopElement = base.Column.HasTopElement || HasVisibleParentBands(base.Column);
			}
			else
			{
				base.UpdateHasTopElement();
			}
		}

		private bool HasVisibleParentBands(ColumnBase column)
		{
			for (BandBase parentBand = column.ParentBand; parentBand != null; parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand)
			{
				if (parentBand.ActualShowInBandsPanel)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static HeaderPresenterType GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromLocalValue(d);
		}

		public static HeaderPresenterType GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromLocalValue(DependencyObject d)
		{
			return ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(d);
		}

		internal static ColumnBase GetColumnByDragElement(UIElement element)
		{
			return (ColumnBase)BaseGridHeader.GetGridColumn(LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BaseGridColumnHeader>((DependencyObject)element));
		}

		protected internal override DependencyObject CreateDragElementDataContext()
		{
			return (DependencyObject)(object)base.GridView.HeadersData.CreateCellDataByColumn(base.Column);
		}

		protected override void OnIsSelectedInDesignTimeChangedCore()
		{
			GridColumnHeaderBase.SetIsSelectedInDesignTime((DependencyObject)(object)base.Column, GridColumnHeaderBase.GetIsSelectedInDesignTime(this));
		}

		protected override void OnDraggedColumnChanged(BaseColumn oldValue, BaseColumn newValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is ColumnBase)
			{
				((ColumnBase)oldValue).OwnerChanging -= OnDraggColumnOwnerChanging;
			}
			if (newValue is ColumnBase)
			{
				((ColumnBase)newValue).OwnerChanging += OnDraggColumnOwnerChanging;
			}
		}

		private void OnDraggColumnOwnerChanging(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DragDropHelper != null && base.DragDropHelper.IsDragging)
			{
				base.DragDropHelper.CancelDragging();
			}
		}

		private void OnColumnFilterPopupContainerChanged(ContentControl old)
		{
			old.Do(delegate(ContentControl x)
			{
				x.Content = null;
			});
			ContainerizeColumnFilterPopup();
			UpdateLayoutPanel();
		}

		private void UpdateColumnFilterPopupContainer()
		{
			ContainerizeColumnFilterPopup();
			UpdateLayoutPanel();
		}

		private void ContainerizeColumnFilterPopup()
		{
			if (ColumnFilterPopupContainer != null)
			{
				base.LayoutPanel.Do(delegate(ColumnHeaderDockPanel x)
				{
					x.FilterPresenter = ColumnFilterPopupContainer;
				});
				ColumnFilterPopupContainer.Content = ColumnFilterPopup;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
			UpdateSortIndicators();
			UpdateHeaderFilterEditor();
			UpdateHeaderFilterDisplay();
			UpdateAllowHighlighting();
		}

		protected override void ResetPanelChildren()
		{
			base.ResetPanelChildren();
			ColumnFilterPopup = null;
			ColumnFilterPopupContainer = null;
			SortIndicator = null;
			HeaderFilterEditor = null;
			HeaderFilterDisplay = null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateLayoutPanel()
		{
			base.UpdateLayoutPanel();
			if (base.LayoutPanel != null)
			{
				if (ColumnFilterPopupContainer != null)
				{
					base.LayoutPanel.FilterPresenter = ColumnFilterPopupContainer;
				}
				else
				{
					base.LayoutPanel.FilterPresenter = (UIElement)(object)ColumnFilterPopup;
				}
				base.LayoutPanel.SortIndicator = SortIndicator;
				base.LayoutPanel.HeaderFilterEditor = HeaderFilterEditor;
				base.LayoutPanel.HeaderFilterDisplay = HeaderFilterDisplay;
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateColumnFilterPopup()
		{
			if (ColumnFilterPopup != null && base.Column != null && base.Column.View != null)
			{
				ColumnFilterPopup = CreateFilterPopup();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColumnFilterPopup(bool allowHide)
		{
			if (base.Column == null || isEnabledChanging || base.Column.OwnerControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ShowFilterButtonOnHover && !base.IsMouseOver && !IsPopupOpen && !base.Column.IsFiltered;
			bool flag2 = base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser || !DesignerHelper.GetValue(this, base.Column.ActualAllowColumnFiltering, designerValue: false);
			if (!allowHide)
			{
				flag = false;
				flag2 = false;
			}
			if (ClearAutomationEventsHelper.UITestingEnabled)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				ColumnFilterPopup = null;
				return;
			}
			if (flag && base.HeaderPresenterType != HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel)
			{
				ColumnFilterPopup.Do(delegate(PopupBaseEdit x)
				{
					((UIElement)(object)x).Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
				});
				return;
			}
			if (ColumnFilterPopup == null)
			{
				ColumnFilterPopup = CreateFilterPopup();
			}
			((UIElement)(object)ColumnFilterPopup).Visibility = (((!base.IsMouseOver && CanShowHeaderAutoFilter() && base.Column.AutoFilterValue != null) || IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode()) ? Visibility.Collapsed : ((flag && base.HeaderPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel) ? Visibility.Hidden : Visibility.Visible));
			((FrameworkElement)(object)ColumnFilterPopup).Style = ColumnFilterPopupStyle;
			BaseGridHeader.SetGridColumn((DependencyObject)(object)ColumnFilterPopup, base.Column);
			SetFilterHitTestAcceptor(ColumnFilterPopup);
		}

		protected virtual PopupBaseEdit CreateFilterPopup()
		{
			PopupBaseEdit val = base.Column.ColumnFilterInfo.CreateColumnFilterPopup();
			val.FocusPopupOnOpen = true;
			val.IgnorePopupSizeConstraints = true;
			return val;
		}

		protected void UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible()
		{
			UpdateColumnFilterPopup(allowHide: true);
		}

		protected virtual void SetFilterHitTestAcceptor(PopupBaseEdit popup)
		{
		}

		internal void UpdateSortIndicators()
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0048: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (base.Column != null)
			{
				Visibility visibility = (((int)base.Column.SortOrder == 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
				if (SortIndicator == null && visibility != Visibility.Collapsed)
				{
					SortIndicator = CreateSortIndicator();
				}
				if (SortIndicator != null)
				{
					UpdateSortIndicator((int)base.Column.SortOrder == 1);
					SortIndicator.Visibility = (IsAutoFilterHeaderEditMode() ? Visibility.Collapsed : visibility);
				}
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateHeaderFilterEditor()
		{
			if (HeaderFilterEditor == null)
			{
				HeaderFilterEditor = CreateHeaderFilterEditor();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateHeaderFilterDisplay()
		{
			if (HeaderFilterDisplay == null)
			{
				HeaderFilterDisplay = CreateHeaderFilterDisplay();
			}
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement CreateSortIndicator()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement CreateHeaderFilterEditor()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual FrameworkElement CreateHeaderFilterDisplay()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateSortIndicator(bool isAscending)
		{
		}

		internal override void InitInnerLayoutElements()
		{
			base.InitInnerLayoutElements();
			if (base.ColumnHeaderLayout != null)
			{
				base.ColumnHeaderLayout.SortIndicator.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					SortIndicator = x;
					UpdateSortIndicators();
				});
				base.ColumnHeaderLayout.Filter.Do(delegate(ContentControl x)
				{
					ColumnFilterPopupContainer = x;
					UpdateIsFilterButtonVisible();
				});
				base.ColumnHeaderLayout.HeaderFilterEditor.Do(delegate(ContentControl x)
				{
					HeaderFilterEditor = x;
					UpdateHeaderFilterEditor();
				});
				base.ColumnHeaderLayout.HeaderFilterDisplay.Do(delegate(FrameworkElement x)
				{
					HeaderFilterDisplay = x;
					UpdateHeaderFilterDisplay();
				});
			}
		}

		}

	public class ColumnResizeHelperOwner : IResizeHelperOwner
	{
		private readonly IColumnPropertyOwner columnPropertyOwner;

		private double maxWidth = double.MaxValue;

		private BaseColumn Column => columnPropertyOwner.Column;

		private DataViewBase View => Column?.ResizeOwner as DataViewBase;

		double IResizeHelperOwner.ActualSize
		{
			get
			{
				return Column?.HeaderWidth ?? 0.0;
			}
			set
			{
				SetWidth(value);
			}
		}

		SizeHelperBase IResizeHelperOwner.SizeHelper => HorizontalSizeHelper.Instance;

		public ColumnResizeHelperOwner(IColumnPropertyOwner columnPropertyOwner)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)columnPropertyOwner, "columnPropertyOwner");
			this.columnPropertyOwner = columnPropertyOwner;
		}

		void IResizeHelperOwner.ChangeSize(double delta)
		{
			if (columnPropertyOwner.GetActualFixedStyle() == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				delta = 0.0 - delta;
			}
			SetWidth(columnPropertyOwner.ActualWidth + delta);
		}

		void IResizeHelperOwner.OnDoubleClick()
		{
			BaseColumn column = Column;
			if (column != null)
			{
				View?.ViewBehavior?.OnColumnResizerDoubleClick(column);
			}
		}

		private void SetWidth(double value)
		{
			View?.ApplyResize(Column, value, maxWidth);
		}

		void IResizeHelperOwner.SetIsResizing(bool isResizing)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = Column as ColumnBase;
			if (isResizing)
			{
				if (columnBase != null && View != null && View.ViewBehavior != null)
				{
					maxWidth = View.ViewBehavior.CalcColumnMaxWidth(columnBase);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				View?.ViewBehavior?.OnResizingComplete();
			}
		}
	}

		FixedStyle GetActualFixedStyle();

		static CellContentPresenter()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.OverrideMetadata<CellContentPresenter>();
			RowDataProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("RowData", typeof(RowData), typeof(CellContentPresenter), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).OnRowDataChanged();
			}));
			FieldNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FieldName", typeof(string), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnFieldNameChanged));
			ColumnProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Column", typeof(ColumnBase), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null, OnColumnChanged));
			ColumnPositionProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ColumnPosition", typeof(ColumnPosition), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ColumnPosition.Middle, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).UpdateLineState();
			}));
			IsFocusedCellProperty = DataViewBase.IsFocusedCellProperty.AddOwner(typeof(CellContentPresenter), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).OnIsFocusedCellChanged();
			}));
			ColumnBase.NavigationIndexProperty.AddOwner(typeof(CellContentPresenter));
			HasRightSiblingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HasRightSibling", typeof(bool), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).UpdateLineState();
			}));
			HasLeftSiblingProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HasLeftSibling", typeof(bool), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).UpdateLineState();
			}));
			HasTopElementProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("HasTopElement", typeof(bool), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).UpdateLineState();
			}));
			ShowVerticalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowVerticalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((CellContentPresenter)d).UpdateLineState();
			}));
			ShowHorizontalLinesProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ShowHorizontalLines", typeof(bool), typeof(CellContentPresenter), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			Editor = GetTemplateChild("PART_CellEditor") as CellEditorBase;
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				Editor.GridCellEditorOwner = this;
				UpdateEditorCellData();
			}
			OnIsFocusedCellChanged();
			OnNavigationIndexChanged();
			OnRowDataChanged();
			SyncColumn();
			SyncFieldName();
			UpdateSelectionState();
			UpdateLineState();
		}

		private void UpdateEditorCellData()
		{
			if (Editor != null && Editor.CellData == null)
			{
				Editor.CellData = GetCellData();
			}
		}

		private EditGridCellData GetCellData()
		{
			if (base.DataContext is EditGridCellData result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (RowData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (EditGridCellData)RowData.GetCellDataByColumn(Column);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateLineState()
		{
			GoToState(GetShowVerticalLineState());
			UpdateContentBorder();
		}

		private void UpdateContentBorder()
		{
			double left = ((Column != null && ColumnPosition == ColumnPosition.Left && HasLeftSibling && ShowVerticalLines) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
			double top = ((HasTopElement && ShowHorizontalLines) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
			double right = ((HasRightSibling && ShowVerticalLines) ? 1.0 : 0.0);
			Thickness thickness = new Thickness(left, top, right, 0.0);
			if (BorderState != thickness)
			{
				BorderState = thickness;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRowSelectionState()
		{
			UpdateSelectionState();
			UpdateLineState();
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionState()
		{
			GoToState(GetSelectionState());
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnIsReadyChanged()
		{
		}

		protected virtual string GetShowVerticalLineState()
		{
			if (RowData == null || RowData.SelectionState != SelectionState.Focused)
			{
				return "Visible";
			}
			return "VisibleFocused";
		}

		protected virtual string GetSelectionState()
		{
			if (RowData == null)
			{
				return "None";
			}
			if (SelectionState == SelectionState.None && RowData.SelectionState == SelectionState.Focused)
			{
				return "RowFocused";
			}
			if (SelectionState == SelectionState.None && RowData.SelectionState == SelectionState.Selected)
			{
				return "RowSelected";
			}
			return Enum.GetName(typeof(SelectionState), SelectionState);
		}

		protected virtual void GoToState(string state)
		{
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, state, useTransitions: false);
		}

		private void SyncFieldName()
		{
			SyncCellEditor(FieldNameProperty, CellEditorBase.FieldNameProperty);
		}

		private void SyncColumn()
		{
			SyncCellEditor(ColumnProperty, CellEditorBase.ColumnProperty);
		}

		private void SyncCellEditor(DependencyProperty property, DependencyProperty editorProperty)
		{
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				((DependencyObject)(object)Editor).SetValue(editorProperty, GetValue(property));
			}
		}

		internal virtual void SyncProperties(GridCellData cellData)
		{
		}

			}
		}

		private void OnNavigationIndexChanged()

			}
		}

		{

			{
				Column = View.ColumnsCore[FieldName];
			}
			SyncFieldName();
		}

		protected virtual void OnColumnChanged()
		{
			SyncColumn();
			UpdateEditorCellData();
		}

		protected virtual void OnRowDataChanged()
		{
			if (Editor != null)
			{
				Editor.RowData = RowData;
			}
			OnCellContentPresenterRowChanged();
		}

		private void OnCellContentPresenterRowChanged()
		{
			if (View != null && (RowData == null || !RowData.treeBuilder.IsPrinting))
			{
				View.ViewBehavior.OnCellContentPresenterRowChanged(this);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
			if (e.Property == FrameworkElement.DataContextProperty && base.DataContext is RowData)
			{
				RowData = base.DataContext as RowData;
			}
		}

		void INotifyNavigationIndexChanged.OnNavigationIndexChanged()
		{
			OnNavigationIndexChanged();
		}

		}

		}

		private void MouseEnterOrLeave()
		{
			if (View != null && CellData != null && CellData.RowData != null && View.CanHighlightedState(CellData.RowData.RowHandle.Value, CellData.Column, isCell: true, CellData.SelectionState))
			{
				CellData.UpdateSelectionState();
			}
		}

			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			MouseEnterOrLeave();
		}

			MouseEnterOrLeave();

			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(AdditionalRowContainerControlBase);

			ItemTemplateProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ItemTemplate", typeof(DataTemplate), typeFromHandle, null);
			IndicatorWidthProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IndicatorWidth", typeof(double), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(16.0));
		}

		protected AdditionalRowContainerControlBase()
		{
			SetBinding(RowData.RowDataProperty, new Binding());
			SetBinding(RowData.CurrentRowDataProperty, new Binding());
		}
	}
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	public class AdditionalRowItemsControl : ItemsControl, INotifyCurrentViewChanged
	{
		private DataViewBase ViewBase => DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(this);

		private ITableView View => DataControlBase.GetCurrentView(this) as ITableView;

		public AdditionalRowItemsControl()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				UpdateRows();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFilterRow()
		{
			if (base.Items != null && base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				AddChild(View.ViewBase.CreateAutoFilterRowElement(View.AutoFilterRowData));
			}
		}

		public void UpdateRows()
		{
			if (base.Items != null)
			{
				if (base.Items.Count == 0)
				{
					UpdateFilterRow();
				}
				if (base.Items.Count == 1 && ViewBase != null && ViewBase.ViewBehavior != null && ViewBase.ViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowVisible && View.NewItemRowData != null)
				{
					AddChild(ViewBase.CreateNewItemRowElement(View.NewItemRowData));
				}
			}
		}

		void INotifyCurrentViewChanged.OnCurrentViewChanged(DependencyObject d)
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.TableViewBehavior.AdditionalRowItemsControl = this;
				UpdateRows();
			}
			foreach (object item in (IEnumerable)base.Items)
			{
				if (item is DependencyObject)
				{
					DataControlBase.SetCurrentView((DependencyObject)item, (View != null) ? View.ViewBase : null);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class GridCachedItemsControl : CachedItemsControl
	{
		private int rowMarginControlVisibleIndex = -1;

		private ColumnBase treeColumn;

		protected internal Control RowMarginControl { get; set; }

		protected internal bool IsRowMarginControlVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowMarginControl != null)
				{
					return rowMarginControlVisibleIndex > -1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected virtual DataViewBase View => null;

		protected override void ValidateVisualTree()
		{
			((CachedItemsControl)this).ValidateVisualTree();
			ValidateRowMarginControl();
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateRowMarginControl()
		{
			if (View == null || View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode != RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl || ((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EnsureRowMarginControlCreated();
			if (RowMarginControl != null)
			{
				OrderPanelBase.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)RowMarginControl, rowMarginControlVisibleIndex);
				if (treeColumn != null)
				{
					ColumnBase.SetNavigationIndex(RowMarginControl, BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)treeColumn));
				}
			}
		}

		private void EnsureRowMarginControlCreated()
		{
			if (RowMarginControl == null)
			{
				if (rowMarginControlVisibleIndex > -1)
				{
					RowMarginControl = CreateRowMarginControl();
					if (RowMarginControl != null)
					{
						((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel.Children.Add(RowMarginControl);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int num = ((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel.Children.IndexOf(RowMarginControl);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					((Panel)VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(RowMarginControl))?.Children.Remove(RowMarginControl);
					((ItemsControlBase)this).Panel.Children.Add(RowMarginControl);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void AssignVisibleIndex(FrameworkElement presenter, object item)
		{
			GridColumnData gridColumnData = (GridColumnData)item;
			OrderPanelBase.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)presenter, (rowMarginControlVisibleIndex < 0 || gridColumnData.VisibleIndex < rowMarginControlVisibleIndex) ? gridColumnData.VisibleIndex : (gridColumnData.VisibleIndex + 1));
		}

		protected virtual Control CreateRowMarginControl()
		{
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdateRowMarginControlVisibleIndex()
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				treeColumn = null;
				rowMarginControlVisibleIndex = ((View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? GetRowMarginControlVisibleIndex() : (-1));
			}
		}

		private int GetRowMarginControlVisibleIndex()
		{
			foreach (GridColumnData item in ((ItemsControlBase)this).ItemsSource)
			{
				GridColumnData gridColumnData2 = item;
				if (gridColumnData2 != null && View.IsTreeColumn(item.Column))
				{
					treeColumn = item.Column;
					return item.VisibleIndex;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged()
		{
			UpdateRowMarginControlVisibleIndex();
			((ItemsControlBase)this).OnCollectionChanged();
		}
	}
	public abstract class CellItemsControlBase : GridCachedItemsControl, INotifyCurrentViewChanged, ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner
	{
		private LayoutNotificationHelper layoutNotificationHelper;

		protected override DataViewBase View => DataControlBase.GetCurrentView((DependencyObject)(object)this);

		DependencyObject ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner.NotificationManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (View == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return View.DataControl;
			}
		}

		public CellItemsControlBase()
		{
			layoutNotificationHelper = new LayoutNotificationHelper(this);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			layoutNotificationHelper.Subscribe();
			return ((CachedItemsControl)this).MeasureOverride(constraint);
		}

		protected sealed override void ValidateElement(FrameworkElement element, object item)
		{
			GridCellData gridCellData = (GridCellData)item;
			if (gridCellData.Column != null)
			{
				ValidateElementCore(element, gridCellData);
			}
		}

		protected abstract void ValidateElementCore(FrameworkElement element, GridCellData cellData);

		protected sealed override FrameworkElement CreateChild(object item)
		{
			return CreateChildCore((GridCellData)item);
		}

		protected abstract FrameworkElement CreateChildCore(GridCellData cellData);

		void INotifyCurrentViewChanged.OnCurrentViewChanged(DependencyObject d)
		{
			OnCurrentViewChanged();
		}

		protected virtual void OnCurrentViewChanged()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged()
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged();
			DoInvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void DoInvalidateMeasure()
		{
			if (View == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
			while (true)
			{
				uIElement = VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(uIElement) as UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null || uIElement == View.DataPresenter)
				{
					break;
				}
				uIElement.InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		void ILayoutNotificationHelperOwner.InvalidateMeasure()
		{
			((UIElement)(object)this).InvalidateMeasure();
		}
	}

	public class GridTableViewLayoutCalculatorFactory
	{
		public virtual ColumnsLayoutCalculator CreateCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo, bool autoWidth)
		{
			if (viewInfo.GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				if (autoWidth)
				{
					return new BandedViewAutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator(viewInfo);
				}
				return new BandedViewColumnsLayoutCalculator(viewInfo);
			}
			if (!autoWidth)
			{
				return new ColumnsLayoutCalculator(viewInfo);
			}
			return new AutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator(viewInfo);
		}
	}
	public class GridViewInfo
	{
		public const double DefaultColumnWidth = 120.0;

		public const double DefaultHeaderHeight = 20.0;

		public const double DefaultRowHeight = 18.0;

		public const double FixedNoneMinWidth = 1.0;

		private DataViewBase gridView;

		private System.Windows.Size columnsLayoutSize;

		private double verticalScrollBarWidth;

		public System.Windows.Size ColumnsLayoutSize
		{
			get
			{
				return columnsLayoutSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(columnsLayoutSize == value))
				{
					columnsLayoutSize = value;
					GridView.UpdateColumnsPositions(needUpdateErrors: false);
				}
			}
		}

		public double VerticalScrollBarWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return verticalScrollBarWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (verticalScrollBarWidth != value)
				{
					verticalScrollBarWidth = value;
					GridView.UpdateColumnsPositions();
				}
			}
		}

		public DataViewBase GridView => gridView;

		public ITableView TableView => (ITableView)GridView;

		public DataControlBase Grid => GridView.DataControl;

		public virtual IList<ColumnBase> VisibleColumns => GridView.VisibleColumnsCore;

		public virtual int GroupCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (Grid == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Grid.ActualLevelCount;
			}
		}

		public virtual double TotalGroupAreaIndent => (IsPrinting ? TableView.ViewBase.PrintRowIndentWidth : TableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent) * (double)GroupCount;

		public virtual double RightGroupAreaIndent
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupCount == 0)
				{
					return 0.0;
				}
				return TableView.RightGroupAreaIndent;
			}
		}

		public GridTableViewLayoutCalculatorFactory LayoutCalculatorFactory { get; set; }

		public virtual BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout => GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore;

		internal double ActualLeftDataAreaIndent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TableView.ShowIndicator)
				{
					return TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		internal double FirstColumnIndent => ActualLeftDataAreaIndent + NewItemRowIndent;

		internal virtual int ServiceIndentsCount => 0;

		internal virtual double NewItemRowIndent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!TableView.ActualShowDetailHeader)
				{
					return TotalGroupAreaIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsPrinting => false;

		public GridViewInfo(DataViewBase gridView)
		{
			this.gridView = gridView;
			LayoutCalculatorFactory = new GridTableViewLayoutCalculatorFactory();
		}

		public double GetHeaderIndentsWidth(BaseColumn column, bool calcBandSeparator = true)
		{
			double num = (gridView.ViewBehavior.IsFirstOrTreeColumn(column, IsPrinting) ? FirstColumnIndent : 0.0);
			if (column != null && calcBandSeparator)
			{
				num += column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore + column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal ColumnsLayoutCalculator CreateColumnsLayoutCalculator()
		{
			return CreateColumnsLayoutCalculator(GetAutoWidth());
		}

		protected virtual bool GetAutoWidth()
		{
			return TableView.AutoWidth;
		}

		protected internal virtual ColumnsLayoutCalculator CreateColumnsLayoutCalculator(bool autoWidth)
		{
			if (!autoWidth && GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				return new LayoutCalculator(this);
			}
			return LayoutCalculatorFactory.CreateCalculator(this, autoWidth);
		}

		public void CalcColumnsLayout()
		{
			TableView.TableViewBehavior.ColumnsLayoutCalculator.CalcActualLayout(ColumnsLayoutSize);
		}

		public double GetColumnHeaderWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return GetColumnDataWidth(column) + GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column);
		}

		private static double CalcMax(double arg1, double arg2)
		{
			return Math.Max(arg1, arg2);
		}

		public double GetColumnDataWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return GetColumnWidthCore(column, (BaseColumn c) => CalcMax(c.ActualWidth, c.MinWidth));
		}

		public double GetDesiredColumnWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return GetColumnWidthCore(column, (BaseColumn c) => GetColumnHeaderWidth(c));
		}

		protected double GetColumnWidthCore(BaseColumn column, Func<BaseColumn, double> method)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return 120.0;
			}
			double num = method(column);
			if (!double.IsNaN(num))
			{
				return num;
			}
			return CalcMax(column.MinWidth, 120.0);
		}

		public double GetDesiredColumnsWidth(IEnumerable columns)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				num += GetColumnWidthCore(column, (BaseColumn c) => GetColumnHeaderWidth(c));
			}
			return num;
		}

		public double GetColumnFixedWidthCore(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return column.MinWidth + GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column);
		}

		internal bool HasStarredColumns()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase visibleColumn in VisibleColumns)
			{
				if (visibleColumn.Width.IsStar)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		}

		protected override bool GetAutoWidth()

		}
	}

	public class GridSortInfo : DependencyObject, IColumnInfo, IMergeWithPreviousGroup
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty FieldNameProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SortOrderProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsGroupedProperty;

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey IsGroupedPropertyKey;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty GroupIndexProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SortIndexProperty;

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MergeWithPreviousGroupProperty;

		internal SortInfoCollectionBase Owner;

		[Description("Gets whether the column which is referred to by the current GridSortInfo object is a grouping column. This is a dependency property.")]
		public bool IsGrouped
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsGroupedProperty);
			}
			internal set
			{
				SetValue(IsGroupedPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the position of the column referred to by the current GridSortInfo object, among grouping columns. This is a dependency property.")]
		public int GroupIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(GroupIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(GroupIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the position of the column referred to by the current GridSortInfo object, among sorted columns. This is a dependency property.")]
		public int SortIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return (int)GetValue(SortIndexProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SortIndexProperty, value);
			}
		}

		[Description("Gets or sets the field name of the column to sort. This is a dependency property.")]

		string IColumnInfo.FieldName => FieldName;

		ColumnSortOrder IColumnInfo.SortOrder => GetSortOrder();

		UnboundColumnType IColumnInfo.UnboundType => (UnboundColumnType)0;

		Type IColumnInfo.UnboundDataType => typeof(void);

		string IColumnInfo.UnboundExpression => string.Empty;

		bool IColumnInfo.ReadOnly => false;

		bool IMergeWithPreviousGroup.MergeWithPreviousGroup => MergeWithPreviousGroup;

		static GridSortInfo()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(GridSortInfo);
			FieldNameProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("FieldName", typeof(string), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(string.Empty, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSortInfo)d).OnChanged();
			}, OnCoerceName));
			SortOrderProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SortOrder", typeof(ListSortDirection), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(ListSortDirection.Ascending, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSortInfo)d).OnChanged();
			}));
			IsGroupedPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("IsGrouped", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false));
			IsGroupedProperty = IsGroupedPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			GroupIndexProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("GroupIndex", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(-1));
			SortIndexProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SortIndex", typeof(int), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(-1));
			MergeWithPreviousGroupProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("MergeWithPreviousGroup", typeof(bool), typeFromHandle, new PropertyMetadata(false, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((GridSortInfo)d).OnChanged();
			}));
		}

		private static string OnCoerceName(DependencyObject d, object baseValue)
		{
			if (baseValue != null)
			{
				return baseValue as string;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal static ColumnSortOrder GetColumnSortOrder(ListSortDirection sortDirection)
		{
			if (sortDirection == ListSortDirection.Ascending)
			{
				return (ColumnSortOrder)1;
			}
			return (ColumnSortOrder)2;
		}

		internal static ListSortDirection GetSortDirectionBySortOrder(ColumnSortOrder sortOrder)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)sortOrder != 1)
			{
				return ListSortDirection.Descending;
			}
			return ListSortDirection.Ascending;
		}

		public static ListSortDirection GetActualDirection(AllowedSortOrders allowedDirections, ListSortDirection defaultDirection)
		{
			return allowedDirections switch
			{
				AllowedSortOrders.Ascending => ListSortDirection.Ascending, 
				AllowedSortOrders.Descending => ListSortDirection.Descending, 
				_ => defaultDirection, 
			};
		}

		internal static ListSortDirection InvertSortDirection(ListSortDirection original)
		{
			if (original != ListSortDirection.Ascending)
			{
				return ListSortDirection.Ascending;
			}
			return ListSortDirection.Descending;
		}

		internal static GridSortInfo GetSortInfoByFieldName(IList sortInfoList, string fieldName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (GridSortInfo sortInfo in sortInfoList)
			{
				if (sortInfo.FieldName == fieldName)
				{
					return sortInfo;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public GridSortInfo()
			: this(string.Empty, ListSortDirection.Ascending)
		{
		}

		public GridSortInfo(string fieldName)
			: this(fieldName, ListSortDirection.Ascending)
		{
		}

		public GridSortInfo(string fieldName, ListSortDirection sortOrder)
			: this(fieldName, sortOrder, mergeWithPreviousGroup: false)
		{
		}

		public GridSortInfo(string fieldName, ListSortDirection sortOrder, bool mergeWithPreviousGroup)
		{
			FieldName = fieldName;
			SortOrder = sortOrder;
			MergeWithPreviousGroup = mergeWithPreviousGroup;
		}

		public void ChangeSortOrder()
		{
			ChangeSortOrder(FieldName);
		}

		public virtual void ChangeSortOrder(string fieldName)
		{
			SortOrder = InvertSortDirection(SortOrder);
		}

		private void OnChanged()
		{
			if (Owner != null)
			{
				Owner.OnChanged();
			}
		}

		internal ColumnSortOrder GetSortOrder()
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return GetColumnSortOrder(SortOrder);
		}

		internal void SetGroupSortIndexes(int sortIndex, int groupIndex)
		{
			GroupIndex = groupIndex;
			SortIndex = sortIndex;
			IsGrouped = groupIndex >= 0;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SortInfoCollectionBase : ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>
	{
		protected int fGroupCount;

		private string defaultSorting;

		private ListSortDirection defaultSortOrder;

		protected bool LockVerifying { get; set; }

		internal string DefaultSorting
		{
			get
			{
				return defaultSorting;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == DefaultSorting))
				{
					defaultSorting = value;
					VerifyDefaultSorting();
				}
			}
		}

		internal ListSortDirection DefaultSortOrder
		{
			get
			{
				return defaultSortOrder;
			}
			set
			{
				if (defaultSortOrder != value)
				{
					defaultSortOrder = value;
					VerifyDefaultSorting();
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GroupCountCore => fGroupCount;

		internal int GroupCountInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (fGroupCount >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count)
				{
					return ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count;
				}
				return fGroupCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					value = 0;
				}
				if (fGroupCount != value)
				{
					fGroupCount = value;
					OnChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public GridSortInfo this[string name] => GridSortInfo.GetSortInfoByFieldName((IList)this, name);

		public void ClearAndAddRange(params string[] fieldNames)
		{
			ClearAndAddRange(0, fieldNames);
		}

		public void ClearAndAddRange(int groupCount, params string[] fieldNames)
		{
			GridSortInfo[] array = new GridSortInfo[fieldNames.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < fieldNames.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = new GridSortInfo
				{
					FieldName = fieldNames[i]
				};
			}
			ClearAndAddRangeCore(groupCount, array);
		}

		public void ClearAndAddRange(params GridSortInfo[] items)
		{
			ClearAndAddRangeCore(0, items);
		}

		internal void ClearAndAddRangeCore(int groupCount, params GridSortInfo[] items)
		{
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Clear();
				AddRange(items);
				GroupCountInternal = groupCount;
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void AddRange(params GridSortInfo[] items)
		{
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (GridSortInfo item in items)
				{
					if (IsValid(item))
					{
						((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Add(item);
					}
				}
				VerifyDefaultSorting();
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void ClearSorting()
		{
			if (GroupCountInternal >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			LockVerifying = true;
			try
			{
				while (GroupCountInternal < ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).RemoveAt(((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count - 1);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				LockVerifying = false;
				VerifyDefaultSorting();
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void SortByColumn(string fieldName, ColumnSortOrder direction, int sortIndex)
		{
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[fieldName];
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			LockVerifying = true;
			try
			{
				if (gridSortInfo == null)
				{
					gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo
					{
						FieldName = fieldName
					};
				}
				else
				{
					if (((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo) < GroupCountInternal)
					{
						GroupCountInternal--;
					}
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
				}
				if (sortIndex > -1 && (int)direction != 0)
				{
					gridSortInfo.SortOrder = GridSortInfo.GetSortDirectionBySortOrder(direction);
					int num = sortIndex + GroupCountInternal;
					if (num > ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count - 1)
					{
						num = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count;
					}
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Insert(num, gridSortInfo);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				LockVerifying = false;
				VerifyDefaultSorting();
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsSingleGroup()
		{
			if (((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count == GroupCountInternal)
			{
				return ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count == 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsSingleSort()
		{
			if (GroupCountInternal == 0)
			{
				return ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count == 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void OnColumnHeaderClick(string name, bool isShift, bool isCtrl, bool singleGroupSortMode = false, AllowedSortOrders allowedDirections = AllowedSortOrders.All, ListSortDirection defaultDirection = ListSortDirection.Ascending, ColumnSortClearMode clearSortMode = ColumnSortClearMode.ClickWithCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return;
			}
			ListSortDirection actualDirection = GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection(allowedDirections, defaultDirection);
			if (isShift)
			{
				OnColumnHeaderClickAddSort(name, allowedDirections, actualDirection, singleGroupSortMode);
				return;
			}
			if (ShouldRemoveSortOnClick(name, isCtrl, allowedDirections, actualDirection, clearSortMode))
			{
				OnColumnHeaderClickRemoveSort(name);
				return;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[name];
			if (singleGroupSortMode && gridSortInfo == null && IsSingleGroup())
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			if (gridSortInfo == null)
			{
				gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo
				{
					FieldName = name,
					SortOrder = actualDirection
				};
			}
			else if (GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection(allowedDirections, GridSortInfo.InvertSortDirection(gridSortInfo.SortOrder)) != gridSortInfo.SortOrder)
			{
				gridSortInfo.ChangeSortOrder(name);
			}
			try
			{
				LockVerifying = true;
				for (int num = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count - 1; num >= GroupCountInternal; num--)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).RemoveAt(num);
				}
				if (this[gridSortInfo.FieldName] == null)
				{
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Add(gridSortInfo);
				}
				LockVerifying = false;
				VerifyDefaultSorting();
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldRemoveSortOnClick(string name, bool isCtrl, AllowedSortOrders allowedDirections, ListSortDirection actualDirection, ColumnSortClearMode clearSortMode)
		{
			if (clearSortMode == ColumnSortClearMode.ClickWithCtrlPressed)
			{
				return isCtrl;
			}
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[name];
			if (gridSortInfo != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo) >= GroupCountInternal)
			{
				return GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection(allowedDirections, GridSortInfo.InvertSortDirection(gridSortInfo.SortOrder)) == actualDirection;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnColumnHeaderClickAddSort(string name, AllowedSortOrders allowedDirections, ListSortDirection direction, bool singleGroupSortMode)
		{
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[name];
			if (singleGroupSortMode && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count > 0 && gridSortInfo == null)
			{
				if (IsSingleGroup())
				{
					return;
				}
				if (IsSingleSort())
				{
					ClearSorting();
				}
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				if (gridSortInfo == null)
				{
					gridSortInfo = new GridSortInfo
					{
						FieldName = name,
						SortOrder = direction
					};
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Add(gridSortInfo);
				}
				else if (GridSortInfo.GetActualDirection(allowedDirections, GridSortInfo.InvertSortDirection(gridSortInfo.SortOrder)) != gridSortInfo.SortOrder)
				{
					if (((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo) >= GroupCountInternal)
					{
						((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
						gridSortInfo.ChangeSortOrder(name);
						((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Add(gridSortInfo);
					}
					else
					{
						gridSortInfo.ChangeSortOrder(name);
					}
				}
				VerifyDefaultSorting();
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<GridSortInfo>)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void OnColumnHeaderClickRemoveSort(string name)
		{
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[name];
			if (gridSortInfo != null && ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo) >= GroupCountInternal)
			{
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
			}
			VerifyDefaultSorting();
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, GridSortInfo item)
		{
			item.Owner = this;
			((ObservableCollection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).InsertItem(index, item);
		}

		protected override void RemoveItem(int index)
		{
			GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this)[index];
			gridSortInfo.Owner = null;
			((ObservableCollection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).RemoveItem(index);
			VerifyDefaultSorting();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsValid(GridSortInfo item)
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.FieldName);
		}

		internal void VerifyDefaultSorting()
		{
			if (LockVerifying || string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefaultSorting))
			{
				return;
			}
			LockVerifying = true;
			try
			{
				GridSortInfo gridSortInfo = this[DefaultSorting];
				if (gridSortInfo != null)
				{
					int num = ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).IndexOf(gridSortInfo);
					if (num < GroupCountInternal || num >= ((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Count - 1)
					{
						return;
					}
					((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Remove(gridSortInfo);
				}
				((Collection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).Add(new GridSortInfo(DefaultSorting, DefaultSortOrder));
			}
			finally
			{
				LockVerifying = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OnChanged()
		{
			((ObservableCollection<GridSortInfo>)(object)this).OnCollectionChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}
	}

	public abstract class PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase : DataTreeBuilder
	{
		protected static ColumnBase[] EmptyColumns = new ColumnBase[0];

		private IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumns;

		public DataTemplate PrintRowTemplate { get; private set; }

		public DataTemplate PrintHeaderTemplate { get; private set; }

		public RowData ReusingRowData { get; private set; }

		public double TotalHeaderWidth { get; private set; }

		public override bool SupportsHorizontalVirtualization => false;

		public DataTemplate PrintFooterTemplate { get; private set; }

		public DataTemplate PrintFixedFooterTemplate { get; private set; }

		protected IList<ColumnBase> VisibleColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibleColumns == null)
				{
					visibleColumns = GetPrintableColumns();
				}
				return visibleColumns;
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool GenerateBottomFixedRowInEnd => true;

		protected internal override bool IsPrinting => true;

		protected internal override int PageOffset => 0;

		protected internal override bool IsPagingMode => false;

		public PrintingDataTreeBuilderBase(DataViewBase view, double totalHeaderWidth)
			: base(view, null, null)
		{
			PrintRowTemplate = view.GetPrintRowTemplate();
			PrintHeaderTemplate = view.PrintHeaderTemplate;
			TotalHeaderWidth = totalHeaderWidth;
			ReusingRowData = CreateReusingRowData();
			PrintFooterTemplate = view.PrintFooterTemplate;
			PrintFixedFooterTemplate = view.PrintFixedFooterTemplate;
		}

		protected virtual IList<ColumnBase> GetPrintableColumns()
		{
			return base.View.PrintableColumns.ToList();
		}

		protected internal virtual RowData CreateReusingRowData()
		{
			return new RowData(this, updateOnlyData: false, updateSelectionState: false);
		}

		public abstract void GenerateAllItems();

		public abstract IDataNode CreateGroupPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode groupNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index, System.Windows.Size pageSize);

		public abstract IDataNode CreateDetailPrintingNode(NodeContainer container, RowNode rowNode, IDataNode parentNode, int index);

		protected virtual double GetBorderThickness()
		{
			return 1.0;
		}

		protected IList<T> CopyList<T>(IList<T> source)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>(source.Count);
			foreach (T item in source)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedNoneColumns()
		{
			return VisibleColumns;
		}

		internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetVisibleColumns()
		{
			return VisibleColumns;
		}

		internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedLeftColumns()
		{
			return EmptyColumns;
		}

		internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedRightColumns()
		{
			return EmptyColumns;
		}

		internal virtual void OnRootNodeDispose()
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class ItemsGenerationStrategyBase
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		private bool autoExpandAllGroups;

		protected DataViewBase View => view;

		protected DataProviderBase DataProvider => view.DataProviderBase;

		internal bool StoreOriginalRowHandles { get; set; } = true;

		public abstract bool RequireFullExpand { get; }

		public abstract string GetTotalSummaryText(ColumnBase column);

		public abstract string GetFixedTotalSummaryLeftText();

		public abstract string GetFixedTotalSummaryRightText();

		public ItemsGenerationStrategyBase(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void PrepareDataControllerAndPerformPrintingAction(Action printingAction)
		{
			try
			{
				GenerateAll();
				printingAction();
			}
			finally
			{
				ClearAll();
			}
		}

		public void GenerateAll()
		{
			autoExpandAllGroups = DataProvider.AutoExpandAllGroups;
			if (RequireFullExpand)
			{
				DataProvider.AutoExpandAllGroups = false;
			}
			GenerateAllCore();
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateAllCore()
		{
		}

		public void ClearAll()
		{
			ClearAllCore();
			if (RequireFullExpand)
			{
				DataProvider.AutoExpandAllGroups = autoExpandAllGroups;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearAllCore()
		{
		}

		public abstract object GetRowValue(RowData rowData);

		public abstract object GetCellValue(RowData rowData, string fieldName);

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
		}
	}

	public static class PrintHelper
	{
		private static readonly string ClipboardExportManagerTypeName;

		private static readonly string PrintHelperTypeName;

		private static Type printHelperType;

		private static Type clipboardExportManagerType;

		public static bool IsPrintingAvailable => printHelperType != null;

		static PrintHelper()
		{
			ClipboardExportManagerTypeName = "DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.ClipboardExportManager`2";
			PrintHelperTypeName = "DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.PrintHelper";
			Assembly assembly = AssemblyHelper.LoadDXAssembly("DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.v23.2");
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				assembly = Helpers.LoadWithPartialName("DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.v23.2, Version=23.2.4.0", false);
			}
			if (assembly != null)
			{
				printHelperType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(assembly, PrintHelperTypeName, false, (bool?)null);
				clipboardExportManagerType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(assembly, ClipboardExportManagerTypeName, false, (bool?)null);
			}
		}

		private static void CheckIsPrintingAvailable()
		{
			if (!IsPrintingAvailable)
			{
				throw new Exception("DevExpress.Xpf.Printing.v23.2 dll is not available.");
			}
		}

		private static object InvokeMemberCore(MethodBase prototypeMethod, BindingFlags flags, params object[] paramValues)
		{
			CheckIsPrintingAvailable();
			Type[] types = (from p in prototypeMethod.GetParameters()
				select p.ParameterType).ToArray();
			MethodInfo method = printHelperType.GetMethod(prototypeMethod.Name, flags, null, types, null);
			return method.Invoke(null, paramValues);
		}

		private static object InvokeMember(MethodBase prototypeMethod, params object[] paramValues)
		{
			return InvokeMemberCore(prototypeMethod, BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, paramValues);
		}

		private static object InvokeInternalMember(MethodBase prototypeMethod, params object[] paramValues)
		{
			return InvokeMemberCore(prototypeMethod, BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.NonPublic, paramValues);
		}

		public static object ClipboardExportManagerInstance(Type typeColumn, Type typeRow, object manager)
		{
			Type[] typeArguments = new Type[2] { typeColumn, typeRow };
			Type type = clipboardExportManagerType.MakeGenericType(typeArguments);
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type, manager);
		}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.HitTest
{
	public abstract class DataViewHitTestAcceptorBase : HitTestAcceptorBase<DataViewHitTestVisitorBase>
	{
		internal static int GetRowHandleByElement(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return RowData.FindRowData(element)?.RowHandle.Value ?? int.MinValue;
		}
	}

	public abstract class PeerCacheBase
	{
		private Dictionary<object, AutomationPeer> peers;

		protected Dictionary<object, AutomationPeer> Peers
		{
			get
			{
				if (peers == null)
				{
					peers = new Dictionary<object, AutomationPeer>();
				}
				return peers;
			}
		}

		public PeerCacheBase()
		{
		}

		public AutomationPeer GetPeer(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AutomationPeer value = null;
			Peers.TryGetValue(obj, out value);
			return value;
		}

		public void AddPeer(DependencyObject obj, AutomationPeer peer, bool checkShouldAdd)
		{
			if (!checkShouldAdd || ShouldAddPeerToCache(peer))
			{
				Peers.Add(obj, peer);
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool ShouldAddPeerToCache(AutomationPeer peer);
	}
	public class LogicalPeerCache
	{
		public Dictionary<int, AutomationPeer> DataRows { get; private set; }

		public Dictionary<int, AutomationPeer> GroupFooterRows { get; private set; }

		public LogicalPeerCache()
		{
			DataRows = new Dictionary<int, AutomationPeer>();
			GroupFooterRows = new Dictionary<int, AutomationPeer>();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			DataRows.Clear();
			GroupFooterRows.Clear();
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataControlAutomationPeerBase : FrameworkElementAutomationPeer, IAutomationPeerCreator
	{
		private DataControlBase dataControl;

		public DataControlBase DataControl => dataControl;

		protected DataControlAutomationPeerBase(DataControlBase dataControl, FrameworkElement element)
			: base(element)
		{
			this.dataControl = dataControl;
		}

		public virtual AutomationPeer CreatePeerCore(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return CreatePeerDefault(obj);
		}

		protected override List<AutomationPeer> GetChildrenCore()
		{
			return null;
		}

		AutomationPeer IAutomationPeerCreator.CreatePeer(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			AutomationPeer peer = DataControl.PeerCache.GetPeer(obj);
			if (peer != null)
			{
				return peer;
			}
			peer = CreatePeerCore(obj);
			DataControl.PeerCache.AddPeer(obj, peer, checkShouldAdd: true);
			return peer;
		}

		protected List<AutomationPeer> GetUIChildrenCore(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			return GetUIChildrenCore(obj, this);
		}

		protected void GetUIChildrenCore(DependencyObject obj, ref List<AutomationPeer> children)
		{
			GetUIChildrenCore(obj, this, ref children);
		}

		protected override void SetFocusCore()
		{
			DataControl.viewCore.Focus();
		}

		protected override bool IsKeyboardFocusableCore()
		{
			return DataControl.viewCore.Focusable;
		}

		protected override bool HasKeyboardFocusCore()
		{
			return DataControl.viewCore.IsFocused;
		}

		public static List<AutomationPeer> GetUIChildrenCore(DependencyObject obj, IAutomationPeerCreator owner)
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> children = null;
			GetUIChildrenCore(obj, owner, ref children);
			return children;
		}

		public static void GetUIChildrenCore(DependencyObject obj, IAutomationPeerCreator owner, ref List<AutomationPeer> children)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount(obj); i++)
			{
				DependencyObject child = VisualTreeHelper.GetChild(obj, i);
				automationPeer = null;
				if (child != null)
				{
					automationPeer = owner.CreatePeer(child);
					if (automationPeer != null)
					{
						if (children == null)
						{
							children = new List<AutomationPeer>();
						}
						children.Add(automationPeer);
					}
				}
				if (automationPeer == null)
				{
					GetUIChildrenCore(child, owner, ref children);
				}
			}
		}

		public static AutomationPeer CreatePeerDefault(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (obj is UIElement3D)
			{
				return UIElement3DAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(obj as UIElement3D);
			}
			if (obj is UIElement)
			{
				return UIElementAutomationPeer.CreatePeerForElement(obj as UIElement);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DependencyObject FindObjectInVisualTree(DependencyObject root, string objectName)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator(root);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is FrameworkElement && (val.Current as FrameworkElement).Name == objectName)
				{
					return val.Current;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static DependencyObject FindObjectInVisualTreeByType(DependencyObject root, Type objectType)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Expected O, but got Unknown
			VisualTreeEnumerator val = new VisualTreeEnumerator(root);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)val).MoveNext())
			{
				if (val.Current is FrameworkElement && objectType.IsAssignableFrom(val.Current.GetType()))
				{
					return val.Current;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static AutomationPeer FindParentAutomationPeerByType(AutomationPeer root, Type type)
		{
			AutomationPeer automationPeer = root;
			while (automationPeer != null && automationPeer.GetType() != type)
			{
				automationPeer = automationPeer.GetParent();
			}
			return automationPeer;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DataControlAutomationPeer : DataControlAutomationPeerBase, IGridProvider, IRawElementProviderSimple
	{
		int IGridProvider.ColumnCount => base.DataControl.ColumnsCore.Count;

		int IGridProvider.RowCount => base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;

		IRawElementProviderSimple IRawElementProviderSimple.HostRawElementProvider => null;

		ProviderOptions IRawElementProviderSimple.ProviderOptions => ProviderOptions.ClientSideProvider;

		protected abstract string ControlName { get; }

		public DataControlAutomationPeer(DataControlBase dataControl)
			: base(dataControl, dataControl)
		{
		}

		protected internal List<AutomationPeer> GetRowPeers()
		{
			List<AutomationPeer> list = new List<AutomationPeer>();
			for (int i = base.DataControl.DataView.PageVisibleTopRowIndex; i < base.DataControl.DataView.PageVisibleTopRowIndex + base.DataControl.DataView.PageVisibleDataRowCount; i++)
			{
				object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(i);
				if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is GroupSummaryRowKey)
				{
					list.Add(GetGroupFooterAutomationPeer(((GroupSummaryRowKey)visibleIndexByScrollIndex).RowHandle.Value));
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(GetRowPeer(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore((int)visibleIndexByScrollIndex)));
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected internal AutomationPeer GetRowPeer(int rowHandle)
		{
			AutomationPeer value = null;
			if (!base.DataControl.LogicalPeerCache.DataRows.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out value))
			{
				value = CreateRowPeer(rowHandle);
				base.DataControl.LogicalPeerCache.DataRows[rowHandle] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal void ClearLogicalPeerCache()
		{
			base.DataControl.logicalPeerCache?.Clear();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetDataPanelChildrenForce()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void ResetDataPanelPeerCache()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract AutomationPeer CreateRowPeer(int rowHandle);

		protected internal abstract AutomationPeer GetGroupFooterAutomationPeer(int rowHandle);

		protected internal abstract AutomationPeer GetCellPeer(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool force = false);

		protected internal abstract void ResetDataPanelPeer();

		protected internal abstract void ResetHeadersChildrenCache();

		protected internal abstract void ResetPeers();

		IRawElementProviderSimple IGridProvider.GetItem(int row, int column)
		{
			if (column >= base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(row);
			base.DataControl.DataView.ScrollIntoView(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			base.DataControl.UpdateLayout();
			ResetDataPanelChildrenForce();
			AutomationPeer cellPeer = GetCellPeer(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, base.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleColumnsCore[column], force: true);
			return ProviderFromPeer(cellPeer);
		}

		object IRawElementProviderSimple.GetPatternProvider(int patternId)
		{
			if (patternId == GridPatternIdentifiers.ColumnCountProperty.Id)
			{
				return ((IGridProvider)this).ColumnCount;
			}
			if (patternId == GridPatternIdentifiers.RowCountProperty.Id)
			{
				return ((IGridProvider)this).RowCount;
			}
			return null;
		}

		object IRawElementProviderSimple.GetPropertyValue(int propertyId)
		{
			if (propertyId == AutomationElementIdentifiers.NameProperty.Id)
			{
				return "";
			}
			if (propertyId == AutomationElementIdentifiers.ClassNameProperty.Id)
			{
				return ControlName;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class EditFormCellData : EditFormCellDataBase, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public delegate void ValueChangedEventHandler(object sender, EventArgs e);

		private bool readOnlyCore;

		private IDefaultEditorViewInfo editorViewInfoCore;

		private BaseValidationError validationErrorCore;

		private bool lockChangingNotification;

		private object valueCore;

		private object initialValue;

		private bool isValueInited;

		public BaseEditSettings EditSettings { get; internal set; }

		public string FieldName { get; internal set; }

		internal DataTemplate EditorTemplate { get; set; }

		public int VisibleIndex { get; internal set; }

		public EditFormRowData RowData { get; internal set; }

		public bool ReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				return readOnlyCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (!IsColumnReadonly)
				{
					readOnlyCore = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ReadOnly");
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsColumnReadonly { get; private set; }

		public IDefaultEditorViewInfo EditorViewInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return (IDefaultEditorViewInfo)(((object)editorViewInfoCore) ?? ((object)EmptyDefaultEditorViewInfo.Instance));
			}
			set
			{
				editorViewInfoCore = value;
			}
		}

		protected override EditFormLayoutItemType ItemTypeCore => EditFormLayoutItemType.Editor;

		public BaseValidationError ValidationError
		{
			get
			{
				return validationErrorCore;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (validationErrorCore != value)
				{
					validationErrorCore = value;
					RaisePropertyChanged("ValidationError");
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasInnerError { get; set; }

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return valueCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (valueCore == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				object obj = valueCore;
				if (!lockChangingNotification)
				{
					lockChangingNotification = true;
					CellEditorData[] datas = RowData?.EditFormOwner.OnEditValueChanging(this, value, valueCore);
					if (RowData != null && RowData.EditFormCellData != null)
					{
						ApplyCellValueChangingData(datas);
					}
					lockChangingNotification = false;
				}
				if (valueCore == obj)
				{
					valueCore = value;
				}
				if (!isValueInited)
				{
					initialValue = value;
					isValueInited = true;
				}
				RaiseValueChangedEvent();
			}
		}

		internal BindingBase IsReadOnlyBinding { get; set; }

		internal BindingBase IsEnabledBinding { get; set; }

		public event ValueChangedEventHandler ValueChangedEvent;

		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		internal void SetInitValue(object value)
		{
			valueCore = value;
			if (!isValueInited)
			{
				initialValue = value;
				isValueInited = true;
			}
		}

		private void ApplyCellValueChangingData(CellEditorData[] datas)
		{
			IEnumerable<EditFormCellData> source = RowData.EditFormCellData.OfType<EditFormCellData>();
			foreach (CellEditorData data in datas)
			{
				EditFormCellData editFormCellData = source.First((EditFormCellData e) => e.FieldName == data.FieldName);
				if (!object.Equals(editFormCellData.Value, data.Value))
				{
					editFormCellData.Value = data.Value;
				}
				if (!object.Equals(editFormCellData.ReadOnly, data.ReadOnly))
				{
					editFormCellData.ReadOnly = data.ReadOnly;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetValue()
		{
			if (isValueInited)
			{
				Value = initialValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void RaiseValueChangedEvent()
		{
			if (this.ValueChangedEvent != null)
			{
				this.ValueChangedEvent(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected internal override void Assign(EditFormColumnSource source)
		{
			base.Assign(source);
			FieldName = source.FieldName;
			EditSettings = source.EditSettings;
			EditorTemplate = source.EditorTemplate;
			ReadOnly = source.ReadOnly;
			IsColumnReadonly = source.ReadOnly;
			EditorViewInfo = source.EditorViewInfo;
			IsReadOnlyBinding = source.IsReadOnlyBinding;
			IsEnabledBinding = source.IsEnabledBinding;
		}

		private void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}

	public class EditFormLayoutCalculator
	{
		private int columnCountCore = 1;

		public int ColumnCount
		{
			get
			{
				return columnCountCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (columnCountCore != value)
				{
					columnCountCore = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual EditFormLayoutSettings LayoutSettings { get; protected set; }

		internal virtual void SetPositions(IEnumerable<IEditFormLayoutItem> items)
		{
			LayoutMatrix layoutMatrix = new LayoutMatrix(ColumnCount);
			Row row = layoutMatrix.AddNewRow();
			foreach (IEditFormLayoutItem item in items)
			{
				if (!ValidateItem(item))
				{
					return;
				}
				while (!row.TryAddItem(item))
				{
					row = layoutMatrix.GetNextRow(row.Index);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < item.RowSpan - 1; i++)
				{
					Row nextRow = layoutMatrix.GetNextRow(row.Index + i);
					nextRow.FillSlotRange(item);
				}
			}
			UpdateLayoutSettings(layoutMatrix);
		}

		private void UpdateLayoutSettings(LayoutMatrix layoutMatrix)
		{
			int count = layoutMatrix.Count;
			if (ColumnCount != LayoutSettings.ColumnCount || count != LayoutSettings.RowCount)
			{
				LayoutSettings = new EditFormLayoutSettings(ColumnCount, count);
			}
		}

		private bool ValidateItem(IEditFormLayoutItem item)
		{
			if (item.ColumnSpan > 0 && item.RowSpan > 0)
			{
				return item.ColumnSpan <= ColumnCount;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal interface IEditFormLayoutItem
	{
		int Column { get; set; }

		int Row { get; set; }

		int ColumnSpan { get; set; }

		int RowSpan { get; set; }

		bool StartNewRow { get; }

		EditFormLayoutItemType ItemType { get; }
	}
	public enum EditFormLayoutItemType
	{
		None,
		Caption,
		Editor
	}
	internal class LayoutMatrix : List<Row>
	{
		private readonly int columnCount;

		public LayoutMatrix(int columnCount)
		{
			this.columnCount = columnCount;
		}

		public Row GetNextRow(int currentIndex)
		{
			Row row = null;
			if (currentIndex == base.Count - 1)
			{
				return AddNewRow();
			}
			return base[currentIndex + 1];
		}

		public Row AddNewRow()
		{
			Row row = new Row(columnCount, base.Count);
			Add(row);
			return row;
		}
	}
	internal class Row
	{
		private int columnCount;

		private int rowIndex;

		private const int IncorrectSlotIndex = -1;

		private bool[] slots;

		public int Index => rowIndex;

		public Row(int columnCount, int index)
		{
			this.columnCount = columnCount;
			rowIndex = index;
			slots = new bool[columnCount];
		}

		public bool TryAddItem(IEditFormLayoutItem item)
		{
			int num = FindIndexOfFreeSlotRange(item.ColumnSpan);
			if (num == -1 || (item.StartNewRow && num != 0))
			{
				FillSlotRange(0, columnCount);
				return false;
			}
			item.Column = num;
			item.Row = rowIndex;
			FillSlotRange(0, item.Column + item.ColumnSpan);
			return true;
		}

		private int FindIndexOfFreeSlotRange(int rangeSize)
		{
			int result = -1;
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < slots.Length; i++)
			{
				if (!slots[i])
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						result = i;
					}
					num++;
				}
				else
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				if (num == rangeSize)
				{
					return result;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public void FillSlotRange(IEditFormLayoutItem item)
		{
			FillSlotRange(item.Column, item.ColumnSpan);
		}

		public void FillSlotRange(int startSlotIndex, int rangeSize)
		{
			for (int i = startSlotIndex; i < startSlotIndex + rangeSize; i++)
			{
				slots[i] = true;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class CaptionedLayoutItem : IEditFormLayoutItem
	{
		private readonly IEditFormLayoutItem captionCore;

		private readonly IEditFormLayoutItem editorCore;

		private int columnCore;

		private int rowCore;

		private bool startNewRowCore;

		private IEditFormLayoutItem Caption => captionCore;

		private IEditFormLayoutItem Editor => editorCore;

		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				return columnCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (columnCore != value)
				{
					columnCore = value;
					SyncColumn();
				}
			}
		}

		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				return rowCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rowCore != value)
				{
					rowCore = value;
					SyncRow();
				}
			}
		}

		public int ColumnSpan { get; set; }

		public int RowSpan { get; set; }

		public bool StartNewRow => startNewRowCore;

		public EditFormLayoutItemType ItemType => EditFormLayoutItemType.None;

		public CaptionedLayoutItem(IEditFormLayoutItem caption, IEditFormLayoutItem editor)
		{
			captionCore = caption;
			editorCore = editor;
			ColumnSpan = editorCore.ColumnSpan;
			RowSpan = editorCore.RowSpan;
			startNewRowCore = editorCore.StartNewRow;
			Caption.ColumnSpan = 1;
			Caption.RowSpan = 1;
			Editor.ColumnSpan = Editor.ColumnSpan * 2 - 1;
			SyncColumn();
			SyncRow();
		}

		private void SyncColumn()
		{
			Caption.Column = Column * 2;
			Editor.Column = Caption.Column + 1;
		}

		private void SyncRow()
		{
			Caption.Row = Row;
			Editor.Row = Row;
		}
	}
