	}
	public interface IEditFormManager
	{
		bool IsEditFormVisible { get; }

		bool IsEditFormModified { get; }

		bool AllowEditForm { get; }

		Locker EditFormOpenLocker { get; }

		void OnDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e);

		void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e);

		void OnEditFormClosed(bool success);

		void OnIsModifiedChanged(bool isModified);

		bool RequestUIUpdate(bool skipUIMessages = false);

		void OnBeforeScroll(int targetRowHandle);

		void OnAfterScroll();

		bool IsInlineFormChild(DependencyObject source);

		EditFormRowData GetInplaceData(int rowHandle);
	}
	public class EditFormManager : IEditFormManager
	{
		private class UIUpdateResultWrapper
		{
			private readonly Func<bool> executeAction;

			public UIUpdateResultWrapper(Func<bool> executeAction)
			{
				this.executeAction = executeAction;
			}

			public bool Execute()
			{
				if (executeAction != null)
				{
					return executeAction();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private readonly ITableView view;

		private bool isPopupEditFormVisibleCore;

		private IMessageBoxService messageBoxServiceCore = (IMessageBoxService)new DXMessageBoxService();

		private readonly Locker editFormOpenLocker = new Locker();

		private EditFormRowData inplaceEditFormDataCore;

		private int? editFormInplaceRowHandle;

		private bool isEditFormModifiedCore;

		private Locker scrollLocker = new Locker();

		private EditFormCommitter committerCore;

		private bool IsPopupEditFormVisible
		{
			get
			{
				return isPopupEditFormVisibleCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isPopupEditFormVisibleCore != value)
				{
					isPopupEditFormVisibleCore = value;
					if (View != null)
					{
						View.IsEditing = value;
					}
					UpdateIndicatorState();
				}
			}
		}

		protected ITableView TableView => view;

		protected DataViewBase View => TableView.ViewBase;

		public IMessageBoxService MessageBoxService
		{
			get
			{
				return messageBoxServiceCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (messageBoxServiceCore != value)
				{
					messageBoxServiceCore = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public Locker EditFormOpenLocker => editFormOpenLocker;

		private EditFormRowData InplaceEditFormData
		{
			get
			{
				return inplaceEditFormDataCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (inplaceEditFormDataCore != value)
				{
					inplaceEditFormDataCore = value;
					OnInplaceEditFormDataChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool IsInlineEditFormVisible => InplaceEditFormData != null;

		public bool IsEditFormVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsPopupEditFormVisible)
				{
					return IsInlineEditFormVisible;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool IsEditFormModified => isEditFormModifiedCore;

		public bool AllowEditForm => TableView.EditFormShowMode != EditFormShowMode.None;

		private EditFormCommitter Committer
		{
			get
			{
				if (committerCore == null)
				{
					committerCore = CreateEditFormCommitter();
				}
				return committerCore;
			}
		}

		public EditFormManager(ITableView view)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("view");
			}
			this.view = view;
		}

		protected internal virtual EditFormRowData CreateEditFormData(CellEditorData[] settings)
		{
			EditFormRowData editFormRowData = new EditFormRowData(settings, CreateEditFormOwner());
			editFormRowData.Committer = Committer;
			return editFormRowData;
		}

		internal IEditFormOwner CreateEditFormOwner()
		{
			return View.CreateEditFormOwner();
		}

		public void ShowDialogEditForm()
		{
			ShowEditForm(delegate(IEditStartingEventArgs settings)
			{
				AssignableServiceHelper2<FrameworkElement, IDialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)View.RootView, TableView.EditFormDialogServiceTemplate, (Action<IDialogService>)delegate(IDialogService service)
				{
					ShowDialogEditFromCore(settings, service);
				});
			});
		}

		private void ShowDialogEditFromCore(IEditStartingEventArgs settings, IDialogService service)
		{
			IsPopupEditFormVisible = true;
			EditFormRowData data = CreateEditFormData(settings.CellEditors);
			data.CanShowUpdateCancelButtons = false;
			List<UICommand> list = UICommand.GenerateFromMessageBoxButton(MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, new EditFormPopupButtonLocalizer());
			list[0].Command = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(delegate(CancelEventArgs x)
			{
				x.Cancel = !data.TryCommit();
			});
			list[1].Command = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(delegate
			{
				data.Cancel();
			});
			UICommand uICommand = service.ShowDialog(list, CreateDialogTitle(), data);
			if (uICommand == null)
			{
				data.Cancel();
			}
			IsPopupEditFormVisible = false;
		}

		private string CreateDialogTitle()
		{
			return GetBindingValue(TableView.EditFormCaptionBinding, View.GetRowData(View.FocusedRowHandle));
		}

		private void BeforeShowEditForm()
		{
			View.ViewBehavior.BeforeShowEditForm();
		}

		private string GetBindingValue(BindingBase binding, object content)
		{
			if (binding == null || content == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BindingBase bindingBase = BindingCloneHelper.Clone(binding, content);
			if (bindingBase == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			BindingValueEvaluator bindingValueEvaluator = new BindingValueEvaluator(bindingBase);
			if (bindingValueEvaluator.Value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return bindingValueEvaluator.Value.ToString();
		}

		private RowData GetActiveInplaceRowData()
		{
			if (editFormInplaceRowHandle.HasValue)
			{
				return View.GetRowData(editFormInplaceRowHandle.Value);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnInplaceEditFormDataChanged()
		{
			View.UpdateColumns(delegate(ColumnBase column)
			{
				column.UpdateEditFormViewInfo();
			});
			View.UpdateCellMergingPanels();
			UpdateIndicatorState();
		}

		private void UpdateIndicatorState()
		{
			RowData rowData = View.GetRowData(View.FocusedRowHandle);
			rowData.Do(delegate(RowData x)
			{
				x.UpdateIndicatorState();
			});
		}

		public void ShowInlineEditForm()
		{
			if (View.IsTopNewItemRowFocused && TableView.UseLightweightTemplates.HasValue && !TableView.UseLightweightTemplates.Value.HasFlag(UseLightweightTemplates.NewItemRow))
			{
				return;
			}
			View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				ShowEditForm(delegate(IEditStartingEventArgs settings)
				{
					int focusedRowHandle = View.FocusedRowHandle;
					editFormInplaceRowHandle = focusedRowHandle;
					InplaceEditFormData = CreateEditFormData(settings.CellEditors);
					InplaceEditFormData.CanShowUpdateCancelButtons = true;
					RowData activeInplaceRowData = GetActiveInplaceRowData();
					if (activeInplaceRowData != null)
					{
						activeInplaceRowData.UpdateClientInlineEditForm();
						View.ScrollIntoView(focusedRowHandle);
					}
				});
			});
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.IsEditing = true;
			}
		}

		public void HideEditForm()
		{
			CloseActiveInplaceFormCore(delegate(EditFormRowData x)
			{
				x.Cancel();
			});
		}

		public bool CloseEditForm()
		{
			bool result = false;
			CloseActiveInplaceFormCore(delegate(EditFormRowData x)
			{
				result = x.TryCommit();
			});
			return !result;
		}

		private void CloseActiveInplaceForm()
		{
			CloseActiveInplaceFormCore(delegate(EditFormRowData x)
			{
				x.Close(IsEditFormModified ? new bool?(false) : ((bool?)null));
			});
		}

		private void CloseActiveInplaceFormCore(Action<EditFormRowData> closeAction)
		{
			if (InplaceEditFormData != null)
			{
				closeAction(InplaceEditFormData);
			}
		}

		public void OnEditFormClosed(bool success)
		{
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.IsEditing = false;
			}
			if (success && isEditFormModifiedCore && Committer.IsLocked)
			{
				View.OnComittingEditFormValue(editFormInplaceRowHandle ?? View.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			isEditFormModifiedCore = false;
			InplaceEditFormData = null;
			GetActiveInplaceRowData().Do(delegate(RowData x)
			{
				x.UpdateClientInlineEditForm();
			});
			editFormInplaceRowHandle = null;
			if (success)
			{
				Committer.Commit();
			}
			else
			{
				View.CancelRowEdit();
			}
			View.ProcessFocusedElement();
		}

		public void OnIsModifiedChanged(bool isModified)
		{
			isEditFormModifiedCore = isModified;
			UpdateIndicatorState();
		}

		public void ShowEditForm()
		{
			switch (TableView.EditFormShowMode)
			{
			case EditFormShowMode.Dialog:
				ShowDialogEditForm();
				break;
			case EditFormShowMode.Inline:
			case EditFormShowMode.InlineHideRow:
				ShowInlineEditForm();
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanShowEditForm()
		{
			if (View.DataControl != null && !IsEditFormVisible && View.FocusedRowHandle != int.MinValue && View.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds() && !View.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return View.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483645;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ShowEditForm(Action<IEditStartingEventArgs> showAction)
		{
			EditFormOpenLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (CanShowEditForm())
				{
					EditFormShowingEventArgs e = new EditFormShowingEventArgs(View.FocusedRowHandle);
					TableView.RaiseEditFormShowing(e);
					if (e.Allow)
					{
						CellEditorData[] cellEditors = CreateCellEditorData(View.FocusedRowHandle);
						CellEditorData[] secondData = CreateCellEditorData(View.FocusedRowHandle);
						IEditStartingEventArgs e2 = TableView.RaiseRowEditStarting(View.FocusedRowHandle, cellEditors);
						if (!e2.Cancel)
						{
							BeforeShowEditForm();
							Action<IEditStartingEventArgs> action = showAction;
							IEditStartingEventArgs obj;
							if (!DataViewBase.IsCellEditorDatasEqual(e2.CellEditors, secondData))
							{
								obj = e2;
							}
							else
							{
								IEditStartingEventArgs e3 = new EditStartingSettings(e2.Cancel, CreateCellEditorData(View.FocusedRowHandle));
								obj = e3;
							}
							action(obj);
						}
					}
				}
			});
		}

		internal CellEditorData[] CreateCellEditorData(int rowHandle)
		{
			return (from ColumnBase c in View.ColumnsCore
				where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(c.FieldName) && EditFormOwner.CalcVisible(c)
				select new CellEditorData(View.DataControl.GetCellValue(rowHandle, c.FieldName), c.FieldName, View.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsColumnReadonly(c.FieldName, requireColumn: false))).ToArray();
		}

		public virtual bool RequestUIUpdate(bool skipUIMessages = false)
		{
			UIUpdateResultWrapper uIUpdateResultWrapper = CalcUIUpdateResult(skipUIMessages) ?? new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => false);
			return !uIUpdateResultWrapper.Execute();
		}

		private UIUpdateResultWrapper CalcUIUpdateResult(bool skipUIMessages = false)
		{
			if (InplaceEditFormData == null || scrollLocker.IsLocked || Committer.IsActive)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (skipUIMessages)
			{
				return new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => CloseEditForm());
			}
			if (InplaceEditFormData.IsModified)
			{
				return GetModifiedRowResult();
			}
			if (!View.IsNewItemRowFocused)
			{
				return new UIUpdateResultWrapper(delegate
				{
					CloseActiveInplaceForm();
					return false;
				});
			}
			return new UIUpdateResultWrapper(delegate
			{
				HideEditForm();
				return false;
			});
		}

		private UIUpdateResultWrapper GetModifiedRowResult()
		{
			return TableView.EditFormPostConfirmation switch
			{
				PostConfirmationMode.YesNoCancel => GetSaveDialogResult(ShowRowChangeMessage(Localize(GridControlStringId.EditForm_Modified), MessageButton.YesNoCancel)), 
				PostConfirmationMode.YesNo => GetCancelDialogResult(ShowRowChangeMessage(Localize(GridControlStringId.EditForm_Cancel), MessageButton.YesNo)), 
				PostConfirmationMode.None => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => true), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private UIUpdateResultWrapper GetSaveDialogResult(MessageResult messageResult)
		{
			return messageResult switch
			{
				MessageResult.Yes => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => CloseEditForm()), 
				MessageResult.No => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(delegate
				{
					HideEditForm();
					return false;
				}), 
				MessageResult.Cancel => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => true), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private UIUpdateResultWrapper GetCancelDialogResult(MessageResult messageResult)
		{
			return messageResult switch
			{
				MessageResult.Yes => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(delegate
				{
					HideEditForm();
					return false;
				}), 
				MessageResult.No => new UIUpdateResultWrapper(() => true), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private MessageResult ShowRowChangeMessage(string message, MessageButton button)
		{
			return MessageBoxService.ShowMessage(message, Localize(GridControlStringId.EditForm_Warning), button, MessageIcon.None, MessageResult.Yes);
		}

		private static string Localize(GridControlStringId id)
		{
			return GridControlLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		public void OnDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (TableView.ShowEditFormOnDoubleClick)
			{
				ShowEditForm();
			}
		}

		public void OnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			Key key = e.Key;
			if (key == Key.Return && ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				CloseEditForm();
			}
			else if ((key == Key.F2 && TableView.ShowEditFormOnF2Key) || (key == Key.Return && TableView.ShowEditFormOnEnterKey))
			{
				ShowEditForm();
			}
			else if (key == Key.Escape && View.IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				HideEditForm();
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public void OnBeforeScroll(int targetRowHandle)
		{
			if (editFormInplaceRowHandle.HasValue && editFormInplaceRowHandle.Value == targetRowHandle)
			{
				scrollLocker.Lock();
			}
		}

		public void OnAfterScroll()
		{
			scrollLocker.Unlock();
		}

		public bool IsInlineFormChild(DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (source == null || !IsInlineEditFormVisible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = GetActiveInplaceRowData().With((RowData x) => x.RowElement);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return LayoutHelper.IsChildElementEx(dependencyObject, source, false);
		}

		public EditFormRowData GetInplaceData(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (editFormInplaceRowHandle.HasValue && editFormInplaceRowHandle.Value == rowHandle)
			{
				return InplaceEditFormData;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private EditFormCommitter CreateEditFormCommitter()
		{
			return new EditFormCommitter(View);
		}
	}
	internal class EditFormPopupButtonLocalizer : IMessageBoxButtonLocalizer
	{
		public string Localize(MessageBoxResult button)
		{
			return button switch
			{
				MessageBoxResult.OK => Localize(GridControlStringId.EditForm_UpdateButton), 
				MessageBoxResult.Cancel => Localize(GridControlStringId.EditForm_CancelButton), 
				_ => string.Empty, 
			};
		}

		private static string Localize(GridControlStringId id)
		{
			return GridControlLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}
	}
	public class EmptyEditFormManager : IEditFormManager

	internal abstract class EditFormCommitterBase
	{
		private Locker commitLocker = new Locker();

		public bool IsActive { get; private set; }

		internal bool IsLocked => commitLocker.IsLocked;

		public bool Commit()
		{
			if (commitLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IsActive = true;
			bool flag = false;
			try
			{
				return CommitCore();
			}
			finally
			{
				IsActive = false;
			}
		}

		public void DoCommitProtectedAction(Action action)
		{
			commitLocker.DoLockedAction(action);
		}

		protected abstract bool CommitCore();
	}
	internal class EditFormCommitter : EditFormCommitterBase
	{
		private readonly DataViewBase view;

		public EditFormCommitter(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("view");
			}
			this.view = view;
		}

		protected override bool CommitCore()
		{
			return view.CommitEditingInternal();
		}
	}
	public interface IEditFormOwner
	{
		int ColumnCount { get; }

		bool ShowUpdateCancelButtons { get; }

		EditFormPostMode EditMode { get; }

		object Source { get; }

		bool IsEditing { get; set; }

		bool AllowLeaveInvalidEditor { get; }

		IEnumerable<EditFormColumnSource> CreateEditFormColumnSource();

		object GetValue(EditFormCellData data);

		void SetValue(EditFormCellData data);

		void OnEditFormClosed(bool? success);

		BaseValidationError Validate(EditFormCellData data);

		void OnIsModifiedChanged(bool isModified);

		CellEditorData[] OnEditValueChanging(EditFormCellData data, object value, object oldValue);

		void OnEditFormOpened();

		void EnqueueImmediateAction(Action action);
	}
	public class EditFormOwner : IEditFormOwner
	{
		private readonly ITableView view;

		private const string CaptionSeparator = ":";

		private int editFormRowHandle;

		internal DataControlBase Grid => DataView.DataControl;

		private DataViewBase DataView => view.ViewBase;

		public int ColumnCount => view.EditFormColumnCount;

		public bool ShowUpdateCancelButtons => view.ShowEditFormUpdateCancelButtons;

		public EditFormPostMode EditMode => view.EditFormPostMode;

		public object Source => DataView.GetRowData(editFormRowHandle);

		public bool IsEditing
		{
			get
			{
				return DataView.IsEditing;
			}
			set
			{
				DataView.IsEditing = value;
			}
		}

		bool IEditFormOwner.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataView == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return DataView.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor;
			}
		}

		public EditFormOwner(ITableView view)
		{
			if (view == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("view");
			}
			this.view = view;
			editFormRowHandle = DataView.FocusedRowHandle;
		}

		IEnumerable<EditFormColumnSource> IEditFormOwner.CreateEditFormColumnSource()
		{
			return CreateEditFormColumnSource();
		}

		internal virtual IEnumerable<EditFormColumnSource> CreateEditFormColumnSource()
		{
			IEnumerable<ColumnBase> source = Grid.ColumnsCore.Cast<ColumnBase>();
			Func<ColumnBase, int> visibleIndexSelector = CreateVisibleIndexSelector(source.Any((ColumnBase x) => x.EditFormVisibleIndex != 0));
			bool defaultAllowEditing = DataView.AllowEditing;
			return source.Select((ColumnBase x) => CreateEditFormColumnSource(x, visibleIndexSelector, defaultAllowEditing));
		}

		private static EditFormColumnSource CreateEditFormColumnSource(ColumnBase column, Func<ColumnBase, int> visibleIndexSelector, bool defaultAllowEditing)
		{
			return new EditFormColumnSource
			{
				FieldName = column.FieldName,
				EditSettings = column.ActualEditSettings,
				Caption = CalcCaption(column),
				ColumnSpan = column.EditFormColumnSpan,
				RowSpan = column.EditFormRowSpan,
				StartNewRow = column.EditFormStartNewRow,
				Visible = CalcVisible(column),
				VisibleIndex = visibleIndexSelector(column),
				EditorTemplate = column.EditFormTemplate,
				ReadOnly = CalcReadOnly(column, defaultAllowEditing),
				EditorViewInfo = (IDefaultEditorViewInfo)(object)column,
				IsReadOnlyBinding = column.IsReadOnlyEditFormBinding,
				IsEnabledBinding = column.IsEnabledEditFormBinding
			};
		}

		private static bool CalcReadOnly(ColumnBase column, bool defaultAllowEditing)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!column.IsActualReadOnly && (int)column.AllowEditing != 1)
			{
				if ((int)column.AllowEditing == 2)
				{
					return !defaultAllowEditing;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static object CalcCaption(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column.EditFormCaption != null)
			{
				return column.EditFormCaption;
			}
			if (column.HeaderCaption == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return column.HeaderCaption.ToString() + ":";
		}

		internal static bool CalcVisible(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!column.EditFormVisible.HasValue)
			{
				return column.Visible;
			}
			return column.EditFormVisible.Value;
		}

		private static Func<ColumnBase, int> CreateVisibleIndexSelector(bool useEditFormIndexes)
		{
			if (useEditFormIndexes)
			{
				return (ColumnBase x) => x.EditFormVisibleIndex;
			}
			return (ColumnBase x) => x.ActualVisibleIndex;
		}

		public object GetValue(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			return Grid.GetCellValue(editFormRowHandle, data.FieldName);
		}

		public void SetValue(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			Locker val = Grid.DataView.CommitEditingLocker.Lock();
			try
			{
				Grid.SetCellValueCore(editFormRowHandle, data.FieldName, data.Value);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				data.ValidationError = (BaseValidationError)(object)RowValidationHelper.CreateEditorValidationError(DataView, editFormRowHandle, exception, GetColumn(data));
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		public BaseValidationError Validate(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			ColumnBase column = GetColumn(data);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			BaseValidationError val = null;
			if (data.HasInnerError)
			{
				val = (BaseValidationError)(object)RowValidationHelper.CreateEditorValidationError(DataView, editFormRowHandle, null, column);
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (BaseValidationError)(object)(column.ActualShowValidationAttributeErrors ? RowValidationHelper.ValidateAttributes(DataView, data.Value, editFormRowHandle, column) : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			return (BaseValidationError)(object)RowValidationHelper.ValidateEvents(DataView, data, data.Value, editFormRowHandle, column);
		}

		private ColumnBase GetColumn(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			return Grid.ColumnsCore[data.FieldName];
		}

		public void OnEditFormClosed(bool? success)
		{
			DataView.EditFormManager.OnEditFormClosed(success == true);
			view.RaiseRowEditFinished(editFormRowHandle, success);
		}

		public void OnIsModifiedChanged(bool isModified)
		{
			DataView.EditFormManager.OnIsModifiedChanged(isModified);
		}

		public void EnqueueImmediateAction(Action action)
		{
			DataView.EnqueueImmediateAction(action);
		}

		private CellEditorData[] CreateCellEditorData(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			return (from c in data.RowData.EditFormCellData.OfType<EditFormCellData>()
				select new CellEditorData(c.Value, c.FieldName, c.ReadOnly)).ToArray();
		}

		public CellEditorData[] OnEditValueChanging(EditFormCellData data, object value, object oldValue)
		{
			if (Source == null)
			{
				return EmptyArray<CellEditorData>.Instance;
			}
			int value2 = ((RowData)Source).RowHandle.Value;
			CellEditorData[] array = CreateCellEditorData(data);
			((ITableView)Grid.DataView).RaiseCellValueChangingInEditForm(value2, Grid.DataView.ColumnsCore[data.FieldName], value, oldValue, array);
			return array;
		}

		public void OnEditFormOpened()
		{
			int value = ((RowData)Source).RowHandle.Value;
			view.RaiseRowEditStarted(value);
		}
	}

	public class EditFormRowData : ImmutableObject
	{
		private IEditFormOwner editFormOwnerCore;

		private bool isModifiedCore;

		private bool canShowUpdateCancelPanelCore = true;

		private Dictionary<string, EditFormCellData> editorDataCache = new Dictionary<string, EditFormCellData>();

		public ICommand EditFormLoadedCommand { get; private set; }

		internal IEditFormOwner EditFormOwner
		{
			get
			{
				return editFormOwnerCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editFormOwnerCore != value)
				{
					editFormOwnerCore = value;
					OnEditFormOwnerChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private IEditFormOwner ActualEditFormOwner { get; set; }

		public IList<EditFormCellDataBase> EditFormCellData { get; protected set; }

		public EditFormLayoutSettings LayoutSettings { get; protected set; }

		public bool IsModified
		{
			get
			{
				return isModifiedCore;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (isModifiedCore != value)
				{
					isModifiedCore = value;
					OnIsModifiedChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowUpdateCancelButtons { get; protected set; }

		public object Source { get; protected set; }

		internal bool CanShowUpdateCancelButtons
		{
			get
			{
				return canShowUpdateCancelPanelCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (canShowUpdateCancelPanelCore != value)
				{
					canShowUpdateCancelPanelCore = value;
					RefreshUpdateCancelPanel();
				}
			}
		}

		internal EditFormCommitterBase Committer { get; set; }

		public ICommand CommitCommand { get; private set; }

		public ICommand CancelCommand { get; private set; }

		public ICommand CloseCommand { get; private set; }

		public EditFormRowData()
		{
			Init();
		}

		public EditFormRowData(CellEditorData[] settings, IEditFormOwner owner)
		{
			Init();
			EditFormOwner = owner;
			IEnumerable<EditFormCellData> enumerable = EditFormCellData.OfType<EditFormCellData>();
			foreach (var item in enumerable.Select((EditFormCellData item, int i) => new { item, i }))
			{
				EditFormCellData data = item.item;
				if (!data.IsColumnReadonly)
				{
					CellEditorData cellEditorData = settings.First((CellEditorData x) => x.FieldName == data.FieldName);
					if (!object.Equals(data.Value, cellEditorData.Value))
					{
						data.SetInitValue(cellEditorData.Value);
					}
					if (data.ReadOnly != cellEditorData.ReadOnly)
					{
						data.ReadOnly = cellEditorData.ReadOnly;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (EditFormCellData item2 in enumerable)
			{
				Validate(item2);
			}
		}

		private void Init()
		{
			ActualEditFormOwner = EmptyEditFormOwner.Instance;
			CancelCommand = new DelegateCommand(Cancel);
			CommitCommand = new DelegateCommand(Commit);
			EditFormLoadedCommand = new DelegateCommand(delegate
			{
				EditFormOwner.OnEditFormOpened();
			});
		}

		private void OnIsModifiedChanged()
		{
			ActualEditFormOwner.OnIsModifiedChanged(IsModified);
		}

		protected void OnEditFormOwnerChanged()
		{
			ActualEditFormOwner = EditFormOwner ?? EmptyEditFormOwner.Instance;
			UnsubscribeFromData();
			RefreshUpdateCancelPanel();
			Source = ActualEditFormOwner.Source;
			if (Source == null)
			{
				ActualEditFormOwner.EnqueueImmediateAction(delegate
				{
					Source = ((ActualEditFormOwner != null) ? ActualEditFormOwner.Source : Source);
				});
			}
			int columnCount = ((ActualEditFormOwner.ColumnCount <= 0) ? 1 : ActualEditFormOwner.ColumnCount);
			List<EditFormCellDataBase> list = CreateCellData(columnCount);
			EditFormLayoutCalculator editFormLayoutCalculator = CreateLayoutCalculator(columnCount);
			UpdatePositions(list, editFormLayoutCalculator);
			LayoutSettings = new EditFormLayoutSettings(editFormLayoutCalculator.LayoutSettings.ColumnCount * 2, editFormLayoutCalculator.LayoutSettings.RowCount);
			EditFormCellData = list;
		}

		private List<EditFormCellDataBase> CreateCellData(int columnCount)
		{
			List<EditFormCellDataBase> list = new List<EditFormCellDataBase>();
			IEnumerable<EditFormColumnSource> enumerable = (from x in ActualEditFormOwner.CreateEditFormColumnSource()
				orderby x.Visible descending
				select x).ThenBy((EditFormColumnSource y) => y.VisibleIndex);
			int num = 0;
			editorDataCache = new Dictionary<string, EditFormCellData>();
			foreach (EditFormColumnSource item in enumerable)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.FieldName) && !editorDataCache.ContainsKey(item.FieldName))
				{
					CoerceSource(item, columnCount);
					EditFormCaptionData editFormCaptionData = CreateCaptionData();
					editFormCaptionData.Assign(item);
					EditFormCellData editFormCellData = CreateCellData();
					editFormCellData.Assign(item);
					editFormCellData.VisibleIndex = num;
					num++;
					editFormCellData.RowData = this;
					editFormCellData.SetInitValue(EditFormOwner.GetValue(editFormCellData));
					editFormCellData.ValueChangedEvent += OnCellValueChanged;
					editorDataCache.Add(editFormCellData.FieldName, editFormCellData);
					if (item.Visible)
					{
						list.Add(editFormCaptionData);
						list.Add(editFormCellData);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CoerceSource(EditFormColumnSource source, int columnCount)
		{
			if (!source.ColumnSpan.HasValue)
			{
				source.ColumnSpan = DefaultSpanHelper.CalcDefaultColumnSpan(source, columnCount);
			}
			if (!source.RowSpan.HasValue)
			{
				source.RowSpan = DefaultSpanHelper.CalcDefaultRowSpan(source);
			}
			if (source.ColumnSpan > columnCount)
			{
				source.ColumnSpan = columnCount;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual EditFormLayoutCalculator CreateLayoutCalculator(int columnCount)
		{
			return new EditFormLayoutCalculator
			{
				ColumnCount = columnCount
			};
		}

		protected internal virtual EditFormCellData CreateCellData()
		{
			return new EditFormCellData();
		}

		protected internal virtual EditFormCaptionData CreateCaptionData()
		{
			return new EditFormCaptionData();
		}

		private void UpdatePositions(IList<EditFormCellDataBase> items, EditFormLayoutCalculator calculator)
		{
			List<IEditFormLayoutItem> list = new List<IEditFormLayoutItem>();
			IEditFormLayoutItem editFormLayoutItem = null;
			IEditFormLayoutItem editFormLayoutItem2 = null;
			foreach (EditFormCellDataBase item in items)
			{
				if (((IEditFormLayoutItem)item).ItemType == EditFormLayoutItemType.Caption)
				{
					editFormLayoutItem = item;
				}
				else if (((IEditFormLayoutItem)item).ItemType == EditFormLayoutItemType.Editor)
				{
					editFormLayoutItem2 = item;
				}
				if (editFormLayoutItem != null && editFormLayoutItem2 != null)
				{
					list.Add(new CaptionedLayoutItem(editFormLayoutItem, editFormLayoutItem2));
					editFormLayoutItem = null;
					editFormLayoutItem2 = null;
				}
			}
			calculator.SetPositions(list);
		}

		private IList<EditFormCellData> GetEditorData()
		{
			return editorDataCache.Values.ToList();
		}

		internal EditFormCellData GetEditorData(string fieldName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			EditFormCellData value = null;
			editorDataCache.TryGetValue(fieldName, out value);
			return value;
		}

		private void UnsubscribeFromData()
		{
			IList<EditFormCellData> editorData = GetEditorData();
			if (editorData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (EditFormCellData item in editorData)
			{
				item.ValueChangedEvent -= OnCellValueChanged;
				item.RowData = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnCellValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EditFormCellData editFormCellData = (EditFormCellData)sender;
			IsModified = true;
			Validate(editFormCellData);
			if (EditFormOwner.EditMode == EditFormPostMode.Immediate)
			{
				EditFormOwner.IsEditing = false;
				CommitCore(editFormCellData);
				EditFormOwner.IsEditing = true;
			}
			if (ActualEditFormOwner == null || !ActualEditFormOwner.AllowLeaveInvalidEditor)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, EditFormCellData> item in editorDataCache)
			{
				if (item.Value != editFormCellData)
				{
					Validate(item.Value);
				}
			}
		}

		private void CommitCore(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			if (!data.IsColumnReadonly)
			{
				ActualEditFormOwner.SetValue(data);
			}
		}

		private void Validate(EditFormCellData data)
		{
			data.ValidationError = ActualEditFormOwner.Validate(data);
		}

		private void RefreshUpdateCancelPanel()
		{
			ShowUpdateCancelButtons = CanShowUpdateCancelButtons && ActualEditFormOwner.ShowUpdateCancelButtons;
		}

		public void Commit()
		{
			TryCommit();
		}

		internal bool TryCommit()
		{
			IList<EditFormCellData> editorData = GetEditorData();
			if (editorData == null || editorData.Count == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (editorData.Any((EditFormCellData x) => x.ValidationError != null))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (EditFormCellData item in editorData)
			{
				CommitCore(item);
				if (item.ValidationError != null)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Committer != null)
			{
				if (!Committer.Commit())
				{
					return false;
				}
				Committer.DoCommitProtectedAction(delegate
				{
					Close(IsModified ? new bool?(true) : ((bool?)null));
				});
				return true;
			}
			Close(IsModified);
			return true;
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			IList<EditFormCellData> editorData = GetEditorData();
			if (editorData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (EditFormOwner.EditMode == EditFormPostMode.Immediate)
			{
				foreach (EditFormCellData item in editorData)
				{
					item.ResetValue();
				}
			}
			ActualEditFormOwner.OnEditFormClosed(IsModified ? new bool?(false) : ((bool?)null));
		}

		public void Close(bool? success)
		{
			ActualEditFormOwner.OnEditFormClosed(success);
		}
	}
	internal static class DefaultSpanHelper
	{
		private static Dictionary<Type, int> defaultColumnSpans = CreateDefaultColumnSpans();

		private static Dictionary<Type, int> defaultRowSpans = CreateDefaultRowSpans();

		private const int AllColumnsSpan = int.MinValue;

		private static Dictionary<Type, int> CreateDefaultColumnSpans()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, int>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(MemoEditSettings), int.MinValue);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ImageEditSettings), 2);
			return dictionary;
		}

		private static Dictionary<Type, int> CreateDefaultRowSpans()
		{
			Dictionary<Type, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<Type, int>();
			dictionary.Add(typeof(MemoEditSettings), 3);
			dictionary.Add(typeof(ImageEditSettings), 3);
			return dictionary;
		}

		public static int CalcDefaultColumnSpan(EditFormColumnSource source, int columnCount)
		{
			int num = GetDefaultSpan(source, defaultColumnSpans);
			if (num == int.MinValue)
			{
				num = columnCount;
			}
			return Math.Min(columnCount, num);
		}

		public static int CalcDefaultRowSpan(EditFormColumnSource source)
		{
			return GetDefaultSpan(source, defaultRowSpans);
		}

		private static int GetDefaultSpan(EditFormColumnSource source, Dictionary<Type, int> registeredSpans)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (source != null && source.EditSettings != null)
			{
				type = ((object)source.EditSettings).GetType();
			}
			int value = 1;
			if (type != null)
			{
				registeredSpans.TryGetValue(type, out value);
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

		private class Interval : IEquatable<Interval>
		{
			internal readonly FunctionOperatorType? Start;

			internal readonly FunctionOperatorType? End;

			internal readonly FunctionOperatorType[] Parts;

			internal static Interval Empty => new Interval(null, null);

			internal Interval(FunctionOperatorType? start, FunctionOperatorType? end, params FunctionOperatorType[] parts)
			{
				Start = start;
				End = end;
				Parts = (FunctionOperatorType[])(((object)parts) ?? ((object)new FunctionOperatorType[0]));
			}

			internal bool IsAdjacent(Interval other)
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return End == other.Start;
			}

			internal Interval Merge(Interval other)
			{
				return new Interval(Start, other.End, Parts.Concat(other.Parts).ToArray());
			}

			public override bool Equals(object obj)
			{
				if (obj == null || GetType() != obj.GetType())
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Equals((Interval)obj);
			}

			public bool Equals(Interval other)
			{
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0043: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (Start == other.Start)
				{
					return End == other.End;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return ToString().GetHashCode();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return $"[{Start} {End}]";
			}
		}

		public static CriteriaOperator ToCriteria(this IEnumerable<FilterDateType> filters, string fieldName)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)fieldName, "fieldName");
			OperandProperty property = new OperandProperty(fieldName);
			return ToCriteria(filters, property) | ToCriteriaAlt(filters, property) | ToNullCriteria(filters, property);
		}

		private static CriteriaOperator ToCriteria(IEnumerable<FilterDateType> filters, OperandProperty property)
		{

		private static Interval[] Merge(IEnumerable<Interval> intervals)
		{
			if (!intervals.Any())
			{
				return new Interval[1] { Interval.Empty };
			}
			Stack<Interval> stack = new Stack<Interval>();
			Interval item = intervals.First();
			IEnumerable<Interval> enumerable = intervals.Skip(1);
			stack.Push(item);
			foreach (Interval item3 in enumerable)
			{
				Interval interval = stack.Peek();
				if (!interval.IsAdjacent(item3))
				{
					stack.Push(item3);
					continue;
				}
				Interval item2 = interval.Merge(item3);
				stack.Pop();
				stack.Push(item2);
			}
			return stack.Reverse().ToArray();
		}

		private static bool IsDateSpan(Tuple<DateTime?, DateTime?> pair, DateTime start, DateTime end)
		{
			DateTime? item = pair.Item1;
			DateTime? item2 = pair.Item2;
			if (!item.HasValue || !item2.HasValue)
			{
				return false;
			}

			{
				DateTime? dateTime = item2;
				DateTime dateTime2 = end;
				if (!dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!dateTime.HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return dateTime.GetValueOrDefault() == dateTime2;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public static bool IsFilterValid(this FilterDateType filter)
		{
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (filter == FilterDateType.None || !FilterToIntervalMap.ContainsKey(filter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Interval interval = FilterToIntervalMap[filter];
			if (!interval.Start.HasValue || !interval.End.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			DateTime dateTime = EvalHelpers.EvaluateLocalDateTime(interval.Start.Value);
			DateTime dateTime2 = EvalHelpers.EvaluateLocalDateTime(interval.End.Value);
			return dateTime2 > dateTime;
		}

			return (CriteriaOperator)new UnaryOperator((UnaryOperatorType)4, (CriteriaOperator)new OperandProperty(propertyName));
		}

		internal static DateTime SixMonthsAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(6);
		}

		internal static DateTime FiveMonthsAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(5);
		}

		internal static DateTime FourMonthsAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(4);
		}

		internal static DateTime ThreeMonthsAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(3);
		}

		internal static DateTime TwoMonthsAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(2);
		}

		internal static DateTime MonthAgo(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAgo(1);
		}

		internal static DateTime MonthAfter(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAfter(1);
		}

		internal static DateTime TwoMonthsAfter(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAfter(2);
		}

		internal static DateTime ThreeMonthsAfter(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.MonthsAfter(3);
		}

		private static DateTime MonthsAgo(this DateTime now, int months)
		{
			return now.AddMonthsAndGetBeginningOfMonth(-months);
		}

		private static DateTime MonthsAfter(this DateTime now, int months)
		{
			return now.AddMonthsAndGetBeginningOfMonth(months);
		}

		private static DateTime AddMonthsAndGetBeginningOfMonth(this DateTime now, int months)
		{
			return now.AddMonths(months).BeginningOfMonth();
		}

		internal static DateTime BeginningOfMonth(this DateTime now)
		{
			return new DateTime(now.Year, now.Month, 1);
		}

		internal static DateTime WeekStart(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.WeekStart(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		internal static DateTime WeekStart(this DateTime now, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = culture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;
			DayOfWeek dayOfWeek = now.DayOfWeek;
			int num = (dayOfWeek - firstDayOfWeek + 7) % 7;
			return now.AddDays(-num).Date;
		}

		internal static DateTime WeekAfter(this DateTime now)
		{
			return now.AddDays(7.0);
		}

		private static string GetFilterNameFromDate(DateTime date)
		{
			return date.ToString("yyyy, MMMM");
		}
	}

	internal class DesignTimeConditionalFormatingWrapper : DesignTimeConditionalFormatingWrapperBase<DataControlBase>
	{
		private static Func<Type, object> createInstance;

		internal static Func<Type, object> CreateInstance
		{
			get
			{
				if (createInstance == null)
				{
					createInstance = (Type x) => Activator.CreateInstance(x);
				}
				return createInstance;
			}
			set
			{
				createInstance = value;
			}
		}

		internal string ShowManager(DataControlBase dataControl, string designerData)
		{
			return base.ShowManager(dataControl, designerData, (Func<DataControlBase, DependencyObject>)((DataControlBase x) => x.DataView), (Func<DependencyObject, string, string>)((DependencyObject view, string str) => GetManagerResult(str, view.GetType())));
		}

		private string GetManagerResult(string serializedFormatConditions, Type viewType)
		{
			if (serializedFormatConditions == "Cancel")
			{
				return serializedFormatConditions;
			}
			return $"{viewType.FullName}{'|'}{serializedFormatConditions}";
		}

		protected override void GetDataControlForSerialization(DataControlBase original, out DataControlBase copy)
		{
			copy = (DataControlBase)CreateInstance(original.GetType());
			copy.DataView = (DataViewBase)CreateInstance(original.DataView.GetType());
			Clone(original, copy);
		}

		private void Clone(DataControlBase from, DataControlBase to)
		{
			using MemoryStream stream = new MemoryStream();
			SaveDataControlToStream(from, stream);
			RestoreDataControlFromStream(to, stream);
		}

		private void SaveDataControlToStream(DataControlBase dataControl, Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			StoreLayoutMode val = AllowSerializeAllProperties(dataControl);
			dataControl.SaveLayoutToStream(stream);
			DXSerializer.SetStoreLayoutMode((DependencyObject)dataControl, val);
			stream.Position = 0L;
		}

		private void RestoreDataControlFromStream(DataControlBase dataControl, Stream stream)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataControlSerializationOptions.SetRemoveOldColumns(dataControl, value: false);
			AllowSerializeAllProperties(dataControl);
			dataControl.RestoreLayoutFromStream(stream);
			UpdateDataControl(dataControl);
		}

		private StoreLayoutMode AllowSerializeAllProperties(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			StoreLayoutMode storeLayoutMode = DXSerializer.GetStoreLayoutMode(obj);
			DXSerializer.SetStoreLayoutMode(obj, (StoreLayoutMode)0);
			return storeLayoutMode;
		}

		private void UpdateDataControl(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			dataControl.BeginInit();
			dataControl.EndInit();
		}

		protected override DesignTimeConditionalFormattingManagerBase<DataControlBase> GetManager(DataControlBase dataControlForSerialization, NetDesignerData designerData)
		{
			ParseColumnDesignerData(designerData.AdditionalData, out var bandIndex, out var columnIndex);
			return new DesignTimeConditionalFormattingManager(dataControlForSerialization, designerData.ProcessID, GetColumnByIndex(dataControlForSerialization, bandIndex, columnIndex));
		}

		private static void ParseColumnDesignerData(string rawData, out int bandIndex, out int columnIndex)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawData))
			{
				bandIndex = -1;
				columnIndex = -1;
				return;
			}
			string[] array = rawData.Split('|');
			if (array.Length == 2 && int.TryParse(array[0], out bandIndex) && int.TryParse(array[1], out columnIndex))
			{
				return;
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Failed to parse a column and band data passed from the designer");
		}

		private static ColumnBase GetColumnByIndex(DataControlBase dataControl, int bandIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			if (columnIndex == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (bandIndex == -1)
			{
				return dataControl.ColumnsCore[columnIndex];
			}
			return (ColumnBase)((BandBase)dataControl.BandsCore[bandIndex]).ColumnsCore[columnIndex];
		}
	}
	internal class DesignTimeConditionalFormattingManager : DesignTimeConditionalFormattingManagerBase<DataControlBase>
	{
		private ColumnBase column;

		internal DesignTimeConditionalFormattingManager(DataControlBase dataControl, int parentWindowProccessId, ColumnBase column)
			: base(dataControl, parentWindowProccessId)
		{
			this.column = column;
		}

		protected override IDialogContext GetDataControlContext()
		{
			DataControlDialogContext dataControlDialogContext = null;
			if (column != null)
			{
				return (IDialogContext)(object)new DataControlDialogContext(column);
			}
			if (base.dataControl != null && base.dataControl.ColumnsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				return (IDialogContext)(object)new DataControlDialogContext(base.dataControl.ColumnsCore[0]);
			}
			return (IDialogContext)(object)new DataControlDialogContext(null, base.dataControl);
		}
	}

namespace DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.Native

	internal abstract class RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected readonly BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout;

		protected abstract bool ApplyVisibleIndex { get; }

		public RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase(BandsLayoutBase layout)
		{
			BandsLayout = layout;
		}

		protected bool IsRootBandsOwner(IBandsOwner bandsOwner)
		{
			return bandsOwner == BandsLayout;
		}

		public IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumns()
		{
			return new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>(RebuildVisibleColumnsCore(BandsLayout));
		}

		protected BandRow UpdateBandRows(ColumnBase column, Dictionary<int, BandRow> rows)
		{
			int actualBandRowIndex = GetActualBandRowIndex(column);
			BandRow value = null;
			if (!rows.TryGetValue(actualBandRowIndex, out value))
			{
				value = (rows[actualBandRowIndex] = new BandRow
				{
					Columns = new List<ColumnBase>(),
					Index = actualBandRowIndex
				});
			}
			value.Columns.Add(column);
			return value;
		}

		protected int GetActualBandRowIndex(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!BandsLayout.AllowBandMultiRow)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return BandBase.GetGridRow((DependencyObject)(object)column);
		}

		public void UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = visibleColumns[i];
				columnBase.ActualVisibleIndex = i;
				if (ApplyVisibleIndex)
				{
					columnBase.VisibleIndex = i;
				}
				columnBase.IsFirst = i == 0;
				columnBase.IsLast = i == visibleColumns.Count - 1;
				columnBase.UpdateHasTopElement();
				columnBase.UpdateHasBottomElement();
			}
		}

		protected abstract IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore(IBandsOwner bandsOwner);

		public abstract void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn baseColumn, int oldVisibleIndex);
	}
	internal class RebuildBandsLayoutHelper : RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected override bool ApplyVisibleIndex => false;

		public RebuildBandsLayoutHelper(BandsLayoutBase layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore(IBandsOwner bandsOwner)
		{
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			int columnVisibleIndexOffset = 0;
			RebuildBandsCore(bandsOwner, isBandVisible: true, list, columnVisibleIndexOffset);
			return list;
		}

		private int RebuildBandsCore(IBandsOwner bandsOwner, bool isBandVisible, List<ColumnBase> visibleColumns, int columnVisibleIndexOffset)
		{
			bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Clear();
			bool hasFixedLeftBands = false;
			List<BandBase> list = new List<BandBase>();
			for (int i = 0; i < bandsOwner.BandsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				BandBase bandBase = bandsOwner.BandsCore[i] as BandBase;
				bandBase.index = i;
				list.Add(bandBase);
				if (bandBase.Visible && bandBase.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left)
				{
					hasFixedLeftBands = true;
				}
			}
			list.Sort(BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleComparison);
			if (IsRootBandsOwner(bandsOwner))
			{
				BandsLayout.PatchBands(list, hasFixedLeftBands);
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				BandBase bandBase2 = list[j];
				bandBase2.VisibleIndex = j;
				if (bandBase2.Visible)
				{
					bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Add(bandBase2);
					bandBase2.ActualVisibleIndex = j - num;
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
				}
				bool flag = isBandVisible && bandBase2.Visible;
				columnVisibleIndexOffset = RebuildBandsCore(bandBase2, flag, visibleColumns, columnVisibleIndexOffset);
				columnVisibleIndexOffset = RebuildBandLayout(bandBase2, flag, visibleColumns, columnVisibleIndexOffset);
			}
			return columnVisibleIndexOffset;
		}

		private Dictionary<int, BandRow> GetAllBandsRows(BandBase band)
		{
			Dictionary<int, BandRow> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, BandRow>();
			for (int i = 0; i < band.ColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = band.ColumnsCore[i] as ColumnBase;
				columnBase.index = i;
				UpdateBandRows(columnBase, dictionary);
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private int RebuildBandLayout(BandBase band, bool isBandActualVisible, List<ColumnBase> visibleColumns, int columnVisibleIndexOffset)
		{
			band.ActualRows.Clear();
			Dictionary<int, BandRow> allBandsRows = GetAllBandsRows(band);
			foreach (int item in allBandsRows.Keys.OrderBy((int i) => i))
			{
				BandRow bandRow = allBandsRows[item];
				bandRow.Columns.Sort(BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleComparison);
				BandRow bandRow2 = new BandRow
				{
					Index = bandRow.Index,
					Columns = new List<ColumnBase>()
				};
				for (int num = 0; num < bandRow.Columns.Count; num++)
				{
					ColumnBase columnBase = bandRow.Columns[num];
					columnBase.VisibleIndex = columnVisibleIndexOffset + num;
					if (!isBandActualVisible || band.VisibleBands.Count > 0 || !columnBase.Visible || !BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(columnBase))
					{
						columnBase.BandRow = null;
						continue;
					}
					bandRow2.Columns.Add(columnBase);
					visibleColumns.Add(columnBase);
					columnBase.BandRow = bandRow2;
				}
				columnVisibleIndexOffset += bandRow.Columns.Count;
				if (bandRow2.Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					band.ActualRows.Add(bandRow2);
				}
			}
			return columnVisibleIndexOffset;
		}

		public override void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn baseColumn, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (baseColumn is BandBase)
			{
				AppylBandVisibleIndexCore((BandBase)baseColumn, oldVisibleIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore((ColumnBase)baseColumn, oldVisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore(ColumnBase source, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			if (source.ParentBand != null)
			{
				Dictionary<int, BandRow> allBandsRows = GetAllBandsRows(source.ParentBand);
				int actualBandRowIndex = GetActualBandRowIndex(source);
				BandRow bandRow = allBandsRows[actualBandRowIndex];
				RebuildColumnsLayoutHelper.ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(bandRow.Columns, source, oldVisibleIndex, delegate(BaseColumn column, bool isMoveToRight)
				{
					if (isMoveToRight || targetVisibleIndex == -1)
					{
						targetVisibleIndex = column.VisibleIndex;
					}
				});
			}
			if (targetVisibleIndex == -1)
			{
				targetVisibleIndex = oldVisibleIndex;
			}
			BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)source, targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		private void AppylBandVisibleIndexCore(BandBase source, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			IList bandsCore = source.Owner.BandsCore;
			int index = RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperBase.CorrectVisibleIndex(bandsCore, source, source.Owner == BandsLayout);
			BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)source, index);
			RebuildColumnsLayoutHelper.ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(bandsCore, source, oldVisibleIndex);
		}
	}
	internal class RebuildBandsLayoutHelperLegacy : RebuildBandsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected override bool ApplyVisibleIndex => true;

		public RebuildBandsLayoutHelperLegacy(BandsLayoutBase layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore(IBandsOwner bandsOwner)
		{
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Clear();
			bool hasFixedLeftBands = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < bandsOwner.BandsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				BandBase bandBase = bandsOwner.BandsCore[i] as BandBase;
				bandBase.index = i;
				if (bandBase.Visible)
				{
					bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Add(bandBase);
					if (bandBase.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left)
					{
						hasFixedLeftBands = true;
					}
				}
			}
			bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Sort(BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleComparison);
			if (IsRootBandsOwner(bandsOwner))
			{
				BandsLayout.PatchBands(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, hasFixedLeftBands);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < bandsOwner.VisibleBands.Count; j++)
			{
				BandBase bandBase2 = bandsOwner.VisibleBands[j];
				bandBase2.VisibleIndex = j;
				bandBase2.ActualVisibleIndex = j;
				list.AddRange(RebuildVisibleColumnsCore(bandBase2));
				list.AddRange(RebuildBandLayout(bandBase2));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private List<ColumnBase> RebuildBandLayout(BandBase band)
		{
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			band.ActualRows.Clear();
			if (!band.Visible || band.VisibleBands.Count > 0 || band.ColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return list;
			}
			Dictionary<int, BandRow> dictionary = new Dictionary<int, BandRow>();
			for (int i = 0; i < band.ColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = band.ColumnsCore[i] as ColumnBase;
				columnBase.index = i;
				if (!columnBase.Visible || !BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(columnBase))
				{
					columnBase.BandRow = null;
				}
				else
				{
					columnBase.BandRow = UpdateBandRows(columnBase, dictionary);
				}
			}
			foreach (int item in dictionary.Keys.OrderBy((int result) => result))
			{
				BandRow bandRow = dictionary[item];
				bandRow.Columns.Sort(BandsLayout.DataControl.viewCore.VisibleComparison);
				foreach (ColumnBase column in bandRow.Columns)
				{
					list.Add(column);
				}
				band.ActualRows.Add(bandRow);
			}
			return list;
		}

		public override void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn baseColumn, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> list = null;
			list = ((!(baseColumn is BandBase)) ? baseColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows.FirstOrDefault((BandRow x) => x.Index == BandBase.GetGridRow((DependencyObject)(object)baseColumn)).With((BandRow x) => ((IEnumerable<BaseColumn>)x.Columns).ToList()) : ((IEnumerable<BaseColumn>)((BandBase)baseColumn).Owner.VisibleBands).ToList());
			if (list != null)
			{
				list = (from y in list
					where y != baseColumn
					orderby y.VisibleIndex
					select y).ToList();
				list.Insert(Math.Max(0, Math.Min(list.Count, baseColumn.VisibleIndex)), baseColumn);
				for (int num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
				{
					list[num].VisibleIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class ColumnChooserHelper
	{
		public static UnsubscribeAction AddPropertyChanged(this DependencyObject source, EventHandler action, params DependencyProperty[] properties)
		{
			UnsubscribeAction result = null;
			properties.ForEach(delegate(DependencyProperty property)
			{
				//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
				PropertyChangeTracker tracker = new PropertyChangeTracker(source, property);
				tracker.Changed += action;
				result = (UnsubscribeAction)Delegate.Combine(result, (UnsubscribeAction)delegate
				{
					tracker.Changed -= action;
				});
			});
			return result;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase
	{
		public class ParsedEventArgs
		{
			public BaseColumn Source { get; set; }

			public BaseColumn Target { get; set; }

			public DropPosition Position { get; set; }

			public HeaderPresenterType HeaderPresenterType { get; set; }
		}

		protected readonly DataControlBase DataControl;

		protected bool AllowChangeColumnParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(DataControl.DataView is ITableView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((ITableView)DataControl.DataView).AllowChangeColumnParent;
			}
		}

		protected bool AllowChangeBandParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(DataControl.DataView is ITableView))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((ITableView)DataControl.DataView).AllowChangeBandParent;
			}
		}

		protected bool UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes
		{
			get
			{
				if (DataControl.DataView == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return DataControl.DataView.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes;
			}
		}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			DataControl = dataControl;
		}

		public DropPosition? ProcessDrag(BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target, double dropPositionRelativeCoefficient, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!TryParseEventArgs(source, target, GetPosition(target, dropPositionRelativeCoefficient), dropPositionRelativeCoefficient, headerPresenterType, out var parsedEventArgs))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CanDrop(parsedEventArgs))
			{
				return parsedEventArgs.Position;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static DropPosition GetPosition(BaseColumn target, double dropPositionRelativeCoefficient)
		{
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (target is ColumnBase)
			{
				if (dropPositionRelativeCoefficient > 0.5)
				{
					return (DropPosition)2;
				}
				return (DropPosition)1;
			}

			{
				result = (DropPosition)1;
			}

			}

		private bool TryParseEventArgs(BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target, DropPosition position, double dropPositionRelativeCoefficient, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType, out ParsedEventArgs parsedEventArgs)
		{

			parsedEventArgs = null;
			if (source == null || source == target)
			{

			}
			if (DataControl.viewCore.ViewBehavior.GetActualColumnFixed(source) != DataControl.viewCore.ViewBehavior.GetActualColumnFixed(target))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ParsedEventArgs e = new ParsedEventArgs();

			e.Target = target;

			e.HeaderPresenterType = headerPresenterType;

	public class ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBands : ExtendedColumnChooserDragDropManagerBase

		private bool CanDropColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn, BaseColumn target, DropPosition position)

		private bool CanDropColumnOnColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn, ColumnBase targetColumn, DropPosition position)

			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		private bool CanDropBand(BandBase sourceBand, BaseColumn target, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0080: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!sourceBand.ActualAllowMoving)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BandBase targetBand = target as BandBase;
			if (targetBand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			BandedViewDropPlace bandedViewDropPlace = UpdateTargetBand(sourceBand, ref targetBand, position);
			if (IsDropParentInChild(sourceBand, targetBand))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!base.AllowChangeBandParent && (sourceBand.ParentBand != targetBand.ParentBand || bandedViewDropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)position == 3)
			{
				return true;
			}

			{

			}
			switch (position - 1)
			{
			case 0:
				if (sourceBand.Fixed != targetBand.Fixed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sourceBand.VisibleIndex < targetBand.VisibleIndex)
				{
					return targetBand.VisibleIndex - sourceBand.VisibleIndex > 1;
				}
				return true;
			case 1:
				if (sourceBand.Fixed != targetBand.Fixed)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (sourceBand.VisibleIndex > targetBand.VisibleIndex)
				{
					return sourceBand.VisibleIndex - targetBand.VisibleIndex > 1;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		private bool IsDropParentInChild(BandBase sourceBand, BandBase targetBand)
		{
			if (targetBand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (targetBand.ParentBand == sourceBand)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsDropParentInChild(sourceBand, targetBand.ParentBand);
		}

		protected override void ProcessDropCore(ParsedEventArgs parsedArgs)
		{
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (parsedArgs.Source is ColumnBase sourceColumn)
			{
				ProcessDropColumn(sourceColumn, parsedArgs);
			}
			BandBase bandBase = parsedArgs.Source as BandBase;
			BandBase bandBase2 = parsedArgs.Target as BandBase;
			if (bandBase != null && bandBase2 != null)
			{
				ProcessDropBand(bandBase, bandBase2, parsedArgs.Position);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDropColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn, ParsedEventArgs parsedArgs)
		{
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (parsedArgs.Target is BandBase target)
			{
				ProcessDropColumnOnBand(sourceColumn, target, parsedArgs.Position, parsedArgs.HeaderPresenterType);
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessDropColumnOnColumn(sourceColumn, parsedArgs.Target as ColumnBase, parsedArgs.Position, parsedArgs.HeaderPresenterType);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessDropColumnOnColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn, ColumnBase targetColumn, DropPosition position, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace = (((int)position == 1) ? BandedViewDropPlace.Left : BandedViewDropPlace.Right);
			DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveColumnTo(sourceColumn, targetColumn, dropPlace, headerPresenterType, base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		private void ProcessDropColumnOnBand(ColumnBase sourceColumn, BandBase target, DropPosition position, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (target.ColumnsCore.Count == 0 || target.ActualRows.Count == 0 || target.ActualRows[target.ActualRows.Count - 1].Columns.Count == 0)
			{
				DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveColumnTo(sourceColumn, target, BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom, headerPresenterType, base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
				RaiseDropInBand(target, sourceColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				BaseColumn target2 = target.ActualRows[target.ActualRows.Count - 1].Columns.Last();
				DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveColumnTo(sourceColumn, target2, BandedViewDropPlace.Right, headerPresenterType, base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
		}

		private BandedViewDropPlace GetBandDropPlace(DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0014: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			return (position - 1) switch
			{
				0 => BandedViewDropPlace.Left, 
				1 => BandedViewDropPlace.Right, 
				_ => BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom, 
			};
		}

		private BandedViewDropPlace UpdateTargetBand(BandBase sourceBand, ref BandBase targetBand, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BandedViewDropPlace bandDropPlace = GetBandDropPlace(position);
			if (bandDropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
			{
				if (targetBand.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
				{
					return bandDropPlace;
				}
				for (int num = targetBand.VisibleBands.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					BandBase bandBase = ((IList)targetBand.VisibleBands)[num] as BandBase;
					if (bandBase != sourceBand)
					{
						targetBand = bandBase;
						return BandedViewDropPlace.Right;
					}
				}
			}
			return bandDropPlace;
		}

		private void ProcessDropBand(BandBase sourceBand, BandBase targetBand, DropPosition position)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace = UpdateTargetBand(sourceBand, ref targetBand, position);
			DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveBandTo(sourceBand, targetBand, dropPlace, HeaderPresenterType.Headers, base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			RaiseDropInBand(targetBand, sourceBand);
		}

		private void RaiseDropInBand(BandBase targetBand, BaseColumn source)
		{
			if (this.DropInEmptyBand != null)
			{
				this.DropInEmptyBand(this, new ExtendedColumnChooserDropInBandEventArgs(targetBand, source));
			}
		}
	}

		public ExtendedColumnChooserDropInBandEventArgs(BandBase targetBand, BaseColumn source)

			TargetBand = targetBand;
			Source = source;
		}

	public interface IAnimationConnector
	{
		AnimationElement ConnectedElement { get; set; }

		void Disconnect();

		void UpdateAppearance();

		void OnAnimationSeriesEnd();
	}
	internal class AnimationController
	{
		private abstract class AnimationTimelineContainerBase
		{
			public IList<AnimationTimeline> TimeLines { get; set; }

			public AnimationTimelineContainerBase()
			{
				TimeLines = new List<AnimationTimeline>();
			}
		}

		private class AnimationControllerQueueItem : AnimationTimelineContainerBase
		{
			public IAnimationConnector Connector { get; set; }
		}

		private class MaskedAnimationTimeline : AnimationTimelineContainerBase
		{
			public AnimationMask Mask { get; set; }

			public bool HasEarlyAnimations { get; set; }

			public IList<AnimationTimeline> EarlyAnimation
			{
				get
				{
					if (!HasEarlyAnimations)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.TimeLines;
				}
			}
		}

		private Queue<AnimationControllerQueueItem> animationQueue = new Queue<AnimationControllerQueueItem>();

		private IAnimationConnector activeConnectorCore;

		private IList<ITimelineWrapper> earlyDeactivationAnimations;

		private IStoryboardWrapper activeStoryboardWrapper;

		private IAnimationWrapperFactory wrapperFactory;

		public Func<AnimationElement> AnimationElementFactory { get; set; }

		private IAnimationConnector ActiveConnector
		{
			get
			{
				return activeConnectorCore;
			}
			set
			{
				if (activeConnectorCore != value)
				{
					StopConnectorAnimation(value == null);
					activeConnectorCore = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private IAnimationWrapperFactory WrapperFactory
		{
			get
			{
				if (wrapperFactory == null)
				{
					wrapperFactory = CreateWrapperFactory();
				}
				return wrapperFactory;
			}
		}

		private void StopConnectorAnimation(bool shouldRestoreConditionalAppearance)
		{
			if (activeConnectorCore != null)
			{
				activeConnectorCore.Disconnect();
				if (shouldRestoreConditionalAppearance)
				{
					activeConnectorCore.UpdateAppearance();
				}
				if (animationQueue.Count == 0)
				{
					activeConnectorCore.OnAnimationSeriesEnd();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ResetActiveStoryboard()
		{
			if (activeStoryboardWrapper != null)
			{
				activeStoryboardWrapper.Stop();
				activeStoryboardWrapper.Completed -= OnStoryboardCompleted;
				activeStoryboardWrapper = null;
				UpdateEarlyDeactivationAnimations(null);
			}
		}

		public AnimationController()
		{
			AnimationElementFactory = () => new AnimationElement();
			earlyDeactivationAnimations = new List<ITimelineWrapper>();
		}

		public virtual void Start(IList<AnimationTimeline> animations, IAnimationConnector connector)
		{
			if (animations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Storyboard storyboard = new Storyboard();
			MaskedAnimationTimeline maskedTimeline = GetMaskedAnimationTimeline(animations);
			foreach (AnimationTimeline timeLine in maskedTimeline.TimeLines)
			{
				storyboard.Children.Add(timeLine);
			}
			AnimationElement element = AnimationElementFactory();
			element.Do(delegate(AnimationElement e)
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				e.Mask = maskedTimeline.Mask;
			});
			Storyboard.SetTarget(storyboard, (DependencyObject)(object)element);
			ActiveConnector = connector;
			ActiveConnector.Do(delegate(IAnimationConnector x)
			{
				x.ConnectedElement = element;
			});
			ResetActiveStoryboard();
			UpdateEarlyDeactivationAnimations(maskedTimeline.EarlyAnimation);
			activeStoryboardWrapper = CreateStoryboardWrapper(storyboard);
			activeStoryboardWrapper.Completed += OnStoryboardCompleted;
			activeStoryboardWrapper.Begin();
		}

		private MaskedAnimationTimeline GetMaskedAnimationTimeline(IList<AnimationTimeline> animations)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AnimationMask val = (AnimationMask)0;
			Stack<AnimationTimeline> stack = new Stack<AnimationTimeline>();
			Duration? duration = null;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = animations.Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				AnimationTimeline animationTimeline = animations[num];
				AnimationMask subMask = GetSubMask(animationTimeline);
				if ((int)subMask == 0 || !((Enum)val).HasFlag((Enum)(object)subMask))
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						Duration duration2 = animationTimeline.Duration;
						if (duration.HasValue && duration.Value != duration2)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						duration = duration2;
					}
					stack.Push(animationTimeline);
					val |= subMask;
				}
			}
			MaskedAnimationTimeline maskedAnimationTimeline = new MaskedAnimationTimeline();
			while (stack.Count > 0)
			{
				maskedAnimationTimeline.TimeLines.Add(stack.Pop());
			}
			maskedAnimationTimeline.Mask = val;
			maskedAnimationTimeline.HasEarlyAnimations = flag;
			return maskedAnimationTimeline;
		}

		private static AnimationMask GetSubMask(Timeline timeline)
		{
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (timeline == null)
			{
				return (AnimationMask)0;
			}
			return AnimationPropertyPaths.GetAnimationMask(Storyboard.GetTargetProperty(timeline));
		}

		private IStoryboardWrapper CreateStoryboardWrapper(Storyboard storyboard)
		{
			return WrapperFactory.CreateStoryboardWrapper(storyboard);
		}

		private void OnStoryboardCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Complete();
		}

		private void UpdateEarlyDeactivationAnimations(IList<AnimationTimeline> timeLines)
		{
			foreach (ITimelineWrapper earlyDeactivationAnimation in earlyDeactivationAnimations)
			{
				earlyDeactivationAnimation.Deactivated -= OnEarlyDeactivation;
			}
			earlyDeactivationAnimations.Clear();
			if (timeLines == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (AnimationTimeline timeLine in timeLines)
			{
				ITimelineWrapper timelineWrapper = WrapperFactory.CreateTimelineWrapper(timeLine);
				timelineWrapper.Deactivated += OnEarlyDeactivation;
				earlyDeactivationAnimations.Add(timelineWrapper);
			}
		}

		private void OnEarlyDeactivation(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(sender is ITimelineWrapper timelineWrapper))
			{
				return;
			}
			AnimationElement val = ActiveConnector.With((IAnimationConnector x) => x.ConnectedElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				AnimationMask subMask = GetSubMask(timelineWrapper.Timeline);
				if ((int)subMask != 0)
				{
					val.Mask &= ~subMask;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Start(IList<IList<AnimationTimeline>> animations, IAnimationConnector connector)
		{
			if (animations == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClearAnimationQueue();
			foreach (IList<AnimationTimeline> animation in animations)
			{
				animationQueue.Enqueue(new AnimationControllerQueueItem
				{
					TimeLines = animation,
					Connector = connector
				});
			}
			if (CanContinueFromActiveAnimationState())
			{
				StartAnimationFromQueue();
			}
			else
			{
				Complete();
			}
		}

		private bool CanContinueFromActiveAnimationState()
		{
			if (activeStoryboardWrapper == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return activeStoryboardWrapper.GetChildren().Any((Timeline x) => AutogeneratedTimelineHelper.GetHideRatio((DependencyObject)x) == 0.0);
		}

		private void ClearAnimationQueue()
		{
			animationQueue.Clear();
		}

		private void StartAnimationFromQueue()
		{
			if (animationQueue.Count > 0)
			{
				AnimationControllerQueueItem animationControllerQueueItem = animationQueue.Dequeue();
				Start(animationControllerQueueItem.TimeLines, animationControllerQueueItem.Connector);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual IAnimationWrapperFactory CreateWrapperFactory()
		{
			return new AnimationWrapperFactory();
		}

		public virtual void Complete()
		{
			ResetActiveStoryboard();
			ActiveConnector = null;
			StartAnimationFromQueue();
		}

		public void Flush()
		{
			ClearAnimationQueue();
			Complete();
		}
	}
	internal class ConditionalCellAppearanceUpdater : ConditionalClientAppearanceUpdaterBase
	{

		private CellEditorBase Editor => CellData.Editor;

		public ConditionalCellAppearanceUpdater(GridCellData cellData)

				throw new ArgumentNullException("cellData");

		}

		protected override bool CanAccessAnimationProvider()
		{
