	public class BandsLayoutCalculator : LayoutCalculator
	{
		private Dictionary<BandBase, BandRow> bandRowCache;

		private BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout => ViewInfo.BandsLayout;

		public BandsLayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
			: base(viewInfo)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcActualLayout(double arrangeWidth)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> columns = CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, clearCache: true);
			CalcColumnsLayout(columns, arrangeWidth, fillPixelColumns: false);
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in BandsLayout.VisibleBands)
			{
				CalcBandLayout(visibleBand);
			}
			UpdateHasStarColumns(columns);
		}

		private List<BaseColumn> CalcDefinitiveColumns(IList bands, bool clearCache = false)
		{
			if (bandRowCache == null || clearCache)
			{
				bandRowCache = new Dictionary<BandBase, BandRow>();
			}
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				CalcDefinitiveColumns(band, list);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandBase band, IList<BaseColumn> list)
		{
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
				{
					CalcDefinitiveColumns(visibleBand, list);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (band.ActualRows.Count > 0)
			{
				BandRow value = null;
				if (!bandRowCache.TryGetValue(band, out value))
				{
					value = GetDefinitiveRow(band, null);
					bandRowCache[band] = value;
				}
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase column in value.Columns)
					{
						list.Add(column);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			list.Add(band);
		}

		private BandRow GetDefinitiveRow(BandBase band, BandRow skipRow)
		{
			BandRow result = null;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			double num4 = 0.0;
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow == skipRow)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double num5 = 0.0;
				double num6 = 0.0;
				double num7 = 0.0;
				double num8 = 0.0;
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					num6 += ((column.Width.IsAbsolute || column.Width.IsAuto) ? column.Width.Value : column.MinWidth);
					num8 += column.MinWidth;
					if (column.Width.IsStar)
					{
						num5 += column.Width.Value;
						num7 += column.MinWidth;
					}
				}
				if (!(num6 < num2) && (num6 != num2 || (!(num8 < num4) && (num8 != num4 || (!(num7 > num3) && (num7 != num3 || !(num5 <= num)))))))
				{
					num2 = num6;
					num = num5;
					result = actualRow;
					num3 = num7;
					num4 = num8;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private double CalcBandLayout(BandBase band)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
				{
					num += CalcBandLayout(visibleBand);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (band.ActualRows.Count <= 0)
				{
					return layoutAssigner.GetWidth(band);
				}
				BandRow bandRow = bandRowCache[band];
				num = bandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ActualHeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(x));
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					if (actualRow != bandRow)
					{
						CalcColumnsLayout(actualRow.Columns, num, fillPixelColumns: true);
					}
				}
			}
			band.ColumnWidth = num;
			num = (band.HeaderWidth = num + ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(band));
			layoutAssigner.SetWidth(band, num);
			return num;
		}

		protected override double GetWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(column.ForcedWidth))
			{
				return column.ForcedWidth;
			}
			return column.Width.Value;
		}

		protected override void ApplyResize(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool correctWidths)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			ResizeRightBands(delta: (!(resizeColumn is BandBase)) ? ResizeColumn(resizeColumn, newWidth) : ResizeBand((BandBase)resizeColumn, newWidth), band: resizeColumn.ParentBandInternal);
		}

		private double ResizeBand(BandBase band, double newWidth)
		{
			IList columns = CalcDefinitiveColumns(new BandBase[1] { band });
			CalcMinMaxWidth(columns, -1, out var minWidth, out var maxWidth, out var actualWidth);
			newWidth = Math.Min(Math.Max(minWidth, newWidth), maxWidth);
			actualWidth = band.ColumnWidth;
			IList columns2 = CreateDefinitiveRow(band, columns);
			ApplyResize(CreateDefinitiveRow(band, new BaseColumn[1] { band }), band, newWidth, CalcHasLeftStar(columns2, null, checkStarMinWidth: false), CalcHasLeftStar(columns2, null, checkStarMinWidth: true), checkExcessiveWidth: true);
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count > 0 || band.ActualRows.Count > 0)
			{
				ChangeBandWidth(new BandBase[1] { band }, band.ColumnWidth - actualWidth);
			}
			return band.ColumnWidth - actualWidth;
		}

		private void ChangeBandWidth(IList bands, double delta)
		{
			IList columns = CalcDefinitiveColumns(bands);
			ResizeRightColumns(columns, -1, 0.0 - delta, hasStar: true, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: false);
			FillBandsToDefinitiveRow(bands);
		}

		private void ResizeRightBands(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			if (base.HasStarColumns)
			{
				FillBandsToDefinitiveRow(BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: false));
			}
		}

		private void FillBandsToDefinitiveRow(IList bands)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count > 0)
				{
					FillBandsToDefinitiveRow(band.VisibleBands);
				}
				else
				{
					if (band.ActualRows.Count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					BandRow bandRow = bandRowCache[band];
					double num = bandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth);
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
					{
						if (actualRow != bandRow)
						{
							double num2 = actualRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth);
							ResizeRightColumns(actualRow.Columns, -1, num2 - num, hasStar: true, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: true);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private double ResizeColumn(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth)
		{
			double delta = CorrectColumnDelta(resizeColumn, newWidth - resizeColumn.ColumnWidth);
			delta = CorrectBandDelta(resizeColumn, delta);
			IList columns = resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns;
			double num = resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth);
			double num2 = CalcDefinitiveDelta(resizeColumn, delta);
			AssignActualStars(resizeColumn);
			bool flag = CalcHasLeftStar(CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.VisibleBands), null, checkStarMinWidth: false);
			if (delta > 0.0)
			{
				ApplyResize(resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns, resizeColumn, resizeColumn.ColumnWidth + num2, (flag || resizeColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count > 1) ? new bool?(true) : ((bool?)null));
			}
			IList columns2 = CreateDefinitiveRow(resizeColumn.ParentBand, resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns);
			ApplyResize(columns2, resizeColumn, resizeColumn.ColumnWidth + delta - num2, flag ? ((bool?)null) : new bool?(false));
			if (delta < 0.0)
			{
				double num3 = resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth);
				SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, resizeColumn.ColumnWidth + num2);
				CalcDefinitiveColumns(new BandBase[1] { resizeColumn.ParentBand }, clearCache: true);
				bool hasStar = resizeColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count > 1 || CalcHasLeftStar(columns, null, checkStarMinWidth: false);
				ResizeRightColumns(columns, columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn), num2, hasStar, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: false);
				ResizeRightColumns(CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.GetBands(resizeColumn.ParentBand, isLeft: false)), -1, resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth) - num3, hasStar, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: false);
			}
			ChangeBandWidth(resizeColumn.ParentBand, resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth) - num, resizeColumn.BandRow, fixStarWidth: true);
			return resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns.Sum((ColumnBase x) => x.ColumnWidth) - num;
		}

		private double CorrectBandDelta(BaseColumn column, double delta)
		{
			if (column?.BandRow == null)
			{
				return delta;
			}
			if (column == column.BandRow.Columns[column.BandRow.Columns.Count - 1])
			{
				double bandMinWidth = GetBandMinWidth(column.ParentBand);
				double val = column.ParentBand.ColumnWidth + delta;
				return Math.Max(bandMinWidth, val) - column.ParentBand.ColumnWidth;
			}
			return delta;
		}

		private double GetBandMinWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					num2 += column.MinWidth;
				}
				num = Math.Max(num, num2);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void AssignActualStars(BaseColumn resizeColumn)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn item in CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.VisibleBands))
			{
				if (!item.Width.IsAbsolute && !item.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					num += item.Width.Value;
					num2 += item.ColumnWidth;
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in resizeColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					if (!column.Width.IsAbsolute && !column.Width.IsAuto)
					{
						double columnWidth = column.ColumnWidth;
						column.Width = new GridColumnWidth(num * columnWidth / num2, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
						column.ColumnWidth = columnWidth;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private double CalcDefinitiveDelta(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double delta)
		{
			BandRow definitiveRow = GetDefinitiveRow(resizeColumn.ParentBand, resizeColumn.BandRow);
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (definitiveRow != null)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column in definitiveRow.Columns)
				{
					num += ((column.Width.IsAbsolute || column.Width.IsAuto) ? column.Width.Value : column.MinWidth);
					num2 += ((column.Width.IsAbsolute || column.Width.IsAuto) ? column.ColumnWidth : column.MinWidth);
				}
			}
			double num3 = CalcCurrentWidth(resizeColumn);
			if (delta > 0.0)
			{
				return Math.Min(Math.Max(0.0, num2 - num3), delta);
			}
			return Math.Min(delta - Math.Min(num - num3, 0.0), 0.0);
		}

		private double CalcCurrentWidth(BaseColumn resizeColumn)
		{
			IList columns = resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns;
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			int num3 = columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn);
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				baseColumn.ForcedWidth = baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
				if (i != num3)
				{
					if (i > num3)
					{
						num2 += ((baseColumn.Width.IsAbsolute || baseColumn.Width.IsAuto) ? baseColumn.Width.Value : baseColumn.MinWidth);
					}
					else if (i < num3)
					{
						num += baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
					}
				}
			}
			return num + resizeColumn.ColumnWidth + num2;
		}

		private IList CreateDefinitiveRow(BandBase band, IList columns)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			foreach (BaseColumn item2 in CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: true)))
			{
				list.Add(item2);
			}
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				list.Add(column);
			}
			List<BaseColumn> list2 = CalcDefinitiveColumns(BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: false));
			foreach (BaseColumn item3 in list2)
			{
				list.Add(item3);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void ChangeBandWidth(BandBase band, double delta, BandRow skipRow, bool fixStarWidth)
		{
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow != skipRow)
				{
					ResizeRightColumns(actualRow.Columns, -1, 0.0 - delta, hasStar: true, reverse: false, fixStarWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private double CorrectColumnDelta(BaseColumn column, double delta)
		{
			if (column.ColumnWidth + delta < column.MinWidth)
			{
				return column.MinWidth - column.ColumnWidth;
			}
			if (column.ColumnWidth + delta > column.MaxWidth && IsDefinitive(column))
			{
				return column.MaxWidth - column.ColumnWidth;
			}
			return delta;
		}

		protected override bool IsDefinitive(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return bandRowCache[column.ParentBand] == column.BandRow;
		}
	}

		public static bool CanUseEditSettingsInExcelColumnFilter(ColumnBase column)
		{

		private static bool AllowAutoFilterCondition(ColumnBase column)
		{
			List<ClauseType> listOperationsByTypesSimple = GetListOperationsByTypesSimple(column);
			if (listOperationsByTypesSimple.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}

			{
				AutoFilterCondition.Like => listOperationsByTypesSimple.Contains((ClauseType)14), 
				AutoFilterCondition.Equals => listOperationsByTypesSimple.Contains((ClauseType)0), 
				AutoFilterCondition.Contains => listOperationsByTypesSimple.Contains((ClauseType)10), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		private static bool AllowAutoFilterCriteria(ColumnBase column)
		{

			if (!column.AutoFilterCriteria.HasValue)
			{

			}

			if (listOperationsByTypes.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return listOperationsByTypes.Contains(column.AutoFilterCriteria.Value);
		}

		public static bool GetAllowAutoFilter(ColumnBase column)
		{

				{
					return IsValidClause(column, CreateFilterColumn(column, getUniqueColumnValues: false), column.AutoFilterCriteria.Value, column.ColumnFilterMode == ColumnFilterMode.DisplayText, checkSingleFieldClause: true);
				}
				return GetDefaultOperation(column, allowChangeDefaultOperation: false).HasValue;
			}
			return AllowAutoFilterCriteria(column);
		}

	public class LayoutCalculator : ColumnsLayoutCalculator
	{
		protected LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner;

		private bool needRoundingLastColumn;

		protected bool HasStarColumns { get; private set; }

		public override bool AutoWidth => HasStarColumns;

		protected internal override bool SupportStarColumns => true;

		public LayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
			: base(viewInfo)
		{
		}

		protected sealed override void CalcActualLayoutCore(double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			this.layoutAssigner = layoutAssigner;
			this.needRoundingLastColumn = needRoundingLastColumn;
			CalcActualLayout(arrangeWidth - ViewInfo.FirstColumnIndent);
		}

		protected virtual void CalcActualLayout(double arrangeWidth)
		{
			CalcColumnsLayout((IList)base.VisibleColumns, arrangeWidth, fillPixelColumns: false);
			UpdateHasStarColumns((IList)base.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns);
		}

		protected void UpdateHasStarColumns(IList columns)
		{
			HasStarColumns = CalcHasLeftStar(columns, null, checkStarMinWidth: true);
		}

		protected void CalcColumnsLayout(IList columns, double arrangeWidth, bool fillPixelColumns)
		{
			arrangeWidth -= CalcFixedColumnsLayout(columns, arrangeWidth, !fillPixelColumns);
			arrangeWidth -= CalcStarColumnsLayout(columns, arrangeWidth, !fillPixelColumns);
			if (fillPixelColumns)
			{
				FillPixelColumns(columns, arrangeWidth, delegate(BaseColumn column, int index, double width)
				{
					column.ColumnWidth = width;
				});
			}
			AssignActualWidth(columns, fillPixelColumns);
		}

		private double FillPixelColumns(IList columns, double arrangeWidth, Action<BaseColumn, int, double> setWidth)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (column.Width.IsAbsolute || column.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					num2 += column.Width.Value;
					if (column.FixedWidth)
					{
						num += column.Width.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn2 = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				if (baseColumn2.Width.IsAbsolute || baseColumn2.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					double num3 = (double.IsNaN(baseColumn2.ForcedWidth) ? baseColumn2.Width.Value : baseColumn2.ForcedWidth);
					if (num == 0.0 || (num == num2 && baseColumn2.ParentBand != null))
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(baseColumn2.MinWidth, num3 + arrangeWidth * baseColumn2.Width.Value / num2);
					}
					else if (!baseColumn2.FixedWidth)
					{
						num3 = Math.Max(baseColumn2.MinWidth, num3 + arrangeWidth * baseColumn2.Width.Value / (num2 - num));
					}
					setWidth(baseColumn2, i, num3);
				}
			}
			return arrangeWidth - num;
		}

		private double CalcFixedColumnsLayout(IList columns, double arrangeWidth, bool checkForcedWidth)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (column.Width.IsAbsolute || column.Width.IsAuto || (checkForcedWidth && !double.IsNaN(column.ForcedWidth)))
				{
					column.ColumnWidth = GetColumnFixedWidth(column);
					num += column.ColumnWidth;
				}
				if (column.Width.IsStar && column.Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
				{
					column.ColumnWidth = column.MinWidth;
					num += column.ColumnWidth;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected double GetColumnFixedWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			double width = GetWidth(column);
			return Math.Min(Math.Max(width, column.MinWidth), column.MaxWidth);
		}

		protected virtual double GetWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (!double.IsNaN(column.ForcedWidth))
			{
				return column.ForcedWidth;
			}
			if (!double.IsNaN(column.ActualWidth))
			{
				return column.ActualWidth;
			}
			return column.Width.Value;
		}

		private double CalcStarColumnsLayout(IList columns, double arrangeWidth, bool checkForcedWidth)
		{
			double starSum = 0.0;
			List<BaseColumn> starColumns = GetStarColumns(columns, 0, checkForcedWidth, delegate(BaseColumn x)
			{
				starSum += x.Width.Value;
			});
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			while (num < starColumns.Count)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = starColumns[num];
				double num4 = arrangeWidth * baseColumn.Width.Value / starSum;
				if (double.IsInfinity(num4))
				{
					num4 = 120.0;
				}
				if (num4 > baseColumn.MaxWidth && IsDefinitive(baseColumn))
				{
					foreach (BaseColumn item in list)
					{
						starSum += item.Width.Value;
						arrangeWidth += item.ColumnWidth;
						num2 -= item.ColumnWidth;
						starColumns.Insert(0, item);
					}
					list.Clear();
				}
				else if (num4 < baseColumn.MinWidth)
				{
					list.Add(baseColumn);
				}
				if (num4 < baseColumn.MinWidth || (num4 > baseColumn.MaxWidth && IsDefinitive(baseColumn)))
				{
					num4 = Math.Min(Math.Max(num4, baseColumn.MinWidth), baseColumn.MaxWidth);
					starSum -= baseColumn.Width.Value;
					arrangeWidth -= num4;
					starColumns.Remove(baseColumn);
					num = 0;
					num2 += num4;
					num3 = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
					num3 += num4;
				}
				baseColumn.ColumnWidth = num4;
				baseColumn.ActualWidth = num4;
			}
			return num2 + num3;
		}

		private void AssignActualWidth(IList columns, bool useAutoWidth)
		{
			useAutoWidth = useAutoWidth || GetStarColumns(columns, 0, checkForcedWidth: true).Any();
			double rest = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				baseColumn.HeaderWidth = baseColumn.ColumnWidth + ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(baseColumn);
				double value = (useAutoWidth ? AutoWidthHelper.GetRoundedActualColumnWidth(baseColumn.HeaderWidth, ref rest, i == columns.Count - 1) : DXArranger.Floor(baseColumn.HeaderWidth, 0));
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(baseColumn, value);
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyResizeCore(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			ApplyResize(resizeColumn, newWidth - indentWidth, correctWidths);
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyResize(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool correctWidths)
		{
			if (!correctWidths)
			{
				SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth);
				return;
			}
			IList columns = base.VisibleColumns.Where((ColumnBase x) => x.Fixed == resizeColumn.Fixed).ToList();
			if (resizeColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				ApplyResize(columns, resizeColumn, Math.Min(Math.Max(newWidth, resizeColumn.MinWidth), resizeColumn.MaxWidth), CalcHasLeftStar(columns, null, checkStarMinWidth: false), CalcHasLeftStar(columns, resizeColumn, checkStarMinWidth: true), checkExcessiveWidth: true);
				return;
			}
			newWidth = Math.Min(Math.Max(CorrectFixedDelta(resizeColumn, newWidth), resizeColumn.MinWidth), resizeColumn.MaxWidth);
			double delta = newWidth - resizeColumn.ColumnWidth;
			SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth);
			CorrectFixedRightColumns(columns, resizeColumn, delta);
		}

		private double CorrectFixedDelta(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth)
		{
			if (resizeColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return newWidth;
			}
			SetFixedColumnWidth();
			double arrangeWidth = GetArrangeWidth();
			newWidth = Math.Min(newWidth, GetArrangeWidth() - CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int index) => (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.None || x == resizeColumn) ? 0.0 : x.Width.Value) - 1.0);
			if (resizeColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.Right || CalcHasLeftStar((IList)base.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns, null, checkStarMinWidth: false))
			{
				return newWidth;
			}
			int columnIndex = base.VisibleColumns.IndexOf((ColumnBase)resizeColumn);
			double num = CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int index) => (x.Fixed != FixedStyle.Right || (!x.Width.IsAbsolute && !x.Width.IsAuto) || index >= columnIndex) ? 0.0 : x.MaxWidth);
			double num2 = CalcColumnWidth(delegate(BaseColumn x, int index)
			{
				if (x.Width.IsStar)
				{
					return x.MinWidth;
				}
				return (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right && index <= columnIndex) ? 0.0 : x.Width.Value;
			});
			return Math.Max(newWidth, arrangeWidth - num2 - num);
		}

		private double CalcColumnWidth(Func<BaseColumn, int, double> getWidth)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				num += getWidth(base.VisibleColumns[i], i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void SetFixedColumnWidth()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase visibleColumn in base.VisibleColumns)
			{
				if (visibleColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.None && (visibleColumn.Width.IsAbsolute || visibleColumn.Width.IsAuto) && double.IsNaN(visibleColumn.ForcedWidth))
				{
					visibleColumn.Width = visibleColumn.ActualHeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(visibleColumn);
					visibleColumn.ColumnWidth = visibleColumn.Width.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void CorrectFixedColumnsWidth()
		{
			double num = CalcHorizontalViewPort();
			double num2 = CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int index) => (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.None) ? 0.0 : x.ColumnWidth);
			if (num < num2 && num > 0.0)
			{
				FillFixedColumns(GetFixedColumns(skipLeft: false), num - num2);
			}
		}

		private void FillFixedColumns(IList columns, double delta)
		{
			double rest = 0.0;
			FillPixelColumns(columns, delta, delegate(BaseColumn column, int index, double newWidth)
			{
				double columnWidth = (column.HeaderWidth = newWidth + ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column));
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(column, AutoWidthHelper.GetRoundedActualColumnWidth(columnWidth, ref rest, index == columns.Count - 1));
				if (column is ColumnBase columnBase)
				{
					columnBase.ActualDataWidth = column.ActualHeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column);
				}
			});
		}

		private void CorrectFixedRightColumns(IList columns, BaseColumn resizeColumn, double delta)
		{
			if (resizeColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right && !CalcHasLeftStar((IList)base.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns, null, checkStarMinWidth: false))
			{
				double arrangeWidth = GetArrangeWidth();
				double num = CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int i) => x.ColumnWidth);
				int index = columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn);
				RestorePixelColumns(columns, index, delta, reverse: true);
				if (arrangeWidth > num)
				{
					FillPixelColumns(columns, index, num - arrangeWidth, reverse: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private IList GetFixedColumns(bool skipLeft)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			foreach (ColumnBase visibleColumn in base.VisibleColumns)
			{
				if (visibleColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.None && !(visibleColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left && skipLeft))
				{
					list.Add(visibleColumn);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override void FillByLastFixedColumn()
		{
			double num = CalcHorizontalViewPort() - ViewInfo.TableView.RightDataAreaIndent - ViewInfo.TableView.RightGroupAreaIndent + 1.0;
			double num2 = CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int index) => (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.None) ? 0.0 : x.ColumnWidth);
			double num3 = CalcColumnWidth((BaseColumn x, int index) => (x.Fixed != FixedStyle.None) ? 0.0 : x.ColumnWidth);
			if (num > num2 + num3)
			{
				FillFixedColumns(GetFixedColumns(skipLeft: true), num - num2 - num3);
			}
		}

		protected void ApplyResize(IList columns, BaseColumn column, double newWidth, bool? forceStars = null)
		{
			ApplyResize(columns, column, newWidth, forceStars.HasValue ? forceStars.Value : CalcHasLeftStar(columns, null, checkStarMinWidth: false), forceStars.HasValue ? forceStars.Value : CalcHasLeftStar(columns, column, checkStarMinWidth: true), checkExcessiveWidth: true);
		}

		protected void ApplyResize(IList columns, BaseColumn column, double newWidth, bool hasStarColumns, bool hasLeftStar, bool checkExcessiveWidth)
		{
			AssignActualStars(column, columns);
			double delta = SetColumnWidth(columns, column, newWidth, hasStarColumns, hasLeftStar, checkExcessiveWidth);
			if (hasStarColumns)
			{
				ResizeRightColumns(columns, columns.IndexOf(column), delta, hasLeftStar || column.Width.IsStar, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: false);
			}
		}

		private bool IsRealStar(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column.ColumnWidth > column.MinWidth)
			{
				return column.ColumnWidth < column.MaxWidth;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AssignActualStars(BaseColumn resizeColumn, IList columns)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			BaseColumn baseColumn = null;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (!column.Width.IsAbsolute && !column.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					if (baseColumn == null)
					{
						baseColumn = column;
					}
					if (IsRealStar(column))
					{
						num += column.Width.Value;
						num2 += column.ColumnWidth;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 == 0.0)
			{
				if (baseColumn == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = baseColumn.Width.Value;
				num2 = baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
			}
			for (int i = columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn); i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn3 = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				if (!baseColumn3.Width.IsAbsolute && !IsRealStar(baseColumn3) && !baseColumn3.Width.IsAuto)
				{
					double columnWidth = baseColumn3.ColumnWidth;
					baseColumn3.Width = new GridColumnWidth(columnWidth * num / num2, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
					baseColumn3.ColumnWidth = columnWidth;
				}
			}
		}

		protected double ResizeRightColumns(IList columns, int index, double delta, bool hasStar, bool reverse, bool fixStarWidth)
		{
			delta = RestorePixelColumns(columns, index, delta, reverse);
			delta = FillStarColumns(columns, index, delta, fixStarWidth);
			if (hasStar)
			{
				delta = FillPixelColumns(columns, index, delta, reverse);
			}
			return delta;
		}

		private double FillStarColumns(IList columns, int index, double delta, bool fixStarWidth)
		{
			double starWidth = 0.0;
			double starSum = 0.0;
			List<BaseColumn> starColumns = GetStarColumns(columns, index + 1, checkForcedWidth: false, delegate(BaseColumn x)
			{
				starWidth += x.ColumnWidth;
				starSum += x.Width.Value;
			});
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			while (num < starColumns.Count)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = starColumns[num];
				double num3 = baseColumn.ColumnWidth - delta * baseColumn.Width.Value / starSum;
				if (num3 < baseColumn.MinWidth || (num3 > baseColumn.MaxWidth && IsDefinitive(baseColumn)))
				{
					num3 = Math.Min(Math.Max(num3, baseColumn.MinWidth), baseColumn.MaxWidth);
					delta += num3 - baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
					double value = starSum / starWidth * num3;
					starSum -= baseColumn.Width.Value;
					starWidth -= baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
					baseColumn.Width = new GridColumnWidth(value, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
					if (fixStarWidth)
					{
						baseColumn.ForcedWidth = num3;
					}
					baseColumn.ColumnWidth = num3;
					starColumns.RemoveAt(num);
					num = 0;
					num2 = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					num++;
					num2 += num3 - baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
				}
			}
			foreach (BaseColumn item in starColumns)
			{
				double num4 = item.ColumnWidth - delta * item.Width.Value / starSum;
				item.Width = new GridColumnWidth(starSum / starWidth * num4, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
				if (fixStarWidth)
				{
					item.ForcedWidth = num4;
				}
				item.ColumnWidth = num4;
			}
			return delta + num2;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsDefinitive(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual double RestorePixelColumns(IList initialColumns, int index, double delta, bool reverse)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (reverse)
			{
				initialColumns = initialColumns.Cast<BaseColumn>().Reverse().ToList();
				index = initialColumns.Count - 1 - index;
			}
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			for (int i = index + 1; i < initialColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)initialColumns[i];
				if (!baseColumn.Width.IsStar && (!baseColumn.FixedWidth || !IsDefinitive(baseColumn)))
				{
					list.Add(baseColumn);
					num += baseColumn.Width.Value - GetWidth(baseColumn);
				}
			}
			double num2 = delta;
			foreach (BaseColumn item in list)
			{
				double num3 = ((num != 0.0) ? (delta * (item.Width.Value - GetWidth(item)) / num) : 0.0);
				double val = item.ColumnWidth - num3;
				val = Math.Min(Math.Max(val, item.MinWidth), item.MaxWidth);
				val = ((!(delta < 0.0)) ? Math.Min(item.ColumnWidth, Math.Max(val, item.Width.Value)) : Math.Max(item.ColumnWidth, Math.Min(val, item.Width.Value)));
				num2 += val - item.ColumnWidth;
				item.ForcedWidth = val;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected virtual double FillPixelColumns(IList initialColumns, int index, double delta, bool reverse)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (reverse)
			{
				initialColumns = initialColumns.Cast<BaseColumn>().Reverse().ToList();
				index = initialColumns.Count - 1 - index;
			}
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			for (int i = index + 1; i < initialColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)initialColumns[i];
				if (!baseColumn.Width.IsStar && (!baseColumn.FixedWidth || !IsDefinitive(baseColumn)))
				{
					list.Add(baseColumn);
					num += baseColumn.ForcedWidth - baseColumn.MinWidth;
				}
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			while (num2 < list.Count)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn2 = list[num2];
				double num4 = ((num != 0.0) ? (delta * (baseColumn2.ForcedWidth - baseColumn2.MinWidth) / num) : delta);
				double num5 = baseColumn2.ForcedWidth - num4;
				if (num5 < baseColumn2.MinWidth || num5 > baseColumn2.MaxWidth)
				{
					num5 = Math.Min(Math.Max(num5, baseColumn2.MinWidth), baseColumn2.MaxWidth);
					delta += num5 - baseColumn2.ForcedWidth;
					num -= baseColumn2.ForcedWidth - baseColumn2.MinWidth;
					list.RemoveAt(num2);
					num2 = 0;
					num3 = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					num2++;
					num3 += num5 - baseColumn2.ForcedWidth;
				}
				baseColumn2.ForcedWidth = num5;
				baseColumn2.ColumnWidth = num5;
				baseColumn2.ActualWidth = num5;
			}
			return delta + num3;
		}

		private double SetColumnWidth(IList columns, BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool hasStarColumns, bool hasLeftStar, bool checkExcessiveWidth)
		{
			double num = newWidth - resizeColumn.ColumnWidth;
			if (hasStarColumns)
			{
				CalcMinMaxWidth(columns, columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn), out var minWidth, out var maxWidth, out var actualWidth);
				minWidth = actualWidth - minWidth;
				maxWidth = actualWidth - maxWidth;
				double num2 = (checkExcessiveWidth ? Math.Round(CalcExcessWidth(columns), 4) : 0.0);
				if (num > 0.0 && hasLeftStar)
				{
					num = Math.Min(minWidth, num);
				}
				if (num < 0.0)
				{
					num = Math.Max(maxWidth - num2, num);
				}
				if (resizeColumn.Width.IsStar && num2 > 0.0)
				{
					newWidth = resizeColumn.ColumnWidth;
					num = 0.0;
				}
				else
				{
					newWidth = resizeColumn.ColumnWidth + num;
					num += Math.Max(num2, 0.0);
				}
			}
			SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth);
			return num;
		}

		protected void CalcMinMaxWidth(IList columns, int index, out double minWidth, out double maxWidth, out double actualWidth)
		{
			minWidth = 0.0;
			maxWidth = 0.0;
			actualWidth = 0.0;
			for (int i = index + 1; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				if (baseColumn.Width.IsStar || !baseColumn.FixedWidth || !IsDefinitive(baseColumn))
				{
					actualWidth += baseColumn.ColumnWidth;
					minWidth += baseColumn.MinWidth;
					maxWidth += baseColumn.MaxWidth;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void SetColumnWidth(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool isAutoResize = false)
		{
			newWidth = Math.Max(resizeColumn.MinWidth, newWidth);
			if (resizeColumn.Width.IsAbsolute || resizeColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.None || resizeColumn.Width.IsAuto)
			{
				resizeColumn.Width = ((resizeColumn.Width.IsAuto && isAutoResize) ? new GridColumnWidth(newWidth, GridColumnUnitType.Auto) : ((GridColumnWidth)newWidth));
			}
			else
			{
				resizeColumn.Width = new GridColumnWidth(resizeColumn.Width.Value / resizeColumn.ColumnWidth * newWidth, GridColumnUnitType.Star);
			}
			resizeColumn.ColumnWidth = newWidth;
		}

		private double GetArrangeWidth()
		{
			return GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false) - ViewInfo.FirstColumnIndent;
		}

		private List<BaseColumn> GetStarColumns(IList columns, int index, bool checkForcedWidth, Action<BaseColumn> action = null)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			for (int i = index; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				if (baseColumn.Width.IsStar && baseColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.None && (!checkForcedWidth || double.IsNaN(baseColumn.ForcedWidth)))
				{
					list.Add(baseColumn);
					action?.Invoke(baseColumn);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected bool CalcHasLeftStar(IList columns, BaseColumn resizeColumn, bool checkStarMinWidth)
		{
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				if (column.Width.IsStar && (!checkStarMinWidth || column.MinWidth != column.ColumnWidth))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (resizeColumn == column)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcExcessWidth(IList columns)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				num += column.ColumnWidth;
			}
			return Math.Max(0.0, num - GetArrangeWidth());
		}

		public override void ApplyBestFit(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			if (!resizeColumn.GetAllowResizing() && !resizeColumn.Width.IsAuto)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (resizeColumn.Width.IsAbsolute || resizeColumn.Width.IsAuto)
			{
				SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth, autoBestFit);
				return;
			}
			ViewInfo.GridView.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
			double columnWidth = resizeColumn.ColumnWidth;
			SetColumnWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth);
			IList columns = base.VisibleColumns.Where((ColumnBase x) => x != resizeColumn).ToList();
			ResizeRightColumns(columns, -1, resizeColumn.ColumnWidth - columnWidth, hasStar: true, reverse: false, fixStarWidth: false);
			ViewInfo.GridView.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
		}
	}
	public abstract class RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected readonly DataViewBase View;

		protected IColumnCollection Columns => View.ColumnsCore;

		protected abstract bool ApplyVisibleIndex { get; }

		public RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperBase(DataViewBase view)
		{
			View = view;
		}

		public void RebuildColumns()
		{
			IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumns = null;
			View.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.DoLockedAction<IList<ColumnBase>>((Func<IList<ColumnBase>>)(() => visibleColumns = RebuildVisibleColumns()));
			View.AssignVisibleColumns(visibleColumns);
		}

		public void UpdateColumnsPositions(IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumns)
		{
			View.UpdateVisibleIndexesLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(visibleColumns);
			});
			View.AssignVisibleColumns(visibleColumns);
		}

		public void ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(BaseColumn source, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (View.DataControl != null && View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ApplyColumnVisibleIndex(source, oldVisibleIndex);
				return;
			}
			ColumnBase source2 = (ColumnBase)source;
			int visibleIndex = CorrectVisibleIndex(Columns, source2, applyCkeckBoxColumnCorrection: true);
			ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore(source2, visibleIndex, oldVisibleIndex);
		}

		public abstract Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace> GetColumnDropTarget(ColumnBase source, int targetVisibleIndex, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom);

		internal static int CorrectVisibleIndex(IList parentCollection, BaseColumn source, bool applyCkeckBoxColumnCorrection)
		{
			int num = (parentCollection.Contains(source) ? (parentCollection.Count - 1) : parentCollection.Count);
			if (applyCkeckBoxColumnCorrection && source.View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
			{
				num++;
			}
			int num2 = Math.Max(Math.Min(source.VisibleIndex, num), 0);
			if (applyCkeckBoxColumnCorrection && source.View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible && num2 == 0)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		protected bool IsColumnVisible(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column.Visible)
			{
				return View.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(column);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected void PatchColumns(IList<ColumnBase> columns, bool hasFixedLeftColumns)
		{
			if (View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
			{
				View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn.Fixed = (hasFixedLeftColumns ? FixedStyle.Left : FixedStyle.None);
				columns.Insert(0, View.CheckBoxSelectorColumn);
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumnsList)
		{
			if (View is ITableView && View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.UpdateVisibleColumnsAndBands(visibleColumnsList);
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleColumnsList.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = visibleColumnsList[i];
				BaseColumn.SetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)columnBase, i);
				if (ApplyVisibleIndex)
				{
					BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)columnBase, i);
				}
				AssignColumnPosition(columnBase, i, visibleColumnsList.Count);
			}
		}

		private IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumns()
		{
			if (View is ITableView && View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				return View.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.RebuildBandsVisibleColumns();
			}
			return RebuildVisibleColumnsCore();
		}

		protected abstract IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore();

		protected abstract void ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore(ColumnBase source, int visibleIndex, int oldVisibleIndex);

		private void AssignColumnPosition(ColumnBase column, int index, int visibleColumnsCount)
		{
			if (View is ITableView)
			{
				AssignColumnPosition(column, index, visibleColumnsCount, (ITableView)View);
			}
		}

		internal static void AssignColumnPosition(ColumnBase column, int index, int visibleColumnsCount, ITableView view)
		{
			column.ColumnPosition = GetColumnPosition(index, view.ShowIndicator, ((DataViewBase)view).IsRootView, view.ActualShowDetailHeader);
			column.IsLast = index == visibleColumnsCount - 1;
			column.IsFirst = index == 0;
		}

		private static ColumnPosition GetColumnPosition(int index, bool showIndicator, bool isRootView, bool showDetailButtons)
		{
			if (index == 0 && isRootView && !showIndicator && !showDetailButtons)
			{
				return ColumnPosition.Left;
			}
			return ColumnPosition.Middle;
		}

		public abstract int GetFixedNoneColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior);

		public abstract int GetFixedLeftColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior);

		public abstract int GetFixedRightColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior);
	}
	public class RebuildColumnsLayoutHelper : RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected override bool ApplyVisibleIndex => false;

		public RebuildColumnsLayoutHelper(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>(base.Columns as IEnumerable<ColumnBase>);
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = list[i];
				columnBase.index = i;
				switch (columnBase.Fixed)
				{
				case FixedStyle.Left:
					num++;
					flag |= columnBase.Visible;
					break;
				case FixedStyle.None:
					num2++;
					break;
				case FixedStyle.Right:
					num3++;
					break;
				}
			}
			View.ViewBehavior.UpdateFixedAreaColumnsCount(num, num2, num3);
			list.Sort(View.VisibleComparison);
			PatchColumns(list, flag);
			List<ColumnBase> list2 = new List<ColumnBase>();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase2 = list[j];
				BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)columnBase2, j);
				if (IsColumnVisible(columnBase2))
				{
					list2.Add(columnBase2);
				}
			}
			UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(list2);
			return new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>(list2);
		}

		protected override void ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore(ColumnBase source, int visibleIndex, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)source, visibleIndex);
			int actualVisibleIndex = ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(base.Columns, source, oldVisibleIndex);
			if (source.Visible)
			{
				UpdateVisibleColumnsList(source, actualVisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		internal static int ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(IList parentCollection, BaseColumn source, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			int actualVisibleIndex = -1;
			ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(parentCollection, source, oldVisibleIndex, delegate(BaseColumn column, bool isMoveToRight)
			{
				if (source.Visible && column.Visible)
				{
					if (isMoveToRight)
					{
						if (actualVisibleIndex < column.ActualVisibleIndex)
						{
							actualVisibleIndex = column.ActualVisibleIndex;
						}
					}
					else if (actualVisibleIndex == -1 || actualVisibleIndex > column.ActualVisibleIndex)
					{
						actualVisibleIndex = column.ActualVisibleIndex;
					}
				}
			});
			if (actualVisibleIndex == -1 && oldVisibleIndex != -1)
			{
				actualVisibleIndex = source.ActualVisibleIndex;
			}
			return actualVisibleIndex;
		}

		internal static void ApplyVisibleIndexInBounds(IList parentCollection, BaseColumn source, int oldVisibleIndex, Action<BaseColumn, bool> columnAction)
		{
			oldVisibleIndex = ((oldVisibleIndex > -1) ? oldVisibleIndex : int.MaxValue);
			int visibleIndex = source.VisibleIndex;
			int leftBound = Math.Min(oldVisibleIndex, visibleIndex);
			int rightBound = Math.Max(oldVisibleIndex, visibleIndex);
			bool flag = visibleIndex > oldVisibleIndex;
			for (int i = 0; i < parentCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)parentCollection[i];
				if (baseColumn != source && IsInBounds(baseColumn, flag, leftBound, rightBound))
				{
					int index = (flag ? (baseColumn.VisibleIndex - 1) : (baseColumn.VisibleIndex + 1));
					columnAction(baseColumn, flag);
					BaseColumn.SetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)baseColumn, index);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsInBounds(BaseColumn column, bool isMoveToRight, int leftBound, int rightBound)
		{
			int visibleIndex = column.VisibleIndex;
			if (isMoveToRight)
			{
				if (visibleIndex > leftBound)
				{
					return visibleIndex <= rightBound;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (visibleIndex >= leftBound)
			{
				return visibleIndex < rightBound;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void UpdateVisibleColumnsList(ColumnBase source, int actualVisibleIndex)
		{
			ObservableCollection<ColumnBase> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>(View.VisibleColumnsCore);
			observableCollection.Remove(source);
			observableCollection.Insert((actualVisibleIndex != -1) ? actualVisibleIndex : 0, source);
			UpdateColumnsPositions(observableCollection);
		}

		public override Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace> GetColumnDropTarget(ColumnBase source, int targetVisibleIndex, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			int num = (View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible ? (base.Columns.Count + 1) : base.Columns.Count);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(source, BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
			}
			if (num <= targetVisibleIndex)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(GetColumnFromVisibleIndex(num - 1), BandedViewDropPlace.Right);
			}
			if (targetVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(GetColumnFromVisibleIndex(View.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible ? 1 : 0), BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
			}
			return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(GetColumnFromVisibleIndex(targetVisibleIndex), BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
		}

		private ColumnBase GetColumnFromVisibleIndex(int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = base.Columns[i];
				if (columnBase.VisibleIndex == targetVisibleIndex)
				{
					return columnBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		}

		public override int GetFixedRightColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior)
		{

	public class RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperLegacy : RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperBase
	{
		protected override bool ApplyVisibleIndex => true;

		public RebuildColumnsLayoutHelperLegacy(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> RebuildVisibleColumnsCore()
		{
			List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = base.Columns[i];
				columnBase.index = i;
				if (IsColumnVisible(columnBase))
				{
					list.Add(columnBase);
					flag |= columnBase.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left;
				}
			}
			PatchColumns(list, flag);
			list.Sort(View.VisibleComparison);
			UpdateVisibleColumnsPositions(list);
			return list;
		}

		protected override void ApplyColumnVisibleIndexCore(ColumnBase source, int visibleIndex, int oldVisibleIndex)
		{
			ObservableCollection<ColumnBase> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>(View.VisibleColumnsCore);
			observableCollection.Remove(source);
			if (visibleIndex >= observableCollection.Count)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(source);
			}
			else
			{
				observableCollection.Insert(visibleIndex, source);
			}
			UpdateColumnsPositions(observableCollection);
		}

		public override Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace> GetColumnDropTarget(ColumnBase source, int targetVisibleIndex, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(source, BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
			}
			if (View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count <= targetVisibleIndex)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(View.VisibleColumnsCore[View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1], BandedViewDropPlace.Right);
			}
			if (targetVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(View.VisibleColumnsCore[0], BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
			}
			return new Tuple<ColumnBase, BandedViewDropPlace>(View.VisibleColumnsCore[targetVisibleIndex], BandedViewDropPlace.Left);
		}

		public override int GetFixedNoneColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior)
		{
			return tableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns.Count;
		}

		public override int GetFixedLeftColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior)
		{
			return tableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count;
		}

		public override int GetFixedRightColumnsCount(TableViewBehavior tableViewBehavior)
		{
			return tableViewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count;
		}
	}

		public static bool AreSameItems(ServiceSummaryItem item, ConditionalFormatSummaryType summaryType, string fieldName, DataProviderBase dataProvider)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Type type = GetType(fieldName, dataProvider);
			if (item.FieldName == fieldName && item.SummaryType == ToSummaryItemType(summaryType, type))
			{
				return item.CustomServiceSummaryItemType == ToCustomServiceSummaryItemType(summaryType, type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Type GetType(string fieldName, DataProviderBase dataProvider)
		{
			return dataProvider.GetActualColumnInfo(fieldName).With((DataColumnInfo x) => x.Type);
		}

		private static CustomServiceSummaryItemType? ToCustomServiceSummaryItemType(ConditionalFormatSummaryType summaryType, Type type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0018: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch (summaryType - 2)
			{
			case 1:
				return CustomServiceSummaryItemType.SortedList;
			case 0:
				if (type == typeof(DateTime))
				{
					return CustomServiceSummaryItemType.DateTimeAverage;
				}
				return null;
			case 2:
				return CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Unique;
			case 3:
				return CustomServiceSummaryItemType.Duplicate;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static SummaryItemType ToSummaryItemType(ConditionalFormatSummaryType summaryType, Type type)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			switch ((int)summaryType)
			{
			case 0:
				return (SummaryItemType)1;
			case 1:
				return (SummaryItemType)2;
			case 2:
				if (type != typeof(DateTime))
				{
					return (SummaryItemType)4;
				}
				return (SummaryItemType)5;
			case 3:
			case 4:
			case 5:
				return (SummaryItemType)5;
			default:
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
		}

			SetExpressionConditionProperties(editableCondition, (ExpressionEditUnit)(object)unit);
