			return editableCondition;
		}

		public IModelItem BuildDataUpdateFormatCondition(AnimationEditUnit unit, IModelItem source)
		{
			IModelItem editableCondition = GetEditableCondition(source, typeof(DataUpdateFormatCondition));
			SetExpressionConditionProperties(editableCondition, (ExpressionEditUnit)(object)unit);
			((BaseEditUnit)unit).SetModelItemProperty<AnimationEditUnit, DataUpdateRule>(editableCondition, DataUpdateFormatCondition.RuleProperty, (Expression<Func<AnimationEditUnit, DataUpdateRule>>)((AnimationEditUnit x) => x.Rule));
			((BaseEditUnit)unit).SetModelItemProperty<AnimationEditUnit, DataUpdateAnimationSettings>(editableCondition, DataUpdateFormatCondition.AnimationSettingsProperty, (Expression<Func<AnimationEditUnit, DataUpdateAnimationSettings>>)((AnimationEditUnit x) => x.AnimationSettings));
			return editableCondition;
		}

		private IModelItem GetEditableCondition(IModelItem source, Type type)
		{
			return source ?? context.CreateItem(type);
		}

		private void SetBaseProperties(IModelItem item, BaseEditUnit unit)
		{
			unit.SetModelItemProperty<BaseEditUnit, string>(item, FormatConditionBase.FieldNameProperty, (Expression<Func<BaseEditUnit, string>>)((BaseEditUnit x) => x.FieldName));
			unit.SetModelItemProperty<BaseEditUnit, string>(item, FormatConditionBase.ExpressionProperty, (Expression<Func<BaseEditUnit, string>>)((BaseEditUnit x) => x.Expression));
			unit.SetModelItemProperty<BaseEditUnit, string>(item, FormatConditionBase.PredefinedFormatNameProperty, (Expression<Func<BaseEditUnit, string>>)((BaseEditUnit x) => x.PredefinedFormatName));
			unit.SetModelItemProperty<BaseEditUnit, bool>(item, FormatConditionBase.IsEnabledProperty, (Expression<Func<BaseEditUnit, bool>>)((BaseEditUnit x) => x.IsEnabled));
			unit.SetModelItemProperty<BaseEditUnit, bool>(item, FormatConditionBase.ApplyToRowProperty, (Expression<Func<BaseEditUnit, bool>>)((BaseEditUnit x) => x.ApplyToRow));
			Freezable format = unit.GetFormat();
			if (format != null && unit.PredefinedFormatName == null && !object.Equals(format, item.Properties["Format"].ComputedValue))
			{
				item.Properties[FormatConditionBase.PredefinedFormatNameProperty.Name].ClearValue();
			}
		}

		private void SetExpressionConditionProperties(IModelItem item, ExpressionEditUnit unit)
		{
			SetBaseProperties(item, (BaseEditUnit)(object)unit);
			((BaseEditUnit)unit).SetModelItemProperty<ExpressionEditUnit, Format>(item, ExpressionConditionBase.FormatProperty, (Expression<Func<ExpressionEditUnit, Format>>)((ExpressionEditUnit x) => x.Format));
		}

		private void SetIndicatorProperties(IModelItem item, IndicatorEditUnit unit)
		{
			SetBaseProperties(item, (BaseEditUnit)(object)unit);
			((BaseEditUnit)unit).SetModelItemProperty<IndicatorEditUnit, object>(item, IndicatorFormatConditionBase.MinValueProperty, (Expression<Func<IndicatorEditUnit, object>>)((IndicatorEditUnit x) => x.MinValue));
			((BaseEditUnit)unit).SetModelItemProperty<IndicatorEditUnit, object>(item, IndicatorFormatConditionBase.MaxValueProperty, (Expression<Func<IndicatorEditUnit, object>>)((IndicatorEditUnit x) => x.MaxValue));
		}
	}
	public class ColorScalePreviewConverter : MarkupExtension, IValueConverter
	{
		private static System.Windows.Point startPoint = new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.5);

		private static System.Windows.Point endPoint = new System.Windows.Point(1.0, 0.5);

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ColorScaleFormat val = (ColorScaleFormat)((value is ColorScaleFormat) ? value : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			GradientStopCollection gradientStopCollection = new GradientStopCollection();
			gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(val.ColorMin, 0.0));
			if (val.ColorMiddle.HasValue)
			{
				gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(val.ColorMiddle.Value, 0.5));
			}
			gradientStopCollection.Add(new GradientStop(val.ColorMax, 1.0));
			return new LinearGradientBrush
			{
				StartPoint = startPoint,
				EndPoint = endPoint,
				GradientStops = gradientStopCollection
			};
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override object ProvideValue(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
	[Browsable(false)]
	[DXToolboxBrowsable(false)]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class PreviewTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ColorTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate DataBarTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate IconSetTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate FormatTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate EmptyTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item is Format)
			{
				return FormatTemplate;
			}
			if (item is ColorScaleFormat)
			{
				return ColorTemplate;
			}
			if (item is DataBarFormat)
			{
				return DataBarTemplate;
			}
			if (item is IconFormatStyle)
			{
				return IconSetTemplate;
			}
			return EmptyTemplate;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SelectionRectangleHelper
	{
		protected System.Windows.Point startPointView;

		protected System.Windows.Point endPointView;

		protected Rect actualRect;

		protected double IndicatorWidth { get; set; }

		public System.Windows.Point StartPoint => startPointView;

		public System.Windows.Point EndPoint => endPointView;

		internal static void CreateSelectionRectangle(DataViewBase view)
		{
			Border border = new Border();
			border.Style = view.SelectionRectangleStyle;
			view.SelectionRectangle = border;
		}

		public abstract void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase view, int rowIndex = 0, ColumnBase column = null);

		public abstract void UpdateSelection(DataViewBase view, DataViewBehavior behavior, double indicatorWidth = 0.0);

		public void OnMouseUp(DataViewBase view)
		{
			view.SelectionRectangle = null;
		}

		public System.Windows.Point GetTransformPoint(DataViewBase view, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			System.Windows.Point minTransformPoint = GetMinTransformPoint(view, IndicatorWidth);
			System.Windows.Point maxTransformPoint = GetMaxTransformPoint(view);
			System.Windows.Point result = view.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.TransformToAncestor(view.RootView.DataControl).Transform(point);
			if (result.Y > maxTransformPoint.Y)
			{
				result.Y = maxTransformPoint.Y;
			}
			if (result.Y < minTransformPoint.Y)
			{
				result.Y = minTransformPoint.Y;
			}
			if (result.X > maxTransformPoint.X)
			{
				result.X = maxTransformPoint.X;
			}
			if (result.X < minTransformPoint.X)
			{
				result.X = minTransformPoint.X;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetMinTransformPoint(DataViewBase view, double indicatorWidth)
		{
			return view.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.TransformToAncestor(view.RootView).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(indicatorWidth, 0.0));
		}

		public static System.Windows.Point GetMaxTransformPoint(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return view.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.TransformToAncestor(view.RootView).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(view.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth, view.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight));
		}

		protected System.Windows.Point GetTransformPoint(DataViewBase view, DataViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			return GetTransformPoint(view.RootView, behavior.View.RootView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition);
		}

		protected void UpdateActualRect()
		{
			double x;
			double num;
			if (endPointView.X < startPointView.X)
			{
				x = endPointView.X;
				num = startPointView.X - endPointView.X;
			}
			else
			{
				x = startPointView.X;
				num = endPointView.X - startPointView.X;
			}
			double y;
			double num2;
			if (endPointView.Y < startPointView.Y)
			{
				y = endPointView.Y;
				num2 = startPointView.Y - endPointView.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				y = startPointView.Y;
				num2 = endPointView.Y - startPointView.Y;
			}
			if (num != 0.0 || num2 != 0.0)
			{
				if (num < 1.0)
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				if (num2 < 1.0)
				{
					num2 = 1.0;
				}
			}
			actualRect = new Rect(x, y, num, num2);
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectionRect(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.SelectionRectangle == null)
			{
				CreateSelectionRectangle(view);
			}
			Border selectionRectangle = view.SelectionRectangle;
			UpdateActualRect();
			view.RootView.SelectionRectanglAdorner.UpdateLocation(new System.Windows.Point(actualRect.X, actualRect.Y));
			selectionRectangle.Width = actualRect.Width;
			selectionRectangle.Height = actualRect.Height;
			if (actualRect.Width > 0.0 || actualRect.Height > 0.0)
			{
				selectionRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
			}
			else
			{
				selectionRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Hidden;
			}
		}

		protected void ValidateAndUpdateRectangle(System.Windows.Point min, System.Windows.Point max, DataViewBase view)
		{
			UpdateActualRect();
			if (min.Y > actualRect.Y || min.X > actualRect.X)
			{
				if (min.X - actualRect.X > 0.0)
				{
					startPointView.X = min.X;
				}
				if (min.Y - actualRect.Y > 0.0)
				{
					startPointView.Y = min.Y;
				}
			}
			else if (max.Y < actualRect.Y + actualRect.Height || max.X < actualRect.X + actualRect.Width)
			{
				if (max.X - (actualRect.X + actualRect.Width) < 0.0)
				{
					startPointView.X = max.X;
				}
				if (max.Y - (actualRect.Y + actualRect.Height) < 0.0)
				{
					startPointView.Y = max.Y;
				}
			}
			UpdateSelectionRect(view);
		}
	}
	public class SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper : SelectionRectangleHelper
	{
		private class StartPointInfo
		{
			private int _startRowHandle;

			private System.Windows.Point _offsetRow;

			private double _startHorizontalOffset;

			private System.Windows.Point _startXY;

			private DataViewBase _view;

			public int StartRowHandle => _startRowHandle;

			public System.Windows.Point OffsetRow => _offsetRow;

			public double StartHorizontalOffset => _startHorizontalOffset;

			public System.Windows.Point StartXY => _startXY;

			public DataViewBase View => _view;

			public StartPointInfo(int rowHandle, System.Windows.Point offsetRow, double startHorizontalOffset, System.Windows.Point startClickPosition, DataViewBase view)
			{
				_startRowHandle = rowHandle;
				_offsetRow = offsetRow;
				_startHorizontalOffset = startHorizontalOffset;
				_startXY = startClickPosition;
				_view = view;
			}
		}

		private double scrollOffsetVertical;

		private double scrollOffsetHorizontal;

		public int RowHandle { get; private set; }

		public override void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle = 0, ColumnBase column = null)
		{
			DataViewBase key = view.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(view.RootView.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y, calcDataArea: false).Key;
			RowHandle = rowHandle;
			startPointView = (endPointView = GetTransformPoint(view, view.ViewBehavior));
			view.SelectionRectangleAnchor = new StartPointSelectionRectangleInfo(rowHandle, Mouse.GetPosition(key.GetRowElementByRowHandle(rowHandle)), ((IScrollInfo)view.RootView.DataPresenter).HorizontalOffset, startPointView, key, column);
			UpdateSelectionRect(view);
			IScrollInfo dataPresenter = view.RootView.DataPresenter;
			scrollOffsetVertical = dataPresenter.VerticalOffset;
			scrollOffsetHorizontal = dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset;
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(DataViewBase view, DataViewBehavior behavior, double indicatorWidth = 0.0)
		{
			if (behavior == null || view == null || view.RootView == null || view.RootView.DataControl == null || view.RootView.DataPresenter == null || view.SelectionRectangleAnchor == null || view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.View == null || view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.View.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataViewBase key = view.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(behavior.LastMousePosition.Y, calcDataArea: false).Key;
			if (key != null)
			{
				base.IndicatorWidth = indicatorWidth;
				endPointView = GetTransformPoint(key, behavior);
				System.Windows.Point minTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMinTransformPoint(key, base.IndicatorWidth);
				System.Windows.Point maxTransformPoint = SelectionRectangleHelper.GetMaxTransformPoint(key);
				IScrollInfo dataPresenter = view.RootView.DataPresenter;
				FrameworkElement rowElementByRowHandle = view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.View.GetRowElementByRowHandle(view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.StartRowHandle);
				if (view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.View.DataProviderBase.IsRowVisible(view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.StartRowHandle) && rowElementByRowHandle != null)
				{
					System.Windows.Point point = rowElementByRowHandle.TransformToAncestor(view.RootView.DataControl).Transform(new System.Windows.Point(indicatorWidth, 0.0));
					startPointView = new System.Windows.Point(startPointView.X, point.Y + view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.OffsetRow.Y);
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = dataPresenter.VerticalOffset > scrollOffsetVertical;
					startPointView.Y = (flag ? minTransformPoint.Y : maxTransformPoint.Y);
				}
				double num = ((TableViewBehavior)behavior).HorizontalOffset - view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.StartHorizontalOffset;
				if (Math.Abs(num) > 0.1)
				{
					startPointView = new System.Windows.Point(view.SelectionRectangleAnchor.StartXY.X - num, startPointView.Y);
				}
				else if (Math.Abs(num) > dataPresenter.ViewportWidth)
				{
					bool flag2 = dataPresenter.HorizontalOffset > scrollOffsetHorizontal;
					startPointView.X = (flag2 ? minTransformPoint.X : maxTransformPoint.X);
				}
				ValidateAndUpdateRectangle(minTransformPoint, maxTransformPoint, key);
			}
		}

		public static Tuple<int, ColumnBase> GetActualRowAndColumn(ITableViewHitInfo hitInfo, DataViewBase view)
		{
			int num = 0;
			ColumnBase item = null;
			if (hitInfo.IsRowCell)
			{
				num = hitInfo.RowHandle;
				item = hitInfo.Column;
			}
			else if (!hitInfo.IsRowCell && hitInfo.InRow)
			{
				num = hitInfo.RowHandle;
				item = view.VisibleColumnsCore.Last();
			}
			else if (hitInfo.IsDataArea && hitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				ITableView tableView = (ITableView)view;
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> viewAndVisibleIndex = view.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(view.ViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y);
				int num2 = 0;
				if (viewAndVisibleIndex.Key == null)
				{
					num2 = view.DataControl.LastRowIndex;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = viewAndVisibleIndex.Value;
					if (num2 < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				num = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num2);
				if (num == -2147483647 && num2 > 0)
				{
					num = view.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(view.DataControl.LastRowIndex - 1);
				}
				item = tableView.TableViewBehavior.GetColumn(tableView.TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X);
			}
			return new Tuple<int, ColumnBase>(num, item);
		}
	}
	public class GenerateColumnMerger
	{
		private readonly Type ColumnType;

		private readonly Type BandType;

		private readonly bool canCreateColumns;

		private readonly bool forcePopulateSmartAttributes;

		private readonly bool canCreateBands;

		private readonly bool generateSmartProperties;

		private readonly bool removeOldColumns;

		private readonly GenerateBandWrapper BandRootWrapper;

		private readonly ModelItemCollectionWrapperHelper ColumnCollectionHelper;

		public GenerateColumnMerger(DataControlBase dataControl, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper, bool forceClearOldColumns, bool forcePopulateColumns, bool ignoreKeepOld)
		{
			ColumnType = dataControl.ColumnType;
			BandType = dataControl.BandType;
			BandRootWrapper = bandRootWrapper;
			switch (dataControl.AutoGenerateColumns)
			{
			case AutoGenerateColumnsMode.None:
				removeOldColumns = forceClearOldColumns;
				break;
			case AutoGenerateColumnsMode.KeepOld:
				canCreateColumns = ignoreKeepOld || dataControl.ColumnsCore.Count == 0;
				break;
			case AutoGenerateColumnsMode.AddNew:
				canCreateColumns = true;
				break;
			case AutoGenerateColumnsMode.RemoveOld:
				removeOldColumns = true;
				canCreateColumns = true;
				break;
			}
			canCreateBands = dataControl.EnableSmartColumnsGeneration;
			if (forcePopulateColumns)
			{
				canCreateColumns = true;
			}
			forcePopulateSmartAttributes = forcePopulateColumns;
			generateSmartProperties = dataControl.EnableSmartColumnsGeneration;
			ColumnCollectionHelper = new ModelItemCollectionWrapperHelper();
		}

		private ColumnAndParent FindColumn(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem bandOwnerModel, string fieldName)
		{
			if (removeOldColumns)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (dataControlModel != bandOwnerModel || ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(dataControlModel).Count == 0)
			{
				ModelItemCollectionWrapper columnCollection = ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(bandOwnerModel);
				IModelItem val = columnCollection.FirstOrDefault(fieldName);
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = TryFindSimpleBindingColumn(columnCollection, fieldName);
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					return new ColumnAndParent(val, bandOwnerModel);
				}
			}
			foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Collection)
			{
				ColumnAndParent columnAndParent = FindColumn(dataControlModel, item, fieldName);
				if (columnAndParent != null)
				{
					return columnAndParent;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private IModelItem TryFindSimpleBindingColumn(ModelItemCollectionWrapper columnsModelCollection, string fieldName)
		{
			return columnsModelCollection.FirstOrDefault("$simpleBinding_" + fieldName);
		}

		private IModelItem FindBand(IModelItem bandOwnerModel, string header)
		{
			foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Collection)
			{
				if (item.Properties["Header"].Value.GetCurrentValue().ToString() == header)
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void RemoveOldElements(IModelItem dataControlModel)
		{
			if (canCreateColumns)
			{
				MoveNonAutoGeneratedBandsToParent(null, dataControlModel);
				RemoveAutoGeneratedBands(dataControlModel);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAutoGeneratedBands(IModelItem bandOwnerModel)
		{
			List<IModelItem> list = new List<IModelItem>();
			foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Collection)
			{
				if (IsAutoGenerated(item))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveAutoGeneratedBands(item);
				}
			}
			foreach (IModelItem item2 in list)
			{
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Remove(item2);
			}
			List<IModelItem> list2 = ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(bandOwnerModel).FindColumns((IModelItem columnModel) => removeOldColumns || IsAutoGenerated(columnModel));
			foreach (IModelItem item3 in list2)
			{
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(bandOwnerModel).Remove(item3);
			}
		}

		private void MoveNonAutoGeneratedColumnsToParent(IModelItem parentModel, ModelItemCollectionWrapper collection)
		{
			List<IModelItem> list = collection.FindColumns((IModelItem columnModel) => !IsAutoGenerated(columnModel));
			foreach (IModelItem item in list)
			{
				collection.Remove(item);
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(parentModel).Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void MoveNonAutoGeneratedBandsToParent(IModelItem parentBandModel, IModelItem childBandModel)
		{
			List<IModelItem> list = new List<IModelItem>();
			foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(childBandModel).Collection)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			foreach (IModelItem item2 in list)
			{
				MoveNonAutoGeneratedBandsToParent(childBandModel, item2);
			}
			if (parentBandModel == null || !IsAutoGenerated(childBandModel))
			{
				return;
			}
			MoveNonAutoGeneratedColumnsToParent(parentBandModel, ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(childBandModel));
			List<IModelItem> list2 = new List<IModelItem>();
			foreach (IModelItem item3 in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(childBandModel).Collection)
			{
				if (!IsAutoGenerated(item3))
				{
					list2.Add(item3);
				}
			}
			foreach (IModelItem item4 in list2)
			{
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(childBandModel).Remove(item4);
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(parentBandModel).Add(item4);
			}
		}

		private bool IsAutoGenerated(IModelItem model)
		{
			return (bool)model.Properties[BaseColumn.IsAutoGeneratedProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
		}

		public void FillColumns(IModelItem dataControlModel)
		{
			RemoveOldElements(dataControlModel);
			MergeBands(dataControlModel, dataControlModel, BandRootWrapper);
			MergeColumns(dataControlModel, dataControlModel, BandRootWrapper);
			MoveExistingColumnsDown(dataControlModel, dataControlModel);
		}

		private IModelItem FindLeftBottomBand(IModelItem bandRootModel)
		{
			if (ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandRootModel).Count == 0)
			{
				return bandRootModel;
			}
			return FindLeftBottomBand(ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandRootModel).Collection[0]);
		}

		private void MergeBands(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem bandRootModel, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper)
		{
			if (bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers)
			{
				IModelItem val = FindOrCreateBand(bandRootModel, bandWrapper);
				if (val == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (IsAutoGenerated(val))
				{
					if (bandRootModel == dataControlModel && ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(dataControlModel).Count == 0)
					{
						MoveColumnsInNewBand(dataControlModel, val);
					}
					ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandRootModel).Add(val);
				}
				MergeBands(dataControlModel, val, bandWrapper);
			}
		}

		private void MoveColumnsInNewBand(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem newBandModel)
		{
			foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(dataControlModel).FindColumns())
			{
				if (IsSmartColumn(item))
				{
					ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(dataControlModel).Remove(item);
					ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(newBandModel).Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		private void MoveExistingColumnsDown(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem bandOwnerModel, List<ColumnAndParent> collectedColumns = null)
		{
			if (ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Count == 0)
			{
				if (collectedColumns == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (ColumnAndParent collectedColumn in collectedColumns)
					{
						if (IsSmartColumn(collectedColumn.ColumnModel) || IsAutoGenerated(collectedColumn.ColumnModel))
						{
							ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(collectedColumn.OwnerModel).Remove(collectedColumn.ColumnModel);
							ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(bandOwnerModel).Add(collectedColumn.ColumnModel);
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (collectedColumns == null)
			{
				collectedColumns = new List<ColumnAndParent>();
			}
			if (dataControlModel == bandOwnerModel)
			{
				foreach (IModelItem item in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(dataControlModel).FindColumns())
				{
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (IModelItem item2 in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(dataControlModel).Collection)
					{
						ColumnAndParent columnAndParent = FindColumn(dataControlModel, item2, item.Properties[ColumnBase.FieldNameProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue().With((object x) => x.ToString()));
						if (columnAndParent != null)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						collectedColumns.Add(new ColumnAndParent(item, bandOwnerModel));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (IModelItem item3 in ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(bandOwnerModel).FindColumns())
				{
					collectedColumns.Add(new ColumnAndParent(item3, bandOwnerModel));
				}
			}
			for (int num = 0; num < ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Count; num++)
			{
				MoveExistingColumnsDown(dataControlModel, ColumnCollectionHelper.GetBandCollection(bandOwnerModel).Collection[num], (num == 0) ? collectedColumns : null);
			}
		}

		private void MergeColumns(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem bandRootModel, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper)
		{
			if (bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers.Count == 0)
			{
				FillColumnsInCollection(dataControlModel, bandRootModel, bandRootWrapper.ColumnWrappers);
				return;
			}
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers)
			{
				IModelItem val = FindBand(bandRootModel, bandWrapper.Header);
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = FindLeftBottomBand(dataControlModel);
				}
				MergeColumns(dataControlModel, val, bandWrapper);
			}
		}

		private void FillColumnsInCollection(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnsOwnerModel, List<GenerateColumnWrapper> columnWrappers)
		{
			foreach (GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper in columnWrappers)
			{
				bool isNewColumn;
				IModelItem val = FindOrCreateColumn(dataControlModel, columnsOwnerModel, columnWrapper, out isNewColumn);
				if (val != null)
				{
					FillColumn(val, columnWrapper, forcePopulateSmartAttributes);
					if (isNewColumn)
					{
						AddColumnInCollection(dataControlModel, columnsOwnerModel, val);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void FillColumn(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnModel, bool ignoreSmartProperty)
		{
			string fieldName = (string)columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.FieldNameProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
			GenerateColumnWrapper generateColumnWrapper = GenerateColumnWrapperHelper.FindColumnWrapper(BandRootWrapper, fieldName);
			if (generateColumnWrapper != null)
			{
				FillColumn(columnModel, generateColumnWrapper, ignoreSmartProperty);
				AddColumnInCollection(dataControlModel, dataControlModel, columnModel);
			}
		}

		private bool IsSmartColumn(IModelItem columnModel)
		{
			return (bool)columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.IsSmartProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
		}

		private void AddColumnInCollection(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnsOwnerModel, IModelItem columnModel)
		{
			if (IsAutoGenerated(columnModel) && CanAddColumn(dataControlModel, columnModel))
			{
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(columnsOwnerModel).Add(columnModel);
			}
		}

		private void FillColumn(IModelItem columnModel, GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper, bool ignoreSmartProperty)
		{
			bool setIsSmart = IsAutoGenerated(columnModel) && generateSmartProperties;
			RuntimeColumnPropertiesPopulator runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator = new RuntimeColumnPropertiesPopulator(columnModel, columnWrapper);
			runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyRuntimeProperties();
			runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyFieldName();
			runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyDefaultProperties(setIsSmart);
			runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplySmartProperties(ignoreSmartProperty);
			runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyPropertiesFromResource();
			if (IsSmartColumn(columnModel))
			{
				IModelItem editSettings = runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.CreateEditSettings();
				runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyEditSettingsProperties(editSettings);
				runtimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyInitializer(editSettings);
			}
		}

		private bool CanAddColumn(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnModel)
		{
			return ((DataControlBase)dataControlModel.GetCurrentValue()).RaiseAutoGeneratingColumn((ColumnBase)columnModel.GetCurrentValue());
		}

		private void MoveExistingColumnToBand(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnsOwnerModel, ColumnAndParent columnAndParent)
		{
			if (dataControlModel != columnsOwnerModel)
			{
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(columnAndParent.OwnerModel).Remove(columnAndParent.ColumnModel);
				ColumnCollectionHelper.GetColumnCollection(columnsOwnerModel).Add(columnAndParent.ColumnModel);
			}
		}

		private void SetIsAutoGenerated(IModelItem modelItem)
		{
			BaseColumn baseColumn = modelItem.GetCurrentValue() as BaseColumn;
			baseColumn.IsAutoGenerated = true;
		}

		private IModelItem FindOrCreateColumn(IModelItem dataControlModel, IModelItem columnsOwnerModel, GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper, out bool isNewColumn)
		{
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b6: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			isNewColumn = false;
			ColumnAndParent columnAndParent = FindColumn(dataControlModel, dataControlModel, wrapper.FieldName);
			if (columnAndParent != null)
			{
				if (columnAndParent.OwnerModel != dataControlModel && IsSmartColumn(columnAndParent.ColumnModel) && (bool)columnAndParent.OwnerModel.Properties[BaseColumn.IsAutoGeneratedProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue())
				{
					MoveExistingColumnToBand(dataControlModel, columnsOwnerModel, columnAndParent);
				}
				return columnAndParent.ColumnModel;
			}
			if (!canCreateColumns)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataControlBase dataControlBase = dataControlModel.GetCurrentValue() as DataControlBase;
			ColumnBase columnBase = GetColumnFromEditorResourceKey(dataControlModel, wrapper) ?? dataControlBase.CreateColumnFromColumnGenerator(wrapper.PropertyDescriptor);
			IModelItem obj;
			if (columnBase != null)
			{
				IModelItem val = (IModelItem)new RuntimeModelItem((EditingContextBase)(RuntimeEditingContext)dataControlModel.Context, (object)columnBase, ModelExtensions.GetRoot(dataControlModel.Context));
				obj = val;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = dataControlModel.Context.CreateItem(ColumnType);
			}
			IModelItem val2 = obj;
			SetIsAutoGenerated(val2);
			isNewColumn = true;
			return val2;
		}

		private ColumnBase GetColumnFromEditorResourceKey(IModelItem dataControlModel, GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper)
		{
			if (wrapper.EditorResourceKey == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataTemplate resourceTemplate = wrapper.Generator.GetResourceTemplate(dataControlModel, wrapper.EditorResourceKey);
			object resourceContentFromTemplate = wrapper.Generator.GetResourceContentFromTemplate(resourceTemplate);
			return resourceContentFromTemplate as ColumnBase;
		}

		private IModelItem FindOrCreateBand(IModelItem bandOwnerModel, GenerateBandWrapper wrapper)
		{
			IModelItem val = FindBand(bandOwnerModel, wrapper.Header);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			if (!canCreateBands)
			{
				return null;
			}
			val = bandOwnerModel.Context.CreateItem(BandType);
			SetIsAutoGenerated(val);
			val.Properties[BaseColumn.HeaderProperty.Name].SetValue((object)wrapper.Header);
			return val;
		}
	}
	public class ColumnAndParent
	{
		public readonly IModelItem ColumnModel;

		public readonly IModelItem OwnerModel;

		public ColumnAndParent(IModelItem columnModel, IModelItem onwerModel)
		{
			ColumnModel = columnModel;
			OwnerModel = onwerModel;
		}
	}
	public class GenerateColumnWrapperComparer : IComparer<GenerateColumnWrapper>
	{
		public int Compare(GenerateColumnWrapper x, GenerateColumnWrapper y)
		{
			if (x.Index == y.Index)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return x.Index - y.Index;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ColumnWrapperGeneratorBase : EditorsGeneratorBase
	{
		protected readonly GenerateBandWrapper BandWrapper;

		protected readonly List<GenerateColumnWrapper> ColumnWrapperCollection;

		protected override EditorsGeneratorMode Mode => (EditorsGeneratorMode)1;

		public override EditorsGeneratorTarget Target => (EditorsGeneratorTarget)0;

		public ColumnWrapperGeneratorBase(GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper)
		{
			BandWrapper = bandWrapper;
			ColumnWrapperCollection = bandWrapper.ColumnWrappers;
		}

		public DataTemplate GetResourceTemplate(IModelItem columnModel, object resourceKey)
		{
			return EditorsGeneratorBase.GetResourceTemplate((FrameworkElement)ModelExtensions.GetRoot(columnModel.Context).GetCurrentValue(), resourceKey);
		}

		public object GetResourceContentFromTemplate(DataTemplate template)
		{
			return EditorsGeneratorBase.GetResourceContent<ColumnBase, BaseEditSettings, BaseEdit>(template);
		}

		protected override void GenerateEditor(IEdmPropertyInfo property, Type editType, Initializer initializer)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GenerateEditor(property, editType, initializer, null, null);
		}

		protected virtual void GenerateEditor(IEdmPropertyInfo property, Type editType, Initializer initializer, object resourceKey, string displayMember)
		{
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GenerateColumnWrapper generateColumnWrapper = new GenerateColumnWrapper(BandWrapper.GetNextPropertyIndex(), property.PropertyType, this, (PropertyDescriptor)property.ContextObject)
			{
				Initializer = initializer,
				EditorResourceKey = resourceKey
			};
			FillColumnWrapperProperties(generateColumnWrapper, property, displayMember);
			FillEditSettingsWrapperProperties(property, generateColumnWrapper, editType);
			ColumnWrapperCollection.Add(generateColumnWrapper);
		}

		private void FillColumnWrapperProperties(GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper, IEdmPropertyInfo property, string displayMember)
		{
			AttributesApplier.ApplyBaseAttributes(property, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				string text = x + (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayMember) ? null : ("." + displayMember));
				wrapper.FieldName = text;
				if (text != x && wrapper.Header == null)
				{
					wrapper.Header = SplitStringHelper.SplitPascalCaseString(x);
				}
			}, (Action<string>)null, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				wrapper.Header = x;
			}, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				wrapper.HeaderToolTip = x;
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				wrapper.ReadOnly = true;
			}, (Action<bool?>)delegate(bool? x)
			{
				wrapper.AllowEditing = x;
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				wrapper.Visible = false;
			}, (Action)delegate
			{
				wrapper.Visible = false;
			}, (Action)null);
		}

		private void FillEditSettingsWrapperProperties(IEdmPropertyInfo property, GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper, Type editType)
		{
			GenerateEditSettingsWrapper wrapper = new GenerateEditSettingsWrapper();
			wrapper.EditSettingsType = editType;
			columnWrapper.EditSettingsWrapper = wrapper;
			AttributesApplier.ApplyDisplayFormatAttributes(property, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				wrapper.Properties[BaseEditSettings.NullTextProperty] = x;
			}, (Action<string>)delegate(string x)
			{
				wrapper.Properties[BaseEditSettings.DisplayFormatProperty] = x;
			}, (Action)null);
			if (wrapper.EditSettingsType == null && wrapper.Properties.Count > 0)
			{
				wrapper.EditSettingsType = typeof(TextEditSettings);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ModelItemCollectionWrapperHelper
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<IModelItem, ModelItemCollectionWrapper> columnCollections;

		private readonly Dictionary<IModelItem, BandModelItemCollectionWrapper> bandCollections;

		public ModelItemCollectionWrapperHelper()
		{
			columnCollections = new Dictionary<IModelItem, ModelItemCollectionWrapper>();
			bandCollections = new Dictionary<IModelItem, BandModelItemCollectionWrapper>();
		}

		public ModelItemCollectionWrapper GetColumnCollection(IModelItem columnCollectionOwnerModel)
		{
			ModelItemCollectionWrapper value = null;
			if (columnCollections.TryGetValue(columnCollectionOwnerModel, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new ModelItemCollectionWrapper(columnCollectionOwnerModel.Properties["Columns"].Collection);
			columnCollections.Add(columnCollectionOwnerModel, value);
			return value;
		}

		public BandModelItemCollectionWrapper GetBandCollection(IModelItem bandCollectionOwnerModel)
		{
			BandModelItemCollectionWrapper value = null;
			if (bandCollections.TryGetValue(bandCollectionOwnerModel, out value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			value = new BandModelItemCollectionWrapper(bandCollectionOwnerModel.Properties["Bands"].Collection);
			bandCollections.Add(bandCollectionOwnerModel, value);
			return value;
		}
	}
	public class ModelItemCollectionWrapper
	{
		public const string SimpleBindingColumnPrefix = "$simpleBinding_";

		private readonly IModelItemCollection source;

		private Dictionary<string, IModelItem> _modelItems;

		private Dictionary<string, IModelItem> ModelItems
		{
			get
			{
				if (_modelItems == null)
				{
					CreateAndFillHashTable();
				}
				return _modelItems;
			}
		}

		public int Count => ModelItems.Count;

		private void CreateAndFillHashTable()
		{
			List<IModelItem> list = ((IEnumerable<IModelItem>)source).ToList();
			_modelItems = new Dictionary<string, IModelItem>(list.Count);
			foreach (IModelItem item in list)
			{
				AddToHashTable(item);
			}
		}

		private void AddToHashTable(IModelItem column)
		{
			string key = GetKey(column);
			if (key != null && !ModelItems.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				ModelItems.Add(key, column);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveFromHashTable(IModelItem column)
		{
			string key = GetKey(column);
			if (key != null && ModelItems.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				ModelItems.Remove(key);
			}
		}

		internal static string GetKey(IModelItem columnModel)
		{
			if (!(columnModel.GetCurrentValue() is ColumnBase { IsSimpleBindingEnabled: not false } columnBase) || columnBase.SimpleBindingProcessor.DataControllerDescriptor == null)
			{
				return columnModel.Properties["FieldName"].With((IModelProperty pr) => pr.ComputedValue).With((object c) => c.ToString());
			}
			return "$simpleBinding_" + columnBase.SimpleBindingProcessor.DataControllerDescriptor.Name;
		}

		public ModelItemCollectionWrapper(IModelItemCollection source)
		{
			this.source = source;
		}

		public IModelItem FirstOrDefault(string fieldName)
		{
			IModelItem value = null;
			ModelItems.TryGetValue(fieldName, out value);
			return value;
		}

		public virtual void Remove(IModelItem element)
		{
			RemoveFromHashTable(element);
			source.Remove(element);
		}

		public virtual void Add(IModelItem element)
		{
			source.Add(element);
			AddToHashTable(element);
		}

		public List<IModelItem> FindColumns()
		{
			return FindColumns((IModelItem columnModel) => true);
		}

		public List<IModelItem> FindColumns(Func<IModelItem, bool> predicate)
		{
			List<IModelItem> list = new List<IModelItem>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, IModelItem> modelItem in ModelItems)
			{
				if (predicate(modelItem.Value))
				{
					list.Add(modelItem.Value);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

		}
	}

	public class DesignTimeColumnsPopulator
	{
		private readonly Type ColumnType;

		private readonly Type BandType;

		private readonly bool ExpandSmartProperties;

		protected readonly IModelItem DataControlModel;

		protected readonly GenerateBandWrapper BandRootWrapper;

		public DesignTimeColumnsPopulator(IModelItem dataControlModel, Type columnType, Type bandType, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper, bool expandSmartProperties)
		{
			ExpandSmartProperties = expandSmartProperties;
			DataControlModel = dataControlModel;
			ColumnType = columnType;
			BandType = bandType;
			BandRootWrapper = bandRootWrapper;
		}

		public void CreateLayout()
		{
			ClearOldLayout();
			CreateLayoutCore();
		}

		protected virtual void CreateLayoutCore()
		{
			if (ExpandSmartProperties)
			{
				CreateLayoutWithBands(DataControlModel, BandRootWrapper);
			}
			else
			{
				CreateLayoutWithotBands(DataControlModel, BandRootWrapper);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ClearOldLayout()
		{
			DataControlModel.Properties["Bands"].Collection.Clear();
			DataControlModel.Properties["Columns"].Collection.Clear();
		}

		protected void CreateLayoutWithBands(IModelItem bandRootModel, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper)
		{
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers)
			{
				IModelItem val = CreateBand(bandWrapper);
				CreateLayoutWithBands(val, bandWrapper);
				bandRootModel.Properties["Bands"].Collection.Add(val);
			}
			foreach (GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper in bandRootWrapper.ColumnWrappers)
			{
				bandRootModel.Properties["Columns"].Collection.Add(CreateColumn(columnWrapper));
			}
		}

		private void CreateLayoutWithotBands(IModelItem bandRootModel, GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper)
		{
			foreach (GenerateColumnWrapper allColumnWrapper in bandRootWrapper.GetAllColumnWrappers())
			{
				bandRootModel.Properties["Columns"].Collection.Add(CreateColumn(allColumnWrapper));
			}
		}

		public void ExpandColumnProperties(IModelItem columnModel)
		{
			string fieldName = (string)columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.FieldNameProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
			GenerateColumnWrapper generateColumnWrapper = GenerateColumnWrapperHelper.FindColumnWrapper(BandRootWrapper, fieldName);
			if (generateColumnWrapper != null)
			{
				FillColumnProperties(columnModel, generateColumnWrapper);
			}
		}

		private IModelItem CreateColumn(GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper)
		{
			IModelItem val = DataControlModel.Context.CreateItem(ColumnType);
			FillColumnProperties(val, wrapper);
			return val;
		}

		protected virtual void FillColumnProperties(IModelItem columnModel, GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper)
		{
			DesignTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator = new DesignTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator(columnModel, wrapper);
			designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyRuntimeProperties();
			designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyFieldName();
			if (ExpandSmartProperties)
			{
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ClearSmartProperty();
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyDefaultProperties(setIsSmart: false);
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplySmartProperties(ignoreSmartProperty: true);
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyPropertiesFromResource();
				IModelItem editSettings = designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.CreateEditSettings();
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyEditSettingsProperties(editSettings);
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.ApplyInitializer(editSettings);
			}
			else
			{
				designTimeColumnPropertiesPopulator.SetSmartProperty();
			}
		}

		private IModelItem CreateBand(GenerateBandWrapper wrapper)
		{
			IModelItem val = DataControlModel.Context.CreateItem(BandType);
			val.Properties[BaseColumn.HeaderProperty.Name].SetValue((object)wrapper.Header);
			return val;
		}
	}

	}
	public class RuntimeColumnPropertiesPopulator
	{
		private readonly IModelItem columnModel;

		protected readonly GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper;

		public RuntimeColumnPropertiesPopulator(IModelItem columnModel, GenerateColumnWrapper wrapper)
		{
			this.columnModel = columnModel;
			this.wrapper = wrapper;
		}

		protected virtual void SetValueIfNotSet(IModelItem modelItem, DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(modelItem.Properties[property.Name], value);
		}

		protected virtual void SafeSetValueIsNotSet(IModelItem modelItem, DependencyProperty property, object value)
		{
			if (!IsPropertySet(modelItem, property))
			{
				ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(modelItem.Properties[property.Name], value);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyRuntimeProperties()
		{
			((ColumnBase)columnModel.GetCurrentValue()).FieldType = wrapper.ColumnFieldType;
		}

		public void SetSmartProperty()
		{
			ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.IsSmartProperty.Name], (object)true);
		}

		public void ClearSmartProperty()
		{
			columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.IsSmartProperty.Name].ClearValue();
		}

		public void ApplyFieldName()
		{
			ModelExtensions.SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.FieldNameProperty.Name], (object)wrapper.FieldName);
		}

		public void ApplyDefaultProperties(bool setIsSmart)
		{
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (setIsSmart)
			{
				SetSmartProperty();
			}
			if (IsAutoGeneratedColumn() || IsSmartColumn())
			{
				if (!wrapper.Visible)
				{
					SafeSetValueIsNotSet(columnModel, BaseColumn.VisibleProperty, wrapper.Visible);
				}
				if (wrapper.HeaderToolTip != null)
				{
					SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel, BaseColumn.HeaderToolTipProperty, wrapper.HeaderToolTip);
				}
				if (wrapper.AllowEditing.HasValue && !wrapper.AllowEditing.Value)
				{
					SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.AllowEditingProperty, DefaultBooleanExtension.ToDefaultBoolean(wrapper.AllowEditing));
				}
				if (wrapper.ReadOnly)
				{
					SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.ReadOnlyProperty, wrapper.ReadOnly);
				}
				if (wrapper.Header != null)
				{
					SafeSetValueIsNotSet(columnModel, BaseColumn.HeaderProperty, wrapper.Header);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ApplySmartProperties(bool ignoreSmartProperty)
		{
			if (!ignoreSmartProperty && !(bool)columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.IsSmartProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue())
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<DependencyProperty, object> property in wrapper.Properties)
			{
				SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel, property.Key, property.Value);
			}
		}

		public void ApplyPropertiesFromResource()
		{
			//IL_0044: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (wrapper.EditorResourceKey != null)
			{
				DataTemplate resourceTemplate = wrapper.Generator.GetResourceTemplate(columnModel, wrapper.EditorResourceKey);
				object resourceContentFromTemplate = wrapper.Generator.GetResourceContentFromTemplate(resourceTemplate);
				IModelItem root = ModelExtensions.GetRoot((IEditingContext)new RuntimeEditingContext(resourceContentFromTemplate, (EditingContextTrace)null));
				if (resourceContentFromTemplate is ColumnBase)
				{
					IModelItem value = ((((ColumnBase)resourceContentFromTemplate).EditSettings != null) ? ModelExtensions.GetRoot((IEditingContext)new RuntimeEditingContext((object)((ColumnBase)resourceContentFromTemplate).EditSettings, (EditingContextTrace)null)) : null);
					SafeSetValueIsNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.EditSettingsProperty, value);
				}
				else if (resourceContentFromTemplate is BaseEditSettings)
				{
					SafeSetValueIsNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.EditSettingsProperty, root);
				}
				else
				{
					SetValueIfNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.CellTemplateProperty, resourceTemplate);
				}
			}
		}

		public IModelItem CreateEditSettings()
		{
			if (!IsEditSettingsSet())
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (IsPropertySet(columnModel, ColumnBase.EditSettingsProperty))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CanApplyEditSettings())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnModel.Context.CreateItem(wrapper.EditSettingsWrapper.EditSettingsType);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanApplyEditSettings()
		{
			return wrapper.EditSettingsWrapper.EditSettingsType != null;
		}

		public void ApplyEditSettingsProperties(IModelItem editSettings)
		{
			if (editSettings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsSmartColumn())
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<DependencyProperty, object> property in wrapper.EditSettingsWrapper.Properties)
				{
					SetValueIfNotSet(editSettings, property.Key, property.Value);
				}
			}
			SafeSetValueIsNotSet(columnModel, ColumnBase.EditSettingsProperty, editSettings);
		}

		public void ApplyInitializer(IModelItem editSettings)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Initializer initializer = wrapper.Initializer;
			((Initializer)(ref initializer)).SetContainerProperties(columnModel);
			if (editSettings != null)
			{
				initializer = wrapper.Initializer;
				((Initializer)(ref initializer)).SetEditProperties(columnModel, editSettings);
			}
		}

		private bool IsEditSettingsSet()
		{
			return wrapper.EditSettingsWrapper.EditSettingsType != null;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSmartColumn()
		{
			return (bool)columnModel.Properties[ColumnBase.IsSmartProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsAutoGeneratedColumn()
		{
			return (bool)columnModel.Properties[BaseColumn.IsAutoGeneratedProperty.Name].Value.GetCurrentValue();
		}

		protected virtual bool IsPropertySet(IModelItem modelItem, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			if (modelItem.Properties[property.Name].IsSet)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(modelItem.GetCurrentValue() is DependencyObject dependencyObject))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return DependencyObjectExtensions.IsPropertySet(dependencyObject, property);
		}

	public class GenerateBandWrapper : IGroupGenerator
	{
		private int propertyIndex;

		private readonly Func<GenerateBandWrapper, EditorsGeneratorBase> GetEditorsGenerator;

		private readonly GenerateBandWrapper ParentBandWrapper;

		public string Header { get; set; }

		public List<GenerateColumnWrapper> ColumnWrappers { get; private set; }

		public List<GenerateBandWrapper> BandWrappers { get; private set; }

		public EditorsGeneratorBase EditorsGenerator => GetEditorsGenerator(this);

		public GenerateBandWrapper(GenerateBandWrapper parentBandWrapper, Func<GenerateBandWrapper, EditorsGeneratorBase> getEditorsGenerator)
		{
			ParentBandWrapper = parentBandWrapper;
			ColumnWrappers = new List<GenerateColumnWrapper>();
			BandWrappers = new List<GenerateBandWrapper>();
			GetEditorsGenerator = getEditorsGenerator;
		}

		public GenerateBandWrapper GetRootBandWrapper()
		{
			if (ParentBandWrapper == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return ParentBandWrapper.GetRootBandWrapper();
		}

		public int GetNextPropertyIndex()
		{
			return GetRootBandWrapper().propertyIndex++;
		}

		public void ApplyGroupInfo(string name, GroupView view, Orientation orientation)
		{
			Header = name;
		}

		public IGroupGenerator CreateNestedGroup(string name, GroupView view, Orientation orientation)
		{
			GenerateBandWrapper generateBandWrapper = new GenerateBandWrapper(this, GetEditorsGenerator)
			{
				Header = name
			};
			BandWrappers.Add(generateBandWrapper);
			return (IGroupGenerator)(object)generateBandWrapper;
		}

		public void OnAfterGenerateContent()
		{
		}

		public void MoveColumnWrappersDown()
		{
			if (BandWrappers.Count == 0)
			{
				ColumnWrappers.Sort(new GenerateColumnWrapperComparer());
				return;
			}
			GenerateBandWrapper generateBandWrapper = BandWrappers[0];
			while (ColumnWrappers.Count > 0)
			{
				GenerateColumnWrapper item = ColumnWrappers[0];
				generateBandWrapper.ColumnWrappers.Add(item);
				ColumnWrappers.RemoveAt(0);
			}
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in BandWrappers)
			{
				bandWrapper.MoveColumnWrappersDown();
			}
		}

		public List<GenerateColumnWrapper> GetAllColumnWrappers()
		{
			List<GenerateColumnWrapper> list = new List<GenerateColumnWrapper>();
			list.AddRange(ColumnWrappers);
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in BandWrappers)
			{
				list.AddRange(bandWrapper.GetAllColumnWrappers());
			}
			return list;
		}
	}

	public static class GenerateColumnWrapperHelper
	{
		public static GenerateColumnWrapper FindColumnWrapper(GenerateBandWrapper bandRootWrapper, string fieldName)
		{
			foreach (GenerateColumnWrapper columnWrapper in bandRootWrapper.ColumnWrappers)
			{
				if (columnWrapper.FieldName == fieldName)
				{
					return columnWrapper;
				}
			}
			foreach (GenerateBandWrapper bandWrapper in bandRootWrapper.BandWrappers)
			{
				GenerateColumnWrapper generateColumnWrapper = FindColumnWrapper(bandWrapper, fieldName);
				if (generateColumnWrapper != null)
				{
					return generateColumnWrapper;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public sealed class DataControlBestFitCalculator : BestFitCalculatorBase
	{
		private class RowsBestFitCalculator : RowsBestFitCalculatorBase
		{
			protected DataControlBestFitCalculator Owner => (DataControlBestFitCalculator)(object)((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).Owner;

			protected DataViewBase View => Owner.View;

			public RowsBestFitCalculator(BestFitCalculatorBase owner, IEnumerable<int> rows)
				: base(owner, rows)
			{
			}

			protected override bool IsValidRowHandle(int rowHandle)
			{
				if (View.CanUseVisibleIndicesForBestFit)
				{
					if (!View.ShouldBestFitCollapsedRows)
					{
						return Owner.DataProviderBase.IsRowVisible(rowHandle);
					}
					return !Owner.DataProviderBase.IsFilteredByRowHandle(rowHandle);
				}
				return IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandle);
			}

			private bool IsValidRowHandleCore(int rowHandle)
			{
				if (Owner.DataProviderBase.IsValidRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					return !Owner.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(rowHandle);
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected override bool IsFocusedCell(IBestFitColumn column, int rowHandle)
			{
				if (View.FocusedRowHandle == rowHandle)
				{
					return (object)View.DataControl.CurrentColumn == column;
				}
				return false;
			}

			protected override void UpdateBestFitControl(FrameworkElement bestFitControl, IBestFitColumn column, int rowHandle)
			{
				((BestFitControlBase)bestFitControl).Update(rowHandle);
				((BestFitControlBase)bestFitControl).UpdateIsFocusedCell(((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).IsFocusedCell(column, rowHandle));
			}

			public override void CalcRowsBestFit(FrameworkElement bestFitControl, IBestFitColumn column, ref double result)
			{
				//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				bool? flag = (View as ITableView)?.TableViewBehavior?.IsFirstAndTreeColumn(column as ColumnBase);
				if (Owner.UseVisibleIndices(((BestFitCalculatorBase)Owner).GetBestFitMode(column)))
				{
					if (flag != true)
					{
						foreach (int row in ((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).Rows)
						{
							int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(row);
							if (IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
							{
								((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).UpdateBestFitControl(bestFitControl, column, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
								((BestFitCalculatorBase)Owner).UpdateBestFitResult(bestFitControl, ref result);
							}
						}
						return;
					}
					TreeColumnCalc(bestFitControl, column, ref result, useVisibleIndices: true);
				}
				else if (flag == true)
				{
					TreeColumnCalc(bestFitControl, column, ref result, useVisibleIndices: false);
				}
				else
				{
					((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).CalcRowsBestFit(bestFitControl, column, ref result);
				}
			}

			private void TreeColumnCalc(FrameworkElement bestFitControl, IBestFitColumn column, ref double result, bool useVisibleIndices)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				ITableView tableView = (ITableView)View;
				int serviceIndentsCount = tableView.TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.ServiceIndentsCount;
				foreach (int row in ((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).Rows)
				{
					if (useVisibleIndices)
					{
						int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(row);
						if (IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
						{
							((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).UpdateBestFitControl(bestFitControl, column, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
							double num = result;
							int num2 = View.DataProviderBase.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) + serviceIndentsCount;
							((BestFitCalculatorBase)Owner).UpdateBestFitResult(bestFitControl, ref result, (0.0 - tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent) * (double)num2);
							if (!flag && result > num)
							{
								flag = true;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).IsValidRowHandle(row))
					{
						((RowsBestFitCalculatorBase)this).UpdateBestFitControl(bestFitControl, column, row);
						double num3 = result;
						int num4 = View.DataProviderBase.GetRowLevelByControllerRow(row) + serviceIndentsCount;
						((BestFitCalculatorBase)Owner).UpdateBestFitResult(bestFitControl, ref result, (0.0 - tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent) * (double)num4);
						if (!flag && result > num3)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					result -= tableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent * (double)tableView.TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.GroupCount;
				}
			}
		}

		protected sealed override double CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore(IBestFitColumn column)

			}

				CalcHeaderBestFit(column as BaseColumn, ref result);

			if (ShouldCalcBestFitArea(column, BestFitArea.Rows))

				((BestFitCalculatorBase)this).CalcDataBestFit(column, ref result);

			{
				CalcTotalSummaryBestFit(column, ref result);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public double CalcBandBestFitWidth(BandBase band, bool indentsWidth = true)
		{

			}
			double result = 0.0;
			if (band.BandsCore.Count != 0 || band.ColumnsCore.Count != 0)
			{
				if (band.BandsCore.Count != 0)
				{
					double result2 = 0.0;
					Dictionary<BandBase, double> widthsBandCache = new Dictionary<BandBase, double>();
					for (int i = 0; i < band.BandsCore.Count; i++)
					{
						indentsWidth = false;
						BandBase bandBase = band.BandsCore[i] as BandBase;
						if (DefaultBooleanExtension.GetValue(bandBase.AllowResizing, TableView.AllowResizing) && TableView.AllowBestFit)
						{
							double num = CalcBandBestFitWidth(bandBase, i == 0);
							widthsBandCache[bandBase] = num;
							result2 += num;
						}
					}
					TableView.TableViewBehavior.BestFitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
					{
						View.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
						foreach (BandBase key in widthsBandCache.Keys)
						{
							TableView.TableViewBehavior.ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyResize(key, widthsBandCache[key], double.MaxValue, 0.0, correctWidths: true);
						}
						View.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
					});
					if ((int)band.AllowBestFit != 1 && ShouldCalcBestFitBandHeader())
					{
						CalcHeaderBestFit(band, ref result2);
						result2 = Math.Ceiling(result2);
					}
					return result2;
				}
				if (band.ActualRows == null || band.ActualRows.Count == 0)
				{
					return band.MinWidth;
				}
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, double> widthsCache = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, double>();
				for (int num2 = 0; num2 < band.ActualRows.Count; num2++)
				{
					double num3 = 0.0;
					foreach (ColumnBase column in band.ActualRows[num2].Columns)
					{
						if (TableView.TableViewBehavior.CanBestFitColumn(column))
						{
							double num4 = CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore((BaseColumn)column);
							widthsCache[column] = num4;
							num3 += num4;
						}
					}
					result = Math.Max(result, num3);
				}
				TableView.TableViewBehavior.BestFitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					View.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
					foreach (ColumnBase key2 in widthsCache.Keys)
					{
						TableView.TableViewBehavior.ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyResize(key2, widthsCache[key2], double.MaxValue, 0.0, correctWidths: false);
					}
					View.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
				});
			}
			if ((int)band.AllowBestFit != 1)
			{
				if (ShouldCalcBestFitBandHeader())
				{
					CalcHeaderBestFit(band, ref result);
				}
				if (result == 0.0)
				{
					result = band.MinWidth;
				}
				result += band.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore + band.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
				if (indentsWidth)
				{
					result += TableView.TableViewBehavior.TreeHeaderIndentsWidth(band);
				}
			}
			else if (result == 0.0)
			{
				return double.NaN;
			}
			return Math.Ceiling(result);
		}

	public abstract class UpdateCellDataStrategyBase<TColumnData> where TColumnData : GridColumnData
	{
		public abstract bool CanReuseCellData { get; }

		public abstract Dictionary<ColumnBase, TColumnData> DataCache { get; }

		public abstract TColumnData CreateNewData();

		public abstract void UpdateData(ColumnBase column, TColumnData columnData);
	}
	public static class ReuseCellDataHelper
	{
		internal static void ReuseCellData<TColumnData>(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, Func<ColumnsRowDataBase, IList<TColumnData>> getter, Action<ColumnsRowDataBase, IList> setter, UpdateCellDataStrategyBase<TColumnData> updateStrategy, IList<ColumnBase> sourceColumns, int bufferLength, int maxDataCount) where TColumnData : GridColumnData
		{
			if (sourceColumns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IList<TColumnData> list = getter(rowData);
			if (list == null)
			{
				list = new VersionedObservableCollection<TColumnData>(Guid.Empty);
				setter(rowData, (IList)list);
			}
			int num = Math.Min(bufferLength + sourceColumns.Count, maxDataCount) - list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				list.Add(updateStrategy.CreateNewData());
			}
			Dictionary<ColumnBase, TColumnData> dictionary = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, TColumnData>();
			List<TColumnData> list2 = new List<TColumnData>();
			foreach (TColumnData item2 in list)
			{
				if (sourceColumns.Contains(item2.Column))
				{
					dictionary.Add(item2.Column, item2);
				}
				else
				{
					list2.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < sourceColumns.Count; j++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase = sourceColumns[j];
				if (dictionary.ContainsKey(columnBase))
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < list2.Count; k++)
				{
					TColumnData val = list2[k];
					if (val.Column != null && columnBase.ActualEditSettings != null && EditSettingsComparer.IsCompatibleEditSettings(val.Column.ActualEditSettings, columnBase.ActualEditSettings))
					{
						dictionary.Add(columnBase, val);
						list2.Remove(val);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int l = 0; l < sourceColumns.Count; l++)
			{
				ColumnBase columnBase2 = sourceColumns[l];
				TColumnData item = GetItem(dictionary, list2, columnBase2);
				if (item.Column != null && updateStrategy.DataCache.ContainsKey(item.Column) && updateStrategy.DataCache[item.Column] == item)
				{
					updateStrategy.DataCache.Remove(item.Column);
				}
				if (rowData.ShouldUpdateCellData(item, columnBase2))
				{
					updateStrategy.DataCache[columnBase2] = item;
					updateStrategy.UpdateData(columnBase2, item);
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					updateStrategy.DataCache[item.Column] = item;
				}
				if (item.VisibleIndex != l)
				{
					flag = true;
					item.VisibleIndex = l;
				}
				if (item.ActualVisibleIndex != columnBase2.ActualVisibleIndex)
				{
					item.ActualVisibleIndex = columnBase2.ActualVisibleIndex;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			foreach (TColumnData item3 in list2)
			{
				if (!OrderPanelBase.IsInvisibleIndex(item3.VisibleIndex))
				{
					flag = true;
					item3.VisibleIndex = -1;
					item3.ActualVisibleIndex = -1;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				((VersionedObservableCollection<TColumnData>)list).RaiseCollectionChanged();
			}
		}

		private static TColumnData GetItem<TColumnData>(Dictionary<ColumnBase, TColumnData> matchedItems, List<TColumnData> unmatchedItems, ColumnBase column) where TColumnData : GridColumnData
		{
			if (matchedItems.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return matchedItems[column];
			}
			int index = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < unmatchedItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (unmatchedItems[i].Column == null)
				{
					index = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			TColumnData result = unmatchedItems[index];
			unmatchedItems.RemoveAt(index);
			return result;
		}
	}

			{
				return property.GetValue(component);
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				((DependencyObject)component).SetValue(propertyKey, value);
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, PropertyDescriptorCollection> propertyCache = new Dictionary<Type, PropertyDescriptorCollection>();

		private static readonly Dictionary<Type, DependencyPropertyKey[]> propertyKeys = new Dictionary<Type, DependencyPropertyKey[]>();

		private static readonly HashSet<DependencyProperty> attachedProperties = new HashSet<DependencyProperty>();

		public static void RegisterKnownPropertyKeys(Type ownerType, params DependencyPropertyKey[] knownKeys)
		{
			propertyKeys.Add(ownerType, knownKeys);
		}

		public static void RegisterKnownAttachedProperty(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			attachedProperties.Add(property);
		}

		public static bool IsKnownAttachedProperty(DependencyProperty property)
		{
			return attachedProperties.Contains(property);
		}

		internal static PropertyDescriptorCollection GetCloneProperties<T>(T component, Type componentType, Type baseComponentType)
		{
			if (!propertyCache.TryGetValue(componentType, out var value))
			{
				List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(componentType);
				foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor copyProperty = GetCopyProperty(component, item, componentType, baseComponentType);
					if (copyProperty != null)
					{
						list.Add(copyProperty);
					}
				}
				value = (propertyCache[componentType] = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray()));
			}
			return value;
		}

		private static bool IsReadOnly<T>(T component, PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			if (NetVersionDetector.IsNetCore3() && component != null)
			{
				PropertyInfo property2 = component.GetType().GetProperty(property.Name, BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
				MethodInfo setMethod = property2.GetSetMethod(nonPublic: false);
				if (setMethod == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return property.IsReadOnly;
		}

		private static PropertyDescriptor GetCopyProperty<T>(T component, PropertyDescriptor property, Type componentType, Type baseComponentType)
		{
			string name = property.Name;
			if (property.Attributes[typeof(CloneDetailModeAttribute)] is CloneDetailModeAttribute cloneDetailModeAttribute)
			{
				if (cloneDetailModeAttribute.Mode == CloneDetailMode.Skip)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (cloneDetailModeAttribute.Mode == CloneDetailMode.Force)
				{
					DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey = FindPropertyKey(componentType, property) ?? FindPropertyKey(baseComponentType, property);
					return new ReadonlyDependencyPropertyDescriptor(property, propertyKey);
				}
			}
			if (IsReadOnly(component, property))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (property.Name == "Resources")
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!baseComponentType.IsAssignableFrom(property.ComponentType))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return property;
		}

		private static DependencyPropertyKey FindPropertyKey(Type type, PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			DependencyPropertyKey dependencyPropertyKey = FindPropertyKeyHelper(type, property);
			if (dependencyPropertyKey == null && type.BaseType != null)
			{
				return FindPropertyKey(type.BaseType, property);
			}
			return dependencyPropertyKey;
		}

		private static DependencyPropertyKey FindPropertyKeyHelper(Type type, PropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			if (!propertyKeys.ContainsKey(type))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return propertyKeys[type].FirstOrDefault((DependencyPropertyKey key) => DependencyPropertyExtensions.GetName(key.DependencyProperty) == property.Name);
		}

		public static T CreateElement<T>(T source, object[] args = null) where T : class
		{
			return ((IDetailElement<T>)source).CreateNewInstance(args);
		}

		public static T CloneElement<T>(T source, Action<T> innerCloneAction = null, Func<T, Locker> getCloneDetailLockerAction = null, object[] args = null) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			T val = CreateElement(source, args);
			CloneElement(source, val, innerCloneAction, getCloneDetailLockerAction);
			return val;
		}

		public static void CloneElement<T>(T source, T destination, Action<T> innerCloneAction = null, Func<T, Locker> getCloneDetailLockerAction = null) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			Action action = delegate
			{
				CopyToElement(source, destination, innerCloneAction);
			};
			if (getCloneDetailLockerAction != null)
			{
				getCloneDetailLockerAction(destination).DoLockedAction(action);
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
		}

		public static void CopyToElement<T>(T source, T destination, Action<T> innerCloneAction = null) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			ISupportInitialize supportInitialize = destination as ISupportInitialize;
			supportInitialize?.BeginInit();
			PropertyDescriptorCollection cloneProperties = GetCloneProperties(destination, destination.GetType(), typeof(T));
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in cloneProperties)
			{
				object value = item.GetValue(destination);
				object value2 = item.GetValue(source);
				if (!object.Equals(value, value2))
				{
					SetClonePropertyValue(source, item, value2, destination);
				}
			}
			innerCloneAction?.Invoke(destination);
			supportInitialize?.EndInit();
		}

		public static void SetClonePropertyValue(DependencyObject sourceObject, PropertyDescriptor property, object sourceValue, DependencyObject destinationObject)
		{
			property.SetValue(destinationObject, ConvertClonePropertyValue(sourceObject, property.Name, sourceValue, destinationObject));
		}

		private static object ConvertClonePropertyValue(DependencyObject sourceObject, string propertyName, object sourceValue, DependencyObject destinationObject)
		{
			if (!(sourceObject is IConvertClonePropertyValue convertClonePropertyValue))
			{
				return sourceValue;
			}
			return convertClonePropertyValue.ConvertClonePropertyValue(propertyName, sourceValue, destinationObject);
		}

		public static void CloneCollection<T>(IList source, IList destination) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			CloneCollectionCore(source, destination, (T item) => CloneElement(item));
		}

		public static void CloneSimpleCollection<T>(IList source, IList destination, object[] args = null) where T : class
		{
			CloneCollectionCore(source, destination, (T item) => CreateElement(item, args));
		}

		private static void CloneCollectionCore<T>(IList source, IList destination, Func<T, T> clone) where T : class
		{
			if (source.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ILockable lockable = destination as ILockable;
			lockable?.BeginUpdate();
			foreach (T item in source)
			{
				destination.Add(clone(item));
			}
			lockable?.EndUpdate();
		}

		public static void CopyToCollection<T>(IList source, IList destination) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			if (destination.Count == 0)
			{
				CloneCollection<T>(source, destination);
				return;
			}
			if (source.Count != destination.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("source.Count != destination.Count");
			}
			int count = source.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				CopyToElement((T)source[i], (T)destination[i]);
			}
		}

		public static T SafeGetDependentCollectionItem<T>(T item, ISupportGetCachedIndex<T> sourceCollection, IList destinationCollection) where T : DependencyObject
		{
			int cachedIndex = sourceCollection.GetCachedIndex(item);
			if (cachedIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (T)destinationCollection[cachedIndex];
		}
	}
	internal static class DataControlOriginationElementHelper
	{
		public static void EnumerateDependentElements<T>(DataControlBase sourceControl, Func<DataControlBase, T> getTarget, Action<T> targetInOpenDetailHandler, Action<T> targetInClosedDetailHandler = null)
		{
			EnumerateDependentElementsCore(sourceControl, getTarget, targetInOpenDetailHandler, targetInClosedDetailHandler, includeSourceControl: false, skipOriginationControl: false);
		}

		public static void EnumerateDependentElementsSkipOriginationControl<T>(DataControlBase sourceControl, Func<DataControlBase, T> getTarget, Action<T> targetInOpenDetailHandler, Action<T> targetInClosedDetailHandler = null)
		{
			EnumerateDependentElementsCore(sourceControl, getTarget, targetInOpenDetailHandler, targetInClosedDetailHandler, includeSourceControl: false, skipOriginationControl: true);
		}

		public static void EnumerateDependentElementsIncludingSource<T>(DataControlBase sourceControl, Func<DataControlBase, T> getTarget, Action<T> targetInOpenDetailHandler, Action<T> targetInClosedDetailHandler = null)
		{
			EnumerateDependentElementsCore(sourceControl, getTarget, targetInOpenDetailHandler, targetInClosedDetailHandler, includeSourceControl: true, skipOriginationControl: false);
		}

		private static void EnumerateDependentElementsCore<T>(DataControlBase sourceControl, Func<DataControlBase, T> getTarget, Action<T> targetInOpenDetailHandler, Action<T> targetInClosedDetailHandler, bool includeSourceControl, bool skipOriginationControl)
		{
			DataControlBase originationDataControl = sourceControl.GetOriginationDataControl();
			T val = getTarget(sourceControl);
			if (!skipOriginationControl && (includeSourceControl || sourceControl != originationDataControl))
			{
				targetInOpenDetailHandler(getTarget(originationDataControl));
			}
			foreach (DataControlBase detailClone in originationDataControl.DetailClones)
			{
				if (includeSourceControl || detailClone != sourceControl)
				{
					if (((RowDetailInfoBase)detailClone.DataControlParent).IsExpanded)
					{
						targetInOpenDetailHandler(getTarget(detailClone));
					}
					else
					{
						targetInClosedDetailHandler?.Invoke(getTarget(detailClone));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public static void UpdateActualTemplateSelector(DependencyObject target, DependencyObject originationObject, DependencyPropertyKey propertyKey, DataTemplateSelector selector, DataTemplate template, Func<DataTemplateSelector, DataTemplate, DataTemplateSelector> createWrapper = null)
		{
			if (createWrapper == null)
			{
				createWrapper = (DataTemplateSelector s, DataTemplate t) => (DataTemplateSelector)new ActualTemplateSelectorWrapper(s, t);
			}
			target.SetValue(propertyKey, (originationObject != null) ? originationObject.GetValue(propertyKey.DependencyProperty) : createWrapper(selector, template));
		}
	}
