	public class DetailScrollInfoCache
	{
		public struct ExpandedDetailInfo
		{
			public readonly int CommonScrollIndex;

			public readonly int LocalScrollIndex;

			public readonly int ScrollRowCount;

			public readonly int Index;

			public readonly int LocalVisibleIndex;

			public readonly int CommonVisibleIndex;

			public readonly int VisibleRowCount;

			public readonly int VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeRow;

			public int ScrollRowCountBeforeRow => CommonScrollIndex - LocalScrollIndex;

			public int ScrollRowCountBeforeNextRow => ScrollRowCountBeforeRow + ScrollRowCount;

			public int LastDetailRowCommonScrollIndex => CommonScrollIndex + ScrollRowCount;

			public int VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeNextRow => VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeRow + VisibleRowCount;

			public int LastDetailRowCommonVisibleIndex => CommonVisibleIndex + VisibleRowCount - 1;

			public ExpandedDetailInfo(int commonScrollIndex, int localScrollIndex, int detailRowsCount, int index, int commonVisibleIndex, int localVisibleIndex, int visibleRowCount, int visibleRowCountBeforeRow)
			{
				CommonScrollIndex = commonScrollIndex;
				LocalScrollIndex = localScrollIndex;
				ScrollRowCount = detailRowsCount;
				Index = index;
				CommonVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex;
				LocalVisibleIndex = localVisibleIndex;
				VisibleRowCount = visibleRowCount;
				VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeRow = visibleRowCountBeforeRow;
			}
		}

		private class CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer : IComparer<ExpandedDetailInfo>
		{
			private readonly List<ExpandedDetailInfo> expandedDetailInfoList;

			internal int Index;

			private readonly Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getIndex;

			public CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer(List<ExpandedDetailInfo> expandedDetailInfoList, Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getIndex)
			{
				this.expandedDetailInfoList = expandedDetailInfoList;
				this.getIndex = getIndex;
			}

			int IComparer<ExpandedDetailInfo>.Compare(ExpandedDetailInfo item, ExpandedDetailInfo ignore)
			{
				if (Index < getIndex(item))
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int index = item.Index;
				if (index < expandedDetailInfoList.Count - 1 && Index >= getIndex(expandedDetailInfoList[index + 1]))
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		private class CalcMasterRowInfoComparer : IComparer<ExpandedDetailInfo>
		{
			private readonly List<ExpandedDetailInfo> expandedDetailInfoList;

			internal int CommonIndex;

			private readonly Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getStartIndex;

			private readonly Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getEndIndex;

			public CalcMasterRowInfoComparer(List<ExpandedDetailInfo> expandedDetailInfoList, Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getStartIndex, Func<ExpandedDetailInfo, int> getEndIndex)
			{
				this.expandedDetailInfoList = expandedDetailInfoList;
				this.getStartIndex = getStartIndex;
				this.getEndIndex = getEndIndex;
			}

			int IComparer<ExpandedDetailInfo>.Compare(ExpandedDetailInfo item, ExpandedDetailInfo ignore)
			{
				int num = getStartIndex(item);
				int num2 = getEndIndex(item);
				if (num <= CommonIndex && CommonIndex <= num2)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (CommonIndex < num)
				{
					int index = item.Index;
					if (index == 0 || CommonIndex > getEndIndex(expandedDetailInfoList[index - 1]))
					{
						return 0;
					}
				}
				if (CommonIndex > num2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		private bool isCacheValid;

		private int ScrollDetailRowsCount;

		private int VisibleDetailRowCount;

		private readonly List<ExpandedDetailInfo> expandedDetailInfoList = new List<ExpandedDetailInfo>();

		private readonly List<int> expandedDetailsVisibleIndices = new List<int>();

		private readonly MasterDetailProvider owner;

		private readonly CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer calcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer;

		private readonly CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer calcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer;

		private readonly CalcMasterRowInfoComparer calcMasterRowScrollInfoComparer;

		private readonly CalcMasterRowInfoComparer calcMasterRowNavigationInfoComparer;

		private DataViewBase View => owner.View;

		public DetailScrollInfoCache(MasterDetailProvider owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			calcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer = new CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer(expandedDetailInfoList, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.LocalScrollIndex);
			calcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer = new CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer(expandedDetailInfoList, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.LocalVisibleIndex);
			calcMasterRowScrollInfoComparer = new CalcMasterRowInfoComparer(expandedDetailInfoList, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.CommonScrollIndex, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.LastDetailRowCommonScrollIndex);
			calcMasterRowNavigationInfoComparer = new CalcMasterRowInfoComparer(expandedDetailInfoList, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.CommonVisibleIndex, (ExpandedDetailInfo info) => info.LastDetailRowCommonVisibleIndex);
		}

		public void InvalidateCache()
		{
			isCacheValid = false;
		}

		public int CalcScrollDetailRowsCount()
		{
			ValidateCache();
			return ScrollDetailRowsCount;
		}

		public int CalcVisibleDetailDataRowCount()
		{
			ValidateCache();
			return VisibleDetailRowCount;
		}

		private void ValidateCache()
		{
			if (isCacheValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			isCacheValid = true;
			expandedDetailsVisibleIndices.Clear();
			foreach (int rowListIndicesWithExpandedDetail in View.DataProviderBase.GetRowListIndicesWithExpandedDetails())
			{
				int rowHandleByListIndex = View.DataProviderBase.GetRowHandleByListIndex(rowListIndicesWithExpandedDetail);
				if (rowHandleByListIndex != int.MinValue)
				{
					int rowVisibleIndexByHandle = View.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandleByListIndex);
					if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle >= 0)
					{
						expandedDetailsVisibleIndices.Add(rowVisibleIndexByHandle);
					}
				}
			}
			expandedDetailsVisibleIndices.Sort();
			int count = expandedDetailsVisibleIndices.Count;
			ScrollDetailRowsCount = 0;
			VisibleDetailRowCount = 0;
			expandedDetailInfoList.Clear();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				int num = expandedDetailsVisibleIndices[i];
				int num2 = View.DataProviderBase.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(num, View.AllowFixedGroupsCore);
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num);
				int num3 = owner.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountForRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				int num4 = owner.CalcVisibleDataRowCountForRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				int num5 = num + VisibleDetailRowCount + 1;
				int visibleRowCountBeforeRow = num5 - num - 1;
				if (View.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					num5++;
				}
				expandedDetailInfoList.Add(new ExpandedDetailInfo(num2 + ScrollDetailRowsCount, num2, num3, i, num5, num, num4, visibleRowCountBeforeRow));
				ScrollDetailRowsCount += num3;
				VisibleDetailRowCount += num4;
			}
		}

		public int CalcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(int scrollIndex)
		{
			ValidateCache();
			calcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer.Index = scrollIndex;
			int num = expandedDetailInfoList.BinarySearch(default(ExpandedDetailInfo), calcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			ExpandedDetailInfo expandedDetailInfo = expandedDetailInfoList[num];
			if (scrollIndex > expandedDetailInfo.LocalScrollIndex)
			{
				return expandedDetailInfo.ScrollRowCountBeforeRow + expandedDetailInfo.ScrollRowCount;
			}
			return expandedDetailInfo.ScrollRowCountBeforeRow;
		}

		public int CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(int visibleIndex)
		{
			ValidateCache();
			calcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer.Index = visibleIndex;
			int num = expandedDetailInfoList.BinarySearch(default(ExpandedDetailInfo), calcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRowComparer);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			ExpandedDetailInfo expandedDetailInfo = expandedDetailInfoList[num];
			if (visibleIndex > expandedDetailInfo.LocalVisibleIndex)
			{
				return expandedDetailInfo.VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeRow + expandedDetailInfo.VisibleRowCount;
			}
			return expandedDetailInfo.VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeRow;
		}

		public MasterRowScrollInfo CalcMasterRowScrollInfo(int commonScrollIndex)
		{
			ValidateCache();
			calcMasterRowScrollInfoComparer.CommonIndex = commonScrollIndex;
			int num = expandedDetailInfoList.BinarySearch(default(ExpandedDetailInfo), calcMasterRowScrollInfoComparer);
			int num2 = commonScrollIndex;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num2 -= GetPrevInfoScrollRowCountBeforeNextRow(expandedDetailInfoList.Count);
				if (num2 < View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount + View.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount())
				{
					return new MasterRowScrollInfo(num2, 0, wholeDetailScrolledOut: true);
				}
				return null;
			}
			ExpandedDetailInfo expandedDetailInfo = expandedDetailInfoList[num];
			if (commonScrollIndex < expandedDetailInfo.CommonScrollIndex)
			{
				num2 -= GetPrevInfoScrollRowCountBeforeNextRow(num);
				return new MasterRowScrollInfo(num2, 0, wholeDetailScrolledOut: true);
			}
			return new MasterRowScrollInfo(expandedDetailInfo.LocalScrollIndex, commonScrollIndex - expandedDetailInfo.CommonScrollIndex, expandedDetailInfo.LastDetailRowCommonScrollIndex == commonScrollIndex);
		}

		private int GetPrevInfoScrollRowCountBeforeNextRow(int index)
		{
			if (index > 0)
			{
				return expandedDetailInfoList[index - 1].ScrollRowCountBeforeNextRow;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		public MasterRowNavigationInfo CalcMasterRowNavigationInfo(int commonVisibleIndex)
		{
			ValidateCache();
			calcMasterRowNavigationInfoComparer.CommonIndex = commonVisibleIndex;
			int num = expandedDetailInfoList.BinarySearch(default(ExpandedDetailInfo), calcMasterRowNavigationInfoComparer);
			int num2 = commonVisibleIndex;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num2 -= GetPrevInfoVisibleRowCountBeforeNextRow(expandedDetailInfoList.Count);
				int num3 = View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				if (View.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					num3++;
				}
				if (0 <= num2 && num2 < num3)
				{
					return new MasterRowNavigationInfo(num2, 0, isDetail: false);
				}
				return null;
			}
			ExpandedDetailInfo expandedDetailInfo = expandedDetailInfoList[num];
			if (commonVisibleIndex < expandedDetailInfo.CommonVisibleIndex)
			{
				num2 -= GetPrevInfoVisibleRowCountBeforeNextRow(num);
				return new MasterRowNavigationInfo(num2, 0, isDetail: false);
			}
			return new MasterRowNavigationInfo(expandedDetailInfo.LocalVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex - expandedDetailInfo.CommonVisibleIndex, isDetail: true);
		}

		private int GetPrevInfoVisibleRowCountBeforeNextRow(int index)
		{
			if (index > 0)
			{
				return expandedDetailInfoList[index - 1].VisibleDetailRowCountBeforeNextRow;
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class MasterRowScrollInfo
	{
		public int StartScrollIndex { get; private set; }

		public int DetailStartScrollIndex { get; private set; }

		public bool WholeDetailScrolledOut { get; private set; }

		public MasterRowScrollInfo(int startScrollIndex, int detailStartScrollIndex, bool wholeDetailScrolledOut)
		{
			StartScrollIndex = startScrollIndex;
			DetailStartScrollIndex = detailStartScrollIndex;
			WholeDetailScrolledOut = wholeDetailScrolledOut;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return base.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is MasterRowScrollInfo masterRowScrollInfo && masterRowScrollInfo.StartScrollIndex == StartScrollIndex && masterRowScrollInfo.DetailStartScrollIndex == DetailStartScrollIndex)
			{
				return masterRowScrollInfo.WholeDetailScrolledOut == WholeDetailScrolledOut;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class MasterRowNavigationInfo
	{
		public int StartVisibleIndex { get; private set; }

		public int DetailStartVisibleIndex { get; private set; }

		public bool IsDetail { get; private set; }

		public MasterRowNavigationInfo(int startVisibleIndex, int detailStartVisibleIndex, bool isDetail)
		{
			StartVisibleIndex = startVisibleIndex;
			DetailStartVisibleIndex = detailStartVisibleIndex;
			IsDetail = isDetail;
		}
	}

	public class MasterDetailProvider : MasterDetailProviderBase, IDetailDescriptorOwner
	{
		private readonly TableViewBehavior viewBehavior;

		private DetailScrollInfoCache detailScrollInfoCache;

		internal DataViewBase View => viewBehavior.View;

		private DetailDescriptorBase DetailDescriptor { get; set; }

		internal RowDetailInfoBase GetRowDetailInfo(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandle, createNewIfNotExist: true);
		}

		public override RowDetailInfoBase GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!View.AllowMasterDetailCore)
			{
				return EmptyRowDetailInfo.Instance;
			}
			return GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandle, createNewIfNotExist: false) ?? EmptyRowDetailInfo.Instance;
		}

		internal RowDetailInfoBase GetRowDetailInfoCore(int rowHandle, bool createNewIfNotExist)
		{
			return View.DataProviderBase.GetRowDetailContainer(rowHandle, () => CreateRowDetailContainer(rowHandle), createNewIfNotExist)?.RootDetailInfo;
		}

		private RowDetailContainer CreateRowDetailContainer(int rowHandle)
		{
			RowDetailContainer rowDetailContainer = new RowDetailContainer(View.DataControl, View.DataProviderBase.GetRowValue(rowHandle));
			DetailInfoWithContent rootDetailInfo = DetailDescriptor.CreateRowDetailInfo(rowDetailContainer);
			rowDetailContainer.RootDetailInfo = rootDetailInfo;
			return rowDetailContainer;
		}

		internal RowDetailInfoBase GetRowDetailInfoForPrinting(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandle, createNewIfNotExist: false) ?? CreateRowDetailContainer(rowHandle).RootDetailInfo;
		}

		public MasterDetailProvider(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
		{
			this.viewBehavior = viewBehavior;
			DetailDescriptor = View.DataControl.DetailDescriptorCore;
			ValidateMasterDetailConsistency();
			detailScrollInfoCache = new DetailScrollInfoCache(this);
		}

		public override bool SetMasterRowExpanded(int rowHandle, bool expand, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			RowDetailInfoBase rowDetailInfoCore = GetRowDetailInfoCore(rowHandle, expand);
			if (rowDetailInfoCore != null)
			{
				SetMasterRowExpandedCore(rowHandle, rowDetailInfoCore, expand, descriptor);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual void SetMasterRowExpandedCore(int rowHandle, RowDetailInfoBase detailInfo, bool expand, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			if (View.CommitEditingInternal() && View.DataControl.RaiseMasterRowExpandStateChanging(rowHandle, detailInfo.IsExpanded))
			{
				View.DataControl.InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache();
				detailInfo.SetDetailRowExpanded(expand, descriptor);
				View.OnDataReset();
				View.DataControl.RaiseMasterRowExpandStateChanged(rowHandle, detailInfo.IsExpanded);
			}
		}

		public override void ChangeMasterRowExpanded(int rowHandle)
		{
			RowDetailInfoBase rowDetailInfo = GetRowDetailInfo(rowHandle);
			if (rowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				SetMasterRowExpandedCore(rowHandle, rowDetailInfo, expand: false, null);
			}
			else
			{
				SetMasterRowExpandedCore(rowHandle, rowDetailInfo, expand: true, null);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateMasterDetailInfo(RowData rowData, bool updateDetailRow)
		{
			int value = rowData.RowHandle.Value;
			if (updateDetailRow)
			{
				GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(value).OnUpdateRow(rowData.Row);
			}
			rowData.IsRowExpanded = IsMasterRowExpanded(value);
			rowData.RowsContainer = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(value).GetRowsContainerAndUpdateMasterRowData(rowData);
		}

		public override bool IsMasterRowExpanded(int rowHandle, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor = null)
		{
			return GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle).IsDetailRowExpanded(descriptor);
		}

		public override NodeContainer GetDetailNodeContainer(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle).GetNodeContainer();
		}

		public override int CalcVisibleDetailRowsCount()
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcScrollDetailRowsCount();
		}

		public override int CalcVisibleDetailDataRowCount()
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcVisibleDetailDataRowCount();
		}

		public override MasterRowScrollInfo CalcMasterRowScrollInfo(int commonScrollIndex)
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcMasterRowScrollInfo(commonScrollIndex);
		}

		public override MasterRowNavigationInfo CalcMasterRowNavigationInfo(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcMasterRowNavigationInfo(visibleIndex);
		}

		public override void InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache()
		{
			detailScrollInfoCache.InvalidateCache();
		}

		public override int CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(int scrollIndex)
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcScrollDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(scrollIndex);
		}

		public override int CalcDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return detailScrollInfoCache.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountBeforeRow(visibleIndex);
		}

		public override int CalcVisibleDetailRowsCountForRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle).CalcRowsCount();
		}

		public int CalcVisibleDataRowCountForRow(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle).CalcVisibleDataRowCount();
		}

		public override int CalcTotalLevel(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex)).CalcTotalLevel();
		}

		public override void SynchronizeDetailTree()
		{
			DetailDescriptor.SynchronizeDetailTree();
		}

		private DataControlBase GetRootDataControl(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return View.DataControl.GetRootDataControl();
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindTargetView(DataViewBase rootView, object originalSource)
		{
			RowData rowData = RowData.FindRowData((DependencyObject)originalSource);
			if (rowData == null)
			{
				return rootView;
			}
			return rowData.View;
		}

		public override bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, int visibleIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				targetView = null;
				targetVisibleIndex = -1;
				return false;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindFirstDetailView();
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl(int rowHandle)
		{
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
		}

		public override DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor(int rowHandle)
		{
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDescriptor();
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindDetailDataControl(int rowHandle, DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandle);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindDetailDataControl(descriptor);
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView(int visibleIndex)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = View.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			RowDetailInfoBase readOnlyRowDetailInfo = GetReadOnlyRowDetailInfo(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			if (!readOnlyRowDetailInfo.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return readOnlyRowDetailInfo.FindLastInnerDetailView();
		}

		public override void UpdateDetailDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateMethod)
		{
			DetailDescriptor.UpdateDetailDataControls(updateMethod);
		}

		public override void UpdateDetailDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateOpenDetailMethod, Action<DataControlBase> updateClosedDetailMethod)
		{
			DetailDescriptor.UpdateDetailDataControls(updateOpenDetailMethod, updateClosedDetailMethod);
		}

		public override void UpdateOriginationDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> updateMethod)
		{
			DetailDescriptor.UpdateOriginationDataControls(updateMethod);
		}

		public override void UpdateDetailViewIndents(ObservableCollection<DetailIndent> ownerIndents)
		{
			DetailDescriptor.UpdateDetailViewIndents(ownerIndents, GetGroupDetailMargin(viewBehavior.TableView.ActualDetailMargin));
		}

		private Thickness GetGroupDetailMargin(Thickness actualMargin)
		{
			return new Thickness((double)View.DataControl.ActualGroupCountCore * viewBehavior.TableView.LeftGroupAreaIndent + actualMargin.Left, actualMargin.Top, actualMargin.Right, actualMargin.Bottom);
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.InvalidateTree()
		{
			View.DataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				DataControlOriginationElementHelper.EnumerateDependentElementsIncludingSource(dataControl, (DataControlBase dc) => dc, delegate(DataControlBase dc)
				{
					dc.MasterDetailProvider.InvalidateDetailScrollInfoCache();
				});
			});
			View.RootView.OnDataReset();
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.EnumerateOwnerDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> action)
		{
			if (View.DataControl != null)
			{
				action(View.DataControl);
				View.DataControl.DataControlOwner.EnumerateOwnerDataControls(action);
			}
		}

		bool IDetailDescriptorOwner.CanAssignTo(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			return dataControl == View.DataControl;
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.InvalidateIndents()
		{
			View.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailViewIndents();
			View.DataControl.GetRootDataControl().UpdateAllDetailAndOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				x.DataView.UpdateColumnsPositions();
			});
		}

		void IDetailDescriptorOwner.EnumerateOwnerDetailDescriptors(Action<DetailDescriptorBase> action)
		{
			View.DataControl.DataControlOwner.EnumerateOwnerDetailDescriptors(action);
		}

		public override void ValidateMasterDetailConsistency()
		{
			View.DataProviderBase.ThrowNotSupportedExceptionIfInServerMode();
			View.ThrowNotSupportedInMasterDetailException();
			View.DataControl.ThrowNotSupportedInMasterDetailException();
		}

		public override void OnDetach()
		{
			View.DataProviderBase.ClearDetailInfo();
			DetailDescriptor.OnDetach();
		}

		public override IEnumerable<DataControlDetailDescriptor> GetDetailDescriptors(DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, int rowHandle)
		{
			return DetailDescriptor.GetDetailDescriptors(treeBuilder, rowHandle);
		}

		public override bool HasDataControlDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return DetailDescriptor.HasDataControlDetailDescriptor();
		}
	}

	public sealed class RowDetailContainer
	{
		public DetailInfoWithContent RootDetailInfo { get; set; }

		public DataControlBase MasterDataControl { get; private set; }

		public int MasterListIndex { get; internal set; }

		public object Row { get; internal set; }

		public RowDetailContainer(DataControlBase masterDataControl, object row)
		{
			MasterDataControl = masterDataControl;
			Row = row;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			EnumerateInfoWithContent(delegate(DetailInfoWithContent x)
			{
				x.Clear();
			});
		}

		public void Detach()
		{
			EnumerateInfoWithContent(delegate(DetailInfoWithContent x)
			{
				x.Detach();
			});
		}

		public void RemoveFromDetailClones()
		{
			EnumerateInfoWithContent(delegate(DetailInfoWithContent x)
			{
				x.RemoveFromDetailClones();
			});
		}

		private void EnumerateInfoWithContent(Action<DetailInfoWithContent> action)
		{
			foreach (RowDetailInfoBase item in RootDetailInfo.GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator())
			{
				if (item is DetailInfoWithContent obj)
				{
					action(obj);
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class RowDetailInfoBase
	{
		internal class DetailRowsContainer : RowsContainer, IDetailRootItemsContainer, IItemsContainer
		{
			private RowData masterRowData;

			private readonly MasterRowsContainer masterRowsContainer;

			private readonly DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor;

			internal RowData MasterRowData
			{
				get
				{
					return masterRowData;
				}
				set
				{
					if (masterRowData != value)
					{
						masterRowData = value;
					}
				}
			}

			internal override MasterRowsContainer MasterRootRowsContainer => masterRowsContainer;

			internal override SynchronizationQueues SynchronizationQueues => detailDescriptor.SynchronizationQueues;

			double IItemsContainer.AnimationProgress => 1.0;

			public DetailRowsContainer(MasterRowsContainer masterRowsContainer, DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor)
			{
				this.masterRowsContainer = masterRowsContainer;
				this.detailDescriptor = detailDescriptor;
				InitItemsCollection();
			}

			internal override RowsContainerSyncronizerBase CreateRowsContainerSyncronizer()
			{
				return new DetailRowsContainerSyncronizer(this);
			}
		}

		private class DetailRowsContainerSyncronizer : RowsContainerSyncronizerBase
		{
			private readonly Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> unmatchedItems = new Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase>();

			public DetailRowsContainerSyncronizer(DetailRowsContainer dataContainer)
				: base(dataContainer)
			{
			}

			protected override IEnumerable<RowDataBase> GetUnmatchedItems()
			{
				return unmatchedItems.Values;
			}

			protected override void EnqueueUnmatchedItem(RowDataBase rowData)
			{
				unmatchedItems.Add((DetailNodeKind)rowData.MatchKey, rowData);
			}

			protected override RowDataBase DequeueUnmatchedItem(object matchKey)
			{
				DetailNodeKind key = (DetailNodeKind)matchKey;
				if (unmatchedItems.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
				{
					unmatchedItems.Remove(key);
					return value;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private bool isExpanded;

		public virtual bool IsExpanded
		{
			get
			{
				return isExpanded;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isExpanded != value)
				{
					isExpanded = value;
					if (isExpanded)
					{
						OnExpanded();
					}
					else
					{
						OnCollapsed();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract DetailRowsContainer RowsContainer { get; }

		protected internal abstract void OnExpanded();

		protected internal abstract void OnCollapsed();

		public virtual bool IsDetailRowExpanded(DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			return IsExpanded;
		}

		public virtual void SetDetailRowExpanded(bool expand, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			IsExpanded = expand;
		}

		public abstract NodeContainer GetNodeContainer();

		public abstract RowsContainer GetRowsContainerAndUpdateMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData);

		public abstract void UpdateMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData);

		public abstract int CalcTotalLevel();

		public abstract int CalcRowsCount();

		public abstract int CalcVisibleDataRowCount();

		public abstract bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex);

		protected internal abstract int GetVisibleDataRowCount();

		protected internal abstract int GetNextLevelRowCount();

		protected internal abstract int GetBottomServiceRowsCount();

		protected internal abstract int GetTopServiceRowsCount();

		internal abstract IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(int nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, int nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, int serviceVisibleRowsCount);

		protected internal abstract DetailNodeKind[] GetNodeScrollOrder();

		public abstract DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView();

		public abstract DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView();

		public abstract DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl();

		public abstract DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor();

		public DataControlBase FindDetailDataControl(DataControlDetailDescriptor descriptor)
		{
			foreach (RowDetailInfoBase item in GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator())
			{
				if (item is DataControlDetailInfo dataControlDetailInfo && (descriptor == null || dataControlDetailInfo.DataControlDetailDescriptor == descriptor))
				{
					return dataControlDetailInfo.DataControl;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void OnUpdateRow(object row)
		{
			foreach (RowDetailInfoBase item in GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator())
			{
				item.UpdateRow(row);
			}
		}

		internal abstract IEnumerable<RowDetailInfoBase> GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator();

		protected abstract void UpdateRow(object row);

		internal virtual void RemoveFromDetailClones()
		{
		}

		protected internal abstract DataControlDetailInfo GetActualDetailInfo(DataControlDetailDescriptor detailDescriptor);

		public virtual void Detach()
		{
		}
	}
	public enum DetailNodeKind
	{
		DetailHeader,
		DetailContent,
		ColumnHeaders,
		NewItemRow,
		DataRowsContainer,
		TotalSummary,
		FixedTotalSummary,
		TabHeaders,
		TopMarginContainer,
		BottomMarginContainer
	}
	public interface IDetailNode
	{
		DetailNodeKind Key { get; }
	}
	public class DetailSynchronizationQueues : SynchronizationQueues
	{
		private readonly Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>> detailRowQueues = new Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>>();

		public LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> GetSynchronizationQueue(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind)
		{
			if (!detailRowQueues.TryGetValue(detailNodeKind, out var value))
			{
				value = (detailRowQueues[detailNodeKind] = new LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>());
			}
			return value;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			foreach (LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> value in detailRowQueues.Values)
			{
				ClearCore(value);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class DetailInfoWithContent : RowDetailInfoBase
	{
		internal abstract class DetailRowNode : RowNode
		{
			private bool isDataExpanded;

			private readonly Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate;

			internal readonly DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind;

			protected readonly DetailInfoWithContent owner;

			internal RowsContainer childrenRowsContainer { get; private set; }

			internal RowDataBase CurrentRowData { get; set; }

			protected override bool IsDataExpanded => isDataExpanded;

			public override object MatchKey => detailNodeKind;

			internal override bool IsFixedNode => owner.IsFixedNode(this);

			public DetailRowNode(DetailInfoWithContent owner, DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
			{
				this.detailNodeKind = detailNodeKind;
				this.createRowDataDelegate = createRowDataDelegate;
				this.owner = owner;
			}

			public void UpdateExpandInfoEx(NodeContainer childrenNodeContainer, RowsContainer childrenRowsContainer, int startVisibleIndex, bool isRowVisible)
			{
				base.NodesContainer = childrenNodeContainer;
				this.childrenRowsContainer = childrenRowsContainer;
				isDataExpanded = childrenNodeContainer != null;
				UpdateExpandInfo(startVisibleIndex, isRowVisible);
			}

			internal override LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> GetFreeRowDataQueue(SynchronizationQueues synchronizationQueues)
			{
				return ((DetailSynchronizationQueues)synchronizationQueues).GetSynchronizationQueue(detailNodeKind);
			}

			internal override RowDataBase GetRowData()
			{
				return CurrentRowData;
			}

			internal override FrameworkElement GetRowElement()
			{
				if (CurrentRowData != null)
				{
					return CurrentRowData.WholeRowElement;
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal override RowDataBase CreateRowData()
			{
				return createRowDataDelegate(detailNodeKind);
			}

			internal abstract void AssignToRowData(RowDataBase rowData, RowDataBase masterRowData);
		}

		internal class DetailHeaderRowNode : DetailRowNode
		{

			public DetailHeaderRowNode(DetailInfoWithContent owner, DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
				: base(owner, detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate)

			internal override void AssignToRowData(RowDataBase rowData, RowDataBase masterRowData)
			{
				if (rowData is DetailRowData)

					(rowData as DetailRowData).SetMasterView(masterRowData.View);
				}
				DetailHeaderControlBase detailHeaderControlBase = (DetailHeaderControlBase)rowData.WholeRowElement;
				detailHeaderControlBase.ShowBottomLine = ShowBottomLine;
			}
		}

		public class DetailRowData : RowDataBase, IDetailNode
		{
			private readonly DetailNodeKind nodeKind;

			internal override object MatchKey => nodeKind;

			DetailNodeKind IDetailNode.Key => nodeKind;

			public DetailRowData(DetailNodeKind nodeKind, Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
				: base(createRowElementDelegate)
			{
				this.nodeKind = nodeKind;
			}

			protected override NotImplementedRowDataReusingStrategy CreateReusingStrategy(Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
			{
				return new DetailRowDataReusingStrategy(this, createRowElementDelegate);
			}

			internal virtual void SetMasterView(DataViewBase view)
			{
				base.View = view;
			}

			internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
			{
				base.LineLevel = 0;
				base.DetailLevel = int.MaxValue;
			}
		}

		internal class DetailColumnsData : ColumnsRowDataBase, IDetailNode
		{
			private readonly DetailNodeKind nodeKind;

			internal override object MatchKey => nodeKind;

			DetailNodeKind IDetailNode.Key => nodeKind;

			public DetailColumnsData(DetailNodeKind nodeKind, DataTreeBuilder treeBuilder, Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
				: base(treeBuilder, createRowElementDelegate)
			{
				this.nodeKind = nodeKind;
			}

			protected override NotImplementedRowDataReusingStrategy CreateReusingStrategy(Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
			{
				return new DetailRowDataReusingStrategy(this, createRowElementDelegate);
			}

			internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
			{
				bool isLastRow = true;
				if (IsNotLastRow())
				{
					base.LineLevel = 0;
					base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
					return;
				}
				DataViewBase targetView = null;
				int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
				if (base.View.DataControl.DataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
				{
					RowData rowData = targetView.GetRowData(targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex));
					if (rowData != null)
					{
						base.LineLevel = GetLineLevel(this, 0, 0);
						base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
						if (isLastRow)
						{
							base.LineLevel = base.DetailLevel;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				base.LineLevel = 0;
				base.DetailLevel = 0;
			}

			private bool IsNotLastRow()
			{
				if (base.View.ShowFixedTotalSummary)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (nodeKind == DetailNodeKind.ColumnHeaders)
				{
					if (!base.View.IsNewItemRowVisible)
					{
						return base.View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (nodeKind == DetailNodeKind.NewItemRow)
				{
					return base.View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, DetailRowNode> nodesCache = new Dictionary<DetailNodeKind, DetailRowNode>();

		private DetailNodeContainer nodeContainer;

		private DetailRowsContainer rowsContainer;

		protected readonly RowDetailContainer container;

		protected readonly DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor;

		protected TableViewBehavior MasterTableViewBehavior => ((ITableView)MasterRootRowsContainer.View).TableViewBehavior;

		internal override DetailRowsContainer RowsContainer => rowsContainer;

		internal DataControlBase MasterDataControl => container.MasterDataControl;

		protected object Row => container.Row;

		{
			get
			{
				int rowHandleByListIndex = MasterDataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowHandleByListIndex(container.MasterListIndex);
				return MasterDataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandleByListIndex);
			}
		}

		protected DetailInfoWithContent(DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptor, RowDetailContainer container)
		{

			this.container = container;

		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnExpanded()
		{
			ForceCreateContainers();

		public void ForceCreateContainers()
		{
			if (nodeContainer == null)
			{
				nodeContainer = new DetailNodeContainer(this);
			}
			if (rowsContainer == null)
			{
				rowsContainer = new DetailRowsContainer(MasterRootRowsContainer, detailDescriptor);
			}
		}

		internal DetailRowNode GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
		{
			DetailRowNode value = null;
			if (!nodesCache.TryGetValue(detailNodeKind, out value))
			{
				value = CreateDetailRowNode(detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate);
				nodesCache[detailNodeKind] = value;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected RowNode FindNodeByDetailNodeKind(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind)
		{
			return nodeContainer.Items.FirstOrDefault((RowNode node) => (DetailNodeKind)node.MatchKey == detailNodeKind);
		}

		internal virtual DetailRowNode CreateDetailRowNode(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
		{
			return new DetailHeaderRowNode(this, detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate);
		}

		internal RowNode GetNodeToScroll()
		{
			DetailNodeKind[] nodeScrollOrder = GetNodeScrollOrder();
			foreach (DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind in nodeScrollOrder)
			{
				RowNode rowNode = FindNodeByDetailNodeKind(detailNodeKind);
				if (rowNode != null)
				{
					return rowNode;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual bool IsFixedNode(DetailRowNode detailRowNode)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected DetailHeaderControlBase CreateDetailHeaderControl(Func<DetailHeaderControlBase> createControl)
		{
			DetailHeaderControlBase detailHeaderControlBase = createControl();
			detailHeaderControlBase.DetailDescriptor = detailDescriptor;
			return detailHeaderControlBase;
		}

		internal IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumerator(int startVisibleIndex)
		{
			int num = GetNextLevelRowCount() - startVisibleIndex;
			int serviceVisibleRowsCount = GetServiceRowsCount() + Math.Min(num, 0);
			return GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(startVisibleIndex, num, serviceVisibleRowsCount);
		}

		public override int CalcTotalLevel()
		{
			return GetTopServiceRowsCount();
		}

		public sealed override int CalcRowsCount()
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return GetServiceRowsCount() + GetNextLevelRowCount();
		}

		public sealed override int CalcVisibleDataRowCount()
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return GetVisibleDataRowCount();
		}

		private int GetServiceRowsCount()
		{
			return GetTopServiceRowsCount() + GetBottomServiceRowsCount();
		}

		protected int CalcHeaderRowCount()
		{
			int num = (detailDescriptor.ShowHeader ? 1 : 0);
			if (detailDescriptor.HasTopMargin)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int CalcBottomRowCount()
		{
			if (!detailDescriptor.HasBottomMargin)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		protected int CalcContentRowCount()
		{
			if (detailDescriptor.ContentTemplate == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		protected RowNode GetDetailHeaderNode(bool showLastDetailMargin)
		{
			return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.DetailHeader, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailRowData(nodeKind, () => CreateDetailHeaderControl(() => MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailHeaderElement(showLastDetailMargin))));
		}

		protected RowNode GetDetailContentNode(bool showLastDetailMargin)
		{
			return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.DetailContent, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailRowData(nodeKind, () => CreateDetailHeaderControl(() => MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailContentElement(showLastDetailMargin))));
		}

		protected RowNode GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, bool showBottomLine)
		{
			DetailHeaderRowNode detailHeaderRowNode = (DetailHeaderRowNode)GetRowNode(detailNodeKind, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailRowData(nodeKind, () => CreateDetailHeaderControl(() => MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailMarginElement(detailNodeKind == DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer))));
			detailHeaderRowNode.ShowBottomLine = showBottomLine;
			return detailHeaderRowNode;
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<RowDetailInfoBase> GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator()
		{
			yield return this;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRow(object row)
		{
			container.Row = row;
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			RowsContainer.Clear();
		}
	}
	public class ContentDetailInfo : DetailInfoWithContent
	{
		private ContentDetailDescriptor ContentDetailDescriptor => (ContentDetailDescriptor)detailDescriptor;

		public ContentDetailInfo(ContentDetailDescriptor contentDetailDescriptor, RowDetailContainer container)
			: base(contentDetailDescriptor, container)
		{
		}

		internal override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(int nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, int nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, int serviceVisibleRowsCount)
		{
			bool isBottomMarginVisible = detailDescriptor.HasBottomMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0;
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			if (detailDescriptor.HasTopMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer, showBottomLine: true);
			}
			bool flag = detailDescriptor.ContentTemplate != null;
			if (detailDescriptor.ShowHeader && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				DetailHeaderRowNode detailHeaderRowNode = (DetailHeaderRowNode)GetDetailHeaderNode(showLastDetailMargin: true);
				detailHeaderRowNode.ShowBottomLine = !flag || serviceVisibleRowsCount == 0;
				yield return detailHeaderRowNode;
			}
			if (serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				DetailHeaderRowNode detailHeaderRowNode2 = (DetailHeaderRowNode)GetDetailContentNode(showLastDetailMargin: true);
				detailHeaderRowNode2.ShowBottomLine = true;
				yield return detailHeaderRowNode2;
			}
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer, showBottomLine: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override DetailNodeKind[] GetNodeScrollOrder()
		{
			return new DetailNodeKind[4]
			{
				DetailNodeKind.DetailContent,
				DetailNodeKind.DetailHeader,
				DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer,
				DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer
			};
		}

		protected internal override int GetTopServiceRowsCount()
		{
			return CalcHeaderRowCount() + 1;
		}

		protected internal override int GetBottomServiceRowsCount()
		{
			return CalcBottomRowCount();
		}

		protected internal override int GetNextLevelRowCount()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected internal override int GetVisibleDataRowCount()
		{
			return 0;
		}

		public override bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			targetView = null;
			targetVisibleIndex = -1;
			return false;
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView()
		{
			return null;
		}

		public override DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return ContentDetailDescriptor;
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override DataControlDetailInfo GetActualDetailInfo(DataControlDetailDescriptor detailDescriptor)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class TabsDetailInfo : DetailInfoWithContent
	{
		internal class TabHeadersRowNode : DetailRowNode
		{
			public TabHeadersRowNode(TabsDetailInfo owner, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
				: base(owner, DetailNodeKind.TabHeaders, createRowDataDelegate)
			{
			}

			internal override void AssignToRowData(RowDataBase rowData, RowDataBase masterRowData)
			{
				((TabHeadersRowData)rowData).AssignFrom((TabsDetailInfo)owner);
				if (rowData is TabHeadersRowData)
				{
					(rowData as TabHeadersRowData).SetMasterView(masterRowData.View);
				}
			}
		}

		public class TabHeadersRowData : DetailRowData
		{
			public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedTabIndexProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SelectedTabIndex", typeof(int), typeof(TabHeadersRowData), new PropertyMetadata(0, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((TabHeadersRowData)(object)d).OnSelectedTabIndexChanged();
			}));

			internal Locker SelectedIndexLocker = new Locker();

			public int SelectedTabIndex
			{
				get
				{
					return (int)((DependencyObject)(object)this).GetValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty);
				}
				set
				{
					((DependencyObject)(object)this).SetValue(SelectedTabIndexProperty, (object)value);
				}
			}

			internal TabsDetailInfo CurrentTabsDetailInfo { get; private set; }

			public TabHeadersRowData(Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
				: base(DetailNodeKind.TabHeaders, createRowElementDelegate)
			{
			}//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown


			private void OnSelectedTabIndexChanged()
			{
				CurrentTabsDetailInfo.SelectedTabIndex = SelectedTabIndex;
			}

			internal void AssignFrom(TabsDetailInfo currentTabsDetailInfo)
			{
				CurrentTabsDetailInfo = currentTabsDetailInfo;
				SelectedIndexLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					SelectedTabIndex = currentTabsDetailInfo.SelectedTabIndex;
				});
			}
		}

		private int selectedTabIndex;

		private Dictionary<DetailDescriptorBase, DetailInfoWithContent> detailInfoCache = new Dictionary<DetailDescriptorBase, DetailInfoWithContent>();

		private DetailInfoWithContent selectedDetailInfo;

		public int SelectedTabIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedTabIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectedTabIndex != value)
				{
					selectedTabIndex = value;
					ValidateChildDetailInfo();
					detailDescriptor.InvalidateTree();
					FocusViewInsideTabOrMaster();
				}
			}
		}

		private TabViewDetailDescriptor TabDetailDescriptor => (TabViewDetailDescriptor)detailDescriptor;

		public TabsDetailInfo(TabViewDetailDescriptor tabDetailDescriptor, RowDetailContainer container)
			: base(tabDetailDescriptor, container)
		{
		}

		protected internal override void OnExpanded()
		{
			base.OnExpanded();
			ValidateChildDetailInfo();
		}

		protected internal override void OnCollapsed()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo != null)
			{
				selectedDetailInfo.IsExpanded = false;
			}
		}

		private void ValidateChildDetailInfo()
		{
			if (!IsExpanded)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			if (TabDetailDescriptor.DetailDescriptors.Count != 0)
			{
				if (selectedDetailInfo != null)
				{
					selectedDetailInfo.IsExpanded = false;
				}
				DetailDescriptorBase detailDescriptorBase = TabDetailDescriptor.DetailDescriptors[SelectedTabIndex];
				if (!detailInfoCache.TryGetValue(detailDescriptorBase, out selectedDetailInfo))
				{
					detailInfoCache[detailDescriptorBase] = (selectedDetailInfo = detailDescriptorBase.CreateRowDetailInfo(container));
				}
				UpdateSelectedDetailInfoMasterRowData(RowsContainer.MasterRowData);
				selectedDetailInfo.IsExpanded = true;
			}
		}

		private void FocusViewInsideTabOrMaster()
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			if (selectedDetailInfo != null)
			{
				dataViewBase = selectedDetailInfo.FindFirstDetailView();
			}
			if (dataViewBase != null)
			{
				if (dataViewBase.DataControl == null || dataViewBase.DataControl.GetAllowInitiallyFocusedRow())
				{
					dataViewBase.MoveFocusedRow(0);
				}
			}
			else if (base.MasterDataControl.GetAllowInitiallyFocusedRow())
			{
				base.MasterDataControl.DataView.MoveFocusedRow(base.MasterVisibleIndex);
			}
		}

		public override RowsContainer GetRowsContainerAndUpdateMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData)
		{
			UpdateSelectedDetailInfoMasterRowData(masterRowData);
			return base.GetRowsContainerAndUpdateMasterRowData(masterRowData);
		}

		private void UpdateSelectedDetailInfoMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData)
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo != null)
			{
				selectedDetailInfo.UpdateMasterRowData(masterRowData);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData)
		{
			base.UpdateMasterRowData(masterRowData);
			UpdateSelectedDetailInfoMasterRowData(masterRowData);
		}

		internal override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(int nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, int nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, int serviceVisibleRowsCount)
		{
			bool isBottomMarginVisible = detailDescriptor.HasBottomMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0;
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			if (detailDescriptor.HasTopMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer, showBottomLine: false);
			}
			if (detailDescriptor.ShowHeader && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailHeaderNode(showLastDetailMargin: false);
			}
			if (TabDetailDescriptor.ContentTemplate != null && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailContentNode(showLastDetailMargin: false);
			}
			if (serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				DetailRowNode rowNode = GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.TabHeaders, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new TabHeadersRowData(() => CreateDetailHeaderControl(base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailTabHeadersElement)));
				if (selectedDetailInfo != null && selectedDetailInfo.NodeContainer != null)
				{
					if (nextLevelVisibleRowsCount > 0)
					{
						rowNode.UpdateExpandInfoEx(selectedDetailInfo.NodeContainer, selectedDetailInfo.RowsContainer, nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, isRowVisible: true);
					}
					else
					{
						rowNode.UpdateExpandInfoEx(null, null, nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, isRowVisible: true);
					}
				}
				yield return rowNode;
			}
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer, showBottomLine: true);
			}
		}

		protected internal override DetailNodeKind[] GetNodeScrollOrder()
		{
			return new DetailNodeKind[5]
			{
				DetailNodeKind.TabHeaders,
				DetailNodeKind.DetailContent,
				DetailNodeKind.DetailHeader,
				DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer,
				DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer
			};
		}

		public override int CalcTotalLevel()
		{
			return base.CalcTotalLevel() + ((selectedDetailInfo != null) ? selectedDetailInfo.CalcTotalLevel() : 0);
		}

		protected internal override int GetNextLevelRowCount()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.CalcRowsCount();
		}

		protected internal override int GetVisibleDataRowCount()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.CalcVisibleDataRowCount();
		}

		protected internal override int GetTopServiceRowsCount()
		{
			return CalcHeaderRowCount() + CalcContentRowCount() + 1;
		}

		protected internal override int GetBottomServiceRowsCount()
		{
			return CalcBottomRowCount();
		}

		internal override DetailRowNode CreateDetailRowNode(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
		{
			if (detailNodeKind == DetailNodeKind.TabHeaders)
			{
				return new TabHeadersRowNode(this, createRowDataDelegate);
			}
			return base.CreateDetailRowNode(detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate);
		}

		public override bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				targetView = null;
				targetVisibleIndex = -1;
				return false;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.FindFirstDetailView();
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.FindLastInnerDetailView();
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
		}

		public override DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor()
		{
			if (selectedDetailInfo == null)
			{
				return TabDetailDescriptor;
			}
			return selectedDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDescriptor();
		}

		public override bool IsDetailRowExpanded(DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			if (IsExpanded)
			{
				if (descriptor == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				int num = TabDetailDescriptor.DetailDescriptors.IndexOf(descriptor);
				if (num > -1 && num == SelectedTabIndex)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void SetDetailRowExpanded(bool expand, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)
		{
			base.SetDetailRowExpanded(expand, descriptor);
			if (IsExpanded && descriptor != null)
			{
				int num = TabDetailDescriptor.DetailDescriptors.IndexOf(descriptor);
				if (num > -1)
				{
					SelectedTabIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override IEnumerable<RowDetailInfoBase> GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator()
		{
			yield return this;
			foreach (DetailInfoWithContent value in detailInfoCache.Values)
			{
				foreach (RowDetailInfoBase item in value.GetRowDetailInfoEnumerator())
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override DataControlDetailInfo GetActualDetailInfo(DataControlDetailDescriptor detailDescriptor)
		{
			return (DataControlDetailInfo)detailDescriptor.CreateRowDetailInfo(container);
		}
	}
	public class DetailDescriptorSelectorInfo : DetailInfoWithContent
	{
		private BindingValueHelper valueHelper;

		private RowDetailInfoBase activeDetailInfo;

		private DetailDescriptorBase CurrentDetailDescriptor => (DetailDescriptorBase)valueHelper.Value;

		private DetailDescriptorSelector DetailDescriptorSelector => (DetailDescriptorSelector)detailDescriptor;

		private RowDetailInfoBase ActiveDetailInfo
		{
			get
			{
				return activeDetailInfo ?? EmptyRowDetailInfo.Instance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (activeDetailInfo != value)
				{
					if (activeDetailInfo != null)
					{
						activeDetailInfo.IsExpanded = false;
						activeDetailInfo.Detach();
					}
					activeDetailInfo = value;
					if (IsExpanded)
					{
						OnExpanded();
					}
					detailDescriptor.InvalidateTree();
				}
			}
		}

		public DetailDescriptorSelectorInfo(DetailDescriptorSelector detailDescriptor, RowDetailContainer container)
			: base(detailDescriptor, container)
		{
			valueHelper = new BindingValueHelper(OnDetailDescriptorChanged);
			valueHelper.ApplyBindings(DetailDescriptorSelector, container.Row);
		}

		private void OnDetailDescriptorChanged(object oldDetailDescriptor)
		{
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = base.MasterDataControl.DataView.RootDataPresenter.Return((DataPresenterBase x) => x.ActualScrollOffset, () => 0.0);
			if (base.MasterDataControl.DataView.IsFocusedRowModified && base.MasterDataControl.CurrentItem == base.Row && base.NodeContainer != null)
			{
				num = base.NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			}
			ActiveDetailInfo = CurrentDetailDescriptor.Return((DetailDescriptorBase x) => x.CreateRowDetailInfo(container), null);
			int num3 = CalcRowsCount();
			if (num > num3)
			{
				base.MasterDataControl.DataView.RootView.LockEditorClose = true;
				base.MasterDataControl.DataView.RootDataPresenter.SetVerticalOffsetForce(num2 - (double)num + (double)num3 - 1.0);
				base.MasterDataControl.DataView.RootView.LockEditorClose = false;
			}
		}

		public override DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return CurrentDetailDescriptor;
		}

		protected internal override void OnExpanded()
		{
			base.OnExpanded();
			UpdateMasterRowData();
			ActiveDetailInfo.IsExpanded = true;
		}

		private void UpdateMasterRowData()
		{
			if (RowsContainer != null)
			{
				ActiveDetailInfo.UpdateMasterRowData(RowsContainer.MasterRowData);
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnCollapsed()
		{
			ActiveDetailInfo.IsExpanded = false;
			base.OnCollapsed();
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl()
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.FindVisibleDetailDataControl();
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView()
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.FindLastInnerDetailView();
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView()
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.FindFirstDetailView();
		}

		public override bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		protected internal override int GetVisibleDataRowCount()
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.GetVisibleDataRowCount();
		}

		protected internal override int GetNextLevelRowCount()
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.GetNextLevelRowCount();

			return ActiveDetailInfo.GetBottomServiceRowsCount();

		}

		internal override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(int nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, int nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, int serviceVisibleRowsCount)
		{
			return ActiveDetailInfo.GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, serviceVisibleRowsCount);

		public override RowsContainer GetRowsContainerAndUpdateMasterRowData(RowData masterRowData)

			UpdateMasterRowData();

		}

		public override void SetDetailRowExpanded(bool expand, DetailDescriptorBase descriptor)

			base.SetDetailRowExpanded(expand, descriptor);
			if (ActiveDetailInfo != null)

				ActiveDetailInfo.SetDetailRowExpanded(expand, descriptor);
			}

	public class DataControlDetailInfo : DetailInfoWithContent, IDataControlParent
	{
		internal class DetailViewRowNode : DetailRowNode
		{
			private readonly DataViewBase view;

			public DetailViewRowNode(DetailInfoWithContent owner, DataViewBase view, DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
				: base(owner, detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate)
			{
				this.view = view;
			}

			internal override void AssignToRowData(RowDataBase rowData, RowDataBase masterRowData)
			{
				if (rowData is IViewRowData viewRowData)
				{
					viewRowData.SetViewAndUpdate(view);
				}
			}
		}

		public class DetailViewRowData : DetailRowData, IViewRowData
		{
			public DetailViewRowData(DetailNodeKind nodeKind, Func<FrameworkElement> createRowElementDelegate)
				: base(nodeKind, createRowElementDelegate)
			{
			}

			internal override void SetMasterView(DataViewBase view)
			{
			}

			internal override void UpdateLineLevel()
			{
				DataViewBase targetView = null;
				int targetVisibleIndex = -1;
				if (base.View.DataControl.DataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
				{
					RowData rowData = targetView.GetRowData(targetView.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(targetVisibleIndex));
					if (rowData != null)
					{
						base.LineLevel = GetLineLevel(this, 0, 0);
						bool isLastRow = true;
						base.DetailLevel = GetDetailLevel(this, 0, ref isLastRow);
						if (isLastRow)
						{
							base.LineLevel = base.DetailLevel;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				base.LineLevel = 0;
				base.DetailLevel = 0;
			}

			protected override int GetLineLevel(RowDataBase rowData, int lineLevel, int detailCount)
			{
				if (rowData is RowData && ((rowData as RowData).RowPosition != RowPosition.Bottom || (rowData as RowData).RowPosition != RowPosition.Single))
				{
					return lineLevel;
				}
				return base.GetLineLevel(rowData, lineLevel, detailCount);
			}

			void IViewRowData.SetViewAndUpdate(DataViewBase view)
			{
				base.View = view;
			}
		}

		private DataControlBase dataControl;

		internal DataControlBase DataControl
		{
			get
			{
				return dataControl;
			}
			set
			{
				dataControl = value;
			}
		}

		internal DataControlDetailDescriptor DataControlDetailDescriptor => (DataControlDetailDescriptor)detailDescriptor;

		private DevExpress.Xpf.Grid.DetailNodeContainer DetailRootNodeContainer => SafeGetViewProperty((DataViewBase view) => view.RootNodeContainer);

		public DataControlDetailInfo(DataControlDetailDescriptor detailDescriptor, RowDetailContainer container)
			: base(detailDescriptor, container)
		{
		}

		internal void UpdateDataControl(bool addToClones)
		{
			DataControlDetailDescriptor.DataControl.CloneDetail(base.MasterDataControl.DataView.MasterRootNodeContainer, base.MasterRootRowsContainer, base.Row, DataControlDetailDescriptor.GetItemsSourceBinding(), this, !DataControlDetailDescriptor.DataControl.CanAutoPopulateColumns, addToClones);
		}

		public void CloneDetail()
		{
			if (dataControl == null)
			{
				UpdateDataControl(addToClones: true);
			}
			DataControlDetailDescriptor.PopulateColumnsIfNeeded(dataControl.DataProviderBase);
			DataControlDetailDescriptor.DataControl.CopyToDetail(dataControl);
			dataControl.DataView.UpdateContentLayout();
			if (dataControl.DataView.RootDataPresenter != null)
			{
				dataControl.DataView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.SecondarySizeScrollInfo.Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void OnExpanded()
		{
			CloneDetail();
		}

		protected internal override void OnCollapsed()
		{
			base.OnCollapsed();
		}

		private T SafeGetViewProperty<T>(Func<DataViewBase, T> getPropertyDelegate) where T : class
		{
			if (dataControl == null || dataControl.DataView == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return getPropertyDelegate(dataControl.DataView);
		}

		public override bool FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool forwardIfServiceRow, out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			int num = DataControl.VisibleRowCount + DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCount();
			if (scrollIndex >= num)
			{
				if (scrollIndex >= num + GetBottomServiceRowsCount())
				{
					if (forwardIfServiceRow)
					{
						targetView = FindFirstDetailView();
						if (targetView != null)
						{
							targetVisibleIndex = 0;
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (((IDataControlParent)this).FindMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (forwardIfServiceRow)
				{
					if (((IDataControlParent)this).FindNextOuterMasterRow(out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					targetView = FindLastInnerDetailView();
					if (targetView != null)
					{
						targetVisibleIndex = targetView.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1;
						return true;
					}
				}
				targetView = null;
				targetVisibleIndex = -1;
				return false;
			}
			return DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndexCore(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindFirstDetailView()
		{
			if (DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0 || DataControl.DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				return DataControl.DataView;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override DataViewBase FindLastInnerDetailView()
		{
			return DataControl.FindLastInnerDetailView();
		}

		public override DataControlBase FindVisibleDetailDataControl()
		{
			return DataControl;
		}

		public override DetailDescriptorBase FindVisibleDetailDescriptor()
		{
			return DataControlDetailDescriptor;
		}

		protected internal override int GetNextLevelRowCount()
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return DataControl.VisibleRowCount + DataControl.viewCore.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount() + DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailRowsCount();
		}

		protected internal override int GetVisibleDataRowCount()
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = DataControl.VisibleRowCount + DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcVisibleDetailDataRowCount();
			if (DataControl.DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override int GetTopServiceRowsCount()
		{
			int num = CalcHeaderRowCount() + CalcContentRowCount();
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				if (DataControl.DataView.CanShowDetailColumnHeadersControl)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (DataControl.DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override int GetBottomServiceRowsCount()
		{
			int num = CalcBottomRowCount();
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				if (DataControl.DataView.ShowTotalSummary)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (DataControl.DataView.ShowFixedTotalSummary)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal override DetailNodeKind[] GetNodeScrollOrder()
		{
			return new DetailNodeKind[9]
			{
				DetailNodeKind.DataRowsContainer,
				DetailNodeKind.NewItemRow,
				DetailNodeKind.TotalSummary,
				DetailNodeKind.FixedTotalSummary,
				DetailNodeKind.ColumnHeaders,
				DetailNodeKind.DetailContent,
				DetailNodeKind.DetailHeader,
				DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer,
				DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer
			};
		}

		internal override IEnumerator<RowNode> GetRowNodesEnumeratorCore(int nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, int nextLevelVisibleRowsCount, int serviceVisibleRowsCount)
		{
			bool isBottomMarginVisible = detailDescriptor.HasBottomMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0;
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			if (detailDescriptor.HasTopMargin && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer, showBottomLine: true);
			}
			bool hasContentRow = detailDescriptor.ContentTemplate != null;
			if (DataControlDetailDescriptor.ShowHeader && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				DetailHeaderRowNode detailHeaderRowNode = (DetailHeaderRowNode)GetDetailHeaderNode(showLastDetailMargin: true);
				detailHeaderRowNode.ShowBottomLine = !hasContentRow;
				yield return detailHeaderRowNode;
			}
			if (hasContentRow && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				DetailHeaderRowNode detailHeaderRowNode2 = (DetailHeaderRowNode)GetDetailContentNode(showLastDetailMargin: true);
				detailHeaderRowNode2.ShowBottomLine = true;
				yield return detailHeaderRowNode2;
			}
			if (DataControl.DataView.CanShowDetailColumnHeadersControl && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.ColumnHeaders, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailColumnsData(nodeKind, SafeGetViewProperty((Func<DataViewBase, DataTreeBuilder>)((DataViewBase view) => view.VisualDataTreeBuilder)), base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailColumnHeadersElement));
			}
			bool isFixedTotalSummaryRowVisible = DataControl.DataView.ShowFixedTotalSummary && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0;
			if (isFixedTotalSummaryRowVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			TotalSummaryPosition totalSummaryPosition = ((serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0) ? DataControl.DataView.TotalSummaryPosition : TotalSummaryPosition.None);
			if (totalSummaryPosition != TotalSummaryPosition.None)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			bool flag = DataControl.DataView.IsNewItemRowVisible && serviceVisibleRowsCount > 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				yield return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.NewItemRow, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailColumnsData(nodeKind, SafeGetViewProperty((Func<DataViewBase, DataTreeBuilder>)((DataViewBase view) => view.VisualDataTreeBuilder)), base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailNewItemRowElement));
			}
			if (totalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Top)
			{
				yield return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.TotalSummary, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailColumnsData(nodeKind, SafeGetViewProperty((Func<DataViewBase, DataTreeBuilder>)((DataViewBase view) => view.VisualDataTreeBuilder)), base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailTotalSummaryElement));
			}
			if (nextLevelVisibleRowsCount > 0)
			{
				DetailRowNode rowNode = GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.DataRowsContainer, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailRowData(nodeKind, () => new EmptyDetailRowControl()));
				rowNode.UpdateExpandInfoEx(DetailRootNodeContainer, SafeGetViewProperty((Func<DataViewBase, RowsContainer>)((DataViewBase view) => view.RootRowsContainer)), nextLevelStartVisibleIndex, isRowVisible: false);
				yield return rowNode;
			}
			if (totalSummaryPosition == TotalSummaryPosition.Bottom)
			{
				yield return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.TotalSummary, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailColumnsData(nodeKind, SafeGetViewProperty((Func<DataViewBase, DataTreeBuilder>)((DataViewBase view) => view.VisualDataTreeBuilder)), base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailTotalSummaryElement));
			}
			if (isFixedTotalSummaryRowVisible)
			{
				yield return GetRowNode(DetailNodeKind.FixedTotalSummary, (DetailNodeKind nodeKind) => new DetailViewRowData(nodeKind, base.MasterTableViewBehavior.CreateDetailFixedTotalSummaryElement));
			}
			if (isBottomMarginVisible)
			{
				serviceVisibleRowsCount--;
				yield return GetDetailMarginNode(DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer, showBottomLine: true);
			}
		}

		internal override DetailRowNode CreateDetailRowNode(DetailNodeKind detailNodeKind, Func<DetailNodeKind, RowDataBase> createRowDataDelegate)
		{
			switch (detailNodeKind)
			{
			case DetailNodeKind.DetailHeader:
			case DetailNodeKind.DetailContent:
			case DetailNodeKind.TopMarginContainer:
			case DetailNodeKind.BottomMarginContainer:
				return base.CreateDetailRowNode(detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate);
			default:
				return new DetailViewRowNode(this, DataControl.DataView, detailNodeKind, createRowDataDelegate);
			}
		}

		internal override bool IsFixedNode(DetailRowNode detailRowNode)
		{
			return false;
		}

		IEnumerable<ColumnsRowDataBase> IDataControlParent.GetColumnsRowDataEnumerator()
		{
			return RowsContainer.Items.Where((RowDataBase rowData) => rowData is ColumnsRowDataBase).Cast<ColumnsRowDataBase>();
		}

		ColumnsRowDataBase IDataControlParent.GetNewItemRowData()
		{
			return (ColumnsRowDataBase)GetRowDataByKind(DetailNodeKind.NewItemRow);
		}

		ColumnsRowDataBase IDataControlParent.GetHeadersRowData()
		{
			return (ColumnsRowDataBase)GetRowDataByKind(DetailNodeKind.ColumnHeaders);
		}

		private RowDataBase GetRowDataByKind(DetailNodeKind kind)
		{
			return RowsContainer.Items.FirstOrDefault((RowDataBase rowData) => object.Equals(rowData.MatchKey, kind));
		}

		DataViewBase IDataControlParent.FindMasterView()
		{
			return base.MasterDataControl.DataView;
		}

		bool IDataControlParent.FindMasterRow(out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			targetView = base.MasterDataControl.DataView;
			targetVisibleIndex = base.MasterVisibleIndex;
			return true;
		}

		bool IDataControlParent.FindNextOuterMasterRow(out DataViewBase targetView, out int targetVisibleIndex)
		{
			return base.MasterDataControl.FindNextOuterMasterRow(base.MasterVisibleIndex, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
		}

		void IDataControlParent.InvalidateTree()
		{
			DataControlDetailDescriptor.InvalidateTree();
		}

		void IDataControlParent.EnumerateParentDataControls(Action<DataControlBase, int> action)
		{
			action(base.MasterDataControl, base.MasterVisibleIndex);
			base.MasterDataControl.DataControlParent.EnumerateParentDataControls(action);
		}

		void IDataControlParent.ValidateMasterDetailConsistency(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			dataControl.DataProviderBase.ThrowNotSupportedExceptionIfInServerMode();
		}

		void IDataControlParent.CollectViewVisibleIndexChain(List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> chain)
		{
			chain.Insert(0, new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(base.MasterDataControl.DataView, base.MasterVisibleIndex));
			base.MasterDataControl.CollectViewVisibleIndexChain(chain);
		}

		void IDataControlParent.CollectParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(List<int> scrollIndexes)
		{
			int num = base.MasterDataControl.DataView.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(base.MasterVisibleIndex);
			for (int num2 = GetTopServiceRowsCount(); num2 >= 1; num2--)
			{
				scrollIndexes.Add(num - num2);
			}
			scrollIndexes.Add(num);
			base.MasterDataControl.CollectParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(base.MasterVisibleIndex, scrollIndexes);
		}

		int IDataControlParent.CalcTotalLevel()
		{
			return base.MasterDataControl.CalcTotalLevel(base.MasterVisibleIndex) + base.MasterDataControl.MasterDetailProvider.CalcTotalLevel(base.MasterVisibleIndex) + 1;
		}

		protected override void UpdateRow(object row)
		{
			base.UpdateRow(row);
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControl.DataContext = row;
			}
		}

		internal override void RemoveFromDetailClones()
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				DataControlDetailDescriptor.DataControl.DetailClones.Remove(DataControl);
			}
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			ClearGrid();
		}

		public override void Detach()
		{
			base.Detach();
			ClearGrid();
		}

		private void ClearGrid()
		{
			if (DataControl != null)
			{
				((CustomizablePopupMenuBase)DataControl.DataView.DataControlMenu).Destroy();
				DataControl.UnselectAll();
				DataControlDetailDescriptor.DataControl.DetailClones.Remove(dataControl);
			}
		}

		protected internal override DataControlDetailInfo GetActualDetailInfo(DataControlDetailDescriptor detailDescriptor)
		{
			return this;
		}
	}
