	public class BandedViewAutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator : BandedViewColumnsLayoutCalculator
	{
		public override bool AutoWidth => true;

		public BandedViewAutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
			: base(viewInfo)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcActualLayoutCore(double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			StretchColumnsToWidth(base.BandsLayout.VisibleBands, arrangeWidth, layoutAssigner, needRoundingLastColumn, allowFixedWidth: true);
		}

		protected override void OnBandResize(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			SetDefaultColumnSize(base.BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: true));
			IList bands = base.BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: false);
			if (delta > 0.0)
			{
				IncreaseBandsWidth(bands, delta);
			}
			else
			{
				DecreaseBandsWidth(bands, delta);
			}
		}

		protected override double CorrectColumnDelta(ColumnBase column, double delta, FixedStyle fixedStyle, bool correctWidths)
		{
			delta = base.CorrectColumnDelta(column, delta, fixedStyle, correctWidths);
			if (correctWidths && !HasSizeableRightColumns(column))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Min(GetColumnHeaderWidth(column) + delta, GetColumnMaxWidth(column)) - GetColumnHeaderWidth(column);
		}

		protected override double CorrectBandDelta(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			delta = base.CorrectBandDelta(band, delta);
			return Math.Min(band.ActualHeaderWidth + delta, GetBandMaxWidth(band)) - band.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		private bool HasSizeableRightColumns(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column?.BandRow == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = column.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(column) + 1; i < column.BandRow.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!column.BandRow.Columns[i].FixedWidth)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			foreach (BandBase band in base.BandsLayout.GetBands(column.ParentBand, isLeft: false))
			{
				foreach (BaseColumn bandColumn in GetBandColumns(band, useMinWidth: true))
				{
					if (!bandColumn.FixedWidth)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double GetBandMaxWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			double num = GetBandsMinWidth(band, isLeft: false);
			foreach (BandBase band2 in base.BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: true))
			{
				num += band2.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
			return GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, base.TableViewBehavior.TableView.ShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false) - num;
		}

		private double GetColumnMaxWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column?.ParentBand == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			double num = GetBandsMinWidth(column.ParentBand, isLeft: false);
			if (column?.BandRow == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			for (int i = column.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(column) + 1; i < column.BandRow.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				num += AutoWidthHelper.GetColumnFixedWidth(column.BandRow.Columns[i], ViewInfo);
			}
			foreach (BandBase band in base.BandsLayout.GetBands(column.ParentBand, isLeft: true))
			{
				num += band.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
			for (int num2 = column.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(column) - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				num += GetColumnHeaderWidth(column.BandRow.Columns[num2]);
			}
			return GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, base.TableViewBehavior.TableView.ShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false) - num;
		}

		private double GetBandsMinWidth(BandBase band, bool isLeft)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase band2 in base.BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft))
			{
				num += GetBandMinWidth(band2);
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class BandedViewColumnsLayoutCalculator : ColumnsLayoutCalculator
	{
		protected BandsLayoutBase BandsLayout => ViewInfo.BandsLayout;

		public BandedViewColumnsLayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
			: base(viewInfo)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcActualLayoutCore(double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			ResetActualColumnHeaders(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, layoutAssigner);
			SetActualColumnWidth(GetSizeableColumns(useMinWidth: false), layoutAssigner);
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in BandsLayout.VisibleBands)
			{
				RecalcBandLayout(visibleBand, layoutAssigner);
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyResizeCore(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = resizeColumn as ColumnBase;
			if (!autoBestFit && columnBase != null && columnBase.WidthCore.IsAuto)
			{
				columnBase.Width = new GridColumnWidth(columnBase.Width.Value);
			}
			if (correctWidths)
			{
				double delta = newWidth - GetColumnHeaderWidth(resizeColumn);
				if (!resizeColumn.IsBand)
				{
					delta = ChangeColumnSize(columnBase, delta, resizeColumn.BandRow.Columns);
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in columnBase.ParentBand.ActualRows)
					{
						if (actualRow != resizeColumn.BandRow)
						{
							ChangeColumnSize(null, delta, actualRow.Columns);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					delta = ChangeBandSize(resizeColumn.ParentBandInternal, delta);
				}
				OnBandResize(resizeColumn.ParentBandInternal, delta);
			}
			else if (resizeColumn.Visible && ViewInfo.GridView.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(resizeColumn))
			{
				double delta2 = newWidth - GetColumnWidth(resizeColumn);
				resizeColumn.ActualWidth = Math.Max(0.0, GetColumnWidth(resizeColumn) + CorrectColumnDelta(columnBase, delta2, FixedStyle.None, correctWidths));
			}
			else
			{
				resizeColumn.ActualWidth = newWidth;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnBandResize(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			if (BandsLayout.GetRootBand(band).Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				SetDefaultColumnSize(BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: false, skipNotFixedBands: true));
			}
		}

		protected void SetDefaultColumnSize(IList bands)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					SetDefaultColumnSize(band.VisibleBands);
				}
				else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
						{
							column.ActualWidth = GetColumnWidth(column);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					band.ActualWidth = GetColumnWidth(band);
				}
			}
		}

		protected double ChangeColumnSize(ColumnBase resizeColumn, double delta, IList columns)
		{
			FixedStyle fixedStyle = FixedStyle.Left;
			if (resizeColumn != null)
			{
				fixedStyle = BandsLayout.GetRootBand(resizeColumn.ParentBand).Fixed;
				delta = CorrectColumnDelta(resizeColumn, delta, fixedStyle, correctWidths: true);
			}
			int columnIndex = columns.IndexOf(resizeColumn);
			SetColumnsWidth(columnIndex, delta, columns);
			if (delta > 0.0)
			{
				return DecreaseColumnsWidth(resizeColumn, delta, columns, columnIndex, fixedStyle == FixedStyle.Right);
			}
			return IncreaseColumnsWidth(resizeColumn, delta, columns, columnIndex, fixedStyle == FixedStyle.Right);
		}

		private void SetColumnsWidth(int columnIndex, double delta, IList columns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				if (i == columnIndex)
				{
					baseColumn.ActualWidth = Math.Max(0.0, GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) + delta);
				}
				else
				{
					baseColumn.ActualWidth = GetColumnWidth(baseColumn);
				}
			}
		}

		private double IncreaseColumnsWidth(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double delta, IList columns, int columnIndex, bool isLeft)
		{
			int num = CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(columnIndex, columns, isLeft);
			double num2 = delta;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!BandsLayout.SkipItem(columnIndex, i, isLeft))
				{
					BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
					if (!baseColumn.FixedWidth)
					{
						double val = GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - num2 / (double)num;
						double num3 = Math.Max(val, baseColumn.MinWidth);
						num--;
						num2 -= GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - num3;
						baseColumn.ActualWidth = num3;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0.0 - num2;
		}

		protected int CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(int columnIndex, IList columns, bool isLeft)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!BandsLayout.SkipItem(columnIndex, i, isLeft) && !((BaseColumn)columns[i]).FixedWidth)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(IList bands)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					num += CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(band.VisibleBands);
				}
				else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					if (CanBeResized(band))
					{
						num += CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(-1, GetBandRow(band, useMinWidth: false).Columns, isLeft: false);
					}
				}
				else if (!band.FixedWidth)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcSizeableWidth(IList bands)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					num += CalcSizeableWidth(band.VisibleBands);
				}
				else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					num += CalcSizeableWidth(-1, GetBandRow(band, useMinWidth: false).Columns, isLeft: false);
				}
				else if (!band.FixedWidth)
				{
					num += GetColumnWidth(band) - band.MinWidth;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double DecreaseColumnsWidth(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double delta, IList columns, int columnIndex, bool isLeft)
		{
			double num = CalcSizeableWidth(columnIndex, columns, isLeft);
			if (num == 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0 - delta;
			}
			double num2 = delta;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!BandsLayout.SkipItem(columnIndex, i, isLeft))
				{
					BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
					if (!baseColumn.FixedWidth)
					{
						double val = GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - (GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - baseColumn.MinWidth) * Math.Min(num, delta) / num;
						double num3 = Math.Max(val, baseColumn.MinWidth);
						num2 -= GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - num3;
						baseColumn.ActualWidth = num3;
					}
				}
			}
			return 0.0 - num2;
		}

		protected double CalcSizeableWidth(int columnIndex, IList columns, bool isLeft)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!BandsLayout.SkipItem(columnIndex, i, isLeft))
				{
					BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
					if (!baseColumn.FixedWidth)
					{
						num += GetColumnWidth(baseColumn) - baseColumn.MinWidth;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double CorrectColumnDelta(ColumnBase column, double delta, FixedStyle fixedStyle, bool correctWidths)
		{
			if (fixedStyle != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				delta = Math.Min(delta, base.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalViewportCore + CalcSizeableWidth(column.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(column), column.BandRow.Columns, fixedStyle != FixedStyle.Left));
			}
			double val = column.MinWidth;
			if (column?.BandRow == null)
			{
				return delta;
			}
			int columnIndex = column.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(column);
			if (column.BandRow.Columns[column.BandRow.Columns.Count - 1] == column)
			{
				double bandMinWidth = GetBandMinWidth(column.ParentBand, column.BandRow);
				val = Math.Max(bandMinWidth - CalcColumnsWidth(column.BandRow.Columns, (BaseColumn col, int index) => index >= columnIndex, useHeaderIndent: true), val);
				val -= ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column, calcBandSeparator: false);
			}
			if (delta > 0.0 && HasFixedSizeRow(column))
			{
				delta = Math.Min(delta, CalcSizeableWidth(columnIndex, column.BandRow.Columns, isLeft: false));
			}
			if (delta < 0.0 && column.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count > 1 && !HasUnfixedColumn(column.BandRow.Columns, columnIndex + 1))
			{
				delta = Math.Max(delta, 0.0 - CalcMinSizeableWidth(column));
			}
			return Math.Max(GetColumnWidth(column) + delta, val) - GetColumnWidth(column);
		}

		private bool HasFixedSizeRow(ColumnBase resizeColumn)
		{
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in resizeColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow == resizeColumn.BandRow)
				{
					continue;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					if (!column.FixedWidth)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool HasUnfixedColumn(List<ColumnBase> columns, int index)
		{
			for (int i = index; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!columns[i].FixedWidth)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcMinSizeableWidth(ColumnBase resizeColumn)
		{
			double num = double.MaxValue;
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in resizeColumn.ParentBand.ActualRows)
			{
				if (actualRow != resizeColumn.BandRow)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, CalcSizeableWidth(-1, actualRow.Columns, isLeft: true));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double CorrectBandDelta(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			if (!CanBeResized(band))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (BandsLayout.GetRootBand(band).Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				delta = Math.Min(delta, base.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalViewportCore);
			}
			if (BandsLayout.GetRootBand(band).Fixed == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				foreach (BandBase band2 in BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: true, skipNotFixedBands: true))
				{
					num += band2.ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
				foreach (BandBase band3 in BandsLayout.GetBands(band, isLeft: false, skipNotFixedBands: true))
				{
					num += band3.ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
				if (band.HasLeftSibling)
				{
					num += ViewInfo.FirstColumnIndent;
				}
				delta = Math.Max(delta, GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, base.TableViewBehavior.TableView.ShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false) - num - base.TableViewBehavior.HorizontalExtent - band.ActualHeaderWidth);
			}
			return Math.Max(band.ActualHeaderWidth + delta, GetBandMinWidth(band)) - band.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		private bool CanBeResized(BandBase band)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
				{
					if (CanBeResized(visibleBand))
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
					{
						if (!column.FixedWidth)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return !band.FixedWidth;
		}

		internal double GetBandMinWidth(BandBase band, BandRow bandRow = null)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
				{
					num += GetBandMinWidth(visibleBand);
				}
			}
			else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					if (actualRow != bandRow)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, AutoWidthHelper.CalcColumnsFixedWidth(actualRow.Columns, ViewInfo));
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num += AutoWidthHelper.GetColumnFixedWidth(band, ViewInfo);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double ChangeBandSize(BandBase band, double delta)
		{
			delta = CorrectBandDelta(band, delta);
			if (delta > 0.0)
			{
				IncreaseBandsWidth(new List<BandBase> { band }, delta);
			}
			else
			{
				DecreaseBandsWidth(new List<BandBase> { band }, delta);
			}
			return 0.0 - delta;
		}

		protected void IncreaseBandsWidth(IList bands, double delta)
		{
			IncreaseBandsWidth(bands, delta, CalcUnfixedColumnsCount(bands));
		}

		private void IncreaseBandsWidth(IList bands, double delta, int unfixedColumnsCount)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					IncreaseBandsWidth(band.VisibleBands, delta, unfixedColumnsCount);
				}
				else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					if (!CanBeResized(band))
					{
						continue;
					}
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					BandRow bandRow = GetBandRow(band, useMinWidth: false);
					foreach (ColumnBase column in bandRow.Columns)
					{
						num += GetColumnWidth(column);
						double num3 = GetColumnWidth(column);
						if (!column.FixedWidth)
						{
							num3 = (column.ActualWidth = CalcColumnWidth(column, delta, unfixedColumnsCount));
						}
						num2 += num3;
					}
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
					{
						if (actualRow != bandRow)
						{
							ChangeColumnSize(null, num - num2, actualRow.Columns);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!band.FixedWidth)
				{
					band.ActualWidth = CalcColumnWidth(band, delta, unfixedColumnsCount);
				}
			}
		}

		private double CalcColumnWidth(BaseColumn column, double delta, int unfixedColumnsCount)
		{
			double val = GetColumnWidth(column) + delta / (double)unfixedColumnsCount;
			return Math.Max(val, column.MinWidth);
		}

		protected void DecreaseBandsWidth(IList bands, double delta)
		{
			double num = CalcSizeableWidth(bands);
			if (num != 0.0)
			{
				DecreaseBandsWidth(bands, delta, num);
			}
		}

		private void DecreaseBandsWidth(IList bands, double delta, double sizeableWidth)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					DecreaseBandsWidth(band.VisibleBands, delta, sizeableWidth);
				}
				else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
				{
					double num = 0.0;
					double num2 = 0.0;
					BandRow bandRow = GetBandRow(band, useMinWidth: false);
					foreach (ColumnBase column in bandRow.Columns)
					{
						num += GetColumnWidth(column);
						double num3 = GetColumnWidth(column);
						if (!column.FixedWidth)
						{
							num3 = (column.ActualWidth = CalcColumnWidth(column, delta, sizeableWidth));
						}
						num2 += num3;
					}
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
					{
						if (actualRow != bandRow)
						{
							ChangeColumnSize(null, num - num2, actualRow.Columns);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!band.FixedWidth)
				{
					band.ActualWidth = CalcColumnWidth(band, delta, sizeableWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private double CalcColumnWidth(BaseColumn column, double delta, double sizeableWidth)
		{
			double val = GetColumnWidth(column) + (GetColumnWidth(column) - column.MinWidth) * delta / sizeableWidth;
			return Math.Max(val, column.MinWidth);
		}

		protected double GetColumnHeaderWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return column.ActualHeaderWidth;
		}

		protected double GetColumnWidth(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return GetColumnHeaderWidth(column) - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column);
		}

		protected double RecalcBandLayout(BandBase band, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
			{
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(band, 0.0);
				foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
				{
					layoutAssigner.SetWidth(band, layoutAssigner.GetWidth(band) + RecalcBandLayout(visibleBand, layoutAssigner));
				}
			}
			else if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
			{
				double num = 0.0;
				BandRow bandRow = null;
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(band, 0.0);
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					double num2 = 0.0;
					foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
					{
						num2 += layoutAssigner.GetWidth(column);
					}
					if (!double.IsNaN(num2) && num < num2)
					{
						bandRow = actualRow;
						num = num2;
					}
				}
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(band, num);
				foreach (BandRow actualRow2 in band.ActualRows)
				{
					if (actualRow2 != bandRow)
					{
						AutoWidthHelper.CalcColumnLayout(actualRow2.Columns, num, ViewInfo, layoutAssigner, needRoundingLastColumn: true, allowFixedWidth: false);
					}
				}
			}
			return layoutAssigner.GetWidth(band);
		}

		protected IList GetSizeableColumns(bool useMinWidth)
		{
			return GetSizeableColumns(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, useMinWidth);
		}

		protected IList GetSizeableColumns(IList bands, bool useMinWidth)
		{
			List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				list.AddRange(GetBandColumns(band, useMinWidth));
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected void ResetActualColumnHeaders(IEnumerable bands, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					ResetActualColumnHeaders(band.VisibleBands, layoutAssigner);
				}
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
					{
						layoutAssigner.SetWidth(column, 0.0);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected IEnumerable<BaseColumn> GetBandColumns(BandBase band, bool useMinWidth)
		{
			if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
			{
				List<BaseColumn> list = new List<BaseColumn>();
				{
					foreach (BandBase visibleBand in band.VisibleBands)
					{
						list.AddRange(GetBandColumns(visibleBand, useMinWidth));
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			if (band.ActualRows.Count != 0)
			{
				return GetBandRow(band, useMinWidth).Columns;
			}
			return new BaseColumn[1] { band };
		}

		internal BandRow GetBandRow(BandBase band, bool useMinWidth)
		{
			BandRow result = band.ActualRows[0];
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
			{
				double num2 = 0.0;
				foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
				{
					num2 = ((!useMinWidth) ? (num2 + ViewInfo.GetColumnDataWidth(column)) : (num2 + AutoWidthHelper.GetColumnFixedWidth(column, ViewInfo)));
				}
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					result = actualRow;
					num = num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void UpdateColumnsActualAllowResizing()
		{
			base.UpdateColumnsActualAllowResizing();
			BandsLayout.ForeachBand(delegate(BandBase e)
			{
				e.UpdateActualAllowResizing();
			});
		}

		protected override void CorrectFixedColumnsWidth()
		{
			double num = GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, base.TableViewBehavior.TableView.ShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false) - ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			double num2 = CalcColumnsWidth(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, (BaseColumn band, int index) => band.Fixed == FixedStyle.None);
			double num3 = CalcColumnsWidth(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, (BaseColumn band, int index) => band.Fixed != FixedStyle.None);
			if (num < num2)
			{
				UpdateFixedColumnsWidth(num + (base.TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements ? ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent : 0.0), skipLeft: false);
			}
			if (num > num2 + num3)
			{
				UpdateFixedColumnsWidth(num - num3 - CalcColumnsWidth(BandsLayout.VisibleBands, (BaseColumn band, int index) => band.Fixed != FixedStyle.Left), skipLeft: true);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateFixedColumnsWidth(double arrangeWidth, bool skipLeft)
		{
			List<BandBase> list = new List<BandBase>();
			foreach (BandBase visibleBand in BandsLayout.VisibleBands)
			{
				if (visibleBand.Fixed != FixedStyle.None && (!skipLeft || visibleBand.Fixed != FixedStyle.Left))
				{
					list.Add(visibleBand);
				}
			}
			StretchColumnsToWidth(list, arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner.Default, needRoundingLastColumn: false, allowFixedWidth: false);
		}

		protected void StretchColumnsToWidth(List<BandBase> bands, double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool allowFixedWidth)
		{
			ResetActualColumnHeaders(bands, layoutAssigner);
			AutoWidthHelper.CalcColumnLayout(GetSizeableColumns(bands, useMinWidth: true), arrangeWidth, ViewInfo, layoutAssigner, needRoundingLastColumn, allowFixedWidth);
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				RecalcBandLayout(band, layoutAssigner);
			}
		}

		private double CalcColumnsWidth(IList list, Func<BaseColumn, int, bool> skipColumn, bool useHeaderIndent = false)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)list[i];
				if (!skipColumn(baseColumn, i))
				{
					num += (useHeaderIndent ? GetColumnHeaderWidth(baseColumn) : GetColumnWidth(baseColumn));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}
	}

		}

		public static InlineCollectionInfo GetFixedSummariesTextValues(IList<GridTotalSummaryData> totalSummaryDataList, Style fixedTotalSummaryElementStyle = null)
		{
			SummaryInlineInfoCreator summaryInlineInfoCreator = new SummaryInlineInfoCreator();
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.SeparatorText = GridControlLocalizer.GetString(GridControlStringId.SummaryItemsSeparator);
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.DefaultStyle = fixedTotalSummaryElementStyle;
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetItemDisplayText = (GridSummaryData d) => ColumnBase.GetSummaryText(d, forceShowColumnName: true);
			summaryInlineInfoCreator.GetSummaryStyle = (SummaryItemBase s) => s.FixedTotalSummaryElementStyle;
			return summaryInlineInfoCreator.Create(totalSummaryDataList);
		}

		private static void GenerateCountTotalSummary(SummaryItemBase item, Func<SummaryItemBase, object> getSummaryValue, IList<GridTotalSummaryData> destination)
		{
			object value = getSummaryValue(item);
			destination.Add(new GridTotalSummaryData(item, value, null));
		}

		public static void GenerateTotalSummaries(IList<SummaryItemBase> source, IColumnCollection ColumnsCore, Func<SummaryItemBase, object> getSummaryValue, IList<GridTotalSummaryData> destination)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			destination.Clear();
			foreach (SummaryItemBase item in source)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.FieldName) && (int)item.SummaryType == 3)
				{
					GenerateCountTotalSummary(item, getSummaryValue, destination);
					continue;
				}
				ColumnBase column = ColumnsCore[item.FieldName];
				object value = getSummaryValue(item);
				destination.Add(new GridTotalSummaryData(item, value, column));
			}
		}
	}

	public class LoadingAnimationHelper
	{
		private ISupportLoadingAnimation owner;

		public Storyboard StoryToLoadedState { get; private set; }

		public Timeline CustomAnimation { get; set; }

		public PropertyPath CustomPropertyPath { get; set; }

		public Effect AddedEffect { get; set; }

		public LoadingAnimationHelper(ISupportLoadingAnimation owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public void ApplyAnimation()
		{
			if (!owner.IsReady)
			{
				ApplyNotLoadedAnimation();
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyLoadedAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void ApplyNotLoadedAnimation()
		{
			if (owner.Element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (StoryToLoadedState != null)
			{
				StoryToLoadedState.Stop();
			}
			if (owner.DataView.RowAnimationKind != RowAnimationKind.None)
			{
				if (!FlyoutAnimator.IsZero(owner.DataView.RowOpacityAnimationDuration))
				{
					owner.Element.Opacity = 0.0;
				}
				SetEditorOpacitySyncEnabled(isEnabled: false);
			}
		}

		private void ApplyLoadedAnimation()
		{
			if (owner.Element == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (owner.DataView.RowAnimationKind == RowAnimationKind.None)
			{
				if (StoryToLoadedState != null)
				{
					StoryToLoadedState.Stop();
					StoryToLoadedState.Completed -= OnAnimationCompleted;
					StoryToLoadedState = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			StopAnimation();
			ResetCustomAnimationProperties();
			RaiseRowAnimationBegin();
			RowAnimationKind realAnimationKind = GetRealAnimationKind();
			SetStoryboardTargetProperty(realAnimationKind);
			if (realAnimationKind == RowAnimationKind.Custom)
			{
				owner.Element.Effect = AddedEffect;
			}
			StoryToLoadedState.Children.Add(CreateAnimation(realAnimationKind));
			Storyboard.SetTargetProperty(StoryToLoadedState, CreatePropertyPath(realAnimationKind));
			StoryToLoadedState.Begin();
		}

		private void OnAnimationCompleted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			owner?.Element?.ClearValue(UIElement.OpacityProperty);
			SetEditorOpacitySyncEnabled(isEnabled: true);
		}

		private void SetEditorOpacitySyncEnabled(bool isEnabled)
		{
			if (owner is ISupportSuspendEditorOpacitySync supportSuspendEditorOpacitySync)
			{
				supportSuspendEditorOpacitySync.IsEditorOpacitySyncEnabled = isEnabled;
			}
		}

		private void StopAnimation()
		{
			if (StoryToLoadedState != null)
			{
				StoryToLoadedState.Stop();
				StoryToLoadedState.Children.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				StoryToLoadedState = new Storyboard();
				StoryToLoadedState.Completed += OnAnimationCompleted;
			}
		}

		private void ResetCustomAnimationProperties()
		{
			CustomAnimation = null;
			CustomPropertyPath = null;
			AddedEffect = null;
		}

		private RowAnimationKind GetRealAnimationKind()
		{
			RowAnimationKind rowAnimationKind = owner.DataView.RowAnimationKind;
			if (rowAnimationKind == RowAnimationKind.Custom && (CustomPropertyPath == null || CustomAnimation == null))
			{
				rowAnimationKind = RowAnimationKind.Opacity;
			}
			return rowAnimationKind;
		}

		private void SetStoryboardTargetProperty(RowAnimationKind kind)
		{
			if (kind == RowAnimationKind.Opacity)
			{
				Storyboard.SetTarget(StoryToLoadedState, owner.Element);
			}
			else
			{
				Storyboard.SetTarget(StoryToLoadedState, owner as DependencyObject);
			}
		}

		private Timeline CreateAnimation(RowAnimationKind animationKind)
		{
			return animationKind switch
			{
				RowAnimationKind.Opacity => CreateOpacityAnimation(), 
				RowAnimationKind.Custom => CustomAnimation, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private PropertyPath CreatePropertyPath(RowAnimationKind animationKind)
		{
			return animationKind switch
			{
				RowAnimationKind.Opacity => new PropertyPath("Opacity"), 
				RowAnimationKind.Custom => CustomPropertyPath, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private DoubleAnimation CreateOpacityAnimation()
		{
			DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation();
			doubleAnimation.From = 0.0;
			doubleAnimation.To = owner.EditorOpacity;
			doubleAnimation.FillBehavior = FillBehavior.Stop;
			doubleAnimation.Duration = owner.DataView.RowOpacityAnimationDuration;
			return doubleAnimation;
		}

		private void RaiseRowAnimationBegin()
		{
			if (owner.DataView.RowAnimationKind == RowAnimationKind.Custom)
			{
				owner.DataView.RaiseRowAnimationBegin(this, owner.IsGroupRow);
			}
		}
	}

		FrameworkElement Element { get; }

	public class HorizontalNavigationStrategyBase
	{
		public static readonly HorizontalNavigationStrategyBase NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategyBaseInstance = new HorizontalNavigationStrategyBase();

		protected HorizontalNavigationStrategyBase()
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnInvalidateHorizontalScrolling(DataViewBase view)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnNavigationIndexChanged(DataViewBase view)
		{
		}

		public virtual void MoveNextNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveNextNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual void MoveNextNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearRightNavigationIndex(view.NavigationIndex, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		public virtual void MovePrevNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MovePrevNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual void MovePrevNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearLeftNavigationIndex(view.NavigationIndex, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		public virtual void MoveLastNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual void MoveLastNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNavigationIndex(view.NavigationIndex, int.MaxValue, findMin: false, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		public virtual void MoveFirstNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual void MoveFirstNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNavigationIndex(0, view.NavigationIndex, findMin: true, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject != null)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			}
		}

		internal void MoveFirstNavigationIndexCore(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			int num = FindFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
			if (num != int.MinValue)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = num;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool CanMoveRightOnString(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearLeftNavigationIndex(int.MaxValue, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int navigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			if (!isTabNavigation)
			{
				return view.NavigationIndex != navigationIndex;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex < navigationIndex;
		}

		internal virtual bool CanMoveLeftOnString(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearRightNavigationIndex(int.MaxValue, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int navigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
			if (!isTabNavigation)
			{
				return view.NavigationIndex != navigationIndex;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex > navigationIndex;
		}

		public virtual bool IsBeginNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return IsBeginNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual bool IsBeginNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearRightNavigationIndex(int.MinValue, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex == ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
		}

		public virtual bool IsEndNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return IsEndNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		internal virtual bool IsEndNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = view.FindNearLeftNavigationIndex(int.MaxValue, isTabNavigation);
			if (dependencyObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex == ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(dependencyObject);
		}

		public virtual bool OnBeforeChangePixelScrollOffset(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected int FindNextNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation, int currentIndex)
		{
			for (int i = currentIndex + 1; i < view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				if (view.IsColumnNavigatable(view.VisibleColumnsCore[i], isTabNavigation))
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		protected int FindFirstNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return FindNextNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation, -1);
		}
	}
	public class NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategy : HorizontalNavigationStrategyBase
	{
		public static readonly NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategy NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategyInstance = new NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategy();

		protected NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategy()
		{
		}

		public virtual void MakeCellVisible(TableViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			if (behavior.View.IsUpdateCellDataEnqueued || !behavior.View.RootDataPresenter.IsMeasureValid)
			{
				behavior.View.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction((Action)behavior.MakeCellVisible);
			}
			else
			{
				behavior.MakeCurrentCellVisible();
			}
		}

		public virtual void UpdateFixedNoneCellData(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, TableViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			rowData.UpdateFixedNoneCellData(virtualized: false);
		}

		public virtual void UpdateViewportVisibleColumns(TableViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			behavior.TableView.ViewportVisibleColumns = null;
			behavior.ResetHorizontalVirtualizationOffset();
		}
	}
	public class VirtualizedHorizontalNavigationStrategy : NormalHorizontalNavigationStrategy
	{
		public static readonly VirtualizedHorizontalNavigationStrategy VirtualizedHorizontalNavigationStrategyInstance = new VirtualizedHorizontalNavigationStrategy();

		private VirtualizedHorizontalNavigationStrategy()
		{
		}

		internal override void MoveNextNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.NavigationIndex < 0)
			{
				view.MoveFirstNavigationIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				if (view.NavigationIndex >= view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = FindNextNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation, view.NavigationIndex);
				if (num == int.MinValue)
				{
					int num2 = FindFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
					if (num2 != int.MinValue && view.CanMoveNextRow())
					{
						view.MoveNextRow();
						view.NavigationIndex = num2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					view.NavigationIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void MovePrevNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.NavigationIndex < 0)
			{
				view.MoveFirstNavigationIndex();
			}
			else
			{
				if (view.NavigationIndex <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = FindPrevNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation, view.NavigationIndex);
				if (num == int.MinValue)
				{
					int num2 = FindLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
					if (num2 != int.MinValue && view.CanMovePrevRow())
					{
						view.MovePrevRow();
						view.NavigationIndex = num2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					view.NavigationIndex = num;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void MoveLastNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				base.MoveLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
				return;
			}
			int num = FindLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
			if (num != int.MinValue)
			{
				view.NavigationIndex = num;
			}
		}

		internal override void MoveFirstNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			if (view.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				base.MoveFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFirstNavigationIndexCore(view, isTabNavigation);
			}
		}

		public override void MoveNextNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveNextNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		public override void MovePrevNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MovePrevNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		public override void MoveLastNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		public override void MoveFirstNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			MoveFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation: false);
		}

		private int FindPrevNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation, int currentIndex)
		{
			for (int num = currentIndex - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				if (view.IsColumnNavigatable(view.VisibleColumnsCore[num], isTabNavigation))
				{
					return num;
				}
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		private int FindLastNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return FindPrevNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation, view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count);
		}

		public override void OnNavigationIndexChanged(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.NavigationIndex != int.MinValue)
			{
				((ITableView)view).TableViewBehavior.MakeColumnVisible(view.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
			}
		}

		public override void MakeCellVisible(TableViewBehavior view)
		{
		}

		public override void UpdateFixedNoneCellData(ColumnsRowDataBase rowData, TableViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			rowData.UpdateFixedNoneCellData(virtualized: true);
		}

		public override void UpdateViewportVisibleColumns(TableViewBehavior behavior)
		{
			behavior.UpdateViewportVisibleColumnsCore();
		}

		public override void OnInvalidateHorizontalScrolling(DataViewBase view)
		{
			view.RowsStateDirty = true;
		}

		internal override bool CanMoveLeftOnString(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			int num = FindFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
			if (!isTabNavigation)
			{
				return view.NavigationIndex != num;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex > num;
		}

		internal override bool CanMoveRightOnString(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			int num = FindLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
			if (!isTabNavigation)
			{
				return view.NavigationIndex != num;
			}
			return view.NavigationIndex < num;
		}

		internal override bool IsBeginNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return view.NavigationIndex == FindFirstNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
		}

		internal override bool IsEndNavigationIndex(DataViewBase view, bool isTabNavigation)
		{
			return view.NavigationIndex == FindLastNavigationIndex(view, isTabNavigation);
		}

		public override bool OnBeforeChangePixelScrollOffset(DataViewBase view)
		{
			try
			{
				view.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				return view.RequestUIUpdate();
			}
			finally
			{
				view.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
			}
		}
	}

		internal void OnTopRowIndexChanged()
		{
			if (View.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				lockTopRowIndexUpdate = true;
			}
			else if (View.TopRowIndex != ((IScrollInfoOwner)View.DataPresenter).Offset && isUpdateScrollInfoNeeded)
			{
				lockTopRowIndexUpdate = false;
				OnTopRowIndexChangedCore();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnTopRowIndexChangedCore()
		{
			double scrollIndex = View.DataProviderBase.Return((DataProviderBase x) => x.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(View.TopRowIndex, View.AllowFixedGroupsCore), () => 0);
			View.DataPresenter.Do(delegate(DataPresenterBase x)
			{
				x.SetDefineScrollOffset(scrollIndex);
			});
		}

		internal void UpdateTopRowIndex()
		{
			if (lockTopRowIndexUpdate)
			{
				View.Dispatcher.BeginInvoke((Action)delegate
				{
					OnTopRowIndexChanged();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				isUpdateScrollInfoNeeded = false;
				View.TopRowIndex = ((view.DataProviderBase != null) ? View.DataProviderBase.ConvertScrollIndexToVisibleIndex(View.ScrollInfoOwner.Offset, View.AllowFixedGroupsCore) : 0);
				isUpdateScrollInfoNeeded = true;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCancelRowEdit(bool isModified)
		{
			if (View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
				View.IsFocusedRowModified = rowData?.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged ?? false;
			}
			else
			{
				View.IsFocusedRowModified = false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnFocusedRowCellModified()
		{
			View.IsFocusedRowModified = true;
			if (View.EnableImmediatePosting)
			{
				View.CurrentCellEditor.Do(delegate(InplaceEditorBase x)
				{
					x.PostEditor(false);
				});
				if (View.ValidationError == null && View.CurrentCellEditor != null)
				{
					View.CurrentCellEditor.Edit.IsValueChanged = false;
				}
				if (View.DataControl != null && View.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null)
				{
					View.DataControl.CurrentColumn.UpdateIsChecked();
				}
				if (View.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(View.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore) && View.DataControl.CurrentColumn.FieldName == View.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore)
				{
					DataControl.UpdateGroupRowChecked(View.FocusedRowHandle, View.GroupRowCheckBoxFieldNameCore);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnCurrentCellEditCancelled()
		{
			if (View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				RowData rowData = GetRowData(FocusedRowHandle);
				View.IsFocusedRowModified = rowData?.UpdateRowButtonsWasChanged ?? View.DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing;
			}
			else
			{
				View.IsFocusedRowModified = View.DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing;
			}
		}

		}

		protected internal virtual bool EndRowEdit(bool isModified)
		{
			if (DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool isCurrentRowEditing = View.DataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing;
			bool result = false;
			DataControl.UpdateFocusedRowDataposponedAction.PerformLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				result = View.DataProviderBase.EndCurrentRowEdit();
			});
			if (DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsICollectionView && isCurrentRowEditing && DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController.DataSource is ICollectionViewHelper)
			{
				DataControl.UpdateTotalSummary();
			}
			if (DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource && isCurrentRowEditing)
			{
				DataControl.UpdateTotalSummary();
			}
			View.IsFocusedRowModified = false;
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual void ProcessPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			DataViewBase focusedView = View.FocusedView;
			if (focusedView.SelectionStrategy.ShouldInvertSelectionOnPreviewKeyDown(e))
			{
				focusedView.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					focusedView.SelectionStrategy.OnInvertSelection();
				});
				e.Handled = true;
			}
			if (((ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && e.Key == Key.V) || (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && e.Key == Key.Insert)) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsAltPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && !View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && e.OriginalSource is DependencyObject && LayoutHelper.FindLayoutOrVisualParentObject((DependencyObject)e.OriginalSource, (Predicate<DependencyObject>)((DependencyObject x) => x is InplaceEditorBase), false, (DependencyObject)null) != null)
			{
				bool flag = DataControl.RaisePastingFromClipboard();
				if (!flag)
				{
					flag = View.RaisePastingFromClipboard();
				}
				e.Handled = flag;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRowData(UpdateRowDataDelegate updateMethod, bool updateInvisibleRows = true, bool updateFocusedRow = true)
		{
			RowDataItemsEnumerator rowDataItemsEnumerator = new RowDataItemsEnumerator(View.RootRowsContainer);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)rowDataItemsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				if (updateInvisibleRows || rowDataItemsEnumerator.Current.GetIsVisible())
				{
					updateMethod(rowDataItemsEnumerator.Current);
				}
			}
			if (updateFocusedRow)
			{
				RowData focusedRowData = View.FocusedRowData;
				if (focusedRowData != null)
				{
					updateMethod(focusedRowData);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void UpdateViewRowData(UpdateRowDataDelegate updateMethod)

		{

		}

		protected bool MovePrevRowCore()
		{
			if (View.IsAdditionalRowFocused || !View.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataControl.NavigateToPreviousInnerDetailRow())
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = ((FocusedRowHandle == int.MinValue) ? 1 : CurrentIndex);
			if (IsFirst(num))
			{
				return !View.CommitEditingInternal();
			}
			int index = num - 1;
			View.SetFocusedRowHandle(IndexToHandle(index), NavigationType.Prev);
			return true;
		}

		protected int GetPrevRowHandleCore(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (rowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (-2147483645 == rowHandle)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (!View.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (DataControl.CanNavigateToPreviousInnerDetailRow(rowHandle))
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandle = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle);
			int num = rowHandle;
			if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1)
			{
				while (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1 && rowHandle > 0)
				{
					num--;
					rowVisibleIndexByHandle = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(num);
				}
			}
			if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1)
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			if (num != rowHandle)
			{
				return IndexToHandle(rowVisibleIndexByHandle);
			}
			if (IsFirst(rowVisibleIndexByHandle))
			{
				return int.MinValue;
			}
			int index = rowVisibleIndexByHandle - 1;
			return IndexToHandle(index);
		}

		internal virtual void MoveNextRow()
		{
			MoveNextRowCore();
		}

		internal virtual int GetNextRowHandle(int rowHandle)
		{
			return GetNextRowHandleCore(rowHandle);
		}

		protected bool MoveNextRowCore()
		{
			if (View.IsAdditionalRowFocused || !View.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataControl.NavigateToFirstChildDetailRow())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (View.IsBottomNewItemRowFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = ((FocusedRowHandle == int.MinValue) ? (-1) : CurrentIndex);
			if (IsLast(num))
			{
				View.CommitEditingInternal();
				return false;
			}
			int index = num + 1;
			View.SetFocusedRowHandle(IndexToHandle(index), NavigationType.Next);
			return true;
		}

		protected int GetNextRowHandleCore(int rowHandle)
		{
			switch (rowHandle)
			{
			case int.MinValue:
				return int.MinValue;
			case -2147483645:
				return 0;
			default:
			{
				if (!View.IsFocusedRowInCurrentPageBounds())
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				if (DataControl.CanNavigateToFirstChildDetailRow(rowHandle))
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				if (View.IsBottomNewItemRowFocused)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				int rowVisibleIndexByHandle = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(rowHandle);
				int num = rowHandle;
				if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1)
				{
					while (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1 && rowHandle < DataControl.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount)
					{
						num++;
						rowVisibleIndexByHandle = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(num);
					}
				}
				if (num != rowHandle)
				{
					return IndexToHandle(rowVisibleIndexByHandle);
				}
				if (IsLast(rowVisibleIndexByHandle))
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				if (rowVisibleIndexByHandle == -1)
				{
					return int.MinValue;
				}
				int index = rowVisibleIndexByHandle + 1;
				return IndexToHandle(index);
			}
			}
		}

		private int IndexToHandle(int index)
		{
			return DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(index);
		}

		private bool IsFirst(int index)
		{
			return DataControl.IsFirst(index);
		}

		private bool IsLast(int index)
		{
			return DataControl.IsLast(index);
		}

		protected internal void IterateCells(int startRowHandle, int startColumnIndex, int endRowHandle, int endColumnIndex, Action<int, ColumnBase> action)
		{
			ValidateIndexes(startRowHandle, startColumnIndex, endRowHandle, endColumnIndex, out var startIndex, out var colStart, out var endIndex, out var colEnd);
			for (int i = startIndex; i < endIndex + 1; i++)
			{
				for (int j = colStart; j < colEnd + 1; j++)
				{
					if (j >= 0 && j <= View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1)
					{
						action(DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i), View.VisibleColumnsCore[j]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal void ValidateIndexes(int startRowHandle, int startColumnIndex, int endRowHandle, int endColumnIndex, out int startIndex, out int colStart, out int endIndex, out int colEnd)
		{
			startIndex = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(startRowHandle);
			endIndex = DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(endRowHandle);
			colStart = startColumnIndex;
			colEnd = endColumnIndex;
			if (colStart > colEnd)
			{
				int num = colEnd;
				colEnd = colStart;
				colStart = num;
			}
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				int num2 = endIndex;
				endIndex = startIndex;
				startIndex = num2;
			}
		}

		internal void OnUpdateRowButtonsIsEditingChanged(bool value)
		{
			if (View.FocusedRowHandle >= 0 || View.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647)
			{
				View.GetRowData(View.FocusedRowHandle)?.OnUpdateRowButtonsIsEditingChanged(value);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowRowButtons()
		{
			if (View.FocusedRowHandle < 0 && View.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483647)
			{
				return;
			}
			View.ResetCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute();
			RowData rowData = View.GetRowData(View.FocusedRowHandle);
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				rowData.ShowRowButtons();
				View.LockEditorClose = true;
				View.ScrollIntoViewCore(rowData.RowHandle.Value, useLock: true, delegate
				{
					view.UpdateRowRectangleHelper.UpdatePosition(View);
				});
				View.LockEditorClose = false;
			}
			view.UpdateRowRectangleHelper.UpdatePosition(View);
			view.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
			{
				view.UpdateRowRectangleHelper.UpdatePosition(View);
			});
		}

		internal void HideRowButtons(bool success, RowData rowData = null)
		{
			if (View.FocusedRowHandle >= 0 || View.FocusedRowHandle == -2147483647 || rowData != null || View.FocusedRowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				View.ResetCanUpdateRowCoreValidationAttribute();
				if (rowData == null)
				{
					rowData = View.GetRowData(View.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
				rowData?.HideRowButtons(success);
				view.UpdateRowRectangleHelper.UpdatePosition(View);
				view.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					view.UpdateRowRectangleHelper.UpdatePosition(View);
				});
			}
		}

		internal RowsRange CalcViewPortRowsRange()
		{
			//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int visibleRowCountInViewPort = VisibleRowCountInViewPort;
			int val = Math.Max(0, View.PageVisibleTopRowIndex);
			val = Math.Min(val, View.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount - visibleRowCountInViewPort);
			return new RowsRange(val, visibleRowCountInViewPort);
		}

		}

			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((int)summaryType == 2 || (int)summaryType == 0 || (int)summaryType == 1) && View.DataControl.HasConditionFormatFilters)

			GroupSummaryRows.Clear();

		}

		{
			if (GroupSummaryNodes.TryGetValue(rowHandle, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override void AddGroupSummaryRowNode(int rowHandle, DataRowNode node)
		{
			GroupSummaryNodes[rowHandle] = node;
		}

		internal override DataRowNode GetRowNode(CreateRowNodeDelegate createDelegate, DataControllerValuesContainer controllerValues)
		{
			if (Nodes.TryGetValue(controllerValues.RowHandle.Value, out var value))
			{
				value.Update(controllerValues);
				return value;
			}
			value = createDelegate(controllerValues);
			Nodes.Add(controllerValues.RowHandle.Value, value);
			return value;
		}

		internal override void UpdateCellData(RowData rowData, GridCellData cellData, ColumnBase column)
		{
			base.UpdateCellData(rowData, cellData, column);
			cellData.UpdateFullState(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			if (base.View.NeedCellsWidthUpdateOnScrolling)
			{
				cellData.SyncCellContentPresenterProperties();
			}
			rowData.UpdateCellDataError(column, cellData, rowData.CustomCellValidate);
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowData(RowData rowData)
		{
			rowData.UpdateFullState();
		}

		internal override void UpdateRowDataError(RowData rowData)
		{
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RowValidationError rowStateError = base.View.DataControl.RowStateError;
			if (rowStateError != null && rowData.RowHandleCore.Value == base.View.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				BaseEditHelper.SetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, (BaseValidationError)(object)rowStateError);
				base.View.ValidationError = (BaseValidationError)(object)rowStateError;
				return;
			}
			if (!base.View.HasCellEditorError || base.View.ValidationError != BaseEditHelper.GetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)rowData))
			{
				if (base.View.ItemsSourceErrorInfoShowMode.HasFlag(ItemsSourceErrorInfoShowMode.Row))
				{
					MultiErrorInfo multiErrorInfo = base.View.DataProviderBase.GetMultiErrorInfo(rowData.RowHandle);
					BaseValidationError val = (multiErrorInfo.HasErrors() ? base.View.CreateRowValidationError(multiErrorInfo.ErrorText, multiErrorInfo.Errors, multiErrorInfo.ErrorType, rowData.RowHandle.Value) : null);
					BaseEditHelper.SetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, val);
					if (!base.View.HasCellEditorError)
					{
						base.View.ValidationError = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					BaseEditHelper.SetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)rowData, (BaseValidationError)null);
				}
			}
			rowData.UpdateIndicatorState();
		}

			dataContainer.CreateRowsContainerSyncronizer().Synchronize(nodeContainer);
		}

	public class FreeRowDataInfo
	{
		public RowDataBase RowData { get; set; }

		public RowsContainer DataContainer { get; set; }

		public FreeRowDataInfo(RowsContainer dataContainer, RowDataBase rowData)
		{
			RowData = rowData;

		}

	public class SynchronizationQueues
	{
		private readonly Queue<UnsynchronizedNodeInfo> unsynchronizedNodes = new Queue<UnsynchronizedNodeInfo>();

		private readonly LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> freeRowDataQueue = new LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>();

		private readonly LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> freeGroupRowDataQueue = new LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>();

		private readonly LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> freeGroupSummaryRowDataQueue = new LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>();

		private readonly LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> freeServiceRowDataQueue = new LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>();

		private List<LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>> allFreeQueues;

		public Queue<UnsynchronizedNodeInfo> UnsynchronizedNodes => unsynchronizedNodes;

		public LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> FreeRowDataQueue => freeRowDataQueue;

		public LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> FreeGroupRowDataQueue => freeGroupRowDataQueue;

		public LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> FreeGroupSummaryRowDataQueue => freeGroupSummaryRowDataQueue;

		public LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> FreeServiceRowDataQueue => freeServiceRowDataQueue;

		internal List<LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>> AllFreeQueues
		{
			get
			{
				if (allFreeQueues == null)
				{
					allFreeQueues = new List<LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo>> { FreeRowDataQueue, FreeGroupRowDataQueue, FreeGroupSummaryRowDataQueue, FreeServiceRowDataQueue };
				}
				return allFreeQueues;
			}
		}

		public void ClearFreeRowData()
		{
			foreach (FreeRowDataInfo item in AllFreeQueues.SelectMany((LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> x) => x))
			{
				item.RowData.ClearRow();
			}
		}

		public void SynchronizeUnsynchronizedNodes()
		{
			while (UnsynchronizedNodes.Count > 0)
			{
				UnsynchronizedNodeInfo unsynchronizedNodeInfo = UnsynchronizedNodes.Dequeue();
				RowNode rowNode = unsynchronizedNodeInfo.NodeContainer.Items[unsynchronizedNodeInfo.NodeIndex];
				RowDataBase rowDataBase = null;
				bool forceUpdate = true;
				LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> linkedList = rowNode.GetFreeRowDataQueue(this);
				if (linkedList.Count > 0)
				{
					FreeRowDataInfo value = linkedList.First.Value;
					rowDataBase = value.RowData;
					if (value.DataContainer != unsynchronizedNodeInfo.RowsContainer)
					{
						value.DataContainer.Items.Remove(rowDataBase);
					}
					linkedList.RemoveFirst();
				}
				if (rowDataBase == null)
				{
					rowDataBase = rowNode.CreateRowData();
					forceUpdate = false;
				}
				rowDataBase.SetVisibleIndex(unsynchronizedNodeInfo.NodeIndex);
				rowDataBase.AssignVirtualizedRowData(unsynchronizedNodeInfo.RowsContainer, unsynchronizedNodeInfo.NodeContainer, rowNode, forceUpdate);
				rowDataBase.UpdateFixedRowPosition();
				unsynchronizedNodeInfo.RowsContainer.AddItemSafe(rowDataBase);
			}
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			foreach (LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> allFreeQueue in AllFreeQueues)
			{
				ClearCore(allFreeQueue);
			}
		}

		protected void ClearCore(LinkedList<FreeRowDataInfo> list)
		{
			while (list.Count > 0)
			{
				FreeRowDataInfo value = list.First.Value;
				if (value.RowData != null)
				{
					HierarchyPanel.DetachItem(value.RowData);
				}
				list.RemoveFirst();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AutoWidthHelper
	{
		public static void CalcColumnLayout(IList columns, double width, GridViewInfo viewInfo, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool allowFixedWidth = true)
		{
			double rest = 0.0;
			Action<BaseColumn, int> action = delegate(BaseColumn column, int columnIndex)
			{
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(column, GetRoundedActualColumnWidth(column.HeaderWidth, ref rest, IsLastColumn(needRoundingLastColumn, columns.Count, columnIndex)));
			};
			double desiredColumnsWidth = viewInfo.GetDesiredColumnsWidth(columns);
			double num = CalcColumnsFixedWidth(columns, viewInfo);
			if (desiredColumnsWidth <= num)
			{
				CalcColumnsLayoutForLargeFixedWidth(columns, width, desiredColumnsWidth, viewInfo, allowFixedWidth, action);
			}
			else
			{
				CalcColumnsLayoutForRegularCase(columns, width, desiredColumnsWidth, num, viewInfo, action);
			}
		}

		private static void CalcColumnsLayoutForLargeFixedWidth(IList columns, double width, double totalWidth, GridViewInfo viewInfo, bool allowFixedWidth, Action<BaseColumn, int> setColumnWidth)
		{
			double num = width - totalWidth;
			int unfixedColumnsCount = GetUnfixedColumnsCount(columns);
			num = ((unfixedColumnsCount != 0) ? (num / (double)unfixedColumnsCount) : (allowFixedWidth ? 0.0 : (num / (double)columns.Count)));
			num = Math.Max(0.0, num);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num))
			{
				num = 0.0;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				baseColumn.HeaderWidth = viewInfo.GetColumnHeaderWidth(baseColumn) + ((baseColumn.FixedWidth && allowFixedWidth && unfixedColumnsCount != 0) ? 0.0 : num);
				setColumnWidth(baseColumn, i);
			}
		}

		private static void CalcColumnsLayoutForRegularCase(IList columns, double width, double totalWidth, double fixedWidth, GridViewInfo viewInfo, Action<BaseColumn, int> updateColumnWidth)
		{
			double val = (width - fixedWidth) / (totalWidth - fixedWidth);
			val = Math.Max(0.0, val);
			if (double.IsInfinity(val))
			{
				val = 1.0;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				BaseColumn baseColumn = (BaseColumn)columns[i];
				double columnFixedWidth = GetColumnFixedWidth(baseColumn, viewInfo, baseColumn.FixedWidth);
				baseColumn.HeaderWidth = Math.Max(0.0, viewInfo.GetColumnHeaderWidth(baseColumn) - columnFixedWidth) * val + columnFixedWidth;
				updateColumnWidth(baseColumn, i);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsLastColumn(bool needRoundingLastColumn, int count, int index)
		{
			if (!needRoundingLastColumn)
			{
				return index == count - 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int GetUnfixedColumnsCount(IList columns)
		{
			return columns.Cast<BaseColumn>().Count((BaseColumn x) => !x.FixedWidth);
		}

		public static double CalcColumnsFixedWidth(IEnumerable columns, GridViewInfo viewInfo)
		{
			return columns.Cast<BaseColumn>().Sum((BaseColumn x) => GetColumnFixedWidth(x, viewInfo, x.FixedWidth));
		}

		public static double GetColumnFixedWidth(BaseColumn column, GridViewInfo viewInfo, bool allowFixedWidth = true)
		{
			if (column.FixedWidth && allowFixedWidth)
			{
				return viewInfo.GetDesiredColumnWidth(column);
			}
			return viewInfo.GetColumnFixedWidthCore(column);
		}

		public static double GetRoundedActualColumnWidth(double columnWidth, ref double rest, bool isLastColumn = false)
		{
			double num = DXArranger.Round(columnWidth + rest, 4);
			if (isLastColumn)
			{
				return DXArranger.Floor(num, 4);
			}
			num = DXArranger.Round(num, 0);
			rest += columnWidth - num;
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class AutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator : ColumnsLayoutCalculator
	{
		public override bool AutoWidth => true;

		public AutoWidthColumnsLayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
			: base(viewInfo)
		{
		}

		protected override void CalcActualLayoutCore(double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			AutoWidthHelper.CalcColumnLayout(base.VisibleColumns as IList, arrangeWidth, ViewInfo, layoutAssigner, needRoundingLastColumn);
		}

		protected virtual void ExtractWidth()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				base.ExtWidth[i] = base.VisibleColumns[i].HeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(base.VisibleColumns[i]);
			}
		}

		protected virtual double CalcMaxWidth(int resizeColumn)
		{
			double num = CalcColumnsExtWidth(0) - CalcColumnsExtWidth(0, resizeColumn, skipFixedWidth: false) - CalcColumnsMinWidth(resizeColumn + 1);
			if (Math.Abs(num - base.ExtWidth[resizeColumn]) < 1.0 && resizeColumn < base.VisibleColumns.Count - 1 && base.VisibleColumns[resizeColumn + 1].GetAllowResizing())
			{
				num += base.ExtWidth[resizeColumn + 1] - base.VisibleColumns[resizeColumn + 1].MinWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double CalcColumnsExtWidth(int startColumn)
		{
			return CalcColumnsExtWidth(startColumn, base.ExtWidth.Length - startColumn, skipFixedWidth: false);
		}

		protected virtual double CalcColumnsExtWidth(int startColumn, bool skipFixedWidth)
		{
			return CalcColumnsExtWidth(startColumn, base.ExtWidth.Length - startColumn, skipFixedWidth);
		}

		protected virtual double CalcColumnsExtWidth(int startColumn, int count, bool skipFixedWidth)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = startColumn; i < startColumn + count; i++)
			{
				if (!skipFixedWidth || !base.VisibleColumns[i].FixedWidth)
				{
					num += base.ExtWidth[i];
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double CalcColumnsMinWidth(int startColumn)
		{
			return CalcColumnsMinWidth(startColumn, base.VisibleColumns.Count - startColumn);
		}

		protected virtual double CalcColumnsMinWidth(int startColumn, int count)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = startColumn; i < startColumn + count; i++)
			{
				num += (base.VisibleColumns[i].FixedWidth ? base.ExtWidth[i] : base.VisibleColumns[i].MinWidth);
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override double CalcColumnMaxWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			ExtractWidth();
			return CalcMaxWidth(GetVisibleIndex(column));
		}

		protected virtual int CalcNonFixedWidthColumnCount(int startIndex, int columnCount)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				if (!base.VisibleColumns[i].FixedWidth)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual double GetDeltaWidth(int incStartIndex, double totalIncValue, int columnCount)
		{
			int num = CalcNonFixedWidthColumnCount(incStartIndex, columnCount);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return totalIncValue / (double)num;
		}

		protected virtual void IncreaseWidths(int incStartIndex, double totalIncValue, int columnCount)
		{
			if (incStartIndex >= columnCount)
			{
				return;
			}
			double deltaWidth = GetDeltaWidth(incStartIndex, totalIncValue, columnCount);
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = incStartIndex; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				if (!base.VisibleColumns[i].FixedWidth)
				{
					num += deltaWidth;
					base.ExtWidth[i] += deltaWidth;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0.0 && base.VisibleColumns[incStartIndex].GetAllowResizing())
			{
				base.ExtWidth[incStartIndex] += totalIncValue;
			}
		}

		protected virtual double GetColumnSizeableWidth(int columnIndex)
		{
			if (base.VisibleColumns[columnIndex].FixedWidth)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Max(0.0, base.ExtWidth[columnIndex] - base.VisibleColumns[columnIndex].MinWidth);
		}

		protected virtual double DecreaseWidth(int columnIndex, double delta)
		{
			double columnSizeableWidth = GetColumnSizeableWidth(columnIndex);
			if (columnSizeableWidth == 0.0)
			{
				return delta;
			}
			delta = Math.Min(columnSizeableWidth, delta);
			base.ExtWidth[columnIndex] -= delta;
			return delta;
		}

		protected virtual double CalcTotalColumnsSizeableWidth(int startIndex, int columnCount)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = startIndex; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				num += GetColumnSizeableWidth(i);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected virtual void DecreaseWidths(int decStartIndex, double totalDecValue, int columnCount)
		{
			if (decStartIndex < columnCount)
			{
				double num = CalcTotalColumnsSizeableWidth(decStartIndex, columnCount);
				if (num < totalDecValue && base.VisibleColumns[decStartIndex].GetAllowResizing())
				{
					base.ExtWidth[decStartIndex] = Math.Max(base.VisibleColumns[decStartIndex].MinWidth, base.ExtWidth[decStartIndex] - totalDecValue);
				}
				for (int i = decStartIndex; i < columnCount; i++)
				{
					DecreaseWidth(i, GetColumnSizeableWidth(i) / num * totalDecValue);
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateWidths(int columnsIndex, double delta)
		{
			if (columnsIndex == base.VisibleColumns.Count - 1)
			{
				if (delta < 0.0)
				{
					IncreaseWidths(0, 0.0 - delta, base.VisibleColumns.Count - 1);
				}
				else
				{
					DecreaseWidths(0, delta, base.VisibleColumns.Count - 1);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num = columnsIndex + 1;
			if (delta < 0.0)
			{
				IncreaseWidths(num, 0.0 - delta, base.VisibleColumns.Count);
			}
			else
			{
				DecreaseWidths(num, delta, base.VisibleColumns.Count);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColumnsWidthFromExtWidth()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				base.VisibleColumns[i].ActualWidth = base.ExtWidth[i];
			}
		}

		protected override void ApplyResizeCore(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			ExtractWidth();
			newWidth = Math.Max(resizeColumn.MinWidth, newWidth - indentWidth);
			newWidth = Math.Min(maxWidth, newWidth);
			bool flag = resizeColumn.Visible && ViewInfo.GridView.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(resizeColumn);
			if (correctWidths && flag)
			{
				int visibleIndex = GetVisibleIndex(resizeColumn);
				UpdateWidths(visibleIndex, newWidth - base.ExtWidth[visibleIndex]);
				base.ExtWidth[visibleIndex] = newWidth;
				UpdateColumnsWidthFromExtWidth();
			}
			else
			{
				resizeColumn.ActualWidth = newWidth;
			}
			if (!base.TableViewBehavior.BestFitLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				UpdateColumnsActualAllowResizing();
			}
		}
	}

	}
	internal class AutoFilterRowHeaderButtonPlacementConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode autoFilterRowClearButtonMode))
			{
				return parameter;
			}
			if (autoFilterRowClearButtonMode != AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode.Edit && autoFilterRowClearButtonMode != AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode.Always)
			{
				return parameter;
			}
			return (object)(EditorPlacement)0;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
	internal class AutoFilterRowButtonPlacementConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Length != 2 || !(values[0] is AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode) || !(values[1] is bool))
			{
				return parameter;
			}
			AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode autoFilterRowClearButtonMode = (AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode)values[0];
			bool flag = (bool)values[1];
			if (autoFilterRowClearButtonMode == AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode.Always)
			{
				return (object)(EditorPlacement)0;
			}
			if (flag && autoFilterRowClearButtonMode == AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode.Edit)
			{
				return (object)(EditorPlacement)0;
			}
			if (!flag && autoFilterRowClearButtonMode == AutoFilterRowClearButtonMode.Display)
			{
				return (object)(EditorPlacement)0;
			}
			return parameter;
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}
	}
