	public class ColumnsLayoutCalculator
	{
		private GridViewInfo viewInfo;

		private double[] extWidth;

		protected double[] ExtWidth
		{
			get
			{
				if (extWidth == null && VisibleColumns.Count > 0)
				{
					extWidth = new double[VisibleColumns.Count];
				}
				return extWidth;
			}
		}

		protected virtual GridViewInfo ViewInfo => viewInfo;

		protected TableViewBehavior TableViewBehavior => ViewInfo.TableView.TableViewBehavior;

		protected IList<ColumnBase> VisibleColumns => ViewInfo.VisibleColumns;

		public virtual bool AutoWidth => false;

		private double AvailableWidth => Math.Min(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize.Width, ViewInfo.GridView.MaxAvailableWidth);

		protected internal virtual bool SupportStarColumns => false;

		public ColumnsLayoutCalculator(GridViewInfo viewInfo)
		{
			this.viewInfo = viewInfo;
		}

		internal void ResetBestFitBandWidth(BandBase band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			band.ActualWidth = double.NaN;
			foreach (BandBase item in band.BandsCore)
			{
				ResetBestFitBandWidth(item);
			}
		}

		public void CalcActualLayout(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds)
		{
			CalcActualLayout(arrangeBounds, LayoutAssigner.Default, TableViewBehavior.TableView.ActualShowIndicator, needRoundingLastColumn: false, ignoreDetailButtons: false);
		}

		public void CalcActualLayout(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			if (!ViewInfo.GridView.IsLockUpdateColumnsLayout)
			{
				double arrangeWidth = GetArrangeWidth(arrangeBounds, layoutAssigner, showIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons);
				CalcActualLayoutCore(arrangeWidth, layoutAssigner, showIndicator, needRoundingLastColumn, ignoreDetailButtons);
				layoutAssigner.CreateLayout(this);
				UpdateAdditionalRowDataWidth();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateAdditionalRowDataWidth()
		{
			if (ViewInfo.GridView.IsTreeView)
			{
				if (VisibleColumns.Count == 1)
				{
					VisibleColumns[0].ActualAdditionalRowDataWidth = ViewInfo.TableView.FixedNoneContentWidth - ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					VisibleColumns[i].ActualAdditionalRowDataWidth = VisibleColumns[i].ActualHeaderWidth - ((!ViewInfo.TableView.ShowIndicator && i == 0) ? ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent : 0.0);
				}
			}
		}

		private double CorrectNewWidth(BaseColumn column, double width)
		{
			if (!TableViewBehavior.BestFitLocker.IsLocked && column.Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				double num = CalcTotalFixedWidth();
				double num2 = CalcHorizontalViewPort();
				double num3 = num + width - column.ActualHeaderWidth;
				for (int i = 0; i < VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					if (VisibleColumns[i].Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
					{
						VisibleColumns[i].ActualWidth = VisibleColumns[i].ActualHeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(VisibleColumns[i]);
					}
				}
				if (num3 > num2 && num2 > 0.0)
				{
					width = num2 - num + column.ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
			}
			return width;
		}

		private double CalcTotalFixedWidth()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				if (VisibleColumns[i].Fixed != FixedStyle.None)
				{
					num += VisibleColumns[i].ActualHeaderWidth - ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(VisibleColumns[i]);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcAutoWidthHorizontalViewPort()
		{
			bool flag = VisibleColumns.Where((ColumnBase c) => c.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left).ToList().Count > 0;
			bool flag2 = VisibleColumns.Where((ColumnBase c) => c.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right).ToList().Count > 0;
			bool flag3 = flag || flag2;
			double num = 0.0;
			if (viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.IndicatorHeaderWidth;
			}
			if (!viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator && !flag && flag2)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
			}
			if (!viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons && !flag && flag2)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			}
			if (viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons && flag3)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			}
			if (viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidth;
			}
			return CorrectValueOnFixedLineWidth(AvailableWidth - num - 1.0);
		}

		protected double CalcHorizontalViewPort()
		{
			double num = ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent + ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			if (viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.IndicatorWidth;
			}
			if (viewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidth;
			}
			return CorrectValueOnFixedLineWidth(AvailableWidth - num - 1.0);
		}

		protected virtual void CorrectFixedColumnsWidth()
		{
			double num = CalcTotalFixedWidth();
			double num2 = CalcHorizontalViewPort();
			if (num2 < num && num2 > 0.0)
			{
				List<ColumnBase> columns = VisibleColumns.Where((ColumnBase c) => c.Fixed != FixedStyle.None).ToList();
				AutoWidthHelper.CalcColumnLayout(columns, CalcAutoWidthHorizontalViewPort(), viewInfo, LayoutAssigner.Default, needRoundingLastColumn: false);
			}
		}

		private double CorrectValueOnFixedLineWidth(double value)
		{
			if (TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements)
			{
				value -= DXArranger.Round(ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLineWidth, 0);
			}
			if (TableViewBehavior.HasFixedRightElements)
			{
				value -= DXArranger.Round(ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLineWidth, 0);
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected internal virtual void CreateLayout()
		{
			CorrectFixedColumnsWidth();
			double totalFixedNoneSize = 0.0;
			double totalFixedLeftSize = 0.0;
			double totalFixedRightSize = 0.0;
			UpdateColumnDataWidths(out totalFixedNoneSize, out totalFixedLeftSize, out totalFixedRightSize);
			double num = ((ViewInfo.GridView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? 0.0 : ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent) + totalFixedLeftSize;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = 0.0;
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.ActualAllowTreeIndentScrolling)
			{
				num3 = num;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = num;
			}
			double num4 = ViewInfo.RightGroupAreaIndent + totalFixedRightSize;
			double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, CorrectValueOnFixedLineWidth(AvailableWidth - num2 - num4));
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
			{
				num5 -= ViewInfo.TableView.IndicatorWidth;
			}
			num5 = Math.Max(num5, 1.0);
			num5 = CorrectDetailExpandButtonAndVerticalScrollBarWidth(num5);
			if (double.IsInfinity(num5))
			{
				num5 = totalFixedNoneSize;
			}
			TableViewBehavior.HorizontalExtent = totalFixedNoneSize + num3;
			TableViewBehavior.LeftIndent = num;
			TableViewBehavior.RightIndent = num4;
			TableViewBehavior.TableView.SetHorizontalViewport(num5);
			ViewInfo.GridView.AdditionalElementWidth = Math.Max(0.0, ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize.Width - ViewInfo.GridView.ActualColumnsWidth - ViewInfo.GridView.AdditionalElementOffset);
			ViewInfo.TableView.IndicatorHeaderWidth = ViewInfo.TableView.IndicatorWidth + ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
			double num6 = (ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons ? ViewInfo.TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidth : 0.0);
			num6 += TableViewBehavior.ActualFixRowButtonWidth;
			if (num6 > 0.0)
			{
				num6 += ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			}
			ViewInfo.TableView.SetActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth(num6);
			double num7 = Math.Min(num5, totalFixedNoneSize + num3);
			if (totalFixedLeftSize == 0.0)
			{
				num7 += num2;
				if (ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailHeader)
				{
					num7 -= ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
				}
				if (!ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
				{
					num7 += ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
				}
			}
			if (totalFixedRightSize == 0.0)
			{
				num7 += TableViewBehavior.RightIndent;
			}
			ViewInfo.TableView.FixedNoneContentWidth = num7;
			bool flag = TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements && ViewInfo.GridView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.FixedLeft;
			ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLeftContentWidth = Math.Max(0.0, totalFixedLeftSize + (flag ? ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent : 0.0));
			ViewInfo.TableView.FixedRightContentWidth = Math.Max(0.0, totalFixedRightSize);
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.ViewBase.GetIsCompactMode())
			{
				ViewInfo.TableView.ViewBase.UpdateRowData(delegate(RowData x)
				{
					x.UpdateClientFixedNoneContentWidth();
				});
			}
			ViewInfo.TableView.TotalGroupAreaIndent = ((flag || ViewInfo.GridView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? 0.0 : ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent);
			ViewInfo.TableView.TotalSummaryFixedNoneContentWidth = GetTotalSummaryFixedNoneContentWidth();
			ViewInfo.TableView.VerticalScrollBarWidth = ViewInfo.VerticalScrollBarWidth;
			UpdateColumnsActualAllowResizing();
			FillByLastFixedColumn();
		}

		protected virtual void FillByLastFixedColumn()
		{
			TableViewBehavior.FillByLastFixedColumn(GetArrangeWidth(ViewInfo.ColumnsLayoutSize, LayoutAssigner.Default, TableViewBehavior.TableView.ShowIndicator, ignoreDetailButtons: false));
		}

		private double GetTotalSummaryFixedNoneContentWidth()
		{
			double num = ViewInfo.TableView.FixedNoneContentWidth;
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLeftContentWidth != 0.0 && ViewInfo.TableView.FixedRightContentWidth != 0.0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.ViewBase.IsRootView && ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.ActualIndicatorWidth;
			}
			num += ViewInfo.TableView.ActualExpandDetailHeaderWidth;
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.FixedRightContentWidth != 0.0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return num + ViewInfo.VerticalScrollBarWidth;
		}

		private void UpdateColumnDataWidths(out double totalFixedNoneSize, out double totalFixedLeftSize, out double totalFixedRightSize)
		{
			totalFixedNoneSize = 0.0;
			totalFixedLeftSize = 0.0;
			totalFixedRightSize = 0.0;
			for (int i = 0; i < VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				VisibleColumns[i].ActualDataWidth = VisibleColumns[i].ActualHeaderWidth - GetHeaderIndentsWidth(VisibleColumns[i]);
			}
			TableViewBehavior.UpdateColumnDataWidths(out totalFixedNoneSize, out totalFixedLeftSize, out totalFixedRightSize);
		}

		private double GetHeaderIndentsWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (ViewInfo.GridView.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl)
			{
				if (ViewInfo.TableView.TableViewBehavior.IsFirstColumn(column, ViewInfo.IsPrinting))
				{
					return ViewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent;
				}
				return 0.0;
			}
			return ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(column);
		}

		protected double CorrectDetailExpandButtonAndVerticalScrollBarWidth(double value)
		{
			double num = ViewInfo.TableView.TableViewBehavior.GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: false, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: false) + ViewInfo.TableView.TableViewBehavior.GetTotalRightIndent();
			return Math.Max(0.0, value - num);
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateHasLeftRightSibling(IList<ColumnBase> columns)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				columns[i].HasRightSibling = i < columns.Count - 1;
				columns[i].HasLeftSibling = i != 0;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateColumnsActualAllowResizing()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < VisibleColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				VisibleColumns[i].UpdateActualAllowResizing();
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CalcActualLayoutCore(double arrangeWidth, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool needRoundingLastColumn, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			SetActualColumnWidth(VisibleColumns, layoutAssigner);
		}

		protected void SetActualColumnWidth(IEnumerable columns, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner)
		{
			double rest = 0.0;
			foreach (BaseColumn column in columns)
			{
				layoutAssigner.SetWidth(column, AutoWidthHelper.GetRoundedActualColumnWidth(ViewInfo.GetColumnHeaderWidth(column), ref rest));
			}
		}

		protected virtual double GetArrangeWidth(System.Windows.Size arrangeBounds, LayoutAssigner layoutAssigner, bool showIndicator, bool ignoreDetailButtons)
		{
			double num = Math.Min(arrangeBounds.Width - ViewInfo.RightGroupAreaIndent, layoutAssigner.GetMaxAvailableWidth(ViewInfo.GridView));
			if (showIndicator)
			{
				num -= ViewInfo.TableView.ActualIndicatorWidth;
			}
			if (TableViewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements && layoutAssigner.UseFixedColumnIndents)
			{
				num -= ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			if (TableViewBehavior.HasFixedRightElements && layoutAssigner.UseFixedColumnIndents)
			{
				num -= ViewInfo.TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			if (layoutAssigner.UseDetailButtonsIndents)
			{
				num = CorrectDetailExpandButtonAndVerticalScrollBarWidth(num);
			}
			if (ViewInfo.TableView.ActualShowDetailHeader && num >= ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent && !ignoreDetailButtons)
			{
				num -= ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			}
			if (!ViewInfo.TableView.ShowIndicator && layoutAssigner.UseDataAreaIndent)
			{
				num += ViewInfo.TableView.LeftDataAreaIndent;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected int GetVisibleIndex(BaseColumn column)
		{
			return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)column);
		}

		public void ApplyResize(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth)
		{
			int visibleIndex = GetVisibleIndex(resizeColumn);
			ApplyResize(resizeColumn, newWidth, maxWidth, ViewInfo.GetHeaderIndentsWidth(resizeColumn));
		}

		public void ApplyResize(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth)
		{
			ApplyResize(resizeColumn, newWidth, maxWidth, indentWidth, correctWidths: true);
		}

		public virtual void ApplyResize(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(newWidth))
			{
				SetDefaultWidths();
			}
			else if (resizeColumn.GetAllowResizing() || resizeColumn.Width.IsAuto)
			{
				ViewInfo.GridView.UpdateAllDependentViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
				});
				ApplyResizeCore(resizeColumn, newWidth, maxWidth, indentWidth, correctWidths, autoBestFit);
				ViewInfo.GridView.UpdateAllDependentViews(delegate(DataViewBase view)
				{
					view.EndUpdateColumnsLayout(calcLayout: false);
				});
				((IColumnOwnerBase)ViewInfo.GridView).CalcColumnsLayout();
			}
		}

		public virtual void ApplyBestFit(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			ApplyResize(resizeColumn, newWidth, double.MaxValue, 0.0, correctWidths, autoBestFit);
		}

		protected virtual void ApplyResizeCore(BaseColumn resizeColumn, double newWidth, double maxWidth, double indentWidth, bool correctWidths, bool autoBestFit = false)
		{
			newWidth = CorrectNewWidth(resizeColumn, newWidth);
			resizeColumn.ActualWidth = Math.Max(0.0, newWidth - indentWidth);
		}

		public virtual double CalcColumnMaxWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return double.MaxValue;
		}

		protected virtual void SetDefaultWidths()
		{
			foreach (ColumnBase visibleColumn in VisibleColumns)
			{
				visibleColumn.ActualWidth = visibleColumn.Width.Value;
			}
			ViewInfo.GridView.UpdateColumnsPositions();
		}

		internal void VisibleColumnsChanged()
		{
			if (VisibleColumns != null && extWidth != null && VisibleColumns.Count != extWidth.Length)
			{
				extWidth = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ColumnHeaderDropTargetBase : HeaderDropTargetBase
	{
		protected class ColumnHeaderHitTestResult : HeaderHitTestResult
		{
			protected override DropPlace GetDropPlace(DependencyObject visualHit)
			{
				return (DropPlace)0;
			}

			protected override DependencyObject GetGridColumn(DependencyObject visualHit)
			{
				FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<BaseGridHeader>(visualHit);
				if (frameworkElement != null)
				{
					return (DependencyObject)(object)BaseGridHeader.GetGridColumn(frameworkElement);
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected virtual DataViewBase GridView => DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel);

		protected DataControlBase Grid
		{
			get
			{
				if (GridView != null)
				{
					return GridView.DataControl;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		protected override FrameworkElement GridElement => Grid;

		protected override FrameworkElement DragIndicatorTemplateSource => GridView;

		protected bool UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes => GridView.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes;

		private HeaderPresenterType HeaderPresenterType => BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromLocalValue(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).AdornableElement);

		protected override string DragIndicatorTemplatePropertyName => "ColumnHeaderDragIndicatorTemplate";

		protected override string HeaderButtonTemplateName => "PART_LayoutPanel";

		public ColumnHeaderDropTargetBase(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected abstract bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType);

		protected abstract bool DenyDropIfGroupingIsNotAllowed(HeaderPresenterType sourceType);

		private ColumnBase GetColumnByDragElement(UIElement element)
		{
			return BaseGridColumnHeader.GetColumnByDragElement(element);
		}

		protected IList<ColumnBase> GetVisibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, UIElement element)
		{
			ColumnBase columnByDragElement = GetColumnByDragElement(element);
			if (columnByDragElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnByDragElement.Fixed switch
			{
				FixedStyle.None => viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns, 
				FixedStyle.Left => viewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns, 
				_ => viewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns, 
			};
		}

		private HeaderPresenterType GetColumnPresenterTypeByDragElement(UIElement element)
		{
			return BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(element);
		}

		protected virtual bool ContainsColumn(FrameworkElement element, ColumnBase column)
		{
			return element.DataContext == column;
		}

		protected sealed override bool CanDrop(UIElement source, int dropIndex)
		{
			if (dropIndex < 0 || Grid.ColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ColumnBase columnBase = DropTargetHelper.GetColumnFromDragSource(source) as ColumnBase;
			if (!columnBase.CanBeGroupedByDataControlOwner() && DenyDropIfGroupingIsNotAllowed(BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(source)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader = BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(source);
			if (Grid.DataView.AllowPartialGroupingCore && columnBase.GroupIndexCore != -1 && headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader == HeaderPresenterType.Headers)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return CanDropCore(dropIndex, columnBase, headerPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader);
		}

		protected override HeaderHitTestResult CreateHitTestResult()
		{
			return (HeaderHitTestResult)(object)new ColumnHeaderHitTestResult();
		}

		protected override Orientation GetDropPlaceOrientation(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return BaseGridHeader.GetDropPlaceOrientation(element);
		}

		protected override int GetRelativeVisibleIndex(UIElement element)
		{
			if (Grid.DataView.ColumnsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			ColumnBase dependentColumnFromDragSource = GetDependentColumnFromDragSource(element);
			return GetVisibleIndex(dependentColumnFromDragSource);
		}

		protected override int GetVisibleIndex(DependencyObject obj, bool useVisibleIndexCorrection)
		{
			if (UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex(obj) - ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			if (!useVisibleIndexCorrection)
			{
				return BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex(obj);
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetActualCollectionIndex(obj);
		}

		protected virtual int GetVisibleIndex(ColumnBase column)
		{
			return IndexOfColumnInChildrenCollection(column);
		}

		protected override bool GetIsFarCorner(HeaderHitTestResult result, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!(result.HeaderElement is FrameworkElement frameworkElement))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)frameworkElement, (UIElement)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel);
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetDropPlaceOrientation((DependencyObject)frameworkElement) == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				return ((FrameworkElement)result.HeaderElement).ActualWidth / 2.0 < point.X - relativeElementRect.X;
			}
			return ((FrameworkElement)result.HeaderElement).ActualHeight / 2.0 < point.Y - relativeElementRect.Y;
		}

		private int IndexOfColumnInChildrenCollection(ColumnBase column)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children.Count; i++)
			{
				if (ContainsColumn((FrameworkElement)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children[i], column))
				{
					if (!UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
					{
						return ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)column, true);
					}
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override bool IsSameSource(UIElement element)
		{
			return HeaderPresenterType == BaseGridColumnHeader.GetHeaderPresenterTypeFromGridColumnHeader(element);
		}

		protected ColumnBase GetDependentColumnFromDragSource(UIElement source)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = DropTargetHelper.GetColumnFromDragSource(source) as ColumnBase;
			return CloneDetailHelper.SafeGetDependentCollectionItem<ColumnBase>(columnBase, (ISupportGetCachedIndex<ColumnBase>)columnBase.View.ColumnsCore, GetColumnsCollection(columnBase));
		}

		protected virtual IList GetColumnsCollection(ColumnBase sourceColumn)
		{
			return Grid.ColumnsCore;
		}

		protected void MoveColumnToGroupMerge(UIElement source, int dropIndex, MergeGroupPosition mergeGroupPosition)
		{
			if (UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				dropIndex += ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			GetViewForDrop(source).MoveColumnTo(GetDependentColumnFromDragSource(source), dropIndex, GetColumnPresenterTypeByDragElement(source), HeaderPresenterType, mergeGroupPosition);
		}

		protected virtual DataViewBase GetViewForDrop(UIElement source)
		{
			return GridView;
		}

		protected override void MoveColumnTo(UIElement source, int dropIndex)
		{
			MoveColumnToGroupMerge(source, dropIndex, MergeGroupPosition.None);
		}

		protected override void SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize(DependencyObject element, double value)
		{
			DataViewBase.SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize(element, value);
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!BaseGridColumnHeader.GetCorrectDragIndicatorLocation(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel))
			{
				return ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(point);
			}
			return GridView.CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel, point);
		}

		protected override void SetDropPlaceOrientation(DependencyObject element, Orientation value)
		{
			BaseGridHeader.SetDropPlaceOrientation(element, value);
		}
	}
	public abstract class DropTargetBase : ColumnHeaderDropTargetBase
	{
		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => 0;

		public DropTargetBase(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool DenyDropIfGroupingIsNotAllowed(HeaderPresenterType sourceType)
		{
			return sourceType == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel;
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)

			return true;
		}

		protected override bool ContainsColumn(FrameworkElement element, ColumnBase column)
		{

		}
	}
	public class DropTarget : DropTargetBase
	{
		public DropTarget(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetDragIndex(int dropIndex, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetDragIndex(dropIndex, pt);
			}
			return GetDragIndexCore(dropIndex, pt);
		}

		protected int GetDragIndexCore(int dropIndex, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int num = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetChildHeaderIndexByPoint(pt, true, ref flag);
			if (flag)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num - GetFirstActualCollectionIndex();
		}

		protected virtual int GetFirstActualCollectionIndex()
		{
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FixedDropTarget : DropTarget
	{
		protected ITableView TableView => (ITableView)GridView;

		protected override IList Children => (IList)((OrderPanelBase)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel).GetSortedChildren();

		protected int FixedNoneColumnsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
				{
					return TableView.TableViewBehavior.GetFixedNoneColumnsCount();
				}
				return FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount;
			}
		}

		protected int FixedLeftColumnsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
				{
					return TableView.TableViewBehavior.GetFixedLeftColumnsCount();
				}
				return FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount;
			}
		}

		protected int FixedRightColumnsCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
				{
					return TableView.TableViewBehavior.GetFixedRightColumnsCount();
				}
				return FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount;
			}
		}

		protected int FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount => TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns.Count;

		protected int FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount => TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count;

		protected int FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount => TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count;

		protected FixedDropTarget(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected bool WouldBeFirstFixedNoneColumn(ColumnBase sourceColumn)
		{
			if (sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected int GetFirstVisibleIndex()
		{
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)GetColumn((FrameworkElement)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children[0]));
		}

		protected int GetFirstActualVisibleIndex()
		{
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)GetColumn((FrameworkElement)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children[0]));
		}

		protected override int GetFirstActualCollectionIndex()
		{
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children.Count <= 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetActualCollectionIndex((DependencyObject)(object)GetColumn((FrameworkElement)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Children[0]));
		}

		private ColumnBase GetColumn(FrameworkElement element)
		{
			return element.DataContext as ColumnBase;
		}
	}
	public abstract class FixedDropTargetEx : FixedDropTarget
	{
		protected FixedDropTargetEx(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected sealed override int GetDropIndexFromDragSource(UIElement element, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			int dropIndexFromDragSource = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetDropIndexFromDragSource(element, pt);
			dropIndexFromDragSource = CorrectDropIndex(dropIndexFromDragSource);
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes || dropIndexFromDragSource == -1)
			{
				return dropIndexFromDragSource;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> columnsList = GetColumnsList();
			if (dropIndexFromDragSource >= columnsList.Count)
			{
				ColumnBase obj = columnsList[columnsList.Count - 1];
				return GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)obj) + 1;
			}
			return GetVisibleIndex((DependencyObject)(object)columnsList[dropIndexFromDragSource]);
		}

		protected abstract int CorrectDropIndex(int dropIndex);

		protected override int GetVisibleIndex(DependencyObject obj, bool useVisibleIndexCorrection)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex(obj) - ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetActualCollectionIndex(obj);
		}

		private int GetVisibleIndex(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return BaseColumn.GetActualVisibleIndex(obj) - ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			return BaseColumn.GetVisibleIndex(obj);
		}

		protected abstract IList<ColumnBase> GetColumnsList();
	}
	public class FixedLeftDropTarget : FixedDropTargetEx
	{
		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => 0;

		public FixedLeftDropTarget(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (!WouldBeFirstFixedNoneColumn(sourceColumn) && (sourceColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.Right || base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount != 0 || base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount != 0))
			{
				return sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override int CorrectDropIndex(int dropIndex)
		{
			if (base.TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible && dropIndex == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return dropIndex;
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> GetColumnsList()
		{
			return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns;
		}
	}
	public class BandedViewBandHeadersDropTarget : BandedViewColumnHeadersDropTarget
	{
		protected override bool ShouldCalcOffsetForOtherColumns => false;

		public BandedViewBandHeadersDropTarget(Panel panel, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
			: base(panel, fixedStyle)
		{
		}

		protected override bool DenyDropToAnotherParent(BaseColumn column, BaseColumn target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (!IsSameRow(column, target, moveFrom))
			{
				return !DesignerHelper.GetValue((DependencyObject)(object)column, column.AllowChangeParent, designerValue: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsSameRow(BaseColumn column, BaseColumn target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (column is BandBase)
			{
				return AreSameBandsOwners(((BandBase)column).Owner, ((BandBase)target).Owner);
			}
			if (!base.Grid.DataView.IsColumnVisibleInHeaders(column) || !column.Visible || moveFrom == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel)
			{
				return AreSameColumns(column.ParentBandInternal, target.ParentBandInternal);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool AreSameBandsOwners(IBandsOwner source, IBandsOwner target)
		{
			IBandsOwner bandsOwner = source;
			if (source.DataControl.IsOriginationDataControl())
			{
				bandsOwner = source.FindClone(base.Grid);
			}
			return bandsOwner == target;
		}

		protected override bool DropToTopBottomEdges(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader target, System.Windows.Point point, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, out BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace)
		{
			if (sourceColumn.ParentBandInternal != sourceColumn)
			{
				if (((BandBase)target.BaseColumn).VisibleBands.Count == 0 && base.Grid.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandMultiRow)
				{
					dropPlace = ((((BandBase)target.BaseColumn).ActualRows.Count == 0) ? BandedViewDropPlace.Left : BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom);
				}
				else
				{
					dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.None;
				}
				return true;
			}
			dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.None;
			if (point.Y > target.ActualHeight - 4.0)
			{
				BandsLayoutBase bandsLayoutCore = GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore;
				if (!DesignerHelper.GetValue((DependencyObject)(object)bandsLayoutCore, bandsLayoutCore.AllowChangeBandParent, designerValue: true) || sourceColumn == target.BaseColumn)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (base.Grid.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandMultiRow)
				{
					dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void MoveBandColumn(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader targetHeader, System.Windows.Point point, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace = GetDropPlace(sourceColumn, targetHeader, GetLocation(targetHeader, point), moveFrom);
			if (sourceColumn is BandBase source)
			{
				GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveBandTo(source, (BandBase)targetHeader.BaseColumn, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
			else
			{
				GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveColumnTo(sourceColumn, (BandBase)targetHeader.BaseColumn, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point GetAdornerLocationOffset(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader header, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace)
		{
			if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Left && !sourceColumn.IsBand)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(0.0, header.ActualHeight);
			}
			return base.GetAdornerLocationOffset(sourceColumn, header, dropPlace);
		}
	}
	public enum BandedViewDropPlace
	{
		None,
		Left,
		Top,
		Right,
		Bottom
	}
	public class BandedViewColumnHeadersDropTarget : DropTargetBase
	{
		private FixedStyle fixedStyle;

		protected virtual bool ShouldCalcOffsetForOtherColumns => true;

		public BandedViewColumnHeadersDropTarget(Panel panel, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
			: base(panel)
		{
			this.fixedStyle = fixedStyle;
		}

		private FixedStyle GetFixedDropPlace(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (fixedStyle != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return FixedStyle.None;
			}
			if (column.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left && GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands.Count == 0)
			{
				return FixedStyle.Left;
			}
			if (column.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right && GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedRightVisibleBands.Count == 0)
			{
				return FixedStyle.Right;
			}
			return FixedStyle.None;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsCompatibleSource(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (!column.IsBand || GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.GetRootBand(column.ParentBandInternal).Fixed == fixedStyle)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return GetFixedDropPlace(column) != FixedStyle.None;
		}

		private BaseColumn GetColumnFromDragSource(UIElement source)
		{
			return DropTargetHelper.GetColumnFromDragSource(source);
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt, out object dragAnchor, bool isDrag)
		{
			dragAnchor = pt;
			BaseColumn columnFromDragSource = GetColumnFromDragSource(source);
			if (columnFromDragSource == null || !IsCompatibleSource(columnFromDragSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetColumnHeaderHitTestResult(pt).HeaderElement as BaseGridHeader;
			HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType = ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(source);
			DataControlBase grid = base.Grid;
			if (headerPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel && !grid.GetOriginationDataControl().DataControlOwner.CanGroupColumn((ColumnBase)columnFromDragSource))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (baseGridHeader == null)
			{
				BandBase bandByOffset = GetBandByOffset(pt.X);
				if (bandByOffset != null && columnFromDragSource.CanDropTo(bandByOffset))
				{
					return !DenyDropToAnotherParent(columnFromDragSource, bandByOffset, headerPresenterType);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return GetDropPlace(columnFromDragSource, baseGridHeader, GetLocation(baseGridHeader, pt), headerPresenterType) != BandedViewDropPlace.None;
		}

		protected virtual bool DenyDropToAnotherParent(BaseColumn column, BaseColumn target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (column.IsBand && ((BandBase)column).Owner == target)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!AreSameColumns(column.ParentBandInternal, target.ParentBandInternal))
			{
				return !DesignerHelper.GetValue((DependencyObject)(object)column, column.AllowChangeParent, designerValue: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool AreSameColumns(BaseColumn source, BaseColumn target)
		{
			BaseColumn baseColumn = source;
			if (source.View.DataControl.IsOriginationDataControlCore())
			{
				Func<DataControlBase, BaseColumn> func = source.CreateCloneAccessor();
				baseColumn = func(base.Grid);
			}
			return baseColumn == target;
		}

		protected virtual bool DropToTopBottomEdges(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader target, System.Windows.Point point, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, out BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace)
		{
			dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.None;
			if (sourceColumn.IsBand)
			{
				dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Top;
				return true;
			}
			if (!base.Grid.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandMultiRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sourceColumn == target.BaseColumn && sourceColumn.BandRow.Columns.Count == 1)
			{
				return moveFrom != HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel;
			}
			int num = target.BaseColumn.ParentBandInternal.ActualRows.IndexOf(target.BaseColumn.BandRow);
			int num2 = sourceColumn.ParentBandInternal.ActualRows.IndexOf(sourceColumn.BandRow);
			bool flag = target.BaseColumn.ParentBandInternal == sourceColumn.ParentBandInternal;
			if (point.Y < 4.0 && (!(num2 == num - 1 && flag) || sourceColumn.BandRow == null || sourceColumn.BandRow.Columns.Count != 1))
			{
				dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Top;
				return true;
			}
			if (point.Y > target.ActualHeight - 4.0 && (!(num2 == num + 1 && flag) || sourceColumn.BandRow == null || sourceColumn.BandRow.Columns.Count != 1))
			{
				dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual BandedViewDropPlace GetDropPlace(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader target, System.Windows.Point point, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (!CanDrop(sourceColumn, target, moveFrom))
			{
				return BandedViewDropPlace.None;
			}
			if (IsCheckBoxSelectorBand(target.BaseColumn))
			{
				return GetCheckBoxSelectorBandDropPlace(target, point);
			}
			BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.None;
			if (DropToTopBottomEdges(sourceColumn, target, point, moveFrom, out dropPlace))
			{
				return dropPlace;
			}
			bool flag = IsFarSide(target, point);
			if (sourceColumn != null && IsSameRow(sourceColumn, target.BaseColumn, moveFrom) && sourceColumn.Visible)
			{
				if (sourceColumn.ActualVisibleIndex == target.BaseColumn.ActualVisibleIndex - 1 && !flag)
				{
					return BandedViewDropPlace.None;
				}
				if (sourceColumn.ActualVisibleIndex == target.BaseColumn.ActualVisibleIndex)
				{
					if (moveFrom != HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel)
					{
						return BandedViewDropPlace.None;
					}
					return BandedViewDropPlace.Left;
				}
				if (sourceColumn.ActualVisibleIndex == target.BaseColumn.ActualVisibleIndex + 1 && flag)
				{
					return BandedViewDropPlace.None;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return BandedViewDropPlace.Left;
			}
			return BandedViewDropPlace.Right;
		}

		private BandedViewDropPlace GetCheckBoxSelectorBandDropPlace(BaseGridHeader target, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			if (!IsFarSide(target, point))
			{
				return BandedViewDropPlace.None;
			}
			return BandedViewDropPlace.Right;
		}

		private bool IsFarSide(FrameworkElement element, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return point.X > element.ActualWidth / 2.0;
		}

		protected bool IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				return !column.IsBand;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsCheckBoxSelectorBand(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (column.IsServiceColumn())
			{
				return column.IsBand;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CanDrop(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			if (!sourceColumn.CanDropTo(target.BaseColumn) || DenyDropToAnotherParent(sourceColumn, target.BaseColumn, moveFrom))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !IsCheckBoxSelectorColumn(target.BaseColumn);
		}

		protected virtual bool IsSameRow(BaseColumn column, BaseColumn target, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom)
		{
			return column.BandRow == target.BandRow;
		}

		protected System.Windows.Point GetLocation(UIElement relativeTo, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return GetLocation(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(relativeTo, ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).AdornableElement), point);
		}

		private System.Windows.Point GetLocation(Rect rect, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			PointHelper.Offset(ref point, 0.0 - rect.Left, 0.0 - rect.Top);
			return point;
		}

		private Rect GetTargetHeaderRelativeRect(BaseGridHeader header, System.Windows.Point point, BaseColumn sourceColumn)
		{
			if (header != null)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)header, ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).AdornableElement);
				if (header.BaseColumn.IsBand && !sourceColumn.IsBand)
				{
					relativeElementRect.Height = GridView.HeadersPanel.ActualHeight;
				}
				return relativeElementRect;
			}
			double actualOffset = 0.0;
			BandBase bandByOffset = GetBandByOffset(GetBandsCollection(fixedStyle), point.X, ref actualOffset);
			return new Rect(actualOffset, 0.0, bandByOffset.ActualHeaderWidth, ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel.ActualHeight);
		}

		private BandBase GetBandByOffset(double offset)
		{
			double actualOffset = 0.0;
			return GetBandByOffset(GetBandsCollection(fixedStyle), offset, ref actualOffset);
		}

		private IEnumerable GetBandsCollection(FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			return fixedStyle switch
			{
				FixedStyle.Left => GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands, 
				FixedStyle.Right => GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedRightVisibleBands, 
				_ => GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedNoneVisibleBands, 
			};
		}

		private BandBase GetBandByOffset(IEnumerable bands, double offset, ref double actualOffset)
		{
			BandBase bandBase = null;
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (actualOffset + band.ActualHeaderWidth < offset)
				{
					actualOffset += band.ActualHeaderWidth;
					continue;
				}
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count != 0)
				{
					bandBase = GetBandByOffset(band.VisibleBands, offset, ref actualOffset);
					if (bandBase == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					return bandBase;
				}
				return band;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateDragAdornerLocationCore(UIElement sourceElement, object headerAnchor)
		{
			if (((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BaseColumn columnFromDragSource = GetColumnFromDragSource(sourceElement);
			FixedStyle fixedDropPlace = GetFixedDropPlace(columnFromDragSource);
			if (fixedDropPlace != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				UpdateDragAdornerLocation(new System.Windows.Point((fixedDropPlace == FixedStyle.Left) ? 0.0 : ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel.ActualWidth, 0.0));
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetDropPlaceOrientation((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, Orientation.Horizontal);
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel.ActualHeight);
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point = (System.Windows.Point)headerAnchor;
			BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetColumnHeaderHitTestResult(point).HeaderElement as BaseGridHeader;
			Rect targetHeaderRelativeRect = GetTargetHeaderRelativeRect(baseGridHeader, point, columnFromDragSource);
			BandedViewDropPlace bandedViewDropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Left;
			if (baseGridHeader != null)
			{
				bandedViewDropPlace = GetDropPlace(columnFromDragSource, baseGridHeader, GetLocation(targetHeaderRelativeRect, point), ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(sourceElement));
			}
			else if (columnFromDragSource.IsBand)
			{
				bandedViewDropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Top;
			}
			System.Windows.Point point2 = RectHelper.Location(targetHeaderRelativeRect);
			System.Windows.Point adornerLocationOffset = GetAdornerLocationOffset(columnFromDragSource, baseGridHeader, bandedViewDropPlace);
			PointHelper.Offset(ref point2, adornerLocationOffset.X, adornerLocationOffset.Y);
			if (columnFromDragSource.IsBand && (baseGridHeader == null || !baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.IsBand))
			{
				point2.Y = 0.0;
			}
			if (bandedViewDropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Top || bandedViewDropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
			{
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetDropPlaceOrientation((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, Orientation.Vertical);
				if (baseGridHeader != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth > 0.0)
				{
					point2.X += baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidth;
				}
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, CalcVerticalDragIndicatorSize(point2, (baseGridHeader != null) ? (baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ParentBandInternal.ActualHeaderWidth - baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore) : targetHeaderRelativeRect.Width));
			}
			else
			{
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetDropPlaceOrientation((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, Orientation.Horizontal);
				((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).SetColumnHeaderDragIndicatorSize((DependencyObject)((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DragIndicator, targetHeaderRelativeRect.Height);
				switch (bandedViewDropPlace)
				{
				case BandedViewDropPlace.Left:
					if (baseGridHeader != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0)
					{
						point2.X += baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore;
					}
					break;
				case BandedViewDropPlace.Right:
					if (baseGridHeader != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn != null && baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore > 0.0)
					{
						point2.X -= baseGridHeader.BaseColumn.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			UpdateDragAdornerLocation(point2);
		}

		private void UpdateDragAdornerLocation(System.Windows.Point location)
		{
			((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).UpdatePopupLocation(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(location));
		}

		private double CalcVerticalDragIndicatorSize(System.Windows.Point point, double width)
		{
			return GridView.CalcVerticalDragIndicatorSize(((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).Panel, point, width);
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Point GetAdornerLocationOffset(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader header, BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if ((dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Top || dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom) && ShouldCalcOffsetForOtherColumns && header != null)
			{
				for (int num3 = header.BaseColumn.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf((ColumnBase)header.BaseColumn) - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					num -= header.BaseColumn.BandRow.Columns[num3].ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
			}
			if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom)
			{
				num2 += header.ActualHeight;
			}
			if (dropPlace == BandedViewDropPlace.Right)
			{
				num += header.ActualWidth;
			}
			return new System.Windows.Point(num, num2);
		}

		protected override void MoveColumnToCore(UIElement source, object dropAnchor)
		{
			System.Windows.Point point = (System.Windows.Point)dropAnchor;
			BaseColumn columnFromDragSource = GetColumnFromDragSource(source);
			if (GetFixedDropPlace(columnFromDragSource) != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				columnFromDragSource.Visible = true;
				return;
			}
			BaseGridHeader targetHeader = ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).GetColumnHeaderHitTestResult(point).HeaderElement as BaseGridHeader;
			MoveBandColumn(columnFromDragSource, targetHeader, point, ColumnBase.GetHeaderPresenterType(source), GridView.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
		}

		protected virtual void MoveBandColumn(BaseColumn sourceColumn, BaseGridHeader targetHeader, System.Windows.Point point, HeaderPresenterType moveFrom, bool useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
		{
			BandedViewDropPlace dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Left;
			if (targetHeader != null)
			{
				dropPlace = GetDropPlace(sourceColumn, targetHeader, GetLocation(targetHeader, point), moveFrom);
			}
			if (sourceColumn.IsBand)
			{
				dropPlace = BandedViewDropPlace.Bottom;
			}
			BaseColumn baseColumn = ((targetHeader != null) ? targetHeader.BaseColumn : GetBandByOffset(point.X));
			if (sourceColumn is BandBase source)
			{
				GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveBandTo(source, baseColumn.ParentBandInternal, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
			else
			{
				GridView.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.MoveColumnTo(sourceColumn, baseColumn, dropPlace, moveFrom, useLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes);
			}
		}
	}
	public class FixedNoneDropTarget : FixedDropTargetEx
	{
		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => base.FixedLeftColumnsCount;

		public FixedNoneDropTarget(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left || sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				int num = ((sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left) ? base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount : base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount);
				if (headerPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.GroupPanel || headerPresenterType == HeaderPresenterType.ColumnChooser)
				{
					return num == 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override int GetDragIndex(int dropIndex, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return dropIndex - GetFirstVisibleIndex() + ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
			}
			return base.GetDragIndex(dropIndex, pt);
		}

		protected override int GetRelativeVisibleIndex(UIElement element)
		{
			if (!base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return base.GetRelativeVisibleIndex(element);
			}
			return base.GetRelativeVisibleIndex(element) + GetFirstVisibleIndex() - ((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).DropIndexCorrection;
		}

		protected override int CorrectDropIndex(int dropIndex)
		{
			if (base.TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible && dropIndex == 0 && base.FixedLeftColumnsCount == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return dropIndex;
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> GetColumnsList()
		{
			return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns;
		}
	}
	public class FixedRightDropTarget : FixedDropTargetEx
	{
		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => base.FixedLeftColumnsCount + base.FixedNoneColumnsCount;

		public FixedRightDropTarget(Panel panel)
			: base(panel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (!WouldBeFirstFixedNoneColumn(sourceColumn) && (sourceColumn.Fixed != FixedStyle.Left || base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount != 0 || base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount != 0))
			{
				return sourceColumn.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override int CorrectDropIndex(int dropIndex)
		{
			return dropIndex;
		}

		protected override IList<ColumnBase> GetColumnsList()
		{
			return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns;
		}
	}
	internal static class DropTargetHelper
	{
		internal static BaseColumn GetColumnFromDragSource(UIElement source)
		{
			BaseGridHeader baseGridHeader = (BaseGridHeader)source;
			return baseGridHeader.DraggedColumn ?? baseGridHeader.Column;
		}
	}
	public abstract class ServiceColumnHeaderDropTarget : FixedDropTarget
	{
		protected override IList Children => null;

		protected override int ChildrenCount => 1;

		public GridColumnHeaderBase ColumnHeader { get; private set; }

		protected override DataViewBase GridView => DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(ColumnHeader);

		protected override UIElement AdornableElement => ColumnHeader;

		protected bool ThereIsNoFixedNoneColumns => base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount == 0;

		protected bool ThereIsNoFixedRightColumns => base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount == 0;

		protected bool ThereIsNoFixedLeftColumns => base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount == 0;

		protected bool AllowDragToServiceColumn => base.Grid.BandsCore.Count == 0;

		protected ScrollInfoBase ScrollInfo
		{
			get
			{
				if (GridView.DataPresenter == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GridView.DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo;
			}
		}

		public ServiceColumnHeaderDropTarget(GridColumnHeaderBase columnHeader)
			: base(null)
		{
			ColumnHeader = columnHeader;
		}

		protected override int GetDragIndex(int dropIndex, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		protected override Orientation GetDropPlaceOrientation(DependencyObject element)
		{
			return Orientation.Horizontal;
		}

		protected override object GetHeaderButtonOwner(int index)
		{
			return ColumnHeader;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Point CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			return GridView.CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(ColumnHeader, point);
		}

		protected bool IsLastColumnOfItsType(ColumnBase column)
		{
			switch (column.Fixed)
			{
			case FixedStyle.None:
				if (base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount - 1] == column;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Left:
				if (base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns[base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount - 1] == column;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Right:
				if (base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns[base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount - 1] == column;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsFirstColumnOfItsType(ColumnBase column)
		{
			switch (column.Fixed)
			{
			case FixedStyle.None:
				if (base.FixedNoneVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[0] == column;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Left:
				if (base.FixedLeftVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns[0] == column;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Right:
				if (base.FixedRightVisibleColumnsCount != 0)
				{
					return base.TableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns[0] == column;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorColumnHeaderDropTarget : ServiceColumnHeaderDropTarget
	{
		public IndicatorColumnHeaderDropTarget(GridColumnHeaderBase columnHeader)
			: base(columnHeader)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetDropIndexFromDragSource(UIElement element, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (base.TableView.IsCheckBoxSelectorColumnVisible)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement = GetVisibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement(base.TableView.TableViewBehavior, element);
			if (visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement == null || visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement[0].VisibleIndex;
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (!base.AllowDragToServiceColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsFirstColumnOfItsType(sourceColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (sourceColumn.Fixed)
			{
			case FixedStyle.None:
				if (base.ThereIsNoFixedLeftColumns)
				{
					if (base.ScrollInfo != null)
					{
						return base.ScrollInfo.Offset == 0.0;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Left:
				return true;
			case FixedStyle.Right:
				if (base.ThereIsNoFixedLeftColumns)
				{
					return base.ThereIsNoFixedNoneColumns;
				}
				return false;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	public class FitColumnHeaderDropTarget : ServiceColumnHeaderDropTarget
	{
		protected override int DropIndexCorrection => base.FixedLeftColumnsCount + base.FixedNoneColumnsCount + base.FixedRightColumnsCount;

		public FitColumnHeaderDropTarget(GridColumnHeaderBase columnHeader)
			: base(columnHeader)
		{
		}

		protected override int GetDropIndexFromDragSource(UIElement element, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement = GetVisibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement(base.TableView.TableViewBehavior, element);
			if (visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement == null || visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement[visibleColumnsCollectionFromDragElement.Count - 1].VisibleIndex + 1;
		}

		protected override void UpdateDragAdornerLocationCore(UIElement sourceElement, object headerAnchor)
		{
			if (!base.UseLegacyColumnVisibleIndexes)
			{
				headerAnchor = 0;
			}
			((HeaderDropTargetBase)this).UpdateDragAdornerLocationCore(sourceElement, headerAnchor);
		}

		protected override bool CanDropCore(int dropIndex, ColumnBase sourceColumn, HeaderPresenterType headerPresenterType)
		{
			if (!base.AllowDragToServiceColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsLastColumnOfItsType(sourceColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (sourceColumn.Fixed)
			{
			case FixedStyle.None:
			{
				ScrollInfoBase scrollInfo = base.ScrollInfo;
				if (base.ThereIsNoFixedRightColumns)
				{
					if (scrollInfo != null && !sourceColumn.Owner.AutoWidth && !(scrollInfo.Extent <= scrollInfo.Viewport))
					{
						return IsScrolledToEnd(scrollInfo);
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case FixedStyle.Left:
				if (base.ThereIsNoFixedRightColumns)
				{
					return base.ThereIsNoFixedNoneColumns;
				}
				return false;
			case FixedStyle.Right:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static bool IsScrolledToEnd(ScrollInfoBase scrollInfo)
		{
			return scrollInfo.Extent - scrollInfo.Viewport == scrollInfo.Offset;
		}
	}

	public class GridCellsEnumerator : VisualTreeEnumerator
	{
		private readonly FrameworkElement row;

		internal DataViewBase RowCurrentView
		{
			get
			{
				if (row is IAdditionalRowElement)
				{
					return ((IAdditionalRowElement)row).RowCurrentView;
				}
				return ((RowDataBase)row.DataContext).View;
			}
		}

		public int CurrentNavigationIndex => ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(((VisualTreeEnumerator)this).Current);

		public GridCellsEnumerator(FrameworkElement row)
			: base((DependencyObject)row, (EnumeratorDirection)0)
		{
			this.row = row;
		}

		protected override IEnumerator GetNestedObjects(object obj)
		{
			if (CurrentNavigationIndex >= 0)
			{
				return NestedObjectEnumeratorBase.EmptyEnumerator;
			}
			return ((VisualTreeEnumerator)this).GetNestedObjects(obj);
		}

		public override bool MoveNext()
		{
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).MoveNext())
			{
				DataViewBase dataViewBase = DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(((VisualTreeEnumerator)this).Current);
				if (CurrentNavigationIndex >= 0 && dataViewBase != null && dataViewBase == RowCurrentView)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GridRowsEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		protected VirtualItemsEnumerator en;

		protected DataViewBase view;

		public RowDataBase CurrentRowData => CurrentNode.GetRowData();

		public FrameworkElement CurrentRow => CurrentNode.GetRowElement();

		public RowNode CurrentNode => en.Current;

		object IEnumerator.Current => en.Current;

		public GridRowsEnumerator(DataViewBase view, NodeContainer containerItem)
		{
			this.view = view;
			en = CreateInnerEnumerator(containerItem);
		}

		public virtual bool MoveNext()
		{
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)en).MoveNext())
			{
				if (CurrentRow != null && IsCurrentRowInTree())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool IsCurrentRowInTree()
		{
			return LayoutHelper.FindParentObject<DataPresenterBase>((DependencyObject)CurrentRow) != null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)en).Reset();
		}

		protected virtual VirtualItemsEnumerator CreateInnerEnumerator(NodeContainer containerItem)
		{
			return new SkipCollapsedGroupVirtualItemsEnumerator(containerItem);
		}
	}
	public class SkipInvisibleGridRowsEnumerator : GridRowsEnumerator
	{
		public SkipInvisibleGridRowsEnumerator(DataViewBase view, NodeContainer containerItem)
			: base(view, containerItem)
		{
		}

		public override bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (!((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)en).MoveNext())
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			do
			{
				if (en.Current != null)
				{
					RowNode current = en.Current;
					if (!current.IsRowVisible)
					{
						if (!((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)en).MoveNext())
						{
							return false;
						}
						continue;
					}
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			while (!flag);
			return IsCurrentRowInTree();
		}
	}
	public abstract class VirtualItemsEnumeratorBase : NestedObjectEnumeratorBase
	{
		protected static IEnumerable EmptyEnumerable = new object[0];

		public VirtualItemsEnumeratorBase(object obj)
			: base(obj)
		{
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).Reset();
			((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).MoveNext();
		}

		protected override IEnumerator GetNestedObjects(object obj)
		{
			IEnumerator containerEnumerator = GetContainerEnumerator(obj);
			if (containerEnumerator != null)
			{
				return containerEnumerator;
			}
			return GetGroupEnumerable(obj).GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerator GetContainerEnumerator(object obj);

		protected abstract IEnumerable GetGroupEnumerable(object obj);
	}
	public class VirtualItemsEnumerator : VirtualItemsEnumeratorBase
	{
		private readonly NodeContainer containerItem;

		public NodeContainer CurrentContainer
		{
			get
			{
				if (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).CurrentParent is NodeContainer)
				{
					return (NodeContainer)((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).CurrentParent;
				}
				return ((RowNode)((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).CurrentParent).NodesContainer;
			}
		}

		public RowNode Current => (RowNode)((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)this).Enumerator.Current;

		public RowDataBase CurrentData => Current.GetRowData();

		public VirtualItemsEnumerator(NodeContainer containerItem)
			: base(containerItem)
		{
			this.containerItem = containerItem;
		}

		protected sealed override IEnumerator GetContainerEnumerator(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is NodeContainer { Initialized: not false } nodeContainer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return nodeContainer.GetSortedItemsEnumerator();
		}

		protected sealed override IEnumerable GetGroupEnumerable(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RowNode groupData))
			{
				return VirtualItemsEnumeratorBase.EmptyEnumerable;
			}
			return GetGroupDataEnumerable(groupData);
		}

		protected virtual IEnumerable<RowNode> GetGroupDataEnumerable(RowNode groupData)
		{
			return groupData.GetChildItems();
		}
	}

		public RowDataItemsEnumerator(RowsContainer containerItem)
			: base(containerItem)

		}

		protected sealed override IEnumerator GetContainerEnumerator(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RowsContainer rowsContainer))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rowsContainer.GetEnumerable().GetEnumerator();
		}

		protected sealed override IEnumerable GetGroupEnumerable(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is RowData rowData))
			{
				return VirtualItemsEnumeratorBase.EmptyEnumerable;
			}
			return rowData.GetCurrentViewChildItems();
		}

	public class GridViewInplaceEditorOwner : InplaceEditorOwnerBase
	{
		private DataViewBase View => (DataViewBase)base.owner;

		public override bool EditorWasClosed
		{
			get
			{
				if (!View.IsRootView)
				{
					return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)View.RootView.InplaceEditorOwner).EditorWasClosed;
				}
				return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).EditorWasClosed;
			}
			set
			{
				if (View.IsRootView)
				{
					((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).EditorWasClosed = value;
				}
				else
				{
					((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)View.RootView.InplaceEditorOwner).EditorWasClosed = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override FrameworkElement TopOwner => View.RootView;

		protected override FrameworkElement FocusOwner => View.RootView.DataControl;

		protected override Type OwnerBaseType => typeof(DataViewBase);

		protected override EditorShowMode EditorShowMode
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				EditorShowMode editorShowMode = View.RootView.EditorShowMode;
				if ((int)editorShowMode != 0)
				{
					return editorShowMode;
				}
				if (View.ShowUpdateRowButtonsCore == ShowUpdateRowButtons.OnCellEditorOpen)
				{
					return (EditorShowMode)2;
				}
				return editorShowMode;
			}
		}

		protected override bool EditorSetInactiveAfterClick => View.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick;

		protected override bool UseMouseUpFocusedEditorShowModeStrategy => View.UseMouseUpFocusedEditorShowModeStrategy;

		protected override bool CanCommitEditing
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CanCommitEditing)
				{
					DataProviderBase dataProviderBase = View.DataProviderBase;
					if (dataProviderBase == null || !dataProviderBase.IsCurrentRowEditing)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return !View.IsEditFormVisible;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanFocusEditor
		{
			get
			{
				if (FloatingContainer.IsModalContainerOpened)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CanFocusEditor && !View.IsColumnFilterOpened && View.IsFocusedView && !View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && (!View.IsKeyboardFocusInHeadersPanel() || View.Navigation.NavigationMouseLocker.IsLocked))
				{
					return !View.ColumnChooserHasKeyboardFocus();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool Optimized
		{
			get
			{
				if (View is ITableView { UseLightweightTemplates: var useLightweightTemplates } tableView)
				{
					if (useLightweightTemplates.HasValue)
					{
						return tableView.UseLightweightTemplates.Value != UseLightweightTemplates.None;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public GridViewInplaceEditorOwner(DataViewBase view)
			: base((FrameworkElement)view, false)
		{
		}

		protected override bool IsNavigationKey(Key key)
		{
			if (key == Key.Return && (View.EnterMoveNextColumn || View.IsNewItemRowFocused))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).IsNavigationKey(key);
		}

		protected override void EnqueueImmediateAction(IAction action)
		{
			View.ImmediateActionsManager.EnqueueAction(action);
		}

		public override void ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			View.ProcessKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override string GetDisplayText(InplaceEditorBase inplaceEditor, string originalDisplayText, object value)
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		protected override bool? GetDisplayText(InplaceEditorBase inplaceEditor, string originalDisplayText, object value, out string displayText)
		{
			displayText = null;
			if (View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CellEditorBase cellEditorBase = (CellEditorBase)(object)inplaceEditor;
			if (cellEditorBase.CellData == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return View.RaiseCustomDisplayText(cellEditorBase.RowHandle, null, cellEditorBase.CellData.ColumnCore, value, originalDisplayText, out displayText);
		}

		protected override bool PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			DependencyObject d = e.OriginalSource as DependencyObject;
			FrameworkElement rowElementByTreeElement = View.GetRowElementByTreeElement(d);
			object rowIdentifierByTreeElement = GetRowIdentifierByTreeElement(View, rowElementByTreeElement);
			View.PerformNavigationOnLeftButtonDownCore(e);
			View.UpdateRowsState();
			if (View.CanStartSelection() || (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers)))
			{
				return object.Equals(rowIdentifierByTreeElement, GetRowIdentifierByTreeElement(View, rowElementByTreeElement));
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object GetRowIdentifierByTreeElement(DataViewBase view, DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			int rowHandleByTreeElement = view.GetRowHandleByTreeElement(originalSource);
			return view.DataProviderBase.GetNodeIdentifier(rowHandleByTreeElement);
		}

		protected override bool CommitEditing()
		{
			return View.CommitEditingInternal();
		}

		protected override bool CommitEditorForce()
		{
			return View.CommitAndCleanEditor();
		}

		protected override void OnActiveEditorChanged()
		{
			View.SetActiveEditor();
		}

		protected override bool IsChildOfCurrentEditor(DependencyObject source)
		{
			if (!Optimized)
			{
				return IsCurrentCellChild(source);
			}
			if (View.ActualAllowCellMerge || (View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && View.IsTreeColumn(View.DataControl.CurrentColumn)))
			{
				return View.RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(source).IsRowCell;
			}
			EditGridCellData cellData = GetCellData(source);
			if (cellData == null || cellData.Column.DisplayTemplate == null)
			{
				return IsCurrentCellChild(source);
			}
			int value = cellData.RowData.RowHandle.Value;
			ColumnBase column = cellData.Column;
			if (View.FocusedRowHandle == value)
			{
				return View.DataControl.CurrentColumn == column;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private EditGridCellData GetCellData(object o)
		{
			object obj = null;
			if (o is FrameworkElement)
			{
				obj = (o as FrameworkElement).DataContext;
			}
			if (o is FrameworkContentElement)
			{
				obj = (o as FrameworkContentElement).DataContext;
			}
			return obj as EditGridCellData;
		}

		private bool IsCurrentCellChild(object source)
		{
			if (View.CurrentCell != null)
			{
				return LayoutHelper.IsChildElement(View.CurrentCell, source as DependencyObject);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ShowEditor(bool selectAll)
		{
			View.OnOpeningEditor();
			return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ShowEditor(selectAll);
		}

		protected override void FocusProcessMouseDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ActiveEditor != null && ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ActiveEditor.EditCore != null && originalSource != null && FocusHelper.GetFocusedElement() != null && FocusManager.GetFocusScope((DependencyObject)FocusHelper.GetFocusedElement()) != FocusManager.GetFocusScope(((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).TopOwner) && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ActiveEditor.EditCore, originalSource))
			{
				KeyboardHelper.Focus((IInputElement)((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).ActiveEditor);
			}
			else if (IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				KeyboardHelper.Focus((UIElement)((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).TopOwner);
			}
			else
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).FocusProcessMouseDown(originalSource);
			}
		}

		private bool IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel()
		{
			if (View.SearchControl != null)
			{
				return ((UIElement)(object)View.SearchControl).IsKeyboardFocusWithin;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool NeedActivateOnLeftMouseButtonEditor(DependencyObject obj)
		{
			if (!(((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor is FilterRowCellEditor))
			{
				return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).NeedActivateOnLeftMouseButtonEditor(obj);
			}
			DependencyObject dependencyObject = obj;
			while (dependencyObject != null && (object)dependencyObject != ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor)
			{
				if (dependencyObject is FilterCriteriaControlBase)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (dependencyObject is Button)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((object)dependencyObject == ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor)
				{
					break;
				}
				dependencyObject = LayoutHelper.GetParent(dependencyObject, false);
			}
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor != null)
			{
				((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor.UpdateEditorButtonVisibility();
			}
			return ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).NeedActivateOnLeftMouseButtonEditor(obj);
		}

		protected override bool IsActivationAction(ActivationAction action, RoutedEventArgs e, bool defaultValue)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GetIsEditorActivationActionEventArgs e2 = new GetIsEditorActivationActionEventArgs(action, e, GetEditorChild(), defaultValue, View, View.FocusedRowHandle, View.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
			View.EventTargetView.RaiseEvent(e2);
			return e2.IsActivationAction;
		}

		protected override bool ShouldReraiseActivationAction(ActivationAction action, RoutedEventArgs e, bool defaultValue)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ProcessEditorActivationActionEventArgs e2 = new ProcessEditorActivationActionEventArgs(action, e, GetEditorChild(), defaultValue, View, View.FocusedRowHandle, View.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
			View.EventTargetView.RaiseEvent(e2);
			return e2.RaiseEventAgain;
		}

		protected override bool NeedsKey(Key key, ModifierKeys modifiers, bool defaultValue)
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor == null || !((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor.IsEditorVisible)
			{
				return defaultValue;
			}
			GetActiveEditorNeedsKeyEventArgs e = new GetActiveEditorNeedsKeyEventArgs(key, modifiers, GetEditorChild(), defaultValue, View, View.FocusedRowHandle, View.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
			View.EventTargetView.RaiseEvent(e);
			return e.NeedsKey;
		}

		private DependencyObject GetEditorChild()
		{
			if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor != null && VisualTreeHelper.GetChildrenCount((DependencyObject)(object)((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor) > 0)
			{
				return VisualTreeHelper.GetChild((DependencyObject)(object)((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)this).CurrentCellEditor, 0);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
