	public class MouseMoveStrategyGridCell : MouseMoveSelectionBase
	{
		public static readonly MouseMoveStrategyGridCell Instance = new MouseMoveStrategyGridCell();

		private int startRowVisibleIndex;

		private double startOffsetX;

		private double startCoordinateX;

		private bool startMouseSelection;

		public override bool CanScrollHorizontally => true;

		public override bool CanScrollVertically => true;

		public override bool AllowNavigation => false;

		public override void OnMouseDown(DataViewBase tableView, IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			startRowVisibleIndex = tableView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			startOffsetX = tableView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
			startCoordinateX = ((ITableView)tableView.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
			tableView.SelectionAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(tableView, hitInfo.RowHandle, hitInfo.Column)
			{
				OffsetX = startOffsetX,
				CoordinateX = startCoordinateX,
				RowVisibleIndex = startRowVisibleIndex
			};
			tableView.SelectionOldCell = tableView.SelectionAnchor;
			startMouseSelection = false;
			tableView.RootView.ScrollTimer.Start();
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(ITableView tableView)
		{
			DataViewBase rootView = tableView.ViewBase.RootView;
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> viewAndVisibleIndex = rootView.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(((ITableView)rootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y);
			DataViewBase key = viewAndVisibleIndex.Key;
			ITableView tableView2 = (key as ITableView) ?? tableView;
			int value = viewAndVisibleIndex.Value;
			if (value < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = key.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(value);
			int commonVisibleIndex = key.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			double offset = rootView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
			double x = ((ITableView)rootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
			ColumnBase columnByCoordinateWithOffset = ((TableViewBehavior)key.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(offset + x, x);
			if (commonVisibleIndex != rootView.SelectionOldCell.RowVisibleIndex || rootView.SelectionOldCell.ColumnCore != columnByCoordinateWithOffset || !(Math.Abs(offset + x - (rootView.SelectionOldCell.OffsetX + rootView.SelectionOldCell.CoordinateX)) <= 3.0))
			{
				if (key != null && key.SelectionAnchor != null && key.DataControl != null && key.SelectionAnchor.ColumnCore != null && !key.SelectionAnchor.ColumnCore.AllowFocus && key.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null)
				{
					startCoordinateX = tableView.TableViewBehavior.GetSelectedColumnOffset(key.DataControl.CurrentColumn) - startOffsetX;
				}
				if (!startMouseSelection)
				{
					key.SelectionStrategy.StartMouseSelection();
					startMouseSelection = true;
				}
				CaptureMouse(key);
				double num = tableView.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
				double num2 = ((TableViewBehavior)tableView.ViewBase.RootView.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(commonVisibleIndex).Key.ViewBehavior).FixedLeftColumnsWidth();
				double num3 = ((startCoordinateX > num) ? startOffsetX : 0.0);
				double num4 = ((x > num2) ? offset : 0.0);
				double startX = startCoordinateX + num3;
				double endX = x + num4;
				((ITableView)key.SelectionAnchor.View).TableViewBehavior.SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(startRowVisibleIndex, commonVisibleIndex, startX, endX, rootView.DataControl);
				rootView.SelectionOldCell = new SelectionAnchorCell(key, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, columnByCoordinateWithOffset)
				{
					OffsetX = rootView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset,
					CoordinateX = ((ITableView)rootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X,
					RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex
				};
			}
		}

		public override void CaptureMouse(DataViewBase tableView)
		{
			if (MouseHelper.Captured != tableView)
			{
				if (tableView.RootView.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					MouseHelper.Capture((UIElement)tableView.RootView);
				}
				else
				{
					tableView.StopSelection();
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnMouseUp(DataViewBase tableView)
		{
			tableView.RootView.ScrollTimer.Stop();
			startMouseSelection = false;
		}

	public abstract class MouseMoveSelectionRectangleBase : MouseMoveSelectionBase
	{
		private SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper helper = new SelectionRectangleTableViewHelper();

		private bool isFirst;

		private System.Windows.Point startPointFirst;

		private bool startMouseSelection;

		private bool isStop;

		public override bool CanScrollVertically => true;

		public override bool AllowNavigation => false;

		protected void OnMouseDownCore(DataViewBase tableView, int rowHandle, ColumnBase column, bool isLastRow)
		{
			isStop = false;
			isFirst = true;
			int commonVisibleIndex = tableView.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandle);
			double offset = tableView.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
			double x = ((ITableView)tableView.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
			tableView.SelectionAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(tableView, rowHandle, column)
			{
				OffsetX = offset,
				CoordinateX = x,
				RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex,
				IsLastRow = isLastRow
			};
			tableView.RootView.ScrollTimer.Start();
			helper.OnMouseDown(tableView, rowHandle, column);
			startPointFirst = helper.StartPoint;
		}

		protected void Stop()
		{
			isStop = true;
		}

		private void UpdateSelectionCore(ITableView tableView)
		{
			DataViewBase viewBase = tableView.ViewBase;
			bool calcDataArea = false;
			if (viewBase.SelectionAnchor != null)
			{
				calcDataArea = !viewBase.SelectionAnchor.IsLastRow;
			}
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> viewAndVisibleIndex = viewBase.GetViewAndVisibleIndex(tableView.TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.Y, calcDataArea);
			DataViewBase key = viewAndVisibleIndex.Key;
			int value = viewAndVisibleIndex.Value;
			if (value >= 0 || value == int.MinValue)
			{
				if (!startMouseSelection)
				{
					viewBase.SelectionStrategy.StartMouseSelection();
					startMouseSelection = true;
				}
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = key.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(value);
				int commonVisibleIndex = key.DataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				double offset = key.RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
				double x = ((ITableView)key.RootView).TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition.X;
				ColumnBase columnByCoordinateWithOffset = ((TableViewBehavior)key.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(offset + x, x);
				CaptureMouse(key);
				key.SelectionOldCell = new SelectionAnchorCell(key, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, columnByCoordinateWithOffset)
				{
					OffsetX = offset,
					CoordinateX = x,
					RowVisibleIndex = commonVisibleIndex
				};
				((ITableView)key.SelectionAnchor.View).TableViewBehavior.UpdateSelectionRectCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, columnByCoordinateWithOffset);
			}
		}

		public override void UpdateSelection(ITableView tableView)
		{
			if (isStop)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isFirst)
			{
				System.Windows.Point transformPoint = helper.GetTransformPoint(tableView.ViewBase, tableView.TableViewBehavior.LastMousePosition);
				if (Math.Abs(startPointFirst.X - transformPoint.X) <= SystemParameters.MinimumVerticalDragDistance && Math.Abs(startPointFirst.Y - transformPoint.Y) <= SystemParameters.MinimumHorizontalDragDistance)
				{
					helper.OnMouseDown(tableView.ViewBase, helper.RowHandle, tableView.ViewBase.SelectionRectangleAnchor.Column);
					return;
				}
				isFirst = false;
			}
			UpdateSelectionCore(tableView);
			helper.UpdateSelection(tableView.ViewBase, tableView.TableViewBehavior, tableView.ShowIndicator ? tableView.IndicatorWidth : 0.0);
		}

		public override void OnMouseUp(DataViewBase tableView)
		{
			tableView.RootView.ScrollTimer.Stop();
			startMouseSelection = false;
			helper.OnMouseUp(tableView);
			Stop();
		}

		public override void CaptureMouse(DataViewBase tableView)
		{
			if (MouseHelper.Captured != tableView)
			{
				if (tableView.RootView.IsKeyboardFocusWithin)
				{
					MouseHelper.Capture((UIElement)tableView.RootView);
				}
				else
				{
					tableView.StopSelection();
				}
			}
		}
	}

			DataViewBase rootView = view.RootView;
			if (rootView == null || rootView.DataControl == null || rootView.DataProviderBase == null)
			{
				return default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);
			}
			DataViewBase view2 = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			rootView.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view2, out visibleIndex);
			if (view2 == null || view2.DataControl == null)
			{
				return default(KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>);

			return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(view2, view2.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex));

				tableView = lastRowHandle.Key;
				num = lastRowHandle.Value;

			else
			{
				num = hitInfo.RowHandle;

			OnMouseDownCore(tableView, num, hitInfo.Column, hitInfo.RowHandle == int.MinValue);

	internal class ScrollOnePageUpAction : IAction
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		public ScrollOnePageUpAction(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			if (View.ImmediateActionsManager.FindActionOfType(typeof(ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpPageDownAction)) == null)
			{
				int num = ScrollActionsHelper.GetOffsetDeltaForPageUp(View);
				bool needToAdjustScroll = true;
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					num = -1;
					needToAdjustScroll = false;
				}
				DataViewBase initialView = null;
				int visibleIndex = 0;
				View.GetFirstScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out initialView, out visibleIndex);
				View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset((int)Math.Ceiling(View.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset) + num - ScrollActionsHelper.GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(View, visibleIndex, needToAdjustScroll));
				View.AddScrollOneItemAfterPageUpAction(initialView, visibleIndex, needToAdjustScroll, 0, 0);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ScrollOnePageDownAction : IAction
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		public ScrollOnePageDownAction(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			if (View.ImmediateActionsManager.FindActionOfType(typeof(ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpPageDownAction)) == null)
			{
				int num = ScrollActionsHelper.GetOffsetDeltaForPageDown(View);
				bool needToAdjustScroll = true;
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					num = 1;
					needToAdjustScroll = false;
				}
				DataViewBase initialView = null;
				int visibleIndex = 0;
				View.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out initialView, out visibleIndex);
				View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(View.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + (double)num + (double)ScrollActionsHelper.GetGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRow(View, visibleIndex, needToAdjustScroll, checkLastRow: true));
				View.AddScrollOneItemAfterPageDownAction(initialView, visibleIndex, needToAdjustScroll, 0, 0);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class ScrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction : IAction
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		public ScrollOnePageUpWithAnimationAction(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			int num = ScrollActionsHelper.GetOffsetDeltaForPageUp(View);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				num = -1;
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			View.GetFirstScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out dataViewBase, out visibleIndex);
			int num2 = dataViewBase.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(visibleIndex) + num;
			if (num2 <= 0)
			{
				num2 = 0;
			}
			View.MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndexForPageUpPageDown(num2, pageUp: true);
			View.OnPostponedNavigationComplete();
		}
	}
	internal class ScrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction : IAction
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		public ScrollOnePageDownWithAnimationAction(DataViewBase view)
		{
			this.view = view;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			int num = ScrollActionsHelper.GetOffsetDeltaForPerPixelPageDown(View);
			if (num <= 0)
			{
				num = 1;
			}
			List<int> parentFixedRowsScrollIndexes = View.DataControl.GetParentFixedRowsScrollIndexes(View.DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex);
			int scrollIndex = ScrollActionsHelper.CalcLastScrollRowFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(View) + num;
			scrollIndex = ScrollActionsHelper.FindNearestScrollableRow(View, scrollIndex);
			int num2 = scrollIndex;
			while (parentFixedRowsScrollIndexes.Contains(scrollIndex))
			{
				scrollIndex = SkipGroupSummaryRows(++scrollIndex, forward: true);
			}
			IScrollInfoOwner rootDataPresenter = View.RootDataPresenter;
			if (scrollIndex >= rootDataPresenter.ItemCount)
			{
				scrollIndex = rootDataPresenter.ItemCount - 1;
				scrollIndex = SkipGroupSummaryRows(scrollIndex, forward: false);
				while (parentFixedRowsScrollIndexes.Contains(scrollIndex))
				{
					scrollIndex = SkipGroupSummaryRows(--scrollIndex, forward: false);
				}
			}
			View.MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndexForPageUpPageDown(scrollIndex, pageUp: false);
			View.OnPostponedNavigationComplete();
		}

		private int SkipGroupSummaryRows(int index, bool forward)
		{
			while (View.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(index) is GroupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				index = ((!forward) ? (index - 1) : (index + 1));
			}
			return index;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpPageDownAction : IAction
	{
		private int tryCount;

		private DataViewBase view;

		private DataViewBase initialView;

		private int initialVisibleIndex;

		private int previousOffsetDelta;

		private bool needToAdjustScroll;

		protected DataViewBase View => view;

		protected DataViewBase InitialView => initialView;

		protected int InitialVisibleIndex => initialVisibleIndex;

		protected bool NeedToAdjustScroll => needToAdjustScroll;

		protected int PreviousOffsetDelta => previousOffsetDelta;

		protected int TryCount => tryCount;

		protected abstract int GetRealOffset();

		protected abstract bool IsOffsetDeltaOutOfRange(int offsetDelta);

		protected abstract void MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndex(bool isOffsetDeltaOutOfRange);

		protected abstract void AddScrollOneItemAction(int offsetDelta);

		public ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpPageDownAction(DataViewBase view, DataViewBase initialView, int initialVisibleIndex, bool needToAdjustScroll, int previousOffsetDelta, int tryCount)
		{
			this.view = view;
			this.initialView = initialView;
			this.initialVisibleIndex = initialVisibleIndex;
			this.needToAdjustScroll = needToAdjustScroll;
			this.previousOffsetDelta = previousOffsetDelta;
			this.tryCount = tryCount;
		}

		protected virtual int GetGroupSummaryRowOffset(int visibleIndex)
		{
			return 0;
		}

		private bool IsElementVisible(RowData rowData)
		{
			FrameworkElement rowElement = rowData.RowElement;
			if (rowElement != null && rowElement.IsVisible)
			{
				if (view.DataPresenter.IsElementPartiallyVisible(rowElement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private RowData GetLastFooterRowData()
		{
			RowData rowData = null;
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = view.RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData2 && rowData2.MatchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey)
				{
					rowData = rowData2;
				}
			}
			if (rowData == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rowData;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			if (CheckIsBadCondition())
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = InitialView.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(InitialVisibleIndex);
			int num2 = num - GetRealOffset() + GetGroupSummaryRowOffset(InitialVisibleIndex);
			bool flag = IsOffsetDeltaOutOfRange(num2);
			if (num2 == 0 || flag || !NeedToAdjustScroll || PreviousOffsetDelta * num2 < 0)
			{
				if (View.ShowGroupSummaryFooter && num2 > 0)
				{
					RowData lastFooterRowData = GetLastFooterRowData();
					if (lastFooterRowData != null && !IsElementVisible(lastFooterRowData) && tryCount < 8)
					{
						view.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(view.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + 1.0);
						AddScrollOneItemAction(1);
						return;
					}
				}
				MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndex(flag);
				View.OnPostponedNavigationComplete();
			}
			else
			{
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					num2 = 1;
				}
				if (num2 < 0)
				{
					num2 = -1;
				}
				View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(View.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + (double)num2);
				AddScrollOneItemAction(num2);
			}
		}

		private bool CheckIsBadCondition()
		{
			if (TryCount > 100)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpAction : ScrollOneItemAfterPageUpPageDownAction
	{
		protected override int GetRealOffset()

		}

		protected override bool IsOffsetDeltaOutOfRange(int offsetDelta)

				return rootDataPresenter.Offset == 0;

	internal class ScrollOneItemAfterPageDownPerPixelAction : ScrollOneItemAfterPageDownAction

		protected override void MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndex(bool isOffsetDeltaOutOfRange)
		{
			if (!isOffsetDeltaOutOfRange)
			{
				AdjustScrollOffset();
				base.MoveFocusedRowToScrollIndex(isOffsetDeltaOutOfRange);
			}
			else
			{
				MoveFocusedRowToLastRow();
			}
		}

		private void AdjustScrollOffset()
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			base.View.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out dataViewBase, out visibleIndex);
			if (dataViewBase != null && visibleIndex < base.View.RootDataPresenter.ItemCount - 1)
			{
				double num = base.View.CalcOffsetForBackwardScrolling(visibleIndex + 1);
				base.View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(base.View.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - num);
			}
		}

		private void MoveFocusedRowToLastRow()
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = base.View.RootView.DataControl.FindLastInnerDetailView();
			DataViewBase dataViewBase2 = base.View;
			if (dataViewBase != null && dataViewBase.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0)
			{
				dataViewBase2 = dataViewBase;
			}
			dataViewBase2.NavigateToLastRow();
		}

	internal class ScrollAndFocusFirstAfterPageUpCardView : IAction

		private DataViewBase view;

		private int visibleIndex;

		private int tryCount;

		private CardsHierarchyPanel CardsHierarchyPanel => (CardsHierarchyPanel)view.DataPresenter.Panel;

		public ScrollAndFocusFirstAfterPageUpCardView(DataViewBase view, int visibleIndex, int tryCount)

			this.view = view;
			this.visibleIndex = visibleIndex;
			this.tryCount = tryCount;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			int num = (int)(ScrollInfo.Offset + ScrollInfo.Viewport - 1.0);
			int num2 = (int)CardsHierarchyPanel.CalcExtent(view.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(view.DataPresenter.LastConstraint), visibleIndex - view.PageOffset);
			double num3 = num2 - num;
			if (num3 == 0.0 || ScrollInfo.Viewport < 1.0 || tryCount > 100)
			{
				view.MoveFocusedRowToFirstScrollRow();
				return;
			}
			if (num3 > 0.0)
			{
				num3 = 1.0;
			}
			ScrollInfo.SetOffset(ScrollInfo.Offset + num3);
			view.EnqueueImmediateAction((IAction)(object)new ScrollAndFocusFirstAfterPageUpCardView(view, visibleIndex, ++tryCount));
		}
	}
	public class ScrollRowIntoViewAction : IAction
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		private int rowHandle;

		private int tryCount;

		private bool prohibitAnimation;

		protected DataViewBase View => view;

		protected int RowHandle => rowHandle;

		protected int FirstInnerScrollIndex { get; set; }

		protected int TopNewItemRowScrollIndex { get; set; }

		protected bool ProhibitAnimation => prohibitAnimation;

		private bool IsTopNewItemRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (View.IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					return RowHandle == -2147483647;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool UseLock { get; set; }

		internal Action PostAction { get; set; }

		public ScrollRowIntoViewAction(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle, int tryCount)
		{
			this.view = view;
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
			this.tryCount = tryCount;
			prohibitAnimation = View.ScrollAnimationLocker.IsLocked || View.DataControl.IsDataResetLocked;
		}

		public void Reassign(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle)
		{
			this.view = view;
			this.rowHandle = rowHandle;
		}

		public void Execute()
		{
			try
			{
				if (UseLock)
				{
					View.EnqueueScrollIntoViewLocker.Lock();
				}
				if (!View.DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(RowHandle) || !View.DataControl.IsRowVisibleCore(RowHandle) || (View.HasFixedRows && View.GetFixedRowByItemCore(View.DataControl.GetRow(RowHandle)) != FixedRowPosition.None) || (IsTopNewItemRow && View.IsRootView) || tryCount > 8)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (View.RootDataPresenter == null || View.RootDataPresenter.Panel.Return((HierarchyPanel x) => !x.IsMeasureValid, () => false))
				{
					EnqueueScrollIntoViewAgain();
					return;
				}
				UpdateScrollIndexes();
				View.EditFormManager.OnBeforeScroll(RowHandle);
				if (ProhibitAnimation)
				{
					View.ScrollAnimationLocker.Lock();
				}
				try
				{
					ScrollIntoViewCore();
				}
				finally
				{
					if (ProhibitAnimation)
					{
						View.ScrollAnimationLocker.Unlock();
					}
					View.EditFormManager.OnAfterScroll();
					PostAction?.Invoke();
				}
				if (!View.RootDataPresenter.CanScrollWithAnimation && (ShouldScrollBack() || ShouldScrollForward()))
				{
					EnqueueScrollIntoViewAgain();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (UseLock)
				{
					View.EnqueueScrollIntoViewLocker.Unlock();
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateScrollIndexes()
		{
			FirstInnerScrollIndex = FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex();
			if (IsTopNewItemRow)
			{
				TopNewItemRowScrollIndex = FindTopNewItemRowScrollIndex();
			}
		}

		private int FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex()
		{
			if (IsTopNewItemRow)
			{
				return View.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex();
			}
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = View.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(RowHandle);
			return View.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore);
		}

		private int FindTopNewItemRowScrollIndex()
		{
			if (View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0)
			{
				return View.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(View.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1) + 1;
			}
			return View.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex();
		}

		private void EnqueueScrollIntoViewAgain()
		{
			View.EnqueueImmediateAction((IAction)(object)new ScrollRowIntoViewAction(View, RowHandle, tryCount + 1)
			{
				UseLock = UseLock,
				PostAction = PostAction
			});
		}

		private void ScrollIntoViewCore()
		{
			if (ShouldScrollBack())
			{
				ScrollBack();
			}
			else if (ShouldScrollForward())
			{
				ScrollForward();
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldScrollBack()
		{
			double actualScrollOffset = View.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset;
			if ((double)GetBackScrollIndex() < actualScrollOffset)
			{
				return actualScrollOffset > 0.0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetBackScrollIndex()
		{
			if (IsTopNewItemRow)
			{
				return TopNewItemRowScrollIndex;
			}
			return FirstInnerScrollIndex - View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount;
		}

		private bool ShouldScrollForward()
		{
			IScrollInfoOwner rootDataPresenter = View.RootDataPresenter;
			if (GetForwardScrollIndex() <= rootDataPresenter.Offset)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (View.IsPagingMode && !View.IsScrollIndexInPageBounds(GetForwardScrollIndex()))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsRowVisibleOnScreen(View))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = View.DataControl.CalcTotalLevelByRowHandle(RowHandle);
			int num2 = ScrollActionsHelper.CalcLastScrollRowTotalLevel(View);
			if (num > num2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return GetForwardScrollIndex() > View.CalcLastScrollRowScrollIndex();
		}

		private int GetForwardScrollIndex()
		{
			return FirstInnerScrollIndex;
		}

		private bool IsRowVisibleOnScreen(DataViewBase view)
		{
			int num = RowHandle;
			DataPresenterBase rootDataPresenter = View.RootDataPresenter;
			FrameworkElement rowElement = GetRowElement();
			if (rowElement != null && rowElement.IsVisible)
			{
				if (rootDataPresenter.IsElementPartiallyVisible(rowElement))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return rootDataPresenter.LastConstraint.Height == double.PositiveInfinity;
		}

		private FrameworkElement GetRowElement()
		{
			if (IsTopNewItemRow)
			{
				return View.GetRowElementByRowHandle(-2147483647);
			}
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = view.RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData is RowData rowData && rowData.View == view && rowData.RowHandle.Value == rowHandle)
				{
					return gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void ScrollBack()
		{
			View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(GetBackScrollIndex());
		}

		private void ScrollForward()
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double actualViewPort = View.RootDataPresenter.ActualViewPort;
			if (View.ShouldChangeForwardIndex(RowHandle))
			{
				IScrollInfoOwner rootDataPresenter = View.RootDataPresenter;
				double num2 = 1.0;
				if (actualViewPort > 1.0)
				{
					num2 = View.CalcOffsetForward(RowHandle, View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling);
					if (!ScrollActionsHelper.IsRowElementVisible(view, RowHandle))
					{
						num2 += (double)ScrollActionsHelper.GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRowByRowHandle(View, RowHandle, needToAdjustScroll: true);
					}
				}
				num = (double)rootDataPresenter.Offset + num2;
			}
			else
			{
				double num3 = Math.Max(actualViewPort, 1.0);
				num = (double)(GetForwardScrollIndex() - View.ActualFixedTopRowsCount) - num3 + (double)View.DataControl.CalcTotalLevelByRowHandle(RowHandle) + 1.0;
			}
			num += (double)ScrollActionsHelper.GetGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRowByRowHandle(View, RowHandle, needToAdjustScroll: false);
			bool flag = view.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling;
			if (!flag)
			{
				flag = view.IsEditFormVisible;
			}
			View.RootDataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(num, flag);
		}
	}
	internal static class ScrollActionsHelper
	{
		internal static int GetOffsetDeltaForPageUp(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return -view.RootDataPresenter.FullyVisibleItemsCount + CalcFirstScrollRowTotalLevel(view) + 1;
		}

		internal static int GetOffsetDeltaForPageDown(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return view.RootDataPresenter.FullyVisibleItemsCount - CalcLastScrollRowTotalLevel(view) - 1;
		}

		internal static int GetOffsetDeltaForPerPixelPageDown(DataViewBase view)
		{
			int num = view.RootDataPresenter.FullyVisibleItemsCount - 1;
			if (!view.RootDataPresenter.IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				num -= CalcLastScrollRowFirstInnerChildTotalLevel(view);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static int CalcFirstScrollRowTotalLevel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = 0;
			view.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(view.CalcFirstScrollRowScrollIndex(), forwardIfServiceRow: true, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex);
			if (targetView == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = targetView.DataControl.CalcTotalLevel(targetVisibleIndex);
			if (targetView.DataControl.IsExpandedFixedRow(targetVisibleIndex))
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int CalcLastScrollRowTotalLevel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			DataViewBase view2 = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			view.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view2, out visibleIndex);
			return view2?.DataControl.CalcTotalLevel(visibleIndex) ?? 0;
		}

		private static int CalcLastScrollRowFirstInnerChildTotalLevel(DataViewBase view)
		{
			int scrollIndex = CalcLastScrollRowFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(view);
			DataViewBase targetView = null;
			int targetVisibleIndex = 0;
			if (view.DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(scrollIndex, forwardIfServiceRow: true, out targetView, out targetVisibleIndex))
			{
				return targetView.DataControl.CalcTotalLevel(targetVisibleIndex);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal static int CalcLastScrollRowFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.RootDataPresenter.IsAnimationInProgress)
			{
				return (int)Math.Ceiling(view.RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset) + view.RootDataPresenter.FullyVisibleItemsCount - 1;
			}
			DataViewBase view2 = null;
			int visibleIndex = 0;
			view.GetLastScrollRowViewAndVisibleIndex(out view2, out visibleIndex);
			return view2?.DataControl.FindFirstInnerChildScrollIndex(visibleIndex) ?? 0;
		}

		internal static int FindNearestScrollableRow(DataViewBase targetView, int scrollIndex)
		{
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = scrollIndex; i < targetView.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount + targetView.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount(); i++)
			{
				object visibleIndexByScrollIndex = targetView.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(i);
				if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex is int)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				for (int num2 = scrollIndex; num2 >= 0; num2--)
				{
					object visibleIndexByScrollIndex2 = targetView.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(num2);
					if (visibleIndexByScrollIndex2 is int)
					{
						num = num2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return scrollIndex;
		}

		internal static int GetGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRowByRowHandle(DataViewBase targetView, int rowHandle, bool needToAdjustScroll, bool checkLastRow = false)
		{
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = targetView.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			return GetGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRow(targetView, rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, needToAdjustScroll, checkLastRow);
		}

		internal static int GetGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRow(DataViewBase targetView, int visibleIndex, bool needToAdjustScroll, bool checkLastRow = false)
		{
			int num = CalcGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRow(targetView, visibleIndex);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (checkLastRow && visibleIndex == targetView.DataControl.VisibleRowCount - 1)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num + (needToAdjustScroll ? 1 : 0);
		}

		internal static int GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRowByRowHandle(DataViewBase targetView, int rowHandle, bool needToAdjustScroll)
		{
			int rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore = targetView.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowHandle);
			return GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(targetView, rowVisibleIndexByHandleCore, needToAdjustScroll);
		}

		internal static int GetGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(DataViewBase targetView, int visibleIndex, bool needToAdjustScroll)
		{
			int num = CalcGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(targetView, visibleIndex);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (visibleIndex == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return num + (needToAdjustScroll ? 1 : 0);
		}

		private static int CalcGroupSummaryRowCountBeforeRow(DataViewBase view, int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!view.ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = view.DataProviderBase.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex, allowFixedGroups: false);
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = num - 1;
			while (num3 >= 0 && view.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(num3) is GroupSummaryRowKey)
			{
				num2++;
				num3--;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private static int CalcGroupSummaryRowCountAfterRow(DataViewBase view, int visibleIndex)
		{
			if (!view.ShowGroupSummaryFooter)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = view.DataProviderBase.ConvertVisibleIndexToScrollIndex(visibleIndex, allowFixedGroups: false);
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = num + 1; i < view.DataProviderBase.VisibleCount + view.CalcGroupSummaryVisibleRowCount() && view.DataProviderBase.GetVisibleIndexByScrollIndex(i) is GroupSummaryRowKey; i++)
			{
				num2++;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal static bool IsRowElementVisible(DataViewBase view, int rowHandle)
		{
			return view.GetRowElementByRowHandle(rowHandle) != null;
		}
	}
	public class AdditionalRowNavigation : GridViewCellNavigation
	{
		public AdditionalRowNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		protected override void UpdateRowsStateCore()
		{
			foreach (DependencyObject additionalRow in GetAdditionalRows())
			{
				RowHandle rowHandle = DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(additionalRow);
				SetRowFocus(additionalRow, rowHandle != null && rowHandle.Value == base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable<DependencyObject> GetAdditionalRows()
		{
			if (View.IsRootView)
			{
				AdditionalRowItemsControl additionalRowItemsControl = GridView.TableViewBehavior.AdditionalRowItemsControl;
				if (additionalRowItemsControl == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (DependencyObject item in (IEnumerable)additionalRowItemsControl.Items)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				FrameworkElement rowElementByRowHandle = View.GetRowElementByRowHandle(-2147483647);
				if (View.IsNewItemRowVisible && rowElementByRowHandle != null)
				{
					yield return rowElementByRowHandle;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class DummyNavigation : GridViewNavigationBase
	{
		public DummyNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}
	}
	public class GridViewCellNavigation : GridViewRowNavigation
	{
		public override bool CanSelectCell => true;

		private bool UseAdvVertNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null && base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowAdvancedVerticalNavigation)
				{
					return base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected bool UseAdvHorzNavigation
		{
			get
			{
				if (!base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(base.View.FocusedRowHandle) && base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore != null)
				{
					return base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowAdvancedHorizontalNavigation;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public GridViewCellNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnHome(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
			{
				base.View.SelectRowForce();
				base.OnHome(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MoveFirstNavigationIndex();
			}
		}

		public override void OnEnd(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)))
			{
				base.View.SelectRowForce();
				base.OnEnd(e);
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MoveLastNavigationIndex();
			}
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (UseAdvHorzNavigation)
			{
				DoBandedViewHorzNavigation(isRight: false);
			}
			else
			{
				OnLeftCore(isCtrlPressed);
			}
		}

		private void OnLeftCore(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused && base.View.IsRootView)
			{
				if (base.View.IsTreeView)
				{
					object obj = ((ContentPresenter)(object)base.View.CurrentCellEditor)?.Content;
					TextEdit val = (TextEdit)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.SelectionLength = 0;
						val.SelectionStart = 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.View.MovePrevCellCore();
				}
			}
			else if (base.View.FocusedRowElement != null)
			{
				if (!base.View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
				{
					base.View.MovePrevCell();
				}
				else
				{
					base.OnLeft(isCtrlPressed);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (UseAdvHorzNavigation)
			{
				DoBandedViewHorzNavigation(isRight: true);
			}
			else
			{
				OnRightCore(isCtrlPressed);
			}
		}

		protected void DoBandedViewHorzNavigation(bool isRight)
		{
			try
			{
				if (base.View != null)
				{
					base.View.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				}
				ColumnBase columnBase = FindNavigationColumn(isRight);
				if (columnBase != null && columnBase != base.DataControl.CurrentColumn)
				{
					base.DataControl.CurrentColumn = columnBase;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (base.View != null)
				{
					base.View.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
				}
			}
		}

		private ColumnBase FindNavigationColumn(bool isRight)
		{
			List<List<List<ColumnBase>>> list = CreateBandRows(base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.VisibleBands);
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FindColumn(base.DataControl.CurrentColumn, list, out var bandIndex, out var rowIndex, out var columnIndex);
			if (isRight)
			{
				if (columnIndex < list[bandIndex][rowIndex].Count - 1)
				{
					return list[bandIndex][rowIndex][columnIndex + 1];
				}
				if (bandIndex >= list.Count - 1 && (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore || base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused))
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (bandIndex < list.Count - 1)
				{
					bandIndex++;
				}
				else if (base.View.ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore && !base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
				{
					bandIndex = 0;
				}
				if (rowIndex >= list[bandIndex].Count)
				{
					rowIndex = list[bandIndex].Count - 1;
				}
				return list[bandIndex][rowIndex][0];
			}
			if (columnIndex > 0)
			{
				return list[bandIndex][rowIndex][columnIndex - 1];
			}
			if (bandIndex <= 0 && (!base.View.ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore || base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (bandIndex > 0)
			{
				bandIndex--;
			}
			else if (base.View.ViewBehavior.AutoMoveRowFocusCore && !base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
			{
				bandIndex = list.Count - 1;
			}
			if (rowIndex >= list[bandIndex].Count)
			{
				rowIndex = list[bandIndex].Count - 1;
			}
			return list[bandIndex][rowIndex][list[bandIndex][rowIndex].Count - 1];
		}

		private List<List<List<ColumnBase>>> CreateBandRows(IList bands)
		{
			List<List<List<ColumnBase>>> list = new List<List<List<ColumnBase>>>();
			CreateBandRowsCore(bands, list);
			return list;
		}

		private void CreateBandRowsCore(IList bands, List<List<List<ColumnBase>>> bandRows)
		{
			foreach (BandBase band in bands)
			{
				if (band.BandsCore.Count != 0)
				{
					CreateBandRowsCore(band.BandsCore, bandRows);
				}
				else
				{
					if (band.ActualRows.Count == 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					List<List<ColumnBase>> list = new List<List<ColumnBase>>();
					for (int i = 0; i < band.ActualRows.Count; i++)
					{
						List<ColumnBase> list2 = new List<ColumnBase>();
						foreach (ColumnBase column in band.ActualRows[i].Columns)
						{
							if (base.View.IsColumnNavigatable(column, isTabNavigation: false))
							{
								list2.Add(column);
							}
						}
						if (list2.Count > 0)
						{
							list.Add(list2);
						}
					}
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						bandRows.Add(list);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void FindColumn(ColumnBase column, List<List<List<ColumnBase>>> bandRows, out int bandIndex, out int rowIndex, out int columnIndex)
		{
			bandIndex = 0;
			rowIndex = 0;
			columnIndex = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < bandRows.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < bandRows[i].Count; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < bandRows[i][j].Count; k++)
					{
						if (bandRows[i][j][k] == column)
						{
							bandIndex = i;
							rowIndex = j;
							columnIndex = k;
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRightCore(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused && base.View.IsRootView)
			{
				if (base.View.IsTreeView)
				{
					object obj = ((ContentPresenter)(object)base.View.CurrentCellEditor)?.Content;
					TextEdit val = (TextEdit)((obj is TextEdit) ? obj : null);
					if (val != null && ((TextEditBase)val).Text != null)
					{
						val.SelectionStart = ((TextEditBase)val).Text.Length;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					base.View.MoveNextCellCore();
				}
			}
			else if (base.View.FocusedRowElement != null)
			{
				if (!base.View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
				{
					base.View.MoveNextCell();
					return;
				}
				base.OnRight(isCtrlPressed);
				base.View.MoveFirstNavigationIndex();
			}
		}

		public override void OnTab(bool isShiftPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
			{
				if (isShiftPressed)
				{
					base.View.MovePrevCell(isTabNavigation: true);
				}
				else
				{
					base.View.MoveNextCell(isTabNavigation: true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TabNavigation(isShiftPressed);
			}
		}

		protected override void SetRowFocus(DependencyObject row, bool focus)
		{
			SetRowFocusOnCell(row, focus);
			base.SetRowFocus(row, focus);
		}

		protected internal override void ClearAllStates()
		{
			ClearAllCellsStates();
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			DependencyObject cell = DataViewBase.FindParentCell(originalSource);
			base.ProcessMouse(originalSource);
			bool flag = base.View.CanMouseNavigationWithUpdateRow() && base.View.FindRowHandle(originalSource) == base.View.FocusedRowHandle;
			try
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					base.View.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI++;
				}
				ProcessMouseOnCell(cell);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					base.View.UpdateButtonsModeAllowRequestUI--;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool GetIsFocusedCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (base.View.CalcActualFocusedRowHandle() == rowHandle)
			{
				return base.DataControl.CurrentColumn == column;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void OnDown()
		{
			if (UseAdvVertNavigation)
			{
				DoVertNavigation(base.OnDown, isDown: true);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnDown();
			}
		}

		public override void OnUp(bool allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow)
		{
			if (UseAdvVertNavigation)
			{
				DoVertNavigation(delegate
				{
					base.OnUp(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow);
				}, isDown: false);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnUp(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow);
			}
		}

		private void DoVertNavigation(Action action, bool isDown)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = base.DataControl.CurrentColumn ?? base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[0];
			int columnIndex = columnBase.BandRow.Columns.IndexOf(columnBase);
			if (!base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				int rowIndex = columnBase.ParentBand.ActualRows.IndexOf(columnBase.BandRow);
				if (TryDoVertNavigation(columnBase.ParentBand, isDown, rowIndex, columnIndex))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			int focusedRowHandle = base.View.FocusedRowHandle;
			action();
			if (focusedRowHandle != base.View.FocusedRowHandle && UseAdvVertNavigation && !base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				TryDoVertNavigation(columnBase.ParentBand, isDown, isDown ? (-1) : columnBase.ParentBand.ActualRows.Count, columnIndex);
			}
		}

		private bool TryDoVertNavigation(BandBase band, bool isDown, int rowIndex, int columnIndex)
		{
			ColumnBase columnBase = null;
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int num2 = (isDown ? 1 : (-1));
			while (true)
			{
				rowIndex += num2;
				if (rowIndex < 0 || rowIndex > band.ActualRows.Count - 1)
				{
					break;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < band.ActualRows[rowIndex].Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					if (base.View.IsColumnNavigatable(band.ActualRows[rowIndex].Columns[i], isTabNavigation: false))
					{
						int num3 = Math.Abs(i - columnIndex);
						if (num > num3)
						{
							num = num3;
							columnBase = band.ActualRows[rowIndex].Columns[i];
						}
					}
				}
				if (columnBase != null)
				{
					base.DataControl.CurrentColumn = columnBase;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GridViewNavigationBase
	{
		private DataViewBase view;

		protected internal Locker NavigationMouseLocker = new Locker();

		internal readonly Locker KeyNavigationLocker = new Locker();

		public DataViewBase View => view;

		private bool IsRightToLeft
		{
			get
			{
				if (view.DataControl != null)
				{
					return view.DataControl.FlowDirection == FlowDirection.RightToLeft;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected DataControlBase DataControl => view.DataControl;

		public virtual bool CanSelectCell => false;

		public virtual bool ShouldRaiseRowAutomationEvents => false;

		protected GridViewNavigationBase(DataViewBase view)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.view = view;
		}

		public virtual void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnUp(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnDown()
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnPageUp()
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnPageUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPageUp();
		}

		public virtual void OnPageDown()
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnPageDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPageDown();
		}

		public virtual void OnHome(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public virtual void OnEnd(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public virtual bool OnPlus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual bool OnMinus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void OnTab(bool isShiftPressed)
		{
		}

		public virtual bool GetIsFocusedCell(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateRowsState()
		{
		}

		protected internal virtual void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
		}

		private void DoActionAndScrollIntoViewIfNeeded(Action action)
		{
			int focusedRowHandle = View.FocusedRowHandle;
			DataViewBase focusedView = View.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView;
			if (View != null)
			{
				View.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					action();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				action();
			}
			DataViewBase focusedView2 = View.MasterRootRowsContainer.FocusedView;
			if (!focusedView2.AllowScrollToFocusedRow && (focusedView != focusedView2 || focusedRowHandle != focusedView.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				focusedView2.ScrollIntoView(focusedView2.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ProcessKey(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (View.IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (RightToLeftHelper.IsLeftKey(e.Key, IsRightToLeft))
			{
				OnLeft(ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			if (RightToLeftHelper.IsRightKey(e.Key, IsRightToLeft))
			{
				OnRight(ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
				e.Handled = true;
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Key)
			{
			case Key.Up:
				if (View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
				{
					OnUp(ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
				}
				else
				{
					DoActionAndScrollIntoViewIfNeeded(delegate
					{
						OnUp(ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
					});
				}
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Down:
				if (View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
				{
					OnDown();
				}
				else
				{
					DoActionAndScrollIntoViewIfNeeded(OnDown);
				}
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Prior:
				OnPageUp(e);
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Next:
				OnPageDown(e);
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Home:
				DoActionAndScrollIntoViewIfNeeded(delegate
				{
					OnHome(e);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.End:
				DoActionAndScrollIntoViewIfNeeded(delegate
				{
					OnEnd(e);
				});
				e.Handled = true;
				break;
			case Key.Add:
			case Key.OemPlus:
				if (!View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
				{
					e.Handled = OnPlus(ModifierKeysHelper.IsOnlyCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
				}
				break;
			case Key.Subtract:
			case Key.OemMinus:
				if (!View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
				{
					e.Handled = OnMinus(ModifierKeysHelper.IsOnlyCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
				}
				break;
			case Key.Tab:
				if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)) && !View.AllowLeaveFocusOnTab && !View.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
				{
					OnTab(ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(ModifierKeysHelper.GetKeyboardModifiers(e)));
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearAllStates()
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldExpandRow()
		{
			if (View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				return !View.IsExpanded(View.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldCollapseRow()
		{
			if (View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				return View.IsExpanded(View.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public abstract class GridViewRowNavigationBase : GridViewNavigationBase
	{
		public override bool ShouldRaiseRowAutomationEvents => true;

		protected GridViewRowNavigationBase(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnLeft(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused || base.View.FocusedRowElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				if (base.View.IsExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					base.View.CollapseFocusedRowCore();
				}
				else
				{
					base.View.MoveParentRow();
				}
				return;
			}
			IScrollInfo rootDataPresenter = base.View.RootDataPresenter;
			if (rootDataPresenter.ExtentWidth <= rootDataPresenter.ViewportWidth)
			{
				base.View.MoveParentRow();
			}
			else
			{
				rootDataPresenter.LineLeft();
			}
		}

		public override void OnRight(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused || base.View.FocusedRowElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.View.IsExpandableRowFocused())
			{
				if (!base.View.IsExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
				{
					base.View.ExpandFocusedRowCore();
				}
				else
				{
					base.View.MoveNextRow();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IScrollInfo rootDataPresenter = base.View.RootDataPresenter;
				rootDataPresenter.LineRight();
			}
		}

		public override void OnUp(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				RowData rowData = base.View.GetRowData(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (rowData != null && rowData.UpdateButtonIsFocused())
				{
					if (base.View.CurrentCellEditor != null)
					{
						((UIElement)(object)base.View.CurrentCellEditor).Focus();
					}
					else
					{
						base.View.MoveLastCell();
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				KeyNavigationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.MovePrevRow();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MovePrevRow();
			}
		}

		public override void OnDown()
		{
			if (base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				RowData rowData = base.View.GetRowData(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (rowData != null && !rowData.UpdateButtonIsFocused())
				{
					if (base.View.IsEditing)
					{
						base.View.CloseEditor();
					}
					rowData.UpdateButtonTabPress(prev: false);
					return;
				}
			}
			if (base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				KeyNavigationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.MoveNextRow();
				});
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MoveNextRow();
			}
		}

		public override void OnPageUp()
		{
			base.View.MovePrevPage();
		}

		public override void OnPageDown()
		{
			base.View.MoveNextPage();
		}

		public override void OnHome(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.View.MoveFirstOrFirstMasterRow();
		}

		public override void OnEnd(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			base.View.MoveLastOrLastMasterRow();
		}

		public override bool OnPlus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAutoFilterRowFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isCtrlPressed && base.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.SetMasterRowExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle, expand: true, null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.View.ExpandFocusedRowCore();
		}

		public override bool OnMinus(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.IsAutoFilterRowFocused)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (isCtrlPressed && base.View.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.SetMasterRowExpanded(base.View.FocusedRowHandle, expand: false, null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return base.View.CollapseFocusedRowCore();
		}

		protected void TabNavigation(bool isShiftPressed)
		{
			if (isShiftPressed)
			{
				base.View.SelectRowForce();
				base.View.MovePrevCell(isTabNavigation: true);
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.MoveNextCell(isTabNavigation: true);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateRowsStateCore()
		{
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = base.View.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				FrameworkElement currentRow = gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow;
				if (currentRow != null)
				{
					SetRowFocus(currentRow, gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData.IsFocusedRow());
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearAllStates()
		{
			if (base.View != null && base.View.DataControl != null)
			{
				GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = new GridRowsEnumerator(base.View, base.View.RootNodeContainer);
				while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SetRowFocus(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow, focus: false);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ProcessMouse(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			int handle = base.View.FindRowHandle(originalSource);
			if (handle == int.MinValue)
			{
				IDataViewHitInfo dataViewHitInfo = base.View.RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(originalSource);
				if (dataViewHitInfo != null && dataViewHitInfo.IsDataArea)
				{
					base.View.CommitEditingInternal();
				}
				return;
			}
			base.View.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				NavigationMouseLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.FocusViewAndRow(base.View, handle, NavigationType.Click);
				});
			});
		}

		protected void ProcessMouseOnCell(DependencyObject cell)
		{
			if (cell == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (cell != null)
			{
				int navigationIndex = ColumnBase.GetNavigationIndex(cell);
				if (((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)base.View.InplaceEditorOwner).IsActiveEditorHaveValidationError())
				{
					DependencyObject element = DataViewBase.FindParentRow(cell);
					if (IsRowAndColumnChanged(DataViewBase.GetRowHandle(element).Value, navigationIndex))
					{
						base.View.RowsStateDirty = true;
						return;
					}
				}
				if ((base.View.VisibleColumnsCore == null || base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count <= navigationIndex || !base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[navigationIndex].AllowFocus) && base.View.FocusedRowHandle != -2147483645)
				{
					if (base.DataControl.CurrentColumn != null && !base.DataControl.CurrentColumn.AllowFocus)
					{
						base.DataControl.ReInitializeCurrentColumn();
					}
					return;
				}
				base.View.NavigationIndex = navigationIndex;
			}
			base.View.RowsStateDirty = true;
		}

		protected virtual void SetRowFocus(DependencyObject row, bool focus)
		{
			DataViewBase.SetIsFocusedRow(row, focus);
			if (focus)
			{
				base.View.ProcessFocusedElement();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateCellsStateCore(DependencyObject row, bool focusedRow)
		{
			GridCellsEnumerator gridCellsEnumerator = new GridCellsEnumerator((FrameworkElement)row);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)gridCellsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				bool flag = focusedRow && gridCellsEnumerator.CurrentNavigationIndex == gridCellsEnumerator.RowCurrentView.NavigationIndex && !(((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current is IRowMarginControl) && ((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current is UIElement && UIElementHelper.IsVisibleInTree((UIElement)((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current);
				DataViewBase.SetIsFocusedCell(((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current, flag);
				if (flag)
				{
					gridCellsEnumerator.RowCurrentView.CurrentCell = ((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current;
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ClearAllCellsState(DependencyObject row)
		{
			GridCellsEnumerator gridCellsEnumerator = new GridCellsEnumerator((FrameworkElement)row);
			while (((NestedObjectEnumeratorBase)gridCellsEnumerator).MoveNext())
			{
				DataViewBase.SetIsFocusedCell(((VisualTreeEnumerator)gridCellsEnumerator).Current, focused: false);
			}
		}

		protected internal sealed override void UpdateRowsState()
		{
			if (base.View != null && base.View.DataControl != null)
			{
				UpdateRowsStateCore();
			}
		}

		protected void SetRowFocusOnCell(DependencyObject row, bool focus)
		{
			if (DataViewBase.GetIsFocusedRow(row) != focus || row == base.View.FocusedRowElement || focus)
			{
				UpdateCellsStateCore(row, focus);
			}
		}

		protected void ClearAllCellsStates()
		{
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = new GridRowsEnumerator(base.View, base.View.RootNodeContainer);
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				ClearAllCellsState(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow);
				SetRowFocus(gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow, focus: false);
			}
			base.View.CurrentCell = null;
		}

		private bool IsRowAndColumnChanged(int rowNavigationIndex, int cellNavigationIndex)
		{
			if (base.View.FocusedRowHandle != rowNavigationIndex)
			{
				return cellNavigationIndex != base.View.NavigationIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	public class GridViewRowNavigation : GridViewRowNavigationBase
	{
		protected ITableView GridView => (ITableView)base.View;

		public GridViewRowNavigation(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnUp(bool isCtrlPressed)
		{
			if (base.View.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction)
			{
				RowData rowData = base.View.GetRowData(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (rowData != null && rowData.UpdateButtonIsFocused())
				{
					if (base.View.CurrentCellEditor != null)
					{
						((UIElement)(object)base.View.CurrentCellEditor).Focus();
					}
					else
					{
						base.View.MoveLastCell();
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (base.View.IsEditing)
			{
				KeyNavigationLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					GridView.TableViewBehavior.MovePrevRow(isCtrlPressed);
				});
			}
			else
			{
				GridView.TableViewBehavior.MovePrevRow(isCtrlPressed);
			}
		}
	}

	public class RemoveColumnDropTarget : IDropTarget
	{
		private DataViewBase dataView;

		public ColumnHeaderDragElement dragElement { get; protected set; }

		public virtual DataViewBase GetDataView(UIElement source)
		{
			return dataView ?? (dataView = DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(source));
		}

		public virtual void Drop(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (IsPositionInDropZone(source, pt))
			{
				ColumnChooserDropTarget.DropColumnCore(source);
			}
			DragDropScroller.StopScrolling(dataView);
		}

		public virtual void OnDragLeave()
		{
			if (dragElement != null)
			{
				BaseGridColumnHeader.SetIsInDropArea(((HeaderDragElementBase)dragElement).DragPreviewElement, value: false);
				DragDropScroller.StopScrolling(dataView);
			}
		}

		public virtual void OnDragOver(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			DragDropElementHelper dragDropHelper = ((BaseGridHeader)source).DragDropHelper;
			dragElement = (ColumnHeaderDragElement)(object)dragDropHelper.DragElement;
			BaseGridColumnHeader.SetIsInDropArea(((HeaderDragElementBase)dragElement).DragPreviewElement, CanDrop(source, pt));
			IExtendedColumnChooserView extendedColumnChooserView = BaseGridHeader.GetExtendedColumnChooserView(source);
			if (extendedColumnChooserView == null || !extendedColumnChooserView.IsInScrollingMode)
			{
				DragDropScroller.StartScrolling(dataView);
			}
		}

		private bool CanDrop(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			if (!ColumnChooserDropTarget.IsForbiddenUngroupGesture(source))
			{
				return IsPositionInDropZone(source, pt);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsPositionInDropZone(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point pt)
		{
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = GetDataView(source);
			if (!DesignerHelper.GetValue(dataViewBase, dataViewBase.AllowMoveColumnToDropArea, designerValue: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsPositionInsideElement(dataViewBase.RootView.DataControl, pt, new Thickness(0.0)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (GetTargetElement(dataViewBase) == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !IsPositionInsideElement(GetTargetElement(dataViewBase), pt, new Thickness(50.0));
		}

		protected virtual UIElement GetTargetElement(DataViewBase view)
		{
			return view.HeadersPanel;
		}

		protected virtual bool IsPositionInsideElement(UIElement source, System.Windows.Point location, Thickness margin)
		{
			UIElement topLevelVisual = LayoutHelper.GetTopLevelVisual((DependencyObject)source);
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(source, topLevelVisual);
			System.Windows.Point point = new System.Windows.Point(location.X - relativeElementRect.X, location.Y - relativeElementRect.Y);
			return LayoutHelper.IsPointInsideElementBounds(point, (FrameworkElement)source, margin);
		}
	}
	public class ScrollBarCombineHelper
	{
		private double maxRatio;

		private double maxInvisiblePart;

		private double finalViewport;

		private double finalExtent;

		public double FinalViewport => finalViewport;

		public double FinalExtent => finalExtent;

		public void ProcessScrollInfo(double viewPort, double extent)
		{
			if (viewPort != 0.0)
			{
				double num = extent / viewPort;
				if (num > maxRatio)
				{
					maxRatio = num;
					finalExtent = extent;
					finalViewport = viewPort;
				}
				maxInvisiblePart = Math.Max(maxInvisiblePart, extent - viewPort);
			}
		}

		public double ConvertToRealOffset(double scrollBarOffset, double viewPort, double extent)
		{
			if (finalExtent == finalViewport || viewPort >= extent)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			scrollBarOffset *= maxInvisiblePart / (finalExtent - finalViewport);
			return Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(scrollBarOffset, extent - viewPort));
		}
	}
	public class ScrollByItemInfo : ScrollInfoBase
	{
		public override double Offset => Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(base.Offset, ScrollOwner.ItemCount - 1));

		public ScrollByItemInfo(IScrollInfoOwner scrollOwner, SizeHelperBase sizeHelper)
			: base(scrollOwner, sizeHelper)
		{
		}

		protected override double ValidateOffsetCore(double value)
		{
			if (value > base.Extent - GetScrollableViewportSize())
			{
				value = base.Extent - GetScrollableViewportSize();
			}
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool OnBeforeChangeOffset()
		{
			return ScrollOwner.OnBeforeChangeItemScrollOffset();
		}

		protected override void OnScrollInfoChanged()
		{
			ScrollOwner.OnDefineScrollInfoChanged();
		}
	}

		}

		protected override double ValidateOffset(double value)

	public class ScrollByPixelInfo : ScrollInfoBase
	{
		public ScrollByPixelInfo(IScrollInfoOwner scrollOwner, SizeHelperBase sizeHelper)
			: base(scrollOwner, sizeHelper)
		{
		}

		protected override double ValidateOffsetCore(double value)
		{
			if (value <= 0.0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Min(value, Math.Max(0.0, base.Extent - base.Viewport));
		}

		protected override void NeedMeasure()
		{
			base.NeedMeasure();
			ScrollOwner.InvalidateHorizontalScrolling();
		}

		protected override void OnScrollInfoChanged()
		{
			if (Offset + base.Viewport > base.Extent)
			{
				fOffset = Math.Max(0.0, base.Extent - base.Viewport);
			}
			ScrollOwner.OnSecondaryScrollInfoChanged();
		}

		protected override bool OnBeforeChangeOffset()
		{
			return ScrollOwner.OnBeforeChangePixelScrollOffset();
		}

		public override void LineDown()
		{
			LinesDown(ScrollOwner.ScrollStep);
		}

		public override void LineUp()
		{
			LinesUp(ScrollOwner.ScrollStep);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ScrollInfo : DependencyObject, IScrollInfo
	{

		private ScrollInfoBase verticalScrollInfo;

		private ScrollInfoBase horizontalScrollInfo;

		private ScrollViewer scrollViewer;

		private bool canHorizontallyScroll = true;

		protected IScrollInfoOwner Owner => owner;

		public abstract ScrollByItemInfo DefineSizeScrollInfo { get; }

		public abstract ScrollByPixelInfo SecondarySizeScrollInfo { get; }

		public virtual ScrollInfoBase HorizontalScrollInfo

		public virtual ScrollInfoBase VerticalScrollInfo

				if (verticalScrollInfo == null)

					verticalScrollInfo = CreateVerticalScrollInfo();
				}
				return verticalScrollInfo;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollInfo.CanHorizontallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				return canHorizontallyScroll;
			}
			set
			{
				canHorizontallyScroll = value;
			}
		}

		bool IScrollInfo.CanVerticallyScroll
		{
			get
			{
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		double IScrollInfo.ExtentHeight => VerticalScrollInfo.Extent;

		double IScrollInfo.ExtentWidth => HorizontalScrollInfo.Extent;

		double IScrollInfo.VerticalOffset => VerticalScrollInfo.Offset;

		double IScrollInfo.HorizontalOffset => HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;

		double IScrollInfo.ViewportHeight => VerticalScrollInfo.Viewport;

		double IScrollInfo.ViewportWidth => HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport;

		ScrollViewer IScrollInfo.ScrollOwner
		{

			}
			set

				scrollViewer = value;
			}
		}

		public ScrollInfo(IScrollInfoOwner owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public virtual void ClearScrollInfo()
		{
			horizontalScrollInfo = null;
			verticalScrollInfo = null;
		}

		protected abstract ScrollInfoBase CreateHorizontalScrollInfo();

		protected abstract ScrollInfoBase CreateVerticalScrollInfo();

		void IScrollInfo.LineDown()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.LineDown();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineUp()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.LineUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineLeft()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.LineUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.LineRight()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.LineDown();
		}

		Rect IScrollInfo.MakeVisible(Visual visual, Rect rectangle)
		{
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(visual as UIElement, (UIElement)Owner.ScrollContentPresenter);
			relativeElementRect.Y -= owner.ScrollInsideActiveEditorIfNeeded(visual, rectangle);
			if (relativeElementRect.Bottom > Owner.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight)
			{
				relativeElementRect.Y -= relativeElementRect.Bottom - Owner.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight;
			}
			if (relativeElementRect.Top < 0.0)
			{
				relativeElementRect.Y -= relativeElementRect.Top;
			}
			if (relativeElementRect.Right > Owner.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
			{
				relativeElementRect.Width -= Math.Min(relativeElementRect.Width, relativeElementRect.Right - Owner.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth);
			}
			if (relativeElementRect.Left < 0.0)
			{
				relativeElementRect.X -= relativeElementRect.Left;
			}
			FrameworkElement frameworkElement = FocusRectPresenter.FindScrollHost(visual, FocusRectPresenter.IsHorizontalScrollHostProperty);
			if (frameworkElement != null)
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect2 = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)frameworkElement, (UIElement)owner.ScrollContentPresenter);
				relativeElementRect.X += relativeElementRect2.Left;
			}
			return relativeElementRect;
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelLeft()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelRight()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.MouseWheelDown();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.MouseWheelUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageDown()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.PageDown();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageUp()
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.PageUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageLeft()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.PageUp();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.PageRight()
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.PageDown();
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetHorizontalOffset(double offset)
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.SetOffset(offset);
		}

		void IScrollInfo.SetVerticalOffset(double offset)
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.SetOffset(offset);
		}

		public void SetVerticalOffsetForce(double value)
		{
			VerticalScrollInfo.SetOffsetForce(value);
		}

		public void SetHorizontalOffsetForce(double value)
		{
			HorizontalScrollInfo.SetOffsetForce(value);
		}

		public virtual void OnScrollInfoChanged()
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (scrollViewer != null)
			{
				scrollViewer.InvalidateScrollInfo();
				Owner.IsTouchScrollBarsMode = (int)ScrollBarExtensions.GetScrollBarMode((DependencyObject)scrollViewer) == 1;
			}
		}

		public void UpdateIsHorizontalScrollBarVisible()
		{
			if (scrollViewer != null)
			{
				Owner.IsHorizontalScrollBarVisible = scrollViewer.ComputedHorizontalScrollBarVisibility == Visibility.Visible;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ScrollInfoBase
	{
		private static TimeSpan defaultUpdateInterval = new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 50);

		private IScrollInfoOwner scrollOwner;

		private SizeHelperBase sizeHelper;

		private double extent;

		private double viewport;

		protected double fOffset;

		private bool isValid;

		private DispatcherTimer timer;

		private double prevOffset;

		protected virtual IScrollInfoOwner ScrollOwner => scrollOwner;

		protected SizeHelperBase SizeHelper => sizeHelper;

		public double Viewport => viewport;

		public double Extent => extent;

		public virtual double Offset => fOffset;

		public ScrollInfoBase(IScrollInfoOwner scrollOwner, SizeHelperBase sizeHelper)
		{
			this.scrollOwner = scrollOwner;
			this.sizeHelper = sizeHelper;
		}

		public virtual void LineDown()
		{
			LinesDown(1.0);
		}

		public virtual void LineUp()
		{
			LinesUp(1.0);
		}

		public void PageDown()
		{
			SetOffsetForce(Offset + GetScrollableViewportSize());
		}

		public void PageUp()
		{
			SetOffsetForce(Offset - GetScrollableViewportSize());
		}

		public void MouseWheelUp()
		{
			if (IsScrollingPerPage())
			{
				PageUp();
			}
			else
			{
				LinesUp(scrollOwner.WheelScrollLines);
			}
		}

		public void MouseWheelDown()
		{
			if (IsScrollingPerPage())
			{
				PageDown();
			}
			else
			{
				LinesDown(scrollOwner.WheelScrollLines);
			}
		}

		internal double GetScrollableViewportSize()
		{
			return Viewport;
		}

		protected bool IsScrollingPerPage()
		{
			return scrollOwner.WheelScrollLines == -1.0;
		}

		public void SetOffset(double value)
		{
			if (ScrollOwner.IsDeferredScrolling)
			{
				SetDeferredOffset(value);
			}
			else
			{
				SetOffsetForce(value);
			}
		}

		public virtual void SetOffsetForce(double value, bool skipValidation = false)
		{
			SetOffsetForce(value, onChanged: true, skipValidation);
			NeedMeasure();
		}

		private void SetOffsetForce(double value, bool onChanged, bool skipValidation)
		{
			if (!skipValidation)
			{
				value = ValidateOffset(value);
			}
			if (fOffset != value && OnBeforeChangeOffset())
			{
				fOffset = value;
				if (onChanged)
				{
					OnScrollInfoChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetDeferredOffset(double value)
		{
			if (double.IsNaN(prevOffset))
			{
				prevOffset = fOffset;
			}
			SetOffsetForce(value, onChanged: false, skipValidation: false);
			if (timer == null)
			{
				timer = new DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Render);
				timer.Interval = defaultUpdateInterval;
				timer.Tick += timer_Tick;
				timer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void timer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			timer.Stop();
			timer = null;
			OnTimerTick();
		}

		internal void OnTimerTick()
		{
			if (!OnBeforeChangeOffset())
			{
				fOffset = prevOffset;
			}
			OnScrollInfoChanged();
			NeedMeasure();
			prevOffset = double.NaN;
		}

		protected virtual double ValidateOffset(double value)
		{
			return ValidateOffsetCore(Math.Ceiling(value));
		}

		protected virtual void ValidateScrollInfo()
		{
		}

		protected abstract bool OnBeforeChangeOffset();

		public void Invalidate()
		{
			isValid = false;
		}

		public void UpdateScrollInfo(double viewport, double extent)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Extent != extent)
			{
				flag = true;
				this.extent = extent;
			}
			if (Viewport != viewport)
			{
				this.viewport = viewport;
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag || !isValid)
			{
				isValid = true;
				OnScrollInfoChanged();
			}
		}

		protected abstract double ValidateOffsetCore(double value);

		protected virtual void NeedMeasure()
		{
			ScrollOwner.InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected abstract void OnScrollInfoChanged();

		protected void LinesDown(double lineSize)
		{
			SetOffsetForce(Offset + lineSize);
		}

		protected void LinesUp(double lineSize)
		{
			SetOffsetForce(Offset - lineSize);
		}
	}

			});
		}
