		private abstract class UpdateColumnsStrategyBase
		{
			internal abstract IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedVisibleColumns(FixedStyle fixedStyle, DataViewBase view);

			internal abstract bool HasFixedLeftElements(ITableView view);

			internal abstract bool HasFixedRightElements(ITableView view);

			internal abstract void UpdateColumnDataWidths(DataViewBase view, GridViewInfo viewInfo, out double totalFixedNoneSize, out double totalFixedLeftSize, out double totalFixedRightSize);

			internal Thickness GetScrollingMargin(ITableView tableView, double secondaryOffset, double virtualizationOffset)
			{
				return GetScrollingMarginCore(secondaryOffset, virtualizationOffset);
			}

			protected abstract Thickness GetScrollingMarginCore(double secondaryOffset, double virtualizationOffset);

			internal abstract List<ColumnBase> GetViewportVisibleColumns(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior);

			internal abstract void FillByLastFixedColumn(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, double arrangeWidth);

			internal abstract FixedStyle GetFixedStyle(BaseColumn column, TableViewBehavior viewBehavior);

			protected void GetColumnVisibleBounds(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, out double leftVisibleBound, out double rightVisibleBound)
			{
				if (!IsTotalSummaryVisible(viewBehavior) || (viewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements && viewBehavior.HasFixedRightElements))
				{
					leftVisibleBound = viewBehavior.HorizontalOffset - viewBehavior.ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
					rightVisibleBound = viewBehavior.HorizontalOffset + viewBehavior.TableView.HorizontalViewport;
					return;
				}
				leftVisibleBound = viewBehavior.HorizontalOffset;
				if (!viewBehavior.HasFixedLeftElements)
				{
					if (viewBehavior.TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons)
					{
						leftVisibleBound -= viewBehavior.TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidth;
					}
					leftVisibleBound -= ((viewBehavior.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? 0.0 : viewBehavior.ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent);
					if (viewBehavior.TableView.ViewBase.IsRootView && viewBehavior.TableView.ActualShowIndicator)
					{
						leftVisibleBound -= viewBehavior.TableView.ActualIndicatorWidth;
					}
				}
				double num = 0.0;
				num = viewBehavior.TableView.TotalSummaryFixedNoneContentWidth;
				rightVisibleBound = leftVisibleBound + num;
			}

			private bool IsTotalSummaryVisible(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
			{
				List<DataControlBase> dataControls = new List<DataControlBase>();
				viewBehavior.View.DataControl.EnumerateThisAndParentDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
				{
					dataControls.Add(dataControl);
				});
				foreach (DataControlBase item in dataControls)
				{
					if (item.viewCore.ShowTotalSummary)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class TableViewUpdateColumnsStrategy : UpdateColumnsStrategyBase
		{
			public static readonly UpdateColumnsStrategyBase Instance = new TableViewUpdateColumnsStrategy();

			internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedVisibleColumns(FixedStyle fixedStyle, DataViewBase view)
			{
				IList<ColumnBase> list = new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>();
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnBase columnBase = view.VisibleColumnsCore[i];
					if (columnBase.Fixed == fixedStyle)
					{
						BaseColumn.SetActualCollectionIndex((DependencyObject)(object)columnBase, num++);
						list.Add(columnBase);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			internal override bool HasFixedLeftElements(ITableView view)
			{
				return view.TableViewBehavior.FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count > 0;
			}

			internal override bool HasFixedRightElements(ITableView view)
			{
				return view.TableViewBehavior.fixedRightVisibleColumns.Count > 0;
			}

			internal override void UpdateColumnDataWidths(DataViewBase view, GridViewInfo viewInfo, out double totalFixedNoneSize, out double totalFixedLeftSize, out double totalFixedRightSize)
			{
				totalFixedNoneSize = 0.0;
				totalFixedLeftSize = 0.0;
				totalFixedRightSize = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < view.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnBase columnBase = view.VisibleColumnsCore[i];
					switch (columnBase.Fixed)
					{
					case FixedStyle.None:
						totalFixedNoneSize += columnBase.ActualDataWidth;
						break;
					case FixedStyle.Left:
						totalFixedLeftSize += columnBase.ActualDataWidth;
						break;
					default:
						totalFixedRightSize += columnBase.ActualDataWidth;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override Thickness GetScrollingMarginCore(double secondaryOffset, double virtualizationOffset)
			{
				return new Thickness(secondaryOffset + virtualizationOffset, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}

			internal override List<ColumnBase> GetViewportVisibleColumns(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
			{
				List<ColumnBase> list = new List<ColumnBase>();
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				int num3 = 0;
				viewBehavior.ResetHorizontalVirtualizationOffset();
				GetColumnVisibleBounds(viewBehavior, out var leftVisibleBound, out var rightVisibleBound);
				while (num3 < viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns.Count)
				{
					if (num + viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[num3].ActualDataWidth > leftVisibleBound)
					{
						list.Add(viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[num3]);
					}
					if (num <= leftVisibleBound)
					{
						viewBehavior.HorizontalVirtualizationOffset = num;
						viewBehavior.HorizontalHeaderVirtualizationOffset = num2;
					}
					num += viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[num3].ActualDataWidth;
					num2 += viewBehavior.FixedNoneVisibleColumns[num3].ActualHeaderWidth;
					num3++;
					if (!(num <= rightVisibleBound))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			internal override void FillByLastFixedColumn(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, double arrangeWidth)
			{
				if (!viewBehavior.TableView.AutoWidth && viewBehavior.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count > 1 && viewBehavior.FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count != 0)
				{
					double desiredColumnsWidth = viewBehavior.ViewInfo.GetDesiredColumnsWidth(viewBehavior.View.VisibleColumnsCore);
					double num = Math.Max(0.0, arrangeWidth - desiredColumnsWidth);
					if (!(num <= 0.0))
					{
						ColumnBase columnBase = viewBehavior.View.VisibleColumnsCore[viewBehavior.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1];
						columnBase.ActualDataWidth += num;
						columnBase.ActualHeaderWidth += num;
					}
				}
			}

			internal override FixedStyle GetFixedStyle(BaseColumn column, TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
			{
				return column.Fixed;
			}
		}

		private class BandedViewUpdateColumnsStrategy : UpdateColumnsStrategyBase
		{
			public static readonly UpdateColumnsStrategyBase Instance = new BandedViewUpdateColumnsStrategy();

			internal override IList<ColumnBase> GetFixedVisibleColumns(FixedStyle fixedStyle, DataViewBase view)
			{
				IList<ColumnBase> result = new ObservableCollection<ColumnBase>();
				BandsLayoutBase.ForeachVisibleBand(GetFixedBands(fixedStyle, view), delegate(BandBase band)
				{
					foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
					{
						foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
						{
							result.Add(column);
						}
					}
				});
				return result;
			}

			private IEnumerable GetFixedBands(FixedStyle fixedStyle, DataViewBase view)
			{
				return fixedStyle switch
				{
					FixedStyle.Left => view.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands, 
					FixedStyle.Right => view.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedRightVisibleBands, 
					_ => view.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedNoneVisibleBands, 
				};
			}

			internal override bool HasFixedLeftElements(ITableView view)
			{
				return view.TableViewBehavior.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands.Count > 0;
			}

			internal override bool HasFixedRightElements(ITableView view)
			{
				return view.TableViewBehavior.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedRightVisibleBands.Count > 0;
			}

			internal override void UpdateColumnDataWidths(DataViewBase view, GridViewInfo viewInfo, out double totalFixedNoneSize, out double totalFixedLeftSize, out double totalFixedRightSize)
			{
				totalFixedNoneSize = 0.0;
				totalFixedLeftSize = 0.0;
				totalFixedRightSize = 0.0;
				for (int i = 0; i < view.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.VisibleBands.Count; i++)
				{
					BandBase bandBase = view.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.VisibleBands[i];
					double num = bandBase.ActualHeaderWidth;
					if (i == 0)
					{
						num = ((view.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? (num - viewInfo.ActualLeftDataAreaIndent) : (num - viewInfo.FirstColumnIndent));
					}
					switch (bandBase.Fixed)
					{
					case FixedStyle.None:
						totalFixedNoneSize += num;
						break;
					case FixedStyle.Left:
						totalFixedLeftSize += num;
						break;
					default:
						totalFixedRightSize += num;
						break;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override Thickness GetScrollingMarginCore(double secondaryOffset, double virtualizationOffset)
			{
				return new Thickness(secondaryOffset, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
			}

			internal override List<ColumnBase> GetViewportVisibleColumns(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
			{
				List<ColumnBase> viewportColumns = new List<ColumnBase>();
				double currentWidth = 0.0;
				GetColumnVisibleBounds(viewBehavior, out var leftVisibleBound, out var rightVisibleBound);
				BandsLayoutBase.ForeachVisibleBand(viewBehavior.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedNoneVisibleBands, delegate(BandBase band)
				{
					currentWidth = GetBandViewportVisibleColumns(band, currentWidth, leftVisibleBound, rightVisibleBound, viewBehavior, viewportColumns);
				});
				return viewportColumns;
			}

			private double GetBandViewportVisibleColumns(BandBase band, double currentWidth, double leftVisibleBound, double rightVisibleBound, TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, List<ColumnBase> viewportColumns)
			{
				if (band.ActualRows.Count == 0)
				{
					if (band.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
					{
						return currentWidth + band.ActualHeaderWidth;
					}
					return currentWidth;
				}
				foreach (BandRow actualRow in band.ActualRows)
				{
					double num = currentWidth;
					foreach (ColumnBase column in actualRow.Columns)
					{
						if (num > rightVisibleBound + viewBehavior.viewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent)
						{
							break;
						}
						if (num + column.ActualHeaderWidth > leftVisibleBound)
						{
							viewportColumns.Add(column);
						}
						num += column.ActualHeaderWidth;
					}
				}
				if (band.VisibleBands.Count == 0)
				{
					return currentWidth + band.ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
				return currentWidth;
			}

			internal override void FillByLastFixedColumn(TableViewBehavior viewBehavior, double arrangeWidth)
			{
			}

			internal override FixedStyle GetFixedStyle(BaseColumn column, TableViewBehavior viewBehavior)
			{
				return viewBehavior.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.GetRootBand(column.ParentBandInternal).Fixed;
			}
		}

			}));
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateBandsLayoutProperties()
		{
			base.UpdateBandsLayoutProperties();
			if (base.DataControl?.BandsLayoutCore != null)
			{
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ShowBandsPanel = TableView.ShowBandsPanel;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowChangeColumnParent = TableView.AllowChangeColumnParent;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowChangeBandParent = TableView.AllowChangeBandParent;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ShowBandsInCustomizationForm = TableView.ShowBandsInCustomizationForm;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandMoving = TableView.AllowBandMoving;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandResizing = TableView.AllowBandResizing;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowAdvancedVerticalNavigation = TableView.AllowAdvancedVerticalNavigation;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowAdvancedHorizontalNavigation = TableView.AllowAdvancedHorizontalNavigation;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparer = TableView.ColumnChooserBandsSortOrderComparer;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.BandHeaderTemplate = TableView.BandHeaderTemplate;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.BandHeaderTemplateSelector = TableView.BandHeaderTemplateSelector;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.BandHeaderToolTipTemplate = TableView.BandHeaderToolTipTemplate;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.PrintBandHeaderStyle = TableView.PrintBandHeaderStyle;
				base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.AllowBandMultiRow = TableView.AllowBandMultiRow;
				UpdateBandsIndicator();
			}
		}

		internal override void NotifyBandsLayoutChanged()
		{
			UpdateViewRowData(delegate(RowData rowData)
			{
				rowData.UpdateCellsPanel();
			});
		}

		internal override void NotifyFixedNoneBandsChanged()
		{
			UpdateViewRowData(delegate(RowData rowData)
			{
				rowData.UpdateClientFixedNoneBands();
			});
		}

		internal override void NotifyFixedLeftBandsChanged()
		{
			UpdateViewRowData(delegate(RowData rowData)
			{
				rowData.UpdateClientFixedLeftBands();
			});
		}

		internal override void NotifyFixedRightBandsChanged()

			{

			}

		}

		private void BestFitColumnIfAllowed(BaseColumn column, bool updateWidths)
		{
			if (CanBestFitColumn(column))
			{
				BestFitColumnCore(column, updateWidths);
			}
		}

		internal bool CanBestFitColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (DefaultBooleanExtension.GetValue(column.AllowResizing, TableView.AllowResizing))
			{
				return CanBestFitColumnCore(column);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool CanBestFitColumnCore(BaseColumn column)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return DefaultBooleanExtension.GetValue(column.AllowBestFit, TableView.AllowBestFit);
		}

		internal void BestFitColumn(object commandParameter)
		{
			BaseColumn baseColumn = ((!(commandParameter is BandBase)) ? base.View.GetColumnByCommandParameter(commandParameter) : (commandParameter as BaseColumn));
			if (baseColumn != null)
			{
				BestFitColumn(baseColumn);
			}
		}

		internal void BestFitColumn(BaseColumn column)
		{
			BestFitColumnCore(column, column.IsBand || base.DataControl.BandsCore.Count == 0);
		}

		private void BestFitColumnCore(BaseColumn column, bool updateWidths)
		{
			if (IsBestFitControlDecoratorLoaded && column.GetAllowResizing())
			{
				if (!column.IsBand)
				{
					ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ResetBestFitBandWidth(column.GetRootParentBand());
				}
				ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyBestFit(column, CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore(column), updateWidths);
			}
		}

		internal void BestFitColumns()
		{
			if (!IsBestFitControlDecoratorLoaded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.BandsCore.Count == 0)
			{
				Dictionary<ColumnBase, double> widthsCache = new Dictionary<ColumnBase, double>();
				foreach (ColumnBase item in base.View.VisibleColumnsCore)
				{
					if (CanBestFitColumn(item))
					{
						widthsCache[item] = CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore(item);
					}
				}
				BestFitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
					foreach (ColumnBase key in widthsCache.Keys)
					{
						if (!key.Width.IsStar)
						{
							ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ApplyResize(key, widthsCache[key], double.MaxValue, 0.0, correctWidths: false);
						}
					}
					base.View.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
				});
				return;
			}
			BestFitLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				foreach (BandBase item2 in base.DataControl.BandsCore)
				{
					TableView.BestFitColumn(item2);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal override IndicatorState GetIndicatorState(RowData rowData)
		{
			int value = rowData.RowHandle.Value;
			if (value == -2147483645)
			{
				return IndicatorState.AutoFilterRow;
			}
			if (BaseEditHelper.GetValidationError((DependencyObject)(object)rowData) != null)
			{
				if (value != base.View.FocusedRowHandleCore || base.View.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.None)
				{
					return IndicatorState.Error;
				}
				return IndicatorState.FocusedError;
			}
			bool flag = value == base.View.FocusedRowHandleCore && (base.View.NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.None || base.View.IsNewItemRowHandle(base.View.FocusedRowHandleCore));
			if (!rowData.View.IsFocusedView || !flag)
			{
				if (!base.View.IsNewItemRowHandle(value))
				{
					return IndicatorState.None;
				}
				return IndicatorState.NewItemRow;
			}
			if (base.View.IsFocusedRowModified || base.View.EditFormManager.IsEditFormModified)
			{
				return IndicatorState.Changed;
			}
			if (base.View.IsEditing || base.View.IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				return IndicatorState.Editing;
			}
			return IndicatorState.Focused;
		}

		public virtual void MakeColumnVisible(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (RootDataPresenter != null && (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null || column.IsBand || column.BandRow != null))
			{
				double num = 0.0 - HorizontalOffset;
				num += GetActualColumnOffset(column);
				MakeRangeVisible(num, num + column.ActualHeaderWidth, UpdateColumnsStrategy.GetFixedStyle(column, this));
			}
		}

		private double GetActualColumnOffset(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore == null)
			{
				return GetColumnOffset((ColumnBase)column);
			}
			return GetBandOffset(column);
		}

		private double GetColumnWidth(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return column.ActualDataWidth + column.ActualBandLeftSeparatorWidthCore + column.ActualBandRightSeparatorWidthCore;
		}

		private double GetColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count && base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[i] != column; i++)
			{
				num += GetColumnWidth(base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[i]);
			}
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count > 0 && i >= FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			return num + TotalVisibleIndent;
		}

		private double GetBandOffset(BaseColumn column)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			if (base.View == null)
			{
				return num;
			}
			foreach (BandBase band in base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.GetBands(column.ParentBandInternal, isLeft: true))
			{
				num += band.ActualHeaderWidth;
			}
			if (!column.IsBand)
			{
				foreach (ColumnBase column2 in column.BandRow.Columns)
				{
					if (column2 == column)
					{
						break;
					}
					num += column2.ActualHeaderWidth;
				}
			}
			if (base.DataControl.BandsLayoutCore.FixedLeftVisibleBands.Count > 0)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void MakeCurrentCellVisible()
		{
			DependencyObject currentCell = base.View.CurrentCell;
			if (currentCell != null && DataControlBase.FindCurrentView(currentCell) != null && LayoutHelper.IsChildElement((DependencyObject)base.View.RootView, currentCell))
			{
				Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)currentCell, (UIElement)RootDataPresenter);
				double totalLeftIndent = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: false);
				MakeRangeVisible(relativeElementRect.Left - totalLeftIndent, relativeElementRect.Right - totalLeftIndent, TableViewProperties.GetFixedAreaStyle(currentCell));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void MakeRangeVisible(double left, double right, FixedStyle fixedStyle)
		{
			if (fixedStyle != FixedStyle.None)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = left - LeftIndent;
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count != 0)
			{
				num -= TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			if (num < 0.0)
			{
				RootDataPresenter.SetHorizontalOffsetForce(HorizontalOffset + num);
				return;
			}
			double num2 = right - LeftIndent - HorizontalViewportCore;
			if (num2 > 0.0)
			{
				if (FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count > 0 || FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count != 0)
				{
					num2 -= TableView.FixedLineWidth;
				}
				double num3 = num - num2;
				if (num3 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 += num3;
				}
				RootDataPresenter.SetHorizontalOffsetForce(HorizontalOffset + num2);
			}
		}

		internal double GetTotalLeftIndent(bool includeIndicator, bool includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible)
		{
			double indent = ((includeIndicator && TableView.ActualShowIndicator) ? TableView.IndicatorWidth : 0.0);
			DataControlBase originationDataControl = base.View.DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl();
			originationDataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				ITableView tableView = (ITableView)dataControl.DataView;
				indent += ((dataControl != originationDataControl) ? tableView.ActualDetailMargin.Left : 0.0);
				if ((includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible && tableView.ActualShowDetailButtons) || dataControl != originationDataControl)
				{
					indent += tableView.TableViewBehavior.ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
				}
			});
			originationDataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDetailDescriptor(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase x)
			{
				indent += x.Margin.Left;
			});
			if (TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons)
			{
				indent += TableView.ActualExpandDetailButtonWidth;
			}
			indent += ActualFixRowButtonWidth;
			return indent;
		}

		internal double GetTotalRightIndent()
		{
			double indent = 0.0;
			DataControlBase originationDataControl = base.View.DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl();
			int level = -1;
			originationDataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				level++;
				ITableView tableView = (ITableView)dataControl.DataView;
				indent += ((dataControl != originationDataControl && tableView.ActualShowDetailButtons) ? tableView.ActualDetailMargin.Right : 0.0);
			});
			originationDataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDetailDescriptor(delegate(DetailDescriptorBase x)
			{
				indent += x.Margin.Right;
			});
			return indent;
		}

		protected internal override bool OnVisibleColumnsAssigned(bool changed)
		{
			changed = UpdateFixedColumns(changed);
			DataPresenter?.UpdateSecondarySizeScrollInfo();
			base.View.DataControl.ResetGridChildPeersIfNeeded();
			return changed;
		}

		private bool UpdateFixedColumns(bool changed)
		{
			IList<ColumnBase> list = GetFixedLeftVisibleColumns();
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<ColumnBase>(FixedLeftVisibleColumns, list))
			{
				FixedLeftVisibleColumns = list;
				changed = true;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> list2 = GetFixedRightVisibleColumns();
			if (!ListHelper.AreEqual<ColumnBase>(FixedRightVisibleColumns, list2))
			{
				FixedRightVisibleColumns = list2;
				changed = true;
			}
			IList<ColumnBase> list3 = GetFixedNoneVisibleColumns();
			if (ListHelper.AreEqual<ColumnBase>(FixedNoneVisibleColumns, list3))
			{
				return changed;
			}
			FixedNoneVisibleColumns = list3;
			changed = true;
			return changed;
		}

		protected internal override KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> GetViewAndVisibleIndex(double verticalOffset, bool calcDataArea = true)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			FrameworkElement firstVisibleRow = RootDataPresenter.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			if (firstVisibleRow != null)
			{
				num = RootDataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset % 1.0 * firstVisibleRow.DesiredSize.Height;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			GridRowsEnumerator gridRowsEnumerator = base.View.RootView.CreateVisibleRowsEnumerator();
			double num3 = Math.Max(0.0, base.View.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight - RootDataPresenter.DesiredSize.Height);
			RowDataBase rowDataBase = null;
			RowNode rowNode = null;
			while (gridRowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				rowNode = gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentNode;
				rowDataBase = gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRowData;
				if (rowNode == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				FrameworkElement currentRow = gridRowsEnumerator.CurrentRow;
				if (currentRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				double actualHeight = currentRow.ActualHeight;
				double num4 = 0.0;
				if (rowDataBase.FixedRowPositionCore == FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					num2 -= num;
					num = 0.0;
					num4 = Math.Max(0.0, num2 + actualHeight - base.View.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight + base.View.RootView.DataPresenter.Panel.FixedBottomRowsHeight);
				}
				else if (rowDataBase.FixedRowPositionCore == FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					num2 += num3;
					num3 = 0.0;
				}
				num2 += actualHeight - num4;
				bool flag = verticalOffset < 0.0;
				bool flag2 = verticalOffset < num2;
				if ((num2 == base.View.RootView.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight && num4 > 0.0) || flag || flag2)
				{
					if (!(rowNode.MatchKey is GroupSummaryRowKey))
					{
						break;
					}
					return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(base.View, -1);
				}
			}
			if (rowDataBase == null)
			{
				return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(base.View, -1);
			}
			DataViewBase dataViewBase = rowDataBase.View;
			int value = -1;
			if (!(rowNode is DataRowNode))
			{
				return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(dataViewBase, value);
			}
			if (!calcDataArea && verticalOffset > num2)
			{
				return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(base.View, int.MinValue);
			}
			value = dataViewBase.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(((DataRowNode)rowNode).RowHandle.Value);
			return new KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>(dataViewBase, value);
		}

		internal ColumnBase GetColumn(double offset)
		{
			if (TableView.ShowIndicator)
			{
				offset -= TableView.IndicatorWidth;
			}
			if (offset < 0.0 - DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset)
			{
				return base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[0];
			}
			double num = ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent;
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedLeftVisibleColumn in FixedLeftVisibleColumns)
			{
				if (offset <= num + GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn))
				{
					return fixedLeftVisibleColumn;
				}
				num += GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn);
			}
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count != 0)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			double num2 = num - DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset;
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedNoneVisibleColumn in FixedNoneVisibleColumns)
			{
				bool flag = offset - num2 - DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset > DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport + TableView.FixedLineWidth;
				if (FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count != 0 && flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (offset <= num2 + GetColumnWidth(fixedNoneVisibleColumn))
				{
					return fixedNoneVisibleColumn;
				}
				num2 += GetColumnWidth(fixedNoneVisibleColumn);
			}
			num += DataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport + TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedRightVisibleColumn in FixedRightVisibleColumns)
			{
				if (offset <= num + GetColumnWidth(fixedRightVisibleColumn))
				{
					return fixedRightVisibleColumn;
				}
				num += GetColumnWidth(fixedRightVisibleColumn);
			}
			return base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1];
		}

		internal double FixedLeftColumnsWidth()
		{
			double num = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedLeftVisibleColumn in FixedLeftVisibleColumns)
			{
				num += GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn);
			}
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count != 0)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal ColumnBase GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(double offset, double? coord = null)
		{
			if (RootDataPresenter == null)

			if (coord.HasValue)

			double num3 = ((base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl) ? 0.0 : (TableView.ActualShowDetailButtons ? 0.0 : ViewInfo.TotalGroupAreaIndent));
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedLeftVisibleColumn in FixedLeftVisibleColumns)
			{
				if (coord.HasValue)

					if (coord.Value - num3 - GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn) < 0.0)

					}
				}
				else if (offset - num3 - GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn) < 0.0)
				{
					return fixedLeftVisibleColumn;
				}
				num3 += GetColumnWidth(fixedLeftVisibleColumn);
			}
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count != 0)

				num3 += TableView.FixedLineWidth;

			double num4 = num3;
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedNoneVisibleColumn2 in FixedNoneVisibleColumns)
			{
				bool flag = offset - RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset - num4 > RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport + TableView.FixedLineWidth;
				if (FixedRightVisibleColumns.Count != 0 && flag)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (offset <= num4 + GetColumnWidth(fixedNoneVisibleColumn2))

				num4 += GetColumnWidth(fixedNoneVisibleColumn2);
			}
			num3 += Math.Min(RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Extent, RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Viewport) + TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			foreach (ColumnBase fixedRightVisibleColumn in FixedRightVisibleColumns)
			{
				if (offset - RootDataPresenter.ScrollInfoCore.HorizontalScrollInfo.Offset <= num3 + GetColumnWidth(fixedRightVisibleColumn))
				{
					return fixedRightVisibleColumn;
				}
				num3 += GetColumnWidth(fixedRightVisibleColumn);
			}
			return base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1];
		}

		internal double GetSelectedColumnOffset(ColumnBase column)
		{
			double num = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count && base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[i] != column; i++)
			{
				num += GetColumnWidth(base.View.VisibleColumnsCore[i]);
			}
			if (FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count > 0 && i >= FixedLeftVisibleColumns.Count)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			num += TotalVisibleIndent;
			return num + GetColumnWidth(column) / 2.0;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Size CorrectMeasureResult(double scrollOffset, System.Windows.Size constraint, System.Windows.Size result)
		{
			if ((scrollOffset > 0.0 || base.View.ScrollingMode == ScrollingMode.Normal) && !double.IsPositiveInfinity(constraint.Height) && result.Height < constraint.Height)
			{
				result.Height = constraint.Height;
			}
			result.Width = Math.Min(constraint.Width, Math.Max(result.Width, CalcDesiredWidth(constraint)));
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual double CalcDesiredWidth(System.Windows.Size constraint)
		{
			double num = HorizontalExtent + LeftIndent + RightIndent + (TableView.ActualShowIndicator ? TableView.IndicatorWidth : 0.0);
			if (HasFixedLeftElements)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			if (HasFixedRightElements)
			{
				num += TableView.FixedLineWidth;
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected internal virtual MouseMoveSelectionBase GetMouseMoveSelection(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (!base.View.AllowMouseMoveSelection || base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				return MouseMoveSelectionNone.Instance;
			}
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = (ITableViewHitInfo)hitInfo;
			if (base.View.ShowSelectionRectangle && TableView.ViewBase.IsMultiSelection && (hitInfo.IsDataArea || (hitInfo.InRow && !tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator)) && !IsAdditionalRow(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				if (TableView.ViewBase.IsMultiCellSelection)
				{
					return MouseMoveSelectionRectangleGridCell.Instance;
				}
				return MouseMoveSelectionRectangleRowIndicator.Instance;
			}
			if (tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator && TableView.ViewBase.IsMultiSelection && TableView.UseIndicatorForSelection && !IsAdditionalRow(base.View.FocusedRowHandle) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				return MouseMoveSelectionRowIndicator.Instance;
			}
			if (hitInfo.IsRowCell && TableView.ViewBase.IsMultiCellSelection && !IsAdditionalRow(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return MouseMoveStrategyGridCell.Instance;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool IsRowIndicator(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			ITableViewHitInfo tableViewHitInfo = TableView.CalcHitInfo(originalSource);
			return tableViewHitInfo.IsRowIndicator;
		}

		protected internal override void StopSelection()

			MouseMoveSelection.ReleaseMouseCapture(base.View);
		}

		public virtual void OnScrollTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.View?.ScrollContentPresenter == null || LastMousePosition.X == double.NaN || LastMousePosition.Y == double.NaN)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			DragScroll();
			if (MouseMoveSelection.CanScrollVertically)
			{
				FixedRowPosition fixedRowPosition = (base.View.HasFixedRows ? base.View.GetFixedRowByItemCore(base.View.DataControl.GetRow(base.View.SelectionAnchor.RowHandleCore)) : FixedRowPosition.None);
				if (LastMousePosition.Y < DataPresenter.Panel.FixedTopRowsHeight && fixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.Top)
				{
					num = -1;
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.Y > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualHeight - DataPresenter.Panel.FixedBottomRowsHeight && fixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					num = 1;
				}
			}
			if (MouseMoveSelection.CanScrollHorizontally)
			{
				double num3 = (TableView.ShowIndicator ? TableView.IndicatorWidth : 0.0);
				if (LastMousePosition.X - num3 < 0.0)
				{
					num2 = -10;
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.X > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
				{
					num2 = 10;
				}
			}
			if (num2 != 0)
			{
				ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(num2);
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				ChangeVerticalOffsetBy(num);
			}
			if (num != 0 || num2 != 0)
			{
				base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					InvalidateSelection();
				});
			}
		}

		private void DragScroll()
		{
			if (DragDropScroller.IsDragging(base.View))
			{
				if (LastMousePosition.X - TableView.IndicatorWidth < 0.0)
				{
					ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(-10.0);
				}
				if (LastMousePosition.X > base.View.ScrollContentPresenter.ActualWidth)
				{
					ChangeHorizontalOffsetBy(10.0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateSelection()
		{
			if (!MergingTimer.IsEnabled)
			{
				base.View.CanSelectLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					MouseMoveSelection.UpdateSelection(TableView);
				});
			}
		}

		protected internal override int? VisibleComparisonCore(BaseColumn x, BaseColumn y)
		{
			if (x.Fixed == y.Fixed)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (y.Fixed == FixedStyle.Left)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (x.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (y.Fixed == FixedStyle.Right)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal override System.Windows.Point CorrectDragIndicatorLocation(UIElement panel, System.Windows.Point point)
		{
			ITableView tableView = (ITableView)base.View.RootView;
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(panel, (UIElement)tableView.ViewBase);
			double totalLeftIndent = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			if (point.X < totalLeftIndent - relativeElementRect.Left)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(totalLeftIndent - relativeElementRect.Left, point.Y);
			}
			if (tableView.ViewBase.ActualWidth - GetVerticalScrollBarWidth() < relativeElementRect.Left + point.X)
			{
				return new System.Windows.Point(tableView.ViewBase.ActualWidth - GetVerticalScrollBarWidth() - relativeElementRect.Left, point.Y);
			}
			return point;
		}

		protected internal override double CalcVerticalDragIndicatorSize(UIElement panel, System.Windows.Point point, double width)
		{
			ITableView tableView = (ITableView)base.View.RootView;
			double num = width;
			Rect relativeElementRect = LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect(panel, (UIElement)tableView.ViewBase);
			double totalLeftIndent = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			if (point.X < totalLeftIndent - relativeElementRect.Left)
			{
				num -= totalLeftIndent - relativeElementRect.Left - point.X;
			}
			if (tableView.ViewBase.ActualWidth - GetVerticalScrollBarWidth() - relativeElementRect.Left < point.X + width)
			{
				num -= point.X + width - tableView.ViewBase.ActualWidth + GetVerticalScrollBarWidth() + relativeElementRect.Left;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void UpdateCompactModeCore()
		{

			TableView.SetIsCompactMode(compactTemplate != null);

		internal virtual DataTemplate GetActualCompactTemplate()
		{
			if (TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth == 0.0 || TableView.DataRowCompactTemplate == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!CheckCompactModeWidth())
			{
				return null;
			}
			return TableView.DataRowCompactTemplate;
		}

		internal void CompactModeUpdate(double oldWeight, double newWeight, bool forceUpdate)
		{
			if (TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth == 0.0 || TableView.DataRowCompactTemplate == null || base.View.RootDataPresenter == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (forceUpdate)
			{
				UpdateCompactModeCore();
				return;
			}
			if (double.IsNaN(oldWeight) || double.IsNaN(newWeight))
			{
				UpdateCompactModeCore();
				return;
			}
			double totalLeftIndent = GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			double num = base.View.RootDataPresenter.ActualWidth - totalLeftIndent;
			double num2 = base.View.RootDataPresenter.ActualWidth + (newWeight - oldWeight) - totalLeftIndent;
			if ((num <= TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth && num2 > TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth) || (num > TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth && num2 <= TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth))
			{
				UpdateCompactModeCore();
			}
		}

		private bool CheckCompactModeWidth()
		{
			if (base.View.RootDataPresenter == null || base.View.DataControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = base.View.RootDataPresenter.ActualWidth - GetTotalLeftIndent(includeIndicator: true, includeCurrentGroupAreaIndentWhenDetailButtonVisible: true);
			return TableView.SwitchToCompactModeWidth >= num;
		}

		protected void UpdateCompactPanelShowMode()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			flag = TableView.CompactPanelShowMode switch
			{
				CompactPanelShowMode.CompactMode => CheckCompactModeWidth(), 
				CompactPanelShowMode.Always => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
			if (flag != base.View.ActualShowCompactPanel)
			{
				base.View.ActualShowCompactPanel = flag;
			}
		}

		private void OnCompactModeFilterItemsSourceUpdate(object oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged.CollectionChanged -= ((WeakEventHandler<TableViewBehavior, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
			TableView.UnsubscribeFilterItemsSource(oldValue as IEnumerable);
			SyncCollectionHelper.PopulateCore(TableView.CompactModeFilterItems, TableView.CompactModeFilterItemsSource, (object obj) => (obj is ICustomItem) ? obj : null);
			if (TableView.CompactModeFilterItemsSource is INotifyCollectionChanged notifyCollectionChanged2)
			{
				notifyCollectionChanged2.CollectionChanged += ((WeakEventHandler<TableViewBehavior, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs, NotifyCollectionChangedEventHandler>)(object)CompactModeFilterItemsCollectionChangedHandler).Handler;
			}
		}

		internal void OnShowCriteriaInAutoFilterRowChanged()

				AutoFilterRowData.UpdateData();
			}
			base.View.UpdateColumns(delegate(ColumnBase col)
			{
				col.ActualShowCriteriaInAutoFilterRowChanged();
			});
		}

			HorizontalNavigationStrategy.MakeCellVisible(this);
		}

		internal override void MovePrevRow()
		{
			MovePrevRow(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow: false);
		}

		internal void MovePrevRow(bool allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow)
		{
			if (!MovePrevRowCore())
			{
				if ((base.View.DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex == 0 || (base.View.IsPagingMode && base.View.DataProviderBase.CurrentIndex == base.View.FirstVisibleIndexOnPage)) && CanNavigateToAdditionalRow(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow) && !base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
				{
					base.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(GetAdditionalRowHandle(), NavigationType.Prev);
				}
				else if (IsNewItemRowFocused && CanNavigateToAutoFilterRow(allowNavigateToAutoFilterRow))
				{
					base.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(-2147483645, NavigationType.Prev);
				}
				else
				{
					base.DataControl.NavigateToMasterRow();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void MoveNextRow()
		{
			if (MoveNextRowCore() || !base.View.CanMoveFromFocusedRow())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.View.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
			{
				if (IsAutoFilterRowFocused && IsNewItemRowVisible)
				{
					base.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(-2147483647, NavigationType.Next);
					return;
				}
				if (base.View.IsTopNewItemRowFocused && !base.View.CommitEditingInternal())
				{
					return;
				}
				if (base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount > 0)
				{
					if (base.View.IsPagingMode)
					{
						base.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(base.View.FirstVisibleIndexOnPage), NavigationType.Next);
					}
					else
					{
						base.View.SetFocusedRowHandle(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(0), NavigationType.Next);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (base.View.IsBottomNewItemRowFocused && IsNewItemRowEditing)
			{
				if (base.View.CommitEditingInternal())
				{
					base.View.ScrollIntoView(base.View.FocusedRowHandle);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.DataControl.NavigateToNextOuterMasterRow();
			}
		}

			{
				return TableView.ShowAutoFilterRow;

			return false;
		}

		internal void InitNewRowEditing(bool showUpdateRowButtons)
		{
			if (!base.View.IsNewItemRowHandle(base.View.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (TableView.EditFormShowMode != EditFormShowMode.None)
			{
				base.View.EditFormManager.EditFormOpenLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
					{
						base.View.EditFocusedRow();
					});
				});
			}
			else if (TableView.ShowUpdateRowButtons != ShowUpdateRowButtons.Never && !base.View.AreUpdateRowButtonsShown && showUpdateRowButtons)
			{
				base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)delegate
				{
					StartEditWithRowButtons();
				});
			}
		}

		internal double CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore(BaseColumn column)
		{
			InplaceEditorBase currentCellEditor = base.View.CurrentCellEditor;
			try
			{
				if (!column.IsBand)
				{
					return ((BestFitCalculatorBase)BestFitCalculator).CalcColumnBestFitWidth((IBestFitColumn)(object)((column is IBestFitColumn) ? column : null));
				}
				base.View.BeginUpdateColumnsLayout();
				try
				{
					return BestFitCalculator.CalcColumnBestFitWidthCore(column as BandBase);
				}
				finally
				{
					base.View.EndUpdateColumnsLayout();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.View.CurrentCellEditor = currentCellEditor;
			}
		}

		internal void CopyCellsToClipboard(int startRowHandle, ColumnBase startColumn, int endRowHandle, ColumnBase endColumn)
		{
			if (IsValidRowHandleAndColumn(startRowHandle, startColumn) && IsValidRowHandleAndColumn(endRowHandle, endColumn))
			{
				List<CellBase> gridCells = new List<CellBase>();
				IterateCells(startRowHandle, startColumn.ActualVisibleIndex, endRowHandle, endColumn.ActualVisibleIndex, delegate(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
				{
					gridCells.Add(TableView.CreateGridCell(rowHandle, column));
				});
				TableView.CopyCellsToClipboard(gridCells);
			}
		}

			return false;
		}

		protected internal override void GetDataRowText(StringBuilder sb, int rowHandle)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count; i++)
			{
				sb.Append(base.View.GetTextForClipboard(rowHandle, i));
				if (base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (i != base.View.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1)
				{
					sb.Append("\t");
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void AddFormatConditionCore(FormatConditionBase formatCondition)
		{
			if (formatCondition == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IModelItem dataControlModelItem = base.View.DesignTimeAdorner.DataControlModelItem;
			IModelEditingScope val = dataControlModelItem.BeginEdit("Add format condition");
			try
			{
				IModelItemCollection formatConditionsModelItemCollection = GetFormatConditionsModelItemCollection(dataControlModelItem);
				if (formatCondition is IndicatorFormatConditionBase)
				{
					IModelItem[] array = ((IEnumerable<IModelItem>)formatConditionsModelItemCollection).Where((IModelItem x) => x.ItemType == formatCondition.GetType() && x.Properties[FormatConditionBase.FieldNameProperty.Name].ComputedValue as string == formatCondition.FieldName).ToArray();
					IModelItem[] array2 = array;
					foreach (IModelItem val2 in array2)
					{
						formatConditionsModelItemCollection.Remove(val2);
					}
				}
				formatConditionsModelItemCollection.Add(base.View.DesignTimeAdorner.CreateModelItem(formatCondition, dataControlModelItem));
				val.Complete();
			}
			finally
			{
				((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void ShowFormatConditionDialogCore(ColumnBase column, FormatConditionDialogType dialogKind)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AssignableServiceHelper2<FrameworkElement, IDialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)base.View, TableView.FormatConditionDialogServiceTemplate, (Action<IDialogService>)delegate(IDialogService service)
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006d: Expected O, but got Unknown
				ConditionalFormattingDialogViewModel viewModel = GetViewModelFactory(dialogKind)((IFormatsOwner)TableView);
				viewModel.Initialize((IDialogContext)(object)new DataControlDialogContext(column, base.DataControl));
				List<UICommand> list = UICommand.GenerateFromMessageBoxButton(MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, (IMessageBoxButtonLocalizer)new DXDialogWindowMessageBoxButtonLocalizer());
				list[0].Command = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(delegate(CancelEventArgs x)
				{
					x.Cancel = !viewModel.TryClose();
				});
				UICommand uICommand = service.ShowDialog(list, viewModel.Title, viewModel);
				if (uICommand == list[0])
				{

					IModelItemCollection formatConditionsModelItemCollection = GetFormatConditionsModelItemCollection(dataControlModelItem);
					IModelItem val = viewModel.CreateCondition(dataControlModelItem.Context, column.FieldName);
					val.Properties[FormatConditionBase.FieldNameProperty.Name].SetValue((object)column.FieldName);
					viewModel.SetFormatProperty(val);
					formatConditionsModelItemCollection.Add(val);
				}
			});
		}

		private Func<IFormatsOwner, ConditionalFormattingDialogViewModel> GetViewModelFactory(FormatConditionDialogType dialogKind)
		{

		protected internal virtual void ClearFormatConditionsFromAllColumnsCore()
		{
			IModelItemCollection formatConditionsModelItemCollection = GetFormatConditionsModelItemCollection(base.View.DesignTimeAdorner.DataControlModelItem);
			IModelItem[] array = FindConditionModelItems(formatConditionsModelItemCollection, (FormatConditionBase x) => ((ISupportManager)x).AllowUserCustomization);
			if (array.Length == ((IEnumerable<IModelItem>)formatConditionsModelItemCollection).Count())
			{
				formatConditionsModelItemCollection.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				RemoveConditions(array, formatConditionsModelItemCollection);
			}
			RemoveOrphanConditionFilters();
		}

		protected internal virtual void ClearFormatConditionsFromColumnCore(ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				IModelItemCollection formatConditionsModelItemCollection = GetFormatConditionsModelItemCollection(base.View.DesignTimeAdorner.DataControlModelItem);
				IModelItem[] conditionsToDelete = FindConditionModelItems(formatConditionsModelItemCollection, (FormatConditionBase x) => x.FieldName == column.FieldName && ((ISupportManager)x).AllowUserCustomization);
				RemoveConditions(conditionsToDelete, formatConditionsModelItemCollection);
				RemoveOrphanConditionFilters();
			}
		}

		private IModelItem[] FindConditionModelItems(IModelItemCollection formatConditions, Func<FormatConditionBase, bool> searchPredicate)
		{
			return ((IEnumerable<IModelItem>)formatConditions).Where((IModelItem x) => searchPredicate((FormatConditionBase)x.GetCurrentValue())).ToArray();
		}

		private void RemoveConditions(IModelItem[] conditionsToDelete, IModelItemCollection formatConditions)
		{
			if (conditionsToDelete.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions).BeginUpdate();
			try
			{
				foreach (IModelItem val in conditionsToDelete)
				{
					formatConditions.Remove(val);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void RemoveOrphanConditionFilters()
		{
			if (DependencyObjectExtensions.IsInDesignTool((DependencyObject)base.DataControl) || !base.DataControl.HasConditionFormatFilters)
			{
				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<FormatConditionFilter> filters = base.DataControl.GetFormatConditionFilters();
			base.DataControl.FilterCriteria = FormatConditionFiltersHelper.RemoveConditionFormatFilters(base.DataControl.FilterCriteria, (Func<AppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo, bool>)((AppliedFormatConditionFilterInfo info) => !filters.Any((FormatConditionFilter x) => FormatConditionFiltersHelper.IsMatchedInfo(x, info))));
		}

		protected internal virtual void ShowConditionalFormattingManagerCore(ColumnBase column)
		{
			AssignableServiceHelper2<FrameworkElement, IDialogService>.DoServiceAction((DependencyObject)base.View, TableView.ConditionalFormattingManagerServiceTemplate, (Action<IDialogService>)delegate(IDialogService service)
			{
				//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b9: Expected O, but got Unknown
				DataControlDialogContext dataControlDialogContext = null;
				dataControlDialogContext = ((column != null) ? new DataControlDialogContext(column, base.DataControl) : ((base.DataControl == null || base.DataControl.ColumnsCore.Count <= 0) ? new DataControlDialogContext(null, base.DataControl) : new DataControlDialogContext(base.DataControl.ColumnsCore[0], base.DataControl)));
				ManagerViewModel viewModel = ManagerViewModel.Factory((IDialogContext)(object)dataControlDialogContext);
				List<UICommand> list = UICommand.GenerateFromMessageBoxButton(MessageBoxButton.OKCancel, (IMessageBoxButtonLocalizer)new DXDialogWindowMessageBoxButtonLocalizer());
				UICommand item = new UICommand
				{
					Caption = XtraLocalizer<ConditionalFormattingStringId>.Active.GetLocalizedString((ConditionalFormattingStringId)268),
					IsCancel = false,
					IsDefault = false,
					Command = new DelegateCommand<CancelEventArgs>(delegate(CancelEventArgs e)
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
						viewModel.ApplyChanges();
					}, (CancelEventArgs x) => viewModel.CanApply)
				};
				list.Add(item);
				UICommand uICommand = service.ShowDialog(list, ((ManagerViewModelBase)viewModel).Description, viewModel);
				if (uICommand == list[0])
				{
					viewModel.ApplyChanges();
					RemoveOrphanConditionFilters();
				}
			});
		}

					data.StartAnimation(GroupAnimationsByGeneration(condition));
				});
			});
		}

			});
		}

		{
			DoRowAction(rowHandle, delegate(RowData x)

			});
		}

		}

		private void DoRowAction(int rowHandle, Func<RowData, Action> getTarget)
		{
			RowData rowData = GetRowData(rowHandle);
			if (rowData != null)
			{
				getTarget(rowData)?.Invoke();
			}
		}

		private GridColumnData GetCellData(RowData rowData, string fieldName)
		{
			return rowData.With((RowData x) => x.GetCellDataByColumn(base.DataControl.With((DataControlBase y) => y.ColumnsCore[fieldName])));
		}

		private IList<IList<AnimationTimeline>> GroupAnimationsByGeneration(FormatConditionBase condition)
		{
			if (condition == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			IConditionalAnimationFactory val = condition.Info.CreateAnimationFactory();
			val.UpdateDefaultSettings(DataUpdateAnimationProvider.CreateDefaultAnimationSettings(TableView));
			return SequentialAnimationHelper.GroupAnimationsByGeneration(val.CreateAnimations());
		}

		internal void UpdateActualAllowCellMergeCore()
		{
			MultiSelectMode actualSelectionMode = base.View.GetActualSelectionMode();
			base.View.ActualAllowCellMerge = (TableView.AllowCellMerge || (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.countColumnCellMerge > 0)) && base.View.NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.Row && (actualSelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.None || actualSelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Cell);
		}

		internal void UpdateCellMergingPanels(bool force = false)
		{
			if (TableView.HasDetailViews || base.View.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				if (force)
				{
					UpdateCellMergingPanelsCore();
					updatePanelsEnqueued = false;
				}
				else if (!updatePanelsEnqueued)
				{
					base.View.EnqueueImmediateAction((Action)UpdateCellMergingPanelsCore);
					updatePanelsEnqueued = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateCellMergingPanelsCore()
		{
			updatePanelsEnqueued = false;
			base.View.UpdateAllRowData(delegate(RowData data)
			{
				if (data.View.ActualAllowCellMerge)
				{
					data.InvalidateCellsPanel();
					data.UpdateIsFocusedCell();
					data.UpdateSelectionState();
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal void OnOpeningEditor()
		{

			{
				base.View.UpdateFocusAndInvalidatePanels();
			}
		}

		internal void OnHideEditor(CellEditorBase editor, bool closeEditor)

				base.View.UpdateFocusAndInvalidatePanels();
			}
		}

		internal int? CalcActualFocusedRowHandle()
		{
			if (base.View.FocusedRowHandleCore == -2147483647 && base.View.ActualAllowCellMerge)
			{
				return base.View.FocusedRowHandleCore;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Tuple<double, double> GetOffsetAndHeightMergeCell(CellEditorBase cell, RowData rowData, double finalSizeHeight, double invisibleCellVerticalOffset)
		{
			int num = base.DataControl.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandleCore(rowData.RowHandle.Value);
			if (base.View.IsNextRowCellMerged(num, cell.Column, checkRowData: true))
			{
				return new Tuple<double, double>(invisibleCellVerticalOffset, finalSizeHeight);
			}
			if (!rowData.IsRowInView())
			{
				return null;
			}
			double num2 = 0.0;
			double num3 = finalSizeHeight;
			bool flag = true;
			while (base.View.IsPrevRowCellMerged(num, cell.Column, checkRowData: true))
			{
				flag = false;
				RowData rowData2 = base.View.GetRowData(base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(num - 1));
				double num4 = rowData2.RowElement.DesiredSize.Height;
				if (rowData2.IsLastFixedRow)
				{
					num4 -= FixedLineHeight + finalSizeHeight - rowData.RowElement.DesiredSize.Height;
				}
				num2 -= num4;
				num3 += num4;
				num--;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return new Tuple<double, double>(num2, num3);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsCellMerged(int visibleIndex1, int visibleIndex2, ColumnBase column, bool checkRowData, int checkMDIndex, bool includeFirstColumn = true)
		{
			bool result = false;
			CellMergeLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				result = IsCellMergeCore(visibleIndex1, visibleIndex2, column, checkRowData, checkMDIndex, includeFirstColumn);
			});
			return result;
		}

		private GridCellData GetGridCellDataByVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, ColumnBase column)
		{
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex);
			return base.View.GetRowData(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore)?.GetCellDataByColumn(column) as GridCellData;
		}

		private bool IsCellMergeCore(int visibleIndex1, int visibleIndex2, ColumnBase column, bool checkRowData, int checkMDIndex, bool includeFirstColumn = true)
		{
			if (!includeFirstColumn && column.ActualVisibleIndex == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (column.AllowCellMerge.HasValue ? (!column.AllowCellMerge.Value) : (!TableView.AllowCellMerge))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(checkMDIndex);
			if (base.DataControl.MasterDetailProvider.IsMasterRowExpanded(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore) || UseRowDetailsTemplate(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex2);
			if (base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2) || !base.DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (checkRowData)
			{
				RowData rowData = GetRowData(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2);
				if (rowData == null || !rowData.IsRowInView())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (base.DataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.Cell)
			{
				GridCellData gridCellDataByVisibleIndex = GetGridCellDataByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex1, column);
				GridCellData gridCellDataByVisibleIndex2 = GetGridCellDataByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex2, column);
				if ((gridCellDataByVisibleIndex != null && gridCellDataByVisibleIndex.IsSelected) || (gridCellDataByVisibleIndex2 != null && gridCellDataByVisibleIndex2.IsSelected))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore3 = base.DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(visibleIndex1);
			if (base.View.EditFormManager.IsEditFormVisible)
			{
				if (TableView.EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.Inline && rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore == base.View.FocusedRowHandle)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (TableView.EditFormShowMode == EditFormShowMode.InlineHideRow && rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 == base.View.FocusedRowHandle)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!TableView.AllowMergeEditor(column, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore3))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 == -2147483647 || rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore3 == -2147483647)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex1) != base.View.GetFixedRowByVisibleIndex(visibleIndex2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return TableView.RaiseCellMerge(column, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore3, checkValues: true).Value;
		}

		internal bool AllowMergeEditor(ColumnBase column, int rowHandle1, int rowHandle2)
		{
			if ((!base.View.IsEditorOpen && ((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)base.View.InplaceEditorOwner).EditorWasClosed) || !base.View.RootView.IsKeyboardFocusWithin || base.View.RootView.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (rowHandle1 != base.View.FocusedRowHandle && rowHandle2 != base.View.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (column != base.DataControl.CurrentColumn)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return !base.View.CanShowEditor(base.View.FocusedRowHandle, base.DataControl.CurrentColumn);
		}

		protected internal override double CalcHeaderBestFit(BaseColumn column)
		{
			if (!IsBestFitControlDecoratorLoaded)
			{
				return column.MinWidth;
			}
			try
			{
				LayoutUpdatedHelper.GlobalLocker.Lock();
				double result = 0.0;
				ColumnsLayoutCalculator.ResetBestFitBandWidth(column.GetRootParentBand());
				BestFitCalculator.CalcHeaderBestFit(column, ref result, clearBestFitElement: true);
				return Math.Max(column.MinWidth, result);
			}
			finally
			{
				LayoutUpdatedHelper.GlobalLocker.Unlock();
			}
		}

		private void OnUseLightweightTemplatesChanged(DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!canChangeUseLightweightTemplates && !DataViewBase.DisableOptimizedModeVerification)
			{
				if (!object.Equals(e.NewValue, frozenUseLightweightTemplates) && DependencyPropertyHelper.GetValueSource(base.View, e.Property).BaseValueSource != BaseValueSource.Default)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Can't change the UseLightweightTemplates property after the GridControl has been initialized.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.View.UpdateColumnsAppearance();
				UpdateActualDataRowTemplateSelector();
				ValidateRowStyle(TableView.RowStyle);
			}
		}

		internal FrameworkElement CreateElement(Func<FrameworkElement> lightweightDelegate, Func<FrameworkElement> ordinaryDelegate, UseLightweightTemplates flag)
		{
			if (canChangeUseLightweightTemplates)
			{
				ForbidChangeUseLightweightTemplatesProperty();
				ValidateRowStyle(TableView.RowStyle);
			}
			if (!UseLightweightTemplatesHasFlag(flag))
			{
				return ordinaryDelegate();
			}
			return lightweightDelegate();
		}

				return false;
			}

		}

		}

		internal override bool UseRowDetailsTemplate(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (base.View.RowMarginControlDisplayMode == RowMarginControlDisplayMode.InCellsControl && !base.View.IsTreeView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TableView.RowDetailsTemplate == null && TableView.RowDetailsTemplateSelector == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TableView.RowDetailsVisibilityMode == RowDetailsVisibilityMode.Collapsed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (TableView.RowDetailsVisibilityMode != RowDetailsVisibilityMode.Visible)
			{
				return rowHandle == base.View.FocusedRowHandle;
			}
			return true;
		}

		void IFormatConditionCollectionOwner.SyncFormatConditionCollectionWithDetails(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DataControl != null && base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsVirtualSource && ((IEnumerable<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions).Any((FormatConditionBase x) => x.GetType() != typeof(FormatCondition)))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("The GridControl bound to the Virtual data source supports the FormatCondition conditional formats only.");
			}
			base.DataControl.Do(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{

		protected internal virtual void OnDeserializeCreateFormatCondition(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e)
		{
			XtraPropertyInfo val = ((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties["TypeName"];
			if (val != null)
			{
				FormatConditionBase formatConditionBase = CreateFormatCondition(val.Value.ToString());
				if (formatConditionBase != null)
				{
					formatConditionBase.OnDeserializeStart();
					CreateInternalContentObjectOnDeserialization(e, formatConditionBase.FormatPropertyForBinding, formatConditionBase);
					CreateInternalContentObjectOnDeserialization(e, formatConditionBase.ActualAnimationSettingsProperty, formatConditionBase);
					((Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)FormatConditions).Add(formatConditionBase);
					e.CollectionItem = formatConditionBase;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CreateInternalContentObjectOnDeserialization(XtraCreateCollectionItemEventArgs e, DependencyProperty property, DependencyObject owner)
		{
			if (((XtraItemRoutedEventArgs)e).Item.ChildProperties[property.Name] != null)
			{
				owner.SetValue(property, Activator.CreateInstance(property.PropertyType));
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDeserializeFormatConditionsStart()
		{
			((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions).BeginUpdate();
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnDeserializeFormatConditionsEnd()
		{
			foreach (FormatConditionBase item in (Collection<FormatConditionBase>)(object)FormatConditions)
			{
				item.OnDeserializeEnd();
			}
			((ObservableCollectionCore<FormatConditionBase>)FormatConditions).EndUpdate();
		}

		protected virtual FormatConditionBase CreateFormatCondition(string conditionTypeName)
		{
			Assembly assembly = typeof(FormatConditionBase).Assembly;
			if (assembly == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type knownType = SafeTypeResolver.GetKnownType(assembly, string.Format("{0}.{1}", "DevExpress.Xpf.Grid", conditionTypeName), false, (bool?)null);
			if (knownType == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Activator.CreateInstance(knownType) as FormatConditionBase;
		}

	public class AnonymousEqualityComparer<T> : EqualityComparer<T>
	{
		private Func<T, T, bool> _equals;

		private Func<T, int> _getHashCode;

		public AnonymousEqualityComparer(Func<T, T, bool> equals, Func<T, int> getHashCode)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)equals, "equals");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)getHashCode, "getHashCode");
			_equals = equals;
			_getHashCode = getHashCode;
		}

		public override bool Equals(T x, T y)
		{
			return _equals(x, y);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode(T obj)
		{
			return _getHashCode(obj);
		}
	}

	internal static class DataControlSelectionHelper
	{
		internal static bool HasSelectedItems(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl.SelectedItems != null)
			{
				return dataControl.SelectedItems.Count != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool HasCurrentItemBinding(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (!dataControl.HasDefaultOrTwoWayBinding(DataControlBase.CurrentItemProperty) && !dataControl.DataView.HasDefaultOrTwoWayBinding(DataViewBase.FocusedRowProperty))
			{
				if (dataControl.SelectionMode == MultiSelectMode.None)
				{
					return dataControl.HasDefaultOrTwoWayBinding(DataControlBase.SelectedItemProperty);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool AllowUpdateCurrentItem(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl.AllowUpdateTwoWayBoundPropertiesOnSynchronization)
			{
				if (dataControl.UpdateCurrentItemWasLocked)
				{
					if (dataControl.DataView != null && dataControl.DataView.IsSynchronizedWithCurrentItem)
					{
						return dataControl.DataProviderBase.CollectionViewSource != null;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (dataControl.DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return !dataControl.HasCurrentItemBinding();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool AllowUpdateSelectedItems(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl.DataSourceChangingLocker.IsLocked && !dataControl.AllowUpdateTwoWayBoundPropertiesOnSynchronization)
			{
				return dataControl.GetBindingExpression(DataControlBase.SelectedItemsProperty) == null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool HasValue(this DataControlBase dataControl, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			if (dataControl.GetValue(property) == null)
			{
				return GetBindingMode(dataControl, property).Return((BindingMode? mode) => mode != BindingMode.OneWayToSource, () => false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool HasDefaultOrTwoWayBinding(this FrameworkElement element, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			BindingMode? bindingMode = GetBindingMode(element, property);
			if (bindingMode != BindingMode.Default)
			{
				return bindingMode == BindingMode.TwoWay;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static BindingMode? GetBindingMode(FrameworkElement element, DependencyProperty property)
		{
			BindingExpression bindingExpression = element.GetBindingExpression(property);
			if (bindingExpression == null || bindingExpression.ParentBinding == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return bindingExpression.ParentBinding.Mode;
		}

		internal static List<DataControlBase> GetAllOriginationDataControls(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			List<DataControlBase> dataControls = new List<DataControlBase>();
			dataControl.UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				dataControls.Add(x);
			});
			return dataControls;
		}

		internal static List<DataControlBase> GetThisAndOwnerDataControls(this DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			List<DataControlBase> dataControls = new List<DataControlBase>();
			dataControl.EnumerateThisAndOwnerDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase x)
			{
				dataControls.Add(x);
			});
			return dataControls;
		}
	}
	public static class GridSortInfoCollectionExtensions
	{
		public static List<GridSortInfo> GetMergeSortInfo(this IEnumerable<GridSortInfo> collection, GridSortInfo sortInfo, int groupCount)
		{
			if (collection == null || sortInfo == null || groupCount <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = 0;
			List<GridSortInfo> list = new List<GridSortInfo>();
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			foreach (GridSortInfo item in collection)
			{
				if (num == groupCount)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (item.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
					{
						list.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (item == sortInfo)
				{
					if (!item.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
					{
						list.Clear();
					}
					flag2 = true;
					list.Add(item);
					flag = true;
					continue;
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else if (item.MergeWithPreviousGroup)
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Clear();
					list.Add(item);
				}
				num++;
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (list.Count > 1)
			{
				return list;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
