	public class UpdateRowRectangleHelper
	{
		public static bool AllowAnimations { get; set; }

		public virtual Duration AnimationDuration => new Duration(new TimeSpan(0, 0, 0, 0, 50));

		static UpdateRowRectangleHelper()
		{
			AllowAnimations = true;
		}

		public virtual void CreateRectangle(DataViewBase view)
		{
			if (view.RootView.IsLoaded)
			{
				System.Windows.Shapes.Path path = new System.Windows.Shapes.Path
				{
					Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
				};
				path.Style = ((ITableView)view).UpdateRowRectangleStyle;
				view.RootView.UpdateRowRectangle = path;
			}
		}

		protected Rect BoundsRelativeTo(FrameworkElement element, Visual relativeTo)
		{
			return element.TransformToVisual(relativeTo).TransformBounds(LayoutInformation.GetLayoutSlot(element));
		}

		public virtual void UpdatePosition(DataViewBase view)
		{
			//IL_013a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ITableView tableView = view as ITableView;
			ITableView tableView2 = ((view != null) ? (view.RootView as ITableView) : null);
			if (tableView != null && (view.UpdateRowButtonsWaitAction || view.UpdateRowButtonsLocker > 0) && view.DataControl != null && view.FocusedRowElement != null)
			{
				System.Windows.Shapes.Path updateRowRectangle = view.RootView.UpdateRowRectangle;
				if (updateRowRectangle == null || FrameworkElementExtensions.GetVisualParent((FrameworkElement)updateRowRectangle)?.Parent == null)
				{
					if (!view.RootView.IsLoaded)
					{
						return;
					}
					CreateRectangle(view.RootView);
					updateRowRectangle = view.RootView.UpdateRowRectangle;
				}
				if (updateRowRectangle == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry = new RectangleGeometry(BoundsRelativeTo(view.RootView, view.RootView));
				FrameworkElement rowElementByRowHandle = view.GetRowElementByRowHandle(view.FocusedRowHandle);
				if (rowElementByRowHandle == null || !rowElementByRowHandle.IsVisible)
				{
					updateRowRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					return;
				}
				if (view.IsHorizontalScrollBarVisible || (tableView2 != null && tableView2.ShowDataNavigator))
				{
					FrameworkElement frameworkElement = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName((FrameworkElement)view.RootView, "gridScroll");
					if (frameworkElement != null)
					{
						FrameworkElement frameworkElement2 = LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(frameworkElement, "PART_HorizontalScrollBar");
						RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry2 = new RectangleGeometry(BoundsRelativeTo(frameworkElement2, view.RootView));
						if (frameworkElement2 != null && (int)ScrollBarExtensions.GetScrollBarMode((DependencyObject)frameworkElement2) == 0)
						{
							rectangleGeometry.Rect = new Rect(rectangleGeometry.Rect.X, rectangleGeometry.Rect.Y, rectangleGeometry.Rect.Width, rectangleGeometry2.Rect.Y - rectangleGeometry.Rect.Y);
						}
					}
				}
				RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry3 = new RectangleGeometry(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)rowElementByRowHandle, (UIElement)view.RootView));
				if (tableView.ShowIndicator)
				{
					rectangleGeometry3.Rect = new Rect(rectangleGeometry3.Rect.X + tableView.IndicatorWidth, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Y, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Width - tableView.IndicatorWidth, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Height);
				}
				double offsetByRowElement = view.GetOffsetByRowElement(rowElementByRowHandle);
				rectangleGeometry3.Rect = new Rect(rectangleGeometry3.Rect.X + offsetByRowElement, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Y, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Width - offsetByRowElement, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Height);
				if (tableView.ShowHorizontalLines)
				{
					rectangleGeometry3.Rect = new Rect(rectangleGeometry3.Rect.X, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Y - 1.0, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Width, rectangleGeometry3.Rect.Height + 1.0);
				}
				if (tableView.ShowIndicator)
				{
					RectangleGeometry rectangleGeometry4 = new RectangleGeometry(LayoutHelper.GetRelativeElementRect((UIElement)rowElementByRowHandle, (UIElement)view.RootView));
					rectangleGeometry4.Rect = new Rect(rectangleGeometry4.Rect.X, rectangleGeometry4.Rect.Y, tableView.IndicatorWidth - 1.0, rectangleGeometry4.Rect.Height);
					Geometry geometry = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Union, rectangleGeometry3, rectangleGeometry4);
					updateRowRectangle.Data = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, rectangleGeometry, geometry);
				}
				else
				{
					updateRowRectangle.Data = new CombinedGeometry(GeometryCombineMode.Exclude, rectangleGeometry, rectangleGeometry3);
				}
				if (AllowAnimations)
				{
					if (updateRowRectangle.Visibility != Visibility.Visible)
					{
						DoubleAnimation animation = new DoubleAnimation(0.0, 1.0, AnimationDuration);
						updateRowRectangle.Opacity = 0.0;
						updateRowRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
						updateRowRectangle.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, animation);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					updateRowRectangle.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
				}
				return;
			}
			System.Windows.Shapes.Path updateRowRectangle2 = view.UpdateRowRectangle;
			if (updateRowRectangle2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (AllowAnimations)
			{
				if (updateRowRectangle2.Visibility == Visibility.Visible)
				{
					DoubleAnimation doubleAnimation = new DoubleAnimation(1.0, 0.0, AnimationDuration);
					doubleAnimation.Completed += delegate
					{
						updateRowRectangle2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
					};
					updateRowRectangle2.BeginAnimation(UIElement.OpacityProperty, doubleAnimation);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				updateRowRectangle2.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
		}
	}
	internal static class BindingHelper
	{
		public static BindingBase CloneBinding(BindingBase sourceBinding)
		{
			if (sourceBinding is Binding binding)
			{
				Binding binding2 = new Binding
				{
					BindsDirectlyToSource = binding.BindsDirectlyToSource,
					Converter = binding.Converter,
					ConverterCulture = binding.ConverterCulture,
					ConverterParameter = binding.ConverterParameter,
					FallbackValue = binding.FallbackValue,
					Mode = binding.Mode,
					NotifyOnValidationError = binding.NotifyOnValidationError,
					Path = binding.Path,
					StringFormat = binding.StringFormat,
					TargetNullValue = binding.TargetNullValue,
					UpdateSourceTrigger = binding.UpdateSourceTrigger,
					ValidatesOnDataErrors = binding.ValidatesOnDataErrors,
					ValidatesOnExceptions = binding.ValidatesOnExceptions,
					AsyncState = binding.AsyncState,
					BindingGroupName = binding.BindingGroupName,
					IsAsync = binding.IsAsync,
					NotifyOnSourceUpdated = binding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated,
					NotifyOnTargetUpdated = binding.NotifyOnTargetUpdated,
					UpdateSourceExceptionFilter = binding.UpdateSourceExceptionFilter,
					XPath = binding.XPath
				};
				if (binding.Source != null)
				{
					binding2.Source = binding.Source;
				}
				{
					foreach (ValidationRule validationRule in binding.ValidationRules)
					{
						binding2.ValidationRules.Add(validationRule);
					}
					return binding2;
				}
			}
			if (sourceBinding is MultiBinding multiBinding)
			{
				MultiBinding multiBinding2 = new MultiBinding
				{
					BindingGroupName = multiBinding.BindingGroupName,
					Converter = multiBinding.Converter,
					ConverterCulture = multiBinding.ConverterCulture,
					ConverterParameter = multiBinding.ConverterParameter,
					FallbackValue = multiBinding.FallbackValue,
					Mode = multiBinding.Mode,
					NotifyOnSourceUpdated = multiBinding.NotifyOnSourceUpdated,
					NotifyOnTargetUpdated = multiBinding.NotifyOnTargetUpdated,
					NotifyOnValidationError = multiBinding.NotifyOnValidationError,
					StringFormat = multiBinding.StringFormat,
					TargetNullValue = multiBinding.TargetNullValue,
					UpdateSourceExceptionFilter = multiBinding.UpdateSourceExceptionFilter,
					UpdateSourceTrigger = multiBinding.UpdateSourceTrigger,
					ValidatesOnDataErrors = multiBinding.ValidatesOnDataErrors,
					ValidatesOnExceptions = multiBinding.ValidatesOnDataErrors
				};
				foreach (ValidationRule validationRule2 in multiBinding.ValidationRules)
				{
					multiBinding2.ValidationRules.Add(validationRule2);
				}
				{
					foreach (BindingBase binding3 in multiBinding.Bindings)
					{
						multiBinding2.Bindings.Add(CloneBinding(binding3));
					}
					return multiBinding2;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo : ScrollInfo
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty OrientationProperty;

		private Orientation orientationCore = Orientation.Vertical;

		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return orientationCore;
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(OrientationProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public override ScrollByItemInfo DefineSizeScrollInfo => (ScrollByItemInfo)((Orientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? VerticalScrollInfo : HorizontalScrollInfo);

		public override ScrollByPixelInfo SecondarySizeScrollInfo => (ScrollByPixelInfo)((Orientation == Orientation.Vertical) ? HorizontalScrollInfo : VerticalScrollInfo);

		static VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo()
		{
			OrientationProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo)d).OnOrientationChanged((Orientation)e.NewValue);
			}));
		}

		public VirtualDataStackPanelScrollInfo(IScrollInfoOwner owner)
			: base(owner)
		{
		}

		protected override ScrollInfoBase CreateVerticalScrollInfo()
		{
			return CreateScrollInfo(base.Owner.VerticalScrollMode, SizeHelperBase.GetDefineSizeHelper(Orientation.Vertical));
		}

		protected override ScrollInfoBase CreateHorizontalScrollInfo()
		{
			return CreateScrollInfo(base.Owner.HorizontalScrollMode, SizeHelperBase.GetDefineSizeHelper(Orientation.Horizontal));
		}

		private ScrollInfoBase CreateScrollInfo(DataControlScrollMode scrollMode, SizeHelperBase sizeHelper)
		{
			return scrollMode switch
			{
				DataControlScrollMode.Pixel => new ScrollByPixelInfo(base.Owner, sizeHelper), 
				DataControlScrollMode.Item => new ScrollByItemInfo(base.Owner, sizeHelper), 
				DataControlScrollMode.ItemPixel => new ScrollByItemPixelInfo(base.Owner, sizeHelper), 
				_ => new ScrollByRowPixelInfo(base.Owner, sizeHelper), 
			};
		}

		private void OnOrientationChanged(Orientation newOrientation)
		{
			orientationCore = newOrientation;
			ClearScrollInfo();
		}
	}

		protected void BeginRangeSelectionCore()
		{
			if (!SelectionLocker.IsLocked && CanUpdateSelectedItems)
			{
				if (!RangeSelectionLocker.IsLocked)
				{
					rangeSelectionIsChanged = false;
				}
				RangeSelectionLocker.Lock();
			}
		}

		protected void EndRangeSelectionCore()
		{
			if (!RangeSelectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			RangeSelectionLocker.Unlock();
			if (!rangeSelectionIsChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			RangeSelectionLocker.DoIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
					{
						EndUpdateSelectedItems();
					});
				});
			});
		}

		public virtual void EndRangeSelection()
		{
			EndSelection();
		}

		public void ClearRangeSelection()
		{
			isClearingRange = true;
			try
			{
				DataProviderBase.Selection.Clear();
			}
			finally
			{
				isClearingRange = false;
			}
		}

		public abstract SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle);

		public SelectionState GetCellSelectionState(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!CanSelectCell(rowHandle))
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return GetCellSelectionStateCore(rowHandle, isFocused, isSelected, column);
		}

		protected virtual bool CanSelectCell(int rowHandle)
		{
			return view.CanSelectCellInRow(rowHandle);
		}

		protected virtual SelectionState GetCellSelectionStateCore(int rowHandle, bool isFocused, bool isSelected, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (!isFocused)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return SelectionState.Focused;
		}

		{
		}

			return null;
		}

		protected void DoSelectionAction(Action action)
		{
			BeginRangeSelection();
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndRangeSelection();
			}
		}

		protected internal void SelectRangeCore(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle, Action<int> selectRowAction)
		{
			if (startRowHandle == int.MinValue || endRowHandle == int.MinValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (startRowHandle == endRowHandle)
			{
				selectRowAction(startRowHandle);
				return;
			}
			int startIndex = DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(startRowHandle);
			int endIndex = DataProviderBase.GetRowVisibleIndexByHandle(endRowHandle);
			if (startIndex < 0 || endIndex < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (startIndex > endIndex)
			{
				int num = endIndex;
				endIndex = startIndex;
				startIndex = num;
			}
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				for (int i = startIndex; i <= endIndex; i++)
				{
					int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = DataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
					selectRowAction(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
				}
			});
		}

		public virtual void SelectOnlyThisRange(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			DoSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				ClearMasterDetailSelection();
				SelectRange(startRowHandle, endRowHandle);
			});
		}

		public virtual void SelectRange(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			SelectRangeCore(startRowHandle, endRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				SelectRow(rowHandle);
			});
		}

		protected bool IsSameSelection(IEnumerable<object> previousSelection, IEnumerable<object> currentSelection)
		{
			return previousSelection?.SequenceEqual(currentSelection) ?? false;
		}

		private void ProcessSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!CanUpdateSelectedItems || view.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(e.ControllerRow))
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				switch (e.Action)
				{
				case CollectionChangeAction.Add:
					AddToSelectedItems(DataControl.GetRow(e.ControllerRow));
					break;
				case CollectionChangeAction.Remove:
					OnRemoveItem(e.ControllerRow);
					break;
				default:
					if (!RangeSelectionLocker.IsLocked)
					{
						UpdateSelectedItemsCore();
					}
					break;
				}
				UpdateSelectedItem();
			});
		}

		private void OnRemoveItem(int rowHandle)
		{
			object row = DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle);
			int num = SelectedItems.IndexOf(row);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (!IsRowSelected(rowHandle))
				{
					RemoveFromSelectedItems(row);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				OnRemoveItemFromItemsSource();
			}
		}

		private void OnRemoveItemFromItemsSource()
		{
			object obj = SelectedItems.Cast<object>().Except(GetSelectedItems()).FirstOrDefault();
			if (obj != null)
			{
				RemoveFromSelectedItems(obj);
			}
		}

		public void UpdateSelectedItems()
		{
			if (CanUpdateSelectedItems)
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemsCore();
			}
		}

		protected void UpdateSelectedItemsCore()
		{
			IList<object> selectedItems = GetSelectedItems();
			if (IsSameSelection(SelectedItems.Cast<object>(), selectedItems))
			{
				return;
			}
			BeginUpdateSelectedItems();
			try
			{
				ClearSelectedItems();
				foreach (object item in selectedItems)
				{
					AddToSelectedItems(item);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					EndUpdateSelectedItems();
				});
			}
			UpdateSelectedItem();
		}

		protected IList<object> GetSelectedItems()
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			if (!CanGetSelectedItems)
			{
				return list;
			}
			int[] selectedRows = GetSelectedRows();
			foreach (int rowHandle in selectedRows)
			{
				if (ShouldAddToSelectedItems(rowHandle))
				{
					object row = DataControl.GetRow(rowHandle);
					if (row != null)
					{
						list.Add(row);
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldAddToSelectedItems(int rowHandle)
		{
			return rowHandle >= 0;
		}

		public virtual void OnSelectedItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public void SelectItems(IList items)
		{
			selectItemsPostponedAction.PerformIfNotLoading((Action)delegate
			{
				SelectItemsIfReady(items);
			}, (Action)null);
		}

		private void SelectItemsIfReady(IList items)
		{
			if (!IsOriginationDataControl)
			{
				DoItemsSelection(items);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectItemsInOriginationGrid(items);
			}
		}

		private void DoItemsSelection(IList items)
		{
			BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				ClearSelection();
				if (items != null && items.Count > 0)
				{
					SelectItemsCore(items);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndSelection();
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void SelectItemsCore(IList items)
		{
			Dictionary<object, int> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, int>();
			for (int i = 0; i < DataControl.DataProviderBase.ListSourceRowCount; i++)
			{
				int rowHandleByListIndex = DataControl.DataProviderBase.GetRowHandleByListIndex(i);
				if (DataControl.IsValidRowHandleCore(rowHandleByListIndex))
				{
					object row = DataControl.GetRow(rowHandleByListIndex);
					if (row != null)
					{
						dictionary[row] = rowHandleByListIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (object item in items)
			{
				if (item != null && dictionary.TryGetValue(item, out var value))
				{
					SelectRow(value);
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual void ProcessSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
		}

		protected void ForceCreateSelectedItems()
		{
			SelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				DataControl.SelectedItems = (IList)new ObservableCollectionCore<object>();
				UpdateSelectedItems();
			});
		}

		protected void AddToSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			if (IsDetailDataControl)
			{
				AddToOriginationSelectedItems(item);
			}
			SelectedItems.Add(item);
		}

		protected void ReplaceFirstSelectedItem(object newItem)
		{
			if (IsDetailDataControl)
			{
				ReplaceFirstOriginationSelectedItem(newItem);
			}
			SelectedItems[0] = newItem;
		}

		protected void RemoveFromSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			if (IsDetailDataControl)
			{
				RemoveFromOriginationSelectedItems(item);
			}
			SelectedItems.Remove(item);
		}

		protected void ClearSelectedItems()
		{
			if (IsDetailDataControl)
			{
				ClearOriginationSelectedItems();
			}
			SelectedItems.Do(delegate(IList x)
			{
				x.Clear();
			});
		}

		private void BeginUpdateSelectedItems()
		{
			if (SelectedItems is ILockable)
			{
				((ILockable)SelectedItems).BeginUpdate();
			}
			if (IsDetailDataControl && OriginationSelectedItems is ILockable)
			{
				((ILockable)OriginationSelectedItems).BeginUpdate();
			}
		}

		private void EndUpdateSelectedItems()
		{
			if (SelectedItems is ILockable)
			{
				((ILockable)SelectedItems).EndUpdate();
			}
			if (IsDetailDataControl && OriginationSelectedItems is ILockable)
			{
				((ILockable)OriginationSelectedItems).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		public void OnSelectedItemChanged(object oldValue)
		{
			ProcessSelectedItemChanged();
			if (IsDetailDataControl)
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemInOriginationGrid();
			}
			if (!IsOriginationDataControl)
			{
				DataControl.RaiseSelectedItemChanged(oldValue);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessSelectedItemChanged()
		{
			if (!IsSelectionLocked)
			{
				if (CanSelectSelectedItem)
				{
					UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked = false;
					OnSelectedItemChangedCore();
				}
				else if (DataControl.SelectedItem != null)
				{
					UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void UpdateSelectedItem()
		{
			if (!UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked && !view.IsDesignTime)
			{
				object obj = (DataControl.HasSelectedItems() ? SelectedItems[0] : null);
				if (obj == null && IsServerMode)
				{
					obj = DataControl.CurrentItem;
				}
				if (DataControl.SelectedItem != obj)
				{
					SetSelectedItem(obj);
				}
				DataControlBase originationDataControl = DataControl.GetOriginationDataControl();
				if (originationDataControl != DataControl && originationDataControl.SelectedItem == null && obj != null)
				{
					SetSelectedItem(originationDataControl, obj);
				}
			}
		}

		private void SetSelectedItem(object selectedItem)
		{
			SetSelectedItem(DataControl, selectedItem);
		}

		private static void SetSelectedItem(DataControlBase dataControl, object selectedItem)
		{
			dataControl.SetCurrentValue(DataControlBase.SelectedItemProperty, selectedItem);
		}

		protected bool RestoreSelectedItem()
		{
			bool flag = UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked && CanSelectSelectedItem;
			if (flag)
			{
				UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked = false;
				OnSelectedItemChangedCore();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSelectedItemChangedCore()
		{
			SelectedItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (IsServerMode)
				{
					DataControl.SetCurrentItemCore(DataControl.SelectedItem);
				}
				else
				{
					SelectItems(new List<object> { DataControl.SelectedItem });
				}
			});
		}

		private void AddToOriginationSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (OriginationSelectedItems != null)
				{
					OriginationSelectedItems.Add(item);
				}
			});
		}

		private void RemoveFromOriginationSelectedItems(object item)
		{
			OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (OriginationSelectedItems != null)
				{
					OriginationSelectedItems.Remove(item);
				}
			});
		}

		private void ClearOriginationSelectedItems()
		{
			if (OriginationSelectedItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				bool flag = true;
				DataControlBase originationDataControl = OriginationDataControl;
				foreach (object item in OriginationSelectedItems)
				{
					bool find = false;
					DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase d)
					{
						find = find || d.FindRow(item) != int.MinValue;
					});
					if (find)
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					OriginationSelectedItems.Clear();
					return;
				}
				foreach (object selectedItem in SelectedItems)
				{
					OriginationSelectedItems.Remove(selectedItem);
				}
			});
		}

		private void ReplaceFirstOriginationSelectedItem(object newItem)
		{
			OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (OriginationSelectedItems != null && OriginationSelectedItems.Count > 0)
				{
					OriginationSelectedItems[0] = newItem;
				}
			});
		}

		internal virtual void SelectAllMasterDetail()
		{
			DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				bool? allItemsSelected = GetAllItemsSelectedMasterDetail();
				UpdateAllVisibleDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectAllMasterDetail(allItemsSelected);
				});
			}, range: false);
		}

		private void UpdateAllVisibleDetailDataControls(Action<DataControlBase> action)
		{
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>> list = new List<KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int>>();
				detail.DataControlParent.CollectViewVisibleIndexChain(list);
				if (list.Where((KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> index) => index.Value < 0).Count() == 0)
				{
					action(detail);
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal void DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(Action action, bool range)
		{
			BeginMasterDetailSelection(range);
			try
			{
				action();
			}
			finally
			{
				EndMasterDetailSelection(range);
			}
		}

		private void BeginMasterDetailSelection(bool range)
		{
			DataControl.UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				if (detail.DataView.GetActualSelectionMode() != MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginUpdateSelectedItems();
				}
			});
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				if (range)
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginRangeSelection();
				}
				else
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginSelection();
				}
			});
		}

		private void EndMasterDetailSelection(bool range)
		{
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				if (range)
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.EndRangeSelection();
				}
				else
				{
					detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy.EndSelection();
				}
			});
			DataControl.UpdateAllOriginationDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase detail)
			{
				if (detail.DataView.GetActualSelectionMode() != MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
				{
					SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategy = detail.DataView.SelectionStrategy;
					selectionStrategy.SelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
					{
						selectionStrategy.EndUpdateSelectedItems();
					});
				}
			});
		}

		protected internal void ClearMasterDetailSelection()
		{
			DataControl.ClearMasterDetailSelection();
		}

		internal virtual void SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRange(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRangeCore(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
		}

		protected void SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRangeCore(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				if (!IsControlPressed)
				{
					ClearMasterDetailSelection();
				}
				SelectMasterDetailRange(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
			}, range: true);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnBeforeSelectionChanged(SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!RangeSelectionLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Refresh && isClearingRange)
				{
					CheckRangeSelectionIsChanged();
					ClearSelectedItems();
				}
				if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Add && !view.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(e.ControllerRow))
				{
					object row = DataControl.GetRow(e.ControllerRow);
					if (row != null)
					{
						CheckRangeSelectionIsChanged();
						AddToSelectedItems(row);
					}
				}
				if (e.Action == CollectionChangeAction.Remove && !view.DataProviderBase.IsGroupRowHandle(e.ControllerRow))
				{
					object row2 = DataControl.GetRow(e.ControllerRow);
					if (row2 != null)
					{
						CheckRangeSelectionIsChanged();
						RemoveFromSelectedItems(row2);
					}
				}
			});
		}

		private void CheckRangeSelectionIsChanged()
		{
			if (!rangeSelectionIsChanged)
			{
				rangeSelectionIsChanged = true;
				BeginUpdateSelectedItems();
			}
		}

		protected internal void SelectMasterDetailRange(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			SelectMasterDetailRangeCore(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
		}

		private void SelectMasterDetailRangeCore(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			if (startCommonVisibleIndex == endCommonVisibleIndex)
			{
				SelectItemByCommonVisibleIndex(startCommonVisibleIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				if (startCommonVisibleIndex < 0 || endCommonVisibleIndex < 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (startCommonVisibleIndex > endCommonVisibleIndex)
				{
					for (int num = startCommonVisibleIndex; num >= endCommonVisibleIndex; num--)
					{
						SelectItemByCommonVisibleIndex(num);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = startCommonVisibleIndex; i <= endCommonVisibleIndex; i++)
					{
						SelectItemByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SelectItemByCommonVisibleIndex(int commonVisibleIndex)
		{
			KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = DataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(commonVisibleIndex);
			DataControlBase dataControl = keyValuePair.Key.DataControl;
			int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(keyValuePair.Value);
			if (dataControl.SelectionMode != MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow)
			{
				dataControl.SelectItem(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
			}
		}

		public bool? GetAllItemsSelectedMasterDetail()
		{
			int globalSelectedRowCount = GetGlobalSelectedRowCount();
			int globalVisibleRowCount = GetGlobalVisibleRowCount();
			return AreAllItemsSelected(globalSelectedRowCount, globalVisibleRowCount);
		}

		private int GetGlobalVisibleRowCount()
		{
			int visibleRowCount = 0;
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				visibleRowCount += dataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				if (dataControl.DataView.ShouldDisplayBottomRow || dataControl.DataView.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow)
				{
					visibleRowCount--;
				}
			});
			return visibleRowCount;
		}

		internal int GetGlobalSelectedRowCount()
		{
			int selectedRowCount = 0;
			DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
			{
				selectedRowCount += dataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles().Length;
			});
			return selectedRowCount;
		}

		private void SelectItemsInOriginationGrid(IList selectedItems)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0041: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SelectionChangedLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(delegate
				{
					ClearDetailsSelection();
					SelectItemsInDetails(selectedItems);
				}, range: false);
			});
			DataControl.RaiseSelectionChanged(new SelectionChangedEventArgs(CollectionChangeAction.Refresh, int.MinValue));
		}

		private void ClearDetailsSelection()
		{
			DataControl.GetRootDataControl().UpdateAllDetailDataControls(ClearDetailDataControlSelection, ClearDetailDataControlSelection);
		}

		private void ClearDetailDataControlSelection(DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			if (dataControl.GetOriginationDataControl() == DataControl)
			{
				dataControl.UnselectAll();
			}
		}

		private void SelectItemsInDetails(IList selectedItems)
		{
			if (selectedItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (object selectedItem in selectedItems)
			{
				SelectItemInOriginationGrid(selectedItem);
			}
		}

		private void SelectItemInOriginationGrid(object item)
		{

			OriginationSelectionStrategy.SelectedItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{

					object obj = (OriginationDataControl.HasSelectedItems() ? OriginationSelectedItems[0] : null);
					if (OriginationDataControl.SelectedItem != obj)
					{
						SetSelectedItem(OriginationDataControl, obj);
					}
				}
			});
		}

	public abstract class MultiSelectionStrategyBase : SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		private Dictionary<DataViewBase, Tuple<int, int>> cashOldView;

		private Dictionary<DataViewBase, Tuple<int, int>> cashNewView;

		protected RectangleMaster OldMasterRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				return view.RootView.SelectionStrategy.oldMasterRectangleCore;
			}
			set
			{
				view.RootView.SelectionStrategy.oldMasterRectangleCore = value;
			}
		}

		public MultiSelectionStrategyBase(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override void OnDataControlInitialized()
		{
			base.DataControl.RequiresReset = true;
			if (base.DataControl.SelectedItems != null)
			{
				ProcessSelectedItemsChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				if (base.DataControl.SelectedItem == null)
				{
					base.OnDataControlInitialized();
					OnDataSourceReset();
					return;
				}
				ProcessSelectedItemChanged();
			}
			base.OnDataControlInitialized();
		}

		public override void ProcessSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			OnSelectedItemsChanged(new NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs(NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset));
		}

		public override void OnSelectedItemsChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!base.CanGetSelectedItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
			{
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						UnselectItem(oldItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add || e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace)
				{
					foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
					{
						SelectItem(newItem);
					}
				}
				if (e.Action == NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Reset)
				{
					SelectItems(base.SelectedItems);
				}
				UpdateSelectedItem();
			});
		}

		public sealed override bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnPreviewKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Key == Key.Space && view.ActiveEditor == null)
			{
				if (base.IsControlPressed)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!view.IsKeyboardFocusInSearchPanel() && !view.IsEditFormVisible)
				{
					return ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace();

		public override void OnItemChanged(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemChanged && base.CanUpdateSelectedItems)
			{
				int newIndex = e.NewIndex;
				if (IsRowSelected(newIndex) && !base.SelectedItems.Contains(base.DataControl.GetRow(newIndex)))
				{
					UnselectRow(newIndex);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void StartMouseSelection()
		{
			OldMasterRectangle = null;
		}

		internal override void SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex, double startX, double endX, DataControlBase rootDataControl, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy, bool startInDataArea = false)
		{
			SelectMasterDetailRangeCellCore(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex, startX, endX, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy, startInDataArea);
		}

		protected void SelectMasterDetailRangeCellCore(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex, double startX, double endX, DataControlBase rootDataControl, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy, bool startInDataArea)
		{
			if (startCommonVisibleIndex < 0 || endCommonVisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				if (!startInDataArea || endCommonVisibleIndex >= 0 || startCommonVisibleIndex <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				endCommonVisibleIndex = startCommonVisibleIndex;
				startCommonVisibleIndex++;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
			int num2 = Math.Max(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
			double num3 = Math.Min(startX, endX);
			double num4 = Math.Max(startX, endX);
			SelectDetailRangeByCommonVisibleIndex(num, num2, num3, num4, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
			OldMasterRectangle = new RectangleMaster
			{
				StartVisibleIndex = num,
				EndVisibleIndex = num2,
				StartX = num3,
				EndX = num4
			};
		}

		private void UnselectDetail(DataControlBase dataControl, int rowHandle, int startColIndex, int endColIndex, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy)
		{
			dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginSelection();
			try
			{
				if (selectOtherStrategy && !dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelection())
				{
					dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.UnselectRow(rowHandle);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelection())
					{
						return;
					}
					if (dataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandle))
					{
						dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.UnselectRow(rowHandle);
						return;
					}
					dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior.IterateCells(rowHandle, startColIndex, rowHandle, endColIndex, delegate(int rHandle, ColumnBase column)
					{
						dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.UnselectCellCore(rHandle, column, useSelectionCount);
					});
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.EndSelection();
			}
		}

		private void UnselectDetailstOldRectange(int startIterate, int endIterate, int minIndex, int maxIndex, DataControlBase rootDataControl, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy)
		{
			for (int i = startIterate; i < endIterate; i++)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = rootDataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
				if (keyValuePair.Key != null)
				{
					int value = keyValuePair.Value;
					DataViewBase key = keyValuePair.Key.OriginationView ?? keyValuePair.Key;
					DataControlBase dataControl = keyValuePair.Key.DataControl;
					int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(value);
					int num;
					int num2;
					if (cashOldView.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						Tuple<int, int> tuple = cashOldView[key];
						num = tuple.Item1;
						num2 = tuple.Item2;
					}
					else
					{
						num = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(OldMasterRectangle.StartX).ActualVisibleIndex;
						num2 = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(OldMasterRectangle.EndX).ActualVisibleIndex;
						cashOldView.Add(key, new Tuple<int, int>(num, num2));
					}
					if (i < minIndex || i > maxIndex)
					{
						UnselectDetail(dataControl, rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore, num, num2, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SelectDetailRangeByCommonVisibleIndex(int minIndex, int maxIndex, double minX, double maxX, DataControlBase rootDataControl, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy)
		{
			bool hasDetailViews = ((ITableView)rootDataControl.DataView).HasDetailViews;
			cashOldView = new Dictionary<DataViewBase, Tuple<int, int>>();
			cashNewView = new Dictionary<DataViewBase, Tuple<int, int>>();
			if (OldMasterRectangle != null)
			{
				UnselectDetailstOldRectange(OldMasterRectangle.StartVisibleIndex, minIndex, minIndex, maxIndex, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
				UnselectDetailstOldRectange(maxIndex + 1, OldMasterRectangle.EndVisibleIndex + 1, minIndex, maxIndex, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
			}
			if (hasDetailViews)
			{
				SelectDetailRangeByCommonVisibleIndexBase(minIndex, maxIndex, minX, maxX, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
			}
			else
			{
				SelectRangeByCommonVisibleIndex(minIndex, maxIndex, minX, maxX, rootDataControl, useSelectionCount, selectOtherStrategy);
			}
			cashOldView = null;
			cashNewView = null;
		}

		private void SelectDetailRangeByCommonVisibleIndexBase(int minIndex, int maxIndex, double minX, double maxX, DataControlBase rootDataControl, bool useSelectionCount, bool selectOtherStrategy)
		{
			int num = minIndex;
			while (num <= maxIndex)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = rootDataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(num);
				if (keyValuePair.Key == null)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				DataControlBase dataControl = keyValuePair.Key.DataControl;
				int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(keyValuePair.Value);
				dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.BeginRangeSelection();
				try
				{
					if (dataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))

						}
						else if (selectOtherStrategy)
						{
							dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
						}
					}
					else if (dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelection())
					{
						DataViewBase key = keyValuePair.Key.OriginationView ?? keyValuePair.Key;
						int num2;
						int num3;
						if (cashNewView.ContainsKey(key))
						{
							Tuple<int, int> tuple = cashNewView[key];
							num2 = tuple.Item1;
							num3 = tuple.Item2;
						}
						else
						{
							num2 = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(minX).ActualVisibleIndex;
							num3 = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(maxX).ActualVisibleIndex;
							cashNewView.Add(key, new Tuple<int, int>(num2, num3));
						}
						int? num4 = null;
						int? num5 = null;
						int num6;
						int num7;
						if (OldMasterRectangle != null)
						{
							if (cashOldView.ContainsKey(key))
							{
								Tuple<int, int> tuple2 = cashOldView[key];
								num4 = tuple2.Item1;
								num5 = tuple2.Item2;
							}
							else
							{
								num4 = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(OldMasterRectangle.StartX).ActualVisibleIndex;
								num5 = ((TableViewBehavior)dataControl.DataView.ViewBehavior).GetColumnByCoordinateWithOffset(OldMasterRectangle.EndX).ActualVisibleIndex;
								cashOldView.Add(key, new Tuple<int, int>(num4.Value, num5.Value));
							}
							num6 = Math.Min(num2, num4.Value);
							num7 = Math.Max(num3, num5.Value);
						}
						else
						{
							num6 = num2;
							num7 = num3;
						}
						SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategy = dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy;
						int incrementCountRows = GetIncrementCountRows(num, maxIndex, dataControl);
						for (int i = num; i <= num + incrementCountRows; i++)
						{
							KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair2 = rootDataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
							if (keyValuePair2.Key == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							int value = keyValuePair2.Value;
							int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 = dataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(value);
							if (rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 == -2147483645 || rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2 == -2147483647)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (dataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2))
							{
								if (dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.IsCellSelection())
								{
									dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectCellCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, dataControl.DataView.VisibleColumnsCore[0], useSelectionCount);
								}
								else if (selectOtherStrategy)
								{
									dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2);
								}
								continue;
							}
							for (int j = num6; j <= num7; j++)
							{
								if (j >= 0 && j <= dataControl.DataView.VisibleColumnsCore.Count - 1)
								{
									ColumnBase columnBase = dataControl.DataView.VisibleColumnsCore[j];
									if (num4.HasValue && i >= OldMasterRectangle.StartVisibleIndex && i <= OldMasterRectangle.EndVisibleIndex && columnBase.ActualVisibleIndex >= num4.Value && columnBase.ActualVisibleIndex <= num5.Value)
									{

									{
										selectionStrategy.SelectCellCore(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore2, columnBase, useSelectionCount);
									}
								}
							}
						}
						num += incrementCountRows;
					}
					else if (selectOtherStrategy)
					{
						dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy.SelectRow(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
					}
				}
				finally

		private int GetIncrementCountRows(int currentIndex, int endIndex, DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			int num = 0;
			DataControlBase rootDataControl = dataControl.GetRootDataControl();
			DataViewBase dataView = dataControl.DataView;
			for (int i = currentIndex + 1; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				KeyValuePair<DataViewBase, int> keyValuePair = rootDataControl.FindViewAndVisibleIndexByCommonVisibleIndex(i);
				if (keyValuePair.Key != null && keyValuePair.Key == dataView)
				{
					num++;
					continue;
				}
				return num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override IList<Tuple<DataControlBase, int>> GetSelectedRowsInfo()
		{
			if (!view.IsRootView && view.DataControl.IsOriginationDataControl())
			{
				List<Tuple<DataControlBase, int>> list = new List<Tuple<DataControlBase, int>>();
				{
					foreach (DataControlBase dataControl in view.DataControl.DetailClones)
					{
						int[] selectedRowHandles = dataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
						if (list != null && selectedRowHandles.Length != 0)
						{
							list.AddRange(selectedRowHandles.Select((int x) => new Tuple<DataControlBase, int>(dataControl, x)).ToList());
						}
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			int[] selectedRows = GetSelectedRows();
			if (selectedRows != null && selectedRows.Length != 0)
			{
				return selectedRows.Select((int x) => new Tuple<DataControlBase, int>(view.DataControl, x)).ToList();
			}
			return base.GetSelectedRowsInfo();
		}
	}
	public abstract class SelectionStrategyRowBase : MultiSelectionStrategyBase
	{
		private Locker DoubleClickLocker = new Locker();

		protected bool HasValidationError
		{
			get
			{
				if (view.HasValidationError)
				{
					return view.IsEditing;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsMultipleMode => view.GetActualSelectionMode() == MultiSelectMode.MultipleRow;

		public bool IsExtendedMode => !IsMultipleMode;

		protected int DataRowCount => base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataRowCount;

		protected virtual int TotalRowCount
		{
			get
			{
				int num = base.DataControl.VisibleRowCount;
				if (base.DataControl.DataView.ShouldDisplayBottomRow || base.DataControl.DataView.ShouldDisplayLoadingRow)
				{
					num--;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

			if (view.SearchPanelColumnProvider == null || !view.SearchPanelColumnProvider.IsSearchLookUpMode)

					return;

			}

		public override void ToggleRowsSelection()
		{
			bool isSelectedEnabled = true;
			bool isUnselectEnabled = true;
			ToggleRowsSelection(GetAllItemsSelected(out isSelectedEnabled, out isUnselectEnabled), isSelectedEnabled, isUnselectEnabled);
		}

		public void ToggleRowsSelection(bool? allItemsSelected, bool enableSelected = true, bool enableUnselected = true)
		{
			if (allItemsSelected.HasValue && allItemsSelected.Value)
			{
				ClearSelection();
			}
			else if (enableSelected)
			{
				SelectAll();
			}
			else
			{
				ClearSelection();
			}
		}

			}
		}

		}

		{

			isUnselectEnabled = true;
			return SelectionStrategyBase.AreAllItemsSelected(SelectedRowCount, TotalRowCount);
		}

		public override void OnDoubleClick(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsMultipleMode && e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
			{
				view.EditorSetInactiveAfterClick = false;
				DoubleClickLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
				{
					((InplaceEditorOwnerBase)base.DataControl.FindTargetView(e.OriginalSource).InplaceEditorOwner).ProcessMouseLeftButtonDown(e);
				});
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldOpenEditor(StylusDevice stylus, int clickCount)
		{
			if (!IsMultipleMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (clickCount == 2 || DoubleClickLocker.IsLocked)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (stylus != null)
			{
				return view.CurrentCellEditor.Return((InplaceEditorBase edit) => edit.IsEditorVisible, () => false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo, StylusDevice stylus, int clickCount)
		{
			if (!ShouldOpenEditor(stylus, clickCount))
			{
				base.OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(hitInfo, stylus, clickCount);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldInvertSelectionOnSpace()
		{
			if (view.RootView.NavigationStyle != GridViewNavigationStyle.Row)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsMultipleMode)
			{
				return !IsRowSelected(view.FocusedRowHandle);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected virtual bool CanInvertSelection(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo)
		{
			if (((base.IsControlPressed && !base.IsShiftPressed) || IsMultipleMode) && (!hitInfo.IsRowCell || hitInfo.RowHandle != view.FocusedRowHandle || hitInfo.Column != view.DataControl.CurrentColumn || view.ActiveEditor == null))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void UpdateSelectionRect(int rowHandle, ColumnBase column)
		{
			if (view.SelectionAnchor != null && view.SelectionOldCell != null)
			{
				int startCommonVisibleIndex = (view.SelectionAnchor.IsLastRow ? (view.SelectionAnchor.RowVisibleIndex + 1) : view.SelectionAnchor.RowVisibleIndex);
				int rowVisibleIndex = view.SelectionOldCell.RowVisibleIndex;
				double startX = view.SelectionAnchor.CoordinateX + view.SelectionAnchor.OffsetX;
				double endX = view.SelectionOldCell.CoordinateX + view.SelectionOldCell.OffsetX;
				SelectMasterDetailRangeCell(startCommonVisibleIndex, rowVisibleIndex, startX, endX, view.RootView.DataControl, useSelectionCount: true, selectOtherStrategy: true, view.SelectionAnchor.IsLastRow);
			}
		}

	public class SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper
	{
		private readonly SelectionStrategyRowBase _selectStrategy;

		private HashSet<int> selectedOldRowHandle = new HashSet<int>();

		private List<int> selectedRowHandle = new List<int>();

		public int? OldRowHandleWithShift { get; set; }

		public SelectionStrategyRowRangeHelper(SelectionStrategyRowBase selectStrategy)
		{
			_selectStrategy = selectStrategy;
		}

		public void SelectRowRange(IEnumerable<int> selectedRowsHandles)
		{
			selectedRowHandle.Clear();
			selectedRowHandle.AddRange(selectedRowsHandles);
			SelectRowRangeCore();
		}

		public void AddSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!selectedRowHandle.Contains(rowHandle))
			{
				selectedRowHandle.Add(rowHandle);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			selectedRowHandle.Remove(rowHandle);
		}

		public void SelectRowRange(int startRowHandle, int endRowHandle)
		{
			selectedRowHandle.Clear();
			_selectStrategy.SelectRangeCore(startRowHandle, endRowHandle, delegate(int rowHandle)
			{
				selectedRowHandle.Add(rowHandle);
			});
			SelectRowRangeCore();
		}

		private void SelectRowRangeCore()
		{
			_selectStrategy.ClearSelection();
			foreach (int item in selectedOldRowHandle)
			{
				_selectStrategy.SelectRow(item);
			}
			foreach (int item2 in selectedRowHandle)
			{
				_selectStrategy.SelectRow(item2);
			}
		}

		public void SelectOnlyThisMasterDetailRange(int startCommonVisibleIndex, int endCommonVisibleIndex)
		{
			_selectStrategy.DoMasterDetailSelectionAction(delegate
			{
				_selectStrategy.SelectMasterDetailRange(startCommonVisibleIndex, endCommonVisibleIndex);
			}, range: true);
		}

		public void OnAfterMouseLeftButtonDown(IDataViewHitInfo hitInfo, Func<IDataViewHitInfo, bool> IsRemoveSelectedRowHandle, DataControlBase dataControl)
		{
			bool flag = IsRemoveSelectedRowHandle(hitInfo);
			if (!ModifierKeysHelper.IsCtrlPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && !ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers))
			{
				dataControl?.ClearMasterDetailSelection();
				_selectStrategy.ClearSelection();
				selectedOldRowHandle.Clear();
				selectedRowHandle.Clear();
				if (hitInfo.RowHandle != int.MinValue)
				{
					dataControl.SelectItem(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				}
				else if (dataControl != null && dataControl.DataView != null)
				{
					dataControl.DataView.SelectionAnchor = new SelectionAnchorCell(dataControl.DataView, int.MinValue, null)
					{
						IsLastRow = true,
						RowVisibleIndex = int.MinValue
					};
				}
				return;
			}
			if (ModifierKeysHelper.IsShiftPressed(Keyboard.Modifiers) && OldRowHandleWithShift.HasValue && dataControl != null && dataControl.DataView != null)
			{
				int commonVisibleIndex = dataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(OldRowHandleWithShift.Value);
				int commonVisibleIndex2 = dataControl.GetCommonVisibleIndex(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				int num = -1;
				bool flag2 = true;
				if (commonVisibleIndex != commonVisibleIndex2)
				{
					int num2;
					if (commonVisibleIndex > commonVisibleIndex2)
					{
						num2 = commonVisibleIndex2;
						num = commonVisibleIndex;
						flag2 = selectedOldRowHandle.Count != 0 && selectedOldRowHandle.Min() != num;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = commonVisibleIndex;
						num = commonVisibleIndex2;
						flag2 = selectedOldRowHandle.Count != 0 && selectedOldRowHandle.Max() != num2;
					}
					if (num2 >= 0 && num >= 0 && flag2)
					{
						for (int i = num2; i <= num; i++)
						{
							if (i == commonVisibleIndex2)
							{
								continue;
							}
							int rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore = dataControl.GetRowHandleByVisibleIndexCore(i);
							if (selectedOldRowHandle.Contains(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
							{
								selectedOldRowHandle.Remove(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
								selectedRowHandle.Remove(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
								if (dataControl.DataView.IsRowSelected(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore))
								{
									dataControl.UnselectItem(rowHandleByVisibleIndexCore);
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (int item2 in selectedRowHandle)
			{
				selectedOldRowHandle.Add(item2);
			}
			int[] selectedRowHandles = dataControl.GetSelectedRowHandles();
			int[] array = selectedRowHandles;
			foreach (int item in array)
			{
				selectedOldRowHandle.Add(item);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				selectedOldRowHandle.Remove(hitInfo.RowHandle);
				selectedRowHandle.Remove(hitInfo.RowHandle);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class SelectionStrategyNone : SelectionStrategyBase
	{
		internal override bool IsFocusedRowHandleLocked => base.UpdateSelectedItemWasLocked;

		protected override bool IsServerMode => base.DataControl.DataProviderBase.IsAsyncServerMode;

		protected virtual bool ShowFocusedRectangle => view.ShowFocusedRectangle;

		public SelectionStrategyNone(DataViewBase view)
			: base(view)
		{
		}

		public override bool IsRowSelected(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return rowHandle == view.FocusedRowHandle;
		}

		public override SelectionState GetRowSelectionState(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			if (rowHandle != view.FocusedRowHandle)
			{
				return SelectionState.None;
			}
			return SelectionState.Focused;
		}

		public override int[] GetSelectedRows()
		{
			if (view.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle || !view.IsFocusedView)
			{
				return new int[0];
			}
			return new int[1] { view.FocusedRowHandle };
		}

		public override void OnFocusedRowDataChanged()
		{
			SetFocusedRowSelected();
		}

		protected override void OnDataSourceResetCore()
		{
			base.OnDataSourceResetCore();
			if (!RestoreSelectedItem())
			{
				UpdateSelectedItems();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnAssignedToGridCore()
		{
			base.OnAssignedToGridCore();
			UpdateSelectedItems();
		}

		public override void OnDataControlInitialized()
		{
			base.DataControl.RequiresReset = true;
			if (base.DataControl.HasValue(DataControlBase.SelectedItemProperty))
			{
				ProcessSelectedItemChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				OnDataSourceReset();
			}
			base.OnDataControlInitialized();
		}

		public override bool UpdateBorderForFocusedElementCore()
		{
			if (!ShowFocusedRectangle)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (base.DataControl.IsGroupRowHandleCore(view.FocusedRowHandle))
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnGroupRow();
				return true;
			}
			if (view.IsAdditionalRowFocused)
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
				return true;
			}
			if (view.NavigationStyle == GridViewNavigationStyle.Cell)
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnCell();
			}
			else
			{
				view.SetFocusedRectangleOnRow();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void CopyToClipboard()
		{
			if (!view.IsInvalidFocusedRowHandle)
			{
				base.DataControl.CopyCurrentItemToClipboard();
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldAddToSelectedItems(int rowHandle)
		{
			if (!base.ShouldAddToSelectedItems(rowHandle))
			{
				if (view.IsNewItemRowHandle(rowHandle))
				{
					return view.ViewBehavior.IsNewItemRowEditing;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnSelectedItemChangedCore()
		{
			if (!base.IsSelectionLocked && base.DataControl.CurrentItem != base.DataControl.SelectedItem)
			{
				SelectedItemChangedLocker.DoLockedActionIfNotLocked((Action)delegate
				{
					base.DataControl.SetCurrentItemCore(base.DataControl.SelectedItem);
				});
			}
		}

		public override void ProcessSelectedItemsChanged()
		{
			UpdateSelectedItems();
		}

		public void SetFocusedRowSelected()
		{
			if (!base.DataControl.AllowUpdateCurrentItem())
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectionLocker.DoLockedAction((Action)delegate
			{
				if (base.CanUpdateSelectedItems)
				{
					IList<object> selectedItems = GetSelectedItems();
					if (!IsSameSelection(base.SelectedItems.Cast<object>(), selectedItems))
					{
						SetFocusedRowSelected(selectedItems);
					}
					UpdateSelectedItem();
				}
				else if (IsServerMode)
				{
					UpdateSelectedItem();
				}
			});
		}

		private void SetFocusedRowSelected(IList<object> selectedItemsCore)
		{
			if (selectedItemsCore.Count > 0)
			{
				if (base.SelectedItems.Count == 0)
				{
					AddToSelectedItems(selectedItemsCore[0]);
				}
				else if (base.SelectedItems.Count == 1)
				{
					ReplaceFirstSelectedItem(selectedItemsCore[0]);
				}
				else
				{
					UpdateSelectedItemsCore();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ClearSelectedItems();
			}
		}

		protected internal override void UpdateSelectedItem()
		{
			if (base.DataControl.AllowUpdateCurrentItem())
			{
				base.UpdateSelectedItem();
			}
		}

		public override void OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(DependencyObject originalSource)
		{
			base.OnBeforeMouseLeftButtonDown(originalSource);
			if (base.IsControlPressed || base.IsShiftPressed)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool clear = true;
			if (view != null && view.RootView != null && view.RootView.DataControl != null && view.RootView is ITableView && ((ITableView)view.RootView).HasDetailViews)
			{
				IDataViewHitInfo dataViewHitInfo = view.RootView.CalcHitInfoCore(originalSource);
				if (!dataViewHitInfo.InRow && !dataViewHitInfo.IsDataArea && !dataViewHitInfo.IsRowCell)
				{
					view.RootView.DataControl.UpdateAllDetailDataControls(delegate(DataControlBase dataControl)
					{
						if (dataControl != null && dataControl.DataView != null)
						{
							clear = clear && dataControl.DataView.SelectionStrategy is SelectionStrategyNone;
						}
					});
				}
			}
			if (clear)
			{
				ClearMasterDetailSelection();
			}
		}
	}

			{
				return val.Infos.SelectMany((DataColumnSortInfo childInfo) => GetSortInfoPath(childInfo));
			}
			string name = sortInfo.ColumnInfo.Name;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
			{
				return name.Yield();
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<string>();
		}

		private static bool IsAffectedByCustomUnboundColumnDataEvent(ColumnBase column, bool hasCustomUnboundColumnDataSubscription)
		{
			if (hasCustomUnboundColumnDataSubscription && column.IsUnbound)
			{
				return column.DisplayMemberBindingCalculator == null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static IEnumerable<string> GetColumnPathCore(bool isUnbound, string unboundExpression, string fieldName)
		{
			if (isUnbound)
			{
				string[] array = CriteriaPropertyNameParser.Parse(unboundExpression);
				if (array.Any())
				{
					return array;
				}
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
			{
				return fieldName.Yield();
			}
			return Enumerable.Empty<string>();
		}

		private static DataDependentEntity GetFormatConditionDataDependentEntity(FormatConditionBase condition, IColumnCollection columns)
		{
			if (condition.IsValid)
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(condition.FieldName) || condition.ApplyToRow)
				{
					return new DataDependentEntity().AddRowConditions();
				}
				ColumnBase columnBase = columns[condition.FieldName];
				if (columnBase != null)
				{
					return new DataDependentEntity().AddColumn(columnBase);
				}
			}
			return new DataDependentEntity();
		}

		protected static IEnumerable<DataDependentEntityInfo> GetSortingDataDependentEntityInfo(IList<DataColumnSortInfo> sortInfo, int groupCount = 0)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < sortInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity = ((i < groupCount) ? new DataDependentEntity().AddGrouping() : new DataDependentEntity().AddSorting());
				yield return new DataDependentEntityInfo(GetSortInfoPath(sortInfo[i]), dataDependentEntity, isFixed: false);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GridPropertySchemeController
	{
		private class DataDependentEntityNodeSource
		{
			public IEnumerable<string> Path { get; private set; }

			public DataDependentEntity Entity { get; private set; }

			public DataDependentEntityNodeSource(IEnumerable<string> path, DataDependentEntity entity)
			{
				Path = path;
				Entity = entity;
			}
		}

		private ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] scheme = (ObservablePropertySchemeNode[])(object)new ObservablePropertySchemeNode[0];

		public DataControlBase Grid { get; }

		private DataViewBase View => Grid.viewCore;

		public ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] Scheme
		{
			get
			{
				return scheme;
			}
			private set
			{
				ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] array = (ObservablePropertySchemeNode[])(((object)value) ?? ((object)new ObservablePropertySchemeNode[0]));
				if (scheme != array)
				{
					scheme = array;
					if (View != null)
					{
						View.AttachObservablePropertyScheme(Scheme);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public DataDependentEntityTree DataDependentEntityGraph { get; private set; } = new DataDependentEntityTree();

		public GridPropertySchemeController(DataControlBase grid)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("grid");
			}
			Grid = grid;
		}

		public void UpdateProperties()
		{
			if (Grid.IsInitialized)
			{
				DataDependentEntityGraph = CreateDataDependentEntityGraph();
				Scheme = CreateScheme();
			}
		}

		public void OnDataSourceExtracted(BindingListAdapter bindingAdapter)
		{
			if (bindingAdapter != null)
			{
				bindingAdapter.ObservablePropertyScheme = Scheme;
			}
		}

		private ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] CreateScheme()
		{
			if (!Grid.ActualAllowComplexPropertyUpdates)
			{
				return (ObservablePropertySchemeNode[])(object)new ObservablePropertySchemeNode[0];
			}
			return CreateScheme(DataDependentEntityGraph.Nodes);
		}

		private ObservablePropertySchemeNode[] CreateScheme(DataDependentEntityNode[] dataDependentEntityNodes)
		{
			return dataDependentEntityNodes.Where((DataDependentEntityNode x) => x.Children.Any()).Select((Func<DataDependentEntityNode, ObservablePropertySchemeNode>)((DataDependentEntityNode x) => new ObservablePropertySchemeNode(x.PropertyName, CreateScheme(x.Children)))).ToArray();
		}

		private DataDependentEntityTree CreateDataDependentEntityGraph()
		{
			if (View == null)
			{
				return new DataDependentEntityTree();
			}
			List<DataDependentEntityNodeSource> list = new List<DataDependentEntityNodeSource>();
			List<DataDependentEntity> list2 = new List<DataDependentEntity>();
			foreach (DataDependentEntityInfo info in View.GetDataDependentEntityInfo())
			{
				if (info.IsFixed)
				{
					list2.Add(info.DataDependentEntity);
					continue;
				}
				list.AddRange(from path in info.Path
					where !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)
					select new DataDependentEntityNodeSource(path.Split('.'), info.DataDependentEntity));
			}
			return new DataDependentEntityTree(CreateDataDependentEntityGraph(list), DataDependentEntity.Combine(list2));
		}

		private static DataDependentEntityNode[] CreateDataDependentEntityGraph(IEnumerable<DataDependentEntityNodeSource> source)
		{
			return (from sourceItem in source
				where sourceItem.Path.Any()
				group new DataDependentEntityNodeSource(sourceItem.Path.Skip(1), sourceItem.Entity) by sourceItem.Path.First() into @group
				select new DataDependentEntityNode(@group.Key, DataDependentEntity.Combine(@group.Select((DataDependentEntityNodeSource x) => x.Entity)), CreateDataDependentEntityGraph(@group))).ToArray();
		}
	}
	internal sealed class DataDependentEntityInfo
	{
		private static readonly DataDependentEntity EmptyDataDependentEntity = new DataDependentEntity();

		public IEnumerable<string> Path { get; }

		public DataDependentEntity DataDependentEntity { get; }

		public bool IsFixed { get; }

		public DataDependentEntityInfo(IEnumerable<string> path, DataDependentEntity dataDependentEntity, bool isFixed)
		{
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)path, "path");
			Guard.ArgumentNotNull((object)dataDependentEntity, "dataDependentEntity");
			Path = path;
			DataDependentEntity = dataDependentEntity;
			IsFixed = isFixed;
		}

		public DataDependentEntityInfo(IEnumerable<string> path)
			: this(path, EmptyDataDependentEntity, isFixed: false)
		{
		}
	}
	internal class DataDependentEntityTree
	{
		private readonly DataDependentEntityNode[] nodes;

		private readonly DataDependentEntity fixedEntity;

		private Dictionary<string, DataDependentEntity> propertyChangeDependencyCache = new Dictionary<string, DataDependentEntity>();

		public DataDependentEntityNode[] Nodes => nodes;

		public DataDependentEntity FixedEntity => fixedEntity;

		public DataDependentEntityTree(DataDependentEntityNode[] nodes, DataDependentEntity fixedEntity)
		{
			this.nodes = nodes;
			this.fixedEntity = fixedEntity;
		}

		public DataDependentEntityTree(DataDependentEntityNode[] nodes)
			: this(nodes, new DataDependentEntity())
		{
		}

		public DataDependentEntityTree()
			: this(new DataDependentEntityNode[0])
		{
		}

		public DataDependentEntity GetPropertyChangeDependency(string changedPropertyName)
		{
			return ((IDictionary<string, DataDependentEntity>)propertyChangeDependencyCache).GetOrAdd(changedPropertyName ?? string.Empty, (Func<DataDependentEntity>)delegate
			{
				List<DataDependentEntity> list = new List<DataDependentEntity>();
				DataDependentEntityNode[] array = FindPropertyDependentNodes(changedPropertyName, Nodes);
				foreach (DataDependentEntityNode node in array)
				{
					CollectDependentEntities(list, node);
				}
				list.Add(FixedEntity);
				return DataDependentEntity.Combine(list);
			});
		}

		private static DataDependentEntityNode[] FindPropertyDependentNodes(string changedPropertyName, DataDependentEntityNode[] rootNodes)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(changedPropertyName))
			{
				return FindPropertyDependentNode(changedPropertyName, rootNodes).Return((DataDependentEntityNode x) => x.YieldToArray(), () => new DataDependentEntityNode[0]);
			}
			return rootNodes;
		}

		private static DataDependentEntityNode FindPropertyDependentNode(string propertyName, DataDependentEntityNode[] nodes)
		{
			return FindPropertyDependentNode(propertyName.Split('.'), 0, nodes);
		}

		private static DataDependentEntityNode FindPropertyDependentNode(string[] descriptorNames, int level, DataDependentEntityNode[] nodes)
		{
			string text = SafeGetDescriptorName(descriptorNames, level);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				return null;
			}
			DataDependentEntityNode dataDependentEntityNode = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < nodes.Length; i++)
			{
				if (nodes[i].PropertyName == text)
				{
					dataDependentEntityNode = nodes[i];
					break;
				}
			}
			if (dataDependentEntityNode == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (level != descriptorNames.Length - 1)
			{
				return FindPropertyDependentNode(descriptorNames, level + 1, dataDependentEntityNode.Children);
			}
			return dataDependentEntityNode;
		}

		private static string SafeGetDescriptorName(string[] descriptorNames, int level)
		{
			if (level >= descriptorNames.Length || level < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return descriptorNames[level];
		}

		private static void CollectDependentEntities(List<DataDependentEntity> dependentEntities, DataDependentEntityNode node)
		{
			dependentEntities.Add(node.Entity);
			DataDependentEntityNode[] children = node.Children;
			foreach (DataDependentEntityNode node2 in children)
			{
				CollectDependentEntities(dependentEntities, node2);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DataDependentEntityNode
	{
		private readonly string propertyName;

		private readonly DataDependentEntity entity;

		private readonly DataDependentEntityNode[] children;

		public string PropertyName => propertyName;

		public DataDependentEntity Entity => entity;

		public DataDependentEntityNode[] Children => children;

		public DataDependentEntityNode(string propertyName, DataDependentEntity entity, DataDependentEntityNode[] children)
		{
			this.propertyName = propertyName;
			this.entity = entity;
			this.children = children;
		}

		public DataDependentEntityNode(string propertyName, DataDependentEntity entity)
			: this(propertyName, entity, new DataDependentEntityNode[0])
		{
		}
	}
}

	public class CardsHierarchyPanel : HierarchyPanel

		public static readonly DependencyProperty FixedSizeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("FixedSize", typeof(double), typeof(CardsHierarchyPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(double.NaN, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeparatorThicknessProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("SeparatorThickness", typeof(double), typeof(CardsHierarchyPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(0.0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty MaxCardCountInRowProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("MaxCardCountInRow", typeof(int), typeof(CardsHierarchyPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(int.MaxValue, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsMeasure));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty CardAlignmentProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CardAlignment", typeof(Alignment), typeof(CardsHierarchyPanel), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata((object)(Alignment)0, FrameworkPropertyMetadataOptions.AffectsArrange));

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey SeparatorInfoPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("SeparatorInfo", typeof(IList<SeparatorInfo>), typeof(CardsHierarchyPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SeparatorInfoProperty = SeparatorInfoPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;

		private System.Windows.Size CardMarginCached;

		private List<FrameworkElement> hiddenItems;

		private int tryCount;

		private double? rest;

		private int actualGenerateItemsOffset;

		private double oldOffset;

		private int scrollDiff;

		private int? lastRowIndex;

		private int? visibleIndex;

		private int? previousGenerateOffset;

		private int rowCardCount;

		public Thickness CardMargin
