		internal double MaxSecondarySize { get; private set; }

		internal List<CardRowInfo> RowsInfo { get; private set; }

		private DetailNodeContainer NodeContainer => base.DataPresenter.View.RootNodeContainer;

		internal int GenerateItemsOffset => Math.Max(0, Math.Min(actualGenerateItemsOffset, base.DataPresenter.ItemCount - 1));

		internal double Extent { get; private set; }

		private GroupRowInfoCollection GroupInfo => ((DataController)base.DataPresenter.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupInfo;

		private int LastGroupLevel => ((DataController)base.DataPresenter.DataControl.DataProviderBase.DataController).GroupedColumnCount - 1;

		internal int RowItemCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (RowsInfo == null || RowsInfo.Count == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return GetRowInfo().Elements.Count;
			}
		}

		private void OnCardMarginChanged()
		{
			CardMarginCached = new System.Windows.Size(CardMargin.Left + CardMargin.Right, CardMargin.Top + CardMargin.Bottom);
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureItemsContainer(System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer)
		{
			if (itemsContainer == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			oldOffset = ((base.DataPresenter != null) ? base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset : 0.0);
			if (!CorrectScrollParametersIfScrollOutOfBounds())
			{
				ValidateTree(base.ItemsContainer);
			}
			hiddenItems = new List<FrameworkElement>();
			RowsInfo = MeasureItemsContainer(0.0, availableSize, itemsContainer, 0);
			MaxSecondarySize = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(itemsContainer.DesiredSize);
			return itemsContainer.DesiredSize;
		}

		internal void ClearRows()
		{
			RowsInfo.Clear();
		}

		internal bool OnLayoutUpdated()
		{
			System.Windows.Size lastConstraint = base.DataPresenter.LastConstraint;
			if (CorrectGenerateItemsOffset(base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(lastConstraint)) && GenerateItemsIfNeeded(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(lastConstraint) - GetRowOffset()))
			{
				tryCount = 0;
				return true;
			}
			tryCount++;
			if (tryCount > 100)
			{
				tryCount = 0;
				return false;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
			return false;
		}

		private bool CorrectScrollParametersIfScrollOutOfBounds()
		{
			if (base.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ScrollOutOfBounds())
			{
				oldOffset = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(Extent - base.Viewport, CalcExtentSimple() - 1.0));
				actualGenerateItemsOffset = Math.Max(0, base.DataPresenter.ItemCount - 1);
				base.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(oldOffset);
				lastRowIndex = actualGenerateItemsOffset;
				NodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(GenerateItemsOffset, 1, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool ScrollOutOfBounds()
		{
			if (base.DataPresenter != null && actualGenerateItemsOffset >= base.DataPresenter.ItemCount)
			{
				return actualGenerateItemsOffset != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private double CalcExtentSimple()
		{
			if (((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count == 0)
			{
				return (int)Math.Ceiling((double)base.DataPresenter.ItemCount / (double)rowCardCount);
			}
			double num = 0.0;
			foreach (GroupRowInfo item in (Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)
			{
				if (item.ParentGroup == null || item.ParentGroup.Expanded)
				{
					num += 1.0;
					if (item.Expanded && item.Level == LastGroupLevel)
					{
						num += Math.Ceiling((double)item.ChildControllerRowCount / (double)rowCardCount);
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool GenerateItemsIfNeeded(double defineSize)
		{
			if (base.DataPresenter == null || !base.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				return true;
			}
			double num = (double)((decimal)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - (decimal)Math.Floor(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset));
			if ((int)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset == 0 && GenerateItemsOffset > 0)
			{
				oldOffset = Math.Ceiling((double)GenerateItemsOffset / (double)rowCardCount) + num;
				base.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(oldOffset);
				return false;
			}
			if (GenerateItemsOffset == 0 && base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset > 1.0)
			{
				oldOffset = num;
				base.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(oldOffset);
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				if (defineSize <= 0.0 && RowsInfo.Count - i > 1)
				{
					if (rest.HasValue)
					{
						double defineSize2 = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetRowInfo().RenderSize);
						AdjustScrollBarByDelta((defineSize2 - rest.Value) / defineSize2);
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				defineSize -= base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(RowsInfo[i].Size);
			}
			if (NodeContainer.IsFinished)
			{
				defineSize = Math.Round(defineSize, 4);
				if (base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset == 0.0 || defineSize <= 0.0)
				{
					if (rest.HasValue && defineSize < 0.0)
					{
						AdjustScrollBarByDelta((0.0 - defineSize) / base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetRowInfo().RenderSize));
						return false;
					}
					rest = null;
					return true;
				}
				if (0.0 - GetRowOffset() == defineSize)
				{
					AdjustScrollBar(base.DataPresenter.ScrollOffset);
					return false;
				}
				if (0.0 - GetRowOffset() > defineSize)
				{
					AdjustScrollBarByDelta((0.0 - defineSize) / base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetRowInfo().RenderSize));
					return false;
				}
				rest = defineSize;
				base.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset((num > 0.0) ? Math.Floor(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset) : (base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - 1.0));
				NodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(GenerateItemsOffset, NodeContainer.ItemCount + 1, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
				return false;
			}
			NodeContainer.GenerateItems(1);
			return false;
		}

		private void AdjustScrollBarByDelta(double delta)
		{
			AdjustScrollBar(Math.Round(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset + delta, 4));
		}

		private void AdjustScrollBar(double value)
		{
			oldOffset = value;
			base.DataPresenter.SetDefineScrollOffset(oldOffset);
			rest = null;
		}

		internal void OnDefineScrollInfoChanged()
		{
			if (base.DataPresenter != null && oldOffset != base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset)
			{
				actualGenerateItemsOffset = CalcGenerateItemsOffset(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset);
				if ((int)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - (int)oldOffset < 0 && RowsInfo.Count > 0 && base.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					visibleIndex = GetControllerIndex(RowsInfo[0].Elements[0]);
				}
				scrollDiff = (int)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset - (int)oldOffset;
				InvalidateMeasure();
			}
		}

		private bool CorrectGenerateItemsOffset(double defineSize)
		{
			if (base.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!FillFirstRowIfNeeded())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CorrectGenerateItemsOffsetCore(defineSize))
			{
				NodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(GenerateItemsOffset, NodeContainer.ItemCount, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
				return false;
			}
			previousGenerateOffset = null;
			scrollDiff = 0;
			return true;
		}

		private bool FillFirstRowIfNeeded()
		{
			if (!lastRowIndex.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (RowsInfo.Count == 0 || lastRowIndex == GetControllerIndex(RowsInfo[0].Elements.Last()))
			{
				if (actualGenerateItemsOffset <= 0 || (RowsInfo.Count > 0 && RowsInfo[0].IsItemsContainer))
				{
					lastRowIndex = null;
					return true;
				}
				actualGenerateItemsOffset--;
				NodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(GenerateItemsOffset, NodeContainer.ItemCount + 1, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
				return false;
			}
			actualGenerateItemsOffset++;
			NodeContainer.ReGenerateItems(GenerateItemsOffset, NodeContainer.ItemCount - 1, checkShouldRegenerateItems: false);
			lastRowIndex = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool CorrectGenerateItemsOffsetCore(double defineSize)
		{
			if (!visibleIndex.HasValue)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (FindRowItem(visibleIndex.Value, out var rowIndex, out var itemIndex))
			{
				return EnsureOffset(rowIndex, itemIndex);
			}
			if (actualGenerateItemsOffset <= 0)
			{
				actualGenerateItemsOffset = 0;
				visibleIndex = null;
				return true;
			}
			lastRowIndex = ((RowsInfo.Count > 0) ? new int?(GetControllerIndex(RowsInfo[0].Elements.Last())) : ((int?)null));
			visibleIndex = null;
			return false;
		}

		private bool EnsureOffset(int rowIndex, int itemIndex)
		{
			if (scrollDiff < 0 && rowIndex > -scrollDiff)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rowIndex + scrollDiff; i++)
				{
					actualGenerateItemsOffset += RowsInfo[i].Elements.Count;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if ((itemIndex == 0 || rowIndex == 0) && actualGenerateItemsOffset <= 0)
			{
				actualGenerateItemsOffset = 0;
				visibleIndex = null;
				return false;
			}
			if (itemIndex == 0)
			{
				visibleIndex = null;
				if (RowsInfo[0].IsItemsContainer)
				{
					return true;
				}
				lastRowIndex = GetControllerIndex(RowsInfo[0].Elements.Last());
				return false;
			}
			if (rowIndex == 0)
			{
				previousGenerateOffset = actualGenerateItemsOffset;
				actualGenerateItemsOffset--;
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int j = 0; j < rowIndex; j++)
			{
				if (RowsInfo[j].IsItemsContainer)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag || previousGenerateOffset.HasValue)
			{
				actualGenerateItemsOffset++;
			}
			if (flag || (previousGenerateOffset.HasValue && previousGenerateOffset.Value == actualGenerateItemsOffset))
			{
				visibleIndex = null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool FindRowItem(int controllerIndex, out int rowIndex, out int itemIndex)
		{
			rowIndex = -1;
			itemIndex = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < RowsInfo[i].Elements.Count; j++)
				{
					IItem item = RowsInfo[i].Elements[j];
					if (GetControllerIndex(item) == controllerIndex)
					{
						rowIndex = i;
						itemIndex = j;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool TryFindRowElement(int index, out int rowIndex, out int elementIndex)
		{
			rowIndex = 0;
			elementIndex = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < RowsInfo[i].Elements.Count; j++)
				{
					if (index == GetControllerIndex(RowsInfo[i].Elements[j]))
					{
						rowIndex = i;
						elementIndex = j;
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private int GetControllerIndex(IItem item)
		{
			return ((RowData)item).ControllerVisibleIndex;
		}

		internal int CalcGenerateItemsOffset(double scrollOffset)
		{
			if (!base.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				return (int)scrollOffset;
			}
			if (base.DataPresenter.DataControl == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = (int)scrollOffset - (int)oldOffset;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return actualGenerateItemsOffset;
			}
			if (((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count == 0)
			{
				return CalcOffset(scrollOffset);
			}
			if (num > 0)
			{
				return CalcGroupedOffsetForward(scrollOffset);
			}
			return CalcGroupedOffsetBack(scrollOffset);
		}

		private int CalcOffset(double scrollOffset)
		{
			int num = (int)scrollOffset - (int)oldOffset;
			int num2 = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			if (num > 0 && num < RowsInfo.Count)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					num2 += RowsInfo[i].Elements.Count;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			if (num < 0 && -num < RowsInfo.Count)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < -num; j++)
				{
					num2 -= RowsInfo[j].Elements.Count;
				}
				return num2;
			}
			return num2 + num * rowCardCount;
		}

		private int CalcGroupedOffsetForward(double scrollOffset)
		{
			int num = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			int num2 = (int)oldOffset;
			FindGroupIndex(out var groupIndex, out var rowIndex);
			for (int i = 0; i < RowsInfo.Count - 1; i++)
			{
				CardRowInfo cardRowInfo = RowsInfo[i];
				if (num2 == (int)scrollOffset)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num2++;
				num += cardRowInfo.Elements.Count;
				if (cardRowInfo.IsItemsContainer)
				{
					if (i != 0)
					{
						groupIndex++;
					}
					rowIndex = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					if (rowIndex == -1)
					{
						rowIndex = 0;
					}
					rowIndex += cardRowInfo.Elements.Count;
				}
			}
			for (int j = groupIndex; j < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count; j++)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[j];
				if (num2 == (int)scrollOffset)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (j > groupIndex || rowIndex == -1)
				{
					num++;
					num2++;
				}
				if (val.Expanded && val.Level == LastGroupLevel)
				{
					int num3 = val.ChildControllerRowCount;
					if (j == groupIndex && rowIndex > 0)
					{
						num3 -= rowIndex;
					}
					int num4 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num3 / (double)rowCardCount);
					if ((double)(num2 + num4) > scrollOffset)
					{
						num += ((int)scrollOffset - num2) * rowCardCount;
						break;
					}
					num += num3;
					num2 += num4;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int CalcGroupedOffsetBack(double scrollOffset)
		{
			int num = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			int num2 = (int)oldOffset;
			FindGroupIndex(out var groupIndex, out var rowIndex);
			for (int num3 = groupIndex; num3 >= 0; num3--)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[num3];
				if (num2 == (int)scrollOffset)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (val.Expanded && val.Level == LastGroupLevel)
				{
					int num4 = val.ChildControllerRowCount;
					if (num3 == groupIndex)
					{
						num4 = ((rowIndex >= 0) ? rowIndex : 0);
					}
					int num5 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num4 / (double)rowCardCount);
					if ((double)(num2 - num5) < scrollOffset)
					{
						num -= Math.Min(num4, (num2 - (int)scrollOffset) * rowCardCount);
						break;
					}
					num -= num4;
					num2 -= num5;
				}
				if (num2 == (int)scrollOffset)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (num3 != groupIndex || rowIndex != -1)
				{
					num--;
					num2--;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void FindGroupIndex(out int groupIndex, out int rowIndex)
		{
			rowIndex = -1;
			groupIndex = 0;
			int num = 0;
			while (num < NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex)
			{
				num++;
				GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[groupIndex];
				if (!val.Expanded)
				{
					for (int i = groupIndex + 1; i < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count && ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[i].Level - 1 == val.Level; i++)
					{
						groupIndex++;
					}
				}
				if (num == NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex)
				{
					if (val.Level == LastGroupLevel)
					{
						rowIndex = 0;
					}
					else
					{
						groupIndex++;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (!val.Expanded || val.Level != LastGroupLevel)
				{
					groupIndex++;
					continue;
				}
				if (num + val.ChildControllerRowCount > NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex)
				{
					rowIndex = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex - num;
					break;
				}
				num += val.ChildControllerRowCount;
				if (groupIndex == ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count - 1)
				{
					rowIndex = val.ChildControllerRowCount;
					break;
				}
				groupIndex++;
			}
		}

		internal double CalcExtent(double defineSize, int? visibleIndex = null)
		{
			defineSize -= GetRowOffset();
			if (base.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			if (!base.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
			{
				return visibleIndex.HasValue ? visibleIndex.Value : base.DataPresenter.ItemCount;
			}
			if (((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count == 0)
			{
				return CalcExtentUngrouped(defineSize, visibleIndex);
			}
			return CalcExtentGrouped(defineSize, visibleIndex);
		}

		private double CalcExtentGrouped(double defineSize, int? visibleIndex)
		{
			int num = (int)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset;
			int num2 = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			FindGroupIndex(out var groupIndex, out var rowIndex);
			if (visibleIndex.HasValue && visibleIndex < num2)
			{
				for (int num3 = groupIndex; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					GroupRowInfo val = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[num3];
					if (num2 == visibleIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (val.Expanded && val.Level == LastGroupLevel)
					{
						int num4 = val.ChildControllerRowCount;
						if (num3 == groupIndex)
						{
							num4 = ((rowIndex >= 0) ? rowIndex : 0);
						}
						if (num2 - visibleIndex <= num4)
						{
							num -= (int)Math.Ceiling((double)(num2 - visibleIndex.Value) / (double)rowCardCount);
							break;
						}
						num2 -= num4;
						num -= (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num4 / (double)rowCardCount);
					}
					if (num3 != groupIndex || rowIndex != -1)
					{
						num2--;
						num--;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < RowsInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				CardRowInfo cardRowInfo = RowsInfo[i];
				if (defineSize <= 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 += cardRowInfo.Elements.Count;
				if (visibleIndex < num2)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
				if (num2 >= base.DataPresenter.ItemCount)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (cardRowInfo.IsItemsContainer)
				{
					if (rowIndex != -1)
					{
						groupIndex++;
						rowIndex = -1;
					}
					if (groupIndex >= ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count)
					{
						return num;
					}
					GroupRowInfo val2 = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[groupIndex];
					if (!val2.Expanded)
					{
						for (int j = groupIndex + 1; j < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count && ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[j].Level - 1 == val2.Level; j++)
						{
							groupIndex++;
						}
					}
					if (val2.Level != LastGroupLevel || !val2.Expanded)
					{
						groupIndex++;
					}
					else
					{
						rowIndex = 0;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (rowIndex == -1)
					{
						rowIndex = 0;
					}
					rowIndex += cardRowInfo.Elements.Count;
				}
				defineSize -= base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(cardRowInfo.RenderSize);
			}
			for (int k = groupIndex; k < ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo).Count; k++)
			{
				GroupRowInfo val3 = ((Collection<GroupRowInfo>)(object)GroupInfo)[k];
				if (val3.ParentGroup != null && !val3.ParentGroup.Expanded)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (k > groupIndex || rowIndex == -1)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (val3.Expanded && val3.Level == LastGroupLevel)
				{
					int num5 = val3.ChildControllerRowCount;
					if (k == groupIndex && rowIndex > 0)
					{
						num5 -= rowIndex;
					}
					int num6 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)num5 / (double)rowCardCount);
					num += num6;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double CalcExtentUngrouped(double defineSize, int? visibleIndex)
		{
			int num = (int)base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset;
			int num2 = NodeContainer.StartScrollIndex;
			if (visibleIndex.HasValue && visibleIndex < num2)
			{
				return (double)num - Math.Ceiling((double)(num2 - visibleIndex.Value) / (double)rowCardCount);
			}
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in RowsInfo)
			{
				if (defineSize <= 0.0)
				{
					break;
				}
				num2 += item.Elements.Count;
				if (visibleIndex.HasValue && num2 - 1 >= visibleIndex.Value)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
				defineSize -= base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
			}
			int num3 = (visibleIndex.HasValue ? visibleIndex.Value : base.DataPresenter.ItemCount);
			return Math.Ceiling((double)num + (double)(num3 - num2) / (double)rowCardCount);
		}

		protected override void CalcViewportCore(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (ScrollOutOfBounds())
			{
				return;
			}
			base.Viewport = 0.0;
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = 0;
			double num3 = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize);
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in RowsInfo)
			{
				double num4 = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
				if (item == GetRowInfo())
				{
					num4 += GetRowOffset();
				}
				double defineSize = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size);
				double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(num4 / defineSize, num3 / defineSize));
				if (num5 == 1.0 || base.AllowPerPixelScrolling)
				{
					base.Viewport += num5 * (double)(base.AllowPerPixelScrolling ? 1 : item.Elements.Count);
				}
				if (num5 == 1.0)
				{
					base.FullyVisibleItemsCount += item.Elements.Count;
				}
				if (!item.IsItemsContainer && num3 >= 0.0)
				{
					foreach (IItem element in item.Elements)
					{
						num2++;
						num += base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(element.Element.DesiredSize) + base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(CardMarginCached);
					}
				}
				num3 -= num4;
			}
			rowCardCount = Math.Min(Math.Max(1, (int)Math.Floor(base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize) / num * (double)num2)), MaxCardCountInRow);
			base.Viewport = Math.Round(base.Viewport, 4);
			Extent = CalcExtent(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize));
		}

		private List<CardRowInfo> MeasureItemsContainer(double offset, System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer, int level)
		{
			List<CardRowInfo> list = new List<CardRowInfo>();
			double maxSecondarySize = 0.0;
			double defineSize = 0.0;
			double maxDefineSize = 0.0;
			double secondarySize = 0.0;
			foreach (IItem sortedChildrenElement in GetSortedChildrenElements(itemsContainer))
			{
				bool flag = MeasureItem(sortedChildrenElement, availableSize, (list.Count > 0) ? list.Last().Elements.Count : 0, ref defineSize, ref secondarySize, ref maxDefineSize, ref maxSecondarySize);
				if (flag && !sortedChildrenElement.IsItemsContainer && list.Count != 0)
				{
					defineSize += SeparatorThickness;
				}
				if (sortedChildrenElement.IsRowVisible)
				{
					CardRowInfo orCreateCurrentRowInfo = GetOrCreateCurrentRowInfo(flag, level, sortedChildrenElement.IsItemsContainer, list);
					orCreateCurrentRowInfo.Elements.Add(sortedChildrenElement);
					UpdateRowInfo(orCreateCurrentRowInfo, maxDefineSize, secondarySize);
				}
				else
				{
					hiddenItems.Add(sortedChildrenElement.Element);
				}
				list.AddRange(MeasureItemsContainer(defineSize + offset, GetContainerSize(availableSize, defineSize), sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer, level + 1));
				defineSize += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer.DesiredSize);
				double secondarySize2 = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer.DesiredSize);
				if (secondarySize2 != 0.0)
				{
					maxSecondarySize = Math.Max(maxSecondarySize, secondarySize2 + ContainerIndent);
				}
			}
			defineSize += maxDefineSize;
			itemsContainer.RenderSize = base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(defineSize, maxSecondarySize);
			double num = Math.Ceiling(defineSize * itemsContainer.AnimationProgress);
			itemsContainer.DesiredSize = base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(num, maxSecondarySize);
			UpdateRowInfoSize(list, num);
			return list;
		}

		private bool MeasureItem(IItem item, System.Windows.Size availableSize, int currentRowCount, ref double defineSize, ref double secondarySize, ref double maxDefineSize, ref double maxSecondarySize)
		{
			item.Element.Measure(GetMeasureSize(item));
			if (!item.IsRowVisible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double num = GetDefineSize(item);
			double num2 = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(item.Element.DesiredSize);
			if (!item.IsItemsContainer)
			{
				num += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(CardMarginCached);
				num2 += base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(CardMarginCached);
			}
			bool flag = item.IsItemsContainer || num2 + secondarySize > base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize) || currentRowCount == MaxCardCountInRow;
			if (flag)
			{
				secondarySize = num2;
				defineSize += maxDefineSize;
				maxDefineSize = num;
			}
			else
			{
				secondarySize += num2;
				maxDefineSize = Math.Max(maxDefineSize, num);
			}
			maxSecondarySize = Math.Max(maxSecondarySize, secondarySize);
			return flag;
		}

		private CardRowInfo GetOrCreateCurrentRowInfo(bool newRow, int level, bool isItemsContainer, List<CardRowInfo> rows)
		{
			if (newRow || rows.Count == 0)
			{
				if (rows.Count != 0)
				{
					CardRowInfo cardRowInfo = rows.Last();
					if (cardRowInfo.Level == level && !cardRowInfo.IsItemsContainer)
					{
						cardRowInfo.HasSeparator = true;
						UpdateRowInfo(cardRowInfo, base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(cardRowInfo.Size) + SeparatorThickness, base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(cardRowInfo.Size));
					}
				}
				CardRowInfo cardRowInfo2 = new CardRowInfo
				{
					Elements = new List<IItem>(),
					Level = level,
					IsItemsContainer = isItemsContainer,
					HasSeparator = false
				};
				rows.Add(cardRowInfo2);
				return cardRowInfo2;
			}
			return rows.Last();
		}

		private void UpdateRowInfo(CardRowInfo rowInfo, double maxDefineSize, double secondarySize)
		{
			rowInfo.Size = base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(maxDefineSize, secondarySize);
			rowInfo.RenderSize = rowInfo.Size;
		}

		private void UpdateRowInfoSize(List<CardRowInfo> info, double availableSize)
		{
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in info)
			{
				item.RenderSize = base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Min(base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize), availableSize), base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(item.RenderSize));
				availableSize -= base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
			}
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetMeasureSize(IItem item)
		{
			return base.SizeHelper.CreateSize((item.IsItemsContainer || double.IsNaN(FixedSize)) ? double.PositiveInfinity : FixedSize, double.PositiveInfinity);
		}

		private double GetDefineSize(IItem item)
		{
			if (item.IsItemsContainer || double.IsNaN(FixedSize))
			{
				return base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Element.DesiredSize);
			}
			return FixedSize;
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetContainerSize(System.Windows.Size availableSize, double defineSize)
		{
			return base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Max(0.0, base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize) - defineSize), Math.Max(0.0, base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize) - ContainerIndent));
		}

		private CardRowInfo GetRowInfo()
		{
			return RowsInfo.First();
		}

		internal double GetRowOffset()
		{
			if (RowsInfo == null || RowsInfo.Count == 0 || base.DataPresenter == null)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return Math.Round((Math.Floor(base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset) - base.DataPresenter.ActualScrollOffset) * base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetRowInfo().Size));
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeItemsContainer(double offset, System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer, int level)
		{
			UpdateSeparatorInfo(availableSize);
			if (itemsContainer == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			double num = offset;
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in RowsInfo)
			{
				if (base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize) > 0.0)
				{
					num = offset;
				}
				double num2 = GetArrangeSecondaryOffset(item, availableSize);
				foreach (IItem element in item.Elements)
				{
					System.Windows.Point location = base.SizeHelper.CreatePoint(num + GetRowOffset(), num2);
					double num3 = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
					if (!element.IsItemsContainer)
					{
						location.Offset(CardMargin.Left, CardMargin.Top);
						num3 = Math.Max(0.0, num3 - base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(new System.Windows.Size(CardMargin.Left, CardMargin.Top)));
						if (item.HasSeparator)
						{
							num3 = Math.Max(0.0, num3 - Math.Min(SeparatorThickness, SeparatorThickness + base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size) - base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize)));
						}
						double defineSize = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(new System.Windows.Size(CardMargin.Right, CardMargin.Bottom));
						double num4 = base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size) - base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
						num3 = Math.Max(0.0, num3 - Math.Max(0.0, defineSize - num4));
					}
					double secondarySize = GetSecondarySize(element, availableSize, item);
					System.Windows.Size size = base.SizeHelper.CreateSize(num3, secondarySize);
					ArrangeItem(element, new Rect(location, size), base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(size) > 0.0, item.Level);
					num2 += secondarySize;
					if (!element.IsItemsContainer)
					{
						num2 += base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(CardMarginCached);
					}
				}
				offset += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize);
				num += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size);
			}
			foreach (FrameworkElement hiddenItem in hiddenItems)
			{
				hiddenItem.Arrange(new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(double.MinValue, double.MinValue), hiddenItem.DesiredSize));
			}
			return itemsContainer.DesiredSize;
		}

		private double GetSecondarySize(IItem item, System.Windows.Size availableSize, CardRowInfo rowInfo)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			double num = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize) - (double)rowInfo.Level * ContainerIndent;
			if (item.IsItemsContainer)
			{
				return num;
			}
			double num2 = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(item.Element.DesiredSize);
			if ((int)CardAlignment == 3)
			{
				num2 += (num - base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(rowInfo.Size)) / (double)rowInfo.Elements.Count;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private double GetArrangeSecondaryOffset(CardRowInfo rowInfo, System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0083: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0089: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			double num = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize);
			double num2 = 0.0;
			if (base.Orientation == Orientation.Vertical)
			{
				num2 += ContainerIndent * (double)rowInfo.Level;
			}
			else
			{
				num -= ContainerIndent * (double)rowInfo.Level;
			}
			if (rowInfo.IsItemsContainer)
			{
				return num2;
			}
			double num3 = num - base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(rowInfo.Size) - num2;
			if ((int)CardAlignment == 1)
			{
				num2 += Math.Floor(num3 / 2.0);
			}
			else if ((int)CardAlignment == 2)
			{
				num2 += num3;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		private void UpdateSeparatorInfo(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (SeparatorInfo == null)
			{
				SeparatorInfo = new ObservableCollection<SeparatorInfo>();
			}
			int num = 0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (CardRowInfo item in RowsInfo)
			{
				if (item.IsItemsContainer || !item.HasSeparator)
				{
					num2 += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size);
					continue;
				}
				if (SeparatorInfo.Count == num)
				{
					SeparatorInfo.Add(new SeparatorInfo
					{
						RowIndex = num + 1
					});
				}
				SeparatorInfo separatorInfo = SeparatorInfo[num];
				separatorInfo.Orientation = base.Orientation;
				separatorInfo.Length = base.SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize) - (double)item.Level * ContainerIndent;
				num2 += base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size) - SeparatorThickness;
				System.Windows.Point point = base.SizeHelper.CreatePoint(num2 + GetRowOffset(), 0.0);
				separatorInfo.Margin = new Thickness(point.X, point.Y, 0.0, 0.0);
				separatorInfo.IsVisible = SeparatorThickness - base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Size) + base.SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.RenderSize) >= 0.0;
				num2 += SeparatorThickness;
				num++;
			}
			for (int i = num; i < SeparatorInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				SeparatorInfo[i].IsVisible = false;
			}
		}
	}

			get

					return DataPresenterCore.View.ActualAllowCellMerge;
				}
				return false;

		public double FixedTopRowsHeight { get; private set; }

			get

				if (DataPresenterCore == null || DataPresenterCore.View == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return DataPresenterCore.View.ViewBehavior.AllowPerPixelScrolling;
			}
		}

		internal static double GetScrollElementOffset(IItem item, double scrollOffset)
		{
			double num = item.Element.DesiredSize.Height;
			if (item.AdditionalElement != null)
			{
				num = Math.Max(num, item.AdditionalElement.DesiredSize.Height);
			}
			return 0.0 - DXArranger.Round(num * scrollOffset, 0);
		}

		static HierarchyPanel()
		{
			ItemsContainerProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ItemsContainer", typeof(IRootItemsContainer), typeof(HierarchyPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((HierarchyPanel)d).OnItemsContainerChanged((IRootItemsContainer)e.OldValue);
			}));
			OrientationProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("Orientation", typeof(Orientation), typeof(HierarchyPanel), new PropertyMetadata(Orientation.Vertical, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((HierarchyPanel)d).OnOrientationChanged();
			}));
			IsItemVisiblePropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterAttachedReadOnly("IsItemVisible", typeof(bool), typeof(HierarchyPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(true));
			IsItemVisibleProperty = IsItemVisiblePropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			FixedElementsPropertyKey = DependencyPropertyManager.RegisterReadOnly("FixedElements", typeof(IList<FrameworkElement>), typeof(HierarchyPanel), (PropertyMetadata)new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(null));
			FixedElementsProperty = FixedElementsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty;
			DataPresenterProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("DataPresenter", typeof(DataPresenterBase), typeof(HierarchyPanel), new PropertyMetadata(null, delegate(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
			{
				((HierarchyPanel)d).OnDataPresenterChanged((DataPresenterBase)e.OldValue);
			}));
		}

			element.SetValue(IsItemVisiblePropertyKey, value);

		private void AddToHierarchy(IItem item, int level)
		{
			List<IItem> value = null;
			if (!hierarchy.TryGetValue(level, out value))
			{
				value = new List<IItem>();
				hierarchy[level] = value;
			}
			value.Add(item);
		}

		private void AssignZIndex()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (int item in hierarchy.Keys.OrderByDescending((int x) => x))
			{
				List<IItem> list = hierarchy[item];
				if (HasFixedRows)
				{
					list = list.OrderBy((IItem x) => x.FixedRowPosition).ToList();
				}
				foreach (IItem item2 in list)
				{
					Panel.SetZIndex(item2.Element, num++);
					if (item2.AdditionalElement != null)
					{
						Panel.SetZIndex(item2.AdditionalElement, num++);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size ArrangeOverride(System.Windows.Size finalSize)
		{
			DataPresenter.With((DataPresenterBase x) => x.View).Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.OnBeginArrangeRows();
			});
			fixedElements = new List<FrameworkElement>();
			hierarchy = new Dictionary<int, List<IItem>>();
			FixedTopRowsHeight = 0.0;
			FixedBottomRowsHeight = 0.0;
			ArrangeItemsContainer(0.0, finalSize, ItemsContainer, 0);
			FixedElements = fixedElements;
			AssignZIndex();
			DataPresenter.With((DataPresenterBase x) => x.View).Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.OnEndArrangeRows();
			});
			return finalSize;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size ArrangeItemsContainer(double offset, System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer, int level)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = ((itemsContainer != null) ? (SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(itemsContainer.RenderSize) * itemsContainer.AnimationProgress) : 0.0);
			IList<IItem> sortedChildrenElements = GetSortedChildrenElements(itemsContainer);
			foreach (IItem item in sortedChildrenElements)
			{
				if (item.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Top)
				{
					FixedTopRowsHeight += SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Element.DesiredSize);
				}
				if (item.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					FixedBottomRowsHeight += SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item.Element.DesiredSize);
				}
			}
			double num3 = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetAvailableSize(availableSize)) - FixedBottomRowsHeight;
			foreach (IItem item2 in sortedChildrenElements)
			{
				double num4 = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item2.Element.DesiredSize);
				if (item2.AdditionalElement != null)
				{
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(item2.AdditionalElement.DesiredSize));
				}
				double num5 = Math.Max(0.0, num4 + GetItemOffset(item2));
				if (item2.FixedRowPosition == FixedRowPosition.Bottom)
				{
					Rect rect = new Rect(SizeHelper.CreatePoint(num3, 0.0), SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(num5, num2 - num)), SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize)));
					ArrangeItem(item2, rect, num2 - num > 0.0, level);
					num3 += num5;
					continue;
				}
				double num6 = 0.0 - num;
				num6 = ((HasFixedRows && !HasCellMerging) ? (num6 + (SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(GetAvailableSize(availableSize)) - FixedBottomRowsHeight)) : (num6 + num2));
				num6 = Math.Min(num6, SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize));
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(SizeHelper.CreatePoint(num + offset, 0.0), SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Max(0.0, Math.Min(num5, num6)), SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize)));
				ArrangeItem(item2, rect2, num2 - num > 0.0, level);
				num += num5;
				num += SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(ArrangeItemsContainer(num + offset, SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Max(0.0, SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize) - num), SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize)), item2.ItemsContainer, level + 1));
			}
			return SizeHelper.CreateSize(num2, SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize));
		}

		protected void ArrangeItem(IItem item, Rect rect, bool isVisible, int level)
		{
			if (item.IsFixedItem)
			{
				fixedElements.Add(item.Element);
			}
			double scrollElementOffset = GetScrollElementOffset(item, (item == ItemsContainer.ScrollItem) ? ItemsContainer.ScrollItemOffset : 0.0);
			if (scrollElementOffset != 0.0)
			{
				item.Element.Clip = new RectangleGeometry
				{
					Rect = new Rect(new System.Windows.Point(0.0, 0.0 - scrollElementOffset), RectHelper.Size(rect))
				};
			}
			else if (item.Element.Clip != null)
			{
				item.Element.Clip = null;
			}
			rect.Y += scrollElementOffset;
			rect.Height -= scrollElementOffset;
			SetIsItemVisible((item as DependencyObject) ?? item.Element, isVisible);
			AddToHierarchy(item, level);
			if (item.AdditionalElement == null)
			{
				item.Element.Arrange(rect);
			}
			else
			{
				double gridAreaWidth = item.GridAreaWidth;
				item.Element.Arrange(new Rect(rect.X, rect.Y, Math.Min(rect.Width, Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaWidth)), rect.Height));
				item.AdditionalElement.Arrange(new Rect(Math.Max(0.0, gridAreaWidth + item.AdditionalElementOffset), rect.Y, Math.Min(rect.Width, item.AdditionalElementWidth), rect.Height));
			}
			DataPresenter.With((DataPresenterBase x) => x.View).Do(delegate(DataViewBase x)
			{
				x.OnArrangeRow(item, rect.Y, rect.Height);
			});
		}

		private System.Windows.Size GetAvailableSize(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			if (DataPresenter != null)
			{
				return DataPresenterCore.LastConstraint;
			}
			return availableSize;
		}

		protected override System.Windows.Size MeasureOverride(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			ValidateTree(ItemsContainer);
			System.Windows.Size result = DXArranger.Ceiling(MeasureItemsContainer(availableSize, ItemsContainer));
			CalcViewport(GetAvailableSize(availableSize));
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual System.Windows.Size MeasureItemsContainer(System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer)
		{
			availableSize = SizeHelper.CreateSize(double.PositiveInfinity, SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize));
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = 0.0;
			foreach (IItem sortedChildrenElement in GetSortedChildrenElements(itemsContainer))
			{
				sortedChildrenElement.Element.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Max(0.0, availableSize.Width - sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElementWidth - sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElementOffset), availableSize.Height));
				double num3 = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.Element.DesiredSize);
				if (sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElement != null)
				{
					sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElement.Measure(new System.Windows.Size(Math.Min(availableSize.Width, sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElementWidth), availableSize.Height));
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElement.DesiredSize));
				}
				num += Math.Max(0.0, num3 + GetItemOffset(sortedChildrenElement));
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, Math.Min(SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize), SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(sortedChildrenElement.Element.DesiredSize) + sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElementWidth + sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElementOffset));
				sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer.DesiredSize = MeasureItemsContainer(SizeHelper.CreateSize(SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize) - num, SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize)), sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer);
				num += SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer.DesiredSize);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer.DesiredSize));
			}
			if (itemsContainer == null)
			{
				return default(System.Windows.Size);
			}
			itemsContainer.RenderSize = SizeHelper.CreateSize(num, num2);
			return SizeHelper.CreateSize(num * itemsContainer.AnimationProgress, num2);
		}

		internal void CalcViewport(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			FullyVisibleItemsCount = 0;
			CalcViewportCore(availableSize);
			if (Viewport == 0.0)
			{
				Viewport = 1.0;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void CalcViewportCore(System.Windows.Size availableSize)
		{
			Viewport = 0.0;
			CalcViewport(availableSize, ItemsContainer);
		}

		private double CalcViewport(System.Windows.Size availableSize, IItemsContainer itemsContainer)
		{
			double num = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(availableSize);
			foreach (IItem sortedChildrenElement in GetSortedChildrenElements(itemsContainer))
			{
				double num2 = SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.Element.DesiredSize);
				if (sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElement != null)
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(num2, SizeHelper.GetDefineSize(sortedChildrenElement.AdditionalElement.DesiredSize));
				}
				if (sortedChildrenElement.FixedRowPosition != FixedRowPosition.None)
				{
					num -= num2;
					continue;
				}
				double itemOffset = GetItemOffset(sortedChildrenElement);
				double num3 = Math.Min(num2 + itemOffset, Math.Max(0.0, num)) / num2;
				num -= num2 + itemOffset;
				if (num2 != 0.0)
				{
					if (num3 == 1.0 || AllowPerPixelScrolling)
					{
						Viewport += num3;
					}
					if (num3 == 1.0)
					{
						FullyVisibleItemsCount++;
					}
				}
				num = CalcViewport(SizeHelper.CreateSize(Math.Max(0.0, num), SizeHelper.GetSecondarySize(availableSize)), sortedChildrenElement.ItemsContainer);
			}
			return num;
		}

		private double GetItemOffset(IItem item)
		{
			return GetScrollElementOffset(item, (item == ItemsContainer.ScrollItem) ? ItemsContainer.ScrollItemOffset : 0.0);
		}

		protected IList<IItem> GetSortedChildrenElements(IItemsContainer itemsContainer)
		{
			if (itemsContainer == null)
			{
				return new IItem[0];
			}
			return OrderPanelBase.GetSortedElements<IItem>((ICollection)new SimpleBridgeList<IItem, IItem>(itemsContainer.Items, (Func<IItem, IItem>)((IItem item) => item), (Func<IItem, IItem>)null), true, (Func<IItem, int>)((IItem item) => ((ISupportVisibleIndex)item).VisibleIndex));
		}

		private void OnItemsContainerChanged(IRootItemsContainer oldValue)
		{
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.HierarchyChanged -= ItemsContainer_HierarchyChanged;
			}
			if (ItemsContainer != null)
			{
				ItemsContainer.HierarchyChanged += ItemsContainer_HierarchyChanged;
			}
			base.Children.Clear();
			cache.Clear();
			ClearFixedElements();
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnDataPresenterChanged(DataPresenterBase oldValue)
		{
			DataPresenterCore = DataPresenter;
			if (oldValue != null)
			{
				oldValue.Panel = null;
			}
			if (DataPresenterCore != null)
			{
				DataPresenterCore.Panel = this;
			}
		}

		private void ClearFixedElements()
		{
			FixedElements = null;
		}

		private void ItemsContainer_HierarchyChanged(object sender, HierarchyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeType == HierarchyChangeType.ItemRemoved)
			{
				e.Item.Element.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
			}
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		private void OnOrientationChanged()
		{
			InvalidateMeasure();
		}

		protected void ValidateTree(IItemsContainer itemsContainer)
		{
			if (itemsContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (IItem item in itemsContainer.Items)
			{
				if (!cache.ContainsKey(item))
				{
					DetachItem(item);
					base.Children.Add(item.Element);
					if (item.AdditionalElement != null)
					{
						base.Children.Add(item.AdditionalElement);
					}
					cache.Add(item, null);
				}
				OrderPanelBase.UpdateChildVisibility((UIElement)item.Element, true, ((ISupportVisibleIndex)item).VisibleIndex);
				if (item.AdditionalElement != null)
				{
					OrderPanelBase.UpdateChildVisibility((UIElement)item.AdditionalElement, true, ((ISupportVisibleIndex)item).VisibleIndex);
				}
				ValidateTree(item.ItemsContainer);
			}
		}

		internal static void DetachItem(IItem item)
		{
			HierarchyPanel hierarchyPanel = (HierarchyPanel)VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(item.Element);
			if (hierarchyPanel != null)
			{
				hierarchyPanel.Children.Remove(item.Element);
				if (item.AdditionalElement != null)
				{
					hierarchyPanel.Children.Remove(item.AdditionalElement);
				}
				hierarchyPanel.cache.Remove(item);
				hierarchyPanel.ClearFixedElements();
			}
		}
	}
